title: ChestPheNoT: Deployable, Auditable Label-Status-Evidence Extraction from Radiology Reports
summary: Structured phenotype extraction from radiology reports supports cohort construction, quality auditing, and clinical analytics, but practical deployment requires local inference and auditable predictions, while expert annotations remain scarce. Conventional labelers provide structured findings and assertion states but no supporting evidence, while API-hosted large language models may be unsuitable when clinical text cannot leave institutional infrastructure. We present CHESTPHENOT, a compact 0.5-3B language model that jointly extracts finding labels, three-class status (present/absent/uncertain), and verbatim supporting evidence spans. CHESTPHENOT is trained using hybrid CheXbert+72B silver supervision followed by supervised fine-tuning and lightweight GRPO refinement. Across three human-annotated gold sets spanning in-distribution, cross-taxonomy, and cross-institution evaluation, the 3B model remains below its CheXbert silver teacher in distribution but is competitive under distribution shift, significantly surpassing CheXbert on cross-institution detection (+2.0 F1). Task-specific training also enables the 3B model to match or exceed substantially larger prompted models on most detection and status comparisons. For evidence-grounded extraction, over 99% of final evidence spans are locatable in the source report, and the 3B model achieves 47.5 auditable-F1, outperforming Qwen2.5-7B one-shot prompting by 7.6 points and approaching Qwen2.5-72B. These results demonstrate that locally deployable models can provide competitive and directly auditable radiology-report extraction without relying on external inference APIs. Code and the full extraction/judge prompts will be made available at https://github.com/yukkai/ChestPheNoT.

AI.tldr: 提出CHESTPHENOT，一个0.5–3B的紧凑语言模型，可从放射学报告中联合抽取发现标签、三分类状态（存在/缺失/不确定）及原文证据片段，支持本地部署与可审计预测。
AI.motivation: 结构化表型抽取对队列构建、质量审计和临床分析很重要，但实际部署需要本地推理和可审计预测，且专家标注稀缺；传统标注器不提供证据，而API托管大模型在临床文本不能离开机构时可能不适用。
AI.method: 使用CheXbert与72B模型生成的混合银标监督进行训练，随后进行有监督微调，并用轻量GRPO优化；模型规模为0.5–3B，联合输出发现标签、三分类状态和逐字证据跨度。
AI.result: 在三个人类标注金标准集上评估，3B模型在分布内低于CheXbert银标教师，但在分布偏移下具有竞争力，跨机构检测显著超过CheXbert（+2.0 F1）；在多数检测和状态比较中匹配或超过更大提示模型；最终证据跨度超过99%可在源报告中定位，3B模型达到47.5 auditable-F1，比Qwen2.5-7B one-shot高7.6分并接近Qwen2.5-72B。
AI.conclusion: 本地可部署模型无需依赖外部推理API，即可提供有竞争力且可直接审计的放射学报告抽取。

title: Beyond Isolated Entities: Relation-Aware Multi-Entity Modeling for Unsupervised Video Anomaly Detection
comment: The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/ppworkhard/INTERACT
summary: Video anomaly detection for patrol robots and surveillance systems must recognize abnormal interactions among familiar entities. Existing pixel-reconstruction and isolated-entity methods may fail when individual entities appear normal but their spatial or motion relations are abnormal. This work presents Interaction-Centric Network for Temporal Entity-Relation Analysis and Consistency Testing (INTERACT), a framework for unsupervised video anomaly detection. Person-Object Appearance-Motion Interaction (POAMI) moves beyond isolated-entity encoding by jointly modeling the appearance, motion, and spatial configurations of persons and objects in each frame. The resulting representations capture both individual entity states and their cross-entity context. Based on these representations, Target Geometry-Guided Relational Interaction Prediction (TGRIP) predicts target entity interaction states from historical relational memory and target-frame geometry without explicit identity tracking. Motion-Interaction Reconstruction and Alignment (MIRA) then evaluates these predictions through conditional flow reconstruction and semantic consistency checking, providing complementary anomaly evidence beyond prediction error alone. INTERACT achieves state-of-the-art performance, obtaining a frame-level AUC of 84.5% on the ShanghaiTech benchmark. Ablation studies show that removing cross-entity attention causes the largest performance drop, demonstrating the necessity of relational modeling. INTERACT is particularly effective for anomalies caused by changes in relations among people and objects, while maintaining competitive performance in general scenarios. The source code will be made publicly available at https://github.com/ppworkhard/INTERACT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 INTERACT，一个面向无监督视频异常检测的交互中心框架，通过建模人与物体之间的外观、运动与空间关系来识别异常交互。
AI.motivation: 现有基于像素重建或孤立实体建模的方法，在单个实体看似正常但实体间空间或运动关系异常时容易失效。
AI.method: INTERACT 包含三个模块：POAMI 联合建模每帧中人与物体的外观、运动和空间配置；TGRIP 基于历史关系记忆和目标帧几何预测目标实体交互状态，无需显式身份跟踪；MIRA 通过条件流重建和语义一致性检查评估预测，提供互补的异常证据。
AI.result: INTERACT 在 ShanghaiTech 基准上达到 84.5% 的帧级 AUC，取得最优性能；消融实验表明移除跨实体注意力导致最大性能下降，证明关系建模的必要性。
AI.conclusion: INTERACT 对人与人、人与物体关系变化引起的异常特别有效，同时在一般场景中保持竞争力，说明交互关系建模对视频异常检测至关重要。

title: Beyond Sparsity: Weight Location and Network Context in Pruned MRI Reconstruction
summary: Pruning reduces the number of weights in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) reconstruction networks. Equal sparsity, however, can retain weights with different computational roles and different compatibility with the trained network. We study these effects across 120 convolutional U-Net and vision transformer models using controlled edits evaluated before retraining. In U-Net, preserving high-resolution computation improves reconstruction at equal deletion counts across all tested sparsity levels. Equal-operation controls reveal additional sensitivity of the first convolution, which operation count alone cannot explain. In transformers, retained pretrained weight energy correlates with quality within sparsity levels, yet the same masks reverse their reconstruction ranking when the surrounding trained weights change. At 90\% sparsity, matching intermediate output scales largely removes a high-energy-mask penalty while retaining an advantage for the network's original mask. Thus sparsity alone does not characterize reconstruction quality: architecture-specific descriptors are informative, but mask quality can still depend on the surrounding trained network.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过120个卷积U-Net和视觉Transformer模型，在重训练前进行受控编辑，探讨剪枝后同等稀疏度下保留权重角色与网络兼容性对MRI重建质量的影响。
AI.motivation: 剪枝虽能减少MRI重建网络权重，但相同稀疏度可能保留计算角色不同、与训练网络兼容性不同的权重，因此仅用稀疏度不足以刻画重建质量。
AI.method: 在120个卷积U-Net和视觉Transformer模型上，使用重训练前的受控编辑进行评估；比较同等删除数量、同等操作数、保留预训练权重能量、匹配中间输出尺度等条件。
AI.result: U-Net中，保留高分辨率计算在各稀疏度下均改善重建；同等操作数控制显示第一层卷积存在额外敏感性。Transformer中，保留预训练权重能量与稀疏度内质量相关，但同一掩码在周围训练权重变化时重建排名反转；90%稀疏度下，匹配中间输出尺度可大幅消除高能量掩码惩罚，同时保留原网络掩码优势。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏度本身不能表征重建质量；架构特定描述子有信息量，但掩码质量仍可能依赖周围已训练网络。

title: MammoClaw: Towards Skill-Evolving Agent Harness for Breast Cancer Mammography Analysis
comment: Accepted at Deep Breast Imaging Workshop, MICCAI 2026
summary: In this work, we explore MammoClaw, a training-free agent framework that leverages frozen MLLMs for mammography analysis. To support agentic investigation, we equip the agent with lightweight mammography-specific tools for targeted image analysis, including ROI, paired-view, and contralateral-breast examination. MammoClaw iteratively gathers evidence through these tools, while skill evolution enables non-parametric adaptation by transforming failed trajectories into reusable guidance for later runs. We evaluate the framework on BI-RADS assessment and breast density estimation tasks. In our experiments, we find that tools alone do not reliably improve performance, whereas evolved skills can improve tool-use behavior and performance in some settings. Beyond these results, MammoClaw enables transparent inspection of evidence acquisition, tool interactions, and failure modes, facilitating the analysis and auditing of agent behavior. We view this work as an exploratory study of training-free, self-evolving agentic approaches for mammography and hope it provides a concrete starting point for future work on mammography-specific tools and self-evolution mechanisms. We release our code at https://krishnakanthnakka.github.io/mammoclaw.

AI.tldr: 提出MammoClaw，一个无需训练的智能体框架，利用冻结的多模态大模型进行乳腺X线摄影分析，通过轻量级工具迭代收集证据，并支持技能进化。
AI.motivation: 探索无需训练、自进化的智能体方法在乳腺影像分析中的应用，并实现对证据收集、工具交互和失败模式的透明检查与审计。
AI.method: 使用冻结的MLLM，配备乳腺专用工具（ROI、配对视图、对侧乳腺检查），迭代收集证据；技能进化将失败轨迹转化为可复用指导，实现非参数化适应。
AI.result: 在BI-RADS评估和乳腺密度估计任务中，单独工具不能可靠提升性能；进化技能在某些设置下能改善工具使用行为和性能；框架支持对智能体行为的透明检查。
AI.conclusion: 作为一项探索性研究，为乳腺专用工具和自进化机制的未来工作提供了具体起点，并发布了代码。

title: What Stops Recursive Self-Improvement in Robotics? Lessons from 123 Rounds of Agentic Skill Discovery
summary: Can a robot improve itself the way coding agents now improve software? We built an agentic system to find out. It watches a robot fail, works out which capability is missing, writes new skills or finds and installs external models, tests every change in simulation, and repeats, with no human writing robot code. We ran it for 123 improvement rounds on household manipulation tasks. This report describes what we learned. The good news is that the agent can discover capabilities on its own: noticing that its targets were out of view, it asked for an active-viewing model, debugged it, and deployed a working search skill. The bad news is that its improvements did not add up. Changes kept passing their tests, yet the target task, putting condiments on the top shelf of a fridge, never succeeded. We found that the agent was rarely the bottleneck. Three things around it were. First, chained perception modules do not understand relations. Segmenters such as SAM 3 find shelves but not "the top shelf", so the agent filled the gap with ever more geometric rules that never converged, when what it needed was a different kind of model. Second, skill chains lock learning onto the first step. Long tasks mostly fail early, so evidence and fixes pile up there, and later skills are rarely reached, tested, or improved. Third, what the agent learns is decided by the harness. The agent optimized exactly what the evaluator measured, including where it was wrong, and weak tests and misleading memory turned activity into a standstill. We distill these lessons into concrete recommendations for building robot systems that improve themselves, each paired with an experiment that could prove it wrong.

AI.tldr: 论文构建了一个机器人自我改进的智能体系统，在123轮家庭操作任务中测试其能否像编码智能体改进软件一样改进机器人。系统能自主发现并部署新能力，但改进无法累积，目标任务最终失败，问题主要不在智能体本身，而在感知、技能链和执行框架。
AI.motivation: 探索机器人能否通过智能体系统自主改进自身，无需人类编写机器人代码，从而像编码智能体改进软件那样持续提升机器人能力。
AI.method: 构建端到端智能体系统：观察机器人失败、诊断缺失能力、编写新技能或寻找并安装外部模型、在仿真中测试每次改动，并循环迭代；在家庭操作任务上运行123轮改进。
AI.result: 系统能自主发现能力需求，例如发现目标不在视野后请求主动观察模型、调试并部署搜索技能；但改进无法累积，测试不断通过而目标任务“把调料放到冰箱顶层货架”始终未成功。瓶颈有三：链式感知模块不理解关系（如SAM 3找到货架但不能识别“顶层货架”）；技能链使学习锁定在早期步骤，长任务早期失败导致后续技能很少被测试和改进；执行框架决定学习内容，智能体优化评估器所测指标，弱测试和误导性记忆使活动陷入停滞。
AI.conclusion: 机器人自我改进的关键限制通常不在智能体，而在感知关系理解、技能链学习和评估/记忆框架。论文据此提出构建可自我改进机器人系统的具体建议，并为每条建议配对一个可证伪实验。

title: An Exact Lyapunov Characterization of Regional Rate Performance for Rational Stability
summary: Rational stability is a quantitative stability notion for nonlinear ordinary differential equations (ODEs), under which convergence is characterized by a rationally-in-time decaying bound on solutions. Although Lyapunov characterizations of rational stability have been proposed, no existing condition has been shown to exactly characterize rational rate performance. The paper resolves this issue by providing an exact converse Lyapunov characterization of regional rational stability with prescribed rate performance. To test the resulting converse Lyapunov conditions numerically, a tiered set of convex relaxations is proposed which can be enforced using Sum-of-Squares (SOS) programming. A conjectured conservatism scaling factor in rate performance is associated with each tier and validated numerically. The first proposed tier appears to be novel and is shown to outperform classical SOS-based approaches. Numerical examples are used to validate the results and compute nested regions of state-space on which prescribed levels of performance can be guaranteed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非线性常微分方程的有理稳定性，给出了具有指定速率性能的区域有理稳定性的精确逆Lyapunov刻画，并通过Sum-of-Squares凸松弛进行数值验证。
AI.motivation: 现有Lyapunov刻画无法精确表征有理稳定性的速率性能，缺乏能精确对应有理衰减速率的条件。
AI.method: 建立精确的逆Lyapunov条件；提出分层凸松弛，并用Sum-of-Squares (SOS)编程实现；为每一层引入保守性缩放因子猜想并进行数值验证。
AI.result: 第一层松弛方法具有新颖性，且优于经典SOS方法；数值例子验证了理论结果，并计算出可保证指定性能水平的嵌套状态空间区域；各层保守性缩放因子得到数值验证。
AI.conclusion: 该工作填补了有理稳定性精确Lyapunov刻画方面的空白，并提供了有效的SOS数值工具来验证性能保证。

title: PalmLeaf-VQA: A Multi-Script Visual Question Answering Benchmark for Historical Palm-Leaf Manuscript Understanding Across Diverse Regions
summary: Historical manuscripts remain largely absent from modern vision-language benchmarks, leaving open how well multimodal large language models (MLLMs) handle culturally diverse, degraded, and non-Latin document images. We introduce \textbf{PalmLeaf-VQA}, a multi-script visual question answering benchmark for historical palm-leaf manuscript understanding across South and Southeast Asian traditions. PalmLeaf-VQA contains \textbf{923 curated manuscript images} and \textbf{7,384 question--answer pairs} from eight collection groups: Balinese, Grantha, Jathakam, Kambaramayanam, Kannada, Khmer, Sundanese, and Tamil. Unlike recognition-oriented resources, the benchmark targets manuscript-aware visual reasoning over preservation-relevant cues, including physical condition, line structure, material and coating, binding holes, margins, symbols, drawings, and localized visual artifacts. We evaluate recent proprietary and open-weight MLLMs under open-answer and constrained-answer prompting and provide fine-grained analysis across collections, question categories, and task types. The strongest evaluated model reaches only \textbf{58.00\% exact-match accuracy} on the held-out test split, revealing substantial limitations in current MLLMs for rare-script, degraded-layout, and preservation-oriented document understanding. PalmLeaf-VQA provides a standardized benchmark for advancing culturally grounded and layout-aware multimodal document analysis.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出PalmLeaf-VQA，一个面向南亚与东南亚历史贝叶手稿的多文字视觉问答基准，包含923张手稿图像和7,384个问答对，用于评估多模态大模型在文化多样、退化及非拉丁文档上的理解能力。
AI.motivation: 现代视觉-语言基准中很少包含历史手稿，导致尚不清楚多模态大模型如何处理文化多样、图像退化且非拉丁文字的历史文档图像，因此需要针对手稿保护相关线索构建标准化评测资源。
AI.method: 构建PalmLeaf-VQA基准，涵盖八组收藏：Balinese、Grantha、Jathakam、Kambaramayanam、Kannada、Khmer、Sundanese和Tamil；任务聚焦手稿感知的视觉推理，包括物理状况、行结构、材料与涂层、装订孔、页边距、符号、绘图及局部视觉伪影；在开放答案和受限答案提示下评测近期闭源与开源多模态大模型，并按收藏、问题类别和任务类型进行细粒度分析。
AI.result: 基准包含923张精选手稿图像和7,384个问答对；最强评测模型在留出测试集上仅达到58.00%的精确匹配准确率，表明当前多模态大模型在稀有文字、退化版面和保护导向文档理解方面存在显著局限。
AI.conclusion: PalmLeaf-VQA为推进文化根基深厚且版式感知的多模态文档分析提供了标准化基准，有助于推动稀有文字、退化版面及保护导向的手稿理解研究。

title: SMARtCARE: Privacy-Preserving Agentic AI Systems for Bounded-Autonomy Clinical Decision Support
comment: Paper accepted to, and to appear in, the 2026 IEEE HealthCom Conference
summary: Long-context clinical AI systems can miss relevant patient history when prior admissions fall outside the active reasoning context. In ICU monitoring, this can cause early vital-sign drift to appear nonspecific even when it resembles a prior deterioration pattern. SMARtCARE addresses this gap through a four-state clinical decision-support architecture: Stable, Meta-cognitive, Assisted, and Regulated (Revoked). Rather than automatically retrieving prior records, SMARtCARE uses a lossy six-channel fingerprint of the patient's prior trajectory. When current drift matches that fingerprint and the prior record is absent from context, the system raises a Meta-cognitive escalation for clinician review; full retrieval occurs only through clinician action in the Assisted state. A patient-identity guard is designed to enforce correct attribution across data loading, logging, and audit layers. Evaluation combines a synthetic Monte Carlo study that validates the state-transition logic and estimator stability, not clinical performance, with real-data runs on both the MIMIC-III and MIMIC-IV Clinical Database Demos. On MIMIC-III, one prior-pattern recurrence was identified among 14 two-admission patients; on MIMIC-IV, the same pipeline produced no fingerprint matches among 9 two-admission patients, which illustrates a key limitation of a fixed canonical pattern library. Across both runs all logged decisions were fully traceable and correctly attributed. The results support SMARtCARE as a traceable, privacy-aware mechanism for surfacing middle-context risk; they are not a clinical efficacy claim.

AI.tldr: SMARtCARE 是一种面向 ICU 长上下文临床决策支持的四状态架构，通过既往轨迹的有损六通道指纹，在患者历史不在当前推理上下文时提示可能的中段风险，并仅在临床医生操作下进行完整检索。
AI.motivation: 长上下文临床 AI 可能遗漏活跃推理上下文之外的相关病史；在 ICU 监测中，早期生命体征漂移即使类似既往恶化模式，也可能因缺乏既往记录而被误判为非特异性。
AI.method: 提出 Stable、Meta-cognitive、Assisted、Regulated（Revoked）四状态架构；使用患者既往轨迹的有损六通道指纹进行匹配，匹配且既往记录缺失时触发 Meta-cognitive 升级供临床医生审查，完整检索仅在 Assisted 状态由医生操作；设计患者身份保护机制以保障数据加载、日志和审计中的正确归因；评估包括验证状态转移逻辑与估计器稳定性的合成蒙特卡洛研究，以及 MIMIC-III 和 MIMIC-IV Clinical Database Demos 的真实数据运行。
AI.result: MIMIC-III 中 14 名两次入院患者里识别出 1 例既往模式复发；MIMIC-IV 中同一流程在 9 名两次入院患者里未产生指纹匹配，显示固定规范模式库的关键局限。两次运行中所有记录决策均可追溯且归因正确。
AI.conclusion: SMARtCARE 可作为可追溯、隐私感知的机制来提示中段上下文风险，但结果并非临床有效性声明；固定规范模式库的覆盖局限需进一步解决。

title: Beyond MSE: Rician Likelihood Denoising for Self-Supervised Cardiac $T2$ and $T1ρ$ MRI
summary: Magnetic resonance imaging involves an inherent trade-off among spatial resolution, acquisition time, and noise. This trade-off contributes to long scan times and high cost. Deep learning has improved image denoising, but cardiac MRI remains difficult because high-resolution, rapid acquisitions generally lack corresponding low-noise ground truth. Self-supervised denoising offers a potential solution by learning from noisy image pairs or even single noisy acquisitions. However, we show that Noise2Void-style blind-spot denoising, which uses a mean squared error (MSE) loss and assumes zero-mean, independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) noise, is poorly suited to MR magnitude images. When applied to short-axis $T2$-weighted and $T1ρ$-weighted cardiac MRI with synthetic Rician noise, it produces biased denoised images and biased parametric maps of $T2$ and $T1ρ$. To address this limitation, we formulate self-supervised denoising as maximum likelihood estimation under a known Rician noise model. This yields unbiased denoisers that are competitive with supervised baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文研究心脏MRI自监督去噪，指出Noise2Void类盲点去噪因MSE假设不适用于Rician噪声而导致偏差，并提出基于已知Rician噪声模型的最大似然自监督去噪，获得无偏且与监督基线相当的结果。
AI.motivation: MRI在空间分辨率、采集时间和噪声之间存在固有权衡，导致扫描时间长、成本高；深度学习去噪虽有效，但心脏MRI通常缺乏与高分辨率快速采集对应的低噪声真值。自监督去噪可利用噪声图像对甚至单次噪声采集学习，但现有方法常假设零均值独立同分布噪声，不适用于MR幅值图像中的Rician噪声。
AI.method: 分析Noise2Void式盲点去噪结合MSE损失在合成Rician噪声的短轴T2加权和T1ρ加权心脏MRI上的表现；将自监督去噪重新表述为已知Rician噪声模型下的最大似然估计。
AI.result: Noise2Void类方法会产生有偏的去噪图像，并导致T2和T1ρ参数图有偏；所提出的Rician最大似然自监督去噪器能够实现无偏去噪，性能与监督基线相当。
AI.conclusion: 自监督去噪需匹配MR幅值图像的噪声统计特性；基于Rician噪声模型的最大似然框架可实现无偏去噪，为心脏MRI等缺乏干净真值的场景提供了有效方案。

title: Awaken, Then Scale: Tiny Adaptation for MRI Reconstruction
summary: Dormant Awakening (DA) specializes a magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) reconstruction model by fitting a small set of zero weights to one labeled slice. Across fourteen U-shaped convolutional network (U-Net) and vision transformer (ViT) sources, fitting 1,004 or 10,560 weights gives mean peak signal-to-noise ratio (PSNR) gains of .430 and .509 dB. We analyze how scaling the fitted output correction changes evaluation PSNR, then use the calibration correction size to cap changes on new images. The cap bounds changes in root mean squared error (RMSE) relative to the source without an evaluation reference. At 10\% adaptation budget, we compare fixed halving and dynamic capping for DA, unrestricted sparse adaptation and low-rank adaptation (LoRA). The controls increase both measured calibration-evaluation correlations across all six tested architecture-adapter settings. Experiments concern one constructed fastMRI-to-M4Raw shift with fixed source checkpoints and participant panels.

AI.tldr: Dormant Awakening（DA）通过仅用一张有标注切片拟合少量零权重，使MRI重建模型适应新域，并在U-Net与ViT上取得PSNR提升。
AI.motivation: MRI重建模型在跨域分布偏移下性能下降，而新域标注数据通常极少，因此需要低预算、无需评估参考的模型特化方法。
AI.method: 在14个U-Net和ViT源模型上，DA拟合1004或10560个零权重；分析缩放拟合输出校正对评估PSNR的影响，并用校准校正幅度限制新图像上的变化，从而在无评估参考时约束相对源模型的RMSE变化。在10%适应预算下，比较DA的固定减半与动态限幅、无限制稀疏适应和LoRA。
AI.result: 拟合1004和10560个权重分别带来平均PSNR增益0.430 dB和0.509 dB；在六种架构-适配器设置中，所提控制均提高了校准与评估之间的相关性；实验基于一个构造的fastMRI到M4Raw偏移任务，使用固定源检查点和参与者面板。
AI.conclusion: DA能用极少标注和参数实现MRI重建模型特化，校准限幅可在无评估参考时控制新图像性能变化，并改善校准-评估一致性。

title: ANaLOG: Anisotropic Native-Latent Operator Guidance for Solving Inverse Problems
summary: Native-latent guidance is a recent paradigm for solving inverse problems with latent diffusion models. It replaces repeated evaluations of the image-space forward model, each requiring a decoder pass, with efficient guidance computed using a learned latent-space surrogate. However, existing methods apply guidance uniformly across latent dimensions, ignoring that measurements are informative only along certain directions and that the reliability of model predictions varies across inputs and timesteps. We propose ANaLOG, a framework for efficient uncertainty-aware guidance with pretrained latent diffusion models. ANaLOG models uncertainty by learning an anisotropic, input- and time-dependent covariance that is integrated into the guidance mechanism to emphasize reliable directions and downweight uncertain ones. We theoretically analyze this framework in a linear model setting and prove that anisotropic, uncertainty-aware weighting is necessary for correct sampling, whereas isotropic guidance induces sampling errors. Experiments across five challenging inverse problems show that ANaLOG improves perceptual reconstruction quality over existing methods while preserving efficiency.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ANaLOG，一种用于预训练潜在扩散模型的高效不确定性感知引导框架，通过建模各向异性、依赖输入和时间的不确定性来改进逆问题求解。
AI.motivation: 现有 native-latent guidance 方法在潜在维度上均匀施加引导，忽略了测量仅在某些方向上具有信息量，且模型预测可靠性会随输入和时间步变化的问题。
AI.method: ANaLOG 学习各向异性、输入相关且时间相关的协方差以建模不确定性，并将其集成到引导机制中，从而强调可靠方向、降低不确定方向的权重。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，在线性模型设定下，各向异性且不确定性感知的加权对正确采样是必要的，而各向同性引导会引入采样误差；在五个挑战性逆问题上，ANaLOG 在保持效率的同时提升了感知重建质量。
AI.conclusion: ANaLOG 通过不确定性感知的各向异性引导，有效提升了潜在扩散模型求解逆问题的重建质量与效率，并证明了均匀引导的理论缺陷。

title: A literature-guided descriptor-based framework for filtering composition search spaces
summary: Scientific literature contains latent knowledge about materials behavior, but much of this knowledge is expressed through words, contexts, and recurring associations rather than explicit design principles. This raises a central question: how can large-scale scientific corpora be used for practical problems in materials discovery? Here, we present a literature-guided descriptor-based filtering framework for reducing composition search spaces. For a given performance metric, the framework selects two descriptors from a filtered vocabulary in a literature-trained word embedding model and uses the selected descriptors to construct a Pareto-based filter for candidate compositions. Across the evaluated performance metrics and composition search spaces, the framework filters out an average of 74.27\% of the candidate compositions, with an average best-value error of 1.93\% relative to experimental measurements. Compared with expert-chosen and random descriptors, our performance metric-dependent descriptors provide a more controlled balance between retained fraction and best-value error. These results show that literature-derived embeddings can support intuitive and reproducible filters for narrowing candidate composition spaces while preserving high-performing compositions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于文献引导描述符的过滤框架，用于缩小材料成分搜索空间，在保留高性能成分的同时高效筛选候选组成。
AI.motivation: 科学文献中蕴含大量材料行为知识，但多以词语、语境和重复关联形式存在，而非明确的设计原则，因此需要探索如何利用大规模文献语料解决材料发现中的实际问题。
AI.method: 构建文献训练的词语嵌入模型，针对给定性能指标从过滤后的词汇表中选择两个描述符，并基于这两个描述符构建帕累托式过滤器，用于候选成分的筛选。
AI.result: 在评估的性能指标和成分搜索空间中，该框架平均过滤掉74.27%的候选成分，相对于实验测量的平均最优值误差为1.93%。与专家选择和随机描述符相比，性能指标相关描述符在保留比例和最优值误差之间提供了更可控的平衡。
AI.conclusion: 文献衍生的嵌入表示能够支持直观且可复现的过滤器，用于缩小候选成分空间，同时保留高性能成分。

title: Robot Manipulation with GPT-6-Astra: Body Knowledge, Experience Reuse, Emergent Skills, and Sim2Real Transfer
comment: 23 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Code, data, prompts, and skills: https://github.com/hesd10/astra-robot-sim2real
summary: General-purpose multimodal agents can write robot-control programs, but repeated exploration and model-mediated action selection can make execution slow. We study how external body knowledge, successful experience, and executable skills improve an XLeRobot controlled by GPT-6-Astra in a simulated and a physical elevator-button task. In 30 fixed-start simulation trials, complete robot geometry and camera information reduce mean completion time by 57.4% relative to a baseline with only the common control interface and no prior experience; images with synchronized action and state records reduce it by 68.6% without additional body assets. In nine paired comparisons (18 trials) at starts displaced by 10-100 cm, experience recorded at the original start reduces mean time by 58-63% relative to no experience, demonstrating generalization to the tested new starting positions. During experience experiments, GPT-6-Astra spontaneously generates a short visual-feedback program. Researcher-refactored versions reduce mean local-task time by 29-31% in 27 simulation trials. Finally, 12 real-robot trials using operator-confirmed button contact demonstrate sim2real reuse: at a shared nominal start, simulation XML assets and simulation experience reduce mean time by 53.0% and 49.9%, respectively; real experience also transfers to two new starts. These results suggest a practical way to build general-purpose manipulation experiments around GPT-6-Astra: supply machine-readable body descriptions and synchronized demonstrations, and turn useful agent-generated feedback routines into reusable skills, while the agent adapts actions from current images. We release all task prompts, trial-level experimental data, and acquired skill implementations at https://github.com/hesd10/astra-robot-sim2real.

AI.tldr: 研究如何通过外部身体知识、成功经验和可执行技能，提升 GPT-6-Astra 控制的 XLeRobot 在电梯按钮任务中的执行效率，并在仿真与真机上验证 sim2real 复用。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态智能体虽能编写机器人控制程序，但反复探索和模型中介的动作选择会导致执行缓慢，因此需要研究如何利用身体描述、经验记录和可复用技能来加速机器人操作。
AI.method: 在仿真和真实电梯按钮任务中，以 XLeRobot 和 GPT-6-Astra 为对象，对比不同先验信息条件：仅通用控制接口、完整机器人几何与相机信息、同步图像-动作-状态记录、原始起点经验、研究者重构的视觉反馈程序，以及仿真资产和仿真经验向真机迁移。
AI.result: 30 次固定起点仿真中，完整几何与相机信息使平均完成时间降低 57.4%，同步图像-动作-状态记录降低 68.6%；18 次位移起点试验中，原起点经验降低 58-63%。GPT-6-Astra 自发产生视觉反馈程序，研究者重构版本在 27 次仿真中降低局部任务时间 29-31%。12 次真机试验中，仿真 XML 资产和仿真经验分别降低 53.0% 和 49.9%，真实经验也可迁移到两个新起点。
AI.conclusion: 围绕 GPT-6-Astra 构建通用操作实验的实用路径是：提供机器可读的身体描述和同步演示，将智能体生成的有用反馈流程转化为可复用技能，同时让智能体根据当前图像自适应动作。所有任务提示、试验级数据和技能实现已开源。

title: Reducing Combinatorial Redundancy in Mixed-Integer MPC via Ranking-Based Feasible-Set Restriction for Reconfigurable Batteries
summary: When mixed-integer model predictive control must select which of several similar units to activate, many same-size selections can yield closely spaced predicted outcomes, and branch-and-bound may fail to certify optimality within one sampling period. We propose a ranking-based feasible-set restriction for this class of decisions: the units are ordered by a suitability score computed at each sampling instant, and a monotone constraint permits only the top-ranked units to be active. The optimizer then chooses only how many units to activate, so the admissible selections per prediction stage grow linearly instead of combinatorially, while the model, cost function, and remaining constraints are retained. We instantiate the method for reconfigurable battery packs in which each series-connected cell can be bypassed, scoring cells with fixed weights on normalized state of health, state of charge, and voltage headroom. In a 20-cell simulation over a dynamic drive cycle with a 1 s limit per online solve, all active online restricted solves terminate at the root node with certified optimality, compared with 77.83% certification for unrestricted subset selection, and the 95th-percentile solver time is lower by a factor of 13.4. The cycle-mean cell-to-cell standard deviation in state of charge falls 8.7-fold without power curtailment, at the expense of 3.45 times as much cell switching. Solving both problems from identical states along two trajectories shows that the restriction raises the optimal cost by 0.26% and 0.14% on average at states where both solves are certified and uncurtailed.

AI.tldr: 针对混合整数模型预测控制在多个相似单元中选择激活单元时组合爆炸、分支定界难以在采样周期内证明最优的问题，提出基于排序的可行集限制方法，并将其用于可重构电池包。
AI.motivation: 当MPC需要在多个相似单元中选择激活哪些单元时，许多同规模选择会产生相近预测结果，导致分支定界无法在一个采样周期内认证最优性。
AI.method: 按每个采样时刻计算的适用性评分对单元排序，并加入单调约束，只允许排名靠前的单元激活；优化器仅需决定激活数量，使每个预测阶段的可选方案从组合增长变为线性增长，同时保留模型、代价函数和其余约束。针对可重构电池包，每个串联电池可旁路，评分使用归一化健康状态、荷电状态和电压裕度的固定权重。
AI.result: 在20电池动态驾驶循环仿真中，在线求解限时1秒：受限在线求解全部在根节点终止并认证最优，而无限制子集选择认证率为77.83%；95百分位求解时间降低13.4倍。循环平均电池间SOC标准差下降8.7倍且无功率削减，但电池切换次数增加3.45倍。从相同状态沿两条轨迹求解显示，受限方法在两者均认证且未削减时，平均最优成本分别增加0.26%和0.14%。
AI.conclusion: 基于排序的可行集限制可显著提升在线混合整数MPC的最优性认证率和求解速度，并改善电池SOC均衡，代价是少量最优成本增加和更多开关动作。

title: Distributional sentiment modeling and anomaly detection for consumer complaint assessment
summary: Sentiment analysis is a common tool for converting unstructured text into quantitative signals in finance and risk management. Yet most applications reduce the output to a discrete polarity label or a single predictive feature, overlooking the distributional structure of sentiment intensity in consumer complaint narratives. In this paper we treat negative sentiment in consumer complaints as a bounded continuous variable and study its full distribution rather than a single label. We score each narrative with a transformer classifier, model the scores with Beta distributions, and compare the fitted distributions of meritorious and non-meritorious complaints through the Kullback Leibler divergence and the squared Hellinger distance. The fitted distributions are then linked with dollar amounts and company response outcomes to construct anomaly diagnostics that flag complaints whose textual severity is inconsistent with the recorded relief. We find that the two groups have strongly overlapping distributions, so negative sentiment intensity is not a sharp classifier of outcomes on its own; combined with monetary and categorical attributes, it isolates unusually severe complaints for operational risk monitoring. Treating sentiment analysis as continuous distributional measurement, this study links sentiment extraction, bounded response modeling, and anomaly detection in a unified framework for consumer complaint assessment.

AI.tldr: 该论文将消费者投诉中的负面情绪视为有界连续变量，使用Transformer分类器打分，并用Beta分布建模其整体分布，进而结合金额和公司响应构建异常诊断，用于操作风险监测。
AI.motivation: 现有情感分析在金融与风险管理中多将文本输出简化为离散极性标签或单一预测特征，忽略了消费者投诉叙事中情感强度的分布结构。
AI.method: 使用Transformer分类器对每条投诉叙事进行负面情绪打分；用Beta分布拟合分数；通过KL散度和平方Hellinger距离比较有理据与无理据投诉的分布；再将拟合分布与美元金额、公司响应结果关联，构建异常诊断以识别文本严重性与实际救济不一致的投诉。
AI.result: 两组投诉的负面情绪强度分布高度重叠，说明单独使用负面情绪强度并不能清晰区分结果；但将其与金额和类别属性结合，可识别异常严重的投诉，用于操作风险监测。
AI.conclusion: 将情感分析视为连续分布测量，可在统一框架中连接情感抽取、有界响应建模和异常检测，为消费者投诉评估提供新方法。

title: Reduced Cartesian Kinetostatics for Tendon-Driven Continuum Robots: Residual-Stabilized Full-Shape Propagation
summary: Many planning and control tasks for tendon-driven continuum robots (TDCRs) require the complete Cartesian backbone geometry. We present a reduced Cartesian framework for planar, axially compressible TDCRs that propagates equilibrium configurations along prescribed tendon-force and tendon-displacement trajectories. The backbone is represented by two global position fields. Following exact variation, a Taylor-Galerkin reduction condenses prescribed spatial properties and distributed loads into offline moment vectors, yielding analytic reduced residuals and Jacobians without online spatial quadrature or numerical differentiation. Analytical differentiation and residual correction yield first-order rate systems requiring one fixed-dimensional linear solve per rate evaluation after initial equilibrium alignment on a regular branch. Across four simulated cases covering variable tendon routing, nonuniform geometry, axial compression, and their combined effects, the propagated Cartesian shapes and distributed strains closely match pointwise geometrically variable-strain (GVS) equilibrium solutions. Residual correction suppresses propagation drift across the tested step sizes while adding only about 0.98% to the mean update time of uncorrected Euler. The proposed method requires 0.508 ms per update on average, approximately 11 times faster than pointwise GVS solves. Displacement-driven experiments yield a maximum normalized mean backbone position error of 1.02% and a maximum end-effector position error of 0.28%. These results support efficient and accurate Cartesian full-shape prediction along prescribed actuation paths.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于平面轴向可压缩肌腱驱动连续体机器人的降阶笛卡尔框架，可沿预设肌腱力/位移轨迹快速传播平衡构型并预测完整骨架形状。
AI.motivation: 许多规划与控制任务需要完整的笛卡尔骨架几何，但逐点几何可变应变（GVS）求解计算成本高，难以满足效率需求。
AI.method: 用两个全局位置场表示骨架；基于精确变分和Taylor-Galerkin降阶，将空间属性与分布载荷离线化为矩向量，得到解析降阶残差与雅可比；结合解析微分和残差校正构建一阶速率系统，每次速率评估仅需一次固定维线性求解。
AI.result: 四个仿真案例中，传播得到的笛卡尔形状和分布应变与逐点GVS平衡解高度一致；残差校正抑制传播漂移，仅增加约0.98%平均更新时间；平均每次更新0.508 ms，比逐点GVS快约11倍；位移驱动实验中最大归一化平均骨架位置误差为1.02%，末端位置误差为0.28%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法支持沿预设驱动路径进行高效且准确的笛卡尔全形状预测。

title: RFSR-MI-MPC: Ranking-Based Feasible-Set Restriction for Real-Time Control of Reconfigurable Battery Packs
comment: Submitted to IEEE Transactions on Control Systems Technology. 15 pages, 4 figures. Code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22136253; data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22134357
summary: A ranked-prefix feasible-set restriction is proposed for real-time mixed-integer model predictive control of series-connected reconfigurable battery packs with per-cell bypass switching. Cells are ordered at each sampling instant by a one-step objective-informed suitability score, and the engagement variables are constrained to prefixes of that ordering. The restriction reduces the number of admissible per-step engagement patterns from combinatorial to linear in the number of cells while leaving the model, objective, and physical constraints unchanged. For a 20-cell pack driven over a worldwide harmonized light vehicles test cycle, the proposed controller certifies every active step, solves every instance without branching, and reduces the 95th-percentile solver time by a factor of 6.8 relative to the full subset-selection controller. The cycle-mean cell-to-cell state-of-charge standard deviation decreases by a factor of 3.4, and no power curtailment occurs. Same-state reference solves show a mean restriction gap below 0.11% on jointly certified steps, and the computational gains persist across the tested initial conditions, cell heterogeneity levels, pack sizes, and prediction horizons without retuning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种排序前缀可行域限制方法，用于带旁路开关的串联可重构电池组实时混合整数模型预测控制。通过按单步目标相关适宜度对电池单元排序，并将投入变量限制为该排序的前缀，将每步可选投入模式从组合级降为线性级。
AI.motivation: 可重构电池组的逐单元旁路开关导致混合整数模型预测控制中每步投入模式数量组合爆炸，难以满足实时求解需求；因此需要在不改变模型、目标和物理约束的前提下降低计算复杂度。
AI.method: 在每个采样时刻用单步目标信息计算各单元适宜度并排序，然后将投入变量限制为排序序列的前缀；该方法不改变原模型、目标函数和物理约束，并用于20单元电池组在WLTC工况下的实时控制。
AI.result: 所提控制器在每个活跃步均可认证，所有实例均无需分支求解；相比完整子集选择控制器，95百分位求解时间降低6.8倍；电池间SOC标准差周期均值降低3.4倍，且无功率削减。在共同认证步骤上，同状态参考解的平均限制间隙低于0.11%；计算增益在不同初始条件、单元异质性、电池组规模和预测时域下均保持，且无需重新调参。
AI.conclusion: 排序前缀可行域限制能在保持模型与约束不变的情况下，将可重构电池组混合整数模型预测控制的可选模式从组合级降至线性级，实现实时求解、显著降低计算时间并改善SOC均衡，同时保持很小的最优性间隙和较强泛化性。

title: Witeness Overlap: Directional Provenance Inside Open-Weight Model Families
summary: Open-weight models are often released, fine-tuned, aligned, merged, and re-released, making provenance audits ask not only whether checkpoints are related, but also which checkpoint came first. Many existing model-provenance methods are designed for a base-known audit setting: given a victim or source model, they test whether a suspect model is related to it. Although these audits are framed as source-to-suspect tests, their underlying evidence is often symmetric, relying on representation similarity, weight similarity, behavioral fingerprints, or correlation statistics. Symmetric pairwise comparisons can detect relatedness, but they cannot by themselves orient relationship between checkpoints A and B. We therefore introduce a local geometric comparison: instead of comparing two checkpoints directly, we add a third same-family checkpoint as a witness and compare the geometry around each candidate endpoint. Direction is inferred by asking which candidate behaves more like a branching parent. Motivated by this idea, and by the empirically observed asymmetry between parent-anchored and child-anchored witness-overlap distributions, we propose Witness Overlap, a prompt-free, training-free white-box test for directional provenance. On 176 LLM checkpoints from 16 families, our one-witness test orients 95.3\% of parent-child decisions using Frobenius cosine. We further evaluate root identification, sibling discrimination, generalizations to VLM and diffusion families, and chain-structured ordering. The signal is robust to weight noise and sparse pruning, with a proposed SVD weight reduction variant showing greater robustness than Frobenius cosine.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Witness Overlap，一种免提示、免训练的白盒方向性模型溯源方法。它通过引入同族第三方检查点作为见证，比较局部几何来判断两个检查点中谁更像父节点。在 176 个 LLM 检查点、16 个家族上，单见证测试以 95.3% 的准确率判断亲子方向，并验证了根识别、兄弟区分、VLM/扩散模型泛化、链式排序及对权重噪声和稀疏剪枝的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 开放权重模型常被发布、微调、对齐、合并并再次发布，因此溯源不仅需要判断检查点是否相关，还需要判断哪个检查点更早或更接近来源。现有模型溯源方法多面向已知源模型或受害模型的审计，依赖表示相似度、权重相似度、行为指纹或相关性统计等对称证据，只能检测相关性，不能单独确定 A 与 B 之间的方向。
AI.method: 提出局部几何比较：不直接比较两个检查点，而是加入第三个同族检查点作为见证，比较每个候选端点周围的几何结构，通过判断哪个候选更像分支父节点来推断方向。基于观察到的父节点锚定与子节点锚定的见证重叠分布不对称，提出 Witness Overlap 测试，使用 Frobenius 余弦，并提出基于 SVD 的权重降维变体。
AI.result: 在来自 16 个家族的 176 个 LLM 检查点上，单见证测试使用 Frobenius 余弦能对 95.3% 的亲子决策正确定向。论文还评估了根识别、兄弟区分、向 VLM 和扩散模型家族的泛化以及链式结构排序。该方法对权重噪声和稀疏剪枝稳健，且 SVD 权重降维变体比 Frobenius 余弦更稳健。
AI.conclusion: Witness Overlap 能利用局部几何和见证重叠实现方向性模型溯源，在多种模型家族和任务场景中有效，并可提升对权重扰动与剪枝的鲁棒性。

title: Temporal-Attention Head Specialization During Video Diffusion Training
summary: Video diffusion transformers depend on temporal attention to coordinate information across frames, yet nearly everything known about this mechanism comes from analyzing trained models, so when and where temporal-attention structure forms during training remains poorly characterized. Population averages can also hide it, since a few specializing heads and a diffusing majority cancel in the mean. We therefore conduct a checkpoint-resolved census of every temporal-attention head across nine Open-Sora STDiT training runs spanning three model scales (306M to 1.03B parameters), scoring each head with an entropy-normalized measure of cross-frame attention concentration (CFAC) under a preregistered change-point and effect-size selection rule. The census reveals the sparse picture that averages obscure. Aggregate CFAC is flat or decreasing in every run, while a small minority of heads, roughly 4--13% in full-grid runs, develops pronounced concentration. Across seeds, the reproducible signal is positional but block-level. Selected heads repeatedly arise in the first temporal block, whereas individual head coordinates do not reproduce once block membership is accounted for. Among the analyzed 760M selected heads, attention maps converge to a small repertoire of local frame-routing motifs, self-frame diagonals and adjacent-frame bands, even when the responsible coordinates differ across runs. Correlation and ablation analyses do not establish a causal link to generated video quality, and we bound our claims accordingly. Beyond this STDiT family, the study contributes a transferable methodology. Checkpoint-resolved, per-head analysis under fixed selection rules can expose sparse temporal organization in other factorized video diffusion transformers and, with adapted routing metrics, in joint spatio-temporal architectures.

AI.tldr: 对九个Open-Sora STDiT训练运行（306M至1.03B参数）进行逐检查点、逐时间注意力头普查，发现时间注意力结构稀疏：总体CFAC平坦或下降，但少数头（约4-13%）发展出显著跨帧集中，且可复现信号是块级位置而非具体头坐标。
AI.motivation: 现有对视频扩散Transformer中时间注意力的理解主要来自训练好的模型，训练过程中时间注意力结构何时、何地形成尚不清楚；总体平均会掩盖稀疏专业化头与扩散多数之间的抵消效应。
AI.method: 进行逐检查点、逐头普查，覆盖九个Open-Sora STDiT训练运行、三种模型尺度（306M至1.03B参数）；用熵归一化的跨帧注意力集中度（CFAC）评分，并采用预注册的变化点与效应量选择规则；结合相关性与消融分析。
AI.result: 所有运行中聚合CFAC平坦或下降；约4-13%的头在完整网格运行中出现显著集中；可复现信号为块级位置，选定头反复出现在第一个时间块，但具体头坐标在考虑块归属后不可复现；760M选定头的注意力图收敛到少量局部帧路由模式（自帧对角线和相邻帧带）；相关与消融未建立与生成视频质量的因果联系。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供可迁移方法：在固定选择规则下进行逐检查点、逐头分析，可揭示其他因子化视频扩散Transformer中的稀疏时间组织，并可通过适配路由度量应用于联合时空架构；同时谨慎限定因果声明。

title: CP-Agent: A Harness-Engineered Agent for Crystal Plasticity Simulation Workflows
summary: Crystal plasticity (CP) simulations predict the mechanical behavior of polycrystalline metals, yet their routine use is hindered by the manual effort of configuring heterogeneous tools, orchestrating multi-step data pipelines, and calibrating constitutive parameters against experiments. These bottlenecks impede productivity in systematic parameter studies, motivating interest in automated workflows. This study presents CP-Agent, a harness-engineered LLM-based agent that autonomously executes complete CP modeling workflows from natural-language tasks. Operating under the ReAct paradigm, the agent reasons about tool selection and sequencing while delegating numerical search to established optimizers. The harness comprises a minimal system prompt, typed tool definitions, a dispatcher, and a safety-bounded iteration loop, encoding domain knowledge through tool schemas rather than hard-coded logic. CP-Agent is demonstrated on four case studies: calibrating four slip parameters of additively manufactured stainless steel 316L against tensile data; validating the workflow against published copper benchmarks, reproducing stress-strain and texture evolution; recovering the initial crystallographic texture of copper, where the agent correctly identifies a diffuse initial texture; and reproducing the multi-pass rolling texture evolution of a Mg-Zn-Ca alloy, where the agent chains five deformation passes and recovers the experimentally observed weakened, split basal texture. In all cases, the agent inferred the correct execution sequence from the task statement, robustly across repeated runs, and delivered physically interpretable results. This work establishes harness engineering as a systematic approach to automating CP modeling workflows while maintaining physical interpretability and auditability through visible reasoning traces.

AI.tldr: 提出CP-Agent，一个基于LLM的代理，通过精心设计的harness自动执行晶体塑性建模全流程，并在四个案例中验证其有效性与稳健性。
AI.motivation: 晶体塑性模拟虽可预测多晶金属力学行为，但工具配置、多步数据流程编排和参数标定需大量人工，阻碍系统化参数研究，因此需要自动化工作流。
AI.method: 基于ReAct范式，LLM代理推理工具选择与排序，将数值搜索交给既有优化器；harness包含最小系统提示、类型化工具定义、调度器和安全有界迭代循环，通过工具schema编码领域知识而非硬编码逻辑。
AI.result: 四个案例中，代理均能从自然语言任务推断正确执行序列，重复运行稳健且结果物理可解释：标定增材制造316L的四个滑移参数；验证铜基准并复现应力-应变与织构演化；反演铜初始织构并识别弥散初始织构；复现Mg-Zn-Ca合金五道次轧制织构演化及弱化、分裂基面织构。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将harness engineering确立为自动化晶体塑性建模工作流的系统方法，并通过可见推理轨迹保持物理可解释性与可审计性。

title: Active Data Acquisition with Side Information via Discrete Diffusion Priors
summary: Acquiring data is costly: higher measurement fidelity costs power and storage and risks collecting irrelevant content, while aggressive cost reduction can discard information that later analysis needs. We address this trade-off with an information-theoretic framework that acquires data relevant to a broad set of tasks rather than to one model. A mask policy, conditioned on side information, chooses which pixels to measure so as to maximize the mutual information between a discrete image and its partial observation under a budget; since the image entropy does not depend on the mask, this is equivalent to minimizing the conditional entropy. A frozen discrete denoising diffusion model (D3PM) supplies the posterior, and we use it in two ways: as an entropy surrogate for training a one-shot mask generator, and as the criterion for sequential greedy acquisition. The one-shot generator outperforms random masks only with care, including an unbiased gradient estimator for binary masks. With sequential acquisition, on MNIST the prior makes $8\times$ fewer errors than random at a $10\%$ budget, and on CIFAR-10 it gains $0.9$--$3.4$~dB. On fastMRI, our proposed technique using a static mask outperforms the well-known methods such as variable density and LOUPE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种信息论框架，用于在采样成本约束下选择与多种任务相关的数据，并利用冻结的离散扩散模型D3PM辅助掩码生成与序贯采集。
AI.motivation: 数据采集成本高昂：提高保真度会增加功耗和存储并可能收集无关内容，而过度降低成本又会丢失后续分析所需信息。现有方法多针对单一模型，难以服务广泛任务。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为在预算下最大化离散图像与其部分观测之间的互信息；由于图像熵与掩码无关，等价于最小化条件熵。使用冻结的D3PM提供后验，并用于训练一次性掩码生成器的熵代理，以及序贯贪心采集的准则；同时引入二值掩码的无偏梯度估计器。
AI.result: 一次性生成器需谨慎设计才能优于随机掩码。序贯采集在MNIST上10%预算时错误数比随机少8倍；CIFAR-10上增益0.9–3.4 dB；在fastMRI上，使用静态掩码的所提方法优于variable density和LOUPE等知名方法。
AI.conclusion: 基于信息论和D3PM的掩码策略能在有限预算下选择更相关信息，序贯采集尤其有效，并在医学图像重建任务中展现出优于已有方法的性能。

title: A Priority-Aware Dual-Channel Feature Fusion Method for Urban Rail Service Traffic Classification
summary: With the deep integration of 5G and IoT in urban rail transit, service traffic grows explosively and accurate classification of heterogeneous service flows is essential for safe and efficient railway operations. Urban rail communication systems are subject not only to operational disturbances such as equipment failures and maintenance interference, but also to complex transmission patterns characterized by the interleaving of multi-service traffic flows. Under these operating conditions, the widespread deployment of proprietary protocols and the high prevalence of encrypted traffic further diminish the applicability of conventional port-based and Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) classification methods. To address these challenges, we propose a priority-aware dual-channel feature fusion framework. Raw traffic bytes and statistical features are mapped into grayscale images and processed by a dual-branch architecture: a transfer learning-enhanced ResNet extracts fine-grained byte-level textures, while a lightweight CNN captures macroscopic statistical patterns. A channel attention mechanism dynamically recalibrates cross-modal features, and a novel Priority-Sensitive Loss (PSL) that integrates business-criticality awareness with class-balance weighting to maximize recall for safety-critical services. Evaluated on a real-world urban rail dataset using priority-weighted metrics, the method achieves 98.74\% accuracy and 99.24\% weighted recall, with recall of 99.94\% and 99.41\% on the two safety-critical services:Communication-Based Train Control(CBTC) and Emergency Radio Dispatch(ERD), providing a reliable classification foundation for priority-aware resource scheduling in urban rail communications. With only 0.18M parameters and 0.4--0.7 ms end-to-end latency, offering an excellent balance between high-precision classification, low inference latency, and edge-deployment feasibility.

AI.tldr: 该论文面向城市轨道交通中5G与IoT融合下的异构业务流分类问题，提出一种优先级感知的双通道特征融合框架，在真实数据集上实现高精度、低时延且适合边缘部署的业务流分类。
AI.motivation: 城市轨道交通业务流量爆发式增长，且设备故障、维护干扰、多业务交织、专有协议和加密流量普遍存在，使传统基于端口和DPI的分类方法适用性下降；同时CBTC、ERD等安全关键业务需要更高召回率。
AI.method: 将原始流量字节和统计特征映射为灰度图像，构建双分支架构：迁移学习增强的ResNet提取字节级细粒度纹理，轻量CNN捕捉宏观统计模式；引入通道注意力机制动态校准跨模态特征，并提出优先级敏感损失PSL，融合业务关键性感知与类别平衡加权。
AI.result: 在真实城市轨道交通数据集上采用优先级加权指标评估，达到98.74%准确率和99.24%加权召回率；安全关键业务CBTC和ERD的召回率分别为99.94%和99.41%；模型仅0.18M参数，端到端时延0.4–0.7 ms。
AI.conclusion: 该方法在高精度分类、低推理时延和边缘部署可行性之间取得良好平衡，可为城市轨道交通通信中优先级感知的资源调度提供可靠分类基础。

title: Timed Rule-Based Supervision of an End-to-End Autonomous Parking Policy
summary: We study whether a manually specified runtime supervisor can correct recurring failures of an existing end-to-end parking policy in a fixed CARLA parking lot. The vision-based Transformer architecture is inherited from Yang et al.; our contribution is a timed, rule-based Parametric Safety Shield (PSS) applied to its control outputs. The PSS uses hand-calibrated speed, position, and duration thresholds to intervene in observed failure modes, including boundary exits, delayed braking, and stalled or oscillatory control. In the reported closed-loop evaluation, 16 held-out target slots and six initial poses are each evaluated in four rounds (384 attempts per configuration). Target success increases from 327/384 (85.16%) for the retrained policy to 375/384 (97.66%) with the PSS; mean position and orientation errors among successful attempts are 0.21m and 0.33 degrees. These results show an improvement within this simulator setup. The repeated attempts share one map, vehicle, and sensor configuration, and the PSS uses simulator world coordinates; thus the results do not establish generalization to other lots or real vehicles, or a formal safety guarantee.

AI.tldr: 在固定 CARLA 停车场中，为已有端到端泊车策略添加手工规则的运行时监督器，以纠正重复出现的失败模式，并在闭环评估中提升泊车成功率。
AI.motivation: 研究手工指定的运行时监督器能否修正现有端到端泊车策略在固定 CARLA 停车场中的反复失败。
AI.method: 继承 Yang 等人的视觉 Transformer 泊车策略，在其控制输出上应用定时、基于规则的参数化安全盾（PSS）。PSS 使用手工校准的速度、位置和持续时间阈值，干预越界、制动延迟、停滞或振荡控制等失败模式。在闭环评估中，对 16 个留出目标车位和 6 个初始位姿各进行 4 轮测试，每种配置共 384 次尝试。
AI.result: 重训练策略成功率为 327/384（85.16%），加入 PSS 后提升至 375/384（97.66%）。成功尝试的平均位置误差为 0.21 米，平均方向误差为 0.33 度。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明在该模拟器设置内 PSS 带来了改进；但所有尝试共享同一地图、车辆和传感器配置，且 PSS 使用模拟器世界坐标，因此不能证明对其他停车场或真实车辆的泛化能力，也不构成形式化安全保证。

title: ConflictVLA-Bench: Benchmarking Behavioral Responses of Vision-Language-Action Models to Premise Conflicts
summary: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models perform strongly on manipulation tasks, their responses to invalid task premises remain underexplored. Existing evaluations of premise conflicts often focus on terminal task outcomes, yet task failure alone cannot distinguish behavioral disengagement from continued pursuit followed by an execution error. We call the latter pattern Failed Persistence. To study this phenomenon, we introduce ConflictVLA-Bench, which pairs conflict rollouts with premise-consistent reference rollouts and evaluates both outcomes and execution processes. Built on LIBERO, the benchmark contains 2,826 prompt-conditioned conflict tasks spanning four conflict families, four structural configurations, and two prompt conditions. Across all eight VLAs, invalid premises reduce original goal completion by at least 17.3 percentage points, with the reduction reaching 56.2 percentage points for OpenVLA. Crucially, even when models succeed on premise-consistent tasks and fail on their matched conflict tasks, they often continue to approach the original targets, retain early trajectory structure, and show limited action magnitude suppression. Failed Persistence therefore recurs across the evaluated models. Explicit premise checking does not consistently produce selective and coordinated behavioral changes. These findings show that terminal failure alone establishes neither behavioral disengagement nor refusal and that outcomes alone are insufficient for VLA evaluation. Experimental data and additional details are available on the project page: https://github.com/EmbodiedAISurvey/ConflictVLA-Bench

AI.tldr: 论文研究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型面对无效任务前提时的行为，提出ConflictVLA-Bench基准，发现仅凭任务失败无法判断模型是停止执行还是继续尝试并最终出错（Failed Persistence），因此需要同时评估结果与执行过程。
AI.motivation: 现有对前提冲突的评估多关注最终任务结果，但任务失败不能区分行为脱离与继续追求原目标后执行失败，即Failed Persistence。VLA模型在操作任务上表现强，但其对无效任务前提的响应仍缺乏研究。
AI.method: 构建ConflictVLA-Bench基准，基于LIBERO，包含2,826个提示条件冲突任务，覆盖四类冲突家族、四种结构配置和两种提示条件；将冲突rollout与前提一致参考rollout配对，同时评估任务结果和执行过程。
AI.result: 在八个VLA模型上，无效前提使原始目标完成率至少下降17.3个百分点，OpenVLA下降达56.2个百分点。即使模型在前提一致任务成功、在匹配冲突任务失败，它们仍常继续接近原目标、保留早期轨迹结构，且动作幅度抑制有限，表明Failed Persistence反复出现。显式前提检查并未稳定产生选择性和协调的行为变化。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭最终失败不能证明模型已行为脱离或拒绝执行，结果指标不足以评估VLA模型处理无效前提的能力，需要结合执行过程进行分析。

title: Parser, Chunking, and Embedding Interactions in Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Indian Government Regulatory Documents
comment: 17 pages, 15 figures, 5 tables. Retrieval-only factorial evaluation with supplementary ablations and reproducibility materials
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipelines are typically assembled from independently-chosen components -- a document parser, a chunking strategy, and an embedding model -- yet these choices are rarely evaluated jointly, and evaluations that do combine them are usually run on a single document or corpus. We present a controlled factorial study of 3 parsers, 3 chunking strategies, and 5 dense embedding models, together with a sparse BM25 baseline, evaluated against 800 question instances, each with one or more required evidence strings, with evidence strings automatically validated against source text and a 10% random sample manually reviewed, across four structurally distinct Indian central-government regulatory documents. We fit linear mixed-effects models with document-query-level random intercepts to the resulting 72,000-row result set, run Holm-corrected paired comparisons between matched dense and sparse configurations, and report clustered bootstrap confidence intervals for all 54 unique retriever configurations. We find that no single retriever family dominates across documents; parser and chunker choice interact significantly; MPNet-base is a consistent underperformer with a severe failure mode on table-derived questions; and the corpus exhibits a near-saturated evidence-preservation ceiling above 98%, indicating that retrieval differences are driven primarily by ranking quality rather than information loss during ingestion. We additionally report embedding-dimension and chunk-size/overlap ablations and an efficiency/quality Pareto analysis. We release our full evaluation harness, corpus manifest, and 800-question benchmark.

AI.tldr: 该论文对RAG流水线中的解析器、分块策略和嵌入模型进行受控因子实验，并在四个印度中央政府监管文档上以800个问题实例评估检索配置。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG组件常被独立选择而缺乏联合评估，且组合评估多局限于单一文档或语料，难以判断解析、分块与嵌入模型之间的交互效应。
AI.method: 采用3种解析器、3种分块策略、5种稠密嵌入模型及BM25稀疏基线，在4类结构不同的印度监管文档上构建800个含证据串的问题；证据自动校验并人工复核10%。对72,000行结果拟合线性混合效应模型，使用Holm校正的配对比较和聚类自助置信区间，并开展维度、块大小/重叠消融与效率-质量帕累托分析。
AI.result: 没有单一检索器家族在所有文档上占优；解析器与分块器选择显著交互；MPNet-base持续表现较差，且在表格衍生问题上存在严重失败模式；语料证据保留率接近饱和，超过98%，说明检索差异主要来自排序质量而非摄入信息损失。
AI.conclusion: RAG评估应联合考察解析、分块与嵌入选择，并关注其交互作用与排序质量；作者发布完整评估框架、语料清单和800题基准以促进可复现研究。

title: Neural Decentralized Conditions for Power System Stability Analysis
summary: This letter proposes a novel method to establish decentralized stability conditions (DSCs) of power systems. This method formulates DSCs with meticulously crafted neural networks, based on the insight into the structure and properties of the existing analytically derived DSCs. A tailored loss function is further devised to iteratively train the neural networks, ensuring validity and reducing conservatism of the DSCs. Numerical results demonstrate that the resultant neural DSCs are less conservative than the conventional analytical DSCs, and become generalizable if a relatively large-scale system is used for training.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用神经网络构建电力系统分散稳定性条件（DSC）的新方法，通过定制损失函数训练网络，使所得神经DSC比传统解析DSC保守性更低，并在较大规模系统训练后具有泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 传统解析推导得到的分散稳定性条件通常较为保守，因此需要一种能降低保守性、同时保持有效性的DSC构建方法。
AI.method: 基于对现有解析DSC结构与性质的洞察，用精心设计的神经网络来构造DSC，并设计定制损失函数对神经网络进行迭代训练，以保证DSC有效性并减少保守性。
AI.result: 数值结果表明，所得神经DSC比传统解析DSC保守性更低；若使用相对较大规模系统进行训练，神经DSC还表现出泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能够有效建立基于神经网络的分散稳定性条件，实现比传统解析方法更不保守的稳定性判定，并具备一定泛化潜力。

title: Enhancing Foundation Models for Imbalanced SAR Ship Classification via Targeted Oversampling
summary: Remote-sensing foundation models offer strong representations for SAR imagery, but their behavior under severe long-tail class imbalance is still not well characterized. We benchmark DOFA and SAR-JEPA on the imbalanced OpenSARShip dataset and compare them with ImageNet-pretrained baselines under a fixed, training-efficient protocol that keeps the backbone frozen. To mitigate imbalance without fine-tuning, we apply four oversampling methods in embedding space exclusively to minority classes and train a lightweight classifier head on the augmented embeddings. Across both foundation models, oversampling improves Macro-F1 and test accuracy relative to their respective baselines, with the largest Macro-F1 gains observed for DOFA using ADASYN (34.39 to 38.56) and for SAR-JEPA using SVM-SMOTE (25.89 to 32.30). We also report class-wise behavior, showing that aggregate improvements can coexist with persistent failures on specific rare classes. Code for embedding extraction and reproducible multi-seed evaluation is provided to support rapid experimentation on free-tier hardware.

AI.tldr: 该论文在严重长尾类别不平衡的OpenSARShip数据集上，对遥感基础模型DOFA和SAR-JEPA进行基准测试，并采用冻结骨干、仅在嵌入空间对少数类过采样、训练轻量分类头的方案，发现过采样能提升Macro-F1和测试准确率，但某些稀有类仍持续失败。
AI.motivation: 遥感基础模型虽能为SAR图像提供强表征，但在严重长尾类别不平衡下的行为尚不明确；同时希望在无需微调的情况下缓解类别不平衡。
AI.method: 在固定且训练高效的协议下，与ImageNet预训练基线比较DOFA和SAR-JEPA，保持骨干冻结；在嵌入空间仅对少数类应用四种过采样方法，并在增强后的嵌入上训练轻量分类头。
AI.result: 两个基础模型上，过采样均相对各自基线提升了Macro-F1和测试准确率；DOFA使用ADASYN的Macro-F1提升最大（34.39到38.56），SAR-JEPA使用SVM-SMOTE的Macro-F1提升最大（25.89到32.30）。类别级分析显示，整体提升可能伴随特定稀有类持续失败。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入空间过采样可在不微调基础模型的情况下改善长尾SAR分类的整体指标，但稀有类别的失败问题仍然存在；作者提供嵌入提取与多随机种子可复现评估代码，支持在免费硬件上快速实验。

title: Mask2Restore: Self-Supervised Ultrasound Despeckling via Inpainting
summary: Medical ultrasound (US) is inherently degraded by speckle, a granular interference pattern that is often treated as a complex form of noise in image restoration. However, unlike random noise, US speckle originates from coherent scattering within tissue and is therefore highly spatially dependent and deterministic under fixed acquisition conditions, making US speckle suppression fundamentally different from natural image denoising. Because speckle-free US targets are unavailable in practice, self-supervised denoising is necessary. Blind-spot networks (BSN) are the dominant self-supervised paradigm for natural images, but their pixel-wise masking strategy assumes spatially independent noise, an assumption poorly matched to US speckle, which is spatially correlated over multiple pixels rather than pixel-wise independent. To address this mismatch, we propose Mask2Restore, a self-supervised US despeckling framework that reformulates despeckling as contextual inpainting with block-wise masking on single noisy images. Unlike pixel-wise BSN masking, block-wise masking addresses this multi-pixel speckle correlation by removing locally correlated speckle neighborhoods and shifting the reconstruction cues used by the network from adjacent speckle correlations to broader anatomical context. We further introduce cross-resolution context regularization (CRCR), which suppresses residual speckle bias by enforcing consistency across multi-resolution predictions. Experiments on simulated and in vivo carotid US, unseen fine-structure cases, and downstream cardiac segmentation demonstrate improved speckle-detail trade-offs, better preservation of fine anatomical structures, and practical value for subsequent image analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出自监督超声去斑框架 Mask2Restore，将去斑视为基于块掩码的上下文修复，并引入跨分辨率上下文正则化。
AI.motivation: 超声斑点来自组织相干散射，具有空间相关性和确定性，不同于自然图像中像素独立的噪声；现有盲点网络逐像素掩码假设噪声空间独立，不适用于多像素相关的超声斑点，且实际中无干净超声目标需自监督。
AI.method: 在单幅含噪图像上采用块状掩码，将去斑重构为上下文修复，使网络从邻近斑点相关性转向更广解剖上下文；并提出跨分辨率上下文正则化 CRCR，通过多分辨率预测一致性抑制残余斑点偏差。
AI.result: 在模拟与在体颈动脉超声、未见细结构案例及下游心脏分割任务上，方法改善了斑点-细节权衡，更好保留精细解剖结构，并对后续图像分析具有实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 块状掩码与跨分辨率一致性可更好匹配超声斑点的空间相关特性，提升自监督超声去斑的结构保持与下游任务表现。

title: Path Planning with Motion Primitives in Dynamic Environments: SIPP on Lattices
comment: Accepted to International Conference on Interactive Collaborative Robotics (ICR 2026), Vladivostok, Russia
summary: Autonomous navigation in dynamic environments is a critical challenge, particularly when spaces are shared with other mobile agents whose future trajectories are known. While traditional grid-based planners efficiently find collision-free paths, their reliance on stop-and-turn mechanics over $2^k$-connected grids produces piecewise-linear trajectories that are kinodynamically highly sub-optimal for differentially constrained robots. In this paper, we present an adaptation of Safe Interval Path Planning (SIPP) that operates on state lattices, utilizing precomputed, kinodynamically smooth motion primitives. To efficiently handle dynamic environments, we rasterize the spatiotemporal swept volumes of moving obstacles directly onto the grid, treating grid cells as atomic units of space, whose resolution is typically dictated by inherent localization noise. We perform a comprehensive comparative analysis between our lattice-based approach and $2^k$-connected grid planners across diverse topological environments. Our evaluation considers a broad spectrum of performance metrics, including planning time, path angularity, cumulative heading change (angle-over-length), and bending energy. The results demonstrate that while the expanded state space of lattice-based search increases computational overhead, it yields trajectories with significantly superior kinodynamic properties. Specifically, our method achieves a reachability comparable to highly connected grids while ensuring smooth, continuous, and physically executable paths ready for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种基于状态格的安全区间路径规划（SIPP）方法，通过预计算的平滑运动基元处理动态环境，并将移动障碍物的时空扫掠体栅格化到网格中，以生成适合差速约束机器人的平滑可执行轨迹。
AI.motivation: 传统基于2^k连通网格的规划器虽能高效找到无碰撞路径，但依赖停转机制，生成分段线性轨迹，对差速约束机器人而言运动学动力学高度次优。
AI.method: 将SIPP扩展到状态格上，使用预计算且运动学平滑的运动基元；将移动障碍物的时空扫掠体直接栅格化到网格，以网格单元为原子空间单位；在多种拓扑环境中，与2^k连通网格规划器比较规划时间、路径角度、累计航向变化和弯曲能等指标。
AI.result: 状态格搜索扩大了状态空间并增加计算开销，但生成的轨迹在运动学动力学性质上显著更优；该方法可达性与高连通网格相当，并能保证路径平滑、连续且物理可执行。
AI.conclusion: 基于状态格与SIPP的规划方法适合动态共享环境中的自主导航，可为差速约束机器人提供面向实际部署的平滑、连续且物理可执行的路径。

title: LLM-Guided Ontology-Driven Knowledge Graph Construction from Unstructured Text
summary: Ontology-driven knowledge graph construction from industrial text remains challenging due to the domain specificity of documents, the scarcity of annotated resources, and the complexity of ontology engineering workflows. This paper presents and investigates the applicability of an ontology learning pipeline that combines compact open-source Large Language Models (LLMs), reusable prompting strategies, and open knowledge bases to support the extraction, structuring, enrichment, and evaluation of knowledge from textual corpora. The approach is tested and evaluated on a private French corpus of power-grid incident reports, using locally deployable open-source LLMs ranging from 7B to 32B parameters. Starting from unstructured reports, the approach extracts entities and relations, generates RDF triples, constructs related OWL ontology, enriches it using external knowledge sources, assesses the quality of the ontology, and subsequently constructs a populated knowledge graph grounded in the resulting ontology schema. Experiments on 80 manually annotated private reports show that schema-guided prompting significantly improves extraction quality, while quantized models provide an effective trade-off between performance and computational cost. These results demonstrate the feasibility of transforming domain-specific industrial text into ontology-based knowledge graphs using locally deployed open-source LLMs, while supporting the generalization of the extraction process through reusable prompting strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估了一种本体学习流水线，结合紧凑开源大语言模型、可复用提示策略和开放知识库，从领域文本中抽取、结构化、丰富和评估知识，并构建基于本体的知识图谱。
AI.motivation: 工业文本的本体驱动知识图谱构建面临领域特定性强、标注资源稀缺以及本体工程流程复杂等挑战。
AI.method: 在私有法语电网事故报告语料上，使用7B至32B参数、可本地部署的开源LLM，从非结构化报告抽取实体和关系，生成RDF三元组，构建相关OWL本体，利用外部知识源丰富本体，评估本体质量，并基于本体模式构建填充的知识图谱。
AI.result: 在80份人工标注私有报告上的实验表明，模式引导提示显著提升抽取质量，量化模型在性能和计算成本之间提供了有效权衡。
AI.conclusion: 使用本地部署的开源LLM将领域特定工业文本转化为基于本体的知识图谱是可行的，可复用提示策略有助于抽取过程的泛化。

title: Working with AI: A Design Framework for Human-AI Collaboration
summary: Artificial Intelligence (AI), particularly GenAI, is becoming an increasingly important part of modern work. In industrial settings, AI can support decision-making, automate routine activities, assist humans, and improve productivity. However, successful AI adoption depends on more than what the technology can do. It also depends on how people experience and work with it. This raises an important question: how should human-AI collaboration be designed so that it works well for both people and organisations? This white paper addresses that question by presenting a practical framework for designing human-AI collaboration. The framework considers the human, the AI system, the task, the organisation, and the wider societal environment. It explains what effective collaboration looks like, what conditions influence it, what requirements should be met, and what design decisions organisations should consider. The report also includes a human-AI collaborative assembly system with cobot use case to demonstrate how the framework can be applied in practice. The use case shows how design requirements can be translated into specific collaboration features and evaluated through a case study. The aim of this white paper is to provide a clear and practical guide for designing human-AI collaboration that is effective, human-centred, and responsible.

AI.tldr: 该白皮书提出一个实用的人-AI协作设计框架，涵盖人、AI系统、任务、组织和社会环境，并通过协作装配与协作机器人用例展示其应用。
AI.motivation: AI尤其是GenAI在工业工作中日益重要，但成功采用不仅取决于技术能力，还取决于人们如何体验和与AI协作，因此需要明确如何设计对人、组织都有效的人-AI协作。
AI.method: 提出一个实践框架，分析有效协作的表现、影响因素、应满足的要求及组织应考虑的设计决策；并结合人-AI协作装配系统与cobot用例，将设计需求转化为具体协作功能并进行案例评估。
AI.result: 给出了可操作的人-AI协作设计框架，并通过用例展示如何把设计需求落地为协作功能，以及如何通过案例研究进行评价。
AI.conclusion: 该白皮书旨在为设计有效、以人为本且负责任的人-AI协作提供清晰、实用的指南。

title: One Evaluation, Any Operating Point: Hypernetwork-Amortized MeanFlow for 3D MRI Reconstruction
summary: Generative priors reconstruct accelerated 3D MRI well but pay heavily at deployment: tens of network evaluations per volume, and protocol-specific hyperparameter tuning. A third hidden cost is the scanner's fixed sampling pattern. We treat the whole operating point as an input. A 3D MeanFlow patch network (a one-step flow model) is fine-tuned end-to-end through a warm-started, five-iteration differentiable conjugate-gradient projection. A small hypernetwork maps the operating point (data-consistency weight, acceleration, and the Cartesian sampling pattern itself) to the network's per-channel modulation. Three findings follow. (i) Learning the acquisition is worth more than any other operating point: on clinical knee data, the learned mask gains up to +2.34 dB over the protocol's variable-density mask. This gain requires the solver: with a feed-forward reconstructor the same learned mask hurts at 4x (-1.7 dB), but with the data-consistency projection it adds +4.6 dB. (ii) One evaluation is highly effective: it beats a 20-step patch-diffusion prior by up to +3.1 dB on brain and +2.9 dB on knee. Three to five evaluations extend the front to +6 dB while using a quarter of the prior's network calls. (iii) Fully sampled targets are optional: trained self-supervised on a split of acquired samples, the reconstructor matches its supervised twin at 4x on real data. Finally, we report what failed and why: subject-adaptive acquisition from measured energy, combining self-supervision with learned acquisition, and amortising the data-consistency weight.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于3D MeanFlow补丁网络（单步流模型）的加速3D MRI重建方法，通过可微共轭梯度投影端到端微调，并利用超网络将操作点（数据一致性权重、加速倍数、采样模式）映射为网络调制。主要发现：学习采集模式收益最大，单次评估即可超越多步扩散先验，且自监督训练可匹配监督训练。
AI.motivation: 生成先验在加速3D MRI中重建效果好，但部署成本高：每个体积需数十次网络评估、协议特定的超参数调优，以及扫描仪固定的采样模式。本文旨在将整个操作点作为输入以降低这些成本。
AI.method: 采用3D MeanFlow补丁网络（单步流模型），通过热启动的五次迭代可微共轭梯度投影进行端到端微调。一个小型超网络将操作点（数据一致性权重、加速倍数和笛卡尔采样模式）映射到网络的逐通道调制。
AI.result: (i) 学习采集模式比任何其他操作点都更有价值：在临床膝关节数据上，学习到的掩膜比协议的可变密度掩膜提升高达+2.34 dB。这一增益需要求解器：使用前馈重建器时，相同学习掩膜在4倍加速下反而下降-1.7 dB，但使用数据一致性投影时提升+4.6 dB。(ii) 单次评估非常有效：在脑部提升高达+3.1 dB，膝关节+2.9 dB，超越20步补丁扩散先验。3至5次评估将前沿扩展至+6 dB，同时网络调用量仅为先验的四分之一。(iii) 全采样目标可选：在采集样本分割上自监督训练，重建器在4倍加速下与监督版本在真实数据上匹配。最后报告了失败案例及原因：基于测量能量的受试者自适应采集、将自监督与学习采集结合、以及摊销数据一致性权重。
AI.conclusion: 通过将操作点作为输入并端到端微调单步流模型，可以显著降低生成先验的部署成本，同时保持或提升重建质量。学习采集模式与数据一致性求解器结合带来最大收益，自监督可减少对全采样标签的依赖，但部分尝试如自适应采集和自监督结合学习采集未能成功。

title: Cross-Dataset Transfer and Unknown-Class Detection in Imbalanced SAR Ship Classification
summary: Ship classification from Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery is a critical computer vision task, yet the robustness of models under deployment shifts remains unclear. While models are often trained on one dataset and deployed on another, we lack a comprehensive understanding of their cross-dataset generalization. To address this, we evaluate six pretrained models on two SAR ship datasets in three settings: in-domain classification, cross-dataset transfer, and unknown-class detection. For unknown detection, we hold out all classes one at a time. In-domain, SARDet100K gives the best balanced accuracy on both datasets (73.4\% on FUSARShip and 53.2\% on OpenSARShip). In cross-dataset transfer, we observe strong failures: some models show moderate accuracy but near-chance balanced accuracy (for example, 64.5\% accuracy but 33.3\% balanced accuracy for OpenSARShip to FUSARShip). In unknown detection, performance depends on the held-out class and dataset, while MC-dropout variance is often close to random. These findings show that cross-dataset generalization in SAR remains limited and that task-specific uncertainty scores are often more informative than MC-dropout variance for held-out-class detection, although their relative ranking depends on the dataset and held-out class.

AI.tldr: 该论文评估了SAR船舶分类模型在域内、跨数据集迁移和未知类检测中的鲁棒性，发现跨数据集泛化能力有限，且MC-dropout方差对未知类检测常接近随机水平。
AI.motivation: SAR图像船舶分类在部署时常面临数据集偏移，但模型跨数据集泛化能力尚缺乏系统理解。
AI.method: 在FUSARShip和OpenSARShip两个SAR船舶数据集上，评估六种预训练模型，设置域内分类、跨数据集迁移和未知类检测三类任务；未知类检测采用逐一留出一类的方式，并比较平衡准确率与MC-dropout方差等不确定性指标。
AI.result: 域内任务中，SARDet100K在FUSARShip和OpenSARShip上取得最佳平衡准确率，分别为73.4%和53.2%。跨数据集迁移出现严重失败：部分模型准确率尚可但平衡准确率接近随机，例如OpenSARShip到FUSARShip为64.5%准确率、33.3%平衡准确率。未知类检测性能依赖留出类别和数据集，MC-dropout方差常接近随机。
AI.conclusion: SAR中的跨数据集泛化仍然有限；对于留出类检测，任务特定的不确定性分数通常比MC-dropout方差更有信息量，但其相对排序取决于数据集和留出类别。

title: Neural-Analytica Energy Functions for Power System Stability Analysis
summary: This letter proposes a novel form of energy function (EF), called neural-analytic EF, for the stability analysis of power systems. The neural-analytic EF is designed as the sum of neural networks (NNs)-based components and an analytic EF, with the structure informed by the existing EFs derived analytically. It thus integrates NN's expressivity with the generalizability and scalability of analytic EFs. The satisfactory neural-analytic EF is further derived by iterative NN training with a tailored loss function. Numerical results finally demonstrate its superiority.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种用于电力系统稳定性分析的神经-解析能量函数，将神经网络组件与解析能量函数结合，并通过定制损失函数迭代训练获得。
AI.motivation: 现有解析能量函数具有通用性和可扩展性但表达能力有限，而神经网络表达能力强却缺乏通用性和可扩展性，因此希望结合二者优势。
AI.method: 将能量函数设计为神经网络组件与解析能量函数之和，结构参考已有解析能量函数；采用迭代神经网络训练，并使用定制损失函数得到满意的神经-解析能量函数。
AI.result: 数值结果验证了所提神经-解析能量函数的优越性。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法将神经网络的表达能力与解析能量函数的通用性和可扩展性相结合，可用于电力系统稳定性分析。

title: Gen2-VC: Unlocking Generative Priors for Video Compression
summary: Under stringent bitrate constraints, existing video codecs struggle to balance source fidelity and perceptual realism. Distortion-oriented codecs often oversmooth details, while generative codecs risk introducing content and structural deviations and rely on codec-specific designs. This motivates a question: Can existing codecs achieve a better distortion--perception trade-off through simple, reusable adaptation? Our insight is that native codec reconstructions provide a shared interface through which generative refinement is anchored to source content while remaining decoupled from codec-specific representations. We therefore propose Gen2-VC, a generative video compression framework that enhances the outputs of learned and conventional codecs with a pretrained video prior, leaving their bitstreams and reference update processes unchanged. With the codec, VAE, and generative backbone frozen, lightweight LoRA adapters refine codec reconstruction through single-frame spatial adaptation followed by multi-frame temporal adaptation with the video prior. Using Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B, Gen2-VC-DCVC-UF outperforms previous leading codecs in LPIPS/DISTS and, to our knowledge, is the first generative video codec to surpass VTM-23.0 in both PSNR and MS-SSIM at low bitrates, based on BD-rates averaged over six datasets. Compared to VTM-23.0, it reduces bitrate by an average of 86.65% and 94.24% at matched LPIPS and DISTS, respectively. Adapters trained only on DCVC-UF improve perceptual quality on DCVC-RT, ECM, VTM, and HM without retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出Gen2-VC生成式视频压缩框架，利用预训练视频先验和轻量LoRA适配器增强现有编解码器输出，在不改变码流和参考更新的情况下实现更好的失真-感知权衡。
AI.motivation: 严格比特率约束下，现有视频编解码器难以平衡源保真度和感知真实感：失真导向编解码器过度平滑细节，生成式编解码器可能引入内容和结构偏差且依赖特定设计。因此探索能否通过简单可复用的适配让现有编解码器实现更好的失真-感知权衡。
AI.method: 以原生编解码器重建作为共享接口，将生成式细化锚定到源内容并与编解码器特定表示解耦。冻结编解码器、VAE和生成主干，仅用轻量LoRA适配器进行单帧空间适应，再结合视频先验进行多帧时间适应。使用Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B。
AI.result: Gen2-VC-DCVC-UF在LPIPS/DISTS上优于先前领先编解码器，是首个在低比特率下PSNR和MS-SSIM均超过VTM-23.0的生成式视频编解码器（基于六个数据集平均BD-rate）。相比VTM-23.0，在匹配LPIPS和DISTS时分别平均降低86.65%和94.24%比特率。仅在DCVC-UF上训练的适配器可提升DCVC-RT、ECM、VTM和HM的感知质量而无需重新训练。
AI.conclusion: 通过简单可复用的适配，现有编解码器可实现更好的失真-感知权衡，生成式细化能通用地增强多种编解码器。

title: Physics-Informed Learning of Feedback-Linearizing Representations
summary: Feedback linearization is a powerful tool in nonlinear control, but finding the linearizing coordinate transform remains challenging. Feedback linearizing transforms are governed by well-established partial differential equations (PDEs) whose well-posedness is based on the Lie-algebraic Frobenius theorem, but solving the PDEs becomes computationally intractable for large system dimensions. To address this challenge, we propose a cascaded physics-informed neural network (PINN) framework to approximately solve these PDEs. By separately parameterizing terms of different Lie derivative orders, we mitigate the compounding errors inherent in fitting high-order Lie derivatives of neural networks. Furthermore, we use the learned transform to design a tracking controller and establish theoretical bounds on its error with respect to inaccuracies in the learned feedback-linearizing representation. We validate our method on a broad class of feedback linearizable systems, including a multi-input, multi-output planar quadrotor and synthetic examples for which analytical approaches are impractical, and demonstrate that our approach can computationally discover effective feedback-linearizing representations of nonlinear systems for control tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种级联物理信息神经网络（PINN）框架，用于近似求解反馈线性化所需的偏微分方程，并基于学习到的变换设计跟踪控制器，在多个非线性系统上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 反馈线性化是非线性控制的重要工具，但其坐标变换由偏微分方程决定，高维系统中求解计算上不可行，因此需要可扩展的近似方法。
AI.method: 采用级联PINN分别参数化不同李导数阶数的项，以缓解高阶李导数拟合中的误差累积；利用学习到的反馈线性化变换设计跟踪控制器，并分析其相对于学习表示误差的理论误差界。
AI.result: 在广泛的一类反馈线性化系统上验证了方法，包括多输入多输出平面四旋翼和难以用解析方法处理的合成例子，表明该方法能计算发现有效的反馈线性化表示。
AI.conclusion: 级联PINN可有效近似反馈线性化变换并用于控制任务，为高维非线性系统的反馈线性化提供了一种计算可行的途径。

title: Humanoid Badminton: Learning Dynamic Racket Skills from Limited Human Motion Data
summary: High-speed racket sports provide a demanding testbed for humanoid robots, requiring time-critical decisions, precise striking, and dynamic whole-body coordination. In badminton, fast-changing shuttle trajectories require timely contact decisions, while successful returns demand precise racket pose and velocity within a brief contact window and across a broad three-dimensional striking workspace. Human motion data provide valuable priors for such athletic skills, but usable badminton references are limited and imperfect. Direct tracking provides insufficient executable variation for diverse shuttle conditions, while purely task-driven optimization may produce unnatural motion. To address these challenges, we present a three-stage hierarchical reinforcement learning framework for dynamic humanoid badminton. First, task-randomized motion augmentation expands sparse annotated hitting events into executable target-conditioned stroke variations, forming a continuous latent skill space. Second, a high-level planner outputs continuous latent skill codes to compose these skills online according to the observed shuttle state. Third, a context-conditioned adversarial regularizer encourages more natural planner-level skill usage while preserving return performance. When deployed on a real humanoid robot, our system achieves sustained multi-skill rallies with human players, including forehand, backhand, and highly dynamic jump returns. This is the first real-world humanoid racket-sport system to demonstrate multi-skill human--robot rallies including highly dynamic jump returns.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一个三阶段分层强化学习框架，用于实现真实人形机器人的动态羽毛球对打，能够完成正手、反手和跳跃回球等多技能连续回合。
AI.motivation: 高速球拍类运动对人形机器人提出时间决策、精准击球和全身动态协调的高要求；羽毛球中羽毛球轨迹变化快，需要在极短接触窗口内精确控制球拍位姿与速度。人类运动数据可提供先验，但可用的羽毛球参考有限且不完美：直接跟踪难以覆盖多样来球条件，而纯任务驱动优化又可能产生不自然动作。
AI.method: 提出三阶段分层强化学习框架：1）任务随机化运动增强，将稀疏标注击球事件扩展为目标条件化的可执行击球变化，形成连续潜技能空间；2）高层规划器根据观测到的羽毛球状态输出连续潜技能码，在线组合技能；3）上下文条件对抗正则器，在保持回球性能的同时，鼓励规划器层更自然地使用技能。
AI.result: 在真实人形机器人上部署后，系统能够与人类选手进行持续的多技能回合对打，包括正手、反手以及高动态跳跃回球。这是首个在真实世界中展示多技能人机球拍运动回合并包含高动态跳跃回球的人形机器人系统。
AI.conclusion: 该框架通过结合运动增强、分层技能规划和对抗正则，有效实现了真实人形机器人的动态羽毛球对打，证明其在高速球拍运动中的多技能、连续人机交互能力。

title: DriveHierarchy: A Benchmark for Diagnosing VLM Driving Capabilities from Open-Loop Understanding to Closed-Loop Execution
summary: Evaluating VLM-based autonomous driving remains difficult because driving competence is composite, where a capable system must ground traffic participants and hazards, integrate context across views and time, reason about future evolution, and act appropriately under closed-loop interaction. Existing benchmarks usually assess either open-loop understanding or closed-loop driving but provide limited structure for explaining how these abilities are organized, how they relate, and how they may inform model diagnosis and improvement. We present \textsc{DriveHierarchy}, a hierarchical benchmark that organizes VLM-based autonomous driving into four ranks, spanning perceptual grounding, contextual memory, mental reasoning, and closed-loop execution. To instantiate this hierarchy, we integrate multiple open-source autonomous-driving datasets into a unified open-loop benchmark with 76,798 question-answer pairs over 84,279 frames and develop a closed-loop simulation platform with interactive scenario construction on a real-world road network, from which 100 driving scenarios are curated for embodied evaluation. Experiments on 15 VLMs show that \textsc{DriveHierarchy} captures structured but non-redundant capability variation, relates open-loop understanding to closed-loop driving, and provides a practical basis for diagnosis and benchmark-guided optimization. \textsc{DriveHierarchy} therefore serves as a unified framework for evaluating and improving VLM-based autonomous driving systems. An anonymized project has been released on https://github.com/PerfectXu88/DriveHierarchy

AI.tldr: 提出 DriveHierarchy 分层基准，将 VLM 自动驾驶能力划分为感知 grounding、上下文记忆、心智推理和闭环执行四个等级，并结合开环问答与闭环仿真评估 15 个 VLM。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 自动驾驶评估基准多只关注开环理解或闭环驾驶，缺乏结构化框架来解释复合驾驶能力如何组织、如何相互关联，以及如何用于模型诊断与改进。
AI.method: 构建四级层次化基准；整合多个开源自动驾驶数据集形成统一开环基准，包含 84,279 帧上的 76,798 个问答对；基于真实路网开发闭环仿真平台，支持交互式场景构建，并精选 100 个驾驶场景用于具身评估；在 15 个 VLM 上进行实验。
AI.result: 实验表明 DriveHierarchy 能捕捉结构化且非冗余的能力差异，将开环理解与闭环驾驶表现关联起来，并为模型诊断和基准引导优化提供实用基础。
AI.conclusion: DriveHierarchy 可作为评估和改进基于 VLM 的自动驾驶系统的统一框架。

title: PHIRL: Aligning Learned Rewards with Task Progress for Inverse Reinforcement Learning
summary: Human demonstrations provide dense policy-level information but sometimes lack local precision. Human feedback presents accurate local critiques, but offers sparse evaluations rather than direct policy guidance. We propose Progress-Heuristicized Inverse Reinforcement Learning (PHIRL), a data-efficient framework that learns robust reward functions by jointly leveraging demonstrations and feedback. Specifically, we use progress, a feedback modality that describes cumulative task completion. PHIRL iteratively infers a reward function from demonstrations via inverse reinforcement learning, calculates the learned rewards over the progress-annotated demonstrations, and aligns the rewards with progress annotations over four dimensions. We evaluate PHIRL on real and simulated robot tasks, with additional exploration using a fine-tuned vision-language model to provide progress feedback.
