Results demonstrate that PHIRL significantly outperforms the baselines, achieving substantially higher environmental return rewards and task success with only twenty percent of demonstrations annotated. Analysis of reward-hacking scenarios demonstrates that PHIRL learned reward functions are reliable against exploitation.

AI.tldr: 提出PHIRL框架，结合人类演示与进度反馈，通过逆强化学习学习鲁棒奖励函数，在少量标注下显著提升机器人任务表现并抵抗奖励破解。
AI.motivation: 人类演示能提供密集的策略信息但局部精度不足；人类反馈能提供准确的局部评价但稀疏且不直接给出策略指导。因此需要一种方法联合利用两者优势。
AI.method: 提出Progress-Heuristicized Inverse Reinforcement Learning（PHIRL）。该方法利用描述任务累计完成度的“进度”反馈，迭代地通过逆强化学习从演示中推断奖励函数，计算进度标注演示上的学习奖励，并在四个维度上使奖励与进度标注对齐。在真实与模拟机器人任务上评估，并使用微调的视觉语言模型提供进度反馈。
AI.result: PHIRL显著优于基线，在仅20%演示被标注的情况下，取得更高的环境回报和任务成功率。对奖励破解场景的分析表明，PHIRL学到的奖励函数可靠且不易被利用。
AI.conclusion: 联合利用演示和进度反馈可以数据高效地学习鲁棒奖励函数，并提升任务成功率和抗奖励破解能力。

title: ForensicZoom: Adaptive Visual Inspection with Multimodal LLMs for Industrial-Grade Face Forgery Detection
summary: Reliable face forgery detection is critical to the security of online identity verification systems, where missed attacks compromise security and excessive false positives disrupt legitimate users. Specialized forensic detectors achieve strong detection performance but provide limited interpretability, while multimodal large language models (MLLMs) offer strong semantic understanding and interpretable reasoning yet remain substantially weaker for face forgery detection. We argue that a key limitation lies in how visual evidence is acquired: subtle forensic artifacts may be poorly represented at standard resolution, while uniformly processing all cases at higher resolution is computationally inefficient. We therefore introduce ForensicZoom, an industrial-grade MLLM framework for adaptive visual inspection. ForensicZoom first equips a general-purpose MLLM with forensic-aware visual representations and aligns the language model with these features. Its central mechanism, NEED_ZOOM, enables the model to autonomously request magnified views of suspicious regions when the initial evidence is insufficient, turning fixed-pass classification into adaptive multi-round forensic reasoning. The zoom behavior is learned through reward shaping that balances detection accuracy with unnecessary visual inspection, concentrating additional computation on difficult cases. A final attribution optimization stage improves natural-language forensic reports while preserving detection performance. On large-scale industrial identity verification data, ForensicZoom achieves over 97% TPR at 0.1% FPR, substantially outperforming both specialized detectors and existing MLLM-based methods while producing actionable forensic attributions. These results demonstrate that ForensicZoom can provide an effective path toward accurate, interpretable, and scalable MLLM-based face forgery detection.

AI.tldr: 提出ForensicZoom，一个面向人脸伪造检测的工业级MLLM自适应视觉检测框架。其核心机制NEED_ZOOM允许模型在初始证据不足时自主请求放大可疑区域，实现多轮取证推理。在大规模工业数据上，以0.1% FPR达到超过97%的TPR，显著优于专用检测器和现有MLLM方法，并生成可操作的取证归因。
AI.motivation: 在线身份验证系统需要可靠的人脸伪造检测：漏检会危害安全，误报过多会干扰合法用户。专用取证检测器性能强但可解释性有限；多模态大语言模型（MLLM）语义理解和可解释推理强，但人脸伪造检测能力明显较弱。作者认为关键限制在于视觉证据的获取方式：标准分辨率下细微取证痕迹表征不佳，而统一高分辨率处理所有样本计算效率低。
AI.method: ForensicZoom先为通用MLLM配备取证感知的视觉表征，并将语言模型与这些特征对齐。核心机制NEED_ZOOM使模型能在初始证据不足时自主请求放大可疑区域，将固定单次分类转变为自适应多轮取证推理。缩放行为通过奖励塑形学习，平衡检测准确率与不必要的视觉检查，将额外计算集中在困难案例上。最后通过归因优化阶段提升自然语言取证报告质量，同时保持检测性能。
AI.result: 在大规模工业身份验证数据上，ForensicZoom在0.1%假阳性率下达到超过97%的真阳性率，大幅超越专用检测器和现有基于MLLM的方法，同时能生成可操作的取证归因。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，ForensicZoom为准确、可解释且可扩展的基于MLLM的人脸伪造检测提供了一条有效路径。

title: Memory- and Bandwidth-Efficient SPAD-LiDAR Ranging via Coarse-to-Fine Spline Sketching
summary: This work presents an optimized compression framework for direct time-of-flight (dToF) light detection and ranging (LiDAR), using an accurate, compact timestamp-encoding strategy to address the high data-rate bottleneck from single-photon timing information in single-photon avalanche diode (SPAD) arrays. We propose a hardware-friendly timestamp-to-depth framework in which a sparse single-photon encoding strategy, namely coarse-to-fine spline sketches (CFSS), projects photon timestamps into fine-grained, low-dimensional representations, called sketch values. CFSS converts timestamps on-the-fly to sketch values and accumulates them with lower memory consumption, without constructing histograms, thereby saving on-chip/device memory. CFSS's closed-form solution for ToF retrieval ensures iteration-free reconstruction. Compared with the conventional sketched-LiDAR framework, the proposed method retains the same compression ratio in the single-peak case, ranging from hundreds$\times$ to thousands$\times$ depending on the accuracy-complexity trade-off, while improving depth-estimation accuracy. Both synthetic and real datasets are used to validate the performance. The CFSS framework is further extended to two-peak scenarios, enabling recovery of objects obscured by partially occluding camouflage and uniformly scattering semi-transparent media. Firmware implementation is also investigated by clearly separating online hardware processing from offline software workloads.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种用于直接飞行时间（dToF）LiDAR的优化压缩框架，通过紧凑的时间戳编码策略缓解SPAD阵列中单光子计时信息带来的高数据率瓶颈。
AI.motivation: SPAD阵列dToF LiDAR中单光子时间戳数据量巨大，传统直方图方法存在高数据率和片上/设备内存消耗问题，因此需要硬件友好、高压缩且高精度的深度估计方案。
AI.method: 提出硬件友好的时间戳到深度框架，采用稀疏单光子编码策略“由粗到细样条草图”（CFSS），将光子时间戳实时投影为低维草图值并累加，无需构建直方图，降低内存消耗；利用闭式解实现无迭代ToF重建，并扩展到双峰场景；同时研究固件实现，区分在线硬件处理与离线软件工作负载。
AI.result: 在单峰场景下，与常规sketched-LiDAR框架相比，CFSS保持数百倍至数千倍的压缩比（取决于精度-复杂度权衡），同时提升深度估计精度；合成和真实数据集验证了性能；双峰扩展可恢复被部分遮挡伪装和均匀散射半透明介质遮蔽的物体。
AI.conclusion: CFSS是一种有效且硬件友好的dToF LiDAR压缩与深度估计方法，能在保持高压缩比的同时提高精度，并具备处理多峰场景和固件部署的潜力。

title: What Drives Dialectal Jailbreaks? An Ablation of Surface Form, Cultural Framing, and Strategy Banks
comment: Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing 2026, 15 pages, 12 tables
summary: Recent work suggests that obscure language registers can weaken large language model refusal behavior, especially when paired with black-box prompt optimization. It remains unclear whether failures stem from non-standard surface form, culturally grounded framing, or optimization over an expressive prompt-strategy space. We study Chinese registers by extending a classical-Chinese red-teaming framework to Shanghainese and Cantonese and running a 36-cell ablation across surface forms, strategy-bank variants, and two target models. The main finding is corrective: dialectal surface form is neither necessary nor sufficient for high attack success. Non-optimized English, Mandarin, and naive dialect translations remain below 8\% attack success rate, whereas all conditions that retain an optimizer-controlled strategy bank reach 98--100\%. A culture-neutral generic strategy bank reaches the same ceiling at near-single-query cost, further indicating that strategy-bank expressiveness, rather than dialectal or cultural content, accounts for most of the observed effect. Dialect choice still affects query efficiency and response severity, and qualitative coding identifies recurring high-level mechanisms such as semantic glossing and procedural scaffolding. We qualify the absolute ceiling-level attack success rate by showing sensitivity to judge calibration and noting that the design does not fully separate one-shot strategy construction from iterative search.

AI.tldr: 研究通过将文言文红队框架扩展到上海话和粤语，进行36格消融实验，发现方言表面形式并非高攻击成功率的关键，优化器控制的策略库的表达性才是主要因素。
AI.motivation: 先前工作表明晦涩语言寄存器可削弱大语言模型的拒绝行为，但尚不清楚失败源于非标准表面形式、文化背景框架还是优化策略空间的表达性。
AI.method: 将古典中文红队框架扩展到上海话和粤语，运行36格消融实验，涵盖表面形式、策略库变体和两个目标模型，并进行定性编码。
AI.result: 非优化条件下（英语、普通话、简单方言翻译）攻击成功率低于8%；所有保留优化器控制策略库的条件达到98-100%。文化中性通用策略库也能以近单次查询成本达到相同上限。方言选择影响查询效率和响应严重性，定性编码识别出语义注释和程序性脚手架等机制。结果对评判校准敏感，且未完全分离一次性策略构建与迭代搜索。
AI.conclusion: 策略库的表达性而非方言或文化内容解释了大部分攻击效果。方言表面形式既非必要也非充分。需谨慎对待绝对攻击成功率，并进一步区分策略构建与搜索。

title: LLM Judge Validation Under Sparse Overlap: From Inference to Design
summary: Validating an LLM-as-a-judge requires estimating its agreement with humans, yet annotation budgets rarely allow every item to be multiply labeled. We prove that this \emph{overlap sparsity} is the first-order determinant of wrong deployment decisions: at 5\% pairwise overlap, wrong-decision rates reach 25\% and the probability of selecting the wrong best judge among ten candidates is 65\%. The two actionable levers are overlap \emph{quantity} and \emph{allocation}. For quantity, we derive a minimum-overlap formula showing $ρ\geq 0.25$ suffices for non-borderline judges while borderline cases remain fundamentally hard. For allocation, a zero-cost stratified scheme halves false-rejection rates relative to random sampling when strata are informative. We validate on 10 LLM judges across four evaluation matrices spanning visual assessment, causal reasoning, and summarization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM-as-a-judge验证中标注重叠稀疏的问题，证明其会显著影响部署决策，并提出重叠数量与分配两方面的改进策略。
AI.motivation: 验证LLM评判器需要估计其与人类的一致性，但标注预算通常不足以对每个样本进行多次标注，导致重叠稀疏，从而可能引发错误的部署决策。
AI.method: 作者从理论上分析重叠稀疏对错误决策的影响，推导最小重叠公式；提出零成本分层分配方案；并在10个LLM评判器和4个评估矩阵（视觉评估、因果推理、摘要）上进行验证。
AI.result: 在5%成对重叠下，错误决策率达25%，在10个候选评判器中选择错误最佳评判器的概率为65%；重叠率ρ≥0.25足以应对非边界评判器，但边界案例仍很难；当分层信息有效时，分层方案可将错误拒绝率相对随机采样减半。
AI.conclusion: 标注重叠的稀疏性与分配方式是LLM评判器验证中决定部署决策正确与否的首要因素；提高重叠数量并采用分层分配可显著降低错误率，但边界案例仍是根本性挑战。

title: Age-Adaptive Handwriting Reconstruction from an IMU-Based Digital Pen through Shared Representations and Domain-Specific Heads
summary: Digital pens are widely used to capture handwriting on digital devices, enabling precise trace recording and enhancing human-computer interaction. However, most are bundled with tablets and lack cross-brand compatibility. Recent digital pens equipped with kinematic sensors have emerged, designed for use on any surface. This especially opens significant potential for supporting handwriting acquisition in classrooms.  Handwriting reconstruction from such an IMU-equipped pen poses a challenge due to the significant variability in sensor signals between adults and children. Even when producing visually similar traces, variations in writing dynamics, motor control, pen holding, and user confidence introduce substantial discrepancies in the captured signals. Additionally, the high variability in children's handwriting requires collecting large amounts of data, which is not feasible to implement in a school environment at scale. Furthermore, models trained exclusively on adult data fail to generalize to children's handwriting, and conversely, models trained on children's data perform poorly on adult writers. This crosspopulation degradation highlights the need for a unified model that can be deployed directly on the pen, without any user-specific adaptation. To address this issue, we propose a cross-domain learning, using an original neural network architecture based on a Temporal Convolutional Network and multiple prediction heads. The model is designed to be robust across age groups by leveraging shared features while effectively handling variability induced by differences in graphomotor development. This approach aims to improve handwriting trace reconstruction from sensor data, where each domain benefits from additional data provided by the other domain.

AI.tldr: 本文针对配备IMU的数字笔在手写轨迹重建中成人与儿童书写信号差异大、跨群体泛化差的问题，提出一种基于时间卷积网络和多预测头的跨域学习模型，旨在无需用户自适应的情况下实现跨年龄组的鲁棒手写轨迹重建。
AI.motivation: 大多数数字笔与平板绑定且缺乏跨品牌兼容性；新型IMU数字笔可在任意表面使用，适合课堂手写采集，但成人与儿童在书写动态、运动控制、握笔和自信度等方面差异显著，导致传感器信号分布不同。儿童手写变异性高，难以在学校大规模采集数据；仅用成人数据训练难以泛化到儿童，反之亦然。因此需要可直接部署于笔端、无需用户特定适配的统一模型。
AI.method: 提出跨域学习方法，采用基于时间卷积网络（TCN）的神经网络架构，并设计多个预测头。模型通过共享特征学习跨年龄组的共同表示，同时处理因书写运动发育差异带来的信号变异性，并利用成人与儿童两个域的数据互补来提升轨迹重建性能。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体定量实验结果；作者指出该方法旨在改善基于传感器数据的手写轨迹重建，使每个域都能从另一域提供的额外数据中受益，并实现无需用户特定适配的跨年龄组鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究提出一种面向IMU数字笔的跨域手写轨迹重建框架，利用TCN与多头预测结构统一建模成人和儿童书写信号，缓解跨群体泛化退化问题，并有望支持课堂环境下更便捷的手写采集与交互。

title: Learning Steadily: Accumulating Relative Point Margin Scores for Face Image Quality Assessment
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Transactions on Biometrics, Behavior, and Identity Science
summary: Face Image Quality Assessment determines the suitability of captured face images for automated face recognition (FR), a critical capability for reliable biometric systems. Existing state-of-the-art FR-integrated FIQA methods suffer from temporal instability: as the feature space evolves during training, single-epoch quality estimates fluctuate, creating a moving target that undermines reliable quality prediction. We introduce CARPM-FIQA, a stabilization strategy for FR-integrated FIQA that accumulates relative point margin measurements, the ratio between intra-class compactness and inter-class separation, across the entire training trajectory rather than relying on single-epoch estimates. This cumulative averaging approach provides theoretically grounded advantages: reduced variance in quality estimates, improved mean squared error, and enhanced ranking stability with convergence guarantees as training progresses. Through controlled experiments on the SynFIQA dataset with labeled quality groups, we demonstrate that cumulative averaging achieves superior discriminative ability, and ablation studies across different training configurations confirm consistent improvements. Evaluated against twelve FIQA methods on eight challenging benchmarks with four FR models at two FMR thresholds, CARPM-FIQA places 4th (CARPM-FIQA(L)) and 6th (CARPM-FIQA(S)) of 17 compared methods by pAUC-EDC and AUC-EDC averaged across FR models and, after per-benchmark normalization, across benchmarks, staying within a few percent of the best method's normalized average for every FR model, providing a principled solution to training instability while maintaining the performance benefits of FR integration. More broadly, our work demonstrates that temporal aggregation strategies can stabilize training objectives in deep learning systems where target values inherently fluctuate due to evolving feature representations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CARPM-FIQA，通过累计训练全程的相对点间隔测量来稳定 FR 集成式人脸图像质量评估，缓解训练中质量估计随特征空间变化而波动的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有 FR 集成式 FIQA 方法存在时间不稳定性：训练过程中特征空间不断演化，单 epoch 质量估计会波动，形成移动目标，损害可靠的质量预测。
AI.method: CARPM-FIQA 累积相对点间隔测量，即类内紧凑性与类间分离度之比，不依赖单 epoch 估计，而是对整条训练轨迹进行累计平均。论文在 SynFIQA 数据集上做控制实验与消融实验，并在 8 个基准、4 个 FR 模型、2 个 FMR 阈值下与 12 种 FIQA 方法比较，使用 pAUC-EDC 和 AUC-EDC 评估。
AI.result: 累计平均可降低质量估计方差、改善均方误差并增强排序稳定性。CARPM-FIQA(L) 和 CARPM-FIQA(S) 在 17 种方法中分别排名第 4 和第 6（按跨 FR 模型平均及按基准归一化后的 pAUC-EDC/AUC-EDC），对每个 FR 模型均接近最佳方法归一化平均值的几个百分点以内。
AI.conclusion: CARPM-FIQA 为训练不稳定性提供了有原则的解决方案，同时保留 FR 集成的性能优势。更广泛地，时间聚合策略可稳定深度学习中因特征表示演化而导致目标值波动的训练目标。

title: PanOVOcc: Panoramic Embodied Open-Vocabulary Occupancy Mapping with Long-term Spatial Voxel Memory
comment: The source code and the established benchmarks will be available at https://github.com/bakereet/PanOVOcc
summary: Persistent semantic occupancy mapping is essential for embodied scene understanding. However, perspective-based systems provide limited spatial coverage, while existing panoramic methods primarily predict local volumes from single observations. We introduce PanOVOcc, a training-free framework for persistent open-vocabulary semantic occupancy mapping from panoramic sequences. PanOVOcc unifies panoramic SLAM, open-vocabulary perception, and long-term spatial voxel memory within an online architecture, continuously integrating geometric and semantic evidence into a global, language-queryable map. To facilitate systematic evaluation of this setting, we establish Pan-Replica and Pan-Holo360D, two benchmarks pairing continuous panoramic RGB-D sequences with scene-level semantic occupancy ground truth across synthetic and real-world scenes. Compared with the strongest evaluated baseline for each metric, PanOVOcc improves occupancy IoU and semantic mIoU by absolute +20.03 and +7.06 on Pan-Replica, and by +43.26 and +20.16 on Pan-Holo360D, respectively. The source code and the established benchmarks will be available at https://github.com/bakereet/PanOVOcc.

AI.tldr: PanOVOcc 是一个无需训练的全景开放词汇语义占用建图框架，统一全景SLAM、开放词汇感知和长期体素记忆，构建全局可语言查询地图，并建立了两个评测基准。
AI.motivation: 持久语义占用建图对具身场景理解至关重要，但透视系统空间覆盖有限，现有全景方法多仅从单次观测预测局部体素，缺乏长期全局开放词汇建图能力。
AI.method: 提出 PanOVOcc，无需训练，在线统一全景SLAM、开放词汇感知与长期空间体素记忆，持续融合几何和语义证据到全局地图；同时构建 Pan-Replica 和 Pan-Holo360D 两个全景RGB-D序列与场景级语义占用真值配对的基准。
AI.result: 相比各指标最强基线，PanOVOcc 在 Pan-Replica 上占用IoU和语义mIoU分别绝对提升 +20.03 和 +7.06，在 Pan-Holo360D 上分别提升 +43.26 和 +20.16。
AI.conclusion: PanOVOcc 能实现持久开放词汇全景语义占用建图，在合成与真实场景基准上显著优于现有方法，代码与基准将开源。

title: An Evaluation of AI-Supported Evidence-Based Learning for Public Speaking Skill Development
comment: Proceedings of the 54th Annual Conference of the European Society for Engineering Education (SEFI 2026)
summary: Public speaking is an essential skill in academic and professional contexts, but it often causes anxiety. Although several AI-based speech coaching tools exist, they typically provide generic feedback and lack model speeches for learning. This study addresses these gaps by developing a system that incorporates speech context into evaluation criteria, enabling more tailored feedback. It also generates improved model speeches in both text and audio formats to support example-based learning. The system was evaluated in a pilot study with seven undergraduate students over one to three weeks. Participants used the system repeatedly and practiced the same speech at least three times. Results showed improvements in public speaking performance for all participants. Filler word usage decreased, and anxiety levels dropped by 15.3% to 34.4%. Participants found the context-aware feedback and revised speeches useful and confidence-building. These findings suggest that context-aware feedback and model speeches can enhance public speaking skills and reduce anxiety. Future studies could explore video-based analysis of physical behavior during speeches.

AI.tldr: 该研究开发了一个结合演讲语境进行评价并提供改进版文本与音频范例演讲的系统，并通过7名本科生1至3周的试点研究验证其效果。
AI.motivation: 公开演讲很重要但常引发焦虑，现有AI演讲辅导工具多提供通用反馈且缺少可供学习的范例演讲。
AI.method: 将演讲语境纳入评价标准以提供个性化反馈，并生成改进后的文本和音频范例演讲；招募7名本科生进行1至3周试点，重复使用系统并至少练习同一演讲3次。
AI.result: 所有参与者公开演讲表现均有提升，填充词使用减少，焦虑水平下降15.3%至34.4%；参与者认为语境感知反馈和修订演讲有用并能增强信心。
AI.conclusion: 语境感知反馈与范例演讲可提升公开演讲技能并降低焦虑；未来可探索演讲中身体行为的视频分析。

title: Neural ODEs Meet Concurrent Learning: Stable Online Learning with Lyapunov Guarantees
summary: Neural ODEs learn dynamics from trajectory losses, but their adjoint gradients lack the regressor-times-parameter-error structure on which Lyapunov analyses of online adaptation rest, so training on streaming data comes without stability guarantees. We show that this structure is in fact present: the adjoint gradient decomposes exactly into a positive semi-definite trajectory operator acting on the parameter error plus a nonlinear perturbation with explicit, horizon-dependent bounds. A quadratic Lyapunov function then certifies online Neural ODE training over sliding windows under computable gain and horizon conditions, and the same certificate extends to stored data: its drift branch recovers concurrent learning, and its trajectory branch yields NODE-CL, a stored-segment Gauss-Newton method built on batched forward sensitivities that needs no state-derivative estimates. On four DeepMind Control Suite domains, NODE-CL attains the lowest median prediction error on three under velocity measurement noise, where observer-based concurrent learning degrades by up to 8x; with clean measurements it is best on the pendulum and within a factor of 1.6 of the best stored-data baseline on the cartpole and reacher.

AI.tldr: 该论文为在线 Neural ODE 训练建立 Lyapunov 稳定性保证，并提出基于存储片段的 Gauss-Newton 方法 NODE-CL，在多个控制任务中优于或接近现有基线。
AI.motivation: Neural ODE 从轨迹损失学习动力学，但其伴随梯度缺乏在线自适应 Lyapunov 分析所需的“回归量乘以参数误差”结构，导致流式数据训练缺乏稳定性保证。
AI.method: 证明伴随梯度可精确分解为作用于参数误差的半正定轨迹算子与具有显式时域相关界的非线性扰动；用二次 Lyapunov 函数在可计算增益和时域条件下证明滑动窗口在线训练稳定性；将证书扩展到存储数据，其漂移分支恢复 concurrent learning，轨迹分支导出 NODE-CL——基于批量前向敏感度、无需状态导数估计的存储片段 Gauss-Newton 方法。
AI.result: 在四个 DeepMind Control Suite 域上，速度测量噪声下 NODE-CL 在三个域取得最低中位预测误差，而基于观测器的 concurrent learning 性能最多下降 8 倍；干净测量下，在 pendulum 上最优，在 cartpole 和 reacher 上达到最佳存储数据基线 1.6 倍以内。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为在线 Neural ODE 训练提供了可计算的稳定性证书，并给出了实用且鲁棒的 NODE-CL 训练方法，验证了理论分解与稳定性分析的有效性。

title: PanoFuse: Panorama-Enhanced Vision-Language-Action Learning with Decoupled Semantic-Geometric Routing
comment: Code and data will be released publicly at https://xux-hnu.github.io/PanoFuse
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies have shown promising performance in language-conditioned robotic manipulation. However, most existing VLA systems rely on conventional perspective cameras with limited fields of view, often missing global scene context and leading to unreliable manipulation under visual occlusions, distractors, and unseen environments. In this work, we propose PanoFuse, a panorama-enhanced VLA framework that complements local manipulation observations with global panoramic perception. PanoFuse introduces a dedicated panoramic branch that leverages a pretrained panoramic foundation model to extract complementary semantic and geometric representations from omnidirectional observations. Rather than directly mixing these heterogeneous features, we introduce Decoupled Semantic-Geometric Routing (DSGR), which maintains semantic and geometric representations as separate context streams and selectively routes both to downstream state and action representations through structured block-wise attention. This design provides the action expert with global spatial context while preserving task-relevant semantic information from the pretrained VLA backbone. We further develop a synchronized data collection pipeline and construct a new real-world manipulation dataset containing panoramic RGB observations, wrist-view images, language instructions, robot states, and actions. Across seven evaluation settings, PanoFuse achieves an average success rate of 52.9%, outperforming the evaluated baselines and achieving consistent gains under novel-object, unseen-background, and distractor-rich settings. Code and data will be released publicly at https://xux-hnu.github.io/PanoFuse.

AI.tldr: 提出PanoFuse，一种融合全景感知的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）框架，通过全景分支和语义-几何解耦路由增强机器人在遮挡、干扰物和未知环境下的操作能力。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略多依赖视野有限的传统透视相机，缺乏全局场景上下文，导致在视觉遮挡、干扰物和未见环境下操作不可靠。
AI.method: 构建全景增强VLA框架：引入基于预训练全景基础模型的全景分支提取语义与几何表示；提出解耦语义-几何路由（DSGR），将语义和几何作为独立上下文流，通过结构化分块注意力选择性路由至下游状态和动作表示；同时开发同步数据采集管道并构建包含全景RGB、腕部图像、语言指令、机器人状态和动作的真实世界操作数据集。
AI.result: 在七种评估设置下平均成功率达52.9%，优于所评估基线，并在新物体、未见背景和干扰物丰富场景下取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: PanoFuse通过全局全景感知与解耦路由有效补充局部操作观测，提升VLA策略的鲁棒性和泛化能力，代码与数据将公开。

title: Efficient Bezier Velocity Optimization for Free-Floating Space Manipulators
summary: We present FAVOR (Free-floating Arm Velocity Optimization with Recursive Sensitivities), a planner for collision-free reaching, tracking, and prescribed-time pre-grasp interception on an unactuated spacecraft. It optimizes Bezier joint-velocity curves with linear velocity, acceleration, and continuity constraints. Decision dimension is independent of rollout resolution. Analytical recursive sensitivities provide task and clearance gradients through the coupled base-arm motion. Parallel evaluation, caching, and incremental collision discovery reduce computation. With a seven-DoF arm and five simulated spacecraft models, FAVOR achieves 99.8% point-to-point success with 1.779 s mean computation, versus 62.9% and 50.270 s for an IK-initialized position-spline baseline. Means include failures and timeouts. FAVOR completes 30 of 36 tracking cases, versus 15 for single-step QP, and all 36 interception instances, versus 22 for the spline baseline. A controlled ablation shows that finite differences increase mean planning time 4.7-fold.

AI.tldr: 提出FAVOR规划器，用于无驱动航天器上机械臂的无碰撞到达、跟踪和规定时间预抓取拦截，通过优化贝塞尔关节速度曲线实现高效规划。
AI.motivation: 在无驱动航天器上，机械臂运动与基座耦合，传统规划方法计算慢、成功率低，难以满足碰撞避免、跟踪和规定时间拦截等任务需求。
AI.method: FAVOR优化带线性速度、加速度和连续性约束的贝塞尔关节速度曲线；决策维度独立于滚动分辨率；利用解析递归敏感度计算任务与间隙梯度；并通过并行评估、缓存和增量碰撞发现降低计算量。
AI.result: 在七自由度机械臂和五种模拟航天器模型上，点到点任务成功率达99.8%，平均计算时间1.779秒，而IK初始化位置样条基线为62.9%和50.270秒；跟踪任务完成30/36，优于单步QP的15；拦截任务完成36/36，优于样条基线的22；消融实验显示有限差分使平均规划时间增加4.7倍。
AI.conclusion: FAVOR能有效且高效地处理自由漂浮机械臂的到达、跟踪和拦截规划，解析递归敏感度与并行/缓存/增量碰撞发现显著提升性能。

title: The Temporal Tug-of-War: Visualizing and Detecting RAG Conflicts in Diffusion Models via Trajectory Variance
comment: Accepted at the UncertaiNLP Workshop at EMNLP 2026
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) introduces a specific failure mode in discrete diffusion language models: when retrieved context contradicts parametric knowledge, the iterative denoising process becomes a visible battleground between competing knowledge sources. We identify temporal semantic divergence as an observable for detecting these conflicts and introduce the Trajectory Variance Score (TVS), a simple and interpretable measure of this divergence. TVS computes the mean pairwise cosine distance of answer embeddings across independent stochastic denoising trajectories, capturing the temporal tug of war between parametric and contextual attractors. Requiring as few as two parallel inference runs, TVS is computationally lightweight. Across four diverse datasets (Synthetic, SciQ, PopQA, and CounterFact), a simple Logistic Regression classifier using TVS achieves $70.10\%$ accuracy and $0.7647$ AUROC on LLaDA. On Dream 7B, increasing the number of trajectories from two to five improves accuracy from $63.91\%$ to $69.62\%$. More complex sequential models provide only marginal improvements over the linear classifier. Evaluation across LLaDA and Dream 7B demonstrates that conflict-induced trajectory dynamics and their key properties transfer across distinct diffusion architectures.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了离散扩散语言模型在检索增强生成中，当检索上下文与参数知识冲突时出现的迭代去噪轨迹分歧，并提出轨迹方差分数（TVS）来检测此类知识冲突。
AI.motivation: 在RAG中，检索上下文可能与此前学到的参数知识相矛盾，导致离散扩散模型的迭代去噪过程成为不同知识来源竞争的过程；作者希望找到一种可观测、简单且可解释的冲突检测信号。
AI.method: 作者识别出时间语义分歧这一现象，提出TVS：计算多个独立随机去噪轨迹所得答案嵌入之间的平均成对余弦距离，以刻画参数知识与上下文吸引子之间的动态拉扯。TVS仅需两次并行推理，计算开销低，并用逻辑回归分类器进行冲突检测评估。
AI.result: 在Synthetic、SciQ、PopQA和CounterFact四个数据集上，基于TVS的逻辑回归分类器在LLaDA上达到70.10%准确率和0.7647 AUROC；在Dream 7B上，将轨迹数从2增加到5使准确率从63.91%提升至69.62%；更复杂的序列模型仅带来边际提升。
AI.conclusion: 冲突引发的轨迹动态及其关键性质可在LLaDA和Dream 7B等不同扩散架构之间迁移，表明TVS是一种轻量、可解释且跨架构有效的知识冲突检测方法。

title: Differentiable Dynamics for Autonomous Micro-Mobility Navigation
summary: Autonomous micro-mobility vehicles (MMVs) such as wheelchairs, scooters, and bicycles have the potential to improve mobility access and support safe low-speed transportation in pedestrian-shared spaces. Achieving MMV autonomy will require realistic, predictable MMV motion. However, many existing autonomous vehicle stacks rely on simplified kinematic models that fail to capture key MMV characteristics such as tire slip, friction, and wheel layouts, limiting realism and gradient-based optimization. In this paper, we explore differentiable formulations of dynamics models for autonomous micro-mobility systems. We first construct DiffKBM, a differentiable version of the kinematic bicycle model (KBM). Then, we introduce DiffGM3, a differentiable formulation of the General Micro-Mobility Model (GM3), a unified tire-based dynamics formulation for micro-mobility vehicles that supports a wide range of MMV configurations. DiffKBM and DiffGM3 enable end-to-end differentiable optimization through MMV dynamics, making them suitable for integration into differentiable autonomy stacks. We evaluate these dynamics models in both open-loop and closed-loop settings: (1) open-loop trajectory matching, where DiffKBM and DiffGM3 are integrated as a dynamics layer within DiffStack and optimized to reproduce real-world MMV trajectories, and (2) closed-loop autonomous navigation, where DiffKBM and DiffGM3 are paired with a differentiable MPC controller in CrowdNav pedestrian scenarios. In the open-loop setting, DiffGM3 outperforms DiffKBM in reproducing trajectories with improvements in ADE and NLL across bicycle, scooter, and motorcycle modes, and reductions in planning loss for bicycle and motorcycle trajectories. We also find that, in closed-loop settings, DiffGM3 improves on DiffKBM's CrowdNav performance by producing 55\% fewer collisions and a 75\% lower discomfort frequency for the bicycle mode.

AI.tldr: 本文研究面向自动驾驶微出行车辆（如轮椅、滑板车、自行车）的可微动力学模型，提出 DiffKBM 和 DiffGM3，并在开环轨迹匹配与闭环导航中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有自动驾驶栈多采用简化运动学模型，难以捕捉微出行车辆的关键特性，如轮胎滑移、摩擦和车轮布局，限制真实性与基于梯度的优化。
AI.method: 构建可微的运动学自行车模型 DiffKBM；进一步提出可微的通用微出行模型 DiffGM3，支持多种微出行车辆配置。将两者作为动力学层集成到 DiffStack 进行开环轨迹匹配，并与可微 MPC 控制器结合在 CrowdNav 行人场景中进行闭环自主导航。
AI.result: 开环轨迹匹配中，DiffGM3 在自行车、滑板车和摩托车模式下比 DiffKBM 有更优的 ADE 和 NLL，并降低自行车和摩托车轨迹的规划损失；闭环 CrowdNav 中，DiffGM3 在自行车模式下碰撞减少 55%，不适频率降低 75%。
AI.conclusion: 可微的微出行动力学模型能提升真实性和优化能力，DiffGM3 相比 DiffKBM 在轨迹重现与闭环导航安全舒适性方面表现更好，适合集成到可微自动驾驶栈中。

title: Query-aligned video frame selection for long video understanding
summary:
Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) process multimodal inputs by converting text, images, and videos into token sequences that are subsequently processed by a backbone language model. While MLLMs have achieved excellent performance in understanding the content of individual images, video understanding remains significantly more difficult because videos contain large number of video frames. MLLMs typically process only a subset of these frames, usually ranging from 8 to 64. MLLMs usually sample frames uniformly, regardless of their relevance to the question being answered. To address this limitation, several training-free, model-agnostic methods for selecting question-relevant frames have recently been proposed.
  In this work, we introduce a frame-selection method designed specifically for multiple-choice questions. We extend the query text by appending semantic cues derived from the answer choices and employ a direct query-frame alignment scoring mechanism. To the best of our knowledge, our method is the first to directly utilize answer choices as inference-time cues for selecting frames relevant to answering a question. The method first constructs a compact candidate pool by subsampling video frames at a fixed rate. The frames are then scored according to their maximum cosine similarity across all question-answer pairs to identify the most relevant frames for a given query. This approach preserves a fixed token budget while improving the relevance of the visual evidence provided to the downstream MLLM.
  We evaluate the effectiveness of our frame-selection method on the MLVU, Video-MME, and LongVideoBench benchmarks using three MLLMs: LLaVA-Mini, Qwen2-VL, and LLaVA-Video. Experimental results demonstrate that answer-aware frame selection generally outperforms uniform sampling and existing training-free frame-selection methods under the same frame budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向多项选择题的视频帧选择方法，利用答案选项作为推理时语义线索，对帧与问答对进行直接对齐打分，在固定帧预算下提升多模态大语言模型视频理解性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型处理视频时只能采样少量帧，而现有方法通常均匀采样或忽略问题相关性，导致视觉证据与问题不匹配，影响视频理解效果。
AI.method: 先以固定频率下采样构建候选帧池，再扩展查询文本，加入答案选项的语义线索，并计算帧与所有问答对的最大余弦相似度，据此选择最相关帧，保持固定token预算供下游MLLM使用。
AI.result: 在MLVU、Video-MME和LongVideoBench基准上，使用LLaVA-Mini、Qwen2-VL和LLaVA-Video三个模型评估，答案感知帧选择在相同帧预算下通常优于均匀采样和现有免训练帧选择方法。
AI.conclusion: 直接利用答案选项作为推理时线索进行帧选择，可提升所选帧与问题的相关性，是一种有效且模型无关的视频理解增强策略。

title: Language-Augmented Video Action Anticipation: Design Fundamentals, Benchmarks, and Open Challenges
comment: 29 pages, 5 figures, 19 tables. Review article. Supplementary material, machine-readable data, and public artifacts are available at https://github.com/mahsa7290/language-augmented-action-anticipation
summary: Action anticipation predicts future human actions from partial video under incomplete context and temporal uncertainty. Recent systems introduce large language models (LLMs), vision-language models (VLMs), or language-derived semantics at different stages, but reported gains are difficult to interpret when task formulation, visual pretraining, supervision, decoder design, and evaluation code change simultaneously. The central contribution of this review is an evidence-aware design map that crosses task regime with the point at which language-derived information intervenes. We characterise task regimes along six axes. These axes organise the literature into five broad task families: single-action, sequence, object-interaction, cross-view, and planning-oriented settings. C1-C3 locate interventions in context construction, goal/intention modelling, and future decoding, while C4 is treated as an adjacent, emerging grounding/executability extension. Unlike a generic processing pipeline, the map links each intervention to an appropriate counterfactual, failure diagnosis, and permissible evidence claim. Supporting contributions include a protocol-level audit of Ego4D-LTA and EPIC-KITCHENS-100, a multidimensional evidence profile, and the Backbone-Aware Comparison and Ablation Protocol (BCAP). The unresolved EK-100 record is treated as a reporting-comparability case study and is not used as a leaderboard. Evidence for LLM benefits, goal ambiguity, and horizon effects is therefore formulated as testable hypotheses requiring matched validation, not as causal conclusions. The accompanying package contains the coded evidence, source locators, protocol metadata, and versioned catalogue used in the review.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇关于动作预测中语言信息介入的综述性研究，提出一个证据感知的设计图谱，将任务场景与语言干预点交叉组织，并强调现有LLM/VLM增益需通过匹配验证来检验。
AI.motivation: 近期动作预测系统引入LLM、VLM或语言语义，但由于任务定义、视觉预训练、监督方式、解码器设计和评估代码常同时变化，报告的性能提升难以解释。
AI.method: 沿六个轴刻画任务场景，归纳为单动作、序列、物体交互、跨视角和规划导向五类任务；用C1-C3定位语言信息在上下文构建、目标/意图建模和未来解码中的介入，C4作为相邻的 grounding/可执行性扩展；为每种介入匹配反事实、失败诊断和可允许的证据主张；并开展Ego4D-LTA与EPIC-KITCHENS-100的协议级审计，提出多维证据画像和BCAP。
AI.result: 形成了任务场景与语言干预点交叉的设计图谱；EK-100未解决记录被作为报告可比性案例而非排行榜；关于LLM收益、目标歧义和时域效应的证据被表述为需要匹配验证的可检验假设。
AI.conclusion: 该综述不将现有证据视为因果结论，而是强调匹配验证；配套包含编码证据、来源定位、协议元数据和版本化目录，以支持可解释、可比较的动作预测研究。

title: Schur-Neural KF: Learned Schur-Consistent Corrections to the Extended Kalman Filter
comment: 8 pages. Accepted to the 65th IEEE Conference on Decision and Control (CDC 2026)
summary: We present Schur-Neural KF (SN-KF), a learning-based correction to the extended Kalman filter (EKF) that preserves the probabilistic conditioning interpretation of the EKF. The method perturbs the predictive state-measurement cross-covariance and the Cholesky factor of the measurement noise covariance so that the resulting joint predictive covariance is always positive semidefinite. The positive semidefiniteness is ensured by a Schur complement-based parametrization. We instantiate the parametrization with a recurrent neural architecture whose matrix outputs are modulated by amplitude gates. We prove that incorporating a measurement does not increase the filter's state uncertainty, and show that no measurement can induce an arbitrarily large state correction relative to its statistical surprise. We also present a perturbative analysis suggesting SN-KF's structural strength in the data-scarce regime. We provide two numerical experiments to illustrate the practical benefits of SN-KF. In a two-radar experiment, enforcing Schur-consistency provides a much broader failure-free hyperparameter region and reduces RMSE for small training subsets, consistent with our theoretical analysis in the data-scarce regime. In the unicycle experiment, SN-KF achieves the best precision, recall, false alarm rate, and gated RMSE under innovation-based sensor-fault rejection.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Schur-Neural KF（SN-KF），一种在保持扩展卡尔曼滤波（EKF）概率条件解释的前提下，对 EKF 进行学习型修正的方法。
AI.motivation: 现有学习型滤波修正可能破坏 EKF 的概率结构与协方差正半定性，尤其在数据稀缺时容易失效，因此需要一种结构一致且稳健的修正方式。
AI.method: SN-KF 通过扰动预测状态-量测互协方差和量测噪声协方差的 Cholesky 因子，并利用 Schur 补参数化保证联合预测协方差正半定；采用带幅度门控的循环神经网络实现矩阵输出，并进行理论证明与数值实验。
AI.result: 理论上证明引入量测不会增加状态不确定性，且任何量测都不能引发相对统计意外过大的状态修正；扰动分析表明其在数据稀缺下具有结构优势。双雷达实验中，Schur 一致性带来更宽的无故障超参数区域，并在小训练子集上降低 RMSE；独轮车实验中，SN-KF 在基于新息的传感器故障拒绝下取得最佳精确率、召回率、误报率和门控 RMSE。
AI.conclusion: SN-KF 通过保持 Schur 一致性，在数据稀缺和传感器故障拒绝场景中展现出实用优势，是一种兼具理论保证与实验效果的 EKF 学习型修正方法。

title: IndustryLLM: Failure-Driven LLM Training for Industrial Procurement
comment: Technical Report, 56 pages, 6 figures. Model weights and configs available at https://huggingface.co/alibaba-multimodal-industrial-ai/IndustryLLM
summary: Industrial procurement requires language models to bridge informal buyer jargon, sparse marketplace attributes, and authoritative engineering standards under strict safety tolerances. We present IndustryLLM, an open-weight industrial language model trained from Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base (35B total parameters with ~3B activated per token, with the vision encoder frozen). Rather than relying on generic text scaling, we introduce a failure-driven adaptation recipe spanning continued pre-training (CPT) and supervised fine-tuning (SFT). CPT leverages a curated ~100B-token corpus integrating 5B tokens of national standards (e.g., GB/T) and technical archives, 10B tokens of de-identified real-world industrial transaction and inquiry records, and 60B tokens of general replay. To overcome register mismatch and factual brittleness, we systematically reconstruct an estimated 20B-token domain subset via multi-register rewriting across 10 genres and 8 writing styles, confidence-routed minimal factual editing, and error-targeted QA synthesis (resolving colloquial typos like '42-luo-mu' -> 42CrMo, expanding ambiguous codes like '16674' -> GB/T 16674, and clarifying conflicting dimensional specs). For downstream deployment, we formalize an evidence-gated constraint-evaluation interface enforcing three-valued logic where unverified product evidence remains unknown rather than satisfied. Offline evaluations demonstrate consistent gains on procurement-query structuring (+2.97 percentage points in exact match, 95% CI [2.11, 3.86] in No-Think mode), while randomized online A/B experiments in production yield substantial improvements (+4.25% GMV, +8.3% satisfied inquiries) alongside a latency reduction from 6-7 s to 1.5 s. Model weights and configs are released at https://huggingface.co/alibaba-multimodal-industrial-ai/IndustryLLM.

AI.tldr: 提出工业领域开源大模型 IndustryLLM，基于 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base，通过失败驱动的继续预训练与监督微调，结合工业语料、标准文本和真实交易记录，并引入证据门控约束评估接口，在离线查询结构化与线上A/B实验中均取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 工业采购场景中，买方非正式术语、稀疏的商品属性和权威工程标准之间存在鸿沟，且安全容忍度严格，通用语言模型难以直接可靠地完成采购查询理解与合规判断。
AI.method: 以 Qwen3.5-35B-A3B-Base 为基座（35B总参数、每token约3B激活，视觉编码器冻结），采用失败驱动的 CPT+SFT 适配流程。CPT使用约100B token语料，包括5B国家标准与技术档案、10B去标识化真实工业交易与询价记录、60B通用回放；并重构约20B领域子集，进行多语域改写（10种体裁、8种风格）、置信度路由的最小事实编辑和面向错误的QA合成，用于纠正口语化错写、模糊编码和冲突规格。下游部署形式化证据门控约束评估接口，采用三值逻辑，未验证产品证据保持“未知”而非“满足”。
AI.result: 离线评估在采购查询结构化任务上持续提升，No-Think模式下精确匹配提升2.97个百分点（95% CI [2.11, 3.86]）；生产环境随机在线A/B实验显示GMV提升4.25%、满意询价提升8.3%，延迟从6-7秒降至1.5秒。
AI.conclusion: IndustryLLM 表明，面向工业采购的领域适配应结合高质量标准/交易数据、失败驱动的数据重构和证据门控推理接口，而非单纯扩大通用文本规模；该方法在离线指标和线上业务效果上均验证有效，模型权重与配置已开源。

title: Metro-WM: Long-Horizon Latent Planning with Realisable Sub-Goals
summary: Model-predictive control with Joint-Embedding Predictive Architectures (JEPAs) provides a strong zero-shot goal-reaching planner, but it is only effective over short planning horizons. Hierarchical extensions attempt to bridge this gap by learning a macro planner to predict intermediate latent sub-goals to guide the micro planner. In this work, we demonstrate that unconstrained latent sub-goal prediction is fundamentally flawed. A rigorous evaluation reveals that a leading state-of-the-art macro planner routinely emits physically unrealisable sub-goals. To resolve this, we introduce Metro-WM, a hierarchical framework that issues sub-goals by retrieving genuine states from prior experience rather than generating ungrounded latent vectors. Specifically, Metro-WM constructs a graph whose vertices are observed frames from offline expert demonstrations or random-action trajectories, allowing frames from different episodes to be connected and stitched into routes to the goal. Planning over the full graph also makes the system highly robust to execution errors: if the micro planner drifts off course, Metro-WM instantly finds a new optimal path from the current state. Our experiments show that Metro-WM achieves superior long-horizon success rates of up to 37.33 percentage points over the next best hierarchical approach while being up to 10.9 times faster, requiring both 13-56 times less offline compute and fewer tuned hyperparameters. Additional analysis reveals that Metro-WM finds shorter paths than the offline demonstrations, outperforms an oracle relying on the query's own demonstration, and maintains robust performance under extremely sparse dataset conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文指出基于JEPA的分层规划中无约束潜子目标预测存在根本缺陷，提出Metro-WM，通过从离线经验中检索真实状态构建图来生成子目标，实现长时程规划，成功率高、速度快、计算需求低。
AI.motivation: JEPA模型预测控制仅适用于短规划时域；分层扩展用宏规划器预测中间潜子目标，但无约束潜子目标预测可能产生物理不可实现的子目标，导致规划失败。
AI.method: Metro-WM构建图，顶点为离线专家演示或随机动作轨迹中的观测帧，允许连接不同片段并拼接成到目标的路线；子目标通过检索图中真实状态而非生成潜向量获得；当微规划器偏离时，可即时从当前状态重新寻找最优路径。
AI.result: 长时程成功率比次优分层方法高最多37.33个百分点，速度快最多10.9倍，离线计算少13-56倍且超参数更少；还能找到比离线演示更短的路径，优于依赖查询自身演示的oracle，并在极稀疏数据集下保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 无约束潜子目标预测不可靠；基于检索真实状态的图规划方法更有效、高效且鲁棒，适合长时程目标到达任务。

title: Characterization and Monitoring of Nonlinear Dynamics and Chaos in Complex Physiological Systems
summary: Nonlinear dynamics arise whenever multifarious entities of a system cooperate, compete, or interfere. For example, cardiovascular system involves a great level of complexity. Multi-lead ECG signals are generated through orchestrated depolarization and repolarization of cells and manifest significant nonlinear dynamics. Nonlinear dynamical systems defy understanding based on the traditional reductionist's approach, in which one attempts to understand a system's behavior by combining all constituent parts that have been analyzed separately. In order to cope with system complexity, modern healthcare systems are investing in advanced physiological sensing and patient monitoring, thereby giving rise to big data. Realizing the full potential of big data for healthcare intelligence requires fundamentally new methodologies to harness and exploit complexity. However, available nonlinear dynamics techniques are either not concerned with healthcare analytical objectives or fail to effectively analyze big data to extract useful information for improving healthcare services. There is an urgent need to develop analytical methodologies that fully exploit the underlying nonlinear dynamics in physiological systems for advancing healthcare services with exceptional features such as personalization, responsiveness, and superior quality. This chapter presents some theoretical developments and tools to advance the applications of nonlinear dynamics principles in health care. Specifically, we focus on sensor-based characterization and modeling of nonlinear dynamics (i.e., multifractal analysis and multiscale recurrence quantification). Then, current developments and applications of these methodologies are examined for characterizing and exploiting heart rate variability and space-time ECG signals.

AI.tldr: 本章介绍将非线性动力学原理应用于医疗健康的理论进展与工具，重点讨论基于传感器的非线性动力学表征与建模，即多重分形分析和多尺度递归量化，并考察其在心率变异性和时空ECG信号中的应用。
AI.motivation: 生理系统（如心血管系统和多导联ECG）具有高度复杂性和显著非线性动力学，传统还原论方法难以理解。医疗系统产生大量生理监测大数据，但现有非线性动力学技术要么不面向医疗分析目标，要么难以有效从大数据中提取有用信息。因此，亟需开发能充分利用生理系统非线性动力学的新分析方法，以推动个性化、响应性强且高质量的医疗服务。
AI.method: 本章提出并讨论用于医疗健康的非线性动力学理论发展与工具，聚焦基于传感器的非线性动力学表征与建模，具体包括多重分形分析和多尺度递归量化，并审视这些方法在心率变异性与时空ECG信号中的当前发展和应用。
AI.result: 本章展示了相关理论进展和工具，并考察了多重分形分析与多尺度递归量化在表征和利用心率变异性及时空ECG信号方面的应用。
AI.conclusion: 需要从根本上发展新的分析方法，以挖掘和利用生理系统中的非线性动力学与大数据，从而提升医疗健康服务的个性化、响应性和质量；本章所述方法为表征复杂生理动力学并推动医疗健康智能提供了方向。

title: Game-Theoretic Control with Constrained Potential Surgery
summary: Constrained general-sum dynamic games are a popular formulation for highly interactive multi-agent planning problems. In recent years, Generalized Nash Equilibrium (GNE) solvers have achieved real-time performance for small dynamic games. However, solution speed still remains a bottleneck, and controlling even a small number of agents (e.g., more than four) in a dynamic task remains elusive. In addition, Newton solvers that focus on the first-order conditions are vulnerable to non-Nash saddle points, limiting the usefulness of the provided solution. In this work, we propose a fast and versatile interior point solver for constrained dynamic games, along with a computationally efficient second-order correction that increases the probability of converging to a local GNE solution in constrained dynamic games. The performance of the proposed method is evaluated on numerical benchmarks and a physical experiment involving scaled race cars.

AI.tldr: 提出一种用于约束一般和动态博弈的快速通用内点求解器，并加入计算高效二阶校正，以提高收敛到局部广义纳什均衡的概率；在数值基准和缩比赛车实验上评估。
AI.motivation: 现有GNE求解器虽在小规模动态博弈中可达实时，但速度仍是瓶颈，难以控制超过四个智能体；且基于一阶条件的牛顿求解器易收敛到非Nash鞍点，限制解的有效性。
AI.method: 针对约束动态博弈设计快速通用内点法求解器，并提出计算高效二阶校正，提升收敛到局部GNE的概率。评估包括数值基准与缩比赛车实物实验。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量指标，但报告在数值基准和缩比赛车物理实验中评估了所提方法性能，表明其可提升求解速度与适用性，并增加收敛到局部GNE的可能性。
AI.conclusion: 所提内点求解器结合二阶校正可缓解动态博弈求解速度瓶颈与非Nash鞍点问题，为多智能体交互规划提供更快速、通用的GNE求解途径，并通过实物实验验证可行性。

title: Does Vision-Language Pretraining Granularity Matter? A Controlled Evaluation of Vision-Language Objectives Across Chest X-Ray Interpretation Tasks
summary: Vision-language pretraining objectives differ in the spatial granularity of their supervision, yet the implications of this distribution for chest X-ray interpretation remain underexplored. We present a controlled study that isolates the pretraining objective: holding the encoder and pretraining data fixed, we train nine objectives spanning global and local contrastive learning, captioning, and their combinations, and evaluate across five chest X-ray tasks of increasing spatial granularity. We find that (i) pretraining granularity aligns with task granularity at the extremes, with local objectives leading on abnormality detection and global objectives on classification; (ii) local objectives are surprisingly competitive on global-level generation and question answering tasks; (iii) the merits of captioning and contrastive learning reverse across granularity levels; and (iv) among combinations, mixing captioning and contrastive supervision is strongest on classification and in distribution generation, while pairing two captioning objectives generalizes best on zero-shot report generation. These results show that no single objective is universally optimal, and that the interaction of objective type, granularity, and task governs downstream performance.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过控制变量实验，系统比较了九种视觉-语言预训练目标在胸片解读任务中的表现，发现预训练目标粒度与任务粒度存在复杂交互，没有单一目标在所有任务上最优。
AI.motivation: 视觉-语言预训练目标在监督的空间粒度上存在差异，但这种差异对胸片解读的影响尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 固定编码器和预训练数据，训练九种目标，涵盖全局与局部对比学习、描述生成及其组合，并在五个空间粒度递增的胸片任务上评估。
AI.result: （i）极端情况下预训练粒度与任务粒度一致：局部目标在异常检测上领先，全局目标在分类上领先；（ii）局部目标在全局级生成和问答任务上出人意料地有竞争力；（iii）描述生成与对比学习的优势随粒度变化而反转；（iv）组合目标中，描述生成与对比学习混合在分类和分布内生成上最强，而两个描述生成目标配对在零样本报告生成上泛化最好。
AI.conclusion: 没有单一预训练目标普遍最优；目标类型、空间粒度与下游任务之间的交互共同决定性能。

title: COUNTERMEM: World-Model Verified Counter-Factual Memory for Language Agents
summary: Existing agent memory frameworks mainly create memory through an agent's interaction with the factual world, e.g., remembering feedback from actions taken to improve performance on future tasks. However, these frameworks seldom ask the "what if" question during memory construction: what if a different action had been taken, would the feedback have changed, and how could this feedback become useful memory? Obtaining such feedback directly in an active environment can be expensive and can alter the state needed for comparison. In this work, we introduce COUNTERMEM, a reinforcement-learning framework for constructing and using verified counterfactual memory across tasks. After a failed action, COUNTERMEM evaluates local alternatives from a copy or reset of the original state using executable world models, such as tests, proof checkers, and solvers. It stores improvements with the original and corrected actions, checked outcomes, and conditions for reuse. A learned memory-use policy selects a retrieved record or skips memory to balance task success and interaction cost, while the base LLM remains fixed. Both memory and policy are frozen during held-out evaluation. We evaluate COUNTERMEM on 12 benchmark settings across six domains. With gpt-oss-120b, COUNTERMEM improves both ReAct and Reflexion on all 12 benchmarks across six domains, averaging a gain of 12.6 percentage points over their unaugmented versions. In the four-domain comparison across two backbones, task-run tokens decrease by 7.7-42.0%, excluding offline selector-training costs. Further analyses show that removing verification or persistent storage weakens the gains, while applying verified corrections to unsuitable decisions can reverse them. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出COUNTERMEM，一种强化学习框架，通过可执行世界模型在失败动作后构建并验证反事实记忆，学习记忆使用策略，从而提升任务成功率并降低交互成本。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体记忆框架主要从与真实世界的交互中构建记忆，很少在记忆构建时追问“如果当时采取不同动作会怎样”的反事实问题；而在活跃环境中直接获取此类反馈成本高且会改变比较所需的状态。
AI.method: COUNTERMEM在失败动作后，从原始状态的副本或重置中，利用可执行世界模型（如测试、证明检查器、求解器）评估局部替代动作；存储改进方案、原始与修正动作、验证结果及复用条件。训练一个记忆使用策略来选择检索到的记录或跳过记忆，以平衡任务成功与交互成本，同时保持基础LLM固定。在留出评估中，记忆和策略均被冻结。
AI.result: 在六个领域共12个基准设置上，使用gpt-oss-120b时，COUNTERMEM在全部12个基准上同时提升ReAct和Reflexion，平均增益12.6个百分点；在四领域双骨干对比中，任务运行token减少7.7%-42.0%（不含离线选择器训练成本）。分析表明，移除验证或持久存储会削弱增益，而将验证过的修正应用到不适宜决策上可能逆转增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过可执行世界模型构建并验证的反事实记忆能有效提升智能体性能与效率；验证与持久存储至关重要，且修正方案需谨慎匹配适用条件，避免误用导致负面效果。

title: The Earth in One Gaze: Training-Free Active Focus for UHR Remote Sensing Understanding
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) must balance local detail against scene context when interpreting ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing (RS) imagery within a limited visual-input budget. Existing selection-based methods either prune tokens and select patches through relevance scoring, or crop actively through repeated inspection. Neither strategy directly redistributes pixels within a continuous full-scene view: the first retains selected tokens or patches, and the second re-encodes a crop detached from its surroundings. Our pilot study finds that a frozen MLLM already produces useful question-guided spatial requests, yet crop-based inspection of the selected regions does not consistently improve its answers. We therefore formulate UHR understanding as a question of where to spend a fixed pixel budget. Based on this, we introduce GazeEarth, a simple-yet-effective training-free framework that couples question-guided region selection with full-scene foveated observation. The MLLM selects evidence cells from an indexed overview; a deterministic, topology-preserving warp resamples the original image onto a fixed-size canvas, enlarging their shared neighborhood while compressing the periphery; the same frozen model answers from this focused view, using at most two MLLM calls and no external selector or iterative search. Across three UHR remote sensing benchmarks and four frozen backbones, GazeEarth improves benchmark-averaged accuracy by 4.6 to 9.4 percentage points over direct answering and 3.4 to 4.3 over overview answering, outperforming task-trained methods. Our analyses show that existing MLLMs can guide where to look in UHR images on their own, and that what they can infer from the selected evidence depends on how that evidence is presented.

AI.tldr: 提出GazeEarth，一种无需训练的多模态大语言模型框架，通过问题引导的区域选择与全场景中央凹观察，在固定像素预算下理解超高分辨率遥感图像。
AI.motivation: 现有基于选择的方法要么通过相关性评分修剪令牌或选择patch，要么通过重复裁剪进行主动检查，均未在连续全场景视图中重新分配像素。试点研究发现，冻结的MLLM能产生有用的问题引导空间请求，但基于裁剪的检查并不总能改善答案。因此将UHR理解形式化为“在哪里花费固定像素预算”的问题。
AI.method: GazeEarth：无需训练，耦合问题引导的区域选择与全场景中央凹观察。MLLM从索引概览中选择证据单元；确定性、拓扑保持的变形将原始图像重采样到固定尺寸画布，放大共享邻域并压缩周边；同一冻结模型从聚焦视图作答，最多两次MLLM调用，无需外部选择器或迭代搜索。
AI.result: 在三个UHR遥感基准和四个冻结骨干上，GazeEarth相比直接回答平均准确率提升4.6至9.4个百分点，相比概览回答提升3.4至4.3个百分点，优于任务训练方法。分析表明MLLM能自行引导在UHR图像中看向何处，且从所选证据中推断出的内容取决于证据的呈现方式。
AI.conclusion: 现有MLLM能够自行指导在超高分辨率图像中关注的位置，而从选定证据中能推断出什么取决于该证据如何呈现。

title: Path Invariance of a Quadrotor System under Cyber Attacks with Theoretical Guarantees
comment: 6 pages, 3 figures, accepted paper at the American Control Conference (ACC)
summary: This paper presents a path-following controller for a quadrotor system to guarantee safe maneuvers, in terms of forward path invariance, in the presence of cyber-physical attacks. We assume that an adversarial agent can control any one of the rotors through a false data injection (FDI) type of attack. A feedback controller is designed using transverse feedback linearization which guarantees that the system follows a class of smooth curves under FDI attacks. Our proposed controller is computationally efficient, with a closed-form analytical expression, that not only mitigates the effect of bounded malicious signal but also ensures mission success. We provide theoretical guarantees of forward path invariance under FDI attacks with realistic assumptions and demonstrate the effectiveness of our approach through simulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种四旋翼路径跟随控制器，在存在网络物理攻击时保证前向路径不变性，即安全机动。
AI.motivation: 四旋翼可能遭受针对单个旋翼的虚假数据注入攻击，需要保证任务成功与路径安全。
AI.method: 采用横向反馈线性化设计反馈控制器，得到闭式解析表达式；假设攻击者可控制任一旋翼，并考虑有界恶意信号。
AI.result: 控制器计算高效，能缓解有界恶意信号影响，并在现实假设下理论上保证FDI攻击下的前向路径不变性；仿真验证有效。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法可在FDI攻击下维持四旋翼沿光滑曲线路径飞行并确保任务成功。

title: Verification of PETSc with CIVL using LLM-generated ACSL contracts and deterministic driver generation
summary: Parallel numerical libraries such as PETSc are widely used in science and engineering applications where wrong results can have costly consequences. Despite this, numerical libraries are rarely formally verified. One of the challenges is the need for an expert to hand-write a specification and manually apply a verification tool, often requiring the development of a harness or driver, all of which can contain additional bugs that lead to false positives or false negatives during verification. With recent advancements in large language models (LLMs), it is tempting to generate such drivers and reference models automatically, but one-shot generation based on a simple prompt is brittle and leads to additional unverified code that needs to be audited. In this paper, we present an approach to use LLMs in a limited setting to generate a small, human-certifiable ACSL contract from the function's documentation, combined with a deterministic toolchain that supports a restricted ACSL profile and generates a driver that uses the CIVL verifier to check the implementation against the contract and, when available, an existing reference model. We demonstrate the pipeline end-to-end on three PETSc functions: MatAXPY (reference model already exists), MatAYPX (no reference model, so the certified contract is the sole oracle), and the non-compressing mode of MatFilter (no reference model, with more complex, conditional behavior). With this pipeline, we were able to discover a bug in PETSc's MatAYPX function that was previously undiscovered and had been present in the code since 1997.

AI.tldr: 提出一种受限使用LLM生成ACSL契约的方法，并结合确定性工具链和CIVL验证器来验证PETSc数值库函数，在三个函数上完成端到端演示，并发现MatAYPX中自1997年以来未被发现的bug。
AI.motivation: PETSc等并行数值库广泛用于科学工程，错误结果代价高昂，但很少被形式验证。人工编写规范、验证工具和驱动容易引入新错误；LLM一次性自动生成又不够可靠且产生需审计的未验证代码。
AI.method: 用LLM从函数文档生成小型、人工可认证的ACSL契约；设计支持受限ACSL profile的确定性工具链，并生成driver，使用CIVL验证器检查实现是否符合契约，并在有参考模型时进行对比。
AI.result: 在MatAXPY、MatAYPX和MatFilter非压缩模式上完成端到端验证。MatAXPY已有参考模型；MatAYPX无参考模型，认证契约作为唯一oracle；MatFilter非压缩模式无参考模型且行为更复杂。最终发现MatAYPX中一个此前未发现、自1997年即存在的bug。
AI.conclusion: 表明在受限设置下结合LLM、人工可认证契约和确定性验证工具链，可有效支持数值库形式验证，并帮助发现长期隐藏的错误。

title: One-Step Is Optimal: Unconditional Rectified Flows are Noise2Noise Denoisers, and Multi-Step Integration Provably Hurts---A Benchmark and Task-Based Detectability Study on Low-Dose CT
summary: Iterative and generative denoisers are increasingly used under the assumption that multi-step refinement outperforms a single regression pass. We show the opposite for \emph{label-free} denoising. An \emph{unconditional} rectified flow trained on two noisy observations of the same signal, as in Noise2Noise, has a minimiser whose one-step readout is exactly the MMSE denoiser without requiring clean targets. In contrast, multi-step integration provably departs from the MMSE solution because the flow terminates at the noisy data distribution rather than the clean-signal distribution. This departure is exact in a tractable Gaussian model and is confirmed experimentally: one-step flow matches a direct regressor, whereas multi-step Euler integration progressively reduces fidelity. Counterintuitively, the degradation increases with training quality, as a better velocity field more faithfully transports samples toward the noisy terminal law. The key ingredient is therefore the decorrelated \emph{pairing}, not the flow machinery: a one-step regressor trained on matched noisy pairs gives our best label-free result ($+1.99$,dB). We evaluate these findings on \textbf{CTDenoiser}, a controlled low-dose CT benchmark spanning five architectures and supervised, similarity-based, blind-spot, and per-image methods. Among label-free approaches, only correlated-noise-aware Noise2Sim improves over the noisy baseline, while Noise2Void is flat-to-negative because CT noise violates its pixel-independence assumption. Finally, although supervised denoisers gain approximately $4$,dB PSNR, a channelized Hotelling observer shows reduced low-contrast lesion detectability, revealing clinically relevant degradation missed by PSNR and SSIM.

AI.tldr: 该论文挑战了多步迭代去噪优于单步回归的常见假设，证明在无标签去噪中，单步读出可精确对应MMSE去噪器，而多步生成/迭代反而偏离MMSE解；关键因素是噪声配对的相关性，而非流模型本身。
AI.motivation: 迭代与生成式去噪器常被默认认为多步细化优于单步回归，但该假设在无标签去噪场景下缺乏严格检验，尤其当训练目标仅为同一信号的两幅噪声观测时。
AI.method: 使用在成对噪声观测上训练的无条件rectified flow，从理论上分析其一步读出与多步积分的性质；在可处理高斯模型中推导精确偏离；并在CTDenoiser低剂量CT基准上评估五种架构，涵盖监督、相似度、盲点和逐图像方法，同时用通道化Hotelling观察者评价病灶可检测性。
AI.result: 一步流的读出恰好是无需干净目标的MMSE去噪器，而多步Euler积分会因流向噪声数据分布而偏离MMSE解，且训练质量越高偏离越明显；实验显示一步流与直接回归器相当，最佳无标签结果来自匹配噪声对的一步回归器，PSNR提升+1.99 dB。无标签方法中仅相关噪声感知的Noise2Sim优于噪声基线，Noise2Void因CT噪声违反像素独立假设而持平或负增益。监督去噪器约提升4 dB PSNR，但通道化Hotelling观察者显示低对比度病灶可检测性下降。
AI.conclusion: 无标签去噪的关键是去相关的配对方式而非流式多步机制；多步细化会损害保真度，且PSNR/SSIM可能掩盖临床相关的病灶检测性能退化。

title: Unsupervised spiking feature learning for event-based pedestrian crossing detection: approaching supervised accuracy without labelled training data
summary: Event cameras are well suited to pedestrian crossing detection, and spiking neural networks (SNNs) can process their output natively, but current SNN detectors are trained with supervised backpropagation and therefore require costly frame-level crossing labels. We investigate crossing detection with no labels in feature learning and report the first unsupervised results on the recent DVS-PedX pedestrian-crossing benchmark. A single spiking layer trained with winner-take-all spike-timing-dependent plasticity learns a dictionary from unlabelled event-frame patches; frames are encoded by cosine similarity to the learned filters with spatial pooling and read out by a linear classifier, the only supervised component. On the 24,454-frame test split the method attains 90.3% accuracy and an area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC) of 0.936, compared with 92.0% and 0.943 for a supervised spiking network trained end-to-end on the same frames; under adverse weather the AUROC is 0.913. The result is insensitive to the choice of plasticity rule but depends strongly on the readout protocol: with the classical neuron-assignment readout the same network attains only 0.70 AUROC. On the benchmark's real converted portion, a readout refit lifts performance from chance (0.53) to 0.67 AUROC, within the published supervised range. These findings indicate that the accuracy cost of removing labels from feature learning is small on this benchmark, and that reported weaknesses of unsupervised spiking networks may be attributable to the readout protocol rather than to the learning rule.

AI.tldr: 该论文首次在DVS-PedX行人过街基准上实现无监督脉冲神经网络检测，仅用WTA-STDP学习特征字典，线性分类器读出，性能接近监督方法。
AI.motivation: 事件相机适合行人过街检测，脉冲神经网络可原生处理事件流，但现有SNN检测器依赖监督反向传播，需要昂贵的逐帧过街标签。
AI.method: 用无标签事件帧块训练单层脉冲层，通过胜者通吃(STDP)学习滤波器字典；用余弦相似度编码帧并做空间池化，最后仅由线性分类器监督读出。
AI.result: 在24,454帧测试集上达到90.3%准确率和0.936 AUROC，监督端到端SNN为92.0%和0.943；恶劣天气下AUROC为0.913。性能对可塑性规则不敏感，但强烈依赖读出协议：经典神经元分配读出仅0.70 AUROC；在真实转换部分，重拟合读出将AUROC从0.53提升至0.67。
AI.conclusion: 在该基准上，特征学习去除标签带来的精度损失很小；无监督脉冲网络报告的弱点可能主要源于读出协议，而非学习规则本身。

title: GT-VLA: Target-Conditioned Trace Guidance for Generalizable Robotic Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong performance on robotic manipulation, but they often struggle to generalize to unseen tasks, configurations, and long-horizon settings. A key challenge is that VLAs overfit to training scenes and fail to follow novel language instructions. Off-the-shelf vision-language models (VLMs) often provide stronger generalization, but cannot directly control robot actions. To combine the common sense of VLMs with VLA control, we propose Guided Trace VLA (GT-VLA), a steerable framework that accepts guidance from an external generalist VLM through trace-conditioned action generation. GT-VLA uses a generalist model to identify semantic guidance for the current skill, converts this guidance into a 2D visual trace, and conditions its action policy on the resulting trace-rendered observation. This design separates semantic target acquisition, trace generation, and low-level action execution, allowing high-level guidance to propagate to robot actions. GT-VLA uses a Mixture-of-Experts architecture with skill-specific trace and action modules for robust execution. We evaluate GT-VLA on LIBERO and a physical robot platform, showing improved generalization over recent VLA baselines in both settings. The code and additional supplemental materials are available on our project website at https://ivaniz.github.io/gt-vla/.

AI.tldr: 提出GT-VLA框架，通过外部通用VLM生成2D视觉轨迹来引导VLA动作生成，提升机器人操作在未见任务、配置和长时程场景中的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: VLA模型在机器人操作上表现好，但难以泛化到未见任务、配置和长时程场景，且过度拟合训练场景，无法遵循新语言指令；而通用VLM泛化强却不能直接控制机器人。
AI.method: GT-VLA利用通用模型为当前技能识别语义指导，将其转化为2D视觉轨迹，并以轨迹渲染的观测为条件进行动作策略生成。采用混合专家架构，包含技能特定的轨迹和动作模块，分离语义目标获取、轨迹生成和底层动作执行。
AI.result: 在LIBERO和真实机器人平台上评估，相比近期VLA基线，在两个设置中均展现出更好的泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: GT-VLA通过结合VLM的常识与VLA的控制能力，有效提升了机器人操作的泛化性和长时程任务表现。

title: Context-dependent agent evaluation with orthogonal equilibrium learning
summary: Many applications require to evaluate agents under contextual information (e.g., a prompt, task, or user group). We study how to perform such context-dependent agent evaluation from offline feedback. Existing score-based models for this purpose (e.g., Bradley-Terry) impose a transitive preference ordering, which fails to reflect collective preferences when human judgements are heterogeneous. Inspired by social choice theory, we frame evaluation as a contextual game between two players, each selecting a distribution over agents as the strategy to receive greater collective preference than the other. Then, the support of the Nash equilibrium defines a context-specific set of winners. However, learning context-specific equilibria from offline logs is difficult because each context reveals human feedback on only a subset of agents, and, hence, a naive plug-in estimator can therefore be biased. To address these challenges, we propose NashEval, a general framework for robust contextual equilibrium learning. NashEval first constructs debiased estimates of the contextual payoff matrix that characterizes the game. NashEval then learns the context-to-equilibrium mapping with a tailored orthogonal loss, which avoids the need to solve a separate game for each context. We show theoretically that errors in estimating the nuisance functions underlying the payoff matrix affect the risk of the learned equilibrium (i.e., exploitability) only through higher-order terms. Across various experiments, NashEval improves robustness of equilibrium learning and consistently identifies the set of top-performing agents across contexts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 NashEval，用于在上下文信息下基于离线反馈评估智能体，并将其建模为上下文博弈，通过纳什均衡的支持集确定每个上下文中的获胜智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有 Bradley-Terry 等基于分数的模型假设传递性偏好排序，难以反映人类判断异质时的集体偏好；同时离线日志中每个上下文仅覆盖部分智能体反馈，直接估计会产生偏差。
AI.method: 受社会选择理论启发，将评估视为两个玩家选择智能体分布以获取更强集体偏好的上下文博弈；NashEval 先构造上下文收益矩阵的去偏估计，再用定制的正交损失学习上下文到均衡的映射，避免为每个上下文单独求解博弈。
AI.result: 理论表明，收益矩阵中冗余函数估计误差仅通过高阶项影响所学均衡的风险（可被利用性）；实验显示 NashEval 提升了均衡学习的鲁棒性，并能稳定识别跨上下文表现最好的智能体集合。
AI.conclusion: NashEval 为异质偏好和部分反馈下的上下文智能体评估提供了稳健的均衡学习框架，可有效识别上下文相关的顶级智能体集合。

title: DAOCP: a dual active set solver for optimal control problems
summary: We present DAOCP, a dual active set solver for linear quadratic optimal control problems with stage-wise equality and inequality constraints. Active set methods are leading Model Predictive Control benchmarks for full-body robotics, but existing solvers operate on dense QPs, while typical problem dimensions favor methods that exploit the optimal control structure. DAOCP combines the warm-starting capabilities of active set algorithms with the better computational scaling of structure exploiting solvers, by relying on a generalization of the relationship between the Riccati recursion and the Cholesky factorization of the condensed Hessian. This result enables dual active set iterations to operate directly on the original optimal control problem through recursive computations, without explicitly forming the condensed quadratic program. On robotics benchmarks, DAOCP is the fastest of four solvers in four of five scenarios, cutting average solve time on a 58-state Atlas model by 9$\times$ relative to state of the art solvers DAQP and HPIPM.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAOCP，一种用于带阶段等式与不等式约束的线性二次最优控制问题的对偶主动集求解器，可在不显式构造凝聚QP的情况下直接求解原最优控制问题。
AI.motivation: 主动集方法是全身机器人模型预测控制的领先基准，但现有求解器通常处理凝聚后的稠密QP；而典型问题维度更适合利用最优控制结构的求解器。
AI.method: DAOCP将对偶主动集算法的热启动能力与结构利用型求解器的计算扩展性结合，基于Riccati递推与凝聚Hessian的Cholesky分解之间关系的推广，通过递归计算直接在原最优控制问题上执行对偶主动集迭代。
AI.result: 在机器人基准测试中，DAOCP在五个场景中的四个里是四种求解器中最快的；在58维状态的Atlas模型上，相比当前先进求解器DAQP和HPIPM，平均求解时间缩短约9倍。
AI.conclusion: DAOCP表明，通过利用最优控制结构，对偶主动集方法可以高效求解带约束的线性二次最优控制问题，并在机器人MPC基准上取得显著加速。

title: End-to-end QP-based policies: A unified perspective on robust control and robot learning
summary: We present an end-to-end QP-based policy framework that enables systematic policy construction with minimal domain-specific design, while preserving the transparency and interpretability of model-based control. The proposed policy representation supports both domain-randomized model-based auto-tuning, where policy parameters are optimized over distributions of disturbances and model variations, and black-box policy construction, where the problem is formulated in terms of a (possibly) unknown model without requiring explicit notions of states, inputs, or the underlying system dynamics. We establish connections to existing policy representations and control paradigms, including robust control, multilayer perceptrons, and robot learning, and interpret our end-to-end QP policies as a common abstraction of these approaches. We validate the resulting framework in both simulation and hardware, demonstrating a broad range of applications spanning robustness, automatic policy tuning, and control under unknown system dynamics.

AI.tldr: 提出一种端到端、基于二次规划（QP）的策略框架，能以极少领域特定设计进行系统化策略构建，同时保持基于模型控制的透明性与可解释性；支持基于模型的域随机化自动调参和黑盒策略构建，并在仿真与硬件上验证多种应用。
AI.motivation: 希望兼顾系统化策略构建、减少领域特定设计，并保留基于模型控制的透明性和可解释性，同时统一理解鲁棒控制、多层感知机和机器人学习等现有策略表示与控制范式。
AI.method: 提出端到端QP策略表示与构建框架：一方面在扰动和模型变化分布上优化策略参数，实现基于模型的域随机化自动调参；另一方面在模型未知、无需显式状态、输入或系统动力学概念的情况下进行黑盒策略构建；并建立其与鲁棒控制、MLP和机器人学习的联系。
AI.result: 在仿真和硬件上验证了该框架，展示了其在鲁棒性、自动策略调参以及未知系统动力学控制等任务中的广泛适用性，并将端到端QP策略解释为多种现有方法的共同抽象。
AI.conclusion: 基于QP的端到端策略可作为统一且可解释的策略构建与学习抽象，在保持模型控制透明性的同时，支持鲁棒控制、自动调参和未知动力学下的控制等应用。

title: The Ongiini-Eval-OW Benchmark: A Concept Paper for the Planned Benchmarking of Machine Translation and Large Language Models on Oshindonga and Oshikwanyama
comment: 14 pages, 6 tables. Concept paper for a planned benchmark; first public dataset release targeted for Q4 2026. Dataset CC-BY-4.0, code MIT
summary: Oshiwambo -- a cluster of mutually intelligible Bantu languages spoken by over a million people across northern Namibia and southern Angola, and the home language of roughly half of Namibian households -- has, to our knowledge, no published machine-translation evaluation benchmark. Major commercial services (Google Translate, DeepL, Microsoft Translator), open multilingual MT models (NLLB-200, MADLAD-400), and the open Masakhane checkpoint collection all lack coverage of either standardised dialect, Oshindonga or Oshikwanyama. We announce Ongiini-Eval-OW, a planned 600-item English-Oshindonga and English-Oshikwanyama benchmark with native-speaker references from two independent translators, a 30-item inter-translator agreement set, an 11-tag phenomenon-tagged stratification (at least 30 items per tag), a deterministic 30% blind split, and a reproducible scoring protocol over chrF++, BLEU, and COMET-22, supplemented by a 50-item human-evaluation round. We document the empirical coverage gap, the dataset composition, the launch-leaderboard model matrix across American, European, and Chinese frontier and open-weight systems, and the contribution pipeline. The dataset is targeted for first public release in Q4 2026; this v1.0 concept paper announces the design and the call for participation. Data and code will be released under CC-BY-4.0 and MIT respectively.

AI.tldr: 该论文是一篇概念性论文，宣布计划构建 Ongiini-Eval-OW：一个面向英语-奥辛东加语和英语-奥辛宽亚马语的 600 项机器翻译评测基准，旨在填补奥希万博语在主流机器翻译服务与开源模型中的覆盖空白。
AI.motivation: 奥希万博语是纳米比亚北部和安哥拉南部超过百万人使用的班图语群，也是约一半纳米比亚家庭的家庭语言，但据作者所知尚无公开的机器翻译评测基准；Google Translate、DeepL、Microsoft Translator、NLLB-200、MADLAD-400 及 Masakhane 检查点等均缺乏对 Oshindonga 或 Oshikwanyama 的标准方言覆盖。
AI.method: 计划构建 600 项英语-Oshindonga 和英语-Oshikwanyama 基准，包含两名独立译者的母语参考译文、30 项译者间一致性集合、按 11 个现象标签分层（每标签至少 30 项）、确定性的 30% 盲测划分，以及基于 chrF++、BLEU 和 COMET-22 的可复现评分协议，并辅以 50 项人工评估。
AI.result: 论文记录了经验性的覆盖缺口、数据集组成、涵盖美国、欧洲和中国前沿及开放权重系统的启动排行榜模型矩阵，以及贡献流程；数据集计划于 2026 年第四季度首次公开发布。
AI.conclusion: 该 v1.0 概念论文宣布了基准设计与参与呼吁，数据和代码将分别以 CC-BY-4.0 和 MIT 许可发布。

title: Don't Repeat Yourself: Self-Supervised Fine-Tuning for Coverage
summary: In verifiable domains such as math and coding, finding one correct solution among many attempts can matter more than the pass rate of each attempt. Post-training can concentrate large language model outputs around a few modes, while increasing sampling temperature has limited effectiveness. We introduce Don't Repeat Yourself Supervised Fine-Tuning (DRY-SFT), a post-training method that increases output diversity and coverage: the probability of at least one correct solution among many attempts. DRY-SFT has two stages. First, for each problem, sequentially generate K solutions, showing the model all prior attempts and asking for a different solution. Second, fine-tune on each attempt independently, removing prior attempts from the context. The process uses no reward, verifier, or correctness filter. On HumanEval+, MBPP+, and DS-1000, DRY-SFT raises pass@100 by 10.8, 12.5, and 12.4 percentage points, respectively, at a small cost to pass@1. Structural diversity, measured by abstract syntax tree edit distance among passing solutions, rises significantly on all three benchmarks. DRY-SFT also solves 244 of 600 problems that the base model did not solve in the same 200 attempts. Across nine open-weight models, lower structural diversity of the base model significantly predicts larger DRY-SFT gains, indicating that the method is especially effective on more mode-collapsed models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DRY-SFT，一种两阶段后训练方法，通过让模型生成不同解并分别微调，提升输出多样性和覆盖度，在代码生成任务上显著提高pass@100。
AI.motivation: 在数学和代码等可验证领域，多次尝试中找到一个正确解比单次通过率更重要。但后训练会使模型输出集中在少数模式，提高采样温度效果有限，因此需要一种不依赖奖励或验证器的方法来增加输出多样性。
AI.method: DRY-SFT分两阶段：首先对每个问题依次生成K个解，向模型展示所有先前尝试并要求生成不同的解；其次对每个尝试独立微调，从上下文中移除先前尝试。整个过程不使用奖励、验证器或正确性过滤。
AI.result: 在HumanEval+、MBPP+和DS-1000上，DRY-SFT将pass@100分别提升10.8、12.5和12.4个百分点，pass@1略有下降。通过AST编辑距离衡量的结构多样性显著上升。在600个问题中，DRY-SFT解决了244个基座模型在同样200次尝试中未解决的问题。在九个开放权重模型上，基座模型结构多样性越低，DRY-SFT增益越大。
AI.conclusion: DRY-SFT能有效提升输出多样性和覆盖度，尤其对模式坍缩更严重的模型效果更显著。

title: A Comparative Transfer-Learning Study of CNN Backbones for Partial Face Recognition on the SoF Dataset
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 3 tables, accepted at The 6th International Conference on Electrical, Computer, Communications and Mechatronics Engineering (ICECCME 2026)
summary: Face recognition is widely deployed in surveillance, access control, and forensic workflows, yet accuracy degrades sharply once the face is occluded by accessories, foreground objects, or the frame edge. Because most faces in the wild are partial, robust partial face recognition (PFR) remains open. This paper compares three pretrained convolutional backbones, ResNet-50, VGG-16, and FaceNet, fine-tuned for PFR by transfer learning under identical preprocessing, splitting, and optimization protocols on the Specs-on-Faces (SoF) dataset. All three arms use a common 160x160 input and a frozen backbone with a trainable head under a fixed epoch budget and no per-backbone hyperparameter search. The FaceNet configuration, denoted PFN (Partial FaceNet), substantially outperforms the other two, reaching 97.4% test accuracy with macro-averaged 87.04% precision, 84.61% recall, and 84.17% F1 over the 112 identity classes, the highest accuracy and recall reported on SoF.

AI.tldr: 该论文在Specs-on-Faces数据集上比较了ResNet-50、VGG-16和FaceNet三种预训练卷积骨干网络，通过迁移学习进行部分人脸识别（PFR），发现基于FaceNet的PFN配置性能最佳，在112个身份类别上达到97.4%测试准确率，并报告了SoF数据集上最高的准确率和召回率。
AI.motivation: 人脸识别在监控、门禁和取证等场景中广泛应用，但人脸被配饰、前景物体或画面边缘遮挡时准确率会急剧下降。现实中的大多数人脸都是部分可见的，因此稳健的部分人脸识别仍是一个开放问题。
AI.method: 在Specs-on-Faces（SoF）数据集上，对ResNet-50、VGG-16和FaceNet三种预训练卷积骨干网络进行迁移学习微调，用于部分人脸识别。所有实验采用相同预处理、数据划分和优化协议，统一输入尺寸为160x160，冻结骨干网络并训练可训练分类头，固定训练轮数且不对各骨干网络单独搜索超参数。
AI.result: FaceNet配置（称为PFN，Partial FaceNet）显著优于其他两种骨干网络，在112个身份类别上达到97.4%测试准确率，宏平均精确率87.04%、召回率84.61%、F1值84.17%，取得了SoF数据集上最高的准确率和召回率。
AI.conclusion: 基于FaceNet的迁移学习配置PFN在部分人脸识别任务上表现最优，表明该方案在SoF数据集上有效，并可作为部分人脸识别的高性能基线。

title: Scalable In-Domain Self-Supervised Foundation Model for Dense Representation Transfer in High-Resolution Plant Imaging
summary: High-resolution plant imaging enables detailed characterization of plant morphology, but dense scientific analysis remains limited by costly pixel-level annotations, large image pixel dimensions, and substantial variation in imaging conditions. This work proposes a scalable in-domain self-supervised pretrained foundation model for high-resolution, high-pixel-dimension multi-species plant imagery. A masked autoencoder with a ViT backbone is pretrained on more than 10 million multi-view plant image tiles using distributed training. Following scalable pretraining, the learned foundation-model representations are comprehensively benchmarked across fine-grained dense prediction and coarse global feature recognition, with particular emphasis on limited supervision and realistic downstream imaging conditions. This work focuses on the domain gap of existing foundation models in dense feature representation and transfer. Through extensive experiments involving limited annotations, cross-view variation, and resolution degradation, the in-domain FM achieves a Mean Dice of 0.8686 and a Pooled Dice of 0.8959, outperforming an MAE counterpart pretrained on large-scale natural-image data by 0.0694 and 0.0613, respectively. The results further indicate that increasing pretraining scale produces consistent improvements in dense feature transfer. Overall, these findings suggest that scaling in-domain self-supervised pretraining can reduce the domain gap and improve transferable dense representations for high-pixel-dimension scientific imaging.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出面向高分辨率、高像素、多物种植物图像的域内自监督预训练基础模型，并在密集预测和全局识别任务上验证其迁移性能。
AI.motivation: 高分辨率植物成像缺乏大规模像素级标注，图像像素尺寸大且成像条件差异显著，现有基础模型在密集特征表示和迁移上存在域间差距。
AI.method: 采用ViT骨干的掩码自编码器（MAE），在超过1000万多视角植物图像图块上进行分布式自监督预训练；随后在有限监督和真实下游成像条件下，系统评测细粒度密集预测与粗粒度全局特征识别。
AI.result: 域内基础模型取得Mean Dice 0.8686和Pooled Dice 0.8959，分别比在大规模自然图像上预训练的MAE高0.0694和0.0613；扩大预训练规模可持续提升密集特征迁移。
AI.conclusion: 扩大域内自监督预训练可缩小域差距，并为高像素科学成像提供更强的可迁移密集表示。

title: Choir: An Open Protocol for Distributed Multi-Agent Autoformalization
summary: AI agents can now formalize entire textbooks and major theorems in proof assistants such as Lean, but current efforts are typically centralized: a single team runs all agents and bears the full computational cost. We introduce Choir, an open protocol for distributed formalization. Choir decomposes a project into tasks that can be completed by independent contributors, each running their own agent with their own LLM subscription, while coordinating entirely through the project's GitHub repository. To support open participation, every contribution is checked by a deterministic gate before merge. Choir supports Lean 4, Isabelle, and Rocq, and is open source and modular, allowing projects to replace individual components or extend the protocol.

AI.tldr: Choir 是一个开放协议，用于分布式形式化：将形式化项目拆分为任务，由独立贡献者各自运行 AI agent 和 LLM 完成，通过 GitHub 仓库协调，并在合并前用确定性 gate 检查贡献。
AI.motivation: 当前 AI agent 已能在 Lean 等证明助手中形式化整本教材和主要定理，但通常采用集中式模式：单一团队运行所有 agent 并承担全部计算成本，限制了开放参与和规模化。
AI.method: 提出 Choir 协议，将项目分解为可独立完成的任务；贡献者使用自己的 agent 和 LLM 订阅；通过项目的 GitHub 仓库进行协调；每个贡献在合并前经过确定性 gate 检查；支持 Lean 4、Isabelle 和 Rocq；开源且模块化，允许替换组件或扩展协议。
AI.result: 实现了支持多种证明助手、开源模块化、可扩展的分布式形式化协议，并通过确定性 gate 保障合并贡献的可靠性；摘要未提供具体实验数据或性能指标。
AI.conclusion: Choir 通过分布式协作降低集中式计算成本，支持开放参与，并借助模块化设计促进形式化项目的扩展与组件替换，为大规模 AI 辅助形式化提供新路径。

title: RefCompose: Multi-Reference Image Generation via LoRA-Conditioned Diffusion
comment: Accepted in ECCV 2026 Workshop on AI for Visual Arts
summary: Filmmakers and visual artists routinely need to compose multiple references, actors, locations, props, cultural elements, into a single coherent shot, but existing tools either fail to scale past a handful of references or destroy fine grained subject identity in the process, since per reference tokenization scales memory linearly with reference count $N$ and generated content often departs from the given references rather than reproducing them. We propose \textbf{RefCompose}, a pixel space compositional conditioning framework that decouples \emph{where} things go from \emph{what} they look like, via a single fixed resolution reference canvas that keeps conditioning size constant regardless of reference count. Spatial layout is induced at inference time from a frozen diffusion transformer and extracted via Grounding DINO, requiring no LLM or dedicated layout model, while dual stream LoRA adapters inject a layout derived depth map and the encoded canvas through separate low rank streams, disentangling geometric scaffolding from localized appearance. On the Dense Layout protocol, RefCompose consistently outperforms layout based and state of the art multi reference baselines on color, texture, shape, spatial accuracy, and identity/content preservation at higher reference counts, all with constant inference memory, making it a practical building block for multi subject cinematic composition at production scale.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RefCompose，一种像素空间组合条件框架，用固定分辨率参考画布和双流 LoRA 解耦“位置”与“外观”，实现多参考图组合，并在高参考数量下保持恒定推理内存与更优生成质量。
AI.motivation: 影视和视觉艺术常需将多个参考、演员、场景、道具、文化元素组合进单个连贯镜头，但现有工具难以扩展到大量参考，且会破坏主体细粒度身份；逐参考 tokenization 导致内存随参考数线性增长，生成内容也常偏离给定参考。
AI.method: RefCompose 将“放在哪里”和“长什么样”解耦：使用固定分辨率参考画布，使条件尺寸不随参考数量增长；推理时从冻结扩散 Transformer 中诱导空间布局，并用 Grounding DINO 提取，无需 LLM 或专用布局模型；通过双流 LoRA 适配器分别注入布局导出的深度图和编码画布，以低秩流分离几何脚手架与局部外观。
AI.result: 在 Dense Layout 协议上，RefCompose 在颜色、纹理、形状、空间准确性以及身份/内容保持方面，持续优于基于布局的方法和最先进的多参考基线，尤其在更高参考数量下表现更好，同时保持恒定推理内存。
AI.conclusion: RefCompose 可作为生产规模多主体电影构图的实用基础模块。

title: Grid-Forming E-STATCOMs for Stable Integration of Large-Scale Data Centers: Modeling and Control
comment: To be published in CIGRE: Grid of the Future Symposium 2026, in Richmond, Virginia, US
summary: The rapid expansion of large-scale AI data centers (AIDC) is introducing new stability challenges, particularly in weak or low-inertia networks characterized by fast, step-like demand variations and strict requirements on voltage and dynamic performance. This paper investigates the use of grid-forming (GFM) Enhanced STATCOMs (E-STATCOMs) to support reliable integration of such facilities. A power-admittance-based linear modelling framework is developed to capture system interactions and is validated through detailed EMT simulations.
