The results demonstrate that E-STATCOMs provide fast, well-damped responses to abrupt load changes while effectively mitigating low-frequency oscillations and interactions with network resonances. By enabling tunable dynamic behavior via a load balancer, virtual impedance, and coordinated active-reactive power support, the proposed approach allows precise shaping of system response and improved regulation at the point of connection. These features make E-STATCOMs a flexible and scalable solution for integrating large data centers into weak grids and long transmission systems, supported by a design-oriented framework that facilitates parameter selection and performance assessment without extensive reliance on EMT studies to meet grid codes and AIDC interconnection requirements.

AI.tldr: 论文研究采用构网型增强STATCOM（GFM E-STATCOM）支持大型AI数据中心接入弱网或低惯量电网，提出基于功率-导纳的线性建模框架并经EMT仿真验证，表明其可提升动态响应与稳定性。
AI.motivation: 大规模AI数据中心快速扩张，在弱网或低惯量网络中带来快速阶跃式负荷变化、电压和动态性能要求严格等新稳定性挑战。
AI.method: 建立基于功率-导纳的线性建模框架以刻画系统交互，并通过详细EMT仿真验证；同时利用负载平衡器、虚拟阻抗以及有功-无功协调支撑实现动态行为可调。
AI.result: E-STATCOM对突变负载变化具有快速且阻尼良好的响应，能有效抑制低频振荡及与网络谐振的交互，并通过可调动态特性改善并网点电压调节。
AI.conclusion: E-STATCOM是灵活且可扩展的解决方案，可支持大型数据中心接入弱电网和长输电系统；所提设计导向框架有助于参数选择与性能评估，减少满足并网规范和数据中心互联要求时对EMT研究的过度依赖。

title: EmailBench: A Benchmark for Evaluating LLM Agents on Enterprise Email and Productivity Tasks
summary: Enterprise email agents must combine information retrieval, structured state changes, temporal reasoning, and multi-step coordination. Recent agent benchmarks include productivity tasks, but few center on typed email workflows in a self-contained environment. We introduce EmailBench, a benchmark of 206 email and productivity scenarios across 16 task categories. The benchmark couples a typed email API specification with provider-neutral naming, a deterministic synthetic Enron-inspired corpus, and a scenario suite whose topic selection was informed by aggregate task-intent telemetry from an interactive prototype. Its hybrid evaluation protocol combines 258 executable static assertions with 211 LLM rubrics. We evaluate eight LM configurations on a fixed single-user corpus. The best-performing configuration passes only 33.5% of scenarios despite 99.7% of its tool calls completing without an observed API failure, with pass rates varying substantially across task categories. This gap shows that valid tool execution is not equivalent to task completion. EmailBench provides a self-contained environment for end-to-end email-agent evaluation, with broader tool coverage, multi-persona testing, and repeated-run evaluation as future work areas.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EmailBench，一个包含 206 个场景、16 类任务的邮件智能体基准，结合类型化邮件 API、确定性合成语料和混合评估协议，用于端到端评测。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体基准虽涉及生产力任务，但缺少在自包含环境中针对类型化邮件工作流的评测，因此需要专门基准来检验信息检索、状态变更、时序推理和多步协调能力。
AI.method: 构建 EmailBench：采用提供商中立的类型化邮件 API 规范、基于 Enron 的确定性合成语料，场景主题参考交互式原型的任务意图遥测；评估采用 258 条可执行静态断言与 211 条 LLM 评分标准相结合的混合协议。
AI.result: 在固定单用户语料上评测 8 种 LM 配置，最佳配置仅通过 33.5% 的场景，尽管其 99.7% 的工具调用未出现 API 失败，且不同任务类别通过率差异显著。
AI.conclusion: 有效工具执行不等于任务完成；EmailBench 为邮件智能体端到端评测提供了自包含环境，未来将扩展工具覆盖、多角色测试和重复运行评估。

title: LoCoVSR: Local Context Diffusion Posterior Sampling for Video Super-Resolution
summary: Video super-resolution (VSR) is an ill-posed inverse problem that aims to reconstruct a high-resolution (HR) video from a noisy, low-resolution (LR) version of it. We present LoCoVSR, a diffusion-based VSR framework that leverages pixel-space denoising diffusion probabilistic models. LoCoVSR integrates the Diffusion Posterior Sampling technique with spatio-temporal context learning, operating in a moving-average form. A localized window of adjacent LR frames is used for recovering each center frame, while applying a shared noise trajectory across all frames. The localized windowing enables processing of long videos without length limitations, supports parallel inference, and prevents error accumulation that may occur in recursive processing. Unlike prior methods, LoCoVSR offers a simple yet very effective VSR solution, avoiding explicit optical flow estimation, or information loss caused by latent space processing. Trained on the VFHQ face dataset, LoCoVSR achieves accurate, temporally consistent and high-quality upscaling with competitive results against recent diffusion-based VSR approaches.

AI.tldr: LoCoVSR 是一个基于像素空间去噪扩散概率模型的视频超分辨率框架，结合扩散后验采样与时空上下文学习，以移动平均方式处理局部窗口，实现长视频、并行推理和稳定的高质量重建。
AI.motivation: 视频超分辨率是一个病态逆问题，需从含噪低分辨率视频重建高分辨率视频。现有方法常依赖显式光流估计或潜空间处理，可能带来信息损失或误差累积，因此作者希望提出更简单有效的扩散式VSR方案。
AI.method: LoCoVSR 使用像素空间扩散模型，融合 Diffusion Posterior Sampling 与时空上下文学习，采用移动平均形式。对每个中心帧，利用相邻低分辨率帧的局部窗口进行恢复，并在所有帧间共享噪声轨迹。该方法支持长视频处理、并行推理，避免递归处理中的误差累积，且无需显式光流估计或潜空间处理。
AI.result: 在 VFHQ 人脸数据集上训练后，LoCoVSR 能够实现准确、时序一致且高质量的视频超分辨率，并与近期基于扩散的 VSR 方法相比具有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: LoCoVSR 提供了一种简单而有效的扩散式视频超分辨率解决方案，避免了光流估计和潜空间信息损失，同时支持长视频和并行推理，在时序一致性和重建质量上表现良好。

title: Control Data Scheduling over Shared Communication Channels: A Sparse and Collision-Free Mechanism
summary: In systems where controllers operate remotely and communicate with actuators over shared communication channels, it is crucial to efficiently schedule the control data transmission to reduce bandwidth usage and actuator effort. In this article, we investigate a novel scheduling mechanism that jointly coordinates control actions across different controllers and different time steps. We propose an algorithm based on the alternating direction method of multipliers (ADMM) to solve the resulting optimization problem. While ADMM is often treated as a black-box solver, the proposed algorithm offers a clear physical interpretation, ensures convergence to a stationary point, and is computationally efficient. Simulation results validate our theoretical results and demonstrate the effectiveness of our proposed algorithm.

AI.tldr: 本文研究远程控制器与执行器通过共享通信信道通信时的控制数据传输调度问题，提出一种联合协调不同控制器和不同时间步控制动作的调度机制，并用ADMM求解。
AI.motivation: 在控制器远程运行且与执行器共享通信信道的系统中，需要高效调度控制数据，以降低带宽占用和执行器负担。
AI.method: 提出一种新的联合调度机制，将不同控制器和不同时间步的控制动作协调优化；采用交替方向乘子法（ADMM）求解该优化问题，并赋予算法清晰的物理解释。
AI.result: 理论分析表明该算法能收敛到驻点且计算高效；仿真结果验证了理论结果并证明了所提算法的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 所提基于ADMM的联合调度算法在保证收敛性和计算效率的同时，能有效优化远程控制系统的通信与执行器资源使用。

title: Inertia-Corrected Newton Method For Generalized Nash Equilibria in Dynamic Games with Optimality Verification
summary:
Newton methods efficiently find Generalized Nash Equilibria (GNE) in dynamic games by solving for the KKT necessary conditions. These methods are fast and can support multi-agent Model Predictive Control (MPC) for highly dynamic robots. However, a small KKT residual alone does not certify that the returned solution satisfies the second-order sufficient conditions for a local GNE.
  In this paper, we propose an efficient numerical method to verify the second-order sufficient conditions (SOSC) for a local GNE. We connect the inertia of the agent KKT matrix with the positive definiteness of the reduced Hessian of the cost function, projected onto the null space of the constraints. Furthermore, we introduce an inertia-corrected update step that improves convergence to local GNEs by destabilizing strict saddle points with weak cross-agent coupling.
  Our main contribution is a fast Newton solver for Constrained Dynamic Games that provides efficient optimality checking. Through numerical benchmarks, we demonstrate the proposed solver's runtime and convergence performance in practical multi-agent planning problems. We also validate the solver's real-time capabilities in physical experiments using a platform of miniature autonomous race cars.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种快速牛顿求解器，用于约束动态博弈，并能高效验证局部广义纳什均衡（GNE）的二阶充分条件（SOSC）。
AI.motivation: 牛顿类方法虽能快速求解动态博弈中的GNE，但仅靠小的KKT残差无法保证解满足局部GNE的二阶充分条件，因此需要高效的最优性验证方法。
AI.method: 将智能体KKT矩阵的惯性与被约束代价函数约化Hessian在约束零空间上的正定性联系起来；引入惯性修正更新步骤，通过 destabilizing 弱跨智能体耦合下的严格鞍点来改善局部GNE收敛；构建约束动态博弈的快速牛顿求解器。
AI.result: 数值基准展示了该求解器在多智能体规划问题中的运行时间和收敛性能，并通过微型自动驾驶赛车平台的物理实验验证了实时能力。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法为约束动态博弈提供了一种高效的最优性检查与快速求解方案，适用于实际多智能体规划与实时控制场景。

title: Omni-IO Skills: Harnessing Your Agent Omni-Native
summary: General-purpose agents can plan, reason, and act over long horizons, yet their production capabilities remain fragmented across text, images, audio, video, documents, 3D assets, and code. Extending a foundation model to additional modalities ties capability growth to costly model updates, while assembling specialist models and tools leaves unresolved how procedures, dependencies, intermediate assets, and cross-turn revisions should be coordinated. We present Omni-IO Skills, a plug-and-play Agent Harness that makes existing agents omni-native through hierarchical Skills, a standardized multimodal execution interface, dependency-aware orchestration, and a persistent Asset Registry. Multi-asset workflows are represented as Declare Execution Graphs, which schedule independent operations concurrently and register successful outputs for downstream and cross-turn reuse across replaceable execution backends. Its 27 Skills cover 38 representative tasks spanning seven artifact modalities and four capability families: understanding, generation, reasoning, and retrieval. On UniM-90, the harness raises the input-support rates of GPT-5.6 Sol and Claude Sonnet 5 from 40.00% and 38.89% to 100%, while increasing relative Semantic--Quality Coupled Score from 26.99 to 74.94 and from 27.82 to 77.78, respectively; Strict Structure Score reaches 100.00 and 99.78. These results establish harness-level capability composition as a practical route to broad, evolvable Omni systems without changing the host agent's reasoning core.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Omni-IO Skills——一个即插即用的 Agent Harness，通过分层 Skills、标准化多模态执行接口、依赖感知编排与持久化资产注册表，让现有智能体无需修改推理核心即可获得跨模态生产与复用能力，在 UniM-90 上大幅提升多模态任务表现。
AI.motivation: 通用智能体虽能长期规划与推理，但文本、图像、音频、视频、文档、3D 资产与代码等生产能力的整合仍是割裂的：向基础模型扩展新模态会把能力增长绑定于昂贵的模型更新，而拼接专家模型与工具又难以协调流程、依赖、中间资产与跨轮修订。
AI.method: 提出 Omni-IO Skills 即插即用 Agent Harness，包含分层 Skills、标准化多模态执行接口、依赖感知编排与持久化 Asset Registry；以 Declare Execution Graphs 表示多资产工作流，并发调度独立操作并注册成功输出以供下游与跨轮复用，可替换执行后端；共 27 个 Skills，覆盖 7 类产物模态与理解、生成、推理、检索四类能力的 38 个代表性任务。
AI.result: 在 UniM-90 上，该 Harness 将 GPT-5.6 Sol 与 Claude Sonnet 5 的输入支持率分别从 40.00% 和 38.89% 提升至 100%；相对 Semantic-Quality Coupled Score 分别从 26.99 提升至 74.94、从 27.82 提升至 77.78；Strict Structure Score 分别达到 100.00 与 99.78。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，Harness 层面的能力组合是在不改变宿主智能体推理核心的前提下，构建广泛且可演进的 Omni 系统的可行路径。

title: HapticWorld: an Interactive World Simulator with Real-time Torque Feedback
summary: Contact-rich manipulation depends on force sensing that is hard to infer from visual signals alone, both for collecting demonstrations and for training policies. Force-annotated data, however, remains hard to obtain at scale: real-robot collection ties every demonstration to physical hardware, physics simulators report contact forces that deviate systematically from real measurements, and learned world simulators, though scalable and realistic, are vision-only, so operators feel nothing during data collection and the data carries no force/torque (F/T) labels. We present HapticWorld, an interactive world simulator that predicts joint torque together with observations and renders it back to the operator in real time, closing the haptic loop between a human and a learned world model. Across three contact-rich tasks, torque feedback raises data collection throughput by 1.6 times on average. Policies trained on HapticWorld-generated demonstrations succeed in 54/60 real-world trials, approaching the 56/60 upper bound of real-world data, and far exceeding the 19/60 success rate of the vision-only baseline. Moreover, the success rates measured inside HapticWorld closely match real-world evaluation, demonstrating that HapticWorld can serve as a stand-alone F/T-conditioned policy evaluation platform.

AI.tldr: 提出 HapticWorld，一个可交互世界模拟器，能预测关节扭矩并与观测一起实时反馈给操作者，形成人类与学习世界模型之间的触觉闭环，用于接触丰富操作的数据采集、策略训练与评估。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富操作依赖力感知，而视觉信号难以推断力信息。真实机器人采集数据受硬件限制，物理模拟器接触力与真实测量存在系统偏差，学习世界模拟器虽可扩展且真实但仅视觉，导致采集时操作者无触觉反馈且数据缺少力/扭矩标签。
AI.method: HapticWorld 预测关节扭矩与观测，并实时将扭矩渲染给操作者，构建触觉闭环。该方法用于生成带力/扭矩标注的演示数据、训练策略，并在三类接触丰富任务中验证其数据采集、策略学习和独立评估能力。
AI.result: 扭矩反馈使数据采集吞吐平均提升1.6倍；基于 HapticWorld 演示训练的策略在真实世界60次试验中成功54次，接近真实数据上限56/60，远高于仅视觉基线的19/60；HapticWorld 内评估成功率与真实世界评估高度一致。
AI.conclusion: HapticWorld 能有效提供力/扭矩标注数据，提高接触丰富任务的数据采集效率与策略真实世界性能，并可作为一个独立的 F/T 条件策略评估平台。

title: Improving Medical Calculation of LLMs with Embedded Coding
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) perform well on medical examinations and question-answering benchmarks, but remain unreliable on medical calculation tasks that require exact numerical outputs. These calculations support high-stakes decisions such as medication dosing, organ-function assessment, and prognostic scoring, for which even small errors can have serious clinical consequences. We introduce MedCode, a framework that improves medical calculation by training LLMs to generate embedded executable code. Given a clinical context, the model identifies the relevant calculator, extracts its input variables, and produces a script that delegates arithmetic operations to a deterministic interpreter. Executing the script returns the calculated value together with an explanation and the appropriate unit. We construct supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and preference datasets from the MedCalc benchmark and additionally curate a dataset for calculation tasks in Intensive Care Unit (ICU) scenarios. We further propose weighted Direct Preference Optimization (wDPO), which adaptively emphasizes preference pairs that are difficult for the model to distinguish. Experiments with LLaMA3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Mistral-7B show absolute accuracy gains of 20--30 percentage points, demonstrating the effectiveness of embedded code generation for medical calculation.

AI.tldr: 提出 MedCode 框架，通过训练大语言模型生成嵌入式可执行代码来完成医学计算任务，并在多个模型上显著提升计算准确率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型在医学考试和问答基准上表现良好，但在需要精确数值输出的医学计算任务上仍不可靠，而这些计算涉及用药剂量、器官功能评估和预后评分等高风险临床决策。
AI.method: MedCode 让模型根据临床背景识别相关计算器、提取输入变量，并生成将算术运算交给确定性解释器执行的脚本，从而返回计算值、解释和单位。基于 MedCalc 基准构建监督微调与偏好数据集，并额外整理 ICU 计算任务数据集；同时提出加权直接偏好优化（wDPO），自适应强调模型难以区分的偏好对。
AI.result: 在 LLaMA3-8B、Qwen2.5-7B 和 Mistral-7B 上实验，绝对准确率提升 20–30 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 嵌入式代码生成能有效提升医学计算任务的可靠性，表明 MedCode 与 wDPO 对高风险医学数值计算具有显著效果。

title: Toward AI-Assisted Poultry Coccidiosis Diagnosis: Evaluating Gemini and BiomedParse on Eimeria Microscopy Images
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, 3 tables, accepted at IEEE International Conference on Sustainability, Innovation and Technology (ICSIT 2026)
summary: Coccidiosis caused by Eimeria parasites is a major economic burden in poultry production, and effective control depends on accurate species-level diagnosis. This study evaluates whether a general-purpose multimodal large language model can support such diagnosis. Google Gemini was assessed on 4,225 mi- croscopy images covering the seven fowl-infecting Eimeria species under two prompting conditions, one without candidate labels and one with a predefined class list, and was further tested for pathology-report generation, while BiomedParse was examined for parasite segmentation. Without candidate labels, the model produced broad and taxonomically inconsistent outputs. With candidate labels, overall accuracy reached only 14.9%, with a strong bias toward E. tenella at 74% and no correct classifications for E. acervulina, E. mitis and E. praecox. Generated treatment reports were coherent but unverified, and segmentation was only partial. Current multimodal models are therefore not yet reliable for standalone Eimeria diagnosis without domain-specific fine- tuning and expert validation.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估通用多模态大模型 Google Gemini 能否用于家禽艾美耳球虫的物种级诊断，并测试其报告生成与分割能力。
AI.motivation: 球虫病给家禽生产带来重大经济损失，有效防控依赖准确的物种级诊断，因此需要探索通用多模态模型能否支持该诊断。
AI.method: 使用 4,225 张显微图像，覆盖 7 种感染家禽的艾美耳球虫；在无候选标签和有预定义类别列表两种提示条件下评估 Gemini，并测试病理报告生成；另用 BiomedParse 评估寄生虫分割。
AI.result: 无候选标签时输出宽泛且分类学不一致；有候选标签时总体准确率仅 14.9%，强烈偏向 E. tenella（74%），对 E. acervulina、E. mitis、E. praecox 无正确分类；生成的治疗报告连贯但未经验证，分割仅部分有效。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态模型尚不能可靠地独立用于艾美耳球虫诊断，需要领域特定微调和专家验证。

title: Devanagari Handwritten Character Recognition Using TrOCR: A Transformer-Based Model with Real-Time Web Deployment
comment: Presented and accepted at the 16th International Conference on Computing, Communication and Networking Technologies (ICCCNT), 2025
summary: Devnagari is a one of the ancient language of the Indian subcontinent consisting of 36 vowels, 14 consonants and 10 numerals. The accurate recognition of handwritten Devnagari characters is challenging due to high complexity of Devnagari scripts. This paper presents a method to fine tune the pre trained TrOCR model to accurately recognize Devanagari handwritten characters. The Methodology consists of a preprocessing mechanism where input images are standardized into RGB format, tokenized in batches and integrated with Hugging Face Dataset. The pre-trained microsoft/trocr-base-handwritten model is fine-tuned over a dataset of nearly 5000 character images that are uniformly partitioned in the ratio 8:1:1 for training, evaluation and testing. Further optimization is done is the training process through mixed precision training, gradient checkpointing, and early stopping mechanism. The model achieves a character error rate (CER) of 3.95% and a character-level accuracy of 96.05%, outperforming the previous CNN based models. A scalable web application is developed using Vite.js, Golang, and FastAPI which practically deploys the OCR model and serves character recognition task with a latency less than 5 seconds per request. This study demonstrates the use of TrOCR model to build a scalable handwritten Devnagari character recognition system and also a foundation to future research on Devnagari Script Recognition using Transformers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于预训练TrOCR模型微调的手写天城文（Devnagari）字符识别方法，并构建了可扩展的Web应用进行实际部署。
AI.motivation: 天城文是印度次大陆古老文字之一，包含36个元音、14个辅音和10个数字，其手写字符识别因文字复杂度高而具有挑战性。现有CNN方法识别性能有限，因此需要更准确、可扩展的识别方案。
AI.method: 方法包括：将输入图像标准化为RGB格式，按批次分词并集成Hugging Face Dataset；在约5000张字符图像上微调预训练模型microsoft/trocr-base-handwritten，数据按8:1:1划分为训练、验证和测试集；训练中采用混合精度训练、梯度检查点和早停机制；最后用Vite.js、Golang和FastAPI开发可扩展Web应用部署OCR模型。
AI.result: 模型达到3.95%的字符错误率（CER）和96.05%的字符级准确率，优于此前的CNN模型；部署的Web应用可在每次请求延迟低于5秒的情况下完成字符识别。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，TrOCR模型可用于构建可扩展的手写天城文字符识别系统，并为未来使用Transformer进行天城文脚本识别研究奠定基础。

title: Agents Can Use Base Models to Evade AI Detection
summary: We show that coding agents equipped with a base language model can successfully assemble responses from its samples to evade detection. Base models have been shown to evade commercial detectors, however, prior "humanization" techniques rely on using these models to paraphrase AI outputs over several iterations, which invariably results in semantic drift. In contrast, equipping coding agents to directly orchestrate the writing process by stitching text samples from a base model allows it to produce outputs that are coherent, task-specific and generally high quality. We find that Claude Opus 5 operating in a Claude Code harness effectively orchestrates a local 32B parameter OLMo-2 base LM and sacrifices little task accuracy across benchmarks spanning creative writing, factual grounding, health QA and instruction following, while using up to 90% base LM tokens. Responses constructed in this manner reduce the effectiveness of both post-hoc detectors (Pangram v4 detection rate drops from 77% to 24%) and soft watermarking applied a priori to the agent's generations (down to a simulated 10% detection at low FPR). While effective, this evasion requires a significantly larger number of input and output tokens from the agent, increasing the dollar cost per query up to 30x at API-pricing. Overall, this work demonstrates the effectiveness of a new class of adversarial attacks against AI text detection, and urges post-hoc detection providers to include outputs of base models in their training.

AI.tldr: 该论文展示：配备基础语言模型的编码智能体可通过拼接基础模型的文本样本来组装回答，从而在保持较高质量和任务准确率的同时规避AI文本检测，但代价是token与金钱成本显著增加。
AI.motivation: 既有“拟人化”规避检测方法通常让模型多次复述AI输出，容易导致语义漂移；而基础模型虽可规避商业检测器，却难以直接生成连贯、高质量内容。因此作者希望利用编码智能体来编排基础模型采样，实现更高质量且能规避检测的输出。
AI.method: 让Claude Opus 5在Claude Code环境中充当编码智能体，编排本地32B参数OLMo-2基础语言模型，通过从基础模型采样并拼接文本来直接组装回答；在创意写作、事实基础、健康问答和指令遵循等基准上评估，并测试对事后检测器Pangram v4和生成前软水印的影响。
AI.result: 该方法任务准确率损失很小，且最多使用90%的基础模型token；Pangram v4检测率从77%降至24%，软水印在低假阳性率下模拟检测率降至10%。但智能体输入输出token显著增加，按API定价每次查询成本最高增加30倍。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了一类新的针对AI文本检测的对抗攻击，说明基础模型输出可被智能体编排用于规避检测，并建议事后检测服务商将基础模型输出纳入训练数据。

title: Unlocking Geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein Distances for 3D Modeling
summary: \textit{Gromov-Wasserstein Distances} (GWDs) provide quantitative ways of comparing probabilistic distributions defined on different metric spaces by applying techniques from the optimal transport theory. As such, GWD can be potentially useful in a large variety of applications ranging from graph matching problems to 3D object detection. However its practical use at scale is significantly limited by cubic time complexity computations involving dense intra-space distance matrices. Even though in the Euclidean metric spaces several techniques (e.g. involving scalable kernel methods) were proposed to address it, to the best of our knowledge, analogous techniques for general geodesic distances on manifolds, or shortest-path distance on graphs in their discretized variants, were not developed. In this paper, we present \textbf{E}fficient \textbf{G}eodesic \textbf{Gro}mov-\textbf{W}asserstein methods (EGGroW), a new class of efficient algorithms designed to calculate geodesic Gromov-Wasserstein distances with entropic Sinkhorn-like approaches, leveraging recently introduced \textit{GenusSink} methods \citep{genussink} and the theory of random features. We provide important downstream applications, namely: 3D pose estimation and 3D template detection. In the latter setting, we formulate a partial 3D template recovery as a staged problem: capacity-constrained scene selection is followed by semi-relaxed recovery of template visibility and correspondence. Our empirical findings show that EGGroW provides accurate solutions when standard Euclidean-based techniques fail and is characterized by light computational footprint, as our theoretical analysis predicts.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 EGGroW，一类基于熵正则化 Sinkhorn 与随机特征的高效测地 Gromov-Wasserstein 距离计算方法，用于比较不同度量空间上的分布，并在 3D 姿态估计与 3D 模板检测中验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: Gromov-Wasserstein 距离可用于图匹配、3D 目标检测等，但计算涉及稠密空间内距离矩阵，复杂度高达三次方，难以大规模应用；欧氏空间已有可扩展核方法，而流形上的测地距离或图上的最短路径距离尚缺乏类似高效方法。
AI.method: 提出 EGGroW 算法，利用熵正则化 Sinkhorn 类方法和随机特征理论，并结合 GenusSink 方法计算测地 Gromov-Wasserstein 距离；在 3D 模板检测中，将部分模板恢复建模为容量约束场景选择与半松弛模板可见性及对应关系恢复的两阶段问题。
AI.result: 实验表明，EGGroW 在标准欧氏方法失败时仍能给出准确解，并具有较轻的计算负担，与理论分析一致。
AI.conclusion: EGGroW 为一般测地距离下的 Gromov-Wasserstein 距离提供了高效、准确的计算框架，适用于 3D 姿态估计和 3D 模板检测等下游任务。

title: Hierarchical Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning for Warehouse Robot Coordination under Communication Loss
summary: In this paper, we propose a hierarchical multi-agent reinforcement learning framework for coordinating robot teams in warehouse environments under communication loss. We partition the robot team into groups, with centralized coordination within each group and distributed coordination across groups. Each group uses a recurrent predictor to estimate unavailable interaction information due to communication loss. A higher-level policy then generates a compact coordination reference that conditions the local control policy within each group. A predictive safety filter evaluates and modifies the proposed controls when they violate safety constraints. Simulation results show improved task completion under communication loss, reduced communication growth as the team size increases, and safe operation in the tested scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种分层多智能体强化学习框架，用于在通信丢失的仓库环境中协调机器人团队。
AI.motivation: 仓库机器人团队在通信丢失时难以有效协调，同时团队规模增大会带来通信开销和安全隐患。
AI.method: 将机器人团队分组，组内集中协调、组间分布式协调；用循环预测器估计因通信丢失而缺失的交互信息；高层策略生成紧凑协调参考以条件化组内局部控制策略；并用预测性安全滤波器评估和修正违反安全约束的控制。
AI.result: 仿真结果表明：通信丢失下任务完成率提高，团队规模增大时通信增长减少，并且在测试场景中实现安全运行。
AI.conclusion: 该分层多智能体强化学习框架能够提升通信丢失下的协调效果、可扩展性和安全性。

title: A Minimum-Order Functional Observer Beyond the Darouach and Luenberger Constructions
summary:
This paper develops a general minimum-order functional observer
  framework that contains the classical Darouach functional observer and
  the reduced-order Luenberger observer as special cases. The required
  functional dimension is determined from the triple $(A,C,L)$ through a
  set of functional observability indices. The minimum dimension permitted
  by the algebraic observer-existence condition is characterized, and the
  complete family of augmentations attaining this dimension is determined.
  Necessary-and-sufficient spectral feasibility conditions are then
  established for this dimension to be the minimum achievable observer
  order. The resulting existence conditions reduce exactly to the
  Darouach conditions when no augmentation is required and to the
  classical observability condition in the reduced-order Luenberger case.
  More generally, the framework admits minimum-order functional observers
  of intermediate order, which may exist even when neither classical
  observer is available.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了一个通用的最小阶函数观测器框架，将经典 Darouach 函数观测器和降阶 Luenberger 观测器作为特例包含在内。
AI.motivation: 现有函数观测器设计缺乏统一的最小阶理论，且经典 Darouach 观测器与降阶 Luenberger 观测器之间存在空白，需要刻画更一般的可实现最小阶观测器条件。
AI.method: 通过三元组 (A,C,L) 定义函数可观性指标，确定所需函数维数；基于代数观测器存在条件刻画最小允许维数，并给出达到该维数的全部增广族；进一步建立谱可行性充要条件。
AI.result: 得到了最小可实现观测器阶数的充要条件；当无需增广时，存在条件退化为 Darouach 条件，在降阶 Luenberger 情形退化为经典可观性条件；框架还允许中间阶最小函数观测器，这类观测器可能在两种经典观测器均不可用时仍存在。
AI.conclusion: 该框架统一并推广了经典函数观测器与降阶 Luenberger 观测器理论，为最小阶函数观测器的存在性和设计提供了完整刻画。

title: Towards Transparent Diagnostics: Investigating Architectural Trade-offs and Explainability in Malaria Detection
summary: More than 80 countries have reported malaria cases with 610 thousand deaths and are projected to increase. Identifying malaria early and accurately helps save lives. The effective way to diagnose malaria is through microscopic methods that are labor intensive and require experts with special equipment. Deep learning (DL) has shown promising results in medical diagnosis. Here, we explored various DL models: ResNet18, MobileNetV2, EfficientNet-B2, VGG19 and also proposed a model for detecting malaria presence using blood smears taken from the NIH Malaria dataset. Our experiment shows that MobileNetV2 achieved 96.35% accuracy with the smallest model size (8.49 MB) and fastest inference (1.35 ms). The proposed model achieved 97.67% accuracy, 0.9756 AUC with longest inference time (13.17 ms). The larger architecture outputs a larger model size with moderate accuracy. Upon further pruning, the proposed model gained a slight improvement in accuracy and inference time. The GRAD-CAM, SHAP and LIME shade explainable AI (XAI) insights of the model.

AI.tldr: 本文利用NIH疟疾血液涂片数据集，比较多种深度学习模型并提出新模型用于疟疾自动检测，同时结合可解释AI方法分析模型。
AI.motivation: 疟疾在全球80多个国家仍有病例报告，且死亡和病例数预计增加；早期准确诊断可挽救生命，但显微镜检查依赖专家和专用设备，劳动强度大，因此需要自动化、高效的深度学习辅助诊断方法。
AI.method: 探索了ResNet18、MobileNetV2、EfficientNet-B2、VGG19等深度学习模型，并提出一个新模型，在NIH疟疾数据集上检测血液涂片中的疟疾。进一步对提出模型进行剪枝，并使用GRAD-CAM、SHAP和LIME提供可解释性分析。
AI.result: MobileNetV2达到96.35%准确率，模型最小（8.49 MB），推理最快（1.35 ms）。提出模型达到97.67%准确率和0.9756 AUC，但推理时间最长（13.17 ms）。较大架构模型体积更大且准确率中等。剪枝后提出模型在准确率和推理时间上有轻微改善。
AI.conclusion: 深度学习可用于疟疾血液涂片检测，MobileNetV2在效率和体积上表现突出，提出模型准确率最高；剪枝可带来轻微性能提升，XAI方法有助于理解模型决策。

title: BioDyad: Synchronize Biomedical Discovery and Machine Learning Engineering
summary: Agentic biomedical machine learning (ML) draws on complementary advances in biomedical evidence acquisition and executable program search. Existing systems connect aspects of these capabilities, but coordinating them throughout program search remains challenging. New evidence must guide candidate construction, execution outcomes must inform subsequent discovery and reuse, and validation demands must fit the search budget. We introduce BioDyad, which couples biomedical discovery and ML engineering through two hierarchies within Monte Carlo graph search. Its scientific hierarchy combines prior biomedical guidance with iterative discovery, then links biomedical plans to execution outcomes in memory for reuse across candidates. Its engineering hierarchy moves candidate programs from smoke execution, through train/validation evaluation, to full-data retraining. We evaluate BioDyad on the 76-task BioXArena benchmark under a two-hour per-task budget with three matched LLM backends. It achieves the highest penalized all-task score and task success rate among four agent methods and a one-shot baseline under each backend. These results support coordinating biomedical discovery and ML engineering to integrate external knowledge into executable programs across heterogeneous biomedical tasks.

AI.tldr: BioDyad 通过蒙特卡洛图搜索中的两个层次耦合生物医学发现与机器学习工程，在 BioXArena 基准上取得最佳表现。
AI.motivation: 现有人工智能生物医学机器学习系统虽结合证据获取与程序搜索，但在整个程序搜索过程中协调二者仍具挑战：新证据需指导候选构建，执行结果需反馈后续发现与复用，验证需求需匹配搜索预算。
AI.method: 提出 BioDyad，在蒙特卡洛图搜索中设置两个层次：科学层次结合先验生物医学指导与迭代发现，并将生物医学计划与执行结果存入记忆以供候选复用；工程层次将候选程序从冒烟执行推进到训练/验证评估，再到全数据重训练。
AI.result: 在 76 任务 BioXArena 基准上，每任务两小时预算和三种匹配 LLM 后端下，BioDyad 在四种智能体方法和单次基线中取得最高的惩罚全任务得分和任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，协调生物医学发现与机器学习工程有助于将外部知识整合为可执行程序，适用于异构生物医学任务。

title: Adapting Vision-Language Models for Human-Readable XAI in Industrial Object Detection
summary: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) solutions are essential for building trust in AI technologies and their integration in real manufacturing lines. However, most existing methods are tailored to technical experts, limiting their accessibility to diverse user groups such as blue-collar workers in manufacturing lines who use AI for quality control. In this work, we introduce an XAI interface for object detection in industrial manufacturing based on a fine-tuned vision-language model, designed to generate intuitive explanations for non-expert users. We benchmark existing vision-language models and demonstrate that out-of-the-box models often fall short in delivering clear, context-relevant explanations for non-expert users. To address this, we fine-tune a vision-language model and integrate it into our interface, enabling contextualized, accessible explanations for non-expert users. We demonstrate improvements in explanation clarity, instruction adherence, image groundedness, and contextual awareness over GPT 4o-mini on proprietary and public robotics dataset. This approach advances the accessibility and usability of AI explanations, making them more intuitive and applicable in manufacturing domain.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向工业制造目标检测的可解释AI界面，基于微调视觉语言模型，为非专家用户生成直观解释。
AI.motivation: 现有XAI方法多面向技术专家，难以被制造产线中从事质量控制的蓝领工人等非专家用户理解和使用。
AI.method: 基准测试现有视觉语言模型；针对其解释不清、上下文相关性不足的问题，微调视觉语言模型并集成到XAI界面中，为工业目标检测生成情境化、易理解的解释。
AI.result: 在专有和公开机器人数据集上，相比GPT-4o-mini，所提方法在解释清晰度、指令遵循、图像依据性和上下文感知方面均有提升。
AI.conclusion: 该方法提升了AI解释的可及性与可用性，使其更直观，并更适用于制造领域。

title: Transformer MLP Gate Thresholds Are Couplings to a Carried Reference Direction
comment: 18 pages, 4 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/EvidentSolutions/llm-interp/tree/main/background. An earlier version of this paper is archived on Zenodo, doi:10.5281/zenodo.21498411; this version supersedes it and corrects several reported values
summary: The corpus-mean direction of a transformer's residual stream is a component shared across all inputs, and is commonly removed by mean-centering before representational analysis. We present evidence that it is a functional component: the reference against which the MLP gate population sets its operating point. In Phi-2, an exact decomposition of resting gate pre-activations shows that at mid-stack layers the resting inhibition of >99.9% of gates is carried by the coupling $w \cdot b_L$ to the carried mean direction, at 48-56$\times$ the explicit bias parameter, and the coupling is direction-specific: a random direction at matched norm orders the population's firing rates at Spearman $ρ\leq 0.09$ where the reference reaches 0.95. (That 0.95 is near-tautological on its own; the paper derives its null.) Causally, removing the stream's projection on the reference multiplies above-threshold firing by about 9$\times$, dose-monotonically, at 23-59$\times$ a norm-matched control; a random-initialised twin is flat, and replacement tests show that the direction carries the function and the magnitude does not. A direction-matched control makes the same point: noise injected along the reference costs 8-42$\times$ the same energy along a random direction. The decomposition replicates on four further families spanning both gate types (GELU with an explicit gate bias, bias-free SwiGLU), and the dose-response on two of them. Across an eight-model scan the mechanism is present in every GELU and SiLU family and absent only in OPT, where an opposing LayerNorm bias cancels the carried reference. Gate thresholds are implemented as couplings to a constant the network builds for the distribution it is reading, with the bias parameters contributing little; how much of that constant is carried in the stream and how much in parameters depends on the architecture.

AI.tldr: 论文发现Transformer残差流的语料均值方向是一个功能性组件：它是MLP门控群体设定其工作点的参考基准，而非可在表征分析前随意去除的冗余成分。
AI.motivation: 残差流的语料均值方向在所有输入间共享，通常在表征分析前被均值中心化去除。作者质疑这一做法，探究该方向是否具有实际功能作用，从而重新审视其被移除的合理性。
AI.method: 在Phi-2中对静息态门控预激活进行精确分解，考察门控抑制与携带均值方向的耦合w·b_L；用随机方向（等范数）作对照比较Spearman相关；进行因果干预（移除流在参考方向上的投影）并测量阈值以上放电率变化，设置等范数对照与随机初始化孪生模型；用方向匹配的噪声注入做能量对照；在另外四个门控家族（含显式偏置的GELU、无偏置的SwiGLU）上复现，并对两个做剂量-响应；在八个模型上扫描该机制。
AI.result: 在中层，>99.9%门控的静息抑制由与携带均值方向的耦合w·b_L承担，是显式偏置参数的48-56倍；该耦合具有方向特异性：随机方向排序放电率的Spearman ρ≤0.09，而参考方向达0.95。因果上，移除该投影使阈值以上放电率约增至9倍，呈剂量单调性，是等范数对照的23-59倍；随机初始化孪生模型无此效应，替换实验表明功能由方向而非幅度承载。沿参考方向的噪声注入耗能为随机方向的8-42倍。机制在四个额外家族及八个模型扫描中复现，仅OPT缺失（因对立的LayerNorm偏置抵消了携带的参考）。
AI.conclusion: 门控阈值被实现为与网络为所读分布构建的常数之间的耦合，偏置参数贡献甚微；该常数有多少由残差流携带、多少存于参数中取决于架构。均值方向是功能性组件，不应在表征分析中被无条件去除。

title: IndicFDB: Benchmarking Full-Duplex Voice Agents across Indian Languages
summary: Full-duplex voice agents must handle pauses, take turns, backchannel, and respond to user interruptions in real time. Full-Duplex-Bench evaluates these behaviors, but its English-only corpus and reliance on word-timestamped ASR and an English-prompted LLM judge make it difficult to extend to Indian languages. We introduce IndicFDB, which extends it to ten languages spoken in India with 12,350 samples, nearly 17 times as many as the original. We address three challenges: finding conversational events in multilingual speech, evaluating their timing without reliable word-level alignment, and judging responses across languages. We mine pause handling, turn taking, and backchanneling samples from roughly 50,000 hours of channel-separated conversations using voice activity detection (VAD), and construct human-validated synthetic user interruption samples. Language-independent VAD heuristics evaluate timing, while an open-weight transcription and translation pipeline converts responses to English for LLM ratings of relevance and quality. Across seven voice agents, commercial APIs show unexpectedly consistent behavior across languages but are either fast or robust to pauses, never both, while monolingual open full-duplex models expose further tradeoffs among backchanneling, response quality, and latency.

AI.tldr: 提出 IndicFDB，将 Full-Duplex-Bench 扩展到印度十种语言，包含 12,350 个样本，约为原基准的 17 倍，用于评估全双工语音代理的停顿处理、轮流、反馈和用户打断等实时交互行为。
AI.motivation: 现有 Full-Duplex-Bench 仅支持英语，且依赖词级时间戳 ASR 和英语提示的 LLM 评判，难以扩展到印度语言，因此需要多语言、语言无关的全双工语音交互评估基准。
AI.method: 从约 50,000 小时声道分离对话中用 VAD 挖掘停顿处理、轮流和反馈样本，并构建人工验证的合成用户打断样本；使用时序无关的 VAD 启发式评估时间行为；采用开放权重转录和翻译流水线将响应转为英语，供 LLM 评分相关性和质量。
AI.result: 在七种语音代理上评估发现：商业 API 跨语言行为意外一致，但要么响应快、要么对停顿稳健，无法兼得；单语开放全双工模型在反馈、响应质量和延迟之间存在进一步权衡。
AI.conclusion: IndicFDB 为印度多语言全双工语音代理提供了可扩展评估方案，并揭示当前商业与开放模型在实时交互行为上的关键局限和权衡。

title: Symbolic Guidance for LLM Agents in Distributed Multiagent Coordination
comment: A preliminary version of this work was published as an extended abstract in the Proceedings of AAMAS 2026
summary:
Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as autonomous agents in multi-agent systems, yet their ability to reliably execute distributed coordination protocols remains poorly understood. While AgentsNet, a benchmark framework for distributed coordination among LLM agents, enables such coordination, granting full reasoning autonomy often leads to inconsistent or degraded performance in complex domains.
  We hypothesize that coordination can be improved by regulating agent autonomy through symbolic guidance derived from established algorithms. To investigate this, we introduce the \emph{Symbolic Guidance Taxonomy (SGT)}, which characterizes a spectrum of autonomy ranging from open-ended natural language reasoning to fully prescribed algorithmic execution, with intermediate levels providing partial pseudocode guidance. Our results show that intermediate autonomy levels consistently outperform both unguided agents and fully prescriptive specifications. These findings identify autonomy regulation as a key design principle for LLM-based distributed coordination.

AI.tldr: 本文研究LLM智能体在分布式协调中的自主性调控问题，提出符号引导分类法（SGT），发现中等自主性水平优于完全自由推理和完全规定式执行。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地被部署为多智能体系统中的自主智能体，但其执行分布式协调协议的可靠性尚不明确；完全推理自主性在复杂任务中常导致性能不稳定或下降。
AI.method: 提出符号引导分类法（SGT），将智能体自主性从开放式自然语言推理到完全规定的算法执行划分为不同层级，其中间层级提供部分伪代码引导，并在AgentsNet等分布式协调基准上进行比较。
AI.result: 实验表明，中等自主性水平（部分伪代码引导）持续优于无引导的智能体和完全规定式规格说明。
AI.conclusion: 自主性调控是提升基于LLM的分布式协调性能的关键设计原则。

title: Grasp2Twist: Learning Bimanual Dexterous Jar Opening by Reinforcement Learning
summary: This paper presents Grasp2Twist, a bimanual dexterous manipulation system that learns to grasp and twist open jar lids using reinforcement learning. Learning this task raises three challenges: learning a unified policy for a multi-stage task, sustaining lid twisting, and sim-to-real transfer. To address the first challenge, we introduce a continuous enclosure measure to guide grasp formation and a binary enclosure indicator to guide the grasp-to-twist transition for unified policy learning. We derive both from the geometric relationship between the object center and the convex hull formed by the hand's palm and fingertips. Kinematic constraints limit how far the hand can rotate the lid with fixed contacts, so sustained twisting requires finger contact reconfiguration. We use a three-stage curriculum to facilitate exploration of these contact changes and also improve robustness for sim-to-real transfer. With our approach, the learned policy demonstrates finger gaiting, reconfiguring hand-object contacts to sustain lid rotation. It transfers zero-shot to the physical system and achieves an 88% task success rate across six household containers, including peanut-butter, vitamin, and instant-coffee jars. Ablations further validate the roles of the geometric enclosure in grasp formation and the curriculum in contact-reconfiguration exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出Grasp2Twist，一种双臂灵巧操作强化学习系统，可学习抓取并旋开罐盖，实现零样本仿真到现实迁移，并在六种家用容器上达到88%成功率。
AI.motivation: 开罐任务面临三大挑战：多阶段任务的统一策略学习、持续旋盖所需的接触重构，以及仿真到现实迁移。
AI.method: 从手掌与指尖形成的凸包和物体中心的几何关系导出连续包围度与二值包围指示，分别引导抓取形成和抓取到旋转的过渡；采用三阶段课程学习促进接触变化探索并提升迁移鲁棒性。
AI.result: 学习到的策略表现出手指步态，能重构手-物接触以持续旋转盖子；零样本迁移到物理系统，在花生酱、维生素、速溶咖啡等六种家用容器上达到88%任务成功率；消融验证了几何包围度和课程学习的作用。
AI.conclusion: 几何包围度引导与三阶段课程能支持统一的多阶段双臂灵巧操作策略学习，并有效实现开罐任务中的接触重构与仿真到现实迁移。

title: Nonlinear Participation Factor-based Power System Model Reduction Addressing Near-Resonance Conditions
summary: This paper proposes an adaptive model reduction approach based on nonlinear participation factors (NPFs) which determines the most effective selection of unimportant generators in a power system to be linearized to accelerate time-domain simulation for the entire system. The method enables a dynamic transition between the full-order model, and a hybrid reduced model. It uses modal energies to rank system modes under contingencies, and computes NPFs for highly energized modes based on Normal Form theory. To accelerate the computation of NPFs and make it achievable online, a tensor contraction technique is introduced. The proposed approach is tested on a 48-machine, 140-bus NPCC system using both partitioned and unpartitioned strategies. It demonstrates significant simulation speedup while preserving better accuracy than a linear participation factor-based method if the nonlinear behaviors of the system cannot be ignored, especially when a near-resonance condition is presented.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于非线性参与因子（NPF）的自适应模型降阶方法，用于在电力系统时域仿真中筛选可线性化的非重要发电机，从而加速仿真并保持精度。
AI.motivation: 为了加速电力系统时域仿真，同时克服线性参与因子方法在系统非线性行为不可忽略（尤其是接近共振条件）时精度不足的问题。
AI.method: 利用模态能量对故障下的系统模态进行排序；基于正规形理论计算高能量模态的NPF；引入张量收缩技术加速NPF计算以实现在线应用；实现全阶模型与混合降阶模型之间的动态切换。
AI.result: 在48机、140节点NPCC系统上采用分区和非分区策略测试，结果表明本方法显著提升仿真速度，并且在非线性行为不可忽略尤其是接近共振时，相比基于线性参与因子的方法具有更好的精度。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的自适应模型降阶方法能够有效选择非重要发电机进行线性化，在保证较优精度的同时显著加速电力系统时域仿真，适用于需要考虑非线性动态的在线场景。

authors: Ana Paula Wernz da Cunha Müller
title: Extraction of clinical findings from mammography and breast ultrasound reports: a comparison between specialists and Artificial Intelligence
comment: 16 pages, 10 figures, 3 tables. Submitted to Artificial Intelligence in Medicine
summary: Breast cancer is the leading cause of cancer-related death among women in Brazil, and the time between the request and the release of mammography reports directly influences adherence to screening, making the agility in processing these reports a critical factor for early diagnosis. In this context, this study compares the performance of a Large Language Model (LLM) with manual extraction performed by a team of health researchers in identifying clinical findings from mammography and breast ultrasound reports written in Brazilian Portuguese. Named Entity Recognition (NER) was applied through Prompt Engineering using a few-shot strategy, employing the Gemini 2.5 Flash model, selected from preliminary exploratory tests with four candidate models. The Gemini 2.5 Flash model demonstrated the best performance, achieving a Macro F1 of 0.91 and a Micro F1 of 0.98. The subjective validation, in which 29 exams of different formats were evaluated by health researchers using a Likert scale, yielded an agreement index of 93.1%. The model outperformed human extraction in overall Macro F1 (0.91 vs. 0.72), as in four reports the model correctly identified information that had been omitted or incorrectly recorded during manual extraction, demonstrating its potential as a complementary verification tool alongside specialists. The results confirm the hypothesis that LLMs, when instructed through Prompt Engineering, can achieve performance comparable to or superior to manual extraction by health professionals.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较了大语言模型与人工从巴西葡萄牙语乳腺X线和乳腺超声报告中提取临床发现的表现，发现 Gemini 2.5 Flash 在少样本提示工程下表现优异，可作为辅助验证工具。
AI.motivation: 巴西乳腺癌是女性癌症相关死亡的主要原因，乳腺筛查报告从申请到发布的时间直接影响筛查依从性，因此加快报告处理对早期诊断至关重要。
AI.method: 采用命名实体识别（NER），通过 Prompt Engineering 和少样本策略，使用从四个候选模型中初步选出的 Gemini 2.5 Flash 模型；将其与健康研究人员的人工提取进行比较，并由研究人员用 Likert 量表对29份不同格式检查进行主观验证。
AI.result: Gemini 2.5 Flash 达到 Macro F1 0.91、Micro F1 0.98；主观验证一致率为93.1%；总体 Macro F1 优于人工提取（0.91 vs. 0.72），并在4份报告中正确识别出人工遗漏或误记的信息。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，LLM 在 Prompt Engineering 指导下可达到与健康专业人员人工提取相当或更优的性能，有潜力作为专家之外的互补验证工具。

title: Goal-Persistent Coding Agents as Scientific Performance Engineers: A Fixed-Radius Nearest-Neighbor Case Study
summary: Coding agents can pursue persistent objectives across many tool-use turns, but evidence that general-purpose agents can conduct rigorous scientific performance engineering remains limited. We present a repository-scale case study in which off-the-shelf Codex and Claude Code agents optimize fixed-radius nearest-neighbor (FRNN) search for particle tracking. Starting from a PyTorch-dependent CUDA implementation, the agents follow an executable goal that specifies exact-correctness tests, profiling requirements, and acceptance criteria without prescribing code transformations. In the primary sequential trajectory, they autonomously remove the PyTorch dependency and conduct hypothesis-driven optimization experiments. The resulting standalone C++/CUDA library exactly reproduces the targeted reference result. Its synchronous NumPy interface achieved 1.6-fold speedup over the original GPU-resident PyTorch interface, despite including host transfers. Similar speedups were observed across different GPU architectures and software stacks. An independent optimization rerun followed a different sequence of hypotheses and reached even better performance on the target workload. These results show that goal-persistent coding agents can act as experimental performance engineers, and that executable scientific contracts are needed both to guide and to validate their optimization.

AI.tldr: 通过仓库级案例研究，展示现成的Codex和Claude Code智能体能够自主优化用于粒子追踪的固定半径最近邻（FRNN）搜索，从PyTorch依赖的CUDA实现出发，最终获得1.6倍加速的独立C++/CUDA库。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体虽能跨多轮工具使用追求持续目标，但通用智能体能否进行严谨的科学性能工程仍缺乏证据。
AI.method: 采用仓库级案例研究，让智能体遵循可执行目标（含精确正确性测试、性能分析要求和验收标准，但不规定代码变换），自主移除PyTorch依赖并进行假设驱动的优化实验；同时进行独立重跑。
AI.result: 生成的独立C++/CUDA库精确复现参考结果；同步NumPy接口比原始GPU驻留PyTorch接口快1.6倍（含主机传输），在不同GPU架构和软件栈上表现类似；独立重跑达到更优性能。
AI.conclusion: 目标持久的编码智能体可充当实验性能工程师，而可执行科学契约对于指导和验证其优化是必要的。

title: Find Something You Can't Do: Agentic Real-World Reinforcement Learning for Self-Improving VLA Models
summary: Vision--language--action (VLA) models provide strong priors for robotic manipulation but are typically deployed as frozen policies, unable to improve from their own failures. Real-world reinforcement learning (RL) offers a path to continued improvement, yet manual environment resets and task-success supervision hinder autonomous learning. We introduce \textbf{FIND}, an agentic real-world RL framework that closes the loop between scene understanding, weakness-aware practice, self-evaluation, and policy improvement in a persistent workspace. FIND reframes autonomous practice as a scene-conditioned, performance-aware task-selection problem: instead of restoring a predefined scene after each rollout, it uses the resulting scene to determine what to practice next. A vision--language agent identifies feasible tasks from a predefined library, prioritizes those with lower recent success rates, and evaluates outcomes using paired pre- and post-execution observations. We instantiate FIND with a frozen $π_{0.5}$ VLA and residual off-policy RL. Across eight real-world manipulation tasks, the independent human-assessed success rate improves from $55\%$ to $71.9\%$. A representative run completes 456 autonomous episodes within 6 hours of interaction, requiring 30 scene-recovery interventions and no human-provided reward labels during online learning. Ablations and systematic evaluations further examine key design choices, agent evaluation accuracy, and human intervention requirements. Our website is made publicly available at: FIND.github.io.

AI.tldr: FIND是一个agentic真实世界强化学习框架，在持久工作空间中实现场景理解、弱点感知练习、自我评估与策略改进的闭环，让冻结的VLA模型无需人工重置场景或奖励标注即可持续提升。
AI.motivation: VLA模型虽为机器人操作提供强先验，但通常以冻结策略部署，无法从自身失败中改进；真实世界RL虽可继续学习，却依赖人工环境重置和任务成功监督，阻碍了自主持续学习。
AI.method: 将自主练习重构为场景条件化、性能感知的任务选择问题：不恢复预定义场景，而是利用每次执行后的场景决定下一步练什么。由视觉语言agent从预定义任务库中识别可行任务，优先选择近期成功率较低者，并用执行前后配对观察评估结果。以冻结的π0.5 VLA结合残差off-policy RL实现。
AI.result: 在八个真实世界操作任务上，独立人工评估的成功率从55%提升至71.9%。代表性运行在6小时交互内完成456个自主回合，仅需30次场景恢复干预，在线学习期间无需人工奖励标签。消融与系统评估进一步考察了关键设计选择、agent评估准确性和人工干预需求。
AI.conclusion: FIND验证了无需人工重置与奖励标注的持续自主改进路径，表明场景条件化的agentic任务选择结合残差RL可有效提升冻结VLA策略的真实世界表现。

title: Low Cost Eye Tracking for Vision Screening
summary: This engineering study assesses gaze-assisted data acquisition during visual screening with a Gaze Quest implementation via webcam and GC308 near infrared camera with an Orlosky eye tracking pipeline. Ten subjects performed under both acquisition conditions. Accuracy of Tumbling E orientation, reported application logMAR value,and response latency were determined from keyboard responses and hence are behavioral outputs as opposed toeye tracker screening results. Frame-to-frame change in theangle between successive normalized gaze vectors (28.2degrees) served as the GC308 eye tracker derived diagnostic with an effective sampling rate of roughly 8 FPS. No screen target calibration or gaze to screen translation was done on the GC308 eye tracker output data for the current analysis and hence, these data represent acquisition stability and not gaze accuracy in relation to the target. The webcam pipeline relied on 25-point screen calibration. Because the display resolution and pixel pitch could not be retained in the records of the study, the reported application logMAR values cannot be viewed as measures of visual acuity in any way.

AI.tldr: 该工程研究评估在视觉筛查中利用注视辅助数据采集的效果，比较基于网络摄像头与GC308近红外相机的Gaze Quest实现。10名受试者在两种条件下完成任务；键盘反应提供行为结果，GC308数据仅用于评估采集稳定性，而非目标注视精度。
AI.motivation: 动机是评估注视辅助数据采集在视觉筛查中的应用，并比较网络摄像头与GC308近红外眼动追踪方案在Gaze Quest筛查中的表现，尤其关注采集稳定性。
AI.method: 10名受试者在两种采集条件下进行Gaze Quest视觉筛查，使用Tumbling E方向判断；通过键盘记录方向正确性、应用logMAR值和反应潜伏期，作为行为输出。GC308条件以相邻归一化注视向量之间的逐帧角度变化（28.2度）作为诊断指标，有效采样率约为8 FPS，未做屏幕目标校准或注视到屏幕的坐标转换；网络摄像头流程采用25点屏幕校准。
AI.result: GC308眼动追踪导出的诊断指标为相邻归一化注视向量间逐帧角度变化28.2度，有效采样率约8 FPS。由于未进行屏幕目标校准或注视-屏幕转换，GC308数据反映的是采集稳定性，而不是相对于目标的注视准确度。因显示分辨率和像素间距记录缺失，所报告的应用logMAR值不能视为视力测量。
AI.conclusion: 在这些条件下，应用logMAR值不能作为视力指标；GC308数据只能说明注视采集稳定性，不能说明目标注视准确性。注视辅助视觉筛查的数据解释需依赖校准、屏幕几何参数和眼动到屏幕映射等条件。

title: Deep Behaviour Cloning of Model Predictive Control for Real-Time Operation of a Hydrogen-Diesel Dual-Fuel Engine
summary: Hydrogen-diesel dual-fuel (H2DF) combustion engines offer a promising pathway for decarbonising hard-to-electrify transport sectors, yet their highly nonlinear dynamics and coupled process variables demand constraint-aware control strategies. Model Predictive Control (MPC) meets these requirements but requires an online optimisation in every combustion cycle, which limits deployment on low-cost embedded hardware. This paper trains a feedforward deep neural network (DNN) by behaviour cloning (BC) to imitate an MPC expert, using 86,000 engine cycles of demonstration data collected at 1500 min-1 on a modified Cummins QSB 4.5-litre hydrogen dual-fuel engine. Two variants, one with process feedback and one without, are validated experimentally. Both track unseen fast-transient load steps (3-8 bar indicated mean effective pressure, IMEP) with normalised root mean square error (NRMSE) values of 7.80% and 9.03% against the expert's 8.01%, while keeping mean NOx and particulate matter emissions at or below those of the expert. Inference takes 2 ms or less on a Raspberry Pi 400 (ARM Cortex-A72 at 2.2 GHz), including 1 ms communication latency, compared to up to 7 ms for the MPC expert, a 3.5x speedup. Open-loop profiling on a low-cost ESP32 microcontroller at 180 MHz gives 4.3 ms per inference, 4x faster than required for the 18 ms cycle window. Beyond the training range the cloned policy saturates its controls but exceeds the pressure-rise-rate limit. To the authors' knowledge, this is the first experimental BC controller for cycle-to-cycle combustion control of an internal combustion engine (ICE), trained from demonstrations recorded on the engine itself.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于行为克隆的深度神经网络控制器，用于氢柴油双燃料发动机的逐循环燃烧控制，通过模仿MPC专家在发动机实测数据上训练，并在低成本嵌入式硬件上验证了实时性与控制性能。
AI.motivation: 氢柴油双燃料发动机有助于难以电气化运输部门脱碳，但其高度非线性动态和耦合过程变量需要约束感知控制。MPC虽满足要求，但每个燃烧循环都需在线优化，难以部署于低成本嵌入式硬件。
AI.method: 在改装Cummins QSB 4.5升氢双燃料发动机上以1500 min-1采集86,000个发动机循环的示范数据，用行为克隆训练前馈深度神经网络以模仿MPC专家。训练了带过程反馈和不带过程反馈两种变体，并进行实验验证；同时在Raspberry Pi 400和ESP32上评估推理速度。
AI.result: 两种变体跟踪未见过的快速瞬态负载阶跃（3-8 bar IMEP），NRMSE分别为7.80%和9.03%，专家为8.01%；平均NOx和颗粒物排放等于或低于专家。Raspberry Pi 400上推理不超过2 ms（含1 ms通信延迟），而MPC专家最多7 ms，加速3.5倍；ESP32在180 MHz下每次推理4.3 ms，比18 ms循环窗口要求快4倍。超出训练范围时，克隆策略控制量饱和，但超过压力升高率限制。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个基于行为克隆、用发动机自身记录示范数据训练的ICE逐循环燃烧控制实验控制器，展示了在低成本硬件上替代MPC的潜力，但外推范围外的约束满足仍存在局限。

title: Architecture-aware Robustness Evaluation of Explainable Deep Learning for Breast Cancer Diagnosis
summary: Explainable Artificial Intelligence (XAI) has become essential in medical image analysis to ensure transparency of deep learning (DL)-based diagnostic systems. However, selecting appropriate XAI techniques for breast cancer recognition remains largely ad hoc, with limited systematic evaluation across different DL architectures. This study presents a systematic architecture-aware evaluation protocol to assess the effectiveness of nine widely used XAI techniques across four categories of DL models: very deep, lightweight, transformer-based and hybrid neural networks. The evaluation is conducted on a breast ultrasound dataset comprising 780 images using clinically aligned spatial metrics, including Pointing Game, Intersection over Union and Mean Coverage, to quantify agreement between generated explanations and expert-annotated lesion regions. Results indicate that explanation quality is primarily influenced by the interaction between model architecture and XAI method, rather than any single technique consistently outperforming others. Hybrid architectures produce more spatially coherent explanations, while lightweight and transformer-based models exhibit greater variability across methods. The findings show that no single technique generalises across architectures and evaluation criteria, emphasising the need for joint selection of DL models and XAI techniques. Explainability depends on both model design and explanation strategy and should not be considered independently. This work provides a structured evaluation protocol and practical guidance for selecting XAI techniques in breast cancer diagnosis, supporting more transparent clinical decision-support systems. \textcolor{blue}{Code is publicly available at https://github.com/Nishan-Charlie/Explainable-AI}

AI.tldr: 本研究系统评估了九种XAI技术在四种深度学习模型（极深、轻量、Transformer和混合网络）上用于乳腺癌超声图像识别的效果，发现解释质量主要取决于模型架构与XAI方法的交互，而非单一技术。
AI.motivation: XAI对医学图像分析中深度学习诊断系统的透明度至关重要，但针对乳腺癌识别选择XAI技术大多是临时的，缺乏跨不同深度学习架构的系统评估。
AI.method: 提出了一种系统性的、感知架构的评估协议，在包含780张图像的乳腺超声数据集上，对九种常用XAI技术跨四类深度学习模型（极深、轻量、Transformer和混合网络）进行评估。采用临床对齐的空间指标（Pointing Game、IoU、Mean Coverage）量化生成解释与专家标注病灶区域的一致性。
AI.result: 解释质量主要受模型架构与XAI方法交互的影响，而非单一技术始终占优。混合架构产生更空间连贯的解释，轻量和Transformer模型在不同方法间变异性更大。没有一种技术能在不同架构和评估标准下普遍适用。
AI.conclusion: 需要联合选择深度学习模型和XAI技术。可解释性取决于模型设计和解释策略，不应独立考虑。本研究提供了结构化评估协议和实用指导，支持更透明的临床决策支持系统。代码已公开。

title: Active 3D weaves for load-bearing and damage-resilient locomotion
summary: The craft of weaving, where different materials are interlaced, has tremendous potential for creating active and functional systems for use in soft robots, prosthetics, wearables, exoskeletons, and more. These textile-like systems are flexible and safe for human-machine interaction; however, this inherent flexibility limits their ability to carry loads, which is essential for many robotic functions. In this work, we introduce a general framework for integrating active materials into three-dimensional (3D) woven shells to create robotic structures that combine high axial stiffness for load bearing, low bending stiffness for efficient actuation, and system-level resilience for damage tolerance. These woven robots can be modularly assembled from 'woven corners', a fundamental unit of 3D woven structures. We use eigenvalue calculations to identify load bearing and actuation mechanisms of the 3D woven structures, and use that information to make five different robots capable of locomotion. We demonstrate that these 3D woven robots can locomote carrying loads 70 times their self-weight, and can maintain repeatable performance even after being subjected to extreme compression. This work is a pathway toward the design, manufacturing, and simulation of future 3D woven robotic systems where load bearing, high stiffness, active functional deformation, locomotion, and system-level resilience are all needed.

AI.tldr: 该研究将活性材料集成到三维编织壳体中，构建兼具高轴向刚度、低弯曲刚度和损伤耐受性的编织机器人，并可模块化组装与运动。
AI.motivation: 编织和纺织类系统柔软、安全，适合人机交互，但固有柔性限制其承载能力，而许多机器人功能需要承载。
AI.method: 提出将活性材料集成到3D编织壳体的通用框架，以“编织角”为基本单元进行模块化组装；通过特征值计算识别承载与驱动机制，并据此制造五种可运动的机器人。
AI.result: 这些3D编织机器人能承载自身重量70倍的负载进行运动，并在经历极端压缩后仍保持可重复的性能。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为未来3D编织机器人系统的设计、制造和仿真提供了路径，可同时满足承载、高刚度、主动功能变形、运动和系统级韧性需求。

title: Fiber-Normalized Manipulability and Determinant Proxies: Intrinsic Redundancy Optimization Across and Within Task Fibers
summary:
This work establishes that determinant-based manipulability is an exact objective for fixed-task redundancy optimization, despite its dependence on task coordinates and the choice of task-space metric used for volume measurement. On every regular task fiber, the determinant proxy, its representation in any task chart, and every metric-completed manipulability differ only by positive constants. They consequently induce the same complete ordering, constrained extrema, gradient directions, critical points, and local optimality classifications.
  For comparisons and trajectory optimization across task fibers, this work introduces fiber-normalized manipulability: the capability attained at an internal state divided by the best capability available on the same fiber. The resulting dimensionless scalar is invariant under coordinate changes on the internal-state and task manifolds and independent of the task-space metric. Its associated loss provides an intrinsic objective for physically admissible cross-fiber trajectories, including problems with prescribed or free task evolution and temporal coupling. Planar-manipulator and redundant aerodynamic-allocation examples demonstrate fixed-fiber equivalence, task-dependent cross-fiber differences, and invariant fiber-normalized trajectory optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文证明基于行列式的可操作度是固定任务冗余优化中的精确目标，尽管它依赖任务坐标和任务空间度量；并引入纤维归一化可操作度，用于跨任务纤维比较与轨迹优化。
AI.motivation: 可操作度常因依赖坐标和度量而受到质疑，固定任务冗余优化需要合理目标；同时，跨任务纤维比较和轨迹优化缺乏内在、无量纲的指标。
AI.method: 在正则任务纤维上比较行列式代理、任务图表示和度量完备可操作度，证明它们仅相差正常数；定义纤维归一化可操作度为内部状态能力除以同纤维最佳能力，并构造相应损失用于轨迹优化。
AI.result: 固定纤维上这些度量诱导相同排序、约束极值、梯度方向、临界点和局部最优分类；纤维归一化可操作度对内部状态与任务流形坐标变换不变，且独立于任务空间度量，可用于规定或自由任务演化及时间耦合轨迹优化。
AI.conclusion: 行列式可操作度在固定任务下是可靠优化目标；纤维归一化可操作度为跨纤维物理可行轨迹优化提供了内蕴目标，平面机械臂和冗余气动分配例子验证了相关性质。

title: Disentangle and Drop: Robust Universal Removal of Image Watermarks via Reconstructive Grayscale Residual Decomposition
summary: Invisible image watermarks are commonly evaluated against benign postprocessing operations such as compression, resizing, blur, and color changes. These tests leave out a different threat: a learned remover that preserves semantic image content while discarding residual evidence that carries the payload. We propose Disentangle and Drop (DnD), an attack that is agnostic to the watermark method and treats watermark removal as a representation routing problem. DnD decomposes a watermarked image into a semantic grayscale carrier and an auxiliary residual branch, and then suppresses the residual branch to reduce watermark evidence. The model is trained with latent spectral perturbations and low-strength diffusion exposure so that the drop operation remains stable under adaptive reconstruction. Experiments on seven representative watermark families show that one shared operating setting gives competitive removal with high visual fidelity. Operating scans and ablations separate usable attacks from image-damaging settings: stronger noise or diffusion can raise removal scores by damaging the image, while the practical regime comes from dropping the residual latent. These results argue for evaluating watermark robustness against learned removal at the representation level, not only against conventional image edits.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种与具体水印方法无关的学习型移除攻击 DnD，将水印移除视为表示路由问题，通过分离并丢弃水印图像中的残差分支来削弱水印，同时保持语义内容。
AI.motivation: 现有不可见图像水印多只针对压缩、缩放、模糊、颜色变化等良性后处理评估，忽略了能保留语义但去除载荷证据的学习型移除器威胁。
AI.method: DnD 将水印图像分解为语义灰度载体和辅助残差分支，抑制残差分支以减少水印证据；训练时引入潜在频谱扰动和低强度扩散暴露，使丢弃操作在自适应重建下保持稳定。
AI.result: 在七类代表性水印家族上，同一共享设置即可实现有竞争力的去除效果和较高视觉保真度；消融表明更强噪声或扩散可通过损伤图像提高去除分数，而实用有效机制来自丢弃残差潜在表示。
AI.conclusion: 应不仅在传统图像编辑下，更应在表示层面评估水印对学习型移除的鲁棒性。

title: CSI-Agent: LLM-Assisted Few-Shot Adaptation for Cross-Domain Wi-Fi CSI Sensing
comment: 10 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to INFOCOM
summary: Wi-Fi channel state information (CSI) has enabled device-free sensing applications such as human activity recognition. However, CSI sensing models remain brittle in cross-domain deployment, where changes in users or environments can produce incorrect predictions. Existing solutions usually treat this problem as an offline model-design problem, by pretraining a stronger representation or applying one fixed adaptation method to the entire target domain. In practice, labeled target data are scarce and different classes may fail in different ways under the same domain shift. To address this, we propose CSI-Agent, an evidence-seeking LLM agent that reformulates cross-domain CSI adaptation as a deployment-time decision-making problem. Rather than processing raw CSI or making sample-level predictions, CSI-Agent summarizes target-domain behavior into sensing-grounded class-level evidence. It establishes a strong target-adaptive default from complementary CSI views and uses an LLM planner to determine whether each class should retain the default or invoke a specialized action. Deterministic verification and bounded execution further reduce unreliable interventions. We evaluate CSI-Agent on four public datasets using five cross-domain splits covering device, user, environment, and compositional shifts. Under 1-shot adaptation, CSI-Agent achieves the best target-domain performance across all splits and improves the average Macro-F1 by about 16\% compared to the strongest baseline method.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 CSI-Agent，将跨域 Wi-Fi CSI 人体活动识别中的域适应问题重新定义为部署时决策问题，利用 LLM 智能体基于类别级证据决定是否调用专门适配动作，从而提升跨域感知性能。
AI.motivation: Wi-Fi CSI 虽支持无设备感知，但跨用户、跨环境部署时模型脆弱，现有方法多将跨域适应视为离线模型设计问题，预训练统一表征或对整个目标域应用固定适配方法；实际中目标域标签稀缺，且同一域偏移下不同类别的失败方式可能不同。
AI.method: 提出 CSI-Agent，一个证据寻求型 LLM 智能体。它不直接处理原始 CSI 或做样本级预测，而是将目标域行为总结为基于感知的类别级证据；先从互补 CSI 视角建立强目标自适应默认方案，再由 LLM 规划器判断每个类别应保留默认方案还是调用专门动作。同时引入确定性验证和有界执行，减少不可靠干预。
AI.result: 在四个公开数据集、五种跨域划分上评估，覆盖设备、用户、环境和组合偏移。在 1-shot 适配设置下，CSI-Agent 在所有划分上取得最佳目标域性能，相比最强基线方法平均 Macro-F1 提升约 16%。
AI.conclusion: 将跨域 CSI 适配建模为部署时决策问题，并结合 LLM 智能体进行类别级证据驱动的自适应，可有效提升跨域 Wi-Fi 感知的鲁棒性和性能。

title: Toward Embedding-Based Psychometrics: Structural Modeling of Assessment-Item Semantics With Contextual Scores
summary: Contextual scores represent assessment items through their similarities to reference words in an external corpus. We examine the semantic structure of scores for 40 TIMSS mathematics scored units using a partially specified two-step factor procedure. A search across factor counts identifies a persistent seven-group structure under the featured construction. Subsequent comparisons consistently favor a general dimension alongside group associations, although individual group memberships remain sensitive to some specification choices. Item examples distinguish recurring, cross-domain, sensitive, and imposed associations. Simpler and unrestricted references clarify the contribution and limits of the anchored representation: it improves on a single factor but does not achieve the lowest working Bayesian information criterion (BIC). A separate response benchmark compares three initial Q constructions and their Hull-PVAF revisions under higher-order and saturated attribute distributions. Among these diagnostic models, BIC favors the official content framework and the Akaike information criterion (AIC) favors its direct four-factor augmentation, but a matched unidimensional two-parameter logistic model has lower AIC and BIC than all twelve conditions. These findings support a conditional semantic representation while limiting direct diagnostic interpretation. We discuss learned text-assisted response calibration as a prospective application requiring a larger calibrated item bank and independent evaluation.

AI.tldr: 论文考察基于外部语料参考词的上下文相似度分数对TIMSS数学题项的语义结构，采用部分设定的两步因子分析，并与响应诊断模型比较。发现稳定的七组结构，同时支持一般维度与组关联并存的语义表示，但直接诊断解释有限。
AI.motivation: 动机是评估上下文分数能否作为题项语义或诊断表示，以及其因子结构是否稳定、是否能替代或补充传统内容框架和响应模型。
AI.method: 对40个TIMSS数学评分单元计算上下文分数，使用部分指定两步因子程序搜索因子数；比较不同参考构造；另用响应基准比较三种初始Q构造及Hull-PVAF修正，在高阶与饱和属性分布下，与单维2PL等模型比较BIC和AIC。
AI.result: 因子搜索识别出持续七组结构；比较支持一个一般维度加组关联，但个别组归属对设定敏感。锚定表示优于单因子但未达到最低工作BIC。响应基准中，BIC偏好官方内容框架，AIC偏好其直接四因子扩展，但匹配的单维2PL在所有十二种条件下AIC和BIC更低。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持条件性的语义表示，但限制其直接诊断解释。文本辅助的响应校准可作为前瞻应用，但需更大校准题库和独立评估。

title: Regime-Dependent Value of CVaR in Preventive Maintenance Scheduling under RUL Uncertainty
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication
summary: We study preventive-maintenance scheduling for a small fleet when several assets compete for a limited number of maintenance slots and their remaining useful lives (RULs) are uncertain. The planning horizon is divided into discrete periods; each asset may be maintained at most once, and at most $K$ assets may be maintained in any one period. Future usage and RUL errors are represented by scenarios. We compare a risk-neutral policy that minimizes expected cost with a risk-aware policy that minimizes expected cost plus conditional value-at-risk (CVaR), where $\operatorname{CVaR}_{0.90}$ is the mean cost among the worst 10\% of scenarios. Both policies are solved exactly by enumerating all capacity-feasible schedules. A $3\times5$ experiment combines capacities $K=1,2,3$ with five increasing levels of RUL uncertainty, with ten paired replications for each combination. The risk-aware policy provides its largest benefit when RUL uncertainty is low-to-moderate and more than one maintenance action can be executed per period. In the best observed case, it reduces CVaR by 13.4\% with an expected-cost increase of only 0.2 relative cost units. At high uncertainty, the benefit becomes negligible and the two policies can select identical schedules. The results show that risk-aware scheduling creates operational value only when prognostic information is sufficiently informative and the maintenance system has enough flexibility to act on it.

AI.tldr: 研究小型机队中多资产竞争有限维修槽位且剩余使用寿命不确定时的预防性维修调度，比较风险中性策略与风险感知策略，发现风险感知调度仅在预测信息较可靠且维修系统有足够灵活性时带来显著价值。
AI.motivation: 资产剩余使用寿命不确定，而维修槽位有限，需要评估风险感知调度是否比仅最小化期望成本更有运营价值。
AI.method: 将规划期离散化，每资产最多维修一次，每期最多维修K个资产；用情景表示未来使用和RUL误差；分别以最小化期望成本和最小化期望成本加CVaR_0.90为目标；通过枚举所有满足容量约束的调度精确求解；开展3×5实验，K=1,2,3，五档RUL不确定性，每组合10次配对重复。
AI.result: 风险感知策略在RUL不确定性低至中等且每期可执行多个维修动作时收益最大；最佳情况下CVaR降低13.4%，期望成本仅增加0.2个相对成本单位；高不确定性下收益可忽略，两种策略可能选择相同调度。
AI.conclusion: 风险感知调度只有在预测信息足够有效且维修系统具备足够灵活性来据此行动时，才会产生实际运营价值。

title: SenseAgent: An LLM Agent for Adaptive Cross-Domain IMU Sensing
comment: 14 pages, 5 figures, 11 tables. Plan to submit to SenSys Phase 2
summary: Deep learning has improved inertial measurement unit (IMU) sensing for mobile and wearable applications. However, an IMU model trained in one domain often becomes unreliable when it is used with a new user, device, or body position. Existing methods usually treat this problem as a static model-design task: they pretrain a stronger representation, add data augmentation, or select one adaptation method before deployment. In practice, the target domain is only gradually observed, labels are scarce, and different domain shifts require different sensing actions. This paper presents SenseAgent, an LLM-guided sensing agent for cross-domain IMU activity recognition. Instead of asking an LLM to classify raw IMU signals, SenseAgent uses the LLM as a runtime planner over sensing tools, source-domain experience memory, online target memory, and verifiers. The agent builds a label-free diagnosis report from the target stream and uses it to decide whether to keep raw inference or invoke specialized tools, including gravity-aware sensing, prototype transfer, and style normalization. Verifiers check source calibration, target-memory reliability, and no-harm criteria before accepting high-risk tool decisions. SenseAgent also supports scarce feedback without retraining the backbone or replacing the label-free route. This design converts cross-domain IMU sensing from a fixed inference pipeline into a closed-loop sensing process that diagnoses target shifts, selects suitable sensing actions, and rejects unsafe adaptations. We evaluate SenseAgent across multiple IMU datasets and deployment shifts. Results show that its verified route selection improves cross-domain sensing, especially under harder placement and compound shifts, and further benefits from limited user feedback.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SenseAgent，一种由 LLM 引导的传感智能体，用于跨域 IMU 活动识别。它将 LLM 作为运行时规划器，根据目标域诊断报告选择保留原始推理或调用特定传感工具，并通过验证器拒绝不安全适配。
AI.motivation: IMU 模型在一个域训练后，面对新用户、设备或身体位置时往往不可靠。现有方法多将跨域问题视为静态模型设计任务，如预训练更强表示、数据增强或部署前选择一种适配方法；但实际中目标域逐步显现、标签稀缺，且不同域偏移需要不同传感动作。
AI.method: SenseAgent 不直接让 LLM 分类原始 IMU 信号，而是让 LLM 在传感工具、源域经验记忆、在线目标记忆和验证器上进行运行时规划。智能体从目标流构建无标签诊断报告，决定保留原始推理或调用重力感知传感、原型迁移、风格归一化等工具；验证器检查源域校准、目标记忆可靠性和无损害标准，以接受高风险工具决策。该方法支持少量反馈，且无需重训练骨干或替换无标签路线。
AI.result: 在多个 IMU 数据集和部署偏移上评估，SenseAgent 的验证式路线选择改善了跨域传感，尤其在较难的佩戴位置和复合偏移下表现更明显，并能从有限用户反馈中进一步受益。
AI.conclusion: SenseAgent 将跨域 IMU 传感从固定推理流水线转变为闭环传感过程：诊断目标偏移、选择合适传感动作并拒绝不安全适配。

title: RemTraceNet: Few-Shot Forensic Detection of Invisible Watermark Attacks
summary: Removing an invisible watermark and concealing the forensic evidence are distinct objectives: successfully disrupting the embedded watermark does not imply that the removal process is forensically undetectable. When verification fails, removal traces can provide complementary evidence for provenance and ownership verification, whereas their absence leaves the cause of the failure ambiguous. Existing methods are typically evaluated by watermark suppression and perceptual quality, while forensic stealth is rarely considered. We therefore study watermark-attack-specific few-shot forensics: for each known pipeline, a specialist can separate its outputs from paired clean and unattacked watermarked controls. Separate Attack-vs-Clean and Attack-vs-Watermarked evaluations prevent watermark-presence shortcuts. Image-aligned and prompt-matched controls are used for post-hoc and generator-integrated schemes, respectively. In this work, we introduce RemTraceNet, which fuses constrained residuals, local relations, FFT/Haar statistics, and block-DCT evidence at native resolution. Across 23 removal pipelines and 10 watermark configurations, we evaluate native 256 x 256 and 512 x 512 inputs. With 100 attacked training images per pipeline, the three-seed TPR@1%FPR, macro-averaged over attacks and watermark configurations, ranges from 82.75% to 88.17% across resolutions and control types. Under the condition of same labels and protocol, RemTraceNet outperforms retrained SRNet, ZhuNet, and SiaStegNet baselines by 10.80--15.68 percentage points. Extensive experimental results show that erasing a watermark and erasing evidence of its removal are distinct challenges, and that removal traces remain learnable under limited supervision.

AI.tldr: 本文研究水印去除攻击的少样本取证，提出 RemTraceNet 检测去除水印后遗留的取证痕迹，并证明去除水印与隐藏去除证据是两个不同问题。
AI.motivation: 成功破坏水印不等于去除过程不可取证检测；现有方法多关注水印抑制和感知质量，很少考虑取证隐蔽性。去除痕迹可作为来源与所有权验证的补充证据，其缺失会导致验证失败原因不明。
AI.method: 设定针对每种已知水印去除流程的少样本专家取证：区分攻击输出与配对的干净/未攻击水印对照，并分别进行 Attack-vs-Clean 和 Attack-vs-Watermarked 评估以避免水印存在捷径；图像对齐和提示匹配分别用于事后与生成器集成方案。提出 RemTraceNet，融合受限残差、局部关系、FFT/Haar 统计和块 DCT 证据，并在原生分辨率下处理。
AI.result: 在23种去除流程和10种水印配置上评估原生256×256与512×512输入；每流程仅100张攻击训练图像时，三种子 TPR@1%FPR 按攻击和水印配置宏平均为82.75%至88.17%。相同标签与协议下，RemTraceNet 比重新训练的 SRNet、ZhuNet、SiaStegNet 基线高10.80至15.68个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 实验表明，擦除水印与擦除其去除证据是不同挑战，且在水印去除攻击下，去除痕迹在有限监督下仍可学习检测。

title: Integrated Thermal and Power Management for Wave-Powered Subsea Data Centers via Nonlinear Model Predictive Control
summary: This paper develops an integrated modeling and nonlinear model predictive control (NMPC) framework for coordinating thermal management, flexible workload scheduling, wave-power utilization, and battery operation in a wave-powered subsea data center. Realistic data center workloads are constructed from job-level CPU, memory, and GPU measurements from the MIT Supercloud dataset and divided into interactive and delay-tolerant flexible jobs. Thermal behavior is represented by a three-node lumped model of the IT equipment, recirculating nitrogen, and pressure hull with surrounding seawater as the thermal boundary. The NMPC jointly optimizes the flexible workload power budget and cooling command subject to thermal, battery, and workload constraints. Closed-loop simulations under different workload, thermal, battery, and renewable-generation conditions demonstrate that the proposed framework maintains thermal safety while adapting cooling operation and flexible workload execution to wave-power availability and battery state-of-charge. The parametric studies show that battery capacity and wave-generation capacity strongly affect battery availability and flexible-workload queue accumulation, while excessive renewable generation capacity may lead to increased energy curtailment. Monte Carlo and distance-correlation analyses further show that flexible-job delay is relatively insensitive to the investigated system parameters, whereas terminal battery state-of-charge is primarily influenced by battery energy capacity and wave generation capacity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个集成建模与非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）框架，用于协调波浪能供电海底数据中心的热管理、柔性工作负载调度、波浪能利用和电池运行。
AI.motivation: 研究动机在于波浪能供电海底数据中心需要同时应对热安全、间歇性可再生能源、电池状态和不同类型工作负载的协调管理问题。
AI.method: 构建基于MIT Supercloud作业级CPU、内存和GPU测量的真实工作负载，分为交互式与可延迟柔性作业；采用IT设备、循环氮气和耐压壳体的三节点集中热模型，以海水为热边界；使用NMPC联合优化柔性工作负载功率预算和冷却指令，并满足热、电池和工作负载约束；开展闭环仿真、参数研究、蒙特卡洛和距离相关分析。
AI.result: 仿真表明框架能在不同工作负载、热、电池和可再生发电条件下维持热安全，并根据波浪能可用性和电池荷电状态调整冷却与柔性工作负载执行；电池容量和波浪发电容量显著影响电池可用性与柔性作业队列积累，过大的可再生能源容量可能导致弃能增加；柔性作业延迟对研究参数相对不敏感，而终端电池荷电状态主要受电池能量容量和波浪发电容量影响。
AI.conclusion: 所提集成建模与NMPC框架可有效协调波浪能海底数据中心的热管理、柔性计算调度和电池运行，并为系统容量配置与运行策略提供设计见解。

title: Communication between Frozen Large Language Models via Prompt Optimization in a Referential Game
summary: We study communication between two frozen large language models from different providers, with different tokenizers, accessed through their API endpoints. The two play a referential game: one sees an object and describes it in a short fixed-length message over a small alphabet; the other must pick that object out of a candidate set. Neither model's weights are updated. Each agent's prompt is rewritten by an isolated prompt optimizer whose reflection model reads that agent's scored interactions. In the positional setting, optimized prompts carry a shared code that generalizes to held-out objects above a measured no-codebook baseline, including when the memory window is removed. In a second setting, independent per-letter blocks no longer fit within the message, although a whole-object place value code does. The base system fails to establish reliable communication: the sender struggles to retain an injective rule, and the receiver has too few confirmed examples in view. A sender collision penalty, retention of successful interactions, and sequential optimization enable successful place value communication in some runs. Outcomes vary across runs and reflection models. In successful runs, the protocol is written into the optimized prompts, where it can be read and audited directly.

AI.tldr: 研究两个来自不同提供方、使用不同分词器且权重冻结的大语言模型，通过API在指称游戏中通信；用提示词优化器分别为双方改写提示，使它们发展出可审计的共享编码协议。
AI.motivation: 探究在不更新模型权重、跨提供方和跨分词器的条件下，两个冻结大模型能否通过提示词优化建立可靠通信，以及何种设置和干预能促成共享编码。
AI.method: 采用指称游戏：发送方看到目标物体后用固定长度短消息（小字母表）描述，接收方从候选集中选出该物体。模型权重不变，仅通过API访问；每个智能体由隔离的提示词优化器改写提示，其反思模型读取该智能体的打分交互。测试位置编码和整体物体位值编码两种设置，并尝试发送方碰撞惩罚、保留成功交互、顺序优化等干预。
AI.result: 基础系统无法可靠通信：发送方难以保持单射规则，接收方可见确认样本过少。优化后的提示在位置设置中可携带共享编码，对留出物体泛化优于无码本基线，即使移除记忆窗口也成立。第二设置中逐字母独立块无法放入消息，但整体物体位值编码可以。加入碰撞惩罚、保留成功交互和顺序优化后，部分运行成功实现位值通信；结果因运行和反思模型而异。成功运行中协议被写入优化提示，可直接读取和审计。
AI.conclusion: 冻结的异构大模型在特定优化条件下可通过提示词优化形成共享通信协议，但成功率不稳定；成功时协议外化于提示词中，因而可审计。

title: Before the Rollout Ends: Early Terminal Reward Prediction for Long-horizon Coding Agents
summary: Long-horizon coding agents receive verifiable rewards only after completing expensive sequences of tool calls. This increases inference cost, amplifies early wrong hypotheses, and can lead to sparse terminal reward and unstable training. We introduce Contextual Early Reward (CER), which predicts terminal reward through behavioral evidence in a trajectory prefix. CER synthesizes adaptive rubrics specific to the current task and stage through experiences summarized from related historical tasks. In test-time scaling on SWE-bench Verified, CER improves RM@8 over the strongest baseline by 4.2 percentage points (pp) on Nemotron 3 Ultra and 2.0 pp on Qwen 3.6 27B; on Nemotron, it takes only 15.3% tokens to match the best baseline performance. In RL training experiments, CER exceeds full-rollout TMax by 1.9 pp while using 52.7% fewer online policy-and-judge tokens. Together, CER provides an interpretable, efficient, and dense evaluation method for long-horizon coding agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出上下文早期奖励（CER），通过轨迹前缀中的行为证据预测最终奖励，为长周期编码智能体提供可解释、高效、密集的评估与训练信号。
AI.motivation: 长周期编码智能体只有在完成昂贵的工具调用序列后才能获得可验证奖励，导致推理成本高、早期错误假设被放大、终端奖励稀疏以及训练不稳定。
AI.method: CER根据从相关历史任务中总结的经验，为当前任务和阶段合成自适应评分规则，并利用轨迹前缀中的行为证据预测终端奖励；在SWE-bench Verified上进行测试时扩展，并开展RL训练实验。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified上，CER在Nemotron 3 Ultra上将RM@8相较最强基线提升4.2个百分点，在Qwen 3.6 27B上提升2.0个百分点；在Nemotron上仅用15.3%的token即可匹配最佳基线性能。RL训练中，CER超过完整rollout的TMax 1.9个百分点，同时减少52.7%的在线策略与评判token。
AI.conclusion: CER为长周期编码智能体提供了一种可解释、高效且密集的评估方法，能提升测试时扩展与RL训练效果并显著降低计算开销。

title: Video Captioning in Low-Light Conditions through Efficient Uncertainty-Aware Caption Correction
summary: Low-light conditions can significantly degrade the ability of vision-language models (VLMs) to accurately describe human actions in videos. In this work, I propose an efficient uncertainty-aware representation correction framework for improving captions generated by VideoChat2 under real-world low-light conditions. Instead of fine-tuning the underlying VLM, the proposed framework introduces a lightweight sparse Gaussian process-based error estimation module between the projection layer and the language model to correct the intermediate representation. The correction module learns to estimate the residual between the original projected representation and a verified target representation, which is then adaptively scaled using a newly formulated uncertainty-aware coefficient and added to the original representation. To further improve residual estimation, I introduce a partitioned combined-kernel design. The correction model is trained separately using only 44 samples from the ARID dataset and requires only a small additional computational overhead during inference. The effectiveness of the proposed correction is evaluated through quantitative residual prediction and qualitative analysis of the generated captions. Although VideoChat2 is used in my experiments, the proposed framework is designed to be applicable to other compatible VLM architectures. \textbf{Code Availability: The implementation accompanying this work is publicly available at}:\href{https://github.com/areferezaee/Low-rank-SVGP-NP-update}{https://github.com/areferezaee/Low-rank-SVGP-NP-update}

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种高效的不确定性感知表示校正框架，用于改善VideoChat2在真实低光条件下生成的视频动作描述。该方法不微调原VLM，而是在投影层与语言模型之间加入轻量级稀疏高斯过程误差估计模块，通过校正中间表示来提升低光视频理解能力。
AI.motivation: 低光条件会显著降低视觉语言模型准确描述视频中人类动作的能力。为避免昂贵且复杂的底层VLM微调，研究希望以轻量、高效的方式校正中间表示，从而提升低光场景下的视频描述质量。
AI.method: 提出不确定性感知表示校正框架：在投影层和语言模型之间引入基于稀疏高斯过程的误差估计模块，学习原始投影表示与已验证目标表示之间的残差；使用新提出的不确定性感知系数对残差进行自适应缩放并加回原表示；进一步设计分区组合核以改进残差估计。校正模型仅使用ARID数据集中的44个样本训练，推理时仅增加少量计算开销。
AI.result: 实验通过定量残差预测和生成描述的定性分析评估校正效果。结果表明，该方法可在真实低光条件下改善VideoChat2生成的描述，同时保持较低训练样本需求和推理开销。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能有效提升兼容VLM在低光视频动作描述中的表现，且设计上可推广到其他兼容的VLM架构。代码已公开。

title: Residual Denoising Enables Sample-Efficient Multi-Agent Coordination on Demand
summary: Pretrained robot policies offer strong manipulation skills but are typically limited to single-agent settings, where a robot acts in isolation. In this work, we study how to adapt pretrained single-agent diffusion policies to multi-agent settings using minimal collaborative data, co-optimizing for two key objectives: high coordination performance and single-agent skill retention.
