To this end, we introduce ALTER, an adaptation method for coordination on demand: the adapted policy coordinates with other robots when deployed in a team while remaining capable of acting independently when operating alone. Execution is decentralized: each robot acts only on its own visual observations, without explicit inter-agent communication. Our method trains a coordination head that predicts a residual denoiser to transform single-agent behavior into coordinated multi-agent behavior when necessary while also preserving single-agent capabilities. To preserve single-agent capabilities, we augment a small number of collaborative demonstrations with self-distilled data generated by the base policy during training of the residual denoiser. In simulation,ALTER achieves higher coordination success over our baselines while retaining much higher source-skill retention. In our hardware experiments, we find similar trends where ALTER better co-optimizes for coordination success and single-agent skill retention than the baselines

AI.tldr: 提出 ALTER，用少量协作数据将预训练单智能体扩散策略适配到多智能体协作场景，在按需协调的同时保留单智能体技能，且执行去中心化。
AI.motivation: 预训练机器人策略具备强操作能力，但通常局限于单智能体设置；直接用极少协作数据适配多智能体时，需同时优化协调性能与单智能体技能保持。
AI.method: 训练一个协调头来预测残差去噪器，在需要时将单智能体行为转化为多智能体协调行为；并用少量协作示范与基础策略生成的自蒸馏数据联合训练，以保留原始单智能体能力。执行时每个机器人仅依赖自身视觉观察，无显式智能体间通信。
AI.result: 仿真中，ALTER 相比基线取得更高的协调成功率，并显著更好地保持源技能；硬件实验也呈现类似趋势，ALTER 在协调成功与单智能体技能保持之间取得更好的平衡。
AI.conclusion: ALTER 能有效将预训练单智能体扩散策略适配为可按需协调的多智能体策略，实现去中心化协作，同时较好保留独立作业能力。

title: A Weak Notion of Symmetry for Control Systems
summary: Symmetry (or invariance) is a powerful structural property that enables efficient, effective solutions for estimation and control. However, the constraints imposed on a system's dynamics by classical invariance make symmetry a very rigid property, which may be broken by external forces or confined to only a portion of the overall system. Seeking greater flexibility, this work introduces a novel relaxed notion of symmetry, termed ``weak invariance'', in which the non-symmetric part of the dynamics (the ``residual'') can be captured entirely by another control system evolving on the symmetry group. Weakly invariant systems are strictly more general than classical invariant systems, but they nonetheless enjoy many similar favorable properties. In particular, we prove that any weakly invariant system admits a cascade decomposition in which the driven subsystem is group affine, showing that weak symmetry generalizes not only classical symmetry, but also the (thus far distinct) class of group affine systems. We also show that a weak symmetry with autonomous residual can be factored out of the system's error dynamics, enabling yet a greater reduction of dimensionality as compared to classical symmetries. Finally, we study the example of an aerial vehicle under the influence of gravity, for which we propose a nine-dimensional weak symmetry (strictly containing the system's familiar four-dimensional classical symmetry). Weak invariance thus generalizes classical symmetry while also preserving key structural properties, thereby laying a foundation for more flexible methods of symmetry-informed control.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种更灵活的“弱不变性”对称概念：非对称部分可由一个在对称群上演化的控制系统完全刻画。弱不变系统比经典不变系统更一般，但仍保留许多良好结构性质，并可用于对称信息控制。
AI.motivation: 经典不变性/对称性虽然能有效简化估计与控制，但其约束过强，容易因外力破坏或仅适用于系统局部，因此需要一种更宽松的对称性框架。
AI.method: 引入“弱不变性”，将动力学中的非对称残差建模为对称群上的控制系统；证明弱不变系统具有级联分解，其中被驱动子系统为群仿射；分析自治残差可从误差动力学中分离；并以受重力影响的飞行器为例构造九维弱对称。
AI.result: 弱不变系统严格比经典不变系统更一般，而且推广了群仿射系统；自治残差可因子化并进一步降维；飞行器例子中的九维弱对称严格包含其熟悉的四维经典对称。
AI.conclusion: 弱不变性在推广经典对称性的同时保留了关键结构性质，为更灵活的对称信息控制方法奠定了基础。

title: GAUGE: Planner-Conditioned Active Calibration of Opaque Quadruped Velocity Interfaces
summary: In this paper, we present a Goal-Aware Uncertainty-Guided Exploration (GAUGE) framework for planner-conditioned active calibration of opaque quadruped velocity interfaces. Commercial quadrupeds commonly expose planar-velocity commands, but the underlying locomotion controller remains inaccessible and can produce systematic discrepancies between commanded and realized motion. A navigation planner typically uses a structured subset of the command envelope. GAUGE maintains a Bayesian command-to-motion model and selects authorized trials according to their expected reduction of posterior epistemic uncertainty under the planner-induced command distribution. The resulting posterior supports validation-based stopping, bounded inverse compensation, and task-relevant recalibration after detected interface shifts. In three controlled response families, GAUGE reaches the joint criterion for task-facing accuracy and uncertainty with fewer trials than passive, D-optimal, and task-agnostic alternatives. Across six held-out Isaac Sim navigation maps, it meets the declared noninferiority margins against dense calibration. Code is available at https://github.com/EurekaZang/CalibAgent.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 GAUGE 框架，用于面向规划器的四足机器人不透明速度接口主动校准，通过目标感知与不确定性引导减少校准试验次数。
AI.motivation: 商用四足机器人通常只暴露平面速度指令，底层运动控制器不可访问，导致指令速度与实际运动之间存在系统性偏差；而导航规划器往往只使用指令空间中的一个结构化子集。
AI.method: GAUGE 维护贝叶斯命令到运动模型，并依据规划器诱导的命令分布，选择能最大程度降低后验认知不确定性的授权试验；后验模型支持基于验证的停止、有界逆补偿以及接口变化后的任务相关重校准。
AI.result: 在三种受控响应族中，GAUGE 比被动、D-最优和任务无关方法用更少试验达到任务精度与不确定性的联合标准；在六个留出的 Isaac Sim 导航地图上，其表现满足相对于密集校准的非劣效性边界。
AI.conclusion: GAUGE 能有效实现规划器条件下的主动校准，在减少校准试验的同时保持任务相关精度，并在仿真导航任务中达到与密集校准相当的效果。

title: What Does the Rank Buy? A Spectral and Distributional Analysis of Low-Rank Adaptation
summary: The rank $r$ in LoRA is widely treated as a capacity control: a smaller rank is assumed to yield a simpler model that generalizes better. We show that, under hard per-factor norm budgets---the idealization of the weight decay and norm control used in practice---this intuition breaks down. The reason is structural: under such budgets, the updates LoRA can reach are exactly the matrices of rank at most $r$ inside a nuclear-norm ball, and every complexity and displacement functional we analyze is maximized over this set by a rank-one update---so the rank cap never binds. The consequences follow directly. The linear-readout model class we study is identical for every $r \ge 1$, its Rademacher complexity carries no dependence on $r$, and the distance the adaptation can move the source distribution obeys a rank-independent upper bound that we show is sharp. If rank does not control capacity, where does it act? We identify two places. Statistically, replacing the per-factor budgets with a joint budget on the product restores a data-dependent, rank-sensitive complexity bound---though the gain appears only for well-spread feature distributions, and the worst case remains rank-free. Spectrally, rank sets the price of adaptation: canceling the leading singular directions of the pretrained weight requires both sufficient rank and sufficient budget. We bound the smallest rank achieving a desired source--target alignment, with upper and lower bounds that match under two-sided spectral decay. Together, these results recast rank as governing which updates are reachable and what cancellation costs---not how much capacity the model has.

AI.tldr: 本文质疑LoRA中“秩r越小容量越低、泛化越好”的常见直觉，指出在硬性逐因子范数预算下，秩并不控制模型容量；秩真正决定的是可达更新集合以及抵消预训练权重主要奇异方向所需的代价。
AI.motivation: LoRA中秩r通常被当作容量控制手段，但作者认为这一直觉在实践常用的权重衰减和范数控制下可能不成立，因此需要重新审视秩的作用。
AI.method: 在逐因子硬范数预算下分析LoRA可达更新集合，将其刻画为核范数球内秩不超过r的矩阵；分析线性读出模型类、Rademacher复杂度、分布位移，并对比逐因子预算与乘积联合预算；进一步从谱角度研究抵消预训练权重主奇异方向所需的最小秩与预算。
AI.result: 在逐因子范数预算下，LoRA可达更新等价于核范数球内秩≤r矩阵，且复杂度与位移泛函由秩一更新最大化，因此秩上限不起约束作用；线性读出模型类对所有r≥1相同，Rademacher复杂度不依赖r，分布位移上界与r无关且紧。改为乘积联合预算后，可在特征分布良好时恢复依赖数据的秩敏感复杂度界，但最坏情况仍与秩无关。谱上，抵消主奇异方向需要足够秩与预算，并给出源-目标对齐所需最小秩的上界和下界，在双侧谱衰减下匹配。
AI.conclusion: 秩不应被理解为控制模型容量，而应被理解为控制哪些更新可达以及抵消预训练权重主要方向需要多高代价。

title: RPA: Residual Patch-Token Adapter for Image Retrieval from EEG and MEG
summary: Most existing MEG and EEG (M/EEG) visual decoding methods align brain signals with a single global embedding extracted from a pretrained visual encoder, leaving open whether intermediate patch representations, which preserve richer and more granular rich visual information, can improve representation learning. To address this question, we introduce the Residual Patch Adapter (RPA), a lightweight, modular adapter that leverages all patch tokens from an intermediate layer of a ViT visual encoder for alignment. Through extensive ablation analyses, we first show that pooling or masking patch tokens degrades the learned representation, demonstrating that retaining the full set of patch tokens is important for EEG alignment, while the CLS token provides little unique information. We then use a series of six quantitative feature analyses to show that both higher-level semantics and lower-level visual features, including color and texture, are essential for this EEG-to-image alignment. Under current protocols, our system achieves Top-1 accuracies of 95.4\% within-subject and 35.5\% cross-subject on THINGS-EEG2, and 65.2\% and 6.7\%, respectively, on THINGS-MEG, achieving state-of-the-art (SOTA) performance across both datasets. Evaluations with alternative brain encoders, including pretrained EEG foundation models, demonstrate that the approach extends beyond the projection-based EEG encoder. Furthermore, we provide a plug-and-play interface that allows RPA to be replaced by convolution, attention, or ConvNeXt alternatives. Together, these findings provide significant insight into M/EEG-to-image representation learning by establishing design principles for leveraging the latent space of visual encoders, and open new directions for brain--image alignment and non-invasive brain--computer interface (BCI).

AI.tldr: 本文提出残差补丁适配器（RPA），利用ViT视觉编码器中间层的全部补丁token来对齐M/EEG脑信号，在THINGS-EEG2和THINGS-MEG上取得SOTA解码性能，并系统分析了设计原则。
AI.motivation: 现有M/EEG视觉解码多将脑信号与预训练视觉编码器的单一全局嵌入对齐，未充分探索中间层补丁表示是否能提供更丰富、更细粒度的视觉信息以改进表示学习。
AI.method: 提出轻量、模块化的RPA，使用ViT中间层的全部patch token进行脑-图像对齐；通过消融分析比较池化或掩蔽patch token的影响；进行六项定量特征分析；在THINGS-EEG2和THINGS-MEG上评测，并测试替代脑编码器及可插拔的卷积、注意力、ConvNeXt版本。
AI.result: 保留全部patch token对EEG对齐很重要，CLS token信息有限；高层语义和低层视觉特征（如颜色、纹理）均关键。THINGS-EEG2上被试内Top-1为95.4%、跨被试35.5%；THINGS-MEG上分别为65.2%和6.7%，均达SOTA。方法可扩展至预训练EEG基础模型等替代编码器。
AI.conclusion: 研究为M/EEG到图像表示学习建立了利用视觉编码器潜在空间的设计原则，并推动脑-图像对齐及非侵入式脑机接口的新方向。

title: Quantization Thresholds Replicate, Failure Modes Do Not: A Three-Model Study of Agentic Tool Use in Polish from 8-bit to 2-bit
comment: 34 pages, 1 figure, 21 tables. Code, tasks, trajectories and analysis scripts: https://github.com/JakubPrejzner/polagentbench
summary: We ask how GGUF quantization affects agentic tool use in Polish and whether the effects generalize across models. We introduce PolAgentBench, a deterministic benchmark with Polish prompts and English tool schemas: a 67-task main suite (15 adversarial probes, 52 hard-tier tasks) and a 46-task arithmetic isolation ladder. Three models span two axes of variation: Bielik-11B-v3.0 and its pruned, distilled child Bielik-Minitron-7B-v3.0 isolate model compression, and Llama-PLLuM-8B adds a change of pretraining family. Each is measured at six precisions, Q8_0 to Q2_K. Only the collapse threshold replicates. (1) All three models fall off a cliff between 3-bit and 2-bit (11B 0.716 to 0.045, 7B 0.463 to 0.149, PLLuM 0.224 to 0.015; paired McNemar p < 0.001 in each), across a fourfold capability spread and both axes. (2) Failure modes do not replicate: at 2-bit the 7B fails long (median 9.1k tokens, 4 steps) while the 11B mostly answers at the first step with a confabulated final answer (37 of 64 failures); PLLuM fails on content across precisions (71.8-92.0% of steps parse). (3) On the arithmetic ladder the unscaffolded rung is a floor, left standing by a rerun that states the no-tool rule; four explicit calls lift the 8-bit 11B from 1/10 to 9/10 and the 7B from 0/10 to 7/10 after format-only failures with the gold value are forgiven, an exploratory effect with eight distinct baseline inputs that does not survive multiplicity correction, while the order-trap arm separates the models at 8-bit (11B 6/6, 7B 0/6). (4) The Polish-versus-English gap is associated with degradation or with task family. We document four artifacts that shaped our conclusions (rounding-hostile gold values, strict answer typing, a no-tool rule the prompt never stated, priority-ordered failure labels), report affected results in strict and corrected form, and release the benchmark, trajectories and commit-stamped artifacts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PolAgentBench，用于评估 GGUF 量化对波兰语智能体工具使用能力的影响，并检验该影响能否跨模型泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有研究较少关注量化对非英语、智能体式工具调用任务的影响，尤其是压缩模型、不同预训练家族和多精度设置下的泛化性与失败模式。
AI.method: 构建确定性基准 PolAgentBench：波兰语提示、英语工具 schema；含 67 个主任务（15 个对抗探针、52 个困难任务）和 46 个算术隔离阶梯。评估 Bielik-11B-v3.0、Bielik-Minitron-7B-v3.0、Llama-PLLuM-8B 三个模型，覆盖 Q8_0 到 Q2_K 六种精度，并用配对 McNemar 检验、失败模式分析和工具调用脚手架实验。
AI.result: 仅“崩溃阈值”可复现：三个模型均在 3-bit 到 2-bit 间性能骤降（11B 0.716→0.045，7B 0.463→0.149，PLLuM 0.224→0.015，p<0.001）。失败模式不泛化：2-bit 下 7B 长程失败，11B 常首步编造答案，PLLuM 各精度均内容失败。算术阶梯中显式工具调用可提升表现，但未通过多重校正；order-trap 在 8-bit 下区分模型。波兰语-英语差距与退化或任务族相关。
AI.conclusion: 量化对智能体工具使用的破坏存在跨模型一致的崩溃阈值，但具体失败模式高度依赖模型；波兰语差距并非单一因素，必须警惕基准伪影，报告严格与修正结果，并发布基准、轨迹和提交戳记工件以支持复现。

title: Decentralized Master-Mind: Joint Action Refinement through Iterative Intent Denoising in Multi-Agent Pathfinding
summary: Decentralized multi-agent path finding (MAPF) with communication requires agents to reach individual goals without collisions under partial observability. Learnable policies trained on expert data provide an effective approach to this problem. However, when several coordinated joint actions are valid in the same context, independently sampling from per-agent distributions can recombine locally valid choices into incompatible joint actions. This failure can arise from the final sampling mechanism even when the per-agent action distributions are learned correctly. DMM (Decentralized Master-Mind) addresses this by replacing one-shot action sampling with discrete, iterative refinement of action intents across communication rounds, inspired by denoising in diffusion models. Agents initialize random action intents and refine them through local communication, coupling their choices before commitment. DMM is pretrained with imitation learning on expert MAPF solutions and further optimized with MICPO, a critic-free group-relative reinforcement-learning method designed for multi-agent, multi-round action refinement. DMM generally achieves higher success rates and lower solution costs than the evaluated learnable baselines. On 1,600 MovingAI tasks, DMM fine-tuned with MICPO solves 1,598, the highest coverage among the evaluated methods, while achieving solution costs close to those of the strongest baselines. DMM also scales to over one million simultaneously acting agents in obstacle-rich environments. These results show that round-level intent refinement can improve joint-action coordination while preserving decentralized execution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DMM，一种用于去中心化多智能体路径规划的通信方法，通过多轮迭代细化动作意图来避免独立采样导致的不兼容联合动作，并在大规模任务上取得高成功率。
AI.motivation: 在部分可观测下，基于专家数据训练的可学习策略虽有效，但当同一情境存在多个协调联合动作时，独立从各智能体分布采样可能把局部有效选择重组为不兼容的联合动作；即使各智能体动作分布学习正确，最终采样机制仍会导致失败。
AI.method: DMM用离散、迭代的动作意图细化取代一次性动作采样，灵感来自扩散模型去噪；智能体初始化随机动作意图，通过局部通信多轮细化以在提交前耦合选择。先用专家MAPF解进行模仿学习预训练，再用MICPO（无评论家的组相对强化学习，面向多智能体多轮动作细化）优化。
AI.result: DMM总体成功率和解成本优于所评估的可学习基线。在1600个MovingAI任务上，MICPO微调的DMM解出1598个，覆盖率最高，解成本接近最强基线；并可扩展至障碍丰富环境中超过一百万个同时行动的智能体。
AI.conclusion: 轮级意图细化能在保持去中心化执行的同时改善联合动作协调。

title: RecastVLA: From Past Interaction to Future Control with Adaptive Policy States
summary: Sequential manipulation requires a robot to track what has already happened, even when the current scene no longer reveals it. Policies with explicit history representations make past interactions available as context for current decisions. We ask how action generation itself can form a persistent state for subsequent control. Building on action-side test-time training, RecastVLA maintains an adaptive policy state within a flow-matching vision-language-action policy. The state is represented by shared fast weights and remains fixed throughout action generation. Depth-specific interfaces read the same state, while features across depths and flow evaluations jointly define one update for the next policy call. Subsequent action losses train the initialization, interfaces, and update rule by differentiating through earlier state transitions. At deployment, updates use the policy's own action-generation features without expert action labels. Across LIBERO, RoboTwin, RoboDojo, and twelve real-robot tasks, RecastVLA improves mean success over a matched policy trained without test-time training, including 10.68 percentage points on RoboTwin Clean-to-Clean. In controlled RoboTwin comparisons, retaining state improves success, and the shared design exceeds independently trained layer-local TTT by 2.58 points.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RecastVLA，将动作生成过程本身作为持续状态，用于序贯操作中的后续控制。它在 flow-matching VLA 策略中引入动作侧测试时训练，通过共享快权重维护自适应策略状态，并在多个基准和真实机器人任务上提升成功率。
AI.motivation: 序贯操作要求机器人跟踪已发生但当前场景不再可见的历史。已有方法依赖显式历史表示，本文追问：动作生成本身能否形成对后续控制有用的持久状态。
AI.method: 基于动作侧测试时训练，在 flow-matching 视觉-语言-动作策略中维护自适应策略状态；状态由共享快权重表示，并在整个动作生成过程中保持固定。不同深度的接口读取同一状态，跨深度与流评估的特征共同定义下一次策略调用的更新。利用后续动作损失，通过反向传播穿过更早的状态转移来训练初始化、接口和更新规则；部署时更新仅使用策略自身动作生成特征，无需专家动作标签。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、RoboTwin、RoboDojo 和 12 个真实机器人任务上，RecastVLA 相比未使用测试时训练的匹配策略提升了平均成功率，其中 RoboTwin Clean-to-Clean 提升 10.68 个百分点。在 RoboTwin 受控对比中，保留状态能提升成功率，且共享设计比独立训练的逐层 TTT 高 2.58 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 动作生成可以构成持久的状态表示，并有效支持后续控制；RecastVLA 通过动作侧测试时训练和共享快权重状态，在序贯操作任务中取得一致性能提升。

title: Derivative-Free Generalized Multivariable Super-Twisting Control for Constrained Euler-Lagrange Systems
summary: Robotic manipulators performing payload lift-and-transfer must track prescribed trajectories under abrupt load changes, with limited actuation and inaccurate plant knowledge. Such plants are inherently described by multivariable Euler--Lagrange~(EL) dynamics with cross-coupling established through inertial and Coriolis terms. The super-twisting algorithm~(STA) is the standard approach to regulating a first-order sliding mode~(FOSM) in such settings, yet existing designs are largely restricted to scalar sliding variables, and rest on a disturbance-derivative assumption that EL systems violate. In particular, the FOSM dynamics depend on the disturbance and become discontinuous under the step changes in load produced by payload engagement and release, rendering that derivative ill-defined. This study resolves both with a derivative-free generalized multivariable super-twisting framework. The discontinuous sign-function integral term is replaced with a continuous fractional-power term whose dynamics are independent of the disturbance derivative, while the known state-dependent scaling of the perturbation is incorporated into both the control law and the adaptive gain update. A time-shifting barrier function guarantees prescribed-time convergence to a user-specified bound independently of initial conditions, with the design relying only on mass-matrix norm bounds. Simulation and experimental results on a 7-DoF manipulator under actuator saturation are used to validate the proposed scheme.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无导数广义多变量超螺旋控制框架，用于负载突变下机械臂的轨迹跟踪，实现预设时间收敛，并通过7自由度机械臂仿真与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 机械臂搬运负载时会发生负载突加或突卸，导致Euler-Lagrange动力学出现强耦合、执行器受限且模型不精确。现有超螺旋算法多局限于标量滑模变量，并依赖扰动导数假设，而负载阶跃会使一阶滑模动力学不连续，该假设不成立。
AI.method: 针对多变量Euler-Lagrange系统，将不连续符号函数积分项替换为连续分数幂项，使滑模动态不依赖扰动导数；将状态相关的扰动缩放纳入控制律和自适应增益更新；采用时移障碍函数保证预设时间收敛到用户指定界，且仅依赖质量矩阵范数界。
AI.result: 所提方法在负载突变和执行器饱和条件下有效，能够在不依赖初始条件的情况下实现预设时间收敛至指定界；仿真和7自由度机械臂实验验证了方案性能。
AI.conclusion: 该无导数广义多变量超螺旋框架解决了现有超螺旋方法在Euler-Lagrange系统负载突变场景中的局限，适用于执行器受限和模型知识不精确的机械臂控制，并保证预设时间收敛。

title: A Benchmark for LLM's Understanding of Middle School and High School Science Topics
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly integrated into educational settings, yet educators lack robust, standards-aligned tools to evaluate their effectiveness in K-12 science contexts. Existing benchmarks predominantly assess general language or advanced scientific reasoning, leaving a critical gap in understanding LLMs' performance on content directly relevant to secondary science curricula. To address this gap, we developed a comprehensive NGSS-aligned benchmark for both middle and high school science using a rigorous synthetic data pipeline, multi-judge validation, and item-level psychometric analysis. Nine open-weight LLMs were systematically evaluated using this benchmark, indicating that several smaller, locally deployable models achieved high accuracy across diverse science domains and question types. Our findings indicate that model size did not consistently predict performance, emphasizing the importance of intentional model selection for educational deployment. We then incorporated a human reviewer into the loop, reviewing the items generated by the LLMs for alignment with NGSS standards. The human review indicated that synthetically generated items were not in perfect alignment with the NGSS standards, indicating the benefits of human-in-the-loop item development, the need to explore the intersection of content and pedagogical knowledge, and the need to extend benchmarks to evaluate LLMs' capacity for interactive, evidence-based feedback in educational scenarios.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对K-12科学教育场景，构建了一个符合NGSS标准的中小学科学基准，用于评估大语言模型，并发现小模型也可表现优异，但合成题目仍需人类审查以确保标准对齐。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型日益进入教育场景，但现有基准多评估通用语言能力或高级科学推理，缺乏与中学科学课程直接相关、符合标准的评估工具，因此难以判断其在K-12科学教育中的有效性。
AI.method: 开发了一个覆盖初中和高中科学的NGSS对齐基准，采用合成数据管道、多评委验证和项目级心理测量分析；系统评估了9个开放权重LLM；并引入人类审查者检查LLM生成题目与NGSS标准的一致性。
AI.result: 多个较小的、可本地部署的模型在多样科学领域和题型上取得高准确率；模型规模并不稳定预测性能；人类审查发现合成生成题目与NGSS标准并非完全一致。
AI.conclusion: 教育部署需有意选择模型，不能仅依赖规模；人类在回路中的题目开发很重要；未来需探索内容知识与教学知识的结合，并扩展基准以评估LLM在真实教育场景中提供交互式、基于证据反馈的能力。

title: mu-bench: A Multilingual Utterance Transcription Benchmark
comment: 5 pages, 7 tables. Dataset: https://huggingface.co/datasets/sierra-research/mu-bench . Code: https://github.com/sierra-research/mu-bench/tree/icassp-2027 . Leaderboard: https://research.sierra.ai/mubench/
summary: Voice agents depend on accurate automatic speech recognition (ASR) to act on what callers say, yet ASR is evaluated on read, English-centric speech with word error rate (WER), which penalizes surface rather than semantic differences. We introduce mu-bench, a dataset of 4,270 caller utterances from 250 phone calls to an AI banking agent in English, Spanish, Turkish, Vietnamese, and Mandarin, centered on form-field inputs such as names, email addresses, and confirmation codes. We release Utterance Error Rate (UER), an LLM judge of whether a transcript preserves meaning, calibrated against human raters, together with an LLM normalizer that makes WER comparable across providers' output formats. On 1,847 human-rated transcripts, UER agrees with annotators at $κ$ = 0.78, versus 0.53 for exact-match WER on normalized text. We rank six commercial providers on a public leaderboard; the best reaches 11.9% UER, and Mandarin is hardest for all six.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 mu-bench，一个来自 250 通 AI 银行客服电话、共 4,270 条用户话语的多语言数据集，覆盖英语、西班牙语、土耳其语、越南语和普通话，聚焦姓名、邮箱、确认码等表单字段输入。同时发布语义层面评估指标 UER、LLM 归一化器，并对六家商业 ASR 提供商进行排名。
AI.motivation: 语音代理依赖准确的 ASR，但现有 ASR 评估多基于朗读式、英语中心语音和 WER，惩罚表面差异而非语义差异，难以反映真实呼叫场景中表单字段输入的多语言识别需求。
AI.method: 构建 mu-bench 数据集；收集 AI 银行代理电话中的真实话语；提出基于 LLM 判断的 UER，用于评估转录是否保留语义，并与人工评分校准；发布 LLM 归一化器，使不同提供商输出格式下的 WER 更可比；在 1,847 条人工评分转录上验证 UER，并对六家商业提供商进行公开排行榜排名。
AI.result: UER 与人工标注者一致性达到 κ=0.78，而归一化文本上的精确匹配 WER 仅为 0.53；最佳提供商达到 11.9% UER；普通话对所有六家提供商都是最难的语言。
AI.conclusion: 传统 WER 不足以评估面向语音代理的 ASR，语义层面的 UER 更符合人类判断；mu-bench 和 UER 为多语言、表单字段输入场景提供了更合适的基准与评估方法。

title: Using LMs to Model the Effects of Context and Coreference during Sentence Comprehension
summary: Language models (LMs) are often used as a tool to model human language processing. Recent studies suggest that severely restricting LMs' context window improves their fit to human psycholinguistic data by simulating human working memory constraints. However, it is possible that this strict memory-decay approach overlooks humans' reliance on long-range structural representations, such as discourse structre. In this work, we systematically vary the context window size of GPT-2 across four large-scale naturalistic English reading-time datasets and observe a U-shaped relationship: Although restricted contexts (< 20 tokens) successfully capture local memory limitations, expanded contexts (500--1,000 tokens) ultimately yield the highest overall psycholinguistic fit. To investigate the mechanism driving this benefit, we conduct a counterfactual inference-time experiment that disrupts cross-sentential entity chains by pronominalizing repeated discourse entities. Obscuring these structural linkages significantly degrades the predictive power of larger context windows by 20% to 40%. Our experiments demonstrate that tracking long-range coreference relations is one important factor for the alignment between LM surprisal and human reading behavior, and approximate the extent to which human comprehenders use global discourse relations during language processing.

AI.tldr: 本文系统改变GPT-2的上下文窗口大小，在四个大规模英语阅读时间数据集上发现：受限上下文能捕捉局部记忆限制，但扩展上下文（500–1000词元）整体心理语言学拟合最好；通过代词化破坏跨句实体链会显著降低大窗口的预测能力，表明长距离共指关系对模型与人类阅读行为对齐很重要。
AI.motivation: 近期研究认为严重限制语言模型上下文窗口可模拟人类工作记忆约束，从而更好拟合心理语言学数据；但这可能忽视人类对长距离结构表征（如语篇结构）的依赖。
AI.method: 系统变化GPT-2上下文窗口大小，在四个大规模自然化英语阅读时间数据集上评估心理语言学拟合；并进行反事实推理实验，通过代词化重复的语篇实体来破坏跨句实体链。
AI.result: 上下文窗口与拟合呈U形关系：小于20词元的受限上下文能捕捉局部记忆限制，而500–1000词元的扩展上下文总体拟合最佳。破坏跨句实体链后，较大上下文窗口的预测能力下降20%–40%。
AI.conclusion: 追踪长距离共指关系是语言模型惊奇度与人类阅读行为对齐的重要因素，并可近似估计人类理解者使用全局语篇关系的程度。

title: AquaBEV-Nav: Learned BEV Occupancy for Underwater Navigation and Exploration
summary: Safe underwater exploration requires a robot to understand where surrounding structures are located and which regions are available for motion. Existing vision-based underwater exploration systems commonly obtain this information indirectly by estimating monocular depth, unprojecting the geometry into 3D space, and accumulating it into a 2D bird's-eye-view occupancy map. This reliance on intermediate depth estimation is particularly problematic underwater, where scattering and wavelength-dependent attenuation degrade visual cues and limit the reliability of monocular depth estimates. We introduce AquaBEV-Nav, an underwater exploration framework that bypasses explicit monocular depth estimation through direct bird's-eye-view occupancy prediction. Built upon the CORAL hierarchical exploration framework, AquaBEV-Nav replaces its depth-based perception front end with AquaBEV. Given a single RGB frame, AquaBEV maps visual features into a learned polar representation, performs causal reasoning along the range dimension, and reconstructs local Cartesian occupancy without relying on intermediate depth prediction. The resulting occupancy map is accumulated into CORAL's persistent spatial memory, providing spatial context for VLM-based high-level planning and collision constraints for dynamics-aware local trajectory generation. Across ten simulated reef environments and six occupancy backbones evaluated under a single protocol, AquaBEV-Nav reaches 37.48 structure IoU and 53.2 target IoU, 88.95% closed-loop coverage with zero collisions.

AI.tldr: 提出AquaBEV-Nav水下探索框架，绕过单目深度估计，直接预测鸟瞰图占用栅格，实现安全探索。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉的水下探索系统依赖单目深度估计，但水下散射和波长相关衰减会降低视觉线索，使深度估计不可靠，从而影响探索安全。
AI.method: 基于CORAL分层探索框架，用AquaBEV替换其深度感知前端。AquaBEV接收单帧RGB图像，将视觉特征映射到学习到的极坐标表示，沿距离维度进行因果推理，直接重建局部笛卡尔占用栅格，无需中间深度预测。占用图累积到CORAL的持久空间记忆中，为VLM高层规划提供空间上下文，并为动态感知的局部轨迹生成提供碰撞约束。
AI.result: 在十个模拟珊瑚礁环境和六种占用骨干网络下，采用统一协议评估，AquaBEV-Nav达到37.48的结构IoU和53.2的目标IoU，闭环覆盖率为88.95%，且零碰撞。
AI.conclusion: 通过直接鸟瞰图占用预测绕过显式单目深度估计，AquaBEV-Nav能有效提升水下探索的感知可靠性与安全性。

title: Modernising the Compressed-Domain Video Captioner: A Controlled Study of SigLIP2 and GPT-2 Substitutions
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 6 tables. Code, configurations and the exact commit for every run: https://github.com/nepalashim/compressed-video-captioning-ablation-cocap-siglip2-gpt2
summary:
Compressed-domain video captioning avoids full video decoding by operating directly on I-frames, motion vectors and residuals, trading a small amount of accuracy for a large gain in inference speed. CoCap established this pipeline using a CLIP vision encoder and a shallow BERT-style multimodal decoder. Both components predate substantially stronger alternatives. We ask a narrow, controlled question: how much of CoCap's accuracy is limited by these two components, and which of the two is the binding constraint?
  We replace the CLIP I-frame encoder with SigLIP2 and the BERT-style decoder with GPT-2, and evaluate three configurations (the original pairing, the encoder substitution alone, and both substitutions together) under identical data, sampling budget and optimisation schedule. All comparisons are made against our own reproduction of CoCap rather than its published numbers, because we train on a 4,999-clip subset of VATEX at a reduced sampling budget; absolute values are therefore not comparable with the original work.
  Our reproduction tracks the published result closely: CIDEr and METEOR run slightly above it (54.9 against 52.7; 23.4 against 23.2), BLEU-4 and ROUGE-L slightly below (29.7 against 31.4; 48.9 against 49.4). We attribute the differences to our evaluation subset rather than to any improvement in either direction. We find the two substitutions pull in opposite directions: SigLIP2 alone improves every metric (+4.5 CIDEr), while adding GPT-2 on top erodes that gain, because a pretrained decoder overfits 4,999 clips within two epochs. We additionally report inference latency for each configuration, since speed is the property that motivates compressed-domain captioning in the first place, and an accuracy gain purchased at a latency cost should be reported as such.

AI.tldr: 该论文在压缩域视频描述框架 CoCap 上做受控替换实验：将 CLIP I 帧编码器换成 SigLIP2，并将 BERT 风格解码器换成 GPT-2，在相同数据、采样预算和优化设置下比较三种配置，以探究 CoCap 精度受哪一组件限制。
AI.motivation: CoCap 使用 CLIP 视觉编码器和浅层 BERT 风格多模态解码器，但这两个组件已有更强替代方案。作者希望回答一个受控问题：CoCap 的精度有多少受限于这两个组件，以及二者中哪一个是瓶颈。
AI.method: 在压缩域直接使用 I 帧、运动矢量和残差。替换 CLIP I 帧编码器为 SigLIP2，替换 BERT 风格解码器为 GPT-2，并评估三种配置：原始组合、仅替换编码器、同时替换两者。所有配置使用相同数据、采样预算和优化计划，并与作者自己对 CoCap 的复现结果比较，而非已发表数值；训练数据为 VATEX 的 4,999 个片段子集且采样预算较低。同时报告各配置的推理延迟。
AI.result: 复现结果与已发表结果接近：CIDEr 和 METEOR 略高（54.9 vs 52.7；23.4 vs 23.2），BLEU-4 和 ROUGE-L 略低（29.7 vs 31.4；48.9 vs 49.4），差异归因于评估子集。两种替换方向相反：仅用 SigLIP2 提升所有指标（CIDEr +4.5）；再叠加 GPT-2 会侵蚀该增益，因为预训练解码器在 4,999 个片段上两个 epoch 内过拟合。
AI.conclusion: 在本文的小数据压缩域设定下，SigLIP2 编码器替换带来一致精度提升，而 GPT-2 解码器替换因过拟合反而有害，说明解码器是更明显的限制因素。精度提升需与推理延迟一起报告，因为速度正是压缩域视频描述的核心动机。

title: Frequency Measurement Practices for Inertia Assessment in Inverter Based Resources Dominated Power Systems
comment: Under Review in IEEE Transactions on Power Systems
summary: Transmission system operators and protective relays compute the rate of change of frequency (RoCoF) from frequency averaged over tens to hundreds of milliseconds, as standards and grid codes specify. Any response delivered inside that window lowers the measured RoCoF, so the inferred inertia depends on the window and the responses in service. This paper defines the windowed inertia estimate and derives an exact identity the system inertia divided by one minus the fraction of the disturbance energy delivered inside the window and a closed-form prediction that applies the same estimator to the trajectory of a linear response model. Eleven IEEE 9-bus RMS runs synchronous, grid-following and grid-forming configurations, disturbance sizes and parameter sweeps are reproduced by that model, and the identity closes on the measured response powers. Fast frequency response inflates the estimate most: at 500 ms a grid-following system with 20 % less synchronous inertia reports the same value as the all-synchronous system, the grid-forming system a higher one. On a reduced Greek transmission system the 500ms estimate exceeds the inertia by 17-26%, and a scenario with 10% less synchronous inertia reports more than the all-synchronous scenario's inertia. Operators can thus compute what their measurement reports.

AI.tldr: 论文定义考虑测量时间窗的惯量估计，揭示RoCoF窗内快速响应会显著抬高惯量推断值，并给出可预测该偏差的解析模型。
AI.motivation: 标准和电网规范要求用数十至数百毫秒平均频率计算RoCoF，但窗内任何响应都会降低测得RoCoF，使推断惯量依赖窗口和在线响应类型，因此需要量化这一偏差。
AI.method: 定义窗口惯量估计，推导精确恒等式：系统惯量除以1减去窗内扰动能量占比，并建立线性响应模型的闭式预测；用11个IEEE 9-bus RMS仿真（同步、跟网、构网、不同扰动和参数）验证，并应用于简化希腊输电网。
AI.result: 线性模型能复现仿真，恒等式对实测响应功率闭合。快速频率响应导致最严重高估：500 ms下，跟网系统少20%同步惯量却报告与全同步系统相同，构网系统报告更高。希腊系统500 ms估计比真实惯量高17-26%，少10%同步惯量场景报告值甚至超过全同步场景惯量。
AI.conclusion: 运行人员可用该框架计算其测量实际报告的惯量，明确RoCoF窗口和快速响应对惯量估计的扭曲，从而更准确解释测量结果。

title: Integrated Deep Learning Framework Designed on Hybrid Optimization Strategies for Automated Health Detection and Analysis in Silkworms
summary: A Hybrid Residual Attention Network is proposed for accurately classifying silkworm images into six different classes, including healthy and diseased states. It uses residual blocks for deep feature extraction and attention to focus on disease related features. A novel Integrated Adaptive Momentum Optimizer was introduced to enhance convergence and improve training efficiency. The dataset of silkworm images underwent preprocessing techniques such as normalization, resizing, and noise reduction, along with augmentation strategies to improve data quality and diversity. It is optimized using IAMO, achieved an accuracy of 98.67%.The integration of spatial and channel wise attention mechanisms, coupled with IAMO, significantly enhanced the model ability to recognize subtle differences between classes. Results indicate that HRAN can be used to detect disease at an early stage in sericulture, and future work will enhance scalability and efficiency in different environments.

AI.tldr: 提出一种混合残差注意力网络（HRAN）用于蚕图像分类，结合残差块、注意力机制和新型优化器IAMO，在六类（健康与疾病）分类上达到98.67%准确率。
AI.motivation: 在蚕业中实现疾病的早期检测，提高分类准确性。
AI.method: 使用残差块进行深度特征提取，空间和通道注意力机制聚焦疾病特征；引入集成自适应动量优化器（IAMO）加速收敛；数据预处理（归一化、调整大小、降噪）和数据增强。
AI.result: 使用IAMO优化后达到98.67%准确率；注意力机制和IAMO显著提升模型识别细微差异的能力。
AI.conclusion: HRAN可用于蚕业早期疾病检测；未来工作将提升可扩展性和在不同环境中的效率。

title: CLC-YOLO: A Compact Channel-Gated Prototype Network for Real-Time Leakage-Aware Breast Ultrasound Lesion Segmentation
summary: Reliable breast ultrasound lesion segmentation requires accurate boundaries and evaluation that prevents patients or duplicate images from crossing data splits. We propose Channel Local Contrast (CLC), a compact refinement of the YOLO26 segmentation prototype head. CLC adds a fixed local high-pass residual controlled by 64 zero-initialized, bounded channel gates. Baseline and CLC were compared in five matched folds on each of four breast ultrasound datasets. BUS-BRA used patient-disjoint outer tests with separate inner validation. BUS-UCLM and BrEaST used patient-grouped validation folds; BUSI used duplicate-component groups because patient identifiers are unavailable. Group-macro Dice increased by 1.68, 3.11, 1.12, and 2.45 percentage points on BUS-BRA, BUS-UCLM, BUSI, and BrEaST, respectively. Only the BUS-BRA paired 95% confidence interval excluded zero. CLC adds 64 parameters and 0.0049 giga floating-point operations (GFLOPs). At 640 pixels, single-T4, batch-one, 16-bit floating-point (FP16) TensorRT graph times were 2.1478 ms for CLC and 2.0512 ms for baseline, excluding preprocessing and postprocessing. CLC increased group-macro Dice across all four datasets with a measured T4 forward-pass overhead of 0.0966 ms. Code: https://github.com/mfazrinizar/CLC-YOLO

AI.tldr: 论文提出通道局部对比度（CLC）模块，用于改进YOLO26分割原型头，并在四个乳腺超声数据集上验证其分割性能与计算开销。
AI.motivation: 乳腺超声病灶分割需要准确边界，同时数据划分必须避免同一患者或重复图像跨训练/测试集泄漏，因此需要可靠的分割方法与严格评估。
AI.method: CLC在YOLO26分割原型头中加入固定的局部高通残差，并由64个零初始化、有界通道门控调节。在四个乳腺超声数据集上以五折匹配比较基线，并根据数据集特点采用患者不交叉、患者分组或重复组件分组的数据划分。
AI.result: 组宏平均Dice在BUS-BRA、BUS-UCLM、BUSI和BrEaST上分别提升1.68、3.11、1.12和2.45个百分点；仅BUS-BRA的配对95%置信区间排除零。CLC仅增加64个参数和0.0049 GFLOPs，640像素下TensorRT FP16前向耗时2.1478 ms，基线为2.0512 ms，开销约0.0966 ms。
AI.conclusion: CLC在四个数据集上均提升组宏平均Dice，且计算开销很小，表明其在乳腺超声分割中具有实用价值。

title: FutureRay: Control-Aligned Future Range for Agile Quadruped Navigation
summary: Moving obstacles can block a previously clear route while a quadruped robot executes a motion command. We investigate whether predicting changing clearance improves navigation when motion selection accounts for the robot footprint and the time needed to react and brake. We present FutureRay, which predicts ranges across viewing directions and future times, together with encounter risk, from depth-derived range history and observable robot motion. Training emphasizes near-term clearance and penalizes errors that overstate available space. A local planner queries the same forecast for candidate headings and combines it with current observations to check clearance around the robot footprint. Model-based reaction--braking limits guide speed selection, and the resulting velocity commands are passed to a fixed locomotion policy. In paired evaluations on 60 static and dynamic simulation scenes, FutureRay achieves 93.3% completion, compared with 75.0% for current-range persistence and 80.0% for Cartesian Kalman rollout, with perception, planning, and locomotion held fixed. FutureRay also records fewer collisions than both baselines. Qualitative trials on a physical quadruped show avoidance initiated while an obstacle is approaching the route, followed by renewed goal progress. These results show that joint range and encounter-risk prediction can improve obstacle avoidance without retraining the locomotion policy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FutureRay，通过预测未来不同视角距离和遭遇风险，结合机器人足迹与反应制动时间，提升四足机器人在动态障碍下的导航避障能力。
AI.motivation: 移动障碍可能在四足机器人执行运动指令时阻塞原本畅通的路径，因此需要预测变化中的净空，并在运动选择中考虑机器人足迹以及反应和制动所需时间。
AI.method: FutureRay基于深度历史范围和可观测机器人运动，预测未来时刻各观察方向的距离范围与遭遇风险；训练强调近期净空并惩罚高估可用空间的误差。局部规划器对候选航向查询同一预测，并结合当前观测检查机器人足迹周围净空；利用基于模型的反制制动限制指导速度选择，最终速度指令交给固定运动策略执行。
AI.result: 在60个静态和动态仿真场景的配对评估中，FutureRay完成率为93.3%，高于当前范围持久法的75.0%和笛卡尔卡尔曼推演法的80.0%，且碰撞更少。物理四足机器人定性试验显示，它能在障碍接近路径时开始避让，随后恢复朝向目标的进展。
AI.conclusion: 联合预测距离范围和遭遇风险可改善避障表现，且无需重新训练运动策略。

title: Robust Variable-Horizon MPC for Landing a Multirotor UAV on a Moving Platform
summary:
Landing a multirotor Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) on a moving platform is challenging because a UAV is underactuated and the desired landing state is generally a non-equilibrium state. Shrinking- and variable-horizon approaches are promising for reaching such non-equilibrium targets, but often lack robustness to disturbances. Robust Variable-Horizon Model Predictive Control (VH-MPC) addresses this limitation but is computationally complex for a high-dimensional system such as a multirotor UAV.
  This paper presents a computationally efficient robust Variable-Horizon MPC method for reaching non-equilibrium targets under bounded disturbances. The online horizon search is restricted to a neighborhood of the previously selected horizon, while maintaining recursive feasibility under bounded disturbances. A fixed robust positively invariant tube provides horizon-independent constraint tightening. By exploiting the differential flatness property of a UAV, this approach is applied to a decoupled linearized system, enabling real-time implementation on an onboard Raspberry Pi 5 at 20 Hz. Simulations show that restricting the horizon search substantially reduces computation with limited impact on the objective, while real-time Gazebo simulations demonstrate the robustness of the method. Physical experiments demonstrate successful landing of a multirotor UAV on a moving Stewart platform.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种计算高效的鲁棒变时域模型预测控制（VH-MPC）方法，用于在有界扰动下使多旋翼无人机降落在移动平台上。
AI.motivation: 多旋翼无人机在移动平台上降落具有挑战性，因为无人机欠驱动且期望着陆状态通常是非平衡状态；变时域方法虽有望到达非平衡目标，但常缺乏对扰动的鲁棒性，而鲁棒VH-MPC计算复杂，难以应用于高维多旋翼系统。
AI.method: 提出计算高效的鲁棒VH-MPC：在线时域搜索限制在先前选择时域的邻域内，同时保持有界扰动下的递归可行性；采用固定鲁棒正不变管实现与时域无关的约束收紧；利用无人机微分平坦特性，将方法应用于解耦线性化系统，并在机载Raspberry Pi 5上以20 Hz实时实现。
AI.result: 仿真表明，限制时域搜索显著减少了计算量且对目标函数影响有限；实时Gazebo仿真验证了方法的鲁棒性；物理实验成功实现了多旋翼无人机在移动Stewart平台上的降落。
AI.conclusion: 所提方法能够高效且鲁棒地到达非平衡目标，适用于多旋翼无人机在移动平台上的自主降落。

title: RoboFFT: Finetuning generative robot policy via online reinforcement learning with forward process
summary: Generative models, such as diffusion and flow-based models, have shown strong promise for robot policy learning by capturing complex and multimodal action distributions from demonstrations. However, policies trained solely with imitation learning often suffer from imperfect demonstrations and distributional shifts, while further improvement typically requires additional expert data. Reinforcement learning offers a natural solution through environment interaction, but effectively finetuning generative robot policies remains challenging due to the intractability of likelihood estimation. In this work, we propose RoboFFT, a forward-process reinforcement learning framework for finetuning generative robot policies, which applies forward noising to sampled actions and uses the weighted score / flow matching loss to construct a surrogate policy ratio for PPO-style updates. We evaluate RoboFFT with popular generative robot policies on representative simulation benchmarks, including long-horizon planning and sparse reward settings. Extensive experiments and analysis demonstrate that RoboFFT consistently improves performance while achieving better stability and training efficiency. We further integrate RoboFFT into a real world RL framework and demonstrate its effectiveness in real world tasks. Project website: https://student-of-holmes.github.io/RoboFFT/.

AI.tldr: RoboFFT 是一种用于微调生成式机器人策略的前向过程强化学习框架，通过前向加噪和加权 score/flow matching 损失构造 PPO 风格的代理策略比率，从而提升策略性能。
AI.motivation: 仅用模仿学习训练的生成式机器人策略容易受不完美演示和分布偏移影响，而进一步改进通常需要额外专家数据。强化学习可通过环境交互解决，但生成式策略的似然估计难以计算，导致微调困难。
AI.method: 提出 RoboFFT：对采样动作进行前向加噪，并利用加权 score / flow matching 损失构建代理策略比率，用于 PPO 风格更新，从而在强化学习中对生成式机器人策略进行微调。
AI.result: 在长时程规划和稀疏奖励等代表性仿真基准上，RoboFFT 持续提升性能，并具有更好的稳定性和训练效率；进一步集成到真实世界 RL 框架中，也验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: RoboFFT 能有效微调生成式机器人策略，克服似然不可计算问题，在仿真和真实任务中均表现良好，是一种稳定且高效的强化学习微调方法。

title: ScopeIF: Improving Scope-Aware Precise Instruction-Following in Large Language Models via Graded Reward Modeling
summary: Precise instruction-following is a fundamental ability of large language models (LLMs), requiring their outputs to strictly satisfy objective constraints in input instructions. In complex application scenarios, these constraints often possess diverse scopes that govern specific response segments rather than the entire output. However, existing optimization methods often neglect constraint scope during data construction and rely on binary per-constraint rewards, yielding limited data diversity and sparse supervision for complex constraints. To this end, we propose ScopeIF, a novel training framework for scope-aware precise instruction-following. We first introduce a unified schema that factorizes objective constraints into three decoupled dimensions: Scope, Target, and Range. Grounded in this schema, we construct ScopeInstruct, a large-scale instruction dataset with diverse scope-aware constraints, and combine tool-grounded verification with graded reward modeling to quantify the violation degree of each constraint, providing dense supervision for policy optimization. Extensive experiments demonstrate that ScopeIF consistently outperforms existing methods, particularly on complex scope-aware constraints, while preserving general capabilities. Notably, it enables optimized Qwen3-4B and 8B models to rival or surpass strong frontier models such as Gemini-2.5-Pro and DeepSeek-V3.2, establishing an effective paradigm for advancing scope-aware instruction-following. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/thu-coai/ScopeIF.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ScopeIF框架，用于提升大语言模型对具有不同作用范围的复杂指令约束的精确遵循能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在数据构建中忽视约束作用范围，且多依赖二元奖励，导致数据多样性不足，并对复杂约束的监督稀疏。
AI.method: 提出统一模式将客观约束分解为Scope、Target、Range三个维度，构建ScopeInstruct数据集，并结合工具验证与分级奖励建模，量化每个约束的违反程度以提供密集监督。
AI.result: ScopeIF在复杂范围感知约束上持续优于现有方法，同时保持通用能力；优化后的Qwen3-4B和8B模型可媲美或超越Gemini-2.5-Pro和DeepSeek-V3.2等前沿模型。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为推进范围感知的精确指令遵循建立了有效范式，并公开了代码与数据。

title: Receiver-Conditioned Latent Communication gives 94% CacheBack
summary: Multi-agent systems distribute large contexts across agents that communicate to solve a task. Text messages are compact but require decoding and may omit evidence the receiving agent needs. Recent latent communication instead transfers KV caches. This avoids text generation and can improve accuracy and latency. However, a full KV cache grows linearly with both the context an individual agent processes, and the number of agents that coordinate together. This raises memory and context costs, often far exceeding available GPU resources and context window sizes. Our key observation is that agents need only send what the receiving agent requires for its local task -- which we call receiver-conditioned communication. The receiver agent passes the sender a small description of its information needs, which serves to filter and compress the sender agent's KV cache. CacheBack is a simple, robust, training-free instance of receiver conditioning based on the sender's attention weights. On FanOutQA, CacheBack with Qwen 3 removes 75% of the state the agent would otherwise receive, improving accuracy by 14.7 percentage points and reducing median task-completion latency by 3.2x relative to text communication. We show comparable improvements across model families that span dense Transformers, Mamba-attention hybrids, and sliding-window attention.

AI.tldr: 多智能体系统通过智能体间通信解决任务。CacheBack提出接收者条件化的潜在通信，只传输接收者所需的KV缓存，从而压缩状态、降低显存与上下文开销，并提升准确率和延迟表现。
AI.motivation: 文本消息虽紧凑，但需要解码且可能遗漏接收者所需证据；近期基于KV缓存的潜在通信可避免文本生成并提升准确率与延迟，但完整KV缓存会随单个智能体上下文和协调智能体数量线性增长，常超出GPU显存和上下文窗口限制。
AI.method: 提出接收者条件化通信：接收者向发送者提供其信息需求的小型描述，用于过滤和压缩发送者的KV缓存。CacheBack是其中一种简单、鲁棒、免训练的实例，基于发送者的注意力权重实现过滤。
AI.result: 在FanOutQA上，CacheBack结合Qwen 3可去除75%原本会传给接收者的状态，准确率提升14.7个百分点，中位任务完成延迟较文本通信降低3.2倍。在稠密Transformer、Mamba-attention混合模型和滑动窗口注意力等模型家族中也观察到类似改进。
AI.conclusion: 接收者条件化通信能有效缓解多智能体潜在通信中的内存和上下文扩展问题，在多种模型架构上实现更准确、更高效的多智能体协作。

title: Typed Decision Models: An Early Evidence Audit and Evaluation Checklist
comment: 25 pages, 8 tables. Corpus: 28 arXiv papers (19-24 September 2026); arXiv versions listed in Appendix A. Ancillary file: per-paper corpus sheet (versions and headline results)
summary: Typed decision models (TDMs) return probability distributions over caller-defined options without generating text. TypeSafe released Jev, a commercial typed decision model, on 15 September 2026, and a small body of evaluation and replication work appeared within days. We review 28 papers posted between 19 and 24 September and relate their findings to earlier work on label-probability classification, constrained decoding, reranking, calibration, and model cascades. In this early literature, the typed readout itself has not shown an independent accuracy advantage over comparable label-probability readouts. Jev's clearest gains are in latency and cost, while accuracy gaps remain on harder tasks. In practical deployments, confidence is often used to decide when to defer to a stronger model or a human. We use recurring weaknesses in these studies to derive a 14-item evaluation checklist for future TDM work. Because the evidence covers only the first nine days after the release of one hosted model, the review should be read as an early evidence map rather than a settled assessment of the model class.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了TypeSafe于2026年9月15日发布商业类型化决策模型Jev后9天内出现的28篇评估与复现论文，并将其发现与标签概率分类、约束解码、重排序、校准和模型级联等早期工作联系起来。
AI.motivation: Jev发布后短时间内出现大量评估与复现研究，需要对这些早期证据进行梳理，判断类型化决策模型是否带来独立优势，并为后续TDM研究提供评估规范。
AI.method: 综述28篇发表于9月19日至24日的论文，将其结果与标签概率分类、约束解码、重排序、校准和模型级联等已有研究关联；根据这些研究中反复出现的弱点，提炼出14项TDM评估清单。
AI.result: 在当前早期文献中，类型化读出本身未显示出相对于可比标签概率读出的独立准确率优势；Jev的主要优势在延迟和成本，较难任务上仍存在准确率差距；实际部署中置信度常用于决定何时交由更强模型或人工处理。
AI.conclusion: 由于证据仅覆盖一个托管模型发布后前9天，该综述应被视为早期证据地图，而非对类型化决策模型这一模型类别的定论；同时提出14项评估清单以改进未来TDM工作。

title: Reasoning Concentrates Errors, and Self-Consistency Never Notices
summary: Self-consistency assumes that independent samples disagree when a model is unsure, so agreement is evidence of correctness. Holding weights fixed and toggling only a reasoning mode, over five benchmarks and 74,944 samples, we show that reasoning concentrates a model's errors: the probability that two independently drawn wrong answers coincide rises in all ten dataset-scale comparisons (p = 0.00098), and in nine of nine after restricting both arms to the problems each gets wrong. Where the answer space is unbounded, reasoning cuts the distinct answers produced to 0.43-0.65 of the non-reasoning count; where it is bounded, both arms hold an identical option set and reasoning concentrates mass on it instead, which no positional prior can explain at fixed weights. The aggregate cost is smaller than the mechanism predicts, because reasoning also shrinks the set of problems where answer diversity can decide anything, in ten of ten cells and by 2.7x; normalized for available headroom, both arms convert a quarter of it in domain. Confidence weighting does not recover what is left. Across 280 method-dataset-model combinations on eight models and five benchmarks, not one beats plain majority voting after correction; weighted voting agrees with it on 98.5% of problem-method pairs and is right 56.3% of the time on the rest; and a signal's direction can invert within fixed weights, with answer log-probability predicting correctness when reasoning is off and error when it is on. A learned six-signal combination gains nothing out of domain. Confidence signals should be evaluated on decisions, not on discrimination.

AI.tldr: 论文检验自洽性假设：独立采样分歧代表不确定、一致代表正确。固定权重仅切换推理模式，在5个基准、74,944个样本上发现推理会集中模型错误，并削弱置信度加权与多数投票的优势。
AI.motivation: 自洽性方法假定独立样本的错误不相关，因此答案一致可作为正确性证据。但若推理模式改变错误相关性，这一假设可能失效，需要系统检验。
AI.method: 固定模型权重，仅切换是否启用推理模式；在多个模型和基准上比较错误答案重合概率、不同答案数量、答案质量集中、置信度加权投票、普通多数投票及六信号学习组合等，共覆盖280个方法-数据集-模型组合。
AI.result: 推理使错误集中：两个独立错误答案重合概率在10/10个数据集规模比较中上升，p=0.00098；无界答案空间中推理将不同答案数降至非推理的0.43-0.65；有界空间中则集中质量。推理也缩小答案多样性可起作用的题目集合（10/10，2.7倍），按余量归一化后两种模式均只转化约四分之一。校正后，280个组合无一优于普通多数投票；加权投票与普通投票98.5%一致，其余仅56.3%正确；答案对数概率在推理关闭时预测正确、开启时预测错误。
AI.conclusion: 推理会集中错误，破坏自洽性与置信度加权所依赖的独立错误假设。置信信号应在实际决策表现上评估，而非仅看区分度。

title: MDL-Calibrated Significance-Gain Pair Encoding: Replication-Aware Automatic Stopping for Subword Tokenization
comment: 15 pages, 3 tables, 1 algorithm. Source code available online
summary:
Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) constructs subword vocabularies through greedy pair merging, but conventional BPE requires the number of merges or target vocabulary size to be specified externally. Significance-Gain Pair Encoding (SG-BPE) replaces frequency-only selection with a statistical criterion based on how strongly an observed pair exceeds its expected co-occurrence under an independence model.
  This paper introduces MDL-Calibrated Significance-Gain Pair Encoding (MDL-SG), a three-stage procedure separating discovery, replication, and utility. Candidate pairs are ranked by Significance-Gain on a discovery partition, tested for replication on a separate partition using an exact one-sided hypergeometric test with per-iteration Benjamini-Hochberg correction, and then evaluated on a utility partition using a Minimum Description Length (MDL) criterion. Merging stops automatically when no replicated candidate yields positive held-out MDL gain.
  On WikiText-103, MDL-SG stops at 209, 433, and 847 merges for 120K, 250K, and 500K-character tokenizer-training samples, respectively. At 500K characters, it selects a stored vocabulary of 1,017 tokens without prescribing the vocabulary size in advance. In a compute-matched TinyGPT experiment with identical 2,024,448-parameter models and 500 optimizer updates per language model, MDL-SG achieves validation/test BPC of 3.2612/3.2436, compared with test BPC of 3.2894 for SG-BPE and 3.3493 for frequency BPE. Frequency BPE achieves stronger raw compression, while MDL-SG achieves lower BPC, showing that compression-oriented merge selection and language-model utility need not coincide.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MDL-SG，一种三阶段 BPE 子词词表构建方法：用显著性增益发现候选对，用复制检验过滤，再用 MDL 效用决定是否合并，从而无需预先指定合并次数或词表大小，并能自动停止。
AI.motivation: 传统 BPE 需要外部指定合并次数或目标词表大小；SG-BPE 虽用统计显著性替代纯频率，但仍需确定停止条件。作者希望让子词合并选择同时兼顾统计显著性与语言模型效用，并自动决定词表规模。
AI.method: MDL-SG 将过程分为发现、复制和效用三阶段：在发现集上按 Significance-Gain 排序候选对；在独立复制集上用精确单侧超几何检验并以逐迭代 Benjamini-Hochberg 校正进行复制检验；最后在效用集上用最小描述长度 MDL 准则评估。当没有复制的候选能带来正的留出 MDL 增益时自动停止合并。
AI.result: 在 WikiText-103 上，MDL-SG 对 120K、250K、500K 字符训练样本分别自动停止于 209、433、847 次合并；500K 字符时得到 1,017 个 token 的存储词表，无需预设词表大小。在计算匹配的 TinyGPT 实验中，使用相同 2,024,448 参数模型和 500 次优化更新，MDL-SG 验证/测试 BPC 为 3.2612/3.2436，SG-BPE 测试 BPC 为 3.2894，频率 BPE 为 3.3493。频率 BPE 原始压缩更强，但 MDL-SG 语言建模 BPC 更低。
AI.conclusion: MDL-SG 能自动确定合并次数和词表大小，并通过 MDL 校准提升语言模型效用。结果说明以压缩为导向的合并选择与语言模型实际效用并不总是一致，子词词表构建应显式考虑下游语言建模目标。

title: Federated Subspace Guided Vision-Language-Action Policy Distillation for Non-IID Multi-Robot Manipulation
summary: Federated learning offers a natural way for multiple robots to jointly improve manipulation policies without requiring centralized access to training demonstrations. However, non-IID task and environment distributions can induce representation drift and mutually incompatible robot-policy updates, making naive parameter aggregation destructive. We present FedDRMan, a federated subspace-guided distillation framework for heterogeneous robot manipulation. At each communication round, the server model provides a frozen teacher for local behavior cloning, while low-rank multimodal subspace and action-distribution distillation preserve globally useful representation geometry and policy behavior. To address heterogeneous aggregation, FedDRMan groups clients by update compatibility and maintains a persistent model for each cluster. The server then spectrally rebalances each compatible aggregate to mitigate attenuation of weaker task-relevant robot-policy update directions. Extensive experiments on LIBERO across diverse non-IID settings, heterogeneity levels, client participation variation, together with ablations and aggregation analyses, show that FedDRMan substantially improves knowledge transfer and consistently outperforms strong federated baselines achieving a peak mean success rate of 80.7%, 11.6 percentage points above the strongest evaluated federated baseline.

AI.tldr: FedDRMan 是一个面向异构机器人操作任务的联邦子空间引导蒸馏框架，用于在非独立同分布任务与环境分布下实现多机器人协同策略学习。
AI.motivation: 联邦学习可让多机器人无需集中训练示范即可共同改进操作策略，但非IID的任务与环境分布会导致表示漂移和机器人策略更新互不兼容，使朴素参数聚合具有破坏性。
AI.method: FedDRMan 在每轮通信中由服务器模型作为冻结教师指导本地行为克隆，并通过低秩多模态子空间蒸馏和动作分布蒸馏保留全局有用的表示几何与策略行为；同时按更新兼容性对客户端分组，为每个簇维护持续模型，并对兼容聚合结果进行谱重平衡，以缓解较弱任务相关策略更新方向的衰减。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 上覆盖多种非IID设置、异构程度、客户端参与变化，以及消融和聚合分析的实验表明，FedDRMan 显著提升知识迁移并持续优于强联邦基线，最高平均成功率达到 80.7%，比最强评估联邦基线高 11.6 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: FedDRMan 能有效应对异构机器人操作中的非IID联邦学习挑战，通过子空间引导蒸馏、兼容性分组和谱重平衡提升聚合质量与策略性能。

title: Two-Timescale Reinforcement Learning for Real-Time Optimization and Economic NMPC: Experimental Validation
comment: 12 pages, submitted to Journal of Process Control
summary: We propose a reinforcement learning (RL) framework that tunes both Real-Time Optimization (RTO) and Economic Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (ENMPC) to address plant--model mismatch in process systems. Drawing on modifier-adaptation concepts, the method parameterizes the dynamic model, stage costs, constraints, and RTO modifiers, and uses Q-learning to adjust these parameters at two timescales: a fast update for the ENMPC layer and a slow update for the RTO layer. The framework is experimentally validated on a laboratory rig emulating a three-well subsea oil-production network. Using plant measurement data, the proposed RTO-RLMPC scheme achieves 8.6% higher economic profit than nominal ENMPC, preserves input feasibility of the deployed ENMPC policy and empirically satisfies the path constraints under disturbances and measurement noise, and drives the learned model parameters toward reference plant values, independently identified from experimental data, along the directions that most affect the economic objective. This work provides one of the first experimental demonstrations of RL-tuned ENMPC integrated with RTO.

AI.tldr: 提出一种强化学习框架，用Q学习在两个时间尺度上调节RTO与经济非线性模型预测控制（ENMPC）的参数，以应对过程系统中的对象-模型失配，并在三井海底采油网络实验平台上验证。
AI.motivation: 过程系统存在对象-模型失配，会降低基于模型的RTO和ENMPC的经济性能；需要一种能在线调节模型与优化参数、同时保持约束满足和经济最优性的方法。
AI.method: 借鉴修正自适应思想，将动态模型、阶段成本、约束及RTO修正项参数化，采用Q学习进行双层调节：快速更新ENMPC层，慢速更新RTO层；并在模拟三井海底采油网络的实验室装置上开展实验验证。
AI.result: 所提RTO-RLMPC方案比标称ENMPC经济利润提高8.6%；保持部署ENMPC策略的输入可行性，并在扰动和测量噪声下经验性满足路径约束；学习到的模型参数沿对经济目标影响最大的方向趋近于由实验数据独立辨识的参考对象参数。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了RL调节ENMPC并与RTO集成的首批实验验证之一，表明该方法能有效缓解对象-模型失配并提升经济性能。

title: Can't Find Waldo: Evaluating VLMs' Sensitivity to Image Resolution and Detail Level
summary: Visual Language Models (VLMs) have achieved remarkable success across diverse tasks, yet they struggle with high-resolution inputs where critical information resides in small regions or detailed, cluttered scenes. While several approaches address this limitation, a systematic understanding of why models fail at high resolutions is lacking. We introduce a controlled evaluation framework that disentangles resolution-related performance degradation from task difficulty through semantics-preserving transformations. We propose two simple metrics: Area Under the Scaling Curve (AUSC), which quantifies scaling robustness independent of baseline accuracy, and Prediction Variance Score (PVS), which measures resolution-induced prediction instability. Through comprehensive experiments across 5 model families and 5 benchmarks, we identify three primary failure modes: (1) information loss from downsampling at vision token limits, (2) tokenization artifacts from patch boundary shifts and positional encoding fragility under non-standard aspect ratios, and (3) attention dilution as token counts increase. Our analysis reveals that even state-of-the-art models suffer from performance drops when processing high-resolution images, with degradation patterns varying systematically by architectural family. We provide actionable insights for model architecture design and data augmentation strategies to mitigate these limitations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个受控评估框架与两个指标AUSC和PVS，系统分析视觉语言模型在高分辨率输入下的性能退化原因。
AI.motivation: VLM在关键信息位于小区域或复杂场景的高分辨率输入中表现不佳，但现有研究缺乏对高分辨率失败原因的系统性理解。
AI.method: 通过语义保持变换解耦分辨率相关性能退化与任务难度；提出AUSC衡量缩放鲁棒性，PVS衡量分辨率导致的预测不稳定性；在5个模型家族和5个基准上进行实验。
AI.result: 识别出三种主要失败模式：视觉token限制下采样导致信息损失、patch边界偏移与非标准宽高比下位置编码脆弱导致token化伪影、token数量增加导致注意力稀释；即使SOTA模型也会在高分辨率下性能下降，且退化模式随架构家族系统性变化。
AI.conclusion: 研究为模型架构设计与数据增强策略提供了可操作见解，以缓解VLM在高分辨率输入下的性能限制。

title: Contract monitoring: governing AI via separation of powers
summary: We propose an AI safety framework that binds worker agents to contracts specifying their permitted actions. We show how these contracts can be enforced and specified by assigning distinct responsibilities to monitor agents and judges, and asymmetric computational resources to monitors and workers. Our framework allows us to empirically measure statistical safety guarantees. The framework applies to a wide range of settings, including code security and escape-the-box scenarios.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种AI安全框架，通过契约约束工作者智能体的允许行为，并利用监控智能体与裁判的分工以及非对称计算资源来执行契约，从而可实证衡量统计安全保证。
AI.motivation: 出于对AI智能体行为安全性的关注，需要限制其可执行动作，并提供可度量、可执行的安全机制。
AI.method: 将工作者智能体绑定到指定允许动作的契约；通过为监控智能体和裁判分配不同职责来指定与执行契约；对监控者与工作者使用非对称计算资源。
AI.result: 该框架能够对统计安全保证进行实证测量，并适用于代码安全、逃逸盒子等多种场景。
AI.conclusion: 基于契约、监控者/裁判分工与非对称计算的AI安全框架，可在广泛场景中提供可度量的安全保障。

title: On the Achievable Inertia Constant of Inverter Based Resources
comment: Under Review in IEEE Transactions on Power Systems
summary: As inverter-based resources (IBRs) displace synchronous generators, the inertia they can actually contribute to the grid becomes a critical planning parameter. Unlike synchronous machines, this contribution is bounded simultaneously by the available energy reserve, the converter power rating combined with voltage ride-through (VRT) obligations, and the inertia-emulation control scheme with its activation delay. This paper derives each bound in closed form and combines them into a unified envelope $\Heff(t,λ,V_g)=\min(\HE,\HP,\HC)$, which uses parameters accessible to the system operator to quantify how much inertia a plant can provide at a given loading $λ$, grid voltage $V_g$, and time $t$ after a disturbance. The analysis shows that below a loading-dependent critical voltage, VRT reactive-current priority does not leave active-current headroom for inertial power injection; that the converter overload ratio $κ$ matters mainly during voltage dips; and that de-loading yields a linear, quantifiable inertia gain, while collocated energy storage (ESS) removes the source-coupling constraint, making grid-following (GFL) and grid-forming (GFM) plants with storage equivalent post-activation, up to the GFL activation-delay discount within short RoCoF measurement windows. Simulations on the IEEE 9-bus system confirm the framework and motivate a two-dimensional inertia capability curve $H(λ,V_{g,\min})$ as a grid-code instrument analogous to the P--Q diagram of synchronous generators.

AI.tldr: 本文推导了逆变器型资源（IBR）可提供惯量的统一包络，综合考虑能量储备、变流器功率额定及电压穿越义务和惯量模拟控制激活延迟，并基于IEEE 9节点系统验证，提出类似同步机P-Q图的二维惯量能力曲线。
AI.motivation: 随着逆变器型资源替代同步发电机，其实际可贡献的惯量成为关键规划参数。与同步机不同，IBR的惯量贡献同时受限于可用能量储备、变流器功率额定与电压穿越（VRT）义务以及惯量模拟控制方案的激活延迟，因此需要量化其可提供的惯量。
AI.method: 以闭式推导各限制边界，并组合成统一包络 H_eff(t,λ,V_g)=min(H_E,H_P,H_C)，其中参数可由系统运行人员获取。分析负载率λ、电网电压V_g和故障后时间t的影响。在IEEE 9节点系统上进行仿真验证。
AI.result: 低于与负载相关的临界电压时，VRT无功电流优先导致无有功电流余量用于惯量功率注入；变流器过载比κ主要在电压跌落期间重要；减载可线性增加惯量；配置储能消除源耦合约束，使跟网型（GFL）和构网型（GFM）电站在激活后等效（短RoCoF测量窗口内GFL有激活延迟折扣）。仿真验证了框架，并推动二维惯量能力曲线 H(λ,V_{g,min}) 作为电网规范工具。
AI.conclusion: 提出类似同步发电机P-Q图的二维惯量能力曲线，可作为电网规范工具，用于量化IBR在给定负载和电压下的惯量支撑能力。

title: EngramRAG: Dynamic Usage-Weighted Topology and Synaptic Consolidation for Multi-Hop Agentic Memory
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures, 4 tables. Code and reproduction suite: https://github.com/bpoti001/epigraph
summary: As autonomous LLM agents are deployed across multi-session environments, conventional memory architectures suffer from Associative Blindness (inability to traverse multi-hop relational dependencies), Scaffolding Amnesia (temporal decay evicting core persona invariants), and Static Topology Stagnation (immutable graphs ignoring usage dynamics). Grounded in Complementary Learning Systems (CLS) principles, we propose EngramRAG, an adaptive memory architecture coupling a low-latency Waking State reflex with an asynchronous background Dreaming State consolidation cycle. EngramRAG introduces: (1) Usage-Modulated Personalized PageRank (U-PPR), where transition probabilities adapt via Hebbian plasticity to promote persistent entities into high-centrality Epistemic Macro-Hubs; (2) Consolidation-Activated Topology Decay (CATD), which scales retention half-life by topological load-bearing weight rather than wall-clock recency, protected by a cold-start grace period (N_grace >= 4); (3) Directed SUPERSEDES DAG filtering to suppress obsolete state during fact mutations; and (4) Triple-source hybrid retrieval fusing dense vectors, BM25, and U-PPR via dynamic Reciprocal Rank Fusion (RRF). Evaluating on all 1,982 QA pairs across 10 long-term conversations in the LoCoMo benchmark, EngramRAG achieves +38.9% relative improvement in Recall@5 (53.21% vs. 38.29%, p < 0.001) and +43.1% in MRR (0.4203 vs. 0.2937) over dense vector RAG, significantly outperforming Okapi BM25 (48.66%) and isolated static graph retrieval (8.50%). On temporal reasoning, EngramRAG reaches 62.33% Recall@5 (+16.67 points over dense vectors). In controlled mutation tests, SUPERSEDES suppresses split-brain hallucinations from 70.0% to 0.0%, while 90-day simulations show 100.0% scaffolding retention under a 26.21ms interactive retrieval reflex.

AI.tldr: 提出EngramRAG自适应记忆架构，基于互补学习系统（CLS），通过清醒反射与异步梦境巩固双状态，解决LLM智能体多会话记忆中的关联盲区、脚手架遗忘和静态拓扑停滞问题，在LoCoMo基准上显著提升检索与推理性能。
AI.motivation: 自主LLM智能体在多会话环境中部署时，传统记忆架构存在三大缺陷：关联盲区（无法遍历多跳关系依赖）、脚手架遗忘（时间衰减驱逐核心人设不变量）、静态拓扑停滞（图结构不可变且忽略使用动态）。
AI.method: 基于CLS原则，提出EngramRAG，耦合低延迟清醒状态反射与异步背景梦境状态巩固周期。具体包括：(1) 使用调制个性化PageRank（U-PPR），通过Hebbian可塑性自适应转移概率，将持久实体提升为高中心性认知宏枢纽；(2) 巩固激活拓扑衰减（CATD），按拓扑承重而非墙钟新近度缩放保留半衰期，并设冷启动宽限期（N_grace>=4）；(3) 有向SUPERSEDES DAG过滤，在事实变更时抑制过时状态；(4) 三源混合检索，融合稠密向量、BM25和U-PPR，并通过动态倒数排名融合（RRF）。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo基准的10个长期对话、共1,982个QA对上评估，EngramRAG相比稠密向量RAG，Recall@5相对提升38.9%（53.21% vs. 38.29%，p<0.001），MRR提升43.1%（0.4203 vs. 0.2937），显著优于Okapi BM25（48.66%）和孤立静态图检索（8.50%）。时间推理Recall@5达62.33%（比稠密向量高16.67个百分点）。在受控突变测试中，SUPERSEDES将分裂脑幻觉从70.0%降至0.0%；90天模拟显示脚手架保留率100.0%，交互式检索反射耗时26.21ms。
AI.conclusion: EngramRAG通过动态自适应记忆架构有效提升长期多会话检索与时间推理能力，抑制过时信息导致的幻觉，并在长期模拟中保持人设稳定与低延迟检索。

title: Generalization and Memorization along the Learning Trajectory of Neural Language Models: A Geometric Account of Categorization
comment: 5 figures in main text, 9 page main text
summary: We investigate how generalization and memorization develop along the learning trajectory of neural language models. Using controlled synthetic grammars, we examine both the geometry of representation space and model behaviour over training. We find that continuous regions of representation space not occupied by observed tokens become systematically structured from the earliest stages of learning, forming category-level geometric organization that supports generalization to unattested combinations. Generalization therefore emerges from the beginning of learning rather than only after extensive memorization. With prolonged training, larger models increasingly distinguish observed from unobserved grammatical combinations. At the same time, the continuous geometric structure supporting category-level generalization is gradually destructed. Together, these results suggest that neural language models initially learn through categorization-based generalization, followed by a gradual transition toward more exemplar-specific memorization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究神经语言模型在学习过程中泛化与记忆如何发展，发现模型早期即形成类别级几何结构并支持泛化，随后逐渐转向样例特异性记忆。
AI.motivation: 探究神经语言模型在训练轨迹中泛化与记忆的先后关系及表征空间几何结构的变化。
AI.method: 使用可控合成文法，分析训练过程中模型表征空间的几何结构与模型行为。
AI.result: 未被观测词占据的连续表征区域从学习早期就形成类别级几何组织，支持对未见过组合的泛化；随训练延长，大模型更能区分见过与未见的语法组合，但支持类别泛化的连续几何结构逐渐被破坏。
AI.conclusion: 神经语言模型最初通过基于类别的泛化学习，随后逐渐过渡到更依赖具体样例的记忆。

title: Strategically Robust Game-Theoretic Multi-Agent Trajectory Optimization
summary: Aviation authorities worldwide expect Advanced Air Mobility (AAM) traffic management to be decentralized among service providers, requiring AAM flights to autonomously plan trajectories by predicting other flights' control inputs rather than relying on centralized coordination. Game-theoretic approaches that formulate multi-agent collision avoidance as an exact dynamic potential game can efficiently find open-loop equilibria, but they assume that agents exactly follow their equilibrium trajectories---an unrealistic assumption given uncertainties in actuation, perception, and computation. We propose a strategically robust formulation where each agent protects against a fictitious adversary that, for each timestep, perturbs other agents' control inputs within a bounded budget to minimize distance at that timestep. We show that, under reasonable assumptions on agents' distance cost and robustness levels, the strategically robust game remains an exact dynamic potential game and admits a quasi-closed-form solution to the inner adversarial problem for linear dynamics, which limits computational overhead. Experiments with up to eight agents using logarithmic distance costs show that strategic robustness selects more robust trajectories in high-collision-risk configurations while leaving low-risk trajectories nearly unchanged, with only a modest increase in runtime.

AI.tldr: 针对去中心化AAM交通管理，提出策略鲁棒博弈避碰方法，在不确定性下预测他机控制输入并规划更鲁棒轨迹。
AI.motivation: 现有博弈论避碰方法虽能高效求开环均衡，但假设智能体精确遵循均衡轨迹，忽略执行、感知和计算不确定性，这一假设不现实。
AI.method: 将多智能体避碰建模为精确动态势博弈，并引入虚拟对手：每个时间步以有界预算扰动其他智能体控制输入以最小化该时刻距离。在合理距离代价与鲁棒水平假设下，证明该策略鲁棒博弈仍为精确动态势博弈；对线性动力学，给出内层对抗问题的拟闭式解以限制计算开销。
AI.result: 最多8个智能体、对数距离代价实验显示，策略鲁棒性在高碰撞风险配置下选择更鲁棒轨迹，在低风险配置下轨迹几乎不变，且运行时间仅小幅增加。
AI.conclusion: 策略鲁棒博弈可在去中心化AAM自主轨迹规划中提升不确定性下的避碰鲁棒性，同时保持较低计算负担，为更现实的空管场景提供可行框架。

title: DS-VLA: A Dendritic-inspired Vision-Language-Action Model for Robust Action Control
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have achieved strong performance in language-conditioned manipulation, yet success under nominal evaluation does not necessarily translate into robust closed-loop behavior when executed actions are transiently corrupted. We introduce DS-VLA, a dendritic-inspired action architecture that incorporates dendritic spiking dynamics into VLA control to address this limitation. Specifically, to enable modularized feature processing and temporal information integration, DS-VLA equips action neurons with multiple sparsely connected dendritic branches, each featuring heterogeneous, learned decay factors. Furthermore, to suppress unreliable state updates while preserving task-relevant historical information, we introduce a neuron-wise inhibitory gate that adaptively regulates the admission of new multimodal evidence into dendritic states prior to somatic dynamics. We evaluate DS-VLA on all four LIBERO suites under both nominal rollouts and a unified closed-loop action-perturbation protocol. DS-VLA achieves a 91.6\% average nominal success rate and an 87.35\% average perturbed success rate, retaining 95.4\% of its nominal performance. Under the same reported perturbation setting, OpenVLA-OFT, FAST, $π_0$, and GR00T achieve 39.45\%, 23.90\%, 28.55\%, and 30.75\%, respectively. A controlled ablation isolates the contribution of neuron-wise shared inhibition, while analyses of neural dynamics and post-perturbation trajectories associate robust performance with selective evidence suppression and effective behavioral recovery. Together, these results demonstrate that integrating brain-inspired computational mechanisms offers a promising architectural prior for robust embodied intelligence beyond merely scaling vision-language backbones or generative action decoders.

AI.tldr: 提出DS-VLA，一种受树突启发的动作架构，将树突脉冲动力学引入VLA控制，以提升闭环执行中动作扰动下的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在语言条件操作任务中表现优异，但在执行动作短暂损坏时闭环鲁棒性不足，名义评估成功不能保证稳健行为。
AI.method: 为动作神经元配备多个稀疏连接的树突分支，每个分支具有异质可学习衰减因子，实现模块化特征处理与时间信息整合；引入神经元级抑制门，在胞体动力学前自适应调节新多模态证据进入树突状态，抑制不可靠状态更新并保留任务相关历史。
AI.result: 在四个LIBERO套件上评估，DS-VLA名义平均成功率91.6%，扰动后平均成功率87.35%，保留95.4%名义性能；相同扰动设置下，OpenVLA-OFT、FAST、π0、GR00T分别为39.45%、23.90%、28.55%、30.75%。消融隔离了神经元级共享抑制的贡献，神经动力学和扰动后轨迹分析表明鲁棒性与选择性证据抑制和有效行为恢复相关。
AI.conclusion: 整合脑启发计算机制为鲁棒具身智能提供了有前景的架构先验，而不仅依赖扩展视觉语言骨干或生成式动作解码器。

title: Hard-Constrained Probabilistic Factor Graph Neural Network for Distribution System State Estimation under Non-Gaussian Uncertainty
comment: Preprint. Submitted to Sustainable Energy, Grids and Networks
summary: Robust and accurate state estimation is fundamental for the reliable operation and monitoring of active distribution networks. Conventional numerical estimators, such as weighted least squares, are computationally slower and often suffer from convergence issues in the presence of sparse measurements affected by non-Gaussian noise. Physics-informed neural networks have recently emerged as a promising alternative by incorporating physical principles through residual-based penalty terms in the objective, which can improve robustness to noise and computational efficiency. However, such penalty-based approaches do not guarantee strict enforcement of physical constraints during inference and provide limited support for principled uncertainty modeling. To address these limitations, we propose a novel Hard-Constrained, Physics-Informed Factor Graph Neural Network (HCP-PINN) that formulates distribution system state estimation as a probabilistic constrained estimation problem on a factor graph. The proposed approach explicitly models non-Gaussian (pseudo-)measurement uncertainty through flexible, closed-form likelihood-based loss functions. It further incorporates a differentiable optimization-based estimation layer that strictly enforces nonlinear equality constraints and measurement consistency, producing physically feasible state estimates during both training and inference. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first PINN-based DSSE framework to combine hard physical constraints with non-Gaussian uncertainty modeling for unbalanced three-phase networks. Numerical experiments demonstrate that the proposed method delivers more accurate and physically consistent state estimates than deep learning benchmarks and numerical estimators, while exhibiting greater robustness to network model errors and improved computational efficiency under realistic measurement scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出一种硬约束物理信息因子图神经网络 HCP-PINN，用于主动配电网三相不平衡状态估计，结合硬物理约束与非高斯不确定性建模。
AI.motivation: 传统加权最小二乘等数值估计器计算较慢，且在稀疏、受非高斯噪声影响的量测下易出现收敛问题；现有物理信息神经网络多采用惩罚项，不能严格保证推理时满足物理约束，且不确定性建模能力有限。
AI.method: 将配电网状态估计建模为因子图上的概率约束估计问题；通过闭式似然损失显式建模非高斯（伪）量测不确定性；引入可微优化估计层，在训练和推理中严格满足非线性等式约束与量测一致性。
AI.result: 数值实验表明，所提方法比深度学习基准和数值估计器具有更准确、更符合物理约束的状态估计，对网络模型误差更鲁棒，并在实际量测场景下具有更高计算效率。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个将硬物理约束与非高斯不确定性建模结合用于三相不平衡网络的 PINN-DSSE 框架，可提升配电网状态估计的可靠性与效率。

title: Toward Interactive Understanding of Code APIs
summary: Empowered by advances in Language Model agents, systems have made substantial strides in code generation and understanding. However, these approaches often rely on read access to the relevant code, an assumption which does not hold when dealing with external APIs. In this work, we introduce the PAU (Python API Understanding) benchmark, where we provide models with black-box, API-level access to code snippets. Models must query the API with exploratory inputs and draw insights from the resulting outputs, with the goal of describing the snippet's true functionality. By treating the code snippets as external tools that must be understood via interaction alone, PAU studies the more general problem of unsupervised tool understanding, specifically for tools implemented as Python methods. Despite recent progress in coding agents, even frontier models struggle to achieve high performance on PAU, with the best model (Claude-4-Opus) failing to understand over 45% of the PAU test set. An investigation into the common error modes reveals that models are overconfident; they often overrate the quality of their current hypothesis, leading to insufficient exploration and premature termination. Finally, we take inspiration from the Asymmetric Actor Critic (AAC) paradigm, frequently used in robot learning, to post-train models for interactive code understanding. Models trained with AAC conduct more active exploration of the APIs, with an AAC-tuned Qwen3-8B model matching the performance of GPT-5-mini.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PAU 基准，让模型仅通过黑盒 API 交互理解 Python 代码片段功能；发现前沿模型表现不佳，并借鉴机器人学习中的 AAC 范式进行后训练，提升交互式代码理解与探索能力。
AI.motivation: 现有代码生成与理解方法通常依赖读取相关代码，但在外部 API 场景中无法访问源码。因此需要研究仅通过交互来理解黑盒工具的问题，尤其是以 Python 方法实现的工具。
AI.method: 构建 PAU（Python API Understanding）基准，为模型提供 API 级黑盒访问；模型需用探索性输入查询 API，并从输出中推断代码片段的真实功能。作者分析常见错误模式，并借鉴 Asymmetric Actor Critic（AAC）范式对模型进行后训练，以增强交互式代码理解。
AI.result: 即使前沿模型也难以在 PAU 上取得高性能，最佳模型 Claude-4-Opus 在测试集中仍有超过 45% 无法理解。错误分析显示模型常过度自信，高估当前假设质量，导致探索不足和过早终止。AAC 调优的 Qwen3-8B 可达到 GPT-5-mini 的性能。
AI.conclusion: 仅通过交互理解黑盒工具是重要且困难的问题。AAC 后训练能促使模型更主动探索 API，并显著提升交互式代码理解能力，使较小模型也能匹配强模型表现。

title: Affordance-Conditioned Decision Making: Bridging the Semantic-Spatial Gap in Zero-Shot Cross-Floor Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-and-language navigation increasingly relies on general-purpose semantic planners, yet translating correct high-level intent into reliable physical execution remains difficult in spatially constrained transitions. Reaching a staircase, doorway, or narrow passage does not ensure traversal; the agent must identify an executable affordance pose and recover from accumulated action errors. We propose PACE (Preference-refined Affordance-Conditioned Execution), a supervised local execution module that augments frozen zero-shot semantic planners for reliable cross-floor navigation. PACE grounds transition-related semantics into a long-horizon, agent-centric traversable affordance pose and conditions short-horizon action generation on this spatial target, thereby aligning semantic goals with physical execution. We further post-train PACE through failure-aware preference refinement using rollout-derived pairs that contrast normal or recovery behaviors with deviation-amplifying behaviors, thereby improving closed-loop correction. We integrate PACE into six open-source zero-shot VLN navigators and demonstrate consistent improvements on the cross-floor subsets of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, increasing the average success rate from 16.35% to 27.65% and from 4.76% to 12.06%, respectively. Real-world experiments further demonstrate PACE's applicability in unseen environments, highlighting the potential of traversable affordances to bridge semantic intent and reliable embodied behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出PACE（偏好精炼的可供性条件执行）监督式局部执行模块，增强冻结的零样本语义规划器，实现跨楼层视觉语言导航中语义意图到可靠物理执行的转化。
AI.motivation: 在空间受限的过渡场景（如楼梯、门道、窄通道）中，仅到达过渡点无法保证成功穿越；智能体需识别可执行的可供性位姿，并从累积动作误差中恢复。
AI.method: PACE将过渡相关语义定位为长时程、以智能体为中心的可通行可供性位姿，并以此空间目标为条件生成短时程动作；通过基于 rollout 的失败感知偏好精炼进行后训练，对比正常/恢复行为与偏差放大行为，提升闭环纠正能力。
AI.result: 集成到六个开源零样本VLN导航器后，在R2R-CE和RxR-CE跨楼层子集上平均成功率分别从16.35%提升至27.65%、从4.76%提升至12.06%；真实世界实验验证了在未见环境中的适用性。
AI.conclusion: 可通行可供性能够桥接语义意图与可靠具身行为，为跨楼层导航提供有效执行保障。

title: Cross-Dataset Generalization of Bangladeshi Rice Leaf Disease Classifiers: Benchmark, Diagnosis, and Mitigation
summary: Cross-dataset transfer in rice leaf disease classification remains a significant challenge, with models trained on one image collection performing substantially worse when deployed on another. We conduct a systematic benchmark across three Bangladeshi rice leaf disease datasets (5,419 images, 6 transfer pairs, 3 CNN backbones, 3 random seeds) to characterize and diagnose this failure. Strong augmentation recovers a mean cross-dataset macro-F1 improvement of +0.070 (Wilcoxon p < 0.001, 15 of 18 transfer pairs positive). Removing non-leaf image content via segmentation shows directional benefit (mean +0.066, p = 0.062, n = 36 paired observations) that is consistent across two independent segmentation methods but does not reach conventional significance. A self-supervised ViT control (DINOv2 linear probe) exhibits equivalent cross-dataset collapse to CNNs, ruling out architecture inductive bias as the primary driver and pointing to acquisition-condition shift. Adaptive batch normalization uniformly harms transfer performance, with harm magnitude correlating with source-target label-prior divergence and model depth (Spearman rho = 0.621, p = 0.009). Grad-CAM attribution analysis on 12 sampled predictions does not distinguish correct from incorrect cross-domain predictions (p = 0.462), indicating that common attribution proxies are insufficient for diagnosing shift at practical sample sizes. We document all frozen results, prespecified analysis criteria, and reproducibility artifacts in a public repository with SHA-256 integrity verification. This work establishes a rigorous empirical baseline for understanding cross-dataset generalization in agricultural computer vision and identifies both effective (augmentation) and ineffective (AdaBN) adaptation strategies.

AI.tldr: 该论文对水稻叶片病害分类的跨数据集迁移进行系统基准测试，诊断性能下降原因，并评估增强、分割、AdaBN等策略。
AI.motivation: 模型在一个图像集训练后在另一个图像集上性能显著下降，跨数据集迁移差，需系统刻画并诊断该失败原因。
AI.method: 在3个孟加拉水稻叶片病害数据集上，共5,419张图像、6个迁移对、3种CNN骨干、3个随机种子；比较强数据增强、分割去除非叶片内容、DINOv2自监督ViT线性探针、自适应批归一化；使用Wilcoxon检验、Spearman相关、Grad-CAM归因分析；公开冻结结果与可复现工件。
AI.result: 强增强平均提升跨数据集macro-F1 +0.070（Wilcoxon p < 0.001，18个迁移对中15个为正）；分割有方向性收益+0.066但不显著（p = 0.062），且两种独立分割方法一致；DINOv2线性探针与CNN同样出现跨数据集崩溃，排除架构归纳偏置为主因，指向采集条件偏移；AdaBN普遍有害，损害与源目标标签先验差异和模型深度相关（Spearman rho = 0.621, p = 0.009）；Grad-CAM无法区分跨域正确与错误预测（p = 0.462）。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为农业计算机视觉跨数据集泛化建立严格经验基线，表明强增强是有效适应策略，而AdaBN无效；跨数据集失败主要源于采集条件偏移而非架构偏置，常用归因代理在实用样本量下不足以诊断偏移。

title: The Judge Is Not Its Twin: Post-training makes a model's writing more predictable but barely moves its taste, as a judge, toward predictable writing
