summary: Language models are now routinely graded by other language models. If post-training makes a model's own writing more predictable, it may also teach the same model, acting as a judge, to reward predictable writing, so that progress on creativity would be invisible to automated evaluation. We follow two open model families, OLMo-2 and Zephyr (7B parameters each), through their public training stages and measure every stage twice, as a writer of short stories and as a judge of pairs of stories. As writers, the models drift as feared: each family's fully trained model finds the stories of its base, supervised fine-tuned (SFT) and preference-trained (DPO) stages progressively more familiar, in all ten prompts, and a model from the other family finds the trained stories 7.0 to 9.2 percent (OLMo-2) and 24 to 25 percent (Zephyr) less surprising per token. As judges, they barely move toward predictable writing. Asked which story is better, a question every judge can use to tell a story from its own words in scrambled order, no trained judge's estimated tilt toward the more predictable story grows by as much as one point in the probability of picking it. A post hoc one-sided 95% upper bound on that growth is 2.7 points on an average pair, about the size of the untrained OLMo-2 judge's own tilt. Asked which is more creative, no trained judge's estimate favors the predictable story more than its base's does. Training instead strengthens a preference for longer stories when the question is creativity, and for one answer slot, and it breaks "more creative" as a question: trained judges asked it no longer reliably prefer a story to its scrambled words. A follow-up could not build pairs that differ in predictability but not in quality, because the routes that made this writer's stories less predictable also broke some of them, often enough to fail a quality floor set in advance.

AI.tldr: 研究追踪OLMo-2与Zephyr两个7B模型家族在公开训练各阶段的写作与评判行为，检验后训练是否会让模型写作更可预测，并让作为评判者的模型偏好可预测文本，从而掩盖创造力进步。
AI.motivation: 语言模型常被其他语言模型自动评分；若后训练使模型自身写作更可预测，它作为评判者也可能奖励可预测写作，导致自动化评估无法察觉创造力进展。
AI.method: 让OLMo-2和Zephyr在base、SFT、DPO等训练阶段分别担任短篇小说写作者和成对小说评判者；测量写作文本的熟悉度/惊奇度，并让模型判断哪篇更好、哪篇更有创造力，同时用打乱词序的文本作为对照，并进行质量下限的后续实验。
AI.result: 作为写作者，模型确实变得更可预测：全训练模型认为base、SFT、DPO阶段的文本逐级更熟悉；另一家族模型对训练后文本每token惊奇度降低7.0–9.2%（OLMo-2）和24–25%（Zephyr）。作为评判者，模型对可预测文本的偏好几乎未增强：选择更可预测故事的概率增幅不足1个百分点，单侧95%上界为平均对2.7个百分点。问“更有创造力”时，无训练后评判者比base更偏好可预测故事；训练反而增强对长故事和某一答案位置的偏好，并破坏“更有创造力”问题——训练后评判者不再可靠地偏好原故事而非打乱词序版本。后续实验无法构造仅可预测性不同而质量相同的文本对，因为降低可预测性的路径也常损坏故事，达不到预设质量下限。
AI.conclusion: 后训练使模型写作更可预测，但并未明显使模型作为评判者更奖励可预测写作；然而训练引入了长度与位置偏差，并削弱了模型判断创造力的能力。因此，自动评估中的创造力信号可能因评判质量下降和偏差而失真，而非简单表现为对可预测性的直接偏好。

title: Statistical Testing for Multiple Instance Learning via Selective Inference with Applications to Computational Pathology
summary: Multiple instance learning (MIL) is widely used in computational pathology because it enables weakly supervised analysis of whole-slide images (WSIs) without requiring patch-level annotations. In attention-based MIL, instances with high attention scores are often interpreted as diagnostically important regions and used as visual explanations. However, attention scores alone cannot determine whether selected high-attention instances are significantly different from normal instances, limiting the reliability of attention-based explanations. In this paper, we formulate the evaluation of high-attention instances as a statistical hypothesis testing problem. Specifically, we assess whether a selected high-attention instance significantly deviates from a representative normal reference instance selected based on feature similarity. A major challenge is that both the target instance and the reference instance are selected through data-dependent procedures, rendering standard hypothesis testing invalid. To address this issue, we introduce a selective inference (SI) framework that explicitly accounts for the selection events induced by attention-based instance selection and adaptive reference selection, thereby enabling the computation of valid selective $p$-values conditional on these events. Experiments demonstrate Type-I error control on synthetic and MNIST-based data and practical applicability to pathological WSIs, with higher statistical power than the conventional over-conditioning approach.

AI.tldr: 本文将注意力多实例学习中高注意力实例解释的可靠性问题转化为统计假设检验，并提出选择性推断框架来计算有效的选择性p值。
AI.motivation: 注意力分数高并不必然说明该实例显著偏离正常，现有基于注意力的解释缺乏统计显著性保障；同时目标实例和参考实例均由数据依赖过程选出，导致常规假设检验失效。
AI.method: 将高注意力实例是否显著偏离正常参考实例形式化为假设检验，其中正常参考实例基于特征相似性自适应选择；引入选择性推断框架，显式考虑注意力实例选择与参考实例选择事件，条件于这些事件计算有效的选择性p值。
AI.result: 在合成数据和MNIST数据上实现了Type-I错误控制，并在病理全切片图像上展示了实际适用性；相比传统over-conditioning方法具有更高统计功效。
AI.conclusion: 所提选择性推断框架能够为注意力MIL中的高注意力实例提供有效统计检验，从而提升视觉解释作为诊断重要区域依据的可靠性。

title: MemTransfer: Benchmarking Memory Beyond Matched Experience in Embodied Decision-Making
summary: Memory lets an embodied agent reuse past experience, yet retaining useful information does not ensure that the agent can apply it when conditions change. We present MemTransfer, a benchmark comparing six memory representations, a working-memory baseline and five representations of past experience, under a shared frozen vision-language-model policy. It comprises 100 navigation cases across ten task types in a simulated warehouse, with expert demonstrations supplying the history. Three comparisons vary the starting pose, route availability, and amount and task relevance of history. With one demonstration per task, Full-context and Episodic memory reach 95.3% and 100.0% success at the original demonstration start, but lose 48-49 percentage points at a new test start. Summary changes little between these two test starts, yet with four demonstrations per task it retains a smaller fraction of its unchanged-route success after blocking (39.3%) than Working memory (44.8%) or the two trajectory memories (56-58%). At the new test start, increasing from one to four relevant demonstrations raises Episodic success by 14.3 percentage points, while the other evaluated representations gain no more than 1.3 percentage points. Replacing half of the relevant histories with other-task experience lowers success for both trajectory memories. These results show that robustness to one kind of mismatch does not imply robustness to another, motivating evaluation of both stored information and its use at decision time.

AI.tldr: 论文提出MemTransfer基准，在共享冻结视觉语言模型策略下比较六种记忆表示，通过改变起始位姿、路线可用性和历史数量与相关性，评估具身导航中记忆的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 记忆能让智能体复用过去经验，但保留有用信息并不保证条件变化时仍能有效应用。需要系统评估不同记忆表示在不同失配下的表现。
AI.method: 构建MemTransfer基准：在模拟仓库中设置100个导航案例、10种任务类型，专家演示提供历史。比较六种记忆表示（工作记忆基线加五种过去经验表示），共享冻结的视觉语言模型策略。三种比较分别改变起始位姿、路线可用性以及历史数量与任务相关性。
AI.result: 每个任务仅一个演示时，Full-context和Episodic在原始起始点成功率达95.3%和100.0%，但在新测试起始点下降48-49个百分点。Summary在两个起始点间变化小，但每任务四个演示时，路线阻断后其保留的未阻断路线成功率（39.3%）低于工作记忆（44.8%）和两种轨迹记忆（56-58%）。新起始点下，相关演示从1增至4使Episodic成功率提升14.3个百分点，其他表示提升不超过1.3个百分点。用其他任务经验替换一半相关历史会降低两种轨迹记忆的成功率。
AI.conclusion: 对一种失配的鲁棒性不代表对另一种失配也鲁棒，因此需要同时评估存储的信息及其在决策时的使用方式。

title: Scalable Small-Signal Stability Assessment of Power Systems Based on Frequency-Domain Quadratic Constraints
summary: Small-signal stability analysis of power electronics-dominated power systems is becoming increasingly challenging due to the large-scale integration of heterogeneous grid-following (GFL) and grid-forming (GFM) converters. Classical centralized methods, such as eigenvalue analysis and the generalized Nyquist criterion, provide direct stability assessment tools but exhibit limited scalability as the system size increases. This motivates scalable analysis methods for stability assessment and device-level diagnosis, and calls for less conservative stability conditions. To this end, this paper proposes a scalable small-signal stability assessment method with quantitative stability indices for multi-converter systems based on frequency-domain quadratic constraints (FQCs). It is shown that several existing stability conditions, including geometric conditions based on the Davis-Wielandt (DW) shell, numerical range, $x$-$z$ graph, scaled relative graph (SRG), mixed gain-phase condition, and passivity condition, are special cases of the FQC-based stability condition. This FQC-based formulation also clarifies the requirements for decentralized verification of these existing stability conditions. To further reduce conservatism, a full-multiplier FQC-based stability condition is developed, based on which an optimization problem is formulated for scalable stability certification and device-level diagnosis using quantitative stability indices without relying on graphical inspection. Combined with the mixed gain-phase condition, this optimization problem forms a hierarchical screening-diagnosis procedure that improves efficiency. Case studies demonstrate that the proposed method is less conservative than existing criteria and can effectively identify problematic devices associated with potential instability risks.

AI.tldr: 针对多变换器系统，提出基于频域二次约束（FQC）的可扩展小信号稳定性评估方法，统一了多种现有判据，并给出全乘子FQC条件与优化问题，实现稳定性认证与设备级诊断。
AI.motivation: 大规模异构跟网型（GFL）和构网型（GFM）变换器接入导致小信号稳定性分析困难；传统集中式方法（特征值、广义奈奎斯特）可扩展性差；需要可扩展的稳定性评估与设备级诊断方法，以及保守性更低的稳定条件。
AI.method: 基于频域二次约束（FQC）提出可扩展小信号稳定性评估方法，并给出定量稳定指标；证明DW壳、数值范围、x-z图、SRG、混合增益相位、无源等条件均为FQC特例，明确其分散验证要求；进一步提出全乘子FQC稳定条件，构建优化问题进行可扩展稳定性认证与设备级诊断；结合混合增益相位条件形成分层筛选-诊断流程。
AI.result: 案例研究表明，所提方法比现有判据保守性更低，能有效识别与潜在失稳风险相关的故障设备。
AI.conclusion: FQC框架统一并推广了现有稳定条件，全乘子FQC优化可实现无需图形检查的可扩展稳定性认证与设备级诊断，降低保守性并提高效率。

title: A model of rational interlocutors: Unification of comprehension and production
comment: A computational model of partner modeling in language comprehension and production. 62 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, including supplementary materials
summary: Who we communicate with influences both our interpretation of their utterances and the design of our own. Such adjustment to the conversational partner is studied as speaker modeling in comprehension and as audience design in production, with the two literatures having developed largely separately. We argue that both adjustments express one rational computation and propose the rational interlocutor (RI) model, a computational account unifying comprehension and production. An interlocutor maintains a model of their partner, defined by three parameters: an identity parameter Π sets the messages and forms expected from the partner; a fidelity parameter Φ sets how reliably messages and utterances map onto each other for them; a knowledge parameter Λ sets how knowledgeable the partner is believed to be. Comprehension and production are thus mirror-image modes of one computation over the partner model. Comprehension chooses the message the partner most likely intends to convey, weighing how well each candidate fits the utterance against how likely this partner is to mean it. Production chooses the utterance from which the partner will best recover the message, weighed against the effort of saying it. This explains why comprehenders appear to rely less on the forms produced by a linguistically less competent speaker, while producers tend to invest more effort in designing forms for them. We conjecture that perceived linguistic competence decomposes into two of these quantities: fidelity and knowledge. Their contrasting profiles across second-language (L2) adults, children, and artificial partners produce distinct and testable predictions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出理性对话者（RI）模型，将理解中的说话者建模和生成中的受众设计统一为一个理性计算，认为对话者通过三个参数（身份、保真度、知识）建模伙伴，并据此进行理解和生成。
AI.motivation: 现有研究中，理解侧的说话者建模和生成侧的受众设计各自独立发展，但作者认为两者本质上是同一理性计算，因此需要统一的计算框架。
AI.method: 提出RI计算模型：对话者维护一个由三个参数定义的伙伴模型——身份参数Π设定预期消息和形式，保真度参数Φ设定消息与话语的映射可靠性，知识参数Λ设定伙伴的知识水平。理解被建模为选择伙伴最可能意图传达的消息（权衡候选消息与话语的匹配度及伙伴意图的可能性）；生成被建模为选择能让伙伴最佳恢复消息的话语（权衡表达努力）。
AI.result: 该模型解释了为何理解者较少依赖语言能力较低者产生的话语形式，而生成者会为其投入更多设计努力；并推测感知语言能力可分解为保真度和知识两个量，二者在第二语言成人、儿童和人工伙伴中呈现不同剖面，产生可检验预测。
AI.conclusion: RI模型统一了理解和生成，将感知语言能力分解为保真度和知识，并产生关于不同对话伙伴的独特且可检验的预测。

title: Statistical Learning of Contractive Dynamical Representations for Composite Adaptive Control
comment: 9 pages, including an additional one-page appendix in this arXiv version. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: We present a representation-learning framework for composite adaptive tracking control under dynamically coupled disturbances. The framework connects classical disturbance-accommodating control (DAC) to recent last-layer adaptive disturbance-rejection methods. Specifically, we introduce a statistically principled hard expectation-maximization (hard-EM) procedure, with a Kalman smoother in the hard E-step, to identify dynamical representations of disturbance whose latent evolution is uniformly contractive. The learned representation evolves a latent disturbance-excitation state from measured plant features and control inputs and decodes that state into the time-varying disturbance acting on the nominal plant, thereby extending prior "fixed-decay" last-layer adaptive methods to a learned, predictive DAC-style formulation. Combined with Bayesian filtering of the learned latent state, this representation yields a composite adaptive tracking controller with predictive capability and provable exponential convergence to a bounded neighborhood. We validate our approach experimentally on a slippery ground vehicle carrying a liquid-sloshing tank and a pendulum load, and we further assess its robustness on a system of coupled Duffing oscillators. Across both settings, the method achieves accurate disturbance prediction and improved overall tracking performance relative to fixed-decay representation-learning ablations, LTI disturbance-accommodating baselines, and model-based PD baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种在动态耦合扰动下用于复合自适应跟踪控制的表示学习框架，将经典扰动适应控制（DAC）与近期末层自适应扰动抑制方法联系起来，通过学习可预测的扰动动态表示并结合贝叶斯滤波，实现具有可证明指数收敛性的复合自适应跟踪控制器。
AI.motivation: 现有末层自适应扰动抑制方法多采用固定衰减表示，难以处理动态耦合、时变且具有预测需求的扰动；同时经典DAC缺乏从数据中学习扰动动态表示的统计化框架。
AI.method: 提出基于统计原理的硬期望最大化（hard-EM）流程，在硬E步中使用卡尔曼平滑器，辨识具有一致收缩潜动态的扰动表示；该表示从可测对象特征和控制输入演化潜扰动激励状态，并解码为作用在标称对象上的时变扰动，从而将固定衰减的末层自适应方法扩展为可学习的预测型DAC公式；再结合学习潜状态的贝叶斯滤波，构建具有预测能力的复合自适应跟踪控制器。
AI.result: 在搭载液体晃动罐和摆锤负载的湿滑地面车辆上进行实验验证，并在耦合Duffing振子系统中评估鲁棒性；结果表明该方法能准确预测扰动，并且整体跟踪性能优于固定衰减表示学习消融、LTI扰动适应控制基线和基于模型的PD基线。
AI.conclusion: 所提表示学习框架能够有效学习动态耦合扰动的可预测表示，并与贝叶斯滤波结合形成具有可证明指数收敛到有界邻域的复合自适应跟踪控制器，在多种复杂扰动场景中提升扰动预测与跟踪性能。

title: Memory as Middleware for Self-Improving AI Agents
comment: Conditionally accepted to Middleware 2026. Extended version
summary:
AI agents are stateless across sessions by default and therefore operationally amnesic: each session begins with little durable knowledge of prior failures, repairs, preferences, or successful strategies. As a result, agents repeat the same mistakes and discard hard-won experience. The dominant fix is \emph{bespoke memory}---retrieval, persistence, and learning logic hand-wired into one agent and bound to one storage engine. This creates a fragmented landscape where memory cannot be swapped, shared, isolated, or reasoned about independently of the agent that owns it. We argue that this is a middleware problem: agent memory deserves a first-class, pluggable layer, just as data access, messaging, and persistence each became middleware concerns.
  We develop this vision through six systems challenges: two-sided pluggability, host-native interposition, multi-tenant isolation, write-path consistency, federated sharing with provenance, and lifecycle governance. We present ALTK-Evolve, a reference implementation of memory middleware for self-improving agents, and use it to motivate a broader research agenda for future memory middleware.

AI.tldr: 论文认为AI智能体的记忆应作为可插拔的中间件层，而非每个智能体定制的内存方案，并提出六大系统挑战及参考实现ALTK-Evolve。
AI.motivation: AI智能体默认跨会话无状态，导致操作失忆，重复犯错并丢弃经验。现有主流方案是定制内存，将检索、持久化和学习逻辑硬编码到单个智能体并绑定单一存储引擎，造成碎片化，内存无法交换、共享、隔离或独立推理。作者主张将智能体记忆视为中间件问题，像数据访问、消息传递和持久化一样成为一等公民。
AI.method: 通过立场/愿景论文展开，提出六大系统挑战：双向可插拔性、宿主原生介入、多租户隔离、写路径一致性、带溯源的联邦共享、生命周期治理。并给出自改进智能体内存中间件的参考实现ALTK-Evolve，以此推动未来内存中间件的研究议程。
AI.result: 识别出六大系统挑战，并展示了ALTK-Evolve参考实现，说明可插拔内存中间件在自改进智能体中的可行性。（摘要未给出定量实验结果。）
AI.conclusion: 智能体记忆应被设计为一等、可插拔的中间件层；ALTK-Evolve作为参考实现验证了该方向，并呼吁更广泛的未来内存中间件研究。

title: OptiArena: Can LLMs Improve Executable Algorithms under Fixed Resource Budgets?
summary: Static QA and code-generation benchmarks only partially capture the role that large language models (LLMs) now play as coding agents and research tools. We introduce OptiArena, a budget-controlled testbed for studying whether LLMs can improve executable game-playing algorithms through five rounds of code edits within a fixed minimal scaffold and under bounded evaluator feedback and fixed resource budgets. The testbed uses two optimization regimes, surface obfuscation controls, calibrated references, held-out/stress splits, and diagnostics for degradation and exceptional failures, with LLM API cost reported separately from local evaluator wall-clock. The empirical study asks three questions: whether models can close the calibrated gap between a designated weak starter and an editable competent baseline, whether they can refine editable competent baselines without damaging them, and whether gains survive surface obfuscation controls. Across twelve frontier LLMs and five games, models improve designated weak starters more consistently than they refine editable competent baselines, with substantial variation across games and models. OptiArena provides a practical testbed for measuring bounded-resource algorithm optimization within the five-edit, fixed-scaffold setting studied here. Code is available at https://github.com/WJ-Peng/OptiArena.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 OptiArena，一个预算受控的测试平台，用于研究 LLM 能否在固定最小脚手架、有限评估反馈和固定资源预算下，通过五轮代码编辑改进可执行博弈算法。
AI.motivation: 静态 QA 和代码生成基准只能部分反映 LLM 作为编码智能体与研究工具的作用，因此需要新的测试平台来评估其在有限资源下持续优化算法的能力。
AI.method: 构建 OptiArena 测试平台，采用五轮代码编辑、固定最小脚手架、有界评估者反馈和固定资源预算；设置两种优化机制、表面混淆控制、校准参考、留出/压力划分，以及退化和异常失败诊断；LLM API 成本与本地评估墙钟时间分开报告。实验覆盖 12 个前沿 LLM 和 5 个游戏。
AI.result: 模型在改进指定弱启动算法方面比优化可编辑的合格基线更一致，但不同游戏和模型之间存在显著差异；研究还考察了增益能否在表面混淆控制下保持。
AI.conclusion: OptiArena 为在五轮编辑、固定脚手架设定下测量有限资源算法优化提供了实用测试平台，代码已在 GitHub 开源。

title: Agentic Video Understanding: A Survey
summary: As large language models (LLMs) become capable of processing increasingly diverse modalities and longer temporal contexts, an emerging line of work is moving beyond fixed video-language inference toward agentic systems that actively decide what information to inspect, retain, verify, and act upon. This survey reviews video understanding agents: systems that use video as the primary information source and solve understanding tasks through adaptive state construction and action selection. We first formalize an agent loop for video understanding, then address a central question: why do agents matter for video understanding? To answer this, we organize the literature through a challenge-to-design taxonomy, linking context bottlenecks to hierarchical evidence memory, evidence sparsity to active evidence acquisition, temporal causality to state and process tracking, and multimodal ambiguity to role-specialized coordination. We further review state space paradigms, learning paradigms, supervision signals, benchmarks, and evaluation protocols. Finally, we identify open directions toward agentic-native temporal modeling and video-native agents. Project page: https://github.com/DXY0711/Awesome-Agentic-Video-Understanding

AI.tldr: 该综述系统梳理视频理解智能体，形式化其智能体循环，并通过挑战到设计的分类法组织文献，总结相关范式、监督信号、基准与评估协议，最后指出未来方向。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型处理多模态和长时上下文能力增强，研究正从固定的视频-语言推理转向能主动决定检查、保留、验证和行动信息的智能体系统，因此需要明确视频理解智能体为何重要及如何设计。
AI.method: 综述首先形式化视频理解智能体循环；然后用挑战到设计的分类法组织文献，将上下文瓶颈、证据稀疏、时序因果和多模态歧义分别关联到分层证据记忆、主动证据获取、状态与过程跟踪、角色专门化协调；并综述状态空间、学习范式、监督信号、基准和评估协议。
AI.result: 建立了视频理解智能体的挑战-设计映射，系统整理了相关状态空间范式、学习范式、监督信号、基准与评估协议，并提供了项目页面。
AI.conclusion: 未来开放方向包括面向智能体原生的时序建模和视频原生智能体。

title: GameBoyWorlds: A Testbed for Self-Improvement in Embodied Video Games
summary: Powered by expert guidance, agents can operate in interactive environments; however, it is unclear whether they can learn autonomously from their own experience. To evaluate such self-improvement methods, we introduce GameBoyWorlds, a testbed for agentic self-improvement in video games. GameBoyWorlds-Execution evaluates task execution on a collection of 5 distinct game series. Agents are allowed access to dedicated training games but are provided no demonstrations, documentation, or rewards. Agents must ground themselves in the environment through self-directed exploration and by inferring actionable knowledge from their own experience. At test time, agents must complete short-horizon tasks that evaluate their ability to navigate, interact, and engage with game-specific mechanics in unseen games. Out-of-the-box frontier models complete fewer than 50% of the 500 tasks due to failures in multimodal grounding, establishing that self-improvement methods have room to push performance. We demonstrate that contemporary approaches to self-improvement are lacking, with world modelling and autonomous skill discovery failing, and a novel strategy that uses curiosity-based exploration to write guides achieving only partial success. GameBoyWorlds-Playthrough tests end-to-end game completion in two fan-made Pokémon games. We show that while frontier models have been pre-exposed to official releases such as Pokémon Red, they lack essential information on the games in our testbed. Instead of relying on their parametric knowledge to succeed, agents must learn from their own experience and autonomously improve over the course of the playthrough. We show that a sophisticated agentic pipeline with multimodal memory and hierarchical subgoals fails to reach even the first major milestone in both games, establishing GameBoyWorlds as an ambitious target for self-improving agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出GameBoyWorlds测试平台，用于评估智能体在电子游戏中的自主自我改进能力，包含短程任务执行和完整通关两类基准。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体多依赖专家指导，尚不清楚它们能否仅凭自身经验自主学习与提升，因此需要专门测试平台来检验自我改进方法。
AI.method: 构建GameBoyWorlds，包括GameBoyWorlds-Execution和GameBoyWorlds-Playthrough。前者在5个游戏系列中测试500个未见游戏的短程任务，不提供示范、文档或奖励，要求智能体自主探索并推断可操作知识；后者测试两款粉丝自制宝可梦游戏的端到端通关。评估前沿模型及多种自我改进策略，如世界建模、自主技能发现、好奇心探索写指南，以及带多模态记忆和分层子目标的智能体流程。
AI.result: 前沿模型在500个任务中完成率低于50%，主要受多模态 grounding 失败影响；当代自我改进方法表现不足：世界建模和自主技能发现失败，好奇心探索写指南仅部分成功。在Playthrough中，即使复杂智能体流程也未能达到两款游戏的首个主要里程碑。
AI.conclusion: GameBoyWorlds表明当前自我改进智能体仍有很大提升空间，自主从经验中学习并完成复杂游戏仍是雄心勃勃的目标。

title: OmniFysics-Captioner Technical Report: Grounding Omni-Modal Understanding in the Physical World for Better Captioning
summary: Building omni-modal models with physical intelligence requires fine-grained supervision that captures physical evidence such as contact, support, deformation, and state transitions. However, existing omni-modal captioners primarily model general audiovisual semantics and often overlook transient or spatially localized physical evidence. We present a unified framework for physics-aware audiovisual captioning spanning data construction, training, and evaluation. Firstly, we build a data construction pipeline that identifies physics-rich clips and leverages OmniFysics-Agent to coordinate audio, visual, and physical-perception tools for collecting spatiotemporally aligned and traceable cross-modal evidence; within the Agent, a physical perception model (PPM) fine-tuned on approximately 2M image-level samples serves as a dedicated tool for extracting object-interaction and state-change cues. Secondly, we build the Daily-Physics 50K dataset and introduce the evidence-driven OmniPhysCap (OPC) benchmark to evaluate the recovery of physical and cross-modal evidence from generated captions. Finally, we train OmniFysics-Captioner from the resulting data. Our Captioner matches Gemini 3.1 Pro on audiovisual captioning, achieves state-of-the-art results on multiple video-captioning benchmarks, and substantially outperforms other open-source models. Ablations show that PPM evidence improves physical coverage and produces finer-grained, more reliable cross-modal descriptions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个面向物理感知的音视频字幕统一框架，涵盖数据构建、训练与评估，构建了Daily-Physics 50K数据集和OmniPhysCap基准，并训练出OmniFysics-Captioner模型。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态字幕模型主要建模通用视听语义，往往忽略接触、支撑、形变、状态变化等瞬时或空间局部的物理证据，而构建具备物理智能的全模态模型需要这种细粒度监督。
AI.method: 提出统一的物理感知音视频字幕框架：一是数据构建流水线，识别物理丰富片段并利用OmniFysics-Agent协调音频、视觉与物理感知工具，采集时空对齐且可追溯的跨模态证据；其中物理感知模型（PPM）基于约200万图像级样本微调，用于提取物体交互与状态变化线索。二是构建Daily-Physics 50K数据集与证据驱动的OmniPhysCap（OPC）基准。三是基于所得数据训练OmniFysics-Captioner。
AI.result: OmniFysics-Captioner在音视频字幕任务上与Gemini 3.1 Pro相当，在多个视频字幕基准上取得最先进结果，并大幅优于其他开源模型；消融实验表明PPM证据提升了物理覆盖度，生成了更细粒度和更可靠的跨模态描述。
AI.conclusion: 以物理证据为核心的数据构建、训练与评估框架能有效提升全模态字幕对物理现象与跨模态证据的刻画能力，验证了专用物理感知工具在细粒度字幕生成中的关键价值。

title: WSM-Aware HRI: An IoT-Enhanced Framework for Early Detection and Norm-Guided Repair of Failures with LLM Guidance
summary: Human-robot interaction (HRI) failures remain a major barrier to deploying robots in real-world environments. Prior work often treats failures as isolated technical faults or focuses on post-hoc recovery behaviors. In practice, many breakdowns arise because humans and robots operate under inconsistent assumptions about the current world state. We propose WSM-Aware HRI, an IoT-enhanced modular framework that unifies diverse HRI breakdowns as World-State Mismatches (WSMs) between a human's instruction-implied assumptions and a robot's grounded world model built from multimodal perception and digital augmentation. A Large Language Model (LLM) is used to make implicit assumptions explicit, map them to a small set of mismatch types, and specify the evidence needed for verification against the robot's world state. WSM-Aware HRI shifts failure handling from execution-time recovery to proactive mismatch detection during intention formation, enabling interventions guided by safety, norm compliance, and multi-user coordination with transparent explanations. We evaluate mismatch identification in ten everyday cases spanning both visual and latent-state mismatches. The system can accurately produce the expected output results, and ablations show that reliable identification depends on appropriate grounding representations and verification-oriented refinement. These results indicate that treating interaction breakdowns as explicit world-state mismatches enables earlier detection of impending failures and offers a principled mechanism for integrating external evidence and social constraints into human-robot interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出WSM-Aware HRI框架，将人机交互失败统一为世界状态不匹配，利用LLM显式化假设并主动检测不匹配，实验表明能准确识别不匹配。
AI.motivation: 人机交互失败阻碍机器人现实部署，现有工作多将失败视为孤立技术故障或事后恢复，而实际中许多故障源于人与机器人对世界状态假设不一致。
AI.method: 提出IoT增强的模块化WSM-Aware HRI框架，将失败建模为人指令隐含假设与机器人多模态感知及数字增强构建的世界模型之间的世界状态不匹配；用LLM显式化隐含假设、映射不匹配类型并指定验证所需证据；在意图形成阶段主动检测不匹配。
AI.result: 在十个日常案例（含视觉和潜在状态不匹配）中评估，系统能准确产生预期输出；消融实验表明可靠识别依赖合适的接地表示和验证导向的细化。
AI.conclusion: 将交互故障视为显式世界状态不匹配可更早检测潜在失败，并为整合外部证据和社会约束到人机交互提供原则性机制。

title: Human Motion Prediction for Human-Robot Collaboration
summary: This paper compares three human motion prediction methods - GMM-based clustering, TransFusion, and Graph-Mixer - evaluating their effectiveness in human-robot collaboration. These predictions are valuable for improving robot motion planning by anticipating human movements and enhancing safety and efficiency in dynamic environments.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了基于GMM聚类、TransFusion和Graph-Mixer三种人体运动预测方法，并评估它们在人机协作中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 通过预测人体运动来改进机器人运动规划，提前预判人类动作，从而在动态环境中提升安全性和效率。
AI.method: 对比三种人体运动预测方法：GMM聚类、TransFusion和Graph-Mixer，并在人机协作场景下评估其效果。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量结果，仅指出这些预测有助于改进机器人运动规划、增强动态环境中的安全性与效率。
AI.conclusion: 人体运动预测对人机协作具有价值；三种方法被纳入比较评估，但具体优劣仍需依赖后续实验分析。

title: Fysiverse-3D-SimReady Technical Report: Agentic Physical Simulation for Pragmatic 3D World Reconstruction
summary: Agentic recognition requires visual perception to move beyond static scene understanding and produce structured scene representations that support the perception--reasoning--action loop. Existing single-image 3D generation methods, however, mainly produce visually plausible object assets rather than simulation-ready scene states. When independently generated meshes are composed in a shared space, they may fail to align with the input camera, violate gravity, interpenetrate nearby objects, or become unstable under physics simulation. We present Fysiverse-3D-SimReady, a grounded refinement framework for reconstructing simulation-ready multi-object scenes from a single RGB image with instance and ground prompts. The method places generated object meshes into a shared gravity-aligned scene, refines their camera-space poses through differentiable rendering, and corrects scene-level supports and contacts for stable physical execution. The scene is then used by an agentic simulation workflow, which converts a scene-specific task goal into an executable physics rollout rendered from the original camera view. Experiments show that Fysiverse-3D-SimReady improves input-view alignment, contact plausibility, and physical stability over existing single-image reconstruction and scene generation baselines, while enabling goal-conditioned physical interactions from a single image.

AI.tldr: 提出 Fysiverse-3D-SimReady，一种从单张 RGB 图像重建可用于仿真的多物体 3D 场景的 grounded refinement 框架，并支持智能体将任务目标转化为可执行的物理仿真 rollout。
AI.motivation: 现有单图 3D 生成方法主要生成视觉上合理的物体资产，难以提供仿真就绪的场景状态；独立生成的网格组合后常出现相机不对齐、违反重力、物体穿插或物理不稳定等问题，无法支撑感知—推理—行动闭环。
AI.method: 利用实例与地面提示，将生成物体网格放入共享的重力对齐场景；通过可微渲染细化相机空间位姿；修正场景级支撑与接触关系以保证物理执行稳定；再接入 agentic simulation workflow，将场景特定任务目标转换为从原始相机视角渲染的可执行物理 rollout。
AI.result: 实验表明，Fysiverse-3D-SimReady 在输入视角对齐、接触合理性和物理稳定性上优于现有单图重建与场景生成基线，并能从单张图像出发实现目标条件下的物理交互。
AI.conclusion: 该框架使单图 3D 场景生成从仅追求视觉合理性转向仿真就绪，为智能体感知—推理—行动循环提供结构化、可物理执行的场景表示。

title: Solving Every Step Is Not Enough: Milestone Oracles Reveal a Composition Gap in LLM Math Reasoning
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track). 47 pages. Code and data: https://github.com/slark-prime/OracleLadder
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can solve every intermediate step of a multi-step math problem on its own and still fail the full problem, even when given a roadmap of the steps and all of their answers. We introduce OracleLadder, a diagnostic evaluation that locates where LLM math reasoning fails by giving the model increasing levels of oracle help. For each problem, a teacher model writes a fixed roadmap of intermediate sub-goals (milestones), and a deterministic symbolic verifier grades every answer. Testing the model with no help, with the roadmap, with the roadmap plus the milestone answers, and on each milestone alone sorts each failure into one of five reasoning gaps. On 354 NuminaMath problems and six models from 8B to 671B parameters (Qwen3, gpt-oss, Llama 3.3, DeepSeek-V3.1), the largest gap for every model is the composition gap, a stricter form of the compositionality gap. It covers 33-48% of problems, and 24-37% after removing problems that an LLM review flags as grading errors. Accuracy and milestone-help recovery rank the two strongest models differently, and two RLVR runs with similar accuracy gains move problems differently. The roadmap effect replicates on MATH500 and AIME 2024/25, per-problem recovery agrees for 83-87% of problems under an independent second teacher, and the help ladder carries over to code generation. We release the data, roadmaps, prompts, and code at https://github.com/slark-prime/OracleLadder.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 OracleLadder 诊断评估，通过逐级提供 oracle 帮助来定位 LLM 数学多步推理的失败环节，发现所有模型的最大失败原因是“组合缺口”。
AI.motivation: LLM 能独立解决多步数学题的每个中间步骤，却仍可能无法解出完整问题，即使给出步骤路线图和所有中间答案；因此需要一种方法定位其推理失败的具体环节。
AI.method: 对每道题由教师模型写出固定的中间子目标路线图，并用确定性符号验证器评分每个答案；在无帮助、仅路线图、路线图加里程碑答案、以及单独测试每个里程碑等条件下评估模型，将失败分类为五种推理缺口；在 354 道 NuminaMath 题和六个 8B 到 671B 模型上测试，并在 MATH500、AIME 2024/25 和代码生成上复现。
AI.result: 所有模型的最大缺口都是组合缺口，即更严格的组合性缺口，占 33–48% 题目，去除被标记为评分错误的题目后占 24–37%；准确率与里程碑帮助恢复对两个最强模型的排名不同，两次准确率提升相近的 RLVR 训练对题目的改善也不同；路线图效应在 MATH500 和 AIME 2024/25 上复现，独立第二教师下逐题恢复一致率为 83–87%，帮助阶梯也适用于代码生成。
AI.conclusion: 当前 LLM 数学推理的主要瓶颈不是单个里程碑能力，而是将可解的中间步骤组合成完整解的能力；OracleLadder 提供了可诊断、可复现的评估工具，并发布了数据、路线图、提示和代码。

title: KinyaMed: Seeds, Not Rows -- What a Corpus Requirement Written in the Wrong Unit Fails to Constrain
comment: 34 pages, 10 tables, 1 figure. Negative-results and methodology paper; no model performance claims are made
summary: Triage decides who is seen first. Building an urgency classifier for patient-voice Kinyarwanda, we found our specification could be met without producing anything it was meant to secure. We report that, and the instruments that detect it, instead of a classifier. Designed for the four languages a Rwandan health centre receives, with every instrument per-language: sentences are authored in all four arms and rows generate in one, because the frame slots those three need do not exist. Our requirement asked for one million examples; generation produced them in 130 seconds. It fails four of the nine quality gates in that specification, six when rows are attributed to their source sentence. The binding gate counts distinct authored seed phrases, not rows: at our 165, no corpus passes at any row count. Two shortfalls follow and differ: 2,835 further sentences to pass the seed-count gate, 19,835 to reach the stated million rows, because a separate gate caps a seed at 50 rows. Rows come from a machine at 7,700 per second; seeds from clinicians. A row count constrains the cheap quantity, leaves the expensive one free, and so does not constrain quality at all. Two further negatives follow. An evaluation set of 17,942 rows built from nine distinct sentences supports no verdict: our gate, which counts distinct sentences, refuses 38 of its cells and reports nothing. A model trained on a corpus of uniform surface form changes its predicted urgency for 31.5% of inputs under capitalisation and 21.0% under a single typo, reported as measurement and not attribution. A model directory shipped without its tokenizer loads without error and answers its class prior on input it cannot read, with well-formed probabilities. No figure here is evidence of model quality; the contribution is the apparatus and the negative results it produced, reproducible from a clean clone except where marked NOT REPRODUCIBLE.

AI.tldr: 论文报告为卢旺达患者语音基尼亚卢旺达语构建分诊紧急度分类器时，发现仅满足规范行数等指标并不等于实现目标；因此不发布分类器，而发布检测这些问题的工具与负面结果。
AI.motivation: 分诊决定谁先就诊，需要为四种语言构建紧急度分类器；但作者发现原规范可被表面满足而未保障实际质量，因此转而揭示生成与评测流程中的失效。
AI.method: 为四种语言分别设计工具；用机器生成大量行、临床上编写种子句；设置九项质量门，包括计数不同种子句和每种子最多50行；构建评测集；测试模型对大小写和拼写扰动的敏感性，以及无tokenizer加载行为。
AI.result: 100万示例130秒生成，但未过4/9质量门，归因到源句时未过6/9；在165个种子下任何行数都无法通过种子数门；达种子门还需2,835句，达100万行还需19,835句；17,942行评测集仅来自9句，门拒绝38个单元格且无结论；模型预测在大小写变化下31.5%、单错字下21.0%改变；缺tokenizer仍可加载并输出类别先验。
AI.conclusion: 行数只约束廉价生成量，不约束昂贵临床种子和质量；这些数字不证明模型质量。贡献是检测工具、负面结果及可复现实验，除标记NOT REPRODUCIBLE处外。

title: Residual Streams Read, Recurrent States Remember: The Global Workspace in Mamba Models
summary: Can the global-workspace account of transformer representations extend to state-space language models? We fit Jacobian lenses to the residual streams and recurrent states of Mamba-1, Mamba-2 and Mamba-3, using the original 1000-prompt recipe. Joint residual--state readouts improve recovery of known intermediate concepts over the residual lens on at least five of six task families in every tested Mamba checkpoint. On Mamba-2, state alone exceeds residual and logit lenses on all six families; a normalised joint readout improves on both components on five. Temporal maps and word-list experiments show earlier content remaining state-readable as residual visibility changes. We also propose sign-guarded steering, which improves target top-five success over coordinate exchange on matched verbal-report trials in five models. Recurrent state alone supports this verbal access. These gains do not extend consistently to relational answers: guarded edits often output the edited concept itself, and Mamba-3's joint edits can disrupt successful state-only redirection. Recurrent state thus provides a complementary carrier of workspace content, whose recovery, persistence and causal uses require separate measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文探究全局工作空间理论能否推广到状态空间语言模型，通过拟合雅可比透镜分析Mamba-1/2/3的残差流与循环状态，发现循环状态是工作空间内容的互补载体。
AI.motivation: 全局工作空间理论已在Transformer表示中得到验证，但其是否适用于状态空间语言模型（如Mamba）尚不明确。
AI.method: 使用原始1000提示词配方，为Mamba-1、Mamba-2和Mamba-3的残差流与循环状态拟合雅可比透镜；进行联合残差-状态读出、时间映射、词表实验；提出符号保护引导（sign-guarded steering）并与坐标交换方法对比。
AI.result: 在至少五个任务族中，联合读出优于残差透镜；Mamba-2上仅状态读出在所有六个任务族上超过残差和logit透镜，归一化联合读出在五个任务族上优于两个分量；时间映射显示早期内容在残差可见性变化时仍可状态读取；符号保护引导在五个模型中提高了目标前五成功率，但关系答案上增益不一致，保护编辑常输出被编辑概念本身，Mamba-3联合编辑可能破坏状态单独重定向。
AI.conclusion: 循环状态提供了工作空间内容的互补载体，其恢复、持续性和因果用途需要分别测量。

title: Proactive Motion Planning for Human-Robot Cooperation
summary: This abstract addresses the incorporation of human motion prediction into proactive and dynamic human-aware motion planning, with the goal of enabling safe collaboration between humans and robots. A deep learning, graph-based model is used to forecast human motion and is integrated into a planning framework. This framework employs a static roadmap along with a time-variant A* algorithm to modify the trajectory of a UR5e manipulator. This method greatly improves human-robot interaction and enables proactive collision avoidance by combining precise motion forecasts with adaptive trajectory planning.

AI.tldr: 该研究将深度学习图模型用于人体运动预测，并将其集成到主动、动态且感知人的运动规划框架中；框架使用静态路网和时变A*算法调整UR5e机械臂轨迹，从而实现安全人机协作。
AI.motivation: 为了实现人与机器人之间的安全协作，机器人需要预测人体运动并进行主动避碰，而仅依赖被动反应式规划难以适应动态人类环境。
AI.method: 采用基于图的深度学习模型预测人体运动；将该预测模型集成到运动规划框架中；使用静态路网结合时间变化的A*算法，修改UR5e机械臂的运动轨迹。
AI.result: 该方法显著改善了人机交互效果，并通过结合精确的运动预测与自适应轨迹规划，实现了主动碰撞避免。
AI.conclusion: 将人体运动预测与自适应轨迹规划相结合，可以有效提升人机协作的安全性和主动性，验证了该框架在动态人类环境中的可行性。

title: LANTERN: Illuminating Hidden Mathematical Knowledge in Language Models
summary: Language models can now prove theorems, but people still decide which problems to pursue. We ask whether a model's internal representations can help identify promising mathematical connections. We develop LANTERN, a fast, cost-efficient pipeline that uses a classifier over pretrained-model activations to rank candidate relations, followed by staged filtering, hypothesis generation, executable verification, and analytical checking. Applied to the On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences (OEIS), LANTERN ranked 50 million pairs among 10,000 frequently referenced sequences and produced 62 verified relations between pairs without an existing OEIS cross-reference. A content screen retained 13 relations worth presenting; nine of these are informative or insightful, including four which are entirely novel to the best of our knowledge: none appears in the OEIS or in our targeted literature search. The entire end-to-end process including classifier training, candidate ranking, filtering and verification took under 8 hours.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出LANTERN，一种利用预训练模型内部激活表示来排序候选数学关系的高效流程，并在OEIS整数序列中发现62条已验证的新关系，其中4条为全新发现。
AI.motivation: 语言模型已能证明定理，但选择研究哪些问题仍由人决定。作者希望探索模型的内部表示是否能帮助识别有前景的数学联系。
AI.method: 开发LANTERN流程：使用基于预训练模型激活的分类器对候选关系排序，再进行分阶段过滤、假设生成、可执行验证和分析检查。将其应用于OEIS中1万个高频引用序列的5000万对候选关系。
AI.result: 在OEIS中没有现有交叉引用的序列对之间，验证出62条关系。内容筛选后保留13条值得展示的关系，其中9条具有信息量或洞察力，4条据作者所知完全新颖，未出现在OEIS或针对性文献检索中。整个端到端过程（包括分类器训练、候选排序、过滤和验证）耗时不到8小时。
AI.conclusion: 预训练模型的内部表示可有效帮助发现有前景的数学联系，且所提流程成本低、速度快，能够发现OEIS中此前未被记录的新关系。

title: Feedback Makes Perfect: A Closed-Loop Framework for NL-to-STL Translation
summary: Signal Temporal Logic (STL) enables rigorous verification and control of cyber-physical systems, but writing correct specifications requires expertise that most requirement holders lack. Large language models can translate natural-language (NL) requirements into STL, yet stronger translators alone approach an accuracy ceiling. We argue that this ceiling stems from how the task is posed: one-shot, open-loop translation is somewhat ill-defined. Natural language is ambiguous, and, more fundamentally, what a person writes may not always be what they intend, so the target specification is not fully contained in the input text. We therefore reformulate NL-to-STL translation as a closed-loop feedback process. Each generated formula is translated back into natural language for the user to check, and natural-language corrections drive revision until the user accepts the specification. Users never read or write formal syntax. This framework rests on an asymmetry familiar from feedback control theory. The forward path, from ambiguous language to formal logic, is hard and error-prone. The feedback path, from structured STL back to language, can be made highly precise, and a precise feedback path lets an imprecise forward path achieve precise closed-loop behavior. Experiments on 500 expert-authored requirements and seven LLMs support this view. Back-translated explanations agree with expert judgments in 99.5\% of cases. Closed-loop refinement raises strong models from about 89\% open-loop accuracy to 98.0--99.2\%, and yields gains of over 30 percentage points for weaker models (e.g., 17.6\%$\rightarrow$48.0\%). Ablations show these gains come from the semantic content of the feedback rather than from repeated attempts. An expert audit and a 280-session user study further confirm the reliability of the loop. We also identify a capability threshold above which feedback no longer helps.

AI.tldr: 该论文将自然语言到信号时序逻辑（STL）的翻译重新定义为闭环反馈过程，而非一次性开放翻译，通过将生成的STL反译回自然语言供用户检查并修正，显著提升翻译准确率。
AI.motivation: 编写正确的STL规约需要专业知识，而需求提供者通常缺乏这种能力。大语言模型可辅助翻译，但仅增强翻译器仍存在准确率上限。作者认为该上限源于任务设定本身：自然语言有歧义，且用户所写未必是其真实意图，目标规约并不完全包含在输入文本中。
AI.method: 提出闭环反馈式NL-to-STL翻译框架：每次生成STL公式后，将其反译回自然语言供用户检查，用户用自然语言给出修正，驱动公式迭代修订，直到用户接受规约；用户无需读写形式化语法。基于反馈控制中的不对称性：前向路径（歧义语言到形式逻辑）困难且易错，反馈路径（结构化STL到语言）可做到高精度，从而让不精确的前向路径在闭环中获得精确行为。
AI.result: 在500条专家撰写的需求和7个LLM上实验：反译解释与专家判断一致率达99.5%。闭环细化将强模型从约89%开放环准确率提升到98.0%–99.2%，对弱模型提升超过30个百分点（如17.6%→48.0%）。消融实验表明增益来自反馈的语义内容而非重复尝试。专家审计和280次会话的用户研究确认了闭环可靠性，并识别出反馈不再有益的模型能力阈值。
AI.conclusion: NL-to-STL翻译应被建模为闭环人机反馈过程。精确的STL到自然语言反译路径可弥补前向翻译的不精确性，显著提升不同能力LLM的规约生成准确率和可靠性，但存在能力阈值，超过后反馈帮助有限。

title: LatentReRig: An SDF-Based VAE with Dual Decoders for Latent-Space Deformation Conditioning
comment: 13 pages, 11 figures, extracted from final dissertation
summary: Transferring deformation between characters with different geometry and topology is challenging because conventional rigs encode behaviour through character-specific structures and correspondences. We present LatentReRig, an experimental framework that investigates whether pose-associated changes can instead be represented as reusable directions in a learned geometric latent space. An SDF-based variational autoencoder is coupled with two decoders: one reconstructs the implicit field, while the other predicts target vertex positions from source geometry and latent deformation conditioning. The source geometry may be neutral or already deformed. Experiments on a controlled humanoid dataset show that several poses induce coherent latent directions across identities, particularly for broad articulated motions. These signals can guide deformation of unseen characters, but explicit predictions remain less accurate for localized changes and corrective contributions. Diagnostic comparisons with repeated SDF sampling show that inter-identity distances exceed same-geometry resampling variability on average, while pose signals exhibit different margins above this baseline. The results support the presence of reusable pose-related structure and identify stable local conditioning and accurate mesh decoding as complementary requirements for improving transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出LatentReRig实验框架，探索能否将姿态相关形变表示为学习到的几何隐空间中的可复用方向，并在人形数据集上验证其跨身份迁移潜力。
AI.motivation: 传统绑定通过角色特定的结构和对应关系编码行为，因此在不同几何与拓扑的角色之间迁移形变十分困难。
AI.method: 使用基于SDF的变分自编码器，并耦合两个解码器：一个重建隐式场，另一个根据源几何和隐式形变条件预测目标顶点位置；源几何可以是中性或已形变状态。
AI.result: 在受控人形数据集上，若干姿态能在不同身份间诱导一致的隐空间方向，尤其对大幅关节运动；这些信号可引导未见角色的形变，但显式预测对局部变化和修正贡献仍不够准确。重复SDF采样诊断显示，身份间距离平均超过同几何重采样波动，不同姿态信号相对该基线的余量不同。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持可复用姿态相关结构的存在，并指出稳定局部条件与精确网格解码是改进形变迁移的两个互补要求。

title: Escaping Alignment: A Physical Trap Model of Best-of-N Jailbreaking
summary: Best-of-$N$ jailbreaking (BoN) bypasses safeguards of aligned models by drawing $N$ independent augmentations of an unsafe prompt and sampling $M$ completions of each. Previous works have shown that the attack success rate (ASR) seems to follow a power-law in $N$, which we challenge. The exponent drifts with $N$, with an exponential crossover which is a finite-size artifact of the adversarial dataset. Little work has been done to explore the entire two-budget ($N, M$) attack surface as well as its dependence on the generation temperature $T$. We introduce a simple barrier model where each prompt has a baseline safety level and each augmentation a random thermally activated barrier. Then four numbers, each backed by an interpretable safety mechanism, determine the entire ($N, M$) attack surface. They extrapolate predictions from $N \leq 100$ to $N = 10^4$, collapse five distinct models on the same scaling function and predict ASR at different temperatures from the one they were fitted at.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战Best-of-N越狱中攻击成功率随N呈幂律增长的结论，提出一个简单的屏障模型，用四个可解释参数刻画(N,M)攻击面及其对生成温度T的依赖。
AI.motivation: 先前工作认为越狱攻击成功率随N呈幂律增长，但作者发现指数会随N漂移，并出现指数交叉，这可能是对抗数据集的有限尺寸伪影；同时，现有研究很少系统探索(N,M)两种预算的完整攻击面以及温度T的影响。
AI.method: 引入简单屏障模型：每个提示有一个基线安全水平，每个增强有一个随机热激活屏障。该模型中四个数字（每个对应可解释的安全机制）决定整个(N,M)攻击面。
AI.result: 该模型能够从N≤100外推到N=10^4；将五个不同模型坍缩到同一缩放函数上；并能预测不同温度下的攻击成功率，即使参数只在某一温度下拟合。
AI.conclusion: Best-of-N越狱的攻击成功率缩放并非简单幂律，而可由少数可解释参数统一描述；该框架能刻画多模型、多预算和温度依赖，并具备外推预测能力。

title: AI Harness: Certification under Proposal-Conditioned Information for Foundation-Model Agents
summary: Foundation-model agents are often modeled as policies over an observed state. In deployed systems, however, a runtime may intervene only after the model has emitted a semantic proposal, making the proposal both an action candidate and a decision-time observation generated by a history-conditioned process. We show that collapsing this structure into a state-only proposal envelope can preserve proposal coverage while destroying certifiability. In a finite robust interface, the viability kernel of the collapsed model is contained in the physical projection of the history-augmented kernel, and the collapse is lossless exactly when every proposal-conditioned collapsed fiber retains a common robust-safe intervention. This gap can be maximal even with constant-size proposal and history alphabets. The same common-action condition yields a dual result: observing the current proposal can restore robust feasibility when it separates latent modes requiring incompatible interventions. We extend these one-step results over time using exact finite beliefs and standard safety and reachability fixed points, separating indefinite operational viability from finite worst-case verified progress. Controlled model-in-the-loop tests reproduce the predicted obstructions when telemetry or effect verification is removed or intervention authority is restricted. Thus, our contribution is not a new fixed-point calculus, but a characterization of when proposal--history correlation at the model--tool boundary is necessary for certification.

AI.tldr: 论文研究基础模型智能体在部署时的认证问题：运行时往往只能在模型输出语义提案后进行干预，提案既是动作候选，也是历史条件过程产生的决策时观测。作者刻画了将这种结构坍缩为仅状态提案包络何时会破坏可认证性，并给出保持或恢复鲁棒可行性的条件。
AI.motivation: 常见建模把智能体视为对观测状态的策略，但真实部署中运行时干预发生在模型提出语义提案之后，提案本身携带历史信息。忽略提案与历史的相关性，可能保留提案覆盖却丧失可认证性。
AI.method: 建立有限鲁棒接口，比较坍缩模型与历史增强模型的生存核；用提案条件下坍缩纤维的共同鲁棒安全干预条件刻画无损性；用精确有限信念以及安全性和可达性不动点将一步结果扩展到时间维度；并通过模型在环受控测试验证。
AI.result: 坍缩模型的生存核包含于历史增强核的物理投影中；坍缩无损当且仅当每个提案条件下的坍缩纤维都存在共同鲁棒安全干预，且该差距在常数大小的提案和历史字母表下也可达最大。相同共同动作条件给出对偶结果：观测当前提案可分离需要不兼容干预的潜在模式，从而恢复鲁棒可行性。时间扩展区分了无限运行可行性与有限最坏情况验证进展。移除遥测、效果验证或限制干预权限时，模型在环测试重现预测的阻碍。
AI.conclusion: 论文的贡献不是新的不动点演算，而是刻画了在模型—工具边界处，提案与历史的相关性何时对认证是必要的。

title: A Disk-Shaped Magnetoelastic Torque Sensor for Robotic Joints Using Permanent Magnetization
summary: Direct torque sensing is a growing need in the robotics community to enable precise control and interactions where torque estimation from motor current is not sufficient. This paper presents a novel disk-shaped magnetoelastic torque sensor with a compact axial envelope of about 1 cm, suitable for integration in robotic joints. A four-magnetometer architecture is used to measure the field modulated by the stress affecting a narrow magnetized region while rejecting the effects of parasitic cross forces. A custom-designed magnetic shield enhances the torque sensitivity while reducing the external stray fields by a factor 7x. The device measures the torque with an accuracy of 1.34 %FS relative to the 50 Nm full scale (FS). The paper details the development of the sensor through the mechanical design, the magnetization procedure, and the experimental validation. The results demonstrate the potential of the proposed sensor for robotic applications.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种新型盘式磁致伸缩扭矩传感器，轴向厚度约1 cm，适用于机器人关节集成；采用四磁力计架构和定制磁屏蔽，在50 Nm满量程下实现1.34%FS的扭矩测量精度。
AI.motivation: 机器人领域对直接扭矩传感的需求不断增长，因为仅靠电机电流估计扭矩不足以支持精确控制和交互。
AI.method: 设计盘式磁致伸缩扭矩传感器，轴向包络紧凑约1 cm；采用四磁力计架构测量窄磁化区域受应力调制的磁场，并抑制寄生交叉力影响；使用定制磁屏蔽增强扭矩灵敏度并降低外部杂散场；涵盖机械设计、磁化流程和实验验证。
AI.result: 定制磁屏蔽将外部杂散场降低约7倍，同时提升扭矩灵敏度；传感器在50 Nm满量程下扭矩测量精度达到1.34%FS。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，该传感器在机器人应用中具有良好潜力。

title: RE-0: Verified Recursive Improvement of Embodied Code-as-Policy Agents through Local On-Policy Distillation
comment: 17 pages, 5 figures. Corresponding author: Hongzhou Wang (wanghongzhou@jlu.edu.cn)
summary: Code-as-Policy agents accomplish long-horizon embodied tasks by generating and executing code, yet continually improving them with teachers that are stronger but not globally reliable remains a key challenge. Existing distillation methods typically treat the teacher's complete behavior as the supervision target and thus misassign training credit on states where the teacher fails. We propose RE-0, a recursively verified policy improvement framework: rather than assuming that the teacher globally outperforms the student, RE-0 requests local corrections from the teacher on the student's own failure histories and checks in the environment whether each correction is genuinely beneficial; verified corrections yield immediate improvement. Building on this, we propose RE-OPD, which turns verified interventions into supervision for on-policy distillation. Only counterfactually verified teacher interventions provide distribution-level supervision, weighted by their measured local benefit, and the improvement they induce is projected back into the standalone student, so both where supervision is applied and how much credit the teacher receives co-evolve with the student policy. We further prove that the student's per-round gain is lower-bounded by its verified intervention gain up to verification and projection error terms. Experiments across multiple Code-as-Policy embodied tasks show that RE-0 improves both teacher-assisted execution and the standalone student, and generalizes to novel robots and scenes.

AI.tldr: 提出RE-0与RE-OPD框架，通过递归验证教师局部修正来改进Code-as-Policy智能体，避免因教师全局不可靠导致的错误信用分配，并在多个具身任务中提升师生双方表现。
AI.motivation: 现有蒸馏方法将教师完整行为作为监督目标，在教师失败的状态上错误分配训练信用，而教师虽更强但并非全局可靠，因此需要一种只利用真正有益修正的改进机制。
AI.method: RE-0在学生的失败轨迹上请求教师局部修正，并在环境中验证修正是否真正有益；验证通过的修正直接提升策略。RE-OPD将验证过的教师干预转化为策略内蒸馏的分布级监督，按局部收益加权，并将改进投影回独立学生，使监督位置与教师信用随学生策略协同演化；同时给出学生每轮收益下界。
AI.result: 在多个Code-as-Policy具身任务中，RE-0同时提升了教师辅助执行和独立学生策略的表现，并能泛化到新机器人与新场景。
AI.conclusion: 递归验证的局部修正可有效替代全局教师监督，实现师生共同进化，为不可靠强教师下的策略改进提供了可验证、可泛化的框架。

title: READ-Bench: Benchmarking Historical Instance Retrieval for Time-Series Diagnosis
summary: Time-series diagnostic systems rarely rely on retrieving relevant historical cases, and when they do, retrieval is evaluated only indirectly through downstream prediction. We introduce READ-Bench, a benchmark for historical-case retrieval across 12 diagnostic datasets, centered on multivariate time series, that defines relevance by shared fault or event type rather than signal shape, so visually different traces of the same fault count as relevant while similar-looking traces of different faults do not. Treating retrieval as a base retriever followed by a reranker, we evaluate classical distances, symbolic retrievers, self-supervised and foundation-model embedders, and their fusion, plus label-aware and language-model rerankers, under one protocol that varies supervision, pollution, and corpus scale with significance testing. Under a common channel-independent interface, pretrained representations offer no statistically detectable advantage over strong classical and symbolic baselines for search alone. The decisive factor is a small amount of resolved-case supervision at reranking, namely a Gaussian-process reranker that propagates a few neighbor labels in embedding space, which helps far more than more sophisticated representations or language-model reasoning and holds under pollution and at full corpus scale. Guided by these findings, we fuse a normal-residual-scored embedder with a dynamic time warping leg via reciprocal-rank fusion, then rerank with the Gaussian-process reranker, improving NDCG@10 over its own search stage on all 12 datasets, by +0.11 from reranking and +0.16 over the strongest single base retriever.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 READ-Bench，一个面向多元时间序列历史案例检索的基准，覆盖12个诊断数据集，并以共享故障/事件类型而非信号形状定义相关性。研究发现，检索性能的关键在于重排阶段使用少量已解决案例监督，而非更复杂的表示或语言模型推理。
AI.motivation: 现有时间序列诊断系统很少依赖检索相关历史案例，即使使用检索，也仅通过下游预测间接评估，缺乏直接衡量历史案例检索质量的基准。
AI.method: 构建 READ-Bench 基准，覆盖12个诊断数据集，以多元时间序列为核心，按共享故障或事件类型定义相关性。将检索建模为基础检索器加重排器，统一评估经典距离、符号检索器、自监督与基础模型嵌入及其融合，以及标签感知和语言模型重排器，并系统变化监督、污染和语料规模，进行显著性检验。最终提出融合正常残差评分嵌入与动态时间规整检索腿的倒数排名融合方法，再用高斯过程重排器重排。
AI.result: 在通道独立接口下，预训练表示在单独搜索时相对强经典和符号基线没有统计显著优势。决定性因素是重排阶段少量已解决案例监督：高斯过程重排器在嵌入空间中传播少量邻居标签，效果远超更复杂表示或语言模型推理，并在污染和全语料规模下保持有效。融合方法在所有12个数据集上提升 NDCG@10，其中重排带来 +0.11，相比最强单基础检索器提升 +0.16。
AI.conclusion: 时间序列诊断中的历史案例检索，少量监督重排比复杂表示更关键。所提出的融合检索与高斯过程重排方案在全部12个数据集上一致提升检索性能，表明简单、监督高效的重排策略对实际诊断检索更有效。

title: Residual Learning-Based Control of Vehicle Platoons with $\ell_2$ Stability Guarantees via Recurrent Equilibrium Networks
comment: Submitted to the 2027 American Control Conference (ACC)
summary: This paper proposes a residual learning-based control framework for heterogeneous vehicle platoons subject to parametric uncertainty and external disturbances. A nominal controller designed via Linear Matrix Inequalities (LMIs), along with disturbance-observer compensation, is enhanced by a Recurrent Equilibrium Network (REN) trained offline using stored trajectories and nominal-model prediction errors. The REN is constrained to satisfy a prescribed $\ell_2$-gain bound, enabling sufficient small-gain conditions for local closed-loop stability and disturbance string stability. Experiments demonstrate reduced spacing and velocity errors relative to the nominal controller.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于残差学习的异构车辆队列控制框架，用于应对参数不确定性和外部干扰，并通过实验验证其相比标称控制器能降低间距和速度误差。
AI.motivation: 异构车辆队列在参数不确定性和外部干扰下，仅依赖标称控制器可能难以获得理想跟踪性能，因此需要一种既能提升控制效果又能保证稳定性的学习增强方法。
AI.method: 设计基于线性矩阵不等式（LMI）的标称控制器，并结合干扰观测器补偿；使用离线存储轨迹和标称模型预测误差训练循环平衡网络（REN）作为残差控制器；约束REN满足给定ℓ2增益界，从而利用小增益条件保证局部闭环稳定性和干扰弦稳定性。
AI.result: 实验表明，与标称控制器相比，所提方法降低了车辆队列的间距误差和速度误差。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够通过学习残差增强标称控制性能，并在异构车辆队列面临参数不确定性和外部干扰时提供稳定性与弦稳定性保障。

title: DRAM: Delta-rule Recurrent Associative Memory for Robot Manipulation Policies
summary: Robotic manipulation is inherently history-dependent, yet most pretrained robotic policies condition on only the current observation or a short temporal window. Equipping such policies with long-term memory remains challenging: existing approaches either feed the backbone multi-frame observation windows, which substantially increase inference cost, or rely on pre-defined semantic features, which limit task generality and may also require the retraining of the backbone to adapt to the memory. We introduce DRAM (Delta-rule Recurrent Associative Memory), a plug-and-play memory module that can be attached to a wide range of pretrained robotic policies, endowing them with long-horizon memory without architectural modification or backbone retraining, requiring only task-specific post-training of the memory module and action expert. DRAM maintains a fixed-size associative memory using gated delta-rule linear attention, with a modified update that incorporates all tokens within each frame in parallel. An architecture-agnostic readout integrates historical context into action prediction across different policy architectures. Experiments show that DRAM consistently improves frozen pretrained policies over short-context baselines and alternative compact memory designs, validating its effectiveness as a fixed-size, post-hoc memory module trained with the backbone frozen.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DRAM（Delta-rule Recurrent Associative Memory），一种即插即用的记忆模块，可在不修改架构、不重训练主干的情况下为预训练机器人策略赋予长时程记忆能力，仅需对记忆模块和动作专家进行任务特定的后训练。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作本质上是依赖历史的，但大多数预训练机器人策略仅以当前观测或短时间窗口为条件。现有赋予长时记忆的方法要么输入多帧观测窗口导致推理成本大幅增加，要么依赖预定义语义特征，限制了任务通用性且可能需要重训练主干网络。
AI.method: DRAM采用门控delta-rule线性注意力维护固定大小的联想记忆，并通过改进的更新方式并行纳入每帧内的所有token；同时设计了一种与架构无关的读出机制，将历史上下文集成到不同策略架构的动作预测中。该模块可即插即用地附加到多种预训练策略上，训练时冻结主干，仅对记忆模块和动作专家进行任务特定后训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，DRAM在冻结的预训练策略上持续优于短上下文基线以及其它紧凑记忆设计，验证了其作为固定大小、事后训练的记忆模块的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DRAM作为一种固定大小、即插即用、在主干冻结条件下训练的记忆模块，能够有效为预训练机器人策略赋予长时程记忆能力，且无需架构修改或主干重训练。

title: Supporting and Performing Culture from the Inside
comment: 9 pages, 1 figure, To appear in Findings of the 2026 Conference on Empirical Methods in Natural Language Processing (EMNLP 2026), Budapest, October 2026
summary: Anthropology and related disciplines which study culture have often found it useful to consider their epistemological and methodological approaches in terms of emic versus etic. This is the distinction between the insider perspective, how the world is viewed by a member of the culture, versus the outsider perspective, the scientific cataloguing of cultural knowledge and practice. We adopt this framework to systematically analyse assumptions in recent research on culture in NLP along the full pipeline of task selection, data collection, system design and evaluation. We draw attention to the `culture of NLP' which shapes the research focus and approaches of our field, and suggest pathways towards a more culturally attuned AI.

AI.tldr: 本文借用人类学的主位（emic）与客位（etic）框架，系统审视近期NLP文化研究中从任务选择到评估全流程的隐含假设。
AI.motivation: 人类学及相关文化研究常用主位/客位区分内部视角与外部视角，而NLP文化研究也需要反思自身的研究文化与方法论假设。
AI.method: 采用emic与etic框架，沿任务选择、数据收集、系统设计和评估这一完整流程，对近期NLP文化研究进行系统分析。
AI.result: 揭示了NLP文化研究中的潜在假设，并指出“NLP文化”如何塑造该领域的研究焦点与方法。
AI.conclusion: 应反思NLP自身文化，推动发展更具文化敏感性的AI。

title: PastForward: Faster On-Device GUI Agents via Computational Experience Reuse
summary: Running GUI agents on edge devices can keep sensitive screens and interaction histories local, but the computational cost of inference at every action step makes deployment challenging. Existing GUI agent systems either perform full vision-language model (VLM) inference at each action step or reuse coarse-grained knowledge matched to prior tasks. However, dynamic mobile environments and user tasks make it difficult to fully utilize prior task executions without additional fine-tuning or task-specific offline exploration. To address this challenge, we present PastForward, a system that accelerates GUI agents through validated, fine-grained reuse of computational experience accumulated during ordinary task execution. During decoding, PastForward retrieves prior output sequences as device-adaptive multi-token proposals and verifies them in a single VLM forward pass. Across action steps, it uses prior GUI transitions to begin next-step inference while the device executes the current action, retains the early computation only when the predicted screen matches the observed screen, and carries reusable KV states forward. We evaluate PastForward on AndroidWorld workloads derived from real mobile usage patterns using multiple VLM backbones across server and edge platforms. On device, PastForward achieves action-step latency speedups of 1.63-2.36$\times$ while maintaining task success rates.

AI.tldr: 提出 PastForward 系统，通过细粒度复用历史任务执行中积累的计算经验，加速边缘设备上的 GUI 智能体，同时保持任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 在边缘设备运行 GUI 智能体可以保护敏感屏幕和交互历史，但每个动作步骤都进行 VLM 推理的计算成本很高；现有系统要么每步全量推理，要么粗粒度复用先验任务知识，难以适应动态移动环境和用户任务，且往往需要额外微调或任务特定离线探索。
AI.method: 在解码阶段，PastForward 检索先前输出序列作为设备自适应多 token 提议，并在一次 VLM 前向传播中验证；跨动作步骤，它利用先前 GUI 转移在设备执行当前动作时开始下一步推理，仅在预测屏幕与观察屏幕匹配时保留早期计算，并向前传递可复用的 KV 状态。
AI.result: 在基于真实移动使用模式的 AndroidWorld 工作负载上，使用多种 VLM 骨干并在服务器和边缘平台评估。在设备上，PastForward 实现动作步骤延迟加速 1.63-2.36 倍，同时保持任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: 通过验证式细粒度计算经验复用，PastForward 能有效加速边缘 GUI 智能体，在动态环境中无需额外微调或任务特定离线探索即可维持性能。

title: Frequency-Domain AI-Generated Image Detection: Exploring Decoder and Channel Attention for Feature Refinement
comment: Accepted at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Optics, Machine Learning and Emerging Technology (OMLET)
summary: With the rapid progress of AI, the number of AI-generated images has increased significantly in recent years. However, the increasing variety of image generation models makes detection more difficult. In this work, we use Fast Fourier Transform (FFT) representation with EfficientNet-B0 for AI-generated image detection. EfficientNet-B0 provides a lightweight architecture that can be useful for resource-limited applications. Most frequency-domain detectors use a standard encoder to extract features from the FFT spectrum and directly pass them to a classifier. We explored a different approach by investigating ECA, U-Net, and Attention U-Net as alternatives to this direct encoder-to-classifier approach. ECA applies channel attention, while U-Net and Attention U-Net use decoder-based architectures to recover and refine spatial information in the extracted frequency features. We used a balanced subset of the MS COCOAI dataset that includes AI-generated images from five different models. Three runs were carried out for each experiment, and the average values were recorded. Experimental results indicate that EfficientNet-B0 obtained an accuracy of 84.64%, which is 4.50 percentage points higher than the ResNet-50 baseline reported in the dataset paper. EfficientNet-B0 with U-Net provided a small improvement, achieving an accuracy of 84.85%, while ECA did not increase the overall performance. EfficientNet-B0 with Attention U-Net achieved the best overall performance, with an accuracy of 85.51% and an ROC-AUC of 92.99%. This represents an improvement of 0.87 percentage points in accuracy compared to the EfficientNet-B0 baseline and 5.37 percentage points over the ResNet-50 baseline reported in the dataset paper.

AI.tldr: 本文使用FFT频域表示和轻量级EfficientNet-B0检测AI生成图像，并比较ECA、U-Net、Attention U-Net对频域特征的改进效果。
AI.motivation: AI生成图像数量快速增长且生成模型种类增多，使检测难度上升；同时需要适用于资源受限场景的轻量级检测方法。
AI.method: 采用FFT将图像转换到频域，并以EfficientNet-B0作为轻量骨干；探索ECA通道注意力、U-Net和Attention U-Net替代直接将编码器特征送入分类器的做法；使用MS COCOAI数据集中包含五类AI生成模型的平衡子集，每次实验运行三次并取平均值。
AI.result: EfficientNet-B0准确率为84.64%，比ResNet-50基线高4.50个百分点；EfficientNet-B0+U-Net为84.85%，提升较小；ECA未提升整体性能；EfficientNet-B0+Attention U-Net表现最佳，准确率85.51%，ROC-AUC为92.99%，比EfficientNet-B0高0.87个百分点，比ResNet-50基线高5.37个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 将Attention U-Net用于频域特征恢复与细化可提升AI生成图像检测性能，且轻量级EfficientNet-B0方案在资源受限应用中具有潜力；但部分改进如U-Net提升有限，ECA无效。

title: Noisy Test-Time Reinforcement Learning for Code LLMs
comment: This paper has been accepted by EMNLP 2026
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance across various code-related tasks. However, unlike carefully curated datasets that are typically high-quality and error-free, real-world user instructions are often vague and error-prone, posing significant challenges to the robustness of code LLMs. Furthermore, robustness-oriented fine-tuning relies on paired clean-noisy samples, which are costly to curate and require sophisticated noisy simulation techniques. To address these challenges, we propose the Noisy Test-time Reinforcement Learning framework (NTRL-Code), which enables robust self-evolution of code LLMs using only unlabeled noisy data during the testing stage. Specifically, NTRL-Code uses conservative self-denoising to obtain a cleaner semantic anchor for target estimation, and employs an abstract-syntax-tree (AST)-based structural aggregation mechanism to estimate a proxy target from multiple candidate programs. The policy is then optimized on the original noisy prompts with a hybrid reward that combines format validity, code similarity, and anti-repetition signals. Extensive experiments on three benchmarks, each incorporating character-level, word-level, and paragraph-level perturbations, demonstrate that NTRL-Code yields robust and consistent improvements, stabilizing the predictions of various base models. Our code is available at https://github.com/Xikai97/NTRL-Code.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出NTRL-Code框架，利用未标注含噪数据在测试阶段进行强化学习，使代码大模型自进化并提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 真实用户指令常模糊且含错，而现有鲁棒微调依赖昂贵干净-噪声配对数据和复杂噪声模拟，因此需要仅用未标注噪声数据提升代码LLM鲁棒性的方法。
AI.method: 采用保守自去噪获取更干净语义锚点，基于AST的结构聚合从多个候选程序估计代理目标，并在原始含噪提示上用结合格式有效性、代码相似性和抗重复信号的混合奖励优化策略。
AI.result: 在三个基准及字符、词、段落级扰动下，NTRL-Code取得稳定一致的鲁棒提升，稳定多种基座模型预测。
AI.conclusion: NTRL-Code证明仅用测试阶段未标注噪声数据即可实现代码LLM鲁棒自进化，为噪声环境下代码生成提供有效方案。

title: Before Answering: Evidence Sufficiency under Size-Matched Memory Construction
summary: Agents that answer questions from compressed or retrieved memory must recognize when the evidence a query needs is no longer in memory. Benchmarks for this task usually create insufficient-evidence examples by deleting supporting passages. We show that this construction leaks the label through memory size: on MuSiQue, a classifier that only counts paragraphs reaches an area under the ROC curve (AUROC) of $0.979$ for detecting unsafe memory, higher than the lexical estimator we initially evaluated. We propose a size-matched construction that provably removes this shortcut, and use it to study MemSafe, an estimator that cross-encodes the query with each memory unit and aggregates the units with a set transformer. Across three multi-hop question answering datasets and five seeds, MemSafe reaches $0.968$ and $0.983$ AUROC on MuSiQue and HotpotQA, $0.26$ to $0.39$ above a lexical baseline, while the third dataset, 2WikiMultiHopQA, is saturated. A frozen pretrained cross-encoder with a logistic head already closes $41\%$ of the MuSiQue gap between the lexical baseline and MemSafe. At the same time, MemSafe degrades more than a weak baseline on the unanswerable questions released with MuSiQue, reaches only $0.639$ AUROC on SQuAD~2.0, and needs several thousand clinical training examples before it outperforms a feature-based estimator. Used as a gate for a 7B reader, it reduces the error rate on answered questions from $0.850$ to $0.631$ at $5\%$ coverage, outperforming both reader confidence and, on average, the ground-truth integrity label, although a 7B LLM judge is the better gate at $10\%$ coverage. These results indicate that the way insufficient evidence is constructed matters as much as the estimator that detects it.

AI.tldr: 论文研究如何检测压缩或检索记忆中证据缺失的问题，指出原基准通过删除支持段落构造无充分证据样本，会因记忆大小泄露标签；作者提出大小匹配构造，并评估 MemSafe 估计器。
AI.motivation: 现有不足证据基准可能让模型仅凭记忆中的段落数量判断安全性，产生捷径并高估检测性能；因此需要消除该捷径，并可靠检测查询所需证据是否已不在记忆中。
AI.method: 提出 size-matched construction 以可证明地移除记忆大小捷径；MemSafe 将查询与每个记忆单元交叉编码，再用 set transformer 聚合。在三个多跳问答数据集和五个随机种子上评估，并与词法基线、冻结预训练交叉编码器加逻辑回归头、特征估计器比较，还将其用作 7B reader 的门控。
AI.result: 仅统计段落数量的分类器在 MuSiQue 上检测不安全记忆的 AUROC 达 0.979。MemSafe 在 MuSiQue 和 HotpotQA 上达 0.968 和 0.983，比词法基线高 0.26 至 0.39，但 2WikiMultiHopQA 饱和。冻结交叉编码器加逻辑回归头已弥补 MuSiQue 上 41% 的差距。MemSafe 在 MuSiQue 不可回答问题、SQuAD 2.0 和临床数据上表现有限或需大量样本。作为 7B reader 门控，在 5% 覆盖率下将已回答问题错误率从 0.850 降至 0.631，优于 reader confidence 和平均真值完整性标签，但 10% 覆盖率下 7B LLM judge 更好。
AI.conclusion: 不足证据的构造方式与检测估计器本身同等重要；记忆大小捷径会显著影响基准结论，MemSafe 有潜力但泛化与领域适应仍存在限制。

title: GlowTact: Simple and Compact Vision-Based Tactile Sensing with High Sensitivity and Spatial Resolution
summary: Vision-based tactile sensors (VBTS) provide rich contact information for robotic manipulation, but existing designs can be hard to simplify and adapt to the size and constraints of humanoid fingertips. We introduce \textbf{GlowTact}, a pressure-responsive vision-based tactile sensing mechanism that directly visualizes contact pressure. \textbf{GlowTact} requires only single-color, non-directional illumination, and the raw tactile image directly represents the pressure distribution without explicit geometry reconstruction. This simple sensing principle enables compact, customizable tactile sensors while preserving high sensitivity and rich spatial detail. We demonstrate gram-scale contact detection, accurate normal-force estimation, and reconstruction of fine contact geometry, including M1 screw threads. These results establish \textbf{GlowTact} as a practical new sensing technology for compact humanoid fingertips, combining a durable nitrile membrane and simple optical design with sensitive and information-rich tactile perception.

AI.tldr: 提出GlowTact，一种压力响应式视觉触觉传感器，可将接触压力直接可视化，无需复杂几何重建，适用于紧凑的人形指尖。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉触觉传感器虽能提供丰富接触信息，但设计复杂、难以简化和适配人形指尖的尺寸与约束。
AI.method: GlowTact采用单色、非方向性照明，通过压力响应机制使原始触觉图像直接表示压力分布；使用耐用丁腈膜和简单光学设计，无需显式几何重建。
AI.result: 实现克级接触检测、法向力准确估计，以及包括M1螺纹在内的精细接触几何重建。
AI.conclusion: GlowTact是一种适用于紧凑人形指尖的实用新型触觉传感技术，兼具简单、紧凑、可定制、高灵敏和信息丰富的特点。

title: SWT: Self-Supervised Video Object Segmentation via Sliding, Wavelet and Transportation
summary: Video Object Segmentation (VOS) aims to accurately segment target objects from consecutive video frames and track the changes of the objects in each frame of the video. Conventional VOS methods typically demand substantial quantities of pixel-level labeled video sequences for fully supervised learning, which limits the performance of the model in sparse video scenes, while existing VOS methods have limited adaptability to global changes in objects. Based on this observation, in this paper, we propose self-supervised VOS with Sliding window, Wavelet transform and optimal Transport (SWT), a self-supervised VOS framework entirely trained on static dataset using contrastive learning. Firstly, a rolling sample buffer reuses overlapping groups of independently sampled images across successive updates. Secondly, to address the long-distance modeling difficulty caused by simple convolutional structures, we introduce wavelet transform to expand the receptive field of convolutional kernels, thus improving the model's representational capability. Finally, we incorporate optimal transport to assist the model in finding the globally optimal match between the target across two frames, improving the model's ability to handle nonrigid deformations of objects. SWT only requires training on the COCO dataset once and achieves excellent results on five VOS datasets as well as an additional body part propagation dataset. The code will be released soon at [https://github.com/machine928/SWT.git](https://github.com/machine928/SWT.git).

AI.tldr: 提出自监督视频目标分割框架 SWT，仅用静态 COCO 数据集训练一次，结合滑动窗口、小波变换与最优传输，在多个 VOS 数据集和身体部位传播数据集上取得优秀效果。
AI.motivation: 传统 VOS 方法通常依赖大量像素级标注的视频序列进行全监督学习，在稀疏视频场景中性能受限；同时现有方法对目标全局变化的适应性不足。
AI.method: 构建完全基于静态数据集和对比学习的自监督 VOS 框架。具体包括：滚动采样缓冲区复用独立采样图像的重叠组；引入小波变换扩大卷积核感受野，增强长距离建模与表示能力；引入最优传输辅助跨帧寻找目标的全局最优匹配，提升对非刚性形变的处理能力。
AI.result: SWT 仅在 COCO 数据集上训练一次，就在五个 VOS 数据集以及一个额外的身体部位传播数据集上取得了优秀结果。
AI.conclusion: SWT 能够减少对像素级视频标注的依赖，并提升模型对目标全局变化和非刚性形变的适应能力，验证了仅用静态数据训练自监督 VOS 框架的有效性。

title: Where Does the Watermark Hide? Push-Pull Disentanglement for Invisible Watermark Removal
summary: Fixed image distortions do not cover an attacker that learns from paired clean and watermarked images. We study this paired-training threat with single-image inference: deployment uses neither the clean reference nor the watermark key, payload, or decoder. An encoder maps each image to a structural latent $g$ and an auxiliary residual latent $u$. Push supervision reconstructs the watermarked image from $D(g_w,u_w)$. Pull supervision trains the zero-auxiliary output $D(A_g(g_w;k),0)$ toward the paired clean image. At $k=1.10,u=0$, the four-method sweep gives an average BER of $0.3958$, PSNR of $31.07$ dB, and SSIM of $0.9554$. Restoring $u$ from $0$ to $0.15$ moves average BER from $0.3893$ to $0.3357$, while PSNR falls from $30.99$ to $28.23$ dB. The intervention supports decoder dependence on the auxiliary input in the evaluated setting. The accompanying theory is a conditional, post-hoc account of this behavior rather than an experimentally verified information-relocation result.

AI.tldr: 本文研究一种配对训练威胁下的单图像推理水印攻击/分析设定：部署时不需要干净参考图、水印密钥、载荷或解码器。方法将图像编码为结构潜变量 g 和辅助残差潜变量 u，并通过 push/pull 监督训练。实验显示在水印破坏与图像质量之间存在权衡，并支持解码器对辅助输入的依赖。
AI.motivation: 固定图像失真不足以刻画能够从干净图像与水印图像配对中学习的攻击者，因此需要研究这种配对训练且仅需单图像推理的威胁。
AI.method: 使用编码器将图像映射为结构潜变量 g 和辅助残差潜变量 u。Push 监督用 D(g_w,u_w) 重建水印图像；Pull 监督使零辅助输出 D(A_g(g_w;k),0) 接近配对的干净图像。通过四方法扫描和改变 k 与 u 进行评估，指标包括 BER、PSNR 和 SSIM。
AI.result: 在 k=1.10、u=0 时，四方法平均 BER 为 0.3958，PSNR 为 31.07 dB，SSIM 为 0.9554。将 u 从 0 恢复到 0.15 后，平均 BER 从 0.3893 变为 0.3357，而 PSNR 从 30.99 降至 28.23 dB。该干预支持在所评估设定中解码器依赖辅助输入。
AI.conclusion: 实验干预表明，在所评估设定下解码器依赖辅助输入；伴随理论是对该行为的条件性、事后解释，而不是经过实验验证的信息迁移结果。

title: TRAP: Understanding and Mitigating Privacy Memorization in Language Models
summary: Fine-tuning a language model on sensitive records can leave it able to reproduce them. We ask when this memorization arises and how to prevent it without knowing in advance which spans are sensitive. Our starting point is that most memorization scores and attacks share one statistical core: whether the model assigns a token more probability than some reference would. Taking as the reference a model trained on the complementary half of the same corpus gives the Target Reference Advantage (TRA), a per-token signal that separates what a model fit to a particular record from what it learned across records, and is cheap and differentiable. We then study what drives memorization during fine-tuning: it keeps growing well past the validation minimum, is larger on small datasets and at higher learning rates, and higher when the underlying task is harder. Early stopping removes much of it, but because it is chosen by aggregate validation loss it helps least for rare, hard-to-predict spans embedded in otherwise learnable text, which is exactly what sensitive information tends to be. We therefore introduce TRAP, a one-sided penalty on tokenwise TRA that acts only where the target model pulls ahead of its reference. On student essays with annotated personal information and clinical cases with patient identifiers, TRAP brings memorization near the level of an untrained model at little utility cost, where generic regularizers barely move and differential privacy gives up most of what fine-tuning bought.

AI.tldr: 论文研究语言模型微调时对敏感记录的记忆现象，提出逐token的TRA信号与TRAP惩罚，以在不预先知道敏感片段的情况下抑制记忆。
AI.motivation: 微调可使模型复现敏感记录；现有方法通常需要预先知道哪些片段敏感，或难以兼顾效用与隐私。
AI.method: 提出Target Reference Advantage（TRA）：用同语料互补半训练参考模型，比较目标模型与参考模型对每个token的概率优势，廉价且可微。分析记忆随微调的变化规律，并提出TRAP：对逐token TRA施加单侧惩罚，仅在目标模型超过参考模型处生效。
AI.result: 记忆会持续增长并超过验证损失最小值，在小数据集、高学习率和较难任务上更强；早停虽能减少部分记忆，但对嵌入可学文本中的稀有、难预测敏感片段帮助最小。在含个人信息的学生作文和含患者标识的临床案例上，TRAP将记忆降至接近未训练模型水平，效用损失很小；通用正则化几乎无效，差分隐私则损失大部分微调收益。
AI.conclusion: 无需预先标注敏感片段，通过单侧惩罚逐token的TRA即可有效抑制微调中的敏感信息记忆，同时较好保持模型效用。

title: CoMemBench: Benchmarking Collaborative Memory Boundaries across Multi-Agent Workflow Topologies
summary: Multi-agent workflows require task-relevant information to be shared across agents, while irrelevant, stale, unverified, or incompatible information must remain isolated. We call this task-conditioned scope of information a collaborative memory boundary. Workflow topology determines which intermediate artifacts are applicable to which downstream workers and when they cease to be valid, thereby providing a structural stress dimension for sharing and isolation. Existing memory benchmarks primarily evaluate retention and retrieval, whereas multi-agent benchmarks emphasize coordination and end-to-end completion, leaving topology-conditioned memory boundaries largely unmeasured. We introduce CoMemBench, an execution-grounded benchmark for collaborative memory sharing and isolation across multi-agent workflow topologies. It constructs 800 composite workflows across four domains from source-grounded dependency graphs, with node-local specifications, verifiable artifact handoffs, native evaluators, and matched isolation challenges. CoMemBench measures workflow completion, verified node progress, required-handoff reliability, isolation robustness, and token cost. Experiments reveal a sharing-isolation trade-off: broader context improves information availability but can weaken isolation, while system rankings shift across topologies and artifact violations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CoMemBench，一个基于执行的多智能体工作流协作记忆共享与隔离基准，用于衡量受拓扑条件约束的协作记忆边界。
AI.motivation: 多智能体工作流既要共享任务相关信息，又要隔离无关、过时、未验证或不兼容的信息；现有记忆基准侧重保持与检索，多智能体基准侧重协调与端到端完成，拓扑条件下的记忆边界基本未被测量。
AI.method: 构建 CoMemBench：从源依赖图生成覆盖四个领域的 800 个复合工作流，包含节点局部规范、可验证的产物交接、原生评估器和匹配的隔离挑战；评估工作流完成度、已验证节点进度、必需交接可靠性、隔离鲁棒性与 token 成本。
AI.result: 实验揭示共享-隔离权衡：更广的上下文提升信息可用性，但可能削弱隔离；不同拓扑和产物违规下系统排名会发生变化。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑条件约束的协作记忆边界是此前缺失的评测维度，CoMemBench 填补该空白，并表明系统需在信息共享与隔离之间取得平衡。

title: When World Models Lie: Adaptive Safety Analysis Under Wrong Imaginations
summary: World models offer a powerful substrate for safety reasoning in high-dimensional robotic systems, but they are also fallible: their predictions can be biased, miscalibrated, or confidently wrong. This creates a central challenge for latent-space safety filters, which often learn Hamilton-Jacobi safety value functions on the dynamics of a world model. If the world model is incorrect, the resulting value function can inherit its errors and produce overconfident safety estimates. Existing latent safety filters often rely on auxiliary signals such as ensemble disagreement or value-target consistency residuals for adaptation, but these signals can remain small even when the world model's predictions deviate from observations. We propose an adaptive latent safety filter that calibrates safety reasoning using directly observed world-model error. Our method uses Adaptive Conformal Inference to construct online uncertainty sets from discrepancies between predicted and observation-inferred latent states, then evaluates safety pessimistically by minimizing the learned value function over these sets. This allows the filter to remain minimally conservative when the world model is accurate, while becoming more cautious when observations reveal model mismatch. We provide a finite-time coverage guarantee for the adaptive uncertainty radius. Through simulation and hardware experiments, we show that our method significantly reduces failures relative to state-of-the-art latent safety filters while preserving task completion.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自适应潜空间安全滤波器，利用观测到的世界模型误差通过自适应保形推断构建在线不确定集，并悲观地评估安全价值函数，从而减少因世界模型错误导致的安全失败。
AI.motivation: 潜空间安全滤波器依赖世界模型学习哈密顿-雅可比安全价值函数，但世界模型预测可能偏差、失准或过度自信，导致价值函数继承错误并产生过度自信的安全估计。现有方法依赖的辅助信号（如集成分歧或价值目标一致性残差）可能在模型预测偏离观测时仍然很小，无法有效检测模型误差。
AI.method: 使用自适应保形推断（Adaptive Conformal Inference）根据预测与观测推断的潜在状态之间的差异构建在线不确定集，然后在这些集合上最小化学习到的安全价值函数以进行悲观安全评估。同时提供了自适应不确定半径的有限时间覆盖保证。
AI.result: 仿真和硬件实验表明，与最先进的潜空间安全滤波器相比，该方法显著减少了失败，同时保持了任务完成。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能有效校准安全推理，在世界模型准确时保持最小保守性，在观测揭示模型不匹配时更加谨慎，从而提升安全性。

title: Language Distances are Practical for Equitable Cross-Lingual Transfer
summary: Cross-lingual transfer is strongly conditional on how the source language is chosen, but it is impractical to determine the best candidate source for every target language, especially for low-resource target languages. Language distances are widely used to rank candidate sources due to their correlation with transfer efficacy and applicability in resource-sparse settings. However, the reliability of distance-based rankers across tasks and resource levels remains underexplored. We therefore present the first equity-focused evaluation of paradigms for ranking source languages, studying resource-level inequality and task inequality across ten cross-lingual tasks and two multilingual models. While both inequalities are most pronounced for individual language distances and an English-always baseline, they are substantially reduced by training-free composite distances, and nearly eliminated by trained rankers.
