We further demonstrate the reliability of rankers using language distances compared to rankers using language model internals. Overall, we find that language distances provide a practical basis for equitable and performant transfer language selection. We recommend using trained rankers when task-specific transfer evaluations are available, and composite distances otherwise.

AI.tldr: 本文首次从公平性角度评估跨语言迁移中源语言排序范式，发现复合距离与训练式排序器能显著缓解资源级和任务级不平等。
AI.motivation: 跨语言迁移效果高度依赖源语言选择，但为每个目标语言尤其是低资源语言寻找最佳源语言不现实；语言距离虽被广泛用于排序源语言，但其在不同任务和资源水平下的可靠性尚未充分研究。
AI.method: 在十个跨语言任务和两个多语言模型上，对源语言排序范式进行公平性评估，分析资源级不平等与任务级不平等，并比较基于语言距离的排序器与基于语言模型内部表示的排序器。
AI.result: 个体语言距离和“总是选英语”基线的不平等最严重；无训练复合距离能大幅降低不平等；训练式排序器几乎消除不平等。基于语言距离的排序器相比基于模型内部表示的排序器更可靠。
AI.conclusion: 语言距离为公平且有效的迁移语言选择提供了实用基础；若有任务特定的迁移评估，推荐使用训练式排序器，否则推荐使用复合距离。

title: Assisting for Open-Ended Tasks: Goal-Oriented Shared Autonomy as a Particle Filter
summary: A common approach for shared autonomy blends human inputs with autonomous assistance based on the human's likely goal. However, most existing approaches assume that a static set of possible goals is known a priori, which limits the use of such methods in unstructured assistive settings. We instead investigate how to enable shared autonomy with open-ended and dynamically changing goals. We formulate goal-oriented shared autonomy as a particle filter in which particles represent candidate human goals. Unlike conventional approaches with a fixed goal set, our transition model dynamically proposes new candidate goals as the interaction evolves, and human actions update the belief over these goals in real time. We instantiate this framework with foundation models (e.g., vision grounding and large language models) that propose context-relevant semantic goals, generate goal-conditioned assistance from low-level skill primitives, and refine those skills from human corrections. We assess our approach through a user study where 12 participants perform a variety of tabletop manipulation tasks with our method and state-of-the-art shared autonomy baselines. The results show that our particle filter-based approach reduces the amount of time users spend teleoperating the system and improves user satisfaction. User study videos: https://youtu.be/Ii26XuRqm9c

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种支持开放式动态目标的共享自主框架：将候选人类目标建模为粒子，并利用基础模型提出语义目标、生成辅助技能，同时根据人类纠正进行改进。
AI.motivation: 现有共享自主方法大多假设已知固定的候选目标集合，限制了其在非结构化辅助场景中的应用，因此需要支持开放式且随交互动态变化的目标。
AI.method: 将目标导向共享自主形式化为粒子滤波：粒子表示候选人类目标，转移模型在交互中动态提出新目标，人类动作实时更新目标信念；并使用视觉接地、大语言模型等基础模型提出上下文相关语义目标，基于低层技能原语生成目标条件辅助，并从人类纠正中细化技能。
AI.result: 在12名参与者完成多种桌面操作任务的用户研究中，与最先进的共享自主基线相比，该方法减少了用户遥操作时间，并提高了用户满意度。
AI.conclusion: 基于粒子滤波的开放式目标共享自主方法能够有效处理动态目标，提升辅助交互效率和用户体验。

title: Jev thinks "I don't know'', but doesn't say it: Introducing Sys1Cal-v1 Dataset for Probability Calibration
summary:
The appearance of Jev marked the era of System One Models, foundation models that return structured decisions with probability distributions rather than text. Aside from low cost and great speed, Jev's central promise is that these probabilities are calibrated: such claim is not backed by any public test and available external benchmarks evaluate confidence calibration, not whether every returned option probability has the right numerical meaning. To tackle this issue, we introduce Sys1Cal-v1, a dataset of True/False questions about a proposition $A$ for which the exact probability $P(A)$ is known by construction. Each item is queried through the three Jev primitives - Noul, Choice and Score - and evaluated by total variation distance from the ground-truth distribution, which can be used to estimate a soft accuracy of System One Models.
  We showcase the utility of Sys1Cal-v1 as a benchmark dataset by evaluating Jev and SemIf, an open-source Choice-style baseline. In this work, however, we focus even more deeply on Jev, by studying the calibration of its Score and Choice answers. In particular, we discover a peculiar behaviour that can be explained by assuming that Jev suppresses a third truth value, going beyond True and False. In other words, in 	exttt{Choice} answers, $P(A)$ and $P(
eg A)$ are presented as if $P(A)+P(
eg A)=1$, while a term $P(U)
eq0$ is missing in the sum. Recovering $P(U)$ leads to an improvement of median soft accuracy in 	exttt{Choice} answers from $0.771$ to $0.978$, suggesting that, even in binary decisions, Jev wants to answer with a third option:``I don't know''.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Sys1Cal-v1 数据集，用于检验 System One Models 返回概率的数值校准性，并发现 Jev 在二选一答案中可能隐藏了第三个真值 P(U)，恢复后能显著提升软准确率。
AI.motivation: Jev 等 System One Models 承诺返回结构化概率分布且概率经过校准，但缺乏公开测试；现有外部基准只评估置信度校准，而非每个选项概率是否具有正确数值含义。
AI.method: 构建 Sys1Cal-v1：围绕命题 A 的真/假问题，且真实概率 P(A) 由构造已知；通过 Jev 的 Noul、Choice、Score 三种原语查询，并用与真实分布的总变差距离评估，以估计软准确率。同时评估 Jev 和开源 Choice 式基线 SemIf，并重点分析 Jev 的 Score 与 Choice 校准。
AI.result: 发现 Jev 存在特殊行为：在 Choice 答案中，P(A) 和 P(¬A) 被呈现为满足 P(A)+P(¬A)=1，但实际缺少 P(U)≠0 的第三真值项。恢复 P(U) 后，Choice 答案的中位软准确率从 0.771 提升到 0.978。
AI.conclusion: Sys1Cal-v1 能揭示概率校准问题；Jev 的概率输出可能因隐藏“未知”选项而未正确校准。即使在二元决策中，Jev 也倾向于给出第三个选项，即“我不知道”。

title: High-Capacity Robust Medical Image Exfiltration via Neural Network Weight Replacement
summary: Collaborative medical AI platforms allow researchers to train models on sensitive imaging data while restricting data export. However, trained models can serve as covert carriers of patient information: medical images may be encoded within model parameters and reconstructed outside the secure environment. Existing defenses rely on lightweight sanitization (e.g., fine-tuning, pruning, quantization) and limited statistical auditing, creating a realistic insider exfiltration risk. We introduce a high-capacity neural steganography attack that encodes medical images as continuous latent representations embedded into model initialization. A StyleGAN2-based adversarial autoencoder learns compact latent codes regularized to match standard weight initialization statistics, keeping embedded parameters statistically consistent with clean models. Noise injection during training improves robustness to export-time mitigation. The carrier model remains functional on its intended task and hidden images can be reconstructed directly from its weights after export. This continuous encoding enables robust and scalable exfiltration, allowing up to 99 brain MRI volumes to be embedded within a 30MB model, and remains recoverable under mitigations that disrupt prior bit-level schemes. While reconstructions are approximate rather than pixel-exact, embedded content remains anatomically recognizable and recoverable at scale, exposing a privacy risk distinct from prior bit-level approaches. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR, BraTS, and LiTS demonstrate effectiveness across modalities, tasks, and architectures, highlighting the need for structural defenses beyond parameter-level sanitization. Code is available at https://github.com/ElieThellier/high-capacity-robust-medical-image-exfiltration.

AI.tldr: 提出一种高容量神经隐写攻击，将医学图像编码为连续潜表示嵌入模型初始化中，使模型在保持任务性能的同时可被导出并重建隐藏图像。
AI.motivation: 协作医疗AI平台虽限制数据导出，但训练好的模型可能成为患者信息的隐蔽载体；现有防御主要依赖轻量净化和有限统计审计，仍存在内部人员外泄风险。
AI.method: 使用StyleGAN2对抗自编码器学习紧凑潜码，并正则化使其匹配标准权重初始化统计；训练时注入噪声以增强对导出时缓解措施的鲁棒性；嵌入后载体模型仍可执行原任务，隐藏图像可直接从模型权重重建。
AI.result: 30MB模型可嵌入多达99个脑MRI体积，并在MIMIC-CXR、BraTS、LiTS上跨模态、任务和架构有效；重建虽为近似而非像素级，但解剖结构可识别且可规模化恢复，在破坏先前比特级方案的缓解下仍可恢复。
AI.conclusion: 该方法暴露了不同于先前比特级方法的隐私风险，表明仅靠参数级净化不足，需要更强的结构性防御。

title: GERIS: A Game-Theoretic Framework for Filtering Instance-Dependent Label Noise in License Plate Data Augmentation
comment: 23 pages, 4 figures. To appear in AUT Journal of Mathematics and Computing (AUT J Math Comput)
summary: In this paper, we propose GERIS, a game-theoretic framework for instance selection in the data augmentation phase of license plate recognition systems. During augmentation, synthetic license plate images are generated and transformed using stochastic noise to simulate real-world conditions. However, certain noise configurations lead to highly distorted, unreadable images that degrade model performance by introducing instance-dependent label noise. GERIS formulates a non-cooperative game in which each noise vector competes for inclusion in the training set based on its similarity to labeled data and its contribution to model reliability. By identifying and pruning low-quality instances, GERIS improves the overall quality of the augmented dataset. Unlike traditional black-box learning methods, GERIS offers a transparent, theoretically grounded mechanism for data filtering. Experimental results demonstrate that GERIS outperforms existing instance selection methods in terms of classification accuracy and robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GERIS，一个用于车牌识别数据增强阶段实例选择的博弈论框架，通过剔除因随机噪声导致低质量、不可读的合成车牌图像，提升增强数据集质量与模型性能。
AI.motivation: 数据增强中生成的合成车牌图像会经过随机噪声变换以模拟真实条件，但某些噪声配置会产生严重失真、不可读的图像，引入实例相关标签噪声，从而降低模型性能。
AI.method: GERIS将每个噪声向量视为非合作博弈中的参与者，依据其与标注数据的相似性及对模型可靠性的贡献，竞争被纳入训练集；通过识别并剪枝低质量实例来优化增强数据集，并提供透明、有理论依据的数据过滤机制。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，GERIS在分类准确率和鲁棒性方面优于现有实例选择方法。
AI.conclusion: GERIS能有效提升增强数据质量，避免低质量合成样本带来的标签噪声，相比传统黑盒学习方法更具透明性和理论支撑，适用于车牌识别中的数据增强实例选择。

title: Adaptive Safety Filtering for Frozen ACC Policies via Conformal Residual Calibration
summary: Frozen adaptive cruise control (ACC) policies can violate constraints when deployment dynamics differ from their training conditions. We propose residual-aware conformal action filtering (RACF), which calibrates residuals of a fixed nominal predictor and converts their quantile into an operating margin for finite-model action projection. Completed transitions update margins and candidate selection without retraining the policy. In a registered comparison over 2,400 controller-trial units, Adaptive RACF achieves 94.3% episode safety, improving by 19.9 percentage points over the evaluated nominal CBF-QP baseline while reducing projection frequency from 8.11% to 6.63%. A controlled study isolates a 4.54-point improvement from residual-margin injection. In a separate matched-hardware evaluation, Adaptive reduces mean amortized rollout time by 21.2% relative to Robust CBF-QP, with 161/180 versus 170/180 safe episodes. We characterize conditions linking one-step residual coverage to constraint satisfaction and quantify the observed safety-computation trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出残差感知保形动作过滤（RACF），通过校准固定名义预测器的残差并转化为操作裕度，在不重新训练策略的情况下提升自适应巡航控制的安全性与计算效率。
AI.motivation: 冻结的自适应巡航控制策略在部署动力学与训练条件不一致时可能违反约束，需要一种无需重训练即可适应部署差异并保证安全性的动作过滤方法。
AI.method: RACF校准固定名义预测器的残差，将其分位数转换为有限模型动作投影的操作裕度；完成的转移用于更新裕度和候选选择，而无需重训练策略。
AI.result: 在2400个控制器—试验单元的注册比较中，Adaptive RACF达到94.3%的回合安全率，比名义CBF-QP基线提升19.9个百分点，并将投影频率从8.11%降至6.63%；受控研究分离出残差裕度注入带来4.54个百分点的改进。匹配硬件评估中，Adaptive相比Robust CBF-QP将平均摊销展开时间减少21.2%，安全回合为161/180对170/180。
AI.conclusion: 论文刻画了一步残差覆盖与约束满足之间的联系，并量化了观察到的安全性与计算量之间的权衡。

title: Instruct, Not Answer: Using Instruction Privileges in On-Policy Context Distillation
summary: On-Policy Context Distillation (OPCD) has recently emerged as a powerful technique for transferring context to student models and for self-improvement. In OPCD, the teacher is conditioned on privileged information, and the goal is to minimize the Kullback-Leibler (KL) divergence between the privileged teacher and the student, evaluated on student-generated tokens. Many existing studies show that using instance-specific gold answers or gold demonstrations as the default privilege can hurt training performance, especially out-of-distribution (OOD). In this work, we instead design general instructions that target common student mistakes observed on the training samples, and show that such simple instructions can outperform gold as the OPCD privilege. In autoformalization tasks, using a matched formatting instruction as the privilege could outperform gold in OOD accuracy by a large margin. In 7 out of 8 experiments using ProverQA, ProofWriter, and ProntoQA as datasets, and Qwen3-Thinking and Olmo3-Thinking families as models, matched instruction privileges outperform gold in OOD by 4 to 17 points, while remaining on par with gold in-domain. Each instruction is only a few sentences (and thus contains much less information compared to all instance-specific gold) and is applied uniformly to every training sample. These results indicate that a general instruction, which applies equally to source and target domain examples, can be substantially more transferable than instance-specific gold in OPCD while maintaining in-domain performance.

AI.tldr: 本文研究On-Policy Context Distillation（OPCD）中的特权信息设计，发现针对学生常见错误设计的通用指令可替代实例级gold作为特权信息，在域外（OOD）显著提升性能，同时保持域内表现。
AI.motivation: 现有OPCD方法常将实例级gold答案或gold示例作为默认特权信息，但这类信息会损害训练表现，尤其在OOD场景中。作者希望找到更具迁移性的通用特权信息形式。
AI.method: 设计针对训练样本中学生常见错误的通用指令，并将其作为OPCD中的特权信息。教师在通用指令条件下对学生生成token进行指导，通过最小化特权教师与学生之间的KL散度来蒸馏。指令仅几句话，且统一应用于所有训练样本。
AI.result: 在自动形式化任务中，匹配的格式指令作为特权信息在OOD准确率上大幅超过gold。在ProverQA、ProofWriter、ProntoQA数据集以及Qwen3-Thinking和Olmo3-Thinking系列模型的8组实验中，7组显示匹配指令特权在OOD上比gold高4到17个点，域内表现与gold相当。
AI.conclusion: 通用指令可平等适用于源域和目标域样本，在OPCD中比实例级gold更具迁移性，同时保持域内性能，说明简单通用指令是更优的特权信息选择。

title: Gradients for Interventions and Activations for Detection: Targeted Feature Learning in Language Models
summary: Model-internal features can be studied through both their ability to identify a specified concept and their causal effect when manipulated, e.g., through steering or weight editing. A prominent approach to feature learning is Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs), which learn broad feature dictionaries whose relation to particular concepts is typically identified post hoc. However, many interpretability questions are instead hypothesis-driven and concern a concept specified in advance. We study this setting as targeted feature learning, where a single feature is constructed for such a predefined concept. We present a controlled comparison across three model signals (activation values, activation gradients, and parameter gradients) and two estimators (contrastive mean and a learned one-dimensional encoder-decoder), yielding six targeted methods, with CAA and GRADIEND as existing instances and four new methods covering the remaining combinations. We compare these methods against pretrained SAEs across 15 tasks and three language models, evaluating both detection and causal intervention. Across models, the strongest detection performance is achieved by contrastive activation value methods, whereas the strongest intervention performance is achieved by gradient-based methods. Overall, our results show that targeted feature quality depends jointly on the model signal and estimator, with detection and intervention capturing complementary properties.

AI.tldr: 本文研究面向预定义概念的“目标特征学习”，系统比较三种模型信号与两种估计器组合出的六种方法，并与预训练SAE在15个任务和3个语言模型上对比检测与因果干预表现。
AI.motivation: SAE等方法通常学习宽泛特征字典，再事后关联到特定概念，但许多可解释性问题本质上是假设驱动的，需要针对预先指定的概念构造单个特征。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为目标特征学习：针对预定义概念构造单一特征。受控比较三种模型信号（激活值、激活梯度、参数梯度）与两种估计器（对比均值、学习式一维编码器-解码器），形成六种目标方法，其中CAA和GRADIEND为已有实例，其余四种为新方法；在15个任务、3个语言模型上与预训练SAE比较，评估概念检测和因果干预。
AI.result: 最强检测性能来自基于对比激活值的方法，而最强干预性能来自基于梯度的方法；不同模型上结论一致。
AI.conclusion: 目标特征质量取决于模型信号与估计器的联合选择，检测与干预分别反映互补特征属性。

title: Think Fast, Plan Selectively: Adaptive Deliberation for Efficient Data-Driven MPC
summary: Data-driven model predictive control (MPC) combines learned world models with online trajectory optimization, achieving strong performance in continuous control. However, the per-step cost of sampling and evaluating hundreds of candidate trajectories restricts deployment to control frequencies well below what real-time robotics demands. Motivated by the dual-process theory of human cognition, which distinguishes between fast, intuitive processing (System 1) and slower, deliberative reasoning (System 2), we ask whether every decision requires the same degree of computational deliberation. We propose Fast-TD-MPC, a lightweight framework that adaptively routes between fast policy execution and test-time planning, reserving costly deliberation for states where it is most needed. Fast-TD-MPC delivers competitive task performance across 103 continuous control tasks while achieving up to ~4x faster inference. Under external disturbances, Fast-TD-MPC selectively falls back to planning, maintaining robustness comparable to the original planner.

AI.tldr: 提出 Fast-TD-MPC，一种在快速策略执行与测试时规划之间自适应切换的轻量级框架，用于降低数据驱动 MPC 的在线计算成本。
AI.motivation: 数据驱动 MPC 虽在连续控制中表现强，但每步需采样和评估大量候选轨迹，计算开销高，难以满足实时机器人控制频率；受人类双过程认知理论启发，研究是否每个决策都需要同等程度的计算 deliberative。
AI.method: Fast-TD-MPC 设计自适应路由机制：在大多数状态下使用快速策略执行，仅在最有需要的状态下调用昂贵的测试时规划，从而保留规划能力但减少每步计算。
AI.result: 在 103 个连续控制任务上取得有竞争力的任务性能，推理速度最高提升约 4 倍；在外部扰动下能选择性回退到规划，鲁棒性与原始规划器相当。
AI.conclusion: 通过按需分配计算 deliberative，Fast-TD-MPC 可在保持性能与鲁棒性的同时显著提升推理效率，使数据驱动 MPC 更适合实时机器人控制。

title: LQR-ArUco Fusion: Robust Hierarchical Control for Navigation and Asymmetric Manipulation in Two-Wheeled Robots
comment: 6 pages, 9 figures, 2 tables. Accepted for presentation at the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Navigation and Systems (CINS), Dubai, UAE
summary: We propose a hierarchical control framework to address severe dynamic instabilities and navigational drift that arise when a two-wheeled inverted pendulum (TWIP) robot attempts asymmetric object manipulation. While two-wheeled platforms are highly manoeuvrable, their constant balancing adjustments make onboard odometry highly unreliable for precise navigation. Furthermore, the addition of a side-mounted robotic arm introduces unactuated lateral roll moments when a payload is lifted, a challenge heavily compounded on uneven terrain. To solve these coupled problems, our architecture divides the workload. An offboard vision system tracks overhead ArUco markers to provide high-latency global waypoint navigation, bypassing odometry drift. Simultaneously, a low-latency onboard control loop rejects active physical disturbances using inertial and encoder data. In our physical experiments, this dual-loop approach enabled the custom-built robot to navigate accurately, reject transient impacts from speed bumps, adapt to a dynamic seesaw ramp, and carry a payload securely without falling over its narrow wheelbase.

AI.tldr: 提出一种分层控制框架，用于解决两轮倒立摆机器人在非对称物体操作中出现的严重动态不稳定和导航漂移问题。
AI.motivation: 两轮倒立摆机器人机动性强，但持续平衡调整导致机载里程计不可靠；侧装机械臂举升负载会产生未驱动的侧向滚转力矩，在崎岖地形上更难控制。
AI.method: 采用双环分层架构：离板视觉系统利用顶部ArUco标记提供高延迟全局航点导航，绕过里程计漂移；同时低延迟机载控制环使用惯性和编码器数据抑制主动物理扰动。
AI.result: 物理实验中，该双环方法使定制机器人在狭窄轮距下准确导航，抵抗减速带瞬态冲击，适应动态跷跷板坡道，并安全携带负载而不翻倒。
AI.conclusion: 该分层控制框架能有效解耦全局导航与局部扰动抑制，提升两轮倒立摆机器人在非对称操作和复杂地形下的稳定性与导航精度。

title: RECAST: Recasting Vision-Language Semantics into an Actionable Cost Map for Robot Navigation
summary: Safe and robust robot navigation across diverse environments requires a high-level understanding of complex scenes and the ability to carry it into stable motion. Recent works tackle this with learning-based models trained at scale and with approaches built on vision-language models (VLMs). However, learning-based models break down outside their training distribution, while VLM-based approaches bring that understanding but rarely ground it in the scene or align the action with it. To address these limitations, we present RECAST, a robot navigation framework that combines the reasoning of a VLM with the spatial grounding of vision foundation models to build an Actionable Cost map. Given the robot's front view and the user's instruction, we first decompose the scene with the VLM, judging which surfaces are traversable, which objects pose a risk, which heading to prefer, and which gaps are passable. Vision foundation models then ground these surfaces and objects in the image, and all four judgments are spatially recast into one compact cost map. This map both conditions the trajectory decoders and scores their proposals to select the one to execute. As the VLM's answers trail the live scene, both steps draw on cost maps from two points in time: the pivot frame the VLM judged, which carries all four judgments, and the current frame, whose terrain and collision costs are rebuilt from the current image. RECAST improves success over the strongest prior method by 13.3 points in simulation and 31.4 points on a real quadruped, and reduces the collision rate relative to it by 9.6 and 14.3 points, reaching the lowest collision rate among all methods. The project page is available at https://recast-nav.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出 RECAST 机器人导航框架，将 VLM 的推理能力与视觉基础模型的空间 grounding 结合，构建可执行的代价地图，以提升复杂环境中的安全与鲁棒导航。
AI.motivation: 现有学习型导航模型在训练分布外易失效，而基于 VLM 的方法虽具备高层理解，却往往缺乏场景 grounding，且未将理解与动作对齐，因此需要兼顾语义推理与空间定位的导航方案。
AI.method: RECAST 根据机器人前视图像和用户指令，先用 VLM 分解场景，判断可通行表面、风险物体、偏好朝向和可通行间隙；再用视觉基础模型将这些表面和物体在图像中定位，并把四类判断空间化重铸为紧凑代价地图。该地图用于条件化轨迹解码器并对其候选轨迹打分，从中选择执行轨迹。为应对 VLM 答案滞后于实时场景，方法同时利用 VLM 判断的 pivot 帧代价地图和由当前图像重建地形与碰撞代价的 current 帧代价地图。
AI.result: RECAST 在仿真中相比最强基线成功率提升 13.3 个百分点，在真实四足机器人上提升 31.4 个百分点；碰撞率分别降低 9.6 和 14.3 个百分点，并在所有方法中达到最低碰撞率。
AI.conclusion: 将 VLM 的复杂场景推理与视觉基础模型的空间 grounding 结合，并统一到可执行代价地图中，能够显著提升机器人导航的成功率与安全性，优于现有强基线方法。

title: PlurVA-LLM-2026 Shared Task Track-1: Pluralistic Value Alignment in LLMs via Multilingual Fine-Tuning and Threshold Calibration
comment: 11 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables, Accepted paper at the first workshop on Pluralistic Value Alignment of LLMs @ AACL-IJCNLP 2026
summary: We present our system for the PlurVA-LLM 2026 Shared Task Track-1, which focuses on pluralistic value alignment in the contexts of China, Indonesia, and Sri Lanka. For this resource-constrained track, we fine-tuned Llama 3.1 8B Instruct using 4-bit QLoRA. Our approach combines option-permutation augmentation for Chinese data, annotator vote expansion for Indonesian data, and binary reformulation with SinhalaMMLU augmentation for Sri Lankan data. We further applied conditional threshold calibration to the predictions for the Sri Lankan data. The final system achieved accuracies of 0.785 for Chinese, 0.715 for Indonesian, and 0.916 for Sri Lankan, resulting in an overall macro-average accuracy of 0.805.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 PlurVA-LLM 2026 Shared Task Track-1 的系统，针对中国、印度尼西亚和斯里兰卡语境下的多元价值对齐任务，在资源受限条件下微调 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct，最终取得 0.805 的宏平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 该研究面向资源受限的多元价值对齐任务，需要在中国、印度尼西亚和斯里兰卡三种不同文化语境中实现有效的价值对齐。
AI.method: 使用 4-bit QLoRA 微调 Llama 3.1 8B Instruct；针对中国数据采用选项排列增强，针对印尼数据采用标注者投票扩展，针对斯里兰卡数据采用二分类重构并结合 SinhalaMMLU 增强，同时对斯里兰卡预测应用条件阈值校准。
AI.result: 最终系统在中国数据上准确率为 0.785，印尼为 0.715，斯里兰卡为 0.916，总体宏平均准确率为 0.805。
AI.conclusion: 该资源受限方案在三个语境下均取得较好表现，尤其斯里兰卡数据表现突出，整体宏平均准确率达到 0.805，验证了所提微调与数据增强策略的有效性。

title: Witness: Discovery, Deciphering, and Epiphany in Interactive Puzzle Environments
summary: Automated science needs agents that can work out the rules of an unfamiliar environment by interacting with it. Interactive rule-discovery puzzles offer a controlled setting for studying this ability: an agent infers hidden rules through experimentation and uses what it has inferred to reach a stated goal. We ask what limits current language models on these puzzles and whether reinforcement learning (RL) improves performance on rules held out from training. To study both, we introduce WITNESS, a 2D grid-based puzzle environment with ground-truth ASCII observations and controlled access to rules. An agentic pipeline generates games for WitnessGym, the RL training suite, and WitnessBench, comprising public validation and private test games. The validation set separately tests new compositions of trained rule primitives and primitives absent from training. Under a shared harness, the best of 18 frontier proprietary and open-weight models solves only 24\% of private test level slots, with scores sensitive to the observation interface and agent configuration. Providing ground-truth rules raises Opus-5's validation RHAE-L5 (relative human action efficiency over the first five levels) from 59.9 to 97.8, whereas a 27B open-weight model gains only 2.1 points and remains limited even with the rules provided. RL on WitnessGym raises the 27B model's private test RHAE-L5 from 2.1 to 5.4 and yields a mean gain of 4.1 points on four external discovery benchmarks. Together, these results point to rule acquisition as a major difficulty for frontier models like Opus-5 while smaller models further struggle on rule-based execution, and indicate that RL on hidden-rule puzzles transfers to broader rules and real-world tasks beyond training. Benchmark is available at: https://witnessbench.ai

AI.tldr: 论文提出 WITNESS 交互式二维网格规则发现谜题环境及 WitnessGym/WitnessBench 基准，研究当前语言模型在隐藏规则发现与执行上的限制，并检验强化学习能否提升规则外推与迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 自动化科学需要智能体通过与环境交互来发现陌生规则。交互式规则发现谜题可受控研究该能力，但目前尚不清楚语言模型在此类任务上的瓶颈，以及强化学习是否能改善训练外规则的泛化。
AI.method: 构建 WITNESS 环境，提供带真实标签的 ASCII 观测和受控规则访问；用智能体流水线生成训练集 WitnessGym、公开验证集和私有测试集 WitnessBench，其中验证集区分已训练规则原语的新组合与未训练原语。在统一框架下评测18个前沿专有与开源模型，并分析观测接口和智能体配置影响；进一步在 WitnessGym 上对27B开源模型进行强化学习，并在4个外部发现基准上测试迁移。
AI.result: 最佳模型仅解决24%的私有测试关卡槽，得分对观测接口和智能体配置敏感。提供真实规则后，Opus-5 的验证 RHAE-L5 从59.9升至97.8，而27B模型仅提升2.1分且仍受限。RL 使27B模型私有测试 RHAE-L5 从2.1升至5.4，并在4个外部发现基准上平均提升4.1分。
AI.conclusion: 规则获取是 Opus-5 等前沿模型的主要难点，较小模型还额外受限于基于规则的执行。在隐藏规则谜题上进行强化学习可迁移到更广泛的规则任务和真实世界任务，表明该训练方式具有超出训练分布的泛化潜力。

title: Fracast-0: Fractal Weight Sharing for a Time Series Foundation Model with Only 85K Parameters
summary: Time series foundation models must preserve multi-domain breadth, probabilistic output, and multiple temporal scales, but parameter count grows when each scale receives a separate representation. We introduce Fracast-0, a probabilistic forecasting foundation model that exploits temporal self-similarity to reuse one operator across scales. A parameter-free detector extracts significant seasonal structure. The encoder applies a shared local block along a geometric dilation ladder with scale conditioning, while the decoder combines context-gathered states with an explicit seasonal future state and reuses a second block along another ladder before emitting nine quantiles. Pretraining across six corpora preserves multi-domain breadth within 85,001 parameters. On 97 GIFT-Eval configurations without per-dataset fine-tuning, Fracast-0 is the smallest of 28 evaluated checkpoints and remains non-dominated in the aggregate parameter-accuracy plane with MASE 0.808 and WQL 0.564. It uses 42.0% fewer parameters than TinyCast, whose MASE and WQL are 4.2% and 3.3% lower. These results support cross-scale weight reuse as a practical route to further time series foundation model compression.

AI.tldr: Fracast-0 是一个概率时间序列基础模型，通过跨尺度权重复用来压缩参数量，在 85,001 个参数下实现多领域概率预测，并在 GIFT-Eval 上保持较强精度。
AI.motivation: 时间序列基础模型需要兼顾多领域泛化、概率输出和多时间尺度，但若每个尺度单独表示，参数量会随尺度增加而增长。
AI.method: 利用时间序列自相似性，在不同尺度间复用同一算子；使用无参数检测器提取显著季节结构；编码器沿几何膨胀阶梯应用共享局部块并进行尺度条件化；解码器结合上下文聚合状态与显式季节未来状态，并沿另一阶梯复用第二个块，最终输出九个分位数。模型在六个语料库上预训练。
AI.result: 模型仅 85,001 个参数。在 97 个 GIFT-Eval 配置且不做逐数据集微调时，它是 28 个评测检查点中参数最少的模型，并在参数-精度聚合平面上保持非支配，MASE 为 0.808，WQL 为 0.564。相比 TinyCast，参数量少 42.0%，但 MASE 和 WQL 分别低 4.2% 和 3.3%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，跨尺度权重复用是进一步压缩时间序列基础模型的可行路径。

title: World SLAM Model: Joint World Modeling for SLAM and Navigation
summary: We introduce World SLAM Model (WSM), a unified framework that brings the SLAM paradigm directly into downstream navigation. Rather than treating SLAM merely as an upstream module that provides poses, maps or tokens, WSM adopts its core mechanisms, including incremental state updates with persistent memory and backend refinement of accumulated errors, to maintain a consistent world state during interaction. Given the current observation and a navigation goal, WSM predicts future visual states and jointly estimates their camera motion and dense geometry, grounding visual prediction in an evolving spatial world state. This spatial state is continuously updated as new observations arrive and provides the basis for action generation and closed-loop navigation. WSM is trained end-to-end with a joint navigation--SLAM objective, enabling downstream navigation to benefit directly from SLAM-style state maintenance and refinement while preserving accurate geometric estimation. Experiments demonstrate improved navigation performance together with strong SLAM accuracy, highlighting the potential of SLAM as an intrinsic mechanism for long-horizon world modeling and embodied interaction.

AI.tldr: 提出World SLAM Model（WSM）统一框架，将SLAM范式直接引入下游导航，通过增量状态更新、持久记忆和后端优化维护一致世界状态，并联合进行未来视觉预测、相机运动估计与稠密几何估计，端到端训练以提升导航和SLAM性能。
AI.motivation: 传统SLAM通常仅作为上游模块提供位姿、地图或token，未将SLAM核心机制直接用于下游导航。长时程世界建模和具身交互需要持续一致的世界状态，因此作者希望将SLAM作为导航的内在机制。
AI.method: WSM采用SLAM核心机制，包括增量状态更新、持久记忆和后端累积误差优化；给定当前观测和导航目标，预测未来视觉状态，并联合估计相机运动和稠密几何；空间状态随新观测持续更新，并用于动作生成和闭环导航；模型以联合导航-SLAM目标进行端到端训练。
AI.result: 实验表明，WSM在提升导航性能的同时，保持了较强的SLAM精度。
AI.conclusion: SLAM可以作为长时程世界建模和具身交互的内在机制，而不仅是上游定位与建图模块。

title: FA-Bench: A Benchmark for Word-Level and Phone-Level Forced-Alignment and ASR Timestamps Under Clean and Noisy Conditions
summary: Forced alignment aligns speech audio with a text transcript to generate word and phone timestamps. Published comparisons normalize transcripts, split the data and match boundaries differently, so their numbers cannot be read together. We present FA-Bench, an open framework that fixes those choices once and releases the code, splits, phone mapping, text normalization and scoring script, with results published periodically. Track 1 gives every aligner the reference transcript and Track 2 gives it a recognizer's output, on the same audio, clean and degraded four ways, with 21 open models and 9 commercial APIs under a unified protocol. We score every boundary of an utterance and check the two labels beside it, so a word the recognizer missed or invented is charged. Using a tolerance-based F1 as our primary metric eliminates the 9% to 14% score inflation that standard MAE causes on recognition-dependent systems in conversational speech. We then group boundaries by their position and how many adjacent words were recognized correctly, which shows where a system lost the score. We discovered systematic bias in how current systems time words, with Whisper about 150 ms early and several commercial ASR APIs over 50 ms late. Code and results are at https://github.com/olewave/fa-bench

AI.tldr: 本文提出FA-Bench，一个统一的强制对齐评测框架，固定文本规范化、数据划分、边界匹配和评分等选择，并在相同音频上以两条赛道、21个开源模型和9个商业API进行可比评测。
AI.motivation: 已有强制对齐评测在文本规范化、数据划分和边界匹配上做法不同，导致结果无法直接比较。
AI.method: 发布代码、划分、音素映射、文本规范化和评分脚本；Track 1使用参考转写，Track 2使用识别器输出；音频包含干净和四种退化条件；对每个边界评分并检查相邻两个标签，使漏识或虚识词被计罚；采用基于容差的F1作为主指标，并按边界位置及相邻词识别正确数分组分析。
AI.result: 基于容差的F1消除了标准MAE在会话语音中对依赖识别系统造成的9%至14%分数膨胀。发现当前系统存在系统性时间偏差：Whisper约提前150毫秒，多个商业ASR API约滞后超过50毫秒。
AI.conclusion: FA-Bench提供了一个可复现、可比较的强制对齐评测协议，能更公平地评估识别依赖型系统，并揭示不同系统在词时间戳上的系统性偏差。

title: PF-RL: Progress Field Reinforcement Learning via Goal-Conditioned Value Geometry for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Reinforcement Fine-Tuning~(RFT) has emerged as a promising paradigm for improving Vision-Language-Action~(VLA) policies, yet sparse task-level outcomes provide limited credit for intermediate transitions, especially in long-horizon manipulation. A natural approach is to model intermediate task progress and use it as dense feedback for policy improvement. Despite their architectural differences, existing progress-aware methods commonly formulate task progress as an explicit scalar prediction, providing limited structure for modeling how intermediate observations relate to the task goal, which may hinder effective transition-level credit assignment. We introduce Progress Field Reinforcement Learning (PF-RL), which learns a structured goal-conditioned progress representation over pretrained VLA features and converts it into dense credit for policy optimization. A lightweight shared Progress Field head maps current and goal representations into a compact progress space, where geometric distance induces goal-conditioned value, while complementary temporal and goal-structure objectives shape the learned geometry. Transition-level value changes naturally yield dense progress advantages, enabling fine-grained credit assignment for both offline policy improvement and online reinforcement fine-tuning. Extensive experiments on LIBERO, RoboTwin2.0, and real-world bimanual manipulation tasks show that PF-RL consistently improves policy performance over strong supervised fine-tuning, reinforcement fine-tuning, and progress-aware baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出PF-RL方法，通过学习结构化的目标条件进度表示，将中间任务进度转化为密集信用，用于视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的强化微调，在多个基准和真实任务上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 强化微调（RFT）能改进VLA策略，但稀疏的任务级结果难以为中间过渡提供有效信用，尤其长程操作任务。现有进度感知方法通常将进度建模为显式标量预测，缺乏对中间观测与任务目标关系的结构化建模，限制过渡级信用分配。
AI.method: PF-RL在预训练VLA特征上学习目标条件进度表示。轻量共享Progress Field头将当前与目标表示映射到紧凑进度空间，几何距离诱导目标条件价值，辅以时间和目标结构目标塑造几何。过渡级价值变化自然产生密集进度优势，支持离线策略改进和在线强化微调。
AI.result: 在LIBERO、RoboTwin2.0和真实双臂操作任务上，PF-RL一致优于强监督微调、强化微调及进度感知基线。
AI.conclusion: PF-RL通过结构化目标条件进度场实现细粒度密集信用分配，有效提升VLA策略在长程操作任务中的性能。

title: SinBrief: A Hybrid Framework for Abstractive Text Summarisation of Sinhala Legal Documents
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 3 tables, Accepted paper at the 13th Conference on Computational Linguistics and Speech Processing (ROCLING) 2026
summary: Legal document summarisation in low-resource languages presents significant challenges due to the scarcity of annotated data and the complexity of domain-specific terminology. This paper presents SinBrief, a hybrid abstractive summarisation framework for Sinhala legal documents that does not require human-annotated training data. The proposed framework combines domain-aware word graph construction with neural sentence scoring to generate abstractive summaries from Sinhala legal text. Five sentence scoring models are evaluated within the framework: mBert, Llama 3.1, Falcon 7B, Laser, and a continually pre-trained Llama model domain-adapted to Sinhala legal text. The framework is evaluated on a Sinhala legal corpus using reference-free metrics, including Coverage, Density, Compression Ratio, SummaC, and Self-BertScore. Experimental results demonstrate that SinBrief produces summaries with lower lexical overlap than extractive baselines while maintaining factual consistency, demonstrating the viability of hybrid, largely annotation-free abstractive summarisation for low-resource legal NLP tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SinBrief，一种面向僧伽罗语法律文档的混合式抽象摘要框架，无需人工标注训练数据，结合领域感知词图构建与神经句子打分，并在僧伽罗语法律语料上验证其可行性。
AI.motivation: 低资源语言的法律文档摘要面临标注数据稀缺和领域术语复杂的问题，传统方法难以获得足够训练数据，因此需要一种 largely annotation-free 的抽象摘要方案。
AI.method: SinBrief结合领域感知词图构建与神经句子打分生成抽象摘要；评估了五种句子打分模型：mBert、Llama 3.1、Falcon 7B、Laser，以及在僧伽罗语法律文本上继续预训练的Llama模型；使用Coverage、Density、Compression Ratio、SummaC、Self-BertScore等无参考指标在僧伽罗语法律语料上评估。
AI.result: 实验表明，SinBrief生成的摘要相比抽取式基线具有更低的词汇重叠，同时保持事实一致性，说明其在低资源法律NLP任务中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 混合式、基本无需标注的抽象摘要方法适用于低资源法律NLP任务，SinBrief为僧伽罗语法律文档摘要提供了一种可行方案。

title: Measuring the evolution of camera distance across a century of film
summary: The rise of computer vision and artificial intelligence has made possible new forms of large-scale computational measurement. We apply these techniques to a deep collection of 5,205 digitized films viewed in theaters between 1922-2025 (covering popular, prestigious, and independent movies) to trace the development of one of the most fundamental ways through which film communicates: by manipulating the space between the camera and its subject. This work finds abrupt changes with the rise of new technologies in sound and television, and allows us to shed an empirical light on gender disparity (women, despite having substantially less screentime than men, are disproportionately the subject of closer shots), and illustrate how animated films both inherit and break free from the norms of live-action filmmaking.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用计算机视觉与人工智能对1922—2025年间5205部影院电影进行大规模计算测量，追踪电影中摄影机与拍摄对象之间空间关系的演变。
AI.motivation: 电影通过操纵摄影机与拍摄对象之间的距离来传达信息，但此前缺乏大规模、长时段的实证测量；同时希望借此考察技术进步、性别差异以及动画电影等议题。
AI.method: 收集并数字化1922—2025年间的5205部电影，涵盖大众、获奖与独立影片，运用计算机视觉和人工智能技术进行大规模计算测量，分析镜头与主体之间的空间关系。
AI.result: 发现声音技术和电视等新技术的兴起伴随电影空间手法的突变；揭示性别差异：女性银幕时间显著少于男性，却不成比例地成为更近景别镜头的主体；并说明动画电影既继承又突破真人电影规范。
AI.conclusion: 大规模计算测量能有效揭示电影语言的长期演变，并为技术变迁、性别不平等及动画与真人电影规范关系提供实证视角。

title: A bilingual AI audiologist built through rubric-guided playbook induction outperforms human audiologists in a blinded evaluation of simulated cases
comment: 75 pages, including 51 pages of Supplementary Information
summary: Audiology consultation requires structured history-taking, audiometric interpretation and patient-centred communication, yet real-world case material is scarce. We present a bilingual AI audiologist pairing a general-purpose large language model with rubric-guided playbook induction, multimodal audiogram interpretation and retrieval-augmented grounding, without fine-tuning the language-model backbone. Using a 21-item rubric and an AI patient simulator, we induced a 19-rule consultation policy from 73 training cases (43 English, 30 Chinese) and evaluated the system on 58 independent simulated cases (30 Chinese, 28 English) in a pre-specified, source-blinded comparison with 17 practising audiologists. The AI audiologist outperformed human audiologists on every case (58/58; mean paired $Δ$ = +1.35 on a 5-point composite, Cohen's d = 1.84, $P = 4.5 \times 10^{-20}$), on 20 of 21 rubric items and in both languages. Component ablation identified the playbook as the largest contributor, offering a practical route to specialist consultation agents in low-data medical domains.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种双语AI听力学家，在不微调大模型主干的情况下，结合通用大模型、评分量表引导的“剧本”归纳、多模态听力图解读和检索增强 grounding，并在模拟病例中与执业听力学家比较，结果AI在每个病例上都优于人类。
AI.motivation: 听力咨询需要结构化病史采集、听力图解读和以患者为中心的沟通，但真实世界病例材料稀缺，限制了相关AI系统的开发与评估。
AI.method: 使用21项评分量表和AI患者模拟器，从73个训练病例（43英文、30中文）中归纳出19条咨询策略；系统无需微调语言模型主干，整合通用大模型、剧本引导、多模态听力图解读与检索增强；在58个独立模拟病例（30中文、28英文）上进行预设定、来源盲法评估，并与17名执业听力学家比较，同时进行组件消融分析。
AI.result: AI听力学家在全部58/58个病例上优于人类听力学家；5分制复合评分平均配对差异为+1.35，Cohen's d=1.84，P=4.5×10^-20；在21项评分标准中的20项以及中英文两种语言上均表现更优。消融实验表明“剧本”是最大贡献组件。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，剧本归纳是提升专科咨询AI性能的关键因素，为低数据医学领域构建专科咨询代理提供了一条实用路径。

title: RAO-Nav: Probing Omni-Language Models for Zero-shot Semantic Audio-Visual Navigation
summary: We explore whether Omni-Language Models (OLMs) can be directly applied to zero-shot Semantic Audio-Visual Navigation (SAVN). Recent work demonstrates that even state-of-the-art specialized models still struggle to achieve generalist multimodal navigation, despite extensive task-specific training. In this paper, we introduce RAO-Nav, short for Reasoning All-in-One OLM, a deployment pipeline for zero-shot SAVN. By leveraging the rich implicit audio-visual knowledge encoded in OLMs, the embodied agent is enabled to ``hear'', ``see'', ``reason'', and ``act'' in the environment. To further elicit the built-in thinking ability of OLMs, we propose a test-time Latent Navigation Reasoning (LNR) module that can be seamlessly integrated into the decoding space. LNR encourages the model to retrieve more target-relevant observations and make effective navigation decisions. Through comprehensive experiments, we show that our framework surpasses existing state-of-the-art baselines on public SAVN benchmarks without using any training data. Moreover, we introduce a new \emph{Global Navigation Instruction} setting to further evaluate the ability of OLMs to serve as embodied navigation agents. Code: https://github.com/rikeilong/OmniAV\_Nav.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 RAO-Nav，一种面向零样本语义音视频导航（SAVN）的全能语言模型部署流程，并结合测试时潜在导航推理模块 LNR，使智能体无需训练即可在环境中听、看、推理和行动。
AI.motivation: 现有专用多模态导航模型即使经过大量任务特定训练，仍难以实现通用多模态导航；作者希望探索能否直接利用全能语言模型（OLM）中隐含的音视频知识来完成零样本 SAVN。
AI.method: 提出 RAO-Nav 部署流程，利用 OLM 的隐式音视频知识驱动具身智能体进行感知、推理与动作；进一步提出测试时潜在导航推理（LNR）模块，可无缝集成到解码空间，引导模型检索更相关的目标观测并做出有效导航决策。
AI.result: 在公开 SAVN 基准上，RAO-Nav 在不使用任何训练数据的情况下超越了现有最优基线；同时引入新的 Global Navigation Instruction 设置，进一步评估 OLM 作为具身导航智能体的能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，全能语言模型可直接用于零样本语义音视频导航，并通过测试时推理增强实现优于专用模型的泛化导航表现，为通用具身多模态导航提供了新思路。

title: When Retrieval Hurts: Measuring and Explaining Retrieval-Induced Hallucination in Chest X-ray Report Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation is an attractive way to improve chest X-ray reporting, because reports from similar prior studies supply clinical context a general vision-language model lacks. We show the same mechanism is a reliable source of clinical error. Over 100 MIMIC-CXR studies with a frozen LLaVA-1.5 generator and BioMedCLIP retrieval, CheXbert clinical F1 doubles under relevant retrieval (0.201 to 0.402) and collapses to 0.043 under clinically mismatched retrieval, a fifth of the image-only score; the retrieval-induced hallucination rate, counting only unsupported findings traceable to retrieved evidence, rises from 0.00 to 0.76 and 0.98. To show this is not an artefact of evidence-set coverage, we introduce a coincidental-overlap control that scores image-only generations against evidence they never saw, placing the chance base rate at 0.18, four to five times below the observed rates. The generator does not merely acquire findings, it transcribes text: 95% of reports produced under relevant retrieval contain an eight-word span occurring verbatim in the retrieved evidence but absent from the reference, against 0% without retrieval. We then explain the mechanism: a normal chest X-ray retrieves at least one abnormal precedent in 24 of 28 cases, because medical image-embedding similarity is dominated by anatomy and acquisition rather than by the presence of disease. This has a direct design consequence. Retrieval similarity does not predict harm (RIH rates 0.80/0.80/0.60/0.84 across similarity quartiles), so relevance gates conditioned on embedding similarity cannot work; gating on predicted pathology agreement removes 61% of unsupported evidence at no cost to useful coverage. We argue that retrieval-augmented clinical systems must be evaluated under retrieval failure, not only under retrieval success.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示检索增强生成用于胸片报告时，检索证据既提供临床上下文，也可靠地引入临床错误：相关检索能提高报告质量，但错配检索会导致性能崩溃和检索诱导幻觉激增，模型甚至会逐字抄录检索证据。
AI.motivation: 胸片报告需要类似既往研究提供的临床背景，而通用视觉语言模型缺乏这种上下文；但检索机制本身可能成为临床错误来源，因此需要评估检索失败而非仅检索成功时的表现。
AI.method: 在超过100例MIMIC-CXR研究上，使用冻结的LLaVA-1.5生成器和BioMedCLIP检索，比较相关检索、临床错配检索和无检索条件；定义检索诱导幻觉（RIH），并引入巧合重叠对照估计偶然基率；分析逐字复制现象；进一步分析医学图像嵌入相似性的机制，并测试基于预测病理一致性的门控。
AI.result: 相关检索下CheXbert临床F1从0.201升至0.402，错配检索降至0.043，仅为纯图像得分的五分之一；RIH从0.00分别升至0.76和0.98；巧合重叠对照的偶然基率为0.18，远低于观察值；相关检索下95%报告含一个在检索证据中逐字出现但参考报告没有的八词片段，无检索时为0%；正常胸片在28例中有24例检索到至少一个异常先例，因图像嵌入相似性主要由解剖和采集而非疾病存在主导；相似度四分位间RIH为0.80/0.80/0.60/0.84，说明相似度不能预测危害；按预测病理一致性门控可去除61%无支持证据且不损失有用覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 检索增强临床系统必须在检索失败条件下评估，而不仅是检索成功时；基于嵌入相似性的相关性门控无法预测危害，应改用病理一致性等门控；设计需防范检索诱导幻觉和逐字抄录证据的问题。

title: LukeNet: A lightweight CNN integrated with an XAI model for Smart acute lymphoblastic leukemia detection and management
summary: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL) patients require early, accurate detection to enable timely treatment and effective patient management. A Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) is well-suited for creating an end-to-end enabling environment for ALL detection and classification. However, most CNN-based ALL detection systems are theoretical and unsuitable for deployment on edge devices due to high computational demands. The Internet of Medical Things (IoMT)-enabled devices offer an opportunity to monitor ALL patients in real time. Wearables that track temperature, heart rate, oxygen saturation, and activity can deliver critical data to support timely clinical intervention and improve patient outcomes. In smart IoMT environments, a lightweight CNN is essential because connected devices often operate under limited computational power, memory, and latency constraints. To address this need, this study proposes LukeNet, a lightweight CNN integrated with explainable artificial intelligence (XAI) for an IoMT-based SMART Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia Detection and Management System. Trained on three (3) ALL datasets and five-fold cross-validation, LukeNet achieved an impressive 99% model accuracy as well as 99% unseen test accuracy, which is higher than six state-of-the-art (SOTA) CNNs, such as DenseNet121, MobileNet, ResNet50, InceptionV3, Xception, and VGG16, as well as transfer learning models. Furthermore, LukeNet was compared with two ensemble models. In addition, explainable AI methods are integrated to highlight relevant regions in microscopic images. The novelty of this study lies in the architecture of LukeNet, which balances model depth and computational efficiency by using depthwise separable convolutions, mitigates the risk of gradient loss in deeper layers, and provides strong global and local feature extraction capabilities.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出轻量级CNN模型LukeNet，结合可解释AI（XAI），用于IoMT环境下的急性淋巴细胞白血病（ALL）智能检测与管理，并在多个ALL数据集上取得99%的准确率，优于六种SOTA CNN及迁移学习模型。
AI.motivation: ALL需要早期、准确检测以支持及时治疗和有效管理。现有CNN-based ALL检测系统多为理论性研究，计算需求高，不适合部署在边缘设备上。IoMT可穿戴设备可实时监测患者，但受计算能力、内存和延迟限制，因此需要轻量级CNN。
AI.method: 提出LukeNet轻量级CNN，采用深度可分离卷积以平衡模型深度和计算效率，缓解深层梯度消失问题，并增强全局和局部特征提取能力。在三个ALL数据集上进行五折交叉验证，集成XAI以突出显微图像中的相关区域。与DenseNet121、MobileNet、ResNet50、InceptionV3、Xception、VGG16六种SOTA CNN、迁移学习模型以及两种集成模型进行比较。
AI.result: LukeNet达到99%的模型准确率和99%的未见测试准确率，高于六种SOTA CNN及迁移学习模型，并与两个集成模型进行了比较。XAI方法能够高亮显微图像中的相关区域。
AI.conclusion: LukeNet在精度与计算效率之间取得平衡，适合IoMT和边缘设备部署，可实现实时、可解释的ALL检测与患者管理，具有较好的临床应用潜力。

title: Shared Worlds, Private Minds: Structured Memory for Long-Form Writing as World Creation
summary: LLM agents that write long-form fiction need an explicit memory of the evolving storyworld to keep new events consistent with established facts. Such memory must keep heterogeneous narrative information distinct, integrate story developments across granularities, and recover dependencies that a writing request leaves implicit. We present NarraWorld, a structured memory system for long-form writing that treats memory construction as world creation. From a shared evidence-grounded graph, NarraWorld derives four connected views: world facts, per-character beliefs, open developments, and hypothetical branches (possible-world continuations). Hierarchical aggregation with atomic closure consolidates events into scenes, plotlines, and plots, keeping each higher-level node traceable to its constituent source spans. For retrieval, planned reconstruction infers a query's dependencies from the current narrative situation and a preview of memory, then assembles the relevant records within a token budget. Across three writing benchmarks, NarraWorld achieves the strongest aggregate results. Its memory also transfers to situated role-playing and largely preserves recall on a general-purpose long-term memory benchmark, paving the way for agents that sustain coherent storyworlds across diverse narrative tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NarraWorld，一种面向长篇小说写作的结构化记忆系统，将记忆构建视为世界创建。它从证据图派生四类视图，并通过分层聚合与计划式重建检索，在三项写作基准上取得最佳综合表现，并可迁移到角色扮演与通用长期记忆任务。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体在长篇虚构写作中需要显式记忆不断演化的故事世界，以保持新事件与既有事实一致。这种记忆必须区分异构叙事信息、跨粒度整合情节发展，并恢复写作请求中隐含的依赖关系。
AI.method: NarraWorld 从共享的证据接地图出发，派生四个相互关联的视图：世界事实、各角色信念、开放情节发展和假设分支。采用带原子闭包的分层聚合，将事件整合为场景、故事线和情节，并保持高层节点可追溯到源文本片段。检索时使用计划式重建，根据当前叙事情境和记忆预览推断查询依赖，并在 token 预算内组装相关记录。
AI.result: 在三项写作基准上，NarraWorld 取得最强的综合结果。其记忆还能迁移到情境化角色扮演，并在通用长期记忆基准上基本保持召回能力。
AI.conclusion: NarraWorld 为智能体在多样叙事任务中维持连贯故事世界提供了可行路径。

title: SEES: A Self-Evolving Embodied System via Failure-Guided VLA Policy Adaptation
summary: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) policies demonstrate promising generalization across diverse short-horizon tasks. However, they remain unreliable on long-horizon tasks, partly because the large-scale training data is biased toward single-stage manipulation tasks that are cheaper to demonstrate. A single weak atomic skill can cause failures across multiple multi-stage tasks. To address such failures, existing methods often require experts to identify the bottleneck and provide additional demonstrations, making the improvement costly and potentially impractical after deployment. To this end, we present a Self-Evolving Embodied System (SEES) that learns from failures and improves the VLA policy without additional expert demonstrations. SEES decomposes long-horizon tasks into atomic tasks and routes them to corresponding family policies. Each family consists of related atomic skills that share one VLA adapter. During execution, the system automatically monitors atomic-task outcomes to identify the most frequently failing atomic skills as the current bottlenecks. To overcome these bottlenecks, SEES constructs tailored RL tasks in simulation by restoring previously encountered states and generating task-specific success criteria with an LLM. Online RL updates the shared family adapters to promote positive transfer among related atomic skills and cumulative improvement across evolution rounds. Extensive experiments show that SEES can be integrated with different VLA backbones to progressively improve their long-horizon performance. We also observe continued improvement on unseen tasks, providing evidence of transfer beyond the evolution settings.

AI.tldr: 提出自进化具身系统SEES，通过分解长时任务、监测失败原子技能并在仿真中用强化学习更新共享适配器，无需额外专家演示即可持续提升VLA策略的长时程表现。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA策略在短时程任务上泛化良好，但在长时程任务上不可靠，部分原因是训练数据偏向于成本较低的单阶段操作任务，单个薄弱的原子技能会导致多个多阶段任务失败。而现有改进方法依赖专家定位瓶颈并提供额外演示，成本高且在部署后难以实施。
AI.method: SEES将长时程任务分解为原子任务并路由到对应的家族策略，每个家族由相关原子技能组成并共享一个VLA适配器。执行时自动监测原子任务结果，识别失败最频繁的原子技能作为当前瓶颈。随后在仿真中恢复遇到过的状态，并利用LLM生成任务特定的成功标准来构建定制RL任务。在线RL更新共享家族适配器，促进相关原子技能间的正向迁移和跨进化轮次的累积改进。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，SEES可与不同VLA骨干集成，逐步提升其长时程性能。同时观察到在未见任务上性能持续改进，证明其超越了进化设置本身的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: SEES能够从失败中学习并自进化，无需额外专家演示即可有效克服长时程任务瓶颈，并具有良好的骨干兼容性与跨任务迁移性。

title: Seeing the Heat: Synthesizing High-Resolution Wood Thermal Responses from Optical Imagery
summary: The thermal behavior of wood is a critical factor in advanced material assembly. However, pixel-level thermal analysis remains fundamentally constrained by the low resolution and noise inherent to infrared thermography. To address this, we introduce an end-to-end computational framework that synthesizes high-resolution thermal responses directly from wood RGB images. We first establish a core physical linkage: because spatial color variation in natural wood is driven by cellular anatomy, optical intensity serves as a reliable geometric proxy for the localized solid volume fraction. By leveraging this theoretical insight, we develop an automated finite-element-method data engine that maps pixel-level optical intensity to a 3D thermodynamic voxel grid, generating high-fidelity synthetic thermal responses. We find that 1) when the thermal conductivity along the thickness direction is uniform or linear, wood RGB images and their corresponding thermal responses exhibit extreme morphological similarities, and the lateral thermal diffusion acts as a low-pass filter that smooths out high-frequency details; 2) when the thermal conductivity along the thickness direction is random, such morphological similarities are destroyed, and wood's 3D structure dominantly governs its thermal response. We further utilize these synthetic thermal responses to supervise a neural surrogate model built upon the DINOv3 foundation model. Our results demonstrate that the neural surrogate model successfully internalizes the governing thermodynamic laws, thereby bypassing computationally expensive simulations and enabling high-resolution thermal inference. This methodology effectively bridges the semantic and thermodynamic domains, unlocking systematic, pixel-level analysis of fine-grained wood thermal responses. Project: https://zekifayes.github.io/seeheat

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个端到端计算框架，可从木材RGB图像合成高分辨率热响应，并训练神经代理模型实现快速高分辨率热推断。
AI.motivation: 木材热行为对先进材料组装很重要，但红外热成像分辨率低、噪声大，限制了像素级热分析。
AI.method: 建立木材颜色变化与细胞解剖结构之间的物理联系，将光学强度作为局部固体体积分数的几何代理；开发自动化有限元数据引擎，把像素级光学强度映射到3D热力学体素网格，生成高保真合成热响应；再用这些数据监督基于DINOv3基础模型的神经代理模型。
AI.result: 当厚度方向热导率均匀或线性时，木材RGB图像与热响应形态高度相似，横向热扩散类似低通滤波，平滑高频细节；当厚度方向热导率随机时，这种形态相似性被破坏，木材3D结构主导热响应。神经代理模型成功内化了控制热力学规律，可绕过昂贵模拟实现高分辨率热推断。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效连接语义域与热力学域，为系统化、像素级的细粒度木材热响应分析提供了新途径。

title: Automatic Speech Recognition for the Basaà Language: A Low-Resource Approach
summary: The rapid advancement of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Natural Language Processing (NLP) has revolutionized the way humans interact with machines. Among the most impactful developments is Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR), which enables computers to convert spoken language into text. Systems such as those built on deep neural networks, transformer architectures, and self-supervised learning have achieved near-human performance for well-resourced languages such as English and French. Yet, these advances have disproportionately benefited a small fraction of the world's languages.

AI.tldr: AI与NLP推动语音识别快速发展，基于深度神经网络、Transformer和自监督学习的ASR系统在英语、法语等资源丰富语言上接近人类水平，但仅惠及全球少数语言。
AI.motivation: 探究或解决自动语音识别技术进步在全球语言覆盖上的严重不平衡问题，尤其是资源丰富语言与大量低资源语言之间的差距。
AI.method: 论文提及使用深度神经网络、Transformer架构以及自监督学习来构建自动语音识别系统。
AI.result: 这些ASR系统在英语、法语等资源丰富语言上已达到接近人类水平的性能，但相关进展只使全球一小部分语言受益。
AI.conclusion: AI与NLP虽已革新人机交互，但ASR的成果分布极不均衡，未来需关注和改善低资源语言的语音识别能力。

title: An Empirical Study on What Matters for Viewpoint-Generalizable Policies in Visual Imitation Learning
summary: Visual imitation learning is a promising approach to training robot manipulation policies capable of completing a wide variety of tasks. However, policies today remain brittle to viewpoint perturbations, making deployment in diverse environments a challenge. We present a controlled empirical study of which design choices allow visuomotor policies to generalize across viewpoints. We find that viewpoint generalization improves when dense visual tokens are retained and the action head participates in geometric reasoning. On a suite of simulated tasks that span a wide range of camera poses, we show that these design choices yield a policy that remains performant across viewpoints. As a practical consequence, a policy trained with these design choices also transfers zero-shot from simulation to the real world under random camera configurations.

AI.tldr: 本文通过受控实证研究探究视觉运动策略跨视角泛化的关键设计选择，发现保留密集视觉token并让动作头参与几何推理能显著提升视角泛化，并实现随机相机配置下的仿真到真实世界零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 视觉模仿学习在训练机器人操作策略方面很有前景，但现有策略对视角扰动非常脆弱，难以部署到多样环境中，因此需要明确哪些设计选择有助于跨视角泛化。
AI.method: 对视觉运动策略的设计选择进行受控实证研究，并在覆盖广泛相机位姿的仿真任务套件上评估不同设计；重点考察是否保留密集视觉token以及动作头是否参与几何推理。
AI.result: 保留密集视觉token且动作头参与几何推理时，策略的视角泛化能力更好；在广泛相机位姿的仿真任务中保持性能，并能在随机相机配置下从仿真零样本迁移到真实世界。
AI.conclusion: 保留密集视觉token并让动作头参与几何推理是提升视觉运动策略视角泛化的重要设计选择，也有助于实现真实环境中的零样本部署。

title: Why Directly Learning Periodic Trajectories Can Fail
summary: Operator learning of periodic solutions requires deciding how simulation data should be recorded and represented. A natural choice is to integrate long enough for transients to decay and record a window wide enough to contain at least one full period of all trajectories. We find that these conservative choices can make the resulting trajectories difficult to learn, even when the underlying periodic orbits vary regularly with system parameters. Unaligned trajectories generalize poorly even within the training distribution. Phase alignment substantially improves in-distribution generalization, but models trained on a fixed physical-time window still have large errors on trajectories with periods outside the training range. We explain both failures through a common mechanism: frequency differences accumulate over time, so the target phase varies rapidly with the parameters. Predictors that cannot track this variation incur a population MSE floor in both settings; for fixed window prediction, we also derive a per-sample lower bound. We then study one of the simplest representations that escape these floors: learning an aligned, normalized waveform and its period separately. We establish regularity of the decoupled targets under ODE assumptions and show experimentally that this approach avoids both failures in ODE systems and a PDE case study.

AI.tldr: 本文研究周期解的算子学习中的数据表示问题，指出长时间积分和固定宽窗口记录会导致轨迹难以学习，并提出将相位对齐后的归一化波形与周期分开学习可避免这些失败。
AI.motivation: 周期解算子学习中，仿真数据应如何记录和表示尚未明确；常见的保守做法（等待瞬态衰减并记录足够宽窗口）可能反而使轨迹难以学习，即使周期轨道随参数规律变化。
AI.method: 分析未对齐轨迹和固定物理时间窗口训练中的泛化失败，提出共同机制：频率差异随时间累积导致目标相位随参数快速变化，从而产生总体MSE下界；对固定窗口预测推导逐样本下界。随后研究解耦表示：分别学习对齐、归一化的波形及其周期，并在ODE假设下建立解耦目标的正则性，进行ODE系统实验和PDE案例研究。
AI.result: 未对齐轨迹即使在训练分布内泛化也很差；相位对齐显著改善分布内泛化，但固定物理时间窗口训练的模型在训练范围外周期的轨迹上仍有大误差。频率差异累积机制解释了两种失败，并给出MSE下界。解耦的波形—周期表示在ODE系统和PDE案例中避免了这两种失败。
AI.conclusion: 周期解算子学习的关键在于数据表示；直接记录长窗口轨迹会引入相位随参数快速变化的困难，而将对齐归一化波形与周期分开学习是一种简单且有效的逃逸下界的表示方式，在ODE和PDE案例中均表现良好。

title: MORPH: Self-Organising Multi-Robot Task Allocation via Neuroplasticity-Inspired Adaptive Topology
comment: Full version of the paper published in The 23rd European Conference on Multi-Agent Systems (EUMAS), 2026.The implementation and experiment scripts are available at https://github.com/Cyber-physical-Systems-Lab/morph_v2
summary: Multi-robot task allocation (MRTA) in dynamic environments faces a fundamental tension: effective coordination requires learned structure, but that structure must adapt when conditions change. Existing methods resolve this by assuming prior task knowledge, a utility function, a cost matrix, or a trained policy making them brittle when deployed without such knowledge or when task distributions shift. We present MORPH(Multi-agent Online Rewiring through Plasticity-guided Hierarchy), a training-free MRTA framework where global allocation quality emerges from 4 local plasticity rules (synaptic, homeostatic, structural, and metaplasticity) applied to a directed pairwise preference matrix updated from runtime co-occurrence and task-completion feedback. MORPH requires no task model, no bid computation, and no offline training; response decisions use learned AGV-to-Picker preferences rather than a fixed proximity rule. Within the Gerkey-Mataric MRTA taxonomy, MORPH is the first method in the single-task, single-robot, instantaneous-assignment class to learn directed pairwise allocation preferences online. Evaluated on the TA-RWARE warehouse benchmark (8-24 agents, 4 maps, 800 steps per episode, 5 seeds), MORPH achieves 110% of all-to-all throughput at N=24 while using only 21% of possible coordination links as an efficiency advantage that grows monotonically with fleet size. Under spatial task distribution shift, MORPH degrades 3x less than proximity-based methods while its learned preferences remain uncorrelated with Manhattan distance. Systematic ablation confirms all four plasticity rules contribute measurably. Two allocation properties emerge without programming: cross-type preference dominance and progressive preference sparsification, mirroring the developmental refinement of biological neural circuits. Learned preferences are driven by task co-occurrence history, not spatial proximity.

AI.tldr: MORPH是一个无需训练的在线多机器人任务分配框架，通过四种局部可塑性规则（突触、稳态、结构和元可塑性）更新有向成对偏好矩阵，在动态环境中实现高质量全局分配，并在TA-RWARE仓库基准上优于基于邻近度的方法。
AI.motivation: 动态环境下的多机器人任务分配存在根本矛盾：有效协调需要学习到的结构，但该结构必须随条件变化而适应。现有方法依赖先验任务知识、效用函数、成本矩阵或训练策略，导致在无知识或任务分布变化时表现脆弱。
AI.method: 提出MORPH（多智能体在线重布线通过可塑性引导层次），一种无训练MRTA框架。全局分配质量从四种局部可塑性规则（突触、稳态、结构、元可塑性）涌现，这些规则作用于根据运行时共现和任务完成反馈更新的有向成对偏好矩阵。无需任务模型、投标计算或离线训练；响应决策使用学习到的AGV到拣货员偏好，而非固定邻近规则。
AI.result: 在TA-RWARE仓库基准（8-24个智能体，4张地图，每回合800步，5个种子）上，MORPH在N=24时达到全对全吞吐量的110%，仅使用21%的可能协调链接，且效率优势随规模单调增长。在空间任务分布偏移下，其性能下降比基于邻近度的方法少3倍，且学习到的偏好与曼哈顿距离不相关。消融实验证实所有四种可塑性规则均有贡献。未编程即涌现出两种分配特性：跨类型偏好主导和渐进偏好稀疏化，类似生物神经回路的发展细化。
AI.conclusion: MORPH是Gerkey-Mataric分类中单任务、单机器人、瞬时分配类别下首个在线学习有向成对分配偏好的方法。学习到的偏好由任务共现历史驱动，而非空间邻近性，表明无训练、基于可塑性的机制可有效适应动态多机器人任务分配。

title: Beyond Volume Overlap: Surface Matching for Topology-Aware Coronary Artery Segmentation
comment: 12 Pages, 2 figures, Statistical Atlases and Computational Modeling of the Heart (STACOM) workshop of MICCAI 2026
summary: Accurate coronary artery segmentation on coronary computed tomography angiography (CCTA) is essential for diagnosing coronary artery disease. Deep networks are conventionally trained and evaluated with the Dice coefficient, but volume-overlap metrics are poorly suited to thin, tubular anatomy: since most voxels belong to a few thickproximal segments, a missing distal branch barely affects Dice despite severely disrupting the connectivity required for clinical use. We introduce a surface metric that matches predicted and reference surface points via bipartite assignment under a localized, vessel-radius tolerance, reporting precision, recall, and F1 with decoupled false positives (spurious branches) and false negatives (missed branches) a distinction the symmetric Dice cannot make. With it we show that a strong Dice-trained baseline omits far more vessel surface than it hallucinates, an asymmetry its high Dice hides. Building on this, we propose a differentiable surface loss that simultaneously suppresses spurious mass and recovers absent structure, validated by fine-tuning three backbones (nnU-Net, SwinUNETR, NexToU) on two public benchmarks (Image-CAS, ASOCA). Against a matched-epoch control, it significantly improves surface F1 by recovering missed distal vessels at comparable Dice. Our findings argue for measuring and optimizing the vessel surface, not the volume it overlaps. Code

AI.tldr: 该文指出Dice等体积重叠指标不适合细长管状冠状动脉分割，提出基于表面的评估指标与可微表面损失，以同时抑制虚假分支并恢复遗漏远端血管。
AI.motivation: CCTA冠状动脉分割对诊断冠心病重要，但传统Dice对薄管状结构不敏感：多数体素属近端粗段，遗漏远端分支对Dice影响很小，却严重破坏临床所需连通性；且Dice无法区分假阳性与假阴性。
AI.method: 提出在局部血管半径容差下，通过二分匹配预测与参考表面点的表面指标，报告精确率、召回率和F1，并解耦假阳性（虚假分支）与假阴性（遗漏分支）。进一步提出可微表面损失，同时抑制虚假质量并恢复缺失结构；在Image-CAS和ASOCA两个公开基准上微调nnU-Net、SwinUNETR、NexToU三个骨干网络，并与匹配epoch的对照比较。
AI.result: 表面指标显示，强Dice训练基线遗漏的血管表面远多于其虚构的表面，这种不对称被高Dice掩盖。微调后，与匹配epoch对照相比，方法在Dice相当的情况下通过恢复遗漏远端血管显著提升表面F1。
AI.conclusion: 研究主张应测量并优化血管表面，而非其重叠体积，以更好反映冠状动脉分割的临床可用性。

title: DualGuard: Dual-Mode Quality Control for Logic-Preserving Data Augmentation
summary: Large language models provide a practical way to generate augmented data for logical reasoning at scale, but a larger generation volume does not guarantee semantic, label, or logical reliability. Existing work has improved generation quality through generation constraints, candidate validation, filtering, and feedback-based revision; however, once a quality judgment is available, deciding whether a candidate should be retained, filtered, or repaired remains an important control problem. We propose DualGuard, a dual-mode quality-control framework for logic-preserving data augmentation. The first mode uses the current instance and candidate batch for selective retention, filtering, attribution, and targeted feedback. The second mode accumulates cross-instance execution records of augmentation actions on top of per-sample diagnosis and attribution, compares new executions against each action's own historical behavior, and supports retrospective anomaly inspection, targeted rollback, and bounded repair. Both modes share semantic verification and additionally use symbolic verification when a reliable logical form is available. Across seven downstream tasks in the Two-Stage Transfer setting, DualGuard achieves the highest Accuracy on five tasks and outperforms the no-augmentation BERT baseline on all seven. Controlled ablations further show complementary roles for Memory, Z3, and history-aware anomaly control.

AI.tldr: 提出DualGuard，一种用于逻辑保持数据增强的双模式质量控制框架，通过语义与符号验证以及历史感知异常控制，提升大模型生成增强数据的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可规模化生成逻辑推理增强数据，但生成量增大并不保证语义、标签或逻辑可靠；已有方法改善生成质量，然而在获得质量判断后，如何决定候选数据保留、过滤或修复仍是一个关键控制问题。
AI.method: 提出双模式框架：模式一利用当前实例与候选批次进行选择性保留、过滤、归因与定向反馈；模式二在单样本诊断与归因基础上积累跨实例的增强动作执行记录，并与各动作自身历史行为比较，支持回溯异常检查、定向回滚与有界修复；两模式共享语义验证，当存在可靠逻辑形式时额外使用符号验证（Z3）。
AI.result: 在Two-Stage Transfer设置下的七个下游任务中，DualGuard在五个任务上取得最高准确率，并在全部七个任务上优于无增强的BERT基线；受控消融进一步表明Memory、Z3与历史感知异常控制具有互补作用。
AI.conclusion: DualGuard能够有效控制逻辑保持数据增强的质量，提升下游任务性能，并验证了各质量控制组件的互补价值。

title: Clarify the User or Verify the World? Uncertainty Routing for Proactive Agents
summary: Tool-using LLM agents must decide not only whether additional information is needed, but also which source can resolve the uncertainty. Existing proactive approaches often specialize in either user clarification or environment verification, without explicitly determining the appropriate information source for each decision. We formulate this problem as uncertainty routing among ACT, CLARIFY, and VERIFY, and propose PROUR, a proactive uncertainty routing framework. PROUR decomposes action uncertainty into disagreement across plausible user-goal interpretations, which signals user-side ambiguity, and the entropy remaining within each interpretation, which signals missing world-side evidence. To acquire information from the routed source, a query generator is trained with a mode-conditioned information-gain reward, targeting user-goal identification under CLARIFY and next-action identification under VERIFY. On $τ$-bench, PROUR achieves 28.17% average success rate across retail and airline, outperforming the strongest prior method by 4.57% while using 2.17 fewer interaction steps. The learned policy further generalizes to stronger task agents and transactional domains of $τ^3$-bench without retraining, demonstrating the benefit of source-aligned uncertainty resolution for proactive agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PROUR，一个面向工具使用型 LLM 智能体的主动不确定性路由框架，将决策建模为在 ACT、CLARIFY 和 VERIFY 之间选择信息源，以解决行动不确定性。
AI.motivation: 现有主动方法通常只专注于向用户澄清或环境验证，未能显式判断每个决策应从哪里获取信息，因此需要一种能够为不确定性选择合适信息源的机制。
AI.method: PROUR 将行动不确定性分解为多种可能用户目标解释之间的分歧，用于指示用户侧歧义；以及每种解释内部的熵，用于指示世界侧证据缺失。根据路由结果，使用模式条件的信息增益奖励训练查询生成器：CLARIFY 下目标为用户目标识别，VERIFY 下目标为下一动作识别。
AI.result: 在 τ-bench 上，PROUR 在零售和航空任务中取得 28.17% 的平均成功率，比最强先前方法高 4.57%，同时减少 2.17 个交互步骤。学习到的策略还能无需重新训练泛化到更强的任务智能体以及 τ^3-bench 的事务型领域。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，面向信息源对齐的不确定性解决方式对主动式智能体有效，能够提升任务成功率、减少交互并增强泛化能力。

title: Masking Frequent Tokens Sharpens Direct Preference Optimization
summary: Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) aligns language models by optimizing over sequence-level sums of token-wise implicit reward differences. However, we identify a pervasive pathology in this formulation: a disproportionately small subset of high-frequency token types dominates cumulative sequence scores while appearing symmetrically across both preferred and dispreferred responses. Specifically, under canonical Qwen tokenization on Anthropic HH-RLHF, merely 69 token types account for $55.1\%$ of all response tokens and $85.9\%$ of within-pair shared token mass, exhibiting substantially lower preference-side specificity than the remaining vocabulary. This symmetric ubiquity induces gradient entanglement and dilutes the discriminative preference signal propagated through the objective. To resolve this issue, we introduce \emph{Anisotropic DPO} (\textsf{ADPO}) and its canonical realization, \emph{Frequency-Hard DPO}. Using a fixed, label-agnostic vocabulary mask, our method zeroes the implicit reward contribution of high-frequency response tokens while assigning unit weight to informative positions, thereby suppressing gradient interference without modifying preference pairs, discarding context, or introducing learned parameters. Here, \emph{anisotropy} designates non-uniform token-level objective weighting rather than representational geometry. Extensive empirical evaluations on AlpacaEval, MT-Bench, and Arena-Hard demonstrate that Frequency-Hard DPO consistently outperforms standard DPO across Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct and Llama-3-8B-Instruct, establishing that selectively masking shared high-frequency tokens offers an effective, zero-overhead mechanism for robust preference alignment.

AI.tldr: 论文发现DPO中少数高频token主导序列级隐式奖励差，稀释偏好信号，并提出Anisotropic DPO/Frequency-Hard DPO，通过固定词表掩码屏蔽高频响应token的奖励贡献，在多个基准上稳定优于标准DPO。
AI.motivation: 标准DPO按token级隐式奖励差求和进行序列级优化，但高频token类型在偏好与非偏好回答中对称且大量出现，导致梯度纠缠并削弱判别性偏好信号。
AI.method: 提出Anisotropic DPO及其实现Frequency-Hard DPO：使用固定、与标签无关的词表掩码，将高频响应token的隐式奖励贡献置零，并给信息性位置单位权重；不修改偏好对、不丢弃上下文、不引入可学习参数。
AI.result: 在Anthropic HH-RLHF与Qwen分词下，仅69个token类型占所有响应token的55.1%、同对共享token质量的85.9%。在AlpacaEval、MT-Bench、Arena-Hard上，Frequency-Hard DPO在Qwen-2.5-7B-Instruct和Llama-3-8B-Instruct上持续优于标准DPO。
AI.conclusion: 选择性屏蔽共享高频token是一种有效且零额外开销的机制，可提升偏好对齐的鲁棒性。

title: PEEL-DDPM: Physics-Enabled Evidential Learning for the Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Model
summary:
Normal-inverse-gamma (NIG) regression is not identifiable from its marginal Student-t likelihood: three combinations of four NIG parameters are determined, leaving one degree of freedom. We introduce PEEL-DDPM, a physics-enabled evidential learning framework for denoising diffusion probabilistic models. A measurement-conditioned DDPM is first trained with epsilon-MSE and then frozen. Its complete reverse trajectory produces a reconstruction, whose residual from the known training object is modeled by a final-image evidential network. The network learns only the identifiable Student-t coordinates, while repeated scanner-noise realizations and repeated diffusion trajectories provide a nested Monte Carlo estimate of final-image aleatoric variance, separated into scanner-induced and sampler-induced components. This measured variance resolves the remaining NIG ambiguity and yields a decomposition of predictive uncertainty into measurement, diffusion, and epistemic terms.
  The method uses sequential training without a cross-loss weighting coefficient. In a feasibility study on eight held-out objects, empirical central-interval coverages were 49.3%, 80.3%, 90.1%, and 95.6% for nominal 50%, 80%, 90%, and 95% intervals. The mean squared residual was 0.967 times the mean predicted variance, and a single-image aleatoric head achieved pooled Spearman correlation 0.785 against an independent nested reference. Across five dose levels, scanner-induced variance showed a log-log dose slope of -1.15, whereas sampler-induced variance remained nearly dose independent with slope -0.01. These results support PEEL-DDPM as a practical route to identifiable and physically interpretable uncertainty quantification in diffusion-based image reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 PEEL-DDPM，一种面向去噪扩散概率模型的物理可解释证据学习框架，用于实现可识别且可分解的不确定性量化，并在图像重建可行性研究中验证其校准性与物理可解释性。
AI.motivation: NIG 回归从其边缘 Student-t 似然中不可识别：四个 NIG 参数只有三个组合可确定，仍留有一个自由度。扩散图像重建需要既能校准又能区分测量、扩散采样与认知不确定性的不确定性量化方法。
AI.method: 先以 epsilon-MSE 训练测量条件 DDPM 并冻结；其完整反向轨迹生成重建结果。最终图像证据网络建模重建与已知训练对象之间的残差，仅学习可识别的 Student-t 坐标。通过重复扫描噪声实现和重复扩散轨迹进行嵌套蒙特卡洛估计，得到最终图像偶然方差，并分离为扫描仪诱导和采样器诱导成分；该测量方差用于解决 NIG 剩余歧义，并将预测不确定性分解为测量、扩散和认知项。训练为顺序式，无需交叉损失权重系数。
AI.result: 在八个留出对象的可行性研究中，名义 50%、80%、90%、95% 区间的经验中心区间覆盖率分别为 49.3%、80.3%、90.1%、95.6%。均方残差为平均预测方差的 0.967 倍。单图像偶然头对独立嵌套参考的汇总 Spearman 相关系数为 0.785。在五个剂量水平上，扫描仪诱导方差的 log-log 剂量斜率为 -1.15，而采样器诱导方差几乎与剂量无关，斜率为 -0.01。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明 PEEL-DDPM 是扩散图像重建中实现可识别、物理可解释不确定性量化的实用途径。

title: Certifying Interventional Agreement Among Observationally Equivalent Causal Models
summary: Observationally equivalent causal models can still disagree about what happens under intervention, because interventions create inputs that never occur in observational data. We introduce Interventional Separation Selection (ISS), which repeatedly queries the true system with an admissible intervention on which the surviving candidate models disagree, discards the candidates the outcome contradicts, and stops once no intervention within a cost bound separates the survivors. If the true system is among the candidates, this stopping condition certifies that every survivor agrees with it on every admissible intervention within the bound, a guarantee that no observational learner can give, however much data it sees. The stopping condition depends only on the survivors, so it can be checked without knowing the truth. For continuous variables the candidates form an infinite version space, and mixed-integer linear programs decide the stopping condition exactly over all of it, with agreement holding up to a tolerance. On a three-digit colored MNIST causal abstraction task in which ink hue tracks digit size, plain convolutional networks trained on examples reach zero held-out error, yet disagree with shape-based labels on 26% of single-digit edits, as often as hue-based labels do. Auditing the causal abstractions of networks observed only on such images, ISS certifies what each network perceives with 13.6 interventions per image on average, and each certificate, checked against every admissible intervention, holds whenever the network's true abstraction is among the candidates. When a network bypasses a unit that every candidate abstraction relies on, certificates covering interventions on that unit can be silently void, and twenty random validation interventions refute 69% of them.

AI.tldr: 论文提出介入分离选择（ISS），通过成本限制内的可允许干预区分观察等价的因果模型。若真模型在候选集中，停止条件可仅凭幸存候选认证其在所有可允许干预下与真系统一致；在彩色MNIST因果抽象审计中，ISS平均每图13.6次干预即可认证网络感知，并揭示旁路单元时证书可能失效。
AI.motivation: 观察等价的因果模型仍可能对干预反应不同，因为干预会产生观测数据中不存在的新输入。仅靠观测学习无法给出干预一致性保证，因此需要主动干预选择与认证方法。
AI.method: ISS反复在幸存候选模型存在分歧的可允许干预上查询真实系统，剔除与结果矛盾的候选，直到成本界内不再有干预能区分幸存者；停止条件只依赖幸存者。对连续变量，候选构成无限版本空间，用混合整数线性规划精确判定停止条件，一致到容差。在三位彩色MNIST因果抽象任务中审计CNN，以干预测试其感知的因果抽象。
AI.result: 若真系统在候选集中，停止条件认证所有幸存者在成本界内每个可允许干预上都与真系统一致，这是观测学习无法提供的。实验显示，普通CNN在留出集零误差，但在单数字编辑上与形状标签不一致达26%，与色相标签一样多；ISS平均每图13.6次干预完成认证，且证书在真抽象属于候选时对每个可允许干预成立。当网络绕过所有候选抽象依赖的单元时，覆盖该单元干预的证书可能静默无效，20个随机验证干预可反驳其中69%。
AI.conclusion: ISS提供了一种不依赖真值的干预认证框架，可在有限干预成本下保证候选模型与真实系统的干预一致性；但认证仍依赖候选抽象覆盖真实抽象及单元依赖等假设，旁路单元会导致证书失效，需注意验证与假设检查。

title: VisionPsy-Nano: Improving Accuracy, Efficiency, and Reliability in On-Device Vision-Language Models
summary: Sub-billion-parameter Vision-Language Models are increasingly viable for on-device deployment, yet compact model size alone does not guarantee usability. On a phone, such a model can still require more than two minutes to produce its first token. On-device usability depends on three axes: accuracy, efficiency, and behavioral reliability; standard benchmarks miss the third, with answers too short to expose doom loops and prompts too benign to probe adversarial safety. We introduce a diagnosis-driven post-training recipe in which a teacher VLM stress-tests the student, uncovers failure modes beyond human priors, and converts them into targeted supervision and preference alignment, supplementing generic data scaling with failure-driven optimization. Coupled with two visual-token policies, the recipe yields two accuracy-efficiency variants with improved behavioral reliability. \textbf{\NanoFull} attains a 62.3 normalized average over 17 benchmarks, the highest among openly released $\sim$0.5B models, +7.4 over its base at identical architecture and token budget, with doom-loop rates at or below the strongest baseline's. \textbf{\FlashFull} retains 61.4 while cutting warm time-to-first-token on a Pixel 9 from 138\,s to 6.1\,s (23$\times$). By jointly addressing all three axes, we move compact VLMs toward practical on-device usability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种诊断驱动的后训练方法，联合优化亚十亿参数视觉语言模型在端侧部署时的准确率、效率与行为可靠性，并给出两个变体 NanoFull 与 FlashFull。
AI.motivation: 紧凑视觉语言模型虽适合端侧部署，但模型小并不等于好用：手机上首次生成 token 可能仍需两分钟以上。端侧可用性取决于准确率、效率和行为可靠性三个维度，而现有基准多忽略行为可靠性，答案过短难以暴露 doom loop，提示过于温和也难以检验对抗安全性。
AI.method: 提出诊断驱动的后训练配方：由教师 VLM 对学生模型进行压力测试，发现超出人类先验的失败模式，并将其转化为针对性监督与偏好对齐，用失败驱动优化补充通用数据扩展；同时结合两种视觉 token 策略。
AI.result: NanoFull 在 17 个基准上取得 62.3 的归一化平均分，为公开约 0.5B 模型中最高，在同架构同 token 预算下比基座提升 7.4，doom loop 率不高于最强基线；FlashFull 保持 61.4，同时将 Pixel 9 上的热启动首 token 时间从 138 秒降至 6.1 秒，加速 23 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时解决准确率、效率与行为可靠性三个维度，该方法推动紧凑视觉语言模型走向实用的端侧部署。

title: Self-Reports Do Not Identify Self-Models: An Identifiability Test for Counterfactual Reports
summary: Language-model self-reports are evidence about behavior in a prompt environment, not by themselves evidence of a self-model. We investigate counterfactual reports about affect-like states under activation interventions and ask whether the report remains bound to the named intervention when the demonstration environment changes. Across three open instruction models, wrong-source demonstrations move reports toward the source answer family, while explicit mechanism binding reduces this pull. Self-report benchmarks should include environment-shift invariance tests under fixed intervention before treating accuracy as evidence for an autonomous report mechanism.

AI.tldr: 研究语言模型自我报告是否反映自身状态，发现其易受提示环境和错误来源示范影响；显式机制绑定可减少这种影响，并建议在自我报告基准中加入固定干预下的环境偏移不变性测试。
AI.motivation: 现有语言模型自我报告基准可能将准确率误认为自主报告机制或自我模型的证据，但自我报告本身可能只是提示环境下的行为表现。
AI.method: 在三种开放式指令模型上，通过激活干预考察对情感类状态的反事实报告；改变示范环境（错误来源示范），并检验显式机制绑定是否能让报告仍绑定于指定干预。
AI.result: 错误来源示范会使报告向来源答案族偏移，而显式机制绑定可降低这种拉动。因此，自我报告基准应包含固定干预下的环境偏移不变性测试。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型自我报告不能单独证明自我模型；只有在固定干预下通过环境偏移不变性检验后，才能将准确率视为自主报告机制的证据。

title: Prefill-Free Cross-Family KV Cache Transfer for Heterogeneous Multi-Agent LLMs
summary: Recent multi-agent LLM systems increasingly combine heterogeneous models for specialized agent roles. However, text-based communication requires each receiver to prefill shared context already processed by the sender. Reusing the sender's key-value (KV) cache avoids this redundancy, but prefill-free transfer across model families must handle differences in tokenization, model depth, and KV representations. To address these issues, we propose \textit{HeteroFold}, a prefill-free cross-family KV cache transfer method that keeps both the sender and receiver frozen. HeteroFold aligns model structures, maps the sender cache into the receiver space, and calibrates it to preserve receiver behavior. Across six transfer directions, HeteroFold achieves the best cache-transfer performance on all four long-context benchmarks and most short-context settings. It also matches text-based communication on the multi-agent benchmark. At 32K context length, Llama-3.1-8B$\rightarrow$Ministral-3-14B transfer is $10.7\times$ faster than Native Prefill and $1.18$--$1.47\times$ faster than the state-of-the-art prefill-free baselines, Dense Latent and KV Ridge. These results show that HeteroFold enables efficient cross-family KV reuse without receiver prefill.

AI.tldr: 提出 HeteroFold，一种无需预填充的跨模型家族 KV 缓存迁移方法，在保持发送方和接收方模型冻结的情况下实现异构 LLM 智能体间高效通信。
AI.motivation: 多智能体 LLM 系统常混合使用不同模型，但基于文本的通信会让接收方重复预填充发送方已处理的共享上下文。复用发送方 KV 缓存可避免冗余，但跨模型家族迁移需解决分词、模型深度和 KV 表示差异。
AI.method: HeteroFold 对齐模型结构，将发送方 KV 缓存映射到接收方空间，并对其进行校准以保持接收方行为；发送方和接收方均保持冻结，实现无预填充的跨家族缓存迁移。
AI.result: 在六个迁移方向上，HeteroFold 在四个长上下文基准上均取得最佳缓存迁移性能，并在多数短上下文设置中表现最优；在多智能体基准上匹配文本通信效果。32K 上下文时，Llama-3.1-8B→Ministral-3-14B 迁移比 Native Prefill 快 10.7 倍，比 Dense Latent 和 KV Ridge 快 1.18–1.47 倍。
AI.conclusion: HeteroFold 能在无需接收方预填充的情况下实现高效的跨模型家族 KV 缓存复用，为异构多智能体 LLM 系统提供更快的通信方式。

title: Copper-Policy: Focus on the Representation for Robust Robot Manipulation
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) acquire behavioral priors by modeling future scene evolution, but predicting detailed futures in pixel or latent space incurs substantial cost. Recent evidence that co-training gains persist without test-time generation raises a question: what must a WAM learn to improve control? We introduce Copper-Policy, which learns a compact World representation with the policy rather than relying on a predefined target space. Through temporal joint-embedding prediction, it predicts future observation embeddings conditioned on task intention without reconstructing pixels. This prediction and action decoding shape the representation jointly, while the policy retains access to current-frame spatial detail for execution. Representation analyses show that the learned features better separate task-driven change from perturbations and provide complementary information for control. Compact prediction targets reduce training tokens per sample, enabling a 2B-parameter model trained in 9.67 hours on 8$\times$ RTX 5090 GPUs and 6$\times$ faster than Fast-WAM on matched A100 GPUs. Copper-Policy outperforms every compared method without embodied pretraining on RoboTwin and several embodied-pretrained VLAs on LIBERO-Plus (80.85%). On three challenging real-robot tasks, it performs comparably to $π_{0.5}$ and attains a higher average score. Together, these results show that Copper-Policy combines strong control performance with efficient training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Copper-Policy，将与策略联合学习的紧凑世界表示用于世界动作模型，通过预测未来观测嵌入而非重建像素来提升控制性能，并显著降低训练成本。
AI.motivation: World Action Models 通过建模未来场景演化获得行为先验，但在像素或潜在空间预测详细未来代价高昂；近期证据表明联合训练收益在无需测试时生成的情况下仍存在，因此需要明确 WAM 为改善控制究竟需要学习什么。
AI.method: Copper-Policy 不依赖预定义目标空间，而是以策略联合学习紧凑世界表示；通过时间联合嵌入预测，在任务意图条件下预测未来观测嵌入，不重建像素；预测与动作解码共同塑造表示，同时策略保留当前帧空间细节用于执行。
AI.result: 表示分析显示学习特征能更好区分任务驱动变化与扰动，并为控制提供互补信息；紧凑预测目标减少每样本训练 token，使 2B 参数模型在 8×RTX 5090 上 9.67 小时完成训练，在匹配 A100 上比 Fast-WAM 快 6 倍；在 RoboTwin 上优于所有未具身预训练对比方法，在 LIBERO-Plus 上达到 80.85% 并优于多个具身预训练 VLA；在三个真实机器人任务上表现与 π_{0.5} 相当且平均得分更高。
