AI.conclusion: 结果表明 Copper-Policy 在实现强控制性能的同时具备高效训练能力，说明无需像素级未来生成、通过紧凑联合嵌入世界表示也能有效提升策略控制。

title: CLAP: Closed-Loop Alignment with Pressure for Precise Suction Manipulation
summary: Stacking and palletising demand precise placement: error left in one layer is inherited by the next, and a flat pad offers no feature to funnel a wrong pose into the right one. Top-down suction suits such dense arrangements, and suction has already been brought into vision-language-action (VLA) policies. What that work does not report, however, is a policy conditioned on a measured vacuum signal, or one that uses it to abandon an action already under way. Vision does not settle the question here, because at the moment it matters the cup and the face it holds occlude each other. We present CLAP, which makes the attachment state observable through a pressure module tapped into the vacuum line. The decoded reading replaces the suction command in the policy's proprioception, is fused with the visual features, and terminates the open-loop execution window so that the policy re-infers from a fresh observation. For data, we record goal-state disassembly on the physical robot and reverse the joint-state sequence offline, without a simulation replay. Targeted phase demonstrations, 8.3% of the training frames, cover the suction transitions and the configurations an interrupted grasp leaves behind. On a real Unitree Z1, one multi-task checkpoint reaches 96.67% average success in both colour settings, 16.67 and 10.00 points above the strongest baseline, its monochromatic four-block successes averaging 15.92 mm of error. Four ablation settings fall 5.00 to 13.33 points short. We will release code and trained weights.

AI.tldr: 提出CLAP，将真空压力信号接入VLA策略，使吸附状态可观测，并在动作中途失败时终止开环执行并重新推理，从而提升堆叠与码垛任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 堆叠和码垛需要精确放置，上一层误差会被下一层继承，而吸盘缺乏引导错误姿态的特征。现有吸盘VLA策略未利用实测真空信号，也不能据此中止已开始的动作；同时视觉在关键时刻因杯体与端面相互遮挡而无法判断吸附状态。
AI.method: 在真空管路中接入压力模块，解码读数后替换策略本体感知中的吸盘命令，并与视觉特征融合；该信号还用于终止开环执行窗口，使策略基于新观测重新推理。数据方面，在真实机器人上记录目标状态拆解过程，再离线反转关节状态序列，无仿真回放；并用占训练帧8.3%的定向阶段演示覆盖吸附转换和中断抓取后的构型。
AI.result: 在真实Unitree Z1上，一个多任务检查点在两套颜色设置中平均成功率达96.67%，分别比最强基线高16.67和10.00个百分点；单色四块任务平均误差15.92 mm。四个消融设置低5.00至13.33个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 通过压力信号让吸附状态可观测，并据此触发重新推理，可显著提升吸盘式VLA策略在真实机器人堆叠码垛中的成功率与精度；代码和训练权重将开源。

title: LAM: Efficient Lossy Agent Memory Framework With A Retrieval-Score Error Bound
summary: Agent memory grows as agents read inputs, reason, and call tools. Longer histories increase inference cost and eventually exceed the context window. LLM-based summarization reduces this history but adds latency and provides no explicit bound on information loss. We propose LAM, a Lossy Agent Memory system with three components: a deterministic deduplication rule with a substitution bound on retrieval scores - a bound on score perturbation, not a certificate of unchanged ranking; a memory manager that preserves the cached prefix and overlaps compaction with inference; and a performance model that estimates compaction costs before deployment. On 600 agent trajectories, LAM removes 22.47% of observation tokens while retaining 99.984% of the measured gold-patch evidence. At a fixed deletion set, the performance model predicts a 71.4x-91.6x end-to-end speedup from removing records before prefill instead of deleting them from a prefilled context. That benefit comes from the schedule rather than the rule and applies to any prefix-preserving test.

AI.tldr: 提出LAM，一种有损智能体记忆系统，通过确定性去重、前缀保留与推理重叠的压缩，以及部署前性能建模，在移除22.47%观察token的同时保留99.984%金标准证据，并预测端到端加速71.4x-91.6x。
AI.motivation: 智能体读写推理与工具调用导致记忆增长，增加推理成本并超出上下文窗口；基于LLM的摘要虽能压缩历史，但增加延迟且对信息损失无显式界。
AI.method: LAM包含三部分：带检索分数替换界的确定性去重规则；保留缓存前缀并将压缩与推理重叠的记忆管理器；部署前估计压缩成本的性能模型。
AI.result: 在600条智能体轨迹上，LAM移除22.47%观察token，保留99.984%测得的金标准补丁证据。固定删除集时，性能模型预测在预填充前移除记录比从已预填充上下文中删除可获得71.4x-91.6x端到端加速。
AI.conclusion: LAM可在信息损失极小的前提下压缩智能体记忆；其加速收益主要来自调度（预填充前移除），而非具体规则，适用于任何前缀保留的测试。

title: Streamlined Reflective Evolution for Task-Adaptive Self-Refinement Pipelines
summary: Reflective prompt optimization improves large language model (LLM) systems without updating model weights, but fixed architectures constrain how self-refinement is organized. We introduce Workflow-Designing Agents (WDA), a framework for streamlined reflective evolution of task-adaptive self-refinement pipelines. Starting from a minimal prompt, WDA jointly evolves stage instructions and their sequential structure. During evolution, we find that repeated revisions can accumulate redundant instructions in a single prompt. In WDA, we propose to address this problem with SPLIT, which redistributes these instructions across specialized stages. Three-example reflection and local screening guide selective search, while calibration scores guide Pareto admission and rollback of unhelpful trailing updates. The resulting pipelines are task-adaptive: their instructions and depth are learned from task data, then fixed for all test inputs within that task. We evaluate WDA on five benchmarks spanning knowledge, mathematical reasoning, multi-hop question answering, and instruction following. On Qwen3.5-9B, WDA achieves an average score of 51.24%, improving over the initial solver by 8.63 percentage points and the variant without SPLIT by 2.60 points. On GPT-4.1-mini, it achieves 49.00%, with corresponding gains of 5.62 and 3.69 points. These results support task-adaptive self-refinement as a complementary direction to broader agentic workflow search.

AI.tldr: 提出Workflow-Designing Agents（WDA）框架，通过反思式演化从极简提示出发，联合优化自细化流程的阶段指令与顺序结构，实现任务自适应的自细化流水线。
AI.motivation: 现有反思式提示优化虽无需更新模型权重，但固定架构限制了自细化的组织方式，需要一种能自动设计并演化任务自适应自细化流水线的方法。
AI.method: WDA从最小提示开始，联合演化各阶段指令及其顺序结构；针对反复修订导致的指令冗余，提出SPLIT将指令重新分配到专门阶段；采用三示例反思、局部筛选进行选择性搜索，并用校准分数指导帕累托准入与无效更新的回滚，最终为每个任务学习固定的指令和深度。
AI.result: 在知识、数学推理、多跳问答和指令遵循五个基准上，Qwen3.5-9B平均得分51.24%，比初始求解器高8.63个百分点，比无SPLIT变体高2.60个百分点；GPT-4.1-mini得分49.00%，对应增益分别为5.62和3.69个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 任务自适应自细化是更广泛智能体工作流搜索的一个互补方向，WDA能有效提升LLM系统性能。

title: CollisionGAT: Controller-Agnostic One-Step Collision Screening for Multi-Agent Motion
comment: 5 pages, 4 figures, 1 table, 2 algorithms. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE MIT Undergraduate Research Technology Conference (URTC)
summary: Before a team of robots moves, each proposed step must be checked for collisions with other robots and with obstacles. We present CollisionGAT, a graph-attention network that reads the current and proposed states of moving agents together with locally relevant stationary obstacles and returns one collision-risk score per moving agent. Any controller can use these scores to accept, repair, replan, or postpone a proposed step. We mount CollisionGAT on a continuous path-following controller and on GATeD, an obstacle-blind D* Lite planner that uses typed vetoes to update its planning graphs. Exact geometric checks supply the training labels and independently audit every executed step.

AI.tldr: 提出 CollisionGAT，一种图注意力网络，用于在多机器人移动前评估每个机器人 proposed step 的碰撞风险，并输出每个移动 agent 的碰撞风险分数。
AI.motivation: 机器人团队移动前，必须检查 proposed step 是否与其他机器人及障碍物发生碰撞，因此需要一种可集成到控制器或规划器中的碰撞风险预测方法。
AI.method: CollisionGAT 读取移动 agent 的当前状态、proposed 状态以及局部相关静态障碍物，输出每个移动 agent 的碰撞风险分数。该分数可供任意控制器用于接受、修复、重新规划或推迟 proposed step。作者将其接入连续路径跟踪控制器和 GATeD（一种使用 typed vetoes 更新规划图的障碍盲 D* Lite 规划器）。训练标签来自精确几何检查，执行步骤也由精确几何检查独立审计。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量实验结果，但表明 CollisionGAT 能生成逐 agent 碰撞风险分数，并可成功集成到路径跟踪控制器和 GATeD 规划器中，以支持碰撞风险决策。
AI.conclusion: CollisionGAT 为多机器人系统提供了一种可集成的碰撞风险评分机制，使控制器或规划器能够在执行前对 proposed step 进行接受、修复、重规划或推迟，并结合精确几何检查进行标签生成与独立验证。

title: When Does a Skill Add Value? Task-Conditional Gain Prediction for Selective Skill Use
summary: Agent skills are expected to improve task performance. Yet we find that they often provide no benefit, and can even hurt performance while incurring additional token costs. Can we predict whether a skill will help before the agent acts? We introduce SkillDelta, a framework for predicting task-conditional skill gains from paired executions of the same agent with and without the skill. A local predictor transfers these historical gains to new tasks without retraining the agent. Under explicit transfer assumptions, our analysis links support coverage, representation mismatch, and execution noise to prediction error and decision regret. Across five benchmarks and three target agents, paired history improves observed-gain ranking over skill-assisted outcomes alone in 12 of 15 settings. At matched expected skill-use rates, SkillDelta improves success over random activation in all 15 settings, with an average absolute gain of 4.3%. Most of this advantage comes from allocation across task groups. Evidence for additional within-group selection value is strongest on ToolQA and weaker elsewhere. Code is available at https://github.com/TankTechnology/skilldelta.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SkillDelta 框架，利用同一智能体在有/无技能条件下的配对执行历史，预测新任务上技能是否值得使用，从而避免无效技能带来的性能下降和额外 token 成本。
AI.motivation: 智能体技能通常被认为能提升任务表现，但研究发现技能往往无益甚至有害，并增加 token 开销。因此，核心问题是在智能体行动前预测技能是否会带来收益。
AI.method: SkillDelta 通过同一智能体在启用与未启用技能时的配对执行，估计任务条件下的技能增益；使用局部预测器将历史增益迁移到新任务，无需重新训练智能体。理论分析在显式迁移假设下，将支持覆盖、表示不匹配和执行噪声与预测误差及决策后悔联系起来。
AI.result: 在五个基准和三个目标智能体上，配对历史在 15 个设置中的 12 个提升了观测增益排序；在匹配预期技能使用率时，SkillDelta 在全部 15 个设置中优于随机激活，平均绝对成功率提升 4.3%。其优势主要来自跨任务组的分配；组内选择价值在 ToolQA 上最强，其他场景较弱。
AI.conclusion: SkillDelta 能有效预测任务条件下的技能收益并改善技能使用决策，尤其擅长跨任务组分配，但组内细粒度选择的额外价值有限。代码已开源。

title: What Should the Reflector See? An Empirical Study of Evidence in Reflective Prompt Optimization
summary: Reflective prompt optimization revises instructions using examples of a model's behavior, but which evidence the reflector should receive remains unclear. We study evidence composition, visibility of examples, candidate selection and domain-knowledge policy within a single-parent Pareto-guided search. Using Qwen3.5-9B as both task model and reflector, we evaluate nine reflection strategies on five datasets. From these experiments, we find three distinct patterns. For performance improvement, Failures-only produces the largest mean test gain (+8.0 percentage points), while Balanced-mix and No-examples+Val share the best mean performance rank. For reflection effectiveness, No-examples achieves the best rank for improving sampled parents, yet yields only a 1.4-point mean test gain: local reflection success does not necessarily produce a stronger final prompt. For overfitting assessment, Failures-only and Balanced-mix share the lowest mean calibration-gap rank, while larger gaps on GPQA and IFBench show that calibration gains can overstate held-out improvement. This gap is a descriptive indicator, not a direct measure of overfitting. Together, these results show why reflection strategies should be assessed separately on final performance, parent improvement and calibration-to-test transfer.

AI.tldr: 研究反思式提示优化中证据组成、示例可见性、候选选择与领域知识策略的影响，并基于Qwen3.5-9B在五个数据集上比较九种反思策略。
AI.motivation: 反思式提示优化利用模型行为示例修改指令，但反思器应接收哪些证据尚不明确，需要系统研究不同证据配置对优化效果的影响。
AI.method: 在单亲Pareto引导搜索框架中，将Qwen3.5-9B同时作为任务模型和反思器，在五个数据集上评估九种反思策略，比较证据组成、示例可见性、候选选择和领域知识策略。
AI.result: 发现三类模式：失败仅策略平均测试提升最大，达+8.0个百分点；平衡混合和无示例+验证的平均性能排名最佳；无示例在改进采样父代上排名最佳，但平均测试增益仅1.4个百分点，说明局部反思成功未必带来更强最终提示；失败仅与平衡混合的校准差距排名最低，而GPQA和IFBench上较大差距表明校准收益可能高估留出改进，该差距是描述性指标而非直接过拟合度量。
AI.conclusion: 反思策略应分别在最终性能、父代改进和校准到测试迁移三个维度上评估，而不能仅依赖单一指标判断其有效性。

title: Towards Kinematic Actionable Infeasibility Detection in Motion Planning
comment: Accepted for publication in IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L)
summary: Motion planning in robotics requires not only computing collision-free paths but also certifying infeasibility when no such path exists. Complete methods are limited to low-dimensional spaces, while sampling-based planners scale efficiently but cannot provide finite-time infeasibility certificates, leaving this problem largely unresolved in high-dimensional spaces. In this letter, we present a geometry-driven framework for certifying infeasibility through an explicit resolution-dependent analysis of configuration space topology. Leveraging signed distance field representations, the proposed method traces separating manifolds induced by obstacle boundaries directly in configuration space, enabling both detection of infeasibility and identification of the specific geometric cause. To address computational challenges, we develop a parallel frontier-expansion algorithm that exploits GPU acceleration for efficient simplicial reconstruction in high-dimensional spaces. We validate the approach on 4-DOF and 5-DOF robot scenarios, certifying infeasibility within seconds for 4-DOF cases and under four minutes for 5-DOF cases. We further discuss avenues for improving scalability to higher-dimensional spaces.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于几何的机器人运动规划不可行性认证框架，通过SDF在配置空间追踪分离流形，并利用GPU并行前沿扩展进行高维单纯形重构，在4-DOF和5-DOF场景验证。
AI.motivation: 在高维空间中，完备方法受限于低维空间，而采样规划器虽可扩展却无法提供有限时间不可行性证明，导致高维不可行性认证问题长期未解决。
AI.method: 进行分辨率相关的配置空间拓扑分析；基于符号距离场表示，在配置空间中追踪由障碍物边界诱导的分离流形；开发并行前沿扩展算法，利用GPU加速高维空间中的单纯形重构。
AI.result: 在4-DOF和5-DOF机器人场景中验证，4-DOF案例可在数秒内认证不可行，5-DOF案例在四分钟内完成；并讨论了向更高维空间扩展的改进方向。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够检测不可行性并识别具体几何原因，为高维运动规划不可行性认证提供了可行途径，但更高维可扩展性仍需进一步研究。

title: EgoTSR++: Egocentric Spatiotemporal Reasoning for Task Progress Understanding
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) have advanced rapidly in static visual understanding, yet remain unreliable when judging how an egocentric task is progressing. Given a task instruction and two visual observations, a model should determine which state is closer to the goal by analyzing task-relevant object configurations and spatial relations, rather than relying on timestamps or presentation order. This distinction is critical in manipulation, where retries, corrective actions, and temporary regressions make progress inherently non-monotonic. We introduce EgoTSR, a unified framework for diagnosing and improving order-robust task-progress understanding. First, SpatialLogic-Bench evaluates each physical state pair in both original and order-swapped presentations across short- and long-horizon settings, exposing whether a model follows task-state evidence or chronological shortcuts. Second, our data construction pipeline converts successful, approximately monotonic manipulation and first-person trajectories into bidirectional supervision; LongTag further preserves intermediate subtask structure for long-horizon comparison, while failure-aware data extend learning to regressions and recoveries. Third, a progressive CoT-to-Tag curriculum first supervises evidence-grounded interpretation of task-relevant state changes and then consolidates the comparison rule through scalable label-only training. Experiments reveal substantial input-order bias in representative VLMs. EgoTSR achieves 92.4% long-horizon accuracy with a 0.1-point forward-inverse Gap. Failure-aware supervision further improves accuracy on non-monotonic trajectories by 11.8 points and Recovery Accuracy by 11.2 points, while maintaining broad visual and spatial capabilities. These results establish goal-conditioned state comparison as an explicit formulation of egocentric spatiotemporal reasoning for task-progress understanding.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 EgoTSR 框架，用于诊断和提升视觉语言模型在自我中心任务进度理解中的顺序鲁棒性，并强调应依据任务相关物体状态与空间关系判断哪一状态更接近目标，而非依赖时间戳或输入顺序。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在静态视觉理解上进展迅速，但在判断自我中心任务进展时仍不可靠；操作任务中存在重试、纠正动作和暂时倒退，使任务进展本质上是非单调的，模型容易受输入顺序和时间线索影响。
AI.method: 提出 EgoTSR 统一框架：1）SpatialLogic-Bench 在原始和顺序交换呈现下评估状态对，覆盖短时与长时任务；2）数据构建流程将成功、近似单调的操作与第一人称轨迹转为双向监督，LongTag 保留子任务结构，失败感知数据覆盖倒退与恢复；3）采用渐进式 CoT-to-Tag 课程，先监督基于证据的任务相关状态变化解释，再通过可扩展的仅标签训练巩固比较规则。
AI.result: 实验显示代表性 VLM 存在明显输入顺序偏差。EgoTSR 在长时任务上达到 92.4% 准确率，前向-反向差距仅 0.1 点；失败感知监督使非单调轨迹准确率提升 11.8 点，恢复准确率提升 11.2 点，同时保持广泛的视觉与空间能力。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，目标条件状态比较可作为自我中心时空推理的显式形式，用于任务进度理解，并有效提升模型对非单调任务进展的判断能力。

title: GLIDE: Generalized Layer-wise Intrinsic Distributional Evaluation for Heterogeneous LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents require reliable step-level evaluation to compare candidate branches and allocate computation effectively. However, lightweight evaluation remains challenging. External verifiers introduce additional inference cost, while agent-produced confidence or self-evaluation scores can be miscalibrated, especially when candidates are generated by heterogeneous agents. We propose \textbf{G}eneralized \textbf{L}ayer-wise \textbf{I}ntrinsic \textbf{D}istributional \textbf{E}valuation (\textbf{GLIDE}) for LLM agents. \textsc{GLIDE} derives intrinsic step evidence from layer-wise residual coherence, which measures whether local residual updates consistently support the global residual change induced by a candidate step. It calibrates this evidence against the recent score distribution of the generating agent and converts it into a pessimistic reward that jointly accounts for absolute residual evidence and agent-relative standing. The reward provides a cross-agent value signal for MCTS branch selection, while normalized predictive uncertainty guides adaptive branching. Experiments on multi-hop reasoning, sequential decision making, and symbolic logic show that \textsc{GLIDE} improves task performance, step-level ranking quality, and computational efficiency without external verifiers or task-specific supervision.

AI.tldr: 提出GLIDE，一种面向LLM智能体的轻量级逐步内在评估方法，利用层间残差一致性生成奖励信号，用于MCTS分支选择与自适应分支，无需外部验证器或任务特定监督。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体需要可靠的步骤级评估来比较候选分支并有效分配计算资源，但现有轻量评估方法存在不足：外部验证器增加推理成本，智能体自产置信度或自评估分数可能校准不良，尤其在异构智能体生成候选时更明显。
AI.method: GLIDE从层间残差一致性中提取内在步骤证据，衡量局部残差更新是否与候选步骤引起的全局残差变化一致；将该证据对照生成智能体近期分数分布进行校准，并转化为同时考虑绝对残差证据和智能体相对位置的悲观奖励。该奖励为MCTS分支选择提供跨智能体价值信号，归一化预测不确定性用于指导自适应分支。
AI.result: 在多跳推理、序列决策和符号逻辑任务上，GLIDE提升了任务性能、步骤级排序质量和计算效率，且无需外部验证器或任务特定监督。
AI.conclusion: GLIDE是一种有效的轻量级内在步骤评估方法，可为LLM智能体提供跨智能体价值信号并支持高效搜索，避免额外验证器与监督依赖。

title: Fusion Under Component Failure: Negative Results and Failure Modes in Ensemble AI-Generated Image Detection
summary:
We built an ordinary stacking ensemble for AI-generated image detection -- three open detectors producing five scores, fused by a gradient-boosted meta-learner that treats a detector's failure as missing data -- deployed it, and then evaluated it against three controls it should have faced first. This paper reports what the controls found, including where they overturned our own earlier conclusions.
  Fusion is worth its cost only when refitted on the target domain. The shipped meta-learner, fitted on a separate corpus, does not beat its best single member on 2000 StyleGAN faces (AUC 0.9896 vs 0.9961; McNemar p = 1.000). But a stacker refitted in-domain beats that member plus a post-hoc calibrator (Delta-AUC = +0.0025, [+0.0014, +0.0038]; p = 3.4e-4). An earlier draft claimed the calibrated single detector won outright; that comparison mixed regimes and we correct it here.
  One corpus is not an evaluation. On 80 screenshots every model's AUC interval contains 0.5. We can say nothing stronger: the difference between the ensemble's drop and its best member's is [-0.185, +0.115].
  Abstention is real, correlated, and mishandled. With four of five detectors silent and the survivor reporting "real", the system returns P(AI) = 0.9985, because an all-NaN input scores 0.9995 in a learner never fitted with missingness. The three AIDE checkpoints fail together, sharing one preprocessing path. A quorum rule requiring two distinct architectures prevents both failures with no retraining.
  We also find Corpus A carries a class-conditional JPEG bias severe enough to separate the classes from the header alone, which limits every in-domain number we report. Code, harness, hash-identified artifacts and all corrections are released.

AI.tldr: 本文对一个已部署的AI生成图像检测堆叠集成进行三项对照检验，发现其收益依赖目标域重拟合，单语料评估不足，弃权与缺失处理存在严重问题，并纠正了先前结论。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是检验已部署的堆叠集成检测器是否真正优于单模型，以及其评估是否因单语料、弃权缺失和数据集偏差而被高估，从而避免部署后的错误结论。
AI.method: 方法为：三个开放检测器产生五个分数，用梯度提升元学习器进行堆叠融合，并将检测器失败视为缺失数据；随后用三项对照评估：目标域重拟合、小规模截图集、弃权/缺失与架构冗余分析；并检查Corpus A的JPEG类别条件偏差。
AI.result: 关键结果：出厂元学习器在2000张StyleGAN人脸上不敌最佳单模型（AUC 0.9896 vs 0.9961，McNemar p=1.000）；目标域重拟合堆叠器优于“最佳成员+事后校准器”（Delta-AUC=+0.0025，[+0.0014,+0.0038]，p=3.4e-4）。80张截图中所有模型AUC区间含0.5，集成与最佳成员差异为[-0.185,+0.115]。四/五检测器沉默且幸存者报“真”时，系统因全NaN输入在未训练缺失的 learner 中得0.9995而返回P(AI)=0.9985；三个AIDE检查点共享预处理路径而共同失败。要求两种不同架构的法定人数规则可无重训练避免两类失败。Corpus A存在严重类别条件JPEG偏差，仅凭文件头即可区分类别，限制所有域内数字。
AI.conclusion: 结论：融合只有在本目标域重拟合时才值得成本；单一语料不能作为评估依据；弃权是真实且相关的，缺失处理必须显式建模；架构冗余会引发共同失败，可用quorum规则缓解；数据集偏差会限制结论强度。作者发布代码、测试框架、哈希标识工件及所有修正。

title: Dimension-Specific Imbalance and an Adaptive Hybrid Label Strategy for Multi-Task Affective State Recognition in Classroom Video
summary: Recognition of student affective states from classroom video is constrained by a class imbalance problem whose true nature is, we argue, under-analyzed. We show that on DAiSEE -- the de facto benchmark for this task -- class imbalance is fundamentally a dimension-specific phenomenon: raw imbalance ratios reach as high as approximately 79:1 (Frustration), and the structure of imbalance -- not only its magnitude -- varies across dimensions, so uniform algorithmic treatments (aggressive class reweighting, focal loss, uniform binary simplification) fail in dimension-dependent ways. We propose the Adaptive Hybrid Label Strategy (AHLS), which assigns four-level classification to dimensions with manageable imbalance and binary classification to severely long-tailed dimensions, coupled with a null-class placeholder mechanism that stabilizes multi-task optimization by compressing the maximum effective inverse-frequency weight ratio from as high as ~79$\times$ to at most ~8.5$\times$ across the four dimensions. Validated on a lightweight FERShuffleNetV2 + LTCN architecture (0.39 M parameters, 0.07 G FLOPs), the strategy attains the highest mean Macro-F1 of 47.70% across all four affective dimensions among 11 compared methods, including five state-of-the-art deep models (up to 167$\times$ larger) and five traditional machine-learning baselines. A cross-model behavioral analysis on DAiSEE indicates that, in this setting, classification strategy may influence minority-state recognition more strongly than further backbone scaling alone. We also report evidence of an annotation-density limitation of DAiSEE on minority affective states, which suggests that benchmark design may bound future progress as much as algorithmic refinement. Index Terms Affective computing, classroom video analysis, class imbalance, multi-task learning, lightweight deep learning, DAiSEE, engagement recognition.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出DAiSEE课堂情感识别中的类别不平衡是维度特定现象，并提出自适应混合标签策略（AHLS），在轻量模型上取得最优平均Macro-F1，同时发现分类策略对少数类识别的影响可能大于骨干网络缩放，且DAiSEE存在标注密度限制。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对课堂视频中学生情感状态识别中的类别不平衡问题分析不足，且DAiSEE基准上的不平衡本质被低估；统一处理方法（如类重加权、focal loss、统一二分类简化）在不同维度上失效。
AI.method: 分析DAiSEE类别不平衡的维度特定性；提出自适应混合标签策略（AHLS），对可管理不平衡维度采用四分类，对严重长尾维度采用二分类，并引入null类占位机制稳定多任务优化；在轻量FERShuffleNetV2 + LTCN架构（0.39M参数，0.07 GFLOPs）上验证。
AI.result: AHLS在四个情感维度上取得最高平均Macro-F1 47.70%，优于11种对比方法（含5种SOTA深度模型和5种传统机器学习基线）；将最大有效逆频率权重比从约79倍压缩至至多8.5倍；跨模型分析表明分类策略对少数类识别的影响可能强于骨干网络缩放；发现DAiSEE在少数情感状态上存在标注密度限制。
AI.conclusion: 类别不平衡处理需维度自适应，分类策略设计比单纯扩大模型更关键；基准数据集的标注密度可能限制未来进展，算法改进与基准设计需协同推进。

title: Scanning While Imagining: A Scene-Graph World Model for Robotic Ultrasound Navigation
summary: Ultrasound (US) acquisition depends on the operator's ability to interpret anatomy and anticipate how the view will change with probe motion. Many robotic US navigation methods select actions without explicitly predicting these anatomical changes. We propose SonoGraph-WM, an action- and goal-conditioned world model for anticipatory probe navigation. The model represents anatomy as scene graphs (SGs), capturing visible structures, their geometry, and spatial relationships without synthesizing US images. Given a history of SGs and probe poses, a unified Transformer jointly predicts future SGs and poses. A receding-horizon planner recursively imagines candidate trajectories, selects the shortest predicted path reaching a goal graph, and follows it over a short execution horizon before replanning from new observations. To reduce reliance on tracked and anatomically annotated US sequences, we generate aligned SG--pose training data from computed tomography (CT) label maps along surface-constrained probe trajectories. On four held-out CT cases, spatial relation F1 remains above 93% over 20 prediction steps, and closed-loop navigation achieves 77.50% and 75.00% success for the gallbladder and pancreas, respectively, using annotation-derived SGs. In robot--phantom navigation experiments with label-map-derived SGs, the planner reached the target view in 73.7% of trials. These findings support CT-supervised anatomical world modeling for probe planning and highlight the importance of frequent observation updates for reliable navigation. Project Page: https://noseefood.github.io/us-sonograph-wm/

AI.tldr: 提出SonoGraph-WM，一种动作与目标条件的世界模型，用于超声探头导航。以场景图表征解剖结构，统一Transformer联合预测未来场景图与探头位姿，并通过滚动时域规划选择最短路径到达目标图。
AI.motivation: 超声采集依赖操作者解读解剖并预判探头运动带来的视图变化，而现有机器人超声导航方法往往不显式预测这些解剖变化。
AI.method: 用场景图表示可见结构、几何和空间关系，不合成超声图像；给定场景图与位姿历史，统一Transformer联合预测未来场景图和位姿；滚动时域规划器递归想象候选轨迹，选最短预测路径到达目标图，短时执行后重规划；从CT标签图沿表面约束轨迹生成对齐的SG-位姿训练数据。
AI.result: 在四个留出CT病例上，20步预测的空间关系F1保持93%以上；使用注释衍生SG的闭环导航对胆囊和胰腺成功率分别为77.50%和75.00%；机器人-体模实验中，使用标签图衍生SG的规划器73.7%的试验到达目标视图。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持CT监督的解剖世界建模用于探头规划，并强调频繁观测更新对可靠导航的重要性。

title: Calibration-Free Surface Normals Estimation in Vision-Based Tactile Sensing using Universal Photometric Stereo
summary: Vision-based tactile sensors are a popular solution for capturing rich contact surface geometry. However, to obtain high-detail contact surface normals and depth, it is necessary to calibrate the sensor by physically pressing a probe with known geometry against the sensor elastomer and mapping tactile images onto the ground truth probe's shape. This approach does not scale across different tactile sensors, and the calibration effort can be complex depending on the sensor shape and optical system. Instead, we propose a calibration-free procedure for the estimation of contact surface normals using Universal Photometric Stereo neural networks. In a series of real-world experiments, we evaluate our approach on 3 sensors with different optical systems, demonstrating that universal methods are a suitable approach for estimating surface normals at the contact patch from tactile images, thereby alleviating the need for tactile sensor calibration. Controlled experiments with a metal ball show that universal methods match the calibrated method, with a mean angular error of $6.56^{\Large\circ}$. We show that the proposed framework recovers high-frequency surface details of objects with natural textures, achieving an overall mean angular error of $10.66^{\Large\circ}$. Universal method robustly recovers the contact surface normals captured with dome-shaped Digit 360, achieving a low angular discrepancy of $10.18^{\Large\circ}$ relative to the calibrated baseline. This experiment demonstrates that with sufficient illumination settings surface normals could be estimated using a model trained solely on synthetic data. By providing a unified representation of contact surfaces across different vision-based tactile sensor designs, Universal Photometric Stereo neural networks lay the foundation for transferable tactile perception across sensors.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需标定的视触觉传感器接触表面法向估计方法，利用通用光度立体神经网络，在不同光学系统的传感器上实现跨传感器泛化。
AI.motivation: 传统视触觉传感器需用已知几何探针物理按压并映射触觉图像到真值形状，标定过程复杂、难以规模化，且依赖具体传感器形状与光学系统。
AI.method: 采用通用光度立体（Universal Photometric Stereo）神经网络，从触觉图像直接估计接触面法向；在3种不同光学系统的传感器上进行真实实验，并与标定基线对比。
AI.result: 金属球实验中通用方法达到与标定方法相当的效果，平均角误差为6.56°；对自然纹理物体恢复高频表面细节，总体平均角误差为10.66°；在穹顶形Digit 360上相对标定基线的角差异为10.18°。
AI.conclusion: 通用光度立体网络可无需触觉传感器标定即可估计接触面法向，并在不同传感器间提供统一表示，为可迁移的触觉感知奠定基础。

title: FINE: Future-Informed Navigation Encoding for Data-Efficient Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Adapting vision-language navigation (VLN) policies to new environments is expensive because every additional route and instruction requires an embodied demonstration. Yet standard observation-to-action training uses only a small fraction of the information already contained in each trajectory. In particular, future observations reveal the instruction-relevant landmarks that the agent will encounter, including what they look like and how they are arranged in 3D. We introduce FINE, a Future-Informed Navigation Encoding framework that extracts this latent supervision from existing demonstrations. FINE equips a VLN backbone with two complementary auxiliary representations. First, explicit landmark tokens follow the ordered landmarks specified by the instruction and are trained to predict future landmark regions in both semantic 2D patch-feature space and viewpoint-dependent 3D geometric feature space. Second, an implicit future token learns to distinguish the landmark state that is actually reached from plausible same-scene counterfactual futures generated by a video world model. On R2R-CE and RxR-CE val-unseen, FINE improves InternVLA-N1 by 2.6 and 4.5 success-rate points, respectively, at full training data. More importantly, as demonstrations become limited, the benefit grows: at a 70% demonstration budget, FINE improves success rate by 6.8 points, recovering roughly one-third of the performance lost by reducing the training demonstrations. Project page is available at https://finevln.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出 FINE 框架，利用现有导航演示中的未来观测信息作为辅助监督，提升视觉语言导航策略在新环境中的泛化能力，尤其在演示数据有限时效果更显著。
AI.motivation: 将视觉语言导航策略适配到新环境成本高昂，因为每条路线和指令都需要具身演示；而标准观测到动作的训练仅利用了轨迹中一小部分信息，未来观测中蕴含的指令相关地标及其3D布局信息未被充分利用。
AI.method: FINE 从已有演示中提取潜在未来监督，为 VLN 主干网络引入两种互补辅助表示：一是显式地标 token，按指令指定的有序地标，在语义2D patch特征空间和视角相关3D几何特征空间中预测未来地标区域；二是隐式未来 token，通过视频世界模型生成同场景合理反事实未来，学习区分实际到达的地标状态与反事实未来。
AI.result: 在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE val-unseen 上，全量训练数据下 FINE 分别将 InternVLA-N1 的成功率提升 2.6 和 4.5 个百分点；演示数据减少时收益更大，在70%演示预算下成功率提升6.8个百分点，约挽回因减少训练演示而损失性能的三分之一。
AI.conclusion: 利用轨迹中未来观测的潜在监督可有效增强VLN策略，且对演示数据稀缺场景尤为有利，说明未来信息建模是提升数据效率与泛化能力的重要方向。

title: PC-SubMax: Efficient Prompt Compression via Regularized Submodular Maximization
summary: While large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in long-context scenarios, lengthy prompts can increase inference costs and latency and exacerbate the ``lost-in-the-middle'' phenomenon. Selective prompt compression offers a model-agnostic approach to alleviating these issues. However, methods based on fixed token- or sentence-level importance scores may overlook how content contributions change with the selected subset, limiting their ability to account for inter-sentence redundancy. Compression procedures that rely on autoregressive LLM scoring can also introduce substantial overhead. We propose PC-SubMax, a theoretically grounded framework that formulates selective prompt compression as regularized monotone submodular maximization under a knapsack constraint. The objective is $U(S)-\ell(S)$, where the monotone submodular utility $U$ combines information coverage, query relevance, and log-determinant diversity, and the non-negative modular penalty $\ell$ captures token cost. Through diminishing marginal returns, the objective evaluates each sentence's contribution relative to the selected content. To optimize this objective, we develop the Regularized Greedy+Max (RGM) algorithm, which deterministically returns a feasible set $Q$ satisfying $U(Q)-\ell(Q)\geq \frac{1}{2}U(O)-\ell(O)$, where $O$ is an optimal feasible solution to the regularized problem. RGM uses $O(nκ)$ value-oracle queries, where $n$ is the number of candidate sentences and $κ$ is the maximum feasible subset size. PC-SubMax uses encoder representations and avoids autoregressive LLM scoring during compression. Experiments across seven diverse benchmarks demonstrate competitive downstream performance with low compression overhead.

AI.tldr: 提出 PC-SubMax，将选择性提示压缩建模为背包约束下的正则化单调子模最大化问题，并设计 RGM 算法，在低开销下实现高效提示压缩。
AI.motivation: 长上下文场景中，长提示会增加推理成本与延迟，并加剧“中间迷失”现象；现有基于固定 token/句子重要性的压缩方法难以处理句子间冗余，且自回归 LLM 打分会带来较大开销。
AI.method: 将选择性提示压缩形式化为正则化单调子模最大化：目标为 U(S)-ℓ(S)，其中 U 融合信息覆盖、查询相关性和对数行列式多样性，ℓ 表示 token 成本；提出 Regularized Greedy+Max（RGM）算法进行优化，使用编码器表示，避免压缩阶段的自回归 LLM 打分。
AI.result: RGM 可确定性地返回可行集 Q，满足 U(Q)-ℓ(Q) ≥ 1/2 U(O)-ℓ(O)，其中 O 为正则化问题最优可行解；算法使用 O(nκ) 次价值 oracle 查询，n 为候选句子数，κ 为最大可行子集大小。在七个不同基准上取得有竞争力的下游性能，且压缩开销较低。
AI.conclusion: PC-SubMax 为选择性提示压缩提供了有理论保证且高效的框架，能兼顾压缩质量与计算开销，适合模型无关的长上下文提示压缩场景。

title: AdaTutoRank: Learning to Rerank Document Sets via Adaptive Tutoring Optimization for RAG and Deep Research
summary: Document rerankers determine what evidence reaches the downstream model in RAG and deep research, yet mainstream rerankers select by relevance matching, and individually relevant documents rarely constitute the complete, complementary, non-redundant set a complex information need demands. Prior work rewards a set by its aggregate rubric score, shifting the objective from ranking documents to composing sets. Yet that score is one scalar shared by every document in the set, so the supervision is sparse: a redundant document is rewarded with the rest whenever the set scores well, and a decisive one penalized with the rest whenever it does not; credit assignment leaves contributors indistinguishable from free riders. On-policy distillation could densify this supervision, but existing methods give every rollout the same fixed guidance, too prescriptive for strong rollouts and too abstract for weak ones. We therefore propose AdaTutoRank, a setwise reranker trained with Adaptive Tutoring Optimization (ATO) under a three-level hierarchy of nine rubric dimensions, which supplies silver labels for the cold start, rewards for reinforcement learning, and hints for distillation. ATO draws three hint forms of increasing specificity from the policy's own frozen snapshot: the rubrics alone, a self-selector's sibling-set chosen under rubrics, and a self-reflector's reflection contrasting the rollout with that sibling-set; each rollout receives the form matched to its quality. Re-scoring that rollout under the hint-conditioned frozen teacher and the hint-free snapshot distills the hint's effect into a token-level advantage that complements the group-relative outcome advantage. Across ten benchmarks spanning RAG, deep research, and setwise evaluation, AdaTutoRank attains the best overall performance while issuing fewer retrieval calls.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AdaTutoRank，一种面向 RAG 与深度研究的集合式重排器，通过自适应辅导优化（ATO）和三级九维评分体系训练，在十个基准上取得最佳综合表现并减少检索调用。
AI.motivation: 主流重排器按相关性匹配选择文档，但单篇相关文档难以组成完整、互补、非冗余的证据集合。已有集合奖励方法使用聚合评分，导致监督稀疏：集合得分高时冗余文档被一并奖励，得分低时关键文档被一并惩罚，无法区分贡献者与搭便车者。现有在线策略蒸馏又对所有 rollout 施加固定指导，对强 rollout 过于具体，对弱 rollout 过于抽象。
AI.method: 提出 AdaTutoRank 集合式重排器，使用自适应辅导优化（ATO）和三级九维评分体系。该体系为冷启动提供银标签、为强化学习提供奖励、为蒸馏提供提示。ATO 从策略自身冻结快照中生成三种逐步具体的提示：仅评分维度、自选择器依据评分维度选出的同类集合、自反思器对 rollout 与该同类集合的对比反思；每个 rollout 按质量匹配提示。再分别在提示条件冻结教师和无提示快照下重打分，将提示效果蒸馏为 token 级优势，补充组相对结果优势。
AI.result: 在涵盖 RAG、深度研究和集合式评估的十个基准上，AdaTutoRank 取得最佳总体性能，同时检索调用次数更少。
AI.conclusion: 自适应、分层次的辅导信号可有效缓解集合式重排中的稀疏监督与固定蒸馏指导问题，提升复杂信息需求下的证据集合构建效果。

title: Agentsensus: Consensus-Compressed Shared Memory for Multi-Agent Story Worlds
summary: A agentic story world is a dynamic system simulating who learned what, when, and from whom -- yet the standard design gives each character a private memory stream. A shared event is therefore stored once per witness, large duplication will be incurred in terms of storage. We present Agentsensus, a story-world simulation framework in which there is an unified long-term memory. Records of the same event merge into one owned by all its witnesses, and semantically relevant memory records are linked. We evaluate on four worlds -- two classical Chinese novels, Hamlet, and a real-world conflict timeline -- run for 40 to 80 rounds against three per-character memory designs under an equal-granularity protocol. Agentsensus writes 22-44% fewer entries than the closest baseline and is the only design whose memory becomes shared (14-28% of records held by more than one character, some by 10) and linked (94-99%), at judged simulation quality indistinguishable or even better than the baselines. An ablation attributes this to the merge itself: disabling it multiplies the store by 3.1x and takes sharing to exactly zero. Sharing also compounds with the horizon rather than saturating early, rising 6% to 9% to 14% as one world is re-run at 10, 20 and 40 rounds.

AI.tldr: Agentsensus 是一个故事世界模拟框架，用统一的长期记忆替代每个角色独立的私有记忆流；同一事件的记录合并为由所有目击者共有，并链接语义相关记录。实验表明它减少存储冗余、实现记忆共享与链接，且模拟质量不降甚至更好。
AI.motivation: 标准智能体故事世界为每个角色维护私有记忆流，导致同一共享事件按目击者重复存储，造成大量存储冗余，且记忆之间缺乏共享与关联。
AI.method: 提出 Agentsensus：使用统一长期记忆；将同一事件的记录合并为所有目击者共有的单条记录；对语义相关记忆建立链接。在四个世界（两部中国古典小说、Hamlet、真实冲突时间线）上运行 40 至 80 轮，与三种按角色记忆设计在等粒度协议下对比，并进行消融实验。
AI.result: Agentsensus 比最接近基线少写 22-44% 条目；是唯一实现记忆共享（14-28% 记录由多个角色持有，部分由 10 个角色持有）和链接（94-99%）的设计；模拟质量与基线无差别或更好。消融显示合并机制是关键：禁用后存储量增至 3.1 倍，共享率降为 0。共享还随模拟轮数增长而累积：同一世界在 10、20、40 轮时为 6%、9%、14%。
AI.conclusion: 统一共享且带链接的长期记忆能有效减少重复存储，促进跨角色记忆共享与关联，同时保持或提升模拟质量，并且其收益随模拟时间延长而增强。

title: 3dgs-sc: a controlled static screen-content benchmark for 3d gaussian splatting
summary: Does high image fidelity imply readable screen content in 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS)? We introduce 3DGS-SC, a controlled static screen-content dataset and benchmark for examining this mismatch. Ten procedural scenes provide fixed multi-view splits, exact cameras, screen masks, text boxes, and transcripts. The protocol separates whole-image fidelity, screen-region fidelity, OCR readability, and edge preservation. In the reported five-method comparison, LightGaussian exceeds Mip-Splatting in screen PSNR by only 0.08 dB, yet trails it in OCR accuracy by 12.7 percentage points. Across all ten method pairs, screen-PSNR and OCR orderings disagree in seven cases. These aggregate results expose a method-selection failure of fidelity-only evaluation. Complementing prior text-aware 3DGS research, 3DGS-SC targets controlled monitor interfaces and exact annotations; scene-wise robustness and acquisition effects remain open validation questions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出3DGS-SC，一个用于3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）中屏幕内容重建的受控静态数据集与基准，揭示高图像保真度并不等于屏幕内容可读。
AI.motivation: 现有评估多关注整体图像保真度，但高保真未必意味着屏幕区域文字可读，仅依赖保真度可能导致方法选择错误。
AI.method: 构建包含十个程序化场景的受控静态屏幕内容数据集，提供固定多视角划分、精确相机、屏幕掩码、文本框和转录文本；评估协议分离整体图像保真度、屏幕区域保真度、OCR可读性和边缘保持，并比较五种方法。
AI.result: LightGaussian在屏幕PSNR上仅比Mip-Splatting高0.08 dB，但OCR准确率低12.7个百分点；在全部十组方法对中，屏幕PSNR与OCR排序有七组不一致，暴露了仅用保真度评估导致的方法选择失败。
AI.conclusion: 3DGS-SC补充了已有文本感知3DGS研究，面向受控显示器界面与精确标注；场景级鲁棒性和采集效应仍是待验证的开放问题。

title: RoboFoundry: System-as-Policy Evolution for Self-Learning Embodied Agents
summary: A foundation model should not act in isolation as an embodied agent. Yet, existing methods often optimize individual components of the agent stack, such as memory, context, skills, or action interfaces, rather than treating the supporting system itself as a unified policy. Moreover, interaction alone does not yield self-improvement unless execution experience is converted into persistent, validated system changes. We therefore propose RoboFoundry, the first embodied agentic framework that formulates this process as Self-Evolving System-as-Policy. RoboFoundry diagnoses capability gaps in decision-making and memory management, converts execution traces into validated task-specific system updates, and promotes recurring improvements to the general system. Evolution operates over two complementary surfaces: a context system that manages active internal context and persistent file-system memory, and a hierarchical skill system that organizes atomic skills, reusable compositions, and failure-conditioned recovery. A shared semantic interface separates embodiment-invariant decisions from embodiment-specific execution, allowing evolved system capabilities to transfer across heterogeneous robots. On EmbodiedBench, RoboFoundry achieves state-of-the-art performance, notably improving GPT-5.5 by 27.8%. It also brings Qwen3.7-Plus to near parity with GPT-5.5 (70.3% vs. 72.7%), showing consistent gains from system-as-policy evolution across foundation models. For long-horizon memory, RoboFoundry outperforms all baselines on RoboMemArena by at least 39.0%, even against methods assisted by external foundation models. On LIBERO-PRO, it further outperforms Cap-Agent0 by 243.8%-679.7% across all perturbation types. In real-world deployments, RoboFoundry demonstrates zero-shot transfer and online evolution across robots and tasks, highlighting its potential for fully autonomous embodied agents.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 RoboFoundry，一个具身智能体框架，将智能体支撑系统本身视为统一策略，并通过自我进化实现决策与记忆能力的持续提升。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常只优化记忆、上下文、技能或动作接口等单个组件，而非将支撑系统作为统一策略；同时，单纯交互并不足以带来自我改进，必须把执行经验转化为持久且经过验证的系统变更。
AI.method: RoboFoundry 将过程形式化为“自我进化系统即策略”。它诊断决策与记忆管理中的能力缺口，将执行轨迹转化为经过验证的任务特定系统更新，并把重复出现的改进提升为通用系统能力。进化发生在两个层面：上下文系统管理活跃内部上下文与持久文件系统记忆；分层技能系统组织原子技能、可复用组合与失败条件恢复。共享语义接口分离具身无关决策与具身特定执行，使进化能力可迁移到异构机器人。
AI.result: 在 EmbodiedBench 上达到最先进性能，使 GPT-5.5 提升 27.8%；使 Qwen3.7-Plus 接近 GPT-5.5（70.3% vs. 72.7%）。在长期记忆 RoboMemArena 上至少超越所有基线 39.0%；在 LIBERO-PRO 上相比 Cap-Agent0 在所有扰动类型中提升 243.8%-679.7%。真实部署中展示跨机器人与任务的零样本迁移和在线进化。
AI.conclusion: RoboFoundry 表明“系统即策略”的进化能在不同基础模型上带来一致收益，并具备实现完全自主具身智能体的潜力。

title: PhiFold: Towards Dynamic Protein Design with Physics-Structured Covariance Modeling
summary: Protein design is moving beyond structural correctness toward function-aware design, yet existing generative models typically treat dynamics as a downstream property estimated through simulation or prediction after structure generation. Using MD trajectories as a generative target is also undesirable because stochastic, path-dependent trajectories over-specify the underlying equilibrium ensemble. We introduce PhiFold, a framework for jointly generating protein backbones and their second-order dynamics, represented by residue-displacement covariance. Rather than predicting the quadratically sized full covariance, PhiFold decomposes dynamics into three interpretable components: local flexibility, a low-rank collective-motion representation, and residue-wise collective participation. These components are assembled into a positive-definite covariance matrix with exact marginal consistency, yielding a compact and physically constrained representation of equilibrium dynamics. Across generated proteins, PhiFold improves recovery of local fluctuations and long-range residue coupling while remaining competitive on dominant collective-motion subspaces. It further enables bidirectional control of residue flexibility while preserving backbone designability. By unifying structure generation with an explicit representation of equilibrium dynamics, PhiFold lays a foundation for designing proteins not only by how they look, but also by how they move.

AI.tldr: PhiFold 提出将蛋白质骨架与其二阶平衡动力学（残基位移协方差）联合生成的框架，用局部柔性、低秩集体运动和残基参与度三个可解释分量紧凑表示动力学，并保持协方差正定与边际一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有蛋白质生成模型主要关注结构正确性，将动力学视为结构生成后通过模拟或预测得到下游属性；直接以 MD 轨迹为生成目标又会过度指定随机、路径依赖的轨迹，偏离平衡系综。
AI.method: 将残基位移协方差分解为局部柔性、低秩集体运动表示和残基级集体参与度，再组装为正定协方差矩阵，并保证精确边际一致性，从而联合生成骨架与二阶平衡动力学。
AI.result: 在生成蛋白中，PhiFold 更好恢复局部涨落和长程残基耦合，在主导集体运动子空间上保持竞争力；还能双向控制残基柔性，同时保持骨架可设计性。
AI.conclusion: 通过将结构生成与显式平衡动力学表示统一，PhiFold 为不仅按外观、也按运动方式设计蛋白质奠定了基础。

title: Train4Merge: A Controlled Single-Teacher Study of RL vs. SFT Teachers for OPD-Based Model Merging
summary: Domain experts trained from a shared checkpoint can be merged into one model through on-policy distillation (OPD), where they act as teachers supervising a student on its own trajectories. One upstream choice is rarely examined: whether to build each expert with supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or reinforcement learning (RL). Yet equally strong teachers need not be equally good teachers. We probe this choice through controlled single-teacher OPD, a building block of multi-teacher OPD: in Agentic, Reasoning, and Perception, comparably performing SFT and RL teachers are trained from Qwen3.5-9B, each guiding a student initialized from it. At their best checkpoints, RL-guided students outperform SFT-guided students by 4.27, 1.50, and 0.86 percentage points in Agentic, Reasoning, and Perception, respectively, and recover more of their teachers' performance gains over the base model. The contrast is clearest in Agentic, where the best SFT-guided student recovers only 44.44% of its teacher's gain, whereas the best RL-guided student recovers 115.00%, surpassing its teacher. Our analysis points to an explanation: RL teachers stay much closer to the shared initialization in parameter space than SFT teachers and are therefore easier for their students to follow.

AI.tldr: 本文研究在on-policy distillation（OPD）中，领域专家教师应由SFT还是RL构建。基于Qwen3.5-9B在Agentic、Reasoning、Perception任务上训练表现相当的SFT与RL教师，并分别用单教师OPD指导学生。结果显示RL教师指导的学生整体优于SFT教师指导，Agentic中甚至超过教师，原因是RL教师参数上更接近共享初始化，更易被学生跟随。
AI.motivation: 多教师OPD中，教师通常从同一检查点出发训练，但一个上游选择很少被检验：每个专家应用监督微调（SFT）还是强化学习（RL）来构建。表现同样强的教师，未必是同样好的教师，因此需要探究教师训练方式对蒸馏效果的影响。
AI.method: 从Qwen3.5-9B共享初始化出发，在Agentic、Reasoning和Perception任务上分别训练性能相当的SFT教师和RL教师。采用受控的单教师OPD设置，让每个教师在其自身轨迹上指导学生，学生也从同一初始化开始。比较最佳检查点下学生的表现，并分析教师参数空间与共享初始化之间的距离。
AI.result: 在最佳检查点上，RL指导的学生在Agentic、Reasoning、Perception上分别比SFT指导的学生高4.27、1.50和0.86个百分点，并更多恢复教师相对基座模型的性能增益。Agentic中对比最明显：最佳SFT指导学生仅恢复教师增益的44.44%，而最佳RL指导学生恢复115.00%，甚至超过教师。分析表明RL教师比SFT教师更接近共享初始化，因此在参数空间上更容易被学生跟随。
AI.conclusion: 在OPD中，教师由RL而非SFT构建可能带来更好的蒸馏效果。教师能力相当并不等于教学效果相当；RL教师更接近共享初始化，使学生更容易学习并继承甚至超过其性能。该发现为多教师OPD中专家构建方式的选择提供了依据。

title: Gauge-Equivariant Attention for Rotation-Stable $360^\circ$ Scene Understanding
comment: 23 pages. Accepted to ACM Transactions on Graphics (SIGGRAPH Asia 2026)
summary: Panoramic $360^\circ$ scene understanding increasingly relies on icosphere transformers, but a state-of-the-art spherical model loses more than half of its segmentation accuracy when the camera rotates by $90^\circ$, and controlled ablations identify gauge dependence in its relative-position bias as a major contributor. We propose gauge-equivariant relative position encoding (GE-RPE): a parameter-free Reynolds average of the bias over a finite cyclic subgroup $C_n\!\subset\!\mathrm{SO}(2)$ of gauge rotations. Plugged into a SphereUFormer backbone the change is invisible at deployment---zero added parameters and $1.5$--$4.4\%$ forward latency---and the matched three-seed GE-RPE model records a $1.3\%$ drop; the published SphereUFormer checkpoint records $53\%$ under the same stress protocol but a different training recipe. Once the gauge defect is removed and a teacher-token permutation $π_R$ aligns the SSL views to the rotated student frame, iBOT$+$MAE pretraining stops being a liability and becomes a clean low-label lever: the full framework EquiSSL (GE-RPE $+$ $π_R$ $+$ iBOT$+$MAE) tightens the drop to $0.8\%$ at $68.30\%$ val mIoU and lifts $1\%$-label fine-tuning by $+2.39$ mIoU on the $N{=}373$ test split (and by $+4.10$ on the smaller $N{=}40$ val split); the same fix carries over to monocular depth and to zero-shot Structured3D segmentation. The construction is provably $C_n$-invariant and $\mathcal{O}(n^{-2})$-close to the continuous $\mathrm{SO}(2)$ average, making the resulting model a usable $360^\circ$ visual-computing primitive across panoramic relighting, immersive video, and cross-dataset transfer. Code is available at https://github.com/Jaywalk18/equissl-release.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 gauge-equivariant relative position encoding（GE-RPE）与 EquiSSL 框架，用于解决 icosphere transformer 在 360° 全景分割中因相机旋转/gauge 变化导致的精度骤降问题，并提升低标签微调表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 SOTA 球形模型 SphereUFormer 在相机旋转 90° 时分割精度下降超过一半；受控消融表明其相对位置偏置的 gauge 依赖性是一大主因。同时，在旋转学生帧下，iBOT+MAE 自监督预训练可能反而成为负担。
AI.method: 提出 GE-RPE：对 relative-position bias 在有限循环子群 C_n⊂SO(2) 上做无参数 Reynolds 平均；再加入教师 token 置换 π_R，将 SSL 视图对齐到旋转后的学生帧。完整框架 EquiSSL = GE-RPE + π_R + iBOT+MAE。理论上证明该构造具有 C_n 不变性，并以 O(n^{-2}) 逼近连续 SO(2) 平均。
AI.result: GE-RPE 零新增参数，仅增加 1.5–4.4% 前向延迟；匹配三 seed 的 GE-RPE 模型在旋转压力测试下仅下降 1.3%，而公开 SphereUFormer checkpoint 同协议下降 53%（但训练配方不同）。EquiSSL 将下降收窄至 0.8%，val mIoU 为 68.30%；1% 标签微调在 N=373 测试集提升 +2.39 mIoU，在 N=40 验证集提升 +4.10 mIoU；同样修复可迁移到单目深度和零样本 Structured3D 分割。
AI.conclusion: 移除 gauge 缺陷并加入 π_R 后，iBOT+MAE 预训练从潜在负担变为干净的低标签增益杠杆。该方法可作为 360° 视觉计算的基础模块，适用于全景重光照、沉浸式视频和跨数据集迁移。

title: Explaining Textual Entailment with Lexical Entailments: Using LLMs to Supply Lexical Relations for Formal Proofs
comment: Accepted at the 11th Workshop on Automated Knowledge Base Construction (AKBC 2026)
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are highly capable of natural language reasoning and appear to store a great deal of lexical knowledge, but it is still unclear how much of this knowledge they actually use when reasoning, and whether they use it in the right way. On the other hand, logic-based Natural Language Inference (NLI) systems provide transparent and formally grounded reasoning, but they need to be supplied with rich lexical knowledge to prove inferences beyond purely logical ones. In this paper, we evaluate whether LLMs can identify all lexical knowledge needed to solve NLI problems and how much this knowledge contributes to proof search in a logic-based NLI system. Our research focuses exclusively on structured lexical entailments (e.g., chinchilla$\sqsubseteq$small animal) as a proxy for structured explanations for NLI problems with an entailment label. First, we curate a dataset for a new task of explaining sentential entailments with a set of lexical entailments. The dataset is used to intrinsically evaluate LLMs on generating structured lexical explanations. Then, we use NLI as an extrinsic evaluation in a simple neuro-symbolic setting, assessing whether LLMs can supply sufficient lexical relations to LangPro, a natural-logic theorem prover for natural language. The results show that the proposed task remains challenging even for hosted proprietary LLMs, and that their contribution to theorem proving is moderate: generated relations are often only partially sound and may be tailored to the specific NLI problem rather than representing generally valid lexical knowledge.

AI.tldr: 论文评估LLM能否为NLI识别所需词汇知识，以及这些知识对逻辑定理证明的贡献；作者构建了结构化词汇解释数据集，并发现该任务即使对专有LLM仍具挑战，生成的关系对证明帮助有限。
AI.motivation: LLM虽具备大量词汇知识，但不清楚其在推理中实际使用多少、使用是否正确；逻辑型NLI系统虽可透明推理，却需要丰富词汇知识来证明超出纯逻辑的推断。
AI.method: 构建新任务数据集：用一组结构化词汇蕴含（如 chinchilla ⊑ small animal）解释句子蕴含；先内在评估LLM生成结构化词汇解释的能力；再在简单神经符号设置中外在评估LLM能否为自然逻辑定理证明器LangPro提供足够词汇关系。
AI.result: 即使托管专有LLM也难完成该任务；生成关系对定理证明贡献中等，常仅部分可靠，且可能针对特定NLI问题定制，而非一般有效的词汇知识。
AI.conclusion: LLM尚不能可靠提供普遍有效的词汇知识来支持逻辑型NLI推理，其在结构化词汇解释和神经符号证明中的作用仍有限。

title: Delayed Supervision for Test-Time Language Models
comment: 11 pages, 3 figures. Equal contribution by both authors. Work done at MIT CSAIL
summary:
Test-time language models adapt a compact memory while processing the input sequence. This
  perspective encompasses nonlinear fast-weight learning in LaCT, associative delta-rule
  updates in DeltaNet, and generalized delta-rule state updates in RWKV-7. Training these
  models to predict the next token does not explicitly require a fact to remain accessible
  after many subsequent memory updates. We study delayed supervision for this test-time memory:
  during post-training, ask a simulator-grounded question only after a long interval of
  unrelated events, and supervise its answer alongside ordinary next-token prediction.
  Questions are evaluated on disposable branches, so their answers never enter the continuing
  event stream. The construction distinguishes retention from revision: a retained fact must
  remain valid throughout the delay, whereas a revised fact must be answered with its latest
  value. We evaluate this approach on LaCT-760M and plain DeltaNet-1.3B using TextWorld
  training trajectories and shared BABILong and RULER evaluation panels, and include a
  separately reported RWKV-7 comparison. Relative to event-only training, delayed QA improves
  BABILong by 5.48 percentage points for LaCT and 1.32 points for DeltaNet, and single-needle
  RULER by 1.45 and 3.27 points, respectively. The RWKV-7 comparison reports gains of 4.60 and
  7.00 points on its own panels. These results support delayed semantic supervision as a
  practical outer training objective for usable test-time memory, while leaving open how much
  of the benefit derives specifically from delay rather than general question-answering and
  answer-termination supervision.

AI.tldr: 论文研究测试时语言模型中紧凑记忆的延迟监督，通过在无关事件长间隔后提问并监督答案，提升事实保持与更新能力，并在 LaCT、DeltaNet 和 RWKV-7 上验证。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时记忆模型（如 LaCT、DeltaNet、RWKV-7）仅用下一词预测训练，未显式要求事实在多次记忆更新后仍可访问，因此需要研究如何让记忆在延迟后仍能正确保持或修订事实。
AI.method: 在后训练阶段引入延迟监督：在长段无关事件后，用模拟器生成问题并监督答案，同时保留普通下一词预测；问题在可丢弃分支上评估，答案不进入后续事件流；该设置区分“保持”与“修订”事实。在 LaCT-760M 和 DeltaNet-1.3B 上用 TextWorld 轨迹训练，并在 BABILong 与 RULER 上评测，另报告 RWKV-7 对比。
AI.result: 相比仅事件训练，延迟 QA 使 LaCT 的 BABILong 提升 5.48 个百分点、DeltaNet 提升 1.32 个百分点；单针 RULER 分别提升 1.45 和 3.27 个百分点。RWKV-7 在其自身评测面板上分别提升 4.60 和 7.00 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 延迟语义监督可作为提升测试时记忆可用性的实用外部训练目标；但收益有多少具体来自“延迟”而非一般问答与答案终止监督，仍待进一步研究。

title: Communication-Aware Heterogeneous Graph Learning for Decentralized Multi-Human Multi-Robot Task Allocation
summary: Multi-human multi-robot (MH-MR) teams combine robotic autonomy with human expertise, but effective task allocation requires coordinating scarce, dynamically available human support with distributed robot execution. Limited robot-robot and human-robot communication further complicates this coupling by delaying information exchange and supervisory intervention. We introduce CommHG, a communication-aware heterogeneous graph learning framework for decentralized MH-MR task allocation. CommHG represents coupled human-robot-task interactions through local graphs conditioned on information availability and age. Learned communication actions enable robots to decide when and which operator to query, and when to share information with peers. Allocation and communication are jointly optimized through cooperative multi-agent reinforcement learning, allowing the team to acquire useful information while managing limited communication and supervisory resources. We also introduce a benchmark integrating heterogeneous humans and robots, dynamic tasks and operational states, and constrained robot-robot and bidirectional human-robot links. Experiments across heterogeneous teams with up to 16 robots, 6 humans, and 112 tasks show that CommHG improves timely weighted mission completion as coordination scale increases, outperforming the strongest baseline in the Large scenario.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CommHG，一种通信感知的异构图学习框架，用于去中心化多人类多机器人任务分配。
AI.motivation: 多人类多机器人团队需要协调稀缺且动态可用的人类支持与分布式机器人执行，但有限的机器人间和人类-机器人通信延迟了信息交换与监督干预。
AI.method: CommHG通过基于信息可用性和时效性条件的局部图表示人-机器人-任务耦合交互，学习通信动作以决定何时向哪个操作员查询及何时与同伴共享信息，并通过协作多智能体强化学习联合优化分配与通信。同时提出了集成异构人类与机器人、动态任务与操作状态以及受限通信链路的基准。
AI.result: 在多达16个机器人、6个人类和112个任务的异构团队实验中，CommHG随着协调规模增加提升了及时加权任务完成度，在大型场景中优于最强基线。
AI.conclusion: CommHG能够有效应对通信受限下的去中心化多人类多机器人任务分配，在大规模协调中表现优越。

title: Locally Sound, Globally Insufficient: The Local-Global Gap in Multi-Hop Reasoning
summary: Reliable multi-hop reasoning requires more than locally supported steps: a trace can be sound at every reasoning step yet still fail to answer the question as a whole. We call this failure regime the local-global gap (LGG), in which the trace is locally sound yet globally insufficient. Local soundness requires each step to be supported by the available evidence and preceding steps, whereas global sufficiency requires the reasoning trace to align with the question and establish the submitted answer. In a human-adjudicated diagnostic of 2,598 responses across three multi-hop QA benchmarks and three models, we find that the LGG occurs in every benchmark-model combination and accounts for nearly half of globally insufficient responses overall. However, conventional faithfulness verifiers that check claims against the evidence largely miss these failures: at thresholds retaining at least 95% of reliable traces, recall for LGG cases is substantially lower than that for locally unsound traces. To address these failures, we formalize three dependencies for reliable reasoning: evidence-to-step support, question-to-trace alignment, and trace-to-answer closure. Instead of post-hoc diagnosis, we introduce E-Closure to supervise these dependencies during training, combining generation supervision on supported original and counterfactual responses with bidirectional switching constraints. Averaged over three benchmarks and three backbones, existing fine-tuning baselines improve accuracy and local soundness over the base models, but at the cost of global sufficiency. E-Closure improves both: among all fine-tuned methods, it achieves the highest average accuracy (92.8%) and trace reliability (89.0%) while yielding the lowest LGG rate (6.2%).

AI.tldr: 论文提出多跳推理中的“局部-全局差距”（LGG）：推理链每一步局部合理，但整体不足以回答原问题。作者通过人工诊断发现该问题普遍存在，且传统忠实性验证器难以检出；进而提出训练期监督方法 E-Closure，同时提升准确率、推理链可靠性与全局充分性。
AI.motivation: 可靠的多跳推理不仅要求每一步有证据支持，还要求整条推理链与问题对齐并支撑最终答案。现有方法多关注局部忠实性，可能忽略局部合理但全局不足的失败，即局部-全局差距。
AI.method: 对三个多跳问答基准和三个模型生成的 2,598 条回答进行人工裁定诊断；形式化可靠推理的三类依赖：证据到步骤支持、问题到推理链对齐、推理链到答案闭合。提出 E-Closure，在训练中监督这些依赖，结合原始与反事实回答的生成监督以及双向切换约束，而非仅做事后诊断。
AI.result: LGG 在每个基准-模型组合中均出现，占所有全局不足回答的近一半。传统忠实性验证器在保留至少 95% 可靠推理链的阈值下，对 LGG 案例的召回率显著低于局部不合理案例。微调基线提升准确率和局部合理性，但损害全局充分性；E-Closure 同时改善两者，在三种基准和三种主干模型上平均准确率达 92.8%，推理链可靠性达 89.0%，LGG 率最低为 6.2%。
AI.conclusion: 局部合理的推理链仍可能全局不足，仅靠事后证据核验不足以发现问题。E-Closure 通过训练期监督证据支持、问题对齐和答案闭合，能有效缓解局部-全局差距，并优于现有微调方法。

title: HGPTrans: Hierarchical Graph-Pooling Transolver for Automotive Aerodynamic Drag Coefficient Prediction
summary: Accurate and rapid prediction of the aerodynamic drag coefficient ($C_D$) is essential for vehicle design, particularly during early-stage styling iterations where a large number of candidate geometries must be evaluated. Although computational fluid dynamics (CFD) provides reliable aerodynamic estimates, its high computational cost, typically requiring hours to days for a single configuration, limits its use in large-scale design exploration. This paper proposes HGPTrans, a hierarchical graph-pooling network with Transolver-based attention, to directly predict $C_D$ from vehicle surface meshes. Motivated by the fact that vehicle aerodynamics depends on both local geometric features and long-range interactions among spatially distant surface regions, HGPTrans integrates three complementary components. Graph isomorphism convolutions encode discriminative local geometry, physics-aware slice attention captures global interactions with linear computational complexity, and information-redundancy-aware hierarchical pooling progressively removes redundant nodes while preserving informative geometric structures. The model is trained and evaluated on the large-scale DrivAerNet and DrivAerNet++ datasets, where it achieves the lowest mean absolute error and mean squared error among the evaluated baselines. Its generalization capability is further assessed through transfer learning on a real-vehicle dataset containing both sedans and SUVs, achieving relative $L_1$ errors of 1.56% (sedans) and 2.12% (SUVs) with an inference time of approximately $0.293$ s per vehicle. This corresponds to an acceleration of several orders of magnitude relative to high-fidelity CFD while keeping the predicted drag coefficients within a few percent of the CFD reference. Ablation studies confirm each component's contribution and reveal the effects of depth and pooling ratio.

AI.tldr: 提出HGPTrans，一种结合分层图池化与Transolver注意力的网络，可直接从车辆表面网格预测风阻系数，在多个数据集上取得最低误差，并实现约0.293秒/车的快速推理。
AI.motivation: 高保真CFD虽准确但计算成本高，单次仿真需数小时至数天，难以用于早期造型阶段的大规模候选几何评估；同时车辆气动既依赖局部几何特征，也依赖空间远距离区域间的相互作用。
AI.method: HGPTrans包含三部分：图同构卷积编码局部几何特征，物理感知切片注意力以线性复杂度捕获全局交互，信息冗余感知分层池化逐步去除冗余节点并保留有效几何结构。模型在DrivAerNet和DrivAerNet++上训练评估，并在包含轿车和SUV的真实车辆数据集上进行迁移学习。
AI.result: 在DrivAerNet和DrivAerNet++上取得所评估基线中最低的MAE和MSE；在真实车辆数据集上相对L1误差为轿车1.56%、SUV 2.12%，推理时间约0.293秒/车，相比高保真CFD加速数个数量级，且预测风阻系数与CFD参考值相差仅几个百分点。消融实验验证了各组件贡献，并揭示了深度和池化比例的影响。
AI.conclusion: HGPTrans能够高效、准确地从车辆表面网格预测风阻系数，支持大规模车辆气动设计探索，并在跨数据集迁移场景下保持较低误差和较快推理速度。

title: RLHarness: Co-evolving Procedural Skills with Reinforcement Learning for Long-horizon Multimodal Reasoning
summary: Multimodal reasoning requires models to preserve visual evidence through long decision chains while selecting appropriate procedures across diverse scenarios and rules. When learning is guided only by terminal verifiers, reinforcement learning (RL) reveals whether a final answer is correct but not how it should be produced. The policy must therefore discover reusable reasoning procedures while learning to execute them, creating a program cold-start problem. Skills can externalize successful procedures, reduce repeated exploration, and provide inspectable guidance. However, a fixed Skill Bank assumes that this guidance remains compatible with an evolving policy, while updating Skills alone can leave their triggers, execution protocols, and demonstrations stale or mutually inconsistent. We introduce RLHARNESS, which organizes Skills, selection and execution protocols, few-shot demonstrations, and task contracts into a unified, versioned Harness and alternates Harness evolution with policy learning. An Exploration-Distillation Harness builds the initial Harness and version-aligned verified traces for SFT and DAPO I. After the first RL block, a Post-RL Reconstruction Harness rebuilds Skills, protocols, and demonstrations from fresh success-failure rollouts, and DAPO II adapts the policy to the reconstructed program. RLHARNESS improves Accuracy from 16.25%/27.50% to 62.00%/50.00% on MetroMap/TravelMap and raises F1 score from 37.13%/45.50% to 65.81%/65.51% on Fee-VL/Cancel-VL. All four tasks achieve their best results only after reconstruction and DAPO II, showing that an evolving Harness complements RL by continually updating the external program that the policy learns to execute.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RLHARNESS框架，将技能、选择与执行协议、少样本示例和任务契约组织为可版本化的统一Harness，并与策略学习交替进行，以解决多模态推理中的程序冷启动和外部指导与策略演化不匹配问题。
AI.motivation: 多模态推理需要在长决策链中保留视觉证据并选择合适流程。仅靠终端验证器的强化学习只能判断最终答案对错，无法指导如何产生答案，导致策略需同时发现并执行可复用推理程序，形成程序冷启动问题。固定技能库又假设外部指导始终与演化策略兼容，单独更新技能可能使触发条件、执行协议和示例过时或不一致。
AI.method: RLHARNESS把技能、选择与执行协议、少样本演示和任务契约整合为统一且版本化的Harness，并与策略学习交替。先由Exploration-Distillation Harness构建初始Harness及版本对齐的验证轨迹，用于SFT和DAPO I；第一轮RL后，Post-RL Reconstruction Harness基于新的成功-失败rollout重建技能、协议和演示，再由DAPO II使策略适配重建后的程序。
AI.result: 在MetroMap/TravelMap上准确率从16.25%/27.50%提升至62.00%/50.00%；在Fee-VL/Cancel-VL上F1从37.13%/45.50%提升至65.81%/65.51%。四个任务均只在重建和DAPO II后达到最佳结果。
AI.conclusion: 演化式Harness通过持续更新策略所学执行的外部程序，补充了强化学习，证明外部程序与策略共同演化对多模态推理任务性能提升至关重要。

title: Learning an Anchored Prompt Space for Continual Adaptation of Large Language Models
summary: Continually adapting large language models requires acquiring new knowledge while preserving previously learned capabilities. Jointly adapting model parameters and task-specific soft prompts offers a promising solution, but faces two key limitations: historical prompts may become less effective as the model evolves, while their transferable cross-task relationships are not explicitly learned. We propose Learning an Anchored Prompt Space (LAPS), which preserves historical prompt effectiveness and learns relationships among task-specific soft prompts to facilitate positive transfer. LAPS first aligns historical prompts with the updated model through self-distillation. LAPS then constructs an anchored prompt space whose vertices correspond to learned task-specific soft prompts and whose intermediate geometry is shaped by learnable Bézier control prompts. Once this anchored prompt space is learned, LAPS identifies the best-performing prompt for each task on its validation set, allowing the optimized prompt to draw on knowledge acquired from observed tasks. Experiments on the TRACE benchmark across three Qwen3 model scales show that LAPS consistently outperforms distillation-based, prompt-based, and joint prompt--parameter adaptation baselines, improving average performance while reducing forgetting.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LAPS方法，用于大语言模型持续适应：通过自蒸馏保持历史提示有效性，并构建由贝塞尔控制提示塑造的锚定提示空间来学习任务间关系，从而提升平均性能并减少遗忘。
AI.motivation: 持续适应大语言模型需要获取新知识同时保留旧能力。联合调整模型参数和任务特定软提示虽有前景，但存在两个问题：模型演化后历史提示可能失效；任务间可迁移关系未被显式学习。
AI.method: LAPS首先通过自蒸馏将历史提示与更新后的模型对齐；然后构建锚定提示空间，其顶点对应已学习的任务特定软提示，中间几何由可学习的贝塞尔控制提示塑造；空间学习完成后，在每个任务的验证集上选择表现最佳的提示，使优化提示能利用已观察任务的知识。
AI.result: 在TRACE基准上的三个Qwen3模型规模实验中，LAPS持续优于基于蒸馏、基于提示以及联合提示-参数适应的基线，提高了平均性能并减少了遗忘。
AI.conclusion: LAPS通过保持历史提示有效性和显式学习任务提示间关系，能够促进正向迁移，实现更有效的持续适应。

title: When Users Change Their Minds: Measuring and Repairing Intent Drift in LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents often operate over multi-turn interactions in which user intent changes before execution. We study intent drift: the failure mode in which superseded parts of the user's intent continue to influence the final answer or tool action. We introduce IntentFlux, an executable benchmark that converts verifiable tasks into dialogues with controlled intent changes while preserving their original graders. In a 627-case calibration, mean task score falls from 0.476 to 0.384 as dialogues contain more superseded and withdrawn information. Across eight models, the rate of fully correct solutions is significantly lower when the same final task must be recovered from an evolving dialogue rather than given directly in a single turn. We further introduce StateForge, which explicitly maintains the active requirements before generation. On General-Test, it improves mean task score from 0.367 to 0.467. Providing the ground-truth final state improves performance further but still does not recover single-turn performance, indicating that state-estimation errors explain only part of the gap. These results establish intent drift as a measurable multi-turn failure mode and explicit state maintenance as a partial mitigation.

AI.tldr: 论文研究多轮交互中因用户意图变化而导致的“意图漂移”失败模式，并提出可执行基准 IntentFlux 及状态维护方法 StateForge。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体常在多轮对话中执行任务，而用户意图可能在执行前发生变化；被取代或撤回的旧意图仍可能影响最终回答或工具调用，但这一失败模式缺乏系统测量。
AI.method: 提出 IntentFlux 基准，将可验证任务转换为受控意图变化的对话，并保留原始评分器；在 627 个案例上校准。进一步提出 StateForge，在生成前显式维护当前活跃需求。
AI.result: 校准中，随着对话包含更多被取代和撤回信息，平均任务得分从 0.476 降至 0.384。八个模型中，从演化对话恢复最终任务时的完全正确率显著低于单轮直接给出任务。StateForge 在 General-Test 上将平均任务得分从 0.367 提升至 0.467；提供真实最终状态还能进一步提升，但仍无法恢复到单轮性能，说明状态估计错误只解释部分差距。
AI.conclusion: 意图漂移是可测量的多轮失败模式，显式状态维护可部分缓解该问题，但并非完全解决。

title: UNMATCH: Selective Unbalanced Token-Patch Matching for Forensic Image-Claim Verification
summary: Contextual image misuse pairs an image with a misleading claim. We study image-claim correspondence in fact-checked pairs containing out-of-context reuse, visual manipulation, or both. Existing pair-based detectors often compress the two modalities into a global compatibility score or learn a highly flexible interaction module, which can obscure a decisive local mismatch. We introduce directional multiscale coverage, a compact representation that summarizes local image-claim affinity in both directions and at three spatial scales. At each scale, each direction is summarized by its mean, lower quartile, and two thresholded support ratios; the signed difference between directional means completes a nine-dimensional scale descriptor. Concatenating the three scales yields a compact local representation for a lightweight global-local classifier. Under leakage-aware three-fold, three-seed evaluation on the Snopes subset of the Fauxtography benchmark, UNMATCH achieves 69.82 Macro-F1 and 71.05 balanced accuracy, exceeding the MCOT adaptation by 2.60 and 2.16 points. A matched-reassigned intervention shows that breaking the observed pairing lowers coverage and increases both discrepancy and false-pair probability.

AI.tldr: 本文研究图文误导配对中的图像-声明对应关系，提出方向性多尺度覆盖表示 UNMATCH，用于检测语境外复用、视觉篡改或二者兼有的虚假配对。
AI.motivation: 现有基于配对的检测器常将图像和文本压缩为全局兼容性分数，或使用高度灵活但难以解释的交互模块，可能掩盖关键的局部不匹配。
AI.method: 提出方向性多尺度覆盖表示：在三个空间尺度上，分别从两个方向汇总图像-声明局部亲和度；每个方向用均值、下四分位数和两个阈值支持率表示，并用方向均值之差构成九维尺度描述符；拼接三个尺度后输入轻量级全局-局部分类器。
AI.result: 在 Fauxtography 基准的 Snopes 子集上，采用防泄漏三折三种子评估，UNMATCH 达到 69.82 Macro-F1 和 71.05 平衡准确率，分别超过 MCOT 适配版本 2.60 和 2.16 个百分点。匹配-重分配干预表明，破坏原有配对会降低覆盖度，并提高差异度和假配对概率。
AI.conclusion: 紧凑的方向性多尺度局部覆盖表示能有效捕捉图像-声明间的决定性局部不匹配，在图文误导检测中优于现有适配方法，并可通过配对干预验证其判别依据。

title: Learning Geometry-Aware Virtual Fixtures From Sparse Demonstrations
summary: In many teleoperation applications, collecting a large number of demonstrations as required for traditional probabilistic learning from demonstration (LfD) approaches may not be feasible. To still give operators the ability to intuitively create trajectories as Virtual Fixtures (VFs), we propose to leverage a motion prior in the learning process. Particularly, by using Linear Quadratic Tracking (LQT), users are able to define guiding trajectories from the demonstration of just a few via points. To account for orientation guidance, we further reformulate classical LQT on Riemannian manifolds, introducing an additional geometric prior. Through a probabilistic interpretation of the LQT solution, we derive a covariance estimate at each trajectory point which we use to modulate the stiffness of the resulting fixture, resulting in strong guidance around the via points and softer guidance when far away. The covariance information is also used to define a validity region of the fixture, allowing the operator to leave its influence area and conduct unmodeled tasks. We evaluate the proposed Riemannian LQT formulation in a set of toy examples and the full framework on a cutting task requiring high precision in a minimally invasive surgery setting on the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种利用运动先验的虚拟夹具生成方法，通过黎曼线性二次跟踪（LQT）从少量路径点推断引导轨迹，并利用概率协方差调节夹具刚度与有效区域。
AI.motivation: 传统概率学习演示（LfD）通常需要大量演示数据，在遥操作场景中难以实现；但仍然需要让操作者能够直观地创建虚拟夹具轨迹。
AI.method: 使用线性二次跟踪（LQT）从少量via points定义引导轨迹；将经典LQT重新表述在黎曼流形上以处理方向引导；对LQT解进行概率解释，得到轨迹点协方差，用于调节夹具刚度，并定义夹具有效区域。
AI.result: 在多个玩具示例中评估了所提出的黎曼LQT公式，并在da Vinci Research Kit（dVRK）上针对需要高精度的微创手术切割任务评估了完整框架。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够从少量演示生成具有方向引导和变刚度的虚拟夹具，允许操作者离开夹具影响区域执行未建模任务，并在微创手术等高精度遥操作场景中具有应用潜力。

title: Panoptic Scene Program Diffusion Transformer
summary: Modern text-to-image models produce high-fidelity images but still struggle with compositional prompts that require instance identity, attribute ownership, counting, spatial ordering, and role-sensitive relations. We introduce Panoptic Scene Program Diffusion Transformer (PSP-DiT), a diffusion-transformer architecture that treats a panoptic scene program as a first-class latent variable rather than an external control signal or post-hoc parse. PSP-DiT jointly denoises image latents and scene-program latents through coupled transformer streams, while panoptic grounding and cycle-consistency objectives tie object instances, attributes, relations, and counts to visual support in the generated image. Under matched training and inference settings, PSP-DiT improves over a strong flat-text baseline across GenEval 2, SANEval-Simple, PSG-Score, and DetailMaster, with the largest gains on counting, attribute binding, role-sensitive relations, and long structured prompts. The method preserves image quality, adds modest inference overhead, and remains robust to imperfect scene programs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PSP-DiT，将全景场景程序作为一等潜变量，通过扩散 Transformer 联合去噪图像与场景程序，提升组合式文本到图像生成能力。
AI.motivation: 现代文生图模型虽能生成高保真图像，但在需要实例身份、属性归属、计数、空间顺序和角色敏感关系的组合提示上仍表现不佳。
AI.method: 提出 Panoptic Scene Program Diffusion Transformer（PSP-DiT），将全景场景程序作为潜变量而非外部控制信号或事后解析；通过耦合 Transformer 流联合去噪图像潜变量和场景程序潜变量，并使用全景 grounding 与循环一致性目标，将实例、属性、关系和计数绑定到生成图像的视觉证据上。
AI.result: 在匹配训练和推理设置下，PSP-DiT 在 GenEval 2、SANEval-Simple、PSG-Score 和 DetailMaster 上优于强 flat-text 基线，在计数、属性绑定、角色敏感关系和长结构化提示上提升最大；同时保持图像质量，仅增加少量推理开销，并对不完美场景程序保持鲁棒。
AI.conclusion: 将全景场景程序建模为潜变量并与图像联合去噪，可有效增强组合式文生图的可控性与准确性，且不会显著牺牲图像质量或推理效率。

title: Enabling Timely Guidance before Skill Retrieval: Retaining Helpful Warm Tips in Agent Context
summary: Reusable skills help LLM-based agents solve complex tasks, but the agent must receive guidance before it commits to an ineffective approach. Existing skill mechanisms often expose only metadata and load full content on demand, leaving useful guidance unavailable until the agent decides to retrieve it. General memory methods can incur substantial maintenance overhead, while keeping guidance in conversation context risks repeatedly exposing the agent to irrelevant or harmful advice. We propose TipsWarm, a mechanism that complements existing skill mechanisms by maintaining a budgeted pool of skill-derived keypoints, or \textit{warm tips}, for selective injection into the context of every message turn. By separating event-triggered LLM assessment from inexpensive per-turn screening, it makes transferable skill guidance readily available while controlling maintenance costs. In three coding and iterative task-execution benchmarks, TipsWarm achieves the highest task success rate while remaining time-efficient, compared to recent skill and general memory baselines.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TipsWarm 机制，通过维护一个带预算的、源自技能的关键点池（warm tips），在每个消息轮次中按需注入上下文，从而在不增加过多维护成本的前提下为 LLM 智能体提供可复用的技能指导。
AI.motivation: 可复用技能能帮助 LLM 智能体解决复杂任务，但现有技能机制通常只暴露元数据、按需加载完整内容，导致智能体在决定检索之前拿不到有用指导；通用记忆方法维护开销大，而将指导常驻对话上下文又可能反复暴露无关甚至有害的建议。
AI.method: TipsWarm 维护一个带预算的技能衍生关键点池，将事件触发的 LLM 评估与低成本的每轮筛选相分离，从而在每个消息轮次选择性地注入关键点，使可迁移的技能指导随时可用并控制维护成本。
AI.result: 在三个编码与迭代式任务执行基准上，与近期技能方法和通用记忆基线相比，TipsWarm 取得了最高的任务成功率，同时保持时间效率。
AI.conclusion: 通过分离事件触发的评估与每轮轻量筛选，TipsWarm 既能及时提供可迁移的技能指导，又能控制维护开销，是现有技能机制的有效补充。

title: HyperReCo: Retrieving and Connecting Evidence with Hypergraph Neural Networks for LLM Multi-hop Reasoning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown strong capabilities, with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) supporting complex multi-hop reasoning by retrieving evidence distributed across documents. Graph-based approaches exploit connections among evidence, and hypergraph-based retrieval further preserves higher-order entity associations within documents and connects documents through shared entities. However, existing hypergraph retrievers often rely on predefined structural expansion or diffusion, which may miss query-dependent interactions needed to identify relevant evidence. They also leave connections among retrieved evidence implicit, requiring LLMs to reconstruct these connections before reasoning. Therefore, we propose HyperReCo, a framework for retrieving and connecting evidence with a hypergraph neural network (HyperGNN). We represent each document as a hyperedge over its extracted entities, with shared entities connecting the hyperedges. Through hypergraph message passing with joint supervision over documents and entities, the HyperGNN learns query-dependent interactions to retrieve complementary evidence. We further introduce Gradient-Guided Hyper-Path Decoding (GGHD), which uses gradient attribution to interpret the learned interactions and translate them into explicit hyper-paths that help LLMs combine complementary facts for multi-hop reasoning. Experiments on six benchmarks show that HyperReCo achieves the best retrieval performance among the compared methods on all three multi-hop QA datasets, together with strong downstream QA performance. Case studies and further analyses demonstrate the utility of decoded hyper-paths for connecting retrieved evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出 HyperReCo，利用超图神经网络检索并连接证据，通过梯度引导超路径解码提升多跳推理。
AI.motivation: 现有超图检索依赖预定义结构扩展或扩散，可能忽略查询相关交互；同时检索证据间连接隐含，需LLM自行重建后才能推理。
AI.method: 将每篇文档表示为实体超边，共享实体连接超边；通过HyperGNN消息传递并对文档和实体联合监督，学习查询相关交互以检索互补证据；引入梯度引导超路径解码GGHD，用梯度归因解释交互并生成显式超路径，帮助LLM组合互补事实。
AI.result: 在六个基准上，HyperReCo在三个多跳QA数据集上取得最佳检索性能，并具有强下游QA表现；案例研究和分析证明解码超路径对连接检索证据有效。
AI.conclusion: HyperReCo能学习查询相关交互并显式连接检索证据，从而更好支持多跳推理。

title: CAPEX: Efficiently Distilling Foundation Model Behavior into Deployable Robot Policies through Experience-Adaptive Reasoning
summary: Robot learning has largely relied on human-teleoperated demonstrations to acquire effective learnable behaviors. However, human-operated data collection processes can be unintuitive, difficult to scale, and inherently asynchronous. We explore an alternative: distilling physical behavior from general-purpose multimodal foundation models into deployable robot policies by using the foundation model itself as an autonomous demonstrator. While sufficiently capable models can generate successful zero-shot manipulation trajectories, repeatedly invoking them during physical execution is slow and expensive, limiting their utility as scalable data generators. As a solution, we introduce CAPEX, an experience-conditioned demonstration collection framework that uses execution experience from previous attempts to adapt how frequently the foundation model must observe, reason, and replan. We evaluate across RoboCasa tasks and on physical Franka and bimanual YAM-arm platforms, measuring task success, model calls, token usage, collection time, and cost. We further train Diffusion Policy and ACT on matched sets of human-teleoperated and foundation-model-generated demonstrations to evaluate the downstream learning value of autonomously collected data. We find that CAPEX increases the number of successful demonstrations by 4.3x while reducing the cost per successful demonstration by 80%. Policies trained on CAPEX-generated data approach the performance of those trained on matched human demonstrations; with longer training, this gap largely closes for policies trained from scratch. These results suggest that foundation models can serve as scalable sources of reusable robot experience. Project page: https://capex-paper.github.io/

AI.tldr: 提出CAPEX框架，利用基础模型作为自主演示者，通过执行经验自适应调整基础模型观察、推理和重规划的频率，从而高效收集机器人演示数据，并验证其下游学习价值。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习依赖人类遥操作演示，但数据收集不直观、难以扩展且本质异步。基础模型虽能零样本生成操作轨迹，但物理执行中反复调用它们缓慢且昂贵，限制了其作为可扩展数据生成器的实用性。
AI.method: CAPEX：一种经验条件演示收集框架，利用先前尝试的执行经验来适应基础模型必须观察、推理和重规划的频率。在RoboCasa任务以及物理Franka和双臂YAM平台上评估，测量任务成功率、模型调用次数、token使用、收集时间和成本，并训练Diffusion Policy和ACT于匹配的人类遥操作与基础模型生成演示数据集上。
AI.result: CAPEX将成功演示数量提高4.3倍，同时将每个成功演示的成本降低80%。在CAPEX生成数据上训练的策略接近匹配人类演示训练的策略性能；随着训练时间延长，从头训练的策略差距基本消失。
AI.conclusion: 基础模型可以作为可扩展的可复用机器人经验来源。

title: SelfCue: Making a 3D CT Report Generator Say What It Already Knows
summary: Progress in 3D CT report generation is usually sought in increasingly sophisticated architectures and larger pools of training data. We find instead that a 3D CT report generator already holds what its report leaves out, and loses it when the hidden state becomes tokens. Over the 18 CT-RATE abnormalities, this hidden-to-report surfacing gap is reflected by a drop in macro AUROC from 0.848 in the hidden states to 0.739 in the generated report. We propose SelfCue based on contrastive decoding. It promotes what the hidden state already supports and suppresses what it does not. It raises clinical efficacy F1 to 0.481 and the LLM-judged GREEN score to 0.510. Distilling that behaviour into the weights gives SelfCue-KD, a student that keeps most of the gain, needs nothing extra at inference, and drops into any pipeline already serving the baseline. Code is available at https://github.com/renjie-liang/SelfCue-CT.

AI.tldr: 该论文发现3D CT报告生成器在隐藏状态中已包含比生成报告更丰富的诊断信息，并提出SelfCue与SelfCue-KD方法，通过对比解码和知识蒸馏缩小隐藏状态到报告之间的信息损失。
AI.motivation: 现有3D CT报告生成研究多聚焦于更复杂架构和更大训练数据，但作者发现模型隐藏状态已具备较强诊断能力，而在将其解码为文本报告时性能显著下降，即隐藏状态到报告存在信息表面化差距。
AI.method: 提出基于对比解码的SelfCue方法，促进隐藏状态已支持的诊断内容并抑制其不支持的内容；进一步将这种行为蒸馏到模型权重中，得到SelfCue-KD学生模型。
AI.result: 在18种CT-RATE异常上，宏AUROC从隐藏状态的0.848降至生成报告的0.739；SelfCue将临床效能F1提升至0.481，LLM评判的GREEN分数提升至0.510；SelfCue-KD保留大部分增益，且推理时无需额外开销。
AI.conclusion: 无需复杂架构或更大数据，通过利用隐藏状态并改进解码可有效提升3D CT报告生成质量；SelfCue-KD可直接替换基线模型，便于现有流程部署。

title: TriDrive: Joint Driver, Vehicle, and Road Modeling for Forecasting and Driver Monitoring
comment: 32 pages (10-page main text plus appendices), 4 figures, 25 tables. Under review. Code, checkpoints, and demo video: https://huggingface.co/HenryYHW/TriDrive
summary: Predicting how drivers, vehicles, and road scenes interact and evolve together is central to driver monitoring. Prior work models in-cabin activity or traffic-conditioned driver motion in isolation, motivating joint driver, vehicle, and road modeling with real-time on-vehicle evaluation. We introduce TriDrive, to our knowledge the first unified framework that jointly forecasts driver kinematics, vehicle dynamics, and road demands through an automation-conditioned transition model.
