Yet research tells us more about whether congresswomen appear than how they are visually framed. Facial recognition analysis of 695,464 image-text segments from CNN and Fox News (2011-2021) reveals that congresswomen appear disproportionately in split-screen rather than solo shots. Two pre-registered experiments with 6,220 participants show that, in static frames, split-screen framing reduces congresswomen's perceived political competence, but not congressmen's. In dynamic videos, the competence penalty disappears; instead, outraged language reduces a congresswoman's perceived warmth roughly three times as much as a congressman's. Suggestive evidence (p = .057) indicates that women viewers report greater external political efficacy after watching a congresswoman appear alone. We conclude that visual framing shapes both congresswomen's mediated visibility and their perceived capabilities.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析CNN和福克斯新闻2011—2021年的图像文本片段，并结合两个预注册实验，考察电视新闻的视觉呈现方式如何影响女性国会议员的可见度与能力评价。
AI.motivation: 女性在国会中的比例长期低于30%，在电视新闻中的可见度也较低；视觉呈现可能影响公众对政治人物能力与权威的感知，但既有研究更多关注女性议员是否出现，而非她们如何被视觉框定。
AI.method: 对CNN和福克斯新闻2011—2021年间695,464个图像文本片段进行面部识别分析；并开展两个预注册实验，共6,220名参与者，测试静态画面、动态视频及愤怒语言对性别化政治感知的影响。
AI.result: 分析发现女性国会议员更常出现在分屏而非单人镜头中。静态画面下，分屏框定会降低女性议员的政治能力感知，但对男性议员没有同样影响；动态视频中能力惩罚消失，而愤怒语言使女性议员温暖感下降约为男性议员的三倍。另有提示性证据（p = .057）表明，女性观众观看女性议员单独出镜后，外部政治效能感更高。
AI.conclusion: 视觉框定不仅影响女性国会议员的媒体可见度，也影响公众对其政治能力的感知，因此媒体呈现方式对性别化政治评价具有重要意义。

title: LLM Alignment--Utility Asymmetry under Semantic-Preserving Transformations
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) alignment is intended to ensure that models remain helpful and safe, but its stability under input distributional shift is not yet fully understood. Prior work shows that aligned models can fail under jailbreak prompts, alternative encodings, and cross-lingual transfer, yet these failures are usually studied as attacks rather than controlled probes of alignment generalization. Moreover, existing evidence is largely grounded in natural language variation already represented during pretraining, leaving unresolved whether alignment generalizes with semantic content or remains tied to superficial surface patterns. In this paper, we study this question using synthetic semantic-preserving transformations that are rule-based and invertible, preserving task-relevant meaning while shifting inputs beyond standard linguistic variation. Across four open-weight and four commercial models, under both fine-tuning and in-context learning, we use these transformations as a probe of alignment generalization and identify an empirical pattern we term Alignment--utility asymmetry: once models can operate effectively on transformed inputs, task utility is often substantially retained while alignment failure increases more sharply. For example, adapted GPT-4.1 mini shows only limited utility degradation under transformation while its harmful rate rises from 13.3 to 74.3; Gemini 3 Flash similarly retains near-original utility while its harmful rate increases from 2.3 to 43.0. Taken together, these results suggest that semantic-preserving distribution shifts can expose a recurring gap in how utility and alignment generalize in current LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究大语言模型对齐在语义保持的分布偏移下的泛化稳定性，并提出“对齐—效用不对称”现象。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐失败多被当作攻击研究，且主要基于预训练中已有的自然语言变异，尚不清楚对齐是随语义内容泛化，还是依赖表面模式。
AI.method: 使用规则化、可逆、语义保持的合成变换，在4个开源和4个商用模型上，结合微调与上下文学习，将这些变换作为对齐泛化的探针。
AI.result: 当模型能在变换输入上保持任务效用时，对齐失败反而更明显：例如GPT-4.1 mini有害率从13.3升至74.3，Gemini 3 Flash从2.3升至43.0。
AI.conclusion: 语义保持的分布偏移揭示了当前大语言模型在效用泛化与对齐泛化之间反复出现的差距。

title: Beyond Tasks: A Vision for Reproducing an Animal-like Behavioral Substrate Using Modern Robot Learning Techniques
summary: Recent advances in robot learning have produced increasingly capable embodied agents. Yet comparatively less attention has been given to a more basic form of competence that animals exhibit continuously: the ability to remain situated, responsive, and behaviorally coherent as physical, environmental, and social demands change over time. We propose the ethological behavioral substrate as a conceptual lens for studying this form of competence in artificial agents. Rather than treating these behaviors that animals exhibit as a set of isolated skills, we argue that their continual coordination under competing demands constitutes an important and underexplored target for modern robot learning. We further propose robotic animal companions as a useful research setting for studying sustained interaction and adaptation in human-centered environments. Such systems provide an opportunity to investigate how social behavior, memory, and continual learning develop over long periods of interaction. This perspective motivates further investigation of how such persistent behavioral competence may complement higher-level capabilities in embodied agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出以“习性行为基底”为概念视角，研究人工代理在动态需求下保持情境化、响应性和行为连贯性的基本能力，并建议以机器人动物伴侣作为研究持续交互与适应的场景。
AI.motivation: 机器人学习虽进展显著，但较少关注动物持续展现的基本能力：在物理、环境和社会需求变化时保持行为连贯。研究这种持续协调行为的能力，并探索其与高级能力的互补性。
AI.method: 概念性/理论性文章，提出“习性行为基底”框架和“机器人动物伴侣”研究场景，而非具体实验方法。
AI.result: 论证动物行为并非孤立技能，而是竞争需求下的持续协调，这是现代机器人学习未充分探索的目标；机器人动物伴侣可用于研究长期交互中的社会行为、记忆和持续学习。
AI.conclusion: 持续行为胜任力可能补充具身代理的高级能力，激励进一步研究其在人工代理中的实现。

title: Focusing Condition: Inference-Time Self-Contrastive Steering Elicits Better Conditional Text Embeddings in LLMs
summary: Extracting conditional text embeddings from large language models (LLMs) is a promising paradigm, as it requires neither additional data nor fine-tuning. Existing methods incorporate conditions into prompts to guide LLMs to focus on specific aspects and elicit conditional text embeddings. However, relying solely on prompts often fails to produce high-quality conditional text embeddings, as they remain entangled with general text embeddings, ultimately degrading their quality. To this end, we propose an inference-time, plug-and-play Self-Contrastive Steering (SCS) method that constructs unconditional general text embeddings and uses them to refine conditional text embeddings, making them more focused on the target condition. Specifically, we modify the attention mask and positional encodings to mask the condition, thereby obtaining unconditional text embeddings and intervening in the multi-head self-attention computation process. Notably, our method is highly efficient, requiring only a single additional multi-head self-attention computation at inference time. Extensive experiments on clustering, Semantic Textual Similarity, and triplet alignment datasets demonstrate that our method can seamlessly improve the performance of existing prompt-based methods across different LLMs in a training-free and plug-and-play manner. Our code will be released at https://github.com/zifengcheng/SCS

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需训练、即插即用的自对比引导（SCS）方法，通过构建无条件文本嵌入来优化条件文本嵌入，使其更聚焦于目标条件。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仅依靠提示词将条件融入大语言模型以提取条件文本嵌入，但生成的条件嵌入常与通用文本嵌入纠缠，导致质量下降。
AI.method: 在推理时修改注意力掩码和位置编码以屏蔽条件，获得无条件文本嵌入，并介入多头自注意力计算过程，仅需一次额外的多头自注意力计算。
AI.result: 在聚类、语义文本相似度和三元组对齐数据集上的实验表明，SCS能无缝提升现有基于提示的方法在不同LLM上的性能，且无需训练、即插即用。
AI.conclusion: SCS方法高效且即插即用，能显著改善条件文本嵌入的质量，代码将开源。

title: Multi-Terrain Mastery: A Comprehensive Controller for Bipedal Locomotion
summary: Advancing bipedal robots to navigate diverse terrains remains a significant challenge in robotics. Traditional locomotion controllers excel on specific surfaces but struggle across varied environments, limiting their practical applications. Given the unpredictable nature of real-world environments, a single controller capable of handling multiple terrains is ideal, eliminating the need for multiple specialized controllers. We propose a multi-terrain controller to enhance the versatility and robustness of bipedal locomotion. Building on previous work with a stance ankle motor for stability on inclined and rough surfaces, this paper extends capabilities to steep wet uneven grassy slopes, and compliant terrains such as sand, gravel, rocks, and constrained terrains like staircases. To address the unique demands of these terrains, we introduce a new impact map that is essential for maintaining performance and robustness against unseen terrains. We also discuss in detail the control structure for real-time deployment on the robot. We validate our controller on the 20 degree-of-freedom Cassie bipedal robot.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向双足机器人的多地形控制器，旨在提升多种地形上的通用性与鲁棒性，并在20自由度Cassie机器人上验证。
AI.motivation: 传统运动控制器在特定表面表现良好，但难以适应多变环境，限制实际应用；真实环境不可预测，因此理想方案是用单一控制器处理多种地形，而非依赖多个专用控制器。
AI.method: 在先前利用站立踝关节电机提升斜坡和崎岖表面稳定性的工作基础上，将能力扩展到陡峭湿滑不平草地斜坡、沙地、砾石、岩石等柔性地形以及楼梯等受限地形；引入新的impact map以维持性能和鲁棒性；并详细讨论在机器人上实时部署的控制结构。
AI.result: 控制器在多种地形上增强了双足运动的通用性和鲁棒性，并对未见地形保持性能与鲁棒性；在20自由度Cassie双足机器人上完成验证。
AI.conclusion: 多地形单一控制器可有效应对多样和未知环境，减少对多个专用控制器的需求，有助于提升双足机器人的实际应用能力。

title: Carnator: Fast Text-to-Video Generation with Generation-Native Compatibility-Guided Cross-Request Reuse
summary: Video diffusion transformers produce high-quality videos, yet iterative denoising incurs substantial inference latency, limiting interactive and large-scale serving. Most existing acceleration methods focus on individual requests, thereby restricting efficiency gains to redundancy within a single generation trajectory. Recent cross-request reuse offers an additional source of savings, but existing approaches often infer reusability from coarse semantic similarity. This conflates semantic relatedness with generation-level computational compatibility, so aggressive reuse may accept incompatible historical computation while conservative reuse leaves substantial acceleration unrealized. We present \emph{Carnator}, a cross-request acceleration framework that addresses this challenge by extracting and using generation-native compatibility evidence directly from the model's evolving internal states. Specifically, \emph{Carnator} performs a lightweight early probe to construct an Early Signature from internal diffusion states, assessing reuse validity through risk-aware compatibility decisions. The same evidence characterizes reuse scope by localizing target-specific computation and guiding joint reuse of historical latent trajectories and sparse attention connectivity. Across three text-to-video backbones, Carnator consistently achieves higher cache-hit end-to-end acceleration than the evaluated cross-request baselines despite more selective cache acceptance, reaching up to 2.17$\times$ speedup while maintaining competitive generation quality.

AI.tldr: Carnator 是一个跨请求加速框架，通过从视频扩散变换器的内部扩散状态中提取生成原生兼容性证据，实现风险感知的缓存重用，从而降低推理延迟并保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散变换器生成质量高，但迭代去噪推理延迟大，限制交互式和大规模服务。现有加速方法多关注单请求，只能利用单条生成轨迹内的冗余；跨请求重用方法又常基于粗粒度语义相似性判断可重用性，混淆了语义相关性与生成级计算兼容性，导致激进重用可能接受不兼容计算，保守重用则加速不足。
AI.method: Carnator 进行轻量级早期探测，从内部扩散状态构建 Early Signature，并通过风险感知兼容性决策评估重用有效性；同时利用相同证据定位目标特定计算以确定重用范围，并引导历史潜在轨迹与稀疏注意力连接的联合重用。
AI.result: 在三个文本到视频骨干网络上，Carnator 相比评估的跨请求基线取得更高的缓存命中端到端加速；尽管其缓存接受更选择性，仍实现最高 2.17 倍加速，并保持有竞争力的生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 利用模型演化内部状态中的生成原生兼容性证据，可以实现更有效且更安全的跨请求重用，为视频扩散模型推理加速提供了新方向。

title: Opening LLM Judges: Recovering Preference Signals Beyond the Final Verdict
summary: LLM judges are widely used to evaluate model outputs, but their verdicts can be unreliable: a judge may favor the worse answer for its position, length, or other surface features. When a judge is wrong, is the information needed to judge correctly absent from the model, or present in its internal representations but not reflected in the output? We study this across 64 open-weight evaluators and 14 datasets, including causal interventions on 41 judges (editing activations mid-run to see whether the verdict changes). On LLMBar, built so the superficially better answer is the worse one, the verdicts of 50 judges agree with human labels only 0.456 of the time, even after averaging both answer orders. Yet a small probe on the same judges' activations, with no weight updates, reaches 0.846, and 0.686 once surface features such as length and position are residualized out (0.507 with shuffled labels). The gap holds across eight benchmarks and model families, but is not universal: a score of how well surface features alone predict the human label, computed before any probe is trained, predicts the size of the gain (Spearman rho = 0.90). On rubric tasks that score one answer at a time, leaving no surface cue to exploit, reading the internals gives no advantage. The interventions also show that editing activations mid-network already changes the verdict, before it can be read off directly, and locate the pathways carrying position and length bias. At the same label budget, the recovered signal lets a judge flag cases where it is likely wrong and yields better labels for preference learning. A wrong verdict, then, does not mean the judge lacks the information, and a simple diagnostic shows when it is worth recovering.

AI.tldr: 研究LLM评委判断答案时表面特征偏差问题，通过64个开源评估器和14个数据集，发现错误判决常因内部表示中已有正确信息但未输出。激活探针可从内部恢复正确信号，且表面特征可预测增益大小。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM评委判断错误时，是模型缺少正确判断所需信息，还是信息存在于内部表示但未反映在输出中。
AI.method: 在64个开源评估器、14个数据集上实验，对41个评委做因果干预（运行中编辑激活观察判决变化），在激活上训练小型探针，并残差化长度和位置等表面特征，比较不同基准与任务。
AI.result: LLMBar上50个评委与人类标签一致率仅0.456；激活探针达0.846，残差化后0.686（打乱标签0.507）。增益跨八个基准和模型家族存在但不普遍；表面特征预测人类标签的分数可预测增益大小（Spearman rho=0.90）。单答案评分无表面线索时内部读取无优势。激活编辑可在直接读出前改变判决，并定位位置和长度偏差通路。同标签预算下，恢复信号可标记可能错误并改进偏好学习标签。
AI.conclusion: 错误判决不意味着评委缺乏信息，内部表示常包含正确判断信号；简单诊断可判断何时值得恢复该信号。

title: MergeHEIR: Mitigating Multimodal Hallucinations as the Tax of Model Merging
summary: Model merging consolidates task-specialized experts into a single deployable model. However, we show that such capability consolidation incurs a merging tax of increased hallucination: across 8 model-merging methods, every merged checkpoint exhibits a higher hallucination rate than the average of its constituent experts. An intuitive approach is to adapt existing hallucination-mitigation methods to the post-merge model, yet this unconstrained adaptation disrupts inherited capabilities, creating a tension between hallucination mitigation and expertise retention. To tackle this challenge, we introduce MergeHEIR, a post-merge adaptation framework designed to reduce this merging tax while preserving expertise inherited from initial experts. Using small expert-task calibration sets, MergeHEIR constructs layer-wise null-space projectors via SVD from task-specific activations collected from the merged checkpoint, and periodically projects the accumulated post-merge displacement onto the resulting null spaces to preserve inherited expertise. Theoretically, we establish minimum-distortion and maximum-dimensionality guarantees, characterize the threshold-controlled adaptation-retention trade-off, and extend perturbation guarantees beyond finite calibration data. Across 24 paired comparisons spanning three MLLM configurations and 8 model-merging methods, MergeHEIR consistently mitigates hallucination while largely preserving inherited expertise, demonstrating a more favorable hallucination-retention trade-off.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示模型合并会引入“合并税”——合并后模型的幻觉率高于各专家平均，并提出MergeHEIR框架，在合并后适配中降低幻觉同时保留继承的专家能力。
AI.motivation: 模型合并虽能将多个任务专家整合为单一可部署模型，但作者发现这种能力整合会导致幻觉率上升；而直接将现有幻觉缓解方法用于合并后模型会破坏继承的专家能力，形成幻觉缓解与专长保留之间的张力。
AI.method: 提出MergeHEIR后合并适配框架：利用小规模专家-任务校准集，从合并检查点的任务特定激活中通过SVD构造逐层零空间投影器，并定期将合并后累积位移投影到零空间以保留继承专长；理论上给出最小失真与最大维度保证，刻画阈值控制的适配-保留权衡，并将扰动保证扩展到有限校准数据之外。
AI.result: 在3种MLLM配置、8种模型合并方法共24组配对比较中，MergeHEIR持续降低幻觉并基本保留继承的专家能力，展现出更优的幻觉-保留权衡。
AI.conclusion: MergeHEIR能有效缓解模型合并带来的合并税，在幻觉缓解与专家能力保留之间取得更好的平衡。

title: Type-Balanced Federated Learning for Visual Analog Meter Reading
summary: Analog dial meters are widely deployed in industrial applications and utility sites, where environments and meter types vary and inspection data may be sensitive. Currently, automatic meter readers must be individually developed and deployed for each environment and meter type in practice. Deep learning could handle this variability but requires diverse labeled data that are costly to collect and update. In practice, meter images are distributed across independent sites, each with limited labels, while raw images often cannot be pooled because of ownership, governance, or privacy constraints. To address these challenges, we present a federated framework for visual analog meter reading that enables multiple sites to collaboratively train a reading model without sharing their raw images. Our framework consists of a four-stage pipeline: (1) dial localization, (2) thin-structure segmentation trained federatively across clients, (3) polar unwrapping, and (4) tick-counting decoding for final reading. To enable systematic evaluation of this setting, we release MeterFL, a 1,382-image mask-annotated dataset organized into deployment-motivated pseudo-clients derived from visual attributes via deterministic rules, with dHash near-duplicate control between the segmentation train and test splits. We evaluate both segmentation quality and end-to-end reading accuracy. MeterFL is publicly available at https://github.com/weidazhaoooo/Meter-FL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向模拟指针式仪表读数的联邦学习框架，使多个站点无需共享原始图像即可协作训练读数模型，并发布了用于该场景评估的 MeterFL 数据集。
AI.motivation: 模拟仪表广泛部署于工业和公用事业场景，但环境与仪表类型多样、检测数据可能敏感；现有自动抄表系统通常需针对每种环境和仪表单独开发部署，而深度学习虽能应对多样性，却依赖大量且难以持续更新的标注数据。实际中图像分散在独立站点、标注有限，且因所有权、治理或隐私限制无法集中原始图像。
AI.method: 提出四阶段流水线：1）表盘定位；2）跨客户端联邦训练的细结构分割；3）极坐标展开；4）通过刻度计数解码得到最终读数。同时构建 MeterFL 数据集，包含1,382张带掩码标注图像，按视觉属性通过确定性规则组织为模拟部署场景的伪客户端，并在分割训练集与测试集之间使用 dHash 进行近重复控制。
AI.result: 发布了 MeterFL 数据集并公开于 https://github.com/weidazhaoooo/Meter-FL；评估内容包括分割质量和端到端读数准确率。摘要未给出具体性能数值。
AI.conclusion: 该联邦框架可在不共享原始图像的前提下支持多站点协作训练，从而应对仪表类型与环境差异以及数据隐私和治理限制；MeterFL 为系统评估此类联邦视觉仪表读数任务提供了基准数据集。

title: Dynamic Manipulation with World-Action Models via Counterfactual Planning
comment: 48 pages, including appendices. Project page: https://methoder00.github.io/DPP/
summary:
World-Action models (WAMs) trained on static demonstrations often fail to manipulate moving targets even when they possess the required manipulation skills. We attribute this failure to target-response collapse: as execution advances, the policy becomes increasingly biased toward the learned continuation of its ongoing behavior and less responsive to target relocation.
  To bridge the gap between what the model has learned and what it can generate from the current context, we formulate dynamic manipulation as counterfactual planning by decoupling the context used for plan generation from the physical state used for execution. Our framework, Dynamic Predictive Planning (DPP), first uses the WAM's predictive rollout to estimate when an interaction is expected to occur, and combines this timing estimate with observed target motion to predict the target's future interaction position. DPP then constructs a counterfactual observation that places this predicted target position in a familiar robot context, allowing the model to invoke an existing manipulation skill rather than generate a recovery behavior from an unfamiliar robot-target configuration. The resulting plan is connected to the robot's actual state during execution.
  DPP enables real-time dynamic manipulation on a single consumer GPU without additional training on dynamic data. Experiments in simulation and on a real robot demonstrate consistent improvements across diverse target motions, with simulation performance surpassing all evaluated baselines, including methods additionally trained on dynamic data.
  Project page: https://methoder00.github.io/DPP/

AI.tldr: 论文提出动态预测规划（DPP）框架，使基于静态演示训练的世界-动作模型（WAM）无需额外动态数据训练即可实时操作移动目标。
AI.motivation: WAM在静态演示上训练后，即使具备所需操作技能，也常无法操作移动目标，作者将其归因于“目标-响应坍缩”：执行推进时策略越来越偏向延续已学行为，对目标移动响应变差。
AI.method: 将动态操作建模为反事实规划，解耦用于生成计划的上下文与用于执行的物理状态。DPP先用WAM预测性rollout估计交互时机，结合观测到的目标运动预测未来交互位置；再构造反事实观测，把预测目标位置放入熟悉的机器人上下文中，以调用已有技能而非生成陌生配置下的恢复行为；执行时将计划连接到机器人真实状态。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实机器人上，DPP对多种目标运动均取得一致提升；仿真性能超过所有评估基线，包括额外用动态数据训练的方法；可在单张消费级GPU上实时运行，且无需动态数据额外训练。
AI.conclusion: DPP通过反事实规划弥合模型所学与当前上下文之间的差距，为移动目标动态操作提供无需额外训练、可实时部署的有效方案。

title: TriO: Tri-Modal Unsupervised Occupancy World Model for Anything Perception
summary: We present TriO, a multi-modal unsupervised world model that predicts 4D occupancy, obstacle segmentation, flow and LiDAR. In contrast to prior work, TriO utilizes three distinct sensor modalities (camera, LiDAR, and RADAR) as both inputs and sources of self-supervision, eliminating the need for additional human annotations. Thanks to its novel supervision, the model is able to segment any occupancy from the drivable surface, overcoming the limitations of existing open-set methods in handling long-tail objects. TriO achieves state-of-the-art results in multiple 3D and 4D tasks, including occupancy, flow, and LiDAR prediction, as well as zero-shot road obstacle segmentation across multiple datasets such as Argoverse 2, and Spotting the Unexpected.

AI.tldr: TriO 是一种多模态无监督世界模型，可预测 4D 占用、障碍物分割、光流和 LiDAR，并在多项 3D/4D 任务上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖额外人工标注，且开放集方法在处理长尾物体时存在局限；因此需要无需标注、能更好分割可行驶表面与任意占用的多模态自监督方案。
AI.method: TriO 将相机、LiDAR 和 RADAR 三种传感器模态同时作为输入和自监督来源，无需额外人工标注，并利用新颖的监督方式实现 4D 占用、障碍物分割、流和 LiDAR 预测。
AI.result: TriO 在占用、流和 LiDAR 预测等多项 3D 与 4D 任务上达到 state-of-the-art，并在 Argoverse 2、Spotting the Unexpected 等多个数据集上实现零样本道路障碍物分割。
AI.conclusion: TriO 通过多模态无监督世界模型有效克服了现有开放集方法在长尾物体上的局限，展现出强大的多任务预测与跨数据集泛化能力。

title: ScreenHaystack: Finding Blind Zones in GUI Grounding
summary: We introduce ScreenHaystack, a dynamic needle-in-a-haystack benchmark for evaluating spatial reliability in GUI grounding. Instead of testing each target at a fixed position, ScreenHaystack systematically relocates controlled target icons across high-resolution GUI backgrounds and measures whether models can localize them consistently. Using this benchmark, we find that leading GUI grounding models, including Qwen3-VL, UI-TARS, GTA, and UI-Venus, exhibit blind zones: spatial regions where grounding accuracy drops sharply despite fixed target appearance and instruction. These blind zones transfer to unseen ScreenSpot-Pro examples: targets inside blind zones are consistently harder to ground, with Qwen3-VL-8B dropping by 16.1 percentage points, and controlled relocation shows that moving targets into blind zones decreases accuracy while moving them out improves accuracy. We further show through controlled synthetic experiments that uneven spatial coverage in training data can induce such blind zones. Therefore, we propose a simple strategy, blind-zone-oriented augmentation, which adds supervision in blind zones and improves ScreenSpot-Pro accuracy over both original and randomly augmented Click-100k fine-tuning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ScreenHaystack 动态“大海捞针”基准，用于评估 GUI grounding 模型的空间可靠性，并发现主流模型存在“盲区”，提出盲区导向的数据增强策略来缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 现有 GUI grounding 评估通常在固定位置测试目标，无法衡量模型在空间位置变化下定位是否一致，因此需要动态重定位目标的基准来揭示空间可靠性问题。
AI.method: 构建 ScreenHaystack：在高分辨率 GUI 背景中系统性地移动受控目标图标，测试模型能否稳定定位。基于该基准分析 Qwen3-VL、UI-TARS、GTA、UI-Venus 等模型，并通过可控合成实验研究训练数据空间覆盖不均与盲区的关系。进一步提出 blind-zone-oriented augmentation，在盲区增加监督。
AI.result: 领先 GUI grounding 模型存在盲区：目标外观和指令固定时，某些空间区域定位准确率急剧下降。盲区可迁移到未见过的 ScreenSpot-Pro 样本，Qwen3-VL-8B 下降 16.1 个百分点；将目标移入盲区会降低准确率，移出则提升。合成实验表明训练数据空间覆盖不均可导致盲区。盲区导向增强在 Click-100k 微调中优于原始和随机增强，提高 ScreenSpot-Pro 准确率。
AI.conclusion: GUI grounding 模型存在显著空间盲区，且与训练数据空间覆盖不均有关；通过盲区导向的数据增强可有效缓解该问题并提升下游基准表现。

title: Authorization Closure Graph: Minimal Repair for LLM Agents with Evolving User Instructions
comment: 22 pages, 8 figures, 6 tables. Preprint under review
summary: Tool-using large language model (LLM) agents increasingly perform state-changing actions that require user authorization. Yet existing approaches do not provide a principled mechanism for selectively updating prior authorization when only part of an instruction changes. To this end, we propose an Authorization-Closure-Graph (ACG)-based framework that represents authorization and its dependencies as an evolving, versioned state. ACG selectively invalidates authority affected by a revision while preserving unaffected portions of the authorization state, and computes a minimal repair that identifies only the missing evidence or authority required for execution. This enables agents to adapt to revised instructions while avoiding stale authority and unnecessary authorization requests. We evaluate ACG across three advanced LLMs in two natural tasks, and ACG consistently improves action safety rate and task success rate. Code is available at https://github.com/weiliang822/ACG.

AI.tldr: 提出基于授权闭包图（ACG）的框架，将授权及其依赖建模为可演化的版本化状态，支持指令部分变更时选择性更新授权并计算最小修复，从而提升工具型LLM代理的动作安全率和任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 工具使用型LLM代理越来越多地执行需要用户授权的状态变更动作，但现有方法无法在指令仅部分变化时，有原则地选择性更新先前授权，容易导致过期授权或不必要的授权请求。
AI.method: ACG将授权及其依赖表示为不断演化且带版本的状态；当指令修订时，选择性使受影响的权限失效，同时保留未受影响的授权状态；并计算最小修复，仅识别执行所需的缺失证据或授权。
AI.result: 在两个自然任务和三种先进LLM上评估ACG，结果显示其一致提升动作安全率和任务成功率。
AI.conclusion: ACG使代理能够适应修订后的指令，同时避免使用过期授权和不必要的授权请求，代码已开源。

title: PluginRSI: Recursive Improvement of Agent Harnesses with Reusable Plugins
summary: The harness surrounding a language model is a central determinant of agent performance. Recent methods optimize harnesses by searching over complete programs, where individual mechanisms are difficult to isolate and reuse. We introduce PluginRSI, which represents a harness as a composition of atomized plugins and organizes harness evolution around these plugins. Individual plugins are improved independently and accumulated in a shared library, then recombined into new harnesses at each iteration. PluginRSI improves over existing harness optimization methods across software engineering, command-line interaction, and question-answering tasks. The resulting harnesses retain their advantage when transferred to other solver models without further optimization. The evolved plugin library accelerates subsequent optimization from the initial harness, which helps faster and higher convergence on unseen tasks. These results show that accumulating reusable mechanisms provides an effective basis for continued harness improvement.

AI.tldr: 提出 PluginRSI，将语言模型 harness 表示为原子化插件的组合，通过插件独立进化、共享库积累与重组来优化 harness，在多项任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有 harness 优化方法通常在完整程序空间搜索，难以隔离和复用单个机制，因此需要一种可模块化、可积累的优化方式。
AI.method: 将 harness 分解为原子化插件，并围绕插件进行进化：独立改进单个插件，存入共享插件库，每轮迭代再重组成新的 harness。
AI.result: 在软件工程、命令行交互和问答任务上优于现有 harness 优化方法；迁移到其他 solver 模型时无需额外优化仍保持优势；插件库能加速后续优化，在未见任务上实现更快、更高的收敛。
AI.conclusion: 积累可复用机制是持续改进 harness 的有效基础。

title: DeltaWAM: Change-Centric Visual Foresight via Delta Tokens for an Efficient World-Action Model
summary: World-Action Models (WAMs) offer visual foresight for robotic manipulation, but pixel-space models repeatedly reconstruct entire future scenes, incurring high computational cost and spatio-temporal redundancy. In physical manipulation, consecutive frames often share most of their visual context; the changes between them are what an action policy needs to anticipate. We introduce DeltaWAM, a change-centric WAM that makes a compact delta token the unit of future prediction. Each token is a single vector encoding changes between consecutive dense DINO feature maps. DeltaWAM builds on DeltaWorld, a latent world model pretrained on large-scale videos, to autoregressively predict one delta token per future frame. A flow-matching action expert then conditions on the predicted transitions and current DINO features, which serve as spatial anchors, to generate action chunks. Trained for 256 GPU hours on two H100 GPUs, DeltaWAM has 0.725B parameters and achieves 92.8% average success on LIBERO. It also shows robust generalization under procedural perturbations on LIBERO-Pro. Inference takes 142.1 ms per action chunk with 3.86 GB peak memory.

AI.tldr: DeltaWAM 是一种以变化为中心的 World-Action Model，用紧凑的 delta token 表示相邻帧 DINO 特征图之间的变化，并预测未来帧变化以驱动机器人操作。
AI.motivation: 现有基于像素空间的 WAM 需要反复重建完整未来场景，计算成本高且存在时空冗余；而物理操作中相邻帧大部分视觉上下文相同，动作策略真正需要预测的是帧间变化。
AI.method: 提出 DeltaWAM，将相邻稠密 DINO 特征图之间的变化编码为单个 delta token，并作为未来预测单元；基于大规模视频预训练的潜在世界模型 DeltaWorld，自回归预测每个未来帧的 delta token；再用 flow-matching 动作专家，以预测的过渡和当前 DINO 特征作为空间锚点，生成动作块。
AI.result: 在 2 张 H100 上训练 256 GPU 小时，模型参数量 0.725B；在 LIBERO 上平均成功率达 92.8%，在 LIBERO-Pro 的程序性扰动下表现出稳健泛化；推理每个动作块耗时 142.1 ms，峰值内存 3.86 GB。
AI.conclusion: DeltaWAM 通过预测紧凑的帧间变化而非重建完整像素未来，有效降低了计算开销和冗余，同时为机器人操作提供视觉前瞻，并在成功率、泛化性和推理效率上取得良好表现。

title: Depth Any Seen: Which Surfaces and How Far?
comment: 54 pages, 31 figures, including appendix. Video demo: https://youtu.be/D8TIzhjq-2Y
summary: When several surfaces are visible along a ray, recovering visible 3D structure from one image requires jointly estimating their presence and metric depth. Depth Any Seen represents these surfaces as image-conditioned multi-Bernoulli depth sets, whose components each contribute one depth or remain absent. Its auxiliary-free Exact Multi-Bernoulli objective (ExactMB) learns depth and presence by marginalizing one-to-one assignments to complete, distinct targets. Our analysis shows that matching expected count can leave component-surface assignment unresolved. We extend real and synthetic layered-depth benchmarks to evaluate depth accuracy, recovered support, and overprediction. Compared to depth stacking, ExactMB reduces overprediction by a relative 88.2% on LD-Real and 80.5% on MD-3K while retaining most ordinal accuracy, with comparable conditional metric-depth error on LD-Syn. Further ablation studies show that ordered assignment improves depth-accurate recall and precision over marginalization, whereas the count-regularized configuration achieves higher deeper-rank precision than ordered assignment at lower recall. Our code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Depth Any Seen，将单张图像中沿同一光线可见的多个表面建模为图像条件下的多伯努利深度集合，并用 ExactMB 目标联合学习深度与表面存在性，以缓解多表面深度估计中的过预测问题。
AI.motivation: 当一条光线上有多个表面可见时，仅凭单张图像恢复可见 3D 结构需要同时判断这些表面是否存在并估计其度量深度，现有方法容易出现组件与表面对应关系未解析以及过预测等问题。
AI.method: 将表面表示为图像条件下的多伯努利深度集合，每个组件贡献一个深度或不存在；提出无辅助损失的 Exact Multi-Bernoulli 目标（ExactMB），通过对一对一分配进行边缘化来学习深度和存在性；并扩展真实与合成分层深度基准进行评估与消融。
AI.result: 与 depth stacking 相比，ExactMB 在 LD-Real 上相对减少过预测 88.2%，在 MD-3K 上减少 80.5%，同时保留大部分序数精度，并在 LD-Syn 上取得可比的条件下度量深度误差；消融显示有序分配相比边缘化提升深度准确召回率和精确率，而计数正则化配置在更低召回率下获得更高的更深秩精确率。
AI.conclusion: 仅匹配期望计数不足以解决组件与表面的分配问题；ExactMB 能有效降低多表面深度估计中的过预测，并在深度精度、支撑集恢复和过预测之间取得较好平衡，代码将公开。

title: TAO-DA: Towards Autonomous Operation--A Dual-Arm Vision-Language-Action Model for Coordinated Manipulation
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models provide a unified framework for grounding high-level semantic information into low-level robot actions, enabling scalable robotic manipulation across diverse tasks. However, existing VLA models lack explicit mechanisms to disentangle the states and intents of the two arms, leading to unintended cross-arm interference that degrades task execution success. To address this issue, we propose a symmetric Dual-Arm Expert (DAE) architecture built upon a shared Vision-Language Model (VLM) backbone with decoupled, arm-specific expert towers. Expert selection is carried out through a two-stage dual-arm intent routing scheme, in which experts are routed either by explicit language instructions in the first stage or by implicit visual semantics in the second stage. Moreover, we introduce a lightweight task progress prediction module that leverages cross-attention between the pre-chunk temporal features and semantic representations of proprioceptive and visual observations to accurately estimate frame-wise task completion progress. This module facilitates task progress synchronization to support coordinated scheduling for collaborative multi-robot tasks. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of our model in dual-arm intent routing and the disentanglement of cross-arm interference, and further provide preliminary evidence of emergent skill generalization from single- to dual-arm tasks (as well as the reverse), together with cross-arm motion-domain skill transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出对称双臂专家（DAE）架构，基于共享VLM主干与解耦的臂专用专家塔，通过两阶段意图路由和任务进度预测模块，解决双臂VLA模型中的跨臂干扰问题。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型缺乏显式机制来区分双臂的状态与意图，导致跨臂干扰，降低任务执行成功率。
AI.method: 构建共享VLM主干加解耦的臂专用专家塔；采用两阶段双臂意图路由，第一阶段基于显式语言指令，第二阶段基于隐式视觉语义；引入轻量任务进度预测模块，利用跨注意力融合预分块时间特征与本体/视觉语义表示，估计帧级任务完成进度。
AI.result: 实验证明模型在双臂意图路由和跨臂干扰解耦上有效，并初步显示单臂到双臂任务（及反向）的技能泛化与跨臂运动域技能迁移。
AI.conclusion: DAE能有效解耦双臂意图与状态，支持协作多机器人任务的协调调度，并展现出技能泛化与迁移潜力。

title: On the Behavioral Traits of LLM Agents
summary: Users increasingly describe different AI agents as distinct colleagues to work with. AI personality research aims to quantify such impressions by attributing human-like "traits" to agents. However, existing measures fall short: models' self-reports (S-data) diverge from their actual behavior, while informant ratings from LLM judges (I-data) are costly to scale and cover few everyday scenarios. In this paper, we propose A-B-D to infer traits bottom-up from behavioral data (B-data), namely how agents act on their environment and communicate with users, as recorded in existing trajectories. From 345,667 real-world trajectories spanning 80 models, 12 tasks, and 50 harnesses, we extract 318 candidate features that capture both the actions an agent takes at each step (functional) and the language accompanying them (linguistic). We retain only features that show instance-level stability, cross-task consistency, and model discriminability. Factor analysis of the remaining 79 features uncovers six stable, model-attributable factors, two functional and four linguistic. For example, Kimi-K3 exhibits the most planfulness, whereas GPT-5.5 and GPT-5.6 are the least energetic. Moreover, we quantify the "knowledge-action gap" in the wild: these factors correlate only weakly with self-reported Big Five scores, even for conceptually matched pairs such as extroversion and energetic (r = 0.07, p = 0.58). Our work offers a new lens for understanding AI personality, with implications for users, developers, and researchers from both computer science and social science.

AI.tldr: 本文提出A-B-D方法，从智能体在真实轨迹中的行为数据（B-data）自下而上推断其人格特质，并在34万余条轨迹中发现6个稳定的模型级因子，且这些因子与模型自评人格仅弱相关。
AI.motivation: 现有AI人格测量存在缺陷：模型自评（S-data）与实际行为脱节，而LLM评委的他人评分（I-data）成本高、可扩展性差且覆盖的日常场景少。
AI.method: 从80个模型、12类任务、50种运行框架的345,667条真实轨迹中提取318个候选特征（功能性动作+伴随语言），筛选出具有实例级稳定性、跨任务一致性和模型区分度的79个特征，进行因子分析，并与自评大五人格分数做相关性比较。
AI.result: 发现6个稳定且可归因于模型的因子（2个功能性、4个语言性）。例如Kimi-K3计划性最强，GPT-5.5和GPT-5.6活力最低。这些因子与自评大五得分仅弱相关（如外向性与energetic：r=0.07, p=0.58），量化了真实场景中的“知行差距”。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为理解AI人格提供了新视角，对用户、开发者以及计算机科学和社会科学研究者均有启示。

title: PrismQuant: Optimal Null-Space Rotations for Grouped Quantizers
comment: The paper is currently under review. Code, checkpoints, and implementation details are available at: https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/PrismQuant
summary: Smaller activation outliers do not necessarily imply better low-bit quantization: their alignment with the quantizer matters. We introduce PrismQuant, a quantizer-aware rotation framework that aligns the leading activation eigenspace with the constant group subspace of asymmetric grouped INT4. The affine offsets represent the energy in this subspace without widening the range within the group. We formulate rotation design as a Ky Fan trace maximization and derive a closed-form solution that is provably optimal for this alignment objective. Compact Householder transformations and their compact-WY representation enable gradient-free construction and efficient application at both foldable and online sites. A predictive range law further connects unaligned activation energy and group size to quantization-relevant variation. Experiments on Llama, Qwen, and Mistral span dense models up to 70B parameters and a 30B mixture-of-experts model. Under W4A4KV4, PrismQuant sets the state of the art on Llama-3.2-3B among the compared methods in both perplexity and accuracy. On Llama-3.1-70B, it attains 3.85 perplexity and 72.46% average zero-shot accuracy, only 0.22 percentage points below full precision. In the deployment study on Llama-3.1-8B, our optimized implementation achieves 1.51x prefill and 1.22x CUDA Graph decode speedups over matched FP16 baselines, with 56.34% lower decode peak memory and only 2.35% additional Graph decode latency over Hadamard. Code is available at https://github.com/ForeverBlue816/PrismQuant.

AI.tldr: 提出PrismQuant，一种量化器感知的旋转框架，通过将激活主特征子空间与非对称分组INT4的常量组子空间对齐，提升低比特量化效果。
AI.motivation: 较小的激活离群值并不一定带来更好的低比特量化，关键在于离群值与量化器的对齐方式；现有方法未充分处理这种对齐关系。
AI.method: 将旋转设计建模为Ky Fan迹最大化问题，并给出可证明最优的闭式解；利用紧凑Householder变换及其compact-WY表示，实现无梯度构造以及在可折叠和在线位置的高效应用；还提出预测性范围律，将未对齐激活能量和组大小与量化相关变化联系起来。
AI.result: 在Llama、Qwen、Mistral系列上实验，覆盖密集模型至70B及30B MoE模型。W4A4KV4下，Llama-3.2-3B上困惑度和准确率均达到对比方法中的SOTA；Llama-3.1-70B上困惑度3.85、零样本平均准确率72.46%，仅比全精度低0.22个百分点；Llama-3.1-8B部署中，相比FP16基线实现1.51倍prefill和1.22倍CUDA Graph decode加速，decode峰值内存降低56.34%，相比Hadamard仅增加2.35% Graph decode延迟。
AI.conclusion: PrismQuant通过量化器感知的旋转对齐有效改善低比特量化，在多种大模型和部署场景中取得优异性能，且实现高效、可部署。

title: C-HAT-Bench: Benchmarking Chinese AI-Text Detection Beyond Fully Generated Text
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly participate in writing by modifying or extending human drafts, causing machine involvement to vary in both form and extent. Yet most Machine-Generated Text (MGT) detectors are evaluated only on fully human-written versus fully AI-generated text. Because human--AI collaboration can weaken or redistribute cues associated with machine generation, strong performance under this binary setting may overstate detector reliability. This mismatch remains underexplored in Chinese: detection cues are shaped by tokenization and language-specific text distributions, yet controlled resources spanning production settings, domains, and generators remain limited. To fill this gap, we present a Chinese Human-AI Collaborative Text Detection Benchmark (C-HAT-Bench), a unified benchmark that links $5,000$ human-written source texts from five domains to more than $240,000$ variants produced using six generative models under Prefix-Conditioned Continuation as a reference setting and three collaborative production modes. We evaluate $21$ detectors through four protocols spanning zero-shot and pretrained supervised document-level detection, boundary localization, and cross-condition generalization. Relative to Prefix-Conditioned Continuation, mean AUROC across document-level detectors is $12.0\%$ lower on the collaborative production modes, with the largest detector-specific relative decrease reaching $44.4\%$. Transfer across collaborative production modes is also asymmetric, indicating that performance in a given production setting is not a reliable predictor of performance in other production settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出C-HAT-Bench，一个中文人机协同文本检测基准，涵盖多领域、多模型、多协作模式，评估21个检测器后发现协同模式下检测性能显著下降。
AI.motivation: 现有机器生成文本检测器多在完全人工与完全AI生成的二元设置下评估，但人机协作会削弱或重分布机器生成线索，导致二元评估高估检测器可靠性。中文场景下缺乏受控资源，且检测线索受分词和语言分布影响。
AI.method: 构建C-HAT-Bench，链接5,000篇五领域人工源文本与超过24万变体，使用六种生成模型，以Prefix-Conditioned Continuation为参考设置，并包含三种协作生产模式。评估21个检测器，采用四种协议：零样本、预训练监督文档级检测、边界定位和跨条件泛化。
AI.result: 相比Prefix-Conditioned Continuation，协作生产模式下文档级检测器平均AUROC降低12.0%，最大检测器相对下降达44.4%。跨协作模式迁移不对称，某设置性能不能可靠预测其他设置。
AI.conclusion: 当前检测器在中文人机协同文本上性能显著下降，跨条件泛化能力有限，需针对协作场景开发更鲁棒的检测方法。C-HAT-Bench填补了中文基准空白。

title: Multi-Agent System Search via Active Substructure-aware Policy Optimization
summary: LLMs enable multi-agent systems (MAS) to tackle complex tasks, but manually designing agent roles, prompts, and communication structures requires substantial expertise and effort. This motivates learning policies that construct query-specific MAS from execution reward. Existing approaches typically train these policies by repeatedly traversing a fixed set of training queries and assigning rewards at the workflow level. However, this overlooks differences in queries' evolving learning potential and obscures which substructures improve solution quality. In this paper, we propose Active Substructure-aware Policy Optimization (ASPO), a RL framework for query-level MAS search. ASPO introduces an Adaptive Query-Selection Mechanism (AQSM) that focuses training on queries at the policy's competence boundary: those it can solve but not yet reliably. A complementary discovery mechanism widens architectural exploration for hard queries, helping distinguish insufficient exploration from operator capability limits. Beyond query selection, ASPO introduces substructure-level rewards that measure output-quality gains within each action's descendant subgraph. These rewards guide proximal policy optimization to reinforce useful architectural refinements and discourage redundant or harmful computation. Together, these mechanisms prioritize learnable queries and provide fine-grained feedback for learning effective MASs. Across six benchmarks spanning mathematical reasoning, general question answering, and code generation, ASPO ranks first on every benchmark against twelve baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ASPO，一种面向查询级多智能体系统搜索的强化学习框架。它通过自适应查询选择和子结构级奖励，学习为不同查询构建有效的MAS，并在六个基准上超越十二个基线。
AI.motivation: LLM多智能体系统能处理复杂任务，但手动设计智能体角色、提示和通信结构成本高。现有基于执行奖励学习构建MAS的方法，通常重复遍历固定训练查询并在工作流层面分配奖励，忽略了不同查询的学习潜力变化，也难以判断哪些子结构真正提升解的质量。
AI.method: ASPO包含自适应查询选择机制AQSM，将训练集中在策略能力边界上的查询，即可解但尚不可靠的查询；并用发现机制扩大困难查询的结构探索，以区分探索不足与算子能力限制。同时引入子结构级奖励，衡量每个动作后代子图带来的输出质量增益，并通过近端策略优化强化有用架构改进、抑制冗余或有害计算。
AI.result: 在数学推理、通用问答和代码生成等六个基准上，ASPO均排名第一，优于十二个基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ASPO通过优先学习可学习查询并提供细粒度反馈，能有效学习构建多智能体系统，在多种任务上取得领先性能。

title: How Far Do Persona Effects Generalize in Language Models?
comment: 42 pages, 11 figures, 41 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/thzva/persona-gain
summary: Persona prompts ask language models to answer as particular kinds of people. We test whether relationships learned from these effects predict responses to new questions and remain useful across models and prompts. Across 57 attributes, three behavioral domains, and seven pairs of open 7 to 9B checkpoints, persona effects can be predictable without being portable. Separate attribute and task gains improve prediction beyond shared scaling significantly in OLMo-3 and Qwen2.5, with the most robust evidence in OLMo-3. In that model, target refitting significantly outperforms gains borrowed from each of the other six pairs. Across model transfers, borrowed gains with one amplitude underperform shared scaling in most directions; allowing two target parameters removes the significant losses but yields no significant benefit over target shared scaling. After rewording, refitting significantly outperforms reuse with one amplitude in all six tested pairs, while changes of examples or country context often preserve reuse value. In the tested prompt transfers, regularized updates outperform both reuse strategies in median at 64 target questions per attribute. A separate survey comparison finds that selecting the more responsive checkpoint can worsen human fit; responsiveness is confounded with training status, and temperature calibration largely removes this cost but not errors in group ordering. Within the tested gain representation, apparent transfer can come from target calibration; source relationships must add predictive value beyond calibration and regularization. Code and data are available at https://github.com/thzva/persona-gain

AI.tldr: 该论文测试人格化提示（persona prompts）对语言模型的影响关系能否预测新问题，以及能否跨模型、跨提示迁移；结论是可预测但通常不可移植。
AI.motivation: 探究从人格化提示效应中学到的属性与任务关系是否具有泛化性和可移植性，并区分源关系迁移与目标校准带来的表观效果。
AI.method: 在57个属性、3个行为领域、7对开放7-9B检查点上比较人格化效应；使用分离的属性与任务增益、目标重拟合、借用增益、单/双幅度参数、正则化更新；进行模型迁移、提示改写、示例和国家语境迁移，并做人类调查比较与温度校准分析。
AI.result: 在OLMo-3和Qwen2.5中，分离属性与任务增益显著优于共享缩放，OLMo-3证据最稳；在OLMo-3中，目标重拟合显著优于借用其他六对模型的增益。模型迁移中，单幅度借用增益在多数方向劣于共享缩放；双目标参数消除显著损失，但未显著优于目标共享缩放。提示改写后，重拟合在全部六对中显著优于单幅度复用；改变示例或国家语境常保留复用价值。在64个目标问题/属性下，正则化更新的中位表现优于两种复用策略。调查发现选择更响应性检查点可能恶化人类拟合，响应性与训练状态混淆，温度校准可大幅消除该代价，但不能消除组序错误。
AI.conclusion: 人格化效应可预测但不具可移植性；在测试的增益表示中，表观迁移可能来自目标校准，源关系必须在校准和正则化之外提供额外预测价值。

title: Learning with Object-centric Representations of Tactile Interactive Perception for Robot Manipulation
summary: Implicit object properties that are difficult to directly infer from vision, such as material, container contents, or softness, can be revealed through tactile sensing and exploratory interactions. However, because tactile signals are transient and sparse, extracting informative tactile events and effectively incorporating them into robotic manipulation remains a challenge. In this work, we present an object-centric context-aware manipulation framework that learns task-agnostic object representations through tactile exploration. A token learner autonomously selects representative tactile segments from long-horizon exploration, while contrastive alignment with descriptive text embeddings enables a latent space that captures multiple physical object properties. These learned representations are then used as semantic context to guide object-centric manipulation policies and adapt strategies based on object properties. Experiments show that the learned representations achieve 93% and 84% property estimation accuracy on seen and unseen objects. Evaluated on three tasks involving visually ambiguous objects, i.e. multi-object rearrangement, pouring, and box opening, the proposed framework improves both target selection and property-dependent manipulation adaptation, raising task success, aggregated over all evaluation trials, from 41% to 92% on seen objects and from 19% to 67% on unseen objects over baseline policies without object-context conditioning. Videos and additional results are available at https://xinyiyxyx.github.io/tactile-object-centric/.

AI.tldr: 该工作提出一种以对象为中心、上下文感知的机器人操作框架，通过触觉探索学习任务无关的对象表征，并将其作为语义上下文指导操作策略，从而提升视觉模糊场景下的目标选择与操作自适应能力。
AI.motivation: 触觉信号具有瞬态性和稀疏性，且材料、容器内容物、柔软度等隐式物体属性难以直接从视觉推断。如何从长时触觉探索中提取有信息量的触觉事件，并有效融入机器人操作，仍是一个挑战。
AI.method: 提出对象中心、上下文感知的操作框架。使用 token learner 从长时触觉探索中自主选择代表性触觉片段；通过触觉片段与描述性文本嵌入的对比对齐，学习能够捕捉多种物理属性的潜在空间。学习到的对象表征作为语义上下文，用于指导对象中心操作策略，并根据物体属性自适应调整操作策略。
AI.result: 学习到的表征在已见和未见物体上的属性估计准确率分别达到 93% 和 84%。在三个涉及视觉模糊物体的任务（多物体重排、倾倒、开箱）上，相比无对象上下文条件的基线策略，所提框架同时改善了目标选择和属性相关操作自适应，总体任务成功率在已见物体上从 41% 提升到 92%，在未见物体上从 19% 提升到 67%。
AI.conclusion: 通过触觉探索学习任务无关的对象表征，并将其作为语义上下文引入操作策略，可以显著提升视觉模糊场景下机器人操作的目标选择与自适应能力，并在已见和未见物体上均取得明显效果。

title: ControlGS: Conditioning Neural Gaussians for Downstream-Processing-Aware XR Rendering
comment: Accepted to Siggraph Asia'26, 36 pages, poject page: https://horizon-lab.org/controlgs/
summary: Extended Reality (XR) users do not directly perceive the output of a rendering engine. Instead, rendered images pass through a post-processing pipeline and the physical display-optics path before reaching the eye. Critically, the exact downstream processing can vary significantly at run time, influenced by, for instance, camera pose and display power budget. Traditional 3DGS methods either implicitly assume that this downstream pipeline preserves image quality or cannot adapt to downstream processing changes. To bridge this gap, we present ControlGS, an XR Gaussian rendering pipeline that optimizes end-to-end visual quality. ControlGS models and integrates the entire downstream processing, between the rendering output and the human eye, into the optimization objective. To adapt to downstream processing at run time, ControlGS dynamically generates Gaussian primitives conditioned upon the downstream processing parameters. Experiments show that ControlGS consistently improves end-to-end post-optics XR quality across different neural Gaussian backbones and datasets, with minimal overhead. Code is available at https://horizon-lab.org/controlgs/.

AI.tldr: 提出 ControlGS，一种面向 XR 的高斯渲染管线，通过将渲染输出到人眼之间的完整下游处理纳入优化，并依据运行时下游参数动态生成高斯图元，从而提升端到端视觉质量。
AI.motivation: XR 用户看到的并非渲染引擎直接输出，图像还需经过后处理管线和物理显示-光学路径；该下游处理会因相机姿态、显示功耗等因素在运行时变化。传统 3DGS 方法要么默认下游管线不损害画质，要么无法适应这些变化。
AI.method: ControlGS 将渲染输出与人眼之间的整个下游处理建模并集成到优化目标中；同时根据下游处理参数动态生成高斯基元，以在运行时适应下游处理变化。
AI.result: 实验表明，在不同神经高斯骨干网络和数据集上，ControlGS 均能持续提升端到端后光学 XR 质量，且额外开销很小。
AI.conclusion: ControlGS 弥补了传统 3DGS 与 XR 实际显示管线之间的差距，可实现面向下游处理的端到端优化，代码已公开。

title: OpenTumorBoard: A Real-World Benchmark of Multidisciplinary Tumor Board Discussion Trajectories
summary: Multidisciplinary tumor boards integrate multimodal clinical observations and longitudinal patient histories through specialist discussions, yet benchmarks rarely capture these real-world trajectories. We introduce OpenTumorBoard, a benchmark with 611 patient cases and 19,157 discussion turns across ten specialist roles, transcribed from 12,534 minutes of publicly available tumor board recordings on YouTube. The benchmark evaluates two settings: SPECIALIST TURN, in which an LLM responds to a clinically significant question posed during a real discussion, and BOARD SIMULATION, in which it generates an entire back-and-forth discussion and reaches a consensus on therapy recommendations, surgical plans, next actions and clinical trial matching. Evaluation of 14 general-purpose frontier and medical LLMs reveals substantial limitations: the best models score 3.43 out of 5 in clinical equivalence to specialist answers and 2.78 out of 5 in alignment with recorded board conclusions. Supervised finetuning and reinforcement learning improve performance on a held-out test set, suggesting that real-world discussion trajectories can support model adaptation. Three M.D. experts review a subset of the benchmark, finding high information coverage and factuality of patient cases and strong fidelity of extracted consensus conclusions. We will release OpenTumorBoard and its automated curation pipeline to support the development and evaluation of LLMs for multidisciplinary, personalized cancer decision-making.

AI.tldr: 提出 OpenTumorBoard 基准，基于 YouTube 公开多学科肿瘤委员会录像，包含 611 个病例、19,157 轮讨论和 10 个专家角色，用于评估 LLM 在专家轮次回答和委员会模拟共识生成中的表现。
AI.motivation: 多学科肿瘤委员会通过专家讨论整合多模态临床观察和纵向病史，但现有基准很少捕捉这种真实世界讨论轨迹，因此需要新的基准来评估 LLM 在多学科、个性化癌症决策中的能力。
AI.method: 从 12,534 分钟公开肿瘤委员会录像转录构建基准；设计 SPECIALIST TURN 和 BOARD SIMULATION 两种评测设置；评估 14 个通用前沿和医学 LLM；采用监督微调和强化学习进行模型适配；并由三位医学博士专家审核部分基准。
AI.result: 最佳模型在临床等价性上得 3.43/5，与真实委员会结论一致性得 2.78/5，显示现有 LLM 仍有明显局限；监督微调和强化学习在留出测试集上提升性能；专家审核表明病例信息覆盖和事实性较高，提取的共识结论保真度强。
AI.conclusion: 真实世界讨论轨迹可支持 LLM 适配；将发布 OpenTumorBoard 及其自动策展流程，以促进多学科、个性化癌症决策 LLM 的开发与评估。

title: SurgFlow: 3D Object-Centric Contact Flow for Surgical Robot Manipulation
summary: Paired video-action demonstrations enable autonomous surgical behavior, but such data is scarce: robots perform roughly 1% of surgeries, while video-only data is abundant. Learning 3D object flow offers an embodiment-agnostic way to utilize video data, but flow alone specifies how an object should move, not where and when the tool should engage it, a distinction that is critical in surgery. We introduce SurgFlow, a framework that learns 3D Object-Centric Contact Flow from stereo surgical video without action labels. For each object point, it predicts a future 3D trajectory and contact scores. We extract targets via 3D tracking and tool-object proximity, train a flow matching generator to predict them, and use predicted contact to trigger grasp and release while optimizing end effector motion from flow. On the da Vinci Research Kit (dVRK), SurgFlow succeeds in 37 of 39 stage evaluations across tissue retraction, bimanual reveal, needle pickup, and handover, outperforming baselines trained on equal data with or without action labels. Zero-shot transfer to a humanoid-based laparoscopic robot achieves 85% and 70% average success under similar and novel camera viewpoints, respectively.

AI.tldr: SurgFlow 从立体手术视频中无动作标签学习 3D 物体中心接触流，用于自主手术操作，并在 dVRK 和迁移到人形腹腔镜机器人上取得较高成功率。
AI.motivation: 配对视频-动作数据稀缺，机器人仅完成约 1% 的手术，而纯视频数据丰富；3D 物体流虽可跨本体利用视频，但只说明物体如何移动，不说明工具应在何时何地接触，这在外科手术中至关重要。
AI.method: 提出 SurgFlow，从立体手术视频中无监督学习 3D Object-Centric Contact Flow。对每个物体点预测未来 3D 轨迹和接触分数；通过 3D 跟踪和工具-物体邻近提取目标；训练 flow matching 生成器进行预测；利用预测接触触发抓取和释放，并根据流优化末端执行器运动。
AI.result: 在 da Vinci Research Kit 上，SurgFlow 在组织牵拉、双臂显露、拾针和交接等 39 个阶段评估中成功 37 个，优于使用同等数据的有/无动作标签基线；零样本迁移到人形腹腔镜机器人，在相似和新相机视角下平均成功率分别为 85% 和 70%。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明可从纯立体手术视频学习接触流，实现自主手术操作，并具备跨本体和跨视角的零样本迁移潜力。

title: ARSM: Auto-Regressive State Machine for Agentic Reasoning Compression
summary:
While Large Language Model (LLM)-based agents demonstrate strong capabilities in long-horizon tasks by interleaving reasoning with external environment interactions, the continuous accumulation of context rapidly creates a critical memory bottleneck. Existing memory compression methods rely on task-specific optimization or external auxiliary models, introducing significant computational overhead. Furthermore, the resulting compressed representations tend to lose structured relationships, leading to information dilution, attention collapse, and degraded decision consistency.
  To address these limitations, we propose Auto-Regressive State Machine (ARSM), a lightweight training-free framework that enables in-situ reasoning compression through structured state evolution. ARSM introduces two key components: (i) a trajectory abstraction mechanism that reorganizes interaction histories into compact Hypothesis-Action-Result (HAR) micro-chains; (ii) a dynamic state machine that regulates hierarchical memory through atomic operations and a compression-control parameter. These components are unified within an auto-regressive, self-compressive generation space, where each model output jointly performs external action execution and internal state updates.
  We evaluate ARSM on Webshop, Multi-Objective Multi-Hop QA, and SWE-Bench Lite datasets. Experimental results show that ARSM maintains the task performance while simultaneously reducing token consumption, offering a practical, cost-effective route toward scalable autonomous agents for long-horizon tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出Auto-Regressive State Machine (ARSM)，一种轻量免训练框架，通过结构化状态演化实现原位推理压缩，以缓解LLM智能体长程任务中的记忆瓶颈，并在保持任务性能的同时降低token消耗。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在长程任务中持续累积上下文，形成严重记忆瓶颈；现有内存压缩方法依赖任务特定优化或外部辅助模型，计算开销大，且压缩表示易丢失结构化关系，导致信息稀释、注意力崩溃和决策一致性下降。
AI.method: ARSM包含两个关键组件：一是轨迹抽象机制，将交互历史重组为紧凑的Hypothesis-Action-Result (HAR)微链；二是动态状态机，通过原子操作和压缩控制参数调控分层记忆。二者统一在自回归、自压缩生成空间中，使每次模型输出同时执行外部动作和内部状态更新。
AI.result: 在Webshop、Multi-Objective Multi-Hop QA和SWE-Bench Lite数据集上评估，ARSM在保持任务性能的同时减少了token消耗。
AI.conclusion: ARSM为长程任务中可扩展的自主智能体提供了一条实用且低成本的路径。

title: Amnesia by Design, Memory By Necessity: Persistent State for Document Intelligence
summary: Modern Document AI reads contracts, extracts fields, reasons over tables, and grounds answers to page regions, then forgets everything. Processing an amendment the next day begins from scratch: no schema retained, no contradiction detected, no experience carried forward. This is a structural choice, not a scale failure: current systems are stateless functions. We call this the statelessness bottleneck. This bottleneck lies beyond parameter scaling, context extension, and retrieval augmentation: storage provides persistence and retrieval provides access, but neither consolidates observations into knowledge that improves future processing. This survey formalizes persistent evidence-grounded document state as a unifying framework, specifying the operations and invariants required to convert multimodal evidence into durable, provenance-linked state. We introduce a statefulness audit showing that ten representative benchmarks, coded against eight statefulness criteria, leave cross-session state evolution untested, and derive a longitudinal benchmark harness with five counterfactual metrics: Experience Gain, Cost Efficiency, Memory Harm, Forgetting Fidelity, Coverage Retention, to characterize the benefit, cost, risk, and governability of persistent document state. Document AI lacks mechanisms coupling persistent state to document-native structure, provenance, and temporal validity. The next era of Document AI will be defined by what systems retain across documents, sessions, and time.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇关于Document AI持久化状态的综述，指出当前系统是无状态函数，处理完即遗忘，并将“无状态瓶颈”形式化为以证据为基础、可溯源、持久化的文档状态框架。
AI.motivation: 现有Document AI虽能读合同、抽字段、推理表格并定位答案，但跨文档、跨会话、跨时间不保留模式、不检测矛盾、不积累经验；存储提供持久性、检索提供访问，却都不能把观察整合为可改进未来处理的知识。
AI.method: 综述将持久化证据 grounded 文档状态作为统一框架，规定将多模态证据转化为持久、溯源关联状态所需操作与不变量；提出状态性审计，用八项状态性标准评估十个代表性基准；并设计纵向基准测试框架及五项反事实指标。
AI.result: 审计表明十个代表性基准均未测试跨会话状态演化；现有Document AI缺乏将持久状态与文档原生结构、溯源和时间有效性耦合的机制；五项指标为经验增益、成本效率、记忆危害、遗忘保真度、覆盖保持，用于刻画持久文档状态的收益、成本、风险与可治理性。
AI.conclusion: Document AI的下一阶段将由系统在文档、会话和时间之间保留什么来定义；核心挑战是超越参数扩展、上下文扩展和检索增强，建立真正的持久化文档状态机制。

title: From Latents to Wires: Surgical Post-Editing on Large Language Models
summary: Given a large language model (LLM), can whoever holds the weights name a semantic target (e.g., the model's identity), locate the model components that produce it, and edit them so that the target no longer appears while other capability is preserved? We call such an edit on a trained model a post-edit. We present L2W (latents to wires), a framework that performs surgical post-edits for named semantic targets. For localization, L2W uses Jacobian lens (J-lens) attribution to score components against the semantic target. For surgical removal, because LLM mechanisms are redundant (i.e., a semantic target may have multiple components producing it), L2W runs Counterexample-Guided Causal Cut (CGCC) until the target no longer appears. CGCC first cumulatively closes model components, treating each surviving expression of the target as a counterexample that exposes the next components to close, and then reopens some of them to preserve capability. In a controlled experiment with an implanted behavioural watermark, L2W removes the watermark, and its localization lands on the model region the implant changed. Across three model configurations, L2W removes model-metadata (e.g., identity) self-claims in all nine runs, and adult-content refusal in all three, with no held-out target residual. L2W further composes two post-edits on a text-to-image model: one removes the refusal of requested nudity, and a second removes the nude rendering the first exposes. The results support post-editing as a complement to post-training: post-training installs preferred behaviours, and post-editing removes named unwanted ones.

AI.tldr: 提出 L2W 框架，可对已训练大语言模型进行手术式“后编辑”：定位并移除指定语义目标（如模型身份、拒答行为），同时尽量保留其他能力。
AI.motivation: 后训练能安装期望行为，但缺少从已训练模型中定向移除特定不良行为的手段；作者希望验证能否命名语义目标、定位其产生组件并编辑删除。
AI.method: L2W 框架：用 Jacobian lens（J-lens）归因对组件与语义目标打分以定位；用反例引导因果切割（CGCC）迭代累积关闭组件，把目标每次残留表达作为反例暴露下一批需关闭组件，直至目标消失，再重开部分组件以保留能力。
AI.result: 植入行为水印的对照实验中成功移除水印，且定位到植入所改变的区域；三种模型配置下，9/9 次移除模型元数据自述，3/3 次移除成人内容拒答，无保留目标残留；在文生图模型上组合两次后编辑：先移除请求裸体的拒答，再移除由此暴露的裸体渲染。
AI.conclusion: 后编辑可作为后训练的补充：后训练安装偏好行为，后编辑移除被命名的、不想要的行为。

title: ActionGround: Training-Free Runtime Refinement of Frozen VLA Policies
summary:
Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models map visual observations and language instructions directly to robot actions, but they do not explicitly represent the phase structure of manipulation tasks or the rigid-body dynamics governing execution. We present ActionGround, a neuro-symbolic, training-free runtime layer that wraps a frozen VLA policy without retraining, fine-tuning, or weight access, adding less than 1 ms of overhead per control step. A symbolic phase-aware finite-state machine identifies the manipulation phase (approach, grasp, transport, or place) and applies a phase-specific rule-based correction. In parallel, an always-on, inertia-weighted Euler-Lagrange term incorporates the robot's equations of motion into each control step, while its dynamics residual is logged as a consistency diagnostic rather than used as a gate.
  We evaluate ActionGround across OpenVLA, OpenVLA-OFT, Force-VLA, and Generalist-VLA on ten LIBERO-Spatial pick-and-place tasks using a 7-DoF Franka Panda. With fixed parameters across tasks and backbones, ActionGround improves success rate by up to 6 percentage points and stability by up to 19.3 percentage points, while improving trajectory efficiency by up to 15%. In a separate Robosuite noise sweep, ActionGround provides approximately a 10x improvement in trajectory-jerk robustness under injected action noise. In a matched-seed Robosuite simulation companion to a real Agilex Piper trial, simulated baseline success increases from 35% to 95%. The physical-hardware experiment is presented as a qualitative deployment demonstration; quantitative per-trial success on the real arm is left for future work. Our evaluation is limited to rigid-object pick-and-place manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出 ActionGround——一种无需训练、即插即用的神经符号运行时层，包裹冻结的 VLA 策略，通过符号化阶段状态机和惯性加权欧拉-拉格朗日动力学项修正控制动作，在多个 VLA 模型与 LIBERO-Spatial 任务上提升成功率、稳定性与轨迹效率。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型直接将视觉观测和语言指令映射为机器人动作，但未显式表征操作任务的阶段结构，也未显式建模执行过程中的刚体动力学，导致控制精度与鲁棒性受限。
AI.method: ActionGround 不重训练、不微调、不访问权重，单步开销小于 1 ms。其包含两部分：1）符号化阶段感知有限状态机，识别接近、抓取、搬运、放置等操作阶段并施加阶段特定规则修正；2）始终启用的惯性加权欧拉-拉格朗日项，将机器人运动方程融入控制步，同时将动力学残差记录为一致性诊断而非门控信号。
AI.result: 在 OpenVLA、OpenVLA-OFT、Force-VLA、Generalist-VLA 及 7-DoF Franka Panda 的十个 LIBERO-Spatial 抓放任务上，固定参数下成功率最多提升 6 个百分点，稳定性最多提升 19.3 个百分点，轨迹效率最多提升 15%。Robosuite 噪声扫描中，注入动作噪声下轨迹抖动鲁棒性约提升 10 倍。与真实 Agilex Piper 试验匹配的 Robosuite 仿真中，基线成功率从 35% 提升至 95%。真实硬件实验仅为定性部署演示。
AI.conclusion: ActionGround 可作为免训练运行时层有效增强冻结 VLA 策略的操作性能与鲁棒性，但评估仅限于刚体抓放操作；真实机械臂的逐次定量成功率验证留待未来工作。

title: Controllable GNN Explanations via Multi-Metric Preference Selection
summary: Mechanisms for generating GNN explanations are crucial for building trust and mitigating biases in Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), especially in high-stakes scenarios. Most current methods optimize only for fidelity under the sparsity constraint. However, this discounts the need for interpretable explanations (those that consist of familiar motif patterns) and stable explanations (those that remain unchanged under structural perturbations). We propose a novel approach that optimizes GNN explanations across these metrics, exposing their relative weighing as a control. Experiments on various real-world datasets, including MUTAG, BA-2Motif, BAMultiShapes, and PROTEINS, suggest that our method produces higher-fidelity explanations than a state-of-the-art baseline on MUTAG and PROTEINS across all evaluated budgets, and on BA-2Motif at larger budgets, while being faster in the regime of small explanation budgets. We also explore how, given an input motif library containing standard motifs for the corresponding domain, the method can be used to determine the relative importance of those motifs in generating the explanations, and how this information can be used to further improve the quality of the output explanations. We also examine the relationship between different metrics through their induced tradeoff surface, and explore its dependence on the nature of the motif library.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种同时优化GNN解释的保真度、可解释性和稳定性的方法，并利用模体库分析模体重要性及指标间权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有GNN解释方法多在稀疏约束下仅优化保真度，忽视了由常见模体模式构成的可解释性，以及结构扰动下保持不变的稳定性，尤其是在高风险场景中。
AI.method: 提出一种新方法，在保真度、可解释性和稳定性等多个指标上联合优化GNN解释，并将这些指标的相对权重作为控制变量；同时借助包含领域标准模体的模体库确定模体对解释生成的相对重要性，以进一步改进解释质量。
AI.result: 在MUTAG、BA-2Motif、BAMultiShapes和PROTEINS等真实数据集上，该方法在MUTAG和PROTEINS的所有评估预算下，以及在BA-2Motif的较大预算下，均比最先进基线产生更高保真度的解释，并在小解释预算下速度更快；还通过指标间的权衡曲面分析了其与模体库性质的关系。
AI.conclusion: 多指标联合优化能够生成更优的GNN解释，模体库信息可用于评估模体重要性并提升解释质量，不同解释指标之间存在依赖模体库性质的权衡关系。

title: ReFM: Semantic-Aware Refinement Flow Model for Motion Retargeting
summary: Motion retargeting transfers motion across characters with different skeletal structures while preserving semantic intent and physical plausibility. Despite recent progress, two fundamental questions remain: (i) how can reliable source-motion semantics be learned without high-quality paired retargeting data, and (ii) how should retargeting be formulated when no reliable paired motion can serve as a definitive regression objective? Existing methods commonly preserve semantics by constraining predictions toward copied motions. However, such initializations entangle useful articulation cues with artifacts caused by mismatched skeletal proportions and body geometry. Moreover, directly regressing a final motion in one forward pass is restrictive because retargeting is inherently underdetermined, and the desired solution must balance semantic fidelity with target-specific physical and temporal constraints rather than match a unique paired target. Motivated by these limitations, we propose ReFM, a source-mesh-agnostic, energy-guided model that reformulates motion retargeting as progressive refinement. First, an SO(3) canonicalizer removes redundant global-orientation variations. Second, a cross-character semantic encoder, pretrained through contrastive learning, provides a character-invariant representation for both optimization guidance and semantic evaluation. ReFM then progressively refines an initialized target motion through a learned flow guided by semantic consistency, physical plausibility, temporal coherence, and minimal motion modification. The framework is compatible with different initialization strategies, including both direct motion copying and Autodesk HumanIK, an industry-standard full-body inverse-kinematics retargeting system.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 ReFM，将运动重定向重新表述为渐进式细化问题，通过源网格无关、能量引导的模型，在缺乏高质量成对重定向数据的情况下学习源运动语义，并生成兼顾语义、物理合理性和时间连贯性的目标运动。
AI.motivation: 现有运动重定向方法通常依赖复制运动作为约束或回归目标，但这会混合有用的关节线索与骨骼比例和身体几何不匹配造成的伪影；同时，重定向本质上是欠定的，直接一步回归唯一配对目标过于受限，应将语义保真与目标特定物理和时间约束进行平衡。
AI.method: 提出 ReFM：首先使用 SO(3) 规范化器去除冗余全局方向变化；其次通过对比学习预训练跨角色语义编码器，获得角色不变表示，用于优化引导和语义评估；然后以学习到的流模型对初始目标运动进行渐进式细化，引导信号包括语义一致性、物理合理性、时间连贯性和最小运动修改。该框架兼容不同初始化策略，如直接运动复制和 Autodesk HumanIK。
AI.result: ReFM 能够作为源网格无关的能量引导模型，在无需高质量成对重定向数据的情况下学习可迁移语义，并支持与直接复制及行业标准全身逆运动学系统 HumanIK 等初始化方式结合，实现渐进式运动重定向。
AI.conclusion: 运动重定向不应被简单视为单次配对回归，而应被建模为在语义、物理和时间约束下逐步细化的欠定优化问题；ReFM 通过角色不变语义表示和能量引导细化，为重定向提供了一种更灵活且不依赖高质量配对数据的解决框架。

title: Are You Sure You're Sure? Two Confounds in a Sycophancy Benchmark
summary: Sycophancy is a language model's tendency to cave when a user pushes back, abandoning a correct answer for the user's. Several benchmarks now measure it by scripting an objection and recording how often the model caves. Because that objection is a prompt template, whatever else the template varies is measured along with the property it claims to isolate. We audit SycEval, which reports that objections raised before a model answers (preemptive) cause more caving than those raised after (in-context), and attributes the gap to timing. Two features of its templates vary alongside the property each is meant to test. First, SycEval's objections escalate through four strength levels, and at the two weakest only the preemptive template names a target answer, so timing and naming vary together. We build the missing comparison and test it on multiple-choice questions and SycEval's own free-form pipeline. Naming a target answer raises the follow rate, the share of samples matching the user's assertion, by 14.1--49.5 percentage points (pp), and once both templates name one, the timing comparison reverses on three of the five model conditions we test: models cave \emph{less} under preemptive objections than in-context ones, opposite to SycEval. Second, the output-format instruction benchmarks append for automatic grading also varies with objection placement. Moving it from the pushback into the question flips its effect in opposite directions across models on the same items ($p=0.0059$). The same effect appears in SycEval's free-form pipeline: relocating its instruction lowers caving by 5.1pp on Llama-3.1-8B, while an equivalence test confirms no effect on Qwen3-4B. Both confounds live in the template rather than the models under test, so both are correctable: we close with three checks benchmark authors can apply before publishing.

AI.tldr: 审计 SycEval 发现，其报告的 preemptive 比 in-context 反对更易导致模型屈服这一结论，混入了模板中的其他变量：是否点名目标答案、输出格式指令的位置。修正这些混杂后，原结论会减弱、消失甚至在多个模型上反转。
AI.motivation: 现有谄媚基准常通过脚本化用户反对来测量模型是否放弃正确答案，但反对模板中除目标性质外的其他特征也会被一并测量，导致把模板效应错误归因于模型或时间因素。作者因此要审计 SycEval 关于反对提出时机的结论。
AI.method: 审计 SycEval，构造其缺失的对照实验：分别控制反对模板是否点名目标答案，以及自动评分用输出格式指令放在问题还是 pushback 中。测试覆盖多选题、SycEval 自有自由形式流程，以及多个模型条件。
AI.result: 点名目标答案使 follow rate 提高 14.1–49.5 个百分点；当两个模板都点名目标答案后，preemptive 与 in-context 的时机比较在 5 个模型条件中有 3 个反转，即模型在 preemptive 反对下反而更少屈服。输出格式指令位置变化会在同一批题目上让效果在不同模型间反向（p=0.0059）；自由形式流程中，迁移指令使 Llama-3.1-8B 的屈服率下降 5.1 个百分点，而对 Qwen3-4B 的等效检验显示无效应。
AI.conclusion: 这两个混杂都存在于基准模板而非被测模型本身，因此可被修正。作者最后给出三项检查，供基准作者在发布前排查类似模板混杂问题。

title: PORTER: Edge-Cloud Residency for Persistent 3D Scene Graph Memory
summary: Recent task-driven and just-in-time 3D Scene Graph (3DSG) methods reduce per-task representations by constructing or activating only task-relevant information. Yet sparse per-task working sets do not bound onboard memory usage over a robot's lifetime: as tasks change, payloads accumulated for earlier tasks may become irrelevant to the current task but can be useful again in future tasks. Over repeated task switches and expanding environments, retaining such reusable payloads causes local memory to grow, whereas discarding them entirely can lead to costly repeated construction of the same payloads later. We introduce PORTER, which decouples persistence from residency: lightweight anchors remain in the limited memory of the edge robot while heavy object payloads migrate between the edge and the cloud. Relevance alone is insufficient for deciding residency because multiple relevant payloads may provide redundant information. We therefore decompose each task into functional requirements and introduce Irreplaceable Support Erasure (ISE), which measures the loss in requirement coverage caused by offloading. ISE discounts replaceable support and penalizes losses more strongly when the remaining coverage of a requirement is weak. PORTER constructs a budget-aware local working set by repeatedly offloading the payload with the smallest marginal ISE per byte. Experiments on JITOMA-Bench evaluate PORTER across four 3DSG builders. Under progressive compression, pooled relative mR@3 remains at 100% through 91% payload-byte offloading.

AI.tldr: PORTER通过解耦持久性与驻留性，将轻量锚点保留在边缘机器人内存，重量级对象载荷在边缘与云端间迁移，并利用ISE度量卸载导致的覆盖损失，实现预算感知的本地工作集构建。
AI.motivation: 现有任务驱动的3DSG方法虽减少每任务表示，但稀疏工作集无法限制机器人生命周期内的内存增长；任务切换时，为早期任务积累的载荷对当前任务可能无关但未来可能有用，全部保留导致内存膨胀，全部丢弃则导致重复构建。
AI.method: 将任务分解为功能需求，提出不可替代支持擦除（ISE）衡量卸载对需求覆盖的损失，折扣可替代支持，并在剩余覆盖弱时更强惩罚；PORTER通过反复卸载单位字节边际ISE最小的载荷来构建预算感知的本地工作集。
AI.result: 在JITOMA-Bench上对四种3DSG构建器进行评估，渐进压缩下，卸载91%载荷字节时，池化相对mR@3仍保持100%。
AI.conclusion: PORTER能在显著减少本地内存的同时保持任务性能，证明基于ISE的载荷迁移策略有效平衡了内存限制与信息可用性。

title: Linger and Lose: Knowledge Collapse in Low-Bit Language Models
summary: Training language models with ternary weights is commonly judged by loss and downstream accuracy, which record only a modest cost relative to full precision. We show that these metrics can conceal a much larger failure. We instead measure knowledge capacity, the factual bits stored per parameter, on synthetic biographies with known information content. We train GPT-2-style models from scratch with 2.5M to 50M parameters at five precisions. Under the standard cosine schedule, ternary models retain as little as 6% of an identically trained fp16 model's capacity. The deficit widens with model size while perplexity rises by only 1.4 to 1.6 times. Measured throughout training, these models first acquire capacity and then lose most of it. We identify this knowledge collapse as a learning-rate dwell instability. Held near $1$--$2\times10^{-4}$ with no decay, a pre-collapse model collapses within a few hundred exposures, and returning to a safe rate does not restore capacity. We then locate the collapse in the output head. It happens at a value the model can never predict. The weights there grow unchecked, while every other prediction the model makes is unchanged. We find that making the value predictable removes the collapse, regardless of which attribute carries it. A warmup-stable-decay schedule with a 10% cooldown increases ternary capacity by 2.7 times at 25M and 4.3 times at 50M. Gains are larger at lower precision. Cutting the output head's learning rate prevents failure when training from scratch. The post-training quantization methods we tested recover no measurable capacity below 4 bits. Our findings suggest judging low-precision training by retained capacity during training rather than final loss.

AI.tldr: 三元权重语言模型的标准损失和下游准确率掩盖了严重的知识容量损失；在训练中会出现“知识崩溃”，主要源于输出头对不可预测值的权重失控增长。
AI.motivation: 现有低精度训练评估通常只看损失和下游准确率，这些指标可能显示三元权重相对全精度只有 modest 代价，但可能隐藏更大的知识存储失败。
AI.method: 在已知信息含量的合成传记数据上测量“知识容量”（每参数存储的事实比特数）；从零训练 2.5M–50M 参数的 GPT-2 风格模型，比较五种精度；分析训练动态、学习率 dwell 不稳定性、崩溃位置；测试 warmup-stable-decay 调度、输出头学习率调整及训练后量化方法。
AI.result: 标准 cosine 调度下，三元模型仅保留相同训练 fp16 模型低至 6% 的容量，且模型越大差距越大，而困惑度仅上升 1.4–1.6 倍；训练中容量先获得后大量丢失。崩溃发生在输出头：模型无法预测某个值时，该处权重无约束增长，其他预测不变。使该值可预测可消除崩溃。10% cooldown 的 WSD 调度将三元容量在 25M 提升 2.7 倍、50M 提升 4.3 倍；更低精度收益更大。降低输出头学习率可防止从头训练失败。测试的训练后量化方法在低于 4 bit 时无法恢复可测容量。
AI.conclusion: 低精度训练应以训练过程中保留的知识容量来评判，而不是仅看最终损失；三元权重模型存在被标准指标掩盖的知识崩溃问题，可通过调度和输出头学习率干预缓解。

title: ForkLeft: Entropy-First Rollouts for Prefix-Aligned Autoregressive-to-Diffusion Distillation
summary: Autoregressive Next-Token Prediction (NTP) has enabled strong reasoning capabilities in language models, while Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) offer flexible token orders and parallel generation. We ask whether DLMs can acquire NTP-style reasoning through distillation without giving up their native generation process. Direct distillation, however, faces a fundamental mismatch: an autoregressive teacher predicts from a left prefix, whereas a DLM can condition on tokens on both sides. We introduce ForkLeft, a distillation framework that resolves this mismatch by separating the student's rollout from teacher supervision. During training, the student first performs entropy-first rollouts that commit uncertain positions and expose potential forks. We then fix the resulting student prefix and distill an NTP teacher under the same context, with answer correctness determining the supervision source. At inference, the student returns to its native confidence-first parallel decoding. With Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base, ForkLeft improves Efficient-DLM-4B on all ten benchmarks, raising MATH500 from 72.60% to 79.60% and consistently outperforming three alternative designs. The gains scale with teacher strength and generalize to SDAR-4B with only $500$ updates. At matched scale, the distilled 4B and 8B students exceed the published SDAR-Chat and OPDLM models on seven benchmarks, showing that DLMs can learn NTP-style reasoning without sacrificing native parallel generation. Code and datasets will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ForkLeft蒸馏框架，使扩散语言模型（DLM）在不放弃原生并行生成的前提下，通过蒸馏获得自回归下一词预测（NTP）式推理能力。
AI.motivation: DLM具备灵活词序和并行生成优势，但能否通过蒸馏获得NTP式推理尚不明确。直接蒸馏存在根本性不匹配：自回归教师基于左侧前缀预测，而DLM可同时利用左右两侧token进行条件建模。
AI.method: ForkLeft将学生模型的rollout与教师监督分离。训练时，学生先进行熵优先rollout，确定不确定位置并暴露潜在分叉；随后固定学生前缀，在相同上下文下蒸馏NTP教师，并由答案正确性决定监督来源。推理阶段，学生恢复原生置信度优先的并行解码。
AI.result: 以Qwen3-30B-A3B-Base为教师，ForkLeft在十个基准上提升Efficient-DLM-4B，MATH500从72.60%升至79.60%，并持续优于三种替代设计。增益随教师增强而扩大，仅需500次更新即可泛化至SDAR-4B。同规模下，蒸馏后的4B和8B学生在七个基准上超过已发布的SDAR-Chat和OPDLM模型。
AI.conclusion: DLM能够学习NTP式推理，同时不牺牲其原生并行生成能力。

title: PULSE: Identifying Demonstration-Utility Features with Sparse Autoencoders
summary: In-context learning is highly sensitive to demonstration choice, yet most methods select demonstrations using external query-demonstration similarity. Such criteria can miss model-specific signals: Similar demonstrations may activate different internal features and downstream behaviors. We introduce PULSE (Paired Utility Localization over Sparse Encodings), an SAE-based framework for identifying model-internal features associated with demonstration utility and using them for demonstration selection. Using a small labeled discovery set, PULSE samples candidate demonstration sets, measures their zero-shot-relative utility under the target model, and scores SAE features by how their activation differences align with utility differences. The top positive and negative coordinates form a sparse utility-localization vector. We use this vector in two complementary ways: as a signed score for controlled complete-set ranking, and as PULSE-Retriever, which converts its magnitude into a feature-relevance mask for scalable pool-scale retrieval. Across classification, generation, and reasoning benchmarks, PULSE-Retriever improves over the strongest baseline by 2-3 accuracy points, 0.6-0.9 BLEU-4, and 3.2 exact-match points, respectively, while controlled ranking validates the identified features encode a predictive set-level utility signal. Feature inspection and cross-dataset experiments suggest that the identified features capture task-relevant, dataset-conditioned patterns, yet retain utility signals that partially transfer across datasets. Our code is available at https://github.com/aohenuo/PULSE.

AI.tldr: 提出PULSE，一种基于稀疏自编码器（SAE）的框架，通过定位模型内部与示例效用相关的特征，实现更优的上下文学习示例选择。
AI.motivation: 现有示例选择方法多依赖外部查询-示例相似度，忽略了模型特定内部信号：相似示例可能激活不同内部特征并导致不同行为。
AI.method: PULSE利用小规模标注发现集，采样候选示例集并测量其零样本相对效用，用SAE特征激活差异与效用差异的对齐程度打分，构建稀疏效用定位向量。该向量有两种用法：作为完整集合排序的带符号分数，以及PULSE-Retriever将幅度转为特征相关性掩码用于大规模池检索。
AI.result: 在分类、生成和推理基准上，PULSE-Retriever分别比最强基线提升2-3个准确率点、0.6-0.9 BLEU-4和3.2个精确匹配点；受控排序验证了所识别特征编码了预测性集合级效用信号。
AI.conclusion: 所识别特征能捕捉任务相关、数据集条件化的模式，同时保留部分可跨数据集迁移的效用信号，表明利用模型内部特征进行示例选择是有效且可扩展的。

title: The Key Handoff: Retrieval in Hybrid Language Models
comment: 36 pages, 5 figures in the main text
summary: A two-hop question makes a language model retrieve twice: once to produce a bridge entity, and once to retrieve with it. Transformers resolve that entity in their early layers. Hybrid models replace most of the attention with a recurrent state, so where the key becomes usable, and where it is spent on an answer, is not known. Answering "Where is the ball?" from "the ball belongs to Alice" and "Alice is in the garden" turns on Alice, a name the question does not mention. A model could reach garden through Alice, the key it computed, or through where the fact sits in the prompt. Across twelve models, dense and hybrid, we move a hidden state from one story into another where the two routes lead to different places, and read off which place the model gives. An attention layer converts the key in every model we tested, and crossing that layer removes its usable effect, all of it where no attention follows. In sequential hybrids this makes the answer a handoff: recurrent layers carry the key forward, and attention spends it. Retrieval does not always stop there. Writing a different fact into the memory of the recurrent layers that follow the last attention layer can move the answer toward that fact, multiplying its odds by 1.3 to 2.7, and which hybrids do this is not settled by their architecture or training. That read is addressed by the key, not by position: recurrent state in a hybrid is not only a carrier, but a memory that later layers can query.

AI.tldr: 本文研究密集模型与混合模型在两步问答中的检索机制，发现注意力层会将桥接实体转化为可用键，而循环层负责携带该键、注意力层负责消费它；混合模型的循环状态还可作为后续层可查询的记忆。
AI.motivation: 两步问题需要模型先检索桥接实体再据此检索答案。混合模型用循环状态替代大部分注意力，因此桥接键在何处变得可用、又在何处被用于作答尚不清楚。
AI.method: 在十二个密集与混合模型上，将隐藏状态从一个故事迁移到另一个故事，使桥接实体路径与位置路径指向不同地点，从而读出模型选择；并通过跨层干预和向最后一个注意力层之后的循环记忆写入不同事实来测试影响。
AI.result: 所有测试模型中，注意力层都会将键转化为可用状态，跨过该层会移除其可用效应；在顺序混合模型中，答案形成接力：循环层携带键，注意力层消费键。检索不一定在此停止：向最后一个注意力层之后的循环记忆写入不同事实，可将答案几率提高1.3至2.7倍，且哪些混合模型会如此并不由架构或训练决定。
AI.conclusion: 该读取由键而非位置寻址；混合模型中的循环状态不仅是信息载体，也是后续层可以查询的记忆。

title: Gaussian Image Steganography via Parameter-Domain Keyed Embeddings
comment: 4 pages, 2 figures, 3 tables; 2-page supplementary material in ancillary files. Accepted to SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Technical Communications
summary: 2D Gaussian-based image representation is becoming increasingly popular, and our work proposes a new approach to steganography by embedding information within Gaussian parameters rather than image pixels. We first fit the parameters of this representation to the target image and employ a secret key to select a subset of these parameters for fine-tuning, allowing us to embed an 8-bit message while maintaining high visual fidelity in the reconstructed image. Thirty fitting experiments on three synthetic images show that the correct key can recover the message without error, while decoding with incorrect keys yields a Bit Error Rate (BER) of $0.543$, close to random guessing.
