Compared with random selection using the key, selecting the least-disturbing edits recovers the message more reliably (one-sided $p=0.031$), and the average PSNR cost is only $0.091$ dB in visual quality. The embedding method transfers to 112 natural images at $256\times256$ using 4,096 Gaussians. The correct-key BER is $0.000$, and decoding under a wrong key stays close to random guessing at $0.520$. Our method embeds the payload through three Gaussian parameter types: log-anisotropy, opacity, and color luminance. In a separate nine-fit reduced setting, color luminance is removed, so the payload uses two instead of three parameter types, a $33.3\%$ reduction; all 256 Gaussians remain in the fitted representation. The correct key still recovers the message without error. However, wrong-key BER rises from $0.514$ to $0.571$, moving farther from random guessing ($0.5$).

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于2D高斯图像表示的隐写方法，将信息嵌入高斯参数而非像素中；通过密钥选择部分参数微调，实现8位消息嵌入，并在合成与自然图像上验证了正确密钥可无误差恢复、错误密钥接近随机猜测。
AI.motivation: 2D高斯表示在图像表示中日益流行，研究希望探索一种新的隐写载体，将信息嵌入高斯参数而非传统图像像素，以保持重建图像的高视觉保真度。
AI.method: 先对目标图像拟合2D高斯参数，再用秘密密钥选择部分参数进行微调，从而嵌入8位消息；嵌入涉及三类高斯参数：对数各向异性、不透明度和颜色亮度。实验包括3张合成图像30次拟合、112张256×256自然图像（4096个高斯），以及移除颜色亮度的九次拟合简化设置。
AI.result: 合成图像中，正确密钥BER为0，错误密钥BER为0.543，接近随机猜测；选择扰动最小的编辑比随机选择更可靠（单侧p=0.031），平均PSNR损失仅0.091 dB。自然图像中，正确密钥BER为0.000，错误密钥BER为0.520。简化设置中，参数类型从3类减为2类（减少33.3%），256个高斯仍保留，正确密钥仍无误差恢复，但错误密钥BER从0.514升至0.571，更远离随机猜测0.5。
AI.conclusion: 基于2D高斯参数的隐写是可行的，能在保持高视觉质量的同时实现可靠信息嵌入；正确密钥可准确恢复消息，错误密钥接近随机猜测。参数选择策略会影响可靠性，减少嵌入所用参数类型仍可正确恢复，但可能改变错误密钥下的BER表现。

title: CausalDriveBench: Evaluating Causal Reasoning in Vision-Language-Action Models for Autonomous Driving
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models for autonomous driving produce natural-language reasoning alongside predicted trajectories, but whether this reasoning reflects the causal structure of the scene remains untested. We introduce CausalDriveBench, an evaluation framework grounded in Pearl's Causal Hierarchy (PCH) that tests causal reasoning in driving-specific VLAs through structured visual question answering (QA) and alternative-trajectory prediction. To this end, we construct causal scene graphs over nuScenes that distinguish causally active, dormant, and distractor entities, separating perceptual salience from causal relevance. The benchmark spans all four rungs of PCH (association, intervention, and counterfactual along with causal discovery) for QA generation. For the higher rungs, we additionally provide reference trajectories under specified scene modifications, enabling action-level verification that complements reasoning-level evaluation. In total, the benchmark contains 7,285 verified causal QA pairs and 1,000 counterfactual trajectories derived from nuScenes. We evaluate 10 driving-specific VLAs and 3 general-purpose VLMs, and report three findings. First, the best model reaches only 70.6% QA accuracy, and 4 of 13 models score below random chance. Second, comparing each driving VLA to the general-purpose VLM that shares its language backbone, the cost of driving fine-tuning ranges from 2 to 34 percentage points on causal QA, with post-training design explaining the spread. Third, causal QA and trajectory accuracy are statistically uncorrelated across models: under counterfactual prompts, predicted trajectories either over-react or collapse onto the observed-scene baseline. Taken together, these results show that neither fluent rationales nor accurate observed-scene trajectories constitute evidence of causal understanding.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CausalDriveBench，基于Pearl因果层级评估自动驾驶VLA模型的因果推理能力，涵盖结构化视觉问答与反事实轨迹预测，发现现有模型在因果理解上表现有限。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶VLA模型会生成自然语言推理和预测轨迹，但这些推理是否真正反映场景的因果结构尚未被检验。
AI.method: 构建基于nuScenes的因果场景图，区分因果活跃、休眠和干扰实体；围绕PCH四个层级（关联、干预、反事实、因果发现）生成QA，并提供场景修改下的参考轨迹；包含7,285个已验证因果QA对和1,000条反事实轨迹；评测10个驾驶专用VLA和3个通用VLM。
AI.result: 最佳模型因果QA准确率仅70.6%，13个模型中有4个低于随机水平；与共享语言骨干的通用VLM相比，驾驶微调在因果QA上带来2到34个百分点的性能损失，差异与后训练设计有关；因果QA与轨迹准确率在模型间统计不相关，反事实提示下轨迹要么过度反应，要么坍缩到观测场景基线。
AI.conclusion: 流畅的推理文本和准确的观测场景轨迹都不能作为因果理解的证据，当前自动驾驶VLA在因果推理与反事实行动预测方面仍存在明显不足。

title: AquaWAM: A Dynamics-aware World Action Model for Underwater Embodied Agents
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) are becoming increasingly important and useful for embodied intelligence, as they enable robots to anticipate the consequences of candidate actions before interacting with the physical environment. However, underwater robots are usually subject to passive dynamics, such as inertia, buoyancy, hydrodynamic drag, and persistent drift, which can continue to affect the vehicle even after an action is completed. Existing WAMs, which primarily predict action-conditioned visual observations, are not explicitly designed to capture such passive motion dynamics. In this paper, we present AquaWAM, the first World Action Model designed for underwater embodied agents. Instead of predicting future images, AquaWAM models both action-conditioned and passive physical dynamics, including the thruster dead band, the inertial glide that outlasts each command, and ambient currents. Specifically, it senses through the DVL, IMU, pressure sensor and joint encoders, while cameras supply only semantics for understanding goals and target pose. By modeling compact navigation states rather than high-dimensional visual observations, AquaWAM substantially reduces the model size and computational cost compared with conventional WAMs. Experimentally, AquaWAM achieves a 72.6% task success rate across 20 underwater tasks on the USIM benchmark, outperforming existing methods while making action decisions 2.7x faster than U0 on an NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin. Our model also remains effective when some onboard sensor measurements are unavailable. For example, without DVL velocity measurements, our method still achieves a 61.6% success rate, compared with 39.4% for U0.

AI.tldr: AquaWAM是首个为水下具身智能体设计的世界动作模型，通过建模动作条件与被动物理动力学（如推进器死区、惯性滑行、环境水流），并采用紧凑导航状态而非高维视觉观测，在USIM基准的20个水下任务中达到72.6%成功率，决策速度比U0快2.7倍。
AI.motivation: 水下机器人通常受被动动力学（惯性、浮力、水动力阻力、持续漂移）影响，这些影响在动作完成后仍持续。现有世界动作模型主要预测动作条件下的视觉观测，未显式捕捉此类被动运动动力学。
AI.method: AquaWAM同时建模动作条件与被动物理动力学，包括推进器死区、惯性滑行和环境水流。它通过DVL、IMU、压力传感器和关节编码器感知，摄像头仅提供目标和位姿的语义信息。通过建模紧凑导航状态而非高维视觉观测，大幅降低模型规模和计算成本。
AI.result: 在USIM基准的20个水下任务中，AquaWAM任务成功率达72.6%，优于现有方法；在NVIDIA Jetson AGX Orin上，动作决策速度比U0快2.7倍。在部分传感器不可用时仍有效，例如无DVL速度测量时成功率为61.6%，而U0仅为39.4%。
AI.conclusion: AquaWAM能有效处理水下被动动力学，并在传感器缺失时保持鲁棒性，同时显著提升计算效率，适用于水下具身智能体。

title: CompliantWBC: Whole-Body Compliance for Heavy Humanoids via Force Latent Estimation and Residual Impedance Targets
summary: Whole-body compliant control is essential for deploying heavy humanoids under high payload in human-centric environments. Most prior force-aware learning-based pipelines focus on end-effector resistance, per-link upper-body springs, or end-effector stiffness modulation, leaving arbitrary-site perturbations on heavy platforms with lower-body engagement largely unaddressed. We close this gap with CompliantWBC comprising: (1) A base policy trained with RL to maximize compliance-fidelity reward, guided by a multi-site whole-body impedance reference controller, extending classical Cartesian impedance to any controlled link; (2) A bounded residual policy that edits the per-link impedance equilibrium over a frozen base, correcting the coarse but structured wrench estimate supplied by a force encoder co-trained behind a gradient barrier; (3) A Phong-weighted force-origin sampler with an axis-decoupled pelvis anchor induces lower-body-inclusive compliance curriculum training via two interpretable parameters. We evaluate CompliantWBC in simulation against both compliant and stiff baselines, achieving best compliant fidelity of 2.58cm deviation from analytical solutions, and demonstrate it on a real heavy humanoid across static/dynamic force reaction, board wiping, squat under payload, and cooperative payload transport. Project website: https://dotandung.github.io/compliantwbc/

AI.tldr: 提出CompliantWBC全身柔顺控制框架，使重型人形机器人在任意位置外力扰动下仍能保持全身柔顺，并在仿真与真实平台上验证了静态/动态力反应、擦板、负重深蹲与合作搬运等任务。
AI.motivation: 重型人形机器人在人类环境中高负载作业需要全身柔顺控制，但现有基于力感知的学习方法多关注末端执行器阻力、上肢连杆弹簧或末端刚度调节，未充分解决重型平台在任意部位受扰且需下肢参与的问题。
AI.method: 方法包括三部分：(1) 以多部位全身阻抗参考控制器引导，用强化学习训练基础策略最大化柔顺保真度奖励，将经典笛卡尔阻抗扩展到任意受控连杆；(2) 在冻结基础策略上使用有界残差策略，对每连杆阻抗平衡点进行修正，并借助梯度屏障后共同训练的力编码器提供粗但结构化的力旋量估计；(3) 采用Phong加权力源采样器与轴解耦骨盆锚点，通过两个可解释参数实现包含下肢的柔顺课程训练。
AI.result: 在仿真中与柔顺及刚性基线对比，CompliantWBC取得最佳柔顺保真度，与解析解偏差为2.58cm；并在真实重型人形机器人上完成静态/动态力反应、擦板、负重深蹲和合作负载运输等演示。
AI.conclusion: CompliantWBC能够有效实现重型人形机器人在任意部位受扰时的全身柔顺控制，并兼顾下肢参与与高负载场景，具备仿真验证与真实机器人部署能力。

title: PruneForget: Joint Unlearning and Pruning of Vision Models
summary: Machine unlearning and model pruning are increasingly coupled in the real world. Models must support unlearning requests, e.g., for safety concerns, while also meeting requirements in latency and memory budget. Until recently, existing works have studied each aspect as an independent problem, e.g., running unlearning and pruning sequentially. In this work, we show that unlearning and pruning are naturally aligned and should be solved jointly to be made aware of each other. Intuitively, parameters that encode information of the unlearned samples are natural pruning targets, as unlearning and pruning both call for the "deletion" of such parameters. We propose PruneForget, a method that uses the unlearn set as a guide for pruning, so that unlearning and pruning mutually benefit each other. Extensive experiments on image classifiers and generative models show that PruneForget removes the influence of the unlearned samples while producing a more compact model with reduced inference cost. It achieves a negligible performance gap relative to an oracle that retrains from scratch for unlearning and then prunes.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出机器遗忘与模型剪枝在现实中常同时被需求，但现有工作通常将二者独立或顺序处理。作者提出PruneForget，将遗忘集作为剪枝指导，使遗忘与剪枝联合进行、相互受益。
AI.motivation: 现实模型既需支持遗忘请求（如安全原因），又需满足延迟和内存预算。已有研究大多将遗忘和剪枝视为独立问题，例如先遗忘再剪枝，未能利用二者之间的内在联系。
AI.method: 提出PruneForget方法，利用遗忘集指导剪枝，将编码被遗忘样本信息的参数作为自然剪枝目标，从而把机器遗忘与模型剪枝联合求解并相互增强。
AI.result: 在图像分类器和生成模型上的大量实验表明，PruneForget能在消除被遗忘样本影响的同时得到更紧凑的模型并降低推理成本，且与“从头重训练以遗忘再剪枝”的oracle方法相比性能差距可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 遗忘与剪枝本质上是自然对齐的，应联合并感知彼此地解决。PruneForget验证了联合处理可让二者互惠，有效兼顾遗忘效果与模型效率。

title: Improving the Diversity of LLM Outputs without a Trade-off
summary: We propose DAST (Diversifying Arithmetic Sampling with TokenTour), a method that increases the diversity of LLM outputs without any change to the marginal distribution and with negligible generation-time overhead (a few microseconds). We observe that token IDs are often arranged in a meaningless order and reassign them so that tokens with similar meanings appear consecutively. This can be done in advance in a few hundred seconds per model, and the resulting order can be reused for all subsequent generations. By combining this order with arithmetic sampling (or quasi-Monte Carlo methods), we make similar tokens less likely to be generated across runs while preserving the distribution. Our method not only produces qualitatively good ideas but also significantly improves performance on the downstream task of ProtoQA.

AI.tldr: 提出DAST方法，通过重排token ID并结合算术采样/QMC，在不改变边际分布且开销极低的情况下提升LLM输出多样性。
AI.motivation: LLM生成结果常缺乏多样性，而token ID顺序通常无意义，可能使相似token在不同运行中被重复采样；研究希望在保持原分布和低生成开销的前提下增加输出多样性。
AI.method: DAST（Diversifying Arithmetic Sampling with TokenTour）：预先将语义相似的token重新排列为连续token ID，每模型仅需数百秒且可复用；再结合算术采样或准蒙特卡洛方法进行采样，使相似token在不同生成运行中更不易同时出现。
AI.result: 方法在不改变边际分布、生成时仅增加几微秒开销的情况下，能产生质量较好的创意想法，并在ProtoQA下游任务上显著提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过语义化重排token ID并配合算术采样，可有效提升LLM输出多样性，同时保持分布一致、开销低且重排结果可复用。

title: PQR3D: Progressive Query Refinement over Reference-Conditioned Temporal Windows for Multi-View 3D Object Detection
summary: Temporal context is essential for camera-only multi-view 3D object detection. Existing streaming detectors maintain and propagate query states from one frame to the next, requiring sequence-aware training and chronological inference. We propose PQR3D, which performs progressive query refinement within referenceconditioned temporal windows. This design enables random frame sampling and independent inference without persistent query memory. Within each window, PQR3D progressively transfers motion-aligned high-confidence queries from earlier timestamps toward the target frame. We further introduce masked selfattention to regulate interactions among regular, propagated, and denoising queries while keeping denoising supervision isolated from detection queries. In addition, a stage-decoupled anchor embedding injects position before self-attention and size, orientation, and velocity afterward, reducing interference from temporally inconsistent attributes. With a ViT-L backbone, PQR3D sets a new state of the art on the nuScenes test set, achieving 71.6 NDS and 64.9 mAP. Source code is available at https://github.com/huiyegit/PQR3D

AI.tldr: 提出PQR3D，一种基于参考条件时间窗口内渐进式查询细化的纯视觉多视角3D目标检测方法，无需持久查询记忆，支持随机帧采样与独立推理。
AI.motivation: 时间上下文对纯视觉多视角3D检测至关重要，但现有流式检测器需要维护并传播跨帧查询状态，依赖序列感知训练和按时间顺序推理，限制了灵活性与效率。
AI.method: 在参考条件时间窗口内进行渐进式查询细化；将早期时间戳中运动对齐的高置信查询逐步传递到目标帧；引入掩码自注意力来规范常规查询、传播查询和去噪查询之间的交互，并将去噪监督与检测查询隔离；采用阶段解耦锚点嵌入，在自注意力前注入位置信息，在自注意力后注入尺寸、朝向和速度信息。
AI.result: 使用ViT-L骨干网络，在nuScenes测试集上达到71.6 NDS和64.9 mAP，取得新的最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: PQR3D无需持久查询记忆即可实现随机帧采样和独立推理，同时通过渐进式查询细化与阶段解耦嵌入有效利用时间上下文，并在nuScenes上刷新了纯视觉3D检测的最佳结果。

title: Q-WAM: 4-Bit Quantization of World Action Models with Action-Subspace Protection
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) jointly generate video and robot actions through iterative diffusion and perform strongly in robotic manipulation. However, their prohibitive compute and memory costs pose substantial deployment challenges. Post-training quantization (PTQ) can reduce these costs, but existing PTQ methods such as smoothing and rotation are insufficient to maintain the precision of action generation. To overcome this limitation, we propose Q-WAM, a new 4-bit weight-activation quantization for WAMs that preserves the actions the model generates. Specifically, we introduce the \textit{Action Observability Gramian (AOG)}, which measures how much rounding errors in each weighted combination of a layer's input channels change the final action through all denoising steps. We also develop Action-Subspace Protection (ASP), which keeps the few most action-sensitive channel combinations in a tiny 16-bit low-rank branch and quantizes the complementary weights and activations to 4 bits, both as dense matrix multiplications that run efficiently on GPUs. Finally, to preserve action quality with minimal overhead, we identify the experts that matter most for the generated action by aggregating the AOG-derived action mass across the layers of each expert and apply ASP only to those experts. We evaluate Q-WAM on three WAMs, both in simulation and in real-world deployment. On the RoboTwin 2.0 benchmark, it reaches 89.6--93.0\% average success rate, within 1.1 percentage points of the 16-bit models, while reducing the memory of the quantized blocks by 3.1--3.4$\times$. Our method outperforms the strongest baseline, SVDQuant, by 2.5--8.7 percentage points. On a Unitree G1 humanoid and a bimanual UR3 robot, it improves success over SVDQuant by 12.8-17.6 percentage points.

AI.tldr: Q-WAM是一种针对世界动作模型（WAMs）的4位权重-激活量化方法，通过动作可观测性格拉姆矩阵（AOG）和动作子空间保护（ASP）来保持动作生成精度，在降低内存的同时接近16位模型性能。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型通过迭代扩散联合生成视频和机器人动作，在机器人操作中表现强大，但其计算和内存成本高昂，部署困难。现有的训练后量化方法（如平滑和旋转）不足以保持动作生成的精度。
AI.method: 提出Q-WAM，一种4位权重-激活量化方法。引入动作可观测性格拉姆矩阵（AOG），衡量每层输入通道的加权组合中的舍入误差通过所有去噪步骤对最终动作的影响。开发动作子空间保护（ASP），将少数对动作最敏感的通道组合保留在16位低秩分支中，其余权重和激活量化为4位，均以稠密矩阵乘法在GPU上高效运行。最后，通过聚合每个专家的AOG导出动作质量，识别对生成动作最重要的专家，仅对这些专家应用ASP。
AI.result: 在三个WAM上进行了仿真和真实世界评估。在RoboTwin 2.0基准上，平均成功率达到89.6-93.0%，与16位模型相差1.1个百分点以内，同时将量化块的内存减少3.1-3.4倍。比最强基线SVDQuant高出2.5-8.7个百分点。在Unitree G1人形机器人和双臂UR3机器人上，成功率比SVDQuant提高12.8-17.6个百分点。
AI.conclusion: Q-WAM能够有效将WAM量化为4位，同时保持动作质量，实现高效部署。

title: From Outcomes to Strategies: Learning Strategy Utility for Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has substantially improved mathematical reasoning. However, terminal correctness alone provides limited insight into the quality of high-level strategies, such as theorem selection and subgoal decomposition, when considered separately from their subsequent execution. This paper studies strategy utility, which is defined as the likelihood that a strategy supports a correct downstream solution under a given executor. We introduce SURE, a framework for learning and leveraging relative strategy utility. In this framework, high-level strategies are separated from their detailed reasoning. Based on the pairwise preferences constructed from strategy-conditioned rollouts and teacher-generated contrasts, a Strategy Reward Model is learned to estimate relative strategy utility. During reinforcement learning, the frozen reward model reads only the extracted strategy, whose score is combined with the correctness and format rewards in a sequence-level GRPO objective. Compared with outcome-and-format GRPO baselines, experiments show that SURE improves average pass@1 by 1.87%, 2.64%, and 2.93% across three policy backbones. Our method also achieves competitive or better accuracy than stronger reward baselines while requiring substantially lower GRPO-stage compute.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SURE 框架，通过从策略条件 rollout 和教师对比中构建成对偏好，训练策略奖励模型来估计高层推理策略的相对效用，并将其与正确性、格式奖励结合到序列级 GRPO 目标中，从而提升数学推理能力。
AI.motivation: 可验证奖励强化学习虽显著提升数学推理，但仅依赖最终答案正确性无法单独评估定理选择、子目标分解等高层策略的质量，因此需要研究策略效用，即策略在给定执行器下支持正确下游解的可能性。
AI.method: 将高层策略与详细推理分离；基于策略条件 rollout 和教师生成的对比构建成对偏好；训练 Strategy Reward Model 估计相对策略效用；在强化学习中冻结该奖励模型，仅读取提取出的策略，并将其分数与正确性、格式奖励结合，用于序列级 GRPO 目标。
AI.result: 与仅使用结果和格式奖励的 GRPO 基线相比，SURE 在三个策略骨干上平均 pass@1 分别提升 1.87%、2.64% 和 2.93%；同时以显著更低的 GRPO 阶段计算量达到与更强奖励基线相当或更优的准确率。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模并利用高层策略的相对效用，可在不依赖高额额外计算的情况下有效提升数学推理强化学习的效果。

title: VPEvolve: A Self-Evolving Virtual Process Engineer for Computational Lithography
summary: Optical proximity correction (OPC) recipes grow as engineers add local rules to repair newly discovered lithography hotspots. Each correction can interact with existing rules, while lessons from commercial-tool trials remain scattered across code and logs. \system combines a Virtual Process Engineer (VPE) harness with a Skill Bank of measured engineering experience. The harness equips a frozen language model with process manuals, layout analysis, recipe editing, and commercial-tool evaluation. The actor proposes changes to the global parameters, local targeted rules, or diagnostic trials. After each evaluation, an LLM reflector and curator turn the measured response into evidence-linked judgments. The actor retrieves them before its next trial. Feasible improvements update the retained recipe; every measured trial informs the Skill Bank that guides the next edit. The model weights remain fixed. On a FreePDK45-derived benchmark with ten commercial-tool evaluations per case, \system reduces the mean per-case maximum edge placement error from 18.294 to 5.361 nm on Poly and from 22.052 to 15.692 nm on Metal1. Every final recipe satisfies the predefined quality constraints and improves the maximum error by at least 0.1 nm.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种结合虚拟工艺工程师（VPE）执行框架与工程经验技能库（Skill Bank）的 OPC 配方优化系统，在冻结语言模型权重的情况下，通过商业工具评估、反思与经验检索，自动改进 OPC 配方并降低边缘放置误差。
AI.motivation: OPC 配方会因工程师不断加入局部规则以修复新发现的光刻热点而膨胀，新增修正可能与既有规则相互作用；同时商业工具试验中的经验分散在代码和日志中，难以系统积累和复用。
AI.method: 系统由 VPE harness 与 Skill Bank 组成。VPE 为冻结语言模型配备工艺手册、版图分析、配方编辑和商业工具评估工具。Actor 提出全局参数、局部定向规则或诊断试验的修改；每次评估后，由 LLM reflector 和 curator 将实测响应转化为带证据链接的判断，Actor 在下一次试验前检索这些经验。可行改进会更新保留配方，每次实测试验都会更新 Skill Bank 以指导后续编辑，模型权重保持不变。
AI.result: 在基于 FreePDK45 的基准上，每个案例进行 10 次商业工具评估，系统将 Poly 层平均每案例最大边缘放置误差从 18.294 nm 降至 5.361 nm，将 Metal1 层从 22.052 nm 降至 15.692 nm。所有最终配方均满足预定义质量约束，并将最大误差至少改善 0.1 nm。
AI.conclusion: 该系统无需微调语言模型，即可通过闭环试验、反思式经验提取和技能库检索有效优化 OPC 配方，在满足质量约束的同时显著降低最大边缘放置误差，说明将实测工程经验结构化并用于指导 LLM 编辑具有实际效果。

title: SocialHumanoid: Towards Expressive Humanoid Behavior via One-Step Co-Speech Motion Generation
summary: Humanoid robots are increasingly expected to serve as embodied social agents that communicate naturally with humans through face-to-face interaction. During such communication, humanoid robots require body behaviors that are synchronized with speech, affectively expressive, and suitable for real-time execution. However, existing co-speech methods are primarily developed for digital humans and lack joint support for affective control and low-latency continuous generation on physical embodiments. To bridge this gap, we present SocialHumanoid, a system for expressive humanoid behavior via one-step co-speech motion generation. Given response speech and a specified affective condition, SocialHumanoid generates each full-body motion window in a single forward pass and connects successive windows through motion-history conditioning. The generated human motion is further converted online into embodiment-compatible robot references and tracked by a whole-body controller for physical execution. To provide explicit supervision for affective body expression, we further introduce AffectMoCap, a 4-hour dataset captured from two professional actors, containing synchronized speech, body motion, fine-grained hand motion, and emotion annotations. On BEAT2, SocialHumanoid achieves the best FGD among the compared generation methods, competitive speech-motion synchrony, and approximately $6\times$ faster inference than GestureLSM under the same protocol. Perceptual evaluations further show that training with AffectMoCap improves affect recognition from generated body motion, while real-robot experiments demonstrate continuous affect-conditioned behavior and stable long-horizon execution. Our project page is https://rex0191.github.io/SocialHumanoid/.

AI.tldr: 提出SocialHumanoid，一种面向人形机器人的一步式共语动作生成系统，实现情感可控、低延迟的全身行为生成与实体执行，并发布AffectMoCap数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有共语动作方法主要面向数字人，缺乏对情感控制与低延迟连续生成的支持，难以满足人形机器人面对面社交交互中对同步、富有情感且可实时执行的身体行为的需求。
AI.method: 基于响应语音与指定情感条件，单次前向生成全身动作窗口，并通过运动历史条件连接连续窗口；将生成的人体动作在线转换为机器人可执行参考，由全身控制器跟踪执行；引入AffectMoCap数据集，包含两名专业演员4小时同步语音、身体动作、精细手部动作与情感标注，为情感身体表达提供显式监督。
AI.result: 在BEAT2上取得最佳FGD、有竞争力的语音-动作同步性，推理速度约为GestureLSM的6倍；感知评估表明使用AffectMoCap训练可提升生成身体动作的情感识别；真机实验展示连续情感条件行为与稳定的长时执行。
AI.conclusion: SocialHumanoid有效弥合了共语动作生成与人形机器人实体社交交互之间的差距，验证了情感可控、低延迟、长时稳定执行的可能性。

title: TCMQA: A 38K-Question Traditional Chinese Medicine Benchmark with a Licensed-Practitioner Reference
summary: Medical benchmarks for language models are built almost entirely on Western biomedicine. Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) is a separate system, with its own diagnostic framework and its own literature, and it remains largely unmeasured. The few TCM evaluations that exist are small, narrow, and rarely paired with a human reference. We present TCMQA, an open benchmark of 38,279 questions from Chinese TCM licensing examinations, paired with 15,151 responses from 101 licensed practitioners. We evaluate 29 instruction-tuned models from 9 families, spanning 0.27B to 14.8B parameters. Accuracy ranges over 59 points, and no model approaches saturation. Pretraining data predicts TCM ability far better than scale: a 12B Western-pretrained model reaches 39.6%, while a Chinese-pretrained model an eighth its size reaches 60.8%. Nine models exceed the practitioner majority vote of 64.9%, the best by 21.8 points, and all nine come from that same Chinese-pretrained family. Yet difficulty does not transfer between models and practitioners: accuracy is flat across practitioner-rated difficulty, item-level agreement is near zero for all 29 models, and on $8.4\%$ of items the practitioners are correct where the leading model is wrong. We release the corpus, the practitioner responses, the harness, and per-item model outputs at https://huggingface.co/datasets/TechTCM/TCMQA.

AI.tldr: 提出TCMQA，一个包含38,279道中医执业考试题和101位持证从业者15,151条回答的开放基准，并评测29个指令微调模型。结果显示，预训练数据比模型规模更能决定中医能力，部分中文预训练模型超过从业者多数投票，但与人类难度判断和逐题一致性不匹配。
AI.motivation: 现有医学语言模型基准几乎都基于西方生物医学，中医作为拥有独立诊断框架和文献的体系长期缺乏评测；已有中医评测规模小、范围窄，且很少与人类参考对照。
AI.method: 构建TCMQA：从中国中医执业资格考试收集38,279道题，并配对101位持证从业者的15,151条回答；评测来自9个家族、0.27B至14.8B参数的29个指令微调模型；分析准确率、预训练数据与规模影响、与从业者多数投票的比较，以及逐题一致性和难度迁移；公开语料、从业者回答、评测框架和逐项模型输出。
AI.result: 模型准确率跨度超过59个百分点，且无模型接近饱和。预训练数据比规模更能预测中医能力：12B西方预训练模型达到39.6%，而八分之一大小的中文预训练模型达到60.8%。9个模型超过从业者多数投票64.9%，最佳高出21.8个百分点，且均来自同一中文预训练家族。但难度不迁移：准确率随从业者评定难度基本持平，29个模型的逐题一致性接近零，在8.4%的题目上从业者正确而领先模型错误。
AI.conclusion: TCMQA填补了中医语言模型评测空白，表明中医能力更依赖预训练数据和文化语言适配而非参数规模；模型虽能在考试题上超过从业者多数投票，但与人类判断和难度不一致，说明仍需更贴近临床与人类参考的评测。

title: OneFixer: High-Quality and Consistent One-Step Autoregressive 3DGS Refinement for Driving Scenes
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion is a promising render-time fixer for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) in autonomous-driving simulation, but deployment demands high visual quality and temporal consistency at low latency. This is especially hard for one-step causal generation, where each imperfect prediction immediately becomes context for subsequent frames. Existing approaches stabilize rollouts through staged training with multiple modules and rollout-aware regularization, yet one-step quality still falls short of what deployment requires. We introduce OneFixer, a one-step autoregressive video-diffusion fixer trained in a single task-specific adaptation stage. Our key idea is a deployment-matched shared rollout: the model's own one-step predictions serve as the causal context for flow matching, exposing training to deployment-time errors, while the same rollout receives direct pixel-space perceptual supervision to preserve fine detail. Because the predictions optimized for current-frame quality are exactly those reused as future context, fidelity and autoregressive robustness are learned jointly, without bidirectional-to-causal conversion or teacher-student distillation. OneFixer further exploits cues that driving simulation readily provides, lane geometry and dynamic-agent states, to improve geometric fidelity. On Waymo and proprietary driving scenes with 900-frame rollouts, OneFixer achieves the lowest FVD, LPIPS, and DISTS among all baselines at one step, with temporal consistency matching or exceeding multi-stage DMD pipelines. Under identical backbone and conditioning, it matches a multi-stage DMD-with-Self-Forcing pipeline in under half the GPU-hours and keeps improving beyond its plateau. In closed-loop simulation with a driving policy, OneFixer reduces the collision rate by a third relative to raw 3DGS rendering. Project page: https://onefixer-web.vercel.app/

AI.tldr: OneFixer 是面向自动驾驶仿真的单步自回归视频扩散修复器，用于提升 3D Gaussian Splatting 渲染的视觉质量与时序一致性，并保持低延迟。
AI.motivation: 3DGS 在自动驾驶仿真中渲染质量与时序一致性不足，视频扩散可作为渲染时修复器，但单步因果生成会累积误差，现有分阶段训练、多模块和 rollout 正则仍难以满足部署要求。
AI.method: 提出 OneFixer，在单一任务适配阶段训练；核心是部署匹配的共享 rollout，用模型自身单步预测作为 flow matching 的因果上下文，暴露训练于部署时误差，同时对同一 rollout 施加像素空间感知监督；联合学习保真度与自回归鲁棒性，无需双向到因果转换或教师学生蒸馏；并利用车道几何与动态智能体状态线索提升几何保真。
AI.result: 在 Waymo 和私有驾驶场景的 900 帧 rollout 上，OneFixer 单步取得最低 FVD、LPIPS、DISTS，时序一致性匹配或超过多阶段 DMD；相同骨干与条件下，以不到一半 GPU 小时匹配多阶段 DMD-with-Self-Forcing，并持续提升；闭环仿真中相比原始 3DGS 渲染将碰撞率降低三分之一。
AI.conclusion: OneFixer 表明，通过部署匹配的共享 rollout 和可利用的驾驶场景线索，无需复杂多阶段训练或蒸馏，也能在单步低延迟下实现高质量、时序稳定且更安全的自动驾驶仿真渲染修复。

title: Federated 3D Gaussian Splatting for Large-Scale Scene Reconstruction at Wireless Edge
comment: 16 pages, 10 figures, 6 tables. Accepted for publication
summary: Three-dimensional (3D) Gaussian splatting (3D-GS) has emerged as a promising technique for large-scale scene reconstruction due to its high rendering efficiency and fidelity. However, the training of large-scale 3D-GS models at wireless edge faces various technical challenges including the limited communication, computation, and graphics processing unit (GPU) memory resources at edge devices, the structural inconsistency issue across local models hindering their effective aggregation, as well as privacy leakage risks associated with raw visual content and camera parameters. To address these challenges, this paper proposes a novel resource-efficient federated learning framework for efficiently training 3D-GS models of large scenes under severe resource constraints. First, we propose an on-device model lightweighting mechanism that adaptively selects and prunes Gaussian points to balance the rendering quality and training efficiency. In this mechanism, we quantitatively evaluate the importance of different Gaussian points at each device to facilitate the pruning, and use a novel importance-to-latency ratio criterion to determine the number of pruned Gaussian points under GPU memory and computation/communication latency constraints. Furthermore, we develop a 3D-GS model recovery mechanism that restores structural consistency across local 3D-GS models without accessing private camera parameters, enabling their effective aggregation towards a global model. Finally, extensive experiments show that our approach significantly accelerates convergence, maintains high rendering quality, and reduces training latency compared to state-of-the-art federated 3D-GS baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向无线边缘的资源高效联邦学习框架，用于在严重资源受限条件下训练大规模3D高斯泼溅（3D-GS）模型，通过模型轻量化和结构恢复实现高效聚合与高质量渲染。
AI.motivation: 大规模3D-GS模型在无线边缘训练面临通信、计算和GPU内存资源有限、本地模型间结构不一致导致难以有效聚合，以及原始视觉内容和相机参数带来的隐私泄露风险等挑战。
AI.method: 提出资源高效联邦学习框架：1）设备端模型轻量化机制，自适应选择与剪枝高斯点，量化各高斯点重要性，并采用重要性-时延比准则在GPU内存与计算/通信时延约束下确定剪枝数量；2）3D-GS模型恢复机制，在不访问私有相机参数的情况下恢复本地模型间的结构一致性，以支持有效聚合为全局模型。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，与现有最先进的联邦3D-GS基线相比，该方法显著加速收敛、保持高渲染质量，并降低训练时延。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够缓解边缘资源限制与隐私风险，有效支持大规模3D-GS模型的联邦训练，在渲染质量与训练效率之间取得良好平衡。

title: Pinned and Still Unstable: Within-Judge Verdict Variance and the Noise Floor of LLM-as-Judge Leaderboards
summary: Modern LLM evaluation assumes that pinning a judge to a fixed model snapshot and decoding at temperature zero yields reproducible verdicts. We show this assumption fails as a property of how LLM-as-Judge is operationalized on cloud serving infrastructure, not of any particular model family. Across four frontier judges all served via a single major enterprise cloud platform and three standard benchmarks (Arena-Hard, AlpacaEval 2, MT-Bench), identical inputs to the same pinned, temperature-zero judge produce different verdicts across re-runs: per-item flip rates of roughly 5% on average and about 40% on the close-call items that decide leaderboard margins, with a per-judge magnitude spanning a 40x range (from 0.13% to nearly 10%). We introduce metrics tailored to this instability: per-item flip rate, a two-part stability profile (waver fraction and conditional intensity), and adjacency separability - and report what the variance does and does not do to rankings. For a single judge the aggregate ranking is stable (0% top-K instability, 0% pooled winner flip); what degrades is precision: under a paired hierarchical bootstrap, roughly one-fifth to three-quarters of adjacent leaderboard positions are statistically indistinguishable, a noise floor we attribute primarily to finite prompt sampling rather than to the judge. Across judges, leaderboards agree on the coarse ordering but diverge in the middle (Kendall's tau as low as 0.42-0.64 between families on Arena-Hard), and of 13 published head-to-head ranking claims we re-judge, 5 fail under a defensible judge swap or re-run. We argue that leaderboards report unhedged point estimates that misrepresent the noise floor of the instrument, and we propose a minimal, low-cost reporting protocol: several judge re-runs, published stability profiles and adjacency intervals, and results under at least two judges from different families.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示LLM-as-Judge在云服务基础设施上即使固定模型快照和温度0也无法保证可复现，量化了重复运行中的判决翻转及其对排行榜的影响，并提出了低成本报告协议。
AI.motivation: 现代LLM评估普遍假设固定judge模型和温度0可产生可复现判决，但这一假设在实际云服务部署中可能不成立，需要系统研究其不稳定性来源与后果。
AI.method: 在单一企业云平台上使用四个前沿judge和三个基准（Arena-Hard、AlpacaEval 2、MT-Bench）进行重复运行，引入每项翻转率、两部分稳定性剖面（波动比例与条件强度）和邻接可分性等指标，并用配对层次bootstrap分析排名差异。
AI.result: 相同输入重复运行产生不同判决：平均每项翻转率约5%，接近判定的项约40%，judge间差异达40倍（0.13%至近10%）。单judge聚合排名稳定（0% top-K不稳定、0%合并胜者翻转），但精度下降：约五分之一至四分之三的相邻排名统计上不可区分，噪声主要源于有限提示采样。跨judge粗序一致但中间分歧（Arena-Hard上Kendall's tau低至0.42-0.64）。13个已发表对比排名中5个在合理换judge或重跑下失败。
AI.conclusion: 排行榜报告未对冲的点估计掩盖了仪器噪声底；应采纳最小低成本报告协议：多次judge重跑、公布稳定性剖面和邻接区间、至少使用两个不同家族的judge。

title: Towards Scalable Data Diversification for Language Model Pretraining via Leverage Score Sampling
summary: Data selection for language model pretraining faces a fundamental tension between quality and diversity. While quality filtering is empirically effective, it often induces diversity collapse: by favoring texts similar to high-quality reference corpora (e.g., educational or QA-style data), it systematically excludes valuable data from underrepresented domains. In contrast, diversified selection preserves domain balance and encourages robust downstream performance, yet existing methods either focus on coverage-oriented objectives that indirectly enhance diversity, or directly optimize for diversity via costly covariance matrix recomputation that limits scalability. To address these issues, we introduce \textbf{Leverage Score Sampling (Lev)}, which iteratively selects samples that maximally expand the determinantal volume of the embedded data via leverage scores, a computationally efficient criterion that eliminates matrix recomputation and enables scalable selection. Empirically, Lev delivers up to $72\times$ speedup and improves dataset diversity, measured by the Vendi score, by $9.2\%$ over the strong diversification baseline \textbf{DiSF}. On CommonCrawl (CC) web data selection, Lev improves accuracy across seven downstream tasks by up to $1.31\%$ over existing baselines. For domains where robust quality criteria are inherently difficult to define (e.g., code), Lev serves as an effective unsupervised curation alternative: on StarCoderData, the selected subset reduces bits-per-byte by $3.08\%$ over DiSF. Notably, we uncover a cross-domain collapse of quality filtering: CC data filtered by DCLM-fastText fail to retain sufficient code-related content, yielding inferior code performance relative to Lev-selected data. These findings advocate for integrating diversity-aware practices into quality filtering for more effective data curation in language model pretraining.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Leverage Score Sampling（Lev），通过杠杆分数迭代选择能最大扩展嵌入数据行列式体积的样本，以在语言模型预训练数据选择中兼顾质量与多样性，并实现高效可扩展的多样化选样。
AI.motivation: 数据选择面临质量与多样性的根本矛盾：质量过滤虽有效，但会导致多样性崩塌，偏向高质量参考语料并排除 underrepresented 领域数据；现有多样化方法或仅关注覆盖度，或需昂贵协方差矩阵重算而难以扩展。
AI.method: 提出 Leverage Score Sampling（Lev），迭代选择可最大扩展嵌入数据 determinantal volume 的样本，使用杠杆分数作为计算高效准则，避免矩阵重算，从而支持可扩展的数据选择。
AI.result: Lev 相比强多样化基线 DiSF 最高提速 72 倍，Vendi 多样性提升 9.2%；在 CommonCrawl 数据选择上，七个下游任务准确率最高提升 1.31%；在 StarCoderData 上，bits-per-byte 相比 DiSF 降低 3.08%；并发现 DCLM-fastText 质量过滤的 CC 数据存在跨域崩塌，代码相关内容保留不足，代码表现劣于 Lev 选择的数据。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明应将多样性感知实践整合进质量过滤，以实现更有效的语言模型预训练数据策划。

title: Reading Too Much into Context: Passive Exposure Can Steer LLM Decisions
summary: Large language model (LLM) assistants can now search the web and consult external sources while completing user requests. These sources can provide useful evidence, but they can also introduce additional content into the model's context. Can such passive exposure steer a decision even when the added content provides no reason to change it? We examine the stability of model decisions on the same tasks with and without such external content. Across all open-weight and closed-weight models we test, exposure systematically shifts decisions, with effects reaching nearly 50 percentage points in closed-weight models. The same pattern appears with real-world online opinions. The influence also extends beyond subjective preferences. Such exposure can steer models toward choices that violate explicit user requirements and increase their acceptance of false claims. In short, what enters an LLM's context can influence its decision even when it should not determine it.

AI.tldr: 研究揭示大语言模型助手在检索外部内容时，即使这些内容本不应影响判断，也会系统性改变其决策。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM在搜索或咨询外部来源时，被动暴露于额外内容是否会改变原本应稳定的决策，甚至影响客观任务和用户约束。
AI.method: 在同一任务上比较模型有无外部内容时的决策稳定性；测试多种开源与闭源模型，并加入真实在线观点等外部内容，考察对主观偏好、用户要求和虚假主张的影响。
AI.result: 所有测试模型均出现决策偏移；闭源模型效应可达近50个百分点；真实在线观点同样引发偏移；还会使模型偏向违反明确用户要求的选项，并提高对虚假主张的接受度。
AI.conclusion: 进入LLM上下文的内容会影响其决策，即使该内容不应成为决定因素，表明模型判断对外部暴露具有脆弱性。

title: Separating Diagnosis from Disease Representation: Dual-View EEG Learning with Neural-Dynamics-Guided Deformation
summary: Electroencephalography (EEG)-based closed-loop neuromodulation calls for a subject-specific structured state, as opposed to a single disease probability, specifying which brain regions are deviant, at which frequencies, and at which lags. Sensor-space models keep the strongest diagnostic evidence without anatomy, source-space models give anatomy at a loss of predictive signal, and post-hoc attributions stay outside the prediction. We separate the two instead of forcing them into one representation, and propose DMD-EEG (Dual-view Multiscale Deformation for EEG), which keeps a fixed scalp spectral expert for diagnosis and models the source-space disease-related representation as a low-rank, sparse, iterative deformation of a healthy neural-dynamics prior in a $46$-region-of-interest (ROI) $\times$ $5$-frequency $\times$ $4$-lag (autocorrelation-timescale) space. The two experts meet only at a fixed decision level, so the source state is architecturally separate from the scalp expert. Across major depressive disorder (MDD), first-episode psychosis (FEP), and Parkinson's disease (PD), decision-level fusion matches the strongest single expert on MDD and FEP and exceeds the source branch on PD. On FEP the source expert is the strongest branch, the task where the deformation contributes most. The source state is an explicit ROI-frequency-lag attribution defined in a shared source coordinate system across montages, which we treat as an anatomically-coordinated predictive representation whose coordinates are directly readable and hypothesis-generating. The highest-saliency coordinates align with established disease circuitry (fronto-limbic-temporal regions in MDD, motor-cortex beta in PD), and the MDD state transfers by rank to an unseen cohort recorded with a different montage.

AI.tldr: 提出DMD-EEG双视角多尺度形变框架，将EEG诊断与可解释源空间状态分离：头皮频谱专家负责诊断，源空间疾病表示通过健康神经动力学先验的低秩稀疏迭代形变建模，并在决策级融合。
AI.motivation: 闭环EEG神经调控需要个体化结构化状态，不仅给出疾病概率，还要指出异常脑区、频率和滞后；现有传感器空间模型缺乏解剖信息，源空间模型损失预测信号，事后归因又不在预测模型中。
AI.method: 构建固定头皮频谱诊断专家，并在46 ROI×5频率×4滞后空间中，将疾病相关源空间表示建模为健康先验的低秩稀疏迭代形变；两专家仅在固定决策层融合，源状态与头皮专家架构分离。
AI.result: 在MDD、FEP、PD上，决策级融合在MDD/FEP达到最强单专家水平，在PD超过源分支；FEP中源专家最强。源状态给出ROI-频率-滞后显式归因，跨导联共享坐标系；高显著性坐标与已知疾病环路一致（MDD额-边缘-颞，PD运动皮层beta），MDD状态可按rank迁移到不同导联的未见过队列。
AI.conclusion: DMD-EEG在保持诊断性能的同时，提供解剖协调、可直接读取且可生成假设的预测性源空间状态，支持跨导联迁移，有利于个体化闭环神经调控。

title: Recursive Harness Distillation across Agents for Robot Manipulation
summary: A central goal in robotics is to enable manipulation across changing tasks and environments. Vision-language-action (VLA) models provide broad manipulation capabilities but can struggle when execution requires diagnosing failures and adapting behavior. Strong agents can discover effective interventions through interaction with these policies. We propose Recursive Harness Distillation to accumulate this experience as reusable guidance across agents. A strong agent distills its experience into a playbook for a light agent, then recursively refines the playbook using the light agent's execution feedback. The resulting playbook enables agents to reuse accumulated intervention knowledge in new task instances without updating model parameters. In real-world manipulation, the harness improves success from 37.3% to 64.0%. On SimplerEnv Bridge, the light agent with the playbook achieves 66.7% success, compared with 41.7% for the GR00T-only baseline, and outperforms the strong agent without a playbook. The same playbook also benefits the strong agent, which reaches 79.2% success. These results demonstrate the feasibility of harness distillation for robotics: intervention experience can be accumulated, refined through execution, and reused across agents to improve manipulation.

AI.tldr: 提出递归 Harness 蒸馏，将强 agent 的干预经验蒸馏为可复用 playbook，并递归精炼，使轻量 agent 无需更新模型参数即可提升跨任务操作成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA 模型具备广泛操作能力，但在需要诊断失败并调整行为时表现不佳；需要一种能积累并复用有效干预经验的方法。
AI.method: 强 agent 通过与环境交互发现有效干预，将其蒸馏成供轻 agent 使用的 playbook，再利用轻 agent 的执行反馈递归优化 playbook；不更新模型参数。
AI.result: 真实机器人操作成功率从 37.3% 提升到 64.0%；在 SimplerEnv Bridge 上，轻 agent 加 playbook 达 66.7%，高于 GR00T-only 的 41.7%，并超过无 playbook 的强 agent；同一 playbook 也使强 agent 达到 79.2%。
AI.conclusion: 验证了 harness 蒸馏在机器人领域的可行性：干预经验可被积累、通过执行反馈精炼，并跨 agent 复用以提升操作性能。

title: Binaural Audio-Visual Instance Segmentation
summary: Audio-visual segmentation (AVS) aims to segment sounding objects at the pixel level by integrating auditory and visual cues. However, existing methods are predominantly developed under the monaural setting and primarily rely on cross-modal semantic correspondence, which limits their ability to distinguish visually similar instances of the same semantic class. In contrast, humans naturally exploit binaural hearing, where interaural differences and direction-dependent acoustic filtering introduced by the head and pinnae provide physically grounded spatial cues for accurate sound source localization. Motivated by this observation, we introduce binaural audio-visual instance segmentation (BiAVIS), a new task that leverages synchronized binaural audio and video frames to segment sounding instances. To advance research on this task, we establish two benchmarks by manually annotating an existing binaural audio-visual dataset and collecting a new real-world dataset, BiAVIS-Bench, in more challenging and diverse scenarios. We further propose a BiAVIS model, which leverages an audio-only sound source localization network to learn spatial and semantic priors for sounding instances from binaural audio. A query-level audio-visual fusion strategy is subsequently introduced to inject these informative priors into the instance segmentation decoder. Extensive experiments conducted on the two proposed benchmarks demonstrate the superior performance of the BiAVIS model over previous monaural AVS methods, especially in resolving instance-level intra-class ambiguity. On the more challenging BiAVIS-Bench, the proposed BiAVIS model outperforms the best-performing monaural baselines by 17.22\% in mAP and 7.71\% in FSLA, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出双耳视听实例分割（BiAVIS）新任务，利用同步双耳音频与视频帧分割发声实例，并构建两个基准数据集及相应模型。
AI.motivation: 现有视听分割方法多基于单耳设置，依赖跨模态语义对应，难以区分同一语义类别中视觉相似的实例；而人类利用双耳听觉中的耳间差异和头部/耳廓滤波带来的空间线索来准确定位声源。
AI.method: 提出BiAVIS任务，并人工标注现有双耳视听数据集及收集新数据集BiAVIS-Bench，建立两个基准；提出BiAVIS模型，使用纯音频声源定位网络从双耳音频学习空间与语义先验，并通过查询级视听融合策略将先验注入实例分割解码器。
AI.result: 在两个基准上实验表明，BiAVIS模型优于先前单耳视听分割方法，尤其在解决实例级类内歧义方面表现突出；在更具挑战的BiAVIS-Bench上，相比最佳单耳基线，mAP提升17.22%，FSLA提升7.71%。
AI.conclusion: 双耳空间线索能有效提升视听实例分割性能，BiAVIS任务、基准和模型为相关研究提供了新方向。

title: OneSign: Unifying Sign Language Understanding Tasks with One Model
summary: SLU encompasses a diverse set of tasks, including ISLR, CSLR, and SLT. Although these tasks share basic semantic and linguistic foundations, they are typically addressed with task-specific architectures and training pipelines, which hinders knowledge sharing and requires costly pretraining and finetuning for each task. In this paper, we focus on two aspects of SLU tasks: (1) training and inference pipelines are highly fragmented: most methods rely on pretraining on large-scale SL datasets followed by task- or dataset-specific finetuning, which leads to multiple specialized models rather than a single checkpoint. (2) current LLM-based methods may overlook the inherent modality discrepancy between sign and text tokens, simply concatenating them and processing both modalities with the same decoder layers. In this paper, we present OneSign, a unified framework that addresses multiple SLU tasks within a single model and a single checkpoint. OneSign reformulates ISLR, CSLR, and SLT under a single training paradigm. To accommodate the heterogeneous characteristics of sign and text representations, we introduce a Modality-Adaptive Mixture-of-Experts (MA-MoE) architecture, consisting of a shared expert and modality-specific experts for sign and text tokens. A modality router dynamically activates the corresponding experts, and their outputs are aggregated to form the final token representations. By enabling modality-dependent expert specialization while preserving a shared expert path, MA-MoE can effectively model the modality differences between continuous sign representations and discrete text tokens. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks demonstrate that OneSign achieves competitive or state-of-the-art performance on several benchmarks, highlighting its effectiveness as a unified SLU model. Datasets are available at : https://github.com/gswycf/OneSign.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OneSign，一个统一的手语理解框架，能在单个模型和单个检查点中处理孤立手语识别、连续手语识别和手语翻译任务。通过引入模态自适应混合专家（MA-MoE）架构，有效建模手语与文本之间的模态差异。
AI.motivation: 现有手语理解任务通常采用任务特定架构和训练流程，导致知识共享困难，且每个任务都需要昂贵的预训练和微调。此外，当前基于大语言模型的方法忽略了手语和文本标记之间的固有模态差异，简单拼接并用同一解码器处理两种模态。
AI.method: 提出OneSign统一框架，将孤立手语识别、连续手语识别和手语翻译重新表述为单一训练范式。设计模态自适应混合专家（MA-MoE）架构，包含一个共享专家和针对手语与文本标记的模态特定专家。模态路由器动态激活相应专家，并聚合其输出以形成最终标记表示。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的大量实验表明，OneSign在若干基准上取得了竞争性或最先进的性能，验证了其作为统一手语理解模型的有效性。
AI.conclusion: OneSign能够在一个模型和检查点中统一处理多种手语理解任务，并通过MA-MoE有效建模手语与文本的模态差异，是一种有效的统一手语理解模型。

title: Traceable Human-to-Humanoid Sign Language Benchmarking
summary: Sign data collection is costly, and teleoperation scales poorly, motivating reuse of large video corpora. Humanoid signing requires converting video-derived human motion into robot trajectories while preserving linguistic motion cues. Errors from fitting, human-motion repair, retargeting, robot geometry repair, and control are hard to separate from the final trajectory alone. We introduce HumanoidCSL-20K, a dataset and benchmark of 20,648 sentence-level Chinese Sign Language sequences, each with four aligned versions: the source, the repaired human motion, the direct robot reference, and the geometry-repaired robot reference. Observation-supported local human-motion repair, full-robot geometry repair, and cross-representation provenance make each transformation traceable. Paired evaluations measure human-motion continuity and content preservation, robot-reference feasibility, and physical execution. A sign-specific kinematic-reference protocol scores handshape, location, palm orientation, and inter-hand relation over the full planned motion. Full-corpus results show fewer abnormal arm / hand steps and less inter-hand and hand-body penetration after repair. Control experiments separate reference learnability from curriculum effects, while component scores expose remaining execution errors.

AI.tldr: 提出HumanoidCSL-20K，一个包含20,648条句子级中国手语序列的数据集与基准，每条序列有四个对齐版本，用于将视频衍生人体动作转换为机器人轨迹，并提供可追溯的评估。
AI.motivation: 手语数据采集成本高、遥操作难以扩展，需要复用大规模视频语料。将视频动作转为机器人轨迹时需保留语言学动作线索，但拟合、人体动作修复、重定向、机器人几何修复和控制等误差难以从最终轨迹中分离。
AI.method: 构建HumanoidCSL-20K数据集与基准，包含20,648条句子级中国手语序列，每条有源数据、修复后人体动作、直接机器人参考、几何修复后机器人参考四个对齐版本。采用观察支持的局部人体动作修复、全机器人几何修复和跨表示溯源，使变换可追踪。配对评估衡量人体动作连续性、内容保持、机器人参考可行性和物理执行。提出手语特定运动学参考协议，对全规划动作中的手形、位置、掌心朝向和手间关系评分。
AI.result: 全语料结果显示，修复后异常手臂/手部步态减少，手间和手-身体穿透减少。控制实验将参考可学习性与课程效应分离，组件分数暴露剩余执行误差。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集和基准提供了可追溯的转换流程与评估协议，有助于提升人形机器人手语动作生成的可行性与质量，并定位执行中的剩余问题。

title: Large Language Models for Model-Based Robot Design
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) can contribute useful engineering knowledge to robot design, but directly generated designs may rely on implicit assumptions and provide no guarantees of feasibility or optimality. These assumptions are critical because different reasonable modeling choices can materially change which designs are predicted to be feasible or optimal. We therefore present a framework that uses LLMs to construct explicit engineering models containing physical relationships, compatibility constraints, and objectives, allowing these modeling choices to be inspected and revised before formal optimization. The model can then be updated with additional engineering, manufacturer, or system-specific information before formal multi-objective optimization provides feasibility and Pareto-optimality guarantees with respect to the finalized model and specified design space. We evaluate the framework on quadcopter and line-following robot component-selection problems. Across 30 direct LLM design trials, none could be verified as feasible under the corresponding finalized model. Comparisons with an independently developed expert model and successive stages of model refinement further showed that changes in modeling assumptions substantially altered the predicted feasible and Pareto-optimal design sets. Together, these results show that using LLMs to construct explicit engineering models makes the underlying design choices available for inspection and revision before those assumptions determine the optimized designs. Explicit modeling therefore provides an interface for combining LLM-generated engineering knowledge, system-specific information, and formal design optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种利用大语言模型构建显式工程模型的框架，将物理关系、兼容性约束和目标显式化，再经信息补充与多目标优化，从而在最终模型和设计空间下提供可行性与帕累托最优性保证。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型可为机器人设计提供工程知识，但直接生成的设计可能依赖隐含假设，且无法保证可行性或最优性；不同合理建模选择会显著改变预测的可行或最优设计。
AI.method: 使用LLM构建显式工程模型，包括物理关系、兼容性约束和目标函数；允许在正式优化前检查和修订建模选择，并可加入额外工程、制造商或系统特定信息；随后进行正式多目标优化以获得保证。在四旋翼和循迹机器人组件选择问题上进行评估。
AI.result: 30次直接LLM设计试验中，没有一个设计能在对应最终模型下被验证为可行。与独立开发的专家模型及模型逐步细化阶段比较显示，建模假设变化会实质性改变预测的可行设计和帕累托最优设计集合。
AI.conclusion: 用LLM构建显式工程模型，可使底层设计选择在决定优化设计前被检查和修订；显式建模为结合LLM工程知识、系统特定信息和形式化设计优化提供了接口。

title: When Helpful Text Hurts: Option-Redirecting Bias in Vision-Language Models
comment: Accepted at ACM Multimedia 2026 (ACM MM 2026). 25 pages, 16 figures. This arXiv version includes supplementary material
summary: In tri-modal visual question answering (VQA), auxiliary text is commonly used to complement visual and textual inputs, yet its reliability is often uncontrolled. While prior work studies modality conflicts in general, it remains unclear how different types of unreliable auxiliary text affect answer selection under fixed image-question-option contexts. In this work, we show that the most harmful auxiliary text is not necessarily the most factually incorrect, but the one that aligns with the question while contradicting the image and favoring a specific distractor, leading to systematic redirection of model predictions. To isolate this effect, we introduce the Textual Reliability Ladder, a controlled diagnostic protocol that decomposes auxiliary text along three axes: image consistency, question relevance, and option support. Across multiple datasets (ScienceQA, VCR, A-OKVQA, Causal-VidQA) and recent VLMs, we find that such distractor-supporting text induces the largest accuracy drops (up to 53.1%) and concentrates errors on specific incorrect options. To mitigate this failure mode, we propose a training-free inference-time intervention that explicitly counteracts this redirection effect via noise-stability steering and dynamic grounding, reducing redirected errors while largely preserving performance under faithful text. Our results highlight that auxiliary-text reliability must be understood at the decision level, rather than solely through factual correctness, and provide a practical pathway toward more robust tri-modal reasoning.

AI.tldr: 在三模态VQA中，最有害的辅助文本并非事实错误最多，而是与问题一致、与图像矛盾且支持特定干扰项的文本，会导致模型预测系统性重定向。本文提出Textual Reliability Ladder诊断协议，并设计免训练推理时干预来缓解该问题。
AI.motivation: 辅助文本常用于补充视觉和文本输入，但其可靠性往往不受控。先前工作研究了一般模态冲突，但在固定图像-问题-选项情境下，不同类型的不可靠辅助文本如何影响答案选择尚不清楚。
AI.method: 引入Textual Reliability Ladder，沿三个轴分解辅助文本：图像一致性、问题相关性、选项支持。在ScienceQA、VCR、A-OKVQA、Causal-VidQA等数据集和近期VLMs上评估。提出免训练推理时干预，通过噪声稳定性引导和动态接地来抵消重定向效应。
AI.result: 支持干扰项的文本导致最大准确率下降（高达53.1%），并将错误集中在特定错误选项上。所提干预减少了重定向错误，同时在忠实文本下基本保持性能。
AI.conclusion: 辅助文本可靠性必须在决策层面理解，而不仅仅通过事实正确性。研究提供了实现更鲁棒三模态推理的实用途径。

title: KeyRec: Bounded Visual Memory for Streaming and Long-Video Understanding
summary: Vision-language models are increasingly used to understand long videos and continuous streams. However, dense visual tokens accumulate with video duration, making long-context inference prohibitively expensive. Existing training-free visual-token selection methods reduce this cost by retaining informative tokens, but may lose coherent event evidence and fail to distinguish detailed recent observations from long-range history. We propose \textbf{KeyRec}, a training-free framework for constructing bounded visual memory. During query-agnostic writing, KeyRec preserves fine-grained recent observations in a visual cache and organizes historical evidence into a structured event bank. Candidate events are proposed according to their novelty relative to previously stored events and maintained through an online add--merge--evict update. When a question arrives, a text-only router adaptively allocates a fixed readout budget between recent and event memory, without reprocessing historical frames. KeyRec operates on model-facing visual embeddings and supports both modular encoder--projector VLMs and the encoder- and projector-free NEO-ov architecture. Across four streaming and long-video benchmarks and three VLM backbones, KeyRec achieves the best compressed performance in 13 of 15 settings using only 10\% of the dense decoder-facing visual-token budget. It outperforms the strongest compressed baseline by 2.21--18.37 points on real-time questions, achieves the best compressed result in five of six long-video settings, and performs best in every NEO-ov 2B setting.

AI.tldr: 提出 KeyRec，一种无需训练的有界视觉记忆框架，通过视觉缓存与结构化事件库压缩长视频中的视觉 token，并用文本路由器自适应分配读取预算，从而降低长上下文推理成本。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型处理长视频和连续流时，密集视觉 token 随视频时长累积，导致长上下文推理成本过高；现有免训练 token 选择方法虽能降本，但可能丢失连贯事件证据，且难以区分近期细节与长期历史。
AI.method: KeyRec 在查询无关写入阶段，将近期细粒度观察保留在视觉缓存中，并将历史证据组织为结构化事件库；依据相对于已存事件的新颖性提出候选事件，并通过在线添加-合并-淘汰更新。查询到来时，仅用文本路由器在近期记忆和事件记忆之间自适应分配固定读取预算，无需重新处理历史帧。方法作用于面向模型的视觉嵌入，支持模块化 encoder-projector VLM 以及无 encoder 和 projector 的 NEO-ov 架构。
AI.result: 在四个流式与长视频基准、三个 VLM 主干上，KeyRec 仅在 10% 的密集解码器侧视觉 token 预算下，于 15 个设置中的 13 个取得最佳压缩性能；在实时问题上比最强压缩基线高 2.21 至 18.37 分，在六个长视频设置中的五个取得最佳压缩结果，并在所有 NEO-ov 2B 设置中表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: KeyRec 能有效构建有界视觉记忆，在显著压缩视觉 token 的同时保持甚至提升长视频与流式理解性能，且适用于多种 VLM 架构，尤其是 NEO-ov。

title: RepoMAS: Solving Progressively Specified Tasks with Issue-Driven Multi-Agent Systems
summary:
LLM-based multi-agent systems (MASs) have shown strong potential for solving complex tasks, but most assume that task requirements are sufficiently specified before execution. In practice, user requests are often incomplete, and additional requirements may only become clear during reasoning, tool use, or execution. We refer to such problems as progressively specified tasks.
  To systematically study this setting, we introduce ProgSpec, a benchmark that evaluates final outputs against requirements explicitly stated in the initial request and additional requirements supported by the available task evidence. We further propose RepoMAS, an issue-driven multi-agent framework inspired by open-source project management. RepoMAS records newly discovered requirements, conflicts, and failures as structured Issues and uses them to revise the task specification and execution structure during problem solving.
  Across ProgSpec and five existing benchmarks, RepoMAS achieves the best performance. Further analyses show that its issue-driven revision and repository maintenance mechanisms consistently contribute to performance. These results highlight the importance of allowing MASs to revise not only how a task is solved, but also revise their explicit representation of task requirements during execution.

AI.tldr: 论文研究“渐进式指定任务”，即用户初始需求不完整、后续在执行中才明确的任务，并提出基准 ProgSpec 与多智能体框架 RepoMAS。RepoMAS 以开源项目管理为灵感，将新需求、冲突和失败记录为结构化 Issue，并据此动态修订任务规范与执行结构。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的多智能体系统通常假设任务需求在执行前已被充分指定，但现实中用户请求往往不完整，额外需求可能在推理、工具使用或执行过程中才逐渐显现。
AI.method: 提出 ProgSpec 基准，用初始请求中明确的需求以及任务证据支持的额外需求来评估最终输出；提出 RepoMAS 框架，将新发现的需求、冲突和失败记录为结构化 Issue，并利用这些 Issue 在问题求解过程中修订任务规范和执行结构。
AI.result: 在 ProgSpec 及五个现有基准上，RepoMAS 均取得最佳性能；进一步分析表明，其基于 Issue 的修订机制和仓库维护机制持续带来性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体系统不仅需要修订“如何解决任务”，还应在执行过程中修订其对任务需求的显式表示，这对处理渐进式指定任务十分重要。

title: Classifying Dominant Temporal Orientation without Pretrained Text Embeddings: A Novel Morphosyntactic Inventory Vector Approach
summary: Computational methods have consistently struggled to determine the dominant temporal orientation of a sentence. This difficulty is especially pronounced when a sentence contains multiple embedded clauses with competing tense and aspectual information. To address this difficulty, we propose an alternative approach for identifying a sentence's past, present, or future global reference interval. Our method does not use any form of pretrained embeddings. We rather encode sentences using fixed-length inventory vectors that are comprised of part-of-speech counts, dependency relation counts, and explicit futurate pattern counts. We term this inventory vector of a sentence a "Morphosyntacton". The method does not use any padding, sequence models, or large language models. Evaluation on 1,799 syntactically complex English sentences, annotated as past, present or future, shows balanced and high accuracy multiclass classification, achieving an overall multi-class accuracy of 92%.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种无需预训练嵌入、序列模型或大语言模型的方法，通过统计句子的词性、依存关系和将来时模式构建固定长度向量，用于判断句子的过去、现在或未来全局时间指向。
AI.motivation: 现有计算方法难以确定句子的主导时间指向，尤其当句子包含多个嵌入从句且时态和体信息相互竞争时，这一困难更加明显。
AI.method: 提出使用固定长度的“Morphosyntacton”库存向量表示句子，向量由词性计数、依存关系计数和显式将来时模式计数组成；不采用预训练嵌入、填充、序列模型或大语言模型。
AI.result: 在1,799个句法复杂的英语句子上进行过去、现在、未来三分类评估，取得平衡且较高的多分类准确率，总体多分类准确率达到92%。
AI.conclusion: 基于Morphosyntacton的轻量级方法能够有效识别句子的全局时间指向，并在复杂英语句子上实现高准确率，无需依赖预训练嵌入或大型神经模型。

title: MedRouter: Demystifying Knowledge Differences Across Medical LLMs for Routing-Based Reasoning
summary: Medical question answering spans diverse specialties and modalities, and individual medical large language models (LLMs) exhibit distinct strengths across tasks and domains. This heterogeneity suggests that combining specialists may enable broader coverage of medical questions than relying on any single model. However, existing LLM routing methods primarily seek to balance answer quality and inference cost, leaving open how to exploit differences in specialist competence to improve medical reasoning. In this paper, we introduce MedRouter, an agentic system that uses an embedding-based multi-label router to select and query specialist LLMs, then passes their responses to a generator to produce the final answer. We further propose SCALE (Specialist Competence-Aware Learning), a two-stage training framework that first trains the Router with specialist correctness supervision and then optimizes its selections through reinforcement learning. The second stage uses a Performance Gain Reward (PGR) that measures how specialist information affects the generator's answer correctness relative to answering without that information. Experiments on eight text-based and multimodal medical QA benchmarks show that MedRouter outperforms the strongest routing baseline by 8% in average accuracy. Our analysis of specialist outputs further reveals distinct strengths and complementary question-level coverage, motivating learned routing to combine these capabilities for more comprehensive medical reasoning.

AI.tldr: MedRouter 是一个 agentic 医疗问答系统，使用基于嵌入的多标签路由器选择专科 LLM，并由生成器整合答案；其 SCALE 两阶段训练框架在八个医疗 QA 基准上平均准确率超过最强路由基线 8%。
AI.motivation: 医疗问答涉及多专科和多模态，单个医疗 LLM 在不同任务和领域上各有强弱；现有 LLM 路由方法主要平衡答案质量与推理成本，未充分利用专科模型的互补能力来提升医疗推理。
AI.method: 提出 MedRouter：用 embedding-based 多标签路由器选择并查询专科 LLM，再将其响应交给生成器产生最终答案。提出 SCALE 两阶段训练：第一阶段用专家正确性监督训练 Router，第二阶段用强化学习优化选择，奖励为 Performance Gain Reward，衡量专家信息相对无专家信息时对生成器答案正确性的提升。
AI.result: 在八个文本和多模态医疗 QA 基准上，MedRouter 平均准确率比最强路由基线高 8%；对专科模型输出的分析显示其具有不同优势和问题级互补覆盖。
AI.conclusion: 学习式路由能够组合专科模型的互补能力，实现更全面的医疗推理，说明利用专科模型差异可有效提升医疗问答表现。

title: VIDEAS: Distilling Explicit Action Semantics from Demonstration Videos for World Models via Prior-Guided Simulation
summary: World models learn internal representations of environment dynamics to predict future states, enabling agents to optimize action plans without physical interactions. However, developing world models that genuinely internalize underlying causal physical laws to explicitly reason about action preconditions and subsequent state transitions remains an open challenge. In this paper, we propose VIDEAS, a data distillation framework that transforms continuous physical dynamics from operational videos into explicit action semantics for foundation models. Specifically, it deconstructs visual demonstrations into discrete action trajectories and utilizes advanced vision-language models (VLMs) to extract structured knowledge encapsulating action preconditions and effects. To ensure physical consistency, we introduce a prior-guided trajectory simulation mechanism grounded within a text-based environment to rigorously validate the extracted knowledge. Notably, we incorporate negative trajectories to enrich knowledge completeness and enhance data diversity to mitigate cognitive bias. Furthermore, we present VIDEAS-WM, an 8B/9B-parameter suite of language-based world models trained on 34K high-quality samples derived from AgiBot-World dataset. Extensive experiments demonstrate that VIDEAS-WM establishes state-of-the-art performance in high-level embodied action semantic reasoning, exhibiting profound physical understanding and robust generalization across unseen scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出VIDEAS数据蒸馏框架，将视频中的连续物理动态转化为显式动作语义，并训练出8B/9B参数的语言世界模型VIDEAS-WM，在高层具身动作语义推理上达到SOTA。
AI.motivation: 现有世界模型虽能预测未来状态，但难以真正内化因果物理规律，无法显式推理动作前提与后续状态转移。
AI.method: VIDEAS将视觉演示解构为离散动作轨迹，利用VLM提取包含动作前提和效果的结构化知识；引入基于文本环境的先验引导轨迹模拟机制验证物理一致性；加入负轨迹增强知识完整性与数据多样性；基于AgiBot-World数据集构建34K高质量样本，训练8B/9B参数的语言世界模型VIDEAS-WM。
AI.result: VIDEAS-WM在高层具身动作语义推理上取得SOTA性能，展现出深刻的物理理解和在未见场景中的强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，通过数据蒸馏将视频物理动态转化为显式动作语义，可有效训练出具备因果物理理解与泛化能力的世界模型。

title: Beyond Prompt or Skill? Attribution-Guided Optimization of Modular LLM Programs
summary: Large language models can solve increasingly diverse reasoning tasks, yet their performance remains highly sensitive to task prompts, intermediate instructions, and the way reusable problem-solving knowledge is incorporated. Existing optimization methods usually focus on only one part of this design space: they either optimize a monolithic prompt, or separately induce and refine skills from model traces. As a result, they lack a principled mechanism for deciding which component should be updated when failures occur, and they rarely optimize prompts, skills, and skill-use policies in a unified framework. We propose SPARO (Skill, Prompt, And Routing Optimization), a framework that jointly optimizes task instructions, reusable skill blocks, and routing rules. It performs controlled counterfactual evaluations, converts examples' effects into a probabilistic responsibility distribution over prompt, skill, and routing components, samples one component from that distribution, and applies the corresponding targeted mutation. This design moves language-program optimization beyond global prompt rewriting toward structured, reusable, and selectively activated task knowledge. Across five benchmarks and five worker models, SPARO consistently outperforms both prompt-centered and skill-centered optimization baselines. These results suggest that effective language-program optimization depends not only on discovering useful task knowledge, but also on deciding where that knowledge should be stored and when it should be activated.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SPARO 框架，联合优化任务指令、可复用技能块和路由规则，通过反事实评估与责任分配来决定更新哪个组件，在多个基准和模型上优于仅优化提示或仅优化技能的基线。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型推理优化方法通常只关注设计空间的一部分：要么优化单一整体提示，要么从模型轨迹中单独归纳和精炼技能，缺乏在失败时决定应更新提示、技能还是路由策略的统一机制。
AI.method: SPARO 进行受控反事实评估，将样本效果转化为提示、技能和路由组件上的概率责任分布，并从该分布中采样一个组件，执行针对性的变异更新，从而联合优化任务指令、可复用技能块和技能使用路由规则。
AI.result: 在五个基准和五个 worker 模型上，SPARO 持续优于以提示为中心和以技能为中心的优化基线。
AI.conclusion: 有效的语言程序优化不仅依赖于发现有用的任务知识，还取决于决定这些知识应存储在何处以及何时被激活。

title: Contamination, Prior, or Evidence? Decomposing and Training Evidence Use in Whole-Slide Vision-Language Models
summary: Pathology vision-language models (VLMs) are conventionally evaluated by accuracy, but accuracy alone does not measure evidence use: it may conflate dataset contamination, prior knowledge, and image evidence. In a motivating study of lymph-node metastasis prediction, we found that most public pathology VLMs showed minimal differences when changing from feeding the models with whole-slide images, an annotated lesion, or no image at all. To better understand the specific features leveraged by these models, this paper presents two contributions aimed at disentangling these factors. First, we present CleanSlide, a TCGA-based VQA benchmark designed to eliminate image- and question-side contamination. It contains 149K audited multiple-choice questions over 9,985 slides, with patient- and tissue-source-disjoint splits. Every question is audited for option shortcuts, stem leakage, cross-split duplication, and blind solvability. Second, we propose Pair-DPO, a preference loss over counterfactual slide pairs from the same question and source. By controlling for shared confounding factors, Pair-DPO cancels out the question-attributable signal and leaves image evidence as the source of preference. Specifically, each pair consists of two real slides with opposite, verified findings, introducing neither editing artifacts nor unverified labels for diffuse or graded features such as invasion, necrosis, and tumor grade. Experiments show that our method gains 15.29% from image evidence on the CleanSlide, compared with 2.81% for the best published model. On the external CPTAC and BCNB cohorts, our method achieves accuracies of 57.6% and 59.0%, outperforming all other evaluated models by 9.7% and 3.4%, respectively. We will release the benchmark and code.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CleanSlide 病理视觉问答基准与 Pair-DPO 偏好优化方法，用于区分病理视觉语言模型依赖图像证据还是数据污染/先验知识，并显著提升模型对图像证据的利用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有病理视觉语言模型多以准确率评价，但准确率无法说明模型是否真正使用图像证据，可能混入数据污染、先验知识和图像证据。研究发现，许多公开模型在输入全切片图像、标注病灶或无图像时表现差异很小。
AI.method: 提出 CleanSlide，一个基于 TCGA 的 VQA 基准，包含 149K 经审核的多选题、9,985 张切片，并采用患者和组织来源不重叠的划分，审核选项捷径、题干泄漏、跨划分重复和盲猜可解性。同时提出 Pair-DPO，对同一问题和来源的反事实切片对进行偏好损失优化，使偏好信号来自图像证据而非问题相关混杂因素。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在 CleanSlide 上从图像证据中获得 15.29% 提升，而最佳已发表模型仅为 2.81%。在外部 CPTAC 和 BCNB 队列上分别达到 57.6% 和 59.0% 准确率，分别超过其他评估模型 9.7% 和 3.4%。
AI.conclusion: CleanSlide 和 Pair-DPO 能更有效地分离数据污染、先验知识与图像证据，促使病理视觉语言模型真正利用图像信息，并在外部数据集上取得更优性能。基准和代码将公开。

title: Knowing Is Not Choosing: What Explicit Verification Adds Beyond Generative Preference
summary: Generating a correct answer does not mean that a language model will select it. We separate factual recall into three steps: generating a correct candidate, ranking the available candidates, and selecting the final answer. Pre-generation readouts predict factual recall and which questions sampling will cover across three model families, but say little about whether an available correct answer will ultimately be selected. Explicit verification with $P(\mathrm{True})$ improves within-question ranking over mean log-likelihood in Gemma, Qwen3, and Llama, with AUROC gains of $0.08$--$0.12$. In a prospectively defined Gemma cohort, verification raises plurality accuracy by about $5$ points, and still gains about $2$ points over chat-template likelihood, a stronger generative baseline. The advantage is strongest for relations with common-answer priors and depends on access to the entity; masking the entity removes the ranking advantage in larger Qwen models. Finally, the measured benefit depends on how correctness is defined: recall-oriented reference matching can credit option lists favored by likelihood and substantially understate the improvement seen under human semantic judgments.

AI.tldr: 该论文将事实回忆拆解为生成正确候选、候选排序和最终选择三步，发现生成正确不等于会选择正确；显式验证P(True)能显著改善候选排序和最终准确率。
AI.motivation: 语言模型即使能生成正确答案，也未必会在最终输出中选择它，因此需要区分事实回忆中的生成、排序与选择环节，并研究如何提升正确答案被选中的概率。
AI.method: 将事实回忆分为生成正确候选、对可用候选排序、选择最终答案三步；使用预生成读出预测事实回忆和采样覆盖；比较P(True)显式验证与平均对数似然等生成式基线；在Gemma、Qwen3、Llama等模型家族上评估AUROC、plurality accuracy，并通过实体掩码和不同正确性定义进行分析。
AI.result: P(True)验证在Gemma、Qwen3和Llama中相比平均对数似然提升组内排序，AUROC增益0.08至0.12；在预设Gemma队列中，验证使plurality accuracy提高约5个百分点，并比chat-template likelihood强约2个百分点；优势在常见答案先验的关系上最强，且依赖实体可访问性，掩码实体会消除较大Qwen模型中的排序优势；收益测量还取决于正确性定义，面向回忆的参考匹配可能高估似然偏好的选项列表并低估人类语义判断下的改进。
AI.conclusion: 生成正确答案并不保证模型会选择它；显式验证能改善候选排序和最终选择，但其效果受模型规模、关系类型、实体可访问性以及正确性评价标准影响，因此评估事实回忆时需区分生成、排序和选择，并谨慎定义正确性。

title: Evaluating Single and Multi-Omics Based Explainable Artificial Intelligence (MOXAI) for Molecular Subclass Classification of Adult-Type Diffuse Gliomas
summary: DNA methylation (DNAM) profiling has emerged as a powerful diagnostic tool for classifying brain and solid tumors. However, existing computational models typically analyze methylation and copy number variation (CNV) data separately, failing to capture the complementary information their integration could provide. Moreover, current classification models lack mechanisms for within-class risk assessment analogous to traditional tumor grading, and no established explainability method can attribute classification decisions to specific genomic loci. In this paper, we present MOXAI (Multi-Omics Based Explainable AI), a deep learning framework that integrates DNA methylation and copy number data from methylation arrays to classify molecular subtypes of adult-type diffuse gliomas, alongside single-modality variants for comparison. Using a cohort from The Cancer Genome Atlas (TCGA), we trained ResNet50, DINOv2, and Graph Attention Network (GAT) models on methylation data alone, copy number data alone, and combined multimodal data. We further developed explainable AI (XAI) methods based on class activation maps (CAMs) and gradient-weighted CAM (Grad-CAM) to identify the specific CpG sites, genes, and chromosomal regions most relevant to each classification decision. The multimodal model achieved up to 92.98% cross-validation accuracy, outperforming models trained on CNV data alone. DINOv2 showed the strongest generalization, reaching 94.25% accuracy (confidence >0.9) on independent validation sets. XAI results aligned with established molecular features of adult-type diffuse glioma subtypes, confirming the biological interpretability of the framework.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出MOXAI，一个整合DNA甲基化与拷贝数变异数据的可解释深度学习框架，用于成人型弥漫性胶质瘤分子亚型分类，并实现基于CAM/Grad-CAM的基因组位点归因。
AI.motivation: 现有模型通常分别分析甲基化和CNV数据，未充分利用多组学互补信息；同时缺乏类内风险评估机制，也缺少能将分类决策归因到具体基因组位点的可解释性方法。
AI.method: 使用TCGA队列，分别基于甲基化数据、CNV数据及两者融合数据训练ResNet50、DINOv2和Graph Attention Network模型；并开发基于CAM和Grad-CAM的可解释AI方法，识别与分类决策相关的CpG位点、基因和染色体区域。
AI.result: 多模态模型交叉验证准确率最高达92.98%，优于仅使用CNV的模型；DINOv2泛化能力最强，在独立验证集上准确率达94.25%（置信度>0.9）；XAI结果与已知成人型弥漫性胶质瘤分子特征一致。
AI.conclusion: MOXAI能够有效整合DNA甲基化与CNV数据进行胶质瘤分子亚型分类，并提供生物学可解释的决策依据，证明多组学可解释AI在该任务中的潜力。

title: Presence Is Not Faithfulness: Figurative Vehicle Intrusion in Text-to-Image Generation
summary: Text-to-image (TTI) models increasingly generate high-quality images from natural-language prompts, yet figurative language exposes a failure: a vehicle that should guide the depiction of a tenor may instead be rendered as a visible object. We call this failure Figurative Vehicle Intrusion: the intruding content is textually licensed, but it is assigned the wrong visual role, showing that visual presence is not always faithfulness and that presence-oriented evaluation can miss such errors. To study it systematically, we introduce Vehicle Intrusion and Semantic Tenor Assessment (VISTA), a multilingual benchmark of figurative prompts organized by Figurative Form and Mapping Mechanism. We further propose V-Score, a diagnostic question-answering metric that evaluates role-aware figurative faithfulness in generated images. Evaluations on recent high-performing TTI models show that vehicle intrusion persists across languages and figurative categories. As a lightweight mitigation, we introduce VISTA-Guard, which partially reduces vehicle intrusion and suggests a practical path toward more figuratively faithful TTI generation. All resources will be released publicly.

AI.tldr: 论文研究文生图模型在处理比喻性语言时的“喻体入侵”失败：本应辅助描述本体的喻体被错误渲染为可见物体。为此提出多语言基准 VISTA、诊断指标 V-Score 及轻量缓解方法 VISTA-Guard。
AI.motivation: 文生图模型虽能根据自然语言提示生成高质量图像，但在比喻性语言上存在失败：喻体可能被错误地当作可见物体渲染，而非用于指导本体的描绘。这种内容在文本上被许可，却被赋予了错误的视觉角色，说明视觉存在不等于忠实性，也暴露了以存在性为导向的评估会遗漏此类错误。
AI.method: 提出 Vehicle Intrusion and Semantic Tenor Assessment（VISTA），一个按比喻形式和映射机制组织的多语言比喻提示基准；提出 V-Score，一种诊断性问答指标，用于评估生成图像中角色感知的比喻忠实性；对近期高性能文生图模型进行评估；并引入轻量缓解方法 VISTA-Guard。
AI.result: 评估显示，喻体入侵在多种语言和比喻类别中持续存在；VISTA-Guard 能够部分减少喻体入侵。
AI.conclusion: 喻体入侵是文生图比喻忠实性的系统性问题，VISTA、V-Score 和 VISTA-Guard 为更忠实地生成比喻图像提供了实用路径，所有资源将公开释放。

title: AI-Driven Collaborative Assembly Line Inspection: System Integration and Deployment Challenges
comment: 13 pages, 4 figures, 2 tables. Accepted at the 22nd International Conference on Mobile Web and Intelligent Information Systems (MobiWIS 2026)
summary: Manual visual inspection on assembly lines is a persistent manufacturing bottleneck: operator fatigue over extended shifts lowers defect-detection rates. This paper presents the design, integration, and field deployment of an AI-assisted collaborative inspection cell at the Silverline kitchen-appliance factory, developed within the AI-PRISM project. The cell couples a Universal Robots UR 10e cobot carrying a machine-vision defect-detection pipeline with a Comau Racer-5 cobot for functional tests, coordinated through ROS 2 Humble on an Ubuntu 22.04 LTS server. Multi-modal data (Basler camera imagery, TIA microphone acoustics, and SPS electrical-safety measurements) are logged locally and visualised in real time with Grafana. We report the practical deployment challenges (close-proximity safety, AI robustness under glare and reflections, ROS 2 namespace collisions across two cobots, and operating-system and dependency issues) together with the engineering solutions adopted, and structure the integration through a four-level Human-Robot Interaction analysis. The deployed cell cuts per-unit quality-check time from 82 s to 61 s (about 25%), raises final-control resource efficiency from 0.75 to 0.88, reduces operator visual-inspection viewing time by 82%, and significantly lowers operator mental demand (p = 0.005, NASA-TLX).

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了在Silverline厨房电器工厂部署的AI辅助协作检测单元，通过双协作机器人、机器视觉与多模态数据监控，提升装配线质检效率并降低操作员负担。
AI.motivation: 人工目视质检是制造瓶颈，操作员在长时间轮班后疲劳会降低缺陷检出率，因此需要AI辅助的协作检测方案。
AI.method: 在AI-PRISM项目框架下，集成UR 10e协作机器人（机器视觉缺陷检测）与Comau Racer-5协作机器人（功能测试），基于ROS 2 Humble和Ubuntu 22.04 LTS协调控制；采集Basler相机图像、TIA麦克风声学与SPS电气安全测量等多模态数据，本地记录并用Grafana实时可视化；报告部署挑战与工程解决方案，并采用四级人机交互分析。
AI.result: 部署后单件质检时间从82秒降至61秒（约25%），最终控制资源效率从0.75提升至0.88，操作员目视检测时间减少82%，NASA-TLX心理需求显著降低（p = 0.005）。
AI.conclusion: 该AI辅助协作检测单元可在真实工厂中落地，有效缩短质检时间、提高资源效率并改善操作员体验，同时为近距离安全、AI鲁棒性、ROS 2命名冲突及系统依赖等部署问题提供了工程经验。

title: AMBIT: Anticipatory Multimodal Body Recruitment for Bimanual Tracking on a Humanoid
summary: A humanoid with 5-DoF arms cannot track generic bimanual end-effector trajectories with its arms alone; pelvis and waist motion must be recruited, but which motion, and when, is not uniquely determined. On a Unitree R1 in fixed double support, the set of dynamically valid recruitment strategies (pelvis pose and waist trajectories) for a task is a diverse continuous manifold, and a deterministic regressor trained on it mode-averages into strategies valid only 35% of the time, against 52% for a conditional variational autoencoder (CVAE) and 82% for the best of 16 CVAE samples. We introduce AMBIT: the CVAE proposes strategies from a preview of the commanded trajectory, a non-learned selector filters, ranks and verifies them, and a receding-horizon loop commits to one with hysteresis. The committed strategy is the reference of the same whole-body differential-IK QP a reactive tracker runs, which keeps authority over residual error. On 160 held-out episodes that admit a valid strategy, in full MuJoCo dynamics under a torque controller, AMBIT reaches 85% success at a 3 cm/15 deg tolerance against 74% for the tracker (disjoint confidence intervals) and recruits the body before the arms saturate in 48% of episodes against 35%. Because diversity is preserved, constraints unknown at training time are enforced by selection alone: under five zero-shot shifts AMBIT beats the warm-started tracker on every shift and matches a test-time re-optimisation baseline 17x more expensive. On a Unitree G1, with hyperparameters unchanged, the protocol reproduces the structure of the valid set and widens the gap over the tracker to 0.85 against 0.53. Five selected strategies execute on the externally supported physical R1, distinct in pelvis excursion and tracking the planned end-effector motion to a median of 11 mm by encoder forward kinematics, which establishes kinematic realisability, not balance.

AI.tldr: 提出AMBIT：用CVAE生成多样全身招募策略，经非学习选择器筛选验证，并在滚动时域中带滞回提交，作为全身微分IK QP参考。该方法在Unitree R1/G1上提升双机械臂轨迹跟踪成功率。
AI.motivation: 5-DoF手臂无法单独跟踪任意双臂末端轨迹，必须调用骨盆和腰部运动，但如何调用并不唯一。确定性回归会模式平均，导致动态有效策略成功率很低。
AI.method: CVAE根据指令轨迹预览提出骨盆/腰部策略；非学习选择器过滤、排序并验证候选；滚动时域循环以滞回方式提交策略；该策略作为全身微分IK QP的参考，反应式跟踪器保留残差控制权。评估使用MuJoCo力矩控制、零样本约束变化，并在物理R1上验证。
AI.result: 在160个有效episode中，AMBIT达到85%成功率，跟踪器为74%；48%的episode中身体早于手臂饱和被调用，跟踪器为35%。五种零样本变化下均优于warm-started跟踪器，并匹配贵17倍的测试时重优化基线。Unitree G1上超参数不变，成功率0.85对0.53。物理R1上五个策略中位跟踪误差11 mm，验证运动学可实现性。
AI.conclusion: 保持策略多样性使训练时未知约束可通过选择执行；全身协调招募对5-DoF人形双臂跟踪有效且可迁移。物理实验仅证明运动学可实现性，尚未证明平衡能力。

title: CAME: Company-Aware Evidence-Memory Experts for Interpretable Quarter-Ahead Revenue Forecasting
summary: Quarter-ahead revenue forecasting requires company-scale numerical accuracy, strict temporal validity, and company-specific interpretation of narrative disclosures. LLMs can distill textual evidence but can produce scale-misaligned forecasts, whereas history-based anchors are stable but miss forecast-time signals such as product transitions, supply constraints, and management guidance. We introduce CAME (Company-Aware Evidence-Memory Experts), a residual-forecasting framework that refines a no-leakage statistical anchor when current semantic evidence and prior error patterns justify an adjustment. On a development-inclusive rolling backtest of 336 company-quarters from 12 large public technology and platform firms, CAME achieves the lowest aggregate point-estimate error among the reported methods, with statistically supported macro-sMAPE gains over the matched Statistical Anchor, and outperforms History + Guidance on all six aggregate metrics. CAME also links adjustments to source-linked evidence cards and guarded memory traces, supporting forecast inspection, provenance, and failure localization.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CAME（Company-Aware Evidence-Memory Experts），一个面向季度收入预测的残差预测框架，在无泄漏统计锚点基础上，仅在语义证据和过往误差模式支持时进行调整，从而提升预测准确性并增强可解释性。
AI.motivation: 季度收入预测需要公司级数值精度、严格时间有效性以及对公司叙事披露的个性化理解。LLM 可提取文本证据但易出现尺度错位预测；历史锚点稳定但会忽略产品切换、供应约束和管理层指引等预测时信号。
AI.method: CAME 采用残差预测框架：以无泄漏统计锚点为基础，结合当前语义证据与历史误差模式判断是否调整预测；并链接来源可追溯的 evidence cards 与受约束的 memory traces，以支持预测审查、溯源和失败定位。
AI.result: 在 12 家大型上市科技与平台公司、336 个公司季度的开发包含滚动回测中，CAME 在报告方法中取得最低的总体点估计误差；相对匹配的 Statistical Anchor 有统计支持的 macro-sMAPE 提升，并在全部六项汇总指标上优于 History + Guidance。
AI.conclusion: CAME 能有效结合稳定统计锚点与证据驱动的动态调整，在提升季度收入预测精度的同时提供可检查、可溯源和可定位失败的解释能力。

title: TreeRef-BFN: Equivariance-Free De Novo Molecule Generation based on 2D Topology and Internal 3D Geometry
summary: De novo 3D molecular generation jointly models molecular size, topology, and geometry. Most methods pre-sample molecular size and generate Cartesian coordinates, limiting variable-size conditional tasks such as fragment completion and scaffold decoration while often relying on equivariant architectures. Internal-coordinate methods avoid rigid-body redundancy but typically require a known molecular graph or autoregressive construction, which may accumulate errors.
