AI.tldr: 提出FoundDSR，一种基于RGB-D对的可泛化基础模型，用于跨未见数据分布的鲁棒深度重建，通过引导式2D高斯泼溅和异构联邦学习实现高分辨率深度重建与稳定的大规模训练。
AI.motivation: 现有深度重建方法在未知场景、不同尺度及噪声条件下泛化能力不足；同时大规模异构数据存在分布差异，导致训练不稳定和偏向主导数据源。
AI.method: 采用引导式2D高斯泼溅策略，以高分辨率RGB为提示优化高斯参数，使高斯基元沿高频结构方向各向异性变形，再通过深度重建分支映射为高分辨率深度；引入异构联邦学习，将每个数据源作为独立客户端进行本地优化和全局聚合。
AI.result: 在合成、真实、任意尺度及噪声条件下的广泛零样本评估中，FoundDSR持续超越现有最先进方法，表现出强鲁棒性和对未知场景的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: FoundDSR能有效应对未知数据分布，实现鲁棒且高分辨率的深度重建，并具备稳定扩展至多样大规模训练数据的能力。

title: Calibration, Not Answer Selection: Distilling Internal Confidence in Reasoning Models
summary: Reinforcement learning with binary correctness rewards trains correctness, not calibrated confidence. The confidence that reasoning models verbalize is systematically overconfident, and the problem is not merely one of scale: verbalized confidence tracks how willing a model is to commit to an answer, not how likely the answer is to be right. Post-hoc rescaling therefore fits one distribution but rarely transfers. We look inside the model instead. On factual question answering, a linear probe on the hidden state between the chain of thought and the answer is substantially better calibrated: its expected calibration error is 5 to 38 times lower than that of the verbalized score across four benchmarks and two model families. However, when used to pick among N sampled answers, that same probe nearly ties majority voting yet falls far short of the oracle. Internal states answer "how certain am I" well and "which answer is right" poorly, so the signal should be reported as a confidence rather than used to select answers. As a result, we introduce probe-guided self-distillation (Probe-SD): score a model's own sampled traces with the probe, overwrite the confidence each trace states, and finetune the base checkpoint of the same family, so nothing but the model itself remains at test time. On Qwen3-14B, Probe-SD cuts ECE from 0.178 to 0.024 in-domain and from 0.542 to 0.113 out-of-domain, where it also beats post-hoc recalibration and self-consistency distillation. The resulting confidence is well-calibrated and useful for weighted voting, behaviors previously attributed to online RL, here obtained with supervised finetuning alone.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究推理模型的置信度校准问题，发现内部隐藏状态探针比模型口头表达的置信度更校准，并提出探针引导自蒸馏（Probe-SD），仅用监督微调即可获得良好校准且可用于加权投票的置信度。
AI.motivation: 基于二元正确性奖励的强化学习只训练正确性，不训练校准置信度；模型口头置信度系统性过度自信，且后处理缩放难以迁移，因此需要从模型内部寻找更可靠的置信信号。
AI.method: 在思维链与答案之间的隐藏状态上训练线性探针来估计置信度；进一步提出 Probe-SD：用探针给模型自身采样轨迹打分，覆盖轨迹中原有的口头置信度，并微调同族基础模型，使测试时只需模型本身。
AI.result: 在事实问答上，线性探针的ECE比口头置信度低5至38倍；但用于N个采样答案选择时仅接近多数投票，远不如oracle。在Qwen3-14B上，Probe-SD将域内ECE从0.178降至0.024，域外从0.542降至0.113，并优于后处理重校准和自一致性蒸馏。
AI.conclusion: 内部状态擅长回答“我有多确定”，但不擅长回答“哪个答案正确”，因此应作为置信度报告而非直接用于答案选择；Probe-SD表明仅靠监督微调即可获得此前被认为需要在线强化学习才能实现的良好校准置信度和加权投票行为。

title: Interpretable Physics Informed WiFi Indoor Localization: Learning an Effective Access Point Geometry and Using It to Prune
summary:
Deep learning models can achieve high accuracy for indoor localization, but their black-box nature limits interpretability and the reuse of learned information. We propose a hierarchical deep learning framework for WiFi fingerprint-based indoor localization that jointly predicts user location and learns an effective geometry of the surrounding access points (APs). Physics-informed decoders infer this geometry directly from RSSI measurements and labelled user positions, without requiring the true AP coordinates during training. The learned geometry is then used to rank and prune APs.
  On the UJIIndoorLoc dataset, the proposed chained model achieves a mean 3D localization error of 7.07 m, reducing error by 26% to 36% compared with baseline models. Previously published methods evaluated on the same official split report errors 10.6% to 31.0% higher. Pruning 35% or 50% of the APs causes only a small loss in localization accuracy. The inferred geometry also enables Fisher-information-based AP ranking even when fingerprint databases do not contain surveyed AP coordinates. Experiments on the Tampere/TUT and UTSIndoorLoc datasets show that geometry-guided AP selection performs comparably to selectors built directly from labelled data. These results show that physics-informed interpretability can improve indoor localization while also supporting effective feature selection.

AI.tldr: 提出一种分层深度学习框架，用于WiFi指纹室内定位，在联合预测用户位置的同时学习接入点（AP）的几何关系。该方法利用物理信息解码器从RSSI和标注位置中推断AP几何，并据此进行AP排序与剪枝。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习室内定位精度高，但黑盒特性限制了可解释性以及所学信息的复用。研究希望借助物理信息提升可解释性，并利用推断出的AP几何关系支持有效的特征选择。
AI.method: 采用分层深度学习框架，联合预测用户位置并学习周边AP的有效几何结构。通过物理信息解码器，仅使用RSSI测量和带标签的用户位置推断AP几何，训练时无需真实AP坐标。学习到的几何结构用于对AP进行排序和剪枝；同时支持基于Fisher信息的AP排序。
AI.result: 在UJIIndoorLoc数据集上，所提链式模型平均3D定位误差为7.07 m，相比基线模型降低26%至36%；同官方划分下，先前方法误差高10.6%至31.0%。剪枝35%或50%的AP仅造成定位精度的小幅下降。在Tampere/TUT和UTSIndoorLoc数据集上，几何引导的AP选择与直接基于标注数据构建的选择器性能相当。
AI.conclusion: 物理信息可解释性既能提升室内定位性能，也能支持有效的特征选择；即使指纹数据库缺少实测AP坐标，也能实现基于几何的AP排序与剪枝。

title: BaatCheet: A Multilingual Corpus for Dialogue Translation in Indian Languages
summary: Existing translation models are typically trained on sentence-level and formal text, limiting their ability to capture everyday conversational dialogue phenomena such as informality, speaker interaction, and discourse coherence. Most existing Indic translation resources and evaluation benchmarks focus on sentence-level or formal text, making it difficult to assess translation quality of the dialogue phenomena. In this work, we introduce BaatCheet, a multilingual dialogue corpus named after the Hindi term for conversation or chitchat, containing approximately 49,000 dialogues for dialogue translation across five translation directions. We fine-tune five open-source LLMs across seven training data configurations and find that fine-tuning yields substantial gains over zero- and few-shot baselines. To comprehensively evaluate dialogue translation quality, we employ multiple evaluation strategies, including automatic metrics, LLM-as-judge, and human assessments using an SQM-guided Direct Assessment (DA) Protocol.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了BaatCheet，一个面向对话翻译的多语言对话语料库，包含约49,000个对话和五个翻译方向，并基于该语料对五个开源LLM进行微调与多策略评估。
AI.motivation: 现有翻译模型多基于句子级和正式文本训练，难以处理日常对话中的非正式性、说话人互动和语篇连贯等现象；同时，现有印度语言翻译资源和评测基准也多聚焦句子级或正式文本，难以评估对话翻译质量。
AI.method: 构建BaatCheet多语言对话语料库；在七种训练数据配置下微调五个开源LLM；采用自动指标、LLM-as-judge以及基于SQM引导的直接评估（DA）协议进行人工评估。
AI.result: 微调相比零样本和少样本基线取得了显著提升，并通过多种评估策略对对话翻译质量进行了较全面的评价。
AI.conclusion: BaatCheet有助于推动对话翻译研究与评测，表明基于对话语料微调LLM能有效提升对话翻译性能。

title: Progressive-View On-Policy Distillation for Regional-to-Global Transfer in Multimodal LLMs
summary: Regional-to-global distillation uses crop-conditioned guidance to improve full-image understanding. The challenge is to effectively transfer the teacher's crop-based advantage to the student's full-image inference. We propose progressive-view on-policy distillation (PVD), which shifts the student's view distribution from the crop toward the full image through an intermediate aspect-preserving padded crop. The padded crop preserves regional content while matching the full image's visual-token grid. Across stages, the view mixture assigns increasing probability to the full image. A lightweight regional-advantage weighting reallocates token-level supervision using the crop-conditioned teacher-student log-probability gap. Evaluated under each sampled input, it applies mild reweighting when the gap is small and emphasizes higher-gap tokens when the gap widens. A Jensen-Shannon metric decomposition interprets this schedule as a shift from matched-input imitation toward the deployment objective. Across benchmarks spanning perception, visual mathematics and general multimodal question answering, PVD-full reaches an average accuracy of 77.51 over three seeds, improving on the reward-free distillation baseline by 2.01 points and on its reward-matched variant by 1.00 point. In the reward-free setting, PVD-distill still gains 1.16 points.

AI.tldr: 提出渐进视图在策略蒸馏（PVD），通过从裁剪到全图的渐进视图分布和区域优势加权，将教师基于裁剪的优势迁移到学生全图推理，在多个多模态基准上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 区域到全局蒸馏中，关键挑战是如何有效把教师模型在裁剪视图上的优势，迁移到学生模型的全图推理中。
AI.method: PVD 将学生视图分布从裁剪逐步转向全图，中间使用保持宽高比的填充裁剪，以保留区域内容并匹配全图视觉 token 网格；各阶段提高全图采样概率。同时采用轻量区域优势加权，根据裁剪条件下教师与学生的对数概率差重新分配 token 级监督，差距小时温和加权，差距大时强调高差距 token。并用 Jensen-Shannon 度量分解解释该课程从匹配输入模仿转向部署目标。
AI.result: 在感知、视觉数学和通用多模态问答等基准上，PVD-full 在三个随机种子上平均准确率为 77.51，比无奖励蒸馏基线高 2.01 分，比奖励匹配变体高 1.00 分；在无奖励设置下，PVD-distill 仍提升 1.16 分。
AI.conclusion: PVD 通过渐进视图蒸馏和区域优势加权，有效缩小裁剪教师与全图学生推理之间的差距，并一致提升多模态理解任务表现。

title: Porimon: An LLM-Based Pokémon Battle Agent Enhanced by Long/Short-Term Knowledge Augmented Generation
summary: In this paper, we use Pokémon Battles as a case study to investigate how to improve the performance of LLM-based agents in tasks that require opponent-aware planning without additional fine-tuning. We propose Long/Short-Term Knowledge Augmented Generation (LSTKAG), a mechanism that enables LLM-based agents to leverage past states of the current task and retrieve experience summaries from similar previous task instances based on the current state. Based on LSTKAG, we design Porimon, an LLM-based agent structure for Pokémon Battles. For optimization, we introduce an external API for precise damage calculation and more detailed information about the game. We conduct tournament-like evaluation experiments comprising 15,000 battles for hyperparameter optimization, ablation studies, and performance evaluation. The results indicate that Porimon-based players with hyperparameter optimization significantly outperform players based on PokéLLMon, an LLM-based agent structure proposed in previous research, and the rule-based heuristic player. Furthermore, our ablation study shows that Porimon variants outperform the one without extension in game information retrieval, which shows the contribution of that extension. However, the current experiment results are inconclusive regarding the contribution of Long-Term KAG. These results suggest that introducing external resources, information from previous states of the current task, and experience summaries from similar previous task instances could elevate the performance of LLM-based agents designed for tasks requiring opponent-aware planning.

AI.tldr: 本文以宝可梦对战为案例，提出LSTKAG机制与Porimon智能体结构，使LLM智能体无需微调即可利用当前任务历史状态和相似任务经验摘要，并结合外部API进行伤害计算与游戏信息增强；通过1.5万场对战实验验证其性能提升。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是提升LLM智能体在需要对手感知规划的任务中的表现，同时避免额外微调。
AI.method: 提出长短时知识增强生成LSTKAG，利用当前任务过去状态并基于当前状态检索相似历史任务的经验摘要；基于LSTKAG设计Porimon智能体结构；引入外部API进行精确伤害计算和提供更详细游戏信息；开展包含15000场对战的锦标赛式实验，用于超参数优化、消融研究和性能评估。
AI.result: 经超参数优化的Porimon玩家显著优于已有LLM智能体结构PokéLLMon和基于规则启发式的玩家；消融实验表明，Porimon变体优于未扩展游戏信息检索的版本，说明该扩展有贡献；但当前实验结果尚不能明确证明长期知识增强生成LSTKAG的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 引入外部资源、当前任务历史状态信息以及相似历史任务的经验摘要，可以提升面向需要对手感知规划的LLM智能体性能。

title: The Text Beside the Image: Detection, Utility and Leakage for Trustworthy Multimodal Medical Data and Beyond
summary: Medical images are released with the reports that describe them, and protecting the image does not protect the report. This paper measures the text component of such releases. We measure identifier detection, downstream utility and residual identity leakage on the same documents, with the pseudonymisation policy as the variable under test: 15 detectors, three release conditions and four corpora of medical reports, legal judgments, news and other genres, and e-mail, in German, English, Chinese and Arabic. A fixed 13-detector union reaches a person sensitivity of 0.9998 at specificity 0.8686 on the medical reports, 0.9958 at 0.8504 on the legal judgments, 0.9352 at 0.9318 on news and other genres, and 0.9906 at 0.6235 on e-mail. With this ensemble, frequency matching with a public name list recovers zero identities by alignment across the four corpora; the names it got right were ones the detector missed, left in clear text. Cross-document linkage ranks the correct person first for 0.93% of e-mail queries without training and 3.94% with it, against 1/3697 chance and 71.98% on unmodified text. On the medical reports it recovers nothing without training and 0.71% of 138 queries with it, against 1/207 chance and a 2.73% ceiling on unmodified text.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究医学图像随附报告文本中的身份泄露与去标识化效果，在德语、英语、中文、阿拉伯语的医学报告、法律判决、新闻及其他文本、电子邮件四类语料上，用15种检测器、3种发布条件和同一批文档评估标识符检测、下游效用和残余身份泄露。
AI.motivation: 医学图像发布时通常附带描述报告，仅保护图像无法保护报告文本；因此需要量化文本发布中的标识符检测、可用性与残余身份泄露，并检验去标识化策略是否足够。
AI.method: 以去标识化策略为测试变量，构建15个检测器的评估流程，采用固定13检测器并集；在4类语料、4种语言上测量标识符检测（person敏感性/特异性）、下游效用和残余身份泄露；使用公共姓名列表做频率匹配，并进行跨文档链接攻击；比较无训练与有训练条件，并与未修改文本、随机概率基线对比。
AI.result: 13检测器并集在医学报告上person敏感性0.9998/特异性0.8686，法律判决0.9958/0.8504，新闻及其他0.9352/0.9318，电子邮件0.9906/0.6235。频率匹配在四类语料上恢复0个身份，正确姓名多因检测器漏检而留在明文中。跨文档链接在电子邮件中无训练将正确人排第一0.93%，有训练3.94%（随机1/3697，未修改文本71.98%）；在医学报告中无训练无恢复，有训练138个查询中恢复0.71%（随机1/207，未修改文本上限2.73%）。
AI.conclusion: 保护医学图像不等于保护随附报告，文本去标识化可显著降低身份泄露，但仍存在残余风险，尤其跨文档链接在电子邮件等场景中高于随机；需要把文本报告作为隐私保护评估对象，并注意漏检导致的明文姓名泄露。

title: CodeActionBench: Evaluating Agentic Code-as-Policy for Embodied Manipulation
comment: 28 pages including references and appendices, 10 figures. Project website: https://codeactionbench.org
summary: How well can general-purpose multimodal models turn visual understanding and reasoning into embodied manipulation via executable code? We introduce CodeActionBench, a benchmark of 25 manipulation tasks that evaluates this capability through agentic Code-as-Policy. Without task-specific fine-tuning, demonstrations, external specialist perception or grasp modules, privileged scene state, or predefined task policies, agents should select visual evidence, form task-relevant 3D estimates, construct manipulation targets, and iteratively execute and revise their policies. A shared robot API provides RGB observations, calibrated geometric operations, robot feedback, and bounded motion, leaving task-dependent decisions to the evaluated agent. Fixed task instances, resource budgets, and a hidden physical-outcome verifier support controlled comparisons across models and harness configurations. Extensive evaluations across nine configurations and 675 attempts achieve success rates ranging from 2.7% to 73.3%. The strongest configuration, GPT-6 Astra with Codex CLI, solves 22 of 25 tasks at least once in three attempts, demonstrating the best performance while still leaving substantial room for improvement. Trajectory analyses reveal difficulties in spatial alignment, object retention, and completion judgment, including task failures despite successfully completed motions. CodeActionBench provides a controlled testbed for measuring how general-purpose models translate their capabilities into manipulation behavior and for examining typical failure scenarios in that process.

AI.tldr: CodeActionBench是一个包含25个操作任务的基准测试，通过Code-as-Policy智能体评估通用多模态模型将视觉理解与推理转化为具身操作的能力。最佳配置GPT-6 Astra与Codex CLI在三次尝试中至少解决22/25个任务。
AI.motivation: 探究通用多模态模型如何将视觉理解与推理通过可执行代码转化为具身操作，并为此提供一个受控测试平台以衡量该能力并分析典型失败场景。
AI.method: 提出CodeActionBench：25个操作任务，采用智能体式Code-as-Policy。无需任务特定微调、演示、外部专家感知或抓取模块、特权场景状态或预定义任务策略。智能体需选择视觉证据、形成任务相关的3D估计、构建操作目标、迭代执行并修正策略。共享机器人API提供RGB观测、标定几何操作、机器人反馈和受限运动。固定任务实例、资源预算和隐藏物理结果验证器支持受控比较。评估了9种配置共675次尝试。
AI.result: 成功率范围从2.7%到73.3%。最强配置GPT-6 Astra与Codex CLI在三次尝试中至少解决22/25个任务，表现最佳但仍存在显著改进空间。轨迹分析揭示空间对齐、物体保持和完成判断方面的困难，包括运动成功但任务失败的情况。
AI.conclusion: CodeActionBench为衡量通用模型如何将其能力转化为操作行为以及检查该过程中的典型失败场景提供了受控测试平台。

title: Are Vision-Language-Action Models Robust to One-Step Observation Perturbations?
summary: Understanding the safety risks of vision-language-action (VLA) models is essential for their deployment in the physical world. Existing safety research has mainly considered persistent perturbations that are applied continuously to observations throughout an episode. However, momentary observation corruption, in which observations are severely perturbed only briefly within an episode, remains an underexplored safety threat. To address this gap, this work investigates robustness to one-step perturbations applied at a single time step per episode. Our experiments reveal that these perturbations substantially degrade VLA performance and that their impact depends on the action chunk execution length. Based on them, we propose CARE, which dynamically selects the execution length based on consistency with the previously predicted action chunk. CARE improves robustness with low computational overhead while preserving clean performance by selecting shorter execution lengths only under perturbations.

AI.tldr: 本文研究视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型对单步、短暂观测扰动的鲁棒性，发现扰动会显著降低性能且影响与动作块执行长度有关，并提出 CARE 方法动态调整执行长度以提升鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 安全研究主要关注持续施加于整个回合观测的扰动，而单步或短暂观测损坏这一安全威胁尚未被充分探索，因此需要研究其对物理部署安全性的影响。
AI.method: 在每个回合的单个时间步施加一步扰动，评估 VLA 模型的鲁棒性；分析动作块执行长度对扰动影响的作用；提出 CARE，根据当前预测动作块与先前预测动作块的一致性动态选择执行长度。
AI.result: 单步扰动会显著降低 VLA 性能，且其影响取决于动作块执行长度；CARE 能以较低计算开销提升鲁棒性，并且仅在扰动时选择更短执行长度，从而保持干净条件下的性能。
AI.conclusion: 短暂观测损坏是 VLA 模型不可忽视的安全威胁，通过基于动作块一致性的动态执行长度选择，可以在低开销下有效增强鲁棒性并兼顾正常性能。

title: SGA-Flow-GRPO: Spatial Gradient-Guided Credit Assignment for Flow-GRPO
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) has proven effective in aligning flow-based generative models with human preferences. Recently, Flow-GRPO has emerged as an efficient critic-free paradigm by calculating advantages over sampled candidate trajectories. However, standard Flow-GRPO applies a uniform scalar advantage across both temporal denoising steps and spatial latent dimensions, without explicitly accounting for the spatial structure of generated images, which may lead to sub-optimal policy updates. To address this, we propose a novel gradient-guided spatial credit assignment framework tailored for Diffusion Transformers (DiTs). We first reformulate the transition-level log-likelihood in Flow-GRPO into a token-wise representation natively aligned with DiT patch architectures, constructing spatially fine-grained importance sampling ratios. To allocate localized credit without rigid, boundary-sensitive segmentation heuristics, we introduce a continuous spatial credit map derived from reward gradients. Crucially, we employ an outlier-robust normalization scheme based on Median Absolute Deviation (MAD) coupled with temperature scaling, effectively eliminating gradient noise while highlighting functional prompt-aligned regions. Extensive evaluations on GenEval show that our approach delivers SOTA alignment quality, achieving a convergence rate comparable to top-tier methods like DiffusionNFT while substantially improving upon Flow-GRPO-based methods in alignment performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种面向 Diffusion Transformers 的梯度引导空间信用分配框架，用于改进 Flow-GRPO 在基于强化学习的流式生成模型对齐中的不足，在 GenEval 上取得 SOTA 对齐效果。
AI.motivation: 标准 Flow-GRPO 在时间去噪步和空间潜变量维度上使用统一的标量优势，未显式考虑生成图像的空间结构，可能导致策略更新次优。
AI.method: 将 Flow-GRPO 的转移级对数似然重构为与 DiT patch 架构对齐的 token 级表示，构造空间细粒度重要性采样比；利用奖励梯度生成连续空间信用图，避免刚性边界敏感的分割启发式；采用基于中位数绝对偏差（MAD）的异常值鲁棒归一化与温度缩放，以消除梯度噪声并突出与提示对齐的功能区域。
AI.result: 在 GenEval 上的大量评估表明，该方法实现了 SOTA 对齐质量，收敛速度与 DiffusionNFT 等顶级方法相当，并显著优于基于 Flow-GRPO 的方法。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的梯度引导空间信用分配框架能有效提升流式生成模型强化学习对齐中的空间信用分配效果，兼顾对齐质量与收敛效率。

title: Achieve What You Imagined: Learning to Align Actions with Visual Plans
summary: World-action models can jointly predict future visual observations and robot actions. However, discrepancies may exist between their visual predictions and the consequences implied by generated actions. We observe that WAMs can often generate visually plausible task-completion outcomes before producing action sequences that reliably achieve them. Consequently, we treat the WAM-generated visual prediction as a goal-conditioned visual proposal rather than a directly executable plan. We use a frozen action-conditioned world model to predict action-conditioned consequences and construct feedback based on consistency between the two future predictions and alignment with the terminal goal. Leveraging this feedback, we employ Flow Policy Optimization (FPO) to optimize the action head of the WAM. This framework avoids online robot interaction and additional training of task-specific reward models. Across four real-world UR5 manipulation tasks, our method increases the mean success rate from 43.4% to 75.1%, compared with 61.4% for $π_{0.5}$. These results show that cross-model prediction discrepancy can provide useful feedback for improving robot policies under the evaluated manipulation tasks. Website: https://imagine-to-achieve.github.io/

AI.tldr: 该论文发现世界-动作模型(WAM)的视觉预测与动作后果常不一致，因此将WAM生成的视觉预测视为目标条件下的视觉提议，并利用冻结动作条件世界模型的反馈，通过Flow Policy Optimization优化动作头，在真实UR5操作任务上显著提升成功率。
AI.motivation: WAM能同时预测未来视觉观测和机器人动作，但其视觉预测与生成动作所隐含的后果之间存在差异：WAM常先产生视觉上合理的任务完成结果，却难以生成可靠实现该结果的动作序列。
AI.method: 将WAM生成的视觉预测作为目标条件下的视觉提议而非直接可执行计划；使用冻结的动作条件世界模型预测动作条件后果；基于两种未来预测间的一致性及与终端目标的对齐构建反馈；利用该反馈通过Flow Policy Optimization (FPO)优化WAM的动作头，无需在线机器人交互或额外训练任务特定奖励模型。
AI.result: 在四个真实世界UR5操作任务中，平均成功率从43.4%提升至75.1%，而对比方法π0.5为61.4%。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型预测差异可为改进机器人策略提供有用反馈，在评估的操作任务中验证了该框架的有效性。

title: CertMark: Distortion-Free Multi-Bit Watermarking with Certified Decoding
summary: Leading multi-bit watermarking methods for language models encode messages by biasing the model's next-token probabilities, creating a trade-off between message recovery and text quality. Their decoders typically return the highest-scoring candidate from accumulated token-level evidence, without a certified abstention rule that bounds the probability of outputting an incorrect message. We introduce CertMark, a distribution-preserving multi-bit watermark with certified decoding. Rather than modifying probabilities, CertMark uses the embedded message to seed an exact Gumbel-max sampler, thereby preserving the model's original sampling distribution. We propose two scalable decoders: a model-agnostic, text-only decoder and a model-aware variant that leverages the original next-token distributions for stronger recovery. Both support certified abstention with mathematical bounds on the probability of returning an incorrect message. Across text completion, summarization, and story generation, CertMark matches the perplexity of unwatermarked text while reliably recovering multi-bit messages. The model-aware decoder further achieves higher bit accuracy than probability-biasing baselines. Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Batorskq/CertMark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CertMark，一种保持模型原始采样分布的多比特水印方法，并支持带数学界保证的认证解码与弃权机制。
AI.motivation: 现有多比特水印方法通常通过偏置模型下一词概率来编码信息，导致消息恢复与文本质量之间存在权衡；其解码器一般直接返回累积证据得分最高的候选，缺乏能够限定错误消息输出概率的认证弃权规则。
AI.method: CertMark 不修改概率，而是用嵌入消息作为种子驱动精确的 Gumbel-max 采样，从而保持模型原始采样分布。论文提出两种可扩展解码器：模型无关的纯文本解码器，以及利用原始下一词分布增强恢复的模型感知解码器；两者均支持认证弃权，并对返回错误消息的概率给出数学上界。
AI.result: 在文本补全、摘要和故事生成任务上，CertMark 在可靠恢复多比特消息的同时，困惑度与无水印文本相当；模型感知解码器相比概率偏置基线取得更高的比特准确率。代码已公开于 https://github.com/Batorskq/CertMark。
AI.conclusion: CertMark 通过保持分布的水印嵌入与认证解码，在文本质量和多比特消息恢复之间取得更好平衡，并提供错误消息概率的可证明保证。

title: DeltaSeek: Toward Active Perception in Evolving Construction Environments
summary: Construction environments evolve continuously, causing large geometric changes that degrade static mapping and registration performance. This necessitates active perception, where robots deliberately select sensing configurations to resolve the environment's current state. We present DeltaSeek, an initial framework toward active perception in evolving built environments. While our broader objective is a system that reasons about where, how, and when to observe, this paper addresses a critical prerequisite: how a robot's sensing embodiment constrains the observations it can acquire. We formalize an embodiment's permissible observation set and evaluate with a Husky A300 equipped with a UR5e on an IFC-derived benchmark under chassis-mounted and wrist-mounted RGB-D configurations, scoring observations by geometric visibility and effort by drivable distance. In a room-scale scene with eight controlled changes spanning four observability conditions, exhaustive evaluation over 240 permissible base poses and five arm postures shows that two changes admit no chassis viewpoint whatsoever, while the wrist camera resolves both. For changes observed by both embodiments, the median base travel is $6.0$~m for the wrist camera and $15.2$~m for the chassis camera. These results distinguish sensing limitations from acquisition costs, clarifying whether an observation is impossible or simply requires more travel.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeltaSeek，一个面向持续变化建筑环境的主动感知初步框架，重点研究机器人感知构型如何限制可获得的观测，并通过仿真基准比较底盘相机与腕部相机的观测能力与移动代价。
AI.motivation: 建筑环境不断变化，会产生显著几何变化，导致静态建图与配准性能下降，因此需要机器人主动选择感知配置来理解当前环境。本文关注一个关键前提：机器人自身的感知构型如何约束其可获得的观测。
AI.method: 形式化定义某感知构型的可行观测集；使用配备UR5e的Husky A300机器人，在基于IFC的基准中评估底盘安装与腕部安装的RGB-D配置；用几何可见性对观测打分，用可行驶距离衡量努力；在包含八种受控变化、四种可观测性条件的房间级场景中，对240个可行底盘位姿和5种机械臂姿态进行穷举评估。
AI.result: 两种变化完全无法由底盘视角观测，而腕部相机均可解析；对于两种构型都能观测到的变化，腕部相机所需底盘移动距离中位数为6.0 m，底盘相机为15.2 m。
AI.conclusion: 结果能够区分感知限制与获取代价，从而明确某个观测是不可行，还是仅仅需要更多移动。

title: Hesitation-Aware On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) generate text by iterative unmasking. At each denoising step, a dLLM proposes a token at every masked position, but the decoder commits only a confident subset of these proposals. Trace-based on-policy distillation (TOPD) builds on this process by matching the student to a stronger teacher, yet only at the committed positions. We argue that this discards much of the useful signal, which resides in the uncommitted proposals, where the student has made a prediction but is not yet confident enough to commit it. We call these proposals hesitations. In our pilot study on an SDAR-4B student, hesitations make up only 24% of supervisable state-position pairs but carry 66% of the teacher-student divergence. To exploit this signal, we propose Hesitation-Aware On-Policy Distillation (HOPD), which extends teacher distribution matching to every masked position of each denoising step. Because hesitations are not equally informative, we further allocate supervision using hindsight from the completed trajectory, placing more weight on positions whose proposal was later disagreed with the final token and on blocks where first-step proposals rarely survive. Since both models already produce distributions at all masked positions, HOPD requires no additional forward passes over TOPD. The only extra cost is evaluating the loss at more positions. With SDAR-1.7B and SDAR-4B students distilled from TraDo-8B-Instruct, HOPD achieves the best average score among the evaluated methods on five math and coding benchmarks, under both static and dynamic decoding and at both scales. It also speeds up decoding. On SDAR-4B, the HOPD student hesitates less and commits 11% more tokens per denoising step than TOPD, while reaching higher accuracy.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 HOPD，一种面向扩散大语言模型（dLLM）的犹豫感知在线策略蒸馏方法，将教师分布匹配扩展到每个去噪步骤的所有掩码位置，以利用未提交候选 token（hesitations）中的监督信号，从而提升学生模型在数学与代码任务上的表现并加速解码。
AI.motivation: 现有基于轨迹的在线策略蒸馏（TOPD）只在已提交位置匹配教师，丢弃了未提交但学生已作出预测的候选方案；作者发现这些“犹豫”虽只占约24%的可监督状态-位置对，却承载约66%的师生分歧。
AI.method: HOPD 在每个去噪步骤的所有掩码位置进行教师分布匹配；利用完整轨迹的事后信息分配监督权重，更重视最终 token 与当时提议不一致的位置，以及首步提议很少存活到最后的块；由于两模型本就产生所有掩码位置的分布，无需额外前向传播，仅增加损失评估位置。
AI.result: 在 SDAR-1.7B 和 SDAR-4B 学生、TraDo-8B-Instruct 教师上，HOPD 在五个数学与代码基准中取得所评估方法的最佳平均分，覆盖静态与动态解码及两种规模；在 SDAR-4B 上，HOPD 学生犹豫更少，每个去噪步骤提交的 token 比 TOPD 多 11%，同时准确率更高并加速解码。
AI.conclusion: 未提交候选包含重要监督信号；HOPD 能有效利用犹豫信号，提升 dLLM 蒸馏效果与解码效率。

title: OpenMASC: An Open-Source Pipeline for Cross-Trajectory Metal-Aware Sampling and Correction in Accelerated MRI
summary: Metal implants corrupt MRI measurements throughout $k$-space, yet existing accelerated MRI methods assume clean data and most metal artifact reduction approaches assume fully sampled acquisitions. No public dataset provides paired $k$-space and images with and without metal for the same anatomy, and no framework jointly addresses artifact-aware acquisition and reconstruction across sampling trajectories. We present OpenMASC, an open-source pipeline covering the full workflow from data generation to deployment. A physics-based data generation module converts public CT volumes into paired clean and metal-corrupted MRI data in both Cartesian and radial formats. MA-VarNet, an unrolled reconstruction network with a per-cascade DC Rectifier, corrects artifacts that data-consistency steps reintroduce from corrupted measurements. A reinforcement learning agent actively selects $k$-space readouts and co-trains with the reconstruction network through a decoupled three-stage procedure. The framework is trajectory-agnostic except for the data-consistency operator, supporting both Cartesian and radial acquisition without architectural changes. Experiments on two datasets at $4\times$ and $8\times$ acceleration demonstrate consistent improvements over conventional and learned baselines on both trajectories.

AI.tldr: 提出OpenMASC开源流程，覆盖含金属伪影MRI从数据生成到重建部署，并联合优化采样与重建。
AI.motivation: 金属植入物会破坏整个k空间MRI测量，但现有加速MRI方法多假设数据干净，金属伪影减少方法多假设全采样；同时缺少同解剖结构配对的含/不含金属k空间与图像公开数据集，也缺少跨采样轨迹的伪影感知采集与重建联合框架。
AI.method: 包含基于物理的数据生成模块，将公开CT体数据转换为笛卡尔和放射状格式的干净与金属污染MRI配对数据；提出MA-VarNet，一种带逐级联DC Rectifier的展开重建网络，用于校正数据一致性步骤从污染测量中重新引入的伪影；使用强化学习智能体主动选择k空间读出，并通过解耦三阶段过程与重建网络共同训练；框架除数据一致性算子外与轨迹无关，支持笛卡尔和放射状采集且无需改变架构。
AI.result: 在两个数据集、4倍和8倍加速下，方法在两种采样轨迹上均持续优于传统和基于学习的基线。
AI.conclusion: OpenMASC为金属伪影MRI提供了从数据生成到部署的开源完整流程，并证明联合伪影感知采样与重建可提升加速MRI表现且具有轨迹泛化能力。

title: Robot-GST: geometry-aware spatial-temporal robot policy representation and evaluation
summary: Robotic manipulation policies are advancing rapidly with increasing reliance on vision-language models for end-to-end decision making. However, reliable deployment remains challenging because many policies lack explicit mechanisms for predicting task outcomes and evaluating whether generated actions will achieve desired final states, causing execution errors to accumulate during long-horizon manipulation. We present Robot-GST, a geometry-aware spatio-temporal behaviour representation and evaluation framework that constructs a Gaussian-SAM robotic environment for real-to-sim policy verification and improves the reliability of real-world manipulation deployment. Our approach constructs a high-fidelity robotic environment from RGB-D observations using 3D Gaussian Splatting and SAM3D, enabling ``simulation and evaluation before acting''. It integrates visual observations and language instructions with spatio-temporal reasoning for long-horizon task planning using large vision-language models. To bridge high-level planning and real-world execution, we introduce Gaussian-aware final-state estimation through geometric sampling and state-based trajectory planning. Before execution, candidate action sequences are simulated and evaluated in the Gaussian-SAM environment to filter infeasible behaviours. We validate our approach on representative manipulation tasks involving rigid, soft, and deformable objects, including cube placing, toy packing, and duck rearrangement, demonstrating that geometry-aware spatio-temporal reasoning and state-aware execution improve manipulation reliability across different object categories. Our results suggest that combining geometry-aware reconstruction with high-quality rendering and simulation provides a scalable approach for evaluating robotic manipulation behaviours. Website: https://robot-gst.github.io

AI.tldr: 提出 Robot-GST，一个几何感知的时空行为表示与评估框架，基于 3D Gaussian Splatting 和 SAM3D 构建 Gaussian-SAM 机器人环境，实现真实到仿真的策略验证，以提升真实世界长时操作部署的可靠性。
AI.motivation: 机器人操作策略日益依赖视觉语言模型进行端到端决策，但许多策略缺乏显式预测任务结果和评估动作能否达成目标状态的机制，导致长时操作中执行误差不断累积，真实部署可靠性不足。
AI.method: 从 RGB-D 观测出发，利用 3D Gaussian Splatting 和 SAM3D 构建高保真机器人环境；结合视觉观测与语言指令，使用大视觉语言模型进行时空推理和长时任务规划；引入 Gaussian-aware 最终状态估计，通过几何采样和基于状态的轨迹规划；在执行前，将候选动作序列放入 Gaussian-SAM 环境进行仿真与评估，过滤不可行行为。
AI.result: 在刚体、软体和可变形物体操作任务上验证，包括方块放置、玩具打包和鸭子重排；结果表明，几何感知的时空推理与状态感知执行能提升不同物体类别下的操作可靠性，并说明结合几何重建与高质量渲染/仿真可为机器人操作行为评估提供可扩展方案。
AI.conclusion: 将几何感知重建、高质量渲染和仿真相结合，是一种可扩展的机器人操作行为评估方法，有助于提升真实世界机器人操作部署的可靠性。

title: ProTTT: Learning to Learn Semantic User Memory with Test-Time Training
summary: Personalization requires language models to capture user-specific knowledge from a growing user history. Existing context-based approaches incur increasing inference costs as user history accumulates and rely on separate retrieval or summarization stages, while parametric-based approaches often require reconstructing user representations when new user data is added. We introduce ProTTT, a profile-supervised meta-learning framework for learning semantic user memory. The memory construction starts from a shared initialization and is updated for each user through test-time training on user history, allowing it to evolve continuously as the history grows. However, since test-time training alone does not explicitly encourage the memory to capture semantic user knowledge necessary for personalization, we learn this shared initialization using textual user profiles as supervision, so that test-time training on user history captures semantic knowledge more effectively. ProTTT consistently outperforms both full history ICL and all parametric baselines across diverse benchmarks, while substantially reducing inference cost by compressing user history into a lightweight parameterized memory. Our analysis also shows that profile supervision is a reliable objective for learning semantic user knowledge and that the resulting memory can track and retain evolving user preferences, while remaining robust across different history sizes. Overall, we demonstrate the effectiveness of test-time training for personalization and establish ProTTT as a baseline for continuously evolving user memory.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ProTTT，一个基于用户画像监督的元学习框架，通过测试时训练学习语义用户记忆，在降低推理成本的同时提升个性化效果。
AI.motivation: 现有基于上下文的方法随着用户历史增长会不断增加推理成本，并依赖独立的检索或摘要阶段；基于参数的方法在新增用户数据时通常需要重建用户表示。
AI.method: ProTTT 从共享初始化出发，针对每个用户在用户历史上进行测试时训练，使记忆随历史增长持续演化；同时使用文本用户画像作为监督来学习共享初始化，从而让测试时训练更有效地捕获个性化所需的语义用户知识。
AI.result: ProTTT 在多个基准上持续优于完整历史 ICL 和所有参数化基线，并通过将用户历史压缩为轻量参数化记忆大幅降低推理成本；分析表明画像监督是学习语义用户知识的可靠目标，所得记忆能够跟踪并保留不断变化的用户偏好，且在不同历史长度下保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 论文证明了测试时训练用于个性化的有效性，并将 ProTTT 确立为持续演化用户记忆的基线方法。

title: CHI: A Composite Hallucination Index Unifying Entity, Relation, and Quantity Dimensions for Summarization Evaluation
summary: Faithfulness evaluation of abstractive summaries remains an open challenge, with existing metrics addressing only isolated hallucination types: factual entity errors, relational inconsistencies, or numerical fabrications, without capturing their co-occurrence or interaction. We introduce CHI (Composite Hallucination Index), the first unified hallucination metric that decomposes faithfulness errors into three orthogonal dimensions: entity hallucination (EHI), relation hallucination (RHI*), and quantity hallucination (QHI). Each dimension employs a shared softmax-normalized architecture over Venn diagram-derived factors representing extractiveness, positive hallucination, over-focus, negative hallucination, and lost focus. The novel QHI component introduces tolerance-aware numerical matching with exact, epsilon, derived, and temporal comparison modes. We fuse the three dimensions via harmonic mean to produce a single composite score that penalizes weakness in any dimension. We validate CHI on 800 source articles spanning four domains (news, medical, legal, financial) with summaries from five generation systems. Empirical results demonstrate that: (i) the three dimensions are statistically orthogonal (mean rho = 0.148), confirming they capture distinct error types; (ii) CHI achieves the highest system-level correlation with human judgments (rho = 0.66, p = 0.006) on SummEval, outperforming ROUGE (rho = 0.53), EHI (rho = 0.58), and all individual components; and (iii) ablation studies confirm that all three dimensions contribute unique variance, with the full composite outperforming any individual component while providing decomposable error diagnostics unavailable from single-score baselines. CHI provides practitioners with a decomposable, interpretable, and efficient faithfulness metric suitable for both offline evaluation and online monitoring of summarization systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CHI（复合幻觉指数），这是首个统一幻觉度量，将摘要忠实度错误分解为实体幻觉（EHI）、关系幻觉（RHI*）和数量幻觉（QHI）三个正交维度，并通过调和平均融合为单一复合分数。在800篇跨领域文章和五种生成系统摘要上验证，CHI与人类判断的系统级相关性最高（rho=0.66），优于ROUGE（rho=0.53）和所有单一组件。
AI.motivation: 现有抽象摘要忠实度评估指标仅针对孤立的幻觉类型（如事实实体错误、关系不一致或数值捏造），无法捕捉这些错误的共现或交互，因此需要一个统一的、可分解的幻觉度量。
AI.method: 提出CHI指标，将忠实度错误分解为EHI、RHI*和QHI三个正交维度。每个维度采用基于维恩图衍生因素（提取性、正幻觉、过度关注、负幻觉、丢失关注）的共享softmax归一化架构。QHI组件引入容差感知的数值匹配，支持精确、epsilon、派生和时间比较模式。三个维度通过调和平均融合为单一复合分数。在800篇来源文章（新闻、医疗、法律、金融）和五种生成系统摘要上进行验证。
AI.result: （i）三个维度统计上正交（平均rho=0.148），确认捕捉不同错误类型；（ii）CHI在SummEval上与人类判断的系统级相关性最高（rho=0.66，p=0.006），优于ROUGE（rho=0.53）、EHI（rho=0.58）和所有个体组件；（iii）消融研究证实三个维度均贡献独特方差，完整复合指标优于任何单一组件，并提供可分解的错误诊断。
AI.conclusion: CHI为实践者提供了一个可分解、可解释且高效的忠实度度量，适用于摘要系统的离线评估和在线监控。

title: Artificial intelligences and human scientists exhibit complementary strengths in theory building
summary: We investigate the effectiveness of artificial intelligences (AI)-specifically large language models (LLMs)-relative to human scientists at high-level cognitive tasks in social science such as theory formulation, predictions of novel empirical results, and theory revision in response to new evidence. The research domain was academic discourse regarding gender and race inequality. Our findings, comparing 25 LLMs with 13 senior researchers and 60 doctoral scholars, reveal that the AIs outperformed most humans individually on most of the present tasks, while human theories were more diverse and exhibited greater gains in predictive accuracy from aggregation. AI-generated theories were more extensively elaborated, involving additional theoretical paths and latent variables, and were rated as higher quality than human theories by independent raters blinded to source. However, this theoretical complexity was in part ornamental, in that it was not associated with more accurate predictions about empirical patterns in data; in contrast, human scientists achieved greater predictive efficiency with simpler theories. The AIs were significantly more likely than human scientists to revise their theories to incorporate new evidence; human scientists updated their beliefs in a selective way that is sensitive to prior prediction errors. We speculate that the superior processing capacity of artificial intelligences makes them especially well-suited to tasks requiring grappling with complexity, but that the greater diversity of human ideas is essential to wise crowds and collective creativity.

AI.tldr: 研究比较25个LLM与13位资深研究者、60位博士生在性别与种族不平等学术话语中的高阶认知任务表现。AI在多数任务上胜过多数人类个体，但人类理论更多样、聚合后预测提升更大；AI理论更复杂且被盲评质量更高，但复杂性部分只是装饰，人类用更简单理论实现更高预测效率；AI更愿根据新证据修正理论，人类则选择性更新。结论是AI擅长处理复杂性，人类观念多样性对群体智慧和集体创造力关键。
AI.motivation: 探究AI尤其是大语言模型相对于人类科学家，在社会科学高阶认知任务如理论构建、预测新实证结果和根据新证据修正理论中的有效性，并比较二者在理论多样性和集体聚合上的差异。
AI.method: 以性别与种族不平等学术话语为研究领域，比较25个LLM、13位资深研究者和60位博士生的表现。任务包括理论表述、对新实证结果的预测、依据新证据修正理论。由不知来源的独立评分者评估理论质量，并分析预测准确性、理论多样性及聚合效果。
AI.result: AI在多数任务上优于多数人类个体；人类理论更多样，且聚合后预测准确率增益更大。AI生成理论更详尽，包含更多理论路径和潜变量，盲评质量更高，但这种复杂性部分与更准确预测无关。人类科学家以更简单理论获得更高预测效率。AI比人类更可能根据新证据修正理论，而人类更新信念更具选择性并敏感于先前预测误差。
AI.conclusion: AI优越的处理能力使其特别适合应对复杂性任务，但人类观念的更大多样性对智慧群体和集体创造力至关重要。

title: Fewer Tokens, More Self-Teaching: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Extreme Visual Token Reduction
summary: Visual token reduction is an effective way to accelerate multimodal large language models (MLLMs), but performance deteriorates rapidly under extremely low token budgets. Existing work has explored both visual-token selection and training-based adaptation to reduced visual inputs. We take a step further by asking how a heavily compressed MLLM should learn from the states induced by its own generations. This setting naturally calls for on-policy self-distillation: a heavily compressed model is supervised on the states induced by its own generations, while its full-token counterpart serves as an information-rich teacher. Based on this insight, we propose LT-OPD, a training framework for extreme visual-token reduction. The student rolls out responses with only a small fraction of visual tokens, and a frozen full-token copy of the same MLLM provides distributional supervision along these student-generated trajectories. To stabilize on-policy learning when visual evidence is severely limited, we further introduce a budget-level curriculum that progressively decreases the token budget during training. Across nine benchmarks on Qwen3.5-4B, LT-OPD raises average retained performance under 5% visual-token retention from 68.6% to 82.3%, outperforming training-free, training-based, and reinforcement-learning baselines at the same budget. The gains transfer consistently to Qwen3.5-9B, GLM-4.6V-9B, and LLaVA-OV-1.5-4B. LT-OPD also reduces KV-cache usage by 85.2% and prefill FLOPs by 85.4% without additional inference overhead, demonstrating that on-policy learning can substantially recover capabilities lost to extreme visual-token reduction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LT-OPD，一种面向极端视觉 token 压缩的多模态大模型训练框架。它让学生模型在自身生成轨迹上接受冻结的全 token 教师模型的分布监督，并配合 token 预算课程学习，从而在极低 token 预算下显著恢复性能。
AI.motivation: 视觉 token 压缩可加速多模态大模型，但在极低 token 预算下性能会快速恶化。现有方法包括视觉 token 选择和训练适配，但仍需探索重度压缩模型如何从自身生成状态中有效学习。
AI.method: 提出 on-policy self-distillation 框架 LT-OPD：学生模型仅使用少量视觉 token 生成响应，冻结的同模型全 token 版本作为教师，在学生生成轨迹上提供分布监督。为稳定视觉证据严重受限时的 on-policy 学习，引入预算级课程，逐步降低训练中的 token 预算。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3.5-4B 的九个基准上，5% 视觉 token 保留率下平均保留性能从 68.6% 提升到 82.3%，优于同预算下的免训练、训练式和强化学习基线。增益可迁移到 Qwen3.5-9B、GLM-4.6V-9B 和 LLaVA-OV-1.5-4B。KV 缓存使用降低 85.2%，prefill FLOPs 降低 85.4%，且无额外推理开销。
AI.conclusion: on-policy 自蒸馏学习能够显著恢复极端视觉 token 压缩所损失的能力，LT-OPD 在多个模型和基准上验证了有效性与可迁移性，并带来显著推理效率收益。

title: CUE-Mem: Benchmarking Long-Term User Memory via Implicit Cues in Multimodal Conversations
comment: 28 pages. Submitted to AAAI 2027. Code: https://github.com/yulinlp/CUE-MEM. Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/Kkryptonite/CUE-Mem
summary: Long-term memory is essential for multimodal agents that interact with users across sustained conversations. However, user memories are not always explicitly stated: they may also be implied by recurring background objects in images, ambient sounds in audio, or other peripheral multimodal cues. Existing benchmarks largely focus on text-only memory or explicit multimodal evidence, leaving implicit multimodal cues underexplored. We introduce CUE-Mem, a text-image-audio benchmark for evaluating long-term user memory from implicit cues. CUE-Mem contains 2,674 questions across explicit and implicit evidence settings and covers four tasks: Entity Recall, Long Pattern, Personalized Recommendation, and Answer Refusal. Across textualized memory systems, implicit performance remains far below oracle evidence, locating the main bottleneck in preserving and retrieving subtle cues rather than question answerability. Increasing caption detail recovers more of this evidence, but brings uneven gains and rapidly growing token costs, motivating native multimodal access. Yet native access does not uniformly resolve the bottleneck: evidence use depends strongly on the backbone, while multimodal indexing introduces substantial retrieval noise. CUE-Mem provides a testbed for memory systems that selectively retain, retrieve, and use subtle multimodal evidence.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CUE-Mem，一个基于文本-图像-音频的多模态长时用户记忆基准，用于评估智能体从隐式多模态线索中回忆用户信息的能力，包含 2,674 个问题及四类任务。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态智能体记忆评测多集中于纯文本或显式多模态证据，而用户记忆常隐含在图像中的重复背景物体、音频中的环境声等外围线索中，这类隐式多模态线索尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 构建 CUE-Mem 基准，涵盖文本、图像和音频三种模态，包含显式与隐式证据设置，并设计四类任务：实体回忆、长模式、个性化推荐和答案拒答；同时评估文本化记忆系统、增加描述细节以及原生多模态访问等方案。
AI.result: 在文本化记忆系统中，隐式证据下的表现远低于 oracle 证据，主要瓶颈在于细微线索的保存与检索而非问题可答性；增加图像描述细节可恢复部分证据，但收益不均且 token 成本快速上升；原生多模态访问也未能统一解决瓶颈，证据利用强烈依赖骨干模型，多模态索引还会引入显著检索噪声。
AI.conclusion: CUE-Mem 为能够选择性保留、检索并利用细微多模态证据的记忆系统提供了测试平台，并表明隐式多模态用户记忆仍是开放挑战。

title: DexTaG: Tactile-as-Guidance in Reinforcement Learning for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Glove-based motion capture is emerging as a scalable approach to collecting dexterous-hand demonstration data. However, due to the kinematic gap between the human and robot hand, the recorded human motions cannot be executed directly on the robot, especially for contact-rich tool-use tasks involving in-hand reorientation. Prior work bridges this gap in simulation through reinforcement learning (RL) or trajectory optimization, but the human contact pattern is hard to preserve under such formulations, often producing unnatural manipulation and unstable functional grasps. These methods also train a separate policy or solve a separate optimization for each reference trajectory, which is inefficient. To solve these problems, we propose DexTaG, a tactile-guided RL framework for dexterous manipulation. During training, tactile signals captured by the glove guide policy search toward the measured human contact pattern, reducing reliance on precise reference geometry for contact supervision. To improve efficiency, we train a single generalizable retargeter jointly on all training trajectories of the same object. The retargeter is further distilled into a tactile-free student controller conditioned on the target object trajectory for real-world deployment. On marker-pen and hammer manipulation tasks, DexTaG learns natural, contact-rich behaviors that baselines with distance-based contact heuristics fail to learn, generalizes to held-out trajectories of the same object and task, and outperforms single-trajectory baselines on OakInk2.

AI.tldr: 提出DexTaG，一种触觉引导的强化学习框架，用于将手套捕捉的人类手部动作重定向到机器人灵巧手，实现接触丰富的工具操作，并蒸馏出无触觉学生控制器用于真实部署。
AI.motivation: 手套动作捕捉可扩展地收集灵巧手演示数据，但人机手部运动学差异导致人类动作无法直接用于机器人，尤其是涉及手内重定向的接触丰富工具使用任务。现有基于强化学习或轨迹优化的方法难以保留人类接触模式，易产生不自然操作和不稳定功能抓取，且每条参考轨迹需单独训练策略或求解优化，效率低下。
AI.method: DexTaG在训练时利用手套采集的触觉信号引导策略搜索，使其趋向测量到的人类接触模式，减少对精确参考几何的接触监督依赖；针对同一物体的所有训练轨迹联合训练一个可泛化的重定向器以提高效率；再将重定向器蒸馏为以目标物体轨迹为条件的无触觉学生控制器，用于真实世界部署。
AI.result: 在记号笔和锤子操作任务上，DexTaG学习到自然、接触丰富的操作行为，而基于距离接触启发式的基线方法无法学到；能泛化到同一物体和任务的留出轨迹；在OakInk2上优于单轨迹基线方法。
AI.conclusion: DexTaG通过触觉引导和联合重定向器训练，有效解决了人机运动学差异下的接触丰富操作重定向问题，提升了学习效率、泛化能力和真实部署可行性。

title: EyeVQA: Benchmarking Ophthalmic Vision-Language Models from Recognition to Spatial Grounding
comment: Accepted to MICCAI 2027 CREATE Workshop. 19 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Project page: [https://github.com/PKUTHM/EyeVQA](https://github.com/PKUTHM/EyeVQA)
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown increasing potential for medical image understanding, yet their capabilities in ophthalmic imaging remain insufficiently characterized. Existing ophthalmic datasets are typically designed for individual diseases or specialized tasks, making it difficult to systematically evaluate whether VLMs can move beyond disease recognition toward comparative reasoning and fine-grained spatial grounding. We introduce EyeVQA, a unified visual question answering benchmark for comprehensive evaluation of ophthalmic VLMs. EyeVQA is constructed from 21 available ophthalmic datasets and contains 20,000 question-answer pairs spanning six disease groups and seven question types: Single-Choice, Multi-Select, Variable-Select, True-False, Ranking, Point Location, and Bounding Box. Gold answers are deterministically derived from source-provided diagnoses, severity grades, clinical findings, segmentation masks, bounding boxes, and anatomical landmarks, enabling reproducible evaluation without relying on model-generated annotations. Notably, 44.5% of the questions require reasoning across multiple images, extending evaluation beyond conventional single-image medical VQA. We benchmark fourteen representative general-purpose, scientific, and medically specialized VLMs under a unified zero-shot protocol. The best-performing model only achieves an overall score of 62.8, while substantial gaps remain in spatial grounding and cross-task generalization. These results highlight the limitations of current VLMs in comprehensive ophthalmic visual understanding and establish EyeVQA as a diagnostic benchmark for developing more reliable and spatially grounded ophthalmic multimodal models. The project page is available at https://github.com/PKUTHM/EyeVQA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了EyeVQA，一个用于综合评估眼科视觉语言模型的统一视觉问答基准，包含2万问答对，覆盖多种疾病和问题类型，并对14个模型进行了零样本评测。
AI.motivation: 现有眼科数据集多针对单一疾病或特定任务，难以系统评估视觉语言模型是否具备超越疾病识别的比较推理和细粒度空间定位能力。
AI.method: 基于21个眼科数据集构建EyeVQA，生成2万问答对，涵盖6个疾病组和7种问题类型；答案由源数据提供的诊断、分级、临床发现、分割掩码、边界框和解剖标志确定；44.5%的问题需要跨图像推理；对14个代表性通用、科学和医学专用VLM进行统一零样本评测。
AI.result: 最佳模型总体得分仅为62.8，在空间定位和跨任务泛化方面存在显著差距。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM在综合眼科视觉理解上存在局限，EyeVQA可作为诊断基准，推动开发更可靠且空间定位更准确的眼科多模态模型。

title: Does Learning to Predict the World Help Agents Act? Auditing World-Model Post-Training
summary: Predicting how an environment will change before acting is a natural route to better decision making for agents. Recent post-training methods therefore require agents to predict the next observation and turn that prediction into a reward or a direct supervision signal, which is called world model. Existing next-observation training methods help the agent to learn the environmental content. However, they additionally involve an optimization process, which may introduce several effects other than learning to predict the world. Consequently, where the performance gain comes from during the training process remains an open question. We answer this research question through replacing true next-observation targets with in-distribution mismatched observations during the training process. Across two interactive text environments, mismatched targets lower prediction accuracy by 15.3-61.6% relative to ground-truth targets, yet retain substantial task gains over the base model. Compared with the base model, trained models consider more candidate actions and exhibit less looping. We also introduce a setting that replaces prediction-based rewards with independent random signals. This training expands task coverage (pass@64) even when the reward carries no environment information. We also generalize this finding to VisualWebArena, where random-reward training raises pass@64 by 14.3% relative to the base model, without observation-matching rewards or an external multimodal teacher for reward construction.

AI.tldr: 该研究探究基于下一观测预测（世界模型）的智能体后训练中，性能提升究竟来自准确预测世界，还是来自训练优化本身。通过将真实下一观测目标替换为分布内错配观测，甚至用随机奖励替代预测奖励，发现即使预测准确性下降或奖励无环境信息，任务表现仍有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 近期后训练方法要求智能体预测下一观测，并将预测转化为奖励或监督信号（世界模型）。但这类训练还包含优化过程，可能带来预测之外的效果，因此性能增益来源不明。
AI.method: 在两个交互式文本环境中，将训练时的真实下一观测目标替换为分布内错配观测；并引入用独立随机信号替代基于预测奖励的训练设置；进一步推广到 VisualWebArena。
AI.result: 错配目标使预测准确率比真实目标低15.3%-61.6%，但仍相对基础模型保留大量任务增益；训练后模型考虑更多候选动作、更少循环。随机奖励训练即使不含环境信息也能扩大任务覆盖（pass@64）。在 VisualWebArena 中，随机奖励训练使 pass@64 相对基础模型提升14.3%，无需观测匹配奖励或外部多模态教师构建奖励。
AI.conclusion: 基于下一观测预测的训练所带来的性能提升，可能并非主要来自准确预测世界，而更多来自训练优化过程本身，如增加候选动作探索、减少重复循环；即使奖励信号随机，也能提升任务覆盖。

title: StegGNN: Learning Graphical Representation for Image Steganography
summary: Image steganography refers to embedding secret messages within cover images while maintaining imperceptibility. Recent advances in deep learning - primarily driven by Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) and architectures such as inverse neural networks, autoencoders, and generative adversarial networks - have led to notable progress. However, these frameworks are primarily built on CNN architectures, which treat images as regular grids and are limited by their receptive field size and a bias toward spatial locality. In parallel, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have recently demonstrated strong adaptability in several computer vision tasks, achieving state-of-the-art performance with architectures such as Vision GNN (ViG). This work moves in that direction and introduces StegGNN - a novel autoencoder-based, cover-agnostic image steganography framework based on GNNs. By modeling images as graph structures, our approach leverages the representational flexibility of GNNs over the grid-based rigidity of conventional CNNs. We conduct extensive experiments on standard benchmark datasets to evaluate visual quality and imperceptibility. Our results show that our GNN-based method performs comparably to existing CNN benchmarks. These findings suggest that GNNs provide a promising alternative representation for steganographic embedding and open the field of deep learning-based steganography to further exploration of GNN-based architectures.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了StegGNN，一种基于图神经网络（GNN）的自编码器式、与封面无关的图像隐写框架，将图像建模为图结构，以利用GNN的表示灵活性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于深度学习的图像隐写方法主要依赖CNN，但CNN将图像视为规则网格，受限于感受野大小和空间局部性偏差，因此需要探索更灵活的表示方法。
AI.method: 采用基于GNN的自编码器架构，将图像建模为图结构，进行隐写嵌入。在标准基准数据集上进行了大量实验，评估视觉质量和不可感知性。
AI.result: 实验表明，基于GNN的方法在性能上与现有CNN基准相当，在视觉质量和不可感知性方面表现良好。
AI.conclusion: GNN为隐写嵌入提供了一种有前景的替代表示，为基于深度学习的隐写术开辟了进一步探索GNN架构的方向。

title: ArticulateArena: A Metric for Articulated Kinematics
summary: Modern methods reconstruct or generate simulation-ready articulated objects, predicting not only their geometry but also how their parts are connected and allowed to move. Evaluating the geometry is straightforward, but evaluating the predicted articulation is not, because articulation specifies a motion rather than a shape, and there is no agreed distance between two motions. More specifically, existing protocols score joint type, axis direction, origin, and motion limits separately, although these parameters jointly describe a single physical motion, and the same motion can be written as different parameter values. As a result, a joint can score maximally wrong against an equivalent encoding of itself, and several component errors are ill-conditioned or undefined exactly where predictions become accurate. We propose ArticulateArena, a representation-invariant counterpart of Chamfer distance for articulation that compares the motions one-DOF joints induce rather than the parameters that encode them. It represents each joint by the unordered pair of its Lie-algebra endpoint twists, and we prove that the resulting quotient distance is a metric. It unifies fixed, revolute, prismatic, and helical joints, brings continuous joints into the same score through a compactification, and reads as the RMS motion of the moving part in meters when weighted by its mass distribution. A motion-aware tree edit distance lifts the metric to full kinematic trees, pricing structural errors such as spurious or missing joints in the same motion units as joint errors, and for a fixed inner product it remains a metric on trees up to relabeling. Alongside the metric we release ArticulateArena-20K, a new suite of 19,977 articulated objects with verified kinematics, and we re-evaluate published reconstruction methods on it under the new metric. Project page: https://heyumeng.com/ArticulateArena-web/

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ArticulateArena，一种表示不变的铰接评估度量，并发布包含 19977 个铰接物体的 ArticulateArena-20K 数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有评估将关节类型、轴方向、原点、运动范围分开打分，但这些参数共同描述同一物理运动，等价编码可能得到错误评分，且部分误差在预测准确时病态或未定义。
AI.method: 不比较编码参数，而是比较单自由度关节诱导的运动；用李代数端点 twists 的无序对表示关节，证明所得商距离为度量；统一 fixed、revolute、prismatic、helical 关节，并通过紧化纳入连续关节；按质量分布加权后解释为运动部件的 RMS 运动米制；用运动感知树编辑距离扩展到完整运动学树。
AI.result: 提出该度量并发布 ArticulateArena-20K，包含 19977 个经验证运动学的铰接物体，并在新度量下重新评估已发表重建方法。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为铰接评估提供了表示不变、物理可解释且可扩展到运动学树的度量，并支持统一基准评测。

title: NLPG: Natural-Language Policy Gradients for Self-Evolving Language Agents
comment: 30 pages, 7 figures, 10 tables. Work in progress
summary: Large language model agents increasingly rely on compound programs for retrieval, tool use, reasoning, and verification, yet their failures often arise from local procedural decisions. Existing reinforcement-learning and prompt-optimization approaches typically rely on scalar rewards or repeatedly modify entire prompts, making it difficult to capture and reuse procedural improvements while preserving a frozen agent. To address this problem, We propose Natural-Language Policy Gradients (NLPG), an external policy-memory method for improving a fixed agent without changing its model parameters or program structure. NLPG diagnoses execution traces, propagates downstream feedback backward through the module graph, and converts recurring failures into route-local natural-language corrections that are aggregated into bounded policy updates for subsequent executions. Across six benchmarks covering memory, reasoning, instruction following, and evidence verification, NLPG also outperforms the strongest listed baseline for each benchmark by 8.71 percentage points on average. These results provide evidence that evaluated procedural experience can be transformed into local and interpretable policy updates, enabling continual improvement of frozen agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出自然语言策略梯度（NLPG），一种不改变固定智能体模型参数或程序结构的外部策略记忆方法，用于持续改进复合程序型LLM智能体。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习或提示优化方法多依赖标量奖励或反复修改整个提示，难以捕捉并复用局部流程性改进，也难以在保持智能体冻结的情况下优化。
AI.method: NLPG通过诊断执行轨迹，将下游反馈沿模块图反向传播，把反复出现的失败转化为路径局部的自然语言修正，并聚合成有界策略更新，供后续执行使用。
AI.result: 在记忆、推理、指令遵循和证据验证等六个基准上，NLPG均优于各基准最强基线，平均提升8.71个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，经过评估的过程经验可以转化为局部且可解释的策略更新，从而实现冻结智能体的持续改进。

title: Language Discrimination Improves Linguistic Learning in Multilingual Speech Models
summary: Multilingual self-supervised speech models can benefit from sharing information across languages, but under a matched total pretraining data budget they still fall short of monolingual models. We show that strengthening the model's ability to discriminate languages during pretraining reduces and, on some measures, closes this multilingual gap on continuous phonetic and higher-level linguistic measures, while preserving substantial cross-language sharing. Using a controlled English/French HuBERT setting, we test two interventions which strengthen language discrimination: an auxiliary language classifier and per-language k-means targets. Across interventions, continuous-feature phone discrimination error (phone-ABX, lower is better) decreases from 11.6% in the bilingual baseline to 10.4% (monolingual: 10.8%), while lexical performance (sWUGGY, higher is better) increases from 52.1% to 56.7% (monolingual: 58.5%) and prosodic performance (ProsAudit, lexical subtask, higher is better) from 68.9% to 72.9% (monolingual: 72.6%). Across HuBERT training stages, the strongest gains on most linguistic measures occur when language discrimination is introduced in the first iteration, whereas later or repeated interventions yield smaller improvements and are accompanied by increased language-wise segregation. These results support a causal role for language discrimination in reducing the additional cost of multilingual learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究多语言自监督语音模型在相同预训练数据预算下仍逊于单语言模型的问题，发现增强预训练中的语言判别能力可缩小甚至在某些指标上消除多语言差距。
AI.motivation: 多语言自监督语音模型虽能跨语言共享信息，但在匹配总预训练数据预算时仍不如单语言模型；作者希望降低多语言学习带来的额外代价。
AI.method: 在受控的英语/法语 HuBERT 设置中，测试两种增强语言判别的干预：辅助语言分类器和按语言 k-means 目标；并在 HuBERT 不同训练阶段引入这些干预。
AI.result: 连续特征音素判别错误率 phone-ABX 从双语基线的 11.6% 降至 10.4%（单语言为 10.8%）；词汇表现 sWUGGY 从 52.1% 升至 56.7%（单语言为 58.5%）；韵律表现 ProsAudit 词汇子任务从 68.9% 升至 72.9%（单语言为 72.6%）。多数语言指标在第一次迭代引入语言判别时提升最大，较晚或重复干预提升较小，并伴随更强的语言间隔离。
AI.conclusion: 语言判别在多语言学习额外代价的降低中起因果作用，同时仍能保留较强的跨语言共享。

title: EpiTransfer: Sparse, Training-Free Long-Range Depth Estimation from Temporal Monocular Aerial Frames
summary: Reliable 3D spatial understanding is essential for autonomous navigation, obstacle avoidance, and scene reconstruction. While state-of-the-art learned depth estimation techniques achieve high accuracy in-distribution, they often generalize poorly to novel viewpoints and altitudes. This paper presents a geometrically derived, training-free depth estimation method using epipolar transfer with only two monocular images and camera pose estimates. By leveraging camera motion to synthesize a virtual stereo pair with a freely chosen baseline, our approach transforms temporal correspondence into a stereo triangulation task while mitigating geometric degeneracies inherent to direct two-view triangulation. Validated across outdoor drone flights (to a maximum range of approximately 90\,m) and indoor OptiTrack environments against LiDAR ground truth, the method achieves an indoor AbsRel of 0.092 and $δ< 1.25$ of 0.940, comparable to direct triangulation (AbsRel 0.073) while retaining valid depth over a larger fraction of challenging scenes, and substantially outperforms off-the-shelf learning-based baselines such as ZoeDepth (AbsRel 0.225) and Depth Anything V2 (AbsRel 0.570), which are not trained or fine-tuned for this domain, with no training data required.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练、基于几何推导的深度估计方法，仅用两幅单目图像和相机位姿，通过极线转移合成虚拟立体对，将时序对应转化为立体三角测量，并在室内外场景中与LiDAR真值验证。
AI.motivation: 现有学习型深度估计在分布内精度高，但在新视角和新高度下泛化差；可靠3D空间理解对自主导航、避障和场景重建至关重要。
AI.method: 利用相机运动合成具有自由选择基线的虚拟立体像对，把时序对应转化为立体三角测量任务，同时缓解直接双视图三角测量的几何退化问题；仅需两幅单目图像和相机位姿，无需训练。
AI.result: 在室外无人机飞行（最大约90米）和室内OptiTrack环境中与LiDAR真值对比：室内AbsRel为0.092，δ<1.25为0.940，接近直接三角测量（AbsRel 0.073），并在更多挑战场景中保持有效深度；显著优于未针对该域训练/微调的ZoeDepth（AbsRel 0.225）和Depth Anything V2（AbsRel 0.570）。
AI.conclusion: 该方法无需训练数据即可实现泛化性较好的深度估计，在挑战性视角和高度变化下优于现成学习型基线，并保留较大比例的有效深度。

title: EMIR$^2$: Evolution-Aware Memory with Intent-Guided Multi-Round Retrieval
summary: Long-term memory enables large language model (LLM) agents to leverage historical interactions for future tasks. However, existing memory systems struggle to utilize continuously evolving historical information, as they often rely on static memory representations and single-round retrieval strategies, failing to track factual changes or integrate distributed evidence across long-term interactions. To address these challenges, we propose \textsc{EMIR}$^{2}$, an \textbf{E}volution-Aware \textbf{M}emory framework with \textbf{I}ntent-Guided Multi-\textbf{R}ound \textbf{R}etrieval, enabling LLM agents to maintain evolving historical knowledge and adaptively retrieve relevant evidence. Specifically, \textsc{EMIR}$^{2}$ constructs a State-Evolving Memory Graph (SEMG) that represents long-term memory as evolving knowledge states supported by temporal event trajectories and evidential associations. By maintaining semantic states through evidence-based updates, SEMG preserves historical evolution and enables evidence tracing under complex and conflicting scenarios. Building upon this, we introduce an intent-guided multi-round retrieval mechanism that iteratively identifies missing evidence and expands retrieval based on accumulated information. Experiments on LoCoMo and MemConflict demonstrate that \textsc{EMIR}$^{2}$ improves long-term memory utilization, dynamic and static conflict handling, and complex retrieval performance, achieving relative improvements of more than 12\% in certain categories. These results highlight the effectiveness of jointly modeling memory evolution and adaptive evidence acquisition for long-term agent interactions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 EMIR^2，一种面向大语言模型智能体的演化感知记忆框架，结合意图引导的多轮检索，以维护持续演化的历史知识并自适应检索相关证据。
AI.motivation: 现有长期记忆系统多依赖静态记忆表示和单轮检索，难以跟踪事实变化或整合长期交互中分散的证据，导致历史信息利用不足。
AI.method: 构建状态演化记忆图（SEMG），将长期记忆表示为随时间演化的知识状态，并关联时间事件轨迹与证据关系；通过基于证据的更新维护语义状态，支持复杂冲突场景下的证据追踪。同时提出意图引导的多轮检索机制，迭代识别缺失证据并基于累积信息扩展检索。
AI.result: 在 LoCoMo 和 MemConflict 数据集上，EMIR^2 提升了长期记忆利用、动态与静态冲突处理以及复杂检索性能，部分类别相对提升超过 12%。
AI.conclusion: 联合建模记忆演化与自适应证据获取，对长期智能体交互有效，能够增强大语言模型智能体的长期记忆利用能力。

title: MA-FPPO: Multi-Agent Flow-Pretrained Policy Optimization
summary: Multi-agent flow policies learn cooperative behavior from fixed offline datasets, but often struggle to complete tasks in situations not covered by the offline data. In these situations, agents must both adapt to changes in the environment and coordinate with one another, yet action patterns learned offline are often insufficient for effective adaptation and coordination. To address this problem, we propose Multi-Agent Flow-Pretrained Policy Optimization (MA-FPPO), which uses online fine-tuning to improve the cooperative behavior of models pretrained with flow matching through new interactions with the environment. Building on the behavior learned during pretraining, we construct policies with explicit action likelihoods for discrete and continuous action spaces. We then update the pretrained model using shared team advantages to further improve coordination based on team performance. Our method achieves, on average, relative gains of 52.8% over the strongest listed offline baselines across 30 settings and 29.8% over purely online learning across 38 comparisons with matched online budgets and evaluation protocols.

AI.tldr: 提出MA-FPPO，通过在线微调改进基于流匹配预训练的多智能体策略，以提升离线数据未覆盖场景中的适应与协调能力。
AI.motivation: 多智能体流策略从固定离线数据中学习协作行为，但在离线数据未覆盖的情况下，学到的动作模式往往不足以有效适应环境变化并完成协调任务。
AI.method: MA-FPPO通过与环境的新交互在线微调流匹配预训练模型；构建具有显式动作似然的策略以支持离散和连续动作空间；使用共享团队优势更新预训练模型，从而基于团队表现进一步提升协调能力。
AI.result: 在30个设置中，相对最强离线基线平均获得52.8%的相对提升；在38个匹配在线预算和评估协议的比较中，相对纯在线学习平均获得29.8%的相对提升。
AI.conclusion: 结合流匹配预训练与在线微调，并利用共享团队优势进行更新，能够有效提升多智能体在离线数据未覆盖场景中的适应与协调表现，优于离线基线和纯在线学习方法。

title: From Position Risks to Block Survival: Faster Generation for Diffusion Language Models
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) can accelerate generation by predicting multiple tokens in parallel, but there is a mismatch between how these tokens are predicted and how they ultimately contribute to generation. Parallel predictions can hardly condition on the tokens selected earlier within the same block, even though their validity depends on this realized prefix. Under the popular proposal-verification decoding, this mismatch makes errors highly asymmetric: an early rejection prevents all subsequent proposals from contributing decoding progress. We introduce BRISK-DLM, a framework that addresses both mismatches by optimizing proposal learning and selection for verified progress. BRISK-DLM trains on self-generated sequences, using risk-reward weighting to dynamically prioritize positions by their impact on verified progress and decoding cost. During inference, a lightweight prefix-conditioned corrector reranks existing candidates using previously selected tokens and preferences distilled from the model's own verifier. The corrector reuses the backbone's parallel representations and requires no additional backbone evaluation, while fused execution keeps its overhead small. BRISK-DLM improves end-to-end throughput by up to 37.4% while preserving task quality, establishing a new quality-throughput frontier for DLM generation.

AI.tldr: 提出 BRISK-DLM 框架，通过优化扩散语言模型的提案学习与选择，缓解并行预测与已验证生成进度之间的不匹配，在保持任务质量的同时提升端到端吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型可并行预测多个 token 来加速生成，但并行预测难以基于同一块内已选 token 进行条件化，导致预测与最终生成贡献不匹配。在提案-验证解码中，这种不匹配会使错误高度不对称：早期提案被拒会阻止后续提案带来解码进展。
AI.method: BRISK-DLM 从两方面改进：训练时使用自生成序列，并引入风险-奖励加权，根据各位置对已验证进度和解码成本的影响动态调整优先级；推理时使用轻量级前缀条件校正器，基于先前已选 token 和从模型自身验证器蒸馏出的偏好对现有候选重新排序。校正器复用主干并行表示，无需额外主干评估，并通过融合执行降低开销。
AI.result: BRISK-DLM 在保持任务质量的同时，将端到端吞吐量最高提升 37.4%，建立了扩散语言模型生成的新质量-吞吐量前沿。
AI.conclusion: 通过同时优化提案学习与选择以服务已验证进度，BRISK-DLM 能有效缓解并行预测与验证解码之间的不匹配，在质量不降的前提下显著加速扩散语言模型生成。

title: CUA-SWE: When Computer-Use Agents Meet Visual Software Engineering
summary: Software development requires more than editing code: developers repeatedly run software, interact with its interfaces, visually inspect its behavior, and use these observations to decide what to change next and whether a change works. Existing coding agents and computer-use agents are largely studied in isolation, leaving this integrated development process underexplored. Diagnosing a runtime interaction failure requires agents to connect visual observations with the responsible code, then use the application again to verify the repair. We introduce CUA-SWE, a benchmark, environment, and evaluation pipeline for software engineering with computer use. Beyond studying how GUI feedback supports diagnosis and repair, we ask whether agents can complete software engineering tasks when required specification or operational information is available only through the running application's visual interface. CUA-SWE spans four software engineering domains and requires agents to modify code and configuration, execute commands, interact with running software, and inspect visual feedback within the same task. Each task includes deterministic, task-specific tests that verify whether the resulting software satisfies the requirements and preserves specified behavior. Our evaluation characterizes how frontier agents combine source-level execution with application screenshots and graphical interaction to produce verified software changes. We examine performance across domains and task information requirements, alongside the development behaviors associated with successful repairs. CUA-SWE provides a unified testbed for studying how agents use visual feedback and interaction to guide software engineering, with executable correctness criteria for the resulting software.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CUA-SWE，一个用于结合计算机使用（图形界面交互与视觉反馈）的软件工程基准、环境与评估流程，覆盖四个领域，要求智能体修改代码与配置、运行命令、操作软件并检查视觉反馈，最终通过确定性测试验证结果。
AI.motivation: 现有编码智能体与计算机使用智能体大多被孤立研究，而真实软件开发需要反复运行软件、观察界面行为、诊断运行时交互失败并验证修复，这一集成开发过程尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 构建覆盖四个软件工程领域的基准与环境，任务要求智能体修改代码和配置、执行命令、与运行中的应用交互并检查视觉反馈；每个任务配有确定性的、任务专属测试，用于验证软件是否满足需求并保持指定行为。
AI.result: 评估刻画了前沿智能体如何结合源码级执行、应用截图和图形交互来产生经验证的软件变更，并分析了不同领域和不同任务信息需求下的表现，以及与成功修复相关的开发行为。
AI.conclusion: CUA-SWE 为研究智能体如何利用视觉反馈和交互引导软件工程提供了统一测试平台，并为生成的软件提供了可执行的正确性判定标准。

title: Endo-TSR: Temporal Spectral Modeling of Appearance and Motion for Endoscopic Reconstruction
summary: Endoscopic scene reconstruction requires modeling tissue motion and temporal appearance while recovering fine surface detail. Deformable Gaussian models provide explicit trajectories, but their fixed colour coefficients lack a dedicated temporal representation for photometric changes. We propose Endo-TSR, which augments deformable Gaussian splatting with bounded Fourier colour residuals and independent translation residuals on shared temporal frequencies. The colour residuals capture local appearance changes, while a Matérn spectral prior regularises motion corrections. Multi-scale Laplacian supervision guides tissue-detail recovery during joint image fitting. Extensive experiments on the EndoNeRF and StereoMIS datasets demonstrate state-of-the-art rendering quality, with the highest PSNR across all evaluated sequences. Ablation studies show that temporal appearance yields the largest PSNR gain among the tested component additions, while appearance and detail supervision jointly improve rendering with fixed Gaussian counts.

AI.tldr: 提出 Endo-TSR，在可变形高斯泼溅中引入有界傅里叶颜色残差和独立平移残差，用于内窥镜场景重建中的组织运动与表观变化建模，并提升渲染质量。
AI.motivation: 内窥镜场景重建需同时建模组织运动、时间外观变化并恢复精细表面细节；现有可变形高斯模型虽提供显式轨迹，但固定颜色系数缺乏专门的时间表示来刻画光度变化。
AI.method: 在可变形高斯泼溅基础上，于共享时间频率上加入有界傅里叶颜色残差和独立平移残差；颜色残差捕捉局部外观变化，Matérn 谱先验正则化运动校正，多尺度拉普拉斯监督引导组织细节恢复，并进行联合图像拟合。
AI.result: 在 EndoNeRF 和 StereoMIS 数据集上取得最优渲染质量，所有评估序列均获得最高 PSNR；消融实验表明时间外观带来最大 PSNR 增益，外观与细节监督在固定高斯数量下共同改善渲染。
AI.conclusion: Endo-TSR 通过显式时间颜色表示与运动/细节正则化，有效提升内窥镜动态场景重建的渲染质量，且各组件互补。

title: Integrity Detection and Characterization of Malicious Injections in RAVEN II
summary:
The increasing adoption of robotic systems in surgery, together with the expanding range of procedures they can support and the growing level of autonomy they provide, has substantially increased the complexity of surgical robots. As these systems integrate more sensors, controllers, communication interfaces, and model-driven control components, their attack surface continues to expand. A compromise of the integrity of a surgical robot can therefore cause unintended robot behavior and potentially threaten patient safety.
  In this paper, we characterize the detection boundary of malicious injections on RAVEN II using a public dataset that pairs the platform's telemetry with external high-resolution encoder ground truth. We identify three injection points spanning the command and observation paths and evaluate three injection patterns with increasing temporal dispersion. To capture different detection behaviors, we perform detection at two timescales: the window scale and the session scale. Rather than reporting detection rates at an arbitrarily chosen threshold, we quantify, for each injection point and injection pattern, the smallest end-effector deviation that can be resolved while maintaining an alarm rate acceptable for surgical operation. Our results show that detectability is strongly influenced by how the injected deviation is distributed over time. An abrupt step can be detected at deviations well below the 1 mm clinical tolerance, whereas the same overall deviation spread across a window or a session can remain hidden from single-window statistics. The open source code can be found at http://github.com/RAVENIIROS/RAVENIIIntegrity.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了手术机器人 RAVEN II 上恶意注入攻击的可检测边界，基于公开遥测数据与外部高分辨率编码器真值，分析不同注入点、注入模式和时间尺度下的检测能力。
AI.motivation: 手术机器人集成更多传感器、控制器、通信接口和模型驱动组件，攻击面扩大；一旦完整性被破坏，可能导致非预期机器人行为并威胁患者安全，因此需要明确恶意注入的可检测边界。
AI.method: 使用 RAVEN II 公开数据集，该数据集将平台遥测与外部高分辨率编码器真值配对；识别命令路径和观测路径上的三个注入点；评估三种时间分散程度递增的注入模式；在窗口尺度和会话尺度两个时间尺度上进行检测；不以任意阈值报告检测率，而是量化在满足手术可接受误报率下，各注入点和注入模式可分辨的最小末端执行器偏差。
AI.result: 可检测性强烈受注入偏差随时间分布方式影响。突发阶跃式偏差可在远低于 1 mm 临床容差的偏差下被检测到；而相同总体偏差若分散到一个窗口或一个会话中，则可能无法被单窗口统计检测到。
AI.conclusion: 手术机器人恶意注入的检测能力取决于注入的时间分散特性；仅依赖单窗口统计可能漏检分散式偏差，因此需要关注不同时间尺度和注入模式下的可检测边界。开源代码见 http://github.com/RAVENIIROS/RAVENIIIntegrity。

title: An End-to-End Latent-Rollout Approach for Pushing Few-Step ImageNet-$256$ Generation to FID $1.11$ without Fréchet Losses
summary: Iterative generation poses a joint optimization problem across steps, as intermediate predictions shape subsequent computations and ultimately determine the final output distribution. Few-step generators distilled from pretrained diffusion and flow-matching models make such optimization computationally practical end to end. We build on this opportunity with a distill-then-refine approach that uses teacher imitation to establish a strong initialization for a few-step rollout in latent space, then shifts to end-to-end refinement of the complete latent rollout against real data. We introduce FiST (Flow-in-Stage Transformer), an architecture that composes learned latent-state transitions in a few stages using a shared Transformer, with optional cross-stage hidden communication. Distillation applies teacher-forced regression to selected states along teacher trajectories; refinement replaces this supervision with adversarial and auxiliary classification objectives on the final latent output. A trainable discriminator module operates on semantically rich features extracted from clean real and generated latents by a frozen SiT backbone pretrained with REPA. All training takes place in latent space, without image decoding. During refinement, FiST consumes its own intermediate predictions, and endpoint gradients pass through every generation stage. For class-conditional generation on ImageNet at $256\times256$, our approach achieves FID 1.11 (IS 282) with three stages and FID 1.15 (IS 280) with two. These results demonstrate competitive few-step generation through learned distribution-level supervision, without explicit Fréchet-distance minimization. Ablations characterize how distillation, pretrained checkpoint choices, refinement supervision, and cross-stage hidden communication affect generation quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种“先蒸馏后精炼”的少步生成方法，在潜空间中先通过教师模仿初始化少步生成器，再对完整潜空间生成轨迹进行端到端精炼。作者设计了FiST架构，在少阶段内用共享Transformer组合潜状态转移，并在ImageNet 256×256类条件生成上取得FID 1.11（三阶段）和1.15（两阶段）的竞争性结果。
AI.motivation: 迭代生成本质上是跨步骤的联合优化问题，中间预测会影响后续计算并最终决定输出分布。从预训练扩散和流匹配模型蒸馏出的少步生成器使端到端优化在计算上可行，因此作者希望利用这一机会提升少步生成质量。
AI.method: 采用蒸馏-精炼框架：首先用教师模仿为潜空间少步生成轨迹提供强初始化，然后针对真实数据对整个潜空间轨迹进行端到端精炼。架构FiST使用共享Transformer在少数阶段组合学习到的潜状态转移，并可选进行跨阶段隐藏通信。蒸馏阶段对教师轨迹上的选定状态进行教师强制回归；精炼阶段则用对抗损失和辅助分类损失监督最终潜输出。可训练判别器作用于由冻结的、经REPA预训练的SiT骨干提取的干净真实潜变量和生成潜变量的语义丰富特征。全部训练在潜空间进行，无需图像解码。精炼时FiST消费自身中间预测，端点梯度流经每个生成阶段。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256×256类条件生成任务上，三阶段模型达到FID 1.11（IS 282），两阶段模型达到FID 1.15（IS 280）。消融实验分析了蒸馏、预训练检查点选择、精炼监督和跨阶段隐藏通信对生成质量的影响。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，通过学习到的分布级监督，无需显式最小化Fréchet距离，也能实现具有竞争力的少步生成。蒸馏-精炼方法和FiST架构有效，消融实验进一步揭示了各组件的作用。

title: Preserving Morphemes: Morphology-Guided Pre-Tokenization for Nepali
comment: 13 pages, 2 figures, 6 tables. Code, data and tokenizers: https://github.com/kalexrt/nepali-morphology-tokenizer
summary: A byte-level BPE vocabulary learns each inflected form of a Nepali word as a separate string, so a noun stem is spelled differently in each of its case-marked forms. We test whether splitting words into stem and affixes before BPE helps, with the corpus, vocabulary size, model and number of training steps held fixed. Our pre-tokenizer, Papaya, uses a finite-state transducer built from a published grammar of Nepali, falls back to regular expressions, and leaves the BPE trainer unchanged. On 607 words annotated by seven native speakers its segmenter reaches 0.96 boundary F1, and the resulting tokens keep stems intact far more often than plain BPE does. In a 17M-parameter language model it lowers bits per byte by about 1% at equal training steps; most of the larger gain seen at equal epochs comes from the extra steps that longer token sequences buy, and an unsupervised Morfessor segmentation gives the same improvement. Downstream the effect is small: NER improves only on entities that contain words unseen in training, POS tagging and news classification do not change, and published Nepali tokenizers perform about as well. We release the annotated boundary set, a 556-affix dataset and the code.

AI.tldr: 本文测试在尼泊尔语 BPE 分词前先将词切分为词干与词缀是否有帮助，并发布 Papaya 预分词器及相关数据。
AI.motivation: 字节级 BPE 会把同一词干的不同屈折形式视为不同字符串，导致词干被拆散；作者想验证显式词干-词缀切分能否改善分词与下游任务。
AI.method: 提出 Papaya 预分词器：基于已发表尼泊尔语语法的有限状态转换器，失败时回退到正则表达式，且不修改 BPE 训练器；在固定语料、词表、模型和训练步数下与普通 BPE 及 Morfessor 无监督切分比较。
AI.result: 在 607 个由七位母语者标注的词上，切分器边界 F1 为 0.96，分词更能保持词干完整；17M 参数语言模型在相同训练步数下 bits per byte 约降低 1%，等 epoch 下更大提升主要来自更长 token 序列带来的额外步数，Morfessor 也有类似提升。下游效果较小：仅含训练中未见词的实体 NER 有提升，POS 标注和新闻分类不变，已发布尼泊尔语分词器表现相近。
AI.conclusion: 显式词干-词缀切分可小幅改善语言建模并更好保留词干，但对下游任务收益有限；作者发布标注边界集、556 个词缀数据集和代码。

title: ReSync: Re-Aligning the Two Clocks of Asynchronous World-Action Models
summary: Jointly generating future video and actions has become a standard recipe for world-action models, and the strongest systems denoise the two streams on separate schedules: actions are decoded in few steps so control stays fast, while the video stream runs longer to keep the predicted future sharp. The design is deliberate, but it leaves the two streams on different clocks, and an action can become executable while the future that should justify it is still largely unresolved. We formalize this as a two-clock view of asynchronous inference and introduce the commitment-evidence gap, a quantity read directly from a model's own sampling schedule rather than measured by search. The gap is predictive: as it widens, candidate utility becomes harder to identify and extra candidate sampling buys less, while advancing the world stream buys more, and the two cross. Spending more world computation is therefore not simply better. The useful interval is closed at both ends, and both ends can be read off the schedule before any rollout. ReSync places the computation inside it: hold the action state, advance only the world within the supported window, then resume native denoising. No parameters change and no candidates are compared. On a frozen paired RoboCasa panel this improves success by 4.48 points, while an equal-compute control that waits without advancing the world does not move, and the same rule transfers to a second benchmark and a second backbone without retuning.

AI.tldr: 世界-动作模型通常以不同时间表去噪动作流与视频流，导致动作可能在其对应的未来视频尚未解析时就已可执行。本文形式化这种异步推理的“双时钟”视角，提出可从采样计划直接读取的“承诺-证据差距”，并据此设计ReSync：在支持窗口内保持动作状态、仅推进世界流后再恢复原生去噪。在RoboCasa配对面板上成功率提升4.48点，且无需调参即可迁移到其他基准和骨干网络。
AI.motivation: 现有最强世界-动作模型为兼顾控制速度与未来预测清晰度，让动作流用少量步数解码、视频流用更长步数去噪，导致二者处于不同“时钟”。这会使动作在世界未来仍大量未解析时就变得可执行，即缺乏足够证据支撑承诺。研究希望理解何时增加世界计算更有利，以及如何在不改变模型参数或搜索候选的情况下解决这种异步不匹配。
AI.method: 将异步推理形式化为双时钟视角，定义“承诺-证据差距”（commitment-evidence gap），该量可直接从模型自身采样计划读出，而非通过搜索测量。基于差距预测性设计ReSync：在支持窗口内保持动作状态不变，仅推进世界流，然后恢复原生去噪。方法不改变参数、不比较候选，仅调整动作流与世界流之间的计算同步。
AI.result: 差距具有预测性：差距扩大时，识别候选效用变难、增加候选采样收益降低，而推进世界流收益增加，二者存在交叉。因此更多世界计算并非总是更好，有效区间两端闭合且可在rollout前从计划读出。在冻结的配对RoboCasa面板上，ReSync将成功率提升4.48点；等计算量但只等待不推进世界流的控制组无提升；同一规则无需重新调参即可迁移到第二个基准和第二个骨干网络。
AI.conclusion: 异步世界-动作推理中存在可提前读取的有效计算区间，更多世界计算并非单调有益。ReSync通过在支持窗口内暂持动作并推进世界流，在不改参数、不比较候选的情况下缩小承诺-证据差距，提升控制成功率并具跨基准、跨骨干泛化性。

title: Toward On-Chip Training of Spiking Neural Networks for Dense Event-Based Vision
summary: Event cameras provide low-latency, asynchronous visual sensing for resource-constrained robotics.
