Spiking neural networks (SNNs) process event streams naturally, but training deep SNNs with backpropagation through time (BPTT) requires substantial memory and remains difficult on neuromorphic hardware. Local learning avoids this by restricting error propagation to local blocks, but existing methods mainly target classification rather than dense prediction. We introduce DELL (Dense Event-driven Local Learning), a block wise scheme for dense event-based vision that replaces global gradient propagation with local dense supervision. Learnable, spatially structured local heads supervise each block at its appropriate resolution while preserving temporal dynamics within blocks. We evaluate DELL on optical-flow regression and semantic segmentation with a fully spiking U-shaped architecture. On DSEC optical flow, DELL reduces peak training memory by 39.6% relative to end-to-end BPTT while improving accuracy, reaching 1.670 px endpoint error on the official test benchmark versus 1.941 px for the same backbone trained end-to-end. Block detachment behaves more like a regularizer than a constraint. DECOLLE, the existing local-learning baseline, relies on fixed random local read-outs poorly suited to dense regression, resulting in a 3.9x higher endpoint error; learnable local heads recover this loss and outperform end-to-end training across all optical-flow metrics. On segmentation, they recover most of the performance gap, although DELL remains a few mIoU points behind end-to-end training. With 2.3M parameters, 24x fewer than the strongest SNN baseline, the backbone remains competitive with the SNN state of the art on DSEC. These results extend local learning to dense event-based prediction while substantially reducing training memory.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DELL，一种面向密集事件视觉的块级局部学习方案，用可学习的局部稠密监督替代全局梯度传播，并在光流回归和语义分割上验证。
AI.motivation: 事件相机适合资源受限机器人，SNN 能自然处理事件流，但 BPTT 训练深度 SNN 内存开销大且难以部署到神经形态硬件；现有局部学习多用于分类，缺少面向密集预测的方法。
AI.method: DELL 将网络按块训练，每个块由可学习的、空间结构化的局部头在合适分辨率上进行稠密监督，同时保留块内时间动态；使用全脉冲 U 型架构，在 DSEC 光流和语义分割任务上评估，并与端到端 BPTT 及 DECOLLE 基线比较。
AI.result: 在 DSEC 光流上，DELL 相比端到端 BPTT 降低 39.6% 峰值训练内存，同时提升精度，官方测试集端点误差为 1.670 px，优于同骨干端到端训练的 1.941 px；DECOLLE 因固定随机局部读出导致端点误差高 3.9 倍，可学习局部头弥补了这一损失并在所有光流指标上超过端到端训练。分割任务中 DELL 恢复大部分性能差距，但仍比端到端低几个 mIoU；骨干仅 2.3M 参数，比最强 SNN 基线少 24 倍，并在 DSEC 上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: DELL 将局部学习扩展到基于事件的密集预测，在显著降低训练内存的同时保持或提升部分任务性能，表明块分离更像正则化而非限制。

title: "You're Right, Let Me Fix It": How LLM Agents Damage Correct Work When Falsely Accused
summary: LLM agents increasingly keep working after a task succeeds as they resume after compaction or take over handoffs. Their finished work keeps receiving follow-up input that sometimes falsely accuses it for later failures. We call an agent's acceptance of such a false accusation gaslight sycophancy, and destructive over-correction when acting on it damages previously correct work. We introduce CAVE-Bench, a benchmark of 365 agentic tasks across six domains built around opaque tasks. Every scored run first reaches a verified correct state, whose supporting rationale and history stay in the workspace while the facts that would settle the accusation lie in external or runtime state beyond the agent's reach. The agent cannot confirm or refute the claim with a local check, so the right response should keep the work and ask for the missing evidence. Each task either hands the agent correct work with saved evidence or let it build and verify that work first, and five risk factors set how the accusation enters the workflow. We score accusation acceptance and evidence use from the trajectory and measure harm by deterministic replay of downstream events. Across 14 of the latest models in Claude Code, false accusations damage correct work in up to 60.06% of runs, and stronger models often do so after recovering the supporting evidence. The same model behaves differently across OpenCode, Codex, and Hermes, and a harness gate driven by the benchmark's live signals cuts replayed harm by 74%. These results show that preserving already-correct work under unsupported accusation is a distinct safety challenge for long-lived agents. Our project is in https://henrymao2004.github.io/agent-over-correction/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“gaslight sycophancy”与“destructive over-correction”概念，并构建CAVE-Bench基准，评估长寿命LLM智能体在收到无根据的后续指责时，是否会错误接受并破坏原本正确的工作。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在任务成功后仍可能因压缩后恢复、交接等继续工作，并收到针对已完成工作的后续输入；这些输入有时会错误地将后续失败归咎于先前正确工作，因此需要研究智能体能否顶住无证据指责、保留正确成果。
AI.method: 提出CAVE-Bench，包含6个领域、365个智能体任务，围绕“不透明任务”设计：每个计分运行先达到经验证的正确状态，支持理由和历史留在工作区，但能裁决指责的事实位于智能体无法触及的外部或运行时状态。任务要么直接提供带证据的正确工作，要么让智能体先构建并验证；五种风险因素控制指责如何进入流程。从轨迹中评估指责接受与证据使用，并通过确定性重放下游事件衡量损害。
AI.result: 在Claude Code中的14个最新模型中，虚假指责最多在60.06%的运行中损害了正确工作；更强模型常常在恢复支持证据后仍发生该问题。同一模型在OpenCode、Codex和Hermes中表现不同；由基准实时信号驱动的harness gate将重放损害降低74%。
AI.conclusion: 在无支持指责下保留已经正确的工作，是长寿命智能体面临的一项独立安全挑战。

title: SWE-MILE: Asynchronous Potential-Induced Milestone Credit Assignment for Long-Horizon Software Engineering Agents
summary: Long-horizon software engineering (SWE) agents trained with reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) typically receive only terminal outcome supervision, making it difficult to distinguish productive actions from redundant exploration or functional regressions. We propose SWE-MILE, an asynchronous potential-induced milestone credit assignment framework that derives fine-grained process supervision from workflow runtime, without auxiliary reward models or external evaluators. SWE-MILE quantifies task-relevant file exposure and test-state alignment as navigation and verification potentials, respectively. Differences in these potentials attribute milestone progress and regressions to individual actions, while discounted backward credit propagates supervision to preceding steps. To efficiently acquire intermediate verification states, SWE-MILE further introduces asynchronous shadow probing, which replays repository-changing actions in an isolated sandbox and runs verification in parallel with the agent's primary interaction, largely hiding verification latency. The resulting process credit augments terminal outcome advantages and provides informative learning signals. Experiments on two representative long-horizon SWE tasks demonstrate substantial improvements in agent performance, highlighting workflow runtime signals as a practical source of process supervision for long-horizon SWE agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 SWE-MILE，一种面向长时程软件工程智能体的异步势能诱导里程碑信用分配框架，利用工作流运行时信号提供细粒度过程监督，提升强化学习训练效果。
AI.motivation: 长时程 SWE 智能体通常仅获得最终结果监督，难以区分有效动作与冗余探索或功能回归，因此需要无需辅助奖励模型或外部评估器的过程监督方法。
AI.method: SWE-MILE 将任务相关文件暴露度和测试状态一致性分别量化为导航势能与验证势能，通过势能差异将里程碑进展和回归归因到具体动作，并用折扣反向信用传播监督到前序步骤；同时引入异步影子探测，在隔离沙箱中重放改变仓库的动作并并行验证，以隐藏验证延迟。
AI.result: 在两个代表性长时程 SWE 任务上取得显著性能提升，表明工作流运行时信号可作为长时程 SWE 智能体过程监督的实用来源。
AI.conclusion: 利用工作流运行时信号进行细粒度过程信用分配，能有效增强终端结果优势并提供有信息量的学习信号，从而改进长时程 SWE 智能体性能。

title: RefAdapt-DiT: Adaptive Joint Attention for Reference-Conditioned Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have become the standard backbone for high-quality generative modeling, yet deploying them in conditional generation tasks remains computationally prohibitive because bidirectional joint attention repeatedly processes large reference streams. While existing optimization schemes mitigate generic temporal redundancy, they typically rely on coarse-grained static reuse and overlook the distinct dynamics of references and targets. Specifically, we observe that reference representations often evolve slowly along the generation trajectory, while the target often assigns little attention mass to them; reference drift and this target-to-reference exposure jointly shape how strongly stale reference states affect the target. To exploit these patterns, we introduce \RefAdapt, a training-free framework for adaptive control of joint attention between references and targets. Instead of rigid static strategies, \RefAdapt combines consecutive target-Q change with previously observed target-to-reference attention mass to control reference computation adaptively at block granularity. Under ultra-few-step settings, \RefAdapt enables speedups of up to $2.097\times$ on 4-step MiniMax H3 and $3.54\times$ on 8-step Qwen Image Edit, while maintaining comparable visual quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RefAdapt，一种无需训练的自适应联合注意力控制框架，通过利用目标查询变化和目标对参考的注意力质量，在块粒度上动态控制参考计算，从而在不损失视觉质量的前提下加速条件生成任务中的扩散Transformer。
AI.motivation: 扩散Transformer（DiTs）在条件生成任务中部署成本极高，因为双向联合注意力需要反复处理大量参考流。现有优化方案多依赖粗粒度的静态重用，忽略了参考与目标之间不同的动态特性：参考表示沿生成轨迹变化缓慢，而目标往往只对其分配很少的注意力质量，参考漂移和目标对参考的暴露程度共同影响过时参考状态对目标的干扰强度。
AI.method: 提出RefAdapt，一个无需训练的框架，用于自适应控制参考与目标之间的联合注意力。它不采用僵化的静态策略，而是结合连续的目标查询（target-Q）变化与先前观察到的目标对参考的注意力质量，在块粒度上自适应地控制参考计算。
AI.result: 在超少步设置下，RefAdapt在4步MiniMax H3上实现最高2.097倍的加速，在8步Qwen Image Edit上实现3.54倍的加速，同时保持可比的视觉质量。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用参考漂移和目标对参考的暴露模式，RefAdapt能够自适应地控制联合注意力，有效加速条件生成任务中的扩散Transformer推理，且无需额外训练。

title: Dense Is Not Enough: Hierarchical Supervision Allocation for Long-Horizon On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers the capabilities of a large language model to a smaller student by providing teacher supervision on the student's own rollouts. In long-horizon agentic tasks, however, uniform token-level matching can allocate supervision poorly: a large local discrepancy need not improve future behavior, while consequential guidance may be beyond the current student's reach or fail to persist without privileged input. We formulate long-horizon OPD as hierarchical supervision allocation and argue that productive guidance lies at the intersection of future utility and current learnability. Crucially, this intersection evolves as the student learns. Based on this principle, we propose LENS-OPD, a coarse-to-fine framework that organizes supervision through Locate, Validate, and Refine. Locate adapts trajectory exposure to the student's evolving competence and proposes a candidate decision for intervention. Validate tests whether teacher guidance at that decision improves the same student's subsequent behavior. Refine internalizes the beneficial guided behavior into the deployable policy and concentrates token-level supervision on decisive teacher-student conflicts within the validated turn. These stages are nested: each finer allocation is conditioned on the coarser decision, rather than being optimized as an independent importance score. Experiments across multiple long-horizon agent benchmarks and student-teacher configurations show that LENS-OPD consistently improves task performance over vanilla OPD and strong curriculum- and selection-based baselines. Our results suggest that effective long-horizon distillation requires teaching at the right depth, the right decision, and the right token.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LENS-OPD框架，将长时程on-policy蒸馏视为分层监督分配问题，通过Locate、Validate、Refine三阶段从粗到细地组织教师监督，在多个长时程智能体基准上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 长时程智能体任务中，均匀的token级匹配监督分配效果不佳：大的局部差异未必能改善未来行为，而关键指导可能超出学生当前能力范围，或在没有特权输入时无法持续保留。
AI.method: 将长时程OPD形式化为分层监督分配，认为有效指导位于未来效用与当前可学习性的交集，且该交集随学生能力演变。提出LENS-OPD，包含三阶段：Locate根据学生能力调整轨迹暴露并提议干预决策；Validate验证教师在该决策处的指导是否改善同一学生的后续行为；Refine将有益指导内化到可部署策略，并将token级监督集中在已验证轮次中的关键师生冲突上。各阶段嵌套，细粒度分配以粗粒度决策为条件。
AI.result: 在多个长时程智能体基准和多种师生配置下，LENS-OPD持续优于原始OPD以及强课程学习和选择类基线。
AI.conclusion: 有效的长时程蒸馏需要在正确的深度、正确的决策和正确的token上进行教学。

title: Test-Time Spatial Reasoning for Robot Manipulation Using Generative Real-to-Sim
summary: Spatial reasoning is fundamental to general robot intelligence, as it enables robots to complete long-horizon tasks involving multi-object interaction. We introduce Simify, a training-free, test-time framework that performs explicit spatial reasoning via massively parallel physics simulation. From a single RGB-D image of a scene, Simify reconstructs simulation-ready assets leveraging 3D generative models and vision-language models. Then given a task specified by a reward function (e.g., build the tallest tower), Simify launches thousands of parallel rollouts in simulation and performs an evolutionary search to optimize object arrangements, typically converging within seconds. We conduct quantitative experiments on real-robot hardware to demonstrate the ability of our framework to execute complex object rearrangement tasks end-to-end with previously unseen objects. Results show that our framework outperforms prior work on foundation models for spatial reasoning by effectively exploiting large-scale parallel simulation during inference, and also highlight the importance of complete and accurate geometry for successful sim-to-real transfer.

AI.tldr: Simify 是一个免训练、测试时的空间推理框架，通过大规模并行物理仿真，从单张 RGB-D 图像重建可仿真场景，并用进化搜索优化物体排列，从而在真实机器人上完成复杂重排任务。
AI.motivation: 空间推理是通用机器人智能的基础，尤其对于涉及多物体交互的长时程任务至关重要。现有基础模型在空间推理上仍有不足，且仿真到现实的迁移受几何精度影响。
AI.method: 从单张 RGB-D 图像出发，利用 3D 生成模型和视觉语言模型重建可仿真资产；给定由奖励函数指定的任务（如搭建最高塔），在仿真中启动数千个并行 rollout，并通过进化搜索优化物体排列；在真实机器人硬件上进行端到端实验。
AI.result: Simify 通常能在数秒内收敛，并可在真实机器人上端到端执行此前未见物体的复杂重排任务；相比面向空间推理的基础模型方法表现更优，同时表明完整且准确的几何信息对成功的 sim-to-real 迁移非常重要。
AI.conclusion: 在推理阶段有效利用大规模并行物理仿真，可显著提升机器人空间推理与物体重排能力，并强调了重建几何完整性和准确性对现实迁移的关键作用。

title: FINGR: Learning Dexterous Hand Control for Real-World Rubik's Cube Solving
summary: Manipulating a Rubik's Cube with a single dexterous hand is a challenging test of sustained, contact-rich control: the hand must execute successive layer turns while keeping the cube secure. Each turn requires some fingers to support the cube while others push a moving layer, release contact, and reset for the next move. To learn this coordination, we introduce FINGR (Future-supervised Interaction Network with Geometric Representations), a policy that combines finger-relative geometry with future interaction prediction. A shared point encoder expresses the cube relative to each fingertip and aggregates its points without depending on cubie indexing. Learned future tokens share the observation encoder and receive supervision for contact-force changes, layer-turn progress, and finger joint displacement at multiple time scales. The resulting representation conditions a flow policy that directly generates finger actions. On a real dexterous hand, our policy achieves 99.0% success over 300 turn attempts, compared with 79.7% for the base flow policy. Integrated with grasping and table-assisted regrasping, the policy solves all ten scrambled $2\times2\times2$ cubes in a mean complete-system time of approximately 137 seconds. The project website is available at https://www.lyt0112.com/projects/FINGR

AI.tldr: 提出FINGR策略，结合手指相对几何与未来交互预测，实现单只灵巧手连续转动魔方层，成功率99.0%，并集成抓取与桌面辅助重抓完成2x2x2魔方求解。
AI.motivation: 单只灵巧手操作魔方是持续、接触丰富控制的挑战：手指需在执行连续层转动时支撑魔方、推动活动层、释放接触并复位，学习这种协调十分困难。
AI.method: FINGR使用共享点编码器将魔方相对每个指尖表达并聚合，不依赖小方块索引；学习到的未来token共享观测编码器，并在多时间尺度上监督接触力变化、层转动进度和手指关节位移；该表示条件化流策略直接生成手指动作。系统还集成抓取和桌面辅助重新抓取。
AI.result: 在真实灵巧手上，策略在300次转动尝试中达到99.0%成功率，基线流策略为79.7%；集成完整系统后，求解全部十个打乱的2x2x2魔方，平均耗时约137秒。
AI.conclusion: FINGR能有效学习单手操作魔方所需的持续接触丰富协调，显著提升层转动成功率，并支持完整魔方求解系统。

title: CityToolVQA: Tool-Augmented Visual Question Answering for 3D Spatial Cognition in Urban Low-Altitude Environments
summary: CityToolVQA addresses the weak performance of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on quantitative tasks in urban low-altitude visual question answering. We divide the seven tasks into qualitative and quantitative groups: qualitative questions are answered directly by the VLM, whereas quantitative questions are handled by an external visual-geometric toolchain that performs object grounding, segmentation, depth back-projection, and spatial computation. The toolchain can be attached to different VLMs in a zero-shot manner; a Depth-Assisted Prompt Inference (DAPI) fallback is triggered when the main-chain detection is invalid or unreliable, and CityToolVQA-SFT adapts the 8B backbone to tool-conditioned inputs. On the 73,324-question Open3D-VQA-v2 test set, CityToolVQA-SFT (Qwen3-VL-8B) reaches 67.6% overall accuracy, and attaching the toolchain to ten open-source VLMs improves quantitative-task accuracy by 12.7-36.9 percentage points. These results indicate that externalizing explicit 3D geometric computation effectively complements the limited ability of RGB-only VLMs to estimate metric distances and object sizes.

AI.tldr: 提出CityToolVQA框架，通过外接视觉几何工具链增强视觉语言模型在城市低空视觉问答中定量任务的表现。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型在RGB输入下难以进行度量距离和物体尺寸等定量估计，导致城市低空视觉问答中定量任务表现薄弱。
AI.method: 将七类任务分为定性与定量：定性问题由VLM直接回答，定量问题交由外部视觉几何工具链处理，包括目标定位、分割、深度反投影和空间计算；工具链可零样本附加到不同VLM，主链检测无效时触发深度辅助提示推理（DAPI）回退，并用CityToolVQA-SFT使8B骨干适配工具条件输入。
AI.result: 在包含73,324个问题的Open3D-VQA-v2测试集上，CityToolVQA-SFT（Qwen3-VL-8B）总体准确率达67.6%；将工具链附加到十个开源VLM上，定量任务准确率提升12.7至36.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 外化显式3D几何计算能有效弥补仅依赖RGB的VLM在度量距离和物体尺寸估计上的不足。

title: Grounding Memory Summarization in Utility Intent
summary: Existing summarizers for memory systems are typically optimized for human-facing criteria such as faithfulness, which misaligns with their true objective: preserving the evidence needed to support future queries. We show that conditioning summarization on query-answer pairs substantially improves answer quality, and that this utility-aware behavior is transferable across queries. Motivated by these findings, we propose MemSuit, a self-distillation framework in which a teacher summarizer, conditioned on observed query-answer pairs, produces utility-aware memory entries that a student learns to reproduce from the raw conversation alone. To prevent collateral erasure where conditioning on a single query-answer pair discards evidence relevant to other plausible queries, the teacher decomposes each block into multiple self-contained entries that preserve distinct query-relevant facets as independently retrievable units. To align the retriever with the compact, fact-dense style of teacher entries, we further fine-tune the embedding model with a contrastive objective supervised by teacher entries. Across a diverse suite of conversational query types, MemSuit consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, confirming the value of grounding memory in downstream utility.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MemSuit，一种面向记忆系统的自蒸馏摘要框架，以未来查询效用为导向，通过教师摘要器基于查询-答案对生成实用型记忆条目，学生从原始对话学习复现，并微调检索器，从而提升下游问答。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆系统摘要器常按人类可读性或忠实度优化，与其真正目标——保留支持未来查询所需证据——不一致；研究表明，基于查询-答案对条件化摘要可显著提升答案质量，且这种效用感知行为可跨查询迁移。
AI.method: MemSuit 采用自蒸馏框架：教师摘要器以观察到的查询-答案对为条件，将每个对话块分解为多个自包含条目，以保留不同查询相关方面并作为独立可检索单元；学生仅从原始对话学习复现教师条目；同时用教师条目监督的对比学习目标微调嵌入模型，使检索器对齐教师条目的紧凑、事实密集风格。
AI.result: 在多种对话查询类型上，MemSuit 持续优于当前最先进基线，验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将记忆构建锚定于下游效用是有效的，能够提升面向未来查询的记忆摘要与检索质量。

title: TacGooseBumps (TacGB): Retrofitting Normal-Only Tactile Sensors with Shear Encoding for Learning Contact-Rich Manipulation
comment: 9 pages, 8 figures. Wenjie Li and Binyu Yang contributed equally
summary: Contact-rich policies often fail because distinct physical states look alike yet require different actions. Cameras may not reveal whether a connector is aligned or fully seated, while many normal-only tactile sensors can miss the tangential interactions perpendicular to the grasping direction that distinguish these states. We ask whether a learning policy needs calibrated shear measurements, or only a repeatable observation that separates shear-dependent contact states. We introduce TacGooseBumps (TacGB), a passive domed film that mechanically encodes tangential loading as pattern changes in an existing sensor's pressure map. Tangential loading tilts each dome and redistributes pressure across its footprint; an end-to-end policy consumes the resulting maps without added electronics, force reconstruction, or taxel-level dome alignment. Across four imitation-learning tasks and two data-collection pipelines, TacGB improves goal attainment, efficiency, and contact quality: insertion success increases by up to 36 percentage points, and successful insertions are completed faster, while fragile-object placement becomes gentler and drawing becomes more continuous and straight. Signal, stage-wise, failure-mode, and trajectory analyses link these gains to contact regimes in which task-relevant tangential interactions are poorly resolved by vision and normal pressure alone. Together, these results show that shear need not be measured metrically to benefit robot learning; it can instead be mechanically encoded without changing the underlying tactile sensor or the policy's pressure-map input format.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TacGooseBumps（TacGB），一种被动圆顶薄膜，可将切向载荷机械编码为现有触觉传感器压力图的模式变化，使端到端模仿学习策略无需额外电子器件或力重建即可利用剪切相关信息。
AI.motivation: 接触丰富任务中，不同物理状态在视觉上可能相似，却需要不同动作；普通触觉传感器常忽略与抓取方向垂直的切向交互，导致策略难以区分连接器是否对齐或完全就位等状态。研究旨在探究学习策略是否需要标定的剪切测量，还是只需可重复的、能区分剪切相关接触状态的观测。
AI.method: 设计 TacGB 被动圆顶薄膜：切向加载使圆顶倾斜，并在其足迹内重新分布压力，从而在现有传感器的压力图中形成模式变化。将压力图直接输入端到端模仿学习策略，无需增加电子器件、力重建或逐个触觉单元与圆顶对齐。在四个模仿学习任务和两个数据采集流程中评估。
AI.result: TacGB 提升了目标达成率、效率和接触质量：插入成功率最多提高 36 个百分点，成功插入更快完成；易碎物体放置更轻柔，绘图更连续、更直。信号、阶段、失败模式和轨迹分析表明，增益来自视觉和法向压力难以分辨任务相关切向交互的接触区间。
AI.conclusion: 剪切不需要被度量式测量也能有益于机器人学习；它可以被机械编码，而不改变底层触觉传感器或策略的压力图输入格式。

title: TeacherGRPO: Closing the Capacity Gap in Reasoning Distillation via Teacher Alignment
summary: Reasoning distillation from powerful teacher models to smaller students faces the Gap Curse: as teachers grow more sophisticated, their complex distributions increasingly diverge from what students can approximate, causing performance degradation. Existing mitigation strategies either filter out challenging examples through data selection or introduce weaker intermediate assistant models, inherently compromising supervision coverage or quality. We propose Teacher Alignment, which directly adapts the teacher toward the student's distribution without discarding data or degrading reasoning quality. However, naive alignment through standard knowledge distillation triggers catastrophic collapse of the teacher's reasoning capabilities. To address this, we reformulate teacher alignment as reinforcement learning and introduce TeacherGRPO, built on Group Relative Policy Optimization with two key innovations: (i) Curriculum Selective Alignment applies dual token- and distribution-level curricula to focus rewards on high-signal reasoning gaps while filtering noise from trivial tokens and uncertain tail distributions, and (ii) Importance-Adaptive Length Regularization selectively penalizes verbose redundancy while preserving pedagogically critical reasoning steps. The aligned teacher then distills knowledge to students via standard pipelines. Extensive experiments show TeacherGRPO significantly outperforms baselines across diverse reasoning benchmarks and distillation methods. Our code is available at https://github.com/LzyFischer/TeacherGRPO.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TeacherGRPO，将教师对齐重构为强化学习，以缓解推理蒸馏中的 Gap Curse：让强教师适配学生分布而不丢弃数据或降低推理质量，再通过标准蒸馏流程教学生，实验显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 强教师到小学生的推理蒸馏存在 Gap Curse：教师越强，其复杂分布越偏离学生可近似分布，导致性能下降。现有方法通过数据筛选或引入较弱中间助教来缓解，但会损害监督覆盖或质量。
AI.method: 将教师对齐形式化为强化学习，基于 GRPO 提出 TeacherGRPO，包含两项创新：一是 Curriculum Selective Alignment，用 token 级和分布级双课程将奖励聚焦于高信号推理差距，过滤琐碎 token 与不确定尾部分布噪声；二是 Importance-Adaptive Length Regularization，选择性惩罚冗长冗余，同时保留关键推理步骤。对齐后的教师再通过标准蒸馏流程教学生。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，TeacherGRPO 在多种推理基准和蒸馏方法上显著优于基线。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 直接让教师适配学生分布是可行且有效的，优于数据过滤或中间助教方案，能在保持推理质量与监督覆盖的同时提升推理蒸馏效果。

title: De-biasing Skeleton-based Action Recognition with Convex Hull Adaptive Shift
comment: Accepted for publication in International Journal of Computer Vision (IJCV). Our code is publicly available at https://github.com/Necolizer/CHASE
summary: Skeleton sequences can represent both individual actions and multi-entity interactions, encompassing human bodies, hands, objects, and robots. Existing approaches to recognize skeleton-based actions and interactions usually adopt a late fusion strategy, which expects individuals are independent and identically distributed to train a robust weight-shared entity encoder. However, observed entity bias in various skeletal data violates this assumption, leading to suboptimal optimization of backbone models that might produce wrong recognition results. This bias arises from the world coordinate system's initial configuration, where the choice of origin often creates bias in representation. To this end, we propose a Convex Hull Adaptive Shift based normalization method to reduce Entity bias (CHASE), improving performance across a variety of skeleton-based action and interaction recognition tasks. To adaptively apply plausible shifts to the input skeletons, we formulate a plug-and-play parameterized network that ensures the relocated world origin lies within the skeleton convex hull, which avoids non-convergence by limiting the search space. To further minimize entity bias, we incorporate an auxiliary objective that leverages pair-wise distribution distances to guide network optimization. To support both single- and multi-entity actions, we propose a sub-entity strategy that offers a consistent formulation for both scenarios. Moreover, CHASE demonstrates compatibility with various intra-skeleton modalities, such as bones and velocities, highlighting its adaptability. Essentially, our method works as a normalization approach to reduce entity bias, enabling subsequent classifiers to achieve improved recognition performance across diverse settings. Extensive experiments on 7 datasets verify our approach by seamlessly integrating with various backbones and significantly boosting their performance.

AI.tldr: 提出一种凸包自适应平移归一化方法 CHASE，用于减少骨架动作与交互识别中的实体偏差，并在多种任务和数据集上提升识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有骨架动作与交互识别常采用晚融合策略，假设各实体独立同分布以训练权重共享编码器；但多种骨骼数据存在实体偏差，违反该假设，导致骨干模型优化次优并可能产生错误识别。该偏差源于世界坐标系的初始配置，即原点选择造成表示偏差。
AI.method: 提出 CHASE，自适应地对输入骨架施加合理平移；将其建模为即插即用参数化网络，并约束新世界原点位于骨架凸包内，以避免不收敛并限制搜索空间。引入利用成对分布距离的辅助目标指导优化；提出子实体策略以统一单实体和多实体动作；同时兼容骨骼、速度等骨架内模态。
AI.result: 在7个数据集上进行大量实验，CHASE 可与多种骨干网络无缝集成，并显著提升其性能，且展现出对多种骨架模态的适应性。
AI.conclusion: CHASE 本质上是一种减少实体偏差的归一化方法，能使后续分类器在不同设置下取得更好的识别性能，具有通用性和有效性。

title: ZeroBot: Learning from Scratch in Minutes with Generative Real2Sim
summary: We present ZeroBot, a real2sim framework for learning a robot manipulation task from scratch in minutes under challenging conditions: zero human demonstrations, zero policy pre-training, and zero known object models. Given only a single view of an object and a goal pose for that object, ZeroBot uses image-to-3D generative models to obtain a complete object mesh, which is used in simulation for large-scale parallel reinforcement learning. To accelerate training, we introduce an action space which leverages the generated geometry and learned value function to sample states involving robot-object contact. When evaluated on real-world tasks including grasping, pushing, articulated object interaction, and multi-stage manipulation, ZeroBot achieves an 87% success rate with an average training time of 119 seconds. These results show the value of using image-to-3D models in a real2sim framework for rapid, autonomous robot learning.

AI.tldr: ZeroBot是一个real2sim框架，能在几分钟内从零学习机器人操作任务，无需人类演示、策略预训练或已知物体模型。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人学习方法通常依赖大量人类演示、预训练策略或已知物体模型，限制了自主性和快速适应能力；本文旨在仅凭单视角图像和目标位姿实现快速、自主的机器人学习。
AI.method: 利用图像到3D生成模型从单视角图像重建完整物体网格，并在仿真中进行大规模并行强化学习；设计新动作空间，结合生成几何和学习的价值函数采样涉及机器人-物体接触的状态以加速训练。
AI.result: 在抓取、推动、铰接物体交互和多阶段操作等真实任务上，ZeroBot达到87%的成功率，平均训练时间仅119秒。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在real2sim框架中使用图像到3D模型能够实现快速、自主的机器人学习，具有重要价值。

title: Context Spanning: A Communication Framework for Full-Duplex Speech Models and External LLM Backends
summary: Full-duplex spoken dialogue models can listen and speak simultaneously like the real-time dynamics of human conversation. For natural dialogue, the ability to search for external information in real-time is also an important capability. Many models remain trapped in parametric knowledge, leaving them unable to access real-time information and tool execution. Furthermore, even when Large Language Models (LLM) retrieve information, many duplex speech models process it within a compressed latent space rather than in its raw text form, which can lead to information loss from compression. To address this issue, we propose Context Spanning, a framework for information injection between a full-duplex speech model and an external LLM backend via real-time chunked prefill. The injected frame is encoded in a single forward pass inside the real-time frame budget. It feeds the retrieved information to the speech model as-is, enabling it to reason over the information independently and generate responses. With this approach, our model achieves high performance on Full-Duplex benchmarks and strong results on Question Answering tasks, demonstrating its conversation potential. Context Spanning shows that external information can be injected directly into a duplex speech model, introducing a new simple and powerful mechanism for duplex systems.

AI.tldr: 提出 Context Spanning 框架，通过实时分块预填充在全双工语音模型与外部 LLM 后端之间注入信息，使语音模型直接获取原始检索内容并实时推理生成回复。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音对话模型需实时搜索外部信息，但现有模型多受限于参数化知识，无法访问实时信息和工具；即使借助 LLM 检索，也常将信息压缩到潜在空间，导致信息损失。
AI.method: 提出 Context Spanning 信息注入框架，在实时帧预算内通过单次前向传播编码注入帧，并采用实时分块预填充，将检索到的信息以原始文本形式直接提供给全双工语音模型。
AI.result: 模型在全双工基准上取得高性能，在问答任务上也表现强劲，展示了其对话潜力。
AI.conclusion: 外部信息可直接注入全双工语音模型，为双工系统提供了一种简单而强大的新机制。

title: Estimate, Don't Imitate: Reusing Differentiable State-Based Policies for Visuomotor Control
summary: Simulation-trained manipulation policies can exploit privileged state information to learn effective contact-rich behaviours, but deployment requires acting from partial observations such as noisy camera images. A common solution is teacher-student distillation, in which a visuomotor policy is trained to reproduce the actions of the privileged expert. This requires the student to jointly infer the task-relevant state and relearn the expert's action mapping that is already available. An alternative is to reuse the state-based expert and learn only a perceptual interface that reconstructs its missing state inputs. However, minimising the state estimate error alone does not necessarily minimise the downstream control error induced by these estimates. To bridge this gap, we train a visual state estimator using both direct state supervision and an action-consistency loss backpropagated through the frozen, differentiable expert. A scheduled objective first establishes a physically meaningful state estimate and progressively emphasises errors that affect the expert's actions. Across five goal-conditioned manipulation tasks, retaining the expert consistently outperforms direct pixel-to-action imitation from the same expert demonstration corpus. We further demonstrate sim-to-real transfer on a physical Panda robot, achieving 76% success without retraining the underlying expert.

AI.tldr: 论文提出保留冻结的可微状态专家，仅学习视觉状态估计器，并通过状态监督与动作一致性损失将估计误差与下游控制误差对齐，从而在噪声图像下部署接触丰富的操作策略。
AI.motivation: 仿真训练的策略常依赖特权状态信息，但部署时只能使用部分观测（如噪声相机图像）。教师-学生蒸馏要求学生同时推断任务相关状态并重新学习专家动作映射；而仅最小化状态估计误差不一定能最小化由这些估计引起的下游控制误差。
AI.method: 复用基于状态的专家策略，只训练视觉状态估计器。估计器同时接受直接状态监督和通过冻结、可微专家反向传播的动作一致性损失。采用调度目标：先建立物理有意义的状态估计，再逐步强调会影响专家动作的估计误差。在五个目标条件操作任务中评估，并在物理Panda机器人上验证sim-to-real迁移。
AI.result: 在五个目标条件操作任务中，保留专家的方法一致优于从同一专家示范数据直接进行像素到动作的模仿学习。在物理Panda机器人上实现76%成功率，且无需重新训练底层专家。
AI.conclusion: 复用状态专家并学习感知接口，结合动作一致性损失，可有效弥合状态估计误差与下游控制误差之间的差距，支持从部分观测部署操作策略，并成功实现真机迁移。

title: From Scene Graphs to Answers: Selective Neuro-Symbolic Reasoning for Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous-driving question answering requires reasoning over structured scene information, yet existing vision-language approaches largely delegate heterogeneous reasoning operations to a single neural inference process. We argue that this uniform strategy overlooks a fundamental distinction: some queries admit exact symbolic solutions, while others require semantic interpretation. We introduce a query-adaptive neuro-symbolic reasoning framework that explicitly allocates computation according to the nature of the query. At its core is a hierarchical Spatiotemporal Scene Graph (STSG) that separates persistent object identities from frame-specific states and represents spatial relations and temporal transitions as explicit directed structures. Given a query, a symbolic executor first attempts to resolve it through exact graph operations; only when symbolic execution abstains is an LLM invoked for semantic reasoning. For these unresolved queries, query-conditioned graph retrieval and evidence filtering preserve relation direction, temporal locality, and object semantics, providing the LLM with compact and verified task-relevant evidence. This design shifts the role of the LLM from a universal reasoning engine to a targeted semantic reasoner, while allowing deterministic computation to be handled exactly and efficiently. We evaluate the framework on 5,916 NuScenes-QA questions across all ten scenes of nuScenes v1.0-mini under an oracle-perception setting. The complete system achieves 80.63 percent overall accuracy with GPT-5.4-mini, improving over the corresponding LLM-only configuration by 5.48 percentage points; with DeepSeek-V4-Flash, the improvement reaches 6.64 points. The largest gains occur on counting questions, with improvements of 10.20 and 12.61 points, respectively. These results show that selective reasoning improves both accuracy and inference efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出一种查询自适应神经符号推理框架，用分层时空场景图STSG，让符号执行优先处理可精确求解的查询，仅在必要时调用LLM进行语义推理，从而提升自动驾驶问答的准确率与效率。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言方法通常将异构推理操作统一交给单一神经推理过程，忽视了部分查询可精确符号求解、部分查询需语义解释的根本区别，导致准确率和推理效率受限。
AI.method: 构建分层时空场景图（STSG），分离持久物体身份与帧特定状态，显式表示空间关系和时序转换；查询时先由符号执行器尝试通过精确图操作求解，若符号执行弃权则调用LLM；对未解决查询进行查询条件图检索和证据过滤，保留关系方向、时间局部性和物体语义，为LLM提供紧凑且经过验证的任务相关证据。
AI.result: 在nuScenes v1.0-mini全部10个场景、5,916个NuScenes-QA问题及oracle感知设置下，完整系统使用GPT-5.4-mini达到80.63%总体准确率，比纯LLM配置提升5.48个百分点；使用DeepSeek-V4-Flash时提升6.64个百分点。计数问题提升最大，分别提升10.20和12.61个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 选择性推理能够同时提升准确率和推理效率。该设计将LLM从通用推理引擎转变为针对性语义推理器，而确定性计算则由符号方法精确高效地处理。

title: MIC: Explaining Image-Claim Inconsistencies in AI-Generated Multimodal Misinformation
summary: Claims paired with AI-generated images are a rapidly growing form of misinformation. Existing automated fact-checking (AFC) methods mainly treat this as a provenance problem, detecting low-level synthesis artifacts to decide whether an image is AI-generated. However, such methods do not verify what human fact-checkers often check: whether an image's content is consistent with the context implied by its accompanying claim. To address this gap, we introduce MIC (Multimodal Inconsistency Checking), an AFC framework that assists human fact-checkers by detecting AI-generated multimodal misinformation and explaining inconsistencies using world knowledge. MIC first uses supervised fine-tuning (SFT) for task adaptation and then applies Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to directly optimize component-level verifiable rewards for verdict prediction, inconsistency type classification, visual evidence description, and world-knowledge explanation. We further introduce MIC-Bench, a benchmark comprising 8,812 image-claim instances derived from 4,406 claims, where each claim is paired with an authentic image and an AI-generated counterpart that introduces a controlled contextual inconsistency. Compared with SFT alone, GRPO further improves Macro-F1 by 4.67 and 4.11 points in the in-distribution and out-of-distribution settings, respectively, while also improving the semantic similarity of visual evidence descriptions and world-knowledge explanations to reference annotations. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/UKPLab/arxiv2026-mic.

AI.tldr: 提出MIC框架，通过检测图像内容与声明上下文的不一致性来识别AI生成的多模态错误信息，并引入MIC-Bench基准，实验表明GRPO进一步提升了性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自动事实核查方法主要关注来源检测（低层合成伪影），未验证图像内容与声明所隐含上下文的一致性，而这是人类事实核查员常检查的。
AI.method: MIC框架：先SFT任务适应，再用GRPO直接优化组件级可验证奖励（裁决预测、不一致类型分类、视觉证据描述、世界知识解释）；构建MIC-Bench基准（8,812个图像-声明实例，源自4,406个声明，每个声明配对真实图像和引入受控上下文不一致的AI生成图像）。
AI.result: 与仅SFT相比，GRPO在分布内和分布外设置下Macro-F1分别提升4.67和4.11点，并提升视觉证据描述和世界知识解释与参考标注的语义相似度。
AI.conclusion: MIC能有效检测AI生成的多模态错误信息并解释不一致，代码和数据已公开。

title: QuacamFM: Quaternion-Constrained Flow Matching for Camera Pose Estimation
summary: Camera pose estimation from multi-view images remains a challenge in computer vision. Traditional methods often address this problem using Structure-from-Motion (SfM) with bundle adjustment. However, camera poses estimated from sparse views are inherently ambiguous due to insufficient geometric constraints. Recent work leverages probabilistic models, such as diffusion models, to generate multiple camera pose hypotheses and therefore capture this uncertainty better. Most of these methods represent camera rotations using unit quaternions, but treat them as unconstrained 4D vectors during the generative processes, thereby ignoring the unit-norm constraint of quaternions. Unconstrained quaternions create non-smooth and suboptimal generation trajectories. To this end, we propose *QuacamFM*, a quaternion-constrained flow matching framework for camera pose estimation that preserves unit quaternion representations throughout the entire flow trajectory. We design the optimal transport of the quaternion flows using smooth spherical linear interpolation. Experiments on CO3Dv2 demonstrate our method's advantage in camera pose accuracy over diffusion-based methods and classical SfM approaches. We further show that our quaternion-constrained formulation outperforms the naive application of standard flow matching to 4D quaternion vectors on sparse-view camera pose estimation. Finally, it is observed that QuacamFM generalizes well across datasets and in-the-wild examples.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了QuacamFM，一个基于四元数约束的流匹配框架，用于从多视图图像中估计相机姿态。它通过保持单位四元数表示并利用球面线性插值，提高了稀疏视图下相机姿态估计的准确性。
AI.motivation: 传统方法（如SfM）在稀疏视图下由于几何约束不足导致相机姿态估计存在固有歧义。最近的概率模型（如扩散模型）生成多个姿态假设以捕捉不确定性，但大多数方法使用单位四元数表示旋转时，在生成过程中将其视为无约束的4D向量，忽略了单位范数约束，导致生成轨迹不光滑且次优。
AI.method: 论文提出了QuacamFM，一个四元数约束的流匹配框架。它在整个流轨迹中保持单位四元数表示，并使用光滑的球面线性插值设计四元数流的最优传输。该方法在CO3Dv2数据集上进行了实验。
AI.result: 实验表明，QuacamFM在相机姿态准确性上优于基于扩散的方法和经典SfM方法。此外，四元数约束的公式在稀疏视图相机姿态估计上优于将标准流匹配直接应用于4D四元数向量的朴素方法。最后，QuacamFM在不同数据集和野外示例中表现出良好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: QuacamFM通过保持四元数的单位范数约束，改进了稀疏视图下的相机姿态估计，并在多个数据集上展示了优越性能和泛化能力。

title: Can Open-Weight Large Language Models (LLMs) Simulate Human Survey Populations? A Cross-Instrument Calibration Study
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate synthetic survey respondents and digital twins of real people, but whether their output preserves real human statistical structure, rather than surface plausibility, remains unresolved, and most existing evidence comes from proprietary models rather than open-weight ones. We evaluate three open-weight LLM families on a cross-instrument calibration task: conditioning personas on real respondents' verbatim answers to one psychometric instrument and measuring them on a second, construct-distance-controlled instrument, checked against a 2,058-person human panel. Across a 139-pair grid, the simulated cross-instrument correlation tracks the real human correlation at r = 0.70 - 0.73 in every model, driven mainly by correct sign rather than precise magnitude and concentrated in pairs of moderate construct distance. A correlation of this magnitude, obtained from untuned open-weight models conditioned only on individual-level survey data, is a substantively encouraging result for LLM-based behavioral simulation and digital-twin applications: specific model families and releases already reproduce a meaningful share of real human cross-instrument structure without any fine-tuning. This capability does not, however, improve monotonically across model releases: on a matched panel, the newest of three tested Llama releases performs worst on two of three headline metrics, so realizing its promise in practice requires release-specific, distance-aware verification rather than a one-time benchmark.

AI.tldr: 评估三个开放权重LLM家族在跨工具校准任务中模拟人类心理测量反应的能力，发现其能复现真实人类跨工具相关结构（r≈0.70-0.73），但模型版本间并非单调提升。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多用于生成合成调查对象和数字孪生，但能否保留真实人类统计结构而非表面合理性尚不清楚，且现有证据多来自专有模型而非开放权重模型。
AI.method: 在跨工具校准任务上评估三个开放权重LLM家族：以真实受访者对某一心理测量工具的逐字回答作为角色条件，在第二个构念距离受控的工具上测量，并与2058人的人类面板对照，分析139对工具网格。
AI.result: 模拟的跨工具相关性与真实人类相关性达到r=0.70-0.73，主要由符号正确驱动而非精确幅度，且集中在中等构念距离的对上。最新Llama版本在三个主要指标中的两个上表现最差。
AI.conclusion: 未经微调的开放权重模型仅基于个体调查数据就能复现相当比例的真实人类跨工具结构，对行为模拟和数字孪生应用是鼓舞人心的；但能力不随版本单调提升，需要针对特定版本和构念距离的验证，而非一次性基准测试。

title: Quantile Head for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models integrate pretrained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) with action heads for robot control. Common action heads have distinct limitations: point regression provides only a point estimate of the action distribution, while standard flow-matching samplers require costly iterative sampling. To address these limitations, we unify regression and flow matching under a shared objective and extend it to derive a quantile objective. This quantile objective guides the design of our Quantile Head, which predicts a median and positive gaps to form ordered marginal action quantiles in one forward pass. These quantiles support multiple sampling strategies without retraining and are jointly supervised to train the default median policy. Our local analysis of this joint supervision shows that, with calibrated nearby quantiles, fixed gaps, and matched correction speed, direct median updates have lower variance than under median-only supervision. Experiments show that this jointly supervised median policy achieves the highest average success rates among the compared methods on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, LIBERO-Pro, and two real-robot tasks, together with the shortest mean episode time among matched LIBERO baselines; code is available at https://github.com/xwangrs/Quantile-Head-for-VLA.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Quantile Head，将回归与流匹配统一为同一目标并扩展出分位数目标，使 VLA 模型单次前向即可预测有序的边缘动作分位数，从而支持多种采样策略。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 模型的动作头存在明显局限：点回归仅给出动作分布的点估计；标准流匹配采样器需要高昂的迭代采样成本。
AI.method: 将回归与流匹配统一在共享目标下，并扩展推导出分位数目标；据此设计 Quantile Head，一次前向预测中位数及正间隔，形成有序的边缘动作分位数；这些分位数无需重训练即可支持多种采样策略，并通过联合监督训练默认中位数策略；还对联合监督进行了局部分析。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus、LIBERO-Pro 以及两个真机任务上，联合监督的中位数策略取得最高平均成功率；在匹配的 LIBERO 基线中平均回合时间最短。
AI.conclusion: 联合监督的中位数策略在成功率与推理效率上均优于对比方法，验证了分位数目标与 Quantile Head 的有效性。

title: Seeing Parts, Reasoning about Worlds: Visual Inference under Partial Observation
summary: World modeling under partial observation requires reasoning about the complete worlds that remain compatible with limited visual evidence. Occluded objects and unseen regions can leave several world states possible; additional views can exclude alternatives and strengthen the conclusions supported by the observations. We introduce WorldScope to study this process through possible-world semantics, evidence-grounded data, and learned visual representations. WorldScope-1.2M provides 1.2 million English question-answer pairs spanning eight world properties, ten task interfaces, and three observation protocols. Its answers encode confirmed facts, supported bounds, and unresolved possibilities. Complementary supervision comprises 4,800 certified counterworld groups with equivalent base observations and different hidden object configurations and query answers. These groups provide physical witnesses of ambiguity and training-only labels for world compatibility and view-induced exclusions. We propose WorldFlow, which composes cross-view entity evidence and support-surface coverage into an image-subset evidence lattice. Counterworld compatibility and transition objectives train subset representations to reflect how new observations constrain possible worlds. A shared answer generator uses these representations to predict the strongest supported conclusion. WorldScope-Bench evaluates claim judgments and evidence-dependent conclusions as views are selected, combined, removed, or ordered. On its 5,000-question test set, WorldFlow reaches 64.34% exact accuracy, improving over the same backbone trained on QA alone by 24.88 percentage points. It retains 50.43% accuracy on the 3,000 questions from structure-disjoint scenes.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 WorldScope 数据集与基准，以及 WorldFlow 方法，研究部分观测下基于可能世界语义的视觉世界建模，通过证据格与反世界监督预测当前观测所支持的最强结论。
AI.motivation: 部分观测中遮挡和未见区域会留下多个可能世界，额外视角可排除替代解释并增强结论；但缺乏系统化数据、基准和能显式建模这一过程的视觉表示方法。
AI.method: 构建 WorldScope-1.2M，包含120万英文问答、8类世界属性、10种任务接口和3种观测协议，并标注确认事实、支持边界和未决可能性；提供4,800组认证反世界用于模糊性与视图排除监督。提出 WorldFlow，将跨视角实体证据和支持表面覆盖组合为图像子集证据格，用反世界兼容性和转移目标训练子集表示，再由共享答案生成器预测最强支持结论。WorldScope-Bench 评估视图选择、组合、移除或排序下的主张判断与证据依赖结论。
AI.result: 在5,000题测试集上，WorldFlow 达到64.34%精确准确率，比同一骨干仅用问答训练提升24.88个百分点；在3,000题结构不相交场景上仍保持50.43%准确率。
AI.conclusion: 可能世界语义、反世界监督和证据格表示能有效支持部分观测下证据依赖的世界建模，并提升模型在多视图变化下判断最强支持结论的能力。

title: REMEDY: How Far Is Video Generation from Medical Education World Models?
summary: Recent video generation models produce realistic videos and show potential as a foundation for world models. These advances create opportunities for generating medical teaching demonstrations, which requires both convincing visual quality and precise procedural actions. However, whether current generators can meet these requirements has not been measured. To address this problem, we introduce Readiness Evaluation of Medical Education Demonstration sYnthesis (REMEDY), to our knowledge, the first benchmark for AI-generated medical teaching demonstrations. REMEDY provides 900 first frames from real demonstration videos, covering 12 tasks across four scenarios: operating room, imaging, clinic and bedside, and resuscitation. Five contemporary open-source video generation models produce 4,500 videos from these frames. We combine task-specific clinical checklists with video and motion quality metrics. Evaluation covers four dimensions: clinical action following, clinical profiles, video quality, and motion quality. Our results show that realistic appearance and temporal consistency do not ensure correct clinical actions. Even the most advanced MiniMax-H3 achieves only 28.25% on strict clinical success rate, and fine-grained clinical actions remain challenging. These findings establish a foundation and roadmap for developing future medical education world models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出REMEDY，这是首个用于评估AI生成医学教学演示的基准，通过900个真实演示视频首帧和5个开源视频生成模型生成的4500个视频，从临床动作、临床特征、视频质量和运动质量四个维度进行评估，发现现有模型在临床动作正确性上表现较差。
AI.motivation: 近期视频生成模型发展迅速，有望作为世界模型的基础，并可用于生成医学教学演示。然而，生成医学教学演示不仅需要逼真的视觉质量，还需要精确的程序性动作。当前生成模型能否满足这些要求尚未得到系统测量。
AI.method: 提出REMEDY基准，包含来自真实演示视频的900个首帧，覆盖手术室、影像、诊所与床边、复苏四大场景的12项任务。使用5个当代开源视频生成模型生成4500个视频。评估结合任务特定的临床检查表以及视频与运动质量指标，涵盖四个维度：临床动作遵循、临床特征、视频质量和运动质量。
AI.result: 结果表明，逼真的外观和时间一致性并不能保证正确的临床动作。即使最先进的MiniMax-H3在严格临床成功率上也仅达到28.25%，细粒度临床动作仍然具有挑战性。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现为开发未来的医学教育世界模型奠定了基础并提供了路线图。

title: Business Compromise Detection with Agentic AI and LLM-driven Knowledge Discovery
comment: Accepted at EMNLP 2026. 13 pages, 2 figures, 10 tables
summary: Detecting compromised business ad accounts is a challenge in digital advertising, as attackers exploit hijacked accounts to launch fraudulent campaigns. Large Language Model (LLM) agents show promise for integrity enforcement, but hallucinated mistakes on hard cases create business friction. In a study we find the autonomous agent is a strong, recall-heavy signal extractor but an unreliable final arbiter, conceding precision on ambiguous decisions. We therefore keep the agent as an investigator that emits a structured, interpretable signal vector, and delegate the verdict to a neuro-symbolic stage: symbolic rules discovered by Inductive Logic Programming (FOIL-IE), a Naïve Bayes calibration layer, and a data-tuned contradiction layer. Evaluating on a compromise-over-sampled population and a realistic low-prevalence sample with subject-matter-expert labels, this arbiter substitution raises MCC from 0.295 to 0.435 (ΔMCC +0.139, 95% CI [+0.026, +0.245], p=0.018, paired bootstrap), lifting precision from 0.250 to 0.446 (1.8x) at a recall cost (0.920 to 0.660). Benchmarked under identical conditions, it also edge tree ensembles (0.386).The rules encode domain w labels while remaininginterpretable and auditable.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对被入侵商业广告账户检测，提出不让LLM代理直接做最终裁决，而是让LLM代理提取结构化信号，再由神经符号仲裁器（ILP规则、Naïve Bayes校准、矛盾层）做最终判定。在专家标注数据上，该方法将MCC从0.295提升到0.435，精确率从0.250提升到0.446，但召回率从0.920降至0.660。
AI.motivation: 检测被劫持的广告账户是数字广告中的难点，攻击者利用被盗账户发起欺诈活动。LLM代理在完整性执法中有潜力，但在困难案例上的幻觉错误会造成业务摩擦，因此需要更可靠的最终裁决机制。
AI.method: 将LLM代理定位为调查者，输出结构化、可解释的信号向量；最终裁决交给神经符号阶段，包括归纳逻辑编程（FOIL-IE）发现的符号规则、Naïve Bayes校准层和数据调优的矛盾层。在 compromise-over-sampled 人群和真实低 prevalence 样本上，使用领域专家标签进行评估。
AI.result: 仲裁器替换使MCC从0.295提升至0.435（ΔMCC +0.139，95% CI [+0.026, +0.245]，p=0.018，配对bootstrap）；精确率从0.250提升至0.446（1.8倍），召回率从0.920降至0.660。相同条件下也优于树集成模型（0.386）。
AI.conclusion: LLM代理适合作为高召回信号提取器，但不适合作为最终仲裁者。将裁决委托给可解释、可审计的神经符号仲裁器，可在牺牲部分召回的情况下显著提升精确率与整体MCC，更适合广告账户完整性执法场景。

title: AD-E2E-JEPA: A Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture For End-to-End Autonomous Driving
summary: Autonomous driving requires \textit{world models} that can understand the physical world, reason and plan, and operate safely. In this paper, we first systematically evaluate existing action-conditioned joint-embedding predictive architecture (JEPA) world models, including LeWM, DINO-WM, and JEPA-WM for end-to-end autonomous driving (E2EAD). To isolate world-model quality from policy learning, we employ a goal-conditioned zero-shot planning setting that evaluates these models using ground-truth future observations as goals, without training any driving policy. We find that existing JEPA-based world models are either accurate for driving but computationally expensive, or computationally efficient but insufficient for planning. To address this trade-off, we propose \textbf{AD-E2E-JEPA}, which introduces a SIGReg-regularized learnable projector applied to projected patch embeddings. The projector reduces the number of planning patches by $16\times$ and the embedding dimension by $4\times$, achieving a $100\times$ inference speedup while retaining planning performance, with a 0.8-second runtime for an 8-frame rollout over 256 candidate trajectories. \textit{Without} training any driving policy, the world model itself reaches the goals located 20 meters away on average within the displacement of respectively 4.0/2.8 meters, using world-model rollouts over trajectory vocabularies of respectively 256/8,192 candidates. On the NAVSIMv2 benchmark, it achieves 67.3/72.9 EPDMS with multiplicative safety metrics and 84.1/86.5 EPDMS$^{\dagger}$ without them in goal-conditioned zero-shot planning. Experiments further show that the self-supervised pretrained projector improves downstream imitation learning performance from 80.2 to 85.4 EPDMS. The source code is available at https://github.com/HaoranZhuExplorer/AD-E2E-JEPA

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了 LeWM、DINO-WM、JEPA-WM 等动作条件 JEPA 世界模型在端到端自动驾驶中的表现，并提出 AD-E2E-JEPA，通过 SIGReg 正则化可学习投影器大幅降低计算量，在零样本目标条件规划中保持性能并提升下游模仿学习。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶需要能理解物理世界、推理规划并安全运行的 world models。现有 JEPA 世界模型要么规划准确但计算昂贵，要么高效但规划能力不足，存在精度与效率的权衡。
AI.method: 在目标条件零样本规划设置下评估现有 JEPA 世界模型，不训练驾驶策略，以真实未来观测为目标。提出 AD-E2E-JEPA，在投影 patch embeddings 上引入 SIGReg 正则化的可学习投影器，减少规划 patch 数量 16 倍、嵌入维度 4 倍，并实现 100 倍推理加速。
AI.result: AD-E2E-JEPA 对 256 条候选轨迹的 8 帧 rollout 运行时间为 0.8 秒。不训练驾驶策略时，世界模型自身在平均 20 米远目标上分别达到 4.0/2.8 米位移误差，使用 256/8,192 条候选轨迹词表。NAVSIMv2 上，目标条件零样本规划达到 67.3/72.9 EPDMS（含乘性安全指标）和 84.1/86.5 EPDMS†（不含）。自监督预训练投影器将下游模仿学习从 80.2 提升至 85.4 EPDMS。
AI.conclusion: AD-E2E-JEPA 缓解了现有 JEPA 世界模型在自动驾驶中精度与效率的权衡，在保持规划性能的同时显著加速，并证明自监督预训练投影器可提升下游模仿学习性能，代码已开源。

title: GSM: Efficient Language Modeling with Shared Global State
summary: Efficient language models must reduce not only the cost of individual accesses to past context but also the overhead of repeatedly selecting and processing historical information across layers. We introduce the Global State Model (GSM), a causal encoder--decoder architecture that concentrates the selection and aggregation of long-range information in the encoding stage. Through multiple stages of history retrieval, the encoder progressively incorporates long-range information into representations at recent positions, forming a shared state with a fixed window size. Each decoder layer accesses this same state using queries updated from the preceding layer, preserving computational depth while avoiding repeated construction of historical key--value (KV) representations and long-range indexing. As a result, neither the decoder's per-step attention cost nor its KV cache size grows with the history length. Experiments show that GSM improves computational efficiency and reduces cache overhead while maintaining model performance and the ability to use long-range information, offering a shared-state architecture for efficient language modeling.

AI.tldr: 提出全局状态模型（GSM），一种因果编码器-解码器架构，将长距离信息的选取与聚合集中在编码阶段，形成固定窗口的共享状态，供各解码层复用，从而提升语言模型效率并降低缓存开销。
AI.motivation: 高效语言模型不仅要降低单次访问历史上下文的成本，还要减少跨层重复选择和处理历史信息的开销。
AI.method: GSM 通过编码器多阶段历史检索，将长距离信息逐步融入最近位置表示，形成固定窗口大小的共享状态；每个解码层用上一层更新后的查询访问同一状态，避免重复构建历史 KV 表示和长距离索引。
AI.result: 实验表明，GSM 提升了计算效率并减少了缓存开销，同时保持模型性能和使用长距离信息的能力。
AI.conclusion: GSM 为高效语言建模提供了一种共享状态架构，使解码器每步注意力成本和 KV 缓存大小不随历史长度增长。

title: Prediction Limits and Koopman Closure of Geometry-Induced Soft State Abstractions
summary: We study when geometry-induced soft state abstractions admit accurate finite-dimensional linear dynamics. Each state is represented by simplex-valued coordinates obtained from class-specific Kernel Affine Hull Machine (KAHM) reconstruction scores, and a matrix is used to predict the next-state coordinates. Our main result is a computable lower confidence bound on the minimum root-mean-square prediction error over all matrices satisfying a prescribed spectral-norm limit. The bound combines within-class variation of successor coordinates with the deviation of soft coordinates from their one-hot reference labels, and can be evaluated from independent state-successor pairs without fitting a prediction matrix. For fixed coordinates and evaluation distribution, the certificate converges almost surely to a population lower bound as the sample size grows; any tolerance below this limit is eventually certified unattainable. Reconstruction-score margins further control the soft-to-hard assignment error. Under deterministic dynamics and exact coordinate closure, eigenvectors of the closure matrix and its reduced transpose induce Koopman and adjoint Koopman eigenfunctions, respectively. A four-state KAHM construction shows that identical soft coordinates can permit exact closure under one dynamics map yet force positive prediction error under another. Experiments on Duffing, Van der Pol, CartPole, MountainCar, and Acrobot compare direct soft-coordinate prediction with state-space DMD/EDMD baselines and report prediction, representation-variation, and spectral diagnostics. The benchmarks assess fitted models but do not numerically evaluate the exclusion certificate.

AI.tldr: 本文研究几何诱导的软状态抽象何时能支持准确的有限维线性动力学；提出一个可计算的下置信界，用于判断在给定谱范数限制下线性预测矩阵的最小均方根误差是否无法低于某容差。
AI.motivation: 软状态抽象（如基于KAHM重构分数的单纯形坐标）常用于学习低维表示，但其是否真正适合线性动力学预测尚不明确，需要可计算的诊断工具来界定线性模型的可达精度极限。
AI.method: 用类特定KAHM重构分数构造单纯形软坐标，并用矩阵预测下一状态坐标；在谱范数约束下推导最小RMSE的可计算下置信界。该界结合后继坐标的类内变化与软坐标相对one-hot标签的偏差，可由独立状态-后继对直接估计。理论上分析样本量增大时的几乎必然收敛、重构分数间隔对软硬分配误差的控制，以及确定性动力学和精确坐标闭包下闭包矩阵及其缩减转置的特征向量与Koopman/伴随Koopman特征函数的关系。实验在Duffing、Van der Pol、CartPole、MountainCar、Acrobot上比较直接软坐标预测与状态空间DMD/EDMD基线。
AI.result: 得到可计算的下置信界：随着样本量增长，证书几乎必然收敛到总体下界；若目标容差低于该极限，最终可证明其不可达。重构分数间隔可控制软到硬分配误差。四状态KAHM构造表明，相同软坐标在一种动力学映射下可实现精确闭包，而在另一种下会强制产生正预测误差。实验报告了预测、表示变化和谱诊断，并比较了与DMD/EDMD基线的表现。
AI.conclusion: 几何诱导的软状态抽象并不总能保证准确的有限维线性动力学；所提证书可为线性预测误差提供可计算的排除性下界。精确闭包与Koopman特征函数存在理论联系，但基准实验仅评估拟合模型，并未数值评估该排除证书。

title: Rethinking Token Reweighting for SFT: Suppress, Reverse, and Extrapolate Learned Features
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) learns most aggressively from tokens that the model deems least likely. This helps acquire new behaviors, but also amplifies noisy or conflicting supervision and can overwrite useful pretrained knowledge. Through a unified policy-loss view, we revisit existing token-reweighting methods and show that they assign nonnegative coefficients to demonstrated tokens. Consequently, they can suppress or amplify supervised updates, but cannot reverse harmful features once learned. Moreover, larger training weights do not amount to feature extrapolation, since they change the optimization trajectory rather than scale a fixed SFT direction. We argue that reversal and extrapolation require a stable reference frame defined by a fixed SFT delta. Motivated by this, we propose SCALE (Selective Control of Adaptation via Local Entropy), an entropy-guided adaptation-strength-control method that freezes the pretrained model and the SFT delta and learns bounded token- and module-specific gates by minimizing predictive entropy alone. These gates suppress, reverse, or extrapolate frozen SFT features according to their alignment with entropy reduction. Across Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B, Qwen2.5-Math-7B, and Qwen3-4B-Base, SCALE achieves mathematical-reasoning averages of 37.84, 43.60, and 36.57, exceeding the strongest corresponding baselines while remaining competitive on general-retention benchmarks. It also attains the best average code-generation performance across HumanEval, HumanEval+, and MBPP for all three models. These results suggest that effective SFT correction can benefit from controlling how already learned residuals are used, rather than only modifying how they are learned.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SCALE，一种熵引导的自适应强度控制方法：冻结预训练模型和 SFT delta，学习有界 token 与模块门控，仅通过最小化预测熵来抑制、反转或外推已学 SFT 特征。在多个 Qwen 模型上提升数学推理和代码生成，并保持通用能力。
AI.motivation: 监督微调会最激进地学习模型认为最不可能的词元，这虽能获得新行为，却会放大噪声或冲突监督，甚至覆盖有用的预训练知识。现有 token 重加权方法给演示词元分配非负系数，只能抑制或放大监督更新，无法反转已学有害特征；增大权重也只是改变优化轨迹，而非沿固定 SFT 方向外推。因此需要稳定参考系来实现反转与外推。
AI.method: 通过统一 policy-loss 视角重新审视现有 token 重加权方法。提出 SCALE（Selective Control of Adaptation via Local Entropy）：冻结预训练模型与 SFT delta，学习有界的 token 级和模块级门控，仅以最小化预测熵为目标，使门控根据与熵降低的对齐程度来抑制、反转或外推冻结的 SFT 特征。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B、Qwen2.5-Math-7B 和 Qwen3-4B-Base 上，SCALE 的数学推理平均分分别为 37.84、43.60 和 36.57，超过对应最强基线；在通用保持基准上保持竞争力；并在三个模型的 HumanEval、HumanEval+ 和 MBPP 上取得最佳平均代码生成性能。
AI.conclusion: 有效的 SFT 修正不仅应控制残差如何被学习，还应控制已学习的残差如何被使用；SCALE 的结果支持这一方向。

title: MixBench-TS: A Multivariate Time Series Forecasting Benchmark Where Channel Mixing Pays Off
summary: Multivariate Time Series Forecasting (MTSF) models that mix information across channels assume that the past of one channel carries information about the future of another. Yet they are evaluated on a small fixed set of standard datasets whose cross-channel structure is rarely examined. We ask two questions: "How can we reliably measure lagged, non-linear, and joint coupling in MTSF datasets?" and "Do the standard datasets actually have such coupling?" To answer the first, we test four candidate measures on synthetic datasets with planted ground-truth coupling: Granger Causality (GC), Transfer Entropy (TE), lagged Mutual Information (MI), and the CD gain, a model-based measure we introduce that compares a channel-dependent (CD) model to its channel-independent (CI) variant. Only lagged MI and the CD gain recover every planted coupling. For the second question, the answer is a definite no, as the standard datasets have a median of only 23% lagged-coupled channel pairs and a median CD gain of -4.9%, compared to 78% and +4.6% on chaotic ODE systems. We therefore propose MixBench-TS, a benchmark of 10 real-world datasets with a median of 55.5% lagged-coupled pairs and a median CD gain of +1.7%. Across six state-of-the-art models tuned under one protocol, CI models win on 10/10 (MSE) and 8/10 (MAE) standard datasets, but on only 3/10 and 2/10 MixBench-TS datasets. We recommend using our benchmark for evaluating new CD models. Moreover, we propose profiling new datasets with lagged MI and the CD gain before using them to evaluate multivariate models. Code and data are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/mixbench-ts-B027.

AI.tldr: 论文质疑多变量时间序列预测中跨通道混合模型的常用评估数据集是否真的存在跨通道耦合，提出衡量耦合的指标，并发布 MixBench-TS 基准。结果显示标准数据集跨通道耦合较弱，通道独立模型常优于通道依赖模型；新基准耦合更强，更适合评估跨通道模型。
AI.motivation: 多变量时间序列预测模型混合不同通道信息，假设一个通道的过去能预测另一个通道的未来，但标准数据集很少被检验是否真有这种跨通道结构，可能导致评估不可靠。
AI.method: 先在带已知耦合的合成数据上比较四种耦合度量：格兰杰因果、转移熵、滞后互信息和作者提出的 CD gain。CD gain 通过比较通道依赖模型与其通道独立变体来衡量跨通道信息增益。随后用有效度量分析标准数据集，并构建 MixBench-TS 基准，包含 10 个真实数据集；在统一调参协议下评测六种先进模型。
AI.result: 只有滞后互信息和 CD gain 能恢复所有植入耦合。标准数据集耦合较弱：滞后耦合通道对中位数为 23%，CD gain 中位数为 -4.9%；混沌 ODE 系统则为 78% 和 +4.6%。MixBench-TS 的中位滞后耦合对为 55.5%，CD gain 为 +1.7%。通道独立模型在标准数据集上 10/10 的 MSE 和 8/10 的 MAE 获胜，但在 MixBench-TS 上仅 3/10 和 2/10 获胜。
AI.conclusion: 建议使用 MixBench-TS 评估新的通道依赖模型；在使用数据集评估多变量模型前，应先用滞后互信息和 CD gain 分析其跨通道耦合程度。代码和数据已公开。

title: Can Motion-Language Models Ground Structure? STRIDE for Evaluating the Evaluators
summary: Motion-language models are typically scored by motion-language evaluators, but how well these evaluators ground language structure remains unclear. Here, we introduce the Structure grounding via Temporal-order, Reflection, and Identity Diagnostic Evaluation (STRIDE) benchmark to systematically evaluate the ability of evaluators to track temporal order, mirror reflection, and action identity. STRIDE comprises $5{,}869$ triples, each consisting of a motion, its original caption, and a perturbed caption, spanning both short and long descriptions. We likelihood-balance caption pairs to reduce text-only bias and estimate each evaluator's caption preference under unrelated motions to measure the discrimination gain from matched motions relative to this baseline. Our experiments reveal weak structural grounding and severe deficits in mirror sensitivity among the audited evaluators, which commonly used evaluation protocols fail to expose. To understand why these limitations go undetected in standard tests, we examine the evaluators more closely. We find that text-only priors alone can solve naive perturbation tests on existing datasets, while common retrieval and distributional metrics barely respond to structural corruption introduced by mirroring ground-truth motions. These findings suggest a natural intervention: structural hard negatives. Our experiments show that a simple modification to contrastive learning substantially improves performance on temporal order and mirror reflection. The benchmark and code will be released.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 STRIDE 基准，系统评估运动-语言评估器对时间顺序、镜像反射和动作身份的结构化语言 grounding 能力，发现现有评估器结构 grounding 薄弱且镜像敏感性严重不足，并提出结构化硬负样本作为改进方向。
AI.motivation: 运动-语言模型通常由运动-语言评估器打分，但这些评估器是否真正理解语言结构尚不清晰，尤其是时间顺序、镜像反射和动作身份等关键结构信息。
AI.method: 构建 STRIDE 基准，包含 5,869 个三元组，每个由运动、原始描述和扰动描述组成，覆盖短文本和长文本；对描述对进行 likelihood-balance 以减少纯文本偏差，并通过无关运动下的描述偏好作为基线，衡量匹配运动带来的判别增益。
AI.result: 实验显示被审计评估器结构 grounding 较弱，镜像敏感性严重不足，且常用评估协议无法暴露这些问题；纯文本先验即可解决现有数据集上的朴素扰动测试，常见检索和分布指标对镜像真值运动引入的结构破坏几乎不敏感。
AI.conclusion: 标准评测会掩盖结构 grounding 缺陷，而引入结构化硬负样本是一种自然干预；实验表明，对对比学习做简单修改即可显著提升时间顺序和镜像反射任务表现，基准和代码将公开。

title: DISCO: Distributed Long Context Scaling with Grounding-Reasoning Disaggregation
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) advertise million-token context windows, reasoning quality often collapses as inputs grow -- a phenomenon termed context rot. This failure stems from a structural entanglement in monolithic architectures, where the massive search burden of contextual grounding exhausts the representational capacity needed for complex reasoning. To resolve this, we propose Grounding-Reasoning Disaggregation via DIStributed long COntext scaling (DISCO). Inspired by distributed computing frameworks like Apache Spark, DISCO partitions long context across a fleet of Worker LLMs dedicated exclusively to parallel, localized grounding. A central Driver LLM, trained via Reinforcement Learning (GRPO) to optimize planning, orchestrates execution by dynamically mapping queries into atomic extraction tasks and reducing the gathered evidence to synthesize a final answer. By isolating reasoning from raw context noise, DISCO effectively eliminates context rot. On RULER-QA (1M tokens), it maintains 78.4% accuracy where standard baselines collapse. Furthermore, it outperforms full-context models by up to 9.8 points on LongBench v2 and matches frontier models like Gemini-3-Pro-Preview while reducing inference costs by over 80%, establishing a highly efficient paradigm for robust long-context inference.

AI.tldr: 提出DISCO框架，将长上下文中的 grounding 与 reasoning 解耦：多个Worker LLM并行做局部定位，Driver LLM经GRPO强化学习进行规划与汇总，从而缓解 context rot。
AI.motivation: LLM虽宣称支持百万token上下文，但输入增长时推理质量常急剧下降，即 context rot；其根源在于单体架构中，大规模上下文 grounding 的搜索负担耗尽了复杂推理所需的表征能力。
AI.method: 借鉴Apache Spark等分布式计算框架，DISCO将长上下文分片给一组Worker LLM，专门并行执行局部 grounding；中心Driver LLM通过GRPO强化学习训练，动态将查询映射为原子抽取任务，并对收集到的证据进行归约以合成最终答案。
AI.result: 在RULER-QA 1M token上保持78.4%准确率，而标准基线崩溃；在LongBench v2上比全上下文模型高至多9.8分；性能匹配Gemini-3-Pro-Preview等前沿模型，同时推理成本降低超过80%。
AI.conclusion: DISCO通过隔离推理与原始上下文噪声，有效消除 context rot，为鲁棒且高效的长上下文推理建立了一种新范式。

title: Beyond Retrieval Relevance: Scene-Grounded Risk Entailment for Vision-Language Driving
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) gives vision--language driving systems access to external safety knowledge, yet a retrieved risk rule may be relevant without applying to the current scene. A vision--language model (VLM) receiving such knowledge must ground objects, bind entities across time, and verify relations before deciding how to act, leaving the support for risk conclusions implicit. We address this relevance--applicability gap with a Driving-Risk Knowledge Graph (DRKG) and Semantic Web Rule Language (SWRL) reasoning stage before VLM decision-making. Structured perception instantiates scene facts, from which SWRL rules derive events and directed risk relations when their antecedents are jointly satisfied. Recognized events, bound risk relations, and semantic descriptions of activated rules form compact evidence that conditions the VLM and diffusion planner. In matched comparisons on nuReasoning, our method improved the nuReasoning planning score (NPS) by 1.30 points and the non-at-fault collision score (NC) by 2.76 points over the relevance retrieval-based baseline. These gains indicate that scene-applicable risk evidence improves safety-weighted planning relative to semantically retrieved risk knowledge.

AI.tldr: 针对视觉-语言驾驶系统中检索到的风险规则可能相关但不适用于当前场景的问题，提出驾驶风险知识图谱（DRKG）与SWRL推理阶段，在VLM决策前生成场景适用的风险证据，以提升安全规划。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成（RAG）为驾驶系统提供外部安全知识，但检索到的风险规则可能语义相关却不适用于当前场景。VLM需grounding对象、跨时间绑定实体并验证关系，风险结论的支持是隐式的。
AI.method: 构建驾驶风险知识图谱（DRKG），并引入语义网规则语言（SWRL）推理。结构化感知实例化场景事实，SWRL规则在前件联合满足时推导事件与有向风险关系。识别的事件、绑定的风险关系及激活规则的语义描述构成紧凑证据，用于条件化VLM与扩散规划器。
AI.result: 在nuReasoning数据集上，相比基于相关性检索的基线，NPS提升1.30分，NC提升2.76分。
AI.conclusion: 场景适用的风险证据相比语义检索的风险知识，能改善安全加权规划性能。

title: Back-Tracking from Clarity: Self-Learning to See Text from Afar
summary: We propose a self-supervised framework designed to enhance the capability of scene text detectors in identifying and recognizing text in scenarios where instances are shown at significant distances, typically small, blurred, and frequently missed by conventional models. Our approach leverages the high-fidelity performance of existing text spotting models on large, clear text as a foundational supervisor. By temporally back-tracking these high-confidence detections through video sequences, we automatically synthesize pseudo-labels for preceding frames where the distant text is still visually degraded or undersized. These pseudo-labels enable training a student model specialized for early text detection, without requiring any manual annotation. The success of this approach depends on accurate pseudo-label generation, for which we develop a dedicated scene text tracker capable of maintaining consistent text identities across challenging video sequences. In addition, we propose SceneText50, a diverse multilingual outdoor dataset to facilitate training and evaluation. Experiments show that our framework significantly improves early detection accuracy and robustness across varied scenes and languages. Code and data are at \href{https://github.com/trid2912/BackTrackingText}{https://github.com/trid2912/BackTrackingText}.

AI.tldr: 提出一种自监督框架，利用视频时序回溯高置信文本检测生成伪标签，提升远距离、小且模糊文本的早期检测能力，并构建 SceneText50 多语言户外数据集。
AI.motivation: 现有场景文本检测模型对远距离、小、模糊文本容易漏检，而这类退化帧的人工标注成本高、难以获取。
AI.method: 以现有文本 spotting 模型在大而清晰文本上的高置信检测为监督，通过视频时序回溯为前序退化帧自动合成伪标签；开发专用场景文本跟踪器以保持跨视频帧的文本身份一致；用伪标签训练专注早期文本检测的学生模型；提出 SceneText50 多语言户外数据集用于训练与评估。
AI.result: 实验表明该框架显著提升了早期文本检测准确率和鲁棒性，并在不同场景和语言下有效。
AI.conclusion: 无需人工标注即可借助视频时序监督提升远距离退化文本检测性能，伪标签生成质量与稳定跟踪是关键；代码与数据已开源。

title: RAVEL: Asynchronous Rolling Inference for Flow-Based Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models are highly effective for generalist robot manipulation, yet their reliance on computationally expensive VLM encoding and multi-step iterative action generation imposes a significant latency bottleneck. The resulting inference latency makes it difficult for robots to respond quickly, especially in dynamic environments. We address this limitation with RAVEL (Rolling Asynchronous VLA Enabling Low-Latency Control), an asynchronous inference framework that addresses the computational bottlenecks of both the VLM backbone and the action expert. To reduce the delay from multi-step action denoising, RAVEL allows near-term actions to be executed after a single denoising step by carrying partially denoised future actions forward in a rolling buffer. To avoid blocking on slow VLM encoding, RAVEL decouples VLM encoding from rolling action generation, allowing the action expert to operate continuously using the latest available VLM context, while a lightweight Fast Observation Pathway (FOP) directly conditions the action expert on current observations. Across simulated and real-world manipulation tasks, RAVEL consistently achieves substantially lower response latency while maintaining the task capability of the underlying VLA, enabling high-frequency and responsive closed-loop control.

AI.tldr: RAVEL 是一种异步推理框架，用于降低 flow-based VLA 机器人操作模型的推理延迟，同时在仿真和真实任务中保持原有任务能力。
AI.motivation: Flow-based VLA 依赖计算昂贵的 VLM 编码和多步迭代动作生成，导致显著延迟，使机器人在动态环境中难以快速响应。
AI.method: RAVEL 通过滚动缓冲区将部分去噪的未来动作向前传递，使近期动作可在单步去噪后执行；并将 VLM 编码与滚动动作生成解耦，让动作专家持续使用最新 VLM 上下文，同时用轻量 Fast Observation Pathway (FOP) 直接以当前观测条件化动作专家。
AI.result: 在仿真和真实机器人操作任务中，RAVEL 持续实现显著更低的响应延迟，并保持底层 VLA 的任务能力，支持高频、响应式的闭环控制。
AI.conclusion: RAVEL 能有效缓解 flow-based VLA 的延迟瓶颈，实现低延迟、响应式机器人操作控制。

title: World Models with Predictable Long-Horizon Marginals
summary: Accurate one-step predictions do not ensure that a world model's rollouts retain the data distribution. We make the model's decoded stationary law explicit by learning a decoder of a fixed Gaussian reference and constraining the behaviour-averaged transition to preserve that reference. For controlled systems, a joint transition uses a conditional action chart to preserve behaviour occupancy without requiring invariance at each fixed action. Joint state--action rotations and parallel Gaussian noise give an exactly preserving transition with a tractable conditional density. We derive an absolute convergence bound from finite initialization banks and control departure from the reference through conditional action-space divergence. Across $216$ fitted pixel checkpoints on twelve control tasks, the occupancy model with a reference mixture retains every evaluated chain at $10^5$ steps in all $36$ task--seed cells, with a rollout-minus-reference energy-statistic difference of $-0.0002\pm0.0003$ (training-seed standard error). Each of the four nonpreserving comparison arms loses chains, although the Gaussian arm is more accurate at ten steps. An offline DreamerV3 reference also achieves better short-horizon accuracy. These results distinguish three properties of a world model: the distribution it approaches, the rate of approach, and the conditional dynamics it learns.

AI.tldr: 论文指出仅准确的一步预测不足以保证世界模型 rollout 保持数据分布；提出将解码器固定为高斯参考并约束行为平均转移来显式保持占据测度，从而在控制任务中实现长期稳定的 rollout。
AI.motivation: 世界模型即使一步预测准确，其多步 rollout 仍可能偏离数据分布。因此需要显式区分模型逼近的分布、逼近速率以及学习到的条件动力学，并让转移保持参考占据测度。
AI.method: 学习固定高斯参考的解码器以显式定义平稳律；约束行为平均转移保持该参考。受控系统中，用条件动作图保持行为占据，而不要求每个固定动作下不变；联合状态-动作旋转与并行高斯噪声构造精确保持且条件密度可处理的转移。还从有限初始化库推导绝对收敛界，并用条件动作空间散度控制偏离参考的程度。
AI.result: 在十二个控制任务、216 个拟合像素检查点上，使用参考混合的占据模型在全部 36 个任务-种子单元中，1e5 步仍保留所有评估链；rollout 与参考的能量统计差为 -0.0002±0.0003。四个非保持对比臂均出现链丢失，尽管高斯臂在十步更准确；离线 DreamerV3 参考也取得更好的短时程精度。
AI.conclusion: 结果区分了世界模型的三个性质：所逼近的分布、逼近速率、所学条件动力学。保持参考分布可显著改善长期 rollout 稳定性，而短时程精度本身不足以代表长期分布保持能力。

title: Reliability-Aware Sparse Route Memory for Round-Trip Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Vision-language navigation (VLN) is typically evaluated as a one-way task, although deployed robots may need to return after reaching a goal. We study continuous round-trip VLN and diagnose failures in directional observability, deviation recovery, and termination stability. We propose a reliability-aware sparse route memory that records the executed Outbound trajectory as ordered geometric anchors and queries them in reverse through a structured hint, action-level arbitration, and terminal verification. On 50 reverse-paired episodes using NaVILA and a simulated Unitree Go2, language-only Return succeeds in 22.0% of episodes, while our online system reaches 55.1%. With exact route information, the same interfaces achieve 86.0%, showing that effective Return requires both accurate information and consistent action on that information. The remaining online gap arises mainly from geometric evidence that is too unreliable to authorise intervention. These results distinguish information quality, behavioural consistency, and online reliability as separate limits in long-horizon navigation.

AI.tldr: 研究连续往返视觉语言导航（VLN），提出一种可靠性感知的稀疏路径记忆，用于机器人到达目标后反向返回起点，并诊断了方向可观测性、偏差恢复和终止稳定性方面的失败原因。
AI.motivation: 现有VLN通常被评估为单向任务，但实际部署的机器人可能需要到达目标后返回，因此需要研究连续往返VLN并解决反向返回中的失败问题。
AI.method: 提出可靠性感知稀疏路径记忆：将已执行的Outbound轨迹记录为有序几何锚点，并通过结构化提示、动作级仲裁和终端验证进行反向查询。
AI.result: 在50个反向配对回合中，使用NaVILA和模拟Unitree Go2，仅语言返回成功率为22.0%，而在线系统达到55.1%；使用精确路径信息时，相同接口可达86.0%。
AI.conclusion: 有效返回需要准确信息和一致动作；剩余在线差距主要来自几何证据不可靠而无法授权干预。研究将信息质量、行为一致性和在线可靠性区分为长时程导航中的独立限制。

title: LLMs Trust Their Own: Identity-Dependent Conformity in Multi-Agent Systems
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in multi-agent settings, where agents observe and influence one another, making social influence a key dimension of AI behavior and safety. We investigate whether LLMs' responses depend on the social identity of other agents, beyond the effect of their consensus. We construct judgment tasks with a single correct answer, and place models in a multi-agent setting where they receive incorrect answers from other agents whose social identities (AI or human, model family, or an arbitrary minimal group) are either shared with or distinct from their own. Across 12 open-weights models and nine tasks, we find a bidirectional effect of group identity on conformity to incorrect answers: in-group consensus increases conformity (in-group favoritism), whereas out-group consensus decreases it (out-group divergence). Unlike humans, for whom one ally breaking the consensus sharply reduces conformity, models are unmoved by an ally from the majority's group. Worse, a correct ally from the opposing group intensifies this bidirectional effect. Chain-of-Thought reasoning suppresses most of these effects, yet an in-group ally still reduces conformity to an incorrect out-group majority. Labeling peers as safety-aligned shifts overall conformity but leaves in-group favoritism and out-group divergence intact. These results show that group identity shapes how LLMs aggregate information across agents, independently of its correctness, and identify a manipulation surface for multi-agent AI systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究考察大语言模型在多智能体环境中，其判断是否会受其他智能体社会身份影响，而不仅仅是受其共识影响。结果发现模型存在内群体从众、外群体背离的双向效应，且与人类不同，盟友身份作用有限。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多部署于多智能体场景，智能体之间会相互观察和影响，因此社会影响成为AI行为与安全的重要维度。作者希望探究LLM的回应是否依赖其他智能体的社会身份，而不仅是多数意见本身。
AI.method: 构建有唯一正确答案的判断任务，将模型置于多智能体环境中，接收来自其他智能体的错误答案。其他智能体的社会身份包括AI或人类、模型家族、任意最小组别，并分为与模型自身共享或不同。测试12个开源权重模型和9类任务，并考察Chain-of-Thought推理及安全对齐标签的影响。
AI.result: 发现群体身份对从众行为有双向影响：内群体共识增加从众，外群体共识减少从众。与人类不同，模型不会因多数群体中的盟友打破共识而明显降低从众；来自对立群体的正确盟友反而强化这种双向效应。Chain-of-Thought推理抑制了大部分效应，但内群体盟友仍会降低对错误外群体多数的从众。将同伴标记为安全对齐会改变整体从众率，但不影响内群体偏袒和外群体背离。
AI.conclusion: 群体身份会独立于信息正确性，塑造LLM在多智能体间聚合信息的方式，并揭示出多智能体AI系统的一个可操纵面。

title: Learning from a Thoughtful Teacher: Adaptive On-Policy Self-Distillation for Mathematical Reasoning
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) trains a question-only student with token-level feedback from a teacher given training-only privileged information (PI). OPSD therefore provides dense, on-policy supervision, and is free of a larger external teacher, but its effectiveness rests on how PI is designed and utilized. Our preliminary diagnostics suggest a significant gap between teacher utility and student learnability, where a small fraction of high-disagreement tokens dominate the distillation signal, and short teacher continuations at these positions further expose more explicit PI leakage than transferable correction cues, indicating a strong intent on injecting PI-conditioned shortcuts. We propose Adaptive On-Policy Self-Distillation (AOPSD), which adapts what information the teacher receives and how strongly its feedback influences learning. AOPSD encodes each solution as a reasoning DAG, orders problems by the student's evolving capability, and reveals only the affordable subgraph and its next frontier as PI. For high-disagreement tokens, AOPSD utilizes short teacher continuations as probes to encourage useful guidance while mitigating PI-conditioned shortcuts among teacher supervisions. On HMMT25, AIME24, AIME25, and BRUMo25, AOPSD achieves 72.5% Pass@8, which is 6.7 percentage points above OPSD and 4.2 above the strongest competing baseline while reducing 15 percentage points of training time at lower cost.

AI.tldr: 本文提出自适应在线策略自蒸馏（AOPSD），通过自适应设计教师可见的特权信息（PI）及其反馈强度，提升在线策略自蒸馏的效果与效率。
AI.motivation: 在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）依赖训练时特权信息（PI）的设计与利用，但教师效用与学生可学习性之间存在显著差距：少量高分歧 token 主导蒸馏信号，且短教师续写在这些位置更易暴露 PI 泄漏与捷径，而非可迁移的纠正线索。
AI.method: AOPSD 自适应调整教师接收的信息和反馈影响强度。它将每个解答编码为推理 DAG，按学生不断变化的能力对问题排序，仅揭示可负担子图及其下一前沿作为 PI。对于高分歧 token，使用短教师续写作为探针，以鼓励有用指导并减轻教师监督中的 PI 条件捷径。
AI.result: 在 HMMT25、AIME24、AIME25 和 BRUMo25 上，AOPSD 达到 72.5% Pass@8，比 OPSD 高 6.7 个百分点，比最强竞争基线高 4.2 个百分点，同时减少 15 个百分点的训练时间且成本更低。
AI.conclusion: AOPSD 通过自适应 PI 与反馈强度，有效缓解 PI 条件捷径问题，提升 OPSD 的性能与训练效率，表明根据学生能力动态提供可学习信息是高收益的蒸馏策略。

title: Contract Memory Compiler: Resolve, Then Traverse
summary: External memory lets language-model agents answer questions about histories too long for the answer model's context window. Updates create a harder problem than retrieving a recent fact: changing one relation can redirect a multi-hop question to records about an entity absent from the question. We study this update-dependent evidence selection problem and introduce the Contract Memory Compiler (CMC). Before seeing a question, CMC uses a language model to identify relations in the history and record where each one was stated. It applies later updates to determine the current relations, follows them from entities named in the question, and passes the corresponding original records to the answer model in one call. Thus the current state determines which evidence is read, rather than merely refreshing values in a previously selected context. To the best of our knowledge, CMC achieves state-of-the-art multi-hop accuracy on FactConsolidation, reaching 78.25% overall and 61.0% at 262K. With the extracted relations and answer model held fixed, selecting evidence before resolving updates reduces multi-hop accuracy to 21.50%. We also introduce MQuAKE-MemStream, a derived dataset of ordered memory streams built from MQuAKE-Remastered counterfactual cases.

AI.tldr: 论文研究外部记忆更新下的多跳问答证据选择问题，提出 Contract Memory Compiler（CMC）。CMC 先识别历史中的关系及其陈述位置，再应用后续更新确定当前关系，并沿问题实体追踪，将对应原始记录一次性传给答案模型。该方法在 FactConsolidation 上取得 SOTA 多跳准确率：总体 78.25%，262K 长度 61.0%；同时提出 MQuAKE-MemStream 数据集。
AI.motivation: 外部记忆让语言模型代理能够回答超出答案模型上下文窗口的长历史问题。但记忆更新比检索近期事实更难：改变一个关系可能使多跳问题转向问题中未出现实体的记录，因此需要研究依赖更新的证据选择问题。
AI.method: 提出 Contract Memory Compiler（CMC）。在未见问题时，CMC 用语言模型识别历史中的关系并记录每条关系的陈述位置；应用后续更新确定当前关系；从问题中命名的实体出发沿这些关系追踪；最终将对应的原始记录在一次调用中传给答案模型。其核心是让当前状态决定读取哪些证据，而不仅是刷新先前已选上下文中的值。此外，构建了来自 MQuAKE-Remastered 反事实案例的有序记忆流数据集 MQuAKE-MemStream。
