AI.result: CMC 在 FactConsolidation 上达到 SOTA 多跳准确率，总体 78.25%，在 262K 长度下为 61.0%。在提取关系和答案模型保持固定时，若在解决更新前选择证据，多跳准确率降至 21.50%。
AI.conclusion: 对于依赖更新的证据选择，应在解析更新后决定读取哪些原始记录。CMC 证明这种先确定当前关系再选择证据的方法能显著提升多跳问答准确率，并优于先选证据再更新值的做法。

title: GeoCR: Learning a Generalist Cloud Removal Prior from Heterogeneous Observations
summary: Cloud removal methods are typically specialized to individual datasets and input configurations, limiting reuse across sensors, spectral bands, and observation settings. We introduce GeoCR, a generalist model that unifies RGB-only-based CR and multispectral-based CR from single- or multi-temporal cloudy observations, with optional SAR guidance, within a single network. To accommodate different spectral and sensing domains, compact input and output stems extend a pretrained RGB autoencoder while keeping its encoder and decoder trunks frozen. This shared latent interface enables a single flow transformer to jointly model clean RGB and non-RGB latents, conditioned on separate cloudy-observation streams and optional SAR tokens. Through joint pretraining on the training splits of ten datasets comprising 883,331 cloud-free target images, GeoCR learns a shared cloud removal prior across these heterogeneous configurations. The same pretrained checkpoint supports direct inference without dataset-specific fine-tuning and efficient adaptation through low-rank adaptation (LoRA). We evaluate GeoCR against general image restoration and cloud removal methods on test splits of the contributing datasets under full-band and RGB-only settings. GeoCR achieves the best FID and DISTS on full-band SEN12MS-CR and Sen2_MTC_New and RGB-only CUHK-CR2, outperforming existing models and demonstrating the effectiveness of a reusable generative model across diverse settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通用去云模型GeoCR，用单一网络统一处理RGB与多光谱、单时相与多时相、可选SAR引导等多种去云配置，在十个数据集共88万余张无云图像上联合预训练，实现无需微调的直接推理与LoRA高效适配。
AI.motivation: 现有去云方法通常针对特定数据集和输入配置专门设计，难以在传感器、光谱波段和观测设置之间复用，缺乏通用性。
AI.method: 基于预训练RGB自编码器，冻结其编解码主干，仅添加紧凑的输入/输出stem以适配不同光谱与传感域；用共享潜空间接口让单个flow transformer联合建模干净RGB与非RGB潜变量，并以独立的多云观测流和可选SAR token为条件；在十个数据集训练集上进行联合预训练，支持直接推理和LoRA微调。
AI.result: 在全波段SEN12MS-CR和Sen2_MTC_New上取得最佳FID与DISTS，在仅RGB的CUHK-CR2上同样最佳，优于通用图像复原方法与现有去云模型。
AI.conclusion: GeoCR证明了可复用的生成式模型能在多样化的去云设置中有效工作，无需针对特定数据集微调即可获得优异表现。

title: E-CONAN (Entailment, CONtradition And Neutral) Diagnostics Dataset Investigating Linguistic Phenomena in Arabic Natural Language Understanding
summary: Natural Language Understanding (NLU) plays a crucial role in various applications, yet its performance suffers from weaknesses in handling the complexities of human languages, ranging from lexical ambiguity to high-level reasoning difficulties. Analyzing errors across diverse linguistic phenomena is crucial for NLU improvement, as it will help humans get insights to comprehensively assess models' limitations and capabilities, so optimizing models' generalization. Notably, several benchmarks contain diagnostics datasets designed for investigation and fine-grained error analysis. When highlighting the gaps in the state-of-the-art, we noted that there is no naming convention for macro and micro categories or even a standard set of linguistic phenomena that should be covered. To overcome this gap, we propose an initial hierarchy for Cross-Lingual NLU error analysis. Moreover, we propose a methodology to create an NLI hierarchical framework and applied a case study on Arabic NLU. Moreover, this paper introduces E-CONAN diagnostics dataset, a freely available dataset manually-annotated with coarse-grained and fine-grained categories based on our proposed Arabic hierarchy. E-CONAN dataset helps NLU designers better understand their models by doing error analysis and in-depth investigation. We used E-CONAN to investigate the performance of 9 pretrained language models and 5 LLMs. Results indicate that LLMs outperform pretrained models in world knowledge and commonsense reasoning macro-category, and underperform pretrained models in syntactic macro-category. Moreover, the hardest phenomena for all models is Reasoning, and the easiest phenomena for all pretrained models is Syntactic, and the easiest for LLMs is Lexico-Syntactic.

AI.tldr: 论文提出跨语言NLU错误分析的分层分类体系，并以阿拉伯语NLU为案例，构建了人工标注的E-CONAN诊断数据集，用于细粒度错误分析，并评估了9个预训练语言模型和5个LLM。
AI.motivation: NLU在处理人类语言复杂性时仍存在不足，包括词汇歧义和高层推理困难；现有诊断数据集缺乏统一的宏观/微观类别命名和标准语言现象覆盖，难以全面评估模型局限与能力。
AI.method: 提出跨语言NLU错误分析的初始层级；提出创建NLI分层框架的方法，并以阿拉伯语NLU进行案例研究；构建E-CONAN诊断数据集，包含粗粒度和细粒度人工标注类别；使用该数据集评估9个预训练模型和5个LLM。
AI.result: LLM在世界知识和常识推理宏观类别上优于预训练模型，但在句法宏观类别上表现不如预训练模型；所有模型最难的语言现象是Reasoning；预训练模型最容易的是Syntactic，LLM最容易的是Lexico-Syntactic。
AI.conclusion: 该层级框架和E-CONAN数据集有助于NLU设计者进行错误分析和深入调查，从而更好地理解模型局限性，并为跨语言NLU误差分析提供初步标准化基础。

title: FailPatch: Failure Residual Patching for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are typically adapted using successful demonstrations, which provide direct action supervision but rarely cover failure-prone states. Deployment failures expose these states, yet lack the corrective actions needed for conventional supervised learning. We propose FailPatch, a failure-driven residual patching framework that decouples action supervision from execution-reliability supervision. Successful demonstrations ground how the policy should act, while deployment trajectories indicate when its behavior becomes unreliable. We further observe that action hidden representations exhibit clear linear separability between reliable and failure-associated states while directly conditioning action generation. Building on these insights, FailPatch introduces a Null-gated Residual Expert Bank into the action hidden space of a frozen VLA policy. A unified Preserve--Redirect--Trust objective retains the original policy in reliable states, selects residual experts in failure-associated states and redirects representations from failure regions toward success-associated regions under bounded intervention. With only 0.52% trainable parameters, FailPatch improves success rates by 11.0 percentage points on four long-horizon RoboTwin tasks under clean evaluation, 9.5 percentage points under clean-to-random generalization, and 16.7 percentage points over the baseline across three real-world tasks. Project and code: https://github.com/yupeng-2003/FailPatch.

AI.tldr: FailPatch 是一种由失败驱动的残差修补框架，通过冻结 VLA 策略并仅在动作隐空间中加入少量可训练专家，实现可靠性与泛化能力提升。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 策略通常只利用成功演示进行适配，虽能提供动作监督，却很少覆盖易失败状态；部署失败虽暴露这些状态，但缺少传统监督学习所需的纠正动作。
AI.method: FailPatch 将动作监督与执行可靠性监督解耦：成功演示定义应如何行动，部署轨迹指示何时行为不可靠。基于动作隐表示中可靠状态与失败状态具有线性可分性的观察，在冻结 VLA 策略的动作隐空间中引入 Null-gated Residual Expert Bank，并使用 Preserve-Redirect-Trust 统一目标，在可靠状态保留原策略，在失败相关状态选择残差专家，并在有限干预下将失败区域表示重定向至成功相关区域。仅 0.52% 参数可训练。
AI.result: 在四个长时程 RoboTwin 任务上，干净评估成功率提升 11.0 个百分点，干净到随机泛化提升 9.5 个百分点；在三个真实世界任务上相对基线提升 16.7 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: FailPatch 能以极少可训练参数有效利用部署失败信息修补冻结 VLA 策略，提升长时程任务成功率与泛化能力。

title: JEPA Learns What the Mask Leaves Unrecoverable
summary: Joint-embedding predictive architectures are unusually sensitive to how the input is masked: block masks work, scattered masks do not, and the explanations are empirical. We give a measurement account. A mask is a linear measurement, and in a compactly supported wavelet basis every atom whose support lies inside the hidden region falls in the measurement's null space and leaves no trace in the data. The JEPA loss asks only that the encoded context suffice for the target, so a target that a low-level prior can recover admits a shortcut, one the moving-average target encoder can make self-consistent. What removes the shortcut is the coarse-scale content the mask leaves unrecoverable, provided enough context stays within reach of each target. We score that content before training and test the account's distinctive predictions in 151 pre-training runs. On ImageNet-100, strip masks match blocks in area and contiguity yet are recoverable, and they land at 40.3% linear top-1, beside random masks at 40.8%, against 64.3% for blocks; within one geometry family, the placements that leave the least unrecoverable content lose 6.5 points to those that leave the most, over five seed pairs; pixel targets span 7 points where latent targets span 25; and against a frozen target the gap between random and block masks, 19 points on the same kind of GPU, closes to 1.5, so the geometry acts through the target the encoder produces for itself. On UCF101 the masking ratio decides which condition, content or reach, binds; removing whole frames, unrecoverable in space but recoverable from neighbouring frames, is worst at both ratios; and on V-JEPA's own masks, batching them intact instead of truncated changes little (36.0% against 35.1%), whereas making 100 target tokens inside the blocks visible lifts them to 48.7% and hiding 100 context tokens outside the blocks does not (33.7%).

AI.tldr: 论文为JEPA对掩码模式异常敏感的现象给出测量论解释：掩码是线性测量，在紧支撑小波基下，隐藏区内原子落入测量的零空间而不留数据痕迹；JEPA损失只要求编码上下文足以预测目标，因此低层先验可恢复的目标会形成捷径，并被移动平均目标编码器变得自洽。真正消除捷径的是掩码留下的不可恢复粗尺度内容，前提是每个目标仍有足够上下文可达。作者在151次预训练中验证了该解释的多项独特预测。
AI.motivation: 联合嵌入预测架构（JEPA）对输入掩码方式异常敏感：块掩码有效，散点掩码常失败，但以往解释主要是经验性的。作者希望给出可测量、可预测的理论说明，解释为什么某些掩码几何有效而另一些无效。
AI.method: 将掩码视为线性测量，在紧支撑小波基中分析隐藏区原子何时落入零空间；从JEPA损失与移动平均目标编码器角度分析低层可恢复目标造成的捷径；提出在训练前对掩码留下的不可恢复粗尺度内容打分；在ImageNet-100与UCF101等上进行151次预训练，比较条带、块、随机掩码，像素与潜在目标，冻结目标，空间与时间掩码，不同掩码比例，以及V-JEPA自身掩码变体。
AI.result: ImageNet-100上，条带掩码与块掩码面积和连续性相同但可恢复，线性top-1为40.3%，接近随机掩码的40.8%，远低于块掩码的64.3%；同一几何族内，留下不可恢复内容最少的放置比最多的低6.5分（五对种子）；像素目标跨度7分，潜在目标跨度25分；使用冻结目标时，随机与块掩码约19分的差距降到1.5分。UCF101上，掩码比例决定“内容”还是“可达性”约束起主导；移除整帧在空间上不可恢复但可由相邻帧恢复，在两种比例下都最差；V-JEPA掩码上，整批与截断差异小（36.0%对35.1%），但让块内100个目标token可见可提升到48.7%，隐藏块外100个上下文token则仅33.7%。
AI.conclusion: JEPA掩码效果的关键在于掩码是否留下不可恢复的粗尺度内容，并且该效应通过编码器为自身产生的目标起作用，而非仅由输入几何决定。可以通过训练前评分不可恢复内容与上下文可达性来预测掩码优劣，为JEPA类自监督学习中的掩码设计提供解释和实用指标。

title: ManiEdit: Sequential Unstructured Knowledge Editing for Language Models from a Manifold Perspective
summary: Large language models (LLMs) inevitably generate some incorrect or outdated content, necessitating efficient and precise mechanisms for continual knowledge updates. However, existing model editing methods struggle to sequentially edit unstructured long-form knowledge, suffering from severe edit forgetting and degradation of general capabilities. To address these challenges, we reframe knowledge editing from a manifold perspective, viewing it as a localized displacement of an edit sub-manifold within the global knowledge manifold. Under this formulation, the problem can be decomposed into two key questions: (i) how to identify representative edit points that effectively anchor the edit sub-manifold, and (ii) how to preserve the remaining manifold structure during the sub-manifold displacement process. Based on this perspective, we propose ManiEdit, a novel manifold-aware autoregressive editing framework consisting of two core components. Pivot Localization addresses the mediocre-point dilemma by identifying high-leverage pivots to anchor the edit sub-manifold. Manifold-Aware Preservation preserves different knowledge types through an energy-weighted penalty combined with recursive null-space alignment. Experiments on two base LLMs and four unstructured editing benchmarks demonstrate that ManiEdit achieves state-of-the-art performance, outperforming the strongest baseline by up to +27.81 BERTScore and +8.50 ROUGE-L, while maintaining near-original general capabilities across six representative downstream tasks. Our code is available at: https://github.com/Areyliu/ManiEdit

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ManiEdit，从流形视角将知识编辑视为编辑子流形在全局知识流形中的局部位移，用于解决 LLM 长文本知识顺序编辑中的遗忘和通用能力退化问题。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型会生成错误或过时内容，需要高效且精准的持续知识更新；但现有模型编辑方法难以顺序编辑非结构化长文本知识，存在严重编辑遗忘和通用能力下降。
AI.method: 将知识编辑重构为全局知识流形中编辑子流形的局部位移，并分解为识别代表性编辑点和保持其余流形结构两个问题。提出 ManiEdit 框架，包含 Pivot Localization 和 Manifold-Aware Preservation：前者识别高杠杆枢轴以锚定编辑子流形，后者通过能量加权惩罚与递归零空间对齐保持不同知识类型。
AI.result: 在两个基座 LLM 和四个非结构化编辑基准上达到 SOTA，相比最强基线最高提升 +27.81 BERTScore 和 +8.50 ROUGE-L，同时在六个代表性下游任务上保持接近原始通用能力。
AI.conclusion: ManiEdit 的流形感知自回归编辑框架能有效缓解顺序长文本知识编辑中的编辑遗忘与通用能力退化，并兼顾编辑性能与通用能力保持。

title: Cross-Domain Few-Shot Writer Adaptation for Real-World Handwritten Mathematical Expression Recognition
comment: Accepted at the 32nd IEEE International Conference on Mechatronics and Machine Vision in Practice (M2VIP 2026)
summary: Handwritten mathematical expression recognition (HMER) refers to the task of recognizing and converting handwritten mathematics into a parsable markup language, usually LaTeX. No current state-of-the-art-competitive system adjusts to the way a specific person writes, and the domain gap between training images (usually digital or perfectly binarized) and images physically taken with a camera used in inference has received fairly little attention for this specific problem. We characterize this domain gap through fragmentation and stroke-width analyses of the images as well as introduce a writer-adaptive fine-tuning pipeline to MFH-CoMER in an attempt to address it. We further introduce sample author-specific datasets, consisting of five handwriting category subsets from two authors, and evaluate using a McNemar's test and permutation tests adapted to limited data. Results suggest an increase in expression recognition rate and a decrease in CER for digital handwriting but more varied results for physical handwriting, with the model struggling for handwriting articles that the base model can already evaluate well. Nonetheless, adapted models were found to have improved results for four out of five subsets. Statistical testing results suggest a consistency in improvement for two of the tested author-specific subsets. Our results point towards the potential feasibility of writer adaptation for the HMER task.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究手写数学表达式识别（HMER）中的书写者适应问题，提出面向 MFH-CoMER 的书写者自适应微调流程，并构建作者特定小样本数据集进行评估。
AI.motivation: 当前先进 HMER 系统通常不能适应特定个人的书写风格，且训练图像（数字或理想二值化）与推理时相机拍摄图像之间存在领域差距，这一问题此前关注较少。
AI.method: 通过碎片化和笔画宽度分析刻画领域差距；提出将书写者自适应微调流程应用于 MFH-CoMER；构建来自两位作者、五个手写类别子集的作者特定数据集；采用适配小样本的 McNemar 检验和置换检验进行评估。
AI.result: 数字手写场景下表达式识别率提高、CER 降低；物理手写场景结果更不一致，模型对基础模型已能较好识别的样本仍较困难；但自适应模型在 5 个子集中有 4 个取得改进，统计检验显示其中 2 个作者特定子集的改进具有一致性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明书写者自适应用于 HMER 任务具有一定可行性，但物理手写和特定书写风格下的效果仍需进一步研究。

title: Refinement Symmetry in Multimodal Transformers
summary: Attention weights depend on token counts, which change with the representation of a signal. We study refinement symmetry: splitting a representation while preserving content, position, visible context, and total mass should preserve its contribution. Building on proportional and quadrature attention, we show that split invariance forces the local mass factor to be linear for any fixed positive attention kernel, provided that factor is nondecreasing. For changed representations, a physical coupling bounds attention error by separating feature change from weight reallocation. In Qwen2.5-Omni-7B, duplicating half the visual tokens threefold changes 255 of 3,586 MVBench answers under standard attention; measure weighting preserves every answer under matched visibility. Under natural frame resampling, it reduces distributional drift. At twofold merging of a frozen video encoding, a five-seed evaluation shows an all-partition-correct accuracy gain of 1.04 percentage points over global count weighting (average group mass) and 0.93 points over standard attention. The advantage over global count also holds on WorldSense but depends on the compression budget. The result is a representation principle with a measured benefit in robustness across partitions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究注意力权重随表示中 token 数量变化的问题，提出“细化对称性”原则：在保持内容、位置、可见上下文和总质量的前提下拆分表示，不应改变其贡献；据此推导并验证一种按度量加权的方法，在视频多模态任务中提升了分区稳健性。
AI.motivation: 注意力权重依赖 token 计数，而信号表示方式会改变 token 数量；这种表示变化不应改变内容贡献。现有注意力在 token 拆分、复制或重采样下可能不稳定，因此需要建立表示层面的对称性原则并设计更稳健的加权方式。
AI.method: 基于 proportional attention 和 quadrature attention，分析拆分不变性对局部质量因子的约束：在固定正注意力核且质量因子非递减时，拆分不变性要求该因子为线性。对表示变化情形，引入物理耦合，将注意力误差分解为特征变化与权重重分配两部分。提出按度量加权（measure weighting），并在 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 上用于视觉 token 复制、自然帧重采样和视频编码合并等场景评估。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5-Omni-7B 中，将一半视觉 token 三倍复制时，标准注意力使 3,586 个 MVBench 答案中的 255 个发生变化；度量加权在匹配可见性下保持所有答案不变。自然帧重采样下，该方法降低分布漂移。在冻结视频编码二倍合并时，五种子评估显示其全分区正确准确率比全局计数加权（平均组质量）高 1.04 个百分点，比标准注意力高 0.93 个百分点。对全局计数的优势在 WorldSense 上也成立，但依赖压缩预算。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提出了一种表示原则：注意力贡献应在保内容的表示拆分下保持不变，并据此给出线性局部质量因子的理论约束和度量加权方法。实验表明，该方法在视频多模态注意力中能提升跨分区的稳健性，但收益受压缩预算影响。

title: UnStep: Training-Free Acceleration of Causal Video Diffusion with Fewer Steps Than Distillation
summary: Distilling bidirectional multi-step video diffusion transformers into few-step causal models has become a common approach for streaming video generation. While these few-step students are significantly faster than the teachers they are distilled from, they remain slow for real-time generation. In this work we present UnStep, a training-free wrapper that accelerates few-step causal video models at inference by running them with fewer diffusion transformer (DiT) steps than during distillation and limiting the temporal window retained in the attention KV cache. We propose two inference-only mechanisms to recover quality lost by step reduction and attention windowing: renoising the generated latent frames to a near-clean level and reusing the existing clean-cache pass to refine them, and applying truncated SVD to the DiT attention value and output projections. We also accelerate inference with a quality-preserving runtime stack for the DiT and VAE decoder, including more efficient attention calls and KV indexing, fused Triton RoPE with cached coefficients, and VAE decoding with optimized memory layout, precision, and convolution kernels. By reducing computation and optimizing the runtime stack, UnStep sets a new throughput regime for causal video diffusion, by running substantially faster than current methods, reaching 50 FPS on a single H100 without quality loss, and 77 FPS on GB200, all without retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出UnStep，一种无需训练即可加速少步因果视频扩散模型的推理包装器，通过减少DiT步数、限制KV缓存时间窗口及两种质量恢复机制，实现实时视频生成。
AI.motivation: 少步学生模型虽比教师模型快，但仍难以满足实时生成需求。
AI.method: 在推理时采用比蒸馏更少的DiT步数并限制注意力KV缓存的时间窗口；提出两种仅推理机制恢复质量：将生成潜帧重新加噪至接近干净水平并复用干净缓存进行精炼，以及对DiT注意力值和输出投影应用截断SVD；同时优化运行时栈，包括高效注意力调用、KV索引、融合Triton RoPE与缓存系数、VAE解码的内存布局、精度和卷积核优化。
AI.result: 在单张H100上达到50 FPS，在GB200上达到77 FPS，且无质量损失，无需重新训练。
AI.conclusion: UnStep为因果视频扩散设定了新的吞吐量水平，显著快于现有方法。

title: Unified Visual-Tactile-Action Modeling from Human Demonstrations for Dexterous Manipulation
summary: Dexterous manipulation requires tactile feedback.However, robot tactile demonstrations are difficult to scale,because dexterous-hand teleoperation provides limited tactile feedback to the operator. In contrast, human demonstrations offer a substantially more scalable source of diverse tactile interactions. Motivated by a simple premise: hands can change, but the underlying physics of interaction does not. We leverage human tactile data to improve dexterous manipulation policies. Specifically, we first build a tactile motion-capture system that synchronously records images, tactile signals, and hand motions. Using this system, we construct the UVTA dataset spanning five contact-rich tasks, with 1,000 human demonstrations covering diverse interaction patterns and 150 robot demonstrations per task. To transfer the underlying physics of human interaction to robot control, we propose a Unified Visual-Tactile-Action Model that maps both embodiments into aligned tactile and action representations and jointly predicts future action and tactile trajectories. The joint objective enables human demonstrations to supervise contact-aware representation learning, while only robot actions are executed during deployment. In real-robot evaluations across five tasks, our method achieves an average success rate of 70%, outperforming the strongest visual-tactile baseline, which achieves 29%, and an architecture ablation, which achieves 42%. Performance improves consistently with additional human demonstrations and exhibits no saturation at 1,000 demonstrations per task, validating the effectiveness of scalable human tactile data for dexterous manipulation. Project page is available at https://uni-vta.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文利用人类触觉数据提升机器人灵巧操作，提出统一视觉-触觉-动作模型，在真实机器人五项接触密集任务上取得70%平均成功率。
AI.motivation: 机器人触觉演示难以规模化，因为灵巧手遥操作给操作者的触觉反馈有限；而人类演示能提供更可扩展、更丰富的触觉交互数据。其核心前提是：手可以不同，但交互背后的物理规律不变。
AI.method: 首先构建同步记录图像、触觉信号和手部运动的触觉动作捕捉系统，并建立UVTA数据集，涵盖5个接触密集任务、每任务1000个人类演示和150个机器人演示。然后提出统一视觉-触觉-动作模型，将人类和机器人本体映射到对齐的触觉与动作表示，联合预测未来动作和触觉轨迹；部署时仅执行机器人动作。
AI.result: 在真实机器人五项任务评估中，方法平均成功率为70%，优于最强视觉-触觉基线的29%和架构消融的42%。性能随人类演示增加而持续提升，在每任务1000个演示时仍未饱和。
AI.conclusion: 可扩展的人类触觉数据能有效用于灵巧操作，跨本体迁移交互物理规律可提升接触感知表示学习和机器人操作性能。

title: What Would Falsify It? A Variable Specific Evidence Standard for Mechanistic Claims About Self Explanation
summary:
When a language model explains an answer it has already given, does it reuse the computation that produced the answer or reconstruct a story from the answer alone? Attribution, transportability and recoverability are each compatible with causal use without establishing it. We propose an evidence standard: pair each positive statistic with a variable specific null that removes the tested variable's identity while matching relevant nuisance dimensions as far as possible, and audit unmatched dimensions.
  We apply this standard to a known cause. A cue naming a wrong option raises the rate of choosing that option by 64 to 68 percentage points across three models. Explanations mention the cue in 1.8 percent of items or fewer in three of four models tested. Three estimator classes yield favorable statistics, but none establishes causal sensitivity to the cue contrast under its own control in the three-model analysis. In the strongest case, a recovered cue direction reaches $R^2$ of 0.95 and exceeds a geometry matched random direction in all three seeds, while a direction fitted by the same pipeline with cue labels scrambled reproduces 61 to 76 percent of its effect at comparable realized edit magnitude. A fourth model passes one interchange endpoint, but unequal edit magnitudes and a contrast that changes both cue identity and cue-answer agreement limit its interpretation.
  These experiments leave causal access unresolved. They establish an evidentiary requirement: favorable mechanistic statistics must survive controls for variable identity and nuisance structure. Reusable controls separate generic from identity specific transport effects, fit null directions with scrambled labels, and audit realized intervention magnitudes.

AI.tldr: 本文研究语言模型解释答案时，究竟是复用产生答案的计算，还是仅根据答案重构叙述；作者提出证据标准，并用“错误选项线索”这一已知原因进行审计，发现现有有利统计量不足以确立因果敏感性。
AI.motivation: 归因、可迁移性和可恢复性都只能说明结果与因果使用相容，却不能证明解释真正因果地使用了内部计算；因此需要更严格的证据标准来区分一般性与身份特异性的传输效应。
AI.method: 提出为每个正向统计量配对变量特异性零假设，在尽可能匹配无关维度的同时移除被测变量的身份，并审计未匹配维度；将其应用于错误选项线索实验，使用三类估计器、几何匹配随机方向、打乱标签拟合零方向，并审计实际干预幅度。
AI.result: 错误选项线索使选择该选项的概率提高64至68个百分点；四个模型中三个的解释提及线索比例不超过1.8%。三类估计器均给出有利统计量，但在三模型分析中无一能在自身控制下确立对线索对比的因果敏感性。最强情形中恢复的线索方向R²达0.95，并在三个随机种子中超过几何匹配随机方向；但打乱线索标签后拟合方向仍复现61%至76%的效果。第四个模型通过一个交换端点，但编辑幅度不等且对比同时改变线索身份与线索-答案一致性，限制了解释。
AI.conclusion: 这些实验未能解决因果访问问题，但确立了证据要求：有利的机制统计量必须通过变量身份和干扰结构的控制。可复用控制应分离一般性与身份特异性传输效应，用打乱标签拟合零方向，并审计实际干预幅度。

title: WB-WAM: Heterogeneous Body-Hand Pre-training for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Humanoid loco-manipulation demands coordinated body and hand behavior, while conventional robot pre-training data provide limited coverage of such whole-body motion. We present WB-WAM, a World Action Model that incorporates explicit whole-body action supervision into generative video pre-training. A shared physical action space integrates body, root, and dexterous hand annotations from heterogeneous sources, enabling joint video and action learning from 1880.2 hours of partially annotated video and motion data. The resulting priors are refined through PICO mid-training and adapted to robot tasks with auxiliary forward kinematics supervision. We construct WB-Datasets to support these stages with retargeted egocentric human demonstrations and robot trajectories, allowing task-aligned human motion to supplement limited robot data. Evaluations in simulation demonstrate strong whole-body task performance with 81.9% in HumanoidArena, while real-world experiments further validate WB-WAM with 84.0% mean success across five tasks. Moreover, task-aligned PICO mid-training improves downstream task performance while reducing the need for real-robot demonstrations. These results support heterogeneous whole-body pre-training and human motion transfer as a practical route to data-efficient humanoid loco-manipulation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出WB-WAM世界动作模型，将显式全身动作监督融入生成式视频预训练，以实现人形机器人的全身移动操作。
AI.motivation: 人形机器人的移动操作需要身体与手部协调动作，但传统机器人预训练数据对全身运动覆盖有限。
AI.method: 构建共享物理动作空间，整合来自异构数据源的身体、根部和灵巧手标注；利用1880.2小时部分标注视频与运动数据进行视频和动作联合学习；通过PICO中期训练精炼先验，并用辅助前向运动学监督适配机器人任务；构建WB-Datasets，用重定向的自我中心人类演示和机器人轨迹支持各阶段训练。
AI.result: 仿真中在HumanoidArena达到81.9%；真实世界五个任务平均成功率为84.0%；任务对齐的PICO中期训练提升下游任务性能并减少对真实机器人演示的需求。
AI.conclusion: 异构全身预训练与人类运动迁移是通往数据高效人形移动操作的可行路径。

title: Expected Reasoning-Step Return Unifies On-Policy Learning from Rewards and Teachers
summary: On-policy reasoning models can learn from task rewards or teacher signals, but these sources differ in form and can favor conflicting updates, leaving unclear which should guide a given reasoning action. We introduce \textbf{Expected Reasoning-Step Return (ERSR)}, which treats semantic reasoning steps as macro-actions and uses Monte Carlo student-policy rollouts to estimate the expected final task reward of student-generated and teacher-proposed actions in a common return space for step-level comparison. ERSR analysis reveals an outcome-dependent asymmetry: student actions are more beneficial than teacher replacements on successful trajectories, whereas teacher replacements become more beneficial on failed trajectories. We further show that student answer-probe gains track student-step ERSR utility and distinguish beneficial from harmful reasoning steps. Based on these findings, we propose \textbf{Return-Referenced On-Policy Learning (R$^2$OPL)}, which reinforces student reasoning on successful trajectories and distills teacher signals on failed ones, while using group success rate for difficulty scaling and student-probe gains for step-level modulation. Experiments across reasoning benchmarks and teacher--student configurations show that R$^2$OPL consistently outperforms strong baselines. ERSR training dynamics further show that R$^2$OPL jointly exploits substantial utility from both reward- and teacher-side signals, whereas existing hybrids often leave substantial residual utility in one branch.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ERSR与R²OPL：用蒙特卡洛学生策略轨迹估计语义推理步的期望最终任务回报，并据此在成功轨迹上强化学生推理、在失败轨迹上蒸馏教师信号，从而统一利用奖励与教师两类信号。
AI.motivation: 在线策略推理模型既可从任务奖励学习，也可从教师信号学习，但二者形式不同且可能产生冲突更新，导致不清楚某一步推理动作应由哪种信号指导。
AI.method: 提出Expected Reasoning-Step Return（ERSR），将语义推理步视为宏动作，通过学生策略的蒙特卡洛 rollout 估计学生生成动作与教师建议动作的期望最终任务奖励，并在统一回报空间中进行步级比较；基于此提出Return-Referenced On-Policy Learning（R²OPL），在成功轨迹上强化学生推理，在失败轨迹上蒸馏教师信号，并用组成功率进行难度缩放、用学生答案探测增益进行步级调制。
AI.result: ERSR分析发现结果依赖的不对称性：成功轨迹上学生动作优于教师替换，失败轨迹上教师替换更有益；学生答案探测增益可追踪学生步的ERSR效用并区分有益与有害推理步。实验表明R²OPL在多种推理基准和教师-学生配置下持续优于强基线，训练动态显示其能同时利用奖励侧与教师侧的显著效用，而现有混合方法常在一侧留下大量未利用效用。
AI.conclusion: 通过ERSR在统一回报空间中比较学生与教师动作，可以按轨迹结果和步级效用决定学习信号；R²OPL据此有效整合奖励与教师信号，提升在线策略推理模型性能。

title: Quizzing the Translation: A Prover-Grounded Evaluation Metric for NL$\rightarrow$FOL
comment: Accepted to EMNLP 2026 (Main Conference). 18 pages, 3 figures, 10 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/pu-suo/siv-metric
summary: A standard pipeline for symbolic reasoning over natural-language problems translates them into first-order logic and invokes a theorem prover. The translation step is the bottleneck: swap "every" for "some" and every inference that follows is corrupted. Yet today's metrics often score more broken translations higher than less broken ones, because BLEU, BERTScore, and Smatch++ reward surface overlap that the worst errors happen to preserve. We introduce SIV, which derives two kinds of probes from the target formula and uses a theorem prover to verify the candidate translation against each. Positive probes are statements the candidate must entail, which detect translations that drop content; contrastive probes are statements the candidate must not entail, which detect translations that assert more than the original. On a controlled pool of perturbed FOLIO translations, the severity of the error accounts for 80% of SIV's score variance, compared with at most 17% for any prior metric. Across six error classes on a disjoint pool, SIV scores the reference above the perturbed candidate in over 99% of pairs. Because each probe is labeled with what it tests, the failure pattern also supplies a labeled error trace, recovering the perturbation class at macro-F1 0.638, nearly double the score-only baseline. On 434 expert-audited real LLM translations, SIV attains the top AUC, uniquely detects and grades expert-labeled major errors, and abstains, rather than mis-scoring, on out-of-vocabulary translations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SIV 方法，用于评估自然语言问题的符号推理中，将自然语言翻译为一阶逻辑的翻译质量。SIV 利用定理证明器，从目标公式生成正向探针（候选翻译必须蕴含的陈述）和对比探针（候选翻译必须不蕴含的陈述），以此验证候选翻译的正确性。
AI.motivation: 在自然语言符号推理流程中，翻译为一阶逻辑是瓶颈：关键词替换（如把 "every" 换成 "some"）会破坏后续所有推理。而现有指标（BLEU、BERTScore、Smatch++）奖励表面重叠，往往给错误翻译更高的分数，无法反映真实语义错误。
AI.method: 提出 SIV：从目标公式派生两类探针，并借助定理证明器验证候选翻译。正向探针用于检测内容丢失（候选未蕴含应有内容），对比探针用于检测内容过度断言（候选蕴含了不应有的内容）。每个探针带有检测标签，可据失败模式生成带标注的错误轨迹，并识别扰动类别。
AI.result: 在受控扰动 FOLIO 翻译池上，错误严重度解释了 SIV 分数方差的 80%，而现有指标最多 17%。在另一独立池的六类错误上，SIV 在超过 99% 的配对中给参考译文打分高于扰动候选。错误类别识别宏 F1 达 0.638，接近仅凭分数基线的两倍。在 434 条专家审核的真实大模型翻译上，SIV 取得最高 AUC，能唯一检测并分级专家标注的重大错误，并对词表外翻译选择弃权而非误评。
AI.conclusion: SIV 通过定理证明器驱动的正/对比探针，实现了对逻辑翻译的语义级评估，显著优于基于表面重叠的传统指标，并提供可解释的错误诊断能力。

title: RLE-Bench: A Qualifying Exam for Coding Agents as Robot Learning Engineers
summary: Coding agents are beginning to move beyond purely digital tasks to tackle physical-world challenges, particularly in robotics. Existing robotics benchmarks, however, primarily focus on the performance of individual artifacts, such as policies or controllers, offering limited coverage of coding agents' broader engineering capabilities. Real-world robotics extends beyond control: agents must build, integrate, diagnose, and improve heterogeneous artifacts under resource constraints and reason from multimodal feedback. To evaluate these broader capabilities, we introduce RLE-Bench, a benchmark of robot-learning tasks spanning four representative robotics development workflows: interactive control, policy learning, perception and estimation, and mechanical design. We use diverse task-specific metrics to evaluate the artifacts submitted by the coding agents, from the success rate the agents achieved to the policy agents trained, the harness agent built, and the mechanical structures the agent designed. We aggregate these metrics into an overall RLE Index and report workflow-specific capability profiles, enabling systematic comparison of coding agents' capabilities across multiple capability dimensions. Beyond performance ranks, we also conduct in-depth case studies examining agent behavior on representative tasks, highlighting both current capabilities and limitations, and pointing to the opportunities robotics tasks have to offer for future agent training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RLE-Bench，一个面向机器人学习任务的基准，用于评估编码智能体在物理世界机器人开发中的综合工程能力，而不仅是策略或控制器性能。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人基准主要关注单个产物（如策略或控制器）的表现，难以覆盖编码智能体在真实机器人开发中所需的构建、集成、诊断、改进异构产物，以及在资源约束和多模态反馈下推理等更广泛能力。
AI.method: 构建涵盖四类机器人开发工作流的任务：交互控制、策略学习、感知与估计、机械设计；使用任务特定指标评估智能体提交的产物，包括成功率、训练出的策略智能体、构建的测试框架和设计的机械结构；将指标聚合为 RLE Index，并生成工作流级能力画像；同时对代表性任务进行案例研究。
AI.result: 该基准能够系统比较编码智能体在多个能力维度上的表现，揭示不同工作流中的能力差异，并通过案例研究展示当前智能体的优势与局限。
AI.conclusion: RLE-Bench 将机器人任务引入编码智能体评估，拓展了对其工程能力的衡量；案例研究也为未来智能体训练指出了机器人任务带来的机会。

title: Jev Matches 7B Language Models for Speech-Neuroprosthesis Rescoring
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/gabrycina/how-much-language-model
summary: A speech neuroprosthesis decodes attempted speech from brain activity and ends by rescoring the decoder's candidate sentences with a language model of several billion parameters, the only component that needs a GPU. Replacing that model with a cheaper one is hard: general language models asked to pick one sentence from a list answer from where a label sits in the list rather than from the sentence itself. We pose rescoring as a single typed decision, one call that returns a probability for every candidate, served by Jev, a hosted model trained for calibrated decisions, and combine it with the decoder's own score. On 978 held-out sentences from a participant with ALS, where the published decoder alone reaches 8.1% word error, Jev reaches 7.5% against 7.8% for both OPT-6.7b and Qwen2.5-7B; with the decoder's weight re-tuned, 6.9% against 7.2% and 7.4%. Jev is ahead in all four comparisons and at most 0.2 points behind at the 95% bound. It costs 0.07 USD per thousand sentences and needs no GPU; a dedicated GPU running a 7B model is cheaper per sentence only above 43% utilisation, far beyond what one user generates. End-to-end latency over the internet is 262 ms, of which 62 ms is spent at the provider, the same order as a 7B model on a local GPU (27 ms) but not faster.

AI.tldr: 语音神经假体解码尝试语音时，需用数十亿参数语言模型对候选句子重打分（唯一需GPU的组件）。本文提出Jev，一个无需GPU的托管模型，将重打分视为单次类型化决策，为每个候选返回概率并与解码器分数结合。在ALS参与者978句上，Jev取得优于7B模型的词错率，成本低且延迟可接受。
AI.motivation: 原方法中语言模型重打分是唯一需GPU的组件，替换为更便宜模型困难，因为通用语言模型从列表中选择句子时倾向于依据标签位置而非句子内容（位置偏差）。因此需要一种无需GPU、低成本且可靠的替代方案。
AI.method: 将重打分建模为单次类型化决策，一次调用返回所有候选句的概率，由Jev（一个为校准决策训练的托管模型）服务，并与解码器自身分数结合；同时重新调整解码器权重。
AI.result: 在ALS参与者978个留出句上，原解码器单独WER为8.1%；Jev达7.5%，而OPT-6.7b和Qwen2.5-7B均为7.8%；重调权重后，Jev为6.9%，对比7.2%和7.4%。Jev在四项比较中均领先，95%置信界内最多落后0.2个点。成本0.07美元/千句，无需GPU；专用GPU运行7B模型仅在利用率超过43%时每句更便宜。端到端网络延迟262 ms，其中62 ms在提供商处，与本地GPU 7B模型（27 ms）同量级但未更快。
AI.conclusion: Jev作为无需GPU的托管模型，在语音神经假体重打分任务上以更低成本达到或超越7B语言模型，且延迟可接受，适合单用户场景。

title: DepthBench: Measuring How Residual Connections Enable More Computational Depth
summary: Depth is a natural way to increase the computational capacity in Transformers, yet the contribution of deeper layers can diminish as depth grows larger. Recent approaches enhance normalization (\text{e.g.}, LayerNorm Scaling) or residual connections (\text{e.g.}, mHC, AttnRes) to enable better information flow and depth utilization. However, it remains unclear whether they truly translate increased architectural depth into effective computational depth, and whether their reported gains stem from better access to information across depth, or unaccounted-for confounding factors. In this paper, we introduce \textbf{DepthBench}, a controlled benchmark for studying computational depth across various architectures. We systematically vary the width--depth aspect ratio ($d_{\text{model}}/n_{\text{layer}}$) from shallow--wide to deep--narrow shapes, while keeping the model size and pre-training recipe fixed. Across 10 representative architectures, we find that the benefit of allocating more capacity to depth is strongly architecture-dependent. Standard Pre-LN and most of its norm- and scaling-based variants provide little benefit and can even degrade performance as models become deeper and narrower, whereas HC and Full AttnRes improve consistently even at extreme deep shapes. These gains extend beyond pre-training loss and consistently translate into improved domain-specific performance and effective computation. Controlled layer-level analyses further show that the gains of HC and Full AttnRes are associated with more effective utilization of additional layers, revealing distinct mechanisms of computational depth across architectures. Overall, our results identify residual connection design as a key determinant of whether depth can serve as a meaningful scaling axis by enabling additional architectural depth to translate into effective computation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DepthBench，一个受控基准，用于研究不同 Transformer 架构的计算深度。通过固定模型规模和预训练配方、系统改变宽度-深度比，发现深度收益高度依赖架构：Pre-LN 及其多数归一化/缩放变体在深层窄模型中收益有限甚至变差，而 HC 和 Full AttnRes 能持续受益。
AI.motivation: 深度是提升 Transformer 计算能力的自然方式，但层数增加后深层贡献会衰减。近期 LayerNorm Scaling、mHC、AttnRes 等方法虽改善信息流和深度利用，但尚不清楚它们是否真正将架构深度转化为有效计算深度，还是受益于未考虑的混杂因素。
AI.method: 引入 DepthBench 受控基准；系统改变宽度-深度比 d_model/n_layer，从浅宽到深窄，同时保持模型规模和预训练配方不变；比较 10 种代表性架构，并进行受控的层级别分析。
AI.result: 将更多容量分配给深度的收益强烈依赖架构。标准 Pre-LN 及多数基于归一化和缩放的变体收益很小，且在更深更窄时甚至性能下降；HC 和 Full AttnRes 在极端深窄形状下仍持续提升。这些增益不仅体现在预训练损失上，也转化为更好的领域特定性能和有效计算。层级别分析表明，HC 和 Full AttnRes 的增益与更有效地利用额外层有关，揭示了不同架构中计算深度的不同机制。
AI.conclusion: 残差连接设计是决定深度能否成为有意义扩展轴的关键因素，它使额外架构深度能够转化为有效计算。

title: PINNMorph: Evolving Online Adaptation Policies for Physics-Informed Neural Networks
summary: Physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) provide a learning-based framework for solving partial differential equations (PDEs), yet their training behavior can change substantially throughout optimization. Residual distributions, gradient interactions, regional learning difficulty, and model-capacity requirements may evolve over time, while the network architecture and major training mechanisms are typically determined before training. We propose PINNMorph, an online PINN adaptation framework based on large language model (LLM)-guided policy evolution. PINNMorph maintains a population of state-conditioned adaptation policies that map execution diagnostics to controlled interventions over topology modification, additive representation augmentation, objective balancing, gradient handling, adaptive sampling, and optimizer-phase control. At each intervention opportunity, candidate programs are instantiated from the current policy population, selected according to the observed training state, and applied directly to the PINN under training. The resulting model inherits its existing parameters and training state and continues optimization along the same trajectory. Execution outcomes are subsequently used to evaluate interventions and evolve the policy population. Unlike pre-training architecture search or fixed adaptation rules, PINNMorph jointly adapts the current PINN and the policies governing its interventions using feedback from actual training. Experiments on 13 PDE benchmarks show that PINNMorph achieves lower solution errors than SA-PINN, ConFIG, RoPINN, HARMONIC, and PINNsAgent across all evaluated problems. Ablation studies further examine the effects of online adaptation, state-conditioned intervention selection, and execution-feedback-driven policy evolution.

AI.tldr: 提出PINNMorph，一种基于大语言模型引导策略演化的在线物理信息神经网络自适应框架，可在训练过程中动态调整网络结构与训练机制。
AI.motivation: PINN训练行为会随优化过程变化，如残差分布、梯度交互、区域学习难度和模型容量需求等会演化，但传统方法通常在训练前固定网络架构和主要训练机制。
AI.method: PINNMorph维护一组状态条件自适应策略，将执行诊断映射为对拓扑修改、加性表示增强、目标平衡、梯度处理、自适应采样和优化器阶段控制的干预。在每个干预机会，根据当前训练状态从策略群体中选择并实例化候选程序，直接作用于正在训练的PINN，使其继承参数和训练状态并沿原轨迹继续优化；随后利用执行结果评估干预并演化策略群体。
AI.result: 在13个PDE基准上，PINNMorph在所有评估问题中均取得比SA-PINN、ConFIG、RoPINN、HARMONIC和PINNsAgent更低的解误差。消融实验进一步考察了在线自适应、状态条件干预选择和执行反馈驱动策略演化的效果。
AI.conclusion: PINNMorph通过联合自适应当前PINN及其干预策略，并利用真实训练反馈驱动策略演化，优于预训练架构搜索或固定自适应规则，能有效提升PINN求解PDE的性能。

title: When Better Gets Worse: Improvement Fidelity for Self-Improving Agents in Adaptive Worlds
summary: Self-improving agents increasingly rely on proxy verifiers to choose policy updates, yet deployment can change the world in which those updates are evaluated. An update that looks better to the verifier can therefore become worse after deployment even when the verifier ranks policies well overall. We formalize this gap as Improvement Fidelity, which asks whether proxy improvements preserve the sign and ordering of deployment improvements over the updates an improvement process actually proposes. We show that global policy accuracy need not guarantee update fidelity: operator shift and deployment response can create update-level errors, while candidate margins determine whether those errors change the replacement decision. We introduce PIVOT-KG, a paired, decision-aware validator that allocates scarce high-fidelity evaluation according to the expected reduction in selection regret per unit cost. Across 90 held-out roots in Leduc, Kuhn, and Melting Pot, proxy and deployment optimal sets are disjoint in 51 cases. In an eight-candidate HighwayEnv stress test, PIVOT-KG reduces mean improvement-selection regret from 0.0435 under the exact Uniform validation rule to 0.0055 at the primary budget. Together, these results show why reliable self-improvement should evaluate proposed improvements in the worlds they induce, while providing a practical rule for allocating scarce deployment evidence when it can affect the replacement decision.

AI.tldr: 论文指出自改进智能体使用代理验证器选择策略更新时，部署会改变评估世界，导致代理上更好的更新在部署后可能变差；为此形式化“改进保真度”并提出PIVOT-KG来分配稀缺的高保真部署评估。
AI.motivation: 代理验证器整体上能较好排序策略，并不保证能正确判断实际提出的更新在部署后是否真的更好；部署响应和算子偏移会造成更新级选择错误，因此需要研究更新选择而非仅关注全局策略准确率。
AI.method: 形式化Improvement Fidelity，分析算子偏移与部署响应导致的更新级误差，并说明候选边际决定误差是否改变替换决策；提出PIVOT-KG，一种成对、决策感知的验证器，按每单位成本带来的期望选择遗憾减少来分配高保真评估。
AI.result: 在Leduc、Kuhn和Melting Pot的90个held-out根上，代理与部署最优集在51例中不相交；在八候选HighwayEnv压力测试中，PIVOT-KG将平均改进选择遗憾从精确Uniform验证规则的0.0435降至主预算下的0.0055。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的自改进应在其所诱导的世界中评估候选改进；当稀缺部署证据可能影响替换决策时，PIVOT-KG提供了实用的证据分配规则。

title: RIPE-MambaSpike: Resolution-Independent Spiking-State-Space Interfaces for Parameter-Efficient Event-Based Vision
summary: Spiking-Mamba hybrids reach strong accuracy on event-based vision, but existing designs often require tens of millions of parameters. Much of that cost comes from how the spiking front-end is connected to the state-space backbone rather than from the hybrid architecture itself. In a representative model, a single resolution-dependent projection accounts for 33.55M of 36.25M parameters. To that end, we introduce RIPE-MambaSpike (Resolution-Independent, Parameter-Efficient), which replaces that projection with a hierarchical multi-resolution bridge of fixed channel width. Its deployed footprint is 0.870M parameters, constant at fixed time steps and widths across a 43x range of input areas. Reparameterized spiking stages, temporal decoupled modulation, and a dynamic convex-hull-bounded dual-stream membrane-potential attention preserve accuracy under this compact design. Result-wise, RIPE-MambaSpike is pareto-optimal on CIFAR10-DVS, N-Caltech101, and DailyDVS-200. Notably, on the 200-class DailyDVS-200, a scaled 8.04M configuration achieves 45.7% top-1 accuracy, the best reported spiking result on that benchmark, and outperforms prior spiking methods with 3.0-15.1x fewer parameters than dense ANNs. Overall, our findings demonstrate that competitive event-based recognition does not require resolution-dependent parameter growth. Code is available at https://github.com/MuhiminOsim/RIPE-MambaSpike.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RIPE-MambaSpike，一种分辨率无关、参数高效的脉冲-Mamba混合模型，用于事件视觉识别，在极低参数量下取得竞争优势。
AI.motivation: 现有脉冲-Mamba混合模型精度强但参数量常达数千万，主要开销来自脉冲前端到状态空间骨干的连接投影，而非混合架构本身；例如某代表模型中单个分辨率相关投影占36.25M参数中的33.55M。
AI.method: 用固定通道宽度的分层多分辨率桥替换分辨率相关投影；引入重参数化脉冲阶段、时间解耦调制，以及动态凸包约束的双流膜电位注意力，以在紧凑设计中保持精度。
AI.result: 部署参数量为0.870M，在输入面积43倍变化范围内保持恒定；在CIFAR10-DVS、N-Caltech101和DailyDVS-200上达到帕累托最优。在200类DailyDVS-200上，8.04M配置达到45.7% top-1，为该基准最佳脉冲结果，并以比密集ANN少3.0-15.1倍参数超越先前脉冲方法。
AI.conclusion: 竞争性事件识别不必然需要分辨率相关的参数增长；RIPE-MambaSpike证明通过分辨率无关的紧凑桥接设计可实现高效且高精度的脉冲-Mamba混合识别。

title: SetOPD: From Few Visual Exemplars to Multimodal Candidate Sets for Remote-Sensing Open-Prompt Detection
summary: Open-prompt detectors allow users to specify targets with text, visual exemplars, or both. We argue that existing designs underuse the visual modality in two ways. First, multiple exemplars are commonly compressed into a single class-level embedding. This textualizes visual prompting: the resulting vector plays the role of another class name, is often aligned to or injected into the text pathway, and may be suboptimal when only a few heterogeneous exemplars are available. Second, existing methods interact primarily in prompt or representation space, before modality-specific detection states are formed. We address both issues from a set perspective: \setopd preserves modality-specific decoding states from a shared prompt-conditioned initialization and performs explicit multimodal collaboration at the candidate-state level. For the first issue, we introduce \br prompting, which reads every boxed exemplar in its full scene context and decomposes the pooled support evidence into a Base anchor and a learned Residual correction; the resulting prompt has fixed capacity regardless of the number of examples and drives its own visual detection pathway. For the second, we recast text--visual collaboration from representation-level fusion into a candidate-set modeling problem. Paired-Query Arbitration (\pqa) then performs explicit cross-modal state arbitration only after modality-specific candidate states have been formed. The two readers share query initialization so their candidates are paired by index; a learned gate arbitrates within each pair, followed by a permutation-equivariant module that reasons over the fused set.

AI.tldr: 提出集合视角的开放提示检测器 setopd，保留模态特定的解码状态，并在候选状态层面进行显式多模态协作；其核心包括 BR prompting 与 Paired-Query Arbitration（PQA）。
AI.motivation: 现有开放提示检测器对视觉模态利用不足：一是将多个视觉示例压缩为单一类级嵌入，使视觉提示被文本化，且示例少而异构时可能次优；二是在模态特定检测状态形成前，主要在提示或表示空间进行交互。
AI.method: setopd 从集合视角出发，在共享提示条件初始化下保留各模态特定解码状态。BR prompting 让每个带框示例在完整场景上下文中被读取，并将汇合的支持证据分解为 Base anchor 与学习到的 Residual 校正，使提示容量固定且驱动独立视觉检测通路。PQA 将文本-视觉协作重述为候选集建模问题：两个读取器共享查询初始化，候选按索引配对；学习门控在每对内仲裁，随后用置换等变模块对融合集合进行推理。
AI.result: 摘要未提供定量实验结果；主要结果为方法设计，声称可解决视觉模态利用不足问题，并在候选状态层面实现显式跨模态仲裁，且提示容量不随示例数量变化。
AI.conclusion: 开放提示检测应保留模态特定检测状态，并在候选集层面进行多模态协作；setopd 通过 BR prompting 和 PQA 更充分地利用视觉示例并实现显式跨模态仲裁。

title: Safety Reconstructed: Generative Modeling via Masked Diffusion Builds Strong Safety Guardrails
summary: Guard models are the last line of defense between a language model and a harmful output, yet their training objective is surprisingly narrow. Existing guards learn to predict a single verdict token from a conversational context, concentrating supervision on a single target. The consequences are structural: models latch onto shortcut features, are overconfident, and remain sensitive to where safety evidence appears in the sequence rather than its role in the full context. We propose a different framing. Rather than predicting a label from text, our LLaDA-Guard asks which label better explains the text: scoring the prompt or response under each label hypothesis and classifying based on their difference. This shifts supervision to every token in the moderated region, forcing the model to account for full content rather than its most discriminative fragments. We instantiate this idea with a masked diffusion language model, fine-tuning LLaDA-8B-Instruct with a class-conditional reconstruction objective using LoRA and requiring no architectural changes beyond the base model. LLaDA-Guard leads on average rank against discriminative baselines trained on stronger backbones across seven held-out safety benchmarks, while exhibiting substantially better confidence calibration (ECE 0.0875 vs. 0.1384 for Qwen3Guard), less over-defense on benign prompts with unsafe-looking cues, and less prompt leakage when moderating responses. Its generative nature further enables token-level risk localization as a natural byproduct, yielding a pipeline for rewriting unsafe prompts into safe equivalents without additional training and achieving a 60.7% average conversion-to-safe rate.

AI.tldr: 提出LLaDA-Guard，将安全防护从单一标签预测转为基于类条件重构的文本解释，利用掩码扩散模型LLaDA-8B-Instruct和LoRA微调，在多个安全基准上表现更优且校准更好。
AI.motivation: 现有guard模型训练目标狭窄，仅从对话上下文预测单一判定标签，导致模型依赖捷径特征、过度自信，并对安全证据在序列中的位置而非其在完整上下文中的作用敏感。
AI.method: 将标签预测重新定义为判断哪个标签能更好地解释文本：对每个标签假设下的提示或回复进行评分，并基于评分差异分类；用掩码扩散语言模型LLaDA-8B-Instruct，通过LoRA以类条件重构目标微调，无需架构改动。
AI.result: 在七个留出安全基准上平均排名领先于用更强骨干训练的判别基线；置信校准显著更好（ECE 0.0875 vs. Qwen3Guard的0.1384）；对含不安全线索的良性提示过度防御更少；审核回复时提示泄露更少；生成特性自然支持token级风险定位，无需额外训练即可将不安全提示改写为安全等价，平均安全转化率达60.7%。
AI.conclusion: 该框架将监督扩展到被审核区域的每个token，迫使模型考虑完整内容而非最具区分性的片段，从而提升安全检测性能、置信校准与泛化能力，并能自然支持风险定位与安全改写。

title: mmHRI: Towards Privacy-Preserving Human-Robot Interaction with Millimeter-Wave Radar
summary: Assistive robots increasingly operate in many human-centered environments and perform various human-robot interaction (HRI) tasks, such as object delivery. However, most existing HRI systems rely on RGB cameras that continuously observe humans to respond to non-verbal commands, such as hand gestures. This raises privacy concerns in privacy- critical environments, such as hospital wards or restaurants, where direct camera observation of humans is restricted. To develop privacy-preserving HRI, we leverage millimeter-wave (mmWave) radar, which can sense human motion through privacy barriers without identifiable imagery. We propose mmHRI, the first multi-modal robot manipulation framework that achieves mmWave radar-guided privacy-preserving HRI. mmHRI introduces two key designs to mitigate the sparsity and temporal inconsistency of radar data in cluttered robot manipulation environments. First, we propose a dual-stream architecture that jointly learns from unfiltered raw radar tensors and radar point clouds to estimate both human actions and 3D poses. To mitigate signal inconsistency, mmHRI further incorporates a memory-based state-space model (MSSM) that retains historical radar features to reduce abrupt changes in pose/action. These estimated human states are then converted into structured textual robot instructions, which control a vision-language-action (VLA) policy for closed-loop robot manipulation and human-aware reactions. Our evaluation covers human action recognition and closed-loop delivery and retrieval. In the privacy-preserving curtain setting, mmHRI achieves 85.09% action-recognition accuracy, outperforming existing radar-based alternatives. Robot trials further demonstrate successful delivery and retrieval under visual occlusion, with stable task performance across unseen subjects, clutter configurations, and environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 mmHRI，一种基于毫米波雷达的隐私保护人机交互与机器人操作框架，可在视觉遮挡或隐私敏感场景中识别人类动作与三维姿态，并驱动机器人完成闭环递送与取回任务。
AI.motivation: 现有 HRI 系统多依赖 RGB 摄像头持续观察人类，在医院病房、餐厅等隐私敏感环境中会引发隐私问题；而毫米波雷达可在不生成可识别图像的情况下感知人体运动，因此适合用于隐私保护型 HRI。
AI.method: mmHRI 采用多模态框架：设计双流架构，联合学习未滤波的原始雷达张量和雷达点云，以估计人类动作与 3D 姿态；引入基于记忆的状态空间模型（MSSM），保留历史雷达特征以缓解雷达数据的稀疏性和时间不一致性；将估计的人体状态转换为结构化文本机器人指令，进而控制视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略，实现闭环机器人操作和人类感知反应。
AI.result: 在隐私保护帘幕场景中，mmHRI 的动作识别准确率达到 85.09%，优于现有基于雷达的替代方案；机器人试验表明，在视觉遮挡下仍能成功完成递送和取回，并在未见受试者、杂乱配置和环境变化下保持稳定任务性能。
AI.conclusion: mmHRI 证明了利用毫米波雷达实现隐私保护 HRI 和机器人操作的可行性，能够在视觉受限或隐私敏感环境中支持稳定的人体状态感知与闭环机器人交互。

title: Learning to Learn from Context: Synthetic Training from Perturbed Public Documents
summary: Real-world tasks often require large language models (LLMs) to learn from complex task-specific context rather than pretrained parametric knowledge. This capability remains a weakness of LLMs, while human annotation for such task contexts is expensive and difficult to scale. Public high-quality documents are an abundant alternative, but much of the public web has already been consumed during pretraining: training on such documents naively would reward memorization rather than context learning. In this work, we attempt to make use of high-quality public documents with small perturbations and empirically find that LLMs can successfully generate context-dependent reasoning traces and answers, which are then used to train a student model. Specifically, we construct a synthesis pipeline that (i) rewrites source documents to reduce memorization risk, (ii) generates questions and rubrics that require reasoning over the document, (iii) answers the questions with the document as context, and (iv) admits only samples that genuinely depend on the document. Without any human annotators, our pipeline generates about 10k samples from 3.5k documents, and the resulting student model substantially improves the performance on CL-bench. SFT raises a Qwen3.6-35B-A3B student from 13.7% to 22.8%, and a subsequent rubric-reward RL stage reaches 24.6%, on CL-bench comparable with a frontier model of over a trillion parameters, Qwen3.8-2.4T (23.9%). We also observe a broad transfer of improvements to long-context understanding, instruction following, and reasoning, while code generation and knowledge remain mostly flat. We hope this work provides a reproducible and scalable way to improve the ability of LLMs to learn from context, and to facilitate further research on context-grounded reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种无需人工标注的合成流水线，利用带小扰动的高质量公开文档生成上下文依赖的推理数据，用于训练LLM提升其从任务上下文学习的能力。
AI.motivation: LLM在复杂任务特定上下文学习上仍较弱，而人工标注昂贵且难扩展；公开高质量文档虽多，但多数已在预训练中被消耗，直接训练会奖励记忆而非上下文学习。
AI.method: 构建合成流水线：(i)重写源文档以降低记忆风险；(ii)生成需要推理文档的问题和评分标准；(iii)以文档为上下文回答问题；(iv)仅保留真正依赖文档的样本。从3.5k文档生成约10k样本，并用于SFT和后续rubric-reward RL训练学生模型。
AI.result: 在CL-bench上，SFT将Qwen3.6-35B-A3B从13.7%提升至22.8%，RL阶段达到24.6%，接近超万亿参数前沿模型Qwen3.8-2.4T的23.9%。改进可迁移到长上下文理解、指令遵循和推理，而代码生成与知识基本持平。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了可复现、可扩展的方法来提升LLM从上下文学习的能力，并促进基于上下文的推理研究。

title: Dude, Where's My State? Execution Information Requirements for Stateful Agents
comment: 35 pages, 12 figures, 15 tables. Supplementary material included
summary: Long-running agents must preserve information that later steps depend on. We introduce the Execution Information Requirement (EIR), a lower bound on the information that must remain accessible for correct completion under specified task and access conditions. We develop LACUNA, a framework that generates tasks with known dependencies and varies information demand, retention, and recovery separately from the difficulty of individual operations. Across four models, restoring a missing result raises accuracy on affected recall steps to 100%, compared with 0% for equal-length irrelevant information. Sufficient storage alone does not ensure success: retention policies can discard required results, errors can propagate through later computations, and agents can stop before recovery is complete. We also introduce VESTIGE, which uses agent execution traces to construct semantic graphs and measure information demand for real tasks. Across 72,562 software-agent trajectories, VESTIGE reveals a steeper distance-related decline in solution-relevant rereading for failed runs (RR 0.951 per distance doubling), while adjusted peak demand alone is not associated with failure. Together, these contributions support evaluating whether agents preserve and recover the information their tasks require.

AI.tldr: 论文提出执行信息需求（EIR）来刻画长时程智能体正确完成任务所需保留和恢复的信息，并开发 LACUNA 与 VESTIGE 分别生成受控任务和分析真实执行轨迹。
AI.motivation: 长时运行的智能体必须保留后续步骤依赖的信息，但现有评估难以区分信息需求、保留、恢复与单步操作难度对任务成功的影响。
AI.method: 提出 EIR 作为在给定任务和访问条件下正确完成所需信息的下界；开发 LACUNA，生成依赖关系已知且可分别变化信息需求、保留和恢复的任务；开发 VESTIGE，利用智能体执行轨迹构建语义图并度量真实任务的信息需求。
AI.result: 在四个模型上，恢复缺失结果可使受影响回忆步骤准确率达到 100%，而等长无关信息仅为 0%；仅有足够存储并不保证成功，保留策略可能丢弃必需结果，错误会向后传播，智能体也可能在恢复完成前停止。分析 72,562 条软件智能体轨迹发现，失败运行中与距离相关的、对解题有用的重读下降更陡（距离每翻倍 RR 0.951），而调整后的峰值需求本身与失败无关。
AI.conclusion: 这些贡献为评估智能体是否保留并恢复任务所需信息提供了方法和证据。

title: Proprioceptive Force Estimation for Quadruped Locomotion and Human-Robot Interaction
summary: Payload forces must be accommodated during locomotion, while leash forces can specify desired motion. We investigate whether a shared three-dimensional force estimate in newtons, inferred from proprioceptive history under sustained loading, can support both tasks. An estimator and locomotion policy are jointly trained with supervised force and velocity outputs and learned latent context. The estimated force conditions locomotion and additionally generates planar-velocity and yaw-rate commands for leash guidance through an analytical map. In sustained-force simulation sweeps, temporal means of componentwise force root mean square error range from 1.44 to 2.83\,N. Compared with a domain-randomized baseline, the framework reduces velocity-tracking and base-orientation error scores by 21.6\% and 46.5\%, respectively, and increases mean survival from 68.29\% to 94.60\% in separate sustained-force tests. Unitree Go1 experiments demonstrate stationary vertical and horizontal force estimation, locomotion with an 8.5\,kg payload whose weight exceeds the 70\,N training force limit, and leash guidance using the same force-estimation interface.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一种共享的三维力估计方法，从本体感觉历史中推断持续负载力，并同时用于负载适应和牵引引导。估计器与运动策略联合训练，输出力和速度并学习潜在上下文。
AI.motivation: 机器人在运动过程中需要适应负载力，同时牵引绳力可用于指定期望运动。作者希望验证一个统一的三维力估计能否同时支持这两类任务。
AI.method: 联合训练力估计器与运动策略，采用监督的力/速度输出和学习的潜在上下文。估计力用于条件化运动策略，并通过解析映射生成平面速度和偏航率指令，以实现牵引引导。
AI.result: 在持续力仿真测试中，各分量力RMSE的时间均值范围为1.44至2.83 N。与域随机化基线相比，速度跟踪和基座朝向误差得分分别降低21.6%和46.5%，平均存活率从68.29%提升至94.60%。Unitree Go1实验展示了静态垂直/水平力估计、承载8.5 kg（超过70 N训练力上限）的运动，以及使用同一力估计接口的牵引引导。
AI.conclusion: 共享的三维力估计接口能够同时支持负载适应与牵引引导，并在超过训练力范围的负载下实现有效泛化。

title: Tsubame: Tree Replay for Diffusion-Based Speculative Decoding
summary: Context-aware dynamic trees allocate the speculative decoding budget according to draft path probabilities, adapting their depth and branching to the current context. Under stochastic decoding, however, we find that this structural advantage does not always compensate for the acceptance gains of random sampling paired with advanced verification, and such dynamic trees can fall behind sampled chains in some settings. These trees grow their topology from the candidates themselves, so the tokens submitted for verification are typically the deterministic high-score tokens selected during construction. This coupling is not inherent: once the topology is fixed, its nodes can be repopulated by sampling, allowing dynamic trees to retain their structural advantage while also benefiting from random sampling and advanced verification. Diffusion-based drafters make this practical, as their parallel outputs or lightweight conditional corrections allow candidates to be regenerated cheaply after the complete topology is known. We introduce Tsubame, a two-pass tree speculative decoding framework for diffusion-based drafters. The first pass plans and freezes a context-aware topology using draft path scores; the second replays the fixed topology, sampling the tokens that populate its nodes to form the candidate tree for verification. We prove that Tsubame is lossless under compatible sampling and verification strategies. Experiments across three diffusion-based drafters, six datasets, and multiple candidate budgets show that Tsubame improves acceptance length and throughput over deterministic trees, including settings where it reverses their disadvantage against sampled chains.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Tsubame，一种面向扩散草稿模型的两遍树式投机解码框架：先基于草稿路径分数规划并冻结上下文感知拓扑，再重放该拓扑并采样节点 token 以进行验证，从而兼顾动态树结构与随机采样及高级验证的优势。
AI.motivation: 上下文感知动态树按草稿路径概率分配投机预算，但在随机解码下，其结构优势不一定能抵消随机采样加高级验证带来的接受率提升，某些场景甚至落后于采样链；原因是动态树由候选本身生长，待验证 token 多为构造时选出的确定性高分 token。
AI.method: 解耦拓扑与节点内容：第一遍规划并冻结上下文感知拓扑；第二遍在固定拓扑上重新采样节点 token，形成候选树再验证。利用扩散草稿器可并行生成或轻量条件修正，在拓扑确定后低成本重生成候选；并证明在兼容采样与验证策略下无损。
AI.result: 在三种扩散草稿器、六个数据集和多种候选预算上，Tsubame 相比确定性树提升接受长度和吞吐，并在部分设置中扭转其相对于采样链的劣势。
AI.conclusion: 通过将上下文感知树拓扑与随机采样及高级验证解耦，可更充分发挥动态树投机解码优势；Tsubame 为扩散草稿器提供无损且高效的树式投机解码方案。

title: GAE: General Action Expert for Real-Time Humanoid Teleoperation
summary: Humanoid avatars extend human physical presence beyond the body, enabling people to participate in social, service, and labor activities through remotely operated robots. This requires teleoperation systems capable of realizing diverse and dynamic whole-body behaviors while maintaining responsive human-robot synchronization. We present General Action Expert(GAE), a unified learning framework for general-purpose, low-latency humanoid whole-body teleoperation. To cover diverse human behaviors, GAE builds a large-scale human motion dataset from heterogeneous sources, including videos, animations, and motion capture, followed by standardization and augmentation. GAE then addresses the noise and embodiment mismatch in human motions with a two-stage training paradigm: a privileged generator policy first tracks human motion references in simulation and rolls out feasible humanoid trajectories; a deployable executor policy then learns to track these generated trajectories under curriculum domain randomization. For responsive human-robot synchronization, GAE introduces a latency-conditioned anticipation mechanism that adaptively compensates for end-to-end delay during real-time teleoperation. Simulation and real-world experiments on Unitree G1 and Westlake O1 robots demonstrate that GAE enables humanoids to smoothly mirror diverse, agile, and expressive human behaviors. Project website: https://wangyf0928.github.io/gae-wlrobotics/

AI.tldr: 本文提出GAE，一个面向通用、低延迟人形机器人全身遥操作的统一学习框架，使机器人能够平滑模仿多样、敏捷且富有表现力的人类行为。
AI.motivation: 人形化身可借助远程操控机器人拓展人类存在感，但现有遥操作需同时支持多样动态的全身行为，并保持响应式人机同步。
AI.method: GAE从视频、动画和动捕等异构来源构建大规模人体运动数据集，并进行标准化与增强；采用两阶段训练：先由特权生成器策略在仿真中跟踪人体运动并生成可行人形轨迹，再由可部署执行器策略在课程域随机化下学习跟踪这些轨迹；同时引入延迟条件预判机制以自适应补偿端到端延迟。
AI.result: 在Unitree G1和Westlake O1机器人上的仿真与真实实验表明，GAE可让人形机器人平滑模仿多样、敏捷且富有表现力的人类行为。
AI.conclusion: GAE可作为通用、低延迟人形全身遥操作的有效统一学习框架，提升人形机器人远程呈现与行为模仿能力。

title: World Agent: Can Language Models Keep a World Running?
summary: World models are moving from generating realistic frames to generating playable worlds, yet whether a delivered world can keep running is not tested anywhere. Existing evaluations stop at generation, at delivery, or at single-step transitions, and each stops at a different point along the way. Correct local state transitions or intermediate outcomes do not guarantee a correctly organized causal event flow. We propose the world agent task, which moves the evaluation point of world generation from the moment of delivery to the continued operation that follows. In this task, a model is not asked to generate a world. It is held responsible for keeping the world running, which requires coordinating events and carrying forward their consequences to constrain subsequent evolution. We instantiate the task in WorldAgent-Benchmark with two complementary tracks. In the maintenance track, the model must ground the events of a continuous narrative into correct transitions of the explicit world state while respecting causal, temporal, and concurrency constraints. In the deduction track, the model must predict how the world will evolve under partial observations and act toward a goal. The maintenance track combines LLM-assisted semantic judgments with programmatic validation and scoring, while the deduction track is evaluated entirely programmatically. Individual judgments are auditable against world states and execution logs, and scores can be recomputed from the saved judgments and execution records. Across 8 models, scores decline steadily as pre-built structure is removed from the world, and causal-relation checking is the weakest component for every model. The benchmark makes the continued operation of a world measurable and distinguishes local completion from failures in event organization. Code and dataset will be released on https://github.com/HCPLab-SYSU/WorldAgent-Benchmark.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“世界智能体”任务及 WorldAgent-Benchmark，将世界模型评估从生成或交付时刻推进到持续运行阶段，通过维护与推演两个赛道检验模型能否组织因果事件并继承后果，从而维持世界运行。
AI.motivation: 现有评估多停留在世界生成、交付或单步状态转移，不能保证正确的事件组织与因果演进；局部状态转移正确不等于世界能持续、一致地运行。
AI.method: 提出 world agent 任务，要求模型负责保持世界持续运行，协调事件并传递后果。构建 WorldAgent-Benchmark，包含：维护赛道，将连续叙事事件落地为显式世界状态转移，并满足因果、时间与并发约束，采用 LLM 辅助语义判断与程序化验证评分；推演赛道，在部分观测下预测世界演化并朝目标行动，完全程序化评估。判断可依据世界状态与执行日志审计，分数可由保存记录重算。
AI.result: 在 8 个模型上，随着预构建结构被移除，分数持续下降；因果关系检查是所有模型最弱的环节。
AI.conclusion: 该基准使世界持续运行能力可测量，并能区分局部完成与事件组织失败；代码与数据集将在 GitHub 发布。

title: One Model Is Not a Crowd: Multi-LLM and Aspect-Conditioned Diverse Comment Generation
summary: Human communication on the internet is shaped by diverse perspectives, most visibly expressed in online comment spaces. As large language model (LLM)based AI agents begin to inhabit these spaces, a key question arises: whether synthetic comment threads can capture the diversity inherent in human discourse. This concern is increasingly important, as the growing presence of homogenized AI-generated content risks reducing diversity over time, potentially leading to model collapse and degrading the richness of digital communication. Inspired by the plurality of human crowds and the aspect-driven nature of discourse, we hypothesize that comment diversity is better approximated by combining multiple LLMs with aspect-conditioned generation. We formalize and evaluate this approach using models from different providers and introduce a framework that characterizes diversity across semantic, linguistic, and socio-pragmatic features along three axes: dispersion, coverage, and alignment. Using this framework, we conduct a large-scale study on over 2 million YouTube comments across multiple domains. Our results reveal that multi-LLM and aspect-conditioned generation better align with human comment distributions and such data remains viable under pretraining style curation and is effective for downstream tasks. Yet, human diversity remains unmatched. Overall, our findings provide a practical foundation for generating more diverse and socially grounded discourse in AI-mediated environments.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨基于大语言模型的AI代理能否生成具有人类多样性的评论，提出多LLM与方面条件生成相结合的方法，并在大规模YouTube评论数据上评估其多样性、可用性与下游任务效果。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM代理进入在线评论空间，AI生成内容可能趋于同质化，长期会降低话语多样性、引发模型崩溃并削弱数字交流的丰富性，因此需要研究如何生成更接近人类多样性的评论。
AI.method: 结合多个不同提供商的LLM与方面条件生成，构建从语义、语言和社会语用特征出发，沿分散度、覆盖度和对齐度三个轴衡量多样性的框架，并对超过200万条多领域YouTube评论进行大规模研究。
AI.result: 多LLM和方面条件生成在评论分布上更接近人类，且在预训练风格筛选下仍具可用性，并对下游任务有效；但生成内容仍无法完全匹敌人类多样性。
AI.conclusion: 研究为在AI介导环境中生成更多样、更具社会根基的话语提供了实用基础，同时表明人类话语多样性仍是更高标准。

title: IGSD: Environment-Verified Hindsight Self-Distillation for Search Agents
summary: On-policy self-distillation densifies agent training without external teachers: a policy conditioned on privileged hindsight provides step-level guidance for its own unprivileged rollouts. For search agents, however, hindsight can make the teacher prefer a query that does not improve retrieval from the student's state. Existing methods either distill this preference directly or filter it with model-internal scores, but neither strategy verifies the query's executed retrieval consequence. We propose Information-Gain-Gated Self-Distillation (IGSD), which verifies on-policy token proposals with environment feedback before distilling them. Treating each query token as a micro-action, IGSD completes the teacher's token proposal and the student's sampled token into matched queries and executes both from the same failed state with the same retriever. Shared counterfactual controls account for query-conditioned shifts in answer likelihood, so their difference, the executed paired information gain, provides a relative utility contrast for the retrieved documents. IGSD uses this contrast as a positive-only soft weight for candidate-pair distillation, while leaving the GRPO objective unchanged and confining verification to training. Across seven single-hop and multi-hop QA benchmarks, IGSD reaches macro-average exact-match accuracies of 42.8% and 47.0% with 3B and 7B policies, respectively, without inference-time verification. These results support environment-verified hindsight as an effective approach to reliable action-level supervision for search agents.

AI.tldr: 提出信息增益门控自蒸馏（IGSD），在蒸馏前用环境反馈验证on-policy token提议，从而为搜索智能体提供动作级监督。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy自蒸馏用特权hindsight指导搜索智能体，但hindsight可能偏好不能改善学生检索的query；已有方法直接蒸馏或用模型内部评分过滤，均未验证query执行后的检索后果。
AI.method: 将每个query token视为微动作，把教师提议的token与学生的采样token补全为匹配query，并在同一失败状态和同一检索器下执行；通过共享反事实控制校正答案似然偏移，以执行配对信息增益作为相对效用对比；将其作为仅正软权重用于候选对蒸馏，保持GRPO目标不变，且验证仅用于训练。
AI.result: 在七个单跳和多跳QA基准上，3B和7B策略的宏平均精确匹配准确率分别达到42.8%和47.0%，且推理时无需验证。
AI.conclusion: 环境验证的hindsight是向搜索智能体提供可靠动作级监督的有效方法。

title: In-Flight KV Cache with Clean Anchors for Faster Autoregressive Video Diffusion
summary: Few-step autoregressive video diffusion generates a long video by splitting the video into temporal chunks and generating chunk-by-chunk, each through a short sequence of denoising stages. To memorize chunks that are already generated, previous methods reconstruct a clean or less-noisy key--value (KV) cache by additional forwards to build the cache without advancing an output latent. However, every denoising forward itself already computes the in-flight KV of the current chunk. We introduce FlashForward, which directly reuses this cache to avoid the heavy cache-update-only model forwards. After the current chunk completes one denoising stage, its stage-specific cache is already available for the next chunk. Assigning one GPU to each stage therefore lets different chunks occupy different stages concurrently. This early availability has a quality cost: the resulting stage-matched history is noisy, causing appearance and motion drift among chunks. To complement it, FlashForward produces sparse auxiliary clean anchor latents before the corresponding region is generated so the generation trajectories can be stabilized by this two-sided conditioning. The two memories operate at different temporal scales: sparse clean anchor KV supplies coarse, long-range two-sided structural guidance, while dense stage-matched history preserves fine, recent evolution. With up to four GPUs, FlashForward runs $1.16$--$1.69\times$ faster than HiAR and $1.42$--$2.92\times$ faster than Self-Forcing for 16 FPS videos of 20 seconds or longer across 1.3B and 14B backbone scales at 480p and 720p. On VBench, for the 1.3B model at 480p, it achieves higher scores and remains stable at longer durations, demonstrating that FlashForward generates high-quality and temporally consistent videos across durations of 20s, 35s and 65s at a much faster generation speed.

AI.tldr: FlashForward 是一种少步自回归视频扩散方法，通过复用去噪过程中的 KV 缓存并分配 GPU 到不同去噪阶段，实现长视频快速生成，同时用稀疏干净锚点 KV 稳定生成。
AI.motivation: 现有方法为记忆已生成块，需额外前向重建干净或低噪 KV 缓存，计算开销大；而每次去噪前向本身已计算当前块的在途 KV，可被直接复用。
AI.method: 直接复用当前块去噪阶段产生的 KV 缓存供下一块使用；每个去噪阶段分配一个 GPU，使不同块在不同阶段并发；同时生成稀疏辅助干净锚点 latent，提供粗粒度长程双侧结构引导，与密集阶段匹配历史（细粒度近期演化）互补。
AI.result: 最多 4 GPU 下，比 HiAR 快 1.16–1.69 倍，比 Self-Forcing 快 1.42–2.92 倍；16 FPS、20 秒以上视频，1.3B 和 14B 模型，480p 和 720p。VBench 上 1.3B 480p 得分更高，20s、35s、65s 时长下稳定。
AI.conclusion: FlashForward 能更快生成高质量、时序一致的长视频，并保持较长时长下的稳定性。

title: Harnessing Coupled Stream Completion For Human-Object Ineraction Modeling
summary: Text-conditioned human-object interaction (HOI) generation requires body motion, object trajectories & rotations, and hand articulation to remain coordinated. These components differ in scale and dynamics, but must agree on contact, relative pose, and timing. A shared representation may limit the distinct structure of each stream, while independent generation prevents each stream from responding to changes in the others. Latent supervision alone also does not directly constrain contact after decoding. We propose TRACE, a continuous latent framework that keeps stream states separate and couples their updates. TRACE encodes body, object, and hand motion into separate latents and predicts each stream velocity from the complete current interaction state. Geometric losses on decoded motion further constrain contact and object-relative motion over time. The same model supports completion of any single absent stream from the other two. Frozen flow features also serve as input to a language model for HOI understanding. Experiments on InterAct, OMOMO, and BEHAVE show that joint completion training improves generation and that frozen flow features improve understanding over raw-motion encoding. On InterAct, TRACE achieves the highest contact precision, recall, and F1 among the compared methods.

AI.tldr: 提出TRACE，一种连续潜在框架，用于文本条件下的人-物交互生成。它将身体、物体和手部运动分别编码为独立潜在状态，并耦合更新，同时用几何损失约束接触与相对运动；同一模型还能从两个已知流补全缺失流，并支持HOI理解。
AI.motivation: 文本条件下的HOI生成需要身体运动、物体轨迹与旋转、手部关节运动保持协调。这些分量尺度与动态不同，但必须在接触、相对姿态和时序上一致。共享表示可能削弱各流独特结构，独立生成又无法响应其他流变化，且仅靠潜在监督不能直接约束解码后的接触。
AI.method: TRACE将身体、物体和手部运动编码为分离的潜在表示，并根据完整当前交互状态预测各流速度，从而在保持流状态分离的同时耦合更新。对解码后的运动施加几何损失，以约束接触和物体相对运动。同一模型可完成任一缺失流。冻结的流特征还可输入语言模型用于HOI理解。
AI.result: 在InterAct、OMOMO和BEHAVE上实验表明：联合补全训练提升生成效果；冻结流特征相比原始运动编码提升理解性能。在InterAct上，TRACE在接触精度、召回率和F1上均优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: 分离但耦合的潜在流表示，结合几何约束和联合补全训练，能有效提升协调的人-物交互生成与理解。

title: WAM-OPD: Sharpening World Action Models via On-Policy Distillation
summary: Pretrained world action models (WAMs) provide generalist capabilities across diverse robotic manipulation tasks, yet improving target-task performance to an expert level without degrading pretrained skills remains challenging. We explore on-policy distillation (OPD) for WAMs and introduce WAM-OPD. WAM-OPD inherits the advantage of OPD methods that transfer task-specific teacher knowledge under the student's own induced distribution, rather than directly fitting the student to a narrow task-specific data distribution. However, in closed-loop manipulation, the observation histories change as the student policy evolves, requiring fresh environment rollouts to remain on-policy. Applying OPD to WAMs entails repeated data collection, which is costly even in simulation and often impractical on real robots. To avoid repeated environment rollouts during distillation, we introduce prefix-weighted trajectory replay (PWTR). PWTR uses a fixed trajectory pool composed primarily of initial-student rollouts, supplemented with task-specific teacher rollouts to broaden trajectory coverage. For each trajectory replayed from this pool, PWTR conditions the current policy on successive stored histories to generate fresh denoising paths, along which the task-specific teacher provides supervision. Although these denoising paths are refreshed as the policy evolves, the replayed environment trajectories remain fixed. PWTR therefore reweights per-decision distillation losses using proxy importance weights derived from path scores accumulated over the trajectory prefix preceding each decision to mitigate the resulting shift in the history distribution. Simulated and real-world experiments demonstrate task adaptation without additional environment interaction during distillation. In both settings, WAM-OPD improves target-task performance while retaining near-initial performance on tasks excluded from adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出WAM-OPD，一种用于预训练世界动作模型(WAM)的在线蒸馏方法，通过前缀加权轨迹重放(PWTR)避免重复环境交互，实现目标任务适应且不遗忘预训练技能。
AI.motivation: 预训练WAM具备通用操作能力，但如何在不降低预训练技能的前提下将目标任务性能提升到专家水平仍具挑战；直接在线蒸馏需重复环境rollout，成本高，真实机器人上常不可行。
AI.method: 基于在线蒸馏(OPD)，让学生策略在自己诱导的分布下学习任务特定教师知识。引入PWTR：使用固定轨迹池（初始学生rollout+教师rollout），对每条重放轨迹，用当前策略基于存储历史生成新去噪路径，教师进行监督；用路径分数累积得到的代理重要性权重对每决策蒸馏损失重加权，缓解历史分布偏移。
AI.result: 仿真与真实实验表明，蒸馏期间无需额外环境交互即可实现任务适应；WAM-OPD提升目标任务性能，同时在未适应任务上保持接近初始性能。
AI.conclusion: WAM-OPD结合PWTR可有效对WAM进行在线蒸馏，实现目标任务专家级适应且避免灾难性遗忘，减少环境交互成本。

title: Closing the Cross-Dialect Gap: Query Plans as a Portable Interface in Text-to-SQL
comment: Accepted at Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Text-to-SQL systems are typically trained and evaluated on a single dialect (SQLite), yet production deployments span PostgreSQL, MySQL, ClickHouse, and beyond. We show that this single-dialect assumption leads to a substantial drop in cross-dialect accuracy for every model we tested. The drop persists across scale, architecture, and even purpose-built text-to-SQL systems. We argue that the fix is to change the generation target: instead of asking an LLM to emit dialect-specific SQL, we have it emit a dialect-agnostic relational algebra query plan, which a deterministic compiler then renders into SQL for any supported backend. Across thirteen models from 3B to frontier scale, this restores cross-dialect portability nearly uniformly, at a small cost in peak accuracy on the model's home dialect for capable prompted models and none once fine-tuned on plans; under matched fine-tuning, plan supervision yields a stronger model than SQL supervision. We also introduce MetricName, a question-aware result-set comparator needed to evaluate fairly across dialects, where existing metrics confound semantic errors with benign cross-dialect variation. More broadly, the result is a reminder that a generation target chosen for execution is not necessarily the one that maximizes generation quality.

AI.tldr: 论文指出Text-to-SQL系统通常在单一SQL方言（如SQLite）上训练和评估，导致跨方言准确率大幅下降；提出让LLM生成方言无关的关系代数查询计划，再由确定性编译器转为任意后端SQL，从而恢复跨方言可移植性，并引入MetricName评估指标。
AI.motivation: 生产环境需支持PostgreSQL、MySQL、ClickHouse等多种数据库方言，但现有系统仅针对单一方言训练评估，导致跨方言部署时性能显著下降，因此需要改变生成目标以提升可移植性。
AI.method: 让LLM生成方言无关的关系代数查询计划，而非特定方言SQL；用确定性编译器将计划渲染为任意支持后端的SQL；在13个3B到前沿规模的模型上验证；引入问题感知的结果集比较器MetricName以公平跨方言评估；并对比计划监督与SQL监督的微调效果。
AI.result: 单一方言假设导致所有测试模型跨方言准确率大幅下降，且该问题跨规模、架构和专用系统持续存在；生成关系代数计划几乎统一恢复跨方言可移植性，有能力的提示模型在母方言峰值准确率上略有损失，微调后则无损失；匹配微调下，计划监督比SQL监督得到更强模型；MetricName可避免现有指标将语义错误与良性方言差异混淆。
AI.conclusion: 为执行选择的生成目标不一定能最大化生成质量；采用方言无关的中间表示（关系代数计划）可有效提升Text-to-SQL系统的跨方言部署能力，评估时需使用问题感知的结果集比较器。

title: Feature Space Guidance for Breast Cancer Classification in DCE-MRI
summary: Dynamic contrast enhanced breast MRI (DCE-MRI) is a powerful clinical tool for breast cancer detection, providing high resolution anatomical detail together with rich temporal contrast information. However, high dimensional 4D inputs, small lesions, and heterogeneous acquisition protocols across clinical sites hinder robust automated classification of healthy, benign, and malignant cases. To address these challenges, we propose a framework that dynamically analyzes latent representations to adapt to protocol-specific characteristics. Spatial variability is mitigated by reducing confounding background uptake and compensating for misalignment caused by deformable soft tissue. Additionally, relationships in the latent space across phases are leveraged to select the most informative temporal features, improving robustness to protocol-specific temporal variability. Finally, task specific discriminative features are promoted through large scale supervised lesion segmentation pretraining, which substantially enhances downstream finetuning. Evaluated under leave-one-center-out validation on the ODELIA dataset and the held-out AMBL cohort, the proposed framework substantially outperforms finetuned radiology foundation models and prior methods, improving mean AUROC by nearly 8 points and balanced accuracy by 4 points over the strongest baseline. Additionally, our method achieved first place in the MICCAI ODELIA Breast MRI Challenge 2025, further demonstrating its effectiveness for robust breast cancer classification. We publicly release our codebase under https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/CURIAtor.

AI.tldr: 提出一种动态分析潜在表示以适配不同采集协议的DCE-MRI乳腺分类框架，在多中心数据集上显著优于基线，并获得MICCAI ODELIA 2025挑战赛第一名。
AI.motivation: DCE-MRI是高维4D数据，病灶小且不同临床中心采集协议差异大，导致健康、良性、恶性病例的自动化分类难以稳健泛化。
AI.method: 动态分析潜在表示以适应协议特征；通过减少背景摄取和补偿软组织形变带来的错位来缓解空间变异；利用跨期潜在空间关系选择最具信息量的时间特征；采用大规模监督病灶分割预训练提升下游微调效果。
AI.result: 在ODELIA数据集和AMBL队列的留一中心验证中，平均AUROC比最强基线提高近8个点，平衡准确率提高4个点，优于微调的放射学基础模型和既有方法，并在MICCAI ODELIA Breast MRI Challenge 2025中获得第一名。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能有效应对多中心DCE-MRI的协议异质性和空间/时间变异，实现稳健的乳腺癌症分类，并已公开代码。

title: UMR: Universal Manipulation Representation
comment: Submitted to IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA)
summary: General-purpose embodied manipulation hinges on a unified action representation that generalizes across embodiments and scales readily. Yet existing policies rely on embodiment-specific action spaces, making cross-embodiment demonstrations difficult to leverage at scale and limiting transfer to new embodiments and spatial variations. To this end, we introduce Universal Manipulation Representation (UMR), a unified action representation that enables zero-shot skill transfer from human demonstrations to heterogeneous robots. UMR decomposes manipulation into two functionally distinct yet geometrically linked components: embodiment-agnostic World Flow, which describes task-relevant object motion in the world frame, and Ego Trajectory, which represents end-effector motion relative to the current pose.
