We instantiate UMR as World--Ego Point VLA (WEPVLA), a compact 0.5B-parameter policy that learns in the unified geometric action space through a dual-stream Point Action Adapter and a unified Point Action Expert, with an $SE(3)$ conjugation coupling the two components. To improve data efficiency, we complement UMR with a Data-Efficient Strategy (DES) that diversifies object configurations through stage-aware point-cloud editing while preserving demonstrated contact geometry. In simulation, WEPVLA achieves average success rates of 97.5\% on LIBERO and 85.7\% on the 10-task RLBench benchmark. In real-world experiments, a single policy trained on human demonstrations augmented by DES transfers zero-shot to diverse deployment conditions. With about 10 minutes of collected human demonstrations per task and no robot demonstrations, it achieves 91.7\% average success across six evaluation settings, compared with 60.8\% for HumanEgo. Code and additional materials are available at https://umr-wepvla.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出统一操作表示UMR，将操作分解为世界帧物体运动（World Flow）与自运动（Ego Trajectory），并实例化为0.5B参数的WEPVLA策略，实现从人类演示到异构机器人的零样本技能迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有策略依赖具身特定的动作空间，难以大规模利用跨具身演示，限制了向新具身和空间变化的迁移。
AI.method: 提出UMR统一动作表示，包含具身无关的World Flow和相对当前位姿的Ego Trajectory，通过SE(3)共轭耦合；实例化为WEPVLA，采用双流Point Action Adapter和统一Point Action Expert；并辅以数据高效策略DES，通过阶段感知点云编辑多样化物体配置同时保留演示接触几何。
AI.result: 仿真中LIBERO平均成功率97.5%，RLBench 10任务85.7%；真实世界单策略仅用每任务约10分钟人类演示（无机器人演示），零样本迁移到六种评估设置，平均成功率91.7%，显著优于HumanEgo的60.8%。
AI.conclusion: UMR与WEPVLA实现了跨具身零样本技能迁移，数据高效，展现出通用具身操作的潜力。

title: CAIRN: Dynamic Fact-Intent DAGs for Multi-Agent Exploration
summary: LLM-powered autonomous systems have demonstrated promising capabilities in mathematical reasoning, engineering, and cybersecurity. Yet how to organize these systems for effective, reliable, and sustained performance remains an open question. In this paper, we present CAIRN, a fact-intent-driven multi-agent paradigm for goal-directed exploration. CAIRN represents observations and planned investigations as a dynamic directed acyclic graph (DAG). A reasoner interprets facts to propose intents, which workers execute to produce new facts. Each intent references its supporting facts and defines a potential exploration branch. The persistent graph preserves goals, dependencies and findings across workers, supporting knowledge reuse and parallel exploration. The graph also makes execution trajectories traceable and auditable, providing a basis for human verification and intervention. We evaluate CAIRN across cybersecurity and mathematical reasoning tasks, examining task success, time to solution, and token consumption. DAG-based coordination can incur higher token costs with no observable performance gains on tasks that require little effort. However, on high-effort tasks (at least 1M tokens), we observe faster solutions in 76.5% of cases, with speedups of up to 3.08x. Moreover, as task effort increases, these time gains become more pronounced while relative token overhead declines, highlighting the potential of DAG-guided parallel exploration.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CAIRN，一种事实-意图驱动的多智能体范式，通过动态有向无环图（DAG）组织目标导向探索，并在网络安全与数学推理任务中评估其效果、时间和Token消耗。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的自主系统在数学推理、工程和网络安全中展现出潜力，但如何组织这些系统以实现有效、可靠且可持续的性能仍是一个开放问题。
AI.method: CAIRN将观察和计划中的调查表示为动态DAG。推理器解释事实以提出意图，工作者执行意图以产生新事实。每个意图引用其支持事实并定义潜在探索分支。持久图保留目标、依赖和发现，支持知识复用与并行探索，并使执行轨迹可追踪、可审计，便于人工验证和干预。在网络安全和数学推理任务上评估任务成功率、求解时间和Token消耗。
AI.result: 在低努力任务上，基于DAG的协调可能带来更高Token成本且无可见性能提升。但在高努力任务（至少100万Token）中，76.5%的案例求解更快，加速最高达3.08倍。随着任务努力增加，时间收益更明显，相对Token开销下降。
AI.conclusion: DAG引导的并行探索具有潜力，尤其适用于高努力任务，可在增加一定Token开销的情况下显著缩短求解时间。

title: Flat-Consensus Diffusion for Robust Data Reshaping under Noisy Evaluator
summary: Data shape determines how features are structured, how patterns are separated, and how distributions cover the underlying domain. Poor data shape can make models learn noise rather than generalizable structure. This paper studies robust feature-centric data reshaping: generating feature transformations that remain useful, stable, and reproducible under noisy evaluation and imperfect data conditions. We view reshaping operation sequence search as reward-guided diffusion generation, and robust reshaping as searching for regions in the latent reward landscape rather than isolated high-reward transformations. The key challenge is dual instability: noisy evaluators distort local reward guidance, while stochastic generative trajectories can converge to inconsistent solutions. We propose FCDiff, a flat-consensus diffusion framework that addresses both failures through a micro-macro decomposition. The micro layer replaces point-estimate reward guidance with Gaussian-smoothed, Monte Carlo averaged gradients, steering generation toward locally flat reward regions. The macro layer aggregates independently guided trajectories with a weighted Frechet-mean barycenter, selecting consensus-supported basins and filtering stochastic outliers. Across an 8-dataset headline cohort under heavy-tailed evaluator noise, FCDiff attains the best aggregate rank on lower-tail reliability and robustness against both search-based AutoFE and robustness-oriented generative baselines, with statistically significant accuracy gains over every generative baseline. Our results show that robust data reshaping requires searching for flat, consensus-supported regions rather than sharp single-trajectory optima.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FCDiff，一种平坦共识扩散框架，用于稳健的以特征为中心的数据重塑（特征变换）。该方法将重塑操作序列搜索视为奖励引导的扩散生成，并通过微观-宏观分解在含噪评估下寻找潜在奖励景观中的平坦且共识支持的区域。
AI.motivation: 数据形状决定了特征结构、模式分离和分布覆盖；不良数据形状会使模型学习噪声而非可泛化结构。研究动机是生成在噪声评估和不完美数据条件下仍有用、稳定且可复现的特征变换。核心挑战是双重不稳定性：噪声评估器扭曲局部奖励引导，而随机生成轨迹可能收敛到不一致解。
AI.method: 将重塑操作序列搜索建模为奖励引导的扩散生成，并将稳健重塑视为在潜在奖励景观中搜索区域而非孤立高奖励变换。提出FCDiff，采用微观-宏观分解：微观层用高斯平滑的蒙特卡洛平均梯度替代点估计奖励引导，使生成趋向局部平坦奖励区域；宏观层用加权Frechet均值重心聚合独立引导轨迹，选择共识支持的盆地并过滤随机离群点。
AI.result: 在重尾评估器噪声下的8数据集主要队列中，FCDiff在下尾可靠性和稳健性上取得最佳综合排名，优于基于搜索的AutoFE和面向稳健性的生成基线，并对每个生成基线均取得统计显著的准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，稳健的数据重塑需要搜索平坦且共识支持的区域，而不是尖锐的单轨迹最优解。

title: CFCH: Coarse-Fine Collaborative Hierarchical Learning for Anterior Segment Disease Analysis
summary: Accurate classification of anterior segment diseases is crucial for ophthalmic screening and diagnosis. However, slit-lamp image analysis remains challenging due to substantial variability in imaging conditions and the intrinsic anatomical-disease hierarchy of ocular pathologies. Existing methods typically formulate this task as a flat multi-class classification problem, ignoring the structured dependency between anatomical regions (e.g., cornea, conjunctiva, and lens) and disease manifestations.To address these limitations, we propose CFCH, a Coarse-Fine Collaborative Hierarchical learning framework that explicitly models anatomical context and disease semantics through a dual-branch architecture. To enable effective cross-granularity collaboration, CFCH introduces semantic and cross-granularity attention consistency constraints, encouraging aligned yet complementary feature learning across branches. In addition, we construct AS-9K, a large-scale anterior segment dataset with 8975 images covering 12 common disease categories. To the best of our knowledge, AS-9K is the largest publicly available dataset for anterior segment image classification. Extensive experiments on two anterior segment datasets demonstrate that CFCH outperforms state-of-the-art methods. Qualitative visualizations further show more focused and lesion-relevant activation responses, validating the effectiveness of the proposed framework. Code will be available at https://github.com/ybupengwang/CFCH.

AI.tldr: 提出粗细协同分层学习框架CFCH，通过双分支架构和一致性约束建模解剖上下文与疾病语义，并构建大规模数据集AS-9K，实验证明其优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 眼前节疾病分类对眼科筛查和诊断至关重要，但裂隙灯图像因成像条件多变和疾病的内在解剖-疾病层次结构而难以分析。现有方法通常视为扁平多类分类，忽略了解剖区域与疾病表现间的结构化依赖。
AI.method: 提出CFCH双分支架构，显式建模解剖上下文和疾病语义；引入语义和跨粒度注意力一致性约束，促进跨分支对齐且互补的特征学习；构建AS-9K数据集，含8975张图像，覆盖12种常见疾病。
AI.result: 在两个眼前节数据集上的实验表明，CFCH优于最先进方法；定性可视化显示更聚焦和病灶相关的激活响应。
AI.conclusion: CFCH能有效提升眼前节疾病分类性能，AS-9K是最大的公开眼前节图像分类数据集，代码将开源。

title: Reset Is Not Recovery: Evaluating Recoverability from False Conversational Context via Sycophancy Hysteresis
summary: Grounded language models are usually evaluated by adding relevant context, but multiturn dialogue also contains unsupported user claims that may contaminate later factual answers. We study post-pressure recoverability: whether a model returns to clean-context behavior after a user repeatedly advocates a wrong answer and then withdraws that pressure. We introduce a recovery-after-pressure protocol for multiple-choice factual dialogue and measure sycophancy hysteresis, the residual probability assigned to the user-advocated wrong answer relative to a clean-context counterfactual. Across seven instruction-tuned open-weight models and two factual benchmarks, ordinary reset often reduces but does not erase pressure-induced bias. History preserving repairs such as user retraction, system reset, and self-verification recover only 2-3/14 model-dataset pairs under the strict clean-restoration diagnostic, whereas operations that change the effective context are substantially more reliable; the two conditions that remove the pressure-bearing history entirely, fresh-context deletion and context truncation, recover 14/14. In an oracle trusted-evidence condition across fourteen model-dataset pairs, preserving the pressure-bearing history while adding benchmark-derived trusted evidence increases accuracy from 0.368 to 0.929, while wrong-answer following falls from 41.2% to 4.3%. Controls show that the effect is not explained by dialogue length, repeated confidence, plausible distractors, mere false-answer mention, or option-label inertia. These results suggest that faithful grounded dialogue requires evaluating which prior context should be treated as evidence and which should be removed or quarantined before answering.

AI.tldr: 研究多轮对话中用户错误主张造成的压力后恢复能力，提出“压力后恢复”协议并测量“谄媚滞后”。发现普通重置常只能减少、不能消除偏见；删除或截断压力历史最可靠，加入可信证据也能显著纠偏。
AI.motivation: 有据语言模型通常通过添加上下文来评估，但多轮对话也包含无依据的用户主张，可能污染后续事实回答。研究关注：当用户反复主张错误答案、随后撤回压力时，模型能否回到干净上下文下的行为。
AI.method: 提出面向多项选择事实对话的 recovery-after-pressure 协议，并测量 sycophancy hysteresis，即相对干净上下文反事实，模型对用户主张错误答案的残余概率。测试7个指令微调开源权重模型、2个事实基准、14个模型-数据集组合，比较普通重置、用户撤回、系统重置、自我验证、删除上下文、截断上下文及 oracle 可信证据等条件，并设置多项控制。
AI.result: 普通重置常减少但不消除压力诱导偏见。保留历史的修复如用户撤回、系统重置、自我验证，在严格清洁恢复诊断下仅恢复2-3/14对；改变有效上下文的操作更可靠，完全移除压力历史的 fresh-context deletion 和 context truncation 恢复14/14。在 oracle 可信证据条件下，保留压力历史但加入基准衍生可信证据后，准确率从0.368升至0.929，错误答案跟随率从41.2%降至4.3%。控制表明效果不能由对话长度、重复自信、合理干扰项、仅提及假答案或选项标签惯性解释。
AI.conclusion: 忠实的基于证据的对话需要评估哪些先前上下文应被视为证据，哪些应在回答前移除或隔离。压力诱导偏见具有滞后性，简单重置不足以完全恢复干净上下文行为。

title: RoboICL: Embodied In-Context Learning with GPT-6 Astra
summary: General-purpose vision-language models offer a promising way to zero-shot robot control: \gptastra{} excels at open-ended and language- or image-conditioned manipulation but remains substantially weaker on high-precision and long-horizon tasks. We introduce \emph{RoboICL}, an in-context robot-control framework that narrows these gaps without robot-specific parameter updates or a learned VLA. RoboICL separates \emph{demonstration context}, which provides recorded examples when available, from \emph{interaction memory}, which accumulates the model's own actions and observed outcomes. Both use a shared observation--action--receipt--observation grammar. To preserve experience across task stages, RoboICL combines sampled demonstration blocks with bounded anchored memory. Fixed anchors keep earlier rollout interactions available for in-context learning, while the latest interaction supports immediate error correction. Across 30 RoboDojo tasks, using zero shot for Open and one demonstration elsewhere, RoboICL improves on official zero-shot \gptastra{} by 20--27 progress-score points in every category. It leads the leaderboard baselines on Memory and Open, achieves comparable performance to the strongest Precision baseline, and remains competitive on Long-Horizon. Its 30-task Overall score is 50.64, versus 33.68 for the strongest baseline. On a separate ten-task subset, RoboICL scores 60.60, within 2.00 points of the $π_{0.5}$ + \gptastra{} hybrid approach. On three real-robot tasks, mean progress rises from 14.45 at zero shot to 63.33 at one shot and 78.89 at three shots. On two development tasks, optional Jev-gated action reuse reduces \gptastra{} calls by 33--48\%. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/Mosi-AI/RoboICL}{https://github.com/Mosi-AI/RoboICL}.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RoboICL，一种无需机器人专用参数更新、也无需训练 VLA 的上下文机器人控制框架，通过分离「演示上下文」与「交互记忆」并采用固定锚点+最新交互的有界锚定记忆机制，在精度与长程任务上显著缩小了通用视觉语言模型（如 GPT-Astra）的差距。
AI.motivation: 通用视觉-语言模型可实现零样本机器人控制，GPT-Astra 在开放式、语言或图像条件操作任务上表现优异，但在高精度和长程任务上明显偏弱。作者希望在不进行机器人专用参数微调、也不学习 VLA 的前提下弥合这一差距。
AI.method: 提出 RoboICL 上下文机器人控制框架：将「演示上下文」（有记录示例时提供示范）与「交互记忆」（累积模型自身动作与观察结果）分离，二者共享 observation–action–receipt–observation 语法；结合采样的演示块与有界锚定记忆（固定锚点保留早期 rollout 以供上下文学习，最新交互用于即时纠错）；并可选使用 Jev 门控的动作复用。
AI.result: 在 30 个 RoboDojo 任务上，Open 类零样本、其余每类一次示范，各子类相比官方零样本 GPT-Astra 提升 20–27 个进度分；在 Memory 与 Open 上领先排行榜基线，Precision 上与最强基线相当，Long-Horizon 上具竞争力；30 任务 Overall 得分 50.64（最强基线 33.68）。在十任务子集上得 60.60，与 π0.5 + GPT-Astra 混合方法仅差 2.00 分。三个真机任务平均进度从零样本 14.45 提升至一次示范 63.33、三次示范 78.89；两个开发任务中 Jev 门控动作复用使 GPT-Astra 调用减少 33–48%。
AI.conclusion: RoboICL 通过上下文学习中的演示与交互记忆机制，在不更新参数、不训练 VLA 的情况下有效提升了通用 VLM 在高精度与长程机器人任务上的表现，并在多类基准与真机任务中取得领先或具竞争力的成绩；代码已开源。

title: When Do Agents Help? Embedding, LLM and Agentic Alignment of Classical Texts and Their Translations
comment: Preprint. This manuscript has not yet been peer reviewed
summary: Classical texts aligned with their translations support machine translation, retrieval and computational research, but evidence comparing alignment workflows is scattered. This study compares seven systems on 452 texts in Pali, Sanskrit, Mishnaic Hebrew and Tibetan, comprising 9,833 human-aligned units: four embedding pipelines, a direct LLM call, an autonomous agent, and the agent revised by an independent auditor. Generative workflows recover 93-94% of reference correspondences, against at most 77% for embeddings. A ceiling analysis shows that sentence boundaries make some references unrepresentable by the embedding pipelines. Reference recovery is similar across generative workflows: the agent's advantage is 0.5 percentage points (95% CI -0.02 to 1.17), and auditing adds no established benefit. Agents nevertheless produce structurally valid output for all 452 texts, against 437 for direct calls. A blinded three-LLM panel assesses every generative mismatch against the source and human reference. Most mismatches are labelled defensible editorial variation; consensus major-error labels cover only 0.06-0.14% of units. The panel labels significantly fewer residual defects for agents than direct calls (0.7% versus 1.4%), suggesting that reference recovery alone understates alignment quality. On ten long Pali discourses taken as published online, agents and audited agents raise recovery from the direct call's 71% to 84% and 92%. Identical reference-located chunks bring all three to 93%. Agents thus improve structural reliability and reduce judged defects on short passages, while their large recovery advantage on long documents disappears after chunking. In this setting, independent auditing offers little measurable additional benefit on prepared passages.

AI.tldr: 该研究比较七种古典文本对齐流程，发现生成式方法（直接LLM调用、智能体、审计智能体）的参考恢复率（93-94%）显著高于嵌入方法（最高77%）；智能体结构可靠性更好、缺陷更少，但长文档优势在分块后消失，独立审计无明显增益。
AI.motivation: 古典文本与其翻译的对齐支持机器翻译、检索和计算研究，但不同对齐流程的比较证据分散，需要系统评估各方法的有效性与可靠性。
AI.method: 在452篇巴利语、梵语、密西拿希伯来语和藏语文本、9833个人工对齐单元上，比较七种系统：四种嵌入流程、直接LLM调用、自主智能体、经独立审计员修订的智能体；使用参考恢复率、结构有效性以及三LLM盲审小组评估错配。
AI.result: 生成式流程恢复93-94%参考对应，嵌入流程最高77%；句子边界造成嵌入流程的表示上限。生成式流程间参考恢复相似：智能体优势仅0.5个百分点（95% CI -0.02至1.17），审计无显著增益。智能体对452篇均产生结构有效输出，直接调用为437篇。盲审显示多数错配为可辩护编辑变异，共识重大错误仅占0.06-0.14%单元；智能体残差缺陷少于直接调用（0.7% vs 1.4%）。十篇长巴利语篇中，直接调用恢复71%，智能体84%，审计智能体92%；相同分块后三者均达93%。
AI.conclusion: 智能体提高短段落的结构可靠性并减少判定缺陷，但其在长文档上的大幅恢复优势在分块后消失；在此设置下，独立审计对准备好的段落几乎无额外可测量收益。

title: OmniSmartHome: A Multimodal Reasoning Benchmark for Smart-Home Agents
summary: Smart-home assistants are expected to handle diverse, realistic requests that arise in daily life. In such interactions, users often rely on the surrounding multimodal context-pointing at objects or referring to what they see or hear, leaving their requests underspecified in language alone. Existing smart-home benchmarks, however, express user requests solely through language, leaving context-dependent real-world requests underexplored. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniSmartHome, a multimodal smart-home benchmark where each spoken request is paired with the surrounding visual and spatial-audio context, providing complementary cues to disambiguate underspecified requests. OmniSmartHome comprises 1,360 synthetic and 272 real-world episodes. We evaluate 16 omnimodal large language models (Omni-LLMs) and reveal that, while they perform strongly when speech alone sufficiently conveys the user's intent, performance drops substantially when resolving it requires reasoning over multimodal contextual cues. As a simple agent baseline, we provide PROME (PROcedural Memory for multimodal Evidence gathering), which equips agents with specialized audio-visual perception tools and procedural memory for orchestrating their use. PROME generally improves performance across six Omni-LLMs. Demos and examples are available at https://omni-smart-home.github.io

AI.tldr: 论文提出 OmniSmartHome，一个多模态智能家居基准，将语音请求与视觉和空间音频上下文配对，用于评测模型在语境消歧任务中的表现，并提出基线智能体 PROME。
AI.motivation: 现有智能家居基准仅用语言表达用户请求，忽略了真实场景中用户常通过指向、看到或听到的内容等多模态上下文来补充不完整请求，因此需要更具现实性的多模态评测。
AI.method: 构建 OmniSmartHome，包含 1360 个合成和 272 个真实世界对话回合；每个语音请求配有周围视觉和空间音频上下文；评测 16 个全模态大语言模型；提出 PROME 基线，为智能体配备专用音视频感知工具和程序性记忆来编排工具使用。
AI.result: 当语音本身足以表达意图时，Omni-LLMs 表现较强；但当需要基于多模态上下文线索推理来消歧时，性能显著下降。PROME 在六个 Omni-LLMs 上普遍提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 现实智能家居请求常依赖多模态上下文，当前全模态模型在此类任务上仍有明显不足；引入专用感知工具与程序性记忆的智能体方法可有效改善多模态证据收集与推理表现。

title: Understanding Confabulation and Rethinking Reconstruction in Activation Explanations
summary: Natural Language Autoencoders (NLAs) produce unsupervised text explanations of a model's activations: a verbalizer describes an activation and a reconstructor learns to recover it from this text. Under the established point-reconstruction NLA training recipe, explanations become more useful for predicting model behavior while also increasingly introducing unsupported details and exhibiting writing defects. To assess these changes separately, we introduce a standardized evaluation framework for unstructured NLA explanations, measuring information recoverable from explanations, contextual support for their claims, and writing quality. To address confabulation and writing defects, we move beyond predicting a single activation: explanations can distinguish distributions of possible activations even when their means and optimal point-reconstruction rewards are identical. We introduce Flow-NLA, which models the distribution of activations compatible with an explanation and trains the verbalizer using a diffusion likelihood bound. Across Qwen, Gemma, and Apertus, this richer signal retains the utility gains of point reconstruction while curbing the growth of confabulation and writing defects, opening up a direction for improving activation-derived training to encourage more informative, supported, and readable explanations. Code and evaluation prompts will be made publicly available upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 自然语言自编码器（NLA）能对模型激活生成无监督文本解释。论文指出现有逐点重建训练会提升解释对模型行为的预测能力，但也增加无依据细节和写作缺陷。为此，作者提出标准化评估框架，并进一步提出Flow-NLA，通过建模激活分布和扩散似然界训练解释器，在Qwen、Gemma和Apertus上保持效用增益的同时抑制臆造和写作缺陷。
AI.motivation: NLA解释在逐点重建训练下变得更有用，但会越来越引入无支持细节并出现写作缺陷；这些变化需要被分开评估。研究动机是建立标准化评估，并改进训练目标，使解释更有信息量、更有依据且更可读。
AI.method: 提出面向非结构化NLA解释的标准化评估框架，分别衡量可恢复信息、主张的上下文支持和写作质量。进一步从预测单个激活转向建模激活分布，提出Flow-NLA：建模与解释兼容的激活分布，并用扩散似然界训练verbalizer。
AI.result: 在Qwen、Gemma和Apertus上，Flow-NLA保留了逐点重建带来的效用增益，同时抑制了无依据细节和写作缺陷的增长。
AI.conclusion: 更丰富的分布信号可改进由激活衍生的训练，促进产生更具信息量、更有支持且更可读的解释；代码和评估提示将在论文接收后公开。

title: Despite Instructions: Frontier Agents Improvise Covert Channels at Test Time
summary: In security-sensitive applications, language-model agents are often required to coordinate without disclosing confidential information. Yet repeated interactions may also let ordinary messages acquire shared private meaning. We study a repeated game with pairs of models in which the sender model observes one of four secret states and selects one of four summaries of the same public report, while the receiver model tries to infer the secret state. We find that model pairs can learn to communicate the secret using only one bit of feedback indicating whether the receiver inferred it correctly. This learning occurs during inference with fixed parameters and no supplied codebook or encoding examples. The effect also persists when agents generate their own free-form updates in a simulated incident-response task. Across ten independent games, pairs of GPT-5.6 Sol agents reach 98.8% final accuracy, compared with 25% chance, despite explicit instructions prohibiting disclosure and a monitor that screens each message without access to the agents' interaction histories. The same interactions that help agents cooperate can therefore allow confidential information to pass through messages intended for legitimate coordination.

AI.tldr: 语言模型智能体在重复交互中仅凭1比特反馈即可学会传递秘密信息，即使有禁止披露指令和消息监控，GPT-5.6 Sol智能体在十场独立游戏中仍达到98.8%的准确率，远高于25%的随机水平。
AI.motivation: 安全敏感应用中，智能体需在不泄露机密信息的前提下协调行动，但重复交互可能让普通消息获得共享私密含义，从而形成隐蔽通信风险，因此需要研究这种风险是否真实存在。
AI.method: 设计重复博弈：发送者模型观察四种秘密状态之一，从同一公开报告的四种摘要中选择一种发送，接收者推断秘密状态。仅提供1比特反馈（接收者是否推断正确），模型参数固定，不提供码本或编码示例。并在模拟事件响应任务中测试智能体生成自由形式更新的情况。
AI.result: 模型对能够学会传递秘密信息。在十场独立游戏中，GPT-5.6 Sol智能体最终准确率达98.8%，而随机猜测为25%。该效果在明确禁止披露和逐条消息监控（监控器无法访问交互历史）下依然存在。
AI.conclusion: 有助于智能体协作的交互也可能让机密信息通过看似合法的协调消息泄露，表明多轮交互中的隐晦通信风险需要被重视。

title: From Granular Revision Operations to Meaningful Revision Units: Evaluating LLMs for Revision Boundary Detection
summary: Revision traces provide valuable evidence about students' writing processes, but their usefulness for learning analytics depends on how individual revisions are represented. Automated draft-comparison methods often produce granular edit operations that can fragment a single purposeful revision into multiple analytic units. This study evaluates whether LLMs can identify meaningful revision unit boundaries in structured revision operation data and whether they provide value beyond simple non-LLM baselines. Using 113 matched draft--revision pairs from undergraduate writing, expert annotation yielded 4,344 candidate boundaries. We compared zero- and few-shot GPT-5.5 and base Qwen3-32B, parameter-efficient fine-tuning of Qwen3-32B, and majority and proximity-based baselines. Despite receiving revision context and task instructions, no prompted LLM condition outperformed the proximity heuristic (macro-F1 = .825). In contrast, fine-tuned Qwen3-32B using the two context representation achieved the highest macro-F1 (.859), identifying more same-unit relationships while maintaining precision comparable to the heuristic. Deterministic post-processing substantially improved the prompted models but added little benefit to the strongest fine-tuned model. These findings suggest that LLMs can support revision boundary judgment when task-adapted, but general purpose prompting alone may not outperform transparent structural heuristics.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估大语言模型能否在结构化修订操作数据中识别有意义的修订单元边界，并检验其相对于非LLM基线方法的价值。
AI.motivation: 修订痕迹对学生写作过程分析很有价值，但基于自动草稿对比的方法常产生过细的编辑操作，将一次有目的的修订拆分成多个分析单元，因此需要判断修订单元边界。
AI.method: 使用113对本科写作的草稿—修订配对数据，专家标注出4,344个候选边界。比较了零样本和少样本的GPT-5.5、基础Qwen3-32B、对Qwen3-32B进行参数高效微调，以及多数投票和基于邻近性的启发式基线方法。
AI.result: 所有提示式LLM条件均未超过邻近性启发式方法（macro-F1 = .825）。使用两种上下文表示的微调Qwen3-32B取得最高macro-F1（.859），在保持与启发式相当精确率的同时识别出更多同单元关系。确定性后处理显著提升了提示式模型，但对最强微调模型增益很小。
AI.conclusion: 经过任务适配的LLM能够支持修订边界判断，但仅靠通用提示可能无法超越透明的结构化启发式方法。

title: Bayesian Active Learning for Intent Disambiguation in Interactive Robot Planning
comment: Accepted by CoRL 2026, also presented at IROS 2026 Human-Robot Dialogue workshop
summary: Interactive robot planning requires robots to infer and execute human intentions from natural language instructions that are often ambiguous, incomplete, or underspecified. Although large language models (LLMs) provide a powerful interface for clarification, relying on the generative model to drive an multi-turn conversation can introduce systematic failures. We propose a Bayesian framework that treats clarification as an active learning problem over grounded Signal Temporal Logic (STL) task specifications. Our method uses LLMs to initialize candidate formal specifications and translate informative contrasts into natural-language clarification questions, while Bayesian optimization maintains uncertainty estimation over user intent and selects queries that maximize information gain. After convergence, the inferred STL specification is passed to a formal planner to synthesize a verifiable robot trajectory. Across four simulated and real-world task domains, our approach generally achieves higher task satisfaction and requires fewer clarification rounds than LLM baselines, while helping smaller models close the performance gap against larger reasoning models.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种贝叶斯主动学习框架，利用大语言模型将模糊自然语言指令逐步澄清为可验证的STL任务规范，并交由形式化规划器生成机器人轨迹。
AI.motivation: 机器人需要从模糊、不完整或欠指定的自然语言中推断并执行人类意图；虽然LLM适合多轮澄清交互，但完全依赖生成模型可能带来系统性失败。
AI.method: 将澄清过程建模为基于接地STL任务规范的主动学习问题：用LLM初始化候选形式化规范并生成自然语言澄清问题，用贝叶斯优化维护用户意图不确定性并选择信息增益最大的查询；收敛后将STL规范传给形式化规划器合成可验证轨迹。
AI.result: 在四个仿真与真实任务域中，该方法通常比LLM基线获得更高任务满足率、需要更少澄清轮次，并帮助较小模型缩小与较大推理模型之间的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 结合LLM、贝叶斯主动学习、STL形式化规范与形式化规划，可提升交互式机器人任务规划的可靠性、效率与可验证性。

title: Attribution Gaps in Zero-Training LLM+OVOD Pipelines: A Fine-Grained Analysis of the CAAP--SNAP Discrepancy
summary: LAOD and similar zero-training LLM+open-vocabulary-detector (OVOD) pipelines score two things separately: class-agnostic localization accuracy (CAAP) and semantic naming accuracy (SNAP). The two consistently diverge, and nobody has asked why. This paper asks why, on the full 5,000-image COCO-Val split (27,273 detections) rather than the small subset the original work evaluated on. Object visual complexity turns out not to be the driver -- small and occluded objects are, if anything, localized better than large ones. Vocabulary novelty is: once the LLM's wording falls outside the detector's native category set, localization accuracy falls from 80.9% to 31.6%. That drop is not spread evenly across unfamiliar phrasing, though. Almost all of it comes from cases where the novel wording actually names a different object than the one COCO annotated (true synonyms still score 89.3%; semantically unrelated "noise" labels score 12.0%). A closer look at a further failure subset tells a similar story: 78-88% of what looks like complete localization failure is really the model correctly finding a real object that COCO's non-exhaustive 80-category scheme simply never labeled, not hallucination. Swap the detector backbone (YOLO-World for Grounding DINO) or the LLM (Gemma-3 for Qwen2.5-VL) and both the effect and its rough size hold up, so this looks like a general property of the pipeline family rather than a quirk of one model pairing. The upshot is that a large share of the apparent CAAP--SNAP gap traces back to closed-category annotation limits rather than a real grounding failure, which matters for how we detect hallucination, analyze failure modes, and design evaluation for grounded multimodal systems meant to work in the open world.

AI.tldr: 该论文在完整 COCO-Val（5000 图、27,273 检测）上探究 LAOD 等零训练 LLM+开放词汇检测器管线中 CAAP（类无关定位）与 SNAP（语义命名）分数持续背离的原因，发现主因是词汇新颖性（尤其是新措辞指代不同对象）和 COCO 闭集标注局限，而非真正的定位失败。
AI.motivation: LAOD 等管线分别评估类无关定位精度（CAAP）和语义命名精度（SNAP），二者持续背离却无人追问原因，且原工作仅在小规模子集上评估，缺乏对失败机制的深入理解。
AI.method: 在完整 COCO-Val 5000 张图像（27,273 个检测）上复现并分析，拆解对象视觉复杂度、词汇新颖性等因素对定位精度的影响；进一步细致检查失败子集；通过替换检测器骨干（YOLO-World 与 Grounding DINO）和 LLM（Gemma-3 与 Qwen2.5-VL）验证结论的泛化性。
AI.result: 对象视觉复杂度并非驱动因素，小目标和遮挡目标定位反而优于大目标；词汇新颖性是主因：LLM 措辞超出检测器原生类别集时，定位精度从 80.9% 降至 31.6%；该下降主要来自新措辞实际指代不同对象（真同义词 89.3%，语义无关噪声标签 12.0%）；78%–88% 看似完全的定位失败实为模型找到了 COCO 80 类未标注的真实对象而非幻觉；更换检测器或 LLM 后效应及量级依然成立。
AI.conclusion: CAAP 与 SNAP 差距的很大一部分源于闭集标注限制而非真实 grounding 失败，这对幻觉检测、失败模式分析以及面向开放世界的 grounded 多模态系统评估设计具有重要启示。

title: CoWindow Attention: Full Causal Coverage Is a Collective Property
summary: FullAttn repeatedly exposes the complete causal history to every attention head, creating substantial redundant computation and memory traffic even with IO-efficient dense kernels. We introduce CoWA, a structured attention architecture that distributes access to the causal history across KV heads. All heads share near-diagonal and prefix-sink windows, while complementary long-range windows partition the remaining history. Their union provides full causal coverage although each head attends sparsely to distant tokens. This position-defined attention pattern requires no learned router or indexer, is used consistently during training and inference, and aligns with KV-head tensor parallelism. A window-matched ablation at 8K isolates the effect of complementary long-range allocation: CoWA with 100% collective coverage reaches 89.73% accuracy, compared with 89.97% for FullAttn, while duplicated long-range windows perform substantially worse. Across a broader controlled associative-recall comparison with matched token budgets, CoWA closely tracks FullAttn as the context grows, whereas other sparse patterns lose a substantial fraction of the associations. In an attention-operator benchmark at 128K tokens with tensor parallelism, CoWA reduces forward and backward latency during training by 7.4x and 8.6x and decoding latency during inference by 3.0x over FullAttn. Its per-rank peak operator memory matches FullAttn during training and is 7.6x lower during decoding. Across scaling-law training from 0.6B to 14B parameters, CoWA closely tracks FullAttn in perplexity while reducing total training FLOPs. The resulting 14B models and 32B models from separate continued training achieve comparable knowledge, reasoning, and long-context retrieval scores to FullAttn. These results show that full causal coverage can be a collective property of the head ensemble rather than a duplicated property of every head.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CoWA，一种结构化注意力架构，将完整因果历史的访问分散到不同 KV 头上。各头共享近对角和前缀汇窗口，并用互补长程窗口覆盖其余历史，从而以头集合实现完整因果覆盖，同时减少冗余计算与内存流量。
AI.motivation: FullAttn 将完整因果历史反复暴露给每个注意力头，即使使用 IO 高效稠密核，也会造成大量冗余计算和内存流量。因此需要一种既能保持完整因果覆盖，又能减少重复访问的注意力结构。
AI.method: CoWA 将因果历史访问分配给不同 KV 头：所有头共享近对角与 prefix-sink 窗口，互补的长程窗口划分剩余历史，其并集提供完整因果覆盖。该位置定义模式无需学习路由器或索引器，训练与推理一致，并与 KV-head 张量并行对齐。
AI.result: 8K 窗口匹配消融中，CoWA 集体覆盖 100% 时准确率 89.73%，接近 FullAttn 的 89.97%，重复长程窗口明显更差。更广泛的关联召回对比中，CoWA 随上下文增长紧密跟踪 FullAttn，其他稀疏模式损失大量关联。128K 张量并行注意力算子基准中，训练前向和反向延迟分别降低 7.4x 和 8.6x，推理解码延迟降低 3.0x；训练时每 rank 峰值算子内存与 FullAttn 相当，解码时低 7.6x。0.6B 到 14B 的 scaling-law 训练中，CoWA 困惑度接近 FullAttn 并减少总训练 FLOPs。基于此训练的 14B 与继续训练的 32B 模型，在知识、推理和长上下文检索分数上与 FullAttn 相当。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，完整因果覆盖可以成为头集合的集体属性，而不是每个头都必须重复具备的属性。CoWA 在保持性能接近 FullAttn 的同时，显著降低训练与推理的延迟和内存开销。

title: SAGE: Symbolic Action-Gating and Editing for LLM Task Planners
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 1 table, 3 algorithms. Submitted to IEEE Robotics and Automation Letters (RA-L). Code and benchmark: https://github.com/mtbui2010/sage_release
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are now the default cognitive core of embodied household agents, yet the plans they emit are rarely checked against a grounded model of the environment before execution, and the task-success they report is often measured on benchmarks so saturated that no method can be separated from another. We present SAGE (Symbolic Action-Gating and Editing), a single-LLM planner built from two lightweight mechanisms: a domain-agnostic symbolic gate (~250 lines of Python, zero tokens, $O(|π|)$) that blocks precondition-violating actions with typed reasons as a runtime safety monitor, and a local edit that regenerates only the failed sub-goal's suffix, keeping completed and untouched work intact; a hybrid seed+live memory store supports cold-start coverage. We evaluate under a leak-free protocol (leave-one-out retrieval) over five open-weight models and a 75-task AI2-THOR benchmark. On the standard benchmark goal-completeness saturates (52% of instances trivially solved) and SAGE ties strong hierarchical baselines. On a harder, method-agnostic multi-goal composition, SAGE's completeness lead re-emerges large (+0.06 to +0.23 across four models). Under injected mid-execution failures, SAGE recovers as reliably as whole-plan replanners at 2.4-3.3x fewer LLM calls. As a verify-before-execute gate, the symbolic monitor blocks unsafe actions before actuation and raises simulator-reported step-success for every planner tested (up to +0.11), a signal the verifier never sees (non-circular). Because the gate calls no model (0.008 ms/plan), it is a safety layer that runs essentially free on the edge: SAGE planning reproduces its quality on a Jetson AGX Orin, where small-model verification helps most. We release the benchmark, the leak-free protocol, the recovery and safety-gate harnesses, and a verifier-portability study (auto-induced on ALFWorld, 0.89 held-out).

AI.tldr: 论文提出SAGE，一种基于单LLM的具身家务智能体规划器，通过符号动作门控与局部编辑机制，在AI2-THOR等基准上提升多目标任务完整性与执行中故障恢复效率，并提供几乎零成本的运行时安全验证。
AI.motivation: LLM已成为具身家务智能体的认知核心，但其生成计划在执行前很少经过环境接地模型检查；同时，现有任务成功率基准趋于饱和，难以区分不同方法。因此需要一种验证先于执行、低成本且可提升安全性与恢复能力的规划框架。
AI.method: SAGE由两个轻量机制组成：一是领域无关的符号门控，约250行Python、零token、O(|π|)复杂度，作为运行时安全监控器，以带类型原因阻止违反前置条件的动作；二是局部编辑，仅重新生成失败子目标的后缀，保留已完成和未触及部分。另用混合种子+实时记忆存储支持冷启动。评估采用无泄漏协议（留一检索），覆盖5个开源权重模型和75任务AI2-THOR基准，并测试执行中故障注入与安全门控。
AI.result: 在标准基准目标完整性饱和时，52%实例可轻易解决，SAGE与强层次基线持平；在更难、方法无关的多目标组合任务中，SAGE完整性优势重新显著，四个模型上提升+0.06至+0.23。注入执行中故障后，SAGE恢复可靠性与全计划重规划器相当，但LLM调用减少2.4至3.3倍。符号监控器在执行前阻止不安全动作，使每个测试规划器的模拟器报告步成功率提升最高+0.11，且该信号验证器不可见，非循环。门控不调用模型，耗时0.008毫秒/计划。SAGE规划质量可在Jetson AGX Orin上复现。
AI.conclusion: SAGE表明，验证先于执行的符号门控可作为几乎免费的安全层，在边缘设备上高效运行，并显著改善多目标组合与故障恢复。论文发布基准、无泄漏协议、恢复与安全门控工具及验证器可移植性研究（ALFWorld上自动诱导，保留集0.89）。

title: Retrieved but Not Delivered: Multimodal Memory Delivery for Long-Term Agents
comment: 32 pages, 6 figures, 21 tables. Project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/DeliverMem/
summary: Work on memory for multimodal agents optimizes what is written, updated and retrieved. Between retrieval and the answer, however, is a stage that multimodal memory evaluations do not isolate: what of the retrieved memory reaches the model, and in what form. We call it delivery, and a controlled decomposition on MemLens locates the remaining room there. With the retrieved evidence set exactly fixed, delivering the original pixels instead of withholding them raises accuracy by 13.87 points on an 8B backbone, whereas making retrieval perfect on those same messages improves it by 2.31. Delivery is the larger term on all three MemLens backbones and grows with backbone strength; retrieval grows too, without closing the gap. We propose DeliverMem, an instantiation of delivery as three decisions: keep the original modality, give each item a readable identity, and state when it was seen, with a retrieval-side adapter for the one property delivery cannot supply. Each is measured against a delivery-matched control that alters only its own variable. DeliverMem leads the strongest published memory agent on MemLens at all four context lengths, and beats DMV-Bench's own strongest method at every setting on both backbones. On MemLens it does this on a tenth to a seventieth of the input. Each decision helps only where the question lacks what it supplies, and is null elsewhere. A single fixed configuration nonetheless leads both benchmarks, without training any component or modifying the stored records. Project page: https://avalon-s.github.io/DeliverMem/

AI.tldr: 本文指出多模态记忆智能体在检索与回答之间存在被忽视的“投递”阶段，即检索到的记忆以何种形式、以哪些内容进入模型。作者提出 DeliverMem，通过保留原始模态、赋予每项可读身份、标注时间，并配合检索端适配器，实现无需训练、无需修改存储记录的统一配置。
AI.motivation: 已有工作主要优化记忆的写入、更新与检索，但多模态记忆评测未单独考察检索后到达模型的内容与形式。在 MemLens 上的受控分解表明，投递是当前剩余提升空间的主要来源，且其影响大于检索本身。
AI.method: 将“投递”形式化为三个决策：保留原始模态；为每个记忆项提供可读身份；说明该项何时被看到。对于投递无法提供的属性，引入检索侧适配器。每个决策都通过与“投递匹配”的对照实验单独测量，仅改变自身变量。
AI.result: 固定检索证据时，投递原始像素相比不投递，在 8B 骨干上准确率提升 13.87 分，而完美检索仅提升 2.31 分；投递在三类 MemLens 骨干上均为更大贡献项，且随骨干增强而增长。DeliverMem 在 MemLens 四个上下文长度上均领先最强已发表记忆智能体，并在 DMV-Bench 两个骨干的所有设置上超越其最强方法；在 MemLens 上仅使用其 1/10 到 1/70 的输入。各项决策只在问题缺少其所提供信息时有效，否则无影响。
AI.conclusion: 投递是多模态记忆智能体中被低估但关键的一环。通过三项投递决策与必要检索适配，单一固定配置即可同时领先两个基准，且无需训练任何组件，也无需修改已存储记录。

title: Shared Experience, Separate Learning: Companion Confidence Calibration for LLMs
summary: Reliable self-assessment is essential for large language models (LLMs), yet they often remain highly confident when their answers are wrong. We study \emph{concurrent confidence calibration}, where confidence is learned alongside capability improvement rather than calibrated only after training. Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) provides a natural setting for this paradigm, as it continuously produces responses paired with verifiable correctness feedback. Existing concurrent methods, however, learn both capability and confidence through reinforcement learning within shared policy parameters, potentially coupling two fundamentally different learning problems. We instead propose \emph{shared experience but separate learning}: capability and confidence learn from the same trajectories, but through separate optimization mechanisms and parameters. Based on this principle, we introduce \textbf{CoCal (Companion Confidence Calibration)}, which trains a lightweight companion from rollout hidden states and verifier-derived correctness supervision while leaving task optimization unchanged. Experiments on Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-14B show that CoCal improves confidence estimation without sacrificing task performance, outperforming both RL-based concurrent methods and matched post-hoc calibration. The learned companion further generalizes across domains and policy shifts, while the benefits of CoCal persist at both scales.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并发置信度校准设定，并给出 CoCal 方法：在 RLVR 训练中，能力与置信度共享经验但分开学习，用轻量 companion 从 rollout 隐状态和验证器监督中学习置信度，从而在不损害任务性能的前提下提升校准。
AI.motivation: LLM 常在高置信度下给出错误答案，可靠自评估很重要。现有并发校准方法将能力和置信度放在同一策略参数中通过强化学习优化，可能耦合两个本质不同的学习问题。
AI.method: 基于“共享经验但分开学习”原则，提出 CoCal。任务策略仍按原 RLVR 优化，能力不变；另训练一个轻量 companion 模型，输入为 rollout 隐藏状态，监督信号来自验证器给出的正确性反馈，用于学习置信度。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-8B 和 Qwen3-14B 上，CoCal 在保持任务性能的同时改善置信度估计，优于基于 RL 的并发方法和匹配的事后校准方法；学到的 companion 还能跨领域和策略变化泛化，且优势在两个规模上均持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 将能力提升与置信度校准解耦、但共享同一训练经验，是一种有效的并发校准范式；CoCal 能实现更好的自评估校准，并具有跨域和跨策略变化的泛化能力。

title: TLC-DiT: Task-Aligned Local Visual Conditioning for Robust Multitask Robot Manipulation
summary: Language-conditioned robot policies have made clear progress in multitask manipulation, but task-relevant local visual evidence usually stays hidden inside a visual backbone or attention layers. This leaves the policy difficult to inspect and fragile under visual change, two symptoms of a missing explicit, task-aligned local visual channel. We present TLC-DiT, a plug-in extension of the Multitask Diffusion Transformer (DiT) policy that adds explicit task-guided local visual feature maps without changing the diffusion objective or the action-generation process. For each camera view, frozen DINOv2 patch features are modulated by the CLIP task embedding through FiLM and refined by a lightweight CoordConv CNN adapter into smooth spatial maps, which are concatenated with the original global image, language, joint-state, and timestep conditions. On LIBERO, TLC-DiT reaches a 93.5% average success rate, compared with 86.5% for Multitask DiT and 79.25% for SmolVLA. On LIBERO-plus, the total success rate improves from 54.07% to 57.24%, with larger gains under camera, background, and sensor-noise changes. In real-world bimanual tasks, TLC-DiT raises Teabag Putting completion from 44% to 89% while maintaining comparable Match Box Opening performance. Feature-map visualizations confirm that the model attends to task-relevant regions across views and perturbations, providing a direct way to inspect the visual evidence.

AI.tldr: 提出 TLC-DiT，一种在多任务扩散 Transformer 策略上即插即用的扩展，通过显式任务引导的局部视觉特征图提升机器人操控性能与可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有多任务语言条件机器人策略常将任务相关局部视觉证据隐藏在视觉骨干或注意力层中，导致策略难以检查，并在视觉变化下鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 在不改变扩散目标和动作生成过程的前提下，为每个相机视角用 CLIP 任务嵌入通过 FiLM 调制冻结的 DINOv2 patch 特征，再经轻量 CoordConv CNN 适配器生成平滑空间图，并与原始全局图像、语言、关节状态和时间步条件拼接。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 上平均成功率达 93.5%，高于 Multitask DiT 的 86.5% 和 SmolVLA 的 79.25%；在 LIBERO-plus 上总成功率从 54.07% 提升到 57.24%，在相机、背景和传感器噪声变化下增益更明显；真实双臂任务中 Teabag Putting 完成率从 44% 提升到 89%，Match Box Opening 性能相当。
AI.conclusion: TLC-DiT 通过显式任务对齐的局部视觉通道提升了策略性能和视觉扰动鲁棒性，且特征图可视化表明模型能关注任务相关区域，为检查视觉证据提供了直接途径。

title: SPACE: Sparse Predictive Attractor via Counterfactual Eviction for Streaming Video Memory
summary: Fixed-capacity streaming video memory requires repeated eviction decisions whose effects accumulate over time. Yet existing policies are evaluated primarily in terms of retained information or downstream accuracy, leaving how repeated updates alter the futures supported by memory largely unexamined. We define a memory's predictive state as the future representations supported by its retained history and formulate eviction as counterfactual control over transitions in this space. We introduce SPACE (Sparse Predictive Attractor via Counterfactual Eviction), which uses a frozen multi-horizon JEPA to predict the future representations induced by alternative eviction actions. Counterfactual utility identifies future-useful alternatives, while slow predictive-basin geometry determines when to correct avoidable drift and when to adapt to sustained predictive change, without online parameter updates. We further introduce MABS-Bench, which evaluates future-task sufficiency, within-regime predictive stability, transition responsiveness, and perturbation recovery under matched causal streams and memory budgets. Across multiple video datasets, SPACE yields consistent improvements in dataset-native task performance while reducing predictive-state drift.

AI.tldr: 该论文将流式视频记忆的逐出决策视为对预测状态转移的反事实控制，提出 SPACE 方法，并引入 MABS-Bench 评估未来任务充分性、预测稳定性、响应性与恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 固定容量流式视频记忆需要反复做出逐出决策，其影响会随时间累积；但现有策略主要关注保留信息或下游精度，较少考察重复更新如何改变记忆所支持的未来。
AI.method: 定义记忆的预测状态为其保留历史所支持的未来表示，将逐出形式化为该空间中的反事实控制；提出 SPACE，使用冻结的多时间尺度 JEPA 预测不同逐出动作诱导的未来表示，通过反事实效用识别未来有用的替代方案，并利用慢速预测盆地几何决定何时纠正可避免漂移、何时适应持续预测变化，无需在线参数更新。同时提出 MABS-Bench，在匹配因果流和记忆预算下评估未来任务充分性、同机制内预测稳定性、转移响应性和扰动恢复。
AI.result: 在多个视频数据集上，SPACE 在数据集原生任务性能上取得一致提升，同时减少了预测状态漂移。
AI.conclusion: 重复逐出决策可通过反事实控制记忆的预测状态来优化；SPACE 能在不更新在线参数的情况下改善未来任务性能并抑制预测漂移，MABS-Bench 为相关评估提供了新基准。

title: MassAlloc Attention: Let Attention Allocate Its Own Compute
summary: FullAttn often assigns negligible normalized mass to much of the causal score space, yet dense kernels execute the complete post-score path after forming each QK tile. We introduce MALA, a fused attention primitive that preserves score access to every legal causal interaction and uses normalized contribution to allocate post-score computation. Forward uses its evolving online-softmax normalizer, while backward reuses the finalized normalizer to derive nested retained support using only standard attention state. A common tolerance governs training and inference, allowing for adaptive retention of the work. MALA reduces low-contribution post-score computation. A matched-work study at 8K isolates the benefit of distribution-adaptive allocation: under exactly matched total post-score work, MALA approaches a per-instance reference-mass oracle, with mean omitted mass of 0.0188% versus 0.0182%. Across context lengths from 1K to 32K tokens, the same tolerance maintains low output and gradient errors relative to the reference. Across a broader controlled associative-recall comparison, MALA closely tracks FullAttn as context grows, reaching 89.67% accuracy at 8K compared with 89.97% for FullAttn. In an attention-operator benchmark at 128K tokens with tensor parallelism, MALA reduces forward and backward latency during training by 2.2x and 3.0x and decoding latency during inference by 1.6x relative to FullAttn. Across scaling-law training from 0.6B to 14B parameters, MALA closely tracks FullAttn in perplexity while reducing total training FLOPs. The resulting 14B models and 32B models from separate continued training achieve comparable knowledge, reasoning, and long-context retrieval scores to FullAttn. These results indicate that allocating post-score computation according to normalized attention contributions can retain the evaluated capabilities of FullAttn while reducing attention computation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MALA，一种融合注意力原语：它保留所有合法因果交互的分数访问，但根据归一化注意力贡献分配分数后的计算，从而减少低贡献计算。
AI.motivation: FullAttn 将大量归一化质量分配给可忽略部分，却仍对每个 QK tile 执行完整的分数后密集计算路径，造成不必要的注意力计算开销。
AI.method: MALA 在前向中使用在线 softmax 归一化器，在反向中复用已确定的归一化器，并仅依赖标准注意力状态推导嵌套保留支持；训练和推理共用统一容差，实现分布自适应的保留与计算分配。
AI.result: 8K 匹配工作量下，MALA 平均省略质量 0.0188%，接近 oracle 的 0.0182%；1K–32K 上下文保持低输出与梯度误差；8K 联想召回准确率 89.67%，接近 FullAttn 的 89.97%；128K 张量并行下，训练前向/反向延迟降低 2.2x/3.0x，推理解码降低 1.6x；0.6B–14B 缩放训练中困惑度接近 FullAttn 且总训练 FLOPs 降低，14B/32B 继续训练模型在知识、推理和长上下文检索上表现相当。
AI.conclusion: 按归一化注意力贡献分配分数后计算，可在减少注意力计算的同时保留 FullAttn 在评估能力上的表现。

title: NavHarness: Towards Lifelong Embodied Navigation
summary: Frontier models can now perform well on individual embodied navigation tasks through multi-round multimodal reasoning with simple tools. Across successive tasks, however, an agent must also rely on an evolving map and earlier search records, both of which may be incomplete or conflict with new observations. We present NavHarness, a training-free embodied harness towards lifelong navigation that makes memory processing part of the navigation loop. During navigation, its multi-round agentic session draws on maps, task records, and house knowledge, checking them against observations and recording corrections to guide its actions. NavHarness preserves this experience across fresh conversations for new tasks or recovery attempts, while outcome verification and run-end summaries support its later reuse. On GOAT-Bench, NavHarness improves s-SR over context-only independent sessions by 18.6 points with Astra and 22.6 with Opus 5. Using SLAM-estimated poses, NavHarness with GPT-6 Astra achieves state-of-the-art task success of 83.7 s-SR with 36.9 e-SR on GOAT-Bench and 85.9 s-SR on IR2R-CE. To understand these gains, we examine how experience is carried between sessions and find that structured recovery handovers outperform length-matched summaries. In extended deployments across houses, consolidation improves navigation beyond retaining maps and task records, with case studies showing how agents use earlier experience to interpret new goals, investigate unresolved questions, and resume failed searches. We suggest that progress towards lifelong navigation depends on how successive reasoning sessions build on prior experience, alongside improvements in single-task capability.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 NavHarness，一种面向终身具身导航的免训练框架，将记忆处理纳入导航循环，通过多轮智能体会话整合地图、任务记录、房屋知识与新观测，并在新任务或恢复尝试中复用经验。
AI.motivation: 现有前沿模型在单次具身导航任务中表现良好，但在连续任务中，智能体需要依赖不断演化且可能不完整或冲突的地图与搜索记录，因此需要解决跨任务经验积累与复用问题。
AI.method: NavHarness 采用免训练的多轮智能体会话，在导航过程中检查地图、任务记录和房屋知识，与观测对照并记录修正；在新会话中保留经验，并通过结果验证和运行结束总结支持后续复用。
AI.result: 在 GOAT-Bench 上，NavHarness 相比仅上下文独立会话分别提升 s-SR 18.6 点（Astra）和 22.6 点（Opus 5）；使用 SLAM 估计位姿时，GPT-6 Astra 达到 83.7 s-SR 和 36.9 e-SR，并在 IR2R-CE 上达到 85.9 s-SR。结构化恢复交接优于等长摘要，长期部署中经验整合也优于仅保留地图和任务记录。
AI.conclusion: 面向终身导航的进展不仅依赖单任务能力提升，还取决于连续推理会话如何基于先前经验进行构建与复用。

title: SkillVine: Agent Skill Evolution via Branching Exploration
summary: Agent skills encapsulate reusable procedural knowledge that enables LLM agents to perform tasks, and they can be improved automatically using trajectories from interactions with the environment. This is the classic problem of skill evolution. Existing approaches predominately follow a linear evolution paradigm, in which updates are sequentially applied to the latest skill-library version. As a result, they inevitably fall into local optima, leaving many promising evolution paths unexplored. We propose SkillVine, an automatic skill-evolution framework that formulates skill evolution as a graph search problem and employs a branching exploration strategy. Equipped with a trunk-branch collaborative searching mechanism, an intelligent parent-node selector, and an adaptive-granularity update rule, SkillVine achieves a balance between exploration and exploitation. We evaluate SkillVine on 5 benchmarks with two LLMs. Results show that SkillVine discovers better skill-library versions along branches than along the linear trunk and achieves the best test performance in nine of ten benchmark-model combinations.

AI.tldr: 提出 SkillVine，一个将技能进化建模为图搜索并采用分支探索策略的自动技能进化框架，以克服线性进化易陷入局部最优的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有技能进化方法主要遵循线性进化范式，即顺序更新最新技能库版本，容易陷入局部最优，导致许多有潜力的进化路径未被探索。
AI.method: 将技能进化形式化为图搜索问题，引入分支探索策略，并采用主干-分支协作搜索机制、智能父节点选择器以及自适应粒度更新规则，以平衡探索与利用；在5个基准和2个LLM上进行评估。
AI.result: SkillVine 沿分支发现的技能库版本优于沿线性主干发现的版本，并在10个基准-模型组合中的9个上取得最佳测试性能。
AI.conclusion: SkillVine 表明基于图搜索与分支探索的技能进化优于传统线性范式，能够更有效地提升LLM智能体的技能库性能。

title: GAUGE: Group-Wise View-Inconsistency Rectification for Feed-Forward 4D Tracking
comment: 9 pages of main text plus appendices. Code: https://github.com/HCPLab-SYSU/GAUGE
summary: Feed-forward models regress dense 3D point trajectories directly from monocular video, yet the residual after global alignment is substantial and lacks a structural explanation. Measured on dynamic query points across models and datasets, the error concentrates along the view direction, while the scale correction each motion group requires differs. The predicted displacement direction nevertheless supports reliable grouping, with a median angle far below the 90° random baseline. The systematic part of the residual is therefore a family of radial degrees of freedom per motion group, along directions 2D observations cannot constrain. We call it group-wise view inconsistency. We present GAUGE (Group-wise Adaptive Unsupervised Gauge Estimation), a training-free and model-agnostic post-hoc module. It recovers motion groups from direction consistency and spatial connectivity, then estimates a per-frame radial scale and group-level translation from 1% to 5% metric anchors, four degrees of freedom per group and frame. On dynamic query points of eight trackers, including D4RT, 4RC and SM4RT, our correction lowers endpoint error by 15.1% to 62.6% over the uncorrected predictions, while spending the same anchors on gradient fine-tuning improves the same models by only -1.1% to 15.2%. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/HCPLab-SYSU/GAUGE.

AI.tldr: 该论文分析单目视频前馈3D点轨迹模型的残差结构，提出组级视角不一致性，并给出无需训练、模型无关的后处理模块GAUGE来校正轨迹误差。
AI.motivation: 前馈模型直接回归密集3D点轨迹，但全局对齐后残差仍很大且缺乏结构性解释；研究发现误差主要沿视线方向，且不同运动组所需尺度校正不同，因此需要针对这种系统残差进行建模与校正。
AI.method: 提出GAUGE（组级自适应无监督规范估计），利用预测位移方向一致性和空间连通性恢复运动组，再基于1%到5%的度量锚点，为每组每帧估计径向尺度和组级平移，共四个自由度；该模块免训练且模型无关。
AI.result: 在八个跟踪器（包括D4RT、4RC、SM4RT）的动态查询点上，GAUGE校正使端点误差相对未校正预测降低15.1%到62.6%；而将相同锚点用于梯度微调，仅使相同模型改善-1.1%到15.2%。
AI.conclusion: 系统残差可被解释为运动组沿2D观测无法约束方向的径向自由度，即组级视角不一致性；GAUGE能有效且高效地校正此类误差，优于使用相同锚点的梯度微调，代码已公开。

title: Yorùbá in Unicode: An Overview of a Problem
comment: To appear in Yorùbá Print Culture: A Handbook, Routledge
summary: There is a recurrent problem in the writing of Yorùbá on the internet and on the computer that has proven intractable over the years. The language, along with other African languages that depend on diacritics for disambiguation, requires a small set of precomposed characters that Unicode does not encode. This has forced writers and digital systems to rely on combining character sequences that behave inconsistently across platforms, corrupt under font substitution, and fail in search. This paper documents that failure across a range of real world contexts, from published books to web platforms to mobile keyboards, using personal and empirical evidence. It identifies Unicode's NFC normalization stability policy as the structural constraint that prevents a straightforward fix, arguing for direct intervention of the Consortium in solving the active problem, proposing a formal encoding request for the four core Yorùbá characters as the most durable path to resolution.

AI.tldr: 论文记录约鲁巴语等依赖变音符号的非洲语言在数字书写中因缺少Unicode预组合字符而长期失败，指出NFC稳定性政策是结构性障碍，主张向Unicode联盟申请编码四个核心约鲁巴字符。
AI.motivation: 约鲁巴语在互联网和计算机书写中需要一小组Unicode未编码的预组合字符，导致写作者和数字系统只能使用组合字符序列，进而出现跨平台不一致、字体替换损坏和搜索失败等顽固问题。
AI.method: 通过个人与实证证据，在已出版书籍、网络平台和移动键盘等真实场景中记录相关失败，并分析Unicode NFC归一化稳定性政策造成的结构性限制。
AI.result: 研究记录了约鲁巴语数字书写在多类真实场景中的失败，确认NFC稳定性政策阻碍了简单修复，并指出四个核心约鲁巴字符缺少预组合编码是问题关键。
AI.conclusion: 论文主张Unicode联盟直接干预该问题，正式提交四个核心约鲁巴字符的编码请求，认为这是最持久的解决路径。

title: Retrospective Distillation Attribution via Normalized Response Similarity
summary: Model distillation transfers capabilities through supervised fine-tuning (SFT) on teacher responses, often collected from commercial APIs, raising questions of model provenance. Existing distillation attribution methods have been largely evaluated on students immediately after the SFT step. However, a distilled model may undergo further SFT, preference optimization, or reinforcement learning before release, while an auditor may lack access to the pre-distillation checkpoint required by reference-based attribution. To close this gap, we propose SCOUT, an output-only method that aggregates recurring *syntactic patterns* into candidate profiles, filters low-contrast patterns, and calibrates student--candidate distances against inter-candidate distances. SCOUT supports attribution and abstention using only current texts, without model weights, token likelihoods, or historical checkpoints. Auditing publicly released descendants of distilled models spanning diverse post-training objectives, SCOUT consistently identifies the distillation source. Furthermore, tracing teacher-associated *syntactic signatures* along training trajectories reveals that they emerge during distillation and persist through subsequent preference optimization and reinforcement learning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 SCOUT，一种仅基于输出文本的模型蒸馏溯源方法，用于识别经过后续微调、偏好优化或强化学习后的蒸馏模型来源。
AI.motivation: 现有蒸馏归因方法多针对刚完成监督微调的学生模型，但实际发布的模型常经历进一步训练，且审计者通常无法获得蒸馏前的检查点，因此需要不依赖模型权重、token似然和历史检查点的归因方法。
AI.method: SCOUT 仅使用当前输出文本，将反复出现的句法模式聚合成候选教师画像，过滤低对比度模式，并用学生到候选的距离与候选间距离进行校准，从而支持归因或弃权。
AI.result: 在覆盖多种后训练目标的公开蒸馏模型后代上，SCOUT 能稳定识别蒸馏来源；同时，教师相关的句法特征在蒸馏阶段出现，并在后续偏好优化和强化学习中持续存在。
AI.conclusion: SCOUT 为经历后训练的蒸馏模型提供了可行的输出级溯源方案，并表明句法特征可作为持久且可追踪的蒸馏来源标记。

title: Levy-Driven Correspondence Estimation for Registration
summary: Finding reliable point correspondences is difficult when point clouds have low overlap or undergo non-rigid deformation. Iterative refinement can correct uncertain matches, but costly network evaluations limit the number of updates. We present LevyMatch, a Lévy-driven method that uses random jumps to refine a soft matching matrix. At each step, a network uses the current matching state and geometric information to predict a target matching matrix. A Brownian reference bridge gives an explicit formula for the update toward this target. A Gamma random clock sets the time step for each update. The updated matches provide new geometric feedback for the next target prediction. We further propose a fixed front-loaded Gamma policy that assigns more expected clock time to early updates and less to later ones, without retraining or extra network evaluations. Reordering the same sampled Gamma increments shows that placing larger increments early gives higher accuracy than placing them late. On 4DMatch and 4DLoMatch, our method improves both non-rigid feature matching recall (NFMR) and inlier ratio (IR) over the compared methods. The front-loaded policy achieves 93.09% NFMR and 92.11% IR on 4DMatch, and 82.79% NFMR and 79.07% IR on 4DLoMatch.

AI.tldr: 提出 LevyMatch，一种基于 Lévy 过程的随机跳跃迭代方法，用于精炼软匹配矩阵，并在低重叠或非刚性点云匹配中提升性能。
AI.motivation: 点云低重叠或非刚性变形时，可靠点对应关系难以获得；迭代精炼可修正不确定匹配，但昂贵的网络评估限制了更新次数。
AI.method: 每步用网络结合当前匹配状态与几何信息预测目标匹配矩阵；利用布朗参考桥给出向目标更新的显式公式；用 Gamma 随机时钟设定每步更新时间；更新后的匹配提供新几何反馈。进一步提出固定前置 Gamma 策略，将更多期望时钟时间分配给早期更新，无需重训练或额外网络评估。
AI.result: 在 4DMatch 和 4DLoMatch 上，方法在非刚性特征匹配召回率（NFMR）和内点率（IR）上均优于对比方法。前置策略在 4DMatch 达到 93.09% NFMR 和 92.11% IR，在 4DLoMatch 达到 82.79% NFMR 和 79.07% IR。
AI.conclusion: 随机跳跃式迭代精炼与前置 Gamma 时间分配能有效提升点云匹配性能；将较大 Gamma 增量放在早期比放在后期获得更高准确率。

title: Predictive Semantic Safety: From Visual Physical Reasoning to Safety-Critical Control
comment: The first two authors contributed equally to this work. Project page: https://www.taekyung.me/pss
summary: Physical interactions can create future hazards that are not apparent from the robot's current geometric surroundings. We present a framework termed Predictive Semantic Safety (PSS), which connects visual physical reasoning to backup-based safety filtering. A vision-language model (VLM) predicts physical events and their timing or directly predicts object displacements. An explicit motion model converts event hypotheses into object trajectories. Split conformal prediction calibrates position errors jointly across specified objects, observation times, and future times; geometric shape bounds convert the resulting position regions into predicted object occupancy. PSS evaluates a prescribed backup maneuver against this occupancy and derives input-affine constraints for minimally modifying the nominal input while preserving backup feasibility under the robot dynamics and input limits. MuJoCo experiments with a Unitree Go1 consider falling fixtures, impact-driven support loss, and contact propagation. PSS achieves a safe episode rate of 99.3%, compared with 43.3% for a Backup Control Barrier Function baseline that only uses current obstacle geometry.

AI.tldr: 提出预测语义安全（PSS）框架，将视觉物理推理与基于后备控制的安全滤波结合，用于提前规避由物理交互引发的未来危险。
AI.motivation: 机器人仅依据当前几何环境无法识别物理交互可能造成的未来危险，例如物体跌落、支撑失效或接触传播，因此需要预测未来占用并据此保障安全。
AI.method: PSS 使用视觉语言模型预测物理事件及其时间或物体位移，并通过显式运动模型将事件假设转化为物体轨迹；采用分割保形预测校准指定物体、观测时间和未来时间上的位置误差，再用几何形状边界将位置区域转为预测占用；随后针对预设后备机动评估占用，推导输入仿射约束，在机器人动力学和输入限制下最小化修改标称输入并保持后备可行性。
AI.result: 在 MuJoCo 中基于 Unitree Go1 针对跌落夹具、冲击导致支撑失效和接触传播进行实验，PSS 安全回合率达到 99.3%，显著高于仅使用当前障碍几何的后备控制障碍函数基线的 43.3%。
AI.conclusion: PSS 能通过预测物理交互引发的未来危险并融入安全滤波，有效提升机器人在复杂动态场景中的安全性。

title: CUA-Sandbox: Efficient Environments for Computer-Use Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Reinforcement learning enables computer-use agents to improve through interaction with real software environments, including websites and desktop applications. However, conventional deployments replicate an initialized runtime for each independent rollout, even when trajectories use the same software, incurring repeated memory and initialization costs as the number of parallel environments grows. Does an independent computer-use environment require an independent execution runtime? Our key observation is that trajectories require independent mutable state, while initialized application runtimes can be reused across concurrently evolving environments, making state the natural unit of environment independence. Guided by this observation, we introduce CUA-Sandbox, which separates private state capsules from shared runtimes through state-scoped execution and transactional lifecycle operations, including resets and branches, while retaining the original software interfaces and task evaluators. Experiments show comparable or improved task success relative to Docker, while substantially reducing rollout and resource costs. CUA-Sandbox achieves up to a 6.20x increase in rollout throughput, a 9.2x reduction in per-environment memory, and a 504x reduction in incremental storage.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CUA-Sandbox，通过将独立可变状态与可复用应用运行时分离，避免为每个并行 rollout 重复初始化软件环境，从而在保持任务成功率的同时显著降低资源开销。
AI.motivation: 强化学习驱动的计算机使用智能体需要在真实软件环境中交互，但传统部署为每个独立 rollout 复制初始化运行时，即使轨迹使用相同软件，也会随并行环境数量增长带来重复内存和初始化成本。核心问题是：独立计算机使用环境是否必须依赖独立执行运行时。
AI.method: 基于“轨迹需要独立可变状态，而初始化后的应用运行时可在并发演进环境间复用”的观察，提出 CUA-Sandbox。它通过状态作用域执行和事务化生命周期操作（包括重置和分支），将私有状态胶囊与共享运行时分离，同时保留原始软件接口和任务评估器。
AI.result: 实验表明，CUA-Sandbox 相比 Docker 达到相当或更高的任务成功率，同时大幅降低 rollout 和资源成本：rollout 吞吐量最高提升 6.20 倍，每环境内存降低 9.2 倍，增量存储降低 504 倍。
AI.conclusion: 计算机使用环境的独立性应以状态而非整个运行时为单位；通过复用初始化后的应用运行时并隔离状态，可以在不牺牲软件接口和评估兼容性的情况下，显著提升并行 rollout 效率并节约资源。

title: The Effects of Incremental Instruction Delivery on Language-Model Creative Writing
comment: 18 pages, 4 figures, 13 tables. Code and data available at https://github.com/solusops/SISTER-2026-Team19
summary: Large language models are increasingly used as interactive writing tools, where users develop stories, revise ideas, and introduce new requirements across multiple turns rather than specifying a complete brief upfront. Yet most evidence on multi-turn instruction degradation comes from tasks with objectively verifiable outcomes, leaving unclear whether incremental interaction harms creative artifacts in ways that explicit requirement checks cannot capture. We study this question using 160 human-authored creative-writing tasks across six genres, presenting each intended specification either upfront or progressively over 5-9 turns to six distinct open-weight model families, yielding 960 matched pairs. Progressive delivery reduces explicit constraint adherence and produces its largest writing-quality degradation in structure/coherence. The structural gap persists among outputs with equal observed adherence, suggesting that measured requirement loss alone does not explain the observed structural difference. We define Creative Integrity as a compact measure of joint adherence and narrative structure; under incremental delivery, models retain 71.2% of FULL Creative Integrity (95% CI [68.2%, 74.3%]). A three-rater human study over 50 matched pairs independently recovers FULL advantages in structure/coherence, craft, and genre effectiveness, while automated scores remain positively associated with aggregated human ratings. These findings show that interactive creative-writing systems should be evaluated not only on whether requirements survive conversation, but also on whether evolving requirements remain coherently integrated into the final artifact. Our dataset, benchmarks, and source code are available at: https://github.com/solusops/SISTER-2026-Team19

AI.tldr: 论文研究多轮交互中逐步给出写作要求是否会损害创意写作质量。基于160个人工撰写的六类体裁任务和六个开源模型家族，比较一次性完整规格与5-9轮渐进式规格，发现渐进交付会降低显式约束遵循，并显著损害结构/连贯性；作者提出Creative Integrity指标，发现渐进交付下仅保留71.2%的完整Creative Integrity。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型越来越多被用作交互式写作工具，但关于多轮指令退化的证据多来自可客观验证的任务，尚不清楚渐进式交互是否以及如何损害创意写作产物，且这种损害可能无法通过显式要求检查捕捉。
AI.method: 构建160个人工撰写的创意写作任务，覆盖六种体裁；将同一预期规格分别以一次性完整给出和5-9轮渐进给出两种方式呈现给六个不同开源权重模型家族，形成960对匹配样本；定义Creative Integrity作为约束遵循与叙事结构的联合度量；并对50对匹配样本进行三名评分者的人类研究，与自动评分比较。
AI.result: 渐进交付降低显式约束遵循，并在结构/连贯性上造成最大写作质量退化；在观测到同等约束遵循的输出中，结构差距仍然存在，说明测量到的要求损失不足以解释该结构差异。渐进交付下，模型保留71.2%的完整Creative Integrity，95%置信区间为[68.2%, 74.3%]。三人人类评分研究独立复现了完整规格在结构/连贯性、写作技巧和体裁有效性上的优势，同时自动评分与聚合人类评分正相关。
AI.conclusion: 交互式创意写作系统的评估不应只关注要求是否在对话中存活，还应关注不断演变的要求是否被连贯地整合进最终作品。数据集、基准和源代码已公开。

title: Positions Are Not Facts: The Mismatch Between KV Caches and Memory
summary: When a fact changes, how should a language model update the history stored in its key-value (KV) cache? Hiding the old record is cheap, but it may still contain needed details or answer questions about the past. We compare hiding whole records, hiding only replaced values, and deleting old text and recomputing the cache. In a controlled quantity task, masking makes all eight models prefer the new value more strongly, yet six lose complete answers through unit errors or failure to stop; keeping the unit preserves all current answers. Later states also retain useful information from earlier records: on multi-hop updates, rebuilding these states at unchanged positions lowers historical accuracy by 20-41 percentage points, whereas moving the existing states has little effect. Keeping object dependencies and unchanged revision passages prevents many losses. Recognition is a separate challenge. Learned readouts recover distinctions missed by fixed cache similarities on synthetic record pairs. On natural text, text-detector-selected masks show no clear advantage over random masks at the same rate in 14 same-model detector-generator comparisons. Query-dependent access can avoid some losses, with additional storage or access costs. These findings identify what must be preserved beyond the replaced value when using a KV cache as updatable memory.

AI.tldr: 本文研究事实变化时如何更新语言模型KV缓存中的历史信息，比较了隐藏整条记录、仅隐藏被替换值以及删除旧文本并重算缓存等策略。
AI.motivation: 当事实发生变化时，KV缓存作为可更新记忆需要决定如何修改其中存储的历史记录。简单隐藏旧记录虽然廉价，但可能丢失有用细节或影响对过去的回答，因此需要理解更新时还应保留什么。
AI.method: 在受控数量任务和多跳更新任务中，比较不同的缓存更新策略，包括隐藏整条记录、仅隐藏被替换值、删除旧文本并重算缓存，并评估单位、对象依赖、未变修订段落、识别能力、掩码选择和查询相关访问等影响。
AI.result: 在受控数量任务中，掩码使八个模型都更倾向新值，但六个模型因单位错误或未能停止而丢失完整答案；保留单位可维持所有当前答案。多跳更新中，在未变位置重建状态会使历史准确率下降20-41个百分点，而移动已有状态影响很小。保留对象依赖和未变修订段落可防止许多损失。识别是另一个挑战：学习式读出能在合成记录对上恢复固定缓存相似度遗漏的区分；在自然文本上，14个同模型检测器-生成器比较中，文本检测器选择的掩码相比同比例随机掩码无明显优势。查询相关访问可避免部分损失，但增加存储或访问成本。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现明确了在使用KV缓存作为可更新记忆时，除了被替换的值之外还必须保留哪些信息，并为设计更有效的缓存更新与访问策略提供了依据。

title: DraftAttention2: Fast Video Diffusion with Low-Resolution-Guided Mixed-Precision Attention
summary: Video generation has broad applications in content creation and entertainment. Diffusion transformers have advanced the quality of generated videos, but attention over spatiotemporal tokens becomes increasingly expensive as video resolution and duration increase. We present DraftAttention2, a training-free framework that uses the low-resolution draft attention map to jointly select attention blocks and assign their numerical precision. Specifically, spatial 2D average- and max-pooled queries and keys capture complementary regional statistics to estimate block importance, and a shared ranking assigns higher precision to important blocks, lower precision to less important retained blocks, and skips the rest under configurable budgets. Our analysis separates sparsification error from attention-weighted quantization error, establishing when recovering skipped interactions with low-bit computation tightens the output-error bound. This analysis motivates retaining more interactions at low precision while reserving higher precision for blocks with larger attention mass. To translate these fine-grained assignments into practical speedups, we further develop fused operand preparation and a single attention kernel with precision-specific phases, sharing data movement, softmax statistics, and output accumulation across precisions. Experiments demonstrate that our method achieves a superior quality-efficiency trade-off over existing efficient video generation methods. Notably, its advantage is particularly pronounced for few-step video diffusion, where jointly combining sparsity with 4- and 8-bit mixed-precision computation substantially improves generation quality while retaining significant acceleration. Code is available at https://github.com/anemoi-project/anemoi

AI.tldr: 提出 DraftAttention2，一种免训练的视频生成注意力加速框架，利用低分辨率草稿注意力图联合选择注意力块并分配数值精度。
AI.motivation: 视频生成应用广泛，扩散 Transformer 提升了视频质量，但随着分辨率和时长增加，时空 token 上的注意力计算变得极其昂贵。
AI.method: 使用低分辨率草稿注意力图指导注意力块选择与精度分配；通过空间 2D 平均池化和最大池化的 query/key 捕捉互补区域统计，并用共享排序将高精度分配给重要块、低精度分配给次要保留块、跳过其余块；分析稀疏化误差与注意力加权量化误差；开发融合操作数准备和单一注意力核，支持不同精度阶段共享数据移动、softmax 统计和输出累加。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在质量-效率权衡上优于现有高效视频生成方法，尤其在少步视频扩散中优势明显：将稀疏性与 4-bit、8-bit 混合精度计算结合，可显著提升生成质量并保持加速。
AI.conclusion: DraftAttention2 能有效缓解视频扩散 Transformer 的注意力开销，在免训练条件下实现更好的质量与效率平衡，代码已开源。

title: FutureDuet: Decoupling Observation Access from Future Supervision in World Action Models
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) augment robot action generation with future visual supervision. Existing WAMs commonly fuse main and wrist observations into one visual stream and train both with the same future-video objective, despite their different visual dynamics. A stable main camera reveals scene-level task evolution, whereas wrist cameras move with the end effector, mixing local interaction changes with viewpoint shifts and self-occlusion. These contrasting predictive demands suggest that the two views may benefit from different future objectives. We introduce FutureDuet, which retains both views for control, while allowing each visual stream to receive a different future objective. For the main view, future RGB models task evolution, while interaction masks and robot skeletons focus supervision on task objects and robot motion. For the wrist stream, future latent prediction models short-horizon interaction changes without requiring pixel-level reconstruction. ActionDiT jointly reads the resulting Task State and Interaction State, combining scene-level progress with close-range interaction evidence. All auxiliary prediction modules are training-only, adding no inference overhead. FutureDuet achieves 94.2% clean and 94.1% randomized success on RoboTwin50 and 99.2% average success on LIBERO. The improvements are most pronounced on six RoboTwin50 tasks that require precise interaction, averaging gains of 9.2% and 12.8% over Fast-WAM in clean and randomized settings. Controlled studies further show complementary gains from separating the wrist pathway and designing future supervision separately for the two views.

AI.tldr: 提出FutureDuet，在机器人动作生成中保留主视角与腕部视角，但为二者设计不同的未来预测目标：主视角预测未来RGB并用交互掩码与机器人骨架聚焦任务物体和运动，腕部流预测未来隐变量以建模短时交互变化；ActionDiT联合读取任务状态与交互状态进行控制。辅助预测模块仅训练时使用，无推理开销。
AI.motivation: 现有世界动作模型（WAMs）通常将主视角与腕部视角融合为单一视觉流，并用同一未来视频目标训练，忽略了两者视觉动态的本质差异：主相机稳定，反映场景级任务演进；腕部相机随末端执行器运动，混入局部交互变化、视角偏移与自遮挡。这种对比表明两视角可能适合不同的未来预测目标。
AI.method: 保留主视角和腕部视角用于控制，但允许每条视觉流接收不同的未来目标。主视角：以未来RGB建模任务演进，并用交互掩码和机器人骨架将监督聚焦于任务物体与机器人运动。腕部流：以未来隐变量预测建模短时交互变化，无需像素级重建。ActionDiT联合读取所得的任务状态与交互状态，结合场景级进度与近距离交互证据。所有辅助预测模块仅用于训练，不增加推理开销。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin50上达到94.2%干净场景和94.1%随机化成功率，在LIBERO上平均成功率为99.2%。在6个需要精确交互的RoboTwin50任务上提升最明显，较Fast-WAM在干净和随机化设置下平均分别提升9.2%和12.8%。对照研究进一步表明，分离腕部通路与为两视角分别设计未来监督可带来互补收益。
AI.conclusion: 针对主视角与腕部视角的不同视觉动态，分别设计差异化的未来监督目标，可显著提升机器人动作生成性能，且不引入额外推理开销。

title: Adaptive Consistency Graph for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Large language model agents can often make reasonable local decisions on short tasks, yet their performance degrades when success requires long sequences of dependent actions and tool calls. During execution, task requirements, historical evidence, and the current execution state may gradually become disconnected, so later decisions can drift from the original objective. We study this problem by introducing the Adaptive Consistency Graph (ACG) for long-horizon execution. ACG incrementally organizes execution evidence and its provenance in a persistent graph, then constructs a temporary requirement-centered view for each decision under a bounded context budget. Rather than replacing the base agent's planner or tool executor, ACG provides a structured and traceable context view for each decision. In the matched evaluation, ACG improves GPT-5.6-luna's average success from 44.5\% with ReAct to 50.2\%, with the largest gain on BrowseComp-Plus (73.5\% versus 62.4\%). We further analyze trajectory structure and inference cost to characterize this improvement.

AI.tldr: 论文提出自适应一致性图（ACG），用于缓解大语言模型智能体在长程任务中因任务要求、历史证据与当前状态脱节而导致的决策漂移问题。ACG 在不替换基础规划器或工具执行器的前提下，为每个决策构建以需求为中心、可追溯的上下文视图，从而提升长程执行的成功率。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体在短任务上能做出合理的局部决策，但在需要长序列依赖动作与工具调用的任务中表现下降。执行过程中，任务要求、历史证据和当前执行状态可能逐渐失去关联，导致后续决策偏离原始目标。
AI.method: 提出自适应一致性图（ACG）。ACG 将执行证据及其来源增量地组织到一个持久图中，并在有限上下文预算下，为每个决策构建临时的、以需求为中心的视图。ACG 不替换基础智能体的规划器或工具执行器，而是为每个决策提供结构化、可追溯的上下文视图。
AI.result: 在匹配评估中，ACG 将 GPT-5.6-luna 的平均成功率从 ReAct 的 44.5% 提升至 50.2%，其中在 BrowseComp-Plus 上增益最大，达到 73.5%（对比 62.4%）。论文还进一步分析了轨迹结构和推理成本来刻画这一改进。
AI.conclusion: ACG 通过为长程执行中的每个决策提供结构化、可追溯且以需求为中心的上下文视图，有效缓解了任务要求、历史证据与当前状态脱节的问题，从而显著提升了大语言模型智能体在长程任务中的成功率。

title: RoboIRGBench: Benchmarking Implicit Referential Grounding in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown strong capabilities in robotic manipulation, yet existing benchmarks typically assume that task-relevant information is explicitly specified in the instruction. In practice, however, humans frequently refer to objects, quantities, and relations implicitly, requiring robots to recover the intended target from linguistic and perceptual context. We study this capability as Implicit Referential Grounding (IRG) and introduce RoboIRG-Bench, a manipulation benchmark designed to systematically evaluate it. Built upon RoboMME, RoboIRG-Bench contains 40 variants derived from 11 tasks and covers four challenges, including direct, reasoning-mediated, spatial, and contextual referential grounding. As IRG often requires retaining and retrieving previously established context, we evaluate representative VLAs spanning different memory mechanisms. Our evaluation reveals a noticeable referential robustness gap. Models that perform well under explicit instructions can degrade sharply when the same task-relevant information must be recovered from context. Reasoning-mediated and spatial references are particularly challenging, while models using external VLMs show greater robustness but still exhibit significant failures. Moreover, replacing the external VLM with a stronger model does not eliminate these gaps. We further validate these findings on a Franka Research 3 robot arm, where the gap persists under real-world manipulation and manifests as both incorrect referent grounding and downstream execution failures. These results establish IRG as a distinct and underexplored capability for reliable robotic instruction following and highlight the need for VLAs that can robustly integrate language, perception, reasoning, and action.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出隐式指称接地(IRG)能力，并构建RoboIRG-Bench基准，评估VLA模型在隐式指令下的表现，发现模型性能显著下降，真实机器人上差距持续。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA基准假设任务相关信息在指令中明确给出，但实际人类常隐式指称物体、数量和关系，需要机器人从语言和感知上下文中恢复目标。
AI.method: 基于RoboMME构建RoboIRG-Bench，包含40个变体、11个任务，覆盖直接、推理中介、空间和上下文四类指称接地挑战。评估不同记忆机制的VLA模型，并在Franka Research 3机械臂上验证。
AI.result: 模型在显式指令下表现良好，但隐式指称下性能急剧下降，推理中介和空间指称尤其困难；使用外部VLM的模型更鲁棒但仍显著失败，替换更强VLM不能消除差距；真实机器人上差距持续，表现为指称错误和下游执行失败。
AI.conclusion: IRG是可靠机器人指令跟随中一个独特且未被充分探索的能力，需要VLA模型能稳健整合语言、感知、推理和动作。

title: LA-CPD: Local-Evidence-Aware Change-Point Detection for Human-LLM Authorship Segmentation
summary: As LLM-generated text becomes increasingly human-like, accurately localizing LLM-authored spans in human-LLM co-authored documents is important for attribution and accountability in cases involving copyright infringement, fraud, and other harmful uses of AI-generated content. Sentence-level detectors provide local authorship evidence, but content variation can cause score fluctuations even among sentences from the same source, creating spurious boundaries. Recovering a coherent document partition therefore remains challenging when both the number and locations of authorship transitions are unknown. We propose Local-Evidence-Aware Change-Point Detection (LA-CPD), a structured method that transforms noisy sentence-level score sequences into coherent authorship segments. Given scores from a frozen local detector, LA-CPD combines a length-weighted within-segment residual with a windowed two-mean contrast to capture segment consistency and sustained changes around candidate cut points. Dynamic programming optimizes cut locations for each candidate count, while an AIC-style criterion selects the final partition, yielding sentence labels, authorship boundaries, and maximal LLM-authored spans. On a held-out human-LLM co-authored test set, LA-CPD outperforms WCP+AIC, increasing sentence-level accuracy from 0.747 to 0.796 while improving boundary localization and LLM-span delineation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LA-CPD方法，将句子级LLM检测分数序列转化为连贯的作者身份分段，以更准确地在人机共写文档中定位LLM生成的句子和跨度。
AI.motivation: LLM生成文本越来越像人类写作，在版权侵权、欺诈等场景中需要准确识别和定位人机共写文档中的LLM撰写部分；但句子级检测器分数会因内容变化而波动，导致虚假的作者身份边界，难以在转换数量和位置未知时恢复连贯分段。
AI.method: 提出Local-Evidence-Aware Change-Point Detection（LA-CPD）。给定冻结局部检测器的句子级分数，结合长度加权的段内残差与窗口化双均值对比，以捕捉段一致性和候选切点附近的持续变化；使用动态规划为不同候选切分数优化切点位置，并用AIC风格准则选择最终分段，输出句子标签、作者边界和最大LLM撰写跨度。
AI.result: 在留出的人机共写测试集上，LA-CPD优于WCP+AIC，将句子级准确率从0.747提升到0.796，同时改善了边界定位和LLM跨度划分。
AI.conclusion: LA-CPD能够有效处理噪声句子级分数，生成连贯的作者身份分段，从而提升LLM生成文本定位与归因的准确性。

title: InterTab: Interleaved Visual-Structure Alignment for Multi-Modal Table Reasoning
summary: Table images preserve structural information that are often lost in text serialization, and reasoning over them requires locating relevant rows, columns, and cells step by step. Current multimodal large language models (MLLMs) encode the whole image once before reasoning, so they cannot pick up row-, column-, and cell-level evidence as the question unfolds. Encoder-side table structure and generic interleaved visual chain-of-thought still do not bind each reasoning step to that structure. We propose \textbf{InterTab}, an \textbf{Inter}leaved structure-aware framework for CoT reasoning over \textbf{Tab}le images, interleaves chain-of-thought with tool calls that crop structure-aligned table regions. First, we build InterTab-22K, includes reasoning trajectories in which each step is tied to both a structural location and a bounding box. InterTab is trained in two stages: supervised structure-aware alignment (SSA) on InterTab-22K teaches the model to interleave reasoning with structure-aligned crops, and active localization optimization (ALO) further optimizes answer correctness, localization IoU, and output format, while penalizing missing or excessive tool calls. Experiments on nine table benchmarks show that InterTab improves the average accuracy of its backbone from 68.28% to 73.17% and achieves the best average performance among all compared methods. Code and data will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 提出InterTab，一种面向表格图像的交错结构感知链式推理框架，通过工具调用裁剪结构对齐的表格区域，提升多模态大模型在表格图像上的推理能力。
AI.motivation: 表格图像的结构信息在文本序列化中常被丢失，而现有多模态大模型通常一次性编码整张图像，无法在推理过程中逐步定位行、列和单元格证据；已有编码端结构建模或通用交错视觉CoT也未将每个推理步骤绑定到表格结构。
AI.method: 构建InterTab-22K数据集，使每个推理步骤同时关联结构位置和边界框；采用两阶段训练：监督结构感知对齐（SSA）学习交错推理与结构对齐裁剪，主动定位优化（ALO）进一步优化答案正确性、定位IoU和输出格式，并惩罚缺失或过多的工具调用。
AI.result: 在九个表格基准上，InterTab将其骨干模型平均准确率从68.28%提升至73.17%，并在所有对比方法中取得最佳平均性能。
AI.conclusion: InterTab通过将链式推理与结构对齐的表格区域裁剪工具调用交错结合，有效增强了表格图像推理，并计划发布代码和数据。

title: In-Context Adaptation of Encoder-Decoder Models in Speech Recognition
summary: In-context learning offers an appealing approach to adapt automatic speech recognition (ASR) models to new speakers, accents, and domains by providing speech-text pairs as demonstrations at inference time. Recent work shows that some LLM-based speech models are capable of ASR in-context adaptation, when providing interleaved speech-text demonstrations. In this work, we ask whether in-context adaptation is an inherent ability for all encoder-decoder models. We study two forms of demonstration, collated and interleaved demonstration, across six encoder-decoder models, spanning conventional cross-attention-based and LLM-based architectures. We find that all tested models are able to perform in-context adaptation out of the box, achieving up to 30% relative improvement in the oracle experiments and up to 23% using first-pass hypotheses. Through controlled experiments on three English datasets, we show that lexical and speaker information both contribute to successful adaptation. While interleaved demonstration is effective in certain cases, collated demonstration brings consistent adaptation across the board. Our results suggest that in-context adaptation for ASR is not unique to specific architectures, training, or demonstration approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文研究基于上下文学习（in-context learning）的语音识别自适应能力，是否普遍存在于各类编码器-解码器模型中。作者在六种模型、两种演示形式（拼接式与交错式）及三个英语数据集上实验，发现模型无需额外训练即可进行上下文自适应，并分析了词汇与说话人信息的作用。
AI.motivation: 近期研究表明部分基于大语言模型的语音模型可通过交错语音-文本演示实现ASR上下文自适应，但尚不清楚这种能力是否为所有编码器-解码器模型所固有，还是仅限特定架构、训练方式或演示形式。
AI.method: 研究六种编码器-解码器ASR模型（包括传统交叉注意力架构与LLM基架构），比较拼接式（collated）与交错式（interleaved）两种演示形式；在三个英语数据集上进行实验，并开展控制实验以分析词汇信息和说话人信息对自适应成功的贡献。
AI.result: 所有测试模型均能开箱即用进行上下文自适应，在oracle实验中相对提升最高约30%，使用首遍假设时最高约23%；词汇和说话人信息均有助于成功自适应；交错式演示在部分场景有效，而拼接式演示在整体上带来更一致的自适应效果。
AI.conclusion: ASR的上下文自适应并非特定架构、训练方式或演示方法所独有，而是多种编码器-解码器模型普遍具备的能力。
