title: Contact-Aware Impedance Controller for Robot-Assisted Ultrasound Imaging
comment: 8 pages, 7 figures, submitted to the IEEE International Conference on Robotics and Automation (ICRA2027)
summary: Safe robot-assisted ultrasound imaging requires a reliable controller able to detect and localize probe--tissue interaction. In this paper, we present a B-mode ultrasound image-based contact perception method and a contact-aware impedance controller for robotic ultrasound imaging. The proposed method detects acoustic contact independently of force measurements, enabling contact-conditioned force/torque taring to reduce residual wrench bias. During contact, the method continuously estimates the effective contact location along the curved probe surface and uses it to update the controller interaction frame, enabling visual servoing of the physical probe--tissue contact point during imaging. Experiments on an agar phantom demonstrated a contact-localization RMSE of $\mathbf{1.46 \pm 0.14}$~mm over probe roll angles from $\mathbf{-15^\circ}$ to $\mathbf{15^\circ}$. During static rolling, the proposed controller maintained task-space tracking accuracy comparable to a conventional fixed-frame impedance controller while reducing the maximum compressive interaction force from $\mathbf{31.56}$~N to $\mathbf{20.09}$~N, corresponding to a $\mathbf{36.3\%}$ reduction. These results demonstrate the potential of ultrasound images as direct contact feedback for safe and accurate robot-assisted ultrasound imaging.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于B超图像的接触感知方法及接触感知阻抗控制器，用于机器人超声成像。该方法无需力测量即可检测声学接触，并连续估计曲面上有效接触位置，以更新控制器交互坐标系，实现接触点的视觉伺服。
AI.motivation: 安全的机器人辅助超声成像需要可靠控制器来检测和定位探头与组织的交互作用，以避免过大接触力并提高成像安全性与准确性。
AI.method: 提出基于B超图像的接触感知方法，独立于力测量检测声学接触；在接触时进行条件化的力/力矩归零以减少残余力偏置；连续估计沿弯曲探头表面的有效接触位置，并据此更新控制器交互坐标系，实现物理探头-组织接触点的视觉伺服。
AI.result: 在琼脂体模实验中，探头滚转角度从-15°到15°时，接触定位RMSE为1.46±0.14 mm。静态滚转时，所提控制器保持与常规固定坐标系阻抗控制器相当的任务空间跟踪精度，同时将最大压缩交互力从31.56 N降至20.09 N，降低36.3%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，超声图像可作为直接接触反馈，用于安全且准确的机器人辅助超声成像。

title: RCVLA: 4D Radar-Grounded Semantic Reasoning and Trajectory Arbitration for Autonomous Driving
summary: 4D radar provides geometric and motion cues that complement visual semantics, but integrating it into vision-language-action (VLA) models requires both radar--language alignment for semantic reasoning and explicit use of radar measurements for trajectory refinement and selection. To support these capabilities, we construct Cap4DR with 86,016 radar-image-text samples for alignment pretraining and OmniHD-QA with 520,161 question-answer pairs for instruction tuning across scene description, key-object reasoning, occupancy understanding, and trajectory planning. Building on these datasets, we propose RCVLA, a radar-camera VLA framework consisting of a radar-grounded semantic reasoning stage (RCVLA-Sem) and a trajectory arbitration stage (RCVLA-Phys). RCVLA-Sem performs gated bidirectional interaction between camera and radar tokens for driving question answering and reference trajectory generation, while auxiliary heads provide object and occupancy queries. RCVLA-Phys refines reference-guided trajectory candidates through truncated diffusion conditioned on these queries and cluster-level radar measurements, then calibrates candidate scores using radar-derived time-to-collision risk. On OmniHD-QA, RCVLA-Sem improves CIDEr by 9.92 points and reduces key-object velocity error by $21.9\%$ relative to OmniDrive. RCVLA-Phys further reduces average L2 error from $0.348$ to $0.259\,\mathrm{m}$ and average open-loop collision rate from $0.576\%$ to $0.175\%$ relative to RCVLA-Sem. Ablation studies further show that language-aligned radar tokens improve semantic reasoning, while cluster-level radar measurements and risk calibration improve trajectory arbitration. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将4D雷达融入视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型，构建Cap4DR与OmniHD-QA数据集，并提出RCVLA框架，包含雷达-相机语义推理阶段RCVLA-Sem和轨迹仲裁阶段RCVLA-Phys，用于驾驶问答、轨迹生成与优化。
AI.motivation: 4D雷达能提供几何与运动线索，补充视觉语义，但将其集成到VLA模型中需要解决雷达-语言对齐以支持语义推理，以及显式利用雷达测量进行轨迹优化与选择的问题。
AI.method: 构建Cap4DR（86,016雷达-图像-文本样本）用于对齐预训练，以及OmniHD-QA（520,161问答对）用于场景描述、关键物体推理、占据理解与轨迹规划的指令微调；提出RCVLA框架：RCVLA-Sem通过门控双向交互融合相机与雷达token，输出驾驶问答与参考轨迹，并用辅助头提供物体与占据查询；RCVLA-Phys基于这些查询和簇级雷达测量，通过截断扩散优化参考引导的轨迹候选，并利用雷达推导的碰撞时间风险校准候选分数。
AI.result: 在OmniHD-QA上，RCVLA-Sem相比OmniDrive将CIDEr提升9.92，关键物体速度误差降低21.9%；RCVLA-Phys进一步将平均L2误差从0.348 m降至0.259 m，平均开环碰撞率从0.576%降至0.175%。消融实验表明，语言对齐的雷达token提升语义推理，簇级雷达测量与风险校准提升轨迹仲裁。
AI.conclusion: RCVLA验证了将4D雷达与视觉语言动作模型结合的有效性，雷达-语言对齐、簇级雷达测量和风险校准分别对语义推理与轨迹优化具有重要作用。

title: Action Shaping: Policies Absorb What They Can Express
summary: Reward shaping has a theorem: a potential-based term can be removed without changing the optimal policy. The same practice on the action channel, an offset added in training and dropped at deployment, has no theorem. Nothing cancels an action offset, so the correction is kept at deployment or removed without a guarantee. We call it action shaping and state its principle. A trainable policy absorbs an offset its own output layer can reproduce exactly, which is what we mean by express; what is absorbed can be removed with the return intact. Its minimal instance is a zero-initialized linear head behind a learnable gate, added to an actor that trains through a learned action-value function, with no penalty or schedule. The gate rises and then falls on its own, for deterministic and stochastic actors alike, and on 20 tasks removing the head costs almost nothing. The condition is exact reproduction, not capacity: a nonlinear head with more parameters is not absorbed, and in a paired control, one linear path added to a nonlinear base head restores absorption. Exact reproduction gives the loss a flat direction that gradient noise drifts along, and the offset's amplitude indicates, before removal, what dropping the head will cost. Action shaping thus gains the counterpart of the shaping theorem, a condition for absorption, together with the mechanism behind it and a diagnostic that reads it. Policies absorb what they can express, and only that.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“动作塑形”原理：若策略输出层能精确复现训练时加在动作通道上的偏移，则该偏移会被吸收，并可在部署时移除而不损失回报。作者用零初始化线性头加可学习门控验证，并在20个任务上发现移除该头几乎无代价。
AI.motivation: 奖励塑形有势函数定理保证可移除，但动作通道上的偏移在训练时加入、部署时移除却缺乏理论保证：没有东西能保证抵消动作偏移，因此要么部署时保留修正，要么无保证地移除。
AI.method: 定义动作塑形并给出吸收条件“可精确表达”。最小实现是在actor后加入零初始化线性头与可学习门控，通过已学习的动作价值函数训练，不施加惩罚或调度；在确定性和随机actor、20个任务上测试，并进行非线性头对照实验。
AI.result: 门控会自行先升后降；移除该头几乎不损回报。关键条件是精确复现而非容量：参数更多的非线性头不被吸收，而在非线性基头旁加入一条线性路径可恢复吸收。精确复现使损失出现平坦方向，梯度噪声沿其漂移；偏移幅度可在移除前诊断丢弃该头的代价。
AI.conclusion: 动作塑形获得了类似塑形定理的对应结果：吸收条件、吸收机制以及诊断方法。策略只能吸收其能精确表达的部分，也只有这部分可被安全移除。

title: Lost with a Map: Conversational State and Behavioral Reliability in Language Models
comment: 9 pages main text, 39 pages total, 3 main-text figures
summary: Task-oriented dialogue requires maintaining and updating information across turns, yet language models expose no explicit belief-state object. We study how conversational state is represented, updated, and used inside eight instruction-tuned language models from four families on MultiWOZ and SGD. Structure and values separate: which domains, slots, and requests are active is linearly readable just before the model acts, whereas exact values are far more readable where the user stated them. After a user changes a value, both values remain accessible at their mentions, and causal interventions show that both continue to influence the model's action. In natural closed-loop interaction, query failures separate into cases of weak structural support, incorrect value resolution, and failure to deploy otherwise-supported constraints, with targeted interventions producing systematically different repair behavior across these cases. These findings motivate a state-action controller that starts from the base model action and selectively edits it using structural readouts, without requiring a complete predicted belief state as an intermediate representation. On held-out MultiWOZ interaction across five models, it raises the base model exact-query accuracy from .318 to .621 and task success from .272 to .371 at negligible added cost. Overall, reliable interaction requires not only retaining conversational information, but resolving which available constraints currently apply and ensuring that they govern action.

AI.tldr: 研究八个指令微调语言模型在任务型对话中如何表示、更新和使用对话状态，并提出一种基于结构读数的状态-动作控制器来提升查询准确率与任务成功率。
AI.motivation: 任务型对话需要跨轮维护和更新信息，但语言模型没有显式的信念状态对象，因此有必要理解其内部对话状态表示、更新与作用于动作的机制。
AI.method: 在MultiWOZ和SGD上分析四个家族共八个指令微调模型；用线性可读性探测区分结构与值，用因果干预检验旧值与新值对动作的影响，并在闭环交互中分类查询失败及干预修复行为；进而提出不依赖完整预测信念状态、从基础动作出发用结构读数选择性编辑的状态-动作控制器。
AI.result: 结构信息（激活的领域、槽位、请求）在动作前线性可读，而精确值在用户提及处更可读；值改变后新旧值仍可访问并共同影响动作；失败可分为结构支持弱、值解析错误、已支持约束未生效三类；控制器在五个模型上将MultiWOZ留出集精确查询准确率从.318提升到.621，任务成功率从.272提升到.371，附加成本可忽略。
AI.conclusion: 可靠交互不仅需要保留对话信息，还需要判定哪些可用约束当前适用，并确保这些约束真正支配模型动作。

title: Readout is not Recovery: Dissociating Coordinate Emission from Visual-Corruption Repair in Vision-Language Models
summary: VLM bounding-box localization is both language generation and spatial commitment. Parseable fields such as bbox_2d make localization easy to score, but dimensions that emit coordinate tokens need not repair localization after visual evidence is damaged. We study this readout/recovery separation in Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct on single-object COCO grounding. We compare clean coordinate-token readout rankings with corruption-derived repair rankings, using object-mask endpoint replacement for recovery and clean-input flooring for depth localization. In Qwen3-VL, coordinate-token rankings are inert through layer 24, load-bearing from layers 32-35, and peak at layer 34; corruption-derived rankings harm layers 16-24 but become beneficial near layer 35/final. A Kimi-VL-A3B diagnostic shows a matching output-proximal transition despite a different box format. Object-mask recovery separates rank budgets: $k=250$ shows necessity, $k=500$ shows Top-$k$ restoration above random, and $k=d/2$ is largely capacity-driven. Partial-occlusion sweeps reveal that high-overlap coordinate-token sets can hurt at $k=1000$ and help mainly at half-width, while population corruption-derived sets provide no reliable fixed repair set. Edge-attribution patching shows coordinate-token paths are high precision but low recall for detection recovery, and RMSNorm quasi-layer controls do not close the endpoint-repair gap. Endpoint coordinate triage is therefore a useful circuit prior, but occlusion recovery requires a separate benchmark.

AI.tldr: 该研究在Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct单目标COCO grounding任务上，分析了VLM边界框定位中“可读性”与“损坏后修复”的分离现象，比较干净坐标token排序与损坏诱导修复排序，并给出层级、修复预算、遮挡与归因实验结论。
AI.motivation: VLM边界框定位既是语言生成也是空间承诺。bbox_2d等可解析字段便于评分，但输出坐标token的维度在视觉证据受损后未必能修复定位，因此需要研究readout与recovery的分离。
AI.method: 在Qwen3-VL-4B-Instruct单目标COCO grounding上，比较干净坐标token readout排序与corruption-derived repair排序；使用object-mask endpoint replacement评估恢复，用clean-input flooring评估深度定位；进行层级分析，并用Kimi-VL-A3B做诊断。还设置object-mask recovery的rank budgets（k=250、k=500、k=d/2）、partial-occlusion sweeps、edge-attribution patching以及RMSNorm quasi-layer controls。
AI.result: Qwen3-VL中坐标token排序在第24层前基本惰性，第32-35层承重，第34层达到峰值；corruption-derived排序在第16-24层有害，但在第35层/最终附近有益。Kimi-VL-A3B尽管框格式不同，也出现匹配的输出近端转变。Object-mask恢复显示rank预算分离：k=250体现必要性，k=500时Top-k恢复高于随机，k=d/2主要由容量驱动。部分遮挡扫描显示，高重叠坐标token集合在k=1000时可能有害，主要在half-width时有益；population corruption-derived集合没有可靠的固定修复集。Edge-attribution patching显示坐标token路径对检测恢复是高精度低召回，RMSNorm quasi-layer controls未能弥合endpoint-repair差距。
AI.conclusion: Endpoint coordinate triage是有用的circuit prior，但遮挡恢复需要单独基准来评估。

title: LLMs learn different forms of metacognition when trained to predict their own accuracy
summary: Large language models are trained to always produce an answer, regardless of whether they possess the relevant knowledge, which leads them to fabricate facts. Prior work has shown that LLMs' confidence estimates correspond poorly to their actual performance, and that fine-tuning can substantially improve them. However, what models actually learn during such training remains poorly understood. We investigate how LLMs acquire metacognitive monitoring, the ability to know what one knows, by training 10 open-weight LLMs to predict their own accuracy on factual multiple-choice questions before answering them. We find that trained confidence reflects two distinct signals. While on questions close to the training data, it tracks the model's true accuracy, in other domains, it instead tracks output consistency: the concentration of the model's answer distribution. Output consistency tracking emerges early in training and generalizes across datasets, whereas accuracy tracking develops later and remains local to the training distribution. These results suggest that calibration training may not teach models to generally detect errors they commit confidently, and they raise broader questions about the nature of metacognition in artificial systems.

AI.tldr: 该研究训练10个开源大语言模型在回答事实性选择题前预测自身正确率，发现模型学到的置信度包含两种不同信号：在训练分布附近反映真实准确率，在其他领域则反映输出一致性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型即使缺乏相关知识也会给出答案，从而编造事实；且其置信度估计与实际表现匹配较差。已有微调可改善校准，但模型在训练中究竟学到了什么尚不清楚，因此需要研究其元认知监控能力如何习得。
AI.method: 训练10个开放权重的大语言模型，在回答事实性多项选择题之前预测自己是否会答对，并分析训练后模型置信度所依赖的信号来源。
AI.result: 训练后的置信度反映两种不同信号：在接近训练数据的问题上，置信度追踪模型真实准确率；在其他领域，置信度追踪输出一致性，即模型答案分布的集中程度。输出一致性追踪在训练早期出现并能跨数据集泛化，而准确率追踪发展较晚且仅局限于训练分布。
AI.conclusion: 校准训练可能并不能教会模型普遍检测其自信犯下的错误，这也对人工系统中的元认知本质提出了更广泛的问题。

title: From World Models to World Action Models: Rethinking Next-State Prediction
summary: Predicting the next state is a core paradigm of World Models for modeling physical dynamics, emphasizing prediction fidelity. As World Models evolve into World-Action Models (WAMs), existing methods still fix the next state before training as RGB, a single latent feature, or a static combination of predefined targets, thereby constraining action learning to the inductive biases preserved by a particular representation. To address this limitation, we propose CF-WAM, a dynamic next-state prediction framework that samples visual, semantic, geometric, and interaction projections of the same future, standardizes them into a common video form, and supervises a unified WAM across these projections. The action-relevant constraints exposed by these projections accumulate across training steps, forcing WAM to capture the underlying state-transition structure that supports multiple projections of the same action-conditioned future. This dynamic mechanism also provides a natural cross-embodiment dynamics reference frame for Human and Robot learning. By jointly learning across different next-state parameterizations, heterogeneous Human and Robot experience can bypass appearance differences and directly contribute to shared state-transition learning, improving cross-embodiment generalization. Experiments show that CF-WAM improves both training efficiency and final control performance, while translating Human experience effectively into policy gains. CF-WAM achieves state-of-the-art performance on RoboCasa-GR1 with an average success rate of 82.50%, while reaching 82.65% on LIBERO-Plus and up to 84.00% in real-world evaluations.

AI.tldr: 提出CF-WAM动态下一状态预测框架，采样同一未来状态的视觉、语义、几何与交互投影并统一为视频形式，监督统一世界-动作模型，提升训练效率、控制性能与跨具身泛化。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型将下一状态在训练前固定为RGB、单一潜特征或预定义目标的静态组合，使动作学习受限于特定表示的归纳偏置。
AI.method: 动态采样同一动作条件下未来的多种投影（视觉、语义、几何、交互），标准化为通用视频形式，统一监督WAM；动作相关约束跨训练步累积；为人类与机器人学习提供跨具身动力学参考系，联合学习不同下一状态参数化。
AI.result: 提升训练效率与最终控制性能；RoboCasa-GR1平均成功率82.50%，LIBERO-Plus 82.65%，真实世界最高84.00%；有效将人类经验转化为策略增益。
AI.conclusion: 跨不同下一状态参数化联合学习可绕过外观差异、共享状态转移学习，改善跨具身泛化，并达到最优性能。

title: From Language to Task Maps: Compiling Semantic Relations While Preserving Task-Relevant Freedom
summary: Natural-language manipulation instructions specify qualitative relations, whereas continuous controllers require state-evaluable task quantities, differentials, and completion conditions. Because a qualitative relation generally leaves part of the relative configuration unspecified, expanding it into a complete pose can introduce unintended constraints. We present a typed semantic-to-geometric interface in which language specifies entities, relations, and phases, while each relation indexes a registered specification of its task-relevant distinctions and preserved freedoms. A robot-side compiler grounds these specifications, constructs relation-specific task maps and consistent differentials using conformal geometric algebra, and composes the resulting policies through RMPflow. To evaluate the division of responsibility between the language model and the compiler, we compared a Semantic Topology interface with one that additionally requires relation-specific geometric specifications over 60 instructions. Both produced correct shared semantic content in 41/60 cases, but critical errors under their respective interface requirements occurred in 19/60 and 58/60 cases. Across 64 grounded evaluations spanning eight geometric relation forms, the task maps preserved registered null directions and responded to relation-relevant perturbations; analytic directional derivatives agreed with finite differences, and Jacobian ranks matched the registered dimensions. In three closed-loop ablations using a simulated Franka Emika Panda in MuJoCo, fixing a relation-preserved coordinate increased median terminal progress error by 20.24--71.00~mm while the retained relation errors remained within their evaluation bounds. These results support compiling relation-visible geometry and preserved freedom together into composable continuous objectives.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种类型化语义到几何接口，将自然语言中的实体、关系和阶段映射为机器人可执行的任务图与微分，并用共形几何代数与RMPflow组合连续控制策略，以保留关系未指定自由度。
AI.motivation: 自然语言操作指令通常只表达定性关系，而连续控制器需要可评估的任务量、微分和完成条件。将定性关系扩展为完整位姿可能引入非预期约束，因此需要明确语言模型与机器人编译器之间的责任划分。
AI.method: 设计类型化语义到几何接口：语言指定实体、关系和阶段，每个关系索引一个注册规范，说明任务相关区分与应保留自由度。机器人侧编译器基于共形几何代数构建关系特定任务图与一致微分，并通过RMPflow组合策略。评估中比较语义拓扑接口与额外要求几何规范的接口，并开展64次 grounded 评估和3个闭环消融实验，使用MuJoCo中模拟Franka Emika Panda。
AI.result: 两种接口在60条指令中均有41/60正确共享语义内容，但在各自接口要求下关键错误分别为19/60和58/60。64次评估覆盖8种几何关系形式，任务图保留注册零方向、响应关系相关扰动，解析方向导数与有限差分一致，雅可比秩与注册维度匹配。闭环消融中，固定关系保留坐标使终端进度误差中位数增加20.24–71.00 mm，而保留关系误差仍在评估界内。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持将关系可见几何与保留自由度共同编译为可组合的连续目标，从而在语言定性关系与连续控制之间建立更可靠的接口。

title: MM-OPD: Towards One More Bottleneck Between Perception and Reasoning
summary: Recent multimodal large language models (MLLMs) advance visual reasoning by strengthening both perception and reasoning, implicitly assuming a process that transitions seamlessly from perception to reasoning. However, we observe a counterintuitive phenomenon that challenges this assumption: holding the model, question, and decoding fixed, we replace images with their caption or code representations (symbolic views), which seems to be redundant given the clear image structures, but the performance surprisingly improves by 10.2% to 23.6% across model scales and datasets. We term this performance gap as the Symbolic Visual Gap and then take a closer look at it. Through experiments, we find that although the visual evidence can already appear in the reasoning trace for the image-input model, the symbolic-view-input model shows much higher attention to the correct evidence than the image-input model. This suggests that despite good capabilities from current works in perception and reasoning themselves, another bottleneck exists between perception and reasoning in selecting perceived visual information as appropriate evidence for subsequent reasoning. To handle this bottleneck, since the symbolic view steers attention toward correct evidence and is readily obtained at scale, it provides supervision for evidence selection without manually labeled evidence. Building on this, we introduce MM-OPD, a multimodal on-policy self-distillation framework for symbolic-to-visual correction that transfers guidance from symbolic-conditioned behavior to the image-conditioned policy through residual token-level targets, steering the model toward correct visual evidence. Experiments across benchmarks and model scales show that MM-OPD improves a broad range of multimodal abilities, with gains in visual perception, chart and document understanding, mathematical reasoning, and general VQA.

AI.tldr: 论文发现多模态大模型中存在“符号视觉鸿沟”：将图像替换为描述或代码等符号表示后，性能反而提升10.2%至23.6%。作者将此归因于感知到推理之间的证据选择瓶颈，并提出MM-OPD框架，通过符号到视觉的在线自蒸馏来提升模型对正确视觉证据的关注与使用。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态大模型常假设感知到推理是顺畅衔接的，但实验表明，固定模型、问题和解码方式时，符号视图输入比图像输入表现更好，说明感知与推理之间存在一个被忽视的瓶颈：如何从已感知的视觉信息中选择合适证据供后续推理使用。
AI.method: 作者定义并分析Symbolic Visual Gap，通过注意力实验比较图像输入与符号视图输入对正确证据的关注差异。基于符号视图能引导注意力且易于大规模获取，提出MM-OPD：一种多模态在线策略自蒸馏框架，将符号条件行为中的指导迁移到图像条件策略，通过残差token级目标进行符号到视觉的校正。
AI.result: 实验发现，符号视图输入使性能提升10.2%至23.6%；符号视图模型对正确证据的注意力显著高于图像输入模型。MM-OPD在多个基准和模型规模上提升了广泛的多模态能力，包括视觉感知、图表与文档理解、数学推理和通用VQA。
AI.conclusion: 感知与推理之间的证据选择是当前MLLM的重要瓶颈。符号视图可作为无需人工标注证据的监督信号，MM-OPD通过符号到视觉的自蒸馏有效缓解该瓶颈，并广泛提升多模态推理与理解性能。

title: Mandela-Bench: Multimodal Models Remember Canonical Images Instead of Seeing Them
summary: Historical photographs and other canonical images can now be edited seamlessly with a single instruction, often leaving no reliable pixel-level trace. In such cases, the only evidence of manipulation may be a fact about what the image depicts. Existing benchmarks instead rely on generator artefacts, image-caption inconsistencies, visual implausibilities, or external references, and therefore do not test whether a model can use its own world knowledge to verify a recognized image. We introduce Mandela-Bench, containing 1,507 edits of canonical images: 1,359 knowledge-only forgeries, each contradicting one verifiable fact, and 148 anchor-free controls that preserve the editing process without introducing a factual contradiction, together with 474 untouched originals. We score not only whether a model detects a forgery, but whether its explanation identifies the inserted entity or the fact being violated. Across 36 multimodal models, from 0.8B parameters to frontier scale, we find a consistent failure mode. When a public figure is removed from a familiar photograph, models still name that person in up to 72.7% of responses. Some models can distinguish the replacement face from the original when shown in isolation, yet still judge the full edited photograph as authentic. Providing the true event and date does not improve knowledge-grounded detection, whereas providing the same information after cropping away the recognizable composition does. Even under explicit verification prompts, only one of the 36 models meets the KGR criterion on at least half of the forged images. These results suggest that the failures cannot be explained by missing knowledge or inadequate perception alone. Instead, they are consistent with recognition biasing verification toward the remembered canonical image rather than the observed edit.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Mandela-Bench 基准，用于测试多模态模型能否用自身世界知识识别经典图像中被编辑掉的事实矛盾。结果显示，36 个模型中普遍存在一种失败模式：模型受记忆中的经典图像影响，而非依据当前观察到的编辑进行验证。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多依赖生成器伪影、图文不一致、视觉不合理或外部参考，无法测试模型能否利用自身世界知识验证已识别图像的真实性。历史照片等经典图像可被单条指令无缝编辑，像素级痕迹可能消失，唯一线索可能是图像内容违背了某个可验证事实。
AI.method: 构建 Mandela-Bench，包含 1,507 个经典图像编辑：1,359 个仅靠知识判断的伪造，每个违反一个可验证事实；148 个无锚点对照，保留编辑过程但不引入事实矛盾；另含 474 张未编辑原图。评分不仅判断模型是否检测到伪造，还判断解释是否指出插入实体或被违反的事实。评估 36 个多模态模型，参数从 0.8B 到前沿规模。
AI.result: 发现一致的失败模式：当熟悉照片中的公众人物被移除时，模型仍在该人物姓名上给出回答的比例最高达 72.7%。一些模型在单独展示替换人脸时能区分原脸，却仍将完整编辑照片判为真实。提供真实事件和日期并不能改善基于知识的检测，而在裁剪掉可识别构图后提供同样信息则可以。即使使用显式验证提示，36 个模型中仅 1 个在至少一半伪造图像上满足 KGR 标准。
AI.conclusion: 这些失败不能仅由知识缺失或感知不足解释，而与识别过程将验证偏向记忆中的经典图像、而非当前观察到的编辑相一致。

title: DPAMixerSR: An Efficient Degradation-Pattern-Aware Model for Image Super-Resolution
summary: While content-adaptive schemes have delivered notable advances in image super-resolution (SR), existing approaches typically focus on texture complexity and ignore intrinsic degradation factors (e.g., blur kernels or noise patterns), leading to suboptimal computation allocation and reconstruction performance. To remedy this, we propose DPAMixerSR, a degradation-pattern-aware framework that enables efficient SR through adaptive sparse computation. We design a lightweight Perceptual Degradation Ranking (PDR) module partitions the image into severely and mildly degraded patches, which are routed to the Adaptive Sparse Processing (ASP) and a lightweight convolutional branch, respectively. ASP performs structure-aligned, multi-scale sparse propagation and bidirectional refinement, while the convolutional branch enhances efficiency in mildly degraded regions. By coupling degradation-driven routing with structure-aligned sparse processing, DPAMixerSR establishes a self-regulating framework that dynamically balances computational efficiency and reconstruction fidelity. Extensive experiments on various SR tasks demonstrate that our DPAMixerSR achieves superior structural restoration and perceptual fidelity with markedly reduced computational overhead, providing a novel and scalable framework for degradation-aware, resource-efficient SR.

AI.tldr: 提出DPAMixerSR，一种退化模式感知的自适应稀疏计算图像超分框架，通过按退化程度路由图像块至稀疏处理或轻量卷积分支，在显著降低计算开销的同时提升结构恢复与感知质量。
AI.motivation: 现有内容自适应超分方法多关注纹理复杂度，忽略模糊核、噪声等内在退化因素，导致计算分配次优和重建性能受限。
AI.method: 设计轻量感知退化排序PDR模块，将图像划分为严重退化和轻微退化块；严重退化块路由至自适应稀疏处理ASP，执行结构对齐的多尺度稀疏传播与双向细化；轻微退化块由轻量卷积分支处理；通过退化驱动路由与结构对齐稀疏处理耦合，形成自调节框架。
AI.result: 在多种超分任务上的实验表明，DPAMixerSR实现了更优的结构恢复和感知保真度，并显著降低计算开销。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为退化感知、资源高效超分提供了新颖且可扩展的框架，能够动态平衡计算效率与重建保真度。

title: Forecasting Intraday USD/CAD Exchange Rate with News-Derived Monetary-Policy Signals
summary: Monetary-policy announcements and central-bank communications play a central role in foreign exchange markets, yet their qualitative, unstructured form makes their forecasting value difficult to quantify. While prior research has largely focused on sentiment extracted from financial news, comparatively little is known about the relative contribution of different dimensions of monetary-policy communication. Existing studies primarily evaluate whether textual information improves overall forecasting performance but provide limited insight into which communication channels drive such improvements. To address this gap, this paper introduces a statistical attribution methodology that decomposes monetary-policy communication into interpretable channels and quantifies their incremental forecasting contribution under false-discovery-rate control. Monetary-policy news is transformed into structured communication signals using large language models (LLMs) and temporal feature engineering. These signals are evaluated using rolling-window experiments with tree-based machine-learning models. The results show that monetary-policy communication contains measurable predictive information. Attribution analysis shows that predictive value is concentrated in a small subset of signals, with communication timing providing the strongest individual feature-level contribution, targeted communication-activity measures also contributing positively, and LLM-derived sentiment providing complementary information at the group level. The findings indicate that communication-based forecasting value extends beyond sentiment alone and that attribution, rather than aggregate accuracy alone, is central to evaluating news-derived signals.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种统计归因方法，将货币政策沟通分解为可解释渠道，并在错误发现率控制下量化各渠道对汇率预测的增量贡献；使用LLM和时序特征工程构建结构化沟通信号，结合树模型滚动窗口实验进行评估。
AI.motivation: 货币政策公告和央行沟通对外汇市场至关重要，但其定性、非结构化特征使其预测价值难以量化。已有研究多关注金融新闻情感，对不同货币政策沟通维度的相对贡献了解有限，且主要评估文本信息是否提升整体预测表现，较少揭示哪些沟通渠道驱动改进。
AI.method: 将货币政策新闻通过大语言模型（LLM）和时序特征工程转化为结构化沟通信号；采用滚动窗口实验和基于树的机器学习模型进行预测评估；提出统计归因方法，将沟通分解为可解释渠道，并在错误发现率控制下量化各渠道的增量预测贡献。
AI.result: 结果显示货币政策沟通包含可测量的预测信息；归因分析表明预测价值集中在少数信号上，其中沟通时机在个体特征层面贡献最强，针对性的沟通活动指标也有正向贡献，而LLM提取的情感在组层面提供互补信息。
AI.conclusion: 基于沟通的预测价值不仅限于情感，归因而非仅看总体准确率，是评估新闻衍生信号的关键。

title: ARS: Agentic Reward System for Robot Learning
summary: Progress reward modeling is the problem of estimating how a robot's behavior changes task progress over time. Reliable estimation requires distinguishing meaningful state changes from failed attempts and task-irrelevant actions. We introduce the Agentic Reward System (ARS), an inference framework for progress reward modeling with general-purpose vision-language models (VLMs), without additional reward-model training. Given an offline trajectory and a task instruction, ARS uses adaptive visual inspection for both event proposal and verification. A subagent proposes a task-relevant event timeline, which a primary agent verifies and revises before estimating per-frame progress. ARS can incorporate optional terminal outcome labels and visual references to inform its judgments. It can also audit progress estimates from external reward models. We evaluate ARS with a 27B VLM on a controlled semantic-mismatch benchmark and downstream policy learning in simulation and on a real robot. The benchmark reveals that several evaluated reward baselines assign spurious progress to wrong-object manipulation even in simple pick-and-place scenes. ARS better suppresses these errors and outperforms these baselines in simulation policy learning. We further demonstrate that ARS supports long-horizon policy learning from mixed-quality offline experience on real-robot multi-screw fastening in a full-scale laboratory replica of an industrial washing-machine assembly line. These results suggest that structured inference and verification can improve the usefulness of general-purpose VLMs for robot reward modeling. Code is at https://github.com/midea-ai/ars

AI.tldr: 提出 Agentic Reward System (ARS)，一种无需额外训练奖励模型、基于通用 VLM 的进度奖励建模推理框架，通过自适应视觉检查估计机器人任务进度，并在基准、仿真和真实机器人任务中验证。
AI.motivation: 可靠估计任务进度需要区分有意义的状态变化、失败尝试和任务无关动作；现有奖励基线可能在简单拾放场景中把错误物体操作误判为有效进度。
AI.method: 给定离线轨迹和任务指令，ARS 使用子代理提出任务相关事件时间线，主代理验证并修订后估计逐帧进度；支持可选终端结果标签和视觉参考，也可审计外部奖励模型的进度估计；使用 27B VLM 进行结构化推理与验证。
AI.result: 在受控语义错配基准上，ARS 更好抑制错误物体操作带来的虚假进度，并优于多个奖励基线；在仿真策略学习中表现更优；在真实机器人多螺钉紧固任务及混合质量离线经验的长时程策略学习中展示有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结构化推理与验证能够提升通用 VLM 在机器人奖励建模中的实用性。

title: Trajectory-Safe Orienteering for Human-Robot Shared Environments
summary: Orienteering problem (OP) has wide real-world applications and also great potential in human-robot collaboration. However, existing approaches struggle to simultaneously ensure safe and feasible trajectories while achieving high-quality task execution in shared workspaces. To this end, this work studies the OP with time windows and variable profits (OPTWVP). A two-stage DEcoupled discrete-Continuous Optimization with Service-time-guided Trajectory (DeCoST) approach is proposed to effectively solve OPTWVP in shared spaces. Meanwhile, the safety-aware time windows of nodes and the discretized workspace are introduced to ensure collision-free trajectories between the end effector and the human. Preliminary results validate the effectiveness of DeCoST in generating collision-free trajectory plans while preserving the quality of orienteering tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究带时间窗和可变收益的定向问题（OPTWVP），提出一种两阶段解耦离散-连续优化方法 DeCoST，用于共享空间中安全且高质量的任务规划。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在共享工作空间中难以同时保证轨迹安全可行并实现高质量任务执行，因此需要研究面向人机协作的定向问题。
AI.method: 提出两阶段 DeCoST 方法（DEcoupled discrete-Continuous Optimization with Service-time-guided Trajectory），并引入安全感知的节点时间窗和离散化工作空间，以避免末端执行器与人类发生碰撞。
AI.result: 初步结果验证了 DeCoST 在生成无碰撞轨迹规划的同时，能够保持定向任务执行质量的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DeCoST 可有效求解共享空间中的 OPTWVP，在安全性与任务质量之间取得平衡。

title: ProDyGS: Dynamic Gaussian Splatting from a Single Static Monocular Camera
summary: We present ProDyGS, a novel dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting framework for high-quality novel view synthesis from videos captured by a single static camera. While existing methods rely on multi-view setups or significant camera motion for geometric constraints, our approach addresses the challenging scenario where multi-view supervision is completely absent. We overcome this limitation by generating synthetic multi-view supervision through depth-guided proxy image synthesis. Specifically, we estimate temporally consistent depth maps using foundational monocular depth networks, then construct 3D Gaussian representations that generate proxy images from arbitrary viewpoints. A deformation network learns temporal dynamics by warping canonical Gaussians using this augmented supervision. Experiments on the DyNeRF dataset demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art performance while requiring only monocular depth estimation as external supervision, outperforming approaches that rely on stronger priors such as scene flow.

AI.tldr: 提出ProDyGS，一种面向单静态相机视频的动态3D高斯泼溅框架，通过深度引导的代理图像合成生成合成多视角监督，实现高质量新视角合成。
AI.motivation: 现有动态场景新视角合成方法通常依赖多视角设置或显著相机运动来提供几何约束，而单静态相机视频中完全缺少多视角监督，导致该场景下重建和合成困难。
AI.method: 使用基础单目深度网络估计时间一致的深度图；构建3D高斯表示并从任意视角生成代理图像，以合成多视角监督；通过变形网络基于该增强监督对规范高斯进行形变，从而学习时序动态。
AI.result: 在DyNeRF数据集上达到最新最优性能，仅需单目深度估计作为外部监督，并优于依赖场景流等更强先验的方法。
AI.conclusion: 深度引导的代理图像合成能够有效弥补单静态相机视频中多视角监督的缺失，使动态3D高斯泼溅在无需多视角采集或强先验条件下仍可实现高质量新视角合成。

title: NSV-Shift: A Contrastive Benchmark for Non-Speech Vocalization Understanding and Response Adaptation in Speech-to-Speech Models
summary: We introduce NSV-Shift, a contrastive benchmark for evaluating whether speech-to-speech models can understand non-speech vocalizations (NSVs) and adapt their responses accordingly. Each pair contains two conversations with identical lexical content that differ only in the NSV embedded in the final turn. Our pilot contains 22 human-verified pairs (44 audio conditions) and evaluates five models on NSV perception, emotion understanding, and response adaptation. Results show that models generally perform better at detecting NSVs than at interpreting their fine-grained emotional meaning or producing appropriately differentiated responses. The data construction pipeline, dataset, and evaluation pipeline are publicly available at https://github.com/ChenzwNina/nsv-construction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 NSV-Shift，一个用于评估语音到语音模型能否理解非语音发声（NSV）并据此调整回复的对比基准。
AI.motivation: 现有语音到语音模型对非语音发声的语义与情感理解能力尚不明确，尤其缺乏能检验其是否根据 NSV 调整回复的评测方法。
AI.method: 构建对比式基准：每对对话词汇内容完全相同，仅最后一轮嵌入的 NSV 不同；试点包含 22 对人工校验样本（44 个音频条件），并在 NSV 感知、情绪理解和回复适应三个维度上评测五个模型。
AI.result: 模型普遍更擅长检测 NSV，而在理解其细粒度情绪含义以及生成有区分度的适应性回复方面表现较差。
AI.conclusion: 当前语音到语音模型在 NSV 细粒度情绪理解和回复适应上仍存在明显不足；论文公开了数据构建流程、数据集和评测流程。

title: Agentic Network Traffic Monitoring
comment: 5 pages, 3 figures, to appear in IEEE URTC 2026
summary: As the use of agentic artificial intelligence increases in nearly every industry, there exists a widening attack surface. It is necessary to monitor agents to ensure that agents are acting in a way that is aligned with the users intent. Auditing an agent's network traffic provides a clear record of the agent interactions. This work presents a novel approach to monitoring the network traffic of agentic systems using complex valued hypersparse traffic matrices by integrating DBOS (DataBase OS), the OneSparse PostgreSQL database, and the GraphBLAS math library. To develop these concepts an agentic simulator was constructed, allowing a varying numbers of AI agents to collectively survey a virtual environment using different strategies. The resulting network traffic matrices enable easy monitoring of the AI agents.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用复值超稀疏流量矩阵监测智能体系统网络流量的方法，并集成DBOS、OneSparse PostgreSQL和GraphBLAS实现；同时构建智能体模拟器验证该方法可便于监控AI智能体。
AI.motivation: 随着智能体AI在各行业广泛应用，攻击面不断扩大，需要监控智能体行为是否与用户意图一致；审计智能体网络流量可提供清晰的交互记录。
AI.method: 使用复值超稀疏流量矩阵监测智能体系统网络流量，集成DBOS、OneSparse PostgreSQL数据库和GraphBLAS数学库；构建智能体模拟器，让不同数量的AI智能体采用不同策略协作勘察虚拟环境。
AI.result: 生成了网络流量矩阵，并表明这些矩阵能够方便地监测AI智能体。
AI.conclusion: 将DBOS、OneSparse PostgreSQL与GraphBLAS结合，利用复值超稀疏流量矩阵监测智能体网络流量是一种可行且便于审计的方法。

title: Region-Local Copula Evidence Fusion for Heterogeneous Remote Sensing Change Detection
summary: Superpixel copula models provide stable regional evidence for heterogeneous remote sensing change detection, but a single label per region limits localization within mixed superpixels. This letter develops a region-local copula evidence fusion method that retains the regional decision structure while introducing spatially varying local dependence anomalies. Independently fitted local models characterize departures from unchanged cross-image relationships. Reference ranking and an upper-tail gate transform these anomalies for fusion with continuous regional confidence. We derive the resulting regiondependent local decision threshold and identify a condition under which gating is equivalent to reparameterizing ungated fusion. On Lake and UK, whole-image optimized configurations achieve kappa coefficients of 0.78136 and 0.90817 and improve mixedregion and boundary decisions. Four-fold retrospective spatial validation over ten training subsets confirms complementary local information, with ungated reference fusion increasing mean kappa by 0.00693 and 0.01793. Fixed gating yields a larger UK gain of 0.03353 but only 0.00041 on Lake. These results support regional-local dependence interaction, while showing that calibration and gating have scene-dependent benefits.

AI.tldr: 该文提出一种区域-局部Copula证据融合方法，用于遥感变化检测，在保留超像素区域决策结构的同时引入空间变化的局部依赖异常，以改善混合超像素内部的变化定位。
AI.motivation: 超像素Copula模型能提供稳定的区域证据，但每个区域仅有一个标签，限制了混合超像素内部的变化定位能力。
AI.method: 独立拟合局部模型以刻画未变化跨图像关系的偏离；通过参考排序和上尾门控将局部异常转换为可与连续区域置信度融合的证据；推导区域相关的局部决策阈值，并分析门控等价于对无门控融合重新参数化的条件。
AI.result: 在Lake和UK数据集上，整图优化配置的kappa系数分别为0.78136和0.90817，并改善了混合区域和边界决策。基于十个训练子集的四折回顾性空间验证表明局部信息具有互补性，无门控参考融合使平均kappa分别提高0.00693和0.01793；固定门控在UK上提升0.03353，但在Lake上仅提升0.00041。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持区域-局部依赖交互作用，同时表明校准与门控的收益具有场景依赖性。

title: Faster Block-Diffusion Serving with Distribution-Free Risk Guarantees
summary: Block-diffusion language models are served at hand-picked operating points, such as acceptance thresholds, buffer depth, schedule, checkpoint and precision, and each point is chosen by its mean benchmark accuracy. However, a mean does not tell an operator how often a faster configuration fails on prompts that the slower one answers correctly. On the serving engine and its decode traces, the default commit rule already commits every fully resolved block, a static skip rule captures nearly all of the compute that allocation can save, and self-distillation on engine-decoded targets adds speed at unchanged accuracy. Larger speedups come from lower thresholds, which commit tokens that are still uncertain. We therefore present Redline, a finite-sample procedure that selects operating points, hand-picked or learned, from the correctness of their answers on calibration prompts. Redline keeps the reference-relative risk, the joint probability that the reference answers correctly and a candidate configuration does not, within a user-chosen budget with high probability, and deploys the fastest configuration that passes. It speeds up math at a smaller risk budget than code in both model families, and at a budget of ten percent it deploys a LLaDA2 math configuration that commits over a third more tokens in each forward. It also applies without modification to the acceptance rule of speculative decoding and to weight quantization. On the same calibration data, Redline stays within its stated failure probability, whereas each tolerance of a mean-accuracy rule either gains less speed for some model and task or exceeds the risk budget far more often for another. Code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/Redline.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Redline，一种基于校准提示正确性的有限样本选择流程，用于在块扩散语言模型服务中安全地选择最快且风险受控的运行点。
AI.motivation: 现有方法仅用平均基准准确率选择运行点，无法说明更快的配置在参考模型能正确回答的提示上失败频率有多高，因此需要控制参考相对风险。
AI.method: Redline 利用校准提示，将参考相对风险（参考正确而候选错误的联合概率）以高概率限制在用户设定的预算内，并部署通过检验的最快配置；方法也适用于投机解码接受规则和权重量化。
AI.result: Redline 在数学任务上比代码任务使用更小风险预算即可提速；在 10% 预算下部署 LLaDA2 数学配置，使每次前向多提交超过三分之一的 token；相比平均准确率规则，Redline 更稳定地满足失败概率约束。
AI.conclusion: Redline 为块扩散语言模型服务提供了一种风险可控的运行点选择方法，能在给定失败概率下获得更大加速，并可直接扩展到投机解码和量化等场景。

title: Learning response-aware patient dynamics for respiratory support
summary: Respiratory support can shape the short-term physiological trajectory of critically ill patients, but patients receiving the same intervention may follow different physiological trajectories. Clinical patient dynamics models typically predict future states from recent physiology and recorded interventions, while physiological change is mainly represented through the predicted future state. We propose a response-aware patient dynamics model that explicitly represents physiological change during autoregressive state updating. The model decomposes predicted physiological change into state-dependent baseline dynamics and respiratory-support-associated deviations, with room air providing a reference for the decomposition. We provide a formal analysis of this reference-anchored formulation. A response pathway encodes the predicted physiological change and uses it to update the latent patient state across the forecast horizon. Across ICU cohorts from two independent institutions, the proposed model achieves comparable overall trajectory prediction to patient dynamics baselines, with more consistent improvements when physiological states are changing.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种响应感知的患者动态模型，在自回归状态更新中显式建模生理变化，将预测的生理变化分解为状态依赖的基线动态与呼吸支持相关偏差，并以室内空气作为参考。在两个独立机构的ICU队列上，该模型整体轨迹预测与基线相当，但在生理状态变化时改善更一致。
AI.motivation: 呼吸支持会影响危重患者的短期生理轨迹，但同一干预下患者可能呈现不同生理轨迹。现有临床患者动态模型通常从近期生理指标和记录干预预测未来状态，而生理变化主要隐含在预测的未来状态中，未显式建模。
AI.method: 提出响应感知患者动态模型。模型在自回归状态更新中显式表示生理变化，将预测的生理变化分解为状态依赖的基线动态和呼吸支持相关偏差，并以室内空气作为分解参考。对参考锚定公式进行形式化分析。通过响应通路编码预测的生理变化，并在整个预测时域内更新潜在患者状态。
AI.result: 在两个独立机构的ICU队列上，所提模型在整体轨迹预测上与患者动态基线模型相当；当生理状态发生变化时，该模型表现出更一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模呼吸支持相关的生理变化并以室内空气为参考，有助于提升患者动态预测在生理状态变化场景下的表现，同时保持与现有基线相当的整体预测性能。

title: Robot-Assisted Deployment and Maintenance of Inflatable Modules for Lunar Habitation: A Field Demonstration
comment: Author's version of a manuscript accepted at the International Conference on Space Robotics 2026 (iSpaRo 2026). (c) IEEE
summary: Long-term human habitation and in-situ development on the Moon open a new era of space utilization. In this context, robots are a key technology for facilitating the construction of future human outposts. Toward the deployment and establishment of human habitation modules on the lunar surface, we propose a combined system consisting of inflatable modules and a modular, reconfigurable robotic system. This paper presents a report demonstrating various robot-assisted task executions using real hardware, namely the modular and reconfigurable robot MoonBot and the inflatable module HIDAS, to enhance the reliability of their deployment and maintenance. The demonstrated tasks include robotic inspection during inflation, module position alignment, final safety locking, and three-dimensional mapping for post-deployment maintenance. All demonstrations were conducted either in a laboratory environment or at a lunar analogue test site. Finally, lessons learned are discussed to provide essential insights for this robotic application to future lunar habitation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将充气式居住舱与模块化可重构机器人系统结合，用于月球表面人类栖息地的部署与维护，并通过真实硬件演示了多项机器人辅助任务。
AI.motivation: 长期月球居住和原位开发需要建设人类前哨，而机器人是支持未来月球栖息地建造与维护的关键技术。
AI.method: 提出由充气模块和模块化可重构机器人MoonBot组成的联合系统，并与充气模块HIDAS配合，在实验室或月球模拟试验场中开展真实硬件任务演示。
AI.result: 成功演示了充气过程中的机器人检查、模块位置对准、最终安全锁定以及部署后维护所需的三维建图等任务。
AI.conclusion: 研究验证了模块化可重构机器人与充气模块协同部署和维护的可行性，并总结了相关经验教训，为未来月球居住中的机器人应用提供了重要参考。

title: SlopBench: How Well Can We Rank Language Models by Slop? A Multi-Domain Benchmark of Repetitive AI Writing
summary: SlopBench asks which models produce the stiff, repetitive prose readers call AI slop, a question detectors leave open once they have classified a text as machine-written. We evaluated eighteen models on 112 hand-written tasks in email, social posts, essays, and workplace chat, sampling each model on each task up to ten times, for 19,928 outputs in all. SlopBench scores four surface behaviors a reader can check by hand: length against the word band each task specifies, opener repetition across a model's own samples of one task, and paragraph rhythm and fixed lexical constructions against pre-ChatGPT human corpora. Under one fixed weighting, Kimi K2.6 scores lowest at 21.1 and Mistral Large highest at 40.6. Across 500 random reweightings Kimi has the lowest score in 58 percent of draws and Mistral the highest in 97 percent. No draw preserves the full order of the eighteen, and a scenario bootstrap leaves exactly one of those ranks unambiguous. We ran three further checks on that middle order: a crowd arena, an AI detector, and lexical diversity. None of them confirmed the order. We therefore report the four behaviors separately and treat the composite as one weighting among many, and we release the prompts, outputs, reference statistics, and scoring code.

AI.tldr: 提出SlopBench基准，用四个可人工核查的表面行为评估18个模型在112个任务上的“AI废话”（AI slop）程度，发现模型综合排名高度依赖权重，无法确定唯一顺序。
AI.motivation: 现有检测器只能判断文本是否为机器生成，却无法回答哪些模型会产生读者称为“AI slop”的僵硬、重复文风。
AI.method: 让18个模型在112个人工编写任务（邮件、社交帖子、论文、职场聊天）上各采样最多10次，共19,928条输出；评分四个表面行为：长度是否符合任务字数区间、同一任务多次采样中的开场白重复度、段落节奏、固定词汇结构（均对照ChatGPT前人语料）。除固定权重外，还进行500次随机重加权和场景自助法；另用众包竞技场、AI检测器和词汇多样性做三项验证。
AI.result: 固定权重下Kimi K2.6得分最低（21.1），Mistral Large最高（40.6）；500次随机重加权中Kimi在58%的抽样里最低，Mistral在97%里最高；没有一次抽样保持18个模型的完整顺序，自助法仅有一个排名明确；三项验证均未确认中间顺序。
AI.conclusion: 因此分别报告四个行为，将综合分视为众多权重之一，并公开提示词、输出、参考统计和评分代码。

title: CLAIRE: A Schema-Grounded Hybrid Workflow for Healthcare Administrative Form Completion
summary: Healthcare administrative staff transfer structured information from electronic health records, referrals, claims systems, provider rosters, and work queues into dynamic forms. We developed and evaluated CLAIRE (Clinical Language and Agentic Intelligence for Reasoning and Entry), a hybrid workflow that separates field-state discovery, source-to-field mapping, deterministic validation, bounded correction, escalation, and audit tracing. We tested five synthetic healthcare administrative schemas, 1,000 source records, four interface variants, two data-quality suites, and six comparators, yielding 24,000 benchmark episodes. A separate strict-output audit evaluated direct mappings from Qwen2.5-1.5B and Qwen2.5-7B, and a trace-derived operational simulation covered 6,000 episodes. Under the evaluated synthetic benchmark conditions, full CLAIRE achieved 1.000 episode success, field accuracy, required-field completion, and dependency completion in both suites; removing validation reduced stress-suite success to 0.500. In the simulation, 100.0% of clean and validation-stress episodes reached a staff-reviewable draft, compared with 68.6% of escalation challenge episodes, unsupported cases were blocked. Scenario-based savings were 149.7-165.5 seconds per case, not observed staff times. The findings support schema-grounded, validation-first healthcare administrative automation in which language-model components assist mapping but do not authorize unsupported or consequential actions.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出并评估了CLAIRE，一种用于医疗行政数据录入的混合工作流，通过分离字段状态发现、源到字段映射、确定性验证、有限纠正、升级和审计追踪，在合成基准中实现高成功率，并强调语言模型仅辅助映射、不授权无支持或高后果操作。
AI.motivation: 医疗行政人员需要将电子健康记录、转诊、理赔系统、提供者名册和工作队列中的结构化信息转入动态表单，这一流程需要自动化，同时必须保证验证优先、可审计且安全可控。
AI.method: 开发并评估CLAIRE混合工作流，分离字段状态发现、源到字段映射、确定性验证、有界纠正、升级和审计追踪。测试使用5个合成医疗行政模式、1000条源记录、4种界面变体、2套数据质量套件和6个比较器，共24000个基准回合；另进行Qwen2.5-1.5B和Qwen2.5-7B直接映射的严格输出审计，以及覆盖6000回合的轨迹派生操作模拟。
AI.result: 在合成基准条件下，完整CLAIRE在两套套件中均达到1.000的回合成功率、字段准确率、必填字段完成率和依赖完成率；移除验证后，压力套件成功率降至0.500。模拟中，100.0%的清洁和验证压力回合达到可供员工审核的草稿，而升级挑战回合为68.6%，不支持案例被阻止。基于场景的节省为每例149.7-165.5秒，但非实际观察到的员工时间。
AI.conclusion: 研究支持基于模式、验证优先的医疗行政自动化，其中语言模型组件辅助映射，但不应授权无支持或高后果的操作。

title: Gradient-Guided Decoupled Adaptation for Geospatial Vision-Language Models
summary: Existing geospatial vision-language models (Geo-VLMs) typically optimize diverse geospatial tasks through a unified multi-task adaptation paradigm without explicitly accounting for the heterogeneous optimization characteristics. Our empirical observations reveal heterogeneous gradient characteristics across tasks, including vision-language differences, intra-branch gradient relationships, and task interference, which hinder effective multi-task optimization. Motivated by these observations, we propose Gradient-Guided Decoupled Adaptation (G2DA), a gradient-aware optimization framework for multi-task Geo-VLM learning. G2DA first partitions tasks into vision- and language-centric groups through gradient-guided cross-modal decoupling. It then constructs modality-specific curricula based on task gradient similarity and employs bidirectional rehearsal to mitigate the recency effects introduced by sequential optimization. We evaluate G2DA on three Geo-VLM benchmarks using six InternVL3 and Qwen3.5-VL variants, along with GeoChat and GeoLLaVA. Across all 24 benchmark-model combinations, G2DA consistently outperforms representative baselines, improving over the strongest competitor by 3.08, 4.30, and 2.81 percentage points on UrBench-MCQ, XLRS-Bench-Lite, and VRS-Bench-VQA, respectively. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of gradient-guided task organization for Geo-VLM adaptation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出G2DA，一种梯度引导的解耦适配框架，用于多任务地理空间视觉语言模型（Geo-VLM）学习，通过任务分组、模态课程与双向回放提升多任务优化效果，并在多个基准上全面超越基线。
AI.motivation: 现有Geo-VLM通常采用统一多任务适配范式，未显式考虑任务间的异构优化特性。实证观察发现任务存在视觉-语言差异、分支内梯度关系及任务干扰等异构梯度特征，阻碍了有效的多任务优化。
AI.method: 提出梯度引导解耦适配（G2DA）：首先通过梯度引导的跨模态解耦将任务划分为视觉中心与语言中心两组；然后基于任务梯度相似性构建模态特定课程；并采用双向回放缓解顺序优化带来的近因效应。在三个Geo-VLM基准上，使用六种InternVL3与Qwen3.5-VL变体以及GeoChat和GeoLLaVA进行评估。
AI.result: 在全部24个基准-模型组合中，G2DA均持续优于代表性基线；在UrBench-MCQ、XLRS-Bench-Lite和VRS-Bench-VQA上分别比最强竞争者提升3.08、4.30和2.81个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，梯度引导的任务组织策略对Geo-VLM适配是有效的。

title: Model-Informed Safe Reinforcement Learning for Bipedal Locomotion via Step-to-Step Prediction
summary: Humanoid robots promise versatile mobility in cluttered, human-centric environments, but real deployment demands principled safety. Classical model-based gait generators yield interpretable motions but often lack the robustness and adaptability of modern reinforcement learning (RL) based approaches. We propose a model-informed reinforcement learning framework anchored to the analytical Angular Momentum Linear Inverted Pendulum (ALIP) template. We provide a step-to-step safety certificate for ALIP stepping via a discrete exponential control barrier function (DECBF) and use it as (i) a training-time shaping signal and (ii) a runtime action filter that minimally adjusts swing-foot placement to satisfy template-level constraints. Full-order safety is evaluated empirically on the Digit humanoid in MuJoCo with a whole-body controller stack. Compared to an unconstrained baseline, our approach reduces safety-violation events in the reported external-disturbance trial, while larger lateral-velocity transients reveal a safety-tracking tradeoff.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于模型信息的强化学习框架，利用ALIP模板和离散指数控制屏障函数（DECBF）为类人机器人步态提供安全保证，并在训练和运行时应用，在Digit机器人上验证了减少安全违规事件，但存在安全与跟踪的权衡。
AI.motivation: 类人机器人在复杂环境中部署需要原则性安全保障；经典基于模型的步态生成器可解释但鲁棒性和适应性不足，而现代强化学习方法鲁棒但缺乏安全性保证。
AI.method: 提出模型信息强化学习框架，以角动量线性倒立摆（ALIP）模板为基础，通过离散指数控制屏障函数（DECBF）提供步到步安全证书，并将其作为训练时的塑形信号和运行时动作过滤器，最小化调整摆动脚落点以满足模板级约束。
AI.result: 在MuJoCo中基于Digit类人机器人和全身控制器堆栈进行全阶安全评估；与无约束基线相比，在外部扰动试验中减少了安全违规事件，但较大的横向速度瞬变揭示了安全与跟踪之间的权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过结合模型信息和强化学习，在类人机器人步态中提升了安全性，但存在安全性与跟踪性能的权衡，需进一步平衡。

title: REALIS: A Curated Dataset for Studying the Challenges of AI Image Detection
summary: AI-generated image detectors are often evaluated on benchmarks where real and synthetic images differ in content, quality, or generation artifacts, allowing models to rely on dataset-specific cues and fail on unfamiliar generators or processed images. Existing datasets provide limited support for evaluating these challenges jointly across diverse visual content. We introduce REALIS, a dataset of 1.43 million real and synthetic images generated by 42 modern text-to-image models, including the latest proprietary systems such as Nano Banana 2. REALIS combines prompts derived from real images, quality filtering, and stratified sampling to reduce class-specific shortcuts while preserving content diversity. We further introduce REALIS-Expert, a stress-test subset for high-quality synthetic images, where real and generated samples are selected with closely matched semantic and visual characteristics. We also propose a robustness protocol covering 35 transformations at five severity levels to analyze detector behavior under image processing. Based on REALIS, our benchmark evaluates pretrained detectors, fine-tuned models, and zero-shot vision-language models under generator and post-processing shifts. On the hardest processed split, the best pretrained conventional detector achieves 0.550 ROC-AUC, compared with 0.752 for the best REALIS-trained detector. REALIS provides a unified framework for measuring and improving the reliability of AI-image detectors under conditions that better reflect real-world use.

AI.tldr: 提出REALIS数据集，包含143万张真实与合成图像、覆盖42个现代文本到图像模型，并引入专家压力测试子集与35种图像变换鲁棒性协议，用于评估AI生成图像检测器在生成器与后处理偏移下的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有AI生成图像检测基准中，真实与合成图像在内容、质量或生成伪影上存在差异，使模型依赖数据集特定线索，难以泛化到未见过的生成器或经过处理的图像；现有数据集难以在多样视觉内容上联合评估这些挑战。
AI.method: 构建REALIS数据集：由42个现代文本到图像模型生成143万张真实与合成图像，使用真实图像提示、质量过滤和分层采样减少类别特定捷径并保持内容多样性；提出REALIS-Expert高质量合成图像压力测试子集，使真假样本语义与视觉特征紧密匹配；设计覆盖35种变换、5个严重级别的鲁棒性协议。
AI.result: 在该基准上评估预训练检测器、微调模型和零样本视觉语言模型。在最难的处理划分上，最佳预训练传统检测器仅达0.550 ROC-AUC，而最佳REALIS训练检测器达到0.752 ROC-AUC。
AI.conclusion: REALIS为衡量和改进AI图像检测器在更接近真实使用条件下的可靠性提供了统一框架。

title: MonoEgo: Monocular Metric Egocentric Demonstration Capture with Passive Wrist Constellations and Sparse Workstation Anchors
summary: Image-aligned metric demonstrations often require dedicated tracking hardware and synchronization across devices. We present MonoEgo, a capture system that replaces active wrist instrumentation with offline monocular reconstruction. One 90-FPS global-shutter camera observes calibrated passive wrist constellations, sparse workstation anchors, and the scene on a shared image clock. MonoTag SLAM combines marker corners with ORB geometry and uses visual evidence to reject ambiguous planar-marker poses. Its metric Atlas supports interval scale re-anchoring, verified map merging, and retrospective localization of earlier frames supported by the final map. Camera and wrist-constellation outputs retain validity and map provenance, and unsupported motion is left missing. Experiments show metric tracking beyond continuous anchor visibility, reconnection of supported map components, and recovery of some missing camera poses. Comparisons against a multisensor camera reference and separate stationary-constellation tests characterize trajectory agreement and precision while revealing incomplete coverage and residual geometric uncertainty. The results indicate that passive fixtures and offline reconstruction can reduce capture-side requirements. Dynamic accuracy, deployment, and downstream policy benefits require further study.

AI.tldr: 提出 MonoEgo，一种用单台90 FPS全局快门相机离线单目重建的采集系统，通过观测被动腕部标记阵列、稀疏工作站锚点和场景，替代主动腕部跟踪硬件，实现图像对齐的度量演示采集。
AI.motivation: 图像对齐的度量演示通常需要专用跟踪硬件和跨设备同步，采集端要求高；研究希望减少对主动腕部仪器和同步设备的依赖。
AI.method: MonoTag SLAM 将标记角点与 ORB 几何结合，并利用视觉证据拒绝模糊的平面标记位姿；其度量 Atlas 支持区间尺度重锚定、经验证的地图合并以及借助最终地图对早期帧进行回溯定位。系统保留相机和腕部阵列输出的有效性及地图来源，不支持的运动则标记缺失。
AI.result: 实验表明系统可在连续锚点可见范围之外进行度量跟踪、重新连接支持的地图组件，并恢复部分缺失相机位姿。与多传感器相机参考和独立静止阵列测试相比，轨迹一致性和精度得到表征，同时揭示覆盖不完整和残余几何不确定性。
AI.conclusion: 被动固定装置和离线重建可降低采集端要求；但动态精度、部署效果及下游策略收益仍需进一步研究。

title: AnesTRACE: Benchmarking Intraoperative Anesthesia from Multimodal Perception to Multi-step Decision-Making
summary: Intraoperative anesthesia requires systems to interpret evolving multimodal evidence, recommend timely management, and revise decisions as patient states change, yet existing benchmarks usually isolate perception or single-point reasoning. We introduce AnesTRACE, an evaluation suite comprising AnesTRACE-Bench and AnesTRACE-Eval. Built from public perioperative datasets with anesthesiologist annotation, AnesTRACE-Bench evaluates Intraoperative Perception, Single-point Anesthesia Decision-Making, and Multi-step Anesthesia Decision-Making. AnesTRACE-Eval assesses open-ended responses through anesthesiologist-defined criteria for Clinical Correctness, Evidence Grounding, Task Completeness, and Safety, with Temporal Consistency for multi-step decisions; its domain-specific evaluator is trained by supervised fine-tuning and preference alignment on expert-reviewed judgments. Across more than 30 models, fine-grained visual grounding and intervention selection remain difficult: the leading model reaches only 32.2 mIoU for TEE visual grounding and retains a 17.5\% Major/Critical Safety Error Rate in multi-step management. Evaluator alignment with anesthesiologists improves across both training stages, while the best decision quality is accompanied by a 74.3-second P95 Latency. These results show that aggregate performance alone does not establish safe, timely longitudinal decision-making. We release our code at https://github.com/zjuDBxAI/AnesTRACE.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 AnesTRACE 评估套件（含 AnesTRACE-Bench 与 AnesTRACE-Eval），用于评测术中麻醉场景下多模态感知、单步与多步决策能力，并揭示当前模型在视觉定位、干预选择与安全性方面仍存在明显不足。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多局限于感知或单点推理，难以反映术中麻醉需要持续解读多模态证据、及时推荐管理方案并随患者状态变化修正决策的真实需求。
AI.method: 基于公开围术期数据集并由麻醉医生标注，构建 AnesTRACE-Bench，覆盖术中感知、单点麻醉决策和多步麻醉决策；提出 AnesTRACE-Eval，按临床正确性、证据支撑、任务完整性和安全性等专家标准评估开放式回答，并对多步决策增加时间一致性；其领域评估器通过监督微调与偏好对齐在专家评审判断上训练。
AI.result: 在30多个模型上评测发现，细粒度视觉定位和干预选择仍很困难：最佳模型 TEE 视觉定位仅达 32.2 mIoU，多步管理仍有 17.5% 的重大/危重安全错误率；评估器与麻醉医生的对齐在两阶段训练中均提升，但最佳决策质量伴随 74.3 秒的 P95 延迟。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭总体性能无法证明模型具备安全、及时且纵向一致的麻醉决策能力；AnesTRACE 强调需同时关注细粒度感知、决策安全性、时间一致性与延迟等实际临床要求。

title: Simple Diffusion Language Models Are More Effective Few-Step Generators Than Reported
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) promise fast parallel generation, yet high-quality samples often require large number of refinement steps, which diminishes their advantage in practice. This has led to massive interest in and rapid development of new methods for effective few-step generation. We show that much of the supposed quality gap at few steps can instead arise from a suboptimally configured sampler. Modest sampler sharpening, without any model retraining, enables a couple years old masked DLM to rival supposedly far improved successors. This differently sampled DLM in fact achieves lower generative perplexity in just 16 steps than what its standard sampler obtains with 1024, while improving both judged quality and semantic diversity. We further show that conventional per-output metrics can fundamentally obscure these gains, since any optimal trade-off between two such metrics can be attained by a generator supported on at most two outputs. We subsequently introduce GroupEval, which separately evaluates quality and across-output semantic diversity, and offers fresh insights including uncovering how 1.5-4.7x perplexity gains of a distilled model yield no corresponding quality gain. Finally, we explain why sharpening helps: parallel unmasking destroys dependencies among simultaneously generated tokens, creating a gap between prediction and generation. We prove that pervasive temperature choice of one is generically suboptimal under parallel sampling even for an exact denoiser, and that worse predictions can yield better samples. Through these results, we argue for a broader evaluation principle of treating the deployed generator as the object of comparison, benchmarking it against tuned baselines, and assessing quality and diversity jointly and with more human-aligned measures.

AI.tldr: 该论文指出扩散语言模型在少步生成中的质量差距很大程度源于采样器配置不佳，而非模型本身。通过简单的采样器锐化，无需重训练即可让旧模型在16步内超越标准采样器1024步的效果，并提出联合评估质量与多样性的GroupEval及理论解释。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型虽支持快速并行生成，但高质量样本常需大量细化步骤，削弱了实际优势；同时，传统逐输出指标可能掩盖生成质量与多样性的真实变化，导致对少步生成方法进展的误判。
AI.method: 采用无需模型重训练的采样器锐化/调优方法；提出GroupEval，分别评估生成质量与跨输出语义多样性；并从理论上分析并行去掩码对token依赖的破坏，证明温度设为1在并行采样下通常次优，且更差的预测有时可产生更好的样本。
AI.result: 一个几年前的掩码扩散语言模型经采样器锐化后，仅16步即达到比其标准采样器1024步更低的生成困惑度，并提升判断质量与语义多样性；GroupEval揭示蒸馏模型获得1.5–4.7倍困惑度增益却无相应质量提升。
AI.conclusion: 应把部署的生成器作为比较对象，与调优后的基线进行基准测试，并联合评估质量与多样性，采用更贴近人类的度量；采样器配置和评估方式对少步扩散语言模型结论至关重要。

title: AgentHabit: Characterizing Distinct Behaviors of Agents on Everyday Tasks
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents assist users with everyday tasks that can be completed in many reasonable ways. Even when their answers are useful, how agents carry out these tasks may not match users' preferences and needs. For example, agents differ in whether they ask clarifying questions or search the web. We introduce HABIT, a taxonomy of 23 behavioral axes in five categories, which three authors and three LLMs derive bottom-up from 408 agent trajectories across 17 domains. On held-out tasks, HABIT distinguishes models more clearly than existing taxonomies of human values and agent actions while supporting comparably consistent annotation. Building on HABIT, we construct AgentHABIT, a benchmark that profiles each agent's behavioral tendencies from its trajectories on 86 everyday tasks. Profiling 18 models with AgentHABIT reveals a range of distinctive tendencies. For example, most GPT and Claude models state their assumptions and offer alternatives when requirements conflict, whereas Qwen and Google's models more often leave assumptions or changes to requirements unstated. These profiles remain recognizable even when built from entirely different sets of tasks, indicating that they reflect general tendencies rather than task-specific behavior. Prompting agents to adopt specific behaviors shifts some axes readily but barely changes others, while fine-tuning on another model's trajectories changes only part of a model's profile and leaves much of it intact. Overall, HABIT and AgentHABIT provide a systematic framework for characterizing how agents carry out everyday tasks beyond task success, offering insights to guide the development of agents whose behavior better fits users' needs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 HABIT 行为分类体系和 AgentHABIT 基准，用于刻画 LLM 智能体在日常任务中的行为倾向，而不仅关注任务是否成功。
AI.motivation: LLM 智能体完成日常任务的方式多样，即使答案有用，其行为也可能不符合用户偏好和需求；现有研究多关注任务成功，缺少系统刻画智能体行为方式的框架。
AI.method: 通过 3 位作者和 3 个 LLM 从 17 个领域、408 条智能体轨迹中自下而上归纳出包含 23 个行为轴、5 个类别的 HABIT 分类体系；基于 HABIT 构建 AgentHABIT 基准，用 86 个日常任务轨迹分析 18 个模型的行为倾向，并测试不同任务集、提示和微调对行为画像的影响。
AI.result: HABIT 比现有人类价值或智能体动作分类法更能区分模型，且标注一致性相当；AgentHABIT 揭示不同模型有独特行为倾向，例如 GPT 和 Claude 多在需求冲突时说明假设并提供替代方案，而 Qwen 和 Google 模型更常不说明假设或需求变更；行为画像在不同任务集上仍可识别，提示能轻易改变部分行为轴，微调另一模型轨迹只改变部分画像。
AI.conclusion: HABIT 和 AgentHABIT 提供了超越任务成功的系统框架，用于刻画智能体执行日常任务的方式，并为开发更符合用户需求的行为提供指导。

title: $T^5$: Twin-Critic Training for Token-Level Thoughts in Reinforcement Mid-Training
summary: Reinforcement mid-training lets language models learn internal thoughts from unlabeled text, but efficient token-level credit assignment remains challenging. Existing group-relative methods require costly repeated generation. Learned critics offer single-rollout feedback, but accurate return prediction alone does not ensure reliable policy updates. Our analysis shows how training--inference mismatch and PPO clipping prevent a common offset in advantage estimates from cancelling out, introducing additional update drift. We propose \tfour{}, a twin-critic method that calibrates token-level advantages from a single generated trajectory. After warmup and held-out qualification, the critics provide two advantage estimates, combined using action-dependent weights learned through a conditional-moment saddle-point objective. This objective brings the average advantage at each prefix toward zero, while a signal-retention constraint prevents the correction from erasing the learning signal. Sharing information across text positions avoids repeated sampling of each prefix. Theoretically, we characterize optimal mixing under the signal-retention constraint and establish an upper bound on residual mean-induced drift. Experiments show that, compared with the state-of-the-art critic-free method, \tfour{} improves mean benchmark performance by 7.8\% and reduces mean training-step time by up to 63.4\%.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种双评论家强化中训练方法，用于在无标签文本中让语言模型学习内部思考，并通过单条生成轨迹实现高效、稳定的 token 级优势分配。
AI.motivation: 现有 group-relative 方法需要重复生成，成本高；已有 learned critic 虽可单次 rollout 反馈，但仅准确预测回报不足以保证策略更新可靠。训练-推理不匹配与 PPO 裁剪会使优势估计中的共同偏移无法抵消，导致额外更新漂移。
AI.method: 提出双评论家方法：预热并通过留出数据资格筛选后，两个评论家给出两个优势估计；利用基于条件矩鞍点目标学习动作相关权重进行融合，使每个前缀的平均优势趋近于零；同时加入信号保留约束，防止修正抹除学习信号。通过跨文本位置共享信息，避免重复采样每个前缀。
AI.result: 理论上刻画了信号保留约束下的最优混合，并给出残差均值导致漂移的上界。实验表明，与最先进的无评论家方法相比，平均基准性能提升 7.8%，平均训练步耗时最多降低 63.4%。
AI.conclusion: 双评论家单轨迹校准可在保持学习信号的同时减少优势估计漂移，提高强化中训练的性能与效率。

title: On the Token Value Inequality in Efficient Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-Thought reasoning has enabled large language models to achieve substantial performance gains on complex tasks. However, these gains come at the cost of dramatically increased token consumption. This raises a fundamental question: is every token in the reasoning trace equally valuable? We present a diagnostic and optimization framework grounded in a key empirical finding: the value of tokens within a CoT reasoning sequence is highly non-uniform, and this non-uniformity can be effectively characterized by token-level log probability signals. We show that normalized log probability helps distinguish core tokens, which carry structural and decisive reasoning content, from redundant tokens, which are exploratory, low-confidence filler that contributes less directly to the final answer. Building on these findings, we formulate the TokenProbe framework around two empirical findings and one claim: findings identify token value inequality first and then establish TokenProbe as a core-token proxy, and the claim introduces an efficient GRPO objective positing that selectively compressing redundant tokens can yield Pareto improvements in the accuracy-token efficiency space. Empirically, our method preserves reasoning quality while reducing the token usage by 76% of the baseline. Under matched reasoning-length budgets, we show that it can even outperform strong flagship baselines like Gemini-3.1-Pro. Homepage: https://runjia.tech/tokenprobe/.

AI.tldr: 论文发现CoT推理序列中token价值高度不均匀，且可用归一化对数概率有效刻画，据此提出TokenProbe框架，通过选择性压缩冗余token，在保持推理质量的同时将token消耗降低76%，并在匹配长度预算下超越Gemini-3.1-Pro等强基线。
AI.motivation: 思维链（CoT）推理虽显著提升了大型语言模型在复杂任务上的表现，但代价是token消耗急剧增加。这引出一个根本问题：推理轨迹中的每个token是否同等重要？
AI.method: 提出一个基于诊断与优化的框架，核心实证发现是token价值高度不均匀，且这种不均匀性可由token级对数概率信号有效表征。利用归一化对数概率区分承载结构与决定性推理内容的核心token，以及探索性、低置信度的冗余token。在此基础上构建TokenProbe框架：两个实证发现先识别token价值不平等，再将TokenProbe确立为核心token代理；并提出一个高效GRPO目标，主张选择性压缩冗余token。
AI.result: 该方法在保持推理质量的同时，将token使用量较基线减少76%；在匹配推理长度预算下，甚至能超越Gemini-3.1-Pro等强力旗舰基线。
AI.conclusion: 选择性压缩冗余token可在准确率与token效率的权衡空间中实现帕累托改进，表明并非所有推理token都同等重要，压缩冗余部分能同时提升效率并保持甚至增强性能。

title: PlanGuard: A Guardrail for Multi-Step Plan Safety in Embodied Agents
summary: Embodied task planners may produce multi-step plans whose subtask dependencies and interactions with the environment create physical risks during execution. Yet existing safeguards overlook such compositional risks, as general-purpose guardrails focus on semantic harm and embodied safety detectors assess subtasks in isolation. To address this gap, we introduce PlanGuard, the first pre-execution detector that evaluates the physical safety of a complete multi-step plan in its current environment. For training and evaluation, we construct a Multi-Step Plan Safety (MSP-Safe) dataset through paired task construction, plan generation using diverse planners, and safety annotation by three judges. Task-oriented SFT on MSP-Safe establishes fundamental plan-safety assessment capabilities, yet a substantial gap remains between compact models suitable for real-time deployment and stronger but costlier large models. Accordingly, we propose Strong-Teacher Adaptive Compensation for On-Policy Distillation (STAC-OPD), which provides compact models with adaptive strong-teacher supervision along their on-policy trajectories. It combines token-level distribution transfer from a fine-tuned strong teacher with probability-routed sequence-level compensation, retaining student-generated targets when the student favors the reference safety decision and using teacher-reconstructed targets otherwise. Across all test subsets, PlanGuard-2B achieves average 87.15% ACC and 87.21% F1, demonstrating effective whole-plan physical-risk detection at compact model scale. Code and dataset will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 提出PlanGuard，首个在执行前评估完整多步具身任务计划物理安全性的检测器，并构建MSP-Safe数据集与STAC-OPD蒸馏方法，使2B紧凑模型达到87.15%准确率和87.21% F1。
AI.motivation: 现有安全防护存在空白：通用护栏关注语义危害，具身安全检测器仅孤立评估子任务，均忽视了多步计划中子任务依赖与环境交互带来的组合性物理风险。
AI.method: 构建MSP-Safe数据集（配对任务构造、多规划器生成计划、三位评审标注安全）；先进行任务导向SFT建立基础评估能力；提出STAC-OPD（强教师自适应补偿的在线策略蒸馏），结合token级分布迁移与概率路由的序列级补偿，在学生偏好参考安全决策时保留学生目标，否则使用教师重构目标。
AI.result: PlanGuard-2B在所有测试子集上平均达到87.15%准确率和87.21% F1，表明紧凑模型规模下可有效检测整计划物理风险。
AI.conclusion: PlanGuard作为首个执行前整计划物理安全检测器，通过MSP-Safe与STAC-OPD有效弥补组合性风险检测空白，实现紧凑模型实时部署与高性能的平衡，代码和数据集将公开。

title: From Feed-Forward to Flow: Unifying Reconstruction and Generation Is Easier Than You Think
comment: 34 pages, including supplementary material. Haoru Wang and Qianfan Shen contributed equally
summary: Reconstruct where the images provide evidence, and generate where they do not: recent success of spatial world models such as Atlas (World Labs Team, 2026) highlights the value of unifying reconstruction and generation in one model. Yet the two have long lived in separate paradigms with distinctive failure modes: feed-forward reconstruction averages ambiguity into blur, while conditional generation invents plausible but scene-inconsistent detail. In this work, we present a unified flow-based formulation for reconstruction and generation, where a shared clean-target predictor performs direct reconstruction at its single-step endpoint and unfolds conditional generation through multi-step flow. A controlled toy study reveals the mechanism: with a single step, the predictor collapses to the conditional mean just like feed-forward methods, favoring consistency over diversity. With multi-step inference, the fidelity of generated details grows with context richness: closer observations reduce ambiguity and yield better-matched details. We further instantiate the formulation in appearance and geometry 3D tasks. JiT-LVSM improves perceptual and distributional quality in novel view synthesis, while JUSt3R retains competitive single-step geometry prediction with additional multi-step inference capabilities that reduces veil and flying-pixel artifacts, producing cleaner surface structure with greater test-time compute. Together, they show that reconstruction and generation can share both a formulation and a backbone, with their behavior governed by denoising configuration---making unification surprisingly simple.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种统一的基于流的重建与生成框架，用共享的干净目标预测器，在单步端点做直接重建，在多步流中做条件生成。
AI.motivation: 重建与生成长期处于不同范式，分别存在前馈重建因歧义而模糊、条件生成会产生合理但不一致细节的问题；近期空间世界模型（如 Atlas）表明统一二者有价值。
AI.method: 提出统一的 flow-based 形式化：共享 clean-target predictor，单步推理对应重建，多步推理对应条件生成；并通过受控玩具实验分析单步与多步行为，再实例化到外观与几何 3D 任务中。
AI.result: 玩具实验显示：单步预测会像前馈方法一样坍缩到条件均值，偏向一致性而非多样性；多步生成细节的保真度随上下文丰富度提升。实例中，JiT-LVSM 提升新视角合成的感知与分布质量；JUSt3R 保持竞争性单步几何预测，并可通过多步推理减少 veil 与 flying-pixel 伪影，生成更干净表面结构。
AI.conclusion: 重建与生成可以共享同一形式化和骨干网络，其行为由去噪配置控制，说明二者的统一可以非常简单。

title: Quantization Error Is Spectrally Flat: A Single Random Probe Is a Calibrated, Data-Free Sensitivity Estimator, with Application to Budget-Targeted Mixed-Precision Quantization
summary: A single random Gaussian probe gives an unbiased estimate of the squared Frobenius norm of a layer's quantization error. The estimator is well-behaved because round-to-nearest error is spectrally flat. Across 1,683 tensors from a 35B MoE and a 9B dense model, effective dimensionality is 0.93 to 0.96 times the i.i.d. noise value of the same shape, and on the MoE the median is unchanged from 2-bit to 8-bit. The probe coefficient of variation is predictable from tensor shape. One probe measures per-tensor sensitivity to within 4 to 7%; twenty probes reach 1.3 to 1.4%.RAM applies the propagated form of this estimator to budget-targeted mixed-precision quantization with no calibration data. Gaussian probes carrying the network's own input statistics score every tensor at six bit-widths. A knapsack solver allocates bits under an exact byte budget, with guardrails against catastrophic 2-bit assignments. One probe pass serves any budget. Isolated and propagated scores rank tensors independently on Qwen3.5-35B-A3B (Spearman -0.01), yet the propagated probe rank-correlates 0.81 to 0.83 with the GPTQ layer objective from real activations, while the isolated estimator is uncorrelated with it. That objective is the wrong allocation target: at matched bytes on Qwen3.8-27B, a block-output probe beats a vendor IQ3_M mix and an oracle that allocates from the real-activation objective.On Qwen3-8B the propagated probe ties HAWQ-V2 at matched bytes. Across seven architectures from 8B to 122B, with probe timing up to a 400B model in nine minutes on one workstation, RAM reaches 3.5 to 13.6% lower median WikiText-2 perplexity than size-comparable uniform 4-bit builds on the tested MoE models

AI.tldr: 提出RAM方法：用随机高斯探针无偏估计量化误差的平方Frobenius范数，无需校准数据即可在精确字节预算下进行混合精度量化，在多个8B至122B模型上优于均匀4-bit基线。
AI.motivation: 混合精度量化需要逐张量敏感度评估，但传统方法依赖校准数据、真实激活和昂贵的GPTQ目标，难以扩展，且该目标可能并非正确分配依据。
AI.method: 利用单个随机高斯探针无偏估计层量化误差平方Frobenius范数（因RTN误差谱平坦）；采用传播形式并携带网络自身输入统计量，对每个张量在6个位宽打分；用背包求解器在精确字节预算下分配比特，并设防护机制避免灾难性2-bit分配；一次探针遍历可服务任意预算。
AI.result: 在1683个张量上有效维度为i.i.d.值的0.93-0.96倍，MoE上2-bit到8-bit中位数不变；单探针敏感度精度4-7%，20探针达1.3-1.4%。传播探针与GPTQ层目标秩相关0.81-0.83，孤立估计器则不相关。Qwen3.8-27B上匹配字节时优于厂商IQ3_M和真实激活oracle；Qwen3-8B上与HAWQ-V2持平。7种架构8B-122B，400B模型单工作站9分钟完成；MoE上比同尺寸均匀4-bit中位WikiText-2困惑度低3.5-13.6%。
AI.conclusion: 随机探针估计可作为高效、免校准的混合精度分配目标，真实激活的GPTQ目标并非最优分配基准；RAM可扩展至超大模型，且一次探针即可支持任意字节预算。

title: Gaze Prompts: Temporally Dense Human Attention for Vision-Language-Action Fine-Tuning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) fine-tuning pairs images with actions at every step, yet typically provides only a task-level language instruction, leaving moment-to-moment visual relevance implicit. We introduce \emph{eye-tracker-supervised gaze prompting}, which uses gaze recorded during VR teleoperation to provide frame-level visual guidance for VLA fine-tuning. During training, recorded gaze locations are rendered as crosshairs on the robot's head-camera images. At deployment, a lightweight predictor estimates gaze locations from recent images and the instruction, supplying the same type of visual prompt without an eye tracker or changes to the policy architecture. Instantiated with $π_0$, gaze prompting increases mean success from $26.3\%$ to $56.0\%$ across six real-world bimanual manipulation tasks, with gains also observed when a single policy is trained on all six tasks. We release \textsc{GazeMani}, a dataset of $1{,}200$ teleoperated trajectories with synchronized gaze.

AI.tldr: 提出眼动追踪监督的 gaze prompting：利用 VR 遥操作中记录的眼动，为 VLA 微调提供帧级视觉引导；部署时用轻量预测器估计 gaze，无需眼动仪或修改策略架构。基于 π0，在六个真实双臂操作任务上平均成功率从 26.3% 提升到 56.0%，并发布 GazeMani 数据集。
AI.motivation: VLA 微调通常将每步图像与动作配对，但语言指令往往只是任务级的，逐步的视觉相关性是隐含的，缺乏细粒度视觉引导。
AI.method: 使用 VR 遥操作中录制的 gaze，在训练时将 gaze 位置渲染为机器人头部相机图像上的十字准星。部署时，用一个轻量预测器根据近期图像和指令估计 gaze 位置，提供同类型视觉提示，无需眼动仪，也不改变策略架构。方法以 π0 为例实现。
AI.result: 在六个真实世界双臂操作任务中，平均成功率从 26.3% 提升到 56.0%；将单个策略在全部六个任务上训练时也观察到增益。发布 GazeMani 数据集，包含 1,200 条带同步 gaze 的遥操作轨迹。
AI.conclusion: 眼动追踪监督的 gaze prompting 能有效为 VLA 微调提供帧级视觉引导，并且在部署时无需眼动仪即可复现，从而显著提升真实双臂操作任务的成功率。

title: Do System One Decisions Add Up? A Study of Probabilistic Coherence
comment: 20 pages, 4 figures. Code and experimental results: https://github.com/samanjoy2/system-one-coherence
summary: A decision model can give probabilities that sum to one for every question yet disagree with itself when the same decision is broken into smaller steps. We study this form of probabilistic coherence in Jev and the English Laya checkpoint, using 2,500 matched examples per system across TREC, CLINC150, and MASSIVE. Across 72,000 classification questions, we compare direct fine-label predictions with broad-category probabilities and predictions reconstructed through those categories. Both systems show substantial disagreement: mean category-level total variation ranges from 0.219 to 0.349 for Jev and from 0.424 to 0.689 for Laya, on a scale where zero means exact agreement. The consequences differ sharply. On CLINC150, reconstruction reduces Jev's accuracy by 22.9 percentage points (paired 95% bootstrap interval: [-24.9, -20.9]) and improves Laya's by 21.3 points ([18.0, 24.5]). The same directions hold across all three datasets, with all six unadjusted accuracy-change intervals excluding zero. Improved accuracy can also accompany less reliable confidence: on MASSIVE, Laya gains 9.2 accuracy points while its expected calibration error rises from 0.046 to 0.124. Error analysis identifies both broad-category mistakes and within-category confusions. These findings show why decision systems need joint evaluation of accuracy, confidence calibration, and probability coherence in the workflow used by an application.

AI.tldr: 研究 Jev 和 English Laya 两个决策系统在概率一致性上的表现：概率虽可归一，但在将同一决策分解为粗类别再重建时会出现自相矛盾，且对准确率和置信校准影响不同。
AI.motivation: 决策模型可能对每个问题给出和为一的概率，却在同一决策被拆分为更小步骤时与自身不一致，因此需要理解这种概率一致性及其对应用效果的影响。
AI.method: 在 TREC、CLINC150、MASSIVE 上各使用 2,500 个匹配示例，共 72,000 个分类问题；比较直接细标签预测、粗类别概率以及经由粗类别重建的预测，并评估准确率、校准误差和错误类型。
AI.result: 两系统均存在显著不一致：类别级总变差均值 Jev 为 0.219–0.349，Laya 为 0.424–0.689。CLINC150 上重建使 Jev 准确率下降 22.9 个百分点，使 Laya 提升 21.3 个百分点；三个数据集方向一致，六个未调整准确率变化区间均不含零。MASSIVE 上 Laya 准确率提升 9.2 点，但 ECE 从 0.046 升至 0.124。错误包括粗类别错误和类内混淆。
AI.conclusion: 决策系统应在实际应用工作流中联合评估准确率、置信校准和概率一致性，而不能只看单一指标。

title: Where Memory Belongs: Ledger, an Object Ledger for Memory-Augmented VLAs
summary: Memory is essential for long-horizon, partially observed robotic manipulation: a robot must remember which object was placed in a drawer, whose cup it moved, or how many action cycles have elapsed. Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models embed memory directly inside the policy, but benchmarks show no single in-policy mechanism covers all spatio-temporal dimensions, trailing oracle methods by a wide margin. We argue that memory type dictates where memory should reside: short-term perceptual memory (repetition, timing, retracing) belongs inside the policy, while long-term object memory (persistent spatial state, containment, event history) belongs outside as an explicit, readable record. We present Ledger, a harness that realizes this split over a single fine-tuned $π_{0.5}$ policy by pairing an in-policy frame-sampling memory with an external spatio-temporal object memory, the ledger, built from a SAM3 tracker and a VLM captioner of the demonstration and read by an LLM planner that decides at step boundaries. On RoboMME, Ledger reaches the highest four-suite average among the evaluated methods, 64.3% (vs. 45.9% for the strongest prior method under identical evaluation), leading object reference (60.7% vs. 40.3%) and object permanence (86.7% vs. 56.2%) using a single set of weights. Choosing the memory source at runtime, from the instruction and the record, removes the need for a task-level router.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Ledger，一种将记忆按类型拆分的框架：短期感知记忆保留在策略内部，长期物体记忆以显式可读记录形式放在策略外部。基于单个微调的 π0.5 策略，结合帧采样记忆与由 SAM3 跟踪器和 VLM 描述的时空物体记忆，并由 LLM 规划器在步边界读取。在 RoboMME 上取得四套件最高平均 64.3%，显著超越最强基线 45.9%。
AI.motivation: 长时程、部分可观测的机器人操作需要记忆，但现有 VLA 模型将记忆内嵌于策略中，基准显示单一策略内机制无法覆盖所有时空维度，远落后于 oracle 方法。作者认为记忆类型决定记忆应存放的位置。
AI.method: 提出 Ledger 框架，在单个微调的 π0.5 策略上实现记忆内外分离：策略内为帧采样记忆（处理重复、时序、回溯等短期感知记忆），策略外为显式的时空物体记忆 ledger（持久空间状态、包含关系、事件历史），由 SAM3 跟踪器与 VLM 描述器从演示中构建，并由 LLM 规划器在步边界读取以决定使用哪类记忆。
AI.result: 在 RoboMME 上，Ledger 使用单一权重取得所评估方法中最高四套件平均 64.3%（最强先前方法为 45.9%），物体指代 60.7%（对比 40.3%），物体恒存 86.7%（对比 56.2%）。
AI.conclusion: 记忆类型决定其应位于策略内还是策略外；在运行时根据指令与记录选择记忆来源，可去除任务级路由器的需要。

title: OmniMoE-VL: A Sparse Vision-Language Model with Coupled Visual-Depth Routing
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly use sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) to scale language-side computation, yet visual information is typically routed only after passing through a fixed cross-modal interface. This leaves an important decision unresolved: which intermediate visual representations should be exposed to language computation for a given question? We introduce OmniMoE-VL, a sparse VLM with a coupled visual-depth routed projector.
