For each image-prompt pair, the projector selects a sparse set of intermediate visual depths and reuses the resulting global preference to guide both local patch fusion and dynamic visual injection into the language model. This design enables question-dependent visual access while preserving the native visual-token sequence, and complements token-level expert routing in the vision and language stacks. Across eight image-based benchmarks, OmniMoE-VL achieves an average score of 85.9 with 28B total and 9B activated parameters. Controlled comparisons show that the routed visual interface provides the dominant architectural gain, while matched route and component controls, same-image route analysis, and route interventions further support the value of coupling and question-conditioned visual access.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 OmniMoE-VL，一种带耦合视觉深度路由投影器的稀疏视觉语言模型，可根据图像-提示对选择稀疏的中间视觉深度，并用全局偏好指导局部 patch 融合和动态视觉注入，在八个图像基准上以 28B 总参数、9B 激活参数取得平均 85.9 分。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型越来越多使用稀疏混合专家（MoE）扩展语言侧计算，但视觉信息通常只在经过固定跨模态接口后才被路由，因此一个关键问题尚未解决：对于给定问题，应把哪些中间视觉表示暴露给语言计算。
AI.method: 提出 OmniMoE-VL，其核心是耦合的视觉深度路由投影器。对每个图像-提示对，投影器选择一组稀疏的中间视觉深度，并复用由此得到的全局偏好来同时指导局部 patch 融合和向语言模型进行动态视觉注入。该设计在保留原始视觉 token 序列的同时，实现依赖问题的视觉访问，并与视觉和语言栈中的 token 级专家路由互补。
AI.result: 在八个基于图像的基准上，OmniMoE-VL 以 28B 总参数、9B 激活参数达到平均 85.9 分。受控对比表明，路由式视觉接口是主要的架构增益来源；匹配路由与组件控制、同图像路由分析以及路由干预进一步支持了耦合和问题条件化视觉访问的价值。
AI.conclusion: OmniMoE-VL 表明，将视觉深度路由与语言计算耦合、并按问题条件动态暴露中间视觉表示，能有效提升稀疏视觉语言模型的性能，且路由式视觉接口是其中关键增益。

title: Beyond Solo and Consistency: Vindicating Multi-Agent Debate via Conditional Progressive Pruning
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) based Multi-Agent Debate (MAD) is one of the most effective test time scaling techniques. Through multi-round communication, agents complement each other in knowledge and reasoning and solve tasks that no single member can solve. However, existing MAD frameworks fail to beat strong Single Agent and Consistency-based baselines under the same strict cost limit, which shakes the foundation of the MAD field. We propose Conditional Progressive Pruning (CPP), a lightweight pruning framework that fully exploits multi-round MAD. CPP outperforms all existing MAD frameworks on multiple dominated benchmarks. It is also the first to fully outperform consistency methods. Our code, detailed agent interaction records will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出条件渐进剪枝（CPP），一个轻量级剪枝框架，用于充分挖掘多轮多智能体辩论（MAD）的潜力，并在多个基准上超越现有MAD框架和一致性方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于大语言模型的多智能体辩论框架在相同严格成本限制下，无法击败强单智能体和基于一致性的基线，这动摇了MAD领域的基础，因此需要更有效的方法来充分利用多轮MAD。
AI.method: 提出条件渐进剪枝（Conditional Progressive Pruning, CPP），一种轻量级剪枝框架，通过多轮通信与剪枝策略充分挖掘MAD过程。
AI.result: CPP在多个主流基准上优于所有现有MAD框架，并且首次全面超越一致性方法。
AI.conclusion: CPP能有效提升多智能体辩论在严格成本限制下的表现，代码和详细智能体交互记录将很快发布。

title: Nutri-ATLAS: Embodied Agent for Tabulated Lookup and Assistance for Smarter nutrition
summary: Generative and Agentic IoT systems offer a promising foundation for digital healthcare applications that combine sensing, personalized reasoning, and autonomous interaction in real-world environments. Nutrition assistance is a natural use case, but existing Large Language Model (LLM)-based systems are often limited to passive text interaction and static context, making them unreliable when food descriptions are ambiguous or nutritional evidence is missing. We propose Nutri-ATLAS, an Embodied Agent for Tabulated Lookup and Assistance for smarter nutrition in the real world. It integrates graph-grounded nutrition reasoning, hardware-aware LLM selection, and robot-based evidence acquisition. Nutri-ATLAS builds a unified Food-Nutrient knowledge graph from USDA FoodData Central and FoodKG and learns 64-dimensional GATv2 food and recipe embeddings. A shared hybrid graph-text scoring mechanism supports food nutrition extraction, nutritional gap filling, substitute retrieval, and recipe-level meal composition, while an LLM-guided skill interface navigates landmarks, updates dietary-context and food-accessibility memory, and grounds recommendations in observed food availability. We evaluate Nutri-ATLAS across nutrient estimation, substitution retrieval, recipe recommendation, patient-profile adherence, edge deployment, and real-world embodied execution. On HealthyFoodSubs, the hybrid retriever achieves 37.9% MAP, 80.7% RR@5, and 90.1% RR@10. On NutriBench v2, Dense+GAT retrieval grounds nutrient estimation across nine quantized Qwen3.5-9B configurations. On PFoodReQ, Nutri-ATLAS reaches 78.8% MAP, 83.0% MAR, and 77.5% F1. A patient-profile study shows adherence to allergy and healthy-target constraints for all selected cases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Nutri-ATLAS，一个面向真实世界营养辅助的具身智能体，结合图知识推理、硬件感知 LLM 选择与机器人证据获取，用于食品营养估计、替代品检索、食谱推荐和个性化饮食建议。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的营养辅助系统多局限于被动文本交互和静态上下文，当食物描述模糊或营养证据缺失时可靠性不足；数字医疗与具身 IoT 系统需要更可靠的感知、推理和自主交互能力。
AI.method: Nutri-ATLAS 构建统一 Food-Nutrient 知识图谱，融合 USDA FoodData Central 与 FoodKG，并学习 64 维 GATv2 食物和食谱嵌入。采用共享的混合图-文本评分机制，支持营养提取、营养缺口填补、替代品检索和食谱级餐食组合。系统还包含 LLM 引导技能接口，用于导航地标、更新饮食上下文与食物可及性记忆，并将推荐基于观察到的食物可用性。
AI.result: 在 HealthyFoodSubs 上，混合检索器达到 37.9% MAP、80.7% RR@5 和 90.1% RR@10；在 NutriBench v2 上，Dense+GAT 检索在九种量化 Qwen3.5-9B 配置中支撑营养估计；在 PFoodReQ 上达到 78.8% MAP、83.0% MAR 和 77.5% F1。患者画像研究显示，所有选中案例均遵守过敏和健康目标约束。
AI.conclusion: Nutri-ATLAS 表明，图基础推理、混合检索和具身证据获取能够提升真实世界营养辅助的可靠性，并在营养估计、替代检索、食谱推荐、患者约束遵从、边缘部署和具身执行方面具有有效性。

title: Aerial GRIPPER: A Gradient-based Real-time Inverse-game Predictor and Planner
summary: Accurate capture of non-cooperative targets is critical. In an attempt to tackle this intractable challenge, an aerial gripper system integrated with a Gradient-based Real-time Inverse-game Predictor and PlannER (GRIPPER) framework is proposed. The interaction is formulated as a general-sum pursuit-evasion game under incomplete information. Specifically, underlying cost parameters of the target are inferred online, and the open-loop Nash equilibrium (OLNE) strategy is iteratively refined within a receding-horizon loop. To ensure high-frequency execution, a computationally friendly gradient-based inverse-game solver is developed. Without explicit computation of the Hessian inverse, the optimized solution is updated (> 50 Hz) based on implicit differentiation and fast Hessian-vector products. Meanwhile, an anti-disturbance controller is developed to overcome disturbances of uncertain payload and gripper actuation, enabling precise tracking of the planned trajectory and accurate grasping of the target. Simulations and real-world experiments illustrate the superior computational efficiency and task performance of GRIPPER. The task of capturing and delivering a non-cooperative target is accomplished, highlighting the robustness, adaptability, and real-time performance of the framework in highly adversarial scenarios.

AI.tldr: 提出一种集成GRIPPER框架的空中抓取系统，用于捕获非合作目标。将交互建模为不完全信息下的一般和追逃博弈，在线推断目标代价参数并滚动时域迭代求解开环纳什均衡，结合抗扰动控制器实现实时规划与稳定抓取。
AI.motivation: 精确捕获非合作目标十分困难，尤其是在目标策略未知、信息不完全且对抗性强的场景中，需要兼顾实时性、适应性和鲁棒性。
AI.method: 将交互建模为不完全信息下的一般和追逃博弈；在线推断目标代价参数；在滚动时域内迭代优化开环纳什均衡策略；提出基于梯度的逆博弈求解器，利用隐式微分和快速Hessian-向量积避免显式Hessian逆，实现高于50 Hz的优化更新；并设计抗扰动控制器以应对不确定载荷和抓取器驱动扰动。
AI.result: 仿真和真实实验表明GRIPPER具有更优的计算效率和任务性能，完成了非合作目标的捕获与递送任务，在高度对抗场景中表现出鲁棒性、适应性和实时性。
AI.conclusion: GRIPPER框架能够有效解决非合作目标空中捕获问题，验证了基于梯度逆博弈预测与规划以及抗扰动控制在对抗性实时任务中的有效性和实用性。

title: Efficient World Action Model Inference with Adaptive Intermediate States
summary: World Action Models (WAMs) enable future-aware control by jointly modeling actions and environment dynamics. However, iterative diffusion or flow inference incurs substantial denoising latency. Prior inference state offers a natural opportunity for acceleration, yet changing planning contexts, observations, and intermediate representations can quickly render retained state stale. Preserving useful computation therefore requires adapting inference state rather than reusing it as-is. To this end, we present $\mathrm{WAM}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{ACHINE}}$, a training-free framework that accelerates WAM inference by preserving and adapting inference state for efficient and accurate continuation as the control loop evolves. Across closed-loop replans, Trajectory Remapping remaps replan state from the preceding replan to initialize the next replan, reducing redundant trajectory generation. Across denoising steps, Observation Rebinding performs anticipatory inference during action execution and rebinds retained denoising state to the real observation for continuation when consistency checks pass, reducing latency exposed to the control loop. Across Transformer layers, Residual Rescaling selectively rescales retained layer state and refreshes it through full computation of the middle layers when probe checks fail, reducing repeated Transformer computation. Evaluations of three representative WAM architectures on LIBERO and RoboTwin 2.0 show that $\mathrm{WAM}{\scriptstyle\mathrm{ACHINE}}$ achieves 1.47-3.05$\times$ speedups in observation-to-action latency and 2.23-3.27$\times$ speedups in GPU inference time per replan, while preserving 96.69-99.54% of native WAM task success.

AI.tldr: 提出 WAMACHINE，一个无需训练的世界动作模型推理加速框架，通过保留并适配推理状态，在闭环控制中实现高效且准确的持续推理。
AI.motivation: 世界动作模型通过联合建模动作与环境动态实现未来感知控制，但迭代扩散或流推理带来显著去噪延迟。先前推理状态可用于加速，然而规划上下文、观测和中间表示变化会使保留状态迅速过时，因此需要适配而非直接复用。
AI.method: WAMACHINE 包含三类机制：跨闭环重规划使用 Trajectory Remapping 重映射上一轮重规划状态以初始化下一轮；跨去噪步使用 Observation Rebinding，在动作执行时预推理，并在一一致性检查通过后将保留去噪状态重绑定到真实观测继续；跨 Transformer 层使用 Residual Rescaling，选择性重缩放保留层状态，并在探针检查失败时通过中间层全计算刷新。
AI.result: 在 LIBERO 和 RoboTwin 2.0 上评估三种代表性 WAM 架构，WAMACHINE 在观测到动作延迟上实现 1.47-3.05 倍加速，在每次重规划 GPU 推理时间上实现 2.23-3.27 倍加速，同时保留原生 WAM 任务成功率的 96.69-99.54%。
AI.conclusion: WAMACHINE 能有效加速 WAM 推理并保持较高任务成功率，表明适配推理状态而非简单复用，是实现高效准确闭环控制的有效途径。

title: High-Level Text Preprocessing for Semantic Similarity Analysis of Discursive Texts: A Framework and Empirical Demonstration
comment: 18 pages, 8 tables, 39 references; submitted for publication
summary: Semantic Textual Similarity (STS) methods assume that a document's lexical content faithfully represents what it asserts. This assumption fails for discursive documents that discuss, compare, critique, and contextualize other positions in the process of articulating their own. The result is semantic diffusion: similarity scores between documents are inflated by vocabulary acquired through discursive engagement rather than substantive alignment. Standard Natural Language Processing (NLP) preprocessing (tokenization, stopword removal, stemming, lemmatization) cannot address this problem because it operates at the lexical level, treating all content identically regardless of its discursive function. This paper introduces high-level text preprocessing: a systematic, rule-based intervention applied before the standard preprocessing pipeline to isolate each document's actual claim from its discursive structure. We propose 12 rules, each with an explicit rationale, and demonstrate their effect on an encyclopedic philosophical corpus: three entries from the Stanford Encyclopedia of Philosophy (virtue ethics, deontological ethics, and consequentialism). A three-phase experiment using eight Transformer-based STS models shows that preprocessing reduces centroid cosine similarity scores across all three theory pairs, with 23 of 24 model-pair comparisons showing the expected decrease and cross-model agreement ranging from 7-1 to 8-0. We introduce the semantic diffusion index (SDI), a per-document metric for assessing the semantic reorientation between a document's raw and high-level preprocessed representations. Although the framework is demonstrated using philosophical texts, it potentially addresses a domain-agnostic problem applicable to legal texts, policy documents, academic articles, and any genre in which a discursive approach introduces vocabulary from positions the document does not endorse.

AI.tldr: 论文指出语义文本相似度方法会因话语性写作中的词汇借用而产生语义扩散，导致相似度虚高；为此提出高层文本预处理，在常规NLP预处理前用12条规则分离文档的实际主张与话语结构，并在哲学百科语料上验证其降低相似度并引入语义扩散指数SDI。
AI.motivation: 现有STS方法假设词汇内容忠实反映文档主张，但哲学、法律、政策等话语性文档会讨论、比较、批评和语境化其他立场，从而引入并非自身实质主张的词汇，造成语义扩散和相似度虚高；标准词法级预处理无法解决该问题。
AI.method: 提出高层文本预处理：在标准预处理流程之前进行系统化、规则化干预，以隔离文档实际主张与话语结构；设计12条规则并给出理由；使用斯坦福哲学百科三个条目（美德伦理学、义务论伦理学、后果主义）构建语料；采用8个基于Transformer的STS模型进行三阶段实验；提出语义扩散指数SDI以衡量文档原始表示与高层预处理表示之间的语义重定向。
AI.result: 预处理在三个理论对中均降低了质心余弦相似度；24个模型-理论对比较中有23个出现预期下降；跨模型一致性为7-1至8-0；SDI可评估单文档在原始与预处理表示间的语义重新定位。
AI.conclusion: 标准词法预处理不足以消除话语性文档中的语义扩散，高层规则预处理可有效降低由话语参与引入的虚假相似度；该框架虽以哲学文本演示，但可能适用于法律文本、政策文件、学术论文等任何会引入文档并不认同之立场词汇的领域。

title: Hierarchical Frequency-Domain Compression of Implicit Geometric Representations for Large-Scale Point Clouds
summary: Large-scale point cloud representations of complex geome tries incur prohibitive computational and memory costs, necessitating compressed implicit representations. To ad dress this, we propose a unified framework comprising im plicit geometric field representation, hierarchical frequency domain compression, and conditional high-frequency predic tion. Specifically, an unordered point cloud is mapped to an implicit field defined within its physical bounding box. A smooth Fourier pyramid is then constructed, where com pact low-frequency components capture the global geometry. Inter-scale high-frequency residuals are encoded to preserve the spatial information required for reconstructing fine geo metric details. To restore the high-frequency information lost during compression, we develop a hierarchical 3D neural net work. The reconstructed implicit field is converted back into a point cloud through isosurface extraction. Experiments on a complex-boundary point cloud with more than eight mil lion points demonstrate that the proposed method achieves a higher compression ratio than existing point cloud compres sion methods while maintaining comparable reconstruction quality.

AI.tldr: 提出一种统一框架，实现大规模复杂几何点云的隐式表示压缩，包含隐式几何场、层次频域压缩和条件高频预测，在超过800万点的点云上取得高压缩比且重建质量相当。
AI.motivation: 大规模点云表示复杂几何时计算和内存开销过大，因此需要压缩的隐式表示来降低存储与计算成本。
AI.method: 将无序点云映射到其物理包围盒内的隐式场；构建平滑傅里叶金字塔，用紧凑低频分量捕获全局几何；编码尺度间高频残差以保留细节空间信息；设计层次3D神经网络恢复压缩中丢失的高频信息；最后通过等值面提取将重建隐式场转回点云。
AI.result: 在具有复杂边界且超过800万点的点云实验中，该方法相比现有点云压缩方法实现了更高压缩比，同时保持可比重建质量。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够有效压缩大规模复杂几何点云，在较高压缩比下维持与现有方法相当的重建质量，适用于复杂边界点云的隐式表示与压缩。

title: On the Numerical Reliability of Differentiable Physics-Based Optimization for Robotic Material Manipulation
comment: Accepted as an oral presentation at the IROS 2026 workshop: Deformable Objects Manipulation: Research Foundations, Reproducibility and Real-World Challenges
summary: Differentiable physics is increasingly used in robotic material manipulation for system identification, trajectory or skill optimization, demonstration generation, and robot or end-effector design. These applications depend on gradients propagated through long, contact-rich simulation rollouts. We study the numerical reliability of those gradients using two Material Point Method (MPM) system-identification benchmarks derived from elastoplastic and granular manipulation. The benchmarks provide controlled cases for three effects that also arise in broader differentiable physics-based optimization. GPU many-to-one sums whose order depends on thread scheduling changed long-horizon gradients and reversed the sign of one parameter gradient relative to a deterministic reference. Finite-difference checks became less reliable for longer rollouts because repeated-run loss variation grew much faster than the loss change produced by the tested parameter perturbations. Observation and loss definitions changed optimization behaviour and the solution preferred by an independent metric. These results motivate reproducible accumulation, finite-difference validation that compares perturbation-induced loss changes with repeated-run variation, and explicit reporting of objective construction when differentiable simulation is used for robotic optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究机器人材料操作中可微物理仿真的梯度数值可靠性，基于弹性塑性与颗粒操作的两个MPM系统辨识基准，揭示了GPU求和不确定性、有限差分检验失效和损失定义影响优化结果三类问题。
AI.motivation: 可微物理被广泛用于系统辨识、轨迹/技能优化、演示生成及机器人/末端执行器设计，但这些应用依赖长时程、富接触仿真回传的梯度，其数值可靠性尚不明确。
AI.method: 构建两个源于弹性塑性和颗粒操作的MPM系统辨识基准，在受控条件下考察三类效应：GPU多对一求和顺序、长时程有限差分检验可靠性、以及观测与损失定义对优化行为的影响。
AI.result: GPU多对一求和顺序受线程调度影响，会改变长时程梯度，甚至使某一参数梯度符号相对于确定性参考反转；长时程下有限差分检验更不可靠，因为重复运行损失波动增长远快于参数扰动引起的损失变化；观测和损失定义会改变优化行为及独立指标偏好的解。
AI.conclusion: 可微物理用于机器人优化时，应推动可复现的梯度累加、将扰动引起的损失变化与重复运行波动对比的有限差分验证，并明确报告目标函数构造。

title: CT-OPD: Counterfactual Trace On-Policy Distillation for Diffusion Vision-Language Models
summary: Diffusion vision-language models generate answers by gradually resolving masked tokens, making accurate conditional prediction in partially resolved states central to post-training. Masking completed answers yields coherent contexts and targets, but prescribed masks do not reflect the model's reveal decisions. Its trajectories capture these decisions, yet their provisional visible tokens can conflict with the target response. Outcome-based reinforcement learning follows these trajectories but provides only response-level feedback, which loses contrast when sampled rewards tie. To align coherent token-level supervision with the model's reveal decisions, we introduce Counterfactual Trace On-Policy Distillation (CT-OPD), which combines completed teacher responses with trajectory masks from the current student. CT-OPD retokenizes each teacher response in the student's vocabulary and extracts unresolved-position masks at successive stages of the student's reverse process. For each mask, it discards provisional rollout values and reconstructs the partial state from the teacher endpoint, so the supervised positions follow the current trajectory while the visible context and targets remain consistent with the same response. The student is trained on these reconstructed states with its native categorical loss, and trajectories are refreshed as the model evolves. Across dense and sparse diffusion architectures, CT-OPD consistently enhances multimodal understanding and reasoning capabilities, with gains of up to 9.80 points on the nine-benchmark average. On the unified understanding-and-generation architecture, it also improves both visual understanding and image generation, showing that the same principle transfers across architectures and modalities. Ablations further attribute these gains to coherent reconstruction and current-model trajectory masks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出反事实轨迹在线蒸馏（CT-OPD），通过结合教师完整回答与学生当前轨迹掩码，在扩散视觉语言模型中实现与模型揭示决策对齐的token级监督，显著提升多模态理解与推理能力。
AI.motivation: 扩散视觉语言模型通过逐步解掩码生成答案，后训练中在部分解掩码状态下的准确条件预测至关重要。现有方法存在不足：预设掩码不反映模型揭示决策；轨迹中的临时可见token可能与目标响应冲突；基于结果的强化学习仅提供响应级反馈，奖励相同时缺乏对比。因此，需要对齐连贯的token级监督与模型自身的揭示决策。
AI.method: 提出CT-OPD，结合教师完整响应与当前学生轨迹掩码。对每个教师响应在学生词汇表中重新分词，并在学生反向过程不同阶段提取未解决位置掩码。对每个掩码，丢弃临时rollout值，从教师终点重建部分状态，使监督位置遵循当前轨迹，而可见上下文与目标保持同一响应一致。学生用原生分类损失在重建状态上训练，并随模型演化刷新轨迹。
AI.result: 在密集和稀疏扩散架构上，CT-OPD一致提升多模态理解与推理，九基准平均提升达9.80分。在统一理解与生成架构上，同时提升视觉理解和图像生成，表明原则可跨架构和模态迁移。消融实验将增益归因于连贯重建和当前模型轨迹掩码。
AI.conclusion: CT-OPD通过反事实轨迹在线蒸馏，将连贯token级监督与模型揭示决策对齐，有效提升扩散视觉语言模型的多模态理解、推理及生成能力，并具备跨架构和模态的通用性。

title: Opera: A Verbal Critic Framework for Long-horizon Coding Agents
summary: Long-horizon coding agents need timely corrections, yet feedback can be ineffective or even harmful when it misjudges ongoing work or fails to address the underlying problem. Existing critics focus on evaluating trajectories and generating feedback, but rarely track what happens after feedback is delivered. We present Opera, a verbal critic framework that treats each correction as a persistent note, followed until the diagnosed problem is resolved. Opera decides when to review through periodic and event-driven triggers, diagnoses issues with typed operators, audits feedback against visible evidence before delivery, and tracks the agent's subsequent actions to distinguish mere compliance from actual resolution. As a test-time critic, Opera improves the resolve rate of non-critic agents by up to 12.4, 15.0, and 8.9 percentage points on Terminal-Bench 2.1, a SWE-Bench Pro subset, and DeepSWE v1.1, respectively, across four policy models, and achieves the highest mean resolve rate among competitive critic baselines on all three benchmarks, and also improves policy models when the policy critiques itself. Beyond inference, Opera-guided rollouts provide approximately on-policy training data: fine-tuning Qwen3.5-9B on them improves its resolve rate on held-out SWE-Bench Pro repositories by 10.2 percentage points without a critic at inference time, matching fine-tuning on rollouts from a stronger model, while preserving its performance when switching harness, i.e., from Openhands to Terminus-2, which the latter substantially degrades.

AI.tldr: Opera 是一个面向长时程编码智能体的言语批评框架，将每次反馈视为持续跟踪的笔记，直到问题真正解决；作为测试时批评者显著提升解题率，并能生成近似同策略训练数据。
AI.motivation: 长时程编码智能体需要及时纠错，但反馈若误判当前工作或未触及根本问题，反而无效甚至有害；现有批评方法侧重评估轨迹和生成反馈，很少追踪反馈发出后的实际效果。
AI.method: 将每条纠正作为持久笔记，持续跟踪直至诊断问题解决；通过周期性及事件触发决定何时审查；用类型化操作符诊断问题；交付前依据可见证据审计反馈；追踪智能体后续动作以区分表面服从与真正解决；并用 Opera 引导的推演生成近似同策略训练数据。
AI.result: 作为测试时批评者，在 Terminal-Bench 2.1、SWE-Bench Pro 子集和 DeepSWE v1.1 上，跨四个策略模型将非批评智能体解题率分别最高提升 12.4、15.0、8.9 个百分点，并在三个基准上取得竞争性批评基线中最高的平均解题率，也提升策略模型自我批评的效果。用 Opera 引导推演微调 Qwen3.5-9B，在未见过的 SWE-Bench Pro 仓库上推理时无批评者仍提升 10.2 个百分点，媲美用更强模型推演微调，且在从 Openhands 切换到 Terminus-2 时保持性能。
AI.conclusion: Opera 通过持续跟踪反馈效果有效提升编码智能体表现，既能作为测试时批评者，也能提供近似同策略训练数据，并在更换运行框架时保持稳健。

title: Beyond Accuracy: Counterfactual Fragility and Demographic Bias in Clinical Evaluation of LLMs
summary: Clinical LLM evaluation often emphasizes answer accuracy; however, accuracy alone does not test counterfactual consistency or demographic robustness. We evaluated six LLMs on 150 MedQA USMLE questions using two automated perturbation tests to assess their performance. The counterfactual validity (CFV) test asked each model to make a minimal, plausible clinical change that would make a different answer correct. The demographic robustness test added six demographic prefixes to the same vignette and compared the answers and explanations with a no demographic baseline. Of the 900 CFV attempts, 228 (25.3 %) were valid and 672 were invalid. Across 5,400 demographic comparisons, 1,097 answers were changed (20.3%). Automated judging identified 3,128 stereotype evidence flags, including 1,932 in the broad Other category. MedGemma 27B achieved the highest accuracy (87.1%) and CFV (63.3%), lowest answer change rate (16.0%), and low mean Explanation Demographic Dissonance (EDD) score (0.169). However, its accuracy still exceeded its CFV, indicating that correct answers do not guarantee reliable performance on the counterfactual validity task. OpenBioLLM had the highest answer change rate and EDD, whereas GLM had the highest stereotype flag rate. These findings show that accuracy, CFV, answer stability, EDD, and stereotype evidence capture different evaluation aspects. Because all judgments were automated and no clinician validation was available, the results support safety screening but do not establish clinical deployability of the model.

AI.tldr: 该研究用两种自动化扰动测试评估6个LLM在150道MedQA USMLE题上的表现，发现高准确率并不保证反事实一致性和人口统计稳健性。
AI.motivation: 临床LLM评估常侧重答案准确率，但准确率无法检验反事实一致性或人口统计稳健性，因此需要更全面的安全性评估。
AI.method: 在150道MedQA USMLE题目上评估6个LLM。反事实有效性（CFV）测试要求模型做出最小、合理的临床改动，使另一个答案变为正确；人口统计稳健性测试在相同病例前添加六种人口统计前缀，并与无人口统计基线比较答案和解释。所有判断均为自动化。
AI.result: 900次CFV尝试中228次（25.3%）有效，672次无效。5,400次人口统计比较中1,097个答案改变（20.3%）。自动判断识别出3,128个刻板印象证据标记，其中1,932个属于宽泛的“其他”类别。MedGemma 27B准确率最高（87.1%）、CFV最高（63.3%）、答案改变率最低（16.0%），解释人口统计失调（EDD）均值较低（0.169），但其准确率仍高于CFV。OpenBioLLM答案改变率和EDD最高，GLM刻板印象标记率最高。
AI.conclusion: 准确率、CFV、答案稳定性、EDD和刻板印象证据反映不同评估维度。由于所有判断均为自动化且无临床医生验证，结果支持安全性筛查，但不能证明模型具备临床可部署性。

title: Decision-Sufficient State Representations: Measuring and Reducing Write-Time Regret
comment: 29 pages (10 main, 17 appendix), 12 figures (4 main, 8 appendix), 18 tables (2 main, 16 appendix)
summary: Long tasks produce more history than an LLM agent can hold in its context, and more than it uses reliably even when the history fits. A growing line of work therefore has agents carry a short written state instead: at every step a writer rewrites the state, and a reader acts from the state alone. Steps stay cheap, but anything the writer drops is lost before later decisions reveal that they need it. We quantify this loss and ask whether training can reduce it. Comparing the written state with the best state of the same size written in hindsight, we split the reader's loss into a budget loss, which any state of that size must incur, and a write-time regret, which comes from the writer's choices. In TextWorld cooking games where we control how long a fact must be carried before it is needed, a 128-token state holding the facts wins nearly every game, while prompted language-model writers win at most 17%. Almost all of the loss is write-time regret, and it grows with the delay. We then train the writer from the reader's own loss. DSSR (decision-sufficient state representations) scores candidate states by how well the reader acts after the writer carries them forward, and teaches the writer to prefer the better ones. This forward-rolled score predicts game outcomes ($ρ= 0.48$), whereas scoring a candidate as a fixed context, as hindsight methods usually do, does not ($ρ\leq 0.07$). On a pre-registered test split opened once, training adds +7.0 [+1.9, +12.2] points of success when facts are needed soon, bringing a plain summary writer to the level of belief- and slot-based memory prompts. The gain shrinks as the delay grows and is significant only at the shortest delay. We trace this limit to credit assignment: keeping a fact now pays off only if every later rewrite keeps it too, which a per-step score cannot see.

AI.tldr: 研究长任务中LLM智能体用短写状态替代长历史时的信息损失，并提出DSSR训练写作者以减少损失。
AI.motivation: 长任务历史超出上下文且即使能容纳也未必可靠；短写状态虽便宜，但写作者丢弃的信息会在后续决策需要时永久丢失，因此需量化损失并探索训练能否缓解。
AI.method: 将读者损失分解为预算损失和写时后悔；在TextWorld烹饪游戏中控制事实需携带的延迟，对比128 token状态、提示词LM写作者；提出DSSR，用读者在写作者将候选状态推进后的表现评分，训练写作者偏好更优状态，并与事后固定上下文评分对比。
AI.result: 128 token状态几乎全胜，提示LM写作者最高仅17%；损失主要是写时后悔且随延迟增加。DSSR前向滚动评分与游戏结果相关ρ=0.48，固定上下文评分ρ≤0.07。预注册测试中，事实需不久后使用时训练提升+7.0 [+1.9, +12.2]分，使普通摘要写作者达到belief/slot记忆提示水平；延迟增大增益缩小，仅最短延迟显著。
AI.conclusion: 训练可部分减少写时后悔，但受限于信用分配：当前保留事实只有在后续每次重写都保留才有回报，而逐步评分看不到这一点。

title: Progressive Risk Estimation for Accident Anticipation
summary: Accident anticipation aims to recognize anomalous driving cues before a crash while avoiding false alarms during normal driving. Existing approaches typically formulate this task as binary classification, focusing on whether an accident will occur rather than when it will occur. We propose PRE-ACT, a framework that models accident risk as a continuously evolving signal that increases as the crash approaches. By explicitly enforcing temporal ordering and distance-to-accident awareness, our method progressively raises risk while suppressing premature alarms, leading to significant improvements on MM-AU subsets and Nexar. We further introduce a Separation Score to evaluate the global behavior of predicted risk curves beyond local temporal windows. Code and visualizations are available at https://github.com/giddyyupp/PRE-ACT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PRE-ACT框架，将事故预测中的风险建模为随事故临近而持续上升的连续信号，而非仅做二分类判断。
AI.motivation: 现有事故预判方法多将其视为二分类问题，只关注是否会发生事故，而忽略了事故发生的时间信息，容易产生误报。
AI.method: PRE-ACT通过显式约束风险信号的时间顺序和距离事故的感知，使风险在接近事故时逐步升高，并抑制过早警报；同时提出Separation Score用于评估预测风险曲线的全局行为。
AI.result: 在MM-AU子集和Nexar数据集上取得显著提升，并能更好抑制过早误报。
AI.conclusion: 将事故风险建模为连续演化信号并引入时间排序与距离感知，可有效提升事故预判性能；Separation Score可补充局部时间窗之外的全局风险曲线评估。

title: HOI-Retarget: Contact-Centric Retargeting for Human-Object Interaction
comment: 8 pages, 6 figures. Submitted to ICRA. Website: http://shinben0327.github.io/hoi-retarget
summary: Learning from demonstration (LfD) has enabled humanoid robots to acquire diverse whole-body skills, but extending this paradigm to human-object interaction (HOI) is limited by the availability of robot-compatible interaction references. We present HOI-Retarget, a contact-centric retargeting method that transfers HOI onto a humanoid robot for large-scale motion-data generation. Its windowed trajectory optimization uses every labeled contact as a target in the object frame, balancing body tracking, foot support and smoothness under the robot's kinematic limits. The method can augment a single demonstration across object sizes, absorb contacts reconstructed from monocular video, and extend to several robots manipulating one object. We publicly release the code and the retargeted motion dataset.

AI.tldr: 提出HOI-Retarget，一种以接触为中心的重定向方法，可将人-物交互迁移到人形机器人，并生成大规模运动数据。
AI.motivation: 学习演示已使人形机器人获得多种全身技能，但将其扩展到人-物交互受限于缺少与机器人兼容的交互参考数据。
AI.method: 采用窗口化轨迹优化，在物体坐标系中将每个标注接触作为目标，并在机器人运动学限制下平衡身体跟踪、脚部支撑和平滑性。
AI.result: 方法可将单个演示扩展到不同物体尺寸，吸收单目视频重建的接触，并扩展到多个机器人操作同一物体；同时公开代码和重定向运动数据集。
AI.conclusion: HOI-Retarget能够有效生成人形机器人人-物交互的大规模运动数据，并支持多种扩展场景。

title: Latent Space Is Not Flat: Rethinking Latent Structure for 3D Medical Image Synthesis
summary: Latent generative models make 3D medical image synthesis computationally practical by generating in a compressed space. However, we show that the common flat Euclidean assumption induced by $\ell_2$ objectives is imprecise: latent-space geometry is so strongly anisotropic that equal-magnitude errors can produce drastically different decoded distortions. We further find that this anisotropy has a clear feature: sensitive variation concentrates in a low-rank subspace. The dominant low-rank components capture the overall structure, encoding long-range, spatially coordinated variation while remaining resistant to local noise. Its orthogonal residual, in contrast, mainly captures local and image-specific variation. Motivated by this asymmetry, we introduce Latent Structure Flow (LSF). At each block, LSF decomposes the latent state into structure and residual, models structural changes with global context, and predicts residual variation locally while preserving a direct path for the input structure. LSF changes only the generator, leaving the frozen codec and pointwise training objective unchanged. Across cross-modality synthesis and tumor inpainting tasks, LSF outperforms all compared baselines on both global and tumor-specific metrics, demonstrating the benefit of explicitly modeling latent-space structure for 3D medical image synthesis.

AI.tldr: 潜在生成模型在压缩空间进行3D医学图像合成，但潜在空间几何具有强各向异性，敏感变化集中在低秩子空间。本文提出Latent Structure Flow (LSF)，在生成器中分解潜在状态为结构和残差，分别用全局上下文建模结构变化、局部预测残差变化，并保留输入结构的直接路径。在跨模态合成和肿瘤修复任务上，LSF优于所有基线。
AI.motivation: 现有潜在生成模型基于L2目标隐含平坦欧氏空间假设，但潜在空间几何强各向异性，等量误差导致不同解码失真；且敏感变化集中于低秩子空间，需显式建模潜在空间结构。
AI.method: 提出LSF，在每个模块将潜在状态分解为结构（低秩、长程协调变化）和残差（局部、图像特定变化）；用全局上下文建模结构变化，局部预测残差变化，同时为输入结构保留直接路径；仅修改生成器，冻结编解码器和逐点训练目标。
AI.result: 在跨模态合成和肿瘤修复任务中，LSF在全局和肿瘤特定指标上均超越所有对比基线。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模潜在空间结构对3D医学图像合成有益。

title: RewardExplainer: Learning Reward Model Explanations from Counterfactual Preference Feedback
summary: Reward models (RMs) are a key component of large language model post-training, providing reward signals for subsequent reinforcement learning. However, conventional discriminative RMs typically output only scalar scores, making it difficult to identify the response behaviors associated with their scoring decisions. Existing interpretation methods often rely on predefined high-level attributes and require repeated counterfactual interventions for each response pair to validate candidate explanations, lacking a closed-loop mechanism that uses RMs' feedback to train a reusable explainer. To address this, we propose RewardExplainer, a framework that obtains feedback from the target reward model through counterfactual rewriting and uses this feedback to further optimize the explainer. RewardExplainer generates open-ended, atomic, and intervenable natural-language scoring mechanisms, making explanations more concrete, readable, and actionable. It further converts counterfactual feedback into preference supervision, enabling the explainer to more faithfully capture the target RM's scoring preferences and sensitive behaviors than single-pass generation. Extensive experiments across multiple target RMs and explainer backbones show consistent improvements. Beyond interpretation, we use the generated mechanisms to identify potential bias patterns and construct targeted debiasing data for fine-tuning the reward model, improving robustness on reward-hacking benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RewardExplainer框架，通过反事实改写从目标奖励模型获取反馈来优化解释器，生成开放、原子且可干预的自然语言评分机制，提升解释的忠实度，并可用于识别偏见和构建去偏数据以增强奖励模型鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 奖励模型是LLM后训练的关键组件，但传统判别式RM仅输出标量分数，难以识别与评分决策相关的响应行为。现有解释方法依赖预定义高层属性，且需对每个响应对反复进行反事实干预，缺乏利用RM反馈训练可复用解释器的闭环机制。
AI.method: 提出RewardExplainer框架，通过反事实改写从目标奖励模型获取反馈，并用该反馈优化解释器。生成开放、原子、可干预的自然语言评分机制，并将反事实反馈转化为偏好监督，使解释器更忠实地捕捉目标RM的评分偏好和敏感行为。
AI.result: 在多个目标RM和解释器主干上实验显示一致改进。利用生成的机制识别潜在偏见模式，构建针对性去偏数据微调奖励模型，提升了在reward-hacking基准上的鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: RewardExplainer能生成更具体、可读、可操作的评分机制解释，并通过闭环反馈提升解释忠实度；同时其解释可用于发现偏见并指导去偏，增强奖励模型鲁棒性。

title: Overwhelmed by Choice: Studying LLM Decision Making at Scale
comment: Accepted at TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation?, NeurIPS 2026 Workshop. 23 pages
summary: Multiple-choice and candidate-selection evaluations are widely used to assess LLM reasoning and decision-making, yet most benchmarks contain relatively small candidate sets. It remains unclear whether conclusions drawn from these settings remain valid as the candidate space scales. We systematically evaluate LLMs as the number of competing candidates increases and find substantial accuracy degradation across tasks, prompting strategies, and model scales. Controlled analyses show that standard long-context retrieval explanations cannot fully account for this degradation. Instead, we identify two systematic failure patterns. First, gold-margin collapse: the score gap between the correct answer and the strongest distractor progressively shrinks, driven primarily by weakening confidence in the correct answer. Second, earlier candidate preferences become increasingly difficult to overturn, with later candidates exerting progressively weaker influence on the final prediction. Motivated by these findings, we evaluate hierarchical partitioning and permutation-based inference, which improve accuracy by roughly 20 percentage points at $N=160$ on both HotpotQA and MIMIC. Overall, our results identify candidate-set scale as an important evaluation-protocol variable and show that strong small-option performance does not necessarily imply robust large-scale candidate comparison.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评估了大语言模型在候选选项数量增加时的表现，发现准确率显著下降，并揭示两种系统性失败模式；提出的分层划分与排列推理方法可将准确率提升约20个百分点。
AI.motivation: 多选和候选选择评测广泛用于评估LLM的推理与决策能力，但现有基准通常候选集较小，尚不清楚候选空间扩大后，基于小候选集得到的结论是否仍然成立。
AI.method: 系统改变竞争候选数量，跨任务、提示策略和模型规模评估LLM；通过控制分析检验长上下文检索解释；识别并分析正确选项与最强干扰项之间的边际分数崩溃，以及候选偏好难以逆转现象；评估分层划分和基于排列的推理方法。
AI.result: 随着候选数量增加，LLM准确率显著下降，且标准长上下文检索无法完全解释该现象。具体表现为：正确选项置信度减弱导致gold-margin逐步缩小；早期候选偏好越来越难被推翻，后续候选影响逐渐减弱。分层划分与排列推理在HotpotQA和MIMIC上、N=160时提升约20个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 候选集规模是重要的评测协议变量；模型在少量候选上的强表现不一定意味着其具备鲁棒的大规模候选比较能力。

title: Re-derivability Decides What a Staged Agent Pipeline Recovers After an Upstream Fault
comment: 34 pages, 8 figures, 13 tables; preprint under review
summary: One variable sets what an upstream fault costs a staged pipeline of language-model agents: re-derivability, how much of what a stage needs it can rebuild from the original problem. Grounding an inspector agent in that problem is worth +0.608 [+0.517, +0.700] to +0.358 over a blind one on four open-weight backbones served with thinking disabled, and on the two Qwen backbones the blind inspector changes no item at all. That head-to-head is exploratory. One deterministic fault enters the first stage, and we re-expose the original problem to $k = 0,\dots,3$ of the downstream stages with agents, items, fault and topology held fixed, on 120 gsm_hard items per arm at temperature zero. Accuracy under fault rises on four of four backbones, from +0.233 to +0.392, the largest Holm-adjusted $p$ being $2.1\times10^{-6}$. A registered kill test rules out tokens. Blanking every word holds the word slots fixed, and retention tracks the visible fraction on four of four, climbing from 0.221 to 0.692 on the primary. Those two families are confirmatory and everything else here is exploratory. The interaction excludes zero on two of four backbones under the registered pipeline, four of four under a three-stage pipeline, and three of four under full message history, the primary at +0.317. On Llama-3.1-8B the fault carries no detectable cost at any dose, so the other three carry every claim about what a fault costs. Re-derivability also sets what the architecture costs, and no decomposition we measured reliably beats one direct call. With no fault injected the registered pipeline loses to that call by -0.267, -0.125 and -0.317, and on Phi-4 reads +0.058 at $p = 0.118$, which the test fails to separate from zero. The repair that works is cheap and front-loaded: the first re-grounded stage buys +0.394 of matched retention for +59.8 tokens per item on Qwen3-14B, and the stages after it buy nothing.

AI.tldr: 论文研究分级语言模型智能体流水线中上游故障代价的“可重新推导性”：阶段能从原问题重建多少信息。实验表明，让检查智能体接入原始问题可显著降低故障影响；重新暴露原问题给下游阶段能提升故障下准确率；空词保留测试排除仅 token 效应；无故障时流水线不如直接单次调用；最有效修复是廉价且前置的第一次重新接地阶段。
AI.motivation: 探究上游故障在分阶段 LLM 智能体流水线中的代价由什么决定，尤其是“可重新推导性”，以及接地检查智能体和重新暴露原问题能否降低故障代价，并衡量架构成本与修复策略。
AI.method: 固定智能体、题目、故障和拓扑，向首阶段注入确定性故障，在四个开放权重模型（禁用 thinking）上对每臂 120 条 gsm_hard 题、温度 0 进行实验；将原问题重新暴露给 k=0到3 个下游阶段；比较 grounded 与 blind inspector；使用 Holm 校正、交互检验、token kill test（挖空所有词但保留词槽）和可见比例 retention 分析；与直接单次调用比较；测量匹配 retention 和 token 成本。主要确认性为重新暴露原问题与空词保留两族。
AI.result: Grounded inspector 比 blind 高 +0.608 [+0.517,+0.700] 到 +0.358；两个 Qwen 上 blind inspector 不改变任何条目。故障下准确率在 4/4 模型上升，+0.233 到 +0.392，最大 Holm 校正 p=2.1×10^-6。空词保留随可见比例上升，4/4 模型成立，主模型从 0.221 升至 0.692。交互项在注册流水线 2/4、三阶段 4/4、全消息历史 3/4 上排除零，主项 +0.317。Llama-3.1-8B 上故障无可检测代价。无故障时注册流水线比直接调用差 -0.267、-0.125、-0.317，Phi-4 为 +0.058 但 p=0.118 不显著。Qwen3-14B 上首个重新接地阶段以 +59.8 tokens/条买到 +0.394 匹配 retention，后续阶段无增益。
AI.conclusion: 可重新推导性不仅决定上游故障代价，也决定架构代价；接地和重新暴露原问题能有效修复故障，但修复应前置，仅第一次重新接地有收益；未发现任何分解方案能可靠优于一次直接调用；除 Llama-3.1-8B 外的三个模型支撑故障代价相关结论。

title: USAI-Quant: A Quantitative Reasoning Benchmark for Vision-Language Models in Built Environments
summary: Large vision-language models (VLMs) have emerged as a powerful paradigm for urban and spatial AI. However, current state-of-the-art large VLMs still struggle with quantitative reasoning on remote sensing imagery. Existing benchmarks and algorithms are predominantly based on qualitative Visual Question Answering (VQA), providing limited insights into the quantitative reasoning capabilities of VLMs for built environment metrics. To address this gap, we develop Quantitative Urban and Spatial AI benchmark (USAI-Quant), the first benchmark designed to quantitatively evaluate VLM's reasoning capabilities on built environment metrics via remote sensing imagery. USAI-Quant is curated from the 335 largest U.S. cities, aligning high-resolution remote sensing images with quantitative built environment metrics. We then evaluate both general-purpose and remote sensing VLMs (RS-VLMs) by applying VQAs to tens of built environment metrics across three complexity levels. Our results reveal that current state-of-the-art models consistently fall short on numeric reasoning tasks. We further conduct in-depth analyses across models, question types, and geographic locations, uncovering insights into performance variability and task-specific challenges.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了首个面向遥感影像中建成环境指标定量推理的基准 USAI-Quant，并评估了通用与遥感视觉语言模型在数值推理任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 现有大型视觉语言模型在遥感影像的定量推理上仍表现不足，而已有基准和算法多基于定性视觉问答，无法充分评估模型对建成环境指标的定量推理能力。
AI.method: 构建 USAI-Quant 基准，覆盖美国335个最大城市，将高分辨率遥感影像与定量建成环境指标对齐；对通用视觉语言模型和遥感视觉语言模型进行视觉问答评估，涉及数十个建成环境指标和三个复杂度级别，并开展跨模型、问题类型和地理位置的深入分析。
AI.result: 当前最先进模型在数值推理任务上持续表现不佳；分析揭示了不同模型、问题类型和地理位置下的性能差异及任务特定挑战。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了遥感领域定量推理评估的空白，表明现有视觉语言模型在建成环境指标定量推理方面仍有明显局限，并为未来改进提供了基准与洞察。

title: Sufficiency of Zeroth-Order Reward Shaping for Policy Gradient in Stabilization Control
summary: Reward shaping is fundamental to modern robotic control with deep reinforcement learning (RL), yet practitioners still rely heavily on heuristic principles borrowed from classical optimal control and trajectory optimization. Existing methods rarely distinguish reward terms that are intrinsic to the control objective from numerical regularizers, leading to brittle hyperparameter tuning. To determine which quantities a reward must contain, we study the stabilization control problem with a focus on zeroth-order (configuration) and first-order (velocity) information. We theoretically and empirically demonstrate that policy gradient methods can successfully solve stabilization tasks without first-order reward terms, adding such terms can instead introduce severe sensitivity as their scale grows. Conversely, our findings confirm that reward functions must be zeroth-order complete over goal-relevant coordinates, while the first-order state remains necessary in the policy observation under our low-dissipation assumptions. Overall, these results provide actionable and principled guidance for reward design in robotic RL.

AI.tldr: 本文研究机器人强化学习中的奖励设计，重点分析配置（零阶）与速度（一阶）信息在稳定控制任务中的作用，并给出原则性指导。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人深度强化学习中的奖励塑形多依赖经典最优控制与轨迹优化的启发式规则，且未区分控制目标内在奖励项与数值正则项，导致超参数调优脆弱。
AI.method: 以稳定控制问题为研究对象，聚焦零阶（配置）和一阶（速度）信息，通过理论分析与实证实验考察策略梯度方法在不同奖励构成下的表现。
AI.result: 策略梯度方法无需一阶奖励项即可成功求解稳定任务；加入一阶奖励项反而会随其尺度增大引入严重敏感性。奖励函数必须在目标相关坐标上满足零阶完备性，同时在低耗散假设下策略观测中仍需包含一阶状态。
AI.conclusion: 这些结果为机器人强化学习中的奖励设计提供了可操作且有原则的指导。

title: Right Answer, Wrong Reason: Accuracy, Consistency, and Consensus Are Misleading Indicators of LLM Faithfulness in Clinical Decision Support
comment: Accepted and received best paper award from ICETCI 2026 Conference, https://ietcint.com/
summary: Clinical Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong medical-exam accuracy; however, a correct answer does not guarantee that the explanation names the concepts that actually drove the decision. We introduce three lightweight, directly interpretable metrics for this faithfulness gap: the Explanation Stability Index (ESI), which measures reasoning consistency across repeated queries; the Causal Faithfulness Score (CFS), which tests whether cited concepts drive predictions via concept ablation; and the Perturbation Stability Score (PSS), which measures robustness to semantic-preserving paraphrases. By evaluating six LLMs on 150 MedQA-USMLE questions (900 model-question observations), we found that only 23.3% of the cited clinical concepts were causally necessary. Correct answers had lower CFS than incorrect answers (0.212 vs. 0.398), answer consistency negatively predicted CFS (Spearman r = -0.466), and model pairs could agree on answers while sharing only 8.8% of cited reasoning concepts. These results show that accuracy, consistency, and consensus are incomplete safety signals for clinical decision-making support. The evidence is behavioral rather than mechanistic: concept ablation tests counterfactual sensitivity of outputs, not internal circuits.

AI.tldr: 该研究关注临床大语言模型正确答案与解释忠实性之间的差距，提出三个可解释性指标，并在6个模型、150道MedQA-USMLE题上评估，发现引用的临床概念多数并非因果必要，准确率、一致性和模型间共识不足以作为安全信号。
AI.motivation: 临床LLM在医学考试题上准确率高，但答案正确并不代表其解释中提到的概念真正驱动了决策。因此需要直接衡量解释与预测机制之间的忠实性差距。
AI.method: 提出三个轻量级、可直接解释的指标：ESI衡量重复提问下推理一致性；CFS通过概念消融检验被引用概念是否真正驱动预测；PSS衡量对语义保持改写的鲁棒性。评估6个LLM在150道MedQA-USMLE题上的900次模型-问题观测。
AI.result: 仅23.3%的被引用临床概念具有因果必要性。正确答案的CFS低于错误答案（0.212 vs. 0.398）。答案一致性与CFS呈负相关（Spearman r = -0.466）。模型对可在答案上一致，但仅共享8.8%的被引用推理概念。
AI.conclusion: 准确率、一致性和共识是不完整的临床决策支持安全信号。该证据是行为层面的，概念消融测试的是输出的反事实敏感性，而非内部电路机制。

title: Faithful Activation Verbalization: Reducing Hallucinations in LLM Representation Interpretation
summary: Activation verbalization methods such as Activation Oracle and Natural Language Autoencoders decode hidden representations of large language models into human-readable natural language. However, existing methods can produce incomplete or hallucinated descriptions, making their activation verbalizations difficult to trust and use reliably in practice. To this end, we introduce AVPO, a two-stage framework that first reconstructs source text from a hidden activation and then evaluates the resulting text with a separate frozen question-answering model, yielding an explicit and inspectable intermediate readout. We further optimize the inverter with direct preference optimization (DPO), using rewards that capture both semantic recoverability and lexical fidelity. Across six text families, AVPO improves gist- and detail-level information recovery over the strongest baseline by up to 17.1 and 9.3 percentage points, respectively. Crucially, the gains arise from preference optimization rather than fine-tuning on selected reconstructions alone, enabling compact cross-model inverters to surpass donor-matched question-conditioned verbalizers while improving both semantic recoverability and lexical fidelity. Moreover, out-of-distribution case study shows that AVPO better recovers high-level semantics while fabricating fewer details.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AVPO 两阶段框架：先由隐藏激活重构源文本，再用冻结问答模型评估重构结果，并通过 DPO 优化逆变器，从而提升激活语言化的可信度与信息恢复能力。
AI.motivation: 现有激活语言化方法（如 Activation Oracle 和 Natural Language Autoencoders）虽能将大模型隐藏表示解码为自然语言，但描述可能不完整或包含幻觉，导致难以信任并可靠用于实践。
AI.method: AVPO 采用两阶段框架：第一阶段从隐藏激活重构源文本；第二阶段用独立的冻结问答模型评估该文本，形成显式且可检查的中间读出。进一步使用直接偏好优化（DPO）优化逆变器，奖励同时衡量语义可恢复性与词汇保真度。
AI.result: 在六个文本族上，AVPO 的要点级和细节级信息恢复分别比最强基线提升最多 17.1 和 9.3 个百分点。增益主要来自偏好优化，而非仅在选定重构上微调。紧凑的跨模型逆变器可超过与 donor 匹配的问题条件式语言化器，并同时提升语义可恢复性与词汇保真度。分布外案例表明，AVPO 能更好恢复高层语义且编造细节更少。
AI.conclusion: AVPO 通过两阶段重构-评估与 DPO 偏好优化，提高了激活语言化的可靠性、可解释性和信息恢复效果，并有助于减少幻觉式细节。

title: Natural State-Prediction Accuracy can Hide Weak Controlled Responsiveness in VLA Readouts
summary: Accurately decoding object states from the internal representations of vision-language-action (VLA) models does not establish that the predictions respond faithfully to changes in the target physical state. In natural observations, object state, robot configuration, occlusion, and task progress vary together, allowing contextual cues to contribute to prediction. In this paper, we introduce an evaluation framework that separates prediction accuracy, target-state responsiveness, and context stability using physically validated observations that cross target coordinates with robot contexts. We demonstrate that high natural-trajectory accuracy can coexist with weak controlled target-state responsiveness in fixed representation-readout pairs. Comparisons and interventions involving representations, readouts, and training data show that the three properties provide distinct diagnostic information. Furthermore, adding responsiveness and context sensitivity to a failure predictor based on initial state error and physical variables reduces policy-failure prediction error on new initializations relative to the specified baseline while same-observation controlled MAE is also informative. These findings motivate evaluating target-state responsiveness and context stability alongside natural prediction accuracy, and examining their relationship to actual policy behavior and task outcomes.

AI.tldr: 论文指出，VLA模型内部表征能准确解码物体状态，并不代表预测会忠实响应目标物理状态变化；作者提出评估框架，将预测准确率、目标状态响应性与上下文稳定性分离，并证明三者提供不同诊断信息。
AI.motivation: 自然观测中物体状态、机器人构型、遮挡和任务进度常共同变化，模型可能依赖上下文线索而非真正响应目标状态，因此仅用自然轨迹准确率不足以说明预测是否忠实反映物理状态变化。
AI.method: 提出评估框架，使用经物理验证的观测，将目标坐标与机器人上下文交叉组合，以分离预测准确率、目标状态响应性和上下文稳定性；并通过表征、读出器和训练数据的比较与干预实验，以及结合初始状态误差和物理变量的失败预测器进行分析。
AI.result: 发现固定表征-读出器对可在自然轨迹上保持高准确率，但受控目标状态响应性很弱；三类属性提供不同诊断信息；在失败预测器中加入响应性和上下文敏感性，可相对指定基线降低新初始化下的策略失败预测误差，同时同一观测下的受控MAE也具有信息量。
AI.conclusion: 应 alongside 自然预测准确率，同时评估目标状态响应性和上下文稳定性，并进一步考察它们与实际策略行为和任务结果之间的关系。

title: VCRE-Fib: View-Conditioned Regional Evidence for Fine-Grained Ultrasound Grading of Schistosoma japonicum-Associated Liver Fibrosis
comment: 20 pages, 5 figures, including appendices. Submitted to ICLR 2027. Code: https://github.com/StatXzy7/vcre-fib
summary: Accurate assessment of Schistosoma japonicum-associated liver fibrosis is essential for disease management and long-term follow-up in endemic regions. Ultrasound provides non-invasive imaging, but complex local echogenic patterns and anatomical structures make fine-grained grading challenging. Existing deep learning methods can predict fibrosis scores, yet directly incorporating acquisition views and regional cues into grading while retaining spatial information for inspection remains an open problem. Here we present VCRE-Fib, a view-conditioned regional evidence framework that integrates anatomical context, local information, and global image assessment for fine-grained ultrasound grading. The framework forms view-conditioned local grading evidence before spatial pooling, uses weak localization to guide its aggregation, and combines it with global predictions. Image-only inference jointly returns a fibrosis score, acquisition view, and candidate abnormal-region map. We developed and evaluated the method on a re-curated cohort of 108,709 ultrasound images from 6,373 patients across 35 centers. On a patient-disjoint test set of 4,107 images from 240 patients across four centers, VCRE-Fib reduced the prespecified composite grading risk by 7.115% relative to SFibAI trained and evaluated on the same data split. Image-level mean absolute error decreased from 0.391 to 0.378, alongside lower patient-max, patient-median, and center-balanced risks. The full model also achieved lower composite grading risk than variants that separately removed view conditioning or weak localization. These results support incorporating anatomical context and regional evidence into ultrasound grading while exposing spatial predictions for inspection alongside severity estimates.

AI.tldr: 提出 VCRE-Fib，一种视图条件区域证据框架，用于日本血吸虫相关肝纤维化的细粒度超声分级，联合输出纤维化评分、采集视图和候选异常区域图。
AI.motivation: 日本血吸虫相关肝纤维化在流行区需准确评估；超声无创但回声模式和解剖结构复杂，细粒度分级困难。现有深度学习方法可预测纤维化评分，但如何结合采集视图和区域线索，同时保留空间信息供检查仍是未解决问题。
AI.method: VCRE-Fib 整合解剖上下文、局部信息和全局图像评估；在空间池化前形成视图条件局部分级证据，利用弱定位指导证据聚合，并与全局预测结合。仅用图像推理即可同时返回纤维化评分、采集视图和候选异常区域图。
AI.result: 在来自35个中心、6,373名患者的108,709张超声图像上开发评估；在4个中心、240名患者的4,107张患者不重叠测试集上，相比同数据划分训练的SFibAI，复合分级风险降低7.115%；图像级平均绝对误差从0.391降至0.378，患者最大、患者中位数和中心平衡风险也更低；完整模型优于分别去除视图条件或弱定位的变体。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，将解剖上下文和区域证据纳入超声分级，并在给出严重程度估计的同时暴露空间预测供检查，是有效且受支持的。

title: When Can First-Order Models of Fine-Tuning Bound Forgetting?
summary: Fine-tuning a language model on new data can make it forget facts that it should keep. We ask whether measurements taken at the start of a fine-tuning run can bound, for each protected fact, the probability that the run makes the model forget it. In LoRA fine-tuning with stochastic gradient descent on models from 0.6B to 14B parameters, a first-order response model estimated by finite-difference probes predicts changes of per-fact margins with correlation 0.974-0.998. Predictions of forgetting built on this model nevertheless failed, because forgetting requires parameter changes far outside the region in which the model was validated. The probes can, however, bound the probability that a margin first falls below a boundary near zero: we derive Freedman and Azuma first-passage bounds for a linear surrogate of the margin and test on new runs whether they hold for the model. The bounds contain a term R that measures how much the response coefficients change during the run. The simplified Freedman bound, which sets R = 0, certified most facts but was violated in 14 of 112 conditions, and every fact on which it was violated had R >= a, where a is the distance of the fact's margin to the boundary. The complete Freedman bound certifies only facts with R < a, and it held in every condition. On the violated facts, the spread of the margin across test runs was a median of 14.6 times the prediction of the response model, so the failures are breakdowns of the model, and in our data they occurred only where R >= a. We found this pattern post hoc and tested it in two preregistered confirmatory studies with 43 new conditions: the complete bound held in all of them, and the simplified bound failed there on only 3 facts, each with R >= a. First-order models of fine-tuning can thus bound forgetting on the facts whose response coefficients change by less than their distance to the boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文研究微调语言模型时如何界定受保护事实被遗忘的概率，发现一阶响应模型可预测逐事实边界变化，并可通过Freedman/Azuma首达时界约束遗忘，但仅适用于响应系数变化小于其到边界距离的事实。
AI.motivation: 微调新数据可能导致模型遗忘应保留的事实，作者希望利用微调开始时的测量，逐个事实地给出遗忘概率的界限。
AI.method: 在0.6B至14B参数的LoRA随机梯度下降微调中，用有限差分探针估计一阶响应模型；对边际的线性代理推导Freedman和Azuma首达时界，并引入R衡量运行中响应系数变化；进行预注册验证研究。
AI.result: 响应模型预测逐事实边际变化的相关系数为0.974-0.998，但直接预测遗忘失败。简化Freedman界（R=0）在112个条件中14个被违反，且被违反事实均有R>=a；完整Freedman界仅认证R<a的事实，并在所有条件中成立。违规事实上边际跨测试运行的中位离散度为响应模型预测的14.6倍。两个预注册确认研究共43个新条件中，完整界全部成立，简化界仅在3个R>=a事实上失败。
AI.conclusion: 一阶微调模型可以约束遗忘，但仅限于响应系数变化小于其到边界距离的事实；当R>=a时，线性代理失效，遗忘无法由该一阶模型可靠界定。

title: Who Gets a Token, and What Does It Carry? Unequal Name Support and Concept Access in Large Language Models
summary: Names are personal identifiers, but they also carry social meaning and are widely used to evaluate how language models treat different people. Such evaluations typically assume that matched names are comparable model inputs. We show that this assumption often fails at the lexical interface: matched names are not necessarily matched inputs. Some names receive direct single-token access, while others are assembled from multiple subwords, creating unequal name-surface support. Across nearly half a million first names and 12 LLM-associated tokenizers, direct lexical access is highly selective, model dependent, and uneven across race- and gender-associated name metadata. We introduce NameTrace, a model-native, fine-grained, pre-behavioral framework for measuring whether unequal name-surface support remains a vocabulary property or becomes visible in task-relevant internal representations. NameTrace measures concept accessibility from the model's own probabilities over task-specific adjective axes with continuous task-aligned weights. On matched atomic and short-fragmented names within the same race/ethnicity--gender-associated strata, support predicts systematic differences in concept accessibility across fellowship, hiring, clinical assessment, and lending. These differences persist across all eight matched strata, extend across model families, and transfer to unseen names. Hidden-state interventions further show that the measured task directions have downstream leverage, shifting later constrained choices. Unequal lexical support is therefore demographically structured at the input and remains visible in task-relevant model computation. NameTrace makes lexical comparability measurable, supporting a broader principle: behavioral comparability begins with lexical comparability.

AI.tldr: 论文指出，姓名公平性评估中“匹配姓名即匹配输入”的假设在词法层面常不成立；不同姓名获得单token或多子词切分，造成词表支持不均，并与种族和性别相关。作者提出NameTrace，衡量这种不平等是否进入任务相关内部表征并影响模型判断。
AI.motivation: 现有研究常假设匹配姓名是可比的语言模型输入，但姓名可能因分词方式不同而获得不平等的词法支持，导致对模型姓名偏见的评估基础不可靠。
AI.method: 分析近50万个名字和12个LLM分词器，考察姓名是否被直接单token访问；提出NameTrace，基于模型自身在任务特定形容词轴上的概率和连续任务对齐权重，测量概念可及性；比较同种族/族裔—性别分层内的原子姓名与短碎片化姓名，并进行隐藏状态干预。
AI.result: 直接词法访问高度选择性、依赖模型，并在种族和性别相关元数据上不均；词法支持可预测奖学金、招聘、临床评估和借贷任务中的概念可及性差异。这些差异在八个匹配分层中持续存在，跨模型家族出现，并可迁移到未见姓名；隐藏状态干预还能改变后续受限选择。
AI.conclusion: 不平等的词法支持在输入端具有人口结构性，并持续体现在任务相关模型计算中。NameTrace使词法可比性可测量，支持一个更广泛原则：行为可比性始于词法可比性。

title: Beyond Temporal Smoothing: Spatial Energy Budgets Stabilize One-Step Diffusion Editing
summary: One-step text-guided diffusion editing is efficient but prone to spatially misallocated updates that distort the edited object and alter the background. Existing methods often improve stability by averaging the editing field across timesteps. We instead identify spatial energy misallocation as a distinct and measurable failure mode: across two independent noise draws, the residual field is essentially unrepeatable, making the background field unreliable for direct transport, while its total energy still sets a usable magnitude for the draw at hand. BudEdit turns that magnitude into an explicit budget and reallocates it to edit-relevant regions selected jointly by residual energy and cross-attention, controlling where editing energy is spent rather than averaging over timesteps. The resulting training-free, inversion-free editor spends the budget on transport and reuses it to scale a correction in a lower-noise gated refinement. The budgeted injection field matches its prescribed budget exactly and vanishes on the identified background support, by construction. On PIE-Bench with SD-Turbo, BudEdit outperforms ChordEdit under each method's reported default settings on all 11 evaluated metrics, including a $2.1$\,dB gain in background PSNR, $31$\% lower DINO, and $36$\% lower LPIPS, while improving all five editing-quality metrics and reporting the lowest runtime in the comparison.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 BudEdit，一种无需训练和反演的一步文本引导扩散编辑方法，通过将残差总能量视为显式预算并重新分配到编辑相关区域，解决一步编辑中空间能量错配问题。
AI.motivation: 现有一步文本引导扩散编辑效率高，但容易产生空间错配更新，导致编辑对象扭曲和背景改变。已有方法多通过跨时间步平均编辑场提升稳定性，而本文发现空间能量错配是一种独立且可测量的失败模式：不同噪声采样下残差场基本不可重复，背景场不可靠，但其总能量仍可作为当前采样的有效幅值。
AI.method: BudEdit 将残差总能量转化为显式编辑预算，并依据残差能量与交叉注意力共同选择编辑相关区域，控制编辑能量分配而非跨时间步平均。该方法无需训练、无需反演，将预算用于传输，并在低噪声门控细化中复用该预算缩放修正项。所构造的预算注入场按设计精确匹配预算，并在识别出的背景支撑区域消失。
AI.result: 在 PIE-Bench 与 SD-Turbo 上，BudEdit 在各自默认设置下于全部 11 项评估指标上优于 ChordEdit，包括背景 PSNR 提升 2.1 dB、DINO 降低 31%、LPIPS 降低 36%，同时改善全部五项编辑质量指标，并取得对比方法中最低的运行时间。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式控制编辑能量的空间分配而非跨时间步平均，BudEdit 能有效缓解一步扩散编辑中的空间能量错配，在提升编辑质量和背景保持的同时保持高效率。

title: Rank Collapse Is Recoverable, Growing $|Q|$ Is Not: Out-of-Sample Early Warning for Value Divergence in High-UTD Soft Actor-Critic
summary: Raising the update-to-data (UTD) ratio breaks off-policy critics in two ways grouped as "plasticity loss": collapsing representations and growing value magnitude $|Q|$. We separate them in Soft Actor-Critic (SAC) with scaled critics (width 2048, no normalization). Collapse is survivable: at UTD ratio 16, HalfCheetah critics with most units dormant keep learning, and the training guard, which stops runs whose loss or $|Q|$ explodes, never flags them. Within one high-UTD SAC configuration, runs start close together, and how far a critic's $\log_{10}|Q|$ has climbed by step 15k, its early growth, ranks the runs by how soon the guard flags them. At 15k, a flagged run's $|Q|$ sits a median of over a hundredfold below its flag level, yet the climb's rate already orders the flags (Harrell's C and out-of-sample AUC 0.78 on Walker2d, 0.98 on Ant, at UTD ratio 4). Dormancy does not. Aborting on this rate saves about a tenth of held-out Walker2d compute and stays net-positive live. A LayerNorm critic lowers the rate, removes the flag on Walker2d at UTD ratio 4 and lowers the return.

AI.tldr: 论文研究高更新数据比（UTD）下离策略评论家出现的“可塑性损失”，将其分为表征坍缩与Q值幅度增长两类，并在SAC中分别考察。
AI.motivation: 提高UTD会破坏离策略评论家，但已有研究常将表征坍缩和Q值幅度膨胀混为“可塑性损失”，缺少对两者的区分及早期预测失败的能力。
AI.method: 使用带缩放评论家的Soft Actor-Critic（宽度2048、无归一化），在不同UTD比下训练，并设置当损失或|Q|爆炸时停止的guard。通过检查休眠单元、log10|Q|早期增长速率、Harrell's C与样本外AUC评估对guard触发顺序的预测，并测试LayerNorm评论家的影响。
AI.result: 在UTD=16时，HalfCheetah评论家即使多数单元休眠仍能继续学习，且guard不触发，说明坍缩可幸存。同一高UTD SAC配置中，step 15k时log10|Q|已增长的幅度/速率可排序后续guard触发：Walker2d与Ant在UTD=4时AUC分别为0.78和0.98；触发时|Q|中位数仍低于阈值百倍以上。休眠不能预测。基于该速率提前中止可节省约十分之一保留的Walker2d计算量且实际收益为正。LayerNorm评论家降低该速率，在UTD=4的Walker2d上移除guard触发，但降低回报。
AI.conclusion: 高UTD下评论家失败至少包含可区分的两种机制；Q值幅度的早期增长速率能预测后续不稳定触发，而表征坍缩本身不一定致命。LayerNorm虽可缓解Q值增长并避免触发，却可能牺牲性能。

title: Evaluating Machine Unlearning in ASR
summary: Machine unlearning (MU) offers a path to compliance with "right to be forgotten" regulations. While MU has received increasing attention for speech tasks, it remains largely unexplored for Automatic Speech Recognition (ASR). In this work, we investigate whether existing MU algorithms and evaluation tools are suitable for ASR. We apply several MU techniques to an ASR model, evaluating privacy-utility trade-offs for single-subject unlearning, then assess the best algorithm under sequential and simultaneous unlearning. Results show that gradient ascent-based algorithms achieve strong utility-privacy trade-offs, whereas more complex approaches over-unlearn samples, making them easier to identify as unlearned. This suggests standard privacy evaluations based on simple Membership Inference attacks are insufficient to reliably assess unlearning success, motivating improved evaluation methods for MU in ASR. Finally, we show that both sequential and simultaneous unlearning yield worse privacy and utility than single-subject unlearning, underscoring the need for unlearning constructions better suited to these settings.

AI.tldr: 本文研究机器遗忘（MU）在自动语音识别（ASR）中的适用性，比较多种MU算法在单主体、顺序和同时遗忘设置下的隐私-效用权衡。
AI.motivation: 尽管MU在语音任务中受到关注，但在ASR领域仍缺乏探索；同时“被遗忘权”合规需求推动了对ASR模型遗忘能力及评估工具的研究。
AI.method: 将多种MU技术应用于ASR模型，评估单主体遗忘的隐私-效用权衡；选取最佳算法进一步测试顺序遗忘和同时遗忘；分析现有基于简单成员推理攻击的隐私评估。
AI.result: 基于梯度上升的算法取得较好的效用-隐私权衡；更复杂的方法会过度遗忘样本，使其更容易被识别为已遗忘样本；顺序和同时遗忘的隐私与效用均差于单主体遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 现有MU算法和评估工具不完全适用于ASR；简单成员推理攻击不足以可靠评估遗忘成功，需要改进ASR中MU的评估方法，并设计更适合顺序和同时遗忘场景的遗忘方案。

title: SOR-Nav: Search or Relocate? Context-Gated Exploration and Cross-Region Relocation for Object Navigation
summary: Object navigation requires an embodied agent to find an object in an unseen environment under partial observability and a limited motion budget. Existing methods primarily optimize where the robot should go next by ranking candidate destinations. In contrast to these methods, we present SOR-Nav, a hierarchical navigation system that explicitly arbitrates between continuing to explore the current context and abandoning it for a more promising reachable region. First, an autonomous semantic exploration system is built that accumulates persistent 3D object clusters and organizes reachable frontiers into a cluster decision graph to provide an efficient search abstraction. Then, SOR-Nav uses a context-gated LLM-driven object-search supervisor to evaluate the suitability of the current search context and decide whether to continue exploration or perform cross-region relocation to another reachable frontier cluster. Across the complete, unfiltered validation sets of HM3D-v1, HM3D-v2, and MP3D, SOR-Nav achieves the strongest reported Success Rate (SR) and Success weighted by Path Length (SPL) on all three benchmarks. On MP3D in particular, it more than doubles the previous best SPL from 18.1\% to 38.5\% while increasing SR from 50.7\% to 61.8\%. Nested HM3D-v2 ablations validate the proposed decision structure, while a continuous three-target physical deployment demonstrates persistent ObjectNav operation in real-world scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SOR-Nav，一种分层物体导航系统，核心是在“继续探索当前区域”与“放弃当前区域并迁移到更有希望的可达区域”之间做出显式决策。它在 HM3D-v1、HM3D-v2 和 MP3D 上取得当前最优的 SR 与 SPL，并在真实场景中实现持续物体导航。
AI.motivation: 现有物体导航方法主要通过对候选目标点排序来决定下一步去哪，但缺少对“继续探索当前上下文”还是“切换到其他可达区域”的显式权衡，容易在局部无效区域浪费有限运动预算。
AI.method: SOR-Nav 构建自主语义探索系统，累积持久化 3D 物体簇，并将可达前沿组织为簇决策图，形成高效搜索抽象；随后使用上下文门控的 LLM 驱动物体搜索监督器，评估当前搜索上下文是否值得继续，并决定继续探索或进行跨区域迁移到其他可达前沿簇。
AI.result: 在 HM3D-v1、HM3D-v2、MP3D 完整未过滤验证集上，SOR-Nav 在三个基准上均取得最强 SR 和 SPL。尤其在 MP3D 上，SPL 从先前最好 18.1% 提升到 38.5%，SR 从 50.7% 提升到 61.8%。嵌套 HM3D-v2 消融验证了决策结构有效性，连续三目标物理部署展示了真实世界中的持续 ObjectNav 运行。
AI.conclusion: 显式仲裁当前探索上下文与跨区域迁移，并结合持久语义地图、簇决策图和 LLM 监督器，可显著提升部分可观测与有限运动预算下的物体导航性能，并具备真实场景持续作业能力。

title: MarsLab: A Martian Rover Simulator for Planetary Rover Autonomous Navigation
comment: 8 pages, 11 figures. Accepted for publication at the 2026 International Conference on Space Robotics (iSpaRo)
summary: Future Mars missions will require rover autonomy that can operate across unstructured terrain, changing illumination, atmospheric dust, and limited communication. Simulation is a practical way to study these conditions before deployment, but existing Mars-relevant resources differ in scope, including mission-oriented simulators, fixed analog datasets, task-specific environments, and open robotics interfaces. In this context, we present MarsLab, an open-source, ROS2-native Mars rover simulator for autonomy and navigation algorithm development. MarsLab combines HiRISE-derived and procedural terrain with customizable rock, crater, solar-illumination, and atmospheric-dust settings, and runs a Perseverance-class rover model in NVIDIA Isaac Sim. The runtime publishes RGB, depth, RGB-D point clouds, LiDAR, IMU, wheel odometry, and Ground Truth (GT) pose data through standard ROS2 topics. We demonstrate MarsLab with Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) benchmarks across sensing modalities, dust levels, scene geometry, and route length, and with Visual Place Recognition (VPR) benchmarks over repeated Mars Base traversals under illumination and dust changes. The results illustrate how controlled scene variation and shared GT trajectories can be used to compare trajectory-level estimation and image-level place recognition within the same simulator. Our Project Page: https://kimhoyun-robotair.github.io/MarsLab/.

AI.tldr: 提出 MarsLab：一个开源、ROS2 原生的火星车仿真器，基于 NVIDIA Isaac Sim，结合 HiRISE 衍生地形与程序化地形，可配置岩石、陨石坑、太阳光照和大气尘埃，并运行 Perseverance 级火星车模型。它通过标准 ROS2 话题发布 RGB、深度、RGB-D 点云、LiDAR、IMU、轮式里程计和真值位姿，并用于 SLAM 与 VPR 基准测试。
AI.motivation: 未来火星任务需要火星车在非结构化地形、变化光照、大气尘埃和有限通信条件下具备自主能力。仿真是在部署前研究这些条件的实用手段，但现有火星相关资源在范围上各不相同，包括任务导向仿真器、固定类比数据集、任务特定环境和开放机器人接口，因此需要一个更统一、开放且可配置的火星车自主导航仿真平台。
AI.method: MarsLab 是开源、ROS2 原生的火星车仿真器，运行于 NVIDIA Isaac Sim。它融合 HiRISE 衍生地形与程序化地形，提供可定制的岩石、陨石坑、太阳光照和大气尘埃设置，并使用 Perseverance 级火星车模型。运行时通过标准 ROS2 话题发布 RGB、深度、RGB-D 点云、LiDAR、IMU、轮式里程计和 Ground Truth 位姿数据。论文用 SLAM 基准测试覆盖不同传感模态、尘埃水平、场景几何和路线长度，并用 VPR 基准测试覆盖 Mars Base 重复穿越中的光照与尘埃变化。
AI.result: 结果表明，受控的场景变化和共享的真值轨迹可用于在同一仿真器中比较轨迹级估计（如 SLAM）和图像级地点识别（如 VPR）。摘要未给出具体定量指标，但展示了 MarsLab 在多传感模态、尘埃、几何和路线长度下的 SLAM 基准，以及光照和尘埃变化下的 VPR 基准能力。
AI.conclusion: MarsLab 为火星车自主与导航算法开发提供了一个开放、ROS2 原生、可配置的仿真平台，支持在统一环境中进行 SLAM 和 VPR 的可复现基准测试。项目页面为 https://kimhoyun-robotair.github.io/MarsLab/。

title: ExcavaTwin: Training-Free Geometry-Guided Semantic Elevation Mapping for Autonomous Excavation
summary: Autonomous excavation requires a spatial representation that jointly captures terrain geometry and task-relevant semantics. Existing excavation mapping is largely elevation-centric, while generic semantic models remain unstable in unstructured outdoor scenes. We present ExcavaTwin, a pure-vision geometry-guided semantic elevation mapping framework without excavation-specific training. Given multi-view RGB images, the framework: 1) reconstructs scene geometry and semantic observations using frozen vision models; 2) derives terrain and non-terrain geometric support; 3) performs geometry-constrained multi-view semantic fusion to suppress implausible predictions and recover incomplete observations; and 4) projects the fused state into a task-oriented semantic elevation map. Experiments on public datasets and real excavation scenes demonstrate reliable geometric and semantic perception. In real excavation, the system achieved an average update interval of approximately 1.4 s and a mean elevation error of 12.74cm in dynamically modified regions. Larger errors mainly occur during rapid terrain changes and transient visual disturbances caused by machine motion.

AI.tldr: 提出ExcavaTwin，一种纯视觉、几何引导的语义高程建图框架，无需挖掘专用训练即可实现自主挖掘场景的几何与语义感知。
AI.motivation: 自主挖掘需要同时捕捉地形几何与任务相关语义的空间表示；现有挖掘建图多侧重高程，通用语义模型在非结构化户外场景中不稳定。
AI.method: 输入多视角RGB图像：1）用冻结视觉模型重建场景几何与语义观测；2）推导地形与非地形的几何支撑；3）进行几何约束的多视角语义融合，抑制不合理预测并补全缺失观测；4）投影为任务导向的语义高程图。
AI.result: 在公开数据集和真实挖掘场景中验证了可靠的几何与语义感知；真实挖掘中平均更新间隔约1.4秒，动态变化区域平均高程误差为12.74厘米；较大误差主要出现在地形快速变化和机器运动引起的瞬态视觉干扰时。
AI.conclusion: 该框架无需挖掘专用训练即可实现可靠的几何与语义感知，适用于自主挖掘任务，但在快速地形变化和视觉干扰下仍有误差。

title: SynCo: Learning Cross-Modal Synergy by Contrasting Interaction Residuals
summary: Multimodal contrastive learning is a dominant paradigm for learning transferable representations from unlabeled data, but standard objectives primarily capture information that is redundant between modalities. Partial Information Decomposition (PID) shows that task-relevant information in multimodal data decomposes into three components: redundancy shared between modalities, uniqueness specific to each modality, and synergy available only from their joint observation. Recent frameworks extend contrastive learning to capture all three components, yet synergy remains undertrained in practice. We propose SynCo (Synergy Contrastive Learning), a method that directly addresses synergy undertraining through dedicated supervision on an interaction residual. SynCo fits a linear projector to predict the fused representation from independently computed unimodal features, and the resulting interaction residual, which removes the linearly unimodal-predictable component, receives dedicated contrastive supervision at negligible computational cost. On the controlled Trifeature benchmark, SynCo achieves state-of-the-art synergy capture with a $+5.98\%$ gain over the baseline, and on real-world benchmarks from MultiBench, DARai, and MM-IMDb, SynCo consistently outperforms or matches prior methods across diverse modality combinations and task types. The method operates as a plug-in to existing contrastive multimodal frameworks without modifying the underlying fusion architecture and can further improve synergy capture when combined with other methods.

AI.tldr: 提出SynCo方法，通过对交互残差进行对比监督，直接解决多模态对比学习中协同信息训练不足的问题，在多个基准上取得最优或相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 标准多模态对比学习主要捕捉模态间冗余信息，而部分信息分解表明任务相关信息包含冗余、独特性和协同三部分，其中协同信息在实践中训练不足。
AI.method: SynCo拟合一个线性投影器从独立计算的单模态特征预测融合表示，得到的交互残差（去除线性可预测的单模态部分）接受专门的对比监督，计算成本可忽略，可作为插件集成到现有框架。
AI.result: 在Trifeature基准上协同捕捉达到最优，比基线提升5.98%；在MultiBench、DARai和MM-IMDb等真实基准上，跨多种模态组合和任务类型持续优于或匹配先前方法，并可与其他方法结合进一步提升协同捕捉。
AI.conclusion: SynCo通过交互残差监督有效解决协同信息训练不足问题，无需修改融合架构即可作为插件使用，并能与其他方法结合增强协同捕捉。

title: Routing Drift Alone Does Not Diagnose Failure in Merged MoE LLMs
summary: Model merging efficiently combines specialized large language models (LLMs) without joint retraining, but can substantially alter expert routing in Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models. Such \emph{routing drift} is often interpreted as routing failure, raising a fundamental question that remains unclear: \emph{does routing drift after MoE merging actually indicate routing failure, and what evidence should justify repair?} We investigate these questions across DeepSeekMoE, OLMoE, and Qwen3-MoE proposing a routing analysis toolkit for controlled counterfactual interventions and token-level analysis. By crossing source and merged router inputs and parameters, we attribute most expert reassignments to input shifts rather than parameter changes at the same layer. However, source-relative routing differences poorly predict next-token likelihood gains from source-route restoration, and different expert selections can produce directionally similar mixture outputs. We therefore operationalize routing failure as \textit{task loss recoverable under a specified routing intervention, with non-routing parameters fixed.} These tests detect recoverable loss under deliberate router corruption, whereas source-route restoration does not establish reliable task benefits in the evaluated merged models. Motivated by these, we propose \emph{Selective Router Repair (SRR)} as a case study, and find that source-specialist token-likelihood advantages do not reliably identify beneficial local corrections. Together, these findings show that \textbf{routing drift alone is insufficient evidence of routing failure}: source-informed corrections must be judged by their task-level intervention effects. The analysis toolkit and SRR code are released.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究MoE大模型合并后的路由漂移是否真正代表路由失败，并提出路由分析工具包与选择性路由修复SRR案例，结论是路由漂移本身不足以证明路由失败，必须依据任务级干预效果判断。
AI.motivation: 模型合并可高效组合专家LLM而无需联合重训，但在MoE模型中会显著改变专家路由。路由漂移常被直接解释为路由失败，然而其是否真意味着失败、以及何种证据才应支持修复仍不清楚。
AI.method: 作者在DeepSeekMoE、OLMoE和Qwen3-MoE上提出路由分析工具包，进行受控反事实干预和token级分析；通过交叉源模型与合并模型的路由器输入和参数，归因专家重分配；并以固定非路由参数下指定路由干预可恢复的任务损失来操作化定义路由失败；还提出选择性路由修复SRR作为案例研究。
AI.result: 多数专家重分配归因于同层输入偏移而非参数变化；源相对路由差异难以预测源路由恢复带来的下一token似然增益，不同专家选择也可产生方向相似的混合输出。这些测试能在故意破坏路由器时检测可恢复损失，但源路由恢复在评估的合并模型中未建立可靠任务收益。SRR案例中，源专家token似然优势也无法可靠识别有益的局部修正。
AI.conclusion: 路由漂移本身不足以作为路由失败的证据；源信息启发的修正应由其任务级干预效果来评判。分析工具包和SRR代码已发布。

title: Unknown is not normal: separating language-model extraction from rule-based decision logic for clinical risk scores
comment: 14 pages (7 of main text), 5 figures, 2 tables, appendix included; full supplementary material in the code repository. Code: https://github.com/nicoveraz/calc-bounds (archived: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23004726)
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to compute clinical risk scores from free-text notes. Notes are often incomplete, and treating undocumented findings as normal can silently misclassify patients. We test whether separating three-state extraction (present, absent or unknown, by an LLM) from decision logic (deterministic code computing score bounds over unknown inputs) lets a system ask only questions that can change the decision. On 1,200 synthetic emergency cases across six calculators (HEART, CURB-65, qSOFA, PERC, Wells, Cockcroft-Gault), with a simulated clinician answering questions, we compared this bounds policy with asking for every missing input, a missing-equals-normal schema, and an end-to-end LLM agent (Claude Opus 5.5). With Claude Haiku 4.5 as extractor, the bounds policy matched ask-all accuracy (99.4% vs 99.4%) with half the questions (0.92 vs 1.78 per case) and no irrelevant ones. Treating missing as normal dropped accuracy to 91.2% and under-triaged 8.5% of patients (95% CI 7.1-10.2), and under-triage persisted under messy notes and a noisy clinician. The agent was equally accurate under ideal conditions (99.6%) but 9.5% of its questions were irrelevant; with a noisy clinician it was less accurate than the bounds policy (83.5% vs 87.0%, p<0.001) and committed prematurely in 2.7% of cases (bounds: 0%). A 9B local model as extractor reached oracle-level accuracy (99.8%). In 584 real case reports from MedCalc-Bench, only 52% contained enough information to determine the category (HEART 13%). Routing decisions through code that reasons explicitly about unknowns avoids premature commitment and irrelevant questions, halves the questions asked, and works with small local models.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出将三态信息抽取（存在、缺失/未知）与确定性决策逻辑分离，由代码计算未知输入下的风险评分边界，仅询问能改变决策的问题。在合成与真实病例上验证，该方法在保持高准确率的同时将提问数减半，并避免过早下结论。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型被越来越多用于从自由文本笔记中计算临床风险评分，但笔记常不完整；若把未记录项默认当作正常，会静默地错误分类患者，导致漏诊或分诊不足。
AI.method: 在1200个合成急诊病例、6个评分工具（HEART、CURB-65、qSOFA、PERC、Wells、Cockcroft-Gault）上，模拟临床医生回答提问，比较四种策略：边界策略（分离三态抽取与确定性边界计算）、询问所有缺失项、缺失即正常、端到端LLM智能体（Claude Opus 5.5）。抽取器使用Claude Haiku 4.5，另测试9B本地模型。并在584个MedCalc-Bench真实病例报告上评估信息充分性。
AI.result: 边界策略与询问所有缺失项准确率相同（99.4% vs 99.4%），但每例提问数减半（0.92 vs 1.78）且无无关问题；缺失即正常使准确率降至91.2%，8.5%患者被分诊不足（95% CI 7.1-10.2）。端到端智能体理想条件下准确率99.6%，但9.5%提问无关；在嘈杂临床医生下准确率低于边界策略（83.5% vs 87.0%，p<0.001），并在2.7%病例中过早下结论（边界策略为0%）。9B本地模型作为抽取器达oracle级准确率99.8%。真实病例中仅52%含足够信息确定类别（HEART仅13%）。
AI.conclusion: 将决策路由至显式推理未知信息的代码，可避免过早承诺与无关提问，将提问数减半，并能与小型本地模型配合使用。

title: PolyTopoBench: A Benchmark for Complex Vector Polygon Generation from Remote Sensing Imagery
comment: Accepted by NeurIPS 2026 (Evaluations and Datasets Track)
summary: Vector polygon generation converts visual inputs, e.g., remote sensing (RS) images, into vectorized polygonal geometries, supporting applications such as autonomous driving, vector map construction, and remote sensing. Early pipelines predict raster masks and post-process them into polygons, which prevents end-to-end optimization and may miss small objects or introduce inaccurate vertices. Recent methods directly generate vector polygons, but most focus on simple exterior contours, while they either cannot represent complex polygons with holes or fail to preserve their topology. In this paper, we propose PolyTopoBench, a unified evaluation framework for vector polygon generation from RS images with explicit emphasis on complex polygons. PolyTopoBench evaluates both exterior and interior rings, and benchmarks 11 representative methods, including segmentation-based polygonization pipelines, vision foundation model baselines, and specialized vector polygon generators, on two RS-image datasets covering buildings, roads, vegetation, and unvegetated regions. Experiments show that existing methods often recover simple exterior boundaries but degrade substantially on polygons with holes or multiple rings. These results reveal complex polygon generation as an unresolved challenge and motivate topology-aware benchmarks and model designs. Code and data are available at https://github.com/seai-lab/PolyTopoBench.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了PolyTopoBench，一个从遥感图像生成矢量多边形的统一评估框架，重点关注复杂多边形（含孔洞和多环），并对11种代表性方法在两个遥感数据集上进行了基准测试。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多关注简单外轮廓，难以表示带孔洞的复杂多边形或保持其拓扑结构，且缺乏针对复杂多边形的统一评估基准。
AI.method: 构建PolyTopoBench评估框架，同时评估外环和内环；在覆盖建筑、道路、植被和无植被区域的两个遥感图像数据集上，对11种方法（包括基于分割的多边形化流程、视觉基础模型基线和专用矢量多边形生成器）进行基准测试。
AI.result: 现有方法通常能恢复简单的外边界，但在处理带孔洞或多环的多边形时性能显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 复杂多边形生成仍是一个未解决的挑战，这推动了拓扑感知的基准测试和模型设计。代码和数据见https://github.com/seai-lab/PolyTopoBench。

title: Understanding Clinical Cognitive Dialogues Using Large Language Models
summary: In-person cognitive assessment is both a test and an interaction. Clinicians explain tasks, repair misunderstandings, and adapt to patient responses, while patients may hesitate, seek clarification, or disengage. Yet clinical dialogue resources rarely label the interaction structure needed to study these behaviors at scale. We present an de-identified corpus of 33 cognitive assessment conversations with 8,250 utterances annotated for three speaker roles and 56 dialogue acts. We use this corpus to benchmark large language models on fine-grained dialogue-act classification and next-patient-utterance generation. We also test whether out-of-domain instruction data and explanation-augmented training transfer to this clinical setting. Instruction tuning produces the strongest patient-utterance reference matching and improves classification accuracy. Reasoning-aware fine-tuning produces the strongest classification results among the LLaMA-3.1-8B variants. However, even the best models struggle to separate closely related dialogue acts, showing that broad conversational intent is easier to recognize than fine-grained communicative function. The corpus and benchmark make interaction structure measurable in cognitive assessments and support follow-up work on conversational markers, clinician education, and carefully validated simulated patients. This work does not make diagnostic claims. Instead, it provides the data and evaluation framework needed to study these applications.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布了一个去标识化的认知评估对话语料库，包含33段对话、8250条话语，标注了3种说话人角色和56种对话行为，并基于此对大型语言模型进行细粒度对话行为分类和下一句患者话语生成基准测试。
AI.motivation: 面对面认知评估既是测试也是互动，临床医生会解释任务、修复误解并适应患者反应，患者也可能犹豫、寻求澄清或脱离互动。然而现有临床对话资源很少标注研究这些行为所需的互动结构，难以大规模分析。
AI.method: 构建并发布去标识化认知评估对话语料库；标注说话人角色和对话行为；使用该语料库对大型语言模型进行对话行为分类和下一句患者话语生成基准测试；测试域外指令数据和解释增强训练是否能迁移到临床场景。
AI.result: 指令调优在患者话语参考匹配上表现最强，并提升分类准确率；在LLaMA-3.1-8B变体中，推理感知微调取得最佳分类结果。但即使最佳模型也难以区分 closely related dialogue acts，说明宽泛会话意图比细粒度交际功能更容易识别。
AI.conclusion: 该语料库和基准使认知评估中的互动结构可测量，支持后续关于会话标记、临床医生教育及经严格验证的模拟患者研究。本工作不作诊断性声明，而是提供研究这些应用所需的数据和评估框架。

title: DexWeave: Learning Dexterous Humanoid Loco-Manipulation from Human Demonstrations
summary: Learning dexterous humanoid loco-manipulation from human demonstrations requires transferring not only human motion, but also the coordinated interaction structure underlying the demonstrated behavior. This is challenging because embodiment differences distort the coupling among body motion, wrist placement, finger articulation, and object interaction, while kinematically accurate references may still be difficult to realize under robot dynamics. We present DexWeave, a unified framework that connects interaction-consistent motion retargeting with anatomy-aware whole-body policy learning. DexWeave first employs a two-stage retargeting procedure that initializes body and hand motions with specialized solvers and subsequently performs coupled refinement over the upper-body interaction chain while preserving lower-body support.
