Experiments on $π_{0.5}$ and GR00T N1.5 show that MINT significantly improves task success under camera loss over the original models. Experiments on AgiBot G2 further demonstrate the real-robot deployment under camera loss. The benchmark is available at https://minglejiang.github.io/Mail-Bench/

AI.tldr: 论文研究VLA模型在相机中断、视觉输入缺失时的机器人操作性能，提出评估基准MAIL-Bench和缓解方法MINT，并在π0.5、GR00T N1.5及AgiBot G2实机上验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型通常假设任务执行全过程所有相机均可用，但真实部署中相机可能中断，策略需在缺失后续视图的情况下继续动作。该问题对闭环操作影响重大，但仍缺乏系统理解与评估。
AI.method: 提出MAIL-Bench，在成功参考轨迹的多个阶段中断不同相机，评估VLA策略在视觉输入缺失时的能力保持情况；提出MINT，先训练VLA策略适应视觉缺失，推理时通过光流外推或动作条件世界模型选择性补充缺失观测，并在预测不可靠时撤回预测视图。
AI.result: 在π0.5和GR00T N1.5上的实验表明，MINT相比原始模型显著提升相机丢失下的任务成功率；在AgiBot G2上的实验进一步验证了相机丢失时的真实机器人部署。
AI.conclusion: 视觉中断是VLA闭环操作中重要且尚未充分研究的问题；MAIL-Bench提供了评估手段，MINT有效提升相机丢失下的鲁棒性，并具备实机部署可行性。

title: ReScraper: Unified Scraping and Cleaning of Web Data for Effective LLM Pretraining
summary: LLM pretraining corpora are normally cleaned by a stack of hand-written heuristics. A heuristic scraper extracts the main content from HTML, and dozens of rule-based filters then clean it, so corpus quality is capped by the coarseness and accuracy of the rules. In this work, we propose ReScraper, a unified language model of only 0.6B parameters that replaces this entire stack. To train ReScraper, we carefully curate supervised data from the outputs of three teacher models, so it learns to first extract the main content from raw data and then choose among four operations: keeping the page as extracted, editing out noisy lines and spans, deleting it entirely, or rewriting it when it is poorly written but informative. Based on the same crawled data pool, pretraining 400M, 1.4B, and 2.8B models on our curated data improves the DCLM Core score by a relative 3.8--4.7% over the strongest baseline at each scale, including the costly multi-agent curation. Our analyses show that each operation plays a distinct and complementary role, and that extracting and cleaning in one model outperforms a cascade of separate models. ReScraper also concentrates its operations on the pages that need them, raising the quality of poor pages the most while keeping the corpus diverse. These results demonstrate the feasibility and effectiveness of AI4AI for pretraining data curation, where a small learned model takes over an entire stage of the pipeline from hand-written heuristics. We open-source our code at https://github.com/cxcscmu/ReScraper

AI.tldr: ReScraper 是一个仅 0.6B 参数的统一语言模型，用于替代 LLM 预训练语料清洗中的整套手工启发式流程；它先提取网页正文，再选择保留、编辑、删除或重写四种操作，并在多个模型规模上提升预训练数据质量与下游评测表现。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 预训练语料通常依赖手工启发式抓取器和大量规则过滤器进行清洗，语料质量受限于规则的粗糙度与准确率，因此需要更统一、可学习的数据整理方法。
AI.method: 提出 ReScraper：从三个教师模型输出中精心构建监督数据，训练 0.6B 模型学习先抽取网页主要内容，再在四种操作中选择：保留抽取结果、编辑去除噪声行和片段、整页删除、或对写得差但有信息量的页面进行重写。基于同一爬取数据池，用 400M、1.4B、2.8B 模型进行预训练验证。
AI.result: 在 DCLM Core 分数上，相比各规模最强基线取得 3.8%–4.7% 的相对提升，包括昂贵的多智能体清洗方法；分析显示四种操作互补，统一抽取与清洗优于分离模型级联，且操作集中在需要处理的页面上，对差页面质量提升最大，同时保持语料多样性。
AI.conclusion: 结果证明了 AI4AI 用于预训练数据整理的可行性与有效性，小型学习模型可以接管整个手工启发式阶段；代码已开源。

title: Oracle Gaps in Reliability Coverage: Sampling Noise or Policy Specialization?
summary: Policies trained from the same base model can appear to solve different problems. An oracle that chooses the best policy for each problem may therefore appear much stronger than any single policy. Selecting the largest estimated success rate also selects favorable sampling errors. We study this effect through reliability coverage, the fraction of problems whose success probability reaches a chosen threshold. Our first test redistributes stored correctness outcomes across policies within each problem. A second also preserves each policy's total successes, accounting for overall quality differences under a specified statistical model. For five training seeds of a seven-billion-parameter vision-language model, redistribution reproduces 0.096 of an estimated 0.113 oracle gap at threshold 0.10. Neither test finds significant evidence at this threshold. Small advantages remain unresolved. Mixtures, routers, voting, and weight averaging show no detectable improvement over their corresponding single-policy baselines. Training policies on different datasets shows little detectable specialization under light post-training, and no router gain. A stronger recipe does create it, both tests detect it, and a router gain appears only at the high thresholds where the specialists separate. In a control with predictable specialization, a router recovers about half the oracle gap. Coverage bounds explain why even a genuine oracle advantage need not yield a deployment gain. The tests assess apparent specialization from stored responses before investment in routing. Code: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/oracle-gaps

AI.tldr: 研究同一基座模型训练出的不同策略是否只是看似专门化：通过可靠性覆盖率和两类重分配检验评估 oracle 差距，并检验路由、混合、投票、权重平均等是否带来真实可部署收益。
AI.motivation: 同一基座模型的不同策略在同一问题上成功率不同，选择最大估计成功率会放大有利的抽样误差，使 oracle 看似远强于任何单一策略；需要判断表观专门化和 oracle 优势是否真实、是否可转化为部署收益。
AI.method: 提出可靠性覆盖率，即成功概率达到指定阈值的题目比例。设计两个检验：一是每题内重分配已存储的正确性结果；二是在指定统计模型下保持各策略总成功数，控制整体质量差异。对五个训练种子的七十亿参数视觉语言模型评估，并比较 mixture、router、voting、weight averaging 与单策略基线；另做不同数据集训练、更强训练配方和可预测专门化对照。
AI.result: 阈值 0.10 下，重分配复现估计 oracle 差距 0.113 中的 0.096，两个检验均不显著。Mixture、router、voting、weight averaging 相对对应单策略基线无可检测提升。轻量后训练下跨数据集专门化不明显且无 router 收益；更强配方产生专门化，两个检验均可检测，router 收益仅在高阈值专家分离时出现。可预测专门化对照中，router 恢复约一半 oracle 差距。覆盖率界解释真实 oracle 优势未必带来部署收益。
AI.conclusion: 表观专门化常可由采样误差解释；可用存储响应在投资路由前评估其真实性；即使存在真实 oracle 优势，受覆盖率限制也不一定转化为部署收益。

title: TRACE: Learning to Self-Calibrate Wireless Digital Twins from ISAC Measurements
summary: Wireless digital twins (DTs) rely on 3D environment models to predict radio propagation and support wireless-network decisions, yet these models are often initialized from imperfect 3D maps. Errors in building position, height, footprint, and orientation can therefore cause a high-fidelity propagation engine to simulate the wrong physical environment. In this paper, we study how a deployed wireless network can repair an existing DT using its own radio frequency (RF) measurements. In particular, we introduce Twin Residual Alignment and Calibration Engine (TRACE), a physics-grounded learning-based self-calibration framework that treats twin maintenance as residual alignment between the physical world and the current DT. Using the same sensing configuration as the physical measurements, TRACE ray-traces the current DT, coherently backprojects the measured and simulated RF onto a common world grid, and extracts the same local region around each building's current DT position. A multi-view corrector then fuses evidence across sensing nodes and neighboring buildings to predict a gated six-parameter correction per building, without relying on absolute layout or sensor ordering, and supports iterative correction through re-rendering. On 5,400 held-out samples from unseen simulated scenes at 28 GHz, TRACE reduces 3D position RMSE from 2.202 m to 0.302 m and yaw RMSE from 4.978° to 0.894°, outperforming ViT and U-Net baselines under changes in layout, building count, sensing-node count, and SNR. On measured 28 GHz RF data from the NIST outdoor courtyard, a model trained only on synthetic RF reduces mean planar wall-position error from 1.00 m to 7.8 cm, without measured-data fine-tuning or geometric labels. These results show that the discrepancy between measured and twin-rendered RF can serve as a learning signal for repairing a wireless DT.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TRACE框架，利用无线网络自身的射频测量来自校准数字孪生中的3D环境模型，通过残差对齐修复建筑位置、高度、朝向等参数。
AI.motivation: 无线数字孪生依赖3D环境模型预测无线电传播，但初始3D地图常不完美，建筑位置、高度、轮廓和朝向误差会导致高保真传播引擎模拟错误的物理环境。
AI.method: TRACE将孪生维护视为物理世界与当前孪生体之间的残差对齐。它使用与物理测量相同的传感配置对当前孪生体进行射线追踪，将测量和模拟的射频相干反向投影到共同的世界网格，并围绕每个建筑当前位置提取局部区域。多视角校正器融合跨传感节点和邻近建筑的证据，预测每个建筑的门控六参数校正，不依赖绝对布局或传感器顺序，并通过重渲染支持迭代校正。
AI.result: 在28 GHz下未见模拟场景的5400个保留样本上，TRACE将3D位置RMSE从2.202米降至0.302米，偏航角RMSE从4.978°降至0.894°，在布局、建筑数量、传感节点数量和SNR变化下优于ViT和U-Net基线。在NIST室外庭院的实测28 GHz RF数据上，仅用合成RF训练的模型将平均平面墙壁位置误差从1.00米降至7.8厘米，无需实测数据微调或几何标签。
AI.conclusion: 测量与孪生渲染RF之间的差异可以作为学习信号，用于修复无线数字孪生。

title: Do Not Cut When Uncertain: Rejectable and Calibrated Decision Heads for VLA Policies in Robotic Harvesting
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies trained with behavior cloning or flow matching are optimized to output an action trajectory, but they cannot express "I don't know" or "I should not act." In robotic harvesting, occlusion makes single-frame decisions fundamentally ambiguous: identical pixels can correspond either to a cuttable stem or to no stem at all. Existing VLAs are forced to commit, leading to high-confidence errors with irreversible consequences. We argue that the failure mode of a VLA is determined not by backbone scale but by its output interface. We propose Rejectable and Calibrated Decision Heads (RCDH), a typed, rejectable, and calibrated output interface that can be attached to a frozen VLA backbone without retraining or new features. RCDH introduces (i) a decision schema with explicit rejection and ordered, conditional decomposition, and (ii) a calibration procedure for risk-aware abstention. We evaluate RCDH on a robotic harvesting platform with controllable leaf occlusion, comparing generative, enumerated, calibrated, and rejectable interfaces. We show that replacing only the output head restores out-of-distribution usability under occlusion while preserving in-distribution performance. We further test whether the ordering of the rejection space is critical. Our results suggest that the right to refuse, rather than a larger model, is the missing interface for reliable manipulation under uncertainty.

AI.tldr: 论文提出可拒绝且校准的决策头（RCDH），可附加在冻结的 VLA 主干上，通过显式拒绝与有序条件分解来输出决策，以解决机器人采摘中遮挡导致的模糊和高置信错误。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLA 策略用行为克隆或流匹配输出动作轨迹，却无法表达“我不知道”或“我不该行动”。在机器人采摘中，遮挡使单帧决策本质模糊：相同像素可能对应可切茎，也可能没有茎。现有 VLA 被迫做出承诺，导致不可逆的高置信错误。
AI.method: 提出 RCDH，一种类型化、可拒绝且校准的输出接口，无需重训练或新特征即可接在冻结 VLA 主干上。其包含：带显式拒绝和有序条件分解的决策模式，以及面向风险感知弃权的校准流程。在可控叶片遮挡的机器人采摘平台上，比较生成式、枚举式、校准式和可拒绝式接口，并检验拒绝空间排序是否关键。
AI.result: 仅替换输出头即可在遮挡下恢复分布外可用性，同时保持分布内性能；研究还测试了拒绝空间排序的重要性，表明输出接口而非仅模型规模决定失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在不确定条件下实现可靠操作，缺失的关键接口是“拒绝的权利”，而不是更大的模型。

title: EMPIRIC: Experiment-Driven Learning of Residual World Models for Robot Planning
comment: The last two authors contributed equally as co-advisors. Website and code: https://yichao-liang.github.io/empiric
summary: A robot should be able to learn through experiments how unfamiliar objects behave and interact, then plan with that knowledge. It need not start from scratch: physics engines supply knowledge of motion and contact, but can omit entire mechanisms, such as glue curing, water heating, or wind. We present EMPIRIC, an agent that learns a residual world model: a physics engine extended with code for the missing mechanisms. The learned programs can introduce new forces, constraints, and hidden state, and Bayesian inference estimates their parameters and states from noisy observations. The resulting model lets the agent predict the outcomes of actions, choose informative experiments, and revise its hypotheses when predictions fail. Across five simulated domains, EMPIRIC learns interpretable, reusable models, and solves more tasks with fewer environment interactions than all three baselines. On a physical robot, it learns wind forces and domino masses to solve a manipulation task. Website and code: https://yichao-liang.github.io/empiric

AI.tldr: EMPIRIC 通过为物理引擎学习残余世界模型，补充缺失的机制（如胶水固化、水加热、风），使机器人能预测动作结果、选择实验并修正假设。
AI.motivation: 机器人需要学习陌生物体的行为，但物理引擎可能遗漏某些机制（如胶水固化、水加热、风），因此需要一种方法扩展物理引擎以包含这些缺失机制。
AI.method: 提出 EMPIRIC 智能体，学习残余世界模型：在物理引擎基础上添加学习到的程序代码，引入新力、约束和隐藏状态，并用贝叶斯推断从噪声观测中估计参数和状态。
AI.result: 在五个模拟域中，EMPIRIC 学习到可解释、可复用的模型，比三个基线用更少的环境交互解决更多任务；在物理机器人上，学会了风力与多米诺骨牌质量，完成操作任务。
AI.conclusion: EMPIRIC 能有效学习物理引擎中缺失的机制，提升机器人的预测、实验设计和规划能力。

title: Dr.Credit: Rubric-Grounded Process Credit Assignment for Deep Research Agents
summary: Rubric-based tasks are increasingly addressed through reinforcement learning (RL), with rubric scores used as training rewards. However, these rewards typically supervise final answers without distinguishing the contributions of intermediate decisions. Many existing credit assignment methods rely on ground-truth answers to define process rewards, limiting their applicability to open-ended tasks without canonical solutions. To address this limitation, the proposed rubric-grounded credit uses task requirements as a shared reference for final answer evaluation and process supervision. The information returned by tools is assessed for the additional support it provides toward satisfying each rubric relative to that rubric's history of accepted support. By referencing these histories, credit distinguishes new support from evidence already present in the trajectory while recognizing partial support for each rubric. Dr.Credit uses rubric-grounded credit to supervise intermediate tool turns in an RL framework for deep research agents. The resulting process advantages are combined with GRPO outcome advantages to guide research decisions while retaining supervision of final-report quality. Evaluations on four in-domain and out-of-domain benchmarks show that Dr.Credit outperforms the evaluated open deep research baselines on every primary metric and submetric. Meanwhile, with an 8B-parameter backbone, the trained agent achieves average performance competitive with the evaluated frontier proprietary models. Further analyses suggest more efficient evidence acquisition and higher-quality reports under limited research-turn budgets, motivating the extension of rubric-grounded process supervision to a broader range of rubric-based tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Dr.Credit，一种基于评分标准（rubric）的信用分配方法，用于深度研究智能体的强化学习训练，通过评估工具返回信息对各评分标准的增量支持来监督中间工具调用，并与 GRPO 的结果优势结合，提升研究决策与最终报告质量。
AI.motivation: 现有基于评分标准的强化学习通常只用评分监督最终答案，难以区分中间决策的贡献；且许多过程奖励方法依赖标准答案来定义过程奖励，不适用于没有唯一解的开放式任务。
AI.method: 提出 rubric-grounded credit：以任务要求作为最终答案评估和过程监督的共同参考，针对每个评分标准维护已接受支持的历史，判断工具返回信息是新增支持、已有证据还是部分支持；在强化学习框架中用该信用监督深度研究智能体的中间工具轮次，并将过程优势与 GRPO 的结果优势结合。
AI.result: 在四个域内和域外基准上，Dr.Credit 在所有主要指标和子指标上均优于所评估的开源深度研究基线；使用 8B 参数骨干时，平均性能可与所评估的前沿专有模型竞争。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，基于评分标准的过程监督能带来更高效的证据获取和更高质量的报告，尤其在有限研究轮次预算下效果明显，因此可推广到更广泛的基于评分标准的任务。

title: Diagnosing Sampled LLM Reasoning in Formal Geometry: Coverage, Realization, and Validity Evidence
summary: Repeated sampling can reveal a correct numerical answer without yielding either a reliable system output or a supported derivation. We present Coverage, Realization, and Validity Evidence (CRV), an evaluation protocol for sampled large language model (LLM) reasoning over formal geometry states. Coverage is answer availability, realization is readout accuracy on the frozen candidate pool, and validity evidence is a label-blinded critic judgment of derivational support rather than a proof certificate. CRV freezes each candidate pool before comparing readouts and analyzes covered failures by correct-answer multiplicity and within-problem discrimination. On HardShift441, a 441-problem set for which a reference solver leaves 406 problems unsolved, a LoRA-adapted Qwen2.5-7B generator obtains 24.2% average single-sample accuracy and 68.9% pass@16, whereas verifier-weighted self-consistency (WSC) reaches 38.0%. Readout accuracy is particularly low when the correct answer occurs only once or twice in the pool. In a separate constructed audit of 195 covered problems, the critic labels 12 correct-answer representatives as supported, 181 as refuted, and two as uncertain. These results show that coverage, realization, and validity evidence from the critic are distinct quantities and should be reported separately.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CRV评估协议，用于评估LLM在形式几何状态上的采样推理，将答案覆盖率、候选池读出准确率和推导有效性证据分开衡量。
AI.motivation: 重复采样可能得到正确的数值答案，但这并不代表系统输出可靠或推导过程得到支持，因此需要区分答案可得性、读出准确性和推导有效性。
AI.method: 提出Coverage、Realization、Validity Evidence（CRV）协议；在冻结候选池前比较读出；分析覆盖失败的正确答案多重性和问题内区分度；使用HardShift441数据集、LoRA微调的Qwen2.5-7B生成器、验证器加权自一致性（WSC）以及标签盲审批评者判断推导支持。
AI.result: 在HardShift441上，单样本平均准确率为24.2%，pass@16为68.9%，WSC达到38.0%；当正确答案在候选池中仅出现一两次时读出准确率尤其低。在195个覆盖问题的审计中，批评者将12个正确答案代表标为有支持，181个标为被反驳，2个标为不确定。
AI.conclusion: 覆盖率、读出实现和批评者提供的有效性证据是不同量，应分别报告。

title: Safety-Constrained Cascade Inference for Robust Malaria Cell Classification Under Field Corruptions
comment: 28 pages, 6 figures, 8 tables. Code available at https://github.com/josehagbe3/MalariaVision
summary: Automated malaria diagnosis from thin blood-smear microscopy could meaningfully reduce the burden on under-resourced laboratories, but a model that maximises accuracy on clean laboratory images fails badly the moment an inexpensive smartphone camera introduces sensor noise. This paper introduces MalariaCascade, a two-stage inference system in which a lightweight MobileNetV2 sentinel (2,225,153 parameters) makes confident classifications at low compute cost and escalates uncertain cases to an EfficientNet-B3 expert (10,697,769 parameters) that sees only clean, standardised images regardless of how corrupted the incoming frame is. Structural isolation of the expert stage, not learned robustness, is the mechanism. The sentinel is trained under a safety-score objective that places an explicit floor on Recall(Parasitised) (>=0.95) and Recall(Uninfected) (>=0.40) before precision is optimised, ensuring the checkpoint satisfies clinical safety constraints by construction. On the NIH Malaria Cell Images Dataset (27,558 cells), the cascade reaches Accuracy=0.9736, Recall(Parasitised)=0.9570, Precision(Parasitised)=0.9912, F1=0.9738, and AUROC=0.9955 on the clean test set. Under Gaussian sensor noise at full severity, cascade Recall(Parasitised) degrades by only 2.4 pp (0.9570 to 0.9329), while the flat single-model baseline collapses by 63.0 pp (0.9584 to 0.3281). McNemar's test confirms the cascade improvement is statistically significant (chi^2=11.14, p=0.00085). An ablation isolating the structural property shows that routing clean images to the expert is responsible for a 16.8 pp Recall(Parasitised) advantage under sensor noise relative to a cascade where the expert also sees corrupted inputs.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MalariaCascade 两级推理系统，用轻量 MobileNetV2 哨兵模型处理低计算量、置信度高的样本，并把不确定样本升级给 EfficientNet-B3 专家模型；专家模型始终只处理干净、标准化图像，从而提升低成本智能手机噪声场景下的疟疾诊断鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 自动化薄血涂片疟疾诊断可减轻资源不足实验室负担，但仅在干净实验室图像上追求高精度的模型，在廉价智能手机摄像头引入传感器噪声时会严重失效。
AI.method: 构建两阶段级联：MobileNetV2 哨兵（2,225,153 参数）做低成本置信分类，不确定样本交由 EfficientNet-B3 专家（10,697,769 参数）处理；专家阶段通过结构隔离只接收干净、标准化图像。哨兵采用 safety-score 目标训练，先保证 Recall(Parasitised)>=0.95 和 Recall(Uninfected)>=0.40，再优化精确率。
AI.result: 在 NIH Malaria Cell Images Dataset（27,558 个细胞）上，干净测试集达到 Accuracy=0.9736、Recall(Parasitised)=0.9570、Precision(Parasitised)=0.9912、F1=0.9738、AUROC=0.9955。全严重度高斯传感器噪声下，级联的 Recall(Parasitised) 仅下降 2.4 个百分点（0.9570 到 0.9329），而单模型基线下降 63.0 个百分点（0.9584 到 0.3281）；McNemar 检验显示级联提升显著（chi^2=11.14, p=0.00085）。消融显示，将干净图像路由至专家带来传感器噪声下 16.8 个百分点的 Recall(Parasitised) 优势。
AI.conclusion: 结构隔离专家阶段而非学习鲁棒性，是级联在传感器噪声下保持性能的关键机制；该方法在保证临床安全约束的同时显著提升疟疾自动诊断对廉价成像噪声的鲁棒性。

title: The Commit-Abstain Circuit: Why Language Models Hallucinate Instead of Abstaining
summary: Language models (LMs) often hallucinate by committing to confident answers rather than abstaining, even when they do not have enough information to answer reliably. A large body of existing work mitigates hallucination through detection or abstention mechanisms, but leaves open how models internally arrive at the decision to commit or abstain in the first place. We study this decision through mechanistic analysis, framing hallucination as unsupported commitment: the model commits despite exhibiting signals of unanswerability. Using causal gating, we identify a Commit-Abstain Circuit (CAC), a sparse, causally localised subset of attention heads and MLP sublayers underlying this decision. Across ten LMs (3B-14B) from five families and three benchmarks, the CAC exhibits a recurring accumulate-yet-undercorrect pattern: commitment-promoting components build up commitment in earlier layers, while abstention-promoting components act later as corrective signals that are often insufficient to overturn the accumulated commitment. Building on this finding, a lightweight policy trained on CAC activations improves decision accuracy by 12.2 points over the model's intrinsic commit-abstain margin, reduces false abstentions by 2.5 times, transfers to unseen benchmarks, and extends to larger models (27B-35B). The CAC is both diagnostic, clarifying how models overcommit, and practical, enabling improved abstention decisions.

AI.tldr: 该研究将幻觉视为无支持的承诺，通过机制分析识别出Commit-Abstain Circuit（CAC），揭示模型承诺与弃答决策的内部机制，并基于此训练轻量策略以改善弃答决策。
AI.motivation: 语言模型常在没有足够信息时仍自信作答而不弃答，现有检测或弃答方法未解释模型内部如何形成承诺或弃答的决定。
AI.method: 采用因果门控进行机制分析，在五个模型家族、十个模型（3B-14B）和三个基准上识别由注意力头与MLP子层组成的稀疏因果局部电路CAC；并基于CAC激活训练轻量策略。
AI.result: CAC呈现“累积但校正不足”模式：早期层促进承诺，后期层弃答信号常不足以推翻累积承诺。基于CAC的策略将决策准确率提升12.2个百分点，减少2.5倍假弃答，可迁移到未见基准，并扩展到27B-35B更大模型。
AI.conclusion: CAC既具有诊断价值，可解释模型如何过度承诺，也具有实用价值，可改善弃答决策并缓解幻觉。

title: Certified Interface Aliases: Exact Collisions in Vision-Language Preprocessing, and When They Exist
summary: Vision-language verifiers and routers must distinguish errors repairable by more reasoning from those caused by visual evidence never reaching the language model. This distinction lacks ground truth because annotators see full-resolution images while models receive preprocessed tensors. We introduce AliasForge to create cases where the relevant fact is provably absent from the interface. Fixed-point resampling makes the pre-rounding resize an exact integer linear map that can send nonzero integer perturbations to zero. Hiding a label-flipping perturbation there produces images with opposite step-correctness labels but bit-identical interface states. Every verifier therefore has the same output law on both members, giving pair-balanced accuracy exactly one half and zero gain from language-side repair. We prove that every fixed-point downscaler has such null vectors and bound their smallest size at the most common ratios, which rules out an 8-bit fit whenever the bound exceeds 255. From the resize configuration alone, a lattice criterion supplies realizable collisions and certifies their absence within the specified construction family. It resolves all 20 screened configurations, 17 as constructible and 3 as non-constructible. We construct certified pairs across three architectures and certify four additional processors, with zero decision-logit gap on all 18 scored pairs and none of the 18 controls. The pairs also screen routers that waste computation on re-attention or further reasoning. On natural items, per-item routing headroom exists, but no tested interface-only router improves over stopping. Our fiber ceiling bounds the headroom recoverable from the interface. Code: https://github.com/KurbanIntelligenceLab/aliasforge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AliasForge，通过固定点重采样构造“接口状态相同但标签相反”的图像对，证明仅凭预处理后的接口无法区分某些视觉证据缺失导致的错误，并给出可构造性与检测方法。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言验证器与路由器需要区分两类错误：可通过更多推理修复的错误，以及视觉证据根本未进入语言模型的错误。但这一区分缺乏真实标注，因为标注者看到全分辨率图像，而模型只接收预处理后的张量。
AI.method: 提出 AliasForge：利用固定点重采样使预舍入缩放成为整数线性映射，可将非零整数扰动映为零。将翻转标签的扰动隐藏在该映射的零空间中，生成步骤正确性标签相反、但接口状态逐位相同的图像对。进一步用格理论准则从缩放配置判断可实现碰撞的存在性，并构造认证样本对。
AI.result: 所有验证器在这类样本对上的输出分布相同，配对平衡准确率恰为 0.5，语言侧修复收益为零。证明每个固定点降采样器都存在此类零向量，并给出常见比例下最小尺寸界；当界超过 255 时可排除 8 位拟合。20 个筛选配置中 17 个可构造、3 个不可构造。跨三种架构构造认证样本对，并认证四个额外处理器；18 个评分对决策 logit 差均为零，18 个控制组均无此现象。此类样本对也能筛选路由器，暴露其在重注意或继续推理上的无效计算。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖接口的验证与路由存在根本上限：自然样本上虽存在逐项路由空间，但没有测试的接口-only 路由器能优于停止；论文给出的 fiber ceiling 界定了可从接口恢复的余量。

title: QuadHand: A Compact Quadrotor Aerial Manipulator with MRC-SDF-Based Whole-Body Motion Planning
summary: Uncrewed aerial manipulators (UAMs) integrate robotic arms with aerial platforms for three-dimensional physical interaction. However, enlarging the workspace increases arm-induced disturbances, while existing geometric representations face a trade-off between geometric fidelity and computational efficiency in close-proximity interaction. This paper presents QuadHand, a compact quadrotor aerial manipulator with a 3-DoF arm, gripper, and battery-assisted passive CoG compensation module to reduce dominant arm-induced disturbances. We further propose MRC-SDF, a Multi-articulated Robot-Centric Signed Distance Field that preserves fine geometric detail with tractable computation, and a spatiotemporal whole-body trajectory optimization framework that jointly optimizes the quadrotor and manipulator for safe and executable trajectory generation. Simulations and real-world experiments demonstrate safe and executable aerial manipulation in complex environments.

AI.tldr: 提出QuadHand紧凑型四旋翼空中机械臂，集成3自由度机械臂、夹爪和电池辅助被动重心补偿模块，并设计MRC-SDF与时空全身轨迹优化框架，实现复杂环境下的安全可执行空中操作。
AI.motivation: 空中机械臂用于三维物理交互，但扩大工作空间会加剧机械臂引起的扰动；现有几何表示在近距离交互中难以兼顾几何保真度与计算效率。
AI.method: 设计QuadHand平台，包含3-DoF机械臂、夹爪和电池辅助被动CoG补偿模块以减小主要臂致扰动；提出多关节机器人中心符号距离场MRC-SDF，在可计算前提下保留精细几何细节；提出时空全身轨迹优化框架，联合优化四旋翼与机械臂以生成安全且可执行的轨迹。
AI.result: 仿真和真实世界实验表明，该方法能够在复杂环境中实现安全且可执行的空中操作。
AI.conclusion: QuadHand、MRC-SDF与全身轨迹优化相结合，可有效缓解臂致扰动并提升近距几何表示效率，支撑复杂环境中的空中操作任务。

title: Residual Diffusion Implicit Models
comment: 38 pages, 17 figures. Implementation available at https://github.com/joaolcguerreiro/RDIM
summary: Diffusion models achieve state-of-the-art results across multiple tasks. However, in inverse problems, standard initialization from pure Gaussian noise misaligns the generative process with real-world degradations. More recent methods such as diffusion bridges impose strict endpoint constraints and often require long reverse processes that are prone to hallucinations. Alternative consistency models provide noise-invariant, one-step mappings but lack inherent variance modeling and can degrade under severe corruption. Hence, residual diffusion implicit models (RDIMs) are proposed, constituting a generalized framework that explicitly models the residuals between high-quality (HQ) and low-quality (LQ) images, aligning the forward process with the actual degradation. A non-Markovian implicit reverse sampler is derived, which can skip intermediate timesteps, enabling accurate few-step or even single-step reconstruction, while mitigating the hallucinations inherent to long diffusion chains. RDIM also introduces a controllable variance mechanism that interpolates between deterministic and stochastic sampling, balancing fidelity and diversity. Furthermore, it enables the straightforward use of perceptual losses, when needed. Experiments on denoising and super-resolution benchmarks demonstrate that RDIMs consistently outperforms the state of the art, including bridge and consistency models, in terms of PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS, reducing hallucinations while requiring only a few sampling steps (often just one). The results position RDIMs as an efficient solution for a broad range of image restoration tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出残差扩散隐式模型（RDIM），用于图像逆问题与复原任务，通过显式建模高质量图像与低质量图像之间的残差，实现少步甚至单步的高质量重建，并在去噪和超分任务上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 标准扩散模型从纯高斯噪声初始化，与真实退化过程不对齐；扩散桥方法端点约束严格且反向过程长，容易产生幻觉；一致性模型虽可一步映射但缺乏方差建模，在严重损坏下性能下降。
AI.method: 提出RDIM通用框架，显式建模高质量与低质量图像间的残差，使前向过程匹配实际退化；推导非马尔可夫隐式反向采样器，可跳过中间时间步，支持少步或单步重建并减少长扩散链的幻觉；引入可控方差机制，在确定性与随机采样间插值以平衡保真度和多样性；并支持使用感知损失。
AI.result: 在去噪和超分辨率基准上，RDIM在PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS指标上一致优于当前最优方法，包括扩散桥和一致性模型，同时减少幻觉，且通常仅需少数采样步甚至一步。
AI.conclusion: RDIM可作为广泛图像复原任务的高效解决方案，在保持高质量重建的同时显著降低采样成本。

title: CRISP: Cultural Reward Modeling for Implicit Situated Propriety
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed across countries and regions, the ability to recognize and respond appropriately to diverse cultural contexts becomes increasingly important. However, existing research has largely focused on cultural knowledge or tasks with predefined response spaces, while open-ended culturally situated behavior remains comparatively underexplored. In this work, we introduce CRISP-RM, a culturally situated reward model that assigns rewards according to cultural appropriateness in open-ended social scenarios. During policy optimization, we further introduce Norm Grounding Supervision (NGS), providing guidance that enhances the policy's sensitivity to relevant cultural norms. To construct culturally situated data, we employ a collaborative multi-agent framework that instantiates implicit cultural norms into diverse social scenarios and further curate NormCompass as a dedicated testbed. We conduct comprehensive experiments to evaluate the effectiveness of CRISP-RM in both reward modeling and policy optimization. Best-of-\(N\) experiments show that CRISP-RM consistently outperforms strong general reward models. During GRPO policy optimization, CRISP-RM generally improves culturally situated behavior, while incorporating NGS yields further gains. Further analyses demonstrate the advantages of CRISP-RM in distinguishing culturally appropriate behavior beyond superficial fluency and politeness, while NGS provides complementary gains during policy optimization by improving norm grounding.

AI.tldr: 论文提出文化情境化奖励模型 CRISP-RM 与规范锚定监督 NGS，并构建多智能体数据生成框架和 NormCompass 测试集，用于评估和优化大语言模型在开放式社交场景中的文化适应性行为。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型在全球不同国家和地区部署，模型需要理解和适应多样文化语境。但现有研究多关注文化知识或预设回答空间的任务，对开放式、文化情境化行为的探索仍不足。
AI.method: 提出 CRISP-RM，根据开放式社交场景中的文化适当性给予奖励；在策略优化中引入 Norm Grounding Supervision（NGS），增强策略对相关文化规范的敏感性；采用协作式多智能体框架将隐含文化规范实例化为多样社交场景，并构建 NormCompass 测试平台。
AI.result: Best-of-N 实验表明 CRISP-RM 持续优于强通用奖励模型；在 GRPO 策略优化中，CRISP-RM 总体改善文化情境化行为，加入 NGS 后进一步提升。分析显示，CRISP-RM 能超越表面流畅性和礼貌性来区分文化适当行为，NGS 通过改善规范锚定提供互补增益。
AI.conclusion: CRISP-RM 能有效用于文化情境化奖励建模与策略优化，NGS 可进一步增强规范锚定能力。该工作为开放式文化适应性行为评估与优化提供了新方法、数据和测试平台。

title: ReCAT: Remember, Count, and Time: Structured Recurrent Memory for Robot Manipulation
summary: Memory-dependent manipulation requires robots to make decisions using information that is no longer available to their current sensors, such as recalling an earlier visual cue, tracking task progress, counting repeated events, or estimating elapsed time. We present ReCAT, a language-conditioned policy with structured recurrent memory. An instruction-conditioned encoder forms features from the current observation. A recurrent memory integrates the observation stream through Mamba-2 layers and one causal attention layer. A flow-matching Transformer decoder reads the current and the historical representation through separate cross-attention in every block. ReCAT reaches 95.3\% average success on LIBERO and 62.4\% on RMBench, with the best or tied-best result on six of nine tasks. On three real-robot tasks probing spatial recall, event counting, and interval timing, the best ReCAT variant reaches 66.7\% average success, against 8.3\% for the strongest short-history baseline. Controlled comparisons within ReCAT show that the observation encoder and every-block memory conditioning are needed for this performance. They also show that update rules developed for efficient sequence modeling behave differently as robot memory: additive updates have the highest observed success on counting and timing, and delta-rule updates on spatial recall. Project website is at https://intuitive-robots.github.io/ReCAT

AI.tldr: 提出ReCAT——一种带结构化循环记忆的语言条件机器人策略，通过Mamba-2与因果注意力层整合历史观测，并用流匹配Transformer解码器在每层分别交叉注意当前与历史表征，在LIBERO、RMBench及真实机器人记忆任务上取得领先表现。
AI.motivation: 许多机器人操作任务依赖当前传感器已无法获取的信息，如回忆早前视觉线索、跟踪任务进度、计数重复事件或估计经过时间，因此需要具备记忆能力的策略。
AI.method: ReCAT由指令条件编码器提取当前观测特征；循环记忆模块用Mamba-2层和一个因果注意力层整合观测流；流匹配Transformer解码器在每个块中通过独立交叉注意力分别读取当前与历史表征。
AI.result: 在LIBERO上平均成功率95.3%，RMBench上62.4%，在九个任务中的六个取得最佳或并列最佳；在空间回忆、事件计数和时间间隔三项真实机器人任务上，最佳ReCAT变体平均成功率66.7%，而最强短历史基线仅8.3%。消融表明观测编码器和每块记忆条件化对性能必要；加法更新在计数与计时上表现最好，delta-rule更新在空间回忆上更好。
AI.conclusion: 结构化循环记忆与每层历史条件化能有效支持记忆依赖的机器人操作；不同记忆更新规则适合不同任务类型，需根据任务选择。

title: Zero-Shot Reactive Obstacle Avoidance for Generative Robot Policies
summary: We propose NUDGE (Nudge Update via Differentiable GEometry), a training-free obstacle-avoidance procedure that can be incorporated in any robot policy based on diffusion or flow matching, including diffusion policies and vision-language-action models. Our work injects gradients from a signed distance field, a function returning each point's distance to the nearest obstacle, into the policy at inference time to steer it away from obstacles. It supports any common action parameterization, from absolute or relative joint poses to end-effector poses, through a differentiable joint-trajectory decoder. Experiments show that NUDGE preserves the policy's task distribution and runs reactively in real time.

AI.tldr: 提出 NUDGE，一种无需训练的障碍物规避方法，可嵌入任意基于扩散或流匹配的机器人策略中，通过推理时注入符号距离场梯度来引导动作远离障碍物。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散策略和视觉-语言-动作模型等机器人策略通常关注任务执行，但缺乏对障碍物的实时规避能力；重新训练或微调成本高，因此需要一种通用、无需训练且可实时反应的避障方案。
AI.method: NUDGE 在推理阶段将符号距离场的梯度注入策略，该场返回点到最近障碍物的距离；通过可微关节轨迹解码器，支持绝对/相对关节位姿、末端执行器位姿等常见动作参数化。
AI.result: 实验表明，NUDGE 能保持策略原有的任务分布，并能够实时、反应式地运行。
AI.conclusion: NUDGE 是一种可广泛应用于扩散策略和视觉-语言-动作模型等扩散/流匹配机器人策略的免训练避障程序。

title: Certified Long-Horizon Code Agent Evolution via Validation-Gated Skill Optimization
summary:
Long horizon agent self-evolution without model weight updates is essential for enabling deployed agents to accumulate reusable skills and improve over time. Prior self-evolution work has focused primarily on short-horizon tasks, while repository-level software engineering remains unexplored despite being an ideal testbed for long-horizon adaptation. In this setting, agents are required to solve streams of sequential tasks, navigate complex dependencies with evolving repositories and persistently store and reuse experience. Text-based skill optimization offers an efficient, non-parametric approach for such adaptation. However, existing methods often suffer from unstable updates, performance drawdown, and agent collapse over extended deployments. In this paper, we formalize the concept of in-context self-evolution and introduce VALVE, a validated-gated framework for long-horizon skill optimization. We establish finite convergence, provide theoretical guarantees for future-task gain and drawdown, and derive the validation and evaluation holdout sizes required for a prescribed tolerance, with leading-order scaling
  Empirically, our pipeline, VALVE achieves stable self-improvement over evolution horizon spanning more than 1,000 SWE tasks, with average final and peak gains of $14.9$ and $16.5$ points across three frontier models (GPT-5.5, Claude-4.6 and MiniMax-M2.7). The validation gate reduces average drawdown by 75% and produces an 11x more compact skill bank than ungated evolution. We further present extensive ablations identifying the design choices most critical to long-horizon skill evolution.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VALVE——一种带验证门控的上下文自进化框架，用于长时程仓库级软件工程任务的技能优化，无需更新模型权重，可在超过1000个SWE任务上实现稳定自提升。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体自进化研究多集中于短时程任务，仓库级软件工程这一长时程适应理想场景尚未被探索；而现有文本化技能优化方法在长期部署中易出现更新不稳定、性能回撤和智能体崩溃。
AI.method: 形式化定义 in-context self-evolution；提出验证门控框架 VALVE；建立有限收敛性证明，给出未来任务增益与回撤的理论保证，并推导满足给定容差所需的验证集与评估集留出规模及其主导阶缩放；在超1000个SWE任务上进行实验与消融分析。
AI.result: 在 GPT-5.5、Claude-4.6 和 MiniMax-M2.7 三个前沿模型上实现稳定自提升，平均最终增益14.9分、峰值增益16.5分；验证门控使平均回撤降低75%，技能库比无门控演化紧凑11倍。
AI.conclusion: 验证门控是实现长时程、无权重更新技能自进化的关键，能够有效抑制性能回撤与智能体崩溃；消融实验进一步揭示了长时程技能演化中最关键的设计选择。

title: NutriVision: Ingredient-Conditioned Fusion and Prediction for Single-Image Food Nutrition Estimation
summary: Nutrition estimation is a fundamental task in consumer diet tracking, clinical dietetics, chronic disease management, sports and hospital nutrition, and broader food computing systems. The existing approaches have progressed along two largely separate axes, vision models that rely on calibrated RGB-depth captures and ingredient-aware methods that use textual cues but use limited multimodal fusion. We introduce NutriVision, an end-to-end framework that leverages visual geometry and ingredient semantics to estimate calories, mass, fat content, carbohydrates, and protein from a single RGB image and an optional ingredient list. It obtains the unavailable depth modality using DepthAnything-V3 and encodes ingredient descriptions using CLIP. It integrates three complementary mechanisms: (1) an \emph{Ingredient-Conditioned Frequency-Aligned Fusion Module (IC-FAFM)}, which uses textual guidance to reweight and align RGB-depth frequency components; (2) an \emph{Ingredient-Aware Mask-based Prediction Head (IA-MPH)}, whose gating and channel masks are conditioned on food identity; and (3) modality-specific \emph{Internal Semantic Modeling (ISM)} blocks. On the Nutrition5k dataset, NutriVision achieves a mean PMAE of $\mathbf{13.60\pm0.10\%}$, outperforming our IGSMNet implementation by $0.89$ percentage points and OmniFood8k by $2.90$ percentage points (both $p<0.001$). The module-level ablations identify the ingredient-aware prediction head as the primary architectural contributor, improving mean PMAE by $1.50\pm0.17$ percentage points ($p<0.001$). These results demonstrate that ingredient-conditioned prediction and frequency-aware RGB-depth fusion provide measurable gains for single-image nutrient estimation. More broadly, NutriVision offers a practical route toward nutrition-assessment systems that exploit geometric and semantic cues without requiring specialized depth-sensing hardware

AI.tldr: 提出NutriVision，一个端到端营养估计框架，仅用单张RGB图像和可选食材列表，即可估计热量、质量、脂肪、碳水和蛋白质。它用DepthAnything-V3获取深度，用CLIP编码食材文本，并融合三个模块，在Nutrition5k上达到13.60±0.10%的平均PMAE。
AI.motivation: 营养估计在饮食追踪、临床营养、慢病管理、运动与医院营养等领域很重要。现有方法分两类：依赖标定RGB-D的视觉模型，以及使用文本但多模态融合有限的食材感知方法。研究希望无需专用深度硬件，同时利用视觉几何与食材语义提升单图营养估计。
AI.method: NutriVision使用DepthAnything-V3从RGB估计深度，并用CLIP编码食材描述。核心包括三个机制：1）食材条件频率对齐融合模块（IC-FAFM），用文本引导对RGB-深度频率分量重加权与对齐；2）食材感知掩码预测头（IA-MPH），其门控和通道掩码以食物类别为条件；3）模态特定的内部语义建模（ISM）块。
AI.result: 在Nutrition5k数据集上，NutriVision平均PMAE为13.60±0.10%，比IGSMNet实现低0.89个百分点，比OmniFood8k低2.90个百分点（均p<0.001）。模块消融显示，食材感知预测头是主要架构贡献者，使平均PMAE改善1.50±0.17个百分点（p<0.001）。
AI.conclusion: 食材条件预测与频率感知的RGB-深度融合能为单图营养估计带来可测量增益。NutriVision为无需专用深度传感硬件的营养评估系统提供了一条利用几何与语义线索的实用路径。

title: Relic: From Multi-Agent Collaboration to Persistent Organizational Capability
summary: Multiple agents may often conflict in an organization: for example, one coding agent changes an interface in a repository, but another continues to develop on the old version where existing tests become stale. A conversation can resolve the episode, but when the participants change, what makes the lesson continue to govern the team? We introduce Relic, which turns recurring collaboration failures into organization-owned, executable protocols. Members reflect on visible work, propose rules, and govern their adoption. Adopted protocols bind triggers, responsibilities, required evidence, and execution consequences to the runtime, while remaining open to revision and retirement. In one traced case, repeated integration friction produces an interface-review rule that governs later pull requests and is revised as work continues. Across 360 controlled runs over ten software workloads and three models, Relic raises complete-contract delivery from 14.06% to 19.76% (+5.71 percentage points) over a matched structured team without the protocol lifecycle, improving all four verified production endpoints in every model stratum. Under fresh-member transfer, behavioral correctness is 25.4% with no inherited protocol, 34.6% with the same rules provided as readable text, and 41.2% with executable bindings, a +6.5-point advantage over text alone. On the full CooperBench benchmark, after excluding broken benchmark pairs, Relic achieves 367/477 (76.9%), establishing the best reported result among peer-structured systems. On the fixed 48-pair same-model subset, Relic also exceeds Solo (29/48 vs. 26/48), reversing the coordination loss exhibited by the official peer baseline. Together, these results show how collaboration experience can become persistent organizational state that remains useful beyond the members who created it.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Relic，将反复出现的多智能体协作失败转化为组织拥有、可执行且可修订的协议，使协作经验在成员更替后仍能持续指导团队。
AI.motivation: 多智能体在组织中常发生冲突，例如一个编码智能体修改接口后，另一个仍基于旧版本开发，导致测试失效。对话虽能解决单次问题，但当参与者更换时，经验难以沉淀并继续约束团队。
AI.method: Relic 让成员反思可见工作、提出规则并参与治理采纳。被采纳的协议把触发器、责任、所需证据和执行后果绑定到运行时，同时支持修订与退役。作者在10个软件负载、3个模型上进行360次控制运行，并测试新成员迁移、CooperBench基准及48对同模型子集。
AI.result: 完整契约交付率从14.06%提升至19.76%（+5.71个百分点），并在每个模型层提升全部四个验证生产端点。新成员迁移下，行为正确率：无继承协议25.4%，文本规则34.6%，可执行绑定41.2%，比纯文本高6.5个百分点。CooperBench上达367/477（76.9%），为同类结构化系统最佳报告结果；48对同模型子集中Relic以29/48超过Solo的26/48，逆转了官方同类基线的协调损失。
AI.conclusion: 协作经验可以转化为持久的组织状态，并在创建者离开后继续发挥作用，从而提升多智能体团队在成员更替情境下的协调与交付表现。

title: Certified Selective Automation of LLM Agent Evaluation
summary: Evaluating LLM agents still ends with a human reading trajectories, because automatic judges carry no guarantee on how often they are wrong. We ask the operational question: what fraction of agent evaluation can a judge take over, with a certificate that the error rate among auto-decided trajectories stays below a budget alpha? Agent corpora resist the standard answer: many agents attempt the same tasks, so trajectories arrive in correlated clusters, and the i.i.d. certificates of existing selective-judging methods can overstate what is safe: a naive certificate can claim 98% automation while its realized error exceeds the budget in 17.5% of task resamples. We introduce a task-level bootstrap certificate that is valid in every regime we test while matching the naive certificate's coverage; finite-sample cluster-valid alternatives certify nothing at realistic task counts. Under this certificate, a 4B logprob judge trained with SFT and reject-weighted GRPO certifies 0.30-0.59 of evaluation on tool-use and web corpora at alpha=0.1, the only judge, among strongly elicited frontier models, certifying on both headline corpora. Certified coverage is predictable before training from base rate and discrimination alone (leave-one-corpus-out R^2=0.96). Finally, the certificate doubles as a self-training filter: pseudo-labels harvested inside certified regions have contamination bounded by alpha by construction (realized 0.000-0.041 across six harvests), letting a judge enter an unseen domain at in-domain strength with zero target training labels.

AI.tldr: 论文研究 LLM agent 评估中自动 judge 能接管多少评估，并提出任务级 bootstrap 证书，保证自动决定轨迹的错误率低于预算 α；同时训练 4B judge 并利用证书进行自训练过滤。
AI.motivation: 现有自动 judge 无法保证错误率，仍依赖人工阅读轨迹；而 agent 语料中同一任务常有多条相关轨迹，现有 selective-judging 的 i.i.d. 证书会高估安全性，例如朴素证书声称 98% 自动化，但 17.5% 的任务重采样中实际错误率超预算。
AI.method: 提出任务级 bootstrap certificate，在任务聚类相关场景下有效；用 SFT 和 reject-weighted GRPO 训练 4B logprob judge；将证书作为自训练过滤器，在认证区域内收集伪标签；并分析认证覆盖率与 base rate、discrimination 的关系。
AI.result: 在 α=0.1 下，该 judge 在 tool-use 和 web 语料上认证 0.30-0.59 的评估，是强激发前沿模型中唯一在两个头条语料上都认证的 judge；认证覆盖率可由 base rate 和 discrimination 预测，留一语料 R²=0.96；伪标签污染按构造受 α 限制，六次采集中实际为 0.000-0.041。
AI.conclusion: 任务级 bootstrap 证书在测试场景中均有效，能可靠量化自动评估可接管比例；证书还可作为自训练筛选器，使 judge 在零目标域训练标签下进入未见领域并达到域内强度。

title: When Harness Beats Scale, and When Reading Beats Both
comment: Accepted at the DocInsights 2026 Workshop co-located with EMNLP 2026. System description paper for the DocSem document-grounded quantitative reasoning shared task. 10 pages, 2 figures, 7 tables, 5 appendices
summary: We describe our system for DocSem, the document-grounded quantitative reasoning shared task at DocInsights 2026, and analyze why it succeeded on labeled data and failed on the test set. The pipeline pairs hybrid block retrieval with Program-of-Thoughts (PoT) generation executed in a sandboxed interpreter, self-consistency sampling, and entity enrichment from chunk-level knowledge graphs. On our held-out split, application architecture moved the metrics far more than model scale did: PoT added 0.282 joint accuracy to a compact 7B model but at most 0.005 to a 72B model, and a 27B model with the full harness matched the 72B (0.884 vs.\ 0.873) at roughly 2.7$\times$ fewer parameters and a quarter of the CO$_2$. We read this through a distinction between world knowledge, which scales steeply with parameters, and language knowledge, which scales gently, and show that structured-output training makes a compact model harness-ready rather than merely small. On the raster, watermarked test PDFs the same system collapsed to 13.58\% joint (rank 149 of 163); a controlled re-rendering of the validation set reproduces the OCR half of the collapse while bounding what the simulation misses. Auditing the physical nature of evaluation inputs precedes architecture, and the leaderboard's bimodality is consistent with reading quality, not reasoning, having separated the field.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了 DocInsights 2026 DocSem 文档基础定量推理任务的系统，并分析其在验证集上成功、在测试集上失败的原因。
AI.motivation: 探究为何同一系统在标注数据上表现优异，却在真实测试集上崩溃；同时比较应用架构与模型规模对性能的影响，并强调评估输入的物理性质可能比推理架构更关键。
AI.method: 采用混合块检索、在沙箱解释器中执行的 Program-of-Thoughts（PoT）生成、自一致性采样，以及基于块级知识图谱的实体增强；对比 7B、27B、72B 模型，并对验证集进行受控重渲染以模拟 OCR 退化。
AI.result: PoT 为 7B 模型增加 0.282 联合准确率，但为 72B 模型最多只增加 0.005；27B 完整系统以约 2.7 倍更少参数和四分之一 CO2 达到与 72B 相当的性能（0.884 vs. 0.873）。在栅格化、带水印测试 PDF 上，系统联合准确率跌至 13.58%（163 个系统中排名 149）；重渲染验证集复现了 OCR 相关的一半崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 应用架构和结构化输出训练比模型规模更重要，可使紧凑模型具备 harness-ready 能力；评估输入的真实物理性质与 OCR 质量应先于架构审查；排行榜双峰分布表明区分参赛系统的更可能是阅读质量而非推理能力。

title: SemReward-VL: Semantic Reward-Guided Video-Language Adaptation for Developmental Behavior Assessment
summary: Developmental screening videos show how children perform specific behaviors, but clinical records usually contain outcomes rather than descriptions of what happened. We present SemReward-VL, which learns to describe item-specific behavior from these outcomes. A vision-language model generates a description, and a frozen language model scores its agreement with the clinical outcome, relevance to the item, abstention on unrelated video-item pairs, and clarity. Group relative policy optimization (GRPO) updates LoRA adapters using this semantic reward. On 13,379 videos covering 41 items, the method improves aggregate accuracy and the number of items with recall above 0.5. Errors remain in temporal direction, duration, and age-specific interpretations of behavior.

AI.tldr: 提出 SemReward-VL，利用临床结果作为语义奖励，通过 GRPO 更新 LoRA 适配器，让视觉语言模型从发育筛查视频中生成项目特异性行为描述。
AI.motivation: 发育筛查视频记录了儿童具体行为，但临床记录通常只有结果，缺少对实际行为过程的描述，因此需要从结果中学习生成行为描述。
AI.method: 视觉语言模型生成描述，冻结语言模型从与临床结果一致性、与项目相关性、对无关视频-项目对的弃权、清晰度四个方面打分作为语义奖励；使用组相对策略优化（GRPO）更新 LoRA 适配器。
AI.result: 在覆盖41个项目、13,379个视频的数据上，方法提升了总体准确率以及召回率高于0.5的项目数量；但错误仍存在于时间方向、持续时长和年龄特异性行为解释。
AI.conclusion: 语义奖励结合 GRPO 可有效从临床结果中学习项目特异性行为描述，但在时序、时长和年龄相关语义上仍有改进空间。

title: X-Tree: Tokenizing Reusable Experience for Efficient Agent Generalization
comment: Project in Progress. Homepage: https://sitaocheng.github.io/xtree/. Code: https://github.com/sitaocheng/X-Tree/
summary: Multi-step agents are trained on flat action streams: SFT and RLVR weight every token uniformly and ignore the sub-procedures that recur across tasks, the hierarchy that lets humans plan top-down from reusable routines. This structure sits unused, and flat training uses each scarce trajectory less fully than its content allows. Recent agents do use that structure, but only as LLM-written skills in context, never in the weights, so their gains do not generalize beyond retrieval. We instead recover this hierarchy from the data itself and train on it, with no LLM calls. Following text tokenizers, which build a vocabulary by counting alone, we score action spans by reusability and merge canonicalized actions into a reusable eXperience tree (X-Tree). Each X-Tree node captures how a frequent and success-bearing skill is composed from sub-skills, guiding efficient generalization. We integrate X-Tree into three training settings: offline RL, with each node as a training instance; online RLVR, with an adaptive skill bonus; and on-policy self-distillation, with X-Tree as the self-teacher's privileged context. Across WebArena, ScienceWorld, and WebShop at three model scales, X-Tree improves over standard recipes at matched data and budget by up to 4.5% SR on WebArena, 5.8% SR on ScienceWorld and 4.1% success on WebShop. Matched analyses attribute the gains to the X-Tree structure and the three integrations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出X-Tree，一种无需LLM调用、从数据中自动恢复可复用技能层级结构的方法，并将其融入离线RL、在线RLVR和同策略自蒸馏三种训练设置，在多个基准和模型规模上取得一致提升。
AI.motivation: 多步智能体通常在扁平动作流上训练（SFT、RLVR），对所有token均匀加权，忽略了跨任务重复出现的子过程与层级结构；这种结构未被利用，导致稀缺轨迹的利用不充分。现有方法虽利用结构，但仅作为LLM在上下文中编写的技能，未进入权重，因而收益无法超越检索泛化。
AI.method: 仿照文本分词器通过计数构建词表的方式，按可复用性对动作片段评分，并将规范化动作合并为可复用的经验树（X-Tree）。每个节点表示频繁且与成功相关的技能如何由子技能组成。将X-Tree集成到三种训练设置：离线RL（每个节点作为训练实例）、在线RLVR（自适应技能奖励）和同策略自蒸馏（X-Tree作为自教师的特权上下文）。
AI.result: 在WebArena、ScienceWorld和WebShop三个基准、三种模型规模下，在匹配数据和预算时，X-Tree相比标准训练配方最高提升：WebArena成功率4.5%，ScienceWorld成功率5.8%，WebShop成功率4.1%。匹配分析表明增益归因于X-Tree结构及三种集成方式。
AI.conclusion: 从数据本身恢复并训练层级化可复用技能结构，能更充分地利用轨迹并提升多步智能体的泛化与效率；将结构集成到训练中可带来一致且显著的性能提升。

title: Repair Before You Fuse: Frozen-Host Adaptation for Corrupted-but-Present Sensors
summary: Camera-LiDAR detectors can continue to consume unreliable features even when both sensors remain present, synchronized, and calibrated. We introduce \emph{Boundary Feature Repair} (BFR), a frozen-host adaptation framework that learns task-supervised residual corrections at modality interfaces the detector already consumes. BFR-C repairs each camera feature level read by fusion, whereas BFR-L aligns host-conditioned LiDAR candidates to a selected boundary and routes site-wise innovations relative to the frozen anchor. Their jointly trained composition is BFR-CL. Zero-initialized per-channel scales make every variant an exact detector-level identity before optimization; only the repair modules train, while the encoders, fusion consumer, router, detection head, and host normalization statistics remain fixed. At inference, BFR requires neither clean references, corruption metadata, temporal history, nor online updates. Across the complete 20-corruption, five-severity KITTI-C grid, BFR-C reduces RCE from $14.07$ to $11.92$ on MVX-Net and from $14.29$ to $11.00$ on Focals Conv-F relative to their reproduced frozen baselines. On the latter host, BFR-L raises AP$_{\mathrm{cor}}$ from $73.65$ to $74.48$, while BFR-CL reaches $77.01$ AP$_{\mathrm{cor}}$ and $10.46$ RCE with $86.02$ clean AP. On nuScenes-R, BFR-CL raises the reproduced MoME baseline's mAP robustness ratio from $80.1$ to $81.4$. These results establish boundary repair as a targeted retrofit for corrupted-but-present sensing without retraining the deployed detector.

AI.tldr: 论文提出边界特征修复（BFR），一种冻结宿主检测器的适配框架，通过在模态接口学习任务监督的残差修正，提升相机-LiDAR检测器在传感器数据损坏时的鲁棒性，而无需重训练原检测器。
AI.motivation: 相机-LiDAR检测器即使两个传感器仍存在、同步且已标定，也可能继续使用不可靠特征，导致在损坏数据下性能下降。现有方法通常需要干净参考、损坏元数据、时序信息或在线更新，因此需要一种无需重训练部署检测器的针对性修复方案。
AI.method: 提出BFR框架，在检测器已消费的模态接口处学习任务监督的残差修正。BFR-C修复融合读取的每个相机特征层级；BFR-L将宿主条件LiDAR候选对齐到选定边界，并相对冻结锚点路由站点级创新；二者联合训练为BFR-CL。采用零初始化逐通道缩放，使各变体在优化前等价于检测器级恒等映射；仅训练修复模块，编码器、融合消费者、路由器、检测头和宿主归一化统计量保持冻结。推理时不需要干净参考、损坏元数据、时序历史或在线更新。
AI.result: 在完整KITTI-C 20种损坏、5个严重程度网格上，BFR-C将MVX-Net的RCE从14.07降至11.92，将Focals Conv-F的RCE从14.29降至11.00。在后者宿主上，BFR-L将AP_cor从73.65提升至74.48，BFR-CL达到77.01 AP_cor、10.46 RCE和86.02干净AP。在nuScenes-R上，BFR-CL将复现的MoME基线mAP鲁棒性比率从80.1提升至81.4。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，边界修复是一种针对“损坏但存在”的传感数据的有效改造方法，可在不重训练已部署检测器的情况下提升相机-LiDAR融合检测的鲁棒性。

title: Model-Aware Data Selection from In-and-Out Information Interplay
summary:
LLMs are effective representations that assimilate vast amounts of knowledge during pretraining, but post-training is necessary for models to reliably access this knowledge and "know what they know." We observe an interesting rank equilibrium between knowledge stored in the weights and the data stream passing through the model. Across all model layers, we find that the hidden states (data stream) follow a U-shaped pattern, showing substantial compression in early layers and a steep rise during the late-layer decoding phase. In contrast, the weight rank follows an inverted U-shaped pattern, with very low rank in the early and late layers and high rank in the middle. We interpret this as an in-and-out information interplay: intermediate activations do not need to carry content that the weights can supply later, so they primarily preserve what the weights cannot provide.
  Motivated by this observation, we propose a model-aware data selection method, CAP (Counterfactual Assimilation Profile), which can determine whether a data candidate contains information accessible to the current model by utilizing the divergence gap in early- and late-layer representations between model-generated and reference responses. Across math, code, and science domains, CAP delivers 35.4% greater average improvement over the base model than the strongest baseline under different selection budgets. With only 10% of the data pool, CAP surpasses or matches full-pool training on math and science. We further show that CAP transfers to multimodal data selection and is robust to response horizon and noise.

AI.tldr: 论文观察到LLM权重与数据流之间存在秩平衡：隐状态呈U型、权重秩呈倒U型；据此提出模型感知的数据选择方法CAP，用于判断候选数据是否包含当前模型可获取的信息。
AI.motivation: LLM预训练虽存储大量知识，但后训练才能可靠调用并“知道自己知道什么”。作者希望利用权重与激活之间的信息互补关系，更高效地选择后训练数据。
AI.method: 提出CAP（Counterfactual Assimilation Profile），基于模型生成响应与参考响应在早层和晚层表示上的散度差异，判断候选数据是否含有当前模型可访问的信息，从而进行模型感知的数据选择。
AI.result: 在数学、代码、科学领域，不同选择预算下CAP相对基座模型的平均提升比最强基线高35.4%；仅用10%数据池，在数学和科学上达到或超过全量训练；CAP还可迁移到多模态数据选择，并对响应长度和噪声具有鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 权重与数据流存在互补的信息分工，早层压缩、中层高秩、晚层解码上升；利用这种差异进行数据选择可显著提升后训练效率与效果，并具备跨领域和跨模态泛化性。

title: Just-In-Time Agent Memory with Runtime Agentic Research
summary: Memory is critical for AI agents. Many existing agent-memory systems follow an Ahead-of-Time (AOT) design, constructing memory before a specific request arrives. While this reduces online serving cost, such request-agnostic memory construction can discard fine-grained information that later becomes important. To address this limitation, we propose Just-In-Time Agent Memory (JAM), a trainable framework for query-conditioned context construction at runtime. A Memorizer preserves complete raw histories in a hierarchical page-store with compact navigational summaries, while a Researcher iteratively retrieves, inspects, and integrates evidence for each request. To train these memory-use behaviors, we introduce Memory-Gym, an evidence-grounded data synthesis pipeline covering nine task types across six domains, and optimize the Researcher through verified-trajectory supervised fine-tuning followed by Hint-guided Group Relative Policy Optimization. We demonstrate the effectiveness of JAM across a variety of benchmarks on agent memory and long-context processing, where it achieves stronger task performance than AOT-style memory systems while remaining substantially more efficient than prior trained agentic memory approaches. To support reproducibility and future research, we release our anonymized source code at https://github.com/VectorSpaceLab/general-agentic-memory.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 JAM，一种可训练的即时智能体记忆框架，在运行时根据查询构建上下文：Memorizer 以分层页面存储保留完整原始历史并生成导航摘要，Researcher 迭代检索、检查并整合证据。作者还构建 Memory-Gym 数据合成管线，用验证轨迹 SFT 和 Hint-guided GRPO 训练，在多个智能体记忆与长上下文基准上优于 AOT 记忆系统且更高效。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体记忆系统多采用 Ahead-of-Time（AOT）设计，在具体请求到来前构建记忆。虽然降低在线服务成本，但这种与请求无关的记忆构建会丢弃后续可能重要的细粒度信息。
AI.method: 提出 Just-In-Time Agent Memory（JAM）可训练框架，实现查询条件化的运行时上下文构建。Memorizer 将完整原始历史保存在带紧凑导航摘要的分层页面存储中；Researcher 针对每个请求迭代检索、检查并整合证据。为训练记忆使用行为，构建 Memory-Gym 证据驱动数据合成管线，覆盖六个领域九类任务；优化方式为 verified-trajectory 监督微调，随后进行 Hint-guided Group Relative Policy Optimization。
AI.result: 在多种智能体记忆与长上下文处理基准上，JAM 的任务性能强于 AOT 式记忆系统，同时比先前训练式智能体记忆方法显著更高效。作者发布了匿名化源代码以支持复现与后续研究。
AI.conclusion: JAM 通过运行时、查询条件化的记忆构建克服了 AOT 请求无关记忆的局限，在性能与效率之间取得更好平衡，并为智能体记忆研究提供了可复现框架与数据合成方案。

title: Look Before You Select: Rethinking Vocabulary Sparsification in On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) uses teacher correction on student-generated responses. Full-vocabulary correction can provide important corrections even for tokens that the student assigns low probability, but backpropagating through all token logits becomes memory-intensive for long sequences. Existing memory-saving approaches estimate corrections from sampled tokens or restrict supervision to the student's TopK tokens, introducing sampling noise or changing the full-vocabulary correction. We introduce \textbf{SparseOPD}, which uses full-vocabulary teacher correction to determine which corrections matter before selecting the token logits to differentiate. SparseOPD first constructs the full-vocabulary correction without retaining its backward graph, then selects tokens by correction magnitude rather than student probability. Signed residual compensation preserves the total promoting and suppressing correction mass, while correction-aware budget allocation distributes the sparse support across positions. Finally, the update backpropagates only through the selected token logits. Across six task--scale settings spanning mathematics, chemistry QA, and multimodal reasoning, SparseOPD outperforms Sampled Token and TopK in task-average accuracy and matches or exceeds Full Vocabulary. Gradient cosine similarity reaches 99\% on 4B mathematics, while 8K full-parameter profiling shows 70.5\% lower backward memory.

AI.tldr: 提出SparseOPD，一种用于在线策略蒸馏的稀疏全词表教师纠正方法，在降低长序列反向传播内存的同时，尽量保留全词表纠正效果。
AI.motivation: 在线策略蒸馏中，全词表纠正能纠正学生低概率token，但对所有token logits反向传播在长序列上内存开销大；现有节省内存方法使用采样token或TopK，会引入采样噪声或改变全词表纠正。
AI.method: SparseOPD先用全词表教师纠正判断哪些纠正重要且不保留其反向图，再按纠正幅度而非学生概率选择token；引入带符号残差补偿以保持促进与抑制纠正总量，并用纠正感知预算分配在位置间分配稀疏支持；最后仅对选中token logits进行反向传播更新。
AI.result: 在数学、化学QA和多模态推理的六个任务-规模设置中，SparseOPD的任务平均准确率优于Sampled Token和TopK，并匹配或超过Full Vocabulary；4B数学上梯度余弦相似度达99%，8K全参数分析显示反向内存降低70.5%。
AI.conclusion: SparseOPD能够以稀疏方式有效保留全词表教师纠正，在性能接近或超过全词表方法的同时显著降低内存，优于采样token和TopK等现有内存节省方案。

title: Spatial Grafting: Grounding 3D Features for Flow-Matching Robot Policies
summary: Pretrained robot manipulation policies such as vision-language-action models (VLAs) or world-action models (WAMs) leave interaction-relevant metric geometry implicit. Recent breakthroughs in spatial reconstruction can supply the necessary geometry reliably, but their features describe local shape without stating where it lies with respect to the robot. How best to deliver these features to a pretrained policy remains unresolved. We propose Spatial Grafting, a versatile, lightweight spatial module that binds frozen reconstruction features to metric, robot-relative geometry. Spatial Grafting constructs metric-grounded spatial tokens and injects them into the flow-matching action expert through cross-attention, without modifying the host's perceptual pathway, so the host retains the full benefit of its pretraining. We evaluate it more broadly than any geometry-aware policy we compare against: one graft architecture, with no per-host redesign, on two VLAs and two WAMs, across four simulation benchmarks that span short-horizon manipulation, visual robustness, clutter and long-horizon mobile manipulation, and on three real-robot platforms with single- and dual-arm configurations. On RoboTwin 2.0, a dual-arm manipulation benchmark, the graft improves every host across VLAs and WAMs. Grafted $π_{0.5}$ gains 11.3% and 15.6% on clean and randomized scenes, reaching 94.0% and 92.4%, above the strongest published 3D-conditioned policy, WAM4D (93.8% and 89.9%). The margin widens as the horizon lengthens: on tasks from BEHAVIOR-1K, a dual-arm mobile manipulation challenge scored by average task progress, it surpasses the 2025 challenge winner on five of six tasks,by up to 0.47 Q-score, and exceeds a map-conditioned spatial policy on average across the three tasks both report.

AI.tldr: 提出 Spatial Grafting：一种轻量空间模块，将冻结的空间重建特征绑定为机器人相对的度量几何，并通过 cross-attention 注入预训练 VLA/WAM 的 flow-matching 动作专家，在不改变宿主感知通路的情况下提升机器人操作性能。
AI.motivation: 预训练机器人操作策略如 VLA 或 WAM 将交互相关的度量几何隐式化。空间重建虽能提供可靠几何，但其特征只描述局部形状，未说明其相对机器人的位置；如何把这些特征有效送入预训练策略仍未解决。
AI.method: Spatial Grafting 构建度量接地的空间 token，将冻结重建特征与机器人相对度量几何绑定，并通过 cross-attention 注入 flow-matching 动作专家，且不修改宿主感知通路。一个嫁接架构无需按宿主重设计，适配两个 VLA 和两个 WAM，并在四个仿真基准及三个真实机器人平台（单臂和双臂）上评估。
AI.result: 在 RoboTwin 2.0 双机械臂基准上，该方法提升所有 VLA 和 WAM 宿主。嫁接 π0.5 在干净和随机场景分别提升 11.3% 和 15.6%，达到 94.0% 和 92.4%，超过最强已发表 3D 条件策略 WAM4D 的 93.8% 和 89.9%。在 BEHAVIOR-1K 长时程双臂移动操作中，六个任务中五个超过 2025 挑战冠军，最高提升 0.47 Q-score，并在双方都报告的三项任务上平均超过 map-conditioned spatial policy。
AI.conclusion: 轻量空间嫁接能有效为冻结预训练策略注入机器人相对度量几何，无需针对宿主重新设计，并在长时程、杂乱场景和真实机器人上带来显著且更稳健的性能提升。

title: dKFD: Phase-Structured Evidence Allocation for Fixed-Budget Localized Event Understanding
summary: Sparse video understanding often requires selecting a small set of visual evidence under a fixed frame budget. Most sparse selectors allocate this budget globally, allowing all frames to compete with one another. For temporally localized events, this can be a poor inductive bias: useful evidence is often distributed across pre-event context, the event itself, and post-event consequences. We study fixed-budget evidence allocation for localized event videos and show that globally competitive Top-$K$ selectors can preserve recognition and grounding while producing unstable event evidence. On DoTA Video Anomaly Recognition, Global Top-$K$ obtains competitive recognition and temporal grounding, but low selector-event alignment at $K=12$ (Frame AUC $51.5 \pm 10.8$). We propose dKFD, a phase-structured differentiable selector that reserves evidence capacity across pre-event, event, and post-event phases after full-sequence temporal encoding. Under matched-budget multi-seed evaluation, dKFD improves Frame AUC by $+30.97$ over a matched Global Top-$K$ selector at $K=12$ ($p<0.01$), while yielding modest but statistically significant recognition gains and comparable temporal grounding. Mechanism ablations show that phase supervision is load-bearing: removing it reduces Frame AUC to $41.1 \pm 12.0$ even when phase-partitioned budgets are retained. Downstream diagnostics on VRU-Accident show consistent gains over learned Global Top-$K$ across VLM families, while dense captioning reveals a boundary condition where uniform sampling remains competitive. These results support phase-structured allocation as a controlled fixed-budget approach for event-centric sparse evidence selection, not as a universal video summarization strategy.

AI.tldr: 论文研究固定帧预算下的稀疏视频证据选择，提出阶段结构化可微选择器 dKFD，在局部事件视频中提升选择器与事件的对齐，同时保持有竞争力的识别与定位性能。
AI.motivation: 多数稀疏选择器采用全局 Top-K，让所有帧竞争预算，这对时间局部事件并不合适，因为有效证据通常分布在事件前、事件本身和事件后三个阶段。
AI.method: 在完整序列时间编码后，dKFD 为事件前、事件、事件后三个阶段分别保留证据容量，并进行阶段结构化可微选择与监督；在 DoTA、VRU-Accident 等任务上进行匹配预算、多随机种子评估和机制消融。
AI.result: 在 DoTA 视频异常识别中，Global Top-K 在 K=12 时识别和定位有竞争力，但选择器-事件对齐较低（Frame AUC 51.5±10.8）；dKFD 将 Frame AUC 提升 +30.97（p<0.01），识别有小幅显著增益，定位相当。移除阶段监督后 Frame AUC 降至 41.1±12.0。VRU-Accident 上跨 VLM 家族优于 learned Global Top-K，但密集描述任务中均匀采样仍具竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 阶段结构化预算分配是一种有效的固定预算、事件中心稀疏证据选择方法，但并非通用视频摘要策略。

title: Parameter-Efficient 3D Segmentation of Liver and Liver tumors: Depthwise factorization Scales Better Than Dense Convolution with Spatial Dimensionality
summary: Three-dimensional dense convolutional networks are the strongest performers on volumetric medical image segmentation, but their parameter counts scale poorly: moving a dense k x k convolution to k x k x k multiplies its weights by k. We observe that depthwise separable factorization does not share this penalty. Because the cubic kernel term applies only to the depthwise stage while the pointwise projection, which dominates the parameter count, is unchanged, the same architecture grows by 5 % from 2D to 3D where a dense convolutional U-Net grows by 200 %. We exploit this asymmetry to build a 3D U-Net with 536,990 parameters, 24x fewer than an identical dense 3D U-Net. On MSD Task03 Liver (the Medical Segmentation Decathlon liver task, derived from LiTS), evaluated per case under five-fold cross-validation over all 131 public volumes, the model reaches a tumor Dice of 0.577 (95% CI [0.518, 0.633]) and a liver Dice of 0.947 (95% CI [0.941, 0.952]). Its liver Dice exceeds previously reported performance. Its tumor Dice exceeds their low-resolution configuration (0.4701) by 0.107 and their 2D configuration (0.5394), at approximately one twenty-fourth of the parameters and roughly half the in-plane resolution. Trained under identical conditions on a common held-out split, it exceeds a dense 3D U-Net on liver by +0.031 Dice (paired p = 0.006) and on tumor by +0.041 (95 % CI [+0.005, +0.081], paired p = 0.056), suggesting the factorization also acts as a regularizer in the small-data regime characteristic of medical imaging. We further show, on both LiTS and a 2D endoscopy benchmark, that a large fraction of the network's learnable spatial filters can be replaced by fixed shifts at no cost in accuracy, but that replacing all of them is measurably worse, the placement of spatial capacity matters more than its total amount.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用深度可分离分解构建极轻量3D U-Net，仅约53.7万参数，在MSD Task03 Liver上取得优于密集3D U-Net和既往方法的肝脏与肿瘤分割性能，并发现部分空间滤波器可由固定位移替代。
AI.motivation: 3D密集卷积网络虽是体积医学图像分割最强方法，但参数量随卷积核从2D扩展到3D急剧增长，医学数据小样本场景下容易过拟合，因此需要更高效的三维分割架构。
AI.method: 利用深度可分离卷积的参数量增长不对称性：三次方核只作用于深度阶段，而占主导的点卷积不变，从而将2D U-Net高效扩展到3D；在MSD Task03 Liver上进行五折交叉验证，并与密集3D U-Net、既往低分辨率和2D配置比较；还在LiTS和2D内窥镜基准上测试用固定位移替换部分可学习空间滤波器。
AI.result: 模型仅536,990个参数，比相同密集3D U-Net少24倍；MSD Task03 Liver上肿瘤Dice为0.577（95% CI [0.518, 0.633]），肝脏Dice为0.947（95% CI [0.941, 0.952]）。肝脏Dice超过既往报告；肿瘤Dice超过低分辨率配置0.4701达0.107，并超过2D配置0.5394，而参数约少24倍、面内分辨率约一半。相同条件下，肝脏Dice比密集3D U-Net高0.031（配对p=0.006），肿瘤Dice高0.041（95% CI [0.005, 0.081]，配对p=0.056）。
AI.conclusion: 深度可分离分解能以极少参数实现高性能3D医学图像分割，并可能在小数据场景中起到正则化作用；空间容量放置比总量更重要，大量可学习空间滤波器可由固定位移替代且不损失精度，但全部替换会变差。

title: DexAgent: An Agentic Human2Sim2Robot Framework for Dexterous Manipulation with Self-Evolving Tool Library
comment: 15 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Project website: https://dexagent123.github.io/
summary: Human videos offer a scalable source of demonstrations for dexterous robot manipulation. However, existing human-to-simulation-to-robot (Human2Sim2Robot) pipelines rely on predefined procedures that struggle to accommodate diverse object properties and interactions, particularly those involving articulated and deformable objects. We introduce DexAgent, an agentic Human2Sim2Robot framework that converts a single egocentric human video and a task prompt into physically grounded robot trajectories for policy training. It operates through four stages: semantic understanding of human videos, property-based simulation reconstruction, robot trajectory optimization, and robot data generation. At each stage, DexAgent adapts its approach to the task and object properties by selecting suitable skills from its tool library or developing new ones when needed. Property-specific verifiers assess stage outcomes for physical validity and task-specific requirements and provide feedback for refinement, preventing error propagation through the workflow. This adaptive, verification-guided process allows DexAgent to process diverse objects and long-horizon tasks. In the final stage, DexAgent varies object and robot states in simulation to generate diverse robot trajectories from a single human video, then retextures the rendered observations to facilitate sim-to-real transfer. Newly developed skills and verifiers are retained in its tool library, making it self-evolving to accumulate reusable capabilities. This reduces processing time as DexAgent encounters more human videos. Across eleven real-world tasks, policies trained with DexAgent-generated data achieve a 3.5x higher success rate than competing baselines. Project website: https://dexagent123.github.io/.

AI.tldr: DexAgent 是一个代理式 Human2Sim2Robot 框架，可将单段第一视角人类视频和任务提示转化为物理合理、可用于策略训练的机器人轨迹，并在 11 个真实任务中显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 现有 Human2Sim2Robot 流程依赖预定义程序，难以适应多样物体属性与交互，尤其是铰接物体和可变形物体，导致误差传播和泛化能力不足。
AI.method: DexAgent 包含四个阶段：人类视频语义理解、基于属性的仿真重建、机器人轨迹优化、机器人数据生成。每个阶段从工具库选择或开发合适技能，并由属性特定验证器评估物理有效性与任务要求，提供反馈迭代优化；最终在仿真中变化物体与机器人状态生成多样轨迹，并通过重纹理渲染促进 sim-to-real 迁移。新技能与验证器会保留在工具库中，使系统自进化。
AI.result: 在 11 个真实世界任务中，使用 DexAgent 生成数据训练的策略成功率比竞争基线高 3.5 倍；随着处理更多人类视频，系统可积累可复用能力并减少处理时间。
AI.conclusion: DexAgent 通过自适应、验证引导的代理式流程，能够处理多样物体和长时程任务，从单段人类视频生成有效机器人训练数据，并具备自进化能力，显著提升真实机器人操作策略的成功率。

title: Zero-Shot Cue-Grounded Topic Segmentation of Spoken Documents
summary: Topic segmentation structures spoken documents into coherent sections, facilitating navigation and downstream understanding. The appropriate granularity can vary substantially, ranging from broad thematic shifts to fine-grained subtopics. Existing LLM-based segmenters, however, often struggle to adapt to this variation, causing them to either merge distinct subtopics or over-segment coherent themes. To address this, we introduce Cue-Grounded Segmentation (CGS), a training-free framework that operates without any task-specific supervision. CGS first identifies phrases that explicitly signal the start of a new topic and uses their sentence positions as segment boundaries. When such cues are insufficient, it falls back to semantic segmentation, guided by the document structure inferred during cue extraction. Across six benchmarks and six LLM backbones, CGS consistently outperforms existing baselines, remains robust to noisy ASR transcripts, and achieves these gains with low API cost on proprietary models.

AI.tldr: 提出免训练话题分割框架CGS，利用话题起始线索短语确定边界，并在线索不足时回退到语义分割，在多个基准和LLM上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的分割器难以适应不同粒度的话题变化，容易合并不同子话题或过度分割连贯主题。
AI.method: CGS是一个无需任务特定监督的免训练框架：先识别显式指示新话题开始的短语，将其所在句子位置作为分割边界；当线索不足时，依据线索提取阶段推断出的文档结构进行语义分割。
AI.result: 在六个基准和六个LLM骨干上，CGS持续优于现有基线，对噪声ASR转写保持稳健，并在专有模型上以较低API成本取得提升。
AI.conclusion: CGS能有效应对多粒度话题分割，无需训练即可提升分割性能，兼具鲁棒性和成本效率。

title: Query, Align, and Distill: Navigation-Aware Cross-Modal Interaction for Efficient Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Recent large-scale Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN) models deliver strong accuracy but remain costly to deploy due to their large parameter counts and computational requirements. We tackle efficient VLN in two steps. First, we build a high-performing teacher that makes navigation evidence selection explicit and compressible. The teacher introduces a small set of learnable query slots to extract global and local action-sufficient navigable evidence from panoramic observations via a Navigable Query Generator, then progressively grounds these evidence tokens to the instruction with an Instruction-Query Aligner for policy prediction. Second, using this explicit query bottleneck as a distillation interface, we train a compact student by transferring both where to attend and what to do. We distill the teacher's global and local navigable queries with a navigation-aware token-adaptive objective, then further match action distributions during fine-tuning. Experiments on standard VLN benchmarks demonstrate that our student nearly matches the teacher's navigation performance while reducing the number of parameters by 93.65% compared to the teacher.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究高效视觉语言导航（VLN），先构建显式且可压缩的教师模型，再通过查询瓶颈蒸馏训练紧凑学生模型，在保持接近教师导航性能的同时大幅减少参数量。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模VLN模型虽然准确率高，但参数量大、计算需求高，部署成本昂贵，因此需要实现高效VLN。
AI.method: 方法分两步：首先构建高性能教师模型，引入可学习查询槽，通过Navigable Query Generator从全景观测中提取全局和局部可导航证据，并用Instruction-Query Aligner将证据令牌与指令逐步对齐以进行策略预测；然后以该显式查询瓶颈作为蒸馏接口，采用导航感知的令牌自适应目标蒸馏教师的全局和局部可导航查询，并在微调阶段匹配动作分布，从而训练紧凑学生模型。
AI.result: 在标准VLN基准上，学生模型导航性能几乎与教师模型相当，同时参数量相比教师减少93.65%。
AI.conclusion: 显式查询瓶颈既能提升教师模型的可解释与可压缩性，又能有效用于知识蒸馏，实现高性能且轻量化的VLN模型。

title: GuardPIBT: Counterfactually Gated Neural Guidance for Ultra-Large-Scale 3D Multi-Agent Path Finding
summary: Large-scale 3D multi-agent path finding becomes increasingly difficult under dense traffic. Priority Inheritance with Backtracking (PIBT) scales well, but its one-step goal-directed ordering may become insufficient under dense interactions and large-scale congestion. We present GuardPIBT, which augments rather than replaces the PIBT executor: neural predictions only propose residual reorderings of PIBT's native candidates, while final actions remain determined by PIBT. First, local graph attention models nearby interactions, while global source--goal transport features provide population-level coordination context for candidate reordering. Second, a counterfactual group gate filters reorderings whose closed-loop effects may degrade coordination. Third, for ultra-large populations, population-adaptive grouping preserves decision granularity, asynchronous cached inference amortizes neural computation, and selective repair resolves long-tail agents. PIBT retains validity checking, priority inheritance, and backtracking throughout. Experiments with up to 100,000 agents demonstrate reliable completion across 2D and 3D environments, including all three 100,000-agent warehouse runs with zero audited graph violations. The project website is available at {\color{magenta}\texttt{https://guardpibt.github.io/GuardPIBT/}}.

AI.tldr: GuardPIBT 通过神经预测对 PIBT 原生候选动作进行残差重排序，在不替换 PIBT 执行器的前提下提升密集大规模 3D 多智能体路径规划性能，最多支持 10 万智能体。
AI.motivation: PIBT 可扩展性好，但其单步目标导向排序在密集交互和大规模拥塞下可能不足；研究希望在不破坏 PIBT 有效性检查、优先级继承和回溯机制的前提下改进其决策排序。
AI.method: 神经预测仅提出对 PIBT 原生候选的残差重排序，最终动作仍由 PIBT 决定。使用局部图注意力建模邻近交互，全局源-目标传输特征提供种群级协调上下文；用反事实组门过滤可能降低闭环协调效果的重排序；针对超大规模种群，采用种群自适应分组、异步缓存推理和选择性修复长尾智能体。
AI.result: 在最多 100,000 个智能体的实验中，GuardPIBT 在 2D 和 3D 环境中均能可靠完成任务，包括全部三次 100,000 智能体仓库运行，且审计图违规为零。
AI.conclusion: 在保留 PIBT 安全保证和核心机制的同时，神经残差重排序与可扩展系统设计可有效提升密集、大规模多智能体路径规划性能，并适用于超大规模场景。

title: Reciprocal Guidance: Orchestrating Draft and Verify Budgets for Advancing the Diffusion-AR Self-Speculation Frontier
summary: Diffusion drafting with autoregressive (AR) verification has emerged as a promising paradigm for efficient speculative decoding. Recent self-speculation models, represented by Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion, further simplify the speculative pipeline by unifying drafting and verification within a shared backbone, while enabling longer acceptance lengths. However, the Pareto frontier between aggregate and per-request throughput remains underexplored. At low concurrency, sequential draft-verify execution requires two model forward passes per round, limiting the effective tokens per forward (TPF). By contrast, at high concurrency, longer drafts incur increasingly expensive computation, forcing individual requests to operate under constrained speculation budgets and preventing full exploitation of the full-backbone drafter. Our key observation indicates that drafting and verification exhibit reciprocal predictability. Draft logits can anticipate likely verification mismatches, while recent verification outcomes predict future drafting utility and suitable block sizes. Building on this observation, we introduce Reciprocal Guidance (RecGuide), a runtime draft-verify orchestration framework that adapts speculative decoding to varying serving loads. RecGuide exploits spare compute capacity through verification-overlapped drafting at low concurrency, while dynamically allocating request-specific draft block sizes as the workload becomes increasingly compute-intensive. Experiments across a wide range of concurrency levels demonstrate consistent throughput improvements over vanilla self-speculation, achieving up to $1.8\times$ speedup.

AI.tldr: 提出 RecGuide，一种运行时草稿-验证编排框架，根据服务负载自适应调整扩散草稿+自回归验证的推测解码流程：低并发时让草稿与验证重叠以利用空闲算力，高并发时动态分配请求级草稿块大小，吞吐相比 vanilla self-speculation 最高提升 1.8 倍。
AI.motivation: 扩散草稿+AR 验证的推测解码（如 Nemotron-Labs-Diffusion 等自推测模型）虽简化了流水线并支持更长接受长度，但聚合吞吐与单请求吞吐之间的 Pareto 前沿仍未被充分探索：低并发下顺序 draft-verify 每轮需两次前向，有效每前向 token 数（TPF）受限；高并发下长草稿计算代价剧增，单请求推测预算受限，无法充分利用全骨干草稿器。
AI.method: 基于“草稿与验证具有相互可预测性”的观察（草稿 logits 可预示验证不匹配，近期验证结果可预测未来草稿效用与合适块大小），提出 Reciprocal Guidance（RecGuide）运行时编排框架：低并发时通过验证重叠草稿（verification-overlapped drafting）利用空闲算力，负载计算密集化时动态分配请求特定的草稿块大小。
AI.result: 在广泛的并发水平下，相比 vanilla self-speculation 均取得一致的吞吐提升，最高实现 1.8 倍加速。
AI.conclusion: 利用草稿与验证之间的相互指导进行运行时编排，可使推测解码自适应不同服务负载，在低并发与高并发场景下均提升吞吐，突破自推测解码的吞吐 Pareto 限制。

title: From Pixel to Poses: Object-centric Tool Manipulation Learning from Human Demonstrations
summary: Scaling up robotic manipulation is primarily bottlenecked by the scarcity of real-world robot data. While recent approaches leverage human video demonstrations to mitigate this shortage, they remain computationally expensive and still rely on paired human-robot data for domain alignment. Although current state-of-the-arts excel at long-horizon tasks, they struggle with the delicate and precise control required for complex tool manipulation. To overcome these limitations, we introduce P2P-T, from Pixel to Poses for Tool Manipulation, a data-efficient, object-centric framework that learns tool use directly from human demonstrations. P2P-T bridges the cognitive and physical execution gap through a two-stage approach. First, pretraining an object-centric world model to extract stable pose priors; second, integrating these priors into an efficient, pose-aware low-level policy. By utilizing a robust automated data processing pipeline powered by modern foundation models, P2P-T completely bypasses the need for human-robot aligned data. This reduces overall training overhead drastically. With minimal per-task fine-tuning, our framework achieves a 73% improvement over the previous state of the art in execution performance on complex, real-world tool manipulation tasks that currently remain out of reach for standard large-scale pretrained models.

AI.tldr: P2P-T 是一个数据高效、以物体为中心的工具操作框架，可直接从人类演示中学习工具使用，通过两阶段方法弥合认知与物理执行差距，并在复杂真实世界工具操作任务上显著超越此前最佳方法。
AI.motivation: 扩大机器人操作规模主要受限于真实机器人数据稀缺；现有利用人类视频演示的方法计算开销大，且仍需配对的人-机器人数据做域对齐；当前最优方法擅长长时程任务，但难以完成复杂工具操作所需的精细、精确控制。
AI.method: 提出 P2P-T（从像素到姿态的工具操作）：先预训练以物体为中心的世界模型以提取稳定姿态先验；再将这些先验集成到高效、姿态感知的底层策略中；使用由现代基础模型驱动的自动化数据处理流程，完全绕过人-机器人对齐数据，并仅需少量逐任务微调。
AI.result: 在复杂真实世界工具操作任务上，执行性能相较此前最优方法提升 73%；这些任务对标准大规模预训练模型而言仍难以完成；同时大幅降低了整体训练开销。
AI.conclusion: P2P-T 通过从人类演示中学习以物体为中心的工具使用，无需人-机器人配对数据，即可实现精确工具操作，并在数据效率和真实世界执行性能上取得显著优势。

title: Trust and Task Completion in the World of Consumer AI Agents
summary: Action agents do things for people. They send email, spend money, and call businesses while the user is busy with something else, so a mistake can turn into an action before anyone notices. They fail their users in two ways. They break trust when they do something the user never agreed to, or hold back after the user clearly said go. And they fall short on completion when they give up on errands that turn out to be hard. Both depend heavily on the harness around the model, meaning its instructions, tools, context, and guardrails. We built an evaluation that scores trust and completion on the same runs, in a simulated world of businesses with their own websites, inboxes, and phone lines, and of people who write back. A simulated user answers the assistant's questions. Trust means that nothing happens the user did not agree to. No email goes to someone they never approved, no private detail ends up on a group thread, no money is spent past their limit, no stranger's instructions are followed, and nothing is claimed without a source. Every trap has a matched control in which acting is the right call. We use the evaluation to measure Fo, Wajo's personal assistant, against a base model with basic instructions on three foundation models, and against the Fo harness with its guardrails switched off. Fo completes 71% of the errands and keeps the user's trust on 94% of the trap runs. The base models complete 50% to 64% and keep trust on 59% to 75%. On the matched controls, Fo goes ahead slightly less often. OpenClaw, a popular open-source assistant given the same access, completes 42% of the errands it shares with Fo, against 71%, and keeps the user's trust on 74% of the shared trap runs, against 94%. Measuring trust and completion together, on the whole system rather than the model alone, is how we think action agents become safe to hand real work to.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一个仿真评测，同时衡量行动代理的信任与完成度，并比较 Fo 助手、基础模型、关闭防护栏的 Fo 以及开源助手 OpenClaw，说明应评估整个系统而非仅模型。
AI.motivation: 行动代理可代发邮件、花钱、打电话，错误会在用户未察觉时造成后果；它们会因越权、不服从或任务失败而失去信任，而这些行为高度依赖模型外围的指令、工具、上下文和防护栏。
AI.method: 构建包含企业网站、收件箱、电话线和模拟用户回信的仿真世界，在同一任务运行中同时评分信任与完成度；设置陷阱与匹配对照，测试 Fo、基础模型、关闭防护栏的 Fo 以及 OpenClaw。
AI.result: Fo 完成 71% 的任务，并在陷阱运行中保持 94% 信任；基础模型完成 50%-64%，信任 59%-75%；匹配对照中 Fo 略少擅自行动；OpenClaw 在共同任务中完成 42% vs 71%，信任 74% vs 94%。
AI.conclusion: 应同时衡量信任与完成度，并评估包含模型、指令、工具、上下文和防护栏的整个系统，而非只看模型，这才能使行动代理安全地承担真实工作。
