title: QSCP: Beyond Class-Name Prompts for Query-Guided Semantic Change Parsing
summary: Traditional change detection (CD) identifies changes between bi-temporal remote sensing images, while semantic change detection (SCD) assigns predefined land-cover classes. However, mapping all changes may not meet a user's specific needs. Referring change detection (RCD) enables selective retrieval through category prompts. However, existing category-prompted RCD uses the queried category to specify the destination of a change and returns only a binary mask of the corresponding regions. Users may instead request a particular transition and paired semantic maps to understand what changed into what. Such requests require explicit source and target reasoning beyond target-class localization. To address these needs, we propose query-guided semantic change parsing (QSCP), which supports category names, synonyms, and intent-bearing sentences and returns a query-specific mask with paired temporal semantic maps. QSCP parses requests into intents and semantic slots, composes bidirectional visual evidence, and predicts both temporal states with a query-conditioned decoder. On SECOND, QSCP outperforms RCDNet on synonym, sentence, and transition queries and improves end-to-end semantic prediction over evaluated semantic baselines. WHU-CDC experiments further assess cross-dataset transfer and consistency across equivalent expressions without target-domain training. Code is available at https://github.com/qianyuancs/QSCP

AI.tldr: 提出查询引导的语义变化解析（QSCP），支持类别名、同义词和意图句子，返回特定查询掩码和配对时序语义图。
AI.motivation: 传统变化检测和语义变化检测无法满足用户特定需求；现有类别提示的指代变化检测仅返回目标类二值掩码，无法理解“什么变成了什么”，需要源和目标推理。
AI.method: QSCP将请求解析为意图和语义槽，组合双向视觉证据，并使用查询条件解码器预测两个时序状态。
AI.result: 在SECOND数据集上，QSCP在同义词、句子和过渡查询上优于RCDNet，并提升端到端语义预测；WHU-CDC实验评估跨数据集迁移和等效表达一致性，无需目标域训练。
AI.conclusion: QSCP能有效处理多种查询形式，实现选择性变化解析和配对语义图生成，代码已开源。

title: When Pair Count Is Not the Sample Size: What All-Pairs Agent Comparisons Estimate
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop TAE (Trust-AI-Eval): Can We Trust AI Evaluation?
summary: When an agent benchmark compares every pair of leaderboard entries, the number of comparisons can look much larger than the independent evidence behind them: A versus B and A versus C both reuse A. Whether this reuse affects inference depends on what the analysis is meant to describe. If the board and its outcomes are fixed, the all-pairs mean is an exact summary of those entries, and any interval must come from another declared source of randomness. If the entries are instead treated as iid draws from a population of future configurations and the pair rule is regular and nondegenerate, the same mean is an order-two U-statistic whose first-order uncertainty depends on the number of configurations, not the number of pairs. We use near ties as the running example, but the distinction extends to other symmetric pair summaries when their regularity conditions hold. We examine both interpretations using a fixed SWE-bench Verified snapshot and an exact binary model with known truth. On SWE-bench, intervals that accounted for shared configurations were more than twice as wide as a pair-iid reference that treated the pairs as independent. In the exact model, pair-iid coverage fell far below the nominal level when edges shared endpoints but remained near nominal for matched independent edges. Results on two other fixed leaderboards show that exact summaries also depend on which pairs are included and how they are weighted. An all-pairs analysis must therefore state what is fixed, what is sampled, and how it handles shared entries and pair aggregation.

AI.tldr: 论文讨论基准排行榜中所有成对比较的统计推断问题：当比较共享同一配置时，比较数量会夸大独立证据。研究区分“固定排行榜”与“从未来配置总体中抽样”两种解释，并用SWE-bench、精确二元模型和另外两个固定排行榜验证共享条目与配对聚合对区间和覆盖率的影响。
AI.motivation: 排行榜常进行所有配对比较，例如A vs B和A vs C都复用A。若把配对当作独立样本，可能严重低估不确定性。因此需要澄清共享配置何时影响推断，以及全配对分析应如何声明固定对象、抽样对象和处理共享条目。
AI.method: 区分两种设定：若排行榜及结果固定，全配对均值只是这些条目的精确汇总，任何区间需来自其他声明的随机性来源；若条目被视为来自未来配置总体的iid抽样，且配对规则正则非退化，则该均值是二阶U统计量，其一阶不确定性取决于配置数而非配对对数。以近并列为例，使用固定的SWE-bench Verified快照和已知真值的精确二元模型，比较考虑共享配置的区间与配对iid参考的区间宽度和覆盖率，并在另外两个固定排行榜上检验配对包含与加权的影响。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench上，考虑共享配置的区间比配对iid参考宽一倍以上。在精确二元模型中，当边共享端点时，配对iid覆盖率远低于名义水平；而在匹配的独立边上，覆盖率接近名义水平。另外两个固定排行榜的结果表明，精确汇总还取决于纳入哪些配对以及如何加权。
AI.conclusion: 全配对分析必须明确说明什么是固定的、什么是抽样的，以及如何处理共享条目和配对聚合。否则，统计区间和推断可能因错误假设配对独立而产生误导。

title: Octree-based Video Representation
summary: Video models commonly use uniform grids even though visual complexity varies substantially across space and time. We introduce OctVideo, which approximates a video clip with an octree. This hierarchy recursively partitions a spatio-temporal volume into eight subvolumes, so that smooth regions remain coarse while detailed regions receive finer cells. Each leaf stores local RGB values and spatio-temporal gradients, supplemented by a lightweight learned residual. For reconstruction, a Conv1D VAE maps the serialized cells to a regular latent grid and selectively refines details during decoding. Our VAE achieves 36.12 dB PSNR with 38.2M parameters and 189.4 GFLOPs per clip on Kinetics-400 (K400). It also generalizes zero-shot to the high-resolution Densely Annotated VIdeo Segmentation (DAVIS) 2016 dataset with reconstruction quality comparable to the best evaluated models. On both datasets, it requires the fewest model FLOPs and achieves the fastest encoding and decoding among the evaluated models. OctVideo also supports video understanding, achieving competitive recognition performance with few input tokens when trained from scratch. By exploiting the redundancy already present in video signals and efficiently processing sparse structures, OctVideo provides an efficient representation for video.

AI.tldr: OctVideo 提出用八叉树对视频时空体进行自适应划分，以稀疏层级结构高效表示视频，并在重建和理解任务上取得有竞争力的性能与更高效率。
AI.motivation: 视频模型通常使用均匀网格，但视觉复杂度在空间和时间上变化很大，均匀表示会造成冗余和计算浪费。
AI.method: 将视频片段近似为八叉树，递归把时空体分成八个子体积，平滑区域保持粗粒度、细节区域使用更细单元；叶子存储局部 RGB 值和时空梯度，并辅以轻量学习残差。重建时用 Conv1D VAE 将序列化单元映射到规则潜网格，并在解码中选择性细化细节。
AI.result: 在 Kinetics-400 上，VAE 达到 36.12 dB PSNR，参数量 38.2M，每片段 189.4 GFLOPs；零样本泛化到 DAVIS 2016 时重建质量与最佳评估模型相当。两个数据集上均具有最少模型 FLOPs，编码和解码速度最快。视频理解方面，从头训练时用少量输入 token 即可取得有竞争力的识别性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用视频信号中的冗余并高效处理稀疏结构，OctVideo 为视频提供了一种高效表示方法。

title: AgentHop: A Diagnostic Benchmark for Agentic Multi-Hop Scientific Question Answering
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Evaluation and Datasets Track
summary: Agentic tasks require a large language model to interact with the world, navigating information and gathering evidence across multiple steps with restricted resources. Due to this complexity, agentic task failures arise from various sources, and pinpointing these failure causes is essential to diagnose and improve agentic systems. Existing benchmarks, however, tend to focus on a single leaderboard score, leaving the underlying failure modes opaque. To fill this gap, we introduce AgentHop, a diagnostic benchmark of 1,011 multiple-choice questions paired with a controlled seven-tool sandbox under fixed token, turn, and tool-call constraints. AgentHop reveals model vulnerabilities by dissecting a single accuracy score along four axes of agent operation: retrieval, synthesis, tool-call, and resource management. Across 19 models, we find that behavior clusters by model family, with tool-call signatures revealing distinct family fingerprints: GPT models commit early, Anthropic and GLM checkpoints verify before committing, DeepSeek and Kimi over-search, and Gemini-3 Pro stays balanced. Decomposed axes further expose within-family structure: Claude Opus 4.6 and Sonnet 4.6 land within one accuracy point yet diverge on retrieval-versus-synthesis emphasis, with Opus retrieving more and Sonnet synthesizing better. We release the full benchmark set and the harness to support diagnostic agent benchmarking.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 AgentHop——一个包含 1,011 道多选题、七工具受控沙盒、固定 token/轮次/工具调用约束的诊断型基准，将单一准确率分解为检索、综合、工具调用与资源管理四个维度，用于定位智能体任务的失败原因。
AI.motivation: 智能体任务需在受限资源下多步交互、搜集证据，失败来源多样；现有基准只关注单一排行榜分数，失败模式不透明，难以诊断和改进智能体系统。
AI.method: 构建 AgentHop 诊断基准：1,011 道多选题，配套受控七工具沙盒，固定 token、轮次与工具调用限制；沿检索、综合、工具调用、资源管理四轴分解准确率；评测 19 个模型，分析工具调用签名与行为聚类。
AI.result: 模型行为按家族聚类并形成工具调用指纹：GPT 倾向早提交，Anthropic 与 GLM 先验证再提交，DeepSeek 与 Kimi 过度搜索，Gemini-3 Pro 保持均衡。分解维度还揭示家族内差异：Claude Opus 4.6 与 Sonnet 4.6 准确率相差 1 分以内，但 Opus 更重检索、Sonnet 更擅长综合。
AI.conclusion: AgentHop 通过分解式诊断揭示单分数掩盖的失败模式与模型家族特征；作者发布完整基准与评测框架，以支持诊断型智能体基准评测。

title: SRE-Marathon: A Continuous, Change-Driven Benchmark for Autonomous Site Reliability Agents
summary: Benchmarks for site reliability engineering (SRE) agents are typically episodic: one fault is injected, the agent receives an incident task, and its response is scored. Production operation is not. Incidents surface through noisy alerts, overlap in time, and often originate from code or configuration changes. We present SRE-Marathon, a benchmark for long-horizon, continuous SRE operation. An agent is invoked at a fixed cadence with cumulative alert history and a persistent workspace while operating a live two-zone Kubernetes deployment as a fault orchestrator injects overlapping faults according to a seeded, production-calibrated schedule. Curated code and configuration changes deployed through the same build pipeline available for repair. Each run is recorded into a sealed bundle and scored offline: Marathon-Score credits each injected fault for ordered progress through correlation, localization, and repair, with all metrics computed deterministically from recorded system evidence. Across three applications and about sixty faults per run, the best of 10 methods reaches only 41.3 out of 100. Agents often correlate and localize faults, but almost never complete repairs while the faults remain active.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SRE-Marathon，一个面向长时程、连续 SRE 运维的基准测试。它在持续运行的 Kubernetes 环境中按固定节奏调用智能体，并注入重叠故障，离线确定性评分；最佳方法仅得 41.3/100。
AI.motivation: 现有 SRE 智能体基准通常是单故障、回合制的，与真实生产运维不符。真实事故来自噪声告警、时间重叠，且常由代码或配置变更引发。
AI.method: 构建 SRE-Marathon：智能体以固定节奏被调用，接收累计告警历史和持久工作区，运维双区 Kubernetes 部署；故障编排器按种子化、生产校准的时间表注入重叠故障；通过同一构建流水线提供代码与配置变更用于修复。每次运行记录为密封数据包并离线评分，Marathon-Score 按关联、定位、修复的有序进展对每个注入故障计分，指标由记录的系统证据确定性计算。
AI.result: 在三个应用、每次运行约 60 个故障的场景下，10 种方法中最佳仅得 41.3/100。智能体常能关联和定位故障，但几乎无法在故障仍活跃时完成修复。
AI.conclusion: 当前 SRE 智能体在长时程、连续、多故障重叠的生产式运维中能力有限，尤其在修复阶段表现不足；SRE-Marathon 为评估此类能力提供了更贴近生产的基准。

title: The Epistemics of Agent Memory: Measuring, and Governing, the Consolidation Decision in Long-Horizon LLM Agents
comment: 13 pages, 4 tables, no figures. A four-phase research program. Experiments executed and adversarially verified by PRIMA (arXiv:2605.24775); per-phase result files and preregistrations available to reviewers on request; certain mechanism internals held under controlled release (see Section 7)
summary:
Long-horizon LLM agents must convert accumulated experience into durable memory, deciding what to keep, compress, abstract into reusable skills and rules, or forget. We report a four-phase research program on this consolidation problem whose central finding is a shift in what is measured: from how much an agent remembers, to whether its consolidation decisions are any good, to whether those decisions can be trusted.
  Phase 1 learns episodic boundaries from agent traces by downstream utility; an honest near-miss (oracle correlation 0.691 vs a 0.70 bar) whose lasting output is a three-gate anti-leakage protocol. Phase 2 learns when to promote experience and to which abstraction level under a token budget, achieving a verified +22.7% task-success improvement with 7x compression, but exposing a degenerate-forgetting failure and a distribution-shift failure mode we name lambda-prevalence coupling. Phase 3 introduces ConsolidationBench, an oracle-by-construction benchmark that scores consolidation decisions against a known optimum on three non-circular axes; production retrieval systems retain information yet score zero on cross-level transfer. Phase 4 introduces governed consolidation: the decision wrapped in poison-resistance, reversibility, and auditability guarantees with a quality gate. Governance is statistically distinct from the quality score ($r^2 = 0.43$; partial $r = 0.27$; identical-quality policies differ threefold in governance), so the contribution survives independently of the metric's external validity. On that question we report a resolved negative: after a graded-reuse redesign removed a structural ceiling, a two-benchmark study with 2,532 real answer cells finds the quality score does not predict real transfer accuracy (pooled Spearman $ρ= -0.24$, n = 12, CI spanning zero). An adversarial self-critique pass cleared the final claim set with zero surviving overclaims.

AI.tldr: 论文报告了一个关于长时程LLM智能体记忆巩固的四阶段研究计划，核心发现是测量重点的转变：从智能体记住多少，到其巩固决策是否好，再到这些决策是否可信。
AI.motivation: 长时程LLM智能体必须将积累的经验转化为持久记忆，决定保留、压缩、抽象为可重用技能和规则，或遗忘。研究旨在解决这一记忆巩固问题。
AI.method: 采用四阶段研究：1) 基于下游效用从智能体轨迹中学习情节边界，并产出三闸防泄漏协议；2) 在token预算下学习何时提升经验及抽象层级；3) 引入ConsolidationBench，从三个非循环轴对巩固决策与已知最优解进行评分；4) 引入受治理的巩固，包含抗毒化、可逆性和可审计性保证及质量门。此外进行了两项基准研究（2,532个真实答案单元）和对抗性自我批评。
AI.result: 阶段1：oracle相关性0.691（未达0.70标准），产出三闸防泄漏协议。阶段2：任务成功率提升22.7%，压缩7倍，但暴露退化遗忘和lambda-流行度耦合失败模式。阶段3：生产检索系统保留信息但在跨级迁移上得零分。阶段4：治理与质量分数统计上不同（r²=0.43；偏r=0.27；相同质量策略治理差异三倍）；质量分数不能预测真实迁移准确率（合并Spearman ρ=-0.24，n=12，CI跨零）。自我批评清除所有过度声称。
AI.conclusion: 贡献独立于指标的外部效度而成立。治理与质量分数统计上不同。质量分数不预测真实迁移准确率的负结果已解决。研究重心从记忆量转向巩固决策质量，再转向决策可信度。

title: Memory in the Sky: Low-Altitude Question Answering with Multi-Agent Memory Aggregation
summary: This paper studies low-altitude question answering (LAQA), in which distributed unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) memories are aggregated at a ground server to answer questions about observations over a long horizon. Unlike conventional resource allocation based on sensing, communication, control, or computation metrics, LAQA requires an explicit measure of memory value. We propose a generative adversarial exam (GAE) that uses forward simulation to evaluate memory retrieval and exam scores to quantify memory quality. This enables the downstream QA value of candidate memories to be measured and optimized without accessing the internal mechanisms of the black-box captioning, retrieval, and reasoning pipeline. Building on this metric, we develop a memory-centric (MemCen) framework that jointly selects UAVs and allocates transmit power to maximize memory quality under communication constraints. In the noise-limited regime, we derive a QoM-aware capped water-filling law that explicitly connects task utility with physical-layer power allocation. We further develop penalty successive optimization (PSO) and learning to memorize (L2M) solvers. MemCen achieves QA accuracies of 92.4% and 84.0% in CARLA Town04 and Town05 under static and dynamic communication conditions, respectively. In real-world experiments, MemCen achieves 88.5% QA accuracy on the panoramic multi-agent system (PMAS) benchmark. Finally, UAV-to-robot-dog demonstrations further validate the practical utility of the acquired memories for environmental understanding and navigation.

AI.tldr: 论文研究低空问答（LAQA），将分布式无人机记忆聚合到地面服务器以回答长时程观测问题；提出以记忆为中心的MemCen框架，通过GAE量化记忆质量，并联合选择无人机与分配功率，在通信约束下提升问答精度。
AI.motivation: 传统资源分配多基于感知、通信、控制或计算指标，而LAQA需要显式度量记忆价值；同时黑盒的captioning、检索和推理流程内部机制不可访问，因此需要在通信约束下直接优化候选记忆的下游问答价值。
AI.method: 提出生成对抗考试（GAE），利用前向仿真评估记忆检索，并用考试分数量化记忆质量；基于该指标开发MemCen框架，联合无人机选择与发射功率分配以最大化记忆质量；在噪声受限场景推导QoM感知的截断注水定律，并提出PSO与L2M求解器。
AI.result: MemCen在CARLA Town04和Town05的静态与动态通信条件下分别达到92.4%和84.0%的QA准确率；在真实世界PMAS基准上达到88.5%的QA准确率；UAV-to-robot-dog演示进一步验证了所获记忆在环境理解与导航中的实用价值。
AI.conclusion: 以记忆质量为中心的资源分配能够有效量化和优化黑盒问答流水线中的记忆价值，在仿真与真实场景中实现较高QA精度，并支持下游机器人环境理解与导航应用。

title: Remember by Asking: Retrieval-Induced Memory Evolution for LLM Agents
summary: Long-term memory is essential for language agents to maintain coherent and effective behavior over extended, multi-session interactions. Existing memory systems mainly use retrieval at read time, while write-time memory formation still relies on direct extraction or compression. However, when future information needs are unknown, compressing an entire interaction in one pass can overlook locally important details that may matter later. To this end, we introduce RIME, a retrieval-induced memory framework that shifts memory construction from monolithic compression toward evidence-centered integration. RIME uses generic self-questions to retrieve focused dialogue evidence and grounds memory formation in both the retrieved evidence and relevant historical memories, which are jointly reconciled into an evolving memory bank with temporal and provenance information. At inference time, compressed memory serves as the primary rather than the sole source of evidence: when it cannot support an answer, RIME retrieves relevant source dialogue together with its local context to recover information omitted during memory formation, without resorting to full-history processing. Extensive experiments on LoCoMo with Qwen3-235B-A22B and GPT-5.6 Sol show that RIME consistently achieves the best performance across all three quality metrics among the compared methods, while requiring substantially fewer query-time LLM tokens.

AI.tldr: 提出RIME——一种检索诱导的记忆框架，将记忆构建从整体压缩转向以证据为中心的整合：写入时用通用自问检索对话证据并与历史记忆融合，推理时若压缩记忆不足则回溯源对话局部上下文，在LoCoMo上取得最佳性能且查询时LLM token大幅减少。
AI.motivation: 语言智能体在长期、多会话交互中需要长期记忆以保持行为连贯。现有系统多在读取时检索，写入时仍依赖直接抽取或一次性压缩。由于未来信息需求未知，一次性压缩整段交互会忽略日后可能重要的局部细节。
AI.method: RIME以证据为中心的整合替代整体压缩：1）用通用自问（self-questions）检索聚焦的对话证据；2）将记忆形成建立在检索到的证据与相关历史记忆之上，并联合协调为带时间与来源信息的演化记忆库；3）推理时以压缩记忆为主要而非唯一证据来源，当无法支撑回答时，检索相关源对话及其局部上下文以恢复记忆形成时遗漏的信息，且无需处理完整历史。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo数据集上，使用Qwen3-235B-A22B与GPT-5.6 Sol进行实验，RIME在三种质量指标上均一致优于所有对比方法，同时查询时消耗的LLM token显著更少。
AI.conclusion: RIME表明，将记忆构建从单次整体压缩转向基于检索证据的整合，并允许推理时回溯源对话局部上下文，可在提升长程对话记忆质量的同时显著降低查询阶段的计算开销。

title: Toward Comprehensive 3D Grounding: Orientation Grounding through Vision-Language Models
summary: Grounding is a core capability of spatial vision-language models, yet most existing work focuses only on where a referred object is. Many 3D tasks also require knowing how it is oriented. Although existing 3D VLMs may predict oriented boxes, box pose does not explicitly capture object-centric orientation or symmetry-induced ambiguities. We introduce orientation grounding, a referring grounding task that predicts an object's 6D orientation and axial symmetry from a language or box query in single-view or multi-view scenes. To support this task, we construct ReferOri, with 331K multi-view and 387K single-view orientation-grounding queries obtained through scalable reconstruction, consistency checking, and human verification. We further present OG-VLM, which adapts a 3D VLM with structured box/orientation outputs, sign and symmetry tokens, and geometry-aware auxiliary losses. Across single-view and multi-view benchmarks, OG-VLM substantially outperforms orientation-aware VLM baselines and surpasses object-level orientation foundation models on scene-level referring benchmarks, showing that explicit orientation grounding is a distinct and learnable capability beyond localization. Downstream results validate its benefit for orientation-related spatial reasoning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出方向接地（orientation grounding）任务：根据语言或框查询预测物体的6D方向与轴对称性，并构建ReferOri数据集与OG-VLM模型。
AI.motivation: 现有3D视觉语言模型多关注物体位置，即便预测有向框，框姿态也不能显式表达物体自身方向及对称性歧义，而许多3D任务需要知道物体朝向。
AI.method: 定义单/多视角下的方向接地任务；通过可扩展重建、一致性检查与人工验证构建331K多视角和387K单视角查询的ReferOri；提出OG-VLM，改造3D VLM，加入结构化框/方向输出、符号与对称性token、几何感知辅助损失。
AI.result: 在单/多视角基准上，OG-VLM显著优于方向感知VLM基线，并在场景级指代基准上超过物体级方向基础模型；下游方向相关空间推理也获益。
AI.conclusion: 显式方向接地是超越定位的独立且可学习能力，验证了其价值。

title: Unbiased Top-$k$ Estimation for On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is becoming an important component of large language model (LLM) post-training for transferring the reasoning capability of a strong teacher LLM to a weaker student LLM. OPD trains the student by minimizing the reverse KL divergence between the teacher and the student via rollouts generated by the student's policy. However, estimating the gradient of the reverse KL divergence in OPD remains a challenge. Using only the sampled token from the student-generated rollout is computationally cheap but provides limited distributional supervision, which will degrade accuracy. In addition, using the full vocabulary provides complete distributional supervision but is computationally expensive. Therefore, recent works propose Top-$k$ OPD (TK-OPD) that use selected top-$k$ tokens, which provides richer distributional supervision than sampled-token estimation at substantially lower computational cost than full-vocabulary estimation. Unfortunately, using only the selected top-$k$ tokens induces bias, leading to accuracy degradation, as the probability mass outside the selected top-$k$ tokens is discarded. To address the bias of TK-OPD, we propose Tail-Corrected Top-$k$ On-Policy Distillation (TT-OPD). It preserves the advantages of TK-OPD, including rich distributional supervision and low computational cost, while providing an unbiased estimator of the gradient of the reverse KL divergence. The key insight of TT-OPD is to use not only the selected top-$k$ tokens, but also the sampled token from the student-generated rollout, thereby recovering the discarded probability mass in expectation, avoiding the bias. Experimental results demonstrate that TT-OPD significantly outperforms other tested OPD variants.

AI.tldr: 提出TT-OPD方法，通过结合Top-k令牌与学生采样令牌，实现无偏的反向KL散度梯度估计，用于LLM的在线策略蒸馏，性能优于其他OPD变体。
AI.motivation: 在线策略蒸馏中，反向KL散度梯度估计面临困难：仅用采样令牌计算廉价但监督有限；全词表计算昂贵；Top-k方法提供更丰富监督且成本低，但丢弃Top-k外概率质量导致偏差，降低准确率。
AI.method: TT-OPD在Top-k令牌基础上，额外使用学生rollout中的采样令牌，以期望方式恢复被丢弃的概率质量，从而获得反向KL散度梯度的无偏估计，同时保留Top-k方法的丰富监督和低计算成本。
AI.result: 实验表明，TT-OPD显著优于其他测试的OPD变体。
AI.conclusion: TT-OPD有效解决了Top-k OPD的偏差问题，在保持低计算成本的同时提供了无偏梯度估计，提升了蒸馏性能。

title: Agent Safety From Within: Detecting Harmful Trajectories from LLM Internal States
summary: Language model agents can now perform sophisticated sequences of actions via tools and harnesses, which has increased the scope of the damage they can cause. Guard models, however, are mainly built for content moderation and thus are not well-suited to detecting this agentic risk. To address this, we proceed by first conducting a representational analysis, then use the resulting insights to build a solution. In our analysis, we focus on two types of trajectory-level agentic harms: harmful content, which is expressed directly, and unsafe tool use, which depends on whether an action is consistent with the interaction that produced it. We investigate how open-source guard models represent these two types of harm and find that they are linearly readable inside the model, even though guard models predict no better than chance on pairs that differ only in the called tool's schema. The two harm types also follow nearly orthogonal internal directions, and neither reliably serves as a proxy for the other. These results motivate reading trajectory safety directly from internal states. We introduce TACIT, a readout of a frozen backbone's internal states that decodes no tokens. Trained on six trajectory-safety benchmarks, a linear probe raises mean macro-F1 from 62.3 for the strongest open guard to 80.7, and refined readouts reach 86.2. With each benchmark held out of training entirely, the refined readouts still lead the strongest guard (65.7 vs. 61.1). With the same backbone, training data and test split, the frozen readout is on par with full safety fine-tuning, and it improves the fine-tuned model further when applied on top. The probe trains about one millionth as many parameters as full fine-tuning in about a sixth of the time, and TACIT has the lowest latency of the guards we evaluate.

AI.tldr: 论文研究语言模型智能体轨迹级安全风险，发现开源守卫模型内部状态可线性解码两类智能体危害，并提出TACIT方法直接从冻结主干内部状态读取安全性，在多个轨迹安全基准上显著优于现有守卫模型。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体可通过工具执行复杂动作，带来更大破坏范围，但现有守卫模型主要面向内容审核，难以检测智能体层面的风险，因此需要专门针对轨迹级智能体危害的检测方法。
AI.method: 先对开源守卫模型进行表征分析，聚焦直接表达的危害内容与依赖动作一致性的不安全工具使用两类轨迹级危害；发现这些危害在模型内部可线性读取，且两类方向近乎正交。据此提出TACIT：不解码token，仅从冻结主干内部状态训练线性探针与精炼读出器，并在六个轨迹安全基准上训练与评估。
AI.result: 线性探针将平均宏F1从最强开源守卫的62.3提升至80.7，精炼读出器达86.2；在完全留出基准上仍以65.7优于最强守卫的61.1。相同主干、训练数据和测试划分下，冻结读出器与完整安全微调相当，叠加后还能进一步提升微调模型；训练参数量约为完整微调的百万分之一，耗时约六分之一，且延迟最低。
AI.conclusion: 直接从模型内部状态读取轨迹安全性是检测智能体风险的有效且高效方案，TACIT在性能、泛化、成本与延迟上均具优势，可作为现有守卫模型与安全微调的补充或替代。

title: Train Together or Merge Later? Unifying VLA Experts via a Shared Action Interface
summary: Co-training offers a straightforward way to build a multi-task vision-language-action (VLA) policy, but can fall short of the performance achieved by training each task independently. The challenge is to retain these task-specific gains in a multi-task policy without joint post-training. Combining independently trained experts through model merging is a natural approach, yet strong individual experts do not necessarily yield a strong merged policy. We identify one source of this incompatibility: task-specific changes to the action interface, comprising action normalization and the action encoder and decoder. We propose PolicyWeave, combining merge-compatible post-training with context-guided sparse merging. During post-training, all experts retain the common base policy's action interface, while task adaptation is restricted to LoRA updates in the hidden layers of the action model. This makes the experts more compatible with existing model merging methods. However, merging all experts can still introduce interference from unrelated tasks at deployment. PolicyWeave scores each expert's LoRA updates using the initial visual-language context, determines the expert set through leave-one-layer-out ranking stability, and forms a sparse weighted merge of the selected updates that remains fixed for current task. We evaluate PolicyWeave with GR00T N1.5 on 18 RoboCasa365 tasks, using only 10% of the target-task demonstrations for supervised fine-tuning (SFT). Preserving the shared action interface raises the average success rate across four static merging methods from 17.0% to 52.8%. PolicyWeave achieves 64.7% success with these SFT experts and 74.1% after task-specific reinforcement learning (RL), compared with 60.7% for joint RL. Further evaluations on LIBERO-10 and an AgileX Piper arm support the deployment of independently learned skills in long-horizon and real-world manipulation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PolicyWeave，通过保持共享动作接口的兼容性微调与基于上下文引导的稀疏合并，将独立训练的专家模型有效融合为多任务 VLA 策略，在 RoboCasa365 等任务上显著优于联合训练。
AI.motivation: 多任务视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略的联合协同训练往往不如各任务独立训练的性能。直接合并独立专家模型时，强专家未必能合并出强策略。作者发现不兼容的一个来源是任务特定的动作接口改动（动作归一化、动作编码器与解码器）。
AI.method: PolicyWeave 包含两部分：（1）合并兼容的后训练：所有专家保留基础策略的共享动作接口，任务适配仅限动作模型隐藏层的 LoRA 更新；（2）上下文引导的稀疏合并：用初始视觉-语言上下文为各专家 LoRA 更新打分，通过留一层排序稳定性确定专家集合，对选中的更新做稀疏加权合并，且该合并对当前任务固定。
AI.result: 在 GR00T N1.5 与 RoboCasa365 的 18 个任务上，仅用 10% 目标任务演示做 SFT：保持共享动作接口使四种静态合并方法的平均成功率从 17.0% 提升至 52.8%；PolicyWeave 达到 64.7%，经任务特定强化学习（RL）后达 74.1%，而联合 RL 为 60.7%。在 LIBERO-10 和 AgileX Piper 机械臂上的进一步实验支持了独立学习技能在长时程与真实世界操作中的部署。
AI.conclusion: 保留共享动作接口可显著提升专家合并兼容性，结合上下文引导的稀疏合并能有效减少无关任务干扰，从而将独立训练的技能成功部署到多任务、长时程及真实机器人操作中。

title: BudgetVerify: Budget-Tiered Verification for Financial QA
summary: Financial question answering often requires precise numerical extraction, unit handling, and arithmetic over tables and text, but applying expensive verification uniformly wastes test-time compute. We propose BudgetVerify, a budget-tiered generator-verifier framework that routes each generated answer to one of three verification tiers: no verification, lightweight check-and-revise, or higher-cost solve-first-then-compare verification. The router is trained from offline correctness and token-cost outcomes and, at test time, selects a verification tier using information available before verification, including the question, context statistics, the generated answer, and associated generator metadata. The selected tier either returns the generated answer directly or invokes the corresponding verifier. Across six commercial and open-weight base models, BudgetVerify consistently produces more efficient accuracy-cost Pareto frontiers than fixed verification policies by selectively allocating stronger verification only when it is useful. Although absolute performance varies across models, these efficiency gains and the resulting qualitative frontier shape are consistent across generator models.

AI.tldr: 提出 BudgetVerify，一种预算分层的生成-验证框架，用于金融问答，通过按需选择验证层级来提升准确率-成本效率。
AI.motivation: 金融问答常需精确数值提取、单位处理和表格/文本算术，但统一使用昂贵验证会浪费测试时计算资源。
AI.method: 将生成答案路由到三级验证：无验证、轻量检查与修正、高成本先解后比。路由器基于离线正确性和 token 成本训练，测试时利用问题、上下文统计、生成答案和生成器元数据选择验证层级。
AI.result: 在六种商用和开源基础模型上，BudgetVerify 比固定验证策略产生更高效的准确率-成本帕累托前沿，仅在有用时分配更强验证。绝对性能因模型而异，但效率增益和前沿形状跨模型一致。
AI.conclusion: 预算分层且选择性的验证能有效改善金融问答的准确率-成本权衡，并具有跨生成器模型的一致性。

title: Uni-VLaT: Whole-Body Tactile Adaptation of VLA Policies for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
summary: Physical contact often determines how a humanoid should respond during loco-manipulation, yet vision and proprioception alone are often insufficient to characterize physical interaction, especially when the contact region is occluded. Unlike sparse force or torque measurements at predefined regions, distributed tactile sensing preserves spatially resolved contact patterns across the robot body. We therefore study how to integrate such whole-body tactile information into vision-language-action (VLA) policies for contact-rich control. Our approach, Uni-VLaT, introduces a tactile pathway whose latent state is trained not only for action generation, but also to predict future tactile, proprioceptive, and visual representations. This predictive objective builds a tactile-anchored multimodal context, encouraging a more structured understanding of the physical world. We evaluate Uni-VLaT on five real-robot tasks covering tactile-triggered locomotion, sustained physical interaction, human-robot contact, and loco-manipulation. Uni-VLaT achieves a 75% average success rate, outperforming a baseline without tactile input by 43 points and a tactile-input baseline without predictive supervision by 7 points. Across two pretrained VLA backbones, our method improves Table Sweeping by 30 points on both backbones and Back-Tap Walking by 85-90 points. Ablations further show that contextualized tactile prediction and absolute future targets are critical to performance. These results indicate that predictive tactile learning provides an effective route for extending pretrained VLA policies to whole-body physical interaction.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出Uni-VLaT，将全身分布式触觉信息集成到视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略中，通过预测未来触觉、本体感觉和视觉表征来学习触觉潜状态，从而增强接触丰富的控制任务。
AI.motivation: 在移动操作中，物理接触常决定人形机器人的响应，但仅靠视觉和本体感觉不足以表征物理交互，尤其是接触区域被遮挡时。稀疏的力/力矩测量也无法提供全身空间分辨的接触模式，因此需要利用分布式触觉传感。
AI.method: 提出Uni-VLaT，在VLA策略中引入触觉通路，其潜状态不仅用于动作生成，还预测未来的触觉、本体感觉和视觉表征。这种预测目标构建了以触觉为锚的多模态上下文，促进对物理世界的结构化理解。
AI.result: 在五个真实机器人任务上评估，平均成功率达75%，比无触觉基线高43个百分点，比有触觉但无预测监督的基线高7个百分点。在两个预训练VLA骨干上，Table Sweeping提升30个百分点，Back-Tap Walking提升85-90个百分点。消融表明上下文触觉预测和绝对未来目标至关重要。
AI.conclusion: 预测性触觉学习为将预训练VLA策略扩展到全身物理交互提供了一条有效途径。

title: Revision, Not Restart: Revisable Visual Plans for Closed-Loop World-Action Models
summary: World-action models use predicted visual futures to condition robot actions, yet execution feedback can invalidate parts of a prediction while leaving its task structure useful. We propose Revisable Temporal Planning (RTP), which maintains the visual future as a persistent action condition and revises it after feedback. Its central mechanism is a learned revision bridge: it resumes an intermediate state saved during visual generation and adapts its continuation to current observations. Visual and action supervision connect this revision to subsequent control. Time-aware history supplies observed evidence, and an adaptive policy selects retention, bridge revision, or fresh replanning from new noise before decoding the next action. On RoboMME and RMBench, RTP achieves task-averaged success rates of 48.6% and 84.8%, respectively. Matched comparisons support learned continuation; estimated checkpoint-source and action-prefix effects are positive but less precisely resolved. These results connect feedback-driven visual-plan revision to closed-loop task performance. Project Page: https://PLACEHOLDER.github.io/RTP/

AI.tldr: 提出可修订时序规划（RTP），将预测的视觉未来作为持续的动作条件，并在获得执行反馈后对其进行修订，从而用于机器人闭环控制。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型常利用预测的视觉未来来条件化机器人动作，但执行反馈可能使预测的部分内容失效，而其任务结构仍然有用，因此需要一种能保留并修订视觉计划的方法。
AI.method: RTP 的核心是学习到的修订桥：恢复视觉生成过程中保存的中间状态，并根据当前观测调整其后续生成；视觉与动作监督将该修订连接到后续控制；时间感知历史提供观测证据；自适应策略根据新噪声选择保留、桥接修订或重新规划，再解码下一动作。
AI.result: 在 RoboMME 和 RMBench 上，RTP 的任务平均成功率分别为 48.6% 和 84.8%；匹配比较支持学习式继续生成，估计的检查点来源与动作前缀效应为正，但精度较低。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，反馈驱动的视觉计划修订能够与闭环任务性能有效连接。

title: Self-Evolving Coding Agents: From Digital Programs to Physical-World Intelligence
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) and world-action (WAM) models map observations and instructions directly to robot actions. This directness ties a policy to training: minor layout or viewpoint changes cause failure, and instructions generalize poorly. The root cause lies in representation: task requirements, conditions, progress, and failure recovery are implicitly encoded in action sequences, making them difficult to inspect or revise. Digital coding agents offer a precedent: LLMs call tools, verify results, and revise from feedback as executable code. The same working pattern of explicit state, manageable execution, and revisable procedures underlies generalization and long-horizon execution in the physical world, letting physical experience return as reusable programs, memory, or evidence. We propose Physical Coding, representing task state and execution as code. Code as World records objects, relations, constraints, and progress; Code as Policy organizes planning, verification, recovery, and execution. We build HexaAnything, which calls perception, planning, and control tools, including VLA/WAM policies, and makes in-the-loop decisions from external feedback. Verified traces become data and memory, enabling evolution from tools and Harness to model weights, architectures, and ultimately hardware and task design. On RoboCasa365, HexaAnything improves Composite-Unseen and overall success over XR-1 VLA, and its Harness-trained HexaModel beats the base on every split, indicating code traces internalize physical execution. On PhyBench and a dual-arm AgileX robot, the agent autonomously completes physics experiments and most tabletop tasks, often faster than published results. We observe data, model, and tool self-evolution; future work targets weight internalization, autonomous redesign of architectures, languages, representations, and tasks, and deployment in manufacturing and science.

AI.tldr: 提出Physical Coding，将机器人任务状态与执行表示为代码，构建HexaAnything，通过调用感知、规划、控制工具（含VLA/WAM策略）并利用反馈进行决策，实现泛化与长时程执行。实验表明其在多个基准和真实机器人上优于基线，并能自我进化。
AI.motivation: VLA/WAM直接将观察和指令映射为动作，导致策略与训练绑定，布局或视角微小变化即失败，指令泛化差。根因是任务需求、条件、进度和失败恢复隐式编码于动作序列，难以检查和修正。数字编码代理（LLM调用工具、验证、修订）的成功启发了将物理任务用可执行代码显式表示。
AI.method: 提出Physical Coding，包括Code as World（记录对象、关系、约束和进度）和Code as Policy（组织规划、验证、恢复和执行）。构建HexaAnything，调用感知、规划、控制工具（包括VLA/WAM策略），基于外部反馈进行循环决策。验证后的轨迹成为数据和记忆，推动工具、Harness、模型权重、架构、硬件和任务设计的进化。
AI.result: 在RoboCasa365上，HexaAnything在Composite-Unseen和整体成功率上优于XR-1 VLA；其Harness训练的HexaModel在每个划分上均超过基座，表明代码轨迹内化了物理执行。在PhyBench和双臂AgileX机器人上，代理自主完成物理实验和大多数桌面任务，常快于已发表结果。观察到数据、模型和工具的自进化。
AI.conclusion: 代码作为物理世界任务表示可提升泛化与长时程执行，未来工作目标包括权重内化、架构/语言/表示/任务的自主重设计，以及制造和科学部署。

title: When Words Fall Short: Iterative Synergy Between Verbalized Reasoning and Hidden Features for LLM Confidence Estimation
summary: Confidence estimation is crucial for developing trustworthy large language models (LLMs), with most methods following estimator-based or verbalization-based paradigms. While recent research increasingly focuses on improving verbalized self-reports of confidence, we challenge the prevailing view that this approach surpasses independent confidence estimators. Our empirical study shows that a dedicated confidence estimator can substantially outperform verbalized confidence, indicating that LLMs' internal representations contain richer confidence signals. Building on this finding, we propose Iterative Policy-Estimator Training (IPoET), a framework that synergizes the complementary strengths of verbalized reasoning traces and informative representations. IPoET alternates policy optimization with estimator updating, integrating estimator-derived confidence feedback into policy learning and refreshing the estimator on new policy rollouts. Experiments across diverse datasets and Qwen and Llama backbones demonstrate that, by iteratively exploiting richer hidden features and adapting to the evolving policy distribution, IPoET consistently outperforms both estimator- and verbalization-based baselines in-domain and achieves superior or comparable results across all out-of-domain metrics. For more details, refer to https://github.com/xyk829/ipoet.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战“语言化置信度优于独立置信度估计器”的主流观点，发现LLM内部表示包含更丰富的置信信号，并提出IPoET框架，协同利用语言化推理轨迹与内部表示，以提升LLM置信度估计的可信度。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM置信度估计主要分为基于估计器和基于语言化两类。近期研究多认为语言化自我报告优于独立置信度估计器，但作者对此提出质疑，并通过实证发现专用置信度估计器可显著优于语言化置信度，表明LLM内部表示中有更丰富的置信信号。
AI.method: 作者先对独立置信度估计器与语言化置信度进行实证比较；随后提出迭代策略-估计器训练框架IPoET。该框架交替进行策略优化与估计器更新：一方面将估计器导出的置信度反馈整合进策略学习，另一方面在新策略展开上刷新估计器。
AI.result: 在多种数据集以及Qwen和Llama骨干模型上的实验表明，IPoET通过迭代利用更丰富的隐藏特征并适应不断变化的策略分布，在域内持续优于基于估计器和基于语言化的基线，并在所有域外指标上取得更优或相当的结果。
AI.conclusion: IPoET能够协同语言化推理轨迹与信息性内部表示的优势，通过迭代训练提升LLM置信度估计性能，说明内部表示与语言化方法并非替代关系，而是可以互补融合。

title: FOCUS: Benchmarking Retinal Model Generalization from Foundation Vision Encoders to Multimodal LLMs
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026, Evaluations & Datasets Track. Interactive benchmark dashboard: https://huggingface.co/spaces/focus-retina-benchmark/focus-retinal-benchmark-arena
summary: Progress in AI-based retinal image analysis has advanced with foundation models, yet evaluating their reliability remains challenging. Performance reported on a single dataset does not capture how models behave under dataset shift, across clinical definitions, or for different patient subgroups. This limitation is particularly critical in medical imaging analysis, where robustness, calibration, and fairness are essential for safe deployment. We introduce FOCUS (Foundation Ophthalmic Cross-Dataset Understanding under Shift), a cross-dataset benchmark for evaluating retinal fundus models that considers vision-only encoder models (VM), vision-language dual-encoder models (VLM), and multimodal large language models (MLLM). FOCUS harmonizes binary diabetic retinopathy, referable diabetic retinopathy, and glaucomatous optic neuropathy tasks across ten public datasets spanning diverse geographies, acquisition conditions, and label protocols. The benchmark evaluates models through a unified analysis layer that measures ranking performance, calibration, subgroup disparities, and image-quality robustness. We present a large-scale evaluation covering 532 base configurations and 228 MLLM configurations adapted through supervised fine-tuning with low-rank adaptation (LoRA). Results show that no model family consistently dominates across tasks and datasets: general VM encoders achieve the strongest average ranking performance, medical MLLMs are competitive but variable, and dual encoder VLMs benefit substantially from lightweight adaptation. Fine-tuning improves in-domain performance but exhibits heterogeneous transfer to external datasets, particularly in calibration. These findings demonstrate that retinal model evaluation is inherently multidimensional. FOCUS provides a practical framework and public benchmark to assess generalization, reliability, and robustness beyond single-dataset leaderboards

AI.tldr: 论文提出FOCUS，一个用于视网膜眼底模型的跨数据集基准，统一评估视觉编码器、视觉语言双编码器和多模态大语言模型在糖尿病视网膜病变与青光眼任务上的排序性能、校准、子群差异和图像质量鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有AI视网膜图像分析虽受益于基础模型，但单数据集性能无法反映数据集偏移、临床定义差异和不同患者亚组下的行为；医疗影像部署需要稳健性、校准和公平性，因此亟需跨数据集、多维度的可靠性评估。
AI.method: FOCUS整合十个公开数据集，覆盖不同地域、采集条件和标注协议，统一二分类糖尿病视网膜病变、需转诊糖尿病视网膜病变和青光眼性视神经病变任务；评估视觉编码器、视觉语言双编码器和多模态大语言模型，并通过统一分析层测量排序性能、校准、子群差异和图像质量鲁棒性，共涵盖532个基础配置和228个经LoRA监督微调的MLLM配置。
AI.result: 没有模型家族在所有任务和数据集上持续占优；通用视觉编码器平均排序性能最强，医学MLLM有竞争力但波动较大，双编码器VLM从轻量适配中获益明显；微调提升域内性能，但向外部数据集的迁移异质，尤其在校准方面表现明显。
AI.conclusion: 视网膜模型评估本质上是多维度的；FOCUS提供了实用框架和公开基准，用于超越单数据集排行榜，评估模型的泛化性、可靠性和鲁棒性。

title: Large Language Models Substantially Compress Well-Being Inequality but Largely Preserve Its Socioeconomic Structure
summary: Research using large language models (LLMs) to generate synthetic populations has repeatedly shown that model outputs compress the diversity of human experience. This has raised doubts about whether LLM-generated data can capture meaningful differences within populations. We show that such compression does not necessarily erase the social structure of human heterogeneity. Using 93,901 respondents from 66 countries and territories in Wave 7 of the World Values Survey, we ask six LLMs to predict respondents' life satisfaction from demographic, socioeconomic, and attitudinal profiles. All six models substantially understate the overall dispersion of life satisfaction. Yet after normalizing for these differences in scale, they largely reproduce the human income gradient in well-being inequality: lower-income groups remain relatively more heterogeneous than higher-income groups. The pattern is robust to country fixed effects, equal-country weighting, WVS survey weights, and observed demographic composition, and it extends directionally to employment, education, and perceived control. Fidelity is weaker for extreme outcomes and country-specific gradients. These results show that the amount of heterogeneity preserved by an LLM and the way that heterogeneity is distributed across social groups are distinct properties. LLM-generated populations can therefore substantially compress human variation while retaining meaningful information about where that variation is concentrated.

AI.tldr: 研究发现，尽管LLM生成的人群数据压缩了整体异质性，但仍能再现社会群体间异质性的分布模式，如收入与幸福感不平等的关系。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM生成的合成人群是否能捕捉人群中有意义的社会差异，尽管之前研究显示LLM输出会压缩人类经验的多样性。
AI.method: 使用世界价值观调查第七波66个国家和地区的93,901名受访者数据，让六个LLM根据人口、社会经济和态度特征预测生活满意度，并分析预测结果的异质性分布。
AI.result: 所有模型都低估了生活满意度的整体离散度，但归一化后，它们大致再现了收入与幸福感不平等的人类梯度：低收入群体异质性更高。该模式对固定效应、等国家权重、调查权重和人口构成稳健，并方向性延伸至就业、教育和感知控制。对极端结果和国家特定梯度的保真度较弱。
AI.conclusion: LLM保留的异质性总量与异质性在社会群体间的分布是两个不同属性。LLM生成的人群可以在大幅压缩人类变异的同时，保留关于变异集中位置的有意义信息。

title: DroneWAM: Efficient World Action Model for Drone Visual Navigation
summary: World-action models give visual navigation agents a way to anticipate how candidate actions will change future observations and to act from the predicted consequences. For drones, this capability must operate under tight accuracy and efficiency constraints. We present DroneWAM, an efficient world-action model for drone visual navigation. DroneWAM adopts a JEPA-based architecture to model future states directly in representation space, avoiding the cost of explicit future image generation. A pretrained Resampler further compresses dense encoder features into fewer latent tokens, reducing the computation repeated at each imagined step. We also introduce adaptive rollout, where a preference-trained Gate adaptively allocates prediction depth according to the current scene. To support learning under richer aerial motion, we construct DroneNav-6D, a simulated visual navigation dataset with synchronized RGB observations, 6-DoF flight trajectories, control commands, and randomized wind disturbances. On DroneNav-6D, DroneWAM achieves the best trajectory accuracy among the compared methods. Adaptive rollout further reduces the average prediction depth from 8 to 4.58 while improving trajectory accuracy, demonstrating that predictive computation can be allocated more effectively across scenes. \href{https://github.com/1e12Leon/DroneWAM}{Codes and data} will be released.

AI.tldr: DroneWAM是一种用于无人机视觉导航的高效世界-动作模型，采用JEPA架构在表示空间中预测未来状态，结合Resampler压缩特征与自适应rollout，在DroneNav-6D数据集上取得最佳轨迹精度。
AI.motivation: 世界-动作模型能让视觉导航智能体预测动作后果，但无人机场景对精度和效率要求严格，需要一种能在丰富空中运动与风扰下高效预测的方法。
AI.method: 采用JEPA架构直接在表示空间建模未来状态，避免生成未来图像；用预训练Resampler将密集编码器特征压缩为更少的潜在token；提出自适应rollout，由偏好训练的Gate根据场景动态分配预测深度；构建DroneNav-6D模拟数据集，含同步RGB、6-DoF飞行轨迹、控制指令和随机风扰。
AI.result: 在DroneNav-6D上，DroneWAM在对比方法中取得最佳轨迹精度；自适应rollout将平均预测深度从8降至4.58，同时提升轨迹精度。
AI.conclusion: 表明预测计算可以根据场景更有效地分配，兼顾无人机视觉导航的精度与效率；代码和数据将开源。

title: Rethinking Causal Action Tokenization with Conditional Annealing in Flow Matching
summary: Autoregressive Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a scalable path to robot learning, yet existing action tokenizers treat tokenization as a compression problem, producing representations that are semantically misaligned with the autoregressive backbone. We propose CATok, a causal action tokenizer that reframes tokenization as a causally structured generative process. CATok introduces a conditional annealing mechanism that extracts action tokens by progressively annealing a flow-matching process: each token is conditioned on all preceding tokens and encodes the residual reconstruction signal at a specific noise level, establishing a coarse-to-fine causal token space whose generative semantics are structurally aligned with autoregressive modeling. A token-conditioned flow-matching decoder built on Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MMDiT) reconstructs continuous action chunks from these discrete tokens with the precision of hybrid diffusion-head architectures. This discrete bottleneck enforces knowledge insulation by design, cleanly separating high-level semantic reasoning from low-level motor execution without requiring explicit attention masking. Extensive evaluations across three simulation benchmarks and real-world robotic manipulation tasks demonstrate that CATok consistently surpasses existing tokenization methods in both reconstruction fidelity-compression tradeoff and inference efficiency, while improving VLA task success rate and training efficiency, establishing a high-performance, scalable foundation for purely autoregressive VLA systems.

AI.tldr: 提出CATok，一种因果动作分词器，将动作分词重构为因果结构化生成过程，用于自回归VLA模型，在重建、压缩、推理效率和任务成功率上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归VLA模型的动作分词器把分词视为压缩问题，导致动作表示与自回归主干在语义上不对齐。
AI.method: CATok通过条件退火机制提取动作token：在流匹配过程中逐步退火，每个token以所有前序token为条件并编码特定噪声水平下的残差重建信号，形成由粗到细的因果token空间；并使用基于MMDiT的token条件流匹配解码器从离散token重建连续动作块。
AI.result: 在三个仿真基准和真实机器人操作任务中，CATok在重建保真度-压缩权衡和推理效率上持续超越现有分词方法，同时提升VLA任务成功率和训练效率。
AI.conclusion: CATok为纯自回归VLA系统提供了高性能、可扩展的基础，并通过离散瓶颈实现知识隔离，无需显式注意力掩码即可分离高层语义推理与底层运动执行。

title: RGDT-Bench: Benchmarking LLM Reasoning for Rule-Governed Decisions and Their Justifications
summary: We study reasoning in Rule-Governed Decision Tasks (RGDTs), where models apply external rules to case facts and justify decisions, as required in policy, contract, and compliance settings. Beyond the deductive capability emphasized by standard mathematical and logical reasoning tasks, RGDTs require interpreting rules and their applicability, assessing conditions from evidence, combining judgments under rules and exceptions, and providing checkable justifications. These demands motivate a benchmark assessing both decisions and their stated grounds. We introduce RGDT-Bench, providing 202.1K condition-level supervision slots across four task tracks and eight supported task-probe combinations that vary access to supporting information. Label-blind extraction and deterministic checks produce labels for warrant completeness: source-referenced coverage and consistency of stated decision grounds. The benchmark attributes failures to four process layers: rule use, condition, evidence, and aggregation, and checks the final outcome. Among evaluable correct responses, warrant incompleteness averages 40.2% across six evaluated LLMs and supported task-probe combinations. Such warrant incompleteness poses potential safety risks and remains difficult to detect: the best of seventeen existing evaluators reaches only 57.69% (random: 50%) task-averaged area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUROC). To address this difficulty, we train a simple reward model with warrant supervision. It achieves 69.24% task-averaged AUROC among correct answers, exceeding the matched outcome-supervised baseline by 10.37 pp (percentage points) and the best existing evaluator by 11.55 pp. Beyond completeness assessment, the model outperforms both outcome-supervised baselines across nearly all response-selection comparisons, supporting RGDT-Bench's warrant supervision for RGDT reasoning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向规则治理决策任务（RGDT）的基准 RGDT-Bench，评估模型决策及其理由是否完整、一致，并训练带理由监督的奖励模型来检测理由不完整问题。
AI.motivation: 传统数学和逻辑推理任务主要考察演绎能力，而政策、合同和合规等场景还要求模型解释规则及其适用性、基于证据评估条件、处理规则与例外并给出可核查的理由。因此需要同时评估决策和决策依据。
AI.method: 构建 RGDT-Bench，包含 202.1K 条件级监督槽、四个任务轨道和八种任务-探针组合；通过标签盲提取和确定性检查，为理由完整性生成标签，包括来源引用覆盖率和决策依据一致性。基准将失败归因于规则使用、条件、证据和聚合四个过程层，并检查最终结果。此外，训练一个简单的带理由监督的奖励模型。
AI.result: 在可评估的正确回答中，六个 LLM 和支持的任务-探针组合平均有 40.2% 的理由不完整。该问题难以检测：十七个现有评估器中最佳仅达 57.69% 的任务平均 AUROC（随机为 50%）。带理由监督的奖励模型在正确回答中达到 69.24% 的任务平均 AUROC，比匹配的结果监督基线高 10.37 个百分点，比最佳现有评估器高 11.55 个百分点，并在几乎所有回答选择比较中优于结果监督基线。
AI.conclusion: 理由不完整是潜在安全风险且难以检测；RGDT-Bench 的理由监督有助于评估和改进 RGDT 推理，带理由监督的奖励模型优于现有评估器和结果监督基线。

title: CARDAMOM: A Micro-Dialectal Arabic Speech Dataset for ASR
summary: We present Cardamom, a micro-dialectal Arabic speech dataset designed to support fine-grained evaluation and adaptation of automatic speech recognition (ASR) systems. Community-curated by native speakers familiar with the represented varieties, Cardamom contains approximately 40 hours of transcribed YouTube speech spanning 21 micro-dialects across Egypt, Jordan, Lebanon, Mauritania, Palestine, and Saudi Arabia. Each segment is annotated with one or more operational micro-dialect labels, code-switching information, and utterance-level perceived gender, enabling analysis of sub-country variation that is obscured by conventional country-level labels. We describe the collection and annotation process, motivate the micro-dialect inventory linguistically, and benchmark four multilingual ASR systems in zero-shot and adapted settings. The strongest zero-shot system obtains 43.47% aggregate WER, with particularly high error rates on Mauritanian and Lebanese varieties; adaptation on Cardamom reduces its WER to 35.21%. Audio-based identification experiments further show that the annotations provide a learnable prediction target, with a dedicated classifier reaching 85.57% accuracy on 21-way micro-dialect identification. Cardamom provides a resource for studying localized dialectal variation and developing Arabic speech systems with broader regional coverage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了Cardamom，一个由母语者社区共建的微方言阿拉伯语语音数据集，包含约40小时YouTube语音，覆盖6个国家的21种微方言，并用于ASR评估与适配。
AI.motivation: 传统国家级别的阿拉伯语方言标签会掩盖国家内部的细粒度方言差异，因此需要支持微方言级别评估和自适应的高质量语音资源。
AI.method: 收集并标注约40小时YouTube阿拉伯语语音，标注微方言标签、语码转换信息和语句级感知性别；对4个多语种ASR系统进行零样本和适配基准测试；并进行基于音频的21类微方言识别实验。
AI.result: 最强零样本系统总体WER为43.47%，在毛里塔尼亚和黎巴嫩方言上错误率尤其高；在Cardamom上适配后WER降至35.21%；专用分类器在21类微方言识别上达到85.57%准确率。
AI.conclusion: Cardamom为研究局部方言变异和开发覆盖更广区域阿拉伯语语音系统提供了有价值的资源，并表明微方言标注是可学习的预测目标。

title: LLM sequential decision making under uncertainty in biochemical domains
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to drive scientific discovery. Understanding how LLMs make decisions from new data and memory of the literature is vital before trusting them to design experiments under tight experimental budgets. However, their decision strategies are invisible in the current performance scores used to evaluate research agents. Here, we benchmark five frontier LLMs in a Bayesian Optimization setting against published statistical baselines on seven combinatorial datasets spanning protein engineering, reaction optimization, molecular design, peptide self-assembly, and catalysis. Performance is paired with direct measurements of model beliefs and actions, enabling highly resolved behavior analysis. A prompt ablation that progressively strips context separates memorization from chemical reasoning and from bare categorical optimization. Prior chemical knowledge helps in expectation, but with high variance and occasionally even harms performance. No configuration tested decisively beats a mean statistical baseline across domains. Belief-movement and Martingale diagnostics, corrected here for a measurement-noise bias that mislabels rational agents as irrational, show that models overreact to incoming data rather than entrenching on their priors in the contexts studied here. Interestingly, while LLM actions are exploitative, models sincerely intend to explore and consistently act on that intent. This failure is a competence gap arising from context-stickiness. Removing in-context history restores exploration, indicating that priors and data must be decoupled to achieve effective LLM-driven discovery.

AI.tldr: 该论文在贝叶斯优化场景中评估了五种前沿大语言模型，并与已发表的统计基线在七个组合数据集上进行比较，涵盖蛋白质工程、反应优化、分子设计、肽自组装和催化等任务。研究结合模型信念与动作的直接测量，分析LLM在科学发现中的决策策略。
AI.motivation: LLM正被越来越多地用于驱动科学发现，但在严格实验预算下，需要理解它们如何基于新数据和文献记忆做决策。现有性能分数无法揭示其决策策略，因此作者希望评估LLM是否值得信任以设计实验。
AI.method: 将五种前沿LLM置于贝叶斯优化设定中，在七个组合数据集上与已发表统计基线对比。同时直接测量模型信念和动作，并设计逐步剥离上下文的提示消融，以区分记忆、化学推理和纯类别优化。还使用信念移动和鞅诊断，并校正测量噪声偏差。
AI.result: 先验化学知识平均有帮助，但方差大，有时甚至损害性能。没有一种配置能在所有领域决定性地超越均值统计基线。校正后的诊断显示，模型对 incoming data 反应过度，而非固守先验。LLM动作是剥削性的，但模型真诚地意图探索并持续按该意图行动，失败源于上下文黏性导致的能力缺口。移除上下文历史可恢复探索。
AI.conclusion: LLM驱动的科学发现中，先验知识与数据必须解耦，才能实现有效探索和决策。当前模型存在探索意图与剥削行为之间的能力差距，需要改进上下文处理机制。

title: Papers Without Code: Availability of GitHub Repositories Linked in *CL Publications
comment: Accepted for publication in Computational Linguistics. Author's final version (pre-MIT Press publication)
summary: Source code and data published at computational linguistics (*CL) venues are increasingly being shared via GitHub. While this generally is a favourable development for the accessibility and potential reusability of research artifacts in natural language processing (NLP), the long-term availability of such repositories has not been evaluated. In this squib, we discuss the availability of repositories linked in papers published in the Computational Linguistics (CL) journal as well as at ACL and its co-located events over the past ten years. Contrary to our expectations, we find that GitHub repositories linked in more recent ACL publications are unavailable at similar rates as in older publications, in parts due to an increase in empty and placeholder repositories. Similar trends hold for other *CL venues, but not for platforms other than GitHub.

AI.tldr: 该文考察了计算语言学领域论文所链接 GitHub 仓库的长期可用性，发现近年 ACL 等论文中的仓库失效比例与较早年论文相近，部分原因是空仓库和占位仓库增多。
AI.motivation: 代码和数据通过 GitHub 共享日益普遍，有利于 NLP 研究可复现与可重用，但其长期可访问性尚未得到系统评估。
AI.method: 分析了过去十年发表在 Computational Linguistics 期刊、ACL 及其同期活动论文中链接的 GitHub 仓库，并与其他 *CL 场所及非 GitHub 平台进行对比。
AI.result: 与预期相反，较新 ACL 论文中的 GitHub 仓库不可用比例与较老论文相似，部分源于空仓库和占位仓库增加；其他 *CL 场所呈类似趋势，但非 GitHub 平台并非如此。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖 GitHub 链接并不能保证研究工件的长期可用性，*CL 领域需关注仓库失效问题，尤其应减少空仓库和占位仓库。

title: FloodDiffusion 2: Efficient and Path Controllable Streaming Motion Generation
summary: We present FloodDiffusion 2 (FD2), an efficient and controllable framework that builds upon FloodDiffusion (FD1), a state-of-the-art streaming motion generation model. While FD1 produces plausible motion, it suffers from low efficiency and limited controllability, as its attention design requires repeated computation over the entire history, and it lacks precise trajectory control for real-world applications. To address these limitations and improve generation quality, FD2 introduces three advances. First, Partial Attention makes finalized history representations independent of the active window, enabling KV-cached inference and shared-history packing for efficient training. Second, we establish a necessary-and-sufficient Bregman criterion for regression losses to preserve diffusion's conditional-mean velocity field. This criterion guides an FK-induced quadratic loss that incorporates motion geometry without online FK evaluation. Third, FD2 introduces precise path conditioning to control the character's root trajectory while preserving natural body motion. Experiments show that FD2 reduces training computation by 4.6$\times$ and accelerates denoising by 11.29$\times$, reaching 2.303 ms per update on long sequences. Alongside these efficiency gains, FD2 improves motion quality over FD1 and achieves state-of-the-art FID scores among streaming methods, with 0.048 on SEED and 0.053 on HumanML3D.

AI.tldr: 提出FloodDiffusion 2（FD2），在FD1流式动作生成模型基础上进行三项改进，同时提升生成效率、轨迹可控性和动作质量。
AI.motivation: FD1虽能生成合理动作，但效率低且可控性有限：其注意力设计需要对整个历史反复计算，并且缺乏真实应用所需的精确轨迹控制。
AI.method: FD2引入三项改进：1）Partial Attention使已确定历史表示独立于活动窗口，支持KV缓存推理和共享历史打包训练；2）提出回归损失的充要Bregman准则以保持扩散的条件均值速度场，并据此设计FK诱导二次损失，无需在线FK评估；3）引入精确路径条件，控制角色根轨迹并保持自然身体运动。
AI.result: FD2将训练计算减少4.6倍，去噪加速11.29倍，长序列每次更新仅2.303 ms；动作质量优于FD1，并在流式方法中取得SOTA FID：SEED上0.048，HumanML3D上0.053。
AI.conclusion: FD2在效率、可控性和生成质量上均优于FD1，并达到流式动作生成方法的领先水平。

title: Structure-Mapping-Guided Self-Explanation for Learning Mathematical Procedures
comment: 19 pages. Accepted for oral presentation at the Thirteenth Annual Conference on Advances in Cognitive Systems (ACS 2026)
summary: Worked examples are a powerful form of instruction, but learners must infer how the demonstrated steps were produced. A naive simulation of this self-explanation process can generate thousands of numerical explanations that reproduce one observed change without capturing its underlying procedure. We propose structure-mapping-guided self-explanation as a computational account of the cognitive biases that reduce search effort and make this inference tractable. The model represents mathematical expressions as typed relational structures and uses structure mapping to identify corresponding source and target regions. For each changed target value, the corresponding source region serves as an anchor: it guides abductive search toward structurally relevant values and operations before broader alternatives, yielding ordered, executable candidate procedures with inspectable source evidence. Across 70 mathematical transformations containing 120 changed numeric components, the model recovered every intended procedure. It returned the intended procedure before any other computation producing the same target value in 104 subproblems (86.7%), compared with a median of 32 (26.7%) across 100 unguided runs that tested candidate calculations in random order. Our proposed model also tested 93.8% fewer combinations of values and operations than unguided search before reaching the intended procedures. These results provide an efficient, interpretable account of how relational structure can guide procedural learning and a testable hypothesis about human self-explanation from worked examples.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种由结构映射引导的自我解释计算模型，用于从已解答示例中推断步骤背后的可执行程序。该模型将数学表达式表示为带类型的关系结构，并通过结构映射定位源区域与目标区域的对应关系，从而引导溯因搜索。在70个数学变换、120个数值变化组件上，模型全部恢复出预期程序，且比无引导搜索更高效、更早找到正确程序。
AI.motivation: 已解答示例是有效的教学形式，但学习者需要推断所示步骤是如何产生的。朴素模拟自我解释会生成成千上万个仅能复现某一观察变化的数值解释，却无法捕捉其背后的程序；因此需要解释认知偏差如何减少搜索并使推断可行。
AI.method: 提出“结构映射引导的自我解释”作为计算解释。模型将数学表达式表示为带类型的关系结构，利用结构映射识别源区域和目标区域的对应关系。对每个变化的目标值，以对应源区域为锚点，引导溯因搜索优先考虑结构相关的值和操作，再考虑更广泛的备选方案，从而生成有序、可执行、带源证据的候选程序。
AI.result: 在包含120个变化数值组件的70个数学变换中，模型恢复了全部预期程序。模型在104个子问题（86.7%）中先于任何其他产生相同目标值的计算返回预期程序；而无引导随机顺序测试的100次运行中，中位数为32次（26.7%）。此外，模型在达到预期程序前测试的值与操作组合数比无引导搜索少93.8%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，关系结构可以高效且可解释地引导程序学习，并为人类从已解答示例中进行自我解释提供了一个可检验的假设。

title: CoBrush: A Hierarchical Planning Framework for Human-Robot Co-Painting
comment: Accepted to the 2026 IEEE/RSJ International Conference on Intelligent Robots and Systems (IROS 2026)
summary: Embodied co-painting requires a robot to repeatedly update a shared physical canvas while human intent evolves over interaction. Existing reference-driven painters or reactive assistants are typically optimized for single-shot rendering or sketch completion, limiting their ability to sustain coherent multi-round collaboration or to construct complex, content-rich scenes over time. We present CoBrush, a hierarchical framework that formulates multi-round co-painting as a coordinated semantic, spatial, and execution process. By separating high-level intent inference from spatial grounding and stroke-level control, the system supports progressive scene development on real acrylic canvases. We evaluate the framework through real human-robot painting sessions, stress tests, and user studies. Compared to single-turn baselines, our approach achieves stronger semantic alignment, more stable spatial progression, and higher perceived plausibility of robot actions. These results demonstrate that structured multi-stage reasoning improves the coherence and robustness of interactive painting and supports the progressive development of content-rich physical artworks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoBrush，一种用于多轮人机协同绘画的分层框架，通过分离高层意图推断、空间定位和笔画级控制，在真实丙烯画布上实现逐步的场景构建。
AI.motivation: 现有的参考驱动绘画机器人或反应式助手通常针对单次渲染或草图补全优化，难以维持连贯的多轮协作，也无法随时间构建复杂、内容丰富的场景。
AI.method: 将多轮协同绘画建模为语义、空间和执行协调的过程，采用分层框架分离高层意图推断、空间定位和笔画级控制，并通过真实人机绘画实验、压力测试和用户研究进行评估。
AI.result: 与单轮基线相比，该方法在语义对齐、空间推进稳定性以及机器人动作感知合理性方面表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 结构化的多阶段推理能够提升交互式绘画的连贯性和鲁棒性，并支持内容丰富的物理艺术作品的逐步发展。

title: QureRadEmbed: Structuring Radiological Similarity through Attribute and Reasoning Supervision
comment: 39 pages, 10 figures, including appendices with per-tag labeling results. Janhavi Prabhu and Sahil are co-first authors. Manoj Tadepalli is the corresponding author
summary: Radiological similarity depends on disease relationships and on fine details such as laterality, lobe, severity, size, and certainty. Broad biomedical similarity can overlook these qualifiers, particularly when several attributes vary together. We introduce QureRadEmbed, a 4B radiology-aware encoder trained with two complementary signals: RadSim supplies deterministic, attribute-decomposed ranking targets, while RadThought aligns reports with hierarchical evidence and reasoning descriptions. A three-stage curriculum combines these signals with report triplets, finding perturbations, and single- and cross-attribute contrasts. The final model achieves 0.996 mean ordering accuracy across ten controlled synthetic attributes and raises Spearman correlation with the designed joint-attribute targets from 0.501 to 0.976. On external findings-to-impression retrieval, Recall@1 reaches 10.5% on Open-I, 12.4% on testing XR, and 42.9% on testing CT, compared with 6.6%, 5.7%, and 31.4% for its backbone. Frozen embeddings support finding extraction with only 100 labeled testing-XR reports (macro-F1 0.481 versus 0.412 for the backbone). Whole-report comparison costs 8.8 seconds per 1,000 pairs in our benchmark, versus 2,755.1 seconds for the generative evaluator GREEN. Sentence-level comparison improves sensitivity to local discrepancies, although generative evaluation remains stronger on several expert-rated and subtle-error tasks. The results support reusable radiology-aware representations for search, structured report indexing, and efficient report comparison.

AI.tldr: 提出QureRadEmbed，一个4B放射学感知编码器，通过RadSim和RadThought双信号及三阶段课程学习，提升放射报告相似度、检索和比较性能。
AI.motivation: 放射学相似性依赖疾病关系及侧别、肺叶、严重程度、大小和确定性等细粒度属性；广泛生物医学相似性会忽略这些限定词，尤其当多个属性共同变化时。
AI.method: 训练4B放射学感知编码器QureRadEmbed；使用RadSim提供确定性、属性分解的排序目标，RadThought对齐报告与分层证据和推理描述；三阶段课程结合报告三元组、发现扰动及单属性/跨属性对比。
AI.result: 在十个受控合成属性上平均排序准确率0.996；与设计联合属性目标的Spearman相关从0.501提升至0.976。外部发现到印象检索Recall@1：Open-I 10.5%、testing XR 12.4%、testing CT 42.9%，骨干分别为6.6%、5.7%、31.4%。冻结嵌入仅用100条标注testing-XR报告做发现抽取，macro-F1 0.481 vs 骨干0.412。全报告比较每1000对8.8秒，GREEN为2755.1秒；句子级比较对局部差异更敏感，但生成式评估在若干专家评级和细微错误任务上仍更强。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明可复用的放射学感知表示可用于搜索、结构化报告索引和高效报告比较。

title: Robot Tool Design from Scratch via Behavior-Aware Hierarchical Optimization
summary: The ability to design a tool for a task marks a level of intelligence beyond merely understanding, selecting, or using one. Existing methods for robotic tool design typically optimize a tool's continuous shape and action within a structure that is prescribed or generated beforehand, so the structure itself stays outside the physical optimization loop. We study task-driven tool design from scratch, where tool structure, shape, and action are all derived from the desired physical outcome. Here we show that the three elements can be designed jointly by HOT, a hierarchical optimization whose upper level searches over discrete tool structures with BASS, while lower-level physical optimization evaluates their task behavior and returns milestone progress as behavioral evidence for the search, ultimately providing jointly optimized shape and action. On four tool-use tasks with distinct physical functions, HOT discovers functional structures after evaluating only a small fraction of search spaces containing up to 56 million structures, and the subsequent refinement of their geometry lowers the task loss on all tasks while preserving success, through deformations that are functionally interpretable. Once 3D printed, the tools accomplish all tasks on a real robot with the actions found in simulation. Designing tools from required physical effects, rather than a catalog of known tools, is a step toward the open-ended tool making seen in humans and animals.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 HOT 分层优化方法，从任务所需的物理效果出发，联合设计工具的结构、形状与动作，并在仿真与真实机器人上验证。
AI.motivation: 现有机器人工具设计多是在预设或生成好的结构下优化连续形状和动作，结构本身不在物理优化循环中；作者希望实现从零开始、由任务物理结果驱动的工具设计。
AI.method: HOT 采用分层优化：上层用 BASS 搜索离散工具结构，下层进行物理优化，评估任务行为并返回“里程碑进展”作为行为证据指导搜索，最终联合优化形状与动作。
AI.result: 在四个具有不同物理功能的工具使用任务中，HOT 仅评估高达 5600 万个结构搜索空间中的一小部分，就发现了功能性结构；后续几何细化在所有任务上降低任务损失并保持成功率，且变形具有功能可解释性；3D 打印后，真实机器人用仿真得到的动作完成了全部任务。
AI.conclusion: 从所需物理效果而非已知工具目录来设计工具，是迈向人类和动物开放式工具制造的一步。

title: RoPE is Dead, Long Live RoPE: Towards Scalable Data-aware Positional Encodings
summary: Transformers process tokens without any inherent notion of order, making positional encoding a fundamental requirement rather than an architectural refinement. Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE) has become the default positional encoding in modern language models, yet it is heavily biased toward nearby tokens. Existing alternatives have been evaluated under different settings, leaving the literature fragmented and without a clear replacement. We bring structure to this landscape by examining a specific weakness of RoPE: its slow frequency bands, whose wavelengths exceed the training context and expose models to unseen angles during extrapolation. We therefore introduce Data aware RoPE (DaRoPE), which preserves standard RoPE on the fast bands but replaces absolute position on the slow bands with bounded coordinates learned from contextual representations. Therefore, the slow-band geometry depends on the data rather than only on positional distance. We compare representative encodings under matched conditions across synthetic tasks, symbolic music, genomics, neural signals, and language models spanning 124M to 50B parameters. Across these experiments, DaRoPE leads on non-text benchmarks, mitigates recency bias, while remaining best or on par in language modeling and length extrapolation. Moreover, the learned coordinates also make the mechanism interpretable, revealing how attention layers leverage contextual information beyond token distance. Together, these results support DaRoPE as the best overall default among the evaluated methods, when there is no domain-specific reasons to prefer another.

AI.tldr: 论文提出数据感知旋转位置编码 DaRoPE：快频段保留标准 RoPE，慢频段用从上下文表示学习的有界坐标替代绝对位置；在合成任务、符号音乐、基因组学、神经信号及124M-50B参数语言模型上，DaRoPE总体最佳或持平。
AI.motivation: RoPE 是现代语言模型默认位置编码，但强烈偏向邻近 token；其慢频段波长超过训练上下文，外推时暴露于未见角度。现有替代方案评测设置不一致，文献碎片化，缺乏明确替代选择。
AI.method: 分析 RoPE 慢频段缺陷后提出 DaRoPE：快频段保留标准 RoPE，慢频段以从上下文表示学习的有界坐标替代绝对位置，使慢频段几何依赖数据而不仅是位置距离。在匹配条件下比较代表性编码，覆盖合成任务、符号音乐、基因组学、神经信号和124M至50B参数语言模型。
AI.result: DaRoPE 在非文本基准上领先，缓解近因偏差，并在语言建模与长度外推中保持最佳或相当表现；学习到的坐标也使机制可解释，揭示注意力层如何利用超出 token 距离的上下文信息。
AI.conclusion: 在没有领域特定理由偏好其他方法时，DaRoPE 是所评估方法中最佳的整体默认选择。

title: ABO-Med: Accelerated Bilevel Optimization for Few-Shot Medical Image Classification
summary: In recent years, bilevel optimization has been widely used in a variety of machine learning tasks. However, prior bilevel optimization algorithms generally require the computation of second-order information, which limits their practical scalability. Only recently has a first-order paradigm for bilevel optimization been established, attaining near-optimal theoretical guarantees for solving bilevel optimization problems. In this paper, we propose ABO-Med, a scalable instantiation of this paradigm for few-shot learning, by incorporating it into the model-agnostic meta-learning (MAML) framework and tailoring it to medical image classification. We also introduce Medical Adaptive RandomAugment (MedRAug), a modality-aware augmentation strategy designed for medical images. Theoretically, ABO-Med establishes the optimality of MAML-type meta-learning approaches. Empirically, ABO-Med outperforms prior baselines on several public medical datasets, with gains of 1.99% to 18.76%, while MedRAug further improves the average accuracy by 2.20% to 6.34%. Additional cross-domain experiments, augmentation ablation studies, backbone ablation studies, and training efficiency analysis further validate the effectiveness and efficiency of the proposed method.

AI.tldr: 提出 ABO-Med，将一阶双层优化范式融入 MAML 用于医学图像小样本分类，并引入 MedRAug 数据增强；在多个公开医学数据集上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有双层优化算法通常需要计算二阶信息，实际可扩展性受限；近期虽有一阶双层优化范式并提供近最优理论保证，但仍缺少面向医学小样本学习的可扩展实例。
AI.method: 将一阶双层优化范式实例化为 ABO-Med，并整合到 MAML 框架；提出模态感知的 Medical Adaptive RandomAugment（MedRAug）增强策略；理论上证明 MAML 类元学习方法的近最优性；在多个公开医学数据集上开展实验、跨域实验、增强消融、骨干消融与训练效率分析。
AI.result: ABO-Med 优于已有基线，提升 1.99% 至 18.76%；MedRAug 进一步将平均准确率提升 2.20% 至 6.34%；跨域实验、消融实验和效率分析验证了方法的有效性与效率。
AI.conclusion: ABO-Med 为医学图像小样本分类提供了可扩展、有效且高效的双层优化/MAML 方案，MedRAug 可进一步增强性能。

title: The Model Knows Another Way: Strategy Switching for Effective RLVR Exploration
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) is often limited by insufficient exploration: difficult problems can yield uniformly incorrect rollout groups and therefore little learning signal. We show that such failures need not reflect missing capability. Instead, finite sampling often concentrates on a problem-specific dominant reasoning strategy while leaving alternative strategies already supported by the model unexplored. Moreover, the accessibility of these strategies evolves during RL: some are internalized into autonomous behavior, while others become difficult to elicit before being absorbed. Motivated by these observations, we introduce Problem--Strategy Rollout Allocation (PSRA), which treats unguided and strategy-conditioned prompts as competing exploration arms and uses Bayesian sequential allocation to direct a fixed rollout budget toward arms most likely to yield informative, non-saturated groups. A preservation objective keeps useful strategy-conditioned routes accessible while successful guided behaviors are transferred to the unguided policy. Across Qwen2.5 models from 1.5B to 7B and two RL training corpora, PSRA consistently improves reasoning performance, reduces dead saturation, strengthens out-of-distribution transfer, and maintains larger gains under increased inference budgets.

AI.tldr: 本文指出RLVR中探索不足常源于有限采样只集中于问题的主导推理策略，而非模型缺乏能力。为此提出PSRA，将无引导和策略条件提示视为竞争探索臂，用贝叶斯序贯分配固定 rollout 预算，并保留有用策略路径，从而提升推理表现。
AI.motivation: 强化学习可验证奖励（RLVR）常因探索不足而受限：困难问题产生全错 rollout 组，缺乏学习信号。作者认为这未必是能力缺失，而是有限采样集中到问题特定的主导推理策略，忽略了模型已支持的替代策略；且这些策略的可及性在RL过程中动态变化，部分被内化，部分在被吸收前难以激发。
AI.method: 提出 Problem–Strategy Rollout Allocation (PSRA)，将无引导与策略条件提示作为竞争探索臂，采用贝叶斯序贯分配，把固定 rollout 预算导向最可能产生信息丰富且非饱和组的臂。同时引入保留目标，维持有用的策略条件路径可及，并将成功的引导行为迁移到无引导策略。
AI.result: 在 Qwen2.5 模型（1.5B 到 7B）和两个 RL 训练语料上，PSRA 持续提升推理性能，减少死饱和，增强分布外迁移，并在增加推理预算时保持更大增益。
AI.conclusion: RLVR 中的探索失败可通过策略层面的 rollout 分配来缓解；PSRA 能有效利用模型已有但未被激发的推理策略，提升训练效率与泛化能力。

title: Can Protein-Derived Knowledge Improve Pathology Foundation Models?
summary: Molecularly guided pathology foundation models (PFMs) exploit transcriptomic or proteomic information to enrich whole-slide image (WSI) representations, yet effectively leveraging large standalone molecular corpora remains challenging. First, existing molecular foundation models encode protein sequences or single-cell states, not the patient-level bulk expression profiles paired with WSIs. Second, because cross-modal supervision is restricted to paired WSI-omics samples, knowledge from standalone molecular corpora reaches the pathology encoder only indirectly, creating a paired-support bottleneck. To address these challenges, we propose a three-stage framework that decouples proteomic knowledge acquisition from cross-modal transfer, yielding ProSlide, a slide-level hierarchical pathology foundation model. First, to close the modality gap, we pretrain a Proteomic Foundation Encoder (PFE) on 12,695 sample-level bulk protein profiles using virtual profile generation and expression-space multi-view pretraining. Second, we pretrain ProSlide, a patch-region-slide encoder, to predict protein expression from paired WSI-protein samples. Third, to relax the paired-support bottleneck, we introduce Prot2Path, a cross-modal relational distillation objective. For each paired sample, it aligns the similarity distributions of the WSI and its protein profile over a shared, frozen bank of PFE-encoded paired and standalone profiles. We evaluate ProSlide on 12 downstream tasks across breast, lung, and renal cancers. Despite being pretrained with only 2,229 WSIs and 12,695 sample-level protein profiles, ProSlide achieves the highest mean accuracy and AUC within each cancer group.

AI.tldr: 本文提出三阶段框架ProSlide，通过解耦蛋白质组知识获取与跨模态迁移，构建幻灯片级分层病理基础模型，在乳腺、肺和肾癌的12项下游任务中取得各组最高平均准确率和AUC。
AI.motivation: 现有分子病理基础模型难以有效利用大规模独立分子语料：一是已有分子基础模型编码蛋白质序列或单细胞状态，而非与WSI配对的患者级bulk表达谱；二是跨模态监督仅限于配对的WSI-组学样本，独立分子语料知识只能间接进入病理编码器，形成配对支持瓶颈。
AI.method: 提出三阶段框架：1）在12,695个样本级bulk蛋白质谱上预训练Proteomic Foundation Encoder（PFE），采用虚拟谱生成和表达空间多视角预训练；2）预训练ProSlide，即patch-region-slide编码器，从配对的WSI-蛋白质样本预测蛋白质表达；3）引入Prot2Path跨模态关系蒸馏目标，将WSI与其蛋白质谱的相似度分布在共享冻结的PFE编码配对及独立谱库上对齐，以缓解配对支持瓶颈。
AI.result: 在乳腺、肺和肾癌的12项下游任务上评估ProSlide。尽管仅使用2,229张WSI和12,695个样本级蛋白质谱预训练，ProSlide在每种癌症组内均取得最高平均准确率和AUC。
AI.conclusion: ProSlide通过解耦蛋白质组知识获取与跨模态迁移，并利用Prot2Path关系蒸馏缓解配对支持瓶颈，能够有效融合独立分子语料与WSI信息，是一种有前景的病理基础模型。

title: ForVis: An In-Field Dataset and Benchmark for VIO Using Under-Canopy UAV Flights in Forests
summary: Visual-inertial Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (VI-SLAM) for UAVs remains difficult to evaluate in real forest environments, where motion, illumination changes, repetitive vegetation, and vibration can all affect estimation. We present ForVis, an in-field dataset and benchmark for evaluating VI-SLAM during UAV flight in forest environments. The dataset contains twelve flights across open meadow, above-canopy, and under-canopy conditions in each environment. In total, it provides 563.8s of flight over 1096.8m of trajectory, recorded simultaneously with an Intel RealSense D435i and an OAK-D Pro Wide together with inertial and flight-controller data. We benchmark seven open-source VI-SLAM systems over 504 runs. The results show that sensor choice has a larger effect on trajectory error than the spread between algorithms: all seven methods achieve lower median error on the OAK-D Pro than on the D435i. ForVis is intended to support evaluation of speed, accuracy and robustness for VI-SLAM in challenging forest flight.

AI.tldr: 提出ForVis，一个用于评估无人机在森林环境中VI-SLAM性能的实地数据集与基准，包含12次飞行、多传感器同步数据和504次基准测试运行。
AI.motivation: 无人机视觉惯性SLAM（VI-SLAM）在真实森林环境中难以评估，因为运动、光照变化、重复植被纹理和振动都会影响估计性能。
AI.method: 构建ForVis数据集与基准，覆盖开阔草地、冠层上方和冠层下方环境，共12次飞行，总时长563.8秒、轨迹1096.8米；同步采集Intel RealSense D435i、OAK-D Pro Wide、惯性及飞控数据；对7个开源VI-SLAM系统进行504次运行测试。
AI.result: 传感器选择对轨迹误差的影响大于算法之间的差异：全部7种方法在OAK-D Pro上的中位误差均低于D435i。
AI.conclusion: ForVis可用于支持在具有挑战性的森林飞行中评估VI-SLAM的速度、精度和鲁棒性。

title: In-game Toxic Detection: Bi-directional Representations with Attention Residuals
summary: In-game toxic language has emerged as a critical concern in the gaming industry and community. While several frameworks and models for online game toxicity analysis have been proposed, detecting toxicity in player chat utterances remains a formidable challenge: stemming not only from the extremely short length of such utterances but also from the heavy reliance on game slang, abbreviations, and domain-specific jargon, which generic language models are poorly suited to recognize. This paper presents a shared task for in-game toxic language detection built upon real-world in-game chat data, and proposes the best-preforming model for the toxic language slot filling: Bi-directional Representations with Attention Residuals (BRAR). Experimental results demonstrate that BRAR effectively captures the global context and outperforms the existing baselines on slot filling.

AI.tldr: 本文基于真实游戏聊天数据构建了游戏内有毒语言检测共享任务，并提出最优模型 BRAR 用于有毒语言槽填充。
AI.motivation: 游戏内有毒语言是游戏行业和社区的重要问题，但玩家聊天文本极短，且大量依赖游戏俚语、缩写和领域术语，通用语言模型难以识别，导致毒性检测仍具挑战。
AI.method: 构建基于真实游戏聊天数据的共享任务，并针对有毒语言槽填充提出 BRAR 模型，即带注意力残差的双向表示。
AI.result: 实验表明，BRAR 能有效捕获全局上下文，并在槽填充任务上优于现有基线模型。
AI.conclusion: BRAR 在游戏内有毒语言槽填充任务中表现最佳，说明结合双向表示与注意力残差有助于提升游戏聊天场景下的毒性检测效果。

title: Terrain-Aware Autonomous Planetary Exploration for Exteroceptive-Proprioceptive Mapping with Quadruped Scouts
comment: Accepted to the International Conference on Space Robotics (iSpaRo 2026)
summary: Autonomous planetary exploration requires robots to navigate unknown, uneven terrain while assessing risk, traversability, and energetic cost. Quadruped scouts are well suited for this task because they can traverse irregular surfaces and gather mobility-relevant information during locomotion. This paper presents a terrain-aware exploration framework that combines exteroceptive and proprioceptive mapping for a quadruped robot in lunar-like environments. An onboard RGB-D camera builds robot-centered elevation maps, estimates geometric traversability, and derives navigation costs for autonomous planning. In parallel, proprioceptive measurements provide interaction-aware terrain cues that complement geometry-based assessment. Local maps are incrementally registered into a global multi-layer representation, which is used by an exploration module to select targets in unexplored regions of interest. The targets are reached by an autonomous navigation system that guides collision-aware motion using the available map and cost layers. Simulation results on NVIDIA Isaac Sim show autonomous exploration, map expansion, and spatial association between terrain geometry and robot-terrain interaction. Subsequent navigation using this information exhibits lower average Cost of Transport (CoT) than initial exploration.

AI.tldr: 提出一种面向月球类环境的四足机器人地形感知探索框架，融合外部与本体感知建图，实现自主探索、导航与地形风险评估。
AI.motivation: 自主行星探索要求机器人在未知、崎岖地形中导航，并评估风险、可通行性与能量消耗；四足机器人适合此类任务，但需结合几何与机器人-地形交互信息。
AI.method: 使用机载RGB-D相机构建以机器人为中心的高程图，估计几何可通行性并生成导航代价；同时利用本体感知提供交互式地形线索。局部地图增量配准到全局多层表示中，探索模块据此选择未探索区域目标，自主导航系统利用地图与代价层进行避障运动。
AI.result: 在NVIDIA Isaac Sim仿真中实现了自主探索、地图扩展以及地形几何与机器人-地形交互之间的空间关联；利用这些信息进行后续导航时，平均运输成本（CoT）低于初始探索阶段。
AI.conclusion: 该地形感知探索框架能有效支持四足机器人在类月球环境中的自主探索与导航，本体感知可补充几何评估，并有助于降低后续导航的能量消耗。

title: FocusDrive: Reasoning with Visual Focus for Autonomous Driving
summary: Driving decisions depend on both where to focus and how to act on what is seen. Effective driving reasoning must establish which objects matter, where they are, and how they inform the intended action. Text-based rationales can describe a driving response while leaving its correspondence to specific visual evidence implicit. Visual focus provides a concrete starting point for this connection by identifying what matters in the scene and where it is. We propose FocusDrive, a structured multimodal reasoning framework that organizes end-to-end planning around explicit visual focus. It pairs descriptions of decision-relevant objects with image-patch references, bringing explicit visual focus into the reasoning that generates driving plans and trajectories. We first assess this focus representation through driver gaze prediction, then investigate its role in planning reasoning using driving-focus annotations within existing NAVSIM training scenes.
