Experiments on W3DA and NAVSIM demonstrate competitive gaze prediction and end-to-end planning performance, with FocusDrive improving over text-based chain-of-thought. These results support visual focus as an effective link between scene understanding and driving action.

AI.tldr: 提出FocusDrive，一种围绕显式视觉焦点组织的结构化多模态推理框架，用于端到端驾驶规划，并在W3DA和NAVSIM上取得有竞争力的注视预测与规划性能。
AI.motivation: 驾驶决策不仅取决于关注什么，也取决于如何基于所见采取行动。文本推理难以显式对应具体视觉证据，而视觉焦点能具体标识场景中重要对象及其位置，从而连接场景理解与驾驶动作。
AI.method: FocusDrive将决策相关物体的描述与图像块引用配对，把显式视觉焦点引入生成驾驶计划和轨迹的推理中。先通过驾驶员注视预测评估焦点表示，再利用NAVSIM训练场景中的驾驶焦点标注研究其在规划推理中的作用。
AI.result: 在W3DA和NAVSIM数据集上，FocusDrive在注视预测和端到端规划任务中均取得有竞争力的性能，并优于基于文本的思维链方法。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，视觉焦点可以作为连接场景理解与驾驶行动的有效桥梁。

title: The Model Knows When to Stop: Training-Free Early Stopping for Long-Context Reading
summary: Language models often process long inputs sequentially in chunks, but continuing to read after sufficient evidence has been acquired wastes computation. Existing stopping mechanisms either learn sufficiency from internal activations or train an exit gate, while a simpler alternative asks the model whether it has read enough. We introduce Answer-Convergence Stopping (ACS), a training-free stopping rule that measures rather than asks. After each chunk, it probes the frozen model's current answer state and stops when that state is both confident and stable. The rule requires only output-side generation and token log probabilities, has no trained components, and uses one shared configuration across models and benchmarks. Because a stopping policy can save computation simply by stopping too early, we evaluate the stopping decision itself using evidence position where available. On the full LongBench-v2 with two frontier models, ACS is the only stopping policy that matches or exceeds full-reading accuracy. Furthermore, across 250 S-NIAH questions, the premature stopping rate for ACS across five models from two families ranges from 0% to 12%, compared to 8.4% to 45.6% for the verbalized gate. Taken together, ACS reveals that by properly utilizing the output signals of frozen models, we can achieve favorable behaviors like adaptive stopping without the need for additional training.

AI.tldr: 提出Answer-Convergence Stopping (ACS)，一种无需训练的停止规则，通过探测冻结模型当前答案状态的置信度与稳定性来决定何时停止继续阅读长输入。
AI.motivation: 语言模型处理长输入时分块顺序读取，获得足够证据后继续读取会浪费计算。现有停止机制要么从内部激活学习充分性，要么训练退出门，而更简单的替代思路是直接询问模型是否读够。
AI.method: ACS是一种无训练停止规则，强调“测量”而非“询问”。每读完一块后探测冻结模型当前的答案状态，当该状态既自信又稳定时停止。规则仅依赖输出端生成和token对数概率，无训练组件，并在不同模型和基准上使用同一配置。
AI.result: 在完整LongBench-v2上，使用两个前沿模型，ACS是唯一匹配或超过全读准确率的停止策略；在250个S-NIAH问题上，ACS在来自两个家族的五个模型上的过早停止率为0%–12%，而语言化门控为8.4%–45.6%。
AI.conclusion: 通过恰当利用冻结模型的输出信号，无需额外训练即可实现自适应停止等有利行为。

title: Modular Discovery of General Game-Playing Algorithms with Large Language Models
summary: General Game Playing across arbitrary games from rules alone remains challenging due to differing algorithmic requirements across game classes and strict decision-time constraints. Rather than hand-designing search heuristics for specific domains, can we leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) to discover general game-playing algorithms? Because language models can propose and refactor structured code, they provide an expressive proposal engine for exploring the space of algorithmic designs. We introduce a multi-agent LLM meta-learning system to co-evolve game-agnostic procedural search mechanisms in C++ alongside domain heuristics synthesized directly from game rules. Controlling the compute budget, we benchmark the discovered mechanisms across more than 400 diverse environments, including OpenSpiel training and held-out games, procedural simulation engines, and games with deep neural policy-value representations trained via PPO. Evaluated via AlphaRank stationary distributions and Soft Condorcet Optimization (SCO) against 15 established MCTS baselines, the discovered search mechanisms consistently achieve top-tier ratings and pairwise ballot majorities over most baselines across independent evolutionary runs, generalizing to unseen human-designed and procedurally synthesized games and remaining competitive with baselines on frozen neural network representations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种多智能体LLM元学习系统，协同进化C++实现的通用博弈搜索机制和从规则合成的领域启发式，在400多个环境中评测，发现的机制在AlphaRank和SCO下对15个MCTS基线取得顶级表现并展现泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 仅从规则出发进行通用博弈仍很困难，因为不同游戏类别需要不同算法，且决策时间约束严格；手工为特定领域设计搜索启发式成本高且泛化差，因此希望利用LLM自动发现通用博弈算法。
AI.method: 使用多智能体LLM元学习系统，共同进化游戏无关的过程搜索机制（C++）与直接从游戏规则合成的领域启发式；控制计算预算，并在OpenSpiel训练与留出游戏、程序化模拟引擎、PPO训练的深度神经策略价值表示游戏等400多个环境中进行基准测试；用AlphaRank平稳分布和Soft Condorcet Optimization与15个MCTS基线对比。
AI.result: 独立进化运行中发现的搜索机制一致获得顶级评分，并在多数成对投票中优于大多数基线；能泛化到未见的人类设计游戏和程序化合成游戏，在冻结神经网络表示上也与基线保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: LLM可作为一种有效的算法发现引擎，自动协同设计通用博弈搜索机制与领域启发式，在广泛游戏环境中实现强表现和跨游戏泛化，展示了自动发现通用博弈算法的潜力。

title: Inspection-SPARS: Task-Oriented Sparse Roadmaps for Inspection Planning
summary: Inspection planning seeks a minimum-length collision-free robot tour that observes a given set of points of interest (POIs). Sampling-based methods reduce this continuous problem to a graph inspection planning (GIP) problem over a discrete roadmap, which is then solved using combinatorial solvers. Dense roadmaps capture diverse inspection viewpoints and motion shortcuts, and thus admit higher-quality solutions, but they induce large combinatorial search spaces on which state-of-the-art GIP solvers struggle to find good solutions within practical time budgets. Roadmap sparsification---restructuring a dense roadmap into a compact representation that preserves connectivity and path lengths---can alleviate this burden. However, existing sparsification approaches are either agnostic to the underlying inspection task, or strive to ensure coverage of the POIs without accounting for the quality of the resulting inspection plan. We present Inspection-SPARS, which is, to our knowledge, the first inspection-roadmap sparsifier with POI coverage and path-quality guarantees relative to the dense roadmap. To this end, we generalize the SPARS framework, a popular task-agnostic sparsifier, from purely geometric criteria to task-oriented ones, introducing an inspection-aware vertex admission mechanism that treats POI coverage as a first-class sparsification criterion alongside connectivity and path quality. Experiments in realistic 3D environments show that Inspection-SPARS reduces vertex and edge counts by 4-8x while preserving coverage, allowing the GIP solver to compute tours up to 25% shorter than with the dense roadmap or state-of-the-art inspection roadmap. More broadly, Inspection-SPARS shows that sparsification can be made task-aware without sacrificing guarantees on solution quality.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Inspection-SPARS，一种面向机器人巡检任务的路线图稀疏化方法，可在保持兴趣点覆盖与路径质量保证的同时，大幅压缩稠密路线图，从而帮助图巡检规划求解器更快找到更短巡检路径。
AI.motivation: 采样方法通常将连续巡检规划转化为离散路线图上的图巡检规划问题。稠密路线图虽能提供更多巡检视角和运动捷径、带来更优解，但会导致组合搜索空间过大，使现有求解器难以在有限时间内找到好解。已有稀疏化方法要么与巡检任务无关，要么只保证兴趣点覆盖，却忽略最终巡检计划的质量。
AI.method: 作者提出 Inspection-SPARS，将经典的通用稀疏化框架 SPARS 从纯几何准则推广到任务导向准则，引入巡检感知的顶点准入机制，把兴趣点覆盖与连通性、路径质量并列为稀疏化的一等准则，从而在相对稠密路线图保持覆盖和路径质量保证的前提下生成紧凑路线图。
AI.result: 在真实感 3D 环境实验中，Inspection-SPARS 将顶点和边数量减少 4 至 8 倍，同时保持覆盖能力，并使图巡检规划求解器计算出的巡检路径比使用稠密路线图或当前最优巡检路线图时最多缩短 25%。
AI.conclusion: Inspection-SPARS 表明，稀疏化可以在不牺牲解质量保证的情况下实现任务感知，为巡检规划在稠密路线图上高效获得高质量解提供了新思路。

title: Compositional Safety Failures in Harness Evolution: Identification and Runtime Monitoring
summary: Self-evolving agent harnesses continually update persistent components such as memory, prompts, skills, and tools. We call this process harness evolution. However, such evolution could introduce unexpected safety risks. Existing work studies harness misevolution and validates candidate harnesses or attributed individual component updates, leaving safety analysis of cross-component update interactions largely unexamined. To address this gap, we study compositional safety failures in harness evolution, where interactions among individually safe and utility-preserving component updates can produce undesirable or unsafe agent behavior, revealing a safety risk intrinsic to harness evolution. Across three safety-related benchmarks, we identify 43 pairwise and 18 irreducible 3-way compositional safety failures. Conventional solution incurs combinatorial complexity in validating cross-component interactions, leaving the safety checking impractical as the harness evolves. To solve this, we introduced a typed hypergraph that represents component states as nodes and safety-relevant higher-order interactions as hyperedges. When the harness changes, the hypergraph updates only the interaction neighborhood of the changed states rather than reconstructing the global composition space. Building on that, we develop a hypergraph-guided runtime monitoring mechanism. Experiments show that our method effectively mitigates compositional safety risks while preserving task utility and reducing interaction-checking costs, and further reveal an empirical safety-utility-cost trade-off across different safety mechanisms.

AI.tldr: 自进化智能体框架会持续更新记忆、提示、技能和工具等持久组件（即框架进化），但组件间更新的交互可能引发组合性安全失效。本文研究该问题，提出类型化超图表示与运行时监控机制来缓解风险。
AI.motivation: 现有工作关注框架误进化，验证候选框架或单个组件更新，但跨组件更新交互的安全分析尚未被充分研究，存在组合性安全失效的空白。
AI.method: 在三个安全基准上识别成对与3路组合安全失效；引入类型化超图，将组件状态表示为节点、安全相关高阶交互表示为超边；框架变化时仅更新变化状态的交互邻域而非重建全局组合空间；基于此开发超图引导的运行时监控机制。
AI.result: 识别出43个成对和18个不可约3路组合安全失效；实验表明方法有效缓解组合安全风险，保持任务效用并降低交互检查成本，同时揭示不同安全机制下的安全-效用-成本权衡。
AI.conclusion: 组合安全失效是框架进化的内在风险；超图引导的运行时监控能有效缓解该风险，在保持任务效用的同时降低检查成本。

title: ReAL: Accelerating Flow Matching through Segment Advancement with Shared Lookahead
summary: Flow-matching models generate high-quality images and videos, but repeated neural network evaluations make sampling expensive. Skipping evaluations reduces this cost by extending an available velocity estimate over a longer span. However, local velocity agreement alone does not determine a suitable span, and checking each candidate endpoint adds costly model calls. We introduce ReAL, a training-free sampler that selects how far to advance using one shared lookahead. Our key insight is that the discrepancy between uncorrected and lookahead-corrected endpoint proposals can be computed directly from the observed velocity mismatch and the candidate span beyond the lookahead. This relation provides a span-dependent selection criterion without additional endpoint evaluations. The same lookahead selects the longest passing candidate span, corrects the accepted update, and supplies its velocity as the next starting estimate. After initialization, each regular iteration requires only one fresh evaluation. ReAL uses the pretrained velocity output and original noise schedule, with no additional training or access to internal features. Experiments cover four image-generation backbones, video generation, and image editing. ReAL achieves 4.91x measured speedup on FLUX.1-dev while retaining 97.0% of dense mean ImageReward. On HunyuanVideo, it achieves a 5.49x speedup while maintaining a VBench score close to that of dense sampling.

AI.tldr: ReAL是一种无需训练的采样器，通过共享前瞻机制自适应选择步长，减少流匹配模型的采样开销，在保持生成质量的同时实现显著加速。
AI.motivation: 流匹配模型能生成高质量图像和视频，但重复的神经网络评估导致采样成本高昂。跳过部分评估可降低成本，但局部速度一致性无法确定合适的步长，且检查每个候选端点会引入额外模型调用。
AI.method: ReAL利用一个共享前瞻：未校正与前瞻校正端点提议之间的差异可直接由观测到的速度不匹配和候选步长计算得到，从而无需额外端点评估即可形成步长相关的选择准则。同一前瞻选择最长的通过候选步长，校正接受的更新，并提供速度作为下一步起始估计。初始化后，每次常规迭代仅需一次新评估，使用预训练速度输出和原始噪声调度，无需额外训练或访问内部特征。
AI.result: 在四个图像生成骨干、视频生成和图像编辑上实验。在FLUX.1-dev上实现4.91倍实测加速，保留97.0%的密集采样平均ImageReward；在HunyuanVideo上实现5.49倍加速，VBench分数接近密集采样。
AI.conclusion: ReAL是一种高效且无需训练的流匹配采样方法，能在大幅加速的同时维持接近密集采样的生成质量。

title: Structured Residual Connectivity Matters for Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have established themselves as a scalable backbone for high-fidelity image synthesis. However, unlike U-Net based diffusion models that rely on rigid, hand-crafted skip connections, DiTs predominantly use a uniform residual stream that integrates all preceding layers as a monolithic state. In this work, we rethink residual connections in diffusion transformers and propose to transform them from passive summation into an active retrieval mechanism optimized for image denoising. First, we conduct a systematic analysis of DiT's internal representation, revealing a latent preference for early-layer feature reuse and symmetric layer guidance. Motivated by this, we introduce a structured connectivity design that explicitly integrates local residual connections with long-range pathways. Instead of static skip connections or dense all-layer routing, our method enables each transformer block to selectively ``attend'' to critical earlier representations, dynamically retrieving spatial and semantic cues through direct, differentiable cross-depth paths. Experiments show that our adaptive connectivity leads to faster convergence, with up to $1.73\times$ fewer training iterations, and significant gains in FID and visual quality with less than $0.1\%$ additional parameters, further improving a strong REPA-XL/2 model from $5.9$ to $4.34$ FID without guidance and reaching $1.39$ FID with classifier-free guidance. Our findings suggest that adaptive cross-layer connectivity is a critical yet underexplored factor in diffusion transformers, and that incorporating structured information pathways provides a simple and effective direction for improving scalable generative models.

AI.tldr: 该论文重新审视扩散Transformer（DiT）中的残差连接，提出将被动求和改为面向图像去噪的主动检索机制，通过结构化跨层连接提升生成质量与训练效率。
AI.motivation: DiT通常使用统一的残差流，将所有前层作为单一状态整合，缺乏U-Net式手工跳跃连接。作者认为这种被动残差连接可能限制模型对早期层特征的重用与跨层信息流动。
AI.method: 首先系统分析DiT内部表示，发现其对早期层特征重用和对称层引导存在潜在偏好。基于此提出结构化连接设计，将局部残差连接与长程路径结合，使每个Transformer块可通过可微的跨深度路径选择性地“关注”关键早期表示，动态检索空间与语义线索。
AI.result: 自适应连接带来更快收敛，训练迭代最多减少1.73倍；在额外参数少于0.1%的情况下，显著提升FID和视觉质量。将强基线REPA-XL/2在无引导下从5.9 FID提升至4.34，在分类器无引导（classifier-free guidance）下达到1.39 FID。
AI.conclusion: 自适应跨层连接是扩散Transformer中被忽视但关键的因素；引入结构化信息通路是提升可扩展生成模型简单而有效的方向。

title: Rewarding Novel Deductions: Solver-guided Process Rewards for Logical Reasoning
summary: Logical reasoning remains a major challenge for large language models (LLMs), particularly on structured problems that require precise constraint tracking, consistency preservation, and multi-step deduction. This challenge is especially acute for small-scale LLMs, which are more prone to producing inconsistent, redundant, or brittle reasoning trajectories. Existing approaches for improving logical reasoning largely optimize for final-answer correctness, providing only weak supervision over the intermediate reasoning process. In this work, we propose SPRING: (Solver-guided Process Rewards for Novel LogIcal ReasoNing Step Generation). SPRING uses SMT solver as a training-time verifier of intermediate reasoning steps to provide process-level supervision. It introduces the notion of a novel reasoning step, namely, a step that is logically valid, consistent with the evolving reasoning state, and not already implied by previously accepted non-contradictory deductions. Based on this solver-based assessment, it designs process rewards that encourage novel inferential progress while penalizing contradictory and uninformative reasoning steps. Evaluation across three logical reasoning benchmarks, ZebraLogic, AR-LSAT, and Knights and Knaves, and four LLMs shows that SPRING consistently outperforms base LLMs, outcome-only reward baselines, and Logic-LM. On ZebraLogic, SPRING improves puzzle accuracy by up to 49.71 and 15.43 points over the base LLM and strongest outcome-only baseline, respectively. On AR-LSAT, it improves overall accuracy by up to 64.93 and 12.14 points, respectively. On Knights and Knaves, SPRING achieves up to 93.14 puzzle accuracy and 96.05 person accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出 SPRING，用 SMT 求解器验证中间推理步骤并提供过程级奖励，提升大语言模型尤其小模型在结构化逻辑推理任务中的表现。
AI.motivation: LLM 在需要精确约束跟踪、一致性和多步演绎的逻辑推理上仍很困难，小模型更易产生不一致、冗余或脆弱推理；现有方法多只优化最终答案，对中间推理过程监督较弱。
AI.method: SPRING 全称为 Solver-guided Process Rewards for Novel LogIcal ReasoNing Step Generation。它将 SMT 求解器作为训练时验证器，评估中间推理步骤，并定义“新颖推理步骤”：逻辑有效、与演化推理状态一致、且未被已接受的非矛盾推论蕴含。基于该评估设计过程奖励，鼓励新颖推进一步，惩罚矛盾和无信息步骤。
AI.result: 在 ZebraLogic、AR-LSAT、Knights and Knaves 三个基准和四个 LLM 上，SPRING 持续优于基础 LLM、仅结果奖励基线和 Logic-LM。ZebraLogic 上相比基础 LLM 和最强仅结果奖励基线最高提升 49.71 和 15.43 分；AR-LSAT 上最高提升 64.93 和 12.14 分；Knights and Knaves 上达到最高 93.14 谜题准确率和 96.05 人物准确率。
AI.conclusion: 使用求解器提供过程级验证与奖励，可有效改进 LLM 的逻辑推理，尤其对小模型效果显著，并优于仅结果监督和现有工具增强方法。

title: EdgeVLN: Runtime-Aware Deployment Ready Quantized Vision Language Navigation Model
summary: Vision-language navigation (VLN) models perform well but target compute-rich platforms, limiting deployment on memory- and power-constrained robotic edge devices. Compression alone does not establish whether a VLN model fits the memory, latency, and energy budgets of an edge platform while preserving navigation behavior. We introduce EdgeVLN, a runtime-aware, deployment-ready quantized VLN model that closes this gap. EdgeVLN combines a quantized StreamVLN model with Latent Trajectory Termination Extractor (LATTE), a lightweight causal transformer that improves real-time stopping by predicting a Stop Action verifier rank. Both execute through our llama.cpp VLN driver, which reconstructs streaming context and prunes memory tokens on-board. We characterize a pretrained StreamVLN backbone across weight quantization from 8 to 2 bits and multiple inference runtimes to identify a feasible operating point. LATTE reuses backbone hidden states within the budget freed by quantization, requiring neither a second vision encoder nor an additional backbone forward pass. We evaluate six backbone precisions and seven candidate stop heads on BF16 and IQ4 NL across all 1,839 R2R VLN-CE val-unseen episodes. We measure success rate (SR) in simulation and latency, energy, and resident memory on an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 16 GB. LATTE achieves our highest SR, 58.02 percent on the deployed 4-bit model, exceeding the BF16 baseline with only 0.013 s additional latency per navigation step. Four-bit formats achieve nearly identical SR, but step energy varies 36.8 times by execution path. Only IQ4 NL under our VLN driver fits the board, using 11.35 GB resident memory while running 20.8 times faster and using 13.3 times less energy than storage-streamed BF16. INT2 collapses. Runtime selection, memory-token pruning, and quantization are essential for efficient edge deployment.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 EdgeVLN，一种面向边缘部署的运行时感知量化 VLN 模型，将量化 StreamVLN 与轻量停止预测模块 LATTE 结合，并通过 llama.cpp VLN driver 在 NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX 上实现实时、低内存和低能耗的视觉语言导航。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLN 模型性能虽好但依赖高算力平台，难以部署到内存和功耗受限的机器人边缘设备；仅靠压缩无法判断模型是否满足边缘平台的内存、延迟和能耗预算，同时保持导航行为。
AI.method: EdgeVLN 结合量化 StreamVLN 与 LATTE：LATTE 是轻量因果 Transformer，通过预测 Stop Action verifier rank 改善实时停止，并复用 backbone 隐状态，无需额外视觉编码器或额外前向传播。系统通过 llama.cpp VLN driver 执行，可在板端重建流式上下文并剪枝 memory tokens。作者表征了 8 到 2 bit 权重量化及多种推理运行时，并在 R2R VLN-CE val-unseen 全部 1,839 个 episode 上评估六种 backbone 精度和七种候选 stop heads，测试 BF16 与 IQ4 NL，测量仿真 SR 以及 Jetson Orin NX 16 GB 上的延迟、能耗和常驻内存。
AI.result: LATTE 在部署的 4-bit 模型上达到最高 SR 58.02%，超过 BF16 baseline，且每导航 step 仅增加 0.013 秒延迟。四种 4-bit 格式 SR 几乎相同，但 step energy 因执行路径不同相差 36.8 倍。只有 IQ4 NL 在 VLN driver 下适配该板，常驻内存 11.35 GB，比 storage-streamed BF16 快 20.8 倍、能耗低 13.3 倍。INT2 性能崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 运行时选择、memory-token pruning 和量化对于高效的边缘 VLN 部署至关重要。

title: On Device Agentic Operation Caches -- Classifier-Centric NL-to-Action Generation
summary:
Agentic AI is increasingly being embedded in software applications to provide natural language interfaces to features and functionality. In most cases these agents are powered by enterprise (100+ billion parameter) or frontier class large language models that require substantial computational resources run and depend on cloud hosted inference to handle the task of transforming natural language inputs into actionable software operations. This reliance on cloud-hosted inference introduces substantial network latency on top of LLM inference times, creates data privacy concerns, and, given the costs of running these models, can rapidly escalate expenses associated with supporting agentic features.
  This paper introduces a novel means of converting the NL-to-Action problem from a generative one into a classification-centric formulation via on-device operation caches. These caches allow an agentic system to handle frequently occurring classes of actions completely on-device -- reducing latency, enhancing privacy, and lowering operational costs. We show that for a classic NL-to-Formula task, generating Excel Formula in response to user requests, this approach reduces total inference cost by 56% when compared to cloud-only model-routing based inference and, on cache hits, reduces the latency to response latency by 5x.

AI.tldr: 本文提出通过端侧操作缓存，将自然语言到动作的生成式问题转化为以分类为中心的公式，从而在设备上处理高频操作，降低延迟、增强隐私并减少成本。
AI.motivation: 智能体AI常依赖云端企业级或前沿大语言模型进行推理，导致网络延迟、数据隐私问题以及高昂的运营成本，尤其在大规模支持智能体功能时费用会迅速上升。
AI.method: 将NL-to-Action任务从生成式问题重新表述为基于端侧操作缓存的分类问题；缓存使智能体系统能在设备上直接处理经常出现的动作类别。以生成Excel公式的NL-to-Formula任务为例进行评估。
AI.result: 与仅使用云端模型路由推理相比，该方法将总推理成本降低56%；在缓存命中时，将响应延迟降低至原来的1/5，即5倍延迟改进。
AI.conclusion: 端侧操作缓存能有效处理高频NL-to-Action任务，在降低延迟、提升隐私保护和减少运营成本方面具有显著优势，为智能体AI的部署提供了一种更高效的方案。

title: CollisionSplatting: Collision-Aware Motion Planning in 3DGS Scenes with Image-Conditioned Objectives and Adjustable Conservatism
summary: Incorporating dense visual information into motion planning remains challenging, as geometric planners rely on abstracted scene representations that discard visual richness, while learned visual models often lack geometric interpretability and computational efficiency. This paper introduces CollisionSplatting, a simple, modular, GPU-accelerated, probability-inspired distance metric with tunable conservatism that operates directly on standard 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) scenes. When combined with learned image-conditioned reward functions, this metric enables joint geometric and visual planning by unifying collision-aware costs with image-space objectives. We integrate the metric into GPU-accelerated Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) and Rapidly-Exploring Random Tree (RRT) planners, and show on-par or better collision-classification performance compared to representative baselines while achieving substantially higher collision-checking throughput and significantly lower VRAM usage. Finally, we demonstrate the effectiveness of our metric in real-world vision-guided navigation and manipulation tasks, highlighting 3DGS as a practical bridge between rich perception and real-time motion planning.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CollisionSplatting：一种直接在 3D 高斯泼溅（3DGS）场景上运行的 GPU 加速、概率启发的距离度量，用于联合几何与视觉的运动规划。
AI.motivation: 现有几何规划器依赖抽象场景表示，丢失视觉丰富信息；而学习到的视觉模型通常缺乏几何可解释性与计算效率。因此需要一种能兼顾视觉信息、几何可解释性和实时性的碰撞检测/距离度量。
AI.method: 在标准 3DGS 场景上定义可调保守性的概率启发距离度量 CollisionSplatting；将其与图像条件奖励函数结合，统一碰撞代价与图像空间目标；并集成到 GPU 加速的 MPPI 和 RRT 规划器中。
AI.result: 在碰撞分类性能上与代表性基线相当或更优，同时碰撞检测吞吐量显著更高、VRAM 占用显著更低；并在真实世界视觉引导导航与操作任务中验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: 3DGS 可作为丰富感知与实时运动规划之间的实用桥梁，CollisionSplatting 支持联合几何与视觉规划，并具备高效、模块化、GPU 加速等优势。

title: Fair Fact-Checking: Closing the Cross-Lingual Gap in LLM Factual Judgement with RoSh
summary: Misinformation on social media remains a critical problem, and more and more people settle it by asking a language model instead of a fact checker. Whether models judge such claims reliably is debated; whether they judge them equally well in every language people ask in has gone almost unasked. We test eight models from five families, 3B to 70B, on 1,500 encyclopedic factual claims that exist in identical form in eight languages. English is judged better than every other language on every model, and the gap is widest on the smallest ones, where Llama-3B on Arabic is no better than guessing. Existing remedies retrain on more multilingual data or fit an unconstrained map between language representations, and neither asks whether the model already holds the answer and simply fails to say it. It largely does: a linear probe recovers the truth from the very activations the model fails to express. We propose RoSh, a per-language shift and rotation of the residual stream, computed in closed form at three layers, with no training and no weight modified. It improves every model and closes 75% of the gap on average, helping most where the model was worst: Arabic on Llama-3B goes from chance to nearly the English level, and a fifth fewer of the claims answered correctly in English are lost in translation. What remains is no longer a read-out failure: afterwards the head recovers as much of what is encoded outside English as it does in English. An unconstrained map fitted on the same pairs falls below the untouched baseline, so the orthogonality constraint is doing the work, and every model clears a scrambled-correspondence control and ten further controls. On the two benchmarks of the closest inference-time method, latent-space intervention, run with its own data and metric code, RoSh's gains are five to thirteen times larger.

AI.tldr: 论文研究大语言模型在多语言事实核查中的可靠性差异，发现英语判断普遍优于其他语言，且小模型差距最大；提出无需训练的 RoSh 方法，通过按语言对残差流进行平移和旋转，显著缩小多语言性能差距。
AI.motivation: 社交媒体虚假信息严重，人们越来越多用语言模型而非事实核查员判断真假。模型判断是否可靠仍有争议，而它们在不同提问语言下是否同样可靠几乎未被研究。
AI.method: 测试 5 个家族、3B 到 70B 的 8 个模型，在 8 种语言中完全相同的 1500 条百科事实声明上评估。用线性探针检查模型激活是否已编码真相。提出 RoSh：在三个层上以闭式解计算每种语言的残差流平移与旋转，无需训练、不修改权重。并与多语言重训练、无约束表征映射、潜空间干预等方法对比，设置扰乱对应等控制。
AI.result: 每个模型上英语判断都优于其他语言，小模型差距最大，Llama-3B 在阿拉伯语上接近随机猜测。线性探针能从模型未表达出的激活中恢复真相。RoSh 改进所有模型，平均缩小 75% 差距；Llama-3B 阿拉伯语从随机提升到接近英语水平，英语答对但在翻译中丢失的声明减少五分之一。之后头部能像英语一样恢复非英语编码信息。无约束映射低于原始基线，说明正交约束起关键作用。在潜空间干预方法的两个基准上，RoSh 增益大 5 到 13 倍。
AI.conclusion: 多语言事实核查差距很大程度上不是知识缺失，而是读出/表达失败。按语言进行带正交约束的残差流变换可无需训练地显著缓解该问题，且通过多项控制验证有效。

title: LiteEvo: Automated, Cost-Efficient Harness Evolution for Generalization to Unseen Tasks
summary: An LLM agent is defined by two things: the weights inside its model and the harness of components assembled around it. Harnesses are still handcrafted, and HarnessX, which evolves them automatically, starts each benchmark from a handcrafted harness, reports gains on the tasks it evolved on, and budgets 100 to 175 million meta-agent tokens per benchmark. We propose LiteEvo, a lightweight harness-evolution algorithm whose tool-free meta-agents mine agent trajectories for reusable components, curate them into a versioned library, and compose each round's harness from it, starting every benchmark from the same neutral harness and never naming the benchmark. Evolving on the graded tasks of five agentic benchmarks with a frozen Qwen3.5-9B, LiteEvo lifts pass@2 by 10.5 to 67.7pp and reaches comparable or higher pass@2 than a reproduction of HarnessX (71.0 against 67.3 on average) at 13.0 lower mean API cost. Harnesses evolved on train tasks keep their gains on unseen test tasks of four benchmarks, and LiteEvo also lifts Claude Code with Sonnet 4.6 by 1.2 to 71.4pp.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级代理框架演化算法 LiteEvo，用无工具元代理从轨迹中挖掘可复用组件并构建版本化组件库，从而自动组合每轮框架；在固定 Qwen3.5-9B 上于五个代理基准上显著提升 pass@2，并以更低成本达到或超过 HarnessX。
AI.motivation: 当前 LLM 代理由模型权重和手工搭建的框架组件共同定义，框架仍依赖人工设计；现有自动演化方法 HarnessX 仍需从手写框架起步、仅在已演化任务上报收益，且每个基准耗费 1 亿至 1.75 亿元代理 token，成本高、泛化性不足。
AI.method: LiteEvo 使用无工具的元代理挖掘代理轨迹中的可复用组件，将其整理为带版本的组件库，并在每轮从该库组合出框架；所有基准都从同一个中性框架开始，且不向元代理透露基准名称。实验在五个代理基准的评分任务上使用冻结的 Qwen3.5-9B 进行演化与评估。
AI.result: LiteEvo 将 pass@2 提升 10.5 至 67.7 个百分点；平均 pass@2 达 71.0，超过 HarnessX 复现的 67.3，且平均 API 成本低 13.0；在训练任务上演化出的框架在四个基准的未见测试任务上保持增益；此外还能将 Claude Code 配合 Sonnet 4.6 的提升范围拉到 1.2 至 71.4 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: LiteEvo 表明无需重型、带工具且高 token 消耗的元代理，也能自动演化出强泛化性的代理框架；其组件库机制、统一中性起点和基准匿名化设计在多个基准和不同模型上均带来显著性能提升与成本优势。

title: F4R: Failure-Driven Recognition, Reconstruction, Refinement, and Redeployment for Continual Robot Self-Improvement
summary: The real-world performance of current vision-language-action models is fundamentally constrained by the limited coverage of expert demonstrations and their insufficient understanding of physical interactions. A common remedy is to collect additional real-world demonstrations of newly encountered failures. However, this process is costly, inefficient, potentially unsafe, and difficult to scale. To address this challenge, we propose Failure for Rising (F4R), a failure-driven real-to-sim-to-real closed-loop learning framework that converts real-world failures into targeted policy improvement. F4R first uses an agent to automatically identify and diagnose failures from rollouts. It reconstructs each failure as an interactive, object-centric table-top environment that preserves the task-relevant spatial and physical conditions. The policy is then refined through failure-conditioned sim-real co-training followed by targeted reinforcement learning in the reconstructed environments. The improved policy is subsequently redeployed, while newly observed failures are continuously fed back into the next reconstruction and learning cycle. Real-world evaluations on four manipulation tasks show that F4R achieves 93.75% In-Distribution and 90.0% Out-of-Distribution (OOD) success, outperforming the budget-matched Targeted BC baseline by 18.75 percentage points under OOD conditions without collecting additional real-world corrective demonstrations.

AI.tldr: 提出Failure for Rising (F4R)框架，将现实失败转化为仿真环境中的针对性学习，实现无需额外真实纠错演示的策略改进。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉-语言-动作模型受限于专家演示覆盖不足和对物理交互理解不够，而收集新失败的真实演示成本高、效率低、不安全且难以扩展。
AI.method: F4R是失败驱动的real-to-sim-to-real闭环学习框架：自动识别与诊断失败，重建为交互式、以物体为中心的桌面环境，通过失败条件化的仿真-现实协同训练和针对性强化学习优化策略，并持续将新失败反馈到下一轮重建与学习。
AI.result: 在四个操作任务上，F4R达到93.75%分布内和90.0%分布外成功率，在OOD条件下比预算匹配的Targeted BC基线高18.75个百分点，且无需收集额外真实纠错演示。
AI.conclusion: F4R能有效将真实失败转化为策略提升，为可扩展、低成本的机器人学习提供新途径。

title: Background Gradients Shape Memorization in Flow Matching
summary: Repetition is closely associated with memorization in generative models, but how other training images affect the retention and copying of targets remains unclear. We study this question in class-conditioned flow matching, where images outside the target set form the background. At fixed target repetition and same-class background row count, replacing repeated same-class images with distinct images reduces the target extraction rate from 80.7% to 18.0%. To explain this effect, we develop a paired-trajectory framework that isolates target-induced parameter displacement and the background gradient response to it. This response has an exact path-integrated curvature representation, connecting background loss geometry to target learning. Reciprocal response transfer between repeated and distinct backgrounds changes target retention and copying in both directions, establishing the response's causal role. After target removal, the response correction parallel to the target-induced displacement preserves approximately 90% of the copying effects of full response transfer. Directly scaling the displacement also changes copying without further training. The post-removal copying effects of reciprocal transfer are reproduced across datasets and architectures. Together, these results identify the background gradient response as a mechanism through which same-class training data shape the retention of target learning and the reproduction of target images.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨类条件流匹配中，同类背景训练图像如何影响生成模型对目标图像的保留与复制，发现背景梯度响应是关键机制。
AI.motivation: 重复训练与生成模型中的记忆现象密切相关，但除目标图像外，其他同类训练图像如何影响目标学习的保留和目标图像复制仍不清楚。
AI.method: 在类条件流匹配中，固定目标重复次数和同类背景行数，比较重复同类背景与不同背景图像的影响；提出配对轨迹框架，分离目标诱导的参数位移与背景梯度响应；使用路径积分曲率表示连接背景损失几何与目标学习，并通过互惠响应转移、目标移除后的响应校正和位移缩放进行因果验证。
AI.result: 在固定目标重复和同类背景行数下，将重复同类图像替换为不同图像使目标提取率从80.7%降至18.0%。响应转移可双向改变目标保留和复制，证明背景梯度响应具有因果作用；目标移除后，平行于目标诱导位移的响应校正可保留约90%的复制效应；直接缩放位移无需再训练即可改变复制效果；这些效应跨数据集和架构复现。
AI.conclusion: 背景梯度响应是同类别训练数据塑造目标学习保留和目标图像复制的重要机制。

title: RepFlow: Reciprocal Supervision Improves Generation and Representation in Flow Models
summary: Generative models learn visual structure through denoising, yet their internal states are entangled with both noise level and network depth, making it difficult to obtain a stable visual representation from the generator itself. We introduce RepFlow, which learns such a representation from the generator's evolving computation and uses it to guide generation. Specifically, a separate timestep-free encoder is trained, through a timestep-conditioned predictor, to recover generator states across depths and noise levels from masked clean images. By excluding the reference noise and masked-out content from the encoder's input, we encourage the encoder to distill visual information that is recoverable from the visible image context and predictive of generator states. The representation learned from the generator's evolving states is then fed back to guide and improve the generator, whose updated states provide supervision for further representation learning, forming a reciprocal learning process. This reciprocal process improves multi-step generation and representation quality, as measured by frozen linear probing on ImageNet with latent-space SiT and pixel-space JiT, without an externally pretrained representation teacher. Across the two unconditional settings, FID decreases by $19.2$--$40.8\%$ relative to native training, while linear-probe accuracy improves by 6.80--10.04 percentage points over the best searched raw generator features. The learned representation also serves as a distributional metric for one-step JiT post-training, extending its role from instance-level alignment to distribution-level supervision.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 RepFlow，从生成器不断演化的去噪计算中学习稳定视觉表示，并用该表示反过来指导生成，形成表示学习与生成相互促进的循环。
AI.motivation: 生成模型通过去噪学习视觉结构，但其内部状态同时纠缠于噪声水平和网络深度，因此难以直接从生成器获得稳定、可用的视觉表示。
AI.method: 训练一个无时间步编码器，通过时间步条件预测器，从被掩码的干净图像中恢复不同深度和噪声水平下的生成器状态；编码器输入排除参考噪声和被掩码内容，以蒸馏可见图像上下文中可恢复且能预测生成器状态的信息。学到的表示再反馈给生成器以改进生成，更新后的生成器状态又用于监督表示学习，形成互惠学习过程。
AI.result: 在 ImageNet 无条件生成设置下，使用潜空间 SiT 和像素空间 JiT，无需外部预训练表示教师，FID 相对原生训练下降 19.2%–40.8%；线性探测准确率相比最佳搜索的原始生成器特征提升 6.80–10.04 个百分点。该表示还可作为一步 JiT 后训练中的分布度量。
AI.conclusion: 互惠学习同时提升了多步生成质量和表示质量，并将表示的作用从实例级对齐扩展到分布级监督。

title: Ceiling of a Task: When Can a Transformer Succeed Without Its Chain of Thought?
summary: Reasoning models generate long chains of thought before they answer, yet it is debated whether the content of these chains does real computational work or is largely decorative. We study this question by viewing a transformer as a shallow circuit. One forward pass through a fixed number of layers has constant depth, so any procedure that runs the model a constant number of times is a shallow circuit. We call the best accuracy that a shallow circuit can reach on a task the ceiling of the task, and a task is serial if its ceiling lies below one. We prove three results on serial tasks that hold for every transformer, no matter how it was trained. Necessity: replacing the chain by anything that does not depend on its content, such as filler tokens or a restatement of the question, drives the accuracy down to the ceiling, and on a maximally serial task down to chance. Depth: no shallow computation can write the chain of a model whose accuracy exceeds the ceiling, not even approximately. Locality: the answer is one shallow pass away from the finished chain, so all of the serial reasoning happens in the chain. On word problems of finite groups, whose ceilings are known, small transformers trained from scratch, with or without reinforcement learning, attain the predicted numbers: chain-trained models solve every input length and fall to chance when the chain is erased, chainless models collapse to the ceiling as the input length grows, and open-weight reasoning models given the same problem in words return to the baseline without their chain. On MATH-500 and AIME, erasing the chain costs open reasoning models 0.52 to 0.82 accuracy, a sentence shuffle is harmless, and a token shuffle is as harmful as erasing; the same holds for checkpoints trained by GRPO with a correct or a random reward. The ceiling of a task therefore answers when a transformer can succeed without its chain of thought.

AI.tldr: 论文研究推理模型的长思维链是否真正参与计算，而非装饰。作者将Transformer视为浅层电路，定义任务的“上限”和“串行任务”，并证明三条定理：必要性、深度、局部性。实验在有限群应用题、MATH-500和AIME上验证：擦除或破坏思维链会显著降低准确率，而句子打乱无害，说明链内容承载串行推理。
AI.motivation: 当前存在争议：推理模型生成的长思维链究竟做了真实计算，还是只是装饰。作者希望给出理论判据，说明Transformer何时必须依赖思维链，以及何时无链也能成功。
AI.method: 把固定层数的Transformer单次前向视为常深度浅层电路；定义浅层电路在任务上能达到的最佳准确率为任务“上限”，上限低于1的任务为“串行任务”。证明串行任务上对任意Transformer都成立的三条结果：必要性、深度、局部性。并在有限群词问题、MATH-500、AIME上，用有无强化学习训练的小模型和开放权重推理模型，通过擦除链、替换链、句子打乱、token打乱等干预验证。
AI.result: 必要性：将链替换为不依赖其内容的形式（填充token或复述问题）会使准确率降到任务上限；在最大串行任务上降到随机水平。深度：任何浅层计算都无法写出准确率超过上限的模型的链，即使近似也不行。局部性：答案距离完成后的链只有一次浅层通过，串行推理都发生在链中。有限群实验符合预测：链训练模型能解所有输入长度，擦除链后降到随机；无链模型随输入长度增长塌缩到上限；开放权重推理模型无链时回到基线。MATH-500和AIME上，擦除链使开放推理模型准确率下降0.52到0.82；句子打乱无害，token打乱与擦除一样有害；GRPO训练检查点也如此。
AI.conclusion: 任务的上限决定了Transformer能否在没有思维链时成功。对于串行任务，思维链不是装饰，而是承载了必要的串行计算；擦除或破坏链会导致模型只能达到浅层电路上限甚至随机水平。

title: Using LLMs to Detect LLM-Generated Texts: A Cross-Generation Analysis
summary: Automated detection of LLM-generated texts (LGTs) is critical, yet dedicated detectors often struggle to generalize across domains and models. While general-purpose LLMs offer flexible zero-shot authorship classification with explanatory rationale, their detection behavior, especially regarding self-detection versus cross-detection across model generations, remains poorly understood. We systematically evaluate 15 LLMs spanning three model generations as both generators and detectors. Using a benchmark of 1,000 human-written texts and 15,000 LGTs (1,000 per model), we collected over 233,000 binary classifications alongside natural-language explanations. Our results reveal that detection efficacy is primarily driven by detector capability rather than generator provenance, although outputs from newer generators remain notably harder to detect. Crucially, statistical comparisons show no systematic advantage or disadvantage for self-detection across models. Error analysis further exposes generational bias shifts: first-generation detectors under-detect LGTs (high false-negative rates), second-generation detectors over-flag human texts (high false-positive rates), and the latest models achieve balanced trade-offs. Finally, we highlight significant inconsistencies in how different LLMs apply textual cues to justify their decisions. Code: https://github.com/hyyuan/detect-llm-generated-texts.

AI.tldr: 论文系统评估15个LLM作为生成器和检测器，在1000篇人类文本与15000篇LLM生成文本上收集23.3万余条二分类及解释，研究LLM生成文本检测、自检测与跨检测。发现检测效果主要由检测器能力决定，新生成器更难检测，自检测无系统优势，不同代际检测器存在不同偏差且文本线索使用不一致。
AI.motivation: 自动检测LLM生成文本至关重要，但专用检测器跨领域和跨模型泛化能力不足。通用LLM可零样本进行作者分类并给出解释，但其检测行为，尤其是自检测与跨检测之间的关系，仍缺乏系统理解。
AI.method: 构建包含1000篇人类文本和15000篇LLM生成文本的基准，覆盖15个LLM且每模型1000篇。将15个跨三代LLM同时作为生成器和检测器，收集超过233000条二分类结果及自然语言解释，并进行统计比较和错误分析。
AI.result: 检测效能主要取决于检测器能力而非生成器来源，但新生成器输出更难检测。自检测未表现出系统性优势或劣势。第一代检测器漏检较多，假阴性率高；第二代检测器过度标记人类文本，假阳性率高；最新模型取得更平衡的权衡。不同LLM在利用文本线索解释决策方面存在显著不一致。
AI.conclusion: 通用LLM的检测行为受检测器能力和模型代际影响，自检测并不天然更优。未来需关注代际偏差、误报漏报权衡以及解释依据不一致等问题。代码已开源：https://github.com/hyyuan/detect-llm-generated-texts。

title: SeOPD: Self-Evolving LLMs via Online Policy Distillation from Self-Generated Chain-of-Thought
summary: Recent advances in online policy self-distillation (OPSD) have demonstrated that large language models (LLMs) can improve their capabilities by leveraging external privileged information (PI), such as manual annotations or feedback from external environments. However, obtaining accurate annotations and constructing sophisticated environments often require substantial human effort and computation, limiting the scalability of OPSD. While a few recent studies have explored self-improvement without external PI, the resulting gains remain limited. In this work, we explore whether LLMs can achieve comparable self-improvement without external PI. Our key observation is that a single LLM can support multiple reasoning modes, such as deep-thinking and non-thinking modes, with deep thinking generating additional information during reasoning. Based on this observation, we propose Self-Evolving Online Policy Distillation (SeOPD), which enables LLMs to distill and internalize information generated by their own chain of thought (CoT). Specifically, it (1) generates CoT with the deep-thinking mode, (2) produces responses with the non-thinking mode, and (3) uses the generated CoT as PI to provide token-level supervision for the non-thinking response, allowing new information inferred during reasoning to guide the non-thinking mode and be internalized into the shared model parameters, thereby improving both non-thinking and deep-thinking capabilities. Extensive experiments across LLMs and tasks demonstrate the effectiveness of SeOPD.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SeOPD，无需外部特权信息，利用同一 LLM 的深度思考模式生成思维链，并将其作为特权信息蒸馏到非思考模式中，从而提升模型整体推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有在线策略自蒸馏（OPSD）依赖人工标注或外部环境反馈等特权信息，成本高、可扩展性差；而无需外部 PI 的自改进方法提升有限。作者希望探索 LLM 能否不依赖外部 PI 实现相当的自改进。
AI.method: 提出自演化在线策略蒸馏（SeOPD）：先用深度思考模式生成思维链（CoT），再用非思考模式生成回答，最后将生成的 CoT 作为特权信息，对非思考回答进行 token 级监督，使推理中产生的新信息被内化到共享模型参数中。
AI.result: 在多种 LLM 和任务上的大量实验表明，SeOPD 能有效提升模型能力，包括非思考模式和深度思考模式的表现。
AI.conclusion: LLM 可以利用自身不同推理模式之间的信息差实现自改进，无需外部特权信息，为可扩展的在线策略自蒸馏提供了新思路。

title: ReMCTS: Reflection-Enhanced Monte Carlo Tree Search for Code Generation
comment: 21 pages, 2 figures. To appear in the Proceedings of EMNLP 2026
summary: Open-weight large language models (LLMs) can generate function-level programs from natural-language prompts, but plausible candidates still fail on hidden semantics and repeat mistakes across repair attempts. We present ReMCTS, an execution-grounded, memory-augmented, LLM-guided MCTS-style search framework. It organizes program candidates as tree states, retains branch-local debugging context, retrieves failure experience across branches, and distinguishes failed checks from unavailable evidence. On HumanEval and MBPP-Sanitized, visible-test ReMCTS improves over direct generation in 8 of 10 model-dataset pairs under held-out evaluation, whereas proxy-only search is less stable. Controlled tree-search, sampling, repair, and memory ablations characterize the source and limits of these gains. A 30-task HumanEval-X C++ pilot further demonstrates compatibility with compiler-backed execution, but does not constitute a broad multilingual evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出ReMCTS，一种基于执行、记忆增强、LLM引导的MCTS风格搜索框架，用于函数级程序生成，在HumanEval和MBPP-Sanitized上多数设置优于直接生成。
AI.motivation: 开放权重LLM能生成函数级程序，但候选程序在隐藏语义上仍会失败，且修复尝试中常重复相同错误。
AI.method: 将程序候选组织为树状态，保留分支本地调试上下文，跨分支检索失败经验，区分失败检查与不可用证据，结合执行反馈进行LLM引导的MCTS风格搜索。
AI.result: 在HumanEval和MBPP-Sanitized上，可见测试的ReMCTS在10个模型-数据集对中8个优于直接生成（留出评估），仅代理搜索稳定性较差；消融实验刻画了增益来源与局限；30任务HumanEval-X C++试点显示与编译器执行兼容，但非广泛多语言评估。
AI.conclusion: 执行接地、记忆增强的MCTS搜索能有效提升程序生成，但多语言泛化能力仍需进一步验证。

title: Beyond Token Alignment: Event Completion for Cross-Tokenizer On-Policy Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers knowledge between language models through teacher supervision on student-generated trajectories. With different tokenizers, a single teacher token may require multiple student tokens to generate, creating intermediate states where the event is entered but not yet completed. Existing cross-tokenizer methods align tokens or text spans to construct comparable prediction targets. We study a complementary problem after partial generation: once the student produces a prefix of a teacher token, multiple next tokens may complete the same remaining bytes, but the teacher only specifies the required completion rather than how probability should be divided among these valid continuations. We introduce Event-Set Completion Distillation (ESCD), which complements cross-tokenizer probability alignment with completion-set supervision. ESCD aggregates prefix-related teacher events and supervises the total probability of byte-compatible one-step student completions, avoiding tokenizer-dependent probability splits among individual tokens. The method reuses student trajectories and predictions, requiring neither additional rollouts nor changes to the student vocabulary. Experiments demonstrate consistent gains in mathematics, code, and scientific reasoning across model families and tokenizers, extending to large-scale MoE distillation from a 1T teacher to a 35B student. Local analyses show that retaining completion sets better matches the reference supervision, while one-step completion covers over 99% of observed compatible teacher mass after partial event entry in the studied tokenizer pairs. These findings support event entry and event completion as complementary supervision targets for cross-tokenizer knowledge transfer. Code will be released on GitHub.

AI.tldr: 论文研究跨分词器在线策略蒸馏中，学生生成教师token部分前缀后，多个学生token可完成同一剩余字节，而教师仅指定所需完成内容、未指定概率分配的问题，提出事件集完成蒸馏（ESCD），在跨分词器概率对齐之外补充完成集监督。
AI.motivation: 跨分词器蒸馏时，一个教师token可能对应多个学生token。当学生生成教师token的部分前缀后，多个下一token都能补全相同剩余字节，但教师只给出需要的完成结果，未说明如何在多个合法延续间分配概率，导致分词器相关的概率切分问题。
AI.method: 提出事件集完成蒸馏（ESCD）。该方法在跨分词器概率对齐基础上，聚合与前缀相关的教师事件，监督所有字节兼容的一步学生完成的总概率，避免在单个token间做依赖分词器的概率切分。方法复用学生轨迹与预测，无需额外rollout，也不改变学生词表。
AI.result: 在数学、代码和科学推理任务上，跨模型家族与分词器均取得一致提升，并扩展到1T教师到35B学生的大规模MoE蒸馏。局部分析表明，保留完成集能更好匹配参考监督；在部分事件进入后，一步完成覆盖了超过99%的观测兼容教师概率质量。
AI.conclusion: 事件进入与事件完成可作为跨分词器知识迁移中互补的监督目标。ESCD通过完成集监督补充现有概率对齐方法，有效提升跨分词器蒸馏效果，代码将在GitHub发布。

title: Denoising Multi-Robot Trajectories
comment: Accepted to IEEE Transactions on Robotics (T-RO)
summary: Multi-robot trajectory planning is a fundamental problem in multi-robot coordination but remains computationally challenging due to its nonconvex, multimodal, and high-dimensional nature. This work builds upon D4orm, a dynamics-aware diffusion-denoising framework, and develops a family of planning architectures for diverse operational requirements. Unlike conventional numerical optimization methods, D4orm employs sampling-based optimization to generate solution trajectories through massively parallel sampling, leveraging modern computing architectures such as GPUs. Its diffusion-denoising structure iteratively optimizes \textit{deformations} to candidate control trajectories, providing an efficient and versatile paradigm for generating kinodynamically feasible and conflict-free trajectories. Using D4orm as the building block for advanced planners, we present a decoupled planner for improved scalability, an online receding-horizon planner with feedback control, and a distributed planner for resource-constrained settings. Evaluations with differential-drive and holonomic robots in 2D and 3D environments demonstrate that D4orm-based approaches find high-quality solutions faster and more reliably than other sampling-based optimization methods, such as MPPI, as well as a learned diffusion-model-based method. We further demonstrate zero-shot deployment on ten real quadrotors with obstacles, large-scale deconfliction with 100 simulated robots, and fully onboard distributed `lifelong' operation with six ground robots. Overall, these results establish diffusion denoising as a scalable and reliable framework for multi-robot coordination. Code and video: https://github.com/proroklab/d4orm

AI.tldr: 本文基于动力学感知的扩散去噪框架 D4orm，提出一系列多机器人轨迹规划架构，包括解耦规划器、在线滚动时域反馈规划器和分布式规划器，并在仿真与真实机器人上验证其可扩展性与可靠性。
AI.motivation: 多机器人轨迹规划具有非凸、多模态和高维特点，计算挑战大；传统数值优化方法难以兼顾效率、可扩展性和实时性，因此需要基于采样与并行计算的新规划范式。
AI.method: 以 D4orm 为基本模块，利用基于采样的优化和 GPU 大规模并行采样，通过扩散去噪迭代优化候选控制轨迹的形变，生成满足动力学可行且无冲突的轨迹；并扩展出解耦规划器、在线滚动时域反馈规划器和分布式规划器。
AI.result: 在 2D 和 3D 环境中的差速驱动与全向机器人评估表明，基于 D4orm 的方法比 MPPI 等采样优化方法及学习扩散模型方法更快、更可靠地找到高质量解；并实现十架真实四旋翼零样本部署、100 个仿真机器人大规模解冲突，以及六台地面机器人全机载分布式终身运行。
AI.conclusion: 扩散去噪可作为多机器人协调中可扩展且可靠的规划框架，适用于多种运行需求、规模与真实场景。

title: Scope-WM: Scoped Computation for Efficient Visual World Models
summary: Visual world models enable robotic planning by predicting future observations, but dense latent-state propagation and sample-intensive trajectory optimization incur high inference latency and peak memory usage, limiting real-time deployment on resource-constrained platforms. Existing sparse world-model acceleration methods either rely on unguided token sparsification, which may discard planning-relevant information and restrict achievable sparsity, or introduce heavy auxiliary modules and cumbersome multi-stage training pipelines. In this work, we present Scope-WM, an efficient visual world model that scopes computation to prediction-relevant latent regions and promising action sequences. Scope-WM distills prediction relevance into a lightweight action-conditioned selector and applies full dynamics prediction only to a compact subset of selected tokens. It updates the remaining tokens using a compact summary of foreground states and their changes, allowing the background to perceive foreground dynamics without costly token-to-token interactions. During planning, Scope-WM preserves and reuses high-quality action sequences discovered during the initial MPC search, focusing subsequent search under reduced rollout budgets. The resulting pipeline requires only a one-off selector distillation followed by a single joint training stage for the sparse world model. On the challenging Push-T task, Scope-WM reduces peak GPU memory usage and planning time to $18.1\%$ and $14.3\%$ of those of dense DINO-WM, respectively, corresponding to a $6.97\times$ planning speedup, while maintaining competitive task performance. Further evaluations across five diverse visual planning tasks demonstrate the general applicability of Scope-WM. Code is available at https://github.com/ChunZheng2022/Scope-WM.

AI.tldr: 提出 Scope-WM 高效视觉世界模型，通过将计算聚焦于与预测相关的潜在区域和有前景的动作序列，显著降低规划延迟与峰值显存，并保持有竞争力的任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉世界模型虽可用于机器人规划，但密集潜在状态传播和样本密集型轨迹优化导致高推理延迟与峰值显存，难以在资源受限平台实时部署；现有稀疏加速方法要么无引导稀疏化而丢失规划相关信息，要么依赖沉重辅助模块和多阶段训练流程。
AI.method: 将预测相关性蒸馏到轻量级动作条件选择器，仅对选定的紧凑 token 子集执行完整动态预测；其余 token 通过前景状态及其变化的紧凑摘要更新，避免昂贵的 token 间交互。规划时保留并复用初始 MPC 搜索中发现的高质量动作序列，在缩减 rollout 预算下继续搜索。整体只需一次性选择器蒸馏和单阶段稀疏世界模型联合训练。
AI.result: 在 Push-T 任务上，Scope-WM 将峰值 GPU 显存和规划时间分别降至 dense DINO-WM 的 18.1% 和 14.3%，实现 6.97 倍规划加速，同时保持有竞争力的任务性能；在五个多样化视觉规划任务上的评估验证了其通用性。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: Scope-WM 能有效加速视觉世界模型规划并降低显存占用，同时保持竞争性能，具有跨任务适用性。

title: Not Too Hard, Not Too Easy: Learning from Intermediate States for LLM Structured Reasoning
summary: A common principle of effective learning is to practice material that is neither already mastered nor too difficult to permit progress. We ask how to apply this principle to structured reasoning tasks such as Sudoku and maze solving. In these tasks, a model can repeatedly revise an incomplete or incorrect candidate solution until it satisfies the problem's constraints. The intermediate candidate solutions along this trajectory provide natural training examples: some are already solved, some cannot yet be repaired by the model, and others lie at its current frontier of achievable progress. We therefore investigate whether pretrained language models can learn to revise such states and whether training on states at this frontier improves reasoning more broadly. To achieve this, we couple a pretrained language-model backbone with a recurrent updater that repeatedly revises an explicit solution state, using the same parameters at every update step. We further introduce Frontier-Oriented Curation Using Self-trajectories (FOCUS), which selects training states from trajectories generated by the current model. FOCUS measures how much the model improves each state within a fixed number of recurrent updates and prioritizes states from which it can make substantial progress. With Qwen3-1.7B, FOCUS achieves 64.4% exact solve accuracy on Sudoku-Extreme and 91.1% on Maze-Hard, with similar gains observed across five Qwen and Llama backbones spanning 1.7B to 8B parameters. We further observe zero-shot transfer in the adapted LLM to mathematical reasoning and code execution, even when the recurrent updater is disabled and no downstream fine-tuning is performed.

AI.tldr: 论文将“练习适中难度材料”的学习原则用于数独、迷宫等结构化推理任务，提出循环更新器与FOCUS训练状态筛选方法，显著提升求解准确率并出现零样本迁移。
AI.motivation: 有效学习通常需要练习既非已掌握也非过难的內容；在结构化推理中，中间候选解天然处于已解决、无法修复和当前能力前沿等不同状态，因此研究训练模型修订这些前沿状态是否能提升更广泛的推理能力。
AI.method: 将预训练语言模型与循环更新器耦合，使其用同一组参数反复修订显式解状态；提出FOCUS方法，从当前模型生成的轨迹中选择训练状态，衡量固定更新步数内模型对每个状态的改进程度，并优先选择能取得显著进展的前沿状态。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-1.7B上，FOCUS在Sudoku-Extreme达到64.4%精确求解准确率，在Maze-Hard达到91.1%；在五个Qwen和Llama骨干模型（1.7B至8B参数）上均观察到类似提升；禁用循环更新器且不做下游微调时，仍对数学推理和代码执行表现出零样本迁移。
AI.conclusion: 训练模型修订其当前能力前沿的中间解状态，可有效提升结构化推理表现，并可能泛化到数学推理和代码执行等其他任务。

title: AevaScenes: An FMCW LiDAR Dataset and Benchmark for Long-Range Perception
summary: FMCW LiDAR measures per-point radial Doppler velocity alongside range, providing a motion cue unavailable in conventional time-of-flight sensors. Exploiting this signal at long range remains understudied. We present an FMCW LiDAR dataset of 575 sequences (57.5K frames) with over 8 million annotated 3D boxes across 16 detection classes and per-point labels across 24 semantic classes, captured by six commercial FMCW LiDAR sensors and six paired 4K cameras across eight Bay Area cities, including 237 nighttime sequences, with annotations extending to 400m. We define a benchmark with three tasks: 3D object detection, scene flow estimation, and semantic segmentation. Detection and scene flow are evaluated across three range bins to 400m, with a public evaluation server. We explore the impact of Doppler measurements on flagship recognition tasks, and find significant improvements up to 2X in detection AP of far-away vehicles and pedestrians, particularly in low-latency single-frame settings. We similarly find scene flow accuracy is significantly improved with Doppler measurements across all ranges. Our dataset and benchmark have been publicly released at https://scenes.aeva.com.

AI.tldr: 本文发布了一个FMCW LiDAR数据集，包含575个序列、5.75万帧、超过800万个3D标注框、16个检测类别和24个语义类别，覆盖8个城市、237个夜间序列，标注距离达400米。基准包含3D目标检测、场景流估计和语义分割，并发现多普勒速度可显著提升远距离车辆和行人的检测AP以及场景流精度。
AI.motivation: 传统ToF LiDAR缺少逐点径向多普勒速度信息，而FMCW LiDAR可同时提供距离和径向速度。但在长距离场景下，如何利用该运动线索仍缺乏系统研究。
AI.method: 采集六种商用FMCW LiDAR和六台配对4K相机的多模态数据，覆盖八个湾区城市并包含夜间场景；提供3D框和逐点语义标注；定义3D目标检测、场景流估计和语义分割三个基准任务，检测与场景流按三个距离区间评估至400米，并提供公开评测服务器。
AI.result: 数据集规模为575序列、57.5K帧、800万+3D框。多普勒测量使远距离车辆和行人的检测AP最高提升2倍，尤其在低延迟单帧设置下；场景流精度在所有距离范围内也显著提升。
AI.conclusion: FMCW LiDAR的多普勒信息能有效提升远距离感知任务性能，尤其在检测和场景流估计中。该数据集和基准已公开，可推动相关研究。

title: PARSEE-VAD: Efficient Training-Free Online Video Anomaly Detection via Proposition-Aware Reasoning and Streaming Evidence Escalation
summary: Training-free online video anomaly detection (VAD) with frozen multimodal language models faces two coupled challenges: extracting reliable current-window semantics under causal and computational constraints, and maintaining temporal continuity without repeatedly transmitting high-dimensional history. Encoding history through text can compress visual evidence and introduce semantic bias, whereas retaining visual history expands multimodal context. We introduce PARSEE-VAD, a two-module framework that separates semantic evidence acquisition from score-state evolution. Proposition-Aware Reasoning (PAR) extracts structured propositional evidence from the current causal window and conditionally activates more specific queries when coarse evidence warrants further refinement. By sharing a reusable causal visual prefix across queries, PAR reduces redundant computation through selective execution. Streaming Evidence Escalation (SEE) maps the acquired proposition evidence into a compact score-domain event state through current evidence escalation, then propagates only the resulting bounded state across decisions to support temporal continuity. Experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate strong training-free online performance while selective routing reduces specialist computation and score-state propagation remains sparse. These results support a current-first principle for streaming multimodal inference: resolve present semantics first, then use compact historical state only to repair residual continuity gaps.

AI.tldr: 提出 PARSEE-VAD，一种无需训练、基于冻结多模态语言模型的在线视频异常检测框架，将语义证据获取与分数状态演化分离。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在因果与计算约束下难以可靠提取当前窗口语义；若用文本编码历史会压缩视觉证据并引入语义偏差，而保留视觉历史又会扩大多模态上下文。
AI.method: 包含两个模块：Proposition-Aware Reasoning (PAR) 从当前因果窗口提取结构化命题证据，并在粗粒度证据需要时条件激活更具体查询，通过共享可复用的因果视觉前缀和选择性执行减少冗余计算；Streaming Evidence Escalation (SEE) 将命题证据映射为紧凑的分数域事件状态，并仅在决策间传播有界状态以维持时间连续性。
AI.result: 在四个基准上取得较强的免训练在线性能；选择性路由降低了专用计算量，分数状态传播保持稀疏。
AI.conclusion: 支持面向流式多模态推理的 current-first 原则：先解析当前语义，再用紧凑历史状态修复残余的连续性缺口。

title: MM-ABC: Towards Generalist Mobile Manipulation via Seeing, Coordinating and Imagining
summary: Mobile manipulation extends robot interaction beyond a fixed kinematic workspace by making the reachable region itself controllable. This flexibility introduces two central challenges: spatially grounded perception under continuous ego-motion and coordinated control of heterogeneous arm and base actions. Existing approaches strengthen geometry through explicit 3D representations or predictive world models, and often decouple mobility and manipulation into separate action streams. We argue that effective mobile manipulation requires not only decoupling, but also representations that support efficient cross-stream collaboration. We present MM-ABC, a foundation model built around Seeing, Coordinating, and Imagining Arm-Base Collaboration. MM-ABC combines sparse multi-level VLM features for spatial perception; a training-only future branch that uses world imagination and geometric intent as extra supervision, strengthening perception and manipulation-intent prediction and improving the overall learning signal; and MM-APT, which coordinates separate manipulation and mobility streams through masked joint attention and clean-action x-prediction. In controlled ablations, replacing clean-action prediction with velocity prediction lowers success on RoboCasa365 composite-seen tasks from 32.8% to 29.2%, and removing future supervision or multilevel conditioning causes larger drops. We pretrain MM-ABC on 5,000+ hours of heterogeneous robot data spanning 400K+ episodes, 12 datasets, and 17 embodiments. Experiments cover EBench, RoboCasa365, ManiSkill-HAB, LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and real-world mobile manipulation. MM-ABC achieves 44.71% success on EBench, 61.2% on RoboCasa365, 99.1% on LIBERO, 82.8% on LIBERO-Plus without perturbation training, and 83% mean success on five real-world tasks.

AI.tldr: MM-ABC 是一个面向移动操作的基础模型，围绕视觉感知、臂-基协同与未来想象，融合稀疏多层级 VLM 特征、仅训练用未来分支和掩码联合注意力，实现移动与操作动作流的协调，并在多个仿真与真实任务上取得较强表现。
AI.motivation: 移动操作使机器人可达空间本身可控，但带来两大挑战：连续自运动下的空间 grounded 感知，以及异构机械臂与移动底座动作的协调控制。现有方法常依赖显式 3D 表示或预测式世界模型，并将移动与操作解耦为独立动作流；作者认为有效移动操作不仅需要解耦，还需要支持跨流高效协作的表征。
AI.method: 提出 MM-ABC，包含 Seeing、Coordinating、Imagining 三部分：使用稀疏多层级 VLM 特征进行空间感知；引入仅训练阶段的未来分支，以世界想象和几何意图作为额外监督，增强感知与操作意图预测；提出 MM-APT，通过掩码联合注意力和 clean-action x-prediction 协调独立的操作与移动流。模型在 5000+ 小时、40 万+ episode、12 个数据集、17 种本体上预训练。
AI.result: 消融显示，将 clean-action 预测替换为速度预测会使 RoboCasa365 composite-seen 成功率从 32.8% 降至 29.2%，移除未来监督或多层级条件下降更大。实验覆盖 EBench、RoboCasa365、ManiSkill-HAB、LIBERO、LIBERO-Plus 和真实移动操作：EBench 44.71%，RoboCasa365 61.2%，LIBERO 99.1%，LIBERO-Plus 82.8%（无扰动训练），五个真实任务平均成功率 83%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，移动操作基础模型在解耦动作流之外，还需要支持跨流协作的表征；未来想象监督与多层级条件能显著提升学习信号，MM-ABC 在多个仿真基准和真实任务上均表现有效。

title: Draft-KV: Learning Useful Latent Communication Between Language Models
summary: Latent communication passes internal states between language models instead of decoded text, but higher receiver accuracy does not show that the receiver used the message content. Across five method-dataset pairs, replacing each message with one from an unrelated question changes accuracy by at most 0.60 points, even when communication adds 15.44 points over the receiver alone. Thus the interface can supply the gain while making the sharer dispensable. Draft-KV instead sends the key-value states formed while the sharer drafts an answer to the current question. Linear projections place these states in a side memory read through a gated attention branch, and progressive training moves from message reconstruction to answer supervision under a guard on harm from mismatched messages. Both models remain frozen and the interface trains 1.05M parameters, 348x fewer than C2C. With a Qwen3-8B sharer, a frozen Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct receiver reaches 78.04% on MMLU-Redux, versus 37.45% alone and 36.40% with reassigned messages. At fixed interface size, scaling the sharer from 0.6B to 8B raises accuracy from 46.11% to 78.04%; communication also transfers to held-out tasks and can exceed both models when each holds different evidence.

AI.tldr: 论文指出潜空间通信中接收器准确率提升不一定代表其真正利用了发送方信息，并提出Draft-KV：用发送方起草答案时形成的KV状态，通过线性投影和门控注意力侧记忆传给冻结接收器，实现参数高效且内容有效的跨模型通信。
AI.motivation: 现有潜空间通信以接收器准确率作为成功标准，但即使把消息替换为无关问题的消息，准确率也几乎不变，说明收益可能来自接口本身而非消息内容，发送方可能变得可有可无。
AI.method: Draft-KV让发送方模型针对当前问题起草答案，并提取此过程中形成的key-value状态；用线性投影将这些状态放入侧记忆，接收方通过门控注意力分支读取；采用渐进训练，从消息重建过渡到答案监督，并加入不匹配消息有害性约束；两个模型保持冻结，仅训练接口参数。
AI.result: 在五个方法-数据集组合中，替换为无关消息后准确率变化不超过0.60个百分点，即使通信相比接收器单独提升15.44个百分点，说明旧接口可能使发送方可替代。Draft-KV仅训练1.05M参数，比C2C少348倍；Qwen3-8B发送方加冻结Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct接收方在MMLU-Redux达78.04%，单独接收方37.45%，重分配消息36.40%。固定接口规模下，发送方从0.6B扩到8B使准确率从46.11%升至78.04%；通信可迁移到留出任务，且当两模型持有不同证据时可超过二者各自表现。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间通信需要更严格的因果评估，不能只看准确率提升；Draft-KV表明，通过传递发送方起草答案时的KV状态，可让冻结接收器真正利用发送方内容，以极少参数获得显著提升，并随发送方规模扩展、具备迁移性，甚至在互补证据下超越两个模型。

title: Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning
summary: Robots that learn from a few demonstrations often require two forms of generalization. Compositional generalization recombines skills to solve new tasks, and skill generalization lets the learned policy behind each skill work in new situations. The two depend on each other, yet information is lost between composition and the skills it calls. Where a skill works is determined by the structure its policy is trained with, while composition sees the skill only through a separate description, such as a name, an instruction, or a symbolic operator, that omits this structure. Our key idea is to use each policy's structural prior as part of the interface between composition and the skill. A structural prior states what a behavior depends on, for example that a grasp depends only on the gripper's pose relative to the object. Built into training, it shapes where the policy generalizes; stated in language, it tells composition where the policy applies. We instantiate this idea in Agent Priors-guided Policy Learning (APPL). A construction agent segments complete demonstrations into reusable skills, proposes several structural priors for each skill, and trains and verifies one policy per prior. A runtime agent then selects among these prior-specific policies and composes them toward new task goals using their interfaces. Across MetaWorld and long-horizon ManiSkill tasks, APPL improves out-of-distribution skill generalization and enables previously unseen skill compositions; ablating the interface information substantially reduces performance. These results support the use of training-time structural assumptions as a bridge between skill learning and skill composition.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 APPL，将策略的结构先验作为技能学习与技能组合之间的接口，从而同时提升技能泛化和组合泛化。
AI.motivation: 少样本演示下的机器人需要组合泛化和技能泛化，但现有方法在组合技能时只通过名称、指令或符号操作符调用技能，丢失了策略训练时的结构信息，导致无法判断技能在何处适用、何时可组合。
AI.method: APPL 包含构造智能体和运行时智能体：构造智能体将完整演示分割为可复用技能，为每个技能提出多个结构先验，并训练和验证每个先验对应的策略；运行时智能体选择这些先验特定策略，并利用其接口信息组合策略以完成新任务目标。
AI.result: 在 MetaWorld 和长时程 ManiSkill 任务上，APPL 提升了分布外技能泛化能力，并实现了此前未见的技能组合；消融接口信息后性能显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 训练时的结构假设可以作为技能学习与技能组合之间的桥梁，支持更有效的泛化和组合。

title: Unlocking Latent Personalization in LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly expected to adapt to individual users, yet effective personalization remains challenging when only limited user-specific samples are available. In this work, we take an alternative perspective: pretrained LLMs may already possess latent capacity for personalization, and a few user samples may therefore suffice to guide the model toward user-aligned behavior with minimal user-specific adaptation. From this perspective, we propose LatentPersonal, a framework that formulates personalization as navigation in a shared latent adaptation space. LatentPersonal infers a compact latent representation from a few user samples to guide user-specific model adaptation, regularized with a variational information bottleneck to encourage compact preference representations. We instantiate LatentPersonal with LoRA, leveraging its low-rank parameterization as a natural low-dimensional adaptation space for personalization. By simply inserting a user-specific guidance vector between the shared low-rank factors, the model can navigate toward personalized adaptations through lightweight inference of this compact representation, without updating the shared LoRA parameters. Experiments across multiple personalization datasets demonstrate that LatentPersonal substantially reduces user-specific adaptation overhead while achieving effective personalization from only a few user-specific interactions, with particularly strong performance in the one-shot regime.

AI.tldr: 提出 LatentPersonal 框架，将大语言模型个性化视为在共享潜在适配空间中的导航，用少量用户样本推断紧凑潜在表示来引导个性化适配，无需更新共享 LoRA 参数。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型需要适应用户个体，但用户特定样本通常很少，传统个性化适配成本高。作者假设预训练 LLM 已具备潜在个性化能力，少量样本即可引导模型产生用户对齐行为。
AI.method: LatentPersonal 从少量用户样本推断紧凑潜在表示以引导用户特定模型适配，并用变分信息瓶颈正则化偏好表示。以 LoRA 作为低维适配空间，在共享低秩因子间插入用户特定引导向量，通过轻量推断实现个性化适配，同时不更新共享 LoRA 参数。
AI.result: 在多个个性化数据集上，LatentPersonal 显著降低用户特定适配开销，并能仅凭少量用户交互实现有效个性化，尤其在单样本场景表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 预训练 LLM 可被有效引导实现个性化；通过在共享潜在适配空间中导航并结合少量用户样本，可以在低适配开销下获得强个性化效果。

title: VGGT-Diff: Visual Geometry Meets Diffusion for Sparse-View Novel View Synthesis
summary: We present VGGT-Diff, a geometry-routed multi-view diffusion model for sparse-view novel view synthesis. Existing novel view synthesis (NVS) methods face a fundamental trade-off: reconstruction-based approaches preserve observed geometry but struggle to synthesize unseen regions, while diffusion-based methods provide strong generative priors yet rely on implicit source-to-query correspondence. VGGT-Diff bridges these regimes by routing visual geometry latents from VGGT-Ω into a pretrained video diffusion model. Each visual token is associated with a 3D point and confidence, then transformed into query-aligned latent conditions through a confidence-aware Visual Geometry Router (VGR) that preserves front and back surface evidence. These conditions guide joint target-view denoising, while Point-Track Residual Consistency (PTRC) regularizes predicted-clean residuals along reliable 3D tracks, improving multi-view stability. We further introduce robust geometry conditioning, combining training-time regularization with inference-time guidance for improved robustness. Experiments show competitive or state-of-the-art performance across interpolation and extrapolation under different viewpoint difficulties. Our code is available at https://github.com/chenkangjie1123/VGGT-Diff.

AI.tldr: 提出VGGT-Diff，一种几何路由的多视角扩散模型，用于稀疏视角新视图合成，将VGGT-Ω的视觉几何隐变量路由到预训练视频扩散模型中，在插值与外推任务上取得竞争性或最先进性能。
AI.motivation: 现有新视图合成方法存在根本性权衡：基于重建的方法能保留观测几何但难以合成未观测区域，而基于扩散的方法虽具备强生成先验却依赖隐式的源到查询对应关系。
AI.method: 将VGGT-Ω的视觉几何隐变量路由至预训练视频扩散模型；每个视觉token关联3D点和置信度，通过置信度感知的视觉几何路由器（VGR）转换为查询对齐的隐条件，保留前后表面证据；这些条件引导联合目标视角去噪，并利用Point-Track Residual Consistency（PTRC）沿可靠3D轨迹正则化预测的干净残差以提升多视角稳定性；进一步引入鲁棒几何条件，结合训练时正则化与推理时引导。
AI.result: 在不同视角难度下的插值与外推实验中，取得具有竞争力或最先进的性能。代码开源。
AI.conclusion: VGGT-Diff桥接了重建与扩散两种范式，通过几何路由和残差一致性正则化有效提升了稀疏视角新视图合成的生成质量与多视角稳定性。

title: Are Benchmarks Reliable? Toward Structural Diagnosis via Sample-Level Capability Boundaries
comment: Submitted to NeurIPS 2026; Rejected with reviewer scores of 4,4,4
summary: Evaluating large language models (LLMs) relies heavily on benchmark scores, yet aggregate metrics can obscure whether benchmark samples reliably support model comparison. We introduce \textbf{BSDProbe}, a sample-level framework for \emph{benchmark structural diagnosis} that estimates capability boundaries from repeated-response trajectories along ordered model axes. BSDProbe summarizes samples by boundary position, boundary width, boundary-signal validity, and order consistency, then aggregates them into benchmark-level structural profiles. Experiments on six benchmarks show that benchmark reliability is axis-conditioned and heterogeneous: GSM8K and MATH exhibit the most stable measurement structures, MMLU and TriviaQA are relatively stable but heterogeneous, while GPQA and PopQA show stronger axis-conditioned risks. These profiles remain consistent across Qwen3, Qwen2.5, and cross-model axes. BSDProbe further selects compact high-value subsets whose model discriminability reaches up to $8.58\times$ that of the full benchmark. These results suggest that reliable benchmark use requires examining sample-level capability boundaries beyond leaderboard scores.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 BSDProbe，一个样本级基准结构诊断框架，通过沿有序模型轴的重复响应轨迹估计能力边界，以评估基准样本能否可靠支持模型比较。
AI.motivation: 现有大语言模型评估依赖基准分数，但聚合指标会掩盖样本层面的测量结构问题，无法判断基准样本是否可靠支持模型比较。
AI.method: BSDProbe 从边界位置、边界宽度、边界信号有效性和顺序一致性四个方面总结样本，并聚合为基准级结构剖面；在六个基准上实验，并在 Qwen3、Qwen2.5 及跨模型轴上验证，同时筛选紧凑高价值子集。
AI.result: 基准可靠性依模型轴而异且具有异质性：GSM8K 和 MATH 测量结构最稳定，MMLU 和 TriviaQA 相对稳定但异质，GPQA 和 PopQA 的轴条件风险更强；这些剖面在 Qwen3、Qwen2.5 和跨模型轴上保持一致；所选子集的模型判别力最高可达全基准的 8.58 倍。
AI.conclusion: 可靠使用基准不能只看排行榜分数，还需要检查样本级能力边界和基准结构。

title: Humanoid Loco-Manipulation With Discrete VLA Model
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models using discrete action tokens have proven effective for controling robotic arms on manipulation tasks. For a humanoid, however, the whole-body action space -- legs, torso, arms, and hands -- is far higher-dimensional and heterogeneous, raising tokenization, training, and real-time inference challenges that the previous VLA models do not address. We present Holo-M, to our knowledge the first discrete VLA model for humanoid loco-manipulation that intrinsically exploits the language model by extending its vocabulary with action tokens. In this model, we devise a unified action tokenizer that decomposes the humanoid action space into four body-part-specific tokenizers -- end-effector, body, hand, and kinematics -- enabling training across drastically different embodiments and data sources, including humanoid teleoperation, ego-centric human video, and simulation. By extending the language model's vocabulary with these action tokens, we avoid the knowledge-insulation problem inherent to the models that use separate continuous action experts. To meet real-time control requirements, we decode each body part's action tokens through grouped discrete diffusion decoding, rather than using autoregression on the action tokens. We have conducted extensive experiments on the SIMPLE humanoid loco-manipulation benchmark, in which Holo-M achieves the highest success rates in both the generalist and specialist evaluations, leading the second best by significant margins. We will release all the code and model weights.

AI.tldr: 提出 Holo-M，首个面向人形机器人全身移动操作（loco-manipulation）的离散视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型。它通过扩展语言模型词表加入动作 token，并利用统一动作分词器与分组离散扩散解码，在 SIMPLE 基准上取得最优表现。
AI.motivation: 现有离散动作 token 的 VLA 模型主要适用于机械臂操作，而人形机器人全身动作空间涵盖腿、躯干、手臂和手，维度更高且异构，带来分词、训练和实时推理方面的挑战，已有 VLA 模型未能很好解决。
AI.method: Holo-M 将人形机器人动作空间分解为四个身体部位特定的 tokenizer：末端执行器、身体、手和运动学，从而统一训练不同本体与数据源，包括人形遥操作、第一人称人类视频和仿真。模型扩展语言模型词表以包含动作 token，避免使用独立连续动作专家带来的知识隔离问题。实时控制方面，采用分组离散扩散解码分别解码各身体部位的动作 token，而非对动作 token 进行自回归。
AI.result: 在 SIMPLE 人形机器人移动操作基准上进行了大量实验，Holo-M 在通用评估和专业评估中均取得最高成功率，并显著领先第二名。
AI.conclusion: Holo-M 表明离散 VLA 模型可有效扩展至人形机器人全身移动操作，通过统一动作分词、语言模型词表扩展和分组离散扩散解码，能兼顾多本体多数据训练与实时控制，并达到当前最优性能。代码和模型权重将开源。

title: EngIntervene: Benchmarking Multimodal Engineering State Understanding and Design Intervention Reasoning
summary: Multimodal engineering benchmarks largely evaluate static understanding, such as recognizing components, interpreting diagrams, or answering technical questions. This leaves a missing middle between engineering perception and full design generation: whether a model can use an understood system state to reason about relations, constraints, and the consequences of design changes. We introduce \textsc{EngIntervene}, a benchmark for this capability. It contains 3,229 questions across seven engineering domains and organizes evaluation into four levels: state grounding (T1), relational and mechanistic reasoning (T2), constraint-aware diagnosis (T3), and intervention reasoning (T4), which asks whether a proposed modification achieves its target while preserving required constraints. The tasks instantiate a unified engineering state representation spanning objects, relations, constraints, and design objectives, and T2--T4 are scored against structured reference answers with atomic criteria. Across open- and closed-weight multimodal models, stronger grounding does not reliably translate into better diagnosis or intervention, and the best open-weight model trails the best closed model by 14.7 percentage points on the T2--T4 average. Removing or shuffling visual evidence consistently degrades performance, while benchmark-specific supervised fine-tuning improves T1 but not T2--T4. T4 further exposes a large gap between satisfying individual revision criteria and producing a fully valid intervention. Engineering reasoning thus requires not only recovering the current state, but also reliably using it to reason about constraints and post-intervention consequences. Code and benchmark artifacts are available at https://github.com/changcv2021/EngIntervene

AI.tldr: 论文提出EngIntervene基准，用于评估多模态模型在工程感知与设计生成之间的推理能力，涵盖状态接地、关系推理、约束诊断和干预推理四个层级，共3229题、七个工程领域。
AI.motivation: 现有工程多模态基准多评估静态理解（如识别部件、解读图纸），缺少对“利用已理解系统状态进行关系、约束及设计变更后果推理”这一中间能力的评估。
AI.method: 构建EngIntervene基准，包含四层任务：T1状态接地、T2关系与机制推理、T3约束感知诊断、T4干预推理。统一工程状态表示涵盖对象、关系、约束与设计目标，T2-T4采用结构化参考答案与原子标准评分。
AI.result: 更强接地能力并未可靠转化为更好的诊断或干预表现；最佳开源模型在T2-T4平均上落后最佳闭源模型14.7个百分点。移除或打乱视觉证据会持续降低性能；基准专用监督微调提升T1但未提升T2-T4。T4还暴露满足单项修订标准与产生完全有效干预之间的巨大差距。
AI.conclusion: 工程推理不仅需要恢复当前状态，还需可靠利用该状态推理约束及干预后后果。

title: Reference-Grounded Data Curation for Instruction-Following Thai-English Machine Translation
summary: Instruction-following machine translation (IF-MT) requires respecting prompt-level rules on terminology, formatting, and register. Rule compliance typically trades off against translation quality, a tension that general-purpose IF data augmentation methods do not address. We propose Reference-Grounded Data Curation, a two-phase pipeline that extracts every supervised constraint from a reference translation that already satisfies it, ensuring feasibility by construction. Phase 1 applies Instruction-Following Difficulty (IFD) scoring to retain the hardest-but-learnable instances from an English-Thai parallel pool. Phase 2 extracts constraints from each reference target and keeps only generations satisfying every constraint, yielding the 1.97M-record Grounded dataset. We fine-tune open-weight bases on Grounded to produce ChindaMT, a Thai-English translation family at 4B, 2B, and 0.8B parameters. Under length-controlled pairwise judging, ChindaMT outperforms or matches every same-size baseline at every tier on both plain translation and under explicit rules, reaching up to a 68.4% win rate against the strongest baseline. The recipe transfers cleanly across Qwen generations. We release model weights, the Grounded dataset, and evaluation suites.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出参考译文锚定的数据筛选流程，用于指令遵循机器翻译（IF-MT）。通过两阶段构建 Grounded 数据集并微调开放权重基座，得到泰英翻译模型 ChindaMT（4B、2B、0.8B）。在长度控制配对评判下，ChindaMT 在普通翻译和显式规则翻译中均达到或超过同规模基线，最高对最强基线取得 68.4% 胜率。
AI.motivation: IF-MT 需要遵守术语、格式和语域等提示级规则，但规则遵循通常与翻译质量存在权衡；通用指令遵循数据增强方法没有专门解决这一矛盾。
AI.method: 提出 Reference-Grounded Data Curation 两阶段流程：阶段1用 Instruction-Following Difficulty（IFD）评分，从英泰平行语料池中保留最难但可学习的样本；阶段2从每个参考译文中抽取约束，只保留满足全部约束的生成结果，得到 1.97M 条 Grounded 数据集。基于该数据微调开放权重基座，训练泰英翻译模型族 ChindaMT，包括 4B、2B 和 0.8B 参数版本。
AI.result: 在长度控制配对评判下，ChindaMT 在普通翻译和显式规则翻译中，在每个规模层级上均优于或匹配同规模基线，对最强基线最高胜率达 68.4%。该配方可干净迁移到不同 Qwen 代际。
AI.conclusion: 参考译文锚定的数据筛选能有效缓解规则遵循与翻译质量之间的权衡，并构建高质量 IF-MT 训练数据。作者发布了模型权重、Grounded 数据集和评测套件。

title: LongPuzzleBench: Evaluating GUI Agents on Long-Horizon Visual Puzzles
summary: GUI agents need long-horizon visual reasoning: they must interpret a changing interface while keeping a multi-step plan viable as earlier actions constrain later ones. Existing benchmarks evaluate grounding, computer use, and game play, but rarely test whether agents stay coherent across long chains of coupled decisions. Long-horizon visual puzzles expose this capability directly: a legal move that looks like progress can make the puzzle unsolvable, and the loss shows only several moves later. We introduce LongPuzzleBench, 114 levels in six puzzle games played through native GUI actions, where one objective can take a human over a thousand actions on persistent boards and dead ends go unannounced. With Native GUI Actions alone, the strongest agents solve most objectives, but success falls sharply on harder, longer boards: seven of ten general-purpose agents solve nothing harder than Medium, and none completes Bolt Unscrew Hard, which a human solves along with every other objective. Code Execution CUA does not close this gap, and its scores mix visual solving with algorithmic search. Controlled diagnostics trace these failures to one limitation that neither rules, state hints, nor failure memory removes: agents judge each move by the visible progress it makes, not by the future options it leaves.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LongPuzzleBench，包含 6 款解谜游戏共 114 关，通过原生 GUI 动作测试 GUI 智能体的长时程视觉推理能力。结果显示，智能体在简单目标上表现尚可，但在更长更难的棋盘上迅速失败，核心缺陷是仅根据当前可见进展判断动作，而非考虑该动作对后续可选空间的影响。
AI.motivation: 现有基准多评估 grounding、computer use 和游戏操作，很少测试智能体在长时间、强耦合决策链中能否保持计划一致性。长时程视觉解谜能直接暴露该能力：看似推进的一步可能让谜题后续无解，而失败往往数步后才显现。
AI.method: 构建 LongPuzzleBench：6 款解谜游戏、114 个关卡，全部通过原生 GUI 动作操作，棋盘持久存在，死路不会明确提示。评估最强智能体的原生 GUI 操作能力，并测试 Code Execution CUA 是否缩小差距。进一步用受控诊断分析规则、状态提示、失败记忆等因素，定位失败原因。
AI.result: 仅用原生 GUI 动作时，最强智能体能解决大多数目标，但在更难、更长的棋盘上成功率骤降：10 个通用智能体中有 7 个无法解决高于 Medium 的关卡，且没有任何智能体完成 Bolt Unscrew Hard，而人类可解包括该目标在内的所有目标。Code Execution CUA 未弥合差距，其得分混合了视觉解题与算法搜索。受控诊断表明，规则、状态提示和失败记忆均无法消除同一限制：智能体按每步可见进展判断，而非按未来可选空间判断。
AI.conclusion: 当前 GUI 智能体缺乏长时程视觉推理与耦合决策规划能力，容易陷入“看似前进、实则自断后路”的局部贪心行为。要提升长时程 GUI 任务表现，需要让智能体在决策时评估动作对未来选项和可解性的影响，而 LongPuzzleBench 为这类评估提供了针对性基准。

title: WorldAgent: Verification-Guided Agentic Physical World Construction
summary: Constructing complex physical worlds from language requires coordinating extensive 3D environments, detailed structures and objects at different spatial scales, and interacting physical processes under both stated goals and implicit physical constraints. We present WorldAgent, an agentic framework for verification-guided physical world construction from a single natural-language prompt, without iterative user debugging. A world construction layer expands the prompt into a structured world specification and uses physical knowledge to build scenes and run numerical simulations. After every step, a verification layer inspects scene geometry and simulation states alongside rendered views. Failed checks guide automatic revisions to the specification and re-execution of the affected steps. Accepted worlds pass the required checks and remain editable for further inspection and resimulation. We introduce AgenticSimBench, on which WorldAgent achieves the best scores among the evaluated agent-based methods on five of seven metrics. In a 26-participant user study, it receives the highest mean ratings across all four criteria.

AI.tldr: 提出 WorldAgent，一个基于验证引导的智能体框架，能从单条自然语言提示构建复杂物理世界，无需用户迭代调试。
AI.motivation: 从语言构建复杂物理世界需协调大规模3D环境、不同空间尺度的细节结构，并处理显式目标与隐式物理约束下的交互过程，且应避免依赖用户反复调试。
AI.method: 框架包含世界构建层与验证层：构建层将提示扩展为结构化世界规范，利用物理知识搭建场景并运行数值模拟；验证层检查场景几何、模拟状态与渲染视图，失败时自动修订规范并重执行相关步骤。
AI.result: 在 AgenticSimBench 上，WorldAgent 在7项指标中的5项上取得所评估的智能体方法中的最佳成绩；26人用户研究中，在全部4项标准上获得最高平均评分。
AI.conclusion: 验证引导的物理世界构建可从单条提示生成通过检查且可编辑、可重新模拟的世界，无需用户迭代调试，并在基准与用户研究中表现优越。

title: TQTS-Bench: A Multi-Syntax Benchmark for Text-to-Query over Time-Series Databases
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have significantly advanced natural language querying over relational databases, yet their ability to query time-series databases (TSDBs) remains largely unassessed. Existing benchmarks fail to adequately capture the non-unified query syntaxes, diverse application domains, and unique time-specific query intents inherent to TSDBs. To address this gap, we introduce TQTS-BENCH, a multi-syntax benchmark for evaluating text-to-query capabilities over TSDBs.
