TQTS-BENCH contains 6,125 high-quality question-answering (QA) pairs spanning 97 TSDBs, 23 distinct query syntaxes, 22 application domains, and 4 types of time-specific query intents. It is constructed through a human-centric AI-assisted workflow, where all QA pairs are carefully reviewed and revised by domain experts to ensure quality and correctness. Extensive evaluations of advanced LLMs and state-of-the-art text-to-query methods reveal challenges in querying TSDBs. Even the best-performing model evaluated, Claude-Opus-5, achieves only 48.98% execution accuracy, while humans reach 87.34%. Error analysis reveals that this performance gap mainly stems from the heterogeneous query syntaxes across different TSDBs, misinterpretation of time-specific intents, and incorrect schema linking. These findings highlight new opportunities to narrow the gap between current LLM capabilities and the requirements of TSDB queries in real-world applications. The benchmark is available at: https://anonymous.4open.science/r/TQTS-Bench-00CD.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TQTS-BENCH，一个面向时序数据库（TSDB）文本到查询任务的多语法基准，包含 6,125 个经专家审核的问答对，覆盖 97 个 TSDB、23 种查询语法、22 个应用领域和 4 类时间特定查询意图。评估显示现有 LLM 在 TSDB 查询上表现远低于人类。
AI.motivation: LLM 在关系数据库自然语言查询上已有进展，但其查询时序数据库的能力尚未被充分评估。现有基准难以覆盖 TSDB 中不统一的查询语法、多样应用领域以及独特的时间特定查询意图。
AI.method: 构建 TQTS-BENCH 多语法基准，采用以人为中心、AI 辅助的工作流生成问答对，并由领域专家逐一审核和修订。基准包含 6,125 个高质量 QA 对，覆盖 97 个 TSDB、23 种查询语法、22 个应用领域和 4 类时间特定查询意图。随后对先进 LLM 和当前最优文本到查询方法进行广泛评估与错误分析。
AI.result: 评估发现 LLM 查询 TSDB 仍面临显著挑战。表现最好的 Claude-Opus-5 仅达到 48.98% 执行准确率，而人类达到 87.34%。错误主要来源于不同 TSDB 间异构查询语法、时间特定意图误判以及错误的 schema linking。
AI.conclusion: 该工作揭示了当前 LLM 能力与真实世界 TSDB 查询需求之间的差距，表明需要针对异构查询语法、时间意图理解和模式链接等问题进行研究，以缩小这一差距。

title: RoboCompiler: Graph-Native Compilation of Closed-Chain Robots for Consistent Modeling, Control, and Simulation
summary: Robots with kinematic loops, coupled actuators, and changing contacts require consistent models of configuration, motion, force, and dynamics. Yet these interfaces are often reconstructed separately for control and simulation, making closure and actuation consistency difficult to maintain. This paper presents RoboCompiler, a graph-native framework that compiles a canonical mechanism graph into a shared mechanical interface. From bodies, joints, frames, inertias, and actuator ports, it constructs closure paths and analytic residual Jacobians, then assembles feasible configurations through rank-checked continuation and correction. A tangent lift maps independent velocities to full robot and task motion, while paired actuator-port maps preserve virtual work. A constraint-curvature correction extends the reduction to accelerations and projected rigid-body dynamics, including floating-base and support modes. Cycle-local evaluation, generated Jacobians, and dependency-aware reuse enable localized updates when closure inputs change. We evaluate physical loops and task-induced constraints on a Komatsu excavator, Unitree Go2, Franka Panda, Kangaroo, and a six-UPS Stewart platform. High-precision constrained-dynamics and independent Pinocchio checks confirm mechanical consistency; MuJoCo and Isaac Sim/PhysX executions demonstrate task performance and model reuse under native contact. For Kangaroo, compilation reduces residual-and-Jacobian evaluation time by 96.7% and closed-loop rollout wall time by 66.8%, with dynamics and control held fixed.

AI.tldr: 提出 RoboCompiler，一个图原生框架，将规范机构图编译为共享机械接口，用于带运动学闭环、耦合执行器和接触变化的机器人，统一保证闭环与驱动一致性。
AI.motivation: 此类机器人需要一致的构型、运动、力和动力学模型，但控制与仿真常分别重建接口，导致闭环约束和执行器一致性难以维护。
AI.method: 从刚体、关节、坐标系、惯量和执行器端口构建规范机构图；生成闭环路径与解析残差雅可比，通过秩检查和延拓校正组装可行构型；用切空间提升映射独立速度到机器人/任务运动，用执行器端口映射保持虚功；引入约束曲率校正扩展到加速度和投影刚体动力学，支持浮动基与支撑模式；采用循环局部求值、生成雅可比和依赖感知复用实现局部更新。
AI.result: 在 Komatsu 挖掘机、Unitree Go2、Franka Panda、Kangaroo 和六-UPS Stewart 平台上评估物理闭环与任务约束；高精度约束动力学和 Pinocchio 独立检查验证机械一致性，MuJoCo 与 Isaac Sim/PhysX 展示原生接触下的任务性能和模型复用；Kangaroo 上编译使残差与雅可比求值时间减少 96.7%，闭环 rollout 墙钟时间减少 66.8%，且动力学与控制保持不变。
AI.conclusion: RoboCompiler 通过将规范机构图编译为共享机械接口，可在接触场景下保持机械一致性并复用模型，同时显著提升闭环仿真与求值效率。

title: VehDyn: A Driving World Model Benchmark for Vehicle Dynamics
summary: Video world models are emerging as data engines, action planners, and generative simulators for autonomous driving, but existing benchmarks primarily assess visual fidelity and coarse physical plausibility, providing limited evidence on whether generated driving futures obey realistic vehicle kinematics and dynamics. This limitation is further compounded by the lack of datasets in which vehicle, road, maneuver, and speed conditions are independently controlled, and ground-truth vehicle states are recorded in synchrony with videos. We introduce VehDyn, a driving world model benchmark for vehicle dynamics. VehDyn is built on a CARLA-CarSim co-simulation platform where photorealistic rendering is coupled with a validated multi-body dynamics model, and it contains 10,080 configurations from a full factorial design over five vehicle types, four tire-road friction coefficients, three maneuvers, four target speeds, 14 scenes, and three illuminations, each paired with synchronized position, velocity, and attitude sequences. Built on this dataset, VehDyn introduces a hierarchical evaluation framework that measures trajectory alignment, kinematic consistency, and dynamic consistency, and benchmarks 12 state-of-the-art video world models. We further assess the video quality using two established protocols and correlate it with the VehDyn score. Trajectory-level metrics are nearly saturated, with ten of twelve models within 20\% of ground truth, while no model reaches 92\% of ground truth on dynamic consistency, and visual-quality metrics are only weakly correlated with vehicle-dynamics fidelity. DrivingWorld achieves the highest VehDyn score, followed by Cosmos 3 Nano and LTX-Video 2.5, and the VehDyn score agrees closely with human judgment. VehDyn provides a systematic foundation for developing driving world models that are physically consistent and visually realistic.

AI.tldr: 论文提出面向驾驶世界模型车辆动力学的基准 VehDyn，基于 CARLA-CarSim 联合仿真构建大规模、条件受控且状态同步的数据集，并从轨迹、运动学和动力学一致性分层评测 12 个先进视频世界模型。
AI.motivation: 现有驾驶世界模型基准主要评估视觉保真度和粗略物理合理性，难以证明生成未来是否遵循真实车辆运动学与动力学；同时缺乏能独立控制车辆、道路、机动和速度条件，并同步记录真值车辆状态的视频数据集。
AI.method: 构建 CARLA-CarSim 联合仿真平台，将照片级渲染与经验证的多体动力学模型耦合；通过全因子设计生成 10,080 种配置，覆盖 5 种车型、4 种轮胎-路面摩擦系数、3 种机动、4 种目标速度、14 个场景和 3 种光照，并提供同步位置、速度和姿态序列。提出分层评估框架，衡量轨迹对齐、运动学一致性和动力学一致性，并对 12 个最先进视频世界模型进行基准测试，同时用两种成熟协议评估视频质量并与 VehDyn 分数做相关性分析。
AI.result: 轨迹级指标接近饱和，12 个模型中有 10 个与真值差距在 20% 以内；但在动力学一致性上，没有模型达到真值的 92%。视觉质量指标与车辆动力学保真度仅弱相关。DrivingWorld 获得最高 VehDyn 分数，其次是 Cosmos 3 Nano 和 LTX-Video 2.5，且 VehDyn 分数与人类判断高度一致。
AI.conclusion: VehDyn 为开发兼具物理一致性和视觉真实性的驾驶世界模型提供了系统化基础。

title: CodeSkill: Latent Skill Abstraction for Long-Horizon Code Agents
summary: Code agents require long-horizon decision-making over complex interaction trajectories. However, existing reinforcement learning (RL) approaches typically optimize behavior at the token level, creating a mismatch between low-level generation and high-level behavioral reasoning. This limitation leads to inefficient exploration and weak credit assignment under sparse rewards. Moreover, while large-scale agent trajectories often contain recurring multi-step behavioral patterns, their noisy token-level representations hinder effective experience reuse. To address these challenges, we propose CodeSkill, a framework that adapts hierarchical latent skill modeling to the code agent domain. CodeSkill first leverages a teacher model to distill both successful and failed trajectories into multi-level textual abstractions. It then integrates temporal variational inference with reinforcement learning to map these discrete semantics into continuous latent variables, while an adaptive boundary mechanism dynamically gates skill transitions based on execution feedback. The learned skills are injected into a frozen LLM policy as latent semantic prefixes, enabling optimization in a compact semantic space rather than over raw token sequences. By shifting RL from token-level exploration to experience-level reasoning, CodeSkill improves optimization efficiency and long-horizon behavioral coherence. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CodeSkill achieves highly competitive performance against strong open-weight baselines across diverse general and industrial coding benchmarks. Furthermore, the learned skills exhibit strong transferability and robust cross-domain generalization, highlighting the effectiveness of explicit behavioral abstraction for scalable agentic code generation.

AI.tldr: 提出CodeSkill，将分层潜在技能建模引入代码智能体，通过教师模型蒸馏轨迹为文本抽象，结合时序变分推断与强化学习学习连续潜在技能，并注入冻结LLM策略，以提升长程决策效率和泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有强化学习方法在token级优化，与高层行为推理不匹配，导致稀疏奖励下探索低效、信用分配弱；同时大规模轨迹中的多步行为模式因token级噪声难以复用。
AI.method: 1) 教师模型将成功与失败轨迹蒸馏为多层级文本抽象；2) 时序变分推断与强化学习结合，将离散语义映射为连续潜在变量；3) 自适应边界机制基于执行反馈动态控制技能切换；4) 学习到的技能作为潜在语义前缀注入冻结LLM策略，在紧凑语义空间优化，将强化学习从token级探索转为经验级推理。
AI.result: 在多种通用与工业编码基准上，CodeSkill与强开源基线相比取得极具竞争力的性能；学习到的技能具有强迁移性和跨域泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 显式行为抽象能有效提升可扩展的智能体代码生成，为代码智能体长程决策提供高效强化学习范式。

title: DexRoam: Learning Mobile Bimanual Dexterous Manipulation from Egocentric Whole-Body Human Demonstrations
summary: Mobile bimanual dexterous manipulation requires continuous coordination of locomotion, whole-body motion, and finger-level dexterity within a single trajectory, creating a severe robot demonstration bottleneck. Egocentric human demonstrations offer a scalable alternative, but prior approaches ease the transfer by simplifying human motion, discarding exactly the fine-grained, coupled structure such tasks depend on. We present DexRoam, a complete system for learning mobile bimanual dexterous manipulation from human demonstrations, in which whole-body motion remains continuous and coupled throughout the human-to-robot transfer process. To enable scalable collection of whole-body human manipulation demonstrations, we develop a tracker-free capture system using only a consumer VR headset and a head-mounted stereo camera, without external cameras or motion trackers. We then perform three explicit alignment stages---embodiment, action-semantic, and temporal---to map captured motion into the robot action space, preserving fine-grained whole-body motion and allowing human and robot demonstrations to be jointly learned by standard VLA policies. Real-world experiments with different VLA backbones show that human demonstrations consistently improve policy learning across training paradigms, raising average success from 29% to 56% on GR00T N1.7 and from 32% to 57% on pi0.5, while matching robot-only training with half the robot demonstrations. Ablations confirm that each alignment stage is necessary. These results highlight the potential of human demonstrations for scalable whole-body mobile manipulation with preserved fine-grained motion structure.

AI.tldr: 提出DexRoam系统，使机器人能从人类演示中学习移动双臂灵巧操作：通过无追踪器VR采集全身演示，并用三级对齐将连续耦合的全身运动迁移到机器人动作空间，供标准VLA策略联合学习。
AI.motivation: 移动双臂灵巧操作需要同时协调移动、全身运动和手指级灵巧性，导致机器人演示瓶颈。人类第一视角演示可扩展，但已有方法常简化人体运动，丢弃了任务所需的细粒度耦合结构。
AI.method: 仅使用消费级VR头显和头戴立体相机，无需外部相机或运动追踪器，采集全身人类操作演示；然后进行具身、动作语义和时间三阶段对齐，将人体动作映射到机器人动作空间，保留细粒度全身运动，并用标准VLA策略联合学习人类与机器人演示。
AI.result: 真实实验显示，人类演示在不同VLA骨干上持续提升策略学习：GR00T N1.7平均成功率从29%升至56%，pi0.5从32%升至57%；且仅用一半机器人演示即可匹配纯机器人训练效果。消融实验确认每个对齐阶段都必要。
AI.conclusion: 人类演示有望支持可扩展的全身移动操作学习，同时保留细粒度运动结构，为移动双臂灵巧操作提供有效数据来源。

title: ActiveMem: Dynamic Latent Memory Trees for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Large Language Model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on external memory to support long-horizon reasoning and decision making. Existing memory systems typically retrieve historical trajectories or summaries as independent context fragments, overlooking the procedural dependencies underlying multi-step execution. As memory scales, such flat retrieval introduces context fragmentation and cross-task interference, leading to structurally inconsistent reasoning trajectories. We propose ActiveMem, a hierarchical memory framework that recursively organizes agent experiences into dependency-aware latent execution trees. ActiveMem abstracts trajectories into reusable subtask nodes while explicitly preserving execution transitions, enabling coherent reasoning-path retrieval conditioned on the current execution state. To support continual adaptation, ActiveMem further learns dynamic memory expansion, retrieval, and pruning policies through reinforcement learning. Experiments across various agent benchmarks demonstrate that ActiveMem consistently improves task completion, reasoning stability, and memory efficiency over existing memory-based agents. Moreover, ActiveMem enables compact open-weight models to achieve competitive performance with substantially larger proprietary systems.

AI.tldr: 提出 ActiveMem，一种面向 LLM 智能体的分层记忆框架，将经验递归组织为依赖感知的潜在执行树，并通过强化学习学习记忆扩展、检索和剪枝策略。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆系统通常将历史轨迹或摘要作为独立上下文片段检索，忽略了多步执行中的程序性依赖，导致记忆规模扩大时出现上下文碎片化、跨任务干扰和推理轨迹结构不一致。
AI.method: ActiveMem 将智能体经验递归组织为依赖感知的潜在执行树，把轨迹抽象为可复用子任务节点并显式保留执行转移，从而基于当前执行状态检索连贯的推理路径；同时利用强化学习学习动态记忆扩展、检索和剪枝策略，以支持持续适应。
AI.result: 在多种智能体基准实验中，ActiveMem 相比现有基于记忆的智能体持续提升任务完成度、推理稳定性和记忆效率；还能使紧凑的开源模型达到与更大规模专有系统相当的性能。
AI.conclusion: ActiveMem 通过分层、依赖感知的记忆组织与自适应记忆策略，有效缓解扁平检索带来的碎片化和干扰问题，提升 LLM 智能体长程推理与决策能力。

title: InfoEdit: Probing Global Layout Reasoning in Infographic Editing
summary: Multimodal foundation models edit natural photographs at production quality, yet the same models struggle with structured visual content such as infographics. Unlike photographs, infographics encode information through logical relations; editing one element often requires surrounding elements to be adapted. We refer to this global layout reasoning capability as reflow. Existing image-editing benchmarks neither provide a dedicated setting for structured visual content nor evaluate the reflow capability. We introduce InfoEdit, a novel benchmark of 1,000 infographics across eight logical-relation families, paired with 4,000 editing instructions across four editing tasks, and a reflow-aware evaluation protocol. Across eight frontier editors, only GPT-Image-2 clears 60% average success rate; most models fall below 7%, and no editor exceeds 36% on the Swap-Block task even with perfect target localization. We further show that code-level editing can match the strongest pixel-level editor, revealing complementary strengths across tasks. InfoEdit identifies reflow as a central challenge in structured visual content editing and provides a diagnostic benchmark to facilitate future progress.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 InfoEdit 基准，用于评估多模态模型在信息图等结构化视觉内容编辑中的“重排（reflow）”能力，发现现有前沿编辑器整体表现很差。
AI.motivation: 多模态基础模型在自然照片编辑上已达生产级质量，但在信息图等结构化视觉内容上表现不佳；这类内容包含逻辑关系，编辑一个元素常需联动调整周边元素，即 reflow 全局布局推理能力，而现有基准缺乏专门设置与评估。
AI.method: 构建 InfoEdit 基准：包含 1,000 张信息图、覆盖 8 类逻辑关系族、4 类编辑任务的 4,000 条编辑指令，并提出 reflow 感知的评估协议；随后评测 8 个前沿编辑器，并比较代码级编辑与像素级编辑。
AI.result: 仅 GPT-Image-2 平均成功率超过 60%，多数模型低于 7%；即使目标定位完美，也没有编辑器在 Swap-Block 任务上超过 36%；代码级编辑可匹配最强像素级编辑器，显示不同任务上的互补优势。
AI.conclusion: InfoEdit 表明 reflow 是结构化视觉内容编辑的核心挑战，并为未来进展提供了一个诊断性基准。

title: InfiMed2: A Generalist Medical Multimodal Foundation Model from Contextual Evidence and Stability-Aware Supervision
summary: Recent medical multimodal models have benefited from larger corpora, broader modality coverage, and stronger reasoning-oriented training, yet effective data design across continued pretraining (CPT) and post-training remains challenging. Medical sources vary substantially in structure, granularity, and information density, and their utility shifts as training progresses from broad knowledge acquisition to late-stage consolidation. Meanwhile, post-training is often dominated by short-form visual question answering, providing limited supervision for informative and answer-consistent explanations. We introduce InfiMed2, a family of 4B and 27B generalist medical multimodal foundation models built around stage-aware data design. We curate a 55.68B-token corpus that combines broad clinical knowledge with context-rich biomedical visual evidence through source-specific processing. Our CPT pipeline first adapts the vision encoder, then builds broad medical knowledge, and finally transitions to an evidence-focused data mixture during learning-rate decay. For supervised fine-tuning (SFT), we regenerate visual question-answering responses using answer stability, answer-masked reconstruction, and correctness-constrained selection to produce more informative and answer-consistent supervision. The 4B model is further optimized with reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR). Across five medical multimodal benchmarks, InfiMed2-4B achieves 66.73% mean accuracy after RLVR, surpassing the larger Qwen3.5-9B, while InfiMed2-27B reaches 73.72%, the highest among the evaluated open-weight models.

AI.tldr: 提出InfiMed2系列4B与27B通用医学多模态基础模型，围绕阶段感知数据设计，覆盖继续预训练、监督微调和RLVR，在五个医学多模态基准上取得领先表现。
AI.motivation: 医学多模态模型虽受益于更大语料、更广模态和推理训练，但继续预训练与后训练的数据设计仍具挑战：医学数据在结构、粒度和信息密度上差异大，其效用随训练阶段变化；后训练又常以短答案VQA为主，缺乏信息丰富且答案一致的解释监督。
AI.method: 构建55.68B token医学多模态语料，按来源处理以融合临床知识与富含语境的生物医学视觉证据。继续预训练先适配视觉编码器，再建立广泛医学知识，并在学习率衰减期转向证据聚焦数据混合。SFT阶段通过答案稳定性、答案掩码重建和正确性约束选择重生成VQA回答，以提供更丰富且答案一致的监督。4B模型进一步用可验证奖励强化学习优化。
AI.result: 在五个医学多模态基准上，InfiMed2-4B经RLVR后平均准确率达66.73%，超过更大的Qwen3.5-9B；InfiMed2-27B达到73.72%，在所评估的开源权重模型中最高。
AI.conclusion: 阶段感知数据设计能有效提升医学多模态基础模型的继续预训练与后训练效果，使较小模型可超越更大模型，27B模型达到开源权重模型中的领先水平。

title: CORTEX: A Verified Experience Layer for Generalist Agents
summary: An agent can solve a task today and face the same task under new facts, tools, or governing knowledge tomorrow. Most agent systems can retrieve relevant text or recall prior conversations, but they lack a principled way to decide when a previous solution is still valid, when it must be adapted, and when it should be discarded. We introduce CORTEX (Contextual Orchestration and Reuse of Task EXperience), a general AI systems framework that connects specialized agents through an external layer of verified experience. Each episode records its task conditions, source and tool state, decisive predicates, proof trace, verifier, and outcome. A meta-controller chooses exact replay, checked adaptation, fresh synthesis, or escalation. Accepted episodes can become task patterns and procedural strategies through a challenge-driven development loop. This gives the system an implicit competence layer that can grow without changing model weights. We formalize system contracts for exact replay and source-version separation, and derive when reuse saves computation. A controlled two-domain implementation tests the exact-replay core on 1,000 synthetic cases. Complete-family holdouts test procedural transfer on 1,000 new-family cases across eight clinical and policy splits, with complete fresh-evidence grounding and perfect invariance to irrelevant-field and insertion-order perturbations. The transfer trace exposes the work required for verified strategy execution. These results establish an initial path toward general intelligence through reusable procedures, typed experience, and developmental transfer.

AI.tldr: 提出CORTEX框架，通过外部验证经验层连接专用智能体，记录每次任务的条件、证明与结果，并由元控制器决定精确重放、受控适配、全新合成或升级，使系统无需更新模型权重即可积累可复用能力。
AI.motivation: 智能体面对同一任务在新事实、工具或规则下，缺乏判断旧解何时仍有效、何时需调整、何时应弃用的原则性机制，现有多数系统仅能检索文本或回忆对话。
AI.method: 构建CORTEX框架：每段经验记录任务条件、源与工具状态、决定性谓词、证明轨迹、验证器与结果；元控制器选择精确重放、校验适配、全新合成或人工升级；接受的经历经挑战驱动开发循环成为任务模式与程序化策略；形式化精确重放与源版本分离的系统契约，并推导复用节省计算的条件；在双域受控实现中测试精确重放核心与程序迁移。
AI.result: 精确重放核心在1000个合成案例上测试；跨八个临床与政策划分的1000个新族案例测试程序迁移，实现完整新证据接地，且对无关字段和插入顺序扰动完全不变；迁移轨迹揭示验证策略执行所需的工作量。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，通过可复用程序、类型化经验与发育式迁移，可为实现通用智能提供一条初步路径。

title: Informative Viewpoint Selection for Episodic-Memory Embodied Question Answering using Omnidirectional Images
comment: Accepted to ACCV 2026. Supplementary video is provided as an ancillary file
summary: Embodied Question Answering (EQA) requires agents to answer natural language questions about surrounding environments from visual observations. In this work, we focus on open-vocabulary episodic-memory EQA (EM-EQA), where an agent answers free-form questions using recorded observation histories. Omnidirectional images are promising for this task, as they provide wide field-of-view observations that can capture surrounding context without requiring explicit camera rotations. However, omnidirectional images introduce two challenges for EQA: (i) equirectangular projection causes severe geometric distortion that degrades vision-language model (VLM) recognition accuracy, and (ii) feeding equirectangular images directly into VLMs introduces excessive irrelevant background information, reducing answer accuracy and increasing the visual-token burden. To address these challenges, we propose a viewpoint selection method for EM-EQA using omnidirectional images. Our method converts equirectangular observations into perspective views via cubemap projection, estimates question-conditioned relevance with fine-tuned BLIP-2, and selects informative and diverse viewpoints through diversity-aware greedy selection. Experiments on the Habitat-Matterport 3D (HM3D) subset of OpenEQA show that our method achieves state-of-the-art model performance among the reported model results with equirectangular observations. Moreover, after removing rotation views, which reduces observation frames by 65.5%, our method largely maintains its answer accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文针对开放词汇情景记忆EQA（EM-EQA）任务，提出一种基于全向图像的视点选择方法：通过立方体贴图投影将等距柱状图像转为透视视图，利用微调BLIP-2估计问题相关度，并采用多样性感知贪心选择信息丰富且多样的视点。在OpenEQA的HM3D子集上达到已报告等距柱状观测模型中的最优性能，且在减少65.5%观测帧后仍基本保持答案准确率。
AI.motivation: 全向图像能提供宽视场、无需相机旋转即可捕捉周围环境，适合EM-EQA；但等距柱状投影带来严重几何畸变，降低视觉语言模型识别精度，且直接输入会引入大量无关背景，降低答案准确率并增加视觉token负担。
AI.method: 将等距柱状观测通过立方体贴图投影转换为透视视图；使用微调BLIP-2估计问题条件下的视点相关度；通过多样性感知贪心选择策略选取信息丰富且多样的视点。
AI.result: 在Habitat-Matterport 3D（HM3D）子集的OpenEQA实验中，与已报告的等距柱状观测模型结果相比达到最先进性能；在移除旋转视图、观测帧减少65.5%后，答案准确率基本保持。
AI.conclusion: 所提视点选择方法能有效缓解全向图像畸变与背景冗余问题，在保持较高答案准确率的同时显著减少所需观测帧，为全向图像EM-EQA提供高效解决方案。

title: Relevance Does Not Imply Applicability: Experience Activation for Personal GUI Agents
summary: Personal Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents rely on interaction history to infer what a user wants from ambiguous instructions and to anticipate recurring routines. Existing approaches retrieve task-relevant history and append it to the policy's context, implicitly assuming that experience relevant to a task remains useful for each decision within it. We find that this help is largely spent at the first decision: retrieved history strongly improves the opening step of an episode, yet provides little sustained benefit over the remaining 90\% of steps, and offers weak guidance on whether a proactive suggestion is warranted. A relevant record may tell the agent where to begin, but not which past action applies to the current screen or whether a routine is due now. The underlying issue is that relevance does not imply applicability}: relevance is determined at the task level, whereas applicability depends on the situation at decision time. We therefore recast personalization as experience activation and introduce ExpActivator, a training-free framework that activates only the experience applicable to the current situation. During execution, ExpActivator matches each new screen to historical states in the frozen GUI backbone's latent space and supplies the corresponding action as a reference. Before execution, it activates a recurring intent only when the current time and scenario provide sufficient support, and otherwise abstains. Across four GUI backbones, ExpActivator improves within-trajectory step success by 28\% on average, achieves the best personalized execution on every backbone while using about one-fifth as many history tokens, and reaches approximately 2.3$\times$ the Matthews correlation coefficient of the strongest proactive baseline. Experience pays where it is activated, not where it is appended.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ExpActivator，将个性化 GUI 智能体从“检索并拼接相关历史”改为“按当前情境激活经验”，无需训练，提升步级成功率和主动建议准确性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法假设任务相关历史对每一步决策都有用，但研究发现检索历史主要帮助回合第一步，对剩余约90%的步骤持续收益很小，且难以判断是否该主动建议。根本原因是任务级“相关性”不等于决策时“适用性”。
AI.method: 将个性化重述为经验激活；ExpActivator 在冻结 GUI 主干潜空间中将当前屏幕与历史状态匹配，并提供对应动作作为参考；执行前仅在当前时间和场景支持充分时激活重复意图，否则弃权；整个框架无需训练。
AI.result: 在四个 GUI 主干上，ExpActivator 使轨迹内单步成功率平均提升28%；在每个主干上均取得最佳个性化执行，同时历史 token 用量约为对比方法的五分之一；主动建议的 Matthews 相关系数约为最强基线的2.3倍。
AI.conclusion: 经验的价值在于被“激活”而非被“附加”；按决策时情境激活适用经验，比任务级检索并拼接历史更有效。

title: Pass or Fail? Evaluating LLMs on Two Greek Examination Benchmarks
summary: The rapid advancement of Large Language Models (LLMs) imposes a thorough evaluation of their linguistic and analytical capabilities as well as constraints, particularly for a language with limited benchmark coverage such as Greek. To address the limited availability of comprehensive benchmarks in this domain, we introduce Prot-Ex and Pan-Ex, two benchmarks consisting of questions from entrance exams for Greek Model and Experimental schools as well as the Panhellenic exams (the Greek national university entrance examinations). These benchmarks are employed to assess the performance of text-only LLMs-including the Greek-adapted KriKri-8B-Instruct, Llama-3.1-8B, Gemma-4-26B, and Qwen-3-32B-across diverse academic disciplines (Modern Greek, Mathematics, Physics, etc.) and task formats (closed, structured, and open-ended), including textualized visual context (i.e., image descriptions). Our findings indicate the localized KriKri-8B significantly outperforms its base model, successfully rivalling much larger LLMs in linguistically demanding humanities tasks. By leveraging an LLM-as-a-Judge methodology, we expose the inadequacy of traditional lexical metrics for evaluating complex reasoning. Crucially, we uncover a few-shot prompting paradox: while synthetic examples improve accuracy in closed-ended questions, they severely overload the context window of 8B models in structured tasks, causing significant performance degradation. Ultimately, this study suggests targeted linguistic adaptation offsets lower parameter counts in specialized domains, despite the fragility of smaller models to prompt verbosity.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对希腊语基准缺乏的问题，提出了两个基于希腊入学考试的基准（Prot-Ex和Pan-Ex），评估了多个文本LLM的性能，发现希腊语适配模型KriKri-8B在人文任务中可与更大模型竞争，并揭示了少样本提示的矛盾现象。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型发展迅速，但希腊语等语言的基准覆盖有限，需要全面评估其语言和分析能力。
AI.method: 引入Prot-Ex和Pan-Ex两个基准，包含希腊示范/实验学校入学考试和泛希腊考试题目；评估文本LLM（KriKri-8B-Instruct、Llama-3.1-8B、Gemma-4-26B、Qwen-3-32B）在多学科（现代希腊语、数学、物理等）和多任务格式（封闭式、结构化、开放式）上的表现，包括文本化视觉上下文，并使用LLM-as-a-Judge方法。
AI.result: KriKri-8B显著优于其基座模型，在人文任务中与更大LLM相当；传统词汇指标不足以评估复杂推理；少样本提示存在矛盾：合成示例提高封闭式问题准确率，但在结构化任务中导致8B模型上下文过载，性能显著下降。
AI.conclusion: 针对性语言适应可弥补较小参数模型在专业领域的不足，但小模型对提示冗长较为脆弱。

title: LoopTrack: A Simple Baseline for Parameter-Efficient Transformer Tracking
comment: Code and models will be released
summary: Current Transformer-based tracking methods typically stack multiple Transformer blocks with separate parameters to model interactions between the target template and the search region for target localization. These trackers often incur substantial parameter overhead from stacked blocks, making their deployment on resource-limited devices difficult. To address this, we propose a parameter-efficient Transformer tracking framework, dubbed LoopTrack, which repeatedly applies a set of Transformer blocks with shared parameters to interact features in a looped architecture for tracking, significantly reducing the number of parameters. To further exploit target cues, we present two lightweight designs, including target-aware looping (TAL) and gated target memory (GTM). The former applies intermediate target information generated by one loop to guide feature interaction in the subsequent loop, enabling progressive feature refinement, while the latter maintains a compact memory across frames, which is incorporated into the loop process to provide long-term information to the tracker, mitigating temporal drift in tracking. Compared to existing Transformer trackers, LoopTrack enables multiple rounds of feature interaction with fewer model parameters, making it resource-friendly for deployment. In extensive experiments on multiple datasets, LoopTrack shows a favorable accuracy-parameter trade-off. In particular, our LoopTrack$_{\rm One}$, with a single shared Transformer block, achieves 66.2\% SUC score on LaSOT with only 3.4M parameters, while LoopTrack$_{\rm Three}$, using three shared blocks, achieves 69.3\% SUC score with 6.4M parameters, surpassing existing parameter-efficient tracking methods with comparable or larger model size. With LoopTrack, we aim to establish a simple yet strong baseline for parameter-efficient Transformer tracking. Our code and models will be released.

AI.tldr: 提出参数高效的Transformer跟踪框架LoopTrack，通过参数共享的循环结构反复交互模板与搜索区域特征，并引入目标感知循环和门控目标记忆，在少量参数下取得良好跟踪性能。
AI.motivation: 现有Transformer跟踪方法通常堆叠多个独立参数的Transformer块，参数开销大，难以部署在资源受限设备上。
AI.method: 采用循环式架构，重复使用一组共享参数的Transformer块进行特征交互；提出目标感知循环（TAL），利用前一轮中间目标信息指导下一轮特征交互以实现渐进细化；提出门控目标记忆（GTM），跨帧维护紧凑记忆并融入循环过程，提供长期信息以缓解时序漂移。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上表现出良好的精度-参数量权衡。LoopTrack_One单共享块在LaSOT上达到66.2% SUC，仅3.4M参数；LoopTrack_Three三共享块达到69.3% SUC，参数量6.4M，超过同等或更大模型规模的现有参数高效跟踪方法。
AI.conclusion: LoopTrack为参数高效Transformer跟踪建立了简单且强力的基线，代码和模型将公开。

title: From Weak Task Specifications to Scientific Extraction Agents: Optimizing Task Construction
summary: Most methods that optimize LLM prompts and agent workflows assume that task-specific output schemas, extraction instructions, and evaluation criteria are predefined. For scientific extraction agents, however, a short task goal may not fully determine these components, while specifying them manually is costly. We study the upstream problem of constructing the task-specific configuration from a weak specification containing only a short goal and unannotated reference documents. Rather than treating automatic construction as a fixed preprocessing step, our framework constructs a task-specific schema, extraction instructions, and base training rubrics, then keeps schema construction and extraction instructions editable during optimization. Failure-focused updates concentrate textual-gradient feedback on lower-scoring documents, while training-time evaluation criteria adapt to recurring failures. On a heterogeneous-catalysis literature corpus, automatic construction remains improvable, and optimizing both schema construction and extraction instructions performs best across all four judge-rubric settings, with ablations and blinded human evaluation supporting the proposed formulation.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何仅凭简短任务目标和未标注参考文献，自动构建科学抽取智能体的任务特定配置，并在优化过程中持续调整模式与抽取指令。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM提示与智能体工作流优化通常假设输出模式、抽取指令和评估标准已预定义；但在科学抽取任务中，简短目标不足以确定这些组件，人工指定成本高昂。
AI.method: 提出一个框架：自动构建任务特定模式、抽取指令和基础训练评分标准，并在优化中保持模式构建与抽取指令可编辑；采用面向失败的更新，将文本梯度反馈集中于低分文档，同时让训练时评估标准适应反复出现的失败。
AI.result: 在异质催化文献语料上，自动构建仍有改进空间；在四种评判标准设置下，同时优化模式构建和抽取指令表现最佳，消融实验与盲评人工评估支持该方案。
AI.conclusion: 自动构建不应被视为固定的预处理步骤，而应纳入优化过程；联合优化模式构建与抽取指令能有效提升科学抽取智能体的任务配置质量。

title: LSTMem: Hierarchical Long Short-Term Online Memory for Large Language Models
summary: Large language models increasingly serve as long-horizon assistants and agents, where they must both accumulate information across interactions and make the relevant parts available when later requests depend on them. Existing compact online memories typically use a single persistent state both to accumulate history and to serve readout, so what the memory stores cannot be controlled separately from what it exposes to the current computation. We propose LSTMem, an LSTM-inspired online memory that instead equips each layer of a frozen LLM with two matrix-valued states: a cell state that accumulates history and a hidden state whose readouts correct the backbone's attention. Input and forget gates control what the cell stores, while an output gate separately controls what the cell exposes through the hidden state. LSTMem further connects memory across depth through forward hidden-state propagation and block-end feedback, and uses higher-layer reconstruction gradients to refine lower-layer cell states before rebuilding hidden states from shallow to deep layers. Across memory benchmarks on Qwen3-4B-Instruct, LSTMem consistently improves MemoryAgentBench, LoCoMo, and HotpotQA over the plain backbone. Comparisons further show that the LSTM-based memory formulation outperforms an associative-memory counterpart, while removing cross-layer hidden-memory propagation degrades performance. These results demonstrate the benefits of separating memory accumulation from memory expression and organizing memory hierarchically across model depth. The code is available at https://github.com/Longchentong/LSTMem.

AI.tldr: 提出LSTMem，一种受LSTM启发的在线记忆机制，为冻结LLM的每一层配备细胞状态和隐藏状态两个矩阵状态，将记忆的积累与表达分离，并跨层传播与反馈，在多个记忆基准上优于原始模型。
AI.motivation: 现有紧凑在线记忆通常用单一持久状态同时完成历史积累和读取，导致记忆存储的内容无法与暴露给当前计算的内容分开控制。
AI.method: 在冻结LLM每层加入LSTM式记忆：细胞状态积累历史，隐藏状态读值修正骨干注意力；输入门和遗忘门控制细胞写入，输出门控制暴露；通过前向隐藏状态传播和块末反馈连接跨层记忆；利用高层重构梯度优化低层细胞状态，再从浅到深重建隐藏状态。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-4B-Instruct上，LSTMem在MemoryAgentBench、LoCoMo和HotpotQA上均持续优于原始骨干；LSTM式记忆公式优于关联记忆对照；移除跨层隐藏记忆传播会降低性能。
AI.conclusion: 分离记忆积累与记忆表达，并按模型深度分层组织记忆，能带来性能提升，验证了LSTMem的有效性。

title: Does Adversarial Training Improve Generalization in Multi-View VLAs? Revealing and Mitigating View Collapse
summary: Vision-language-action (VLA) models adapt pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) for closed-loop robot control, transferring their perceptual and semantic capabilities to action prediction. Despite strong in-distribution performance, however, VLAs often degrade under deployment shifts. Adversarial training (AT) offers a model-adaptive approach to robustness without explicitly anticipating individual shifts, but its effect on natural distribution-shift generalization in multi-view VLAs remains unclear. We study this question using a multi-view VLA directly adapted from a pretrained VLM and evaluate generalization across seven LIBERO-Plus shift axes. Direct AT substantially improves Camera Viewpoint and Sensor Noise, the two shifts affecting only the third-person view, yet produces mixed or negative effects on other shifts. Controlled view interventions reveal a surprising failure mode that we term view collapse: Direct AT can shift cross-view reliance so strongly that the policy becomes dominated by the wrist view. This exposes a \textit{robustness shortcut}: apparent robustness to a shifted view can arise from reduced use of that view rather than more robust perception of it. This motivates a distinction between robust perception, extracting reliable information under within-view shifts, and robust fusion, adapting reliance across views according to their reliability. To reduce fixed view reliance, we use a simple View Swap intervention and then re-evaluate AT. With View Swap, AT further improves Camera Viewpoint, Sensor Noise, and Robot Initial State, while its effects remain mixed on other shifts. Our results show that multi-view robustness requires separating improved perception from changes in cross-view reliance, and that AT provides selective rather than generic distribution-shift benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多视图VLA在分布偏移下的鲁棒性，发现直接对抗训练仅对部分偏移有效，并揭示“视图崩溃”与“鲁棒性捷径”现象，提出应区分鲁棒感知与鲁棒融合，并通过View Swap干预改善跨视图依赖。
AI.motivation: VLA模型虽在分布内表现良好，但在部署偏移下往往退化。对抗训练可作为一种无需显式预测具体偏移的模型自适应鲁棒性方法，但其对多视图VLA自然分布偏移泛化的影响尚不明确。
AI.method: 使用直接从预训练VLM适配的多视图VLA，在LIBERO-Plus的七个偏移轴上评估泛化；采用直接对抗训练；通过受控视图干预分析跨视图依赖；引入简单的View Swap干预以减少固定视图依赖，并重新评估对抗训练效果。
AI.result: 直接对抗训练显著改善Camera Viewpoint和Sensor Noise（仅影响第三人称视图），但对其他偏移效果混合或负面。受控干预发现“视图崩溃”：策略过度依赖腕部视图，表明存在鲁棒性捷径，即对某视图偏移的鲁棒性可能来自减少使用该视图而非更鲁棒的感知。加入View Swap后，对抗训练进一步改善Camera Viewpoint、Sensor Noise和Robot Initial State，其他偏移仍混合。
AI.conclusion: 多视图鲁棒性需要区分改进的感知与跨视图依赖变化；对抗训练提供的是选择性而非通用的分布偏移收益。

title: OpenWhistle: A Large-Scale Longitudinal Dataset and Benchmark of Bottlenose Dolphin Vocalizations
comment: Accepted as a Spotlight at the NeurIPS 2026 Datasets & Evaluations Track
summary: Recent advances in bioacoustics have been driven by large-scale corpora and standardized benchmarks, yet existing resources are overwhelmingly bird-centric and shallow per species, limiting their use for studying the structure of a single species' communication system. This gap is particularly acute for cetaceans: despite bottlenose dolphins (Tursiops truncatus) being a compelling case of complex vocal communication among non-human mammals, existing dolphin datasets are small, fragmented, and largely closed. We introduce OpenWhistle, the largest publicly available dataset of dolphin vocalizations. It comprises approximately 180,000 whistles (114 hours) recorded over five years from a stable pod of five individuals in a semi-natural environment, paired with a curated subset of 8,354 expert-annotated whistles and reproducible evaluation protocols for whistle-type detection and classification. We further release the full processing pipeline for whistle detection, segmentation, and categorization. To demonstrate its utility, we pretrain a Wav2Vec2.0 model adapted to dolphin acoustics on the OpenWhistle corpus and show that it learns effective representations, outperforming general-purpose bioacoustic models such as AVES and BioLingual on both tasks while leaving meaningful headroom for future work. By releasing the dataset, pipeline, and evaluation protocol, we provide the first open dolphin whistle dataset tailored for training self-supervised models, laying the groundwork for advancing dolphin communication research and developing models that capture fine-grained acoustic structure within species.

AI.tldr: 该论文发布了迄今最大的公开海豚哨声数据集 OpenWhistle，包含约18万条哨声、114小时录音及8,354条专家标注子集，并提供处理流程与评测协议；基于该数据预训练的 Wav2Vec2.0 模型在哨声类型检测和分类任务上优于通用生物声学模型。
AI.motivation: 现有生物声学资源以鸟类为主，且对单一物种的覆盖较浅，难以研究单个物种的通信系统结构；海豚虽具有复杂发声交流能力，但现有数据集规模小、碎片化且大多不公开。
AI.method: 构建并公开 OpenWhistle 数据集，采集自半自然环境稳定群体中5只海豚、历时5年；提供哨声检测、分割、分类的完整处理流程，以及哨声类型检测与分类的可复现评测协议；在 OpenWhistle 上预训练适配海豚声学的 Wav2Vec2.0 模型。
AI.result: OpenWhistle 是最大公开海豚发声数据集，含约18万条哨声（114小时）和8,354条专家标注哨声；预训练的 Wav2Vec2.0 学到有效表征，在两项任务上超过 AVES 和 BioLingual 等通用生物声学模型，同时仍留有提升空间。
AI.conclusion: 通过公开数据集、处理流程和评测协议，该工作提供了首个面向自监督模型训练的开源海豚哨声数据集，为推进海豚通信研究及开发捕捉物种内细粒度声学结构的模型奠定基础。

title: TC-ADA: One-Shot Active Domain Adaptation for Semantic Segmentation
summary: Manual dense annotation remains a major obstacle to deploying semantic segmentation models in new driving environments. Active domain adaptation (ADA) seeks label-efficient transfer by annotating only a selected portion of the target domain. Existing ADA methods commonly implement this process through multiple rounds of acquisition, annotation, and retraining. We study a practical one-shot image-level setting that selects and densely annotates a fixed target subset in a single round, followed by uninterrupted adaptation. Within this setting, we develop Target-Calibrated Active Domain Adaptation (TC-ADA) as a joint design of complete-image acquisition and target-calibrated adaptation. Stage~1 uses visual representations from a vision foundation model (VFM) together with semantic predictions from a fixed unsupervised domain adaptation model to select representative and informative target images without target annotations. Stage~2 jointly uses labeled source data, labeled target data, and the remaining unlabeled target data, while calibrating source and target supervision under limited target labels. Extensive experiments across five synthetic-to-real and real-to-real driving transfers show consistent improvements over representative ADA baselines. With only 23 to 46 labeled target images on four transfers and 140 on Mapillary, TC-ADA stays within 1.9 mean intersection over union (mIoU) points of target-only full supervision. Code will be available at https://github.com/ywher/TC-ADA.

AI.tldr: 本文提出面向语义分割的单轮图像级主动域适应方法TC-ADA，通过视觉基础模型与无监督域适应模型联合选样，并结合目标校准适应，在少量目标标注下接近全监督性能。
AI.motivation: 手动密集标注是语义分割在新驾驶环境部署的主要障碍；现有主动域适应方法需多轮采集、标注和重训练，效率低。本文研究更实际的一次性图像级设定：单轮选择并密集标注固定目标子集，随后不间断适应。
AI.method: 提出TC-ADA，将完整图像采集与目标校准适应联合设计。第一阶段：利用视觉基础模型（VFM）的视觉表示和固定无监督域适应模型的语义预测，在无目标标注下选择有代表性和信息量的目标图像。第二阶段：联合使用有标注源数据、有标注目标数据和剩余无标注目标数据，在目标标签有限时校准源域和目标域监督。
AI.result: 在五个合成到真实和真实到真实的驾驶迁移任务上，TC-ADA持续优于代表性ADA基线。在四个迁移任务上仅用23至46张标注目标图像，在Mapillary上仅用140张，性能与仅目标域全监督相差不超过1.9 mIoU。代码将开源。
AI.conclusion: TC-ADA为单轮主动域适应提供有效方案，显著降低标注成本，在少量目标标注下达到接近全监督的分割性能。

title: PIC-UIE: Predicting Image-Adaptive Corrections for Lightweight Underwater Image Enhancement
summary: Underwater image enhancement (UIE) aims to restore visibility, color fidelity, and structural detail from images degraded by wavelength-dependent attenuation and backscatter. State-of-the-art UIE methods often rely on large backbones and dense image-to-image prediction, limiting their practicality for edge deployment. Moreover, operating entirely in a single color space couples degradation estimation with luminance and chroma correction. To address these challenges, we propose PIC-UIE, a lightweight predictor--executor framework that predicts image-adaptive corrections from a fixed $256\times256$ RGB thumbnail and applies them to the native-resolution input in the YCbCr color space. The predictor produces seven outputs, organized into spatial correction, nonlinear luminance and coupled chroma mapping, and image-level color calibration. A depth map regularizes the transmission proxy during training, whereas inference uses only the RGB input. With 9,486 parameters and 0.094 GFLOPs at $256\times256$, PIC-UIE achieves 24.137 dB PSNR and 0.9216 SSIM on UIEB-90 and 21.320 dB PSNR on zero-shot LSUI. It further processes native 4K images at 55.0 FPS under the comparison protocol. These results show that structured correction prediction provides an effective and practical alternative to dense RGB reconstruction for underwater image enhancement.

AI.tldr: 提出PIC-UIE，一种轻量级预测器-执行器框架，从固定256×256 RGB缩略图预测图像自适应校正，并在YCbCr空间应用到原始分辨率图像，实现高效水下图像增强。
AI.motivation: 现有水下图像增强方法多依赖大骨干网络和密集图像到图像预测，难以边缘部署；且仅在单一颜色空间操作会将退化估计与亮度和色度校正耦合。
AI.method: PIC-UIE包含预测器和执行器：预测器在256×256 RGB缩略图上输出七项校正，包括空间校正、非线性亮度与耦合色度映射及图像级颜色校准；执行器在YCbCr空间将校正应用于原始分辨率输入。训练时用深度图正则化传输代理，推理时仅需RGB输入。
AI.result: 仅9,486参数、256×256下0.094 GFLOPs；在UIEB-90上达到24.137 dB PSNR和0.9216 SSIM，在零样本LSUI上达到21.320 dB PSNR；在对比协议下处理原生4K图像达55.0 FPS。
AI.conclusion: 结构化校正预测为水下图像增强提供了一种有效且实用的替代方案，优于密集RGB重建，适合实际部署。

title: Structured Sparse Memory for Recurrent Reasoning
summary: Recurrent models trained from scratch have recently become competitive on ARC-style reasoning tasks, but the usual framing around small recurrent backbones overlooks two important parts of the system: task-conditioned memory and synthetic augmentation data. We study this regime through CHARM, a compact hybrid ARC model that combines recurrent reasoning with structured task memory, synthetic data, and inference-time aggregation. In existing approaches, task-conditioned memory supplies a large hidden source of capacity, reaching more than 30x the size of the recurrent backbone. We introduce a compositional sparse embedding (CoSE) for task conditioning that reduces learned task-memory parameters by over 90% while improving pass@2 in controlled ARC ablations. For the recurrent backbone, recurrent depth helps only when balanced with learning horizon. Combining these ingredients, our system reaches 84% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-1 and 46.7% pass@2 on ARC-AGI-2 public evaluation. The benefits of structured memory also generalize to unseen puzzles and other domains. Our code, dataset, and model checkpoints are available at https://github.com/water-vapor/charm.

AI.tldr: 论文提出CHARM，一个结合循环推理、结构化任务记忆、合成数据和推理时聚合的紧凑混合ARC模型。引入组合稀疏嵌入（CoSE）将任务记忆参数减少90%以上，并在ARC-AGI-1上达到84% pass@2，在ARC-AGI-2公开评估上达到46.7% pass@2。
AI.motivation: 现有围绕小型循环骨干的框架忽略了任务条件记忆和合成增强数据这两个关键部分，而它们对ARC风格推理任务至关重要。
AI.method: 通过CHARM模型整合循环推理、结构化任务记忆、合成数据和推理时聚合；提出CoSE用于任务条件，降低任务记忆参数量；研究循环深度与学习视野的平衡关系。
AI.result: CoSE在受控ARC消融中减少超过90%的任务记忆参数并提升pass@2；循环深度需与学习视野平衡才能发挥作用；最终系统在ARC-AGI-1上达84% pass@2，在ARC-AGI-2公开评估上达46.7% pass@2；结构化记忆的优势可泛化到未见谜题和其他领域。
AI.conclusion: 结构化任务记忆和合成数据是ARC推理系统的重要组成部分；CoSE能有效压缩任务记忆参数；CHARM在公开评估中表现优异，且其结构化记忆优势具有泛化性。

title: Next Thoughts Are Distributions: Generative Autoregressive Reasoning in the Latent Space
summary: Reasoning problems often admit multiple valid ways to proceed. Continuous reasoning promises to move computation beyond language tokens into a more compact latent space, but representing several plausible ways to think next remains difficult. We introduce Autoregressive Thought Flow (ATF), which models the next continuous thought as a multimodal distribution. A causal autoregressive model performs the reasoning computation, while a lightweight diffusion head generates a plausible next thought from the resulting condition. The sampled thought is fed back into the model, allowing continuous reasoning to unfold for a variable number of steps while preserving the pretrained backbone. Across mathematical reasoning tasks, ATF improves accuracy with compact latent traces and benefits from reinforcement learning and additional test-time thinking. Multi-sample evaluation shows broader solution coverage, indicating that its multimodal predictions capture useful diversity among reasoning paths. Our results suggest that continuous reasoning is more effective when multiple possible next thoughts remain available rather than being collapsed into a single prediction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Autoregressive Thought Flow (ATF)，将下一个连续思考建模为多模态分布，用轻量扩散头从自回归模型的条件下采样下一思考，并反馈回模型以实现可变步数的连续推理。
AI.motivation: 推理问题通常有多种可行路径，而现有连续推理方法难以表示多个合理的下一步思考，往往将预测坍缩为单一结果。
AI.method: ATF 使用因果自回归模型执行推理计算，并用轻量扩散头生成多模态的下一连续思考；采样出的思考反馈给模型，使连续推理可展开可变步数，同时保持预训练骨干不变，并可结合强化学习与额外测试时思考。
AI.result: 在数学推理任务上，ATF 以紧凑的潜在推理轨迹提升准确率，受益于强化学习和更多测试时计算；多样本评估显示更广的解覆盖范围，表明其多模态预测捕获了推理路径中有用的多样性。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，当多个可能的下一思考被保留而非坍缩为单一预测时，连续推理更有效。

title: VisionHOPE: Visual Backbones as Self-Modifying Learning Systems
summary: Visual backbones have evolved from Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) with local aggregation to Vision Transformers (ViTs) with global interactions, State-Space Models (SSMs) with input-dependent state transitions, and Test-Time Training (TTT) layers that adapt an inner learner while processing an image. Across this progression, visual computation has become increasingly adaptive to each input, yet the rules governing that adaptation remain largely prescribed by the trained backbone. We introduce VisionHOPE, the first generic visual backbone formulated as a self-modifying learning system, in which what the model remembers and how it learns co-evolve within an image. Building on the self-referential construction of Nested Learning (NL), VisionHOPE realizes this co-evolution through five coupled memories that store content, generate key and value representations, and govern learning rate and retention. These memories evolve jointly as visual context accumulates along each scan. However, directly applying the unconstrained self-referential update to a visual backbone leads to instability. We therefore derive a stability-matched step-size control scheme that combines a soft cap on self-referential injection with a spectral clamp on the retained memory transition, and prove that the resulting memory dynamics are non-expansive along each scan. For two-dimensional feature maps, we adapt NL's chunk formulation by aligning chunks with image rows and columns across four directional scans. The proposed VisionHOPE achieves competitive results on ImageNet-1K, COCO, and ADE20K, establishing self-modifying learning systems as a practical foundation for general-purpose visual backbones. The code is available at https://github.com/PSRben/VisionHOPE.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 VisionHOPE，一种将视觉骨干建模为自修改学习系统的通用视觉架构，通过五个耦合记忆在图像内共同演化内容与学习规则，并在 ImageNet-1K、COCO、ADE20K 上取得有竞争力的结果。
AI.motivation: 视觉骨干从 CNN、ViT、SSM 到 TTT 层，计算越来越依赖输入，但自适应规则仍主要由训练好的骨干预设，缺乏在图像内让“记忆什么”与“如何学习”协同演化的通用机制。
AI.method: 基于 Nested Learning 的自指构造，设计五个耦合记忆分别存储内容、生成 key/value、控制学习率与保留率；针对直接自指更新的不稳定性，提出稳定匹配步长控制，包括自指注入软上限和保留记忆转移的谱裁剪，并证明沿扫描的记忆动态非扩张；将 NL 分块适配到二维特征图，按图像行和列在四个方向扫描对齐。
AI.result: VisionHOPE 在 ImageNet-1K、COCO 和 ADE20K 上取得有竞争力的性能，验证了自修改学习系统作为通用视觉骨干的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 自修改学习系统可作为通用视觉骨干的实用基础，通过记忆与学习规则在图像内共同演化提升视觉表示能力。

title: Adapt Semantics, Not Structure: Few-Instance Schema Calibration for Scientific PDF Extraction
summary: A well-designed extraction schema is not necessarily ready for reliable LLM execution. When only limited verified extractions are available, manually tuning hundreds of field definitions through trial and error is costly. We frame this problem as few-instance schema calibration: adapting the operational semantics of an existing schema from a few annotated documents while preserving its structural contract. We introduce CPSE, a contract-preserving semantic extraction framework that jointly calibrates extraction prompts and field-level semantic descriptions from a few gold annotations. CPSE decomposes the schema into an invariant structural contract and mutable field semantics, and further separates identity discovery from record completion using manifest-conditioned resolution. On expert-annotated polymer-science documents, CPSE improves extraction by 9.93 points over an execution-matched baseline, with consistent gains under an independent judge and in a blinded expert audit. These results show that CPSE enables low-resource schema execution while preserving the output structure required downstream.

AI.tldr: 提出CPSE框架，仅用少量标注即可校准抽取模式，在聚合物科学文档上抽取性能提升9.93分。
AI.motivation: 设计良好的抽取模式未必能可靠执行，且手动调整大量字段定义成本高昂，因此需要少量实例下的模式校准方法。
AI.method: 将模式分解为不变的结构契约与可变的字段语义，联合校准抽取提示和字段级语义描述，并通过manifest条件解析分离身份发现与记录补全。
AI.result: 在专家标注的聚合物科学文档上，相比执行匹配基线提升9.93分，独立评判和盲审专家审计结果一致。
AI.conclusion: CPSE能在低资源条件下执行模式，同时保持下游所需输出结构。

title: 3D Point Tracking with State Space Models
comment: 20 pages, 11 figures, 9 tables. Submitted to Computer Vision and Image Understanding
summary: Tracking any point of a dynamic scene in metric 3D - in absolute meters, not up to an unknown scale - underpins 3D and 4D reconstruction, robot navigation, and autonomous driving, where decisions are made in meters, not pixels. Our objective is a 3D point tracker accurate in those absolute terms and operating within a single commodity GPU, pose-free, monocular budget. Our method rests on one observation: once a point's 2D image trajectory is fixed, the quantity that governs its metric accuracy is the depth along its pixel ray. Rather than learning tracking end-to-end, we therefore compose two frozen front-ends - dense optical flow for 2D correspondence and a monocular metric-depth network for the third dimension - and learn only the residual they cannot supply: that depth, refined by a compact state space model (Mamba-3) conditioned on appearance features (DINOv3). A state space model rather than the transformers the strongest 3D trackers adopt is what makes a single-GPU budget attainable: it summarises a track in a fixed-size recurrent state whose memory cost is constant in the number of frames, whereas attention requires a key-value cache that grows linearly with them. On the TAPVid-3D minival benchmark our best configuration attains the highest absolute metric accuracy among methods evaluated under identical conditions (mean metric Average Jaccard, 0.256), exceeding strong feed-forward trackers, while a companion analysis, reproduced with each competitor's own evaluator, explains why several published trackers lose most of their accuracy under this budget.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种在单张消费级GPU、无需位姿、单目条件下对动态场景进行绝对米制3D点跟踪的方法。它组合冻结的稠密光流与单目米制深度网络，仅用Mamba-3状态空间模型结合DINOv3外观特征学习残差深度细化，在TAPVid-3D minival上取得最高绝对米制精度（mean metric Average Jaccard 0.256）。
AI.motivation: 3D/4D重建、机器人导航和自动驾驶需要在绝对米制（而非未知尺度）下进行3D点跟踪。现有最强的3D跟踪器多采用Transformer，其键值缓存随帧数线性增长，难以在单张商品GPU的预算内运行。
AI.method: 核心观察是：一旦点的2D图像轨迹固定，决定其米制精度的量就是沿像素射线的深度。因此不端到端学习跟踪，而是组合两个冻结前端：稠密光流提供2D对应，单目米制深度网络提供第三维；仅学习它们无法提供的残差深度，并用紧凑状态空间模型Mamba-3、以DINOv3外观特征为条件进行细化。SSM将轨迹压缩为固定大小的循环状态，内存开销与帧数无关，而注意力机制则需要随帧数线性增长的键值缓存。
AI.result: 在TAPVid-3D minival基准上，最佳配置在相同评测条件下取得最高的绝对米制精度，mean metric Average Jaccard为0.256，超过强前馈跟踪器；伴随分析用各竞争者自身评测器复现，解释了为何多个已发表跟踪器在该预算下损失大部分精度。
AI.conclusion: 通过冻结前端加SSM残差深度细化，可在单GPU、无位姿、单目预算下实现高精度绝对米制3D点跟踪；状态空间模型相对注意力在长序列内存效率上具有优势，是达成单GPU预算的关键。

title: FeCoSplat: Feedback-Guided Compression for Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Feed-forward 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) enables efficient novel-view synthesis from sparse multi-view images, yet its representations remain costly to store and transmit. Existing approaches compress either the input images, incurring heavy receiver-side reconstruction, or the reconstructed Gaussian primitives, which are difficult to compress due to their heterogeneous and irregular attributes. We instead compress compact intermediate features, providing a better balance between compression efficiency and receiver-side complexity. Based on this paradigm, we propose FeCoSplat, a feedback-guided compression framework for feed-forward 3DGS. FeCoSplat first compresses multi-view features to obtain an intermediate 3DGS, whose rendered views are used as feedback to guide a second-stage compression for further refinement. The resulting bitstreams are decoded into a compact implicit state, from which the final Gaussian primitives are reconstructed with a lightweight predictor. Experiments demonstrate that FeCoSplat achieves favorable rate--distortion performance, particularly at low bitrates, while requiring only 3.45M parameters for receiver-side Gaussian reconstruction. Code will be released soon.

AI.tldr: 提出FeCoSplat，一种面向前馈式3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）的反馈引导压缩框架，通过压缩紧凑的中间特征，在压缩效率与接收端复杂度之间取得更好平衡。
AI.motivation: 现有前馈3DGS表示存储和传输成本高；已有方法要么压缩输入图像（接收端重建负担重），要么压缩重建后的高斯基元（其异构且不规则的属性难以压缩）。
AI.method: 先压缩多视角特征得到中间3DGS，将其渲染视图作为反馈引导第二阶段压缩以进一步优化；最终码流解码为紧凑隐状态，并用轻量级预测器重建最终高斯基元。
AI.result: 在率失真性能上表现良好，尤其在低码率下优势明显；接收端高斯重建仅需3.45M参数。
AI.conclusion: 压缩紧凑的中间特征是一种有效范式，能兼顾压缩效率与接收端复杂度，为前馈3DGS的高效存储与传输提供了新思路。

title: AGILE-GS: Anchor-Guided Fast Next-Best-View Selection for Active 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: Radiance fields need hundreds of views, and their placement matters as much as their number. Next-best-view (NBV) selection for 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) usually scores every candidate in the pool and keeps one. Searching for information and choosing a camera, however, are separable problems. We present AGILE-GS, an anchor-guided NBV method that separates the two. A virtual anchor pose is optimized on SE(3) by Riemannian gradient ascent on expected information gain. It need not be reachable or in the pool; it marks where the model is most uncertain. Candidates are scored against the anchor's viewing geometry, and a greedy ridge-leverage step distills the pool into a small, non-redundant shortlist without rendering any candidate. The shortlist can be used in two ways. AGILE-GS takes the first view on it as the next view, so no Fisher information is computed for any candidate. AGILE-GS+ computes the Fisher information gain of each shortlisted view and picks the best, so the expensive evaluation runs on a handful of views rather than the whole pool. On standard benchmarks and in closed-loop embodied acquisition, both match or exceed existing baselines while cutting selection latency by one to two orders of magnitude.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AGILE-GS，一种锚点引导的3D高斯溅射（3DGS）下一最佳视角（NBV）选择方法，将信息搜索与相机选择分离，从而在保持或超越基线性能的同时大幅降低选择延迟。
AI.motivation: 辐射场重建需要大量视角，且视角位置与数量同样重要。现有3DGS的NBV方法通常对整个候选池逐一评分再选一个，计算开销大。作者认为搜索信息与选择相机是两个可分离的问题，因此希望避免对所有候选进行昂贵评估。
AI.method: AGILE-GS在SE(3)上通过黎曼梯度上升优化一个虚拟锚点姿态，以最大化期望信息增益；该锚点无需可达或位于候选池中，仅表示模型最不确定的区域。候选视角依据锚点的观察几何进行评分，并通过贪心岭杠杆步骤将候选池压缩为小且非冗余的候选列表，且无需渲染任何候选。AGILE-GS直接取候选列表中的第一个视角作为下一视角，不计算任何候选的Fisher信息；AGILE-GS+则仅对候选列表中的少量视角计算Fisher信息增益并选择最佳视角。
AI.result: 在标准基准和闭环具身采集任务中，AGILE-GS与AGILE-GS+均匹配或超过现有基线，同时将视角选择延迟降低一到两个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 将信息搜索与相机选择分离，并通过锚点引导生成非冗余候选列表，能够显著提升3DGS的NBV选择效率，在少量候选上执行昂贵评估即可取得优秀性能。

title: Neural Language Models Learn the Contextual Distributions of Dependency Structures: a statistical learning theory to compositionality
summary: It is unclear how Neural Language Models (NLMs) acquire the structural meaning encoded by grammatical structures that is independent of lexical semantics. We propose a statistical learning process in which learned dependency structures themselves become new distributional units for subsequent statistical learning. Under this account, once a dependency structure is acquired, the model tracks its contextual distributions. These contextual features reflect the semantic properties of a composite structure. To test this hypothesis, we design a synthetic grammar in which each grammatical structure has distinct contextual distributions that cannot be recovered from the distributional statistics of their component tokens alone. We train a series of BERT-style masked language models on this grammar and examine their developmental trajectory. The results show that models can successfully learn the contextual distributions of composite dependency structures even though they cannot be inferred from token statistics alone. Developmental analysis further reveals a clear developmental trajectory. The learning of the dependency relations that define a grammatical structure consistently precedes the learning of its contextual features. These findings suggest that statistical learning in NLMs is not merely the accumulation of token co-occurrence statistics, but a process in which learned dependency structures become new units of distributional learning. We argue that this process provides a statistical-learning account of how NLMs solve the compositionality problem in language. Finally, we discuss the possibility that this statistical learning process provides an explanatory theory on how language cognition could emerge from pure distributional statistics.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出，神经语言模型通过将学到的依存结构作为新的分布单元进行后续统计学习，从而获得独立于词汇语义的语法结构意义，并用合成语法和BERT式掩码语言模型验证了这一假设。
AI.motivation: 目前尚不清楚神经语言模型如何习得独立于词汇语义、由语法结构编码的结构意义；同时希望解释组合性问题以及语言认知能否从纯分布统计中涌现。
AI.method: 提出一种统计学习过程：一旦习得依存结构，模型便将其视为新的分布单元并追踪其语境分布。设计合成语法，使每个语法结构具有独特的语境分布，且不能仅从组成词元的分布统计中恢复。训练一系列BERT式掩码语言模型，并考察其发展轨迹。
AI.result: 模型能够成功学习复合依存结构的语境分布，即使这些分布无法从词元统计中推断出来。发展分析显示清晰轨迹：定义语法结构的依存关系学习始终先于其语境特征学习。
AI.conclusion: 神经语言模型的统计学习不只是词元共现统计的累积，而是习得的依存结构成为新的分布学习单元。该过程为神经语言模型如何解决语言组合性问题提供了统计学习解释，并可能为语言认知如何从纯分布统计中涌现提供解释理论。

title: ChronoFlow: Hierarchical Flow Matching for Irregular Time Series Generation
summary: Recent advances in generative modeling have substantially improved time series generation, yet most existing methods either assume a regular temporal grid or focus on feature dynamics under a given sampling structure. This makes them illsuited for generating irregular time series in their native form, where a model must capture not only feature values, but also how many observations occur, when they occur, and which features are observed together. To address this heterogeneous generation problem, we propose ChronoFlow, a unified hierarchical flow matching framework organized by statistical granularity. Following a coarse-to-fine hierarchy, ChronoFlow first generates observation counts and feature-wise frequencies, then jointly generates observation times and feature co-observation patterns, and finally generates values conditioned on the realized pattern. This turns a complex joint generation problem into structurally aligned subproblems while preserving their dependencies. To evaluate complete irregular time series generation, we introduce complementary metrics spanning sample realism, sampling structure, value fidelity, and temporal and cross-feature dependencies, and validate them through controlled corruptions. Across five benchmarks, ChronoFlow achieves strong improvements in generation fidelity over existing baselines, while factorization studies support the proposed hierarchy. Our code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/ChronoFlow.

AI.tldr: 提出 ChronoFlow，一种按统计粒度组织的分层流匹配框架，用于原生不规则时间序列生成，并引入多维度评估指标；在五个基准上取得显著生成保真度提升。
AI.motivation: 现有生成模型多假设规则时间网格或固定采样结构，主要关注特征动态，难以生成原生不规则时间序列，因为模型还需建模观测次数、观测时间以及哪些特征被共同观测。
AI.method: ChronoFlow 采用粗到细的分层流匹配：先生成观测计数和各特征频率，再联合生成观测时间与特征共观测模式，最后在已实现模式下生成特征值。同时提出覆盖样本真实性、采样结构、值保真度、时间依赖和跨特征依赖的互补指标，并通过受控损坏验证。
AI.result: 在五个基准数据集上，ChronoFlow 相比现有基线在生成保真度上有显著提升；因子分解研究支持所提出的分层结构。
AI.conclusion: ChronoFlow 能有效完成完整不规则时间序列生成，将复杂联合生成问题分解为结构对齐的子问题并保留依赖关系，配套指标可全面评估生成质量。

title: Multi-Dimensional Comparative Scale Construction for Efficient Personalized Subjective Judgment in High-Traffic Applications
summary: Subjective judgments are central to many high-traffic applications, but subjective intensity is difficult to quantify and perceptions vary substantially across individuals. To address these challenges, we propose a pairwise comparative framework for multi-dimensional scale construction. By comparing case-person pairs along case and profile dimensions, the framework constructs relative scales that capture both fine-grained intensity and individual variation. To support practical high-traffic deployment, we optimize both offline scale construction and online inference. For scale construction, we combine sparse Elo comparisons with multi-judge voting, cutting the comparison cost from $O(N^2)$ to $O(NK)$ for $N$ objects and a budget of $K$ opponents per object, while limiting reliance on any single judge. For inference, we propose SubJudge, a System One model for personalized scoring with Batchwise Preference Optimization (BPO). Using Bradley-Terry comparisons, BPO trains the model to learn relative orderings, and SubJudge reads a continuous score from digit-token probabilities at the first response position, requiring only one forward pass per criterion and reducing the inference complexity to $O(1)$. Experiments on PluriHarms and iNews show that our 9B models match or surpass the evaluated frontier LLMs on multiple metrics. On the H100 GPU, SubJudge achieves an approximately $1.29\times$ to $261\times$ speedup in mean inference latency over Qwen3.5-9B with different thinking budgets. The code is available at https://github.com/Longchentong/SubJudge.

AI.tldr: 论文提出一种成对比较框架，用于多维主观强度量表构建，并推出个性化评分模型 SubJudge，在降低比较与推理成本的同时达到或超越前沿大模型表现。
AI.motivation: 主观判断广泛存在于高流量应用中，但主观强度难以量化，且个体感知差异显著，因此需要既能刻画细粒度强度又能适应个体差异的方法。
AI.method: 采用成对比较框架，通过案例-人物对在案例维度和画像维度上比较来构建相对量表；离线阶段结合稀疏 Elo 比较与多评审投票，将比较成本从 O(N^2) 降至 O(NK)；在线阶段提出 SubJudge，使用 Batchwise Preference Optimization（BPO）和 Bradley-Terry 比较训练模型学习相对排序，并从首个响应位置的数字 token 概率读取连续分数，每次标准仅需一次前向传播，推理复杂度为 O(1)。
AI.result: 在 PluriHarms 和 iNews 上，9B 模型在多个指标上匹配或超过所评估的前沿 LLM；在 H100 GPU 上，SubJudge 相比 Qwen3.5-9B 在不同思考预算下实现约 1.29 倍到 261 倍的平均推理延迟加速。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够高效构建多维主观量表并支持个性化在线评分，在效果和效率上均具优势，适合高流量部署场景。

title: OPERA: A Unified Omnimodal Progressive Spatio-Temporal Reasoning Agent for Referring Video Segmentation
summary: Referring video segmentation with heterogeneous multimodal queries---spanning text, audio, and reference images---demands both robust cross-modal understanding and precise spatio-temporal reasoning. We propose OPERA (Omnimodal Progressive spatio-tEmporal Reasoning Agent), a unified reasoning agent built on a single MLLM that performs dual-axis progressive reasoning via three specialized stages. Along the temporal axis, a Temporal Reasoning Agent narrows the frame search space through coarse-to-fine filtering to identify the most informative key frame. Along the spatial axis, a Distillation Agent establishes what to locate via cross-modal semantic distillation, and a Grounding Agent enhanced with GRPO determines where the target appears, with dense mask propagation completing the pixel-level output. OPERA sets a new state of the art on OmniAVS and Ref-AVS and transfers zero-shot to standard referring video segmentation benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 OPERA，一个基于单一多模态大模型的统一推理智能体，用于处理文本、音频和参考图像等异构多模态查询的参考视频分割。
AI.motivation: 现有参考视频分割需要同时理解异构多模态查询并完成精确的时空推理，而统一且渐进地处理时间与空间推理仍具挑战。
AI.method: OPERA 采用双轴渐进推理，包含三个阶段：时间轴上的 Temporal Reasoning Agent 通过由粗到细过滤缩小帧搜索空间并定位关键帧；空间轴上的 Distillation Agent 进行跨模态语义蒸馏以确定“找什么”，Grounding Agent 结合 GRPO 确定目标“在哪里”，最后通过密集掩码传播生成像素级结果。
AI.result: 在 OmniAVS 和 Ref-AVS 上取得新的 state of the art，并能零样本迁移到标准参考视频分割基准。
AI.conclusion: OPERA 表明基于单一 MLLM 的双轴渐进推理智能体可有效统一处理异构多模态查询下的参考视频分割任务。

title: Dexterous Tactile World Model
summary: World models for manipulation are typically trained from video, yet the events that determine how manipulation unfolds, such as making and releasing contact, are difficult to observe visually and are often easier to sense through touch. We present the Dexterous Tactile World Model (DTWM), a video world model for future-frame prediction of egocentric manipulation from both observed video and tactile signals from a glove worn on each hand. We condition a pretrained video diffusion transformer on each hand's tactile signal through a zero-initialized residual at the corresponding hand location in the video tokens, while a causal mask prevents predicted frames from accessing future information. Compared with a vision-only model matched in architecture, parameters, and training, DTWM reduces the underestimation of hand motion from 23% to 9%, while reducing the perceptual error in the hand region by 7.4% across three training runs per model. The benefit also increases over the prediction horizon, with the improvement in the later predicted chunks being about 4.1x larger than in the first. DTWM also outperforms other visual-tactile world models under the same setting, and training with touch improves future-frame prediction even when no touch is available at inference. Ablations show that the model benefits from both the magnitude and spatial location of force: replacing the tactile signal with binary contact states, either per hand or per location, increases prediction error. The observed course of the force indicates whether the interaction will persist or change.

AI.tldr: 提出DTWM，一种结合双手触觉手套信号与视频扩散Transformer的灵巧触觉世界模型，用于第一人称操作未来帧预测。相比纯视觉模型，手部运动低估从23%降至9%，手部区域感知误差降低7.4%，且预测时域越长收益越大，并优于其他视触觉世界模型。
AI.motivation: 基于视频的世界模型难以从视觉中观察接触与释放等决定操作走向的事件，而这些事件通过触觉更易感知，因此希望融合触觉提升操作未来帧预测能力。
AI.method: 以预训练视频扩散Transformer为骨干，通过零初始化残差将每只手的触觉信号注入到视频token中对应手部位置，并使用因果掩码防止预测帧访问未来信息。与架构、参数量和训练匹配的纯视觉模型对比，并在相同设定下与其他视触觉世界模型比较，同时进行消融实验，如用二元接触状态替代触觉信号。
AI.result: DTWM将手部运动低估从23%降至9%，手部区域感知误差降低7.4%（三次训练运行）；预测越靠后改善越大，后期预测块的改善约为第一块的4.1倍；优于其他视触觉世界模型；即使推理时无触觉输入，训练时使用触觉仍能改善未来帧预测；消融显示用二元接触状态替代触觉信号会增加误差，表明力的大小和空间位置均有贡献；力的变化过程可指示交互将持续还是改变。
AI.conclusion: 触觉信号能有效增强视频世界模型对操作动态的预测，且预测时域越长收益越明显；力的幅值和空间信息对性能均不可或缺。

title: Text-Vision Synergistic Token Caching: A Training-Free Framework for Efficient Vision-Language-Action Inference
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable generalizable robotic control but remain computationally expensive. Token caching provides a training-free, plug-and-play acceleration alternative. However, existing VLA caching does not fully exploit a key inductive bias of VLA models: text-vision synergy, wherein textual semantics guide the precise visual grounding of task-relevant regions. In particular, existing designs insufficiently account for head-wise reliability in attention aggregation and layer-wise stability in cache reuse. To address this, we propose Text-Vision Synergistic Token Caching (TVCache), a training-free framework for efficient VLA inference. TVCache filters attention heads based on text-vision information focus to improve task-relevant and physically consistent visual grounding. Concurrently, we introduce a reuse-layer selection mechanism guided by text-vision entropy differences to avoid caching unstable representations and improve cache resource allocation. Extensive experiments across four representative VLA models, two simulation benchmarks, and real-world robotic tasks demonstrate the effectiveness and generality of TVCache. At matched token-retention ratios, TVCache consistently improves task success over existing VLA caching with comparable computational cost. On OpenVLA-OFT, it improves average success by up to 14.5 percentage points over VLA-Cache at 12.5% retention while reducing FLOPs by 2.45x relative to full-token inference.

AI.tldr: 提出TVCache，一种免训练的VLA推理加速框架，通过文本-视觉协同的token缓存，在计算成本相当的情况下提升任务成功率。
AI.motivation: VLA模型计算开销大，现有token缓存方法未充分利用文本语义引导视觉定位这一归纳偏置，且未充分考虑注意力头级可靠性与层间缓存复用稳定性。
AI.method: 基于文本-视觉信息焦点过滤注意力头，提升任务相关且物理一致的视觉定位；引入由文本-视觉熵差引导的复用层选择机制，避免缓存不稳定表示并优化缓存资源分配。
AI.result: 在4个VLA模型、2个仿真基准和真实机器人任务上验证。相同token保留率下成功率持续优于现有VLA缓存。OpenVLA-OFT上，12.5%保留率时平均成功率比VLA-Cache提升最多14.5个百分点，FLOPs较全token推理减少2.45倍。
AI.conclusion: TVCache是一种有效且通用的免训练、即插即用VLA推理加速方案。

title: Semantic Uncertainty Quantification Needs Factual Equivalence
summary: Semantic uncertainty quantification for large language models rests on a common template: sample several answers, measure how much they agree, and treat disagreement as uncertainty. We first formalize this template as two separate roles: an operator that compares two answers, and an aggregator that combines all pairwise comparisons into a scalar. Existing methods differ almost entirely in how they aggregate, while taking the operator off the shelf, typically an NLI model or a generic sentence encoder. We show that this reliance on off-the-shelf operators is the primary bottleneck of semantic UQ: they do not accurately measure factual equivalence of multiple answers to the same question. We resolve this with a deliberately simple recipe: a single encoder trained contrastively to isolate the targeted fact, utilizing synthetic data generated by an LLM and dataset both disjoint from all evaluation settings. Integrating the resulting operator into existing methods improves performance on 120 of 126 evaluation settings (95%) spanning 18 model dataset combinations across language and vision-language models. The best variant reaches 0.76 mean AUROC against 0.68 for the strongest baseline, while replacing the quadratic cross-encoder comparisons of entailment-based operators with one encoder pass per answer. The uniformity of the improvement supports the view that the operator, not the aggregator, is the limiting factor. The same operator also improves single generation token-level estimators: the norm it assigns to each token measures how much that token bears on the answer, and reweighting token log-likelihoods accordingly sharpens the estimate.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究大语言模型中的语义不确定性量化，指出常用方法的核心瓶颈在于拿来即用的答案比较算子，而非聚合器；作者提出用一个对比学习训练的单一编码器来更准确地判断事实等价性，并在大量评测中显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有语义不确定性量化通常先采样多个答案，再用现成的 NLI 模型或通用句编码器比较答案，并将成对比较结果聚合为不确定性分数。作者认为，这些现成算子无法准确衡量同一问题下多个答案的事实等价性，是当前方法的主要限制。
AI.method: 作者将语义不确定性量化模板形式化为“比较两个答案的算子”和“将所有成对比较聚合成标量的聚合器”。他们用一个LLM生成的合成数据以及所有评测场景均不重叠的数据集，对比学习训练单一编码器，使其隔离目标事实。将该算子集成到现有方法中，并用每个答案一次编码替代基于蕴含算子的二次跨编码器比较；同时用于单生成 token 级估计，按 token 对答案的重要性重加权对数似然。
AI.result: 在涵盖语言模型和视觉语言模型的18个模型-数据集组合、共126个评测设置中，该方法在120个设置（95%）上提升性能。最佳变体达到0.76平均AUROC，最强基线为0.68。改进的一致性支持“算子而非聚合器是限制因素”的观点。同一算子也改进了单生成 token 级估计器。
AI.conclusion: 语义不确定性量化的关键瓶颈是比较答案的算子。一个刻意简单、基于对比学习和合成数据训练的编码器即可广泛提升现有方法，并兼具有效性与效率，同时可增强 token 级不确定性估计。

title: ReLoc: Rethinking Scene Coordinate Regression Architecture for Robust Outdoor LiDAR-based Localization
summary: Scene Coordinate Regression (SCR) has recently emerged as a promising approach for LiDAR-based localization, achieving accurate localization without requiring an explicit 3D map. Despite their effectiveness, existing SCR methods rely on scene classification-based global embedding that struggles to provide fine-grained discrimination among nearby locations. Moreover, their reliance on uniform sampling of local features during training assigns equal importance to all points, thereby inadvertently propagating features from dynamic objects or unstable regions and potentially degrading training stability. In this paper, we present ReLoc, a revamped SCR architecture that can effectively address these limitations. First, we redesign the global embedding module by combining learnable context tokens with a feature aggregator to capture richer and more discriminative scene context. Second, we introduce an attention-based local feature enhancement module to mitigate the impact of noisy local features while encouraging context-consistent structures, yielding more robust local feature representations. Experimental results on two large-scale outdoor datasets demonstrate that our approach achieves state-of-the-art accuracy over previous SCR-based methods while maintaining real-time inference performance.

AI.tldr: 提出 ReLoc，一种改进的场景坐标回归（SCR）架构，用于 LiDAR 定位，通过增强全局场景嵌入和局部特征表示，在保持实时推理的同时提升定位精度。
AI.motivation: 现有 SCR 方法依赖基于场景分类的全局嵌入，难以区分邻近位置；同时均匀采样局部特征，会同等对待动态或不稳定区域，导致噪声传播并影响训练稳定性。
AI.method: 重新设计全局嵌入模块，将可学习上下文 token 与特征聚合器结合；引入基于注意力的局部特征增强模块，抑制噪声局部特征并促进上下文一致的结构。
AI.result: 在两个大规模户外数据集上，ReLoc 相比先前 SCR 方法达到最先进精度，同时保持实时推理性能。
AI.conclusion: ReLoc 能有效解决现有 SCR 在全局判别力和局部噪声鲁棒性方面的不足，实现更准确、稳健且实时的 LiDAR 定位。

title: Nürnberg NLP at ChildSafeAds 2026: Structurally Dissimilar Voter Ensembles under Four Levels of Data Access
comment: Accepted at the ChildSafeAds 2026 Shared Task @ NLLP Workshop, EMNLP 2026 (1st place in 2 of 3 subtasks)
summary: We describe the Nürnberg NLP system for ChildSafeAds 2026. The shared task asks what a monitoring system for commercial content in child-facing YouTube videos can achieve at a given level of data access. We answer with per-subtask ensembles of nine voters, organised into three branches that differ in backbone, adaptation method and class scope. Selection rests on channel-disjoint cross-validation, with the development set as a transfer check. The system wins two of the three subtasks. Its product-category score (ST2, 0.8243) and its compliance-flag score (ST3, 0.6530) are the best of the 22 final entries, and it places third on the task mean (0.7079). We further compare four access levels and report the cost at test-set scale.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了用于 ChildSafeAds 2026 的 Nürnberg NLP 系统，通过按子任务集成的九模型投票器，在三个子任务中赢得两个，并在给定数据访问级别下评估儿童向 YouTube 视频商业内容监测的性能与成本。
AI.motivation: ChildSafeAds 2026 共享任务关注：在特定数据访问级别下，面向儿童的 YouTube 视频商业内容监测系统能达到何种效果。研究旨在回答该问题并比较不同访问级别的代价。
AI.method: 采用按子任务的九投票器集成，分为三个分支，分支在骨干模型、适配方法和类别范围上不同。模型选择基于频道不相交交叉验证，并以开发集作为迁移检查。同时比较四种数据访问级别，并报告测试集规模的成本。
AI.result: 系统在三个子任务中赢得两个。产品类别得分（ST2）为 0.8243，合规标志得分（ST3）为 0.6530，均为 22 个最终提交中的最佳；任务平均分 0.7079，排名第三。
AI.conclusion: 该集成系统在 ChildSafeAds 2026 任务中表现优异，验证了在限定数据访问下监测儿童向视频商业内容的可行性，并提供了不同访问级别的性能与成本权衡。

title: The Right Lesson at the Right Step: Deriving Control Updates for Self-Evolving Agents
summary: Self-evolving agents improve future behavior by reusing past experience, typically as global prompts, memories, or reflections. Yet these mechanisms rarely control where experience takes effect. In long tool-use workflows, the same lesson may correct one decision but distract another, making experience reuse a problem of localized control rather than memory alone. We introduce EvoCUE (Evolution through Control Updates from Evidence), a framework for learning reusable control-program updates from completed agent executions. EvoCUE represents the agent as an explicit state-machine controller, whose nodes perform model or tool calls and whose edges define where control passes next. This makes the workflow editable at precise locations, so each learned update can specify what to add, where it acts, and when it applies. From completed trajectories, EvoCUE uses residual goals and observed execution traces to propose localized instruction or skill edits. Each candidate is evaluated at the point where it would act by resuming the parent and edited controllers from the same checkpoint and comparing their final outcomes. Accepted edits are compiled with applicability rules, confirmed on held-out tasks, and inherited by later executions. We evaluate EvoCUE on long tool-use environments where learned conventions must reach the right execution step. From a minimal AppWorld controller without benchmark-specific onboarding instructions, EvoCUE learns the missing task-completion convention and substantially improves success on Test-Normal and Test-Challenge. On PAST-Bench office workflows, EvoCUE transfers organizational requirements from prior episodes to later tasks, improving task-execution quality. These results show that self-evolving agents should place experience inside the control flow, rather than only store it as text.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 EvoCUE 框架，将智能体表示为显式状态机控制器，从历史执行轨迹中学习可复用的局部控制程序更新，使经验在正确执行位置生效，而非仅作为全局提示或记忆。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化智能体多通过全局提示、记忆或反思复用经验，但难以控制经验在何处生效。在长流程工具使用中，同一经验可能纠正某一步却干扰另一步，因此经验复用本质上是局部控制问题。
AI.method: EvoCUE 将智能体建模为状态机控制器，节点表示模型或工具调用，边定义控制流。它利用已完成轨迹中的残余目标和执行记录，提出局部的指令或技能编辑。每个候选编辑在与原控制器相同检查点恢复执行并进行结果比较，以评估其作用点效果。被接受的编辑会附带适用规则、在留出任务上验证，并被后续执行继承。
AI.result: 在 AppWorld 中，从无基准特定引导指令的最小控制器出发，EvoCUE 学到了缺失的任务完成约定，并在 Test-Normal 与 Test-Challenge 上显著提升成功率。在 PAST-Bench 办公工作流中，EvoCUE 能将先前回合中的组织要求迁移到后续任务，提高任务执行质量。
AI.conclusion: 自进化智能体不应仅将经验存储为文本，而应将经验放入控制流中，以局部化、可验证和可继承的方式复用。

title: When the Score Becomes the Target: Rethinking Metric Validity in Autonomous Driving
summary: Driving benchmark scores are increasingly used not only for evaluation but also as optimization targets. This raises a fundamental question: do score gains remain reliable evidence of driving improvement once the score itself is optimized? We address this question by examining how the scoring process responds to changes in driving behavior and whether the resulting gains persist under repeated execution and replanning. We decompose the process into execution, measurement, subscore mapping, and aggregation. Controlled interventions reveal substantial behavioral changes that receive little score response because distinctions are omitted, thresholded, or attenuated between requested and executed motion. Closed-loop comparisons further show that optimization gains can reverse when the execution interface changes, demonstrating their dependence on how requests are executed and returned as feedback. Together, these findings connect the behavioral distinctions preserved by a metric to the conditions under which its gains transfer. Metric validity under optimization therefore requires examining both what the scoring process measures and how the optimized behavior is executed.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨驾驶基准分数被用作优化目标后，其分数提升是否仍能可靠反映驾驶性能提升；通过分解评分流程并开展干预与闭环比较，发现分数增益可能因执行差异和接口变化而失真甚至反转。
AI.motivation: 驾驶基准分数日益不仅用于评估，也被直接作为优化目标，因此需要检验在优化分数本身时，分数提升是否仍是驾驶改进的可靠证据。
AI.method: 将评分过程分解为执行、测量、子分数映射和聚合四个环节；通过受控干预考察行为变化与分数响应的关系，并通过闭环比较检验优化增益在重复执行、重新规划及执行接口变化下的持续性。
AI.result: 受控干预显示，许多行为变化因请求与执行运动之间的区分被忽略、阈值化或衰减，仅带来很小分数响应；闭环比较进一步表明，当执行接口改变时，优化增益可能反转，说明增益依赖于请求如何被执行并作为反馈返回。
AI.conclusion: 指标能否在优化下保持有效性，取决于其保留的行为区分与优化行为的执行方式；因此需同时考察评分过程测量了什么，以及被优化行为如何执行。

title: Focus and Supplement: Dual-Enhanced Vision Transformer for Multi-Class Anomaly Classification
summary: Multi-class anomaly classification in industrial vision remains challenging due to noisy/incomplete anomaly representations and the unknown number of anomaly classes. To overcome this, we propose MACO, a novel multi-class anomaly classification framework that learns comprehensive representations and dynamically estimates class number without prior knowledge. First, a soft-focus attention uses anomaly maps to concentrate on relevant abnormal regions, while suppressing background noise. Second, auxiliary classification ([A-CLS]) tokens complement the [CLS] token. They collectively attend to diverse anomaly sub-regions, yielding more holistic and discriminative features. These [A-CLS] tokens are also effective across more tasks and domains. To infer the class number, we propose Correlation-based Number Estimation strategy. It computes the average correlation among labeled classes and transfers its separability cue to the unlabeled set. Experiments on MVTec AD and MTD datasets demonstrate our superiority. Under known class number, MACO improves ARI by 6.5% and $\textbf{16.3%}$ on both datasets, respectively. In the more challenging unknown number scenario, it achieves an $\textbf{11.2%}$ NMI gain on MTD and outperforms existing number estimation strategies by $\textbf{24.1%}$ UPS on MVTec AD. Code will be released at https://github.com/HUST-SLOW/MACO.

AI.tldr: 提出MACO多类异常分类框架，可学习更全面的异常表示并在无先验知识下动态估计异常类别数，在MVTec AD和MTD数据集上取得领先性能。
AI.motivation: 工业视觉中的多类异常分类面临异常表示有噪声/不完整以及异常类别数未知的挑战。
AI.method: 采用软聚焦注意力，利用异常图聚焦相关异常区域并抑制背景噪声；引入辅助分类[A-CLS] token，与[CLS] token共同关注多样异常子区域，获得更整体且具判别性的特征；提出基于相关性的类别数估计策略，将标注类间的平均相关性可分性线索迁移到无标注集。
