AI.result: 在已知类别数下，MACO在MVTec AD和MTD上分别将ARI提升6.5%和16.3%；在未知类别数场景下，MTD上NMI提升11.2%，MVTec AD上UPS比现有类别数估计策略高24.1%。
AI.conclusion: MACO能有效应对已知和未知类别数下的多类异常分类，验证了其异常表示学习与动态类别数估计策略的优越性。

title: Learning to Sell: Reinforcement Learning for Strategic Large Language Model Agents in Multi-Product Markets
summary: Autonomous large language model (LLM) agents operating in multi-product markets must make sequential decisions under information asymmetry and resource constraints. We develop a machine learning approach for training such agents to act effectively as sellers in a multi-item bargaining environment, where a seller concurrently negotiates a catalog of substitutable assets across a pool of independent buyers. Buyers hold private, heterogeneous valuations across products, and each can purchase at most one item. Facing limits on total communication turns, the seller must dynamically match buyers with the most profitable products considering their private valuations, while strategically allocating its limited interaction budget toward combinations of greater potential value. We formalize this problem as a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process using a structured, four-part message protocol that maps natural language into a parsable and regulated decision space. Using this formalization, we design a post-training method using Reinforcement Learning from Verifiable Rewards (RLVR). To evaluate this framework, we construct a multidimensional metric suite that quantifies constraint adherence, seller surplus extraction, and allocation quality. Our trained seller agent learns to match limited inventory to buyers more effectively, matching or outperforming trillion-parameter frontier models in both seller surplus extraction and buyer-product allocation quality. Finally, these learned strategies generalize robustly to unseen market structures, correlated valuation distributions, and price ranges not encountered during training.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多商品市场中自主大语言模型代理的序贯决策问题，提出一种基于强化学习的方法训练卖家代理，在信息不对称和有限沟通轮次下与多个独立买家进行多物品议价，并学习将有限库存有效匹配给买家。
AI.motivation: 自主大语言模型代理在多产品市场中需在信息不对称与资源约束下做序贯决策。卖家同时面对多个买家、可替代资产目录、买家私有异质估值且最多购买一件商品，并受总沟通轮次限制，因此需要更有效的训练与评估框架。
AI.method: 将问题形式化为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程（POMDP），采用结构化四部分消息协议，把自然语言映射为可解析且受约束的决策空间；设计基于可验证奖励的强化学习后训练方法（RLVR）；构建多维评估指标，量化约束遵循、卖家剩余提取和分配质量。
AI.result: 训练后的卖家代理能更有效地将有限库存匹配给买家，在卖家剩余提取和买家-产品分配质量上匹配或超越万亿参数前沿模型；学习到的策略还能稳健泛化到未见市场结构、相关估值分布及训练中未遇到的价格范围。
AI.conclusion: 该工作表明，通过结构化协议和RLVR后训练，LLM代理可在复杂多商品议价环境中学习有效且可泛化的卖家策略，在信息不对称和资源约束下实现更好的匹配与收益提取。

title: TraceDance: An Automated System for Building Agent Behavior Benchmarks from Real-World Agent Deployment Traces
summary: An agent can complete a task while exhibiting undesirable behavior during execution. Developers need tests for the specific behaviors encountered in deployment, beyond fixed benchmark suites. We present TraceDance, an agent system that constructs targeted benchmarks from deployment traces for user-specified undesirable behaviors. For efficient construction, Anchor-and-Confirm combines programmable retrieval with candidate-level confirmation by a Flash large language model (LLM), while the Anchor Synthesis Loop generates and revises specifications for custom behaviors. The benchmarks use decision-point continuation to evaluate an LLM's next turn at a recorded decision point with a behavior-specific rubric, without a reference answer or environment replay. Experiments in coding and general tool use draw on 252,557 sessions and produce 107 benchmarks with 4,125 instances, fulfilling 95.3% of build-target requests. Both human annotators confirm the requested behavior in 84% of sampled instances, and the automated grader's agreement with human pass/fail judgments is comparable to that between the annotators. Nine frontier LLMs achieve a mean pass rate of only 26.7%, showing that they still struggle to respond appropriately at the evaluated decision points. Analysis across behavior-specific benchmarks further reveals weaknesses in how current LLMs behave as agents. By turning deployment problems into targeted benchmarks, TraceDance could serve as a key component of the recursive self-improvement (RSI) loop.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TraceDance，一个能从部署轨迹中自动构建针对用户指定不良行为的基准测试的智能体系统，用于评估 LLM 作为智能体在真实决策点上的表现。
AI.motivation: 智能体可能在完成任务时表现出不良行为，而固定基准套件无法覆盖部署中遇到的具体行为，开发者需要针对实际部署问题的测试。
AI.method: TraceDance 通过 Anchor-and-Confirm 结合可编程检索与 Flash LLM 的候选级确认来高效构建测试；Anchor Synthesis Loop 生成和修正自定义行为规范；基准采用 decision-point continuation，在记录的决策点用行为特定评分标准评估 LLM 的下一轮回复，无需参考答案或环境重放。
AI.result: 在编码和通用工具使用场景中，基于 252,557 个会话构建了 107 个基准、4,125 个实例，满足 95.3% 的构建目标请求；人工标注者在 84% 的抽样实例中确认了请求行为，自动评分器与人工通过/失败判断的一致性接近标注者之间的一致性；九个前沿 LLM 平均通过率仅 26.7%。
AI.conclusion: 当前 LLM 作为智能体在特定决策点仍难以做出恰当行为；TraceDance 能将部署问题转化为针对性基准，有望成为递归自我改进（RSI）循环的关键组件。

title: RINI: Seeing the Prior Is Not Enough
summary: A research proposal can describe an established mechanism correctly while claiming to introduce it. We study whether providing the earlier paper corrects such contribution claims. Three controlled experiments compare proposals generated with a contribution-bearing prior and a same-topic control. Providing the prior yields no clear aggregate reduction in unsupported novelty. Human analysis of 175 interpretable exposed proposals finds that 137 recognize the prior's relevance, but 61 correctly attribute the established contribution. Of 71 proposed remaining distinctions, 37 are covered by the same prior. We introduce Research Idea Novelty Inspection (RINI), which audits contribution claims against evidence, checks the remaining distinction, and applies local revisions. Five human annotators evaluate 1,080 original-revision pairs across three methods. On the same 240 originals judged to require correction, successful repair is 11.7% for Self-Revision, 39.1% for Retrieve-and-Revise, and 72.2% for RINI, with research tasks weighted equally. The improvement over same-evidence direct revision is 33.0 percentage points. The revised proposals retain their research questions and technical methods. These results motivate explicit contribution attribution when using literature to generate and revise research proposals.

AI.tldr: 论文研究提供早期文献能否纠正研究提案中把已有机制误称为新颖贡献的问题，并提出RINI方法审计贡献声明并局部修订。
AI.motivation: 生成研究提案时可能正确描述已有机制却错误声称首次提出，而仅提供先前论文是否能修正这种贡献归属尚不明确。
AI.method: 开展三项对照实验，比较有贡献性先验与同主题对照；人工分析175个可解释暴露提案；提出RINI，对贡献声明进行证据审计、检验剩余差异并局部修订；5名标注者评估3种方法共1080对原稿-修订稿。
AI.result: 仅提供先验未显著减少无依据新颖性；175个提案中137个认识到先验相关性，但仅61个正确归属已有贡献；71个剩余差异中37个仍被同一先验覆盖；在240个需修正原稿上，Self-Revision成功率11.7%，Retrieve-and-Revise为39.1%，RINI为72.2%，比同证据直接修订高33.0个百分点，且保留研究问题和技术方法。
AI.conclusion: 使用文献生成和修订研究提案时应显式进行贡献归属，RINI能有效修正不支持的创新性主张。

title: PanoVLN: Towards Effective Panoramic Vision-and-Language Navigation
summary: Recent vision-language models (VLMs) have advanced vision-and-language navigation (VLN), enabling models to predict navigation actions from visual observations and language instructions. In this work, we explore VLN with panoramic observations and introduce PanoVLN. The motivation is straightforward: more complete visual context should enable better-informed navigation decisions. For example, a panorama can reveal a passage outside a perspective camera's field of view, allowing the model to identify the intended route without additional exploration. However, we find that simply replacing perspective images with panoramas yields only limited gains. Our diagnosis suggests that fully exploiting wider visibility requires modifications to action prediction, training supervision, and visual representation. First, wider visibility supports longer-horizon action planning. We make the model predict longer action sequences, enabling larger turns and subsequent movement from a single panorama. Specifically, we introduce a confidence-guided execution (CGE) strategy that dynamically determines how many predicted actions to execute before replanning. Second, wider visibility also brings more complex route choices. We therefore construct training routes with frequent branching points and clear instructions to provide targeted supervision for route selection. Third, panoramic navigation requires understanding spatial relationships across viewing directions, beyond recognizing individual landmarks. We combine semantic and geometric features from RGB panoramas to capture both scene content and spatial layout without adding visual tokens. With a 4B backbone and RGB-only input, PanoVLN surpasses the previous SOTA by 11.9% and 8.7% in success rate on R2R-CE and RxR-CE Val-Unseen. Real-world experiments on a quadruped further demonstrate faster navigation with fewer pauses than prior VLN methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 PanoVLN，探索使用全景观测的视觉语言导航，通过改进动作预测、训练监督和视觉表征，显著提升导航性能，并在真实四足机器人上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 全景图像比透视图像提供更完整的视觉上下文，理论上能让模型做出更好的导航决策，例如发现视野外的通道。但简单替换为全景图像收益有限，说明还需在动作预测、训练监督和视觉表征上做针对性改进。
AI.method: 提出 PanoVLN：1）使用置信度引导执行（CGE）策略，动态决定一次预测后执行多少动作再重新规划，以支持更长时程动作规划；2）构建带有频繁分支点和清晰指令的训练路线，提供路线选择监督；3）融合 RGB 全景的语义与几何特征，在不增加视觉 token 的情况下理解跨视角空间关系。模型基于 4B 骨干，仅用 RGB 输入。
AI.result: 在 R2R-CE 和 RxR-CE Val-Unseen 上，PanoVLN 成功率分别超过此前 SOTA 11.9% 和 8.7%。真实四足机器人实验表明，相比先前 VLN 方法，导航更快且暂停更少。
AI.conclusion: 有效利用全景观测需要同时改进动作规划、训练监督和视觉表征；PanoVLN 在这些方面取得显著效果，并具备真实世界部署潜力。

title: Echoes of Deeds: Moral History Can Shape and Steer LLM Behavioral Choices
summary: Evaluations of Large Language Models (LLMs) morality typically consider decisions in isolation, thus overlooking whether an individual's unrelated prior conduct influences the model's subsequent choices. This leaves open the question of whether, and to what extent, moral history shapes LLM decisional behaviors. Prior work on human moral decision-making shows that past behavior can influence subsequent moral choices. Building on this observation, we investigate whether analogous effects emerge in LLMs in two complementary ways: at the behavioral level, through the model's observable responses, and at the representation level, through its latent internal representations. We introduce MoralLedger, a framework for studying how an actor's moral history shapes actions for LLMs' behaviors under a fixed decision context. At the behavioral level, we find that prior moral histories systematically alter subsequent choices as a function of their valence and intensity. At the internal representation level, these histories induce a linearly recoverable direction in the residual stream that generalizes to held-out examples. Intervening along this direction on neutral-history prompts produces two-sided intensity-dependent changes in subsequent choices, with effects that are stronger than those induced by prompting alone or by favorable-nonmoral direction. To our knowledge, this is the first demonstration that a latent representation of an actor's prior moral conduct can provide signed inference-time control over a moral decision. Our MoralLedger extends moral evaluation beyond static dilemmas, establishing moral history as both a source of behavioral sensitivity and a causal target for auditing and controlling moral behavior in LLMs.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 MoralLedger 框架，研究 LLM 的道德历史是否以及如何影响其后续道德决策，并从行为层面和内部表征层面验证了这种影响。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 道德评估通常孤立地看待决策，忽略个体先前无关行为是否影响模型后续选择；而人类道德决策研究表明过去行为会影响后续道德选择，因此作者希望检验 LLM 中是否存在类似效应。
AI.method: 提出 MoralLedger 框架，在固定决策情境下操纵行为主体的道德历史，考察其效价和强度对 LLM 后续选择的影响；同时在行为层面观察模型输出，在表征层面分析残差流中的潜在方向，并通过干预中性历史提示来验证因果作用。
AI.result: 行为层面，先前道德历史会依据其效价和强度系统性地改变后续选择；表征层面，这些历史在残差流中形成可线性恢复且能泛化到留出样本的方向；沿该方向干预中性历史提示会产生双向、强度依赖的选择变化，且强于仅靠提示或非道德有利方向干预的效果。
AI.conclusion: 该研究首次表明，行为主体先前道德行为的潜在表征可对道德决策提供有符号的推理时控制；MoralLedger 将道德评估从静态困境扩展到道德历史，使道德历史既是行为敏感性的来源，也是审计和控制 LLM 道德行为的因果目标。

title: When Confidence Rises Too Early: Detecting Shortcut Reasoning via Premature Answer Commitment
summary: The reasoning trajectory of a Large Language Model (LLM) is often treated as a verbalized description of its internal reasoning. However, such trajectories can be unfaithful: a model may rely on shortcuts to reach an answer and then post-rationalize the decision with a seemingly coherent chain of thought. Detecting this shortcut reasoning is challenging because existing monitors and verifiers mainly inspect textual traces or final outcomes, rather than how the model's belief in its answer develops during generation. We introduce ConfLens, a framework that tracks the evolution of confidence in the final answer throughout reasoning. Across three shortcut reasoning settings, we observe a common pattern of premature confidence, where shortcut samples become highly confident in the final answer at early reasoning stages. Existing confidence estimation methods, however, show limited generalizability, reliability, or efficiency for detecting this behavior. We therefore propose the Distributional Answer Commitment Score (DACS), a distributional confidence estimator that measures the entropy of the model's probability distribution over answer commitment at each reasoning step. DACS captures how concentrated the model's answer belief is without requiring ground-truth answers or task-specific verifiers. We further convert ConfLens detection results into interpretable signals for reward models to reduce their preference for shortcut reasoning. Experiments on mathematical and code reasoning tasks show that ConfLens with DACS improves shortcut reasoning detection by over 4.3% F1 compared with strong baselines and reduces the mismatch between faithfulness and correctness in reward model preferences.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ConfLens 框架，通过追踪 LLM 在推理过程中对最终答案置信度的演变，检测其是否依赖捷径推理并事后合理化。针对现有置信度估计方法的不足，提出分布答案承诺分数 DACS，并将检测信号用于奖励模型以减少对捷径推理的偏好。
AI.motivation: LLM 的推理轨迹常被视为其内部推理的言语化描述，但可能并不忠实：模型可能先通过捷径得到答案，再用看似连贯的思维链进行事后合理化。现有监控器和验证器主要检查文本痕迹或最终结果，难以检测这种捷径推理，尤其是模型在生成过程中对答案信念如何演变。
AI.method: 提出 ConfLens 框架，追踪推理过程中模型对最终答案置信度的演变，并观察到捷径样本存在“过早自信”模式。进一步提出 Distributional Answer Commitment Score (DACS)，一种分布式置信度估计器，通过测量每个推理步骤中模型对答案承诺的概率分布熵来捕捉答案信念的集中程度，无需真实答案或任务特定验证器。最后将 ConfLens 检测结果转化为奖励模型的可解释信号，以降低其对捷径推理的偏好。
AI.result: 在数学和代码推理任务上，ConfLens 结合 DACS 相比强基线将捷径推理检测的 F1 提升超过 4.3%，并减少了奖励模型偏好中忠实性与正确性之间的不匹配。
AI.conclusion: 通过跟踪推理过程中答案置信度的演变，可以有效识别 LLM 的捷径推理；DACS 提供了一种无需真值答案的分布式检测信号，并能用于改进奖励模型，使其偏好更忠实的推理而非仅追求正确答案。

title: ECHO: Event-Augmented Context with Hindsight and Outlook for Wrist-Only Manipulation
summary: Learning-based manipulation policies relying on RGB cameras often suffer from degraded observations under extreme exposure. Event cameras mitigate this degradation by asynchronously detecting pixel-level intensity changes to offer a high dynamic range. However, their observations heavily depend on camera placement, as fixed cameras miss static scene content while wrist-mounted camera motion causes previously visited regions to leave the field of view. To address these spatial-temporal limitations, we present ECHO (Event-augmented Context with Hindsight and Outlook), a wrist-only latent world action model that encodes wrist events into compact motion representations to provide temporal and spatial context for policy reasoning. Specifically, ECHO utilizes a pretrained event encoder to explain visual-feature changes between frames. Its hindsight module preserves the gripper trajectory with past event stream as addressable off-camera context. Concurrently, the outlook module introduces learnable event foresight queries supervised to anticipate the event window for future actions, enabling the policy to predict upcoming scene changes. Evaluated on wrist-only RLBench tasks, ECHO outperforms RGB and RGB+event baselines by 20.6 and 12.0 percentage points under normal lighting, and by 14.6 and 11.3 points under severe exposure drops, respectively, while also surpassing RGB references using a third-person camera. Real-world experiments with a wrist-mounted event camera validate that ECHO outperforms RGB-only and RGB+event baselines across multiple tasks under both nominal and severely dark lighting. Project page is at https://echo-wam.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ECHO，一种仅使用腕部事件相机的潜在世界动作模型，通过将腕部事件编码为紧凑运动表示，并结合回顾与前瞻模块，为策略推理提供时空上下文，从而在极端曝光和暗光下提升操作策略性能。
AI.motivation: 基于 RGB 相机的学习型操作策略在极端曝光下观测质量下降。事件相机动态范围高，但固定相机易漏掉静态场景内容，腕部相机运动又会使已访问区域离开视野，存在时空局限。
AI.method: ECHO 使用预训练事件编码器解释帧间视觉特征变化；回顾模块以过去事件流保存夹爪轨迹，作为可寻址的离相机上下文；前瞻模块引入可学习事件预见查询，并监督其预测未来动作的事件窗口，使策略能预测即将发生的场景变化。
AI.result: 在腕部-only RLBench 任务中，正常光照下 ECHO 分别比 RGB 和 RGB+事件基线高 20.6 和 12.0 个百分点；严重曝光下降时高 14.6 和 11.3 个百分点，并超过使用第三人称相机的 RGB 参考。真实世界腕部事件相机实验表明，在正常和严重暗光下，ECHO 在多个任务上优于 RGB-only 和 RGB+事件基线。
AI.conclusion: ECHO 通过事件增强的回顾与前瞻机制缓解腕部事件观测的时空局限，显著提升操作策略在极端曝光与暗光条件下的鲁棒性和表现。

title: When Does Geometric View Synthesis Help Wine Label Retrieval? A Public One-Shot Benchmark Across Self-Supervised and Vision-Language Backbones
summary: Geometric view synthesis can expand a single wine-label photograph into a training set, but its value with pretrained image encoders is unclear. We study this on a public WineSensed-derived benchmark of 1,000 classes, one enrollment photograph per class, and 4,295 real queries. With the earlier DINO vision transformer (ViT-S/16) recipe, geometric views raise top-1 accuracy from 34.1% to 62.6-63.7%, about three times the gain from two-dimensional (2D) augmentation. Frozen SigLIP 2-B already reaches 94.7%. A linear head over its frozen features gains 1.2-1.3 percentage points with the two geometric pipelines localized by the Segment Anything Model (SAM), while the other pipelines gain an inconclusive 0.3-0.6 points. Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) and validation-selected full fine-tuning show no clear gain within the reported confidence intervals; fixed-budget full fine-tuning loses 9-24 points. SAM localization supplies all six views for 99% of sources, compared with 43% for the edge-based front end. Recognition differences between the two cylinder constructions depend on the training recipe and are confounded by their crop and canvas conventions. Rendered-cylinder tests show different responses to source tilt, but an uncalibrated rim-ratio proxy establishes no corresponding trend in recognition on real photographs. An author-confirmed audit of 50 residual errors identifies 21 query-enrollment appearance mismatches, without establishing an irreducible error rate. These results support geometric synthesis for the tested self-supervised recipe and a smaller benefit through frozen-feature adaptation of the text-supervised encoder.

AI.tldr: 本文在基于 WineSensed 的公开基准（1000 类、每类 1 张注册照片、4295 条真实查询）上研究几何视图合成对预训练图像编码器的价值：对 DINO ViT-S/16 大幅提效，对冻结的 SigLIP 2-B 仅带来小幅增益。
AI.motivation: 几何视图合成可将单张酒标照片扩展为训练集，但它在搭配预训练图像编码器时是否仍有价值尚不明确，作者希望系统评估其实际收益。
AI.method: 在 1000 类酒标基准上，对比几何视图合成与二维增强；使用 DINO ViT-S/16 与 SigLIP 2-B 等编码器；采用 SAM 定位与边缘前端生成视图；测试线性头、LoRA、验证集选择的完全微调与固定预算完全微调；并以渲染圆柱体与 rim-ratio 代理进行真实性检验，辅以 50 例残差错误的人工审计。
AI.result: DINO 配方下 top-1 从 34.1% 提升至 62.6–63.7%，约为二维增强增益的 3 倍；冻结 SigLIP 2-B 已达 94.7%，线性头在 SAM 定位的两条几何流水线上再增 1.2–1.3 个百分点，其余流水线仅 0.3–0.6 个点且不具决定性；LoRA 与验证选择的完全微调在置信区间内无明确增益，固定预算完全微调反而下降 9–24 个点；SAM 对 99% 源图能提供全部六视图，边缘前端仅 43%；两种圆柱构造差异受裁剪与画布约定混淆；rim-ratio 代理未在真实照片识别上呈现相应趋势；50 例残差错误中 21 例为查询-注册外观不匹配。
AI.conclusion: 几何合成对所测试的自监督配方（DINO）确有显著价值，对文本监督编码器（SigLIP 2-B）经冻结特征适配仅有较小收益；无法确认不可约错误率，圆柱构造与倾斜等效应需在更严格控制下进一步验证。

title: PulseQuant: Propagation-Guided Subspace Correction for 4-Bit Video Diffusion Transformers
summary: Quantization errors in video diffusion transformers can be amplified or attenuated by subsequent denoising updates, making local reconstruction error an incomplete predictor of final impact. We introduce PulseQuant, a 4-bit post-training quantization method that combines trajectory sensitivity with activation geometry to guide offline calibration. Isolated block--step interventions estimate propagation risk, which prioritizes sensitive trajectory states during row-radius selection. With these radii fixed, response-subspace correction uses neighboring-code edits to reduce residual components along dominant activation directions. Both stages preserve the original 4-bit weight representation. Controlled interventions show that short-horizon propagated error predicts final latent error more reliably than immediate block-output error, supporting calibration beyond local reconstruction objectives. Evaluations on Wan models, Self Forcing, and MiniMax-H3 demonstrate improvements in key consistency and dense-reference metrics while remaining competitive on other attributes across model scales and generation paradigms.

AI.tldr: 提出PulseQuant，一种4比特训练后量化方法，针对视频扩散Transformer，将轨迹敏感性与激活几何结合指导离线校准，在多个模型上提升关键一致性及密集参考指标。
AI.motivation: 视频扩散Transformer中的量化误差会被后续去噪更新放大或衰减，因此局部重建误差无法完整预测最终影响，需要超越局部重建目标的校准方法。
AI.method: PulseQuant结合轨迹敏感性与激活几何进行离线校准：通过孤立的块-步干预估计传播风险，在行半径选择中优先处理敏感轨迹状态；固定半径后，用响应子空间校正通过邻码编辑减少沿主导激活方向的残差分量，且两阶段均保持原始4比特权重表示。
AI.result: 受控干预表明，短时程传播误差比即时块输出误差更能可靠预测最终潜变量误差；在Wan模型、Self Forcing和MiniMax-H3上评估，关键一致性与密集参考指标提升，其他属性保持竞争力，跨模型规模和生成范式有效。
AI.conclusion: 量化校准应基于传播后的误差而非局部重建误差，PulseQuant通过轨迹敏感性与响应子空间校正有效提升视频扩散Transformer的4比特量化性能。

title: The Error You See Is Not the Error You Made: Progression-aware Reasoning Origin for Reasoning Error Localization
summary: Verifying multi-step LLM reasoning requires more than determining whether a trace is correct: a useful verifier should identify where the reasoning first goes wrong. However, existing holistic methods provide little positional evidence, while forward sequential verification often treats the first rejected step as the error source. Under error propagation, this assumption can fail, since an earlier mistake may remain locally plausible and become observable only through its downstream consequences. We therefore rethink reasoning verification as a progression-aware error-source localization problem: rather than asking only where a reasoning trace first appears inconsistent, we ask which earlier step best explains how that inconsistency emerges along the trajectory. Based on this view, we propose Progression-aware Reasoning Origin (PRO), a training-free framework for first-error localization. PRO jointly models incoming support from the preceding context and outgoing compatibility with subsequent reasoning, selectively refines regions where these signals disagree, and finally performs detector-conditioned source attribution with intervention-based evidence to distinguish the true error origin from its propagated manifestations. We further formalize the gap between forward rejection and structural exposure, showing why incoming-side evidence alone is insufficient for reliable localization under error propagation. Experiments across open-form, medical, and structured reasoning tasks demonstrate consistent improvements over strong verification baselines, supporting progression-aware source attribution as a more faithful formulation of reasoning verification.

AI.tldr: 该论文将多步LLM推理验证重新定义为“进展感知的首错溯源”问题，并提出无需训练的PRO框架，用于定位推理轨迹中真正导致后续不一致的早期错误步骤。
AI.motivation: 现有整体验证方法难以给出错误位置，而前向顺序验证常把第一个被拒绝的步骤当作错误源；但在错误传播下，早期错误可能局部看似合理，只有通过后续后果才显现，因此需要区分真正错误源与其传播表现。
AI.method: PRO联合建模来自前文上下文的“入向支持”与与后续推理的“出向兼容性”，在二者信号不一致的区域进行选择性细化，并通过基于干预的证据进行检测器条件下的错误源归因，以区分真实错误起源和传播表现；同时形式化前向拒绝与结构性暴露之间的差距。
AI.result: 在开放式、医学和结构化推理任务上，PRO相比强验证基线取得一致的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 进展感知的错误源归因是更忠实的推理验证表述，能够更可靠地定位错误起源，而仅依赖前向拒绝或入向证据在错误传播下并不充分。

title: What Makes World Action Models Generalize? An Empirical Study of Test-Time Future Modeling
summary: World action models (WAMs) predict the future alongside actions during \emph{training}. Due to the heavy computation cost of video denoising, whether the future must still be generated during \emph{inference} is disputed: Explicit WAMs denoise it into clean frames along with every action chunk, whereas Latent WAMs discard it entirely for acceleration. We find that latent WAMs, despite matching explicit ones on in-distribution tasks, fail to retain the generalization benefits that originally motivated WAMs. To demonstrate this, we evaluate generalization along three axes: \emph{environmental perturbation}, \emph{data efficiency}, and \emph{task generalization}. Controlled comparisons with a matched backbone, training data, and budget reveal consistent degradation across all three axes when the action expert no longer conditions on future representations. Further analysis shows that the gap arises almost entirely from the first denoising step: the benefit comes from \emph{preparing} the future, not \emph{generating} it. We therefore propose \textbf{Simple-WAM}, which simplifies future modeling into a single forward pass of fully noised video tokens and adapts the training-time noise schedule to this inference behavior. Across simulation and real-world tasks, Simple-WAM achieves the best of both worlds, leading explicit WAMs in generalization performance with efficiency comparable to Latent WAMs. Project Page: \href{https://zrporz.github.io/Simple-WAM-Web/}{\textcolor{panton}{\texttt{https://zrporz.github.io/Simple-WAM-Web}}}

AI.tldr: 论文研究世界动作模型（WAM）在推理阶段是否必须生成未来视频。作者发现，隐式WAM虽能加速推理，却会丧失WAM原本带来的泛化优势；并提出Simple-WAM，用单次前向传播处理完全加噪的视频token，在保持高效的同时恢复泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 显式WAM在推理时去噪生成未来帧，计算开销大；隐式WAM直接丢弃未来以加速。但隐式WAM是否仍保留WAM的泛化收益尚不清楚，这促使作者系统评估未来表示对泛化的作用。
AI.method: 在匹配骨干网络、训练数据和计算预算的条件下，对比显式与隐式WAM，并从环境扰动、数据效率、任务泛化三个维度评估泛化。进一步分析去噪步骤，定位性能差距来源，进而提出Simple-WAM：将未来建模简化为对完全加噪视频token的单次前向传播，并调整训练时噪声调度以适配推理行为。
AI.result: 隐式WAM在分布内任务上与显式WAM相当，但在环境扰动、数据效率和任务泛化三方面均一致退化；性能差距几乎完全来自首个去噪步骤，说明收益主要来自“准备未来”而非“生成未来”。Simple-WAM在仿真和真实任务中取得最佳平衡，泛化性能超过显式WAM，效率与隐式WAM相当。
AI.conclusion: 推理时无需完整生成未来视频；关键在于对未来表示进行轻量准备。Simple-WAM通过单次前向传播和噪声调度适配，兼顾了显式WAM的泛化优势与隐式WAM的推理效率。

title: A mechanistic study of language model introspection
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can sometimes report perturbations to their internal activations---even when the input provides no evidence that an intervention occurred. How do models detect and localize such internal changes? We study this question using a controlled task that keeps the input text fixed. We either inject a concept vector into the hidden state at one of ten token positions or apply no intervention. The model is asked to identify the perturbed position or report that no intervention occurred. Across three model families, we identify two small groups of attention heads with distinct roles in introspective reporting. Middle-layer gate heads influence whether the model reports a change, while router heads in a later layer help select the position to report. Interventions on gate heads can suppress position reports even when router heads supply location information. We further examine why reporting accuracy varies across concepts. Concept vectors that are localized more accurately produce stronger attention-score and output responses in gate heads, which is associated with better alignment of the induced key and value changes in their QK and OV computations. Together, these findings identify attention-head mechanisms supporting introspective detection and localization.

AI.tldr: 研究大语言模型如何检测并定位自身内部激活扰动，发现两类注意力头分别参与报告变化和选择位置。
AI.motivation: LLM有时能在输入没有证据表明发生干预时，仍报告内部激活扰动；其检测与定位机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 固定输入文本，在十个token位置之一注入概念向量或不干预，要求模型识别扰动位置或报告无干预；分析三个模型家族的注意力头，并考察不同概念可定位性与QK、OV计算的关系。
AI.result: 发现中层gate heads影响模型是否报告变化，后层router heads帮助选择报告位置；干预gate heads可抑制位置报告，即使router heads提供位置信息。概念向量定位越准，gate heads的注意力分数和输出响应越强，并与QK/OV中key-value变化对齐更好相关。
AI.conclusion: 这些发现识别出支持内省检测与定位的注意力头机制。

title: From Normative Frameworks to Alignment Data: Constructing and Evaluating SFT and Preference Data
summary: Aligning language models with a specified normative framework requires translating abstract principles into concrete examples and preference signals from which models can learn. We present an expert-driven methodology for constructing such alignment data and apply it to a normative framework grounded in Islamic ethical, theological, and jurisprudential traditions. Over approximately one year, seven domain experts systematically probed language models to identify alignment deficiencies, curated desired responses, and constructed preference pairs from model outputs and expert judgments. The resulting Arabic-English datasets contain approximately 2.8K supervised fine-tuning (SFT) examples and 5.4K preference pairs spanning a broad range of normative domains. We evaluate the datasets through controlled post-training experiments comparing a Baseline model with models incorporating the curated SFT data alone and both the SFT and preference data. In blind expert evaluation on 150 separately constructed prompts, the model trained with the curated SFT data was preferred over the Baseline in 51.3% of assessor judgments, compared with 14.4% in the opposite direction (p < .001 at the prompt level). Adding the preference data resulted in a smaller difference, with the model trained with both datasets preferred over the SFT model in 28.0% of judgments versus 20.9% in the opposite direction; this difference was not statistically significant at the prompt level (p = .166). Standard Arabic and English benchmarks show no broad degradation in general-purpose capabilities. These results demonstrate how expert-defined normative principles can be systematically operationalized into alignment data and evaluated through controlled model training.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种专家驱动的方法，将伊斯兰伦理、神学与法学传统等规范框架转化为对齐数据，并通过受控训练实验评估其效果。
AI.motivation: 使语言模型与特定规范框架对齐，需要把抽象原则转化为模型可学习的具体示例和偏好信号，但如何系统构建此类对齐数据仍具挑战。
AI.method: 七位领域专家历时约一年，系统探测语言模型的对齐缺陷，整理理想回复，并基于模型输出与专家判断构建偏好对。最终形成阿拉伯语-英语数据集，包含约2.8K条SFT样本和5.4K个偏好对。通过对比基线模型、仅使用SFT数据的模型、以及同时使用SFT和偏好数据的模型进行受控后训练实验，并在150个独立构造的提示上进行盲评专家评估。
AI.result: 在盲评专家判断中，仅使用SFT数据的模型相比基线被偏好比例为51.3%，相反方向为14.4%，在提示层面显著（p < .001）。加入偏好数据后，同时使用两类数据的模型相比仅SFT模型被偏好比例为28.0%，相反方向为20.9%，差异在提示层面不显著（p = .166）。标准阿拉伯语和英语基准未显示通用能力广泛退化。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明，专家定义的规范原则可以被系统操作化为对齐数据，并通过受控模型训练进行评估；SFT数据带来显著改进，偏好数据增益有限但未损害通用能力。

title: SciGen-Verifier: A Multimodal Reasoner for Explainable Verification in Scientific Image Generation
summary: In realistic education, a solution is often expressed not only in words but in a drawing--a circuit, a geometric construction, a function plot--and a teacher must grade the drawing as carefully as the text. Recent advances in unified multimodal models have enabled scientific image generation, yet verifying the correctness of these specialized visual outputs remains a critical bottleneck: errors often arise from intricate domain knowledge, structural reasoning, and multi-step instruction rather than surface-level artifacts. Existing verifiers mainly target natural images and compress judgement into scalar scores, leaving scientific coverage and explainable feedback for error correction underexplored. To bridge this gap, we make three main contributions. (1) We construct SciGen-Verify, a benchmark dedicated to explainable verification of scientific image generation, spanning instruction following, multidisciplinary reasoning, and world knowledge domains. It contains a three-tier hierarchical protocol over the binary judgement, supporting explanation, and corrective editing instruction. (2) We develop SciGen-Verifier, a reasoning-driven multimodal verifier trained via cold-start supervised fine-tuning followed by a curriculum-based two-stage reinforcement learning pipeline. The rubric-guided process rewards first strengthen scientific reasoning exploration and outcome rewards subsequently align output with ground-truth annotation. (3) On SciGen-Verify, SciGen-Verifier achieves competitive performance against much larger proprietary models. It further serves as a practical online critic for iterative image rectification.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对科学图像生成正确性验证的瓶颈，构建了可解释验证基准 SciGen-Verify，并提出推理驱动的多模态验证器 SciGen-Verifier，通过冷启动监督微调与课程式两阶段强化学习训练，在基准上取得与更大专有模型相当的性能，并可作为在线批评器迭代修正图像。
AI.motivation: 现实教育中图形（电路、几何作图、函数图像）与文字同等重要，教师需仔细批改；统一多模态模型虽已能生成科学图像，但其正确性验证仍是关键瓶颈，错误常源于复杂领域知识、结构推理与多步指令而非表面伪影。现有验证器主要面向自然图像且仅输出标量分数，科学覆盖与可解释纠错反馈尚未充分探索。
AI.method: 论文有三项贡献：(1) 构建 SciGen-Verify 基准，用于科学图像生成的可解释验证，覆盖指令遵循、多学科推理与世界知识领域，并在二值判断之上设计三层级协议：支持性解释与纠正性编辑指令。(2) 提出 SciGen-Verifier，一个推理驱动的多模态验证器，训练流程为冷启动监督微调后接课程式两阶段强化学习；其中评分标准引导的过程奖励先增强科学推理探索，结果奖励再使输出对齐真实标注。(3) 在 SciGen-Verify 上评估，并作为在线批评器用于迭代图像修正。
AI.result: SciGen-Verifier 在 SciGen-Verify 基准上取得了与规模更大的专有模型相竞争的性能，并能作为实用的在线批评器支持迭代图像修正。
AI.conclusion: 该工作通过 SciGen-Verify 基准与 SciGen-Verifier 验证器，弥补了科学图像生成验证在科学覆盖与可解释反馈方面的不足，验证了推理驱动多模态验证器在科学图像生成验证与迭代修正中的有效性。

title: Agentic Multi-Turn Reasoning: A Fairness Approach
summary: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have enabled agentic systems capable of solving complex tasks through multi-turn planning, tool use, verification, and memory updates. However, learning agentic systems remains difficult due to two fundamental challenges, i.e., (1) long-horizon credit assignment, where supervision is available only at the final outcome, and (2) imbalanced data distributions, where dominant data patterns bias optimization and weaken adaptation to rare but informative reasoning behaviors. In this paper, we propose Fair Multi-Level Preference Optimization (Fair-MPO or $Φ$-MPO), a new preference optimization framework for agentic learning. We first show that Multi-Level Preference Optimization provides a principled and more computationally efficient framework for long-horizon reasoning. Then, we introduce a Fair Multi-Level Objective that addresses imbalance in agentic learning. We provide a comprehensive theoretical analysis demonstrating that our approach addresses both long-horizon reasoning and data imbalance. Our experiments on agentic reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that our approach achieves State-of-the-Art (SOTA) performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出公平多级偏好优化（Fair-MPO / Φ-MPO），一种面向智能体学习的偏好优化框架，通过多级偏好优化与公平多级目标解决长时程信用分配和数据分布不平衡问题，并在智能体推理基准上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体系统虽能通过多轮规划、工具使用、验证与记忆更新解决复杂任务，但其学习面临两大挑战：(1) 长时程信用分配，监督信号仅来自最终结果；(2) 数据分布不平衡，主导模式会偏置优化，削弱对稀有但重要推理行为的适应能力。
AI.method: 提出Fair Multi-Level Preference Optimization（Fair-MPO / Φ-MPO）框架。首先证明多级偏好优化为长时程推理提供有原则且计算更高效的框架；进而引入公平多级目标（Fair Multi-Level Objective）以应对智能体学习中的不平衡问题；并给出全面的理论分析。
AI.result: 理论分析表明该方法能同时解决长时程推理与数据不平衡问题；在智能体推理基准上的实验证明其达到最先进（SOTA）性能。
AI.conclusion: Fair-MPO通过多级偏好优化与公平多级目标，有效应对智能体学习中的长时程信用分配与数据分布不平衡挑战，并在智能体推理任务上实现SOTA表现。

title: Understanding On-Policy Distillation: A Mechanistic Interpretability Perspective via Sparse Crosscoders
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) is a widely adopted post-training technique for LLM reasoning. It is commonly believed to transfer knowledge from a stronger teacher, yet what OPD actually distills into the student's internal representations remains unclear. We study this question with sparse crosscoders, which learn one feature dictionary shared by the student before and after OPD and the teacher. Standard crosscoder analyses, however, identify model-specific features but cannot tell how a model's use of its features changes, since all models are encoded into one set of feature activations. We therefore propose the swap readout, which reads each student checkpoint's feature activations on its own, measuring how training changes the student's use of each feature, even for checkpoints unseen by the crosscoder. Across three OPD settings, we find that OPD neither creates features nor passes on the teacher's own, and leaves the firing rates of over 98% of the student's frequently used features within 20%. We further examine the SFT warm-up on the teacher's rollouts that commonly precedes OPD and makes it more effective. Rather than adding features, the warm-up reweights the shared ones in two ways. First, it already raises and lowers many of the features that OPD later raises and lowers, doing part of OPD's work in advance. Second, it changes features that OPD alone would not, notably those for conversation format, reasoning style, and mathematical notation, and these changes persist through OPD. Imposing this reweighting on a directly distilled student's features, without changing its weights, brings its accuracy close to that of the warmed-up student, whereas the same change on shuffled features does not. Together, these findings suggest that OPD reweights existing features rather than acquiring new ones: the student learns from the teacher how to use the features they already share.

AI.tldr: 本文利用稀疏交叉编码器与提出的swap readout方法，研究LLM推理中on-policy蒸馏（OPD）究竟将教师知识蒸馏到学生内部表征的哪些方面。
AI.motivation: OPD被广泛用于LLM推理后训练，通常被认为能从更强教师迁移知识，但OPD实际在学生内部表征中蒸馏了什么尚不清楚。
AI.method: 使用稀疏交叉编码器学习学生OPD前后与教师共享的特征字典；提出swap readout，独立读取每个学生检查点的特征激活，衡量训练如何改变学生对特征的使用。
AI.result: 在三种OPD设置下，OPD既不创造新特征也不传递教师自身特征，并使超过98%高频使用特征激活率变化在20%以内；SFT预热会重新加权共享特征：提前完成部分OPD的升降，并改变对话格式、推理风格、数学符号等OPD不会改变的特征且持续到OPD后；对直接蒸馏学生施加该重加权可在不改权重下接近预热学生准确率，而打乱特征后无效。
AI.conclusion: OPD主要是重新加权学生已有特征，而非获取新特征：学生向教师学习如何使用它们已共享的特征。

title: JRDB-AVR: An Active Visual Reasoning Benchmark for Embodied Agents in Real-World Environments
summary: In complex embodied visual reasoning scenarios, an agent often has only a limited field of view, and the evidence needed to answer a question may be distributed across time, viewpoint, and interacting objects. A model may therefore give a plausible answer without ever observing the relevant object, time, or view that supports it. Current visual reasoning benchmarks largely evaluate passive observations and final answers, overlooking settings that require active reasoning and evidence acquisition. We introduce JRDB-AVR, a benchmark derived from existing real-world JRDB robotics data through a structured question-generation engine that turns this gap into an explicit evaluation: an embodied agentic system receives a visual reasoning question, requests bounded observations by timestamp and viewing angle, and is evaluated on both the final answer and the grounded visual evidence supporting it. The benchmark contains diverse questions over multiple real-world environments involving temporal search, viewpoint selection, and human-oriented compositional reasoning. We also introduce JRDB-AVR-Agent, a reference active reasoning agentic method that maintains an explicit observation-grounded graph-based world model and answers through solving. Experiments reveal a substantial gap between answer accuracy and evidence accuracy in current baselines, showing that current VLMs can produce unsupported correct answers and that active evidence-aware evaluation is necessary for embodied visual reasoning. Code and benchmark are available at https://github.com/ControlNet/JRDB-AVR.

AI.tldr: 提出JRDB-AVR基准，用于评估具身智能体在有限视野下主动获取视觉证据并进行推理的能力，同时考察最终答案和支撑证据；并给出参考智能体JRDB-AVR-Agent。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉推理基准多评估被动观察和最终答案，忽略了智能体需主动获取证据的场景。在真实具身场景中，智能体视野有限，证据常分布于时间、视角和交互对象中，模型可能给出看似合理但缺乏观察证据支持的答案。
AI.method: 基于真实世界JRDB机器人数据，通过结构化问题生成引擎构建基准。智能体接收视觉推理问题后，可按时间戳和视角请求有限观察，评估同时考虑最终答案和所依据的视觉证据。同时提出JRDB-AVR-Agent参考方法，维护显式的观察图世界模型并通过求解回答问题。
AI.result: 实验显示当前基线在答案准确率与证据准确率之间存在显著差距，表明当前视觉语言模型可能产生无证据支持的正确答案。
AI.conclusion: 主动的、证据感知的评估对于具身视觉推理是必要的。

title: ActionUNet: Improving Robustness of VLA Models with Efficient Multi-scale Fine-tuning
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown great promise for robotic manipulation by mapping multi-modal semantics to physical actions. However, this mapping inherently struggles to align these coarse-grained semantics with fine-grained temporal execution. It leaves VLA models with limited generalization and insufficient robustness in cluttered environments. To overcome this issue, we propose ActionUNet, an efficient multi-scale fine-tuning framework that enhances pre-trained VLA models with minimal computational cost. ActionUNet first constructs a lightweight temporal U-Net within the temporal-aligned action feature space to fuse hierarchical structural priors, effectively bridging the scale gap between semantics and temporal executions. Recognizing that multi-scale modeling can disrupt microscopic temporal continuity and cause mechanical oscillations, ActionUNet then employs a conditional SIREN as a continuous action decoder. Equipped with explicit second-order smoothness constraints, this decoder guarantees temporal continuity and reduces high-frequency motion jitter. By smoothing temporal discontinuities from multi-scale fusion, this continuous formulation reduces mechanical execution failures while preserving the base VLA model's generalization and manipulation robustness. Extensive experiments on RoboTwin 2.0 and LIBERO-Plus benchmarks, together with real-world hard evaluations, demonstrate that ActionUNet significantly improves π0.5 success rates by absolute 9.8%, 6.1%, and 11.4%, respectively, while also generalizing to the regression-based OpenVLA-OFT backbone, highlighting its effectiveness and efficiency as a fine-tuning strategy. Code and implementation details are available at https://github.com/Di-Zhu123/ActionUNet.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ActionUNet，一种高效的多尺度微调框架，用于增强预训练VLA模型。它通过轻量级时序U-Net融合层次结构先验，并采用带二阶平滑约束的条件SIREN连续动作解码器，在保持泛化性的同时显著提升操作成功率，且计算成本低。
AI.motivation: VLA模型虽能将多模态语义映射为物理动作，但难以将粗粒度语义与细粒度时序执行对齐，导致在杂乱环境中泛化能力有限、鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: ActionUNet在时序对齐的动作特征空间内构建轻量级时序U-Net以融合层次结构先验，弥合语义与时序执行间的尺度差距；并采用条件SIREN作为连续动作解码器，结合显式二阶平滑约束，保证时序连续性并减少高频运动抖动，从而降低机械执行失败。
AI.result: 在RoboTwin 2.0、LIBERO-Plus基准及真实世界困难评估中，ActionUNet将π0.5的成功率分别绝对提升9.8%、6.1%和11.4%，并可泛化至基于回归的OpenVLA-OFT骨干网络。
AI.conclusion: ActionUNet是一种有效且高效的微调策略，通过平滑多尺度融合带来的时序不连续性，在减少机械执行失败的同时保持了基础VLA模型的泛化性和操作鲁棒性。

title: Groupwise Selective State-Space Filtering for Accurate and Streaming Action Boundary Detection
summary: Action boundary detection partitions untrimmed video into intervals without assigning action classes. We present a boundary-detection adapter operating on pre-extracted video features, learning temporal representations via groupwise selective scans. Learned group fusion and temporal modeling convert these into transition scores, which are decoded into boundary timestamps. Trained with boundary-time supervision, the class-agnostic model is evaluated on Breakfast, GTEA, and 50Salads using temporal tolerances and bipartite matching, achieving boundary $F_1$ scores of 0.457, 0.622, and 0.611. A stateful variant enables feature-streaming inference with zero neural look-ahead, one-sample peak confirmation, and bounded memory. Downstream systems can subsequently assign s

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种动作边界检测适配器，在预提取视频特征上学习时序表示，将视频划分为无类别动作区间，并给出边界时间戳；在三个数据集上取得边界F1分数，并支持流式推理。
AI.motivation: 动作边界检测需要将未裁剪视频划分为区间但不分配动作类别，现有方法可能依赖端到端视频建模或难以支持流式、低延迟推理，因此需要一种基于预提取特征、类别无关且可用于下游系统的边界检测方法。
AI.method: 在预提取视频特征上构建边界检测适配器，通过分组选择性扫描学习时序表示；使用学习到的组融合和时序建模生成转移分数；将转移分数解码为边界时间戳；采用边界时间监督训练类别无关模型；评估时使用时间容差和二分匹配，并设计有状态变体实现特征流式推理。
AI.result: 在Breakfast、GTEA和50Salads数据集上，边界F1分数分别为0.457、0.622和0.611；有状态变体支持零神经前瞻、单样本峰值确认和有界内存的特征流式推理。
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够以类别无关方式有效检测动作边界，并在多个数据集上取得有竞争力的结果；其流式变体适合低延迟在线场景，且检测出的边界可供下游系统进一步分配动作类别。

title: PhysAlign: A Benchmark for Evidence-Grounded Role Alignment in Multimodal Physics Reasoning
summary: A key challenge in physics diagram understanding is correctly associating visual information with the physical entities, relations, and conditions it describes. Even when a value, symbol, or other local element is accurately recognized, assigning it to the wrong entity or scope can distort the underlying physical premise and lead to incorrect reasoning. To systematically study this challenge, we introduce \textbf{PhysAlign}, a benchmark designed to assess whether multimodal models correctly associate information recognized from physics diagrams with its intended physical role. By disentangling visual recognition from physical-role assignment through localized probes and controlled variants, PhysAlign isolates correspondence errors from recognition failures. It contains 3,341 human-validated probes spanning 986 physics problems, enabling systematic evaluation of visual recognition and physical-role correspondence at scale. We further introduce five complementary evaluation metrics, including CAcc, GAcc, and JAcc, which provide a comprehensive assessment of models' ability to recognize diagram content, establish correct physical correspondences, and solve the underlying physics problem. Across our evaluated multimodal models, PhysAlign reveals a consistent gap between local visual recognition and physical-role grounding. Even when the queried content is correctly recognized, the conditional correspondence error rate remains 13.8\% for GPT-6-Astra and rises to about 50.6\% for InternVL3.5-8B. These findings indicate that strong perception alone does not ensure reliable physical interpretation, exposing a distinct grounding bottleneck that is largely hidden by answer-level accuracy and highlighting the need for future models to better align recognized visual evidence with its physical meaning.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了PhysAlign基准，用于评估多模态模型在物理图表理解中能否正确地将视觉信息与物理实体、关系和条件关联。通过局部探针和受控变体解耦视觉识别与物理角色分配，包含3341个人工验证探针，覆盖986个物理问题。
AI.motivation: 物理图表理解中的关键挑战是正确关联视觉信息与物理实体、关系和条件。即使局部元素被准确识别，若分配到错误的实体或范围也会扭曲物理前提导致错误推理。现有评估多关注答案级准确率，掩盖了这种对应错误。
AI.method: 引入PhysAlign基准，通过局部探针和受控变体解耦视觉识别与物理角色分配，隔离对应错误与识别失败。构建3341个人工验证探针，覆盖986个物理问题。提出五个互补评估指标，包括CAcc、GAcc、JAcc，分别评估模型识别图表内容、建立正确物理对应和解决物理问题的能力。
AI.result: 评估多模态模型发现，局部视觉识别与物理角色grounding之间存在一致差距。即使查询内容被正确识别，条件对应错误率在GPT-6-Astra上仍为13.8%，在InternVL3.5-8B上高达约50.6%。
AI.conclusion: 强感知能力并不保证可靠的物理解释，存在一个被答案级准确率 largely 隐藏的 grounding 瓶颈，未来模型需要更好地将识别出的视觉证据与其物理意义对齐。

title: ANTMAN: Adaptive Need Tracking for Multi-Agent Navigation in Large Information Spaces
summary: Information-seeking agents increasingly operate over information spaces that are too large to process exhaustively. Yet many multi-agent systems organize computation around static partitions of the available space, causing coordination to grow with how information is segmented rather than with what the query still requires. We introduce ANTMAN, an adaptive coordination framework that treats evolving unresolved information needs as the unit of runtime coordination. ANTMAN maintains a revisable Need Graph that tracks unresolved requirements, accumulated evidence, prior attempts, and search progress, and uses this state to control worker selection, routing, and task-local recovery as new evidence is discovered. By separating the coordination policy from substrate-specific search interfaces, the same need-conditioned mechanism can operate across different information spaces. Experiments across multi-document question answering, controlled long-context scaling, and realistic structured navigation show that ANTMAN remains effective across settings, including when execution is delegated to substantially smaller worker models. Under a 16x increase in searchable context, ANTMAN increases active coordination by only 1.23x, compared with more than 15x for partition-driven baselines, while preserving strong answer quality.

AI.tldr: ANTMAN是一个自适应协调框架，将未解决的信息需求作为运行时协调单元，通过可修订的需求图动态调控多智能体信息搜索，显著提升大规模信息空间下的扩展效率。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统基于静态空间划分组织计算，导致协调开销随信息分割方式增长，而非随查询剩余需求变化，在信息空间过大时效率低下。
AI.method: 提出ANTMAN框架，维护可修订的Need Graph追踪未解决需求、累积证据、先前尝试和搜索进度；基于此状态控制工作者选择、路由和任务局部恢复；将协调策略与底层搜索接口分离，实现跨信息空间的通用机制。
AI.result: 在多文档问答、受控长上下文扩展和结构化导航实验中，ANTMAN均有效，即使使用更小的工作者模型；搜索上下文增加16倍时，活跃协调仅增加1.23倍，而分区驱动基线增加超过15倍，同时保持强答案质量。
AI.conclusion: ANTMAN通过需求驱动的自适应协调，解决了静态分区导致的协调开销随信息分割增长的问题，在大规模信息空间中实现高效扩展和稳定性能。

title: SignFLIP: A Unified Model for Sign Language Translation and Generation via Stage-wise Alignment at Scale
summary: Sign language translation and generation share the goal of bidirectional alignment between text and sign representations. However, existing approaches either treat them as isolated tasks or are only verified on limited datasets, limiting effective modeling between modalities. In this paper, we propose SignFLIP, a unified LLM-centered framework for translation and generation. To enable bidirectional mapping between text and sign, SignFLIP adopts a symmetric architecture together with a stage-wise training strategy built on large-scale data. The shared sign--text representation is progressively refined: pre-alignment facilitates subsequent SLT, while the SLT-adapted representation further benefits SLG. Extensive experiments on multiple benchmarks show that SignFLIP shows competitive performance compared with task-specific models on both translation and generation tasks, as well as strong transferability to sign language recognition.

AI.tldr: 提出 SignFLIP，一个以 LLM 为中心的统一框架，用于手语翻译（SLT）和手语生成（SLG），并在多基准上验证其性能与迁移能力。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常将手语翻译和生成视为孤立任务，或仅在有限数据集上验证，限制了文本与手语模态之间的有效双向建模。
AI.method: SignFLIP 采用对称架构和大规模数据上的分阶段训练策略；通过预对齐学习共享的手语-文本表示，再用于提升 SLT，并进一步利用 SLT 适配后的表示促进 SLG。
AI.result: 在多个基准上的实验表明，SignFLIP 在翻译和生成任务上均能媲美任务专用模型，并对 手语识别 具有较强的迁移能力。
AI.conclusion: 统一的 LLM 框架能够有效支持文本与手语之间的双向对齐，并在翻译、生成及识别迁移任务上展现良好效果。

title: VaME: Exploring Variational Latent Reasoning for Multimodal Embeddings
summary: Universal multimodal retrieval requires compact embeddings that preserve task-relevant semantic information across diverse modalities. Prior works have incorporated latent reasoning into multimodal embedding learning to refine this information before embedding extraction. However, most existing approaches remain confined to deterministic latent paths, without exploring alternative trajectories to discover better embeddings. Thus, we propose VaME (Variational Multimodal Embeddings), a framework that models latent reasoning as a learnable distribution over trajectories. Specifically, we first introduce Variational Latent Reasoning (VLR) to enable autoregressive exploration in latent space, guided by answer reconstruction through a lightweight decoder. Meanwhile, we augment the original embedding-token readout with a latent-fused embedding to facilitate exploration during subsequent reinforcement learning. Finally, we optimize latent reasoning over stochastic variational trajectories through reinforcement learning, using Semantic Decoding Reward (SDR) to favor semantically meaningful trajectories with interpretable decoded outcomes. On the 78-task MMEB-V2 benchmark, spanning image, video, and visual-document retrieval, VaME outperforms most explicit CoT-based models and all latent-reasoning baselines. VaME also demonstrates robust performance on reasoning-intensive benchmarks such as MRMR, with substantial gains after reinforcement learning. Importantly, VaME achieves these gains with at least a 4.25x inference speedup over the deterministic latent autoregressive baselines. The code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 VaME 框架，将多模态嵌入中的潜在推理建模为可学习的轨迹分布，结合变分潜在推理与强化学习优化，在跨模态检索任务上取得更优性能并显著加速推理。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态嵌入学习中的潜在推理大多局限于确定性路径，未探索替代轨迹以发现更优嵌入，从而限制了检索性能。
AI.method: 1) 提出变分潜在推理 VLR，在潜在空间中进行自回归探索，并由轻量解码器通过答案重建引导；2) 在原始嵌入 token readout 上增加 latent-fused embedding，以促进后续强化学习中的探索；3) 通过强化学习优化随机变分轨迹，并使用 Semantic Decoding Reward (SDR) 偏好语义有意义、解码结果可解释的轨迹。
AI.result: 在涵盖图像、视频和视觉文档检索的 78 任务 MMEB-V2 基准上，VaME 优于大多数显式 CoT 模型和所有潜在推理基线；在 MRMR 等推理密集型基准上表现稳健，强化学习后提升显著；相比确定性潜在自回归基线，至少实现 4.25 倍推理加速。
AI.conclusion: VaME 通过变分轨迹建模与强化学习优化，实现了更强且高效的通用多模态检索，代码将公开。

title: Naturalness-guided Manifold Flow Matching for Sign Language Production
summary: Sign Language Production (SLP) aims to generate sign motions from text. Conditional Flow Matching methods have achieved strong performance in SLP by constructing conditional paths that transform a source distribution into a target distribution. However, existing methods construct these paths via linear interpolation, whereas the rotational geometry of human joints confines valid joint rotations to a manifold embedded in Euclidean space. Consequently, linear interpolation between two sign motions leaves this manifold and ignores the motion distribution on it. In this paper, we revisit SLP from the perspective of manifold transport and propose a Naturalness-guided Manifold Flow Matching framework, termed \textbf{SignNMFlow}, which constructs conditional paths directly on the motion manifold by jointly considering geometric efficiency and the motion distribution. Specifically, we exploit the intrinsic geometry of the manifold and introduce a motion naturalness measure to characterize the motion distribution. By minimizing the kinetic energy under this measure, we learn a naturalness-guided interpolation that couples a closed-form geodesic, which provides geometrically efficient transport, with a learnable deviation that incorporates the motion distribution, thereby significantly improving the fidelity of generated sign motions. Extensive qualitative and quantitative evaluations demonstrate the effectiveness of this work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 SignNMFlow，一种自然性引导的流形流匹配框架，用于手语生成（SLP），通过在运动流形上构建条件路径来提升生成手语动作的保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有基于条件流匹配的手语生成方法通常使用线性插值构建条件路径，但人体关节旋转受几何约束，有效旋转位于嵌入欧氏空间的流形上；线性插值会偏离该流形并忽略其上的运动分布。
AI.method: 从流形传输视角重新审视手语生成，提出自然性引导的流形流匹配框架 SignNMFlow。利用流形内在几何，引入运动自然性度量刻画运动分布，并通过最小化该度量下的动能，学习一种自然性引导插值：将提供几何高效传输的闭式测地线与可学习偏差相结合，以融入运动分布。
AI.result: 大量定性与定量评估表明该方法有效，能够显著提升生成手语动作的保真度。
AI.conclusion: 在运动流形上直接构建条件路径，并联合考虑几何效率与运动分布，可有效改进手语生成中的流匹配建模。

title: Resolving State-Representation Mismatch: State-Space Visual Reasoning for Open-Loop VLA Planning
summary: Despite rapid progress in vision-language-action (VLA) models, existing reasoning paradigms still face a fundamental \emph{state-representation mismatch} in open-loop planning. Given only an initial observation, models must internally simulate action-conditioned state transitions, whereas text-, pixel-, and latent-space reasoning can suffer from lossy spatial compression, error-accumulating visual generation, and bypass of intermediate latent tokens, respectively, undermining reliable long-horizon planning. We propose \textbf{State-Space Visual Reasoning} (SSVR), which decouples static visual context, language constraints, and a recurrent latent state. SSVR encodes the initial image and instruction once, then conditions each action prediction on the latent state and updates it with an action-conditioned GRU. Using Qwen2.5-VL as the backbone, SSVR achieves 99.5/99.6, 96.3/98.0, and 83.9/90.6 EM/PR on FrozenLake, Maze, and MiniBehavior, substantially outperforming prior methods. Extensive experiments support the effectiveness of recurrent state modeling for VLA open-loop planning across input transformations and transfer settings. By reusing static visual-textual context and updating a compact recurrent state, SSVR supports efficient multi-step inference, achieving up to $98.58\times$ faster Maze decoding rollouts than the evaluated baselines with the prefix cache prebuilt.

AI.tldr: 论文提出状态空间视觉推理（SSVR），通过解耦静态视觉上下文、语言约束和循环潜在状态，提升VLA模型在开环规划中的长时程推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型在开环规划中存在状态表示不匹配问题：仅给定初始观测时，模型需内部模拟动作条件状态转移，但文本、像素和潜在空间推理分别面临空间压缩有损、视觉生成误差累积、跳过中间潜在token等问题，影响可靠的长时程规划。
AI.method: 提出State-Space Visual Reasoning（SSVR），将静态视觉上下文、语言约束和循环潜在状态解耦。模型一次性编码初始图像和指令，每次动作预测以潜在状态为条件，并用动作条件GRU更新该状态。以Qwen2.5-VL作为骨干网络。
AI.result: 在FrozenLake、Maze和MiniBehavior上分别达到99.5/99.6、96.3/98.0、83.9/90.6的EM/PR，显著优于此前方法。在预构建前缀缓存时，Maze解码滚动推理速度最高比评估基线快98.58倍。
AI.conclusion: 循环状态建模对VLA开环规划有效，在不同输入变换和迁移设置下均表现良好；通过复用静态视觉-文本上下文并更新紧凑循环状态，SSVR支持高效多步推理。

title: RoGSW4RLD: Feed-Forward 4D Gaussian Lifting for Robot World Model Rollouts
summary: Action-conditioned video world models predict future robot interactions from multiple cameras, yet their outputs remain disparate video collections rather than a shared metric scene queryable across viewpoints and time. While existing 4D reconstruction methods offer a path to spatialize these predictions, independently reconstructing and merging each camera stream fails to enforce cross-view consistency. This limitation is particularly detrimental when combining moving robot-mounted cameras with fixed external views. To address this, we introduce RoGSW4RLD, a feed-forward framework that lifts synchronized multi-camera rollouts into a unified, time-queryable metric 4D Gaussian field. Rather than learning a separate geometric transition model, RoGSW4RLD directly reconstructs the visual future generated by existing world models. Its core innovation is a two-stage architecture: Stage 1 jointly forms the metric 4D field by fusing cross-view evidence with robot-specific articulated geometry and kinematics, while Stage 2 refines the field's geometry and appearance while strictly preserving the initial temporal displacements. Evaluated on 256 held-out DROID episodes, RoGSW4RLD significantly outperforms camera-wise reconstruction with calibrated merging, improving novel-view PSNR by 2.15 dB, reducing depth AbsRel by 47%, and lowering robot displacement error by 61%. These robust gains extend to action-conditioned Cosmos 3 rollouts, demonstrating that predicted video futures can be successfully translated into consistent, spatially queryable 4D metric representations.

AI.tldr: 论文提出RoGSW4RLD，一个前馈框架，将同步多相机机器人交互视频提升为统一的、可时间查询的度量4D高斯场，实现跨视角一致的未来场景重建。
AI.motivation: 动作条件视频世界模型能预测机器人未来交互，但输出是多相机视频集合，而非跨视角和时间的共享度量场景。现有4D重建方法独立重建并合并各相机流，无法保证跨视角一致性，尤其当结合移动的机器人搭载相机和固定外部视角时问题更严重。
AI.method: 提出RoGSW4RLD，前馈框架。两阶段架构：阶段1通过融合跨视角证据与机器人特定铰接几何和运动学，联合构建度量4D场；阶段2在严格保持初始时间位移的同时细化场的几何和外观。直接重建现有世界模型生成的视觉未来，无需学习单独的几何转换模型。
AI.result: 在256个DROID留出片段上评估，显著优于逐相机重建加校准合并，新视角PSNR提升2.15 dB，深度AbsRel降低47%，机器人位移误差降低61%。在动作条件Cosmos 3生成结果上也取得稳健提升。
AI.conclusion: 预测的视频未来可成功转化为一致、可空间查询的4D度量表示。

title: Rubric-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation for LLM Personalization
summary: LLM personalization aims to generate responses aligned with individual users' preferences and needs. User-specific rubrics make these expectations explicit, providing direct supervision on what a satisfactory answer should cover. Existing rubric-guided approaches, however, exploit such guidance only at a coarse granularity, either by using rubrics to supervise the prediction of relevant aspects for subsequent generation or by reducing aspect coverage to a single response-level reward for reinforcement learning. This leaves a gap between specifying what a personalized answer should contain and teaching the model how to generate it. To bridge this gap, we propose GRASP, a rubric-aware on-policy self-distillation framework for LLM personalization that turns user-specific rubric aspects into fine-grained, token-level supervision. Specifically, GRASP pairs a rubric-free student with a rubric-informed teacher that additionally receives the target user-specific rubrics. By aligning their next-token distributions along on-policy trajectories generated by the student, GRASP transfers the teacher's rubric-conditioned guidance into the student, translating user-specific semantic requirements into dense token-level supervision. Since rubric-informed teachers can still produce inadequate supervision, we further introduce Rubric-based Teacher Validation (RTV), which retains only instances where the teacher sufficiently covers the target aspects, improving both supervision quality and training efficiency. Experiments on the LaMP-QA benchmark for personalized question answering demonstrate that GRASP achieves state-of-the-art performance across multiple backbones, supporting the effectiveness of rubric-guided token-level supervision for personalization. To ensure reproducibility, our code is available at https://github.com/SnowCharmQ/GRASP.

AI.tldr: 论文提出GRASP，一种评分标准感知的在线策略自蒸馏框架，将用户特定评分标准转化为细粒度的token级监督，用于大语言模型个性化。
AI.motivation: 现有评分标准引导方法仅在粗粒度上利用指导，要么用评分标准监督相关方面的预测，要么将方面覆盖压缩为强化学习的单一响应级奖励，导致“指定个性化答案应包含什么”与“教模型如何生成”之间存在鸿沟。
AI.method: GRASP配对无评分标准的学生模型与额外接收用户特定评分标准的教师模型，沿学生生成的在线策略轨迹对齐二者的下一token分布，将教师的标准条件引导迁移到学生；并引入基于评分标准的教师验证（RTV），仅保留教师充分覆盖目标方面的实例，提升监督质量与训练效率。
AI.result: 在LaMP-QA个性化问答基准上，GRASP在多个骨干模型上取得最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 实验结果支持评分标准引导的token级监督对LLM个性化任务的有效性。

title: SCBO: Semantically Coherent Batching and Ordering for LLM-Based Social Surveys
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer a scalable way to simulate survey respondents using demographic profiles and observed reference responses. However, the conventional approach of predicting one question per prompt repeatedly encodes the same context, limits each target to a narrow set of reference responses, and prevents later predictions from using information in earlier answers. Predicting multiple questions in one prompt can reduce these costs, share a broader pool of references, and let later predictions build on earlier ones. This requires forming coherent batches, selecting shared references, and ordering questions and references effectively. We propose Semantically Coherent Batching and Ordering (SCBO), a training-free framework that addresses these challenges. SCBO first uses an LLM to extract compact semantic representations from survey items and filter out template noise. It then groups related questions into batches and builds a shared reference bank using target-specific retrieval and centroid-based completion. Finally, it orders target questions from easy to hard and arranges references according to their semantic alignment with those questions. Experiments on four large-scale survey datasets and four LLMs show that SCBO substantially reduces token consumption and inference time while generally improving prediction accuracy over a non-batched baseline. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/SCBO-41D8.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SCBO框架，通过语义分批与排序实现LLM多问题预测，降低开销并提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 传统逐个问题预测的方式重复编码相同上下文，每个目标仅依赖少量参考回答，且后续预测无法利用先前答案的信息。
AI.method: 无训练框架SCBO：先用LLM提取调查项的紧凑语义表示并过滤模板噪声；将相关问题分组为批次，通过目标特定检索和质心补全构建共享参考库；按易到难排序目标问题，并按语义对齐排列参考。
AI.result: 在四个大规模调查数据集和四个LLM上的实验表明，SCBO大幅减少token消耗和推理时间，预测准确率普遍优于非分批基线。
AI.conclusion: SCBO能有效应对多问题批量预测的挑战，实现高效且准确的调查模拟。

title: Concept Score Relearning: A Unified Cross-Architecture Attack on Concept Erasure
summary: Concept erasure aims to suppress undesirable knowledge in text-to-image generative models. However, existing robustness evaluations typically rely on relearning attacks tailored to specific model architectures. We study concept reactivation across two substantially different generative paradigms: noise-prediction U-Nets and flow-matching Transformers. We introduce \textbf{Concept Score Relearning (CSR)}, a unified parameter-level framework that reactivates erased concepts by optimizing each model within its native prediction space. CSR requires no external target-concept image dataset and applies the same concept-directed objective to both U-Net-based Stable Diffusion and Transformer-based FLUX. Experiments across diverse concepts and multiple erasure methods demonstrate consistent concept reactivation across both architectures, highlighting the cross-architecture applicability of CSR and the persistent recoverability of apparently erased concepts. For strict nudity, CSR reaches average ASRs of 50.47\% on FLUX and 40.29\% on Stable Diffusion, consistently ranking first across all evaluated safety settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Concept Score Relearning (CSR)，一个统一的参数级概念重激活框架，用于评估文本到图像生成模型中概念擦除的鲁棒性，并在 U-Net 与 Transformer 两类架构上验证被擦除概念可被重新激活。
AI.motivation: 现有概念擦除鲁棒性评估多依赖针对特定模型架构的重学习攻击，缺乏跨架构的统一评估方法，因此需要研究不同生成范式下被擦除概念是否仍可恢复。
AI.method: 提出 CSR，通过在模型原生预测空间中优化参数来重激活被擦除概念，无需外部目标概念图像数据集，并对 Stable Diffusion 的 U-Net 与 FLUX 的 flow-matching Transformer 使用相同概念导向目标。
AI.result: 在多种概念和多种擦除方法上，CSR 在两类架构中均能一致地重激活被擦除概念；对严格裸体概念，CSR 在 FLUX 上平均 ASR 达 50.47%，在 Stable Diffusion 上达 40.29%，在所有评估安全设置中均排名第一。
AI.conclusion: CSR 具有跨架构适用性，表明看似被擦除的概念仍具有持续可恢复性，现有概念擦除方法的鲁棒性仍面临显著挑战。

title: Unmask the State: When Does State Adaptation Matter for Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models (MDMs) admit flexible generation orders, making the unmasking strategy an inference decision. Existing methods vary in how they prioritize positions, control parallelism, restrict selection regions, revise predictions, or plan future denoising, yet it remains unclear when these choices should change during generation. We study this question through strategy reversals, where an alternative action becomes preferable to a fixed choice. We organize MDM inference into five axes--score, cardinality, region, commitment, and planning--and define adaptation opportunity as the one-step utility advantage of the best candidate action over a validation-selected fixed action. This view shows that adaptation value depends on both the frequency and magnitude of such reversals. Across three MDMs and ten tasks, adaptation opportunities are highly heterogeneous, with some regimes exhibiting concentrated and predictable one-step gains. This motivates selective adaptation: lightweight detectors calibrated on validation prompts identify high-opportunity states, capturing, for example, 56.9 percent of the candidate-set oracle opportunity by adapting only the top 10 percent of states on LLaDA-8B constrained JSON filling. Our transition-level results suggest that state adaptation is most useful when applied selectively rather than uniformly.

AI.tldr: 论文研究掩码扩散语言模型（MDM）推理中解掩码策略的自适应问题，提出用“策略反转”衡量何时应改变固定策略，并发现选择性自适应比统一自适应更有效。
AI.motivation: 现有MDM解掩码方法在位置优先级、并行度、选择区域、预测修正和去噪规划上各不相同，但尚不清楚这些选择应在生成过程中何时改变，因此需要研究自适应策略的时机与价值。
AI.method: 将MDM推理解构为五个维度：分数、基数、区域、承诺和规划；定义“自适应机会”为最佳候选动作相对验证集选定的固定动作的一步效用优势，并据此分析策略反转的频率与幅度。进一步提出选择性自适应：用验证提示校准轻量检测器，识别高机会状态并仅在这些状态上自适应。
AI.result: 在3个MDM和10个任务上，自适应机会高度异质，部分场景存在集中且可预测的一步收益。在LLaDA-8B约束JSON填充任务中，仅对前10%状态进行自适应即可捕获56.9%的候选集oracle机会。
AI.conclusion: 状态级自适应应选择性应用而非统一应用；选择性自适应能有效利用集中出现的策略反转机会，提升MDM推理效率与效果。

title: QuPID: Quantum Parameter-Efficient Input-Dependent Retrieval Adaptation for Medical RAG
summary: Fidelity-based quantum retrieval ranks candidates by the fidelity between query and archive states. Applying a shared input-independent unitary after fixed state encoding leaves that fidelity unchanged, so training the circuit cannot alter the ranking. Quantum parameter-efficient input-dependent retrieval adaptation (QuPID) repairs this by making the circuit input-dependent through data re-uploading and by comparing measurement readouts, vectors of local Pauli expectations, rather than states. The result is a small readout for adapting frozen image features to a local archive with limited data: training simulates the circuit classically, and inference runs on a GPU with fixed learned parameters. We characterize the class as a structured factorization of input-modulated quadratic feature maps, bound the frequency support of its re-uploading channel, and give a parameter-count generalization bound that motivates its small budget. Under a shared frozen backbone and a label-free protocol, QuPID's 60 parameters give higher precision-at-5 (P@5) on ChestX-ray14 and MURA than frozen medical encoders, and than adapters and low-rank adaptation (LoRA) with up to 5.25 million trainable parameters. On ChestX-ray14, the P@5 gain over the frozen encoder is +0.116, the lead over retuned adapters is widest at 512 adaptation examples (+0.040), and the full-budget margin over an equally compact classical rotation-plane head is +0.023 with a 95% interval excluding zero. Medical imaging is the primary testbed; the pattern recurs on two non-medical benchmarks, in report generation, and under simulated gate noise and finite-shot readout.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 QuPID，一种输入依赖的量子参数高效检索适配方法。它通过数据重上传和比较测量读出（局部泡利期望向量）替代状态保真度，解决固定编码后共享输入无关酉变换不改变排序的问题，并在医学图像检索等任务上以极少参数取得更优性能。
AI.motivation: 基于保真度的量子检索按查询态与档案态之间的保真度排序。若在固定态编码后应用共享的、输入无关的酉变换，保真度不变，因此训练该电路无法改变检索排序，限制了其适配能力。
AI.method: QuPID 通过数据重上传使电路输入依赖，并比较测量读出向量（局部泡利期望）而非量子态本身。它用小型读出模块将冻结图像特征适配到小规模本地档案，训练时经典模拟电路，推理时在 GPU 上以固定学习参数运行。论文还将其刻画为输入调制二次特征图的结构化分解，界定重上传通道的频率支撑，并给出参数数量泛化界。
AI.result: 在共享冻结骨干和无标签协议下，QuPID 仅用 60 个参数，在 ChestX-ray14 和 MURA 上的 P@5 高于冻结医学编码器、适配器和最多 525 万可训练参数的 LoRA。ChestX-ray14 上，相比冻结编码器 P@5 提升 +0.116，在 512 个适配样本时对重调适配器领先 +0.040，对同等紧凑的经典 rotation-plane 头领先 +0.023，且 95% 区间不包含零。该模式也在两个非医学基准、报告生成以及模拟门噪声和有限采样读出下重现。
AI.conclusion: QuPID 修复了保真度检索中共享酉变换导致排序不可训练的问题，表明输入依赖的量子参数高效适配能以极小参数预算有效适配冻结特征，并在医学与非医学检索任务及噪声条件下具有稳健优势。

title: TT-VidT: Decoupling the Temporal Axis for Efficient Motion-Centric Video Pretraining
summary: Comparisons in video self-supervised learning often evaluate complete training recipes rather than isolating the method itself: architecture, objective, data exposure, schedule, scale, and decoder capacity can all vary at once. This makes it hard to identify which choices yield motion-prioritized representations, whose gains concentrate on frame-to-frame change while retaining useful appearance. We address this with a matched $4 \times 6 = 24$ architecture-objective study at roughly 170M ~ 190M encoder scale on $\sim$1.7M OpenVid and Moments-in-Time v2 clips for 8 epochs, and propose TT-VidT. TT-VidT combines a DINOv3-initialized ViT-B/16 per-frame spatial path with a compact Temporal Transfer Layer, trained by Diff Compression to reconstruct target frames from a first-frame appearance anchor and frame-specific motion tokens. The sweep shows that TT3D with Diff Compression, not either component alone, enters the strongest motion-sensitive regime, and decoder ablations favor a compact video-pretrained decoder. In final comparison, TT-VidT leads Jester, Something-Something V2, ARID, and Diving48 fine-tuning simultaneously, improving over the strongest non-TT row by 54% ~ 121%, while using 48% fewer encoder FLOPs than DisMo and 55% fewer than VideoMAE or V-JEPA2. HMDB51, IARD, and EPIC-Kitchens bound the claim.

AI.tldr: 本文通过匹配的 4×6=24 种架构-目标函数研究，提出 TT-VidT：在 DINOv3 初始化的 ViT-B/16 逐帧空间路径上加入紧凑时序迁移层，并用 Diff Compression 从首帧外观锚点和逐帧运动 token 重建目标帧，从而获得运动优先且保留外观的视频自监督表示。
AI.motivation: 现有视频自监督学习比较常评估完整训练配方，而非隔离方法本身；架构、目标、数据暴露、调度、规模和解码器容量同时变化，难以判断哪些选择真正产生运动优先的表示。
AI.method: 在约 170M~190M 编码器规模、约 1.7M OpenVid 与 Moments-in-Time v2 片段上训练 8 个 epoch，进行 4×6=24 的架构-目标匹配研究；提出 TT-VidT，结合 DINOv3 初始化的 ViT-B/16 逐帧空间路径与紧凑 Temporal Transfer Layer，并用 Diff Compression 重建目标帧；同时进行解码器消融。
AI.result: 扫描表明 TT3D 与 Diff Compression 结合、而非单独任一组件，进入最强运动敏感区间；解码器消融偏好紧凑的视频预训练解码器。最终比较中，TT-VidT 同时在 Jester、Something-Something V2、ARID、Diving48 微调上领先，较最强非 TT 行提升 54%~121%，且编码器 FLOPs 比 DisMo 少 48%、比 VideoMAE 或 V-JEPA2 少 55%；HMDB51、IARD、EPIC-Kitchens 用于限定该结论范围。
AI.conclusion: 通过受控的架构-目标匹配研究，可以更清晰识别视频自监督中产生运动优先表示的关键因素；TT-VidT 在多个运动敏感基准上取得领先，同时显著降低编码器计算量，但结论受 HMDB51、IARD、EPIC-Kitchens 等基准约束。

title: When Words Speak Louder than Images: Towards Understanding Language Bias in Vision-Language Models
summary: Despite substantial progress across downstream applications, vision-language models (VLMs) remain susceptible to language bias, often prioritizing linguistic cues over visual evidence and consequently producing incorrect predictions. Prior studies have proposed various approaches to understanding and mitigating language bias in VLMs, yet their findings often conflict due to the difficulty of tracing how language bias propagates within black-box VLMs. Building on the word completion task, we trace how language bias propagates through VLM inference by (1) proposing a diagnostic framework that decomposes the inference process into four distinct yet interdependent stages to trace the propagation of language bias; and (2) examining how two key factors underlying language bias, i.e., linguistic priors and cross-modal coverage, evolve across these stages and ultimately give rise to incorrect predictions. The linguistic prior captures the strength of statistical bias induced by the language model component of a VLM and represents the origin of language bias, whereas cross-modal coverage measures the extent to which linguistic cues cover the visual content. By decomposing inference into four stages and characterizing the interplay between linguistic priors and cross-modal coverage across these stages, we propose a systematic framework for tracing the propagation of language bias throughout the inference process; and uncover the underlying mechanism of language bias by revealing the interplay between linguistic priors and cross-modal coverage.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出一个诊断框架，通过将VLM推理过程分解为四个相互依赖的阶段，追踪语言偏差的传播，并揭示语言先验与跨模态覆盖度之间的相互作用如何导致错误预测。
AI.motivation: 视觉语言模型虽在下游任务上取得进展，但仍易受语言偏差影响，常常优先依赖语言线索而非视觉证据，导致错误预测；已有研究结论不一致，原因在于难以追踪黑盒VLM内部语言偏差的传播过程。
AI.method: 基于词补全任务，提出诊断框架，把VLM推理分解为四个不同但相互依赖的阶段以追踪语言偏差传播；并考察两个关键因素——语言先验和跨模态覆盖度——在这些阶段中的演变及其相互作用。
AI.result: 该框架能够系统追踪语言偏差在整个推理过程中的传播；发现语言先验是语言偏差的起源，跨模态覆盖度衡量语言线索覆盖视觉内容的程度，二者的相互作用最终导致错误预测，从而揭示语言偏差的内在机制。
AI.conclusion: 研究提供了一个系统框架来追踪语言偏差在VLM推理中的传播，并通过揭示语言先验与跨模态覆盖度之间的相互作用，阐明了语言偏差导致错误预测的底层机制。

title: TTRSD: Test-Time Reinforcement Learning with Self-Distillation for Vision-Language Models
summary: Test-time reinforcement learning enables vision-language models (VLMs) to adapt using unlabeled inputs. However, repeated sampling under fixed visual conditions can reinforce shared perceptual errors, while sequence-level rewards fail to isolate visual perception the foundational bottleneck that anchors multimodal reasoning risking the degradation of pre-trained reasoning capabilities. We propose TTRSD, a test-time reinforcement learning framework combining multi-view answer-level self-distillation with visual contrastive token selection. A shared policy aggregates teacher predictions across original, cropped, and downsampled views into an answer distribution. Student trajectories generated from the original image receive rewards based on the support for their final answers in this distribution. To allocate this feedback precisely toward perceptual bottlenecks, we compare the log-probabilities of the same sampled tokens under original and visually ablated inputs while holding their textual prefixes fixed, selecting visually sensitive positions for policy-gradient updates. TTRSD separates update direction, determined by group-relative advantages, from update position, determined by visual sensitivity, without requiring ground-truth labels, external verifiers, or a separate teacher. With only 20 unlabeled adaptation samples, TTRSD improves performance across seven benchmarks and three VLMs, raising InternVL3-2B's MMMU accuracy from 35.79% to 49.32%(+13.53%), demonstrating cross-dataset generalization while preserving inherent reasoning integrity.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TTRSD，一种面向视觉语言模型的无标签测试时强化学习框架，结合多视角答案级自蒸馏与视觉对比 token 选择，在仅 20 个适应样本下提升多基准性能并保持推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时强化学习虽能让 VLM 利用无标签输入自适应，但固定视觉条件下的重复采样会强化共享感知错误；序列级奖励难以隔离视觉感知这一多模态推理的基础瓶颈，甚至可能损害预训练推理能力。
AI.method: TTRSD 使用共享策略聚合原图、裁剪图和下采样图的多视角教师预测，形成答案分布；学生轨迹从原图生成，并根据其最终答案在该分布中的支持度获得奖励。同时，通过比较相同采样 token 在原始输入与视觉消融输入下、固定文本前缀时的对数概率，选出视觉敏感位置用于策略梯度更新，从而将更新方向（组相对优势）与更新位置（视觉敏感性）分离，无需真值标签、外部验证器或独立教师模型。
AI.result: 仅用 20 个无标签适应样本，TTRSD 在 7 个基准和 3 个 VLM 上取得提升；InternVL3-2B 在 MMMU 上准确率由 35.79% 提升至 49.32%（+13.53%），并展现出跨数据集泛化能力，同时保持固有推理完整性。
AI.conclusion: TTRSD 表明可通过多视角自蒸馏和视觉敏感 token 选择，将测试时强化学习集中于视觉感知瓶颈，在无标签条件下有效提升 VLM 多模态推理表现并避免破坏预训练推理能力。

title: Long-Horizon Analog Design Bench: Benchmarking Agents on Hours-Long Analog and Mixed-Signal Circuit Design Tasks
summary: Coding agents now sustain hours-long, tool-driven loops, yet their ability to carry long-horizon analog and mixed-signal circuits to electrical specification remains unmeasured. We introduce Analog Design Bench, a long-horizon agentic benchmark of 50 transistor-level design tasks contributed by 17 chip designers. Agents work with an open-source simulator, while an isolated verifier evaluates the submitted circuit using specification-based electrical tests. We evaluate 15 agent configurations across 2,250 two-hour attempts and observe full-specification pass rates from 8.0% to 78.0%. Coding-benchmark performance correlates with analog results but leaves much of the performance spread unexplained. Our failure analysis shows that most unsuccessful submissions have no recorded legality rejection but fail electrical acceptance, identifying electrical closure as the dominant endpoint challenge. We test time, reasoning effort, agent harness, and supplied design knowledge as interventions. Longer budgets and higher reasoning effort improve performance, while general skill documents provide little benefit and sometimes reduce performance. Supplying a task-matched reference topology, an idealized form of circuit-IP retrieval, raises DeepSeek V4 Pro by 18.7 percentage points and mainly accelerates GPT-5.6 Sol.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Analog Design Bench，一个由17名芯片设计师贡献50个晶体管级设计任务的长时程智能体基准，用于评估编码智能体在模拟与混合信号电路设计中达到电气规格的能力；在2250次两小时尝试中，15种智能体配置的完整规格通过率为8.0%至78.0%。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体已能维持数小时的工具驱动循环，但其在长时程模拟和混合信号电路中达到电气规格的能力尚未被测量，因此需要专门基准来评估这一能力。
AI.method: 构建 Analog Design Bench：50个晶体管级设计任务，智能体使用开源仿真器，隔离验证器通过基于规格的电气测试评估提交电路。评估15种智能体配置，共2250次两小时尝试，并分析失败原因；同时测试时间预算、推理努力、智能体框架和提供设计知识等干预。
AI.result: 完整规格通过率为8.0%至78.0%；编码基准表现与模拟结果相关，但不能解释大部分性能差异。多数失败提交未被记录为合法性拒绝，而是未通过电气验收，表明电气闭包是主要终点挑战。更长预算和更高推理努力提升性能；通用技能文档帮助很小，有时降低性能；提供任务匹配的参考拓扑使 DeepSeek V4 Pro 提升18.7个百分点，并主要加速 GPT-5.6 Sol。
AI.conclusion: 长时程模拟电路设计对智能体仍具挑战，电气闭包是核心瓶颈；通用能力或文档不足以解决该问题，任务匹配的电路IP检索式知识可显著提升部分模型表现。

title: A Visual Classification Dataset and Model Evaluation for Historical Manuscript Illustrations
summary: Historical manuscript illustrations preserve rich visual evidence of past cultures. They depict people, animals, plants, diagrams, music notations, and decorative forms. Although large digitization projects have made many manuscripts available online, the material itself remains difficult to explore at scale. Extraction systems can find illustrations on manuscript pages, but without meaningful categories, large collections remain hard to search and explore. We address this gap by introducing a manually labeled dataset of 15,000 illustrations from manuscripts dating back hundreds of years across 22 categories, and evaluating modern vision models for image classification on this task. The problem is challenging due to stylistic diversity, degradation, and semantic ambiguity, with many images that fit more than one category. We compare fine-tuned CNN and Transformer-based classifiers, zero-shot CLIP, embedding-based classifiers, and direct vision-language models. Results show that fine-tuned image classifiers perform best overall, with ConvNeXt reaching 88.9% accuracy and 81.3% macro-F1. Using CLIP embeddings with XGBoost provides a strong alternative. In contrast, zero-shot CLIP and direct vision-language classification perform substantially worse, highlighting the limits of general-purpose models in this domain. Beyond overall performance, the analysis reveals which categories are visually separable and where errors reflect genuine semantic overlap, suggesting that some limitations arise from the taxonomy itself.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一个包含22类、15,000幅历史手稿插图的人工标注数据集，并系统评测多种现代视觉模型在该插图分类任务上的表现。
AI.motivation: 手稿大规模数字化后仍难以按语义类别检索和探索，现有提取系统只能定位插图，缺少有意义的分类体系，因此需要可扩展的分类方法与基准数据。
AI.method: 构建人工标注的15,000幅手稿插图数据集，涵盖22个类别；比较微调CNN与Transformer分类器、零样本CLIP、基于嵌入的分类器以及直接使用视觉语言模型的方法。
AI.result: 微调图像分类器整体最佳，ConvNeXt达到88.9%准确率和81.3%宏F1；CLIP嵌入配合XGBoost是强替代方案；零样本CLIP和直接视觉语言模型分类效果明显较差。
AI.conclusion: 该领域受风格多样、图像退化与语义歧义影响，部分错误源于类别体系本身的重叠；通用模型在该领域仍有明显局限。

title: DrafTS: Time-Aware Decomposition with Residual Correction for Time Series Modeling
summary: Real-world time series contain evolving underlying dynamics with irregular variations that lack stable temporal patterns and are often referred to as noise. Existing methods address this mixture by filtering frequencies or suppressing noisy observations. They either miss temporal evolution or risk suppressing useful dynamics. We propose DrafTS, a model-agnostic framework that aims to reduce noise while preserving evolving dynamics through time-aware Decomposition with ResiduAl correction For Time Series. DrafTS uses features derived from instantaneous amplitude and frequency to guide decomposition into a primary component intended to capture underlying dynamics. A task-specific backbone models the primary component, while a lightweight correction module uses residual information to correct the backbone output. Across four time series modeling tasks, DrafTS improves six diverse backbones, demonstrating its effectiveness. Code is at https://github.com/Autumn61q/DrafTS

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DrafTS，一种模型无关的时间序列去噪框架，通过时间感知分解和残差校正，在降低噪声的同时保留不断演化的动态信息。
AI.motivation: 真实时间序列常包含演化的潜在动态和不规则变化，后者缺乏稳定时间模式，通常被视为噪声。现有方法通过频率过滤或抑制噪声观测来处理这种混合，但要么忽略时间演化，要么可能误抑制有用动态。
AI.method: DrafTS 利用瞬时幅度和频率特征引导时间感知分解，将序列分解为主成分以捕捉潜在动态；使用任务特定骨干网络建模主成分，并用轻量级校正模块利用残差信息修正骨干输出。
AI.result: 在四类时间序列建模任务中，DrafTS 提升了六种不同骨干模型的性能，验证了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: DrafTS 是一种有效的模型无关框架，能够在保留演化动态的同时降低噪声，并可广泛增强不同时间序列骨干模型。

title: DISCERN: Can AI Agents Work Like Scientists and Guide Discovery?
summary: Reliable automated research requires agents to vet data, verify analyses, and generate hypotheses grounded in trustworthy evidence, potentially reducing routine scientific workload while allowing scientists to focus on interpretation and discovery.
