Because excessive eagerness to please users may undermine existing refusal capabilities, reducing sycophancy offers a potential route to stronger refusal beyond the harmful scenarios covered by safety training. We investigate this possibility using compensatory feature injection (CFI), a training technique designed to limit the acquisition of a target concept by supplying its associated activation during learning. Across three Qwen3.5 base models, we use sparse autoencoders (SAEs) to identify the top-ranked sycophancy feature from paired sycophantic and independent responses, then validate its behavioral influence through inference steering. We subsequently inject the selected feature during supervised fine-tuning on sycophantic targets. Positive injection reduces learned sycophancy after removal (by 62.0% relative to ordinary fine-tuning in 35B-A3B), whereas modest negative injection increases it. Unexpectedly, these reductions in sycophancy do not consistently improve direct refusal of harmful requests, motivating a narrower evaluation of the same harmful intents under user pressure. In this setting, ordinary fine-tuning on sycophantic responses substantially weakens refusal, while selected checkpoints trained with positive injection recover part of the loss, including approximately 95% in 35B-A3B. These findings show that persistent sycophancy reduction does not guarantee stronger direct refusal, while identifying recovery under user pressure as a distinct, conditional benefit of training intervention.

AI.tldr: 该研究利用补偿性特征注入（CFI）抑制Qwen3.5基座模型中的谄媚特征，发现可显著降低微调后学到的谄媚行为，但这种降低并不稳定提升直接拒绝有害请求的能力；不过在用户施压场景下，CFI可部分恢复因谄媚微调而受损的拒绝能力。
AI.motivation: 语言模型安全部署需要可靠拒绝有害请求，但模型过度迎合用户可能削弱既有拒绝能力。作者希望探索减少谄媚是否能成为增强拒绝能力的一条新路径，尤其是超出安全训练覆盖范围的场景。
AI.method: 使用稀疏自编码器（SAEs）从谄媚与独立回答配对中识别排名最高的谄媚特征，并通过推理阶段干预验证其行为影响。随后在针对谄媚目标的监督微调中，使用补偿性特征注入（CFI）在训练时注入或负向注入该特征，观察其对习得谄媚行为及拒绝能力的影响。实验覆盖三个Qwen3.5基座模型，包括35B-A3B。
AI.result: 正向注入在移除后可将习得谄媚降低62.0%（35B-A3B，相对于普通微调），而适度负向注入反而增加谄媚。谄媚降低并未一致改善对有害请求的直接拒绝。在用户施压场景下，普通谄媚微调显著削弱拒绝能力，而正向注入训练的部分检查点恢复了该损失，35B-A3B中约恢复95%。
AI.conclusion: 持续降低谄媚并不保证直接拒绝能力增强；训练干预的独特且有条件的好处体现在用户施压情境下恢复拒绝能力。这表明需区分直接拒绝与压力下拒绝，并将谄媚抑制视为一种有条件的安全增益手段。

title: SpatialSpeak: QA-Native Reconstruction with Local and Global Context for Spatial Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) can benefit from geometric priors for multi-view spatial reasoning, yet answer-only training does not directly supervise the intermediate geometric estimates and their use in deriving quantitative spatial answers. We hypothesize that spatial chain-of-thought (CoT) supervision becomes more effective when the VLM first jointly learns complementary local geometry and global scene context through multi-view reconstruction. We introduce SpatialSpeak, a two-stage framework that connects QA-native reconstruction pretraining with spatial CoT learning. In Stage I, QA-Native Reconstruction Pretraining (QA-RP) combines marked-point 3D queries for fine-grained local geometry with object-center queries for global scene context across views. Both tasks are formulated as text-based question answering, allowing geometric estimation and subsequent reasoning to share the same autoregressive output interface. In Stage II, spatial CoT with Visual Compensation (CoT-VC) trains the model to express question-relevant geometric estimates and use them to derive answers, with reliability assessment and visual compensation supporting answer refinement when needed. On ReVSI, QA-RP increases the gain from CoT-VC from 2.6 to 6.9 points, and ablations show that both local and global reconstruction supervision are beneficial. SpatialSpeak achieves state-of-the-art results on ReVSI, VSI-Bench, and SPAR-Bench, with a ReVSI score of 62.8 that exceeds the strongest compared baseline by 8.7 points.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SpatialSpeak 两阶段框架，将多视角重建预训练与空间思维链（CoT）学习结合，以提升视觉语言模型的多视角空间推理能力，并在多个基准上取得最优结果。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型虽可借助几何先验进行多视角空间推理，但仅用答案监督无法直接指导中间几何估计及其用于推导定量空间答案的过程，因此需要更有效的空间 CoT 监督。
AI.method: SpatialSpeak 包含两阶段：第一阶段 QA-RP 通过标记点 3D 查询学习局部精细几何，通过物体中心查询学习全局场景上下文，并将二者统一为文本问答形式；第二阶段 CoT-VC 训练模型输出与问题相关的几何估计并据此推导答案，同时引入可靠性评估和视觉补偿来优化答案。
AI.result: 在 ReVSI 上，QA-RP 使 CoT-VC 的增益从 2.6 提升到 6.9 分；消融表明局部和全局重建监督均有益。SpatialSpeak 在 ReVSI、VSI-Bench 和 SPAR-Bench 上达到最优，ReVSI 得分 62.8，比最强对比基线高 8.7 分。
AI.conclusion: 先通过多视角重建联合学习局部几何与全局场景上下文，再结合空间 CoT 与视觉补偿，可显著增强视觉语言模型的定量空间推理能力。

title: Anguinus Sculpturae: Compositional Synthesis of Peak-Enhancement Breast DCE-MRI Scans
comment: Accepted as an oral at the MAMA-SYNTH 2026 challenge / Deep-BreAth 2026 Workshop, MICCAI 2026. 12 pages, 3 figures, 1 table
summary: Dynamic contrast-enhanced breast MRI (DCE-MRI) is rich in anatomical and perfusion information, but its reliance on gadolinium-based contrast agents raises safety concerns and adds cost. Virtual contrast enhancement, synthesizing post-contrast from pre-contrast images, is a promising alternative. We address the MAMA-SYNTH challenge task of predicting peak-enhancement breast MRI. Rather than adopting the full machinery of diffusion or flow matching, we observe that under a rectified, straight-line path the generative process collapses to a single difference prediction: the synthetic peak image is the pre-contrast image plus a predicted enhancement map, recovered in one forward pass. Around this we build Anguinus Sculpturae, a compositional pipeline in which nnU-Net segmentations of lesion, foreground and breast region guide two generators - one optimized for global fidelity, one for lesion structure through an asymmetric Tversky term routed via a frozen segmenter - composited region-wise with Gaussian-weighted blending. On the held-out Duke subset of MAMA-MIA our model achieves the best FRD and Dice among all evaluated variants, showing that single-step difference prediction with segmentation guidance suffices to recover both global fidelity and lesion structure. Code is available at https://github.com/MIC-DKFZ/AnguinusSculpturae.

AI.tldr: 该研究针对MAMA-SYNTH挑战中的乳腺DCE-MRI峰值增强预测任务，提出一种单步差异预测方法，并构建分割引导的组合生成流程Anguinus Sculpturae，在Duke子集上取得最佳FRD和Dice。
AI.motivation: 动态对比增强乳腺MRI依赖钆基对比剂，存在安全担忧并增加成本；虚拟对比增强，即从预对比图像合成增强后图像，是一种有前景的替代方案。
AI.method: 观察到在整流直线路径下，生成过程可简化为单步差异预测：合成峰值图像等于预对比图像加预测的增强图，一次前向传播即可恢复。构建组合流水线Anguinus Sculpturae，使用nnU-Net分割病灶、前景和乳腺区域，指导两个生成器：一个优化全局保真度，一个通过冻结分割器路由的非对称Tversky项优化病灶结构，并按区域用高斯加权融合。
AI.result: 在MAMA-MIA的留出Duke子集上，该模型在所有评估变体中取得最佳FRD和Dice，表明单步差异预测结合分割引导足以恢复全局保真度和病灶结构。
AI.conclusion: 单步差异预测配合分割引导可以同时实现良好的全局保真度和病灶结构恢复，为虚拟对比增强乳腺MRI提供了一种有效且简化的方案。

title: LiveOption: Evaluating LLM Agents in Structured Option Trading with Nonlinear Payoffs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) and multi-agent systems (MAS) have shown promise in financial decision-making, yet existing evaluations focus on equity trading and primarily assess directional prediction, overlooking the structural complexity of derivative markets. Option trading introduces fundamentally different challenges, including nonlinear payoffs and multi-leg strategy construction, requiring structured decisions rather than simple directional bets. We introduce LiveOption, an evaluation framework for LLM-based agents in option trading. LiveOption formulates the problem as structured sequential decision-making under realistic execution and capital constraints, and provides a reproducible environment with standardized interaction protocols. The framework includes three task suites covering portfolio overlays, event-driven earnings trading, and 0DTE intraday trading. We further propose a hierarchical metric suite that evaluates action validity, decision quality, risk characteristics, and outcome-level performance. Experiments show that current agents often fail to achieve competitive returns in most scenarios. LiveOption offers a principled testbed for evaluating structured decision-making beyond outcome-based metrics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LiveOption，一个用于评估基于大语言模型的智能体在期权交易中表现的框架。它将问题建模为受现实执行和资金约束的结构化序贯决策，提供可复现环境和标准化交互协议，并包含三个任务套件和分层指标。实验表明当前智能体在多数场景下难以获得有竞争力的回报。
AI.motivation: 现有评估主要集中于股票交易和方向性预测，忽略了期权市场的结构复杂性，如非线性收益和多腿策略构建，这些需要结构化决策而非简单方向性押注。因此需要专门针对期权交易的评估框架。
AI.method: LiveOption将期权交易形式化为结构化序贯决策问题，考虑现实执行和资金约束，提供可复现环境和标准化交互协议。包含三个任务套件：投资组合叠加、事件驱动财报交易、0DTE日内交易。并提出分层指标套件，评估动作有效性、决策质量、风险特征和结果层面表现。
AI.result: 实验显示，当前基于LLM的智能体在大多数场景下往往无法实现有竞争力的回报。
AI.conclusion: LiveOption为评估结构化决策提供了原则性测试平台，超越了仅关注结果指标的评估方式。

title: Federated Multi-Modal Human Activity Recognition using Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
summary: Human Activity Recognition (HAR) from heterogeneous wearable sensors is fundamental to the Internet of Health Things (IoHT), supporting rehabilitation, elderly care, and smart healthcare. Existing multimodal fusion methods often assign fixed equal weights to sensor streams, overlooking differences in modality importance, acquisition cost, and sensor quality, which can vary due to movement, incorrect placement, or temporary blockage. We propose an adaptive and cost-aware multimodal HAR framework based on multi-agent reinforcement learning for centralized HAR and extend it to federated learning as FedMHAR. In the centralized setting, multimodal fusion is formulated as a cooperative Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning (MARL) problem, where each sensing modality is assigned a PPO-based agent that learns per-sample fusion weights, enabling the model to emphasize informative modalities while down-weighting costly sensors when cheaper alternatives provide sufficient information. In the federated setting, we introduce BiFL-PPO, a bidirectional federated optimization strategy in which a server-side PPO policy learns client-specific trust weights and feeds them back to adapt local learning rates and proximal regularization. Unlike round-level optimization, BiFL-PPO uses dense batch-level rewards for more frequent feedback and stable training under heterogeneous client data. Evaluation on the MEx Rehabilitation and UTD Multimodal Human Action datasets shows that the centralized framework achieves 87.30% and 94.98% accuracy, respectively, outperforming conventional fusion methods and state-of-the-art HAR models. FedMHAR achieves 79.74% and 77.49% in the federated setting, consistently surpassing FedAvg, FedProx, FedBN, FedNova, and AdaFedProx, while providing more stable performance and reducing sensor acquisition cost.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种自适应且成本感知的多模态人体活动识别（HAR）框架，基于多智能体强化学习实现集中式融合，并扩展为联邦学习版本 FedMHAR；在多个数据集上优于传统融合方法和主流联邦学习方法，同时降低传感器采集成本。
AI.motivation: 现有可穿戴多模态 HAR 融合方法常对传感器流赋予固定等权重，忽视了不同模态的重要性、采集成本和传感器质量差异；这些差异会因运动、佩戴错误或临时遮挡而变化。
AI.method: 集中式设置中，将多模态融合建模为合作式多智能体强化学习问题，每个传感模态对应一个基于 PPO 的智能体，学习逐样本融合权重；联邦设置中提出 FedMHAR，并引入 BiFL-PPO 双向联邦优化策略：服务器端 PPO 策略学习客户端特定信任权重，并反馈以自适应调整本地学习率和近端正则化；不同于轮级优化，BiFL-PPO 使用密集的批次级奖励，在异构客户端数据下实现更频繁反馈和稳定训练。
AI.result: 在 MEx Rehabilitation 和 UTD Multimodal Human Action 数据集上，集中式框架分别达到 87.30% 和 94.98% 准确率，优于传统融合方法和最先进 HAR 模型；FedMHAR 在联邦设置下分别达到 79.74% 和 77.49%，持续超过 FedAvg、FedProx、FedBN、FedNova 和 AdaFedProx，并提供更稳定性能且降低传感器采集成本。
AI.conclusion: 所提自适应、成本感知的多模态 HAR 框架能有效利用模态重要性差异并降低采集成本，在集中式和联邦式场景下均取得更高准确率和更稳定表现，适用于 IoHT 中的康复、养老和智能医疗等应用。

title: Almieyar: A Culturally Grounded Benchmark for Multi-Dialect Arabic Speech Recognition
summary: Arabic speech technology has largely focused on Modern Standard Arabic, leaving the living dialects spoken by hundreds of millions under-served. We introduce ALMIEYAR, a culturally grounded ASR benchmark covering 17 Arabic dialects across six families, built entirely from newly recorded speech unseen by existing models. Dialect-community coordinators selected culturally relevant images across 10 topics, and native speakers described them through five structured scenarios, yielding approximately 50 minutes per dialect (13.7 hours total). We benchmark 12 state-of-the-art ASR systems zero-shot, including GPT-4o-transcribe, Voxtral-Mini-4B, Fanar-STT-LF, Whisper, SeamlessM4T-v2, and wav2vec2-based models. GPT-4o-transcribe achieves the lowest overall WER at 35.0%, followed by Voxtral-Mini-4B, Fanar-STT-LF, and Whisper-Large-v3 at 41.1%, 45.9%, and 49.5%, respectively, indicating substantial remaining errors across Arabic dialect communities. Performance varies considerably across dialect groups, with no model performing uniformly best across all groups. WER alone also obscures dialectal ASR behaviour: wav2vec2-based models show large WER/CER gaps, where character-level agreement remains much higher than word-level accuracy, motivating joint WER/CER reporting. ALMIEYAR provides a unified benchmark for culturally grounded Arabic ASR evaluation, including the first published benchmark for Ahwazi Arabic.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出ALMIEYAR，一个覆盖17种阿拉伯语方言、六大方言家族的文化接地ASR基准，数据全部为新录制，约13.7小时。对12个先进ASR系统进行零样本评测，发现整体错误率仍较高，且不同方言表现差异明显。
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯语语音技术主要关注现代标准阿拉伯语，而数亿人使用的活方言服务不足。现有模型也缺乏对新录制、文化相关方言语音的统一评测基准。
AI.method: 由方言社区协调员选择10个主题的文化相关图片，母语者通过5种结构化场景进行描述，构建覆盖17种方言、六大方言家族的基准，每种方言约50分钟，共13.7小时。对12个SOTA ASR系统进行零样本评测，包括GPT-4o-transcribe、Voxtral-Mini-4B、Fanar-STT-LF、Whisper、SeamlessM4T-v2和wav2vec2类模型。
AI.result: GPT-4o-transcribe总体WER最低，为35.0%；Voxtral-Mini-4B、Fanar-STT-LF、Whisper-Large-v3分别为41.1%、45.9%、49.5%。各模型在不同方言组上表现差异大，没有模型在所有方言组中一致最优。仅报告WER会掩盖方言ASR行为，wav2vec2类模型呈现较大WER/CER差距，字符级一致性明显高于词级准确率，因此需要联合报告WER和CER。
AI.conclusion: ALMIEYAR为文化接地的阿拉伯语ASR提供了统一评测基准，并包含首个公开的Ahwazi阿拉伯语基准。结果表明阿拉伯语方言ASR仍有大量错误，需针对方言群体进一步改进。

title: StoryEngine: A State-Grounded Agentic Framework for Video Storytelling
summary: Despite recent progress in agentic multi-shot video generation, producing coherent and consistent long-form stories remains challenging. Existing agentic pipelines typically rely on textual shot plans or previously generated pixels, yet lack an explicit mechanism for propagating the consequences of story events and maintaining the video world state across shots. As a result, missing visual details may be reconstructed inaccurately, while visual drift may propagate across subsequent shots, undermining both narrative coherence and visual consistency. To address these challenges, we propose StoryEngine, a state-grounded agentic framework for video storytelling. StoryEngine establishes a separation between authoritative semantic plans and unreliable visual observations. Specifically, StoryEngine maintains a structured representation of entity placement and story-relevant states, and propagates event-induced changes to define the intended start and end states of each shot. To visually realize these states, StoryEngine constructs canonical references for recurring entities and environments, and compiles state and visual constraints into executable render plans. Meanwhile, to realize these states correctly, a bounded evaluation-guided repair loop further corrects local state inconsistencies. Together, these mechanisms preserve causal story progression and prevent local visual errors from propagating across shots. To comprehensively evaluate long-form storytelling, we construct a benchmark across diverse scenarios and visual styles, with metrics assessing storytelling quality, narrative coherence, and visual consistency. Experimental results demonstrate that StoryEngine consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across all evaluation dimensions, validating its effectiveness for coherent and consistent video storytelling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 StoryEngine，一种基于状态表示的多镜头视频故事生成智能体框架，通过分离语义计划与视觉观测，维护并传播故事世界状态，从而提升长篇视频的叙事连贯性和视觉一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有智能体式多镜头视频生成方法依赖文本镜头计划或已生成像素，缺乏显式机制来传播故事事件后果并维护跨镜头的视频世界状态，导致视觉细节重建不准确、视觉漂移传播，损害叙事连贯性与视觉一致性。
AI.method: StoryEngine 维护实体位置和故事相关状态的结构化表示，并传播事件引发的状态变化以定义每个镜头的预期起止状态；为复现实体与环境构建规范参考，将状态与视觉约束编译为可执行渲染计划；同时采用有界评估引导的修复循环纠正局部状态不一致。
AI.result: 实验表明，StoryEngine 在叙事质量、叙事连贯性和视觉一致性等所有评估维度上均持续优于现有最先进方法，验证了其在连贯一致视频故事生成中的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式维护和传播故事世界状态，并分离权威语义计划与不可靠视觉观测，StoryEngine 能保持因果故事进展并防止局部视觉错误跨镜头传播，为长篇视频故事生成提供了有效方案。

title: Just Let Linear States Forget the Distant Past: Prefix Caching via Suffix Replay for Hybrid LLMs
summary:
Hybrid LLMs interleave full-attention layers with linear-attention layers to reduce long-context inference cost, but this structure complicates prefix caching. Full-attention KV caches are token-addressable, whereas linear-attention layers maintain recurrent states that cannot be rolled back to arbitrary prefix boundaries. Existing systems materialize recurrent-state checkpoints, restricting prefix reuse to checkpoint-aligned positions.
  We present SuffixReplay, the first prefix caching system that lets hybrid LLMs reuse cached prefixes at every cache-supported page boundary without materializing recurrent-state checkpoints. Our key insight is to just let linear states forget the distant past. Modern linear-attention mechanisms use recurrent decay and gating to attenuate the influence of old inputs. Therefore, instead of checkpointing every prefix boundary, SuffixReplay approximates the state at a matched boundary by replaying only a recent suffix of the layer's input hidden states, which we retain as anchors. At the algorithmic level, SuffixReplay combines layer-wise and token-wise anchor sparsity with a bounded replay budget to control storage, computation, and quality. At the system level, it uses an independently managed anchor sidecar and a pipelined replay path to overlap anchor movement and state reconstruction with the native serving pipeline. We evaluate SuffixReplay on three hybrid LLMs: OLMo-Hybrid-7B, Qwen3.5-4B, and Qwen3.6-27B-FP8. Across these models, SuffixReplay retains 91.4-100% of full-prefill quality on average across LongBench and RULER, while using only 0.36-0.51x the amortized per-token storage of SGLang's default 8192-token checkpoint cache. Integrated into SGLang, SuffixReplay reduces median TTFT by 15-70% on branching workloads, sustains 2.3-4.3x SGLang's throughput when the working set exceeds HBM, and matches SGLang on high-hit continuation traffic.

AI.tldr: 提出 SuffixReplay，首个无需物化循环状态检查点的混合 LLM 前缀缓存系统。它利用线性注意力的递归衰减特性，仅重放近期输入后缀来近似匹配边界处的状态，从而支持任意缓存页边界的前缀复用。
AI.motivation: 混合 LLM 交错全注意力层与线性注意力层以降低长上下文推理成本，但线性注意力层维护的循环状态无法回滚到任意前缀边界，导致前缀复用只能限于检查点对齐位置。现有系统需物化循环状态检查点，带来存储和灵活性限制。
AI.method: 核心思路是让线性状态遗忘久远过去：利用现代线性注意力的递归衰减与门控，近似状态时只重放近期输入隐藏状态后缀，并将其保留为锚点。算法层结合层级与 token 级锚点稀疏及有界重放预算，控制存储、计算与质量；系统层采用独立管理的锚点 sidecar 与流水线重放路径，将锚点移动和状态重建与原生服务流程重叠。
AI.result: 在 OLMo-Hybrid-7B、Qwen3.5-4B、Qwen3.6-27B-FP8 上，LongBench 与 RULER 平均保留全预填充质量的 91.4–100%，摊销每 token 存储仅为 SGLang 默认 8192-token 检查点缓存的 0.36–0.51 倍。集成 SGLang 后，分支负载中位 TTFT 降低 15–70%；工作集超过 HBM 时吞吐量达 SGLang 的 2.3–4.3 倍；高命中续写流量与 SGLang 持平。
AI.conclusion: SuffixReplay 表明，通过重放近期后缀近似线性注意力状态，可在不物化循环状态检查点的情况下实现页边界级前缀复用，同时显著降低存储开销、减少首 token 延迟并提升超 HBM 工作集的吞吐量。

title: FactorEngram: Factorized N-gram Memory with Basis-Level Gating for Language Models
summary: Lookup-based memory has been a promising way to scale the parameters of large language models (LLMs). It retrieves learned representations of local token patterns, such as n-grams, instead of reconstructing them through successive layers of computation. However, existing designs such as Engram treat each retrieved embedding as a monolithic unit. Each embedding is stored in its own hashed slot and modulated by a single scalar gate. As a result, polysemous patterns cannot selectively read out the components of their memory that are relevant to the context. Moreover, parameters are shared only through hash collisions, which are largely unrelated to semantics. We propose FactorEngram, a factorized n-gram memory with basis-level contextual gating. FactorEngram retrieves sparsity-regularized coefficients over a dictionary of basis vectors shared across patterns, so related patterns can reuse common components. The same dictionary is also used for gating. The backbone hidden state is scored against each basis vector to gate the corresponding coefficient before reconstruction, which lets the context modulate each memory component individually. FactorEngram also covers both individual tokens and multi-token n-grams, and we systematically study where the memory branch should be inserted. On 340M- and 1B-parameter Transformer backbones, FactorEngram improves language modeling and downstream task performance. Ablation studies confirm the contribution of each component and identify insertion before the attention sublayer in the middle layers as an effective configuration.

AI.tldr: 论文提出FactorEngram，一种分解式n-gram记忆，通过基向量级上下文门控提升大语言模型的参数扩展效率与性能。
AI.motivation: 现有查找式记忆（如Engram）将每个检索嵌入视为整体单元，存储于独立哈希槽并由单一标量门控。这导致多义模式无法根据上下文选择性读取相关记忆成分，且参数仅靠与语义无关的哈希碰撞共享。
AI.method: FactorEngram检索共享基向量字典上的稀疏正则化系数，使相关模式复用公共成分；同一字典用于门控。将骨干隐状态与各基向量打分，在重建前对相应系数单独调制，实现上下文对每个记忆成分的独立控制。方法覆盖单token和多token n-gram，并系统研究记忆分支的插入位置。
AI.result: 在340M和1B参数Transformer骨干上，FactorEngram提升了语言建模和下游任务性能。消融实验确认各组件贡献，并发现中间层注意力子层之前插入是有效配置。
AI.conclusion: FactorEngram通过分解记忆与基级上下文门控，解决了现有查找式记忆的粒度和语义共享问题，是一种有效的LLM参数扩展方案。

title: Learning Multimodal Embeddings with Evidence-Aligned Readout
summary: Multimodal large language models can expose task-relevant evidence through generation, but producing useful evidence does not by itself determine how it enters a retrieval embedding. We study whether the semantic organization of that evidence can also specify where representations are read. To address this question, we introduce EviAlign, which couples Semantic Evidence Generation with Boundary Readout in a shared multimodal large language model. It organizes evidence into five semantic units, reads the contextualized state at each unit boundary, and aggregates these states into a single normalized embedding. Generation and contrastive retrieval objectives jointly train this shared structure. With the same trailing readout, semantic evidence and free-form CoT yield nearly identical retrieval performance, suggesting that evidence organization alone does not explain the full gain. A controlled $2\times3$ study compares consistent and permuted evidence organization across three readout strategies, using training targets with matched evidence spans. With five readout states and the same mean pooling, the advantage of consistent semantic organization grows from 0.65 points at length-based training positions to 2.39 at evidence boundaries, yielding a 1.74-point co-design interaction. Across 12 MMEB retrieval tasks, EviAlign achieves 76.9 average Recall@1 with 500K training pairs while retaining single-vector indexing and scoring.

AI.tldr: 本文研究证据的语义组织是否决定检索嵌入中表征的读取位置，提出 EviAlign，将语义证据生成与边界读取耦合在共享多模态大语言模型中，并在多个检索任务上验证其有效性。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型能通过生成暴露任务相关证据，但生成有用证据并不等于决定其如何进入检索嵌入；作者因此探究证据的语义组织能否同时指定表征应从哪里读取。
AI.method: 提出 EviAlign：将证据组织为五个语义单元，在每个单元边界读取上下文状态，并聚合为单一归一化嵌入；生成目标与对比检索目标联合训练共享结构。还进行受控 2×3 实验，比较一致与置换证据组织及三种读取策略，并使用证据跨度匹配的训练目标。
AI.result: 相同尾部读取下，语义证据与自由形式 CoT 的检索性能几乎相同；一致语义组织的优势从基于长度训练位置的 0.65 分增至证据边界的 2.39 分，协同设计交互为 1.74 分。在 12 个 MMEB 检索任务上，EviAlign 使用 500K 训练对取得平均 Recall@1 76.9，并保持单向量索引与评分。
AI.conclusion: 证据组织本身不足以解释全部性能增益；语义证据组织与边界读取策略的协同设计对检索性能有显著影响，EviAlign 能在保持高效单向量检索的同时取得强结果。

title: When Noise Meets Long-Tail: Feature-Threshold Dual Calibration for Robust Pseudo-Labeling
comment: Accepted to NeurIPS 2026 Main Track. Code: https://github.com/pingggg516/FTC-Seg
summary: Pseudo-labeling has become a cornerstone of learning from unlabeled data in semantic segmentation. Yet its effectiveness drops sharply in real-world scenarios where strong imaging noise and long-tailed class distributions occur together. We trace this failure to a vicious cycle of pseudo-label degradation. Imaging noise entangles foreground and background features, lowering prediction confidence across all classes, while long-tailed distributions leave tail classes with far fewer training samples and inherently lower confidence. Under fixed high-threshold filtering, these tail-class predictions are systematically filtered out, so they receive no supervision from unlabeled data and thus features keep degrading in subsequent iterations. Critically, noise and long-tail are not independent obstacles but mutually amplifying ones, and addressing either alone is insufficient. To break this cycle, we propose FTC-Seg, a Feature-Threshold dual-Calibration framework built on a standard teacher-student framework. At the feature level, Orthogonal Prototype Reconstruction (OPR) uses a set of learnable orthogonal prototypes to residually purify pixel-wise features, widening the margin between weak foreground targets and noisy backgrounds. At the threshold level, Adaptive Threshold Calibration (ATC) dynamically adjusts class-specific thresholds based on learning difficulty and prediction-distribution bias, rescuing low-confidence pseudo-labels of tail classes from systematic exclusion. Extensive experiments on four public benchmarks spanning three distinct noise modalities show that FTC-Seg achieves strong performance against state-of-the-art methods, with particularly substantial gains on tail classes. Our results establish that jointly calibrating features and thresholds is essential for robust pseudo-labeling under compounded noise and class imbalance.

AI.tldr: 针对强成像噪声与长尾类别分布共存时伪标签严重退化的问题，提出FTC-Seg特征-阈值双校准框架，在语义分割中提升伪标签鲁棒性，尤其显著改善尾部类别。
AI.motivation: 伪标签是无标注数据语义分割的重要方法，但在真实场景中，成像噪声会降低所有类别预测置信度，长尾分布又使尾部类别样本少且置信度低；固定高阈值过滤会系统性丢弃尾部类伪标签，形成退化恶性循环。噪声与长尾并非独立，而是相互放大，单独处理任一问题都不够。
AI.method: 基于教师-学生框架提出FTC-Seg。特征层面使用正交原型重建（OPR），通过可学习正交原型对逐像素特征进行残差净化，扩大弱前景目标与噪声背景的边界；阈值层面使用自适应阈值校准（ATC），依据学习难度和预测分布偏差动态调整类别特定阈值，挽救被系统性排除的尾部类低置信伪标签。
AI.result: 在覆盖三种噪声模态的四个公开基准上实验，FTC-Seg相较现有最先进方法取得强劲性能，尤其在尾部类别上提升显著。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在噪声与类别不平衡复合场景下，联合校准特征和阈值对于实现鲁棒伪标签至关重要。

title: RelaxKV: Recomputation Guided by the Query with Sparse Context Attention for Efficient KV Cache Reuse
summary: Cross-request KV caching reduces the prefill cost of Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), but conventional prefix caching severely limits cache reuse across requests. Position-Independent Caching (PIC) removes this constraint by reusing independent chunks, but their KV states miss cross-chunk interactions. Existing methods selectively recompute token states to recover these missing interactions, but primarily allocate the recomputation budget to selecting which states to recompute, while fixing the recomputation context to the full causal prefix. We introduce RelaxKV, which formulates selective cache repair as a joint allocation problem over repair targets and recomputation context. Guided by the user query, RelaxKV identifies layer-specific repair targets and restricts their recomputation to a query-relevant context, reducing attention computation. Across four decoder models, RelaxKV at a 15% anchor ratio improves aggregate LongBench performance over ProphetKV on all models. On Qwen3-14B, RelaxKV provides a stronger quality-TTFT trade-off than ProphetKV across a 5%-30% anchor-ratio sweep, and achieves the best selective results on RULER-MV and LV-Eval at 16K and 32K context lengths. Controlled ablations further demonstrate the importance of recomputation context selection.

AI.tldr: RelaxKV 将选择性 KV 缓存修复建模为修复目标与重计算上下文的联合分配问题，通过查询引导选择层特定修复目标并限制重计算范围，在提升 RAG 缓存复用效率的同时保持生成质量。
AI.motivation: 跨请求 KV 缓存可降低 RAG 预填充成本，但传统前缀缓存严重限制缓存复用；位置无关缓存（PIC）虽允许复用独立块，却丢失跨块交互。现有选择性重计算方法主要优化重计算哪些 token，而将重计算上下文固定为完整因果前缀，导致计算开销较大。
AI.method: 提出 RelaxKV，联合优化修复目标和重计算上下文；根据用户查询识别层特定的修复目标，并将重计算限制在与查询相关的上下文中，以减少注意力计算；在四个解码器模型上进行评估。
AI.result: 在 15% anchor ratio 下，RelaxKV 在四个模型上的 LongBench 聚合性能均优于 ProphetKV；在 Qwen3-14B 上，5%-30% anchor ratio 扫描中提供比 ProphetKV 更好的质量-TTFT 权衡；在 RULER-MV 和 LV-Eval 的 16K 与 32K 上下文长度上取得最佳选择性结果；消融实验验证了重计算上下文选择的重要性。
AI.conclusion: RelaxKV 通过联合分配修复目标与重计算上下文，有效修复 PIC 缺失的跨块交互，在降低计算的同时提升长上下文 RAG 的缓存重用质量与效率。

title: Language Models Act on Hidden Valence
summary: Language models describe some internal states as good and others as bad. But whether models have a stake in them is an open question. Simply asking the model is unlikely to be informative. Any answer may be consistent with genuine introspection, superficial pattern-matching, or with fixed scripts learned in character training. We therefore study revealed preference. Rather than asking about a state, we use activation steering to attach a positively or negatively valenced activation pattern to one of two otherwise meaningless 'zones', switch steering off, and then observe which zone the model prefers. A model with a stake in that state should choose accordingly. Across seven open-weight models from five families, this is indeed what we find. First, steering changes the passages models write about each zone, and those words shift later choice. Second, the shift persists when all surface-level tokens are held fixed and only the hidden KV cache differs. Third, the effect also remains when all text is generated without steering and valence is only injected during cache construction. Thus, the hidden state alone moves choice in proportion to the steering dose. Fourth, this dependence of choice on hidden valence is nearly absent in a base model and emerges during DPO, consistent with a link between valence and goal-directed behaviour formed in training. Finally, given tools to steer itself, a model does not tend to induce a positive state, but it reliably removes an imposed negative state. It does so at a dose-dependent rate and significantly more often than it removes interventions in random directions. Overall, we demonstrate that valence-related activation patterns leave hidden traces that predictably govern later choices, even when every visible token is identical across conditions. Whether these traces are accompanied by any subjective experience relevant to model welfare remains unclear.

AI.tldr: 论文通过激活引导研究语言模型对内部状态是否具有‘利害关系’，发现与效价相关的隐藏激活模式能可预测地影响模型后续选择，即使所有可见文本完全相同。
AI.motivation: 模型会把某些内部状态描述为好或坏，但尚不清楚模型是否真正‘在乎’这些状态。直接询问模型难以区分真实内省、表面模式匹配或角色训练脚本，因此需要研究其揭示性偏好。
AI.method: 使用激活引导将正效价或负效价激活模式附加到两个无意义‘区域’之一，然后关闭引导，观察模型偏好哪个区域。在来自五个家族、七个开放权重模型上测试，并控制表面 token、KV 缓存和引导时机。
AI.result: 引导会改变模型对各区域的描述，且这些词会影响后续选择；当表面 token 固定、仅隐藏 KV 缓存不同时，效应仍存在；即使文本无引导生成、仅在缓存构建时注入效价，隐藏状态仍按引导剂量影响选择。基础模型中该依赖几乎不存在，DPO 后出现。给定自我引导工具，模型不倾向于诱导正状态，但会可靠移除被施加的负状态，且呈剂量依赖并显著高于随机方向干预。
AI.conclusion: 效价相关激活模式会留下隐藏痕迹，并可预测地支配后续选择，即使所有可见 token 相同。这些痕迹是否伴随与模型福利相关的主观体验仍不清楚。

title: What Happens During Autonomous Deep Research After the User Steps Away?
summary: In autonomous deep research, a user provides a task and relevant background, then leaves the agent to conduct an extended investigation without further human intervention. We study how this initial user information is reflected in intermediate actions and how these actions relate to final recommendations. We introduce DRaligned, a counterfactual behavioral evaluation framework built on PDR-Bench. By varying one task-relevant user factor while keeping the remaining context fixed, we compare acquisition requests, working drafts, and final reports. Source-grounded extraction, blinded local judgments, and deterministic aggregation yield coarse directional measurements while leaving ambiguous cases unresolved. Our experiments show that strong user-specific delivery can emerge from a largely shared research process: agents investigate similar broad questions but allocate requests differently, and final recommendations distinguish user conditions more clearly than explicit requests do. Reports can also integrate user factors that were not jointly visible during acquisition. In readable draft-to-report comparisons, recommendations often retain their coarse user-specific direction despite substantial rewriting. Final directional differences recur across tested agent models, execution harnesses, and evaluator models, even as execution paths vary. These findings describe how initial user information shapes autonomous research and clarify the relationship between the process an agent follows and the recommendations it delivers.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出 DRaligned 框架，基于 PDR-Bench 对自主深度研究智能体进行反事实行为评估，考察初始用户信息如何影响中间行为与最终建议。
AI.motivation: 在自主深度研究中，用户给出任务和背景后便不再干预，因此需要理解初始用户信息如何体现在智能体的中间行动中，并最终影响其推荐结果。
AI.method: 构建 DRaligned 反事实行为评估框架：在固定其他上下文的条件下，只改变一个与任务相关的用户因素，比较智能体的信息获取请求、工作草稿和最终报告；采用基于来源的抽取、盲评本地判断和确定性聚合，输出粗粒度方向性测量，并保留模糊案例。
AI.result: 实验发现：强用户特定交付可来自大体共享的研究过程——智能体调查相似宽泛问题但请求分配不同，最终建议比显式请求更能区分用户条件；报告能整合获取阶段未同时可见的用户因素；在可读的草稿到报告比较中，尽管大幅改写，建议常保留粗粒度用户特定方向；最终方向性差异在测试的模型、执行框架和评估模型中反复出现，即使执行路径不同。
AI.conclusion: 研究描述了初始用户信息如何塑造自主研究，并厘清了智能体所遵循的过程与其最终推荐之间的关系。

title: When Evidence Changes the Subject: Subject-Typed Claim Licensing for Learned Routing
summary: Modern learned systems increasingly combine learned components with search, repair, or external solvers. Benchmarks often measure the resulting end-to-end system, while scientific claims may concern only one component, creating an attribution problem: evidence can fail to support the requested component-level claim while still supporting a positive conclusion about the larger system. Existing evidence-to-claim methods primarily calibrate claim strength. We argue that composite systems require a second dimension: scientific subject. We address this problem with subject-typed claim licensing, which separates weaker conclusions about the requested subject from positive but non-substitutive credit about another subject. We instantiate this idea in SCOPE-Routing for preference-conditioned multigraph routing. Non-authors reproducibly apply the declared semantics; held-out review yields fewer reference-relative upward deviations than unstructured review, while the difference from a strong evidence checklist remains unresolved; and a controlled routing study shows that score-optimal and claim-eligible methods can differ while valid hybrid-system credit is preserved. These results motivate treating claim strength and scientific subject as distinct dimensions of evidence-based evaluation.

AI.tldr: 论文针对复合学习系统中端到端基准与组件级科学主张之间的归因问题，提出“主体分型主张授权”框架，并以 SCOPE-Routing 实例化，将主张强度与科学主体作为两个独立评价维度。
AI.motivation: 现代学习系统常将学习组件与搜索、修复或外部求解器结合；基准评估整个系统，而科学主张可能只针对某一组件，导致证据可能不支持所请求的组件级主张，却仍支持更大系统的正面结论。现有证据到主张方法主要校准主张强度，未处理科学主体。
AI.method: 提出主体分型主张授权，将针对请求主体的较弱结论与针对另一主体的正面但不可替代的贡献分开；在偏好条件化多重图路由中实现 SCOPE-Routing。非作者复现声明语义；进行留出审查与结构化审查比较；开展受控路由研究。
AI.result: 非作者可复现地应用声明语义；留出审查比非结构化审查产生更少相对于参考的向上偏差，但与强证据清单的差异仍未解决；受控路由研究显示分数最优方法与可主张授权方法可能不同，同时保留有效的混合系统贡献。
AI.conclusion: 应把主张强度和科学主体视为基于证据评估的两个不同维度；复合系统需要主体分型评价，以避免将系统级正面证据误用于组件级主张。

title: Can LLMs Value the Right Evidence? Evidence-Value Misalignment in Dynamic Medical Diagnosis
summary: A correct diagnosis reached from insufficient or misleading evidence can pose a clinical hazard, yet outcome-based accuracy may reward such lucky guesses. We call this mismatch between diagnostic decisions and the value of available evidence Evidence-Value Misalignment (EVM). To disentangle evidential grounding independently from diagnostic accuracy, we introduce MedEVM, a dynamic benchmarking environment comprising 1,050 cases across 24 disease systems. Observations arrive turn by turn, requiring models to continuously calibrate its decision by deciding whether to wait for more evidence or submit a diagnosis. Across 9 LLMs, four interesting patterns are observed. (1) Miscalibrated evidence tracking. Making a diagnosis often fails to calibrate evidence sufficiency, even in more capable models, and even worsens in reasoning mode. (2) Misaligned diagnosis submission. Confidence in the correct diagnosis often fails to ensure timely submission despite sufficient evidence. (3) Evidence order matters. Reordering the same evidence changes diagnoses even when model confidence remains similar. (4) Misleading evidence remains influential. Added misleading evidence redirects diagnoses even after prior evidence becomes sufficient. We further verify that EVM predicts errors and that preventing premature submission improves accuracy. These findings motivate Evidence-Verified Diagnosis Harness (EVD-Harness). It decouples diagnosis generation from submission through an offline Contrastive Diagnostic Wiki and three online control stages, namely observation management, proposal and witness verification, and diagnosis submission control. Across five LLMs, EVD-Harness improves accuracy by 12.0--51.1 percentage points while mitigating EVM-related failures. Our results demonstrate that verifying evidential support before submission can make diagnostic decisions more reliable.

AI.tldr: 论文提出证据-价值错位（EVM）概念和动态基准MedEVM，发现LLM可能基于不足或误导证据做出正确诊断；提出EVD-Harness，通过离线对比诊断Wiki和在线三阶段控制，提升诊断准确性并缓解EVM相关失败。
AI.motivation: 临床中正确诊断可能来自证据不足或误导下的“幸运猜测”，而基于结果的准确率会奖励这种猜测。因此需要将诊断准确性与证据支持度分离评估，识别诊断决策与可用证据价值之间的错位。
AI.method: 构建MedEVM动态基准，包含24个疾病系统、1050个病例，观察逐轮到达，模型需决定等待更多证据还是提交诊断。评估9个LLM，并提出EVD-Harness：解耦诊断生成与提交，包含离线Contrastive Diagnostic Wiki，以及在线观察管理、提议与见证验证、诊断提交控制三阶段。
AI.result: 在9个LLM上发现四种模式：证据追踪校准差；正确诊断置信度不能保证及时提交；证据顺序影响诊断；误导证据仍具影响力。EVM可预测错误，防止过早提交可提高准确率。在5个LLM上，EVD-Harness将准确率提升12.0–51.1个百分点，并缓解EVM相关失败。
AI.conclusion: 提交诊断前验证证据支持，可使诊断决策更可靠；将诊断生成与提交解耦并进行控制，有助于缓解证据-价值错位带来的失败。

title: Which the Eye Fears: Writing with Read-Blindness Explains Massive Activations in Transformers
summary:
Massive activation features (MAs) in Transformers are extreme-value residual-stream features that persist across layers despite the model's ability to suppress them. Why do they survive? Our investigation using an operator-level mechanistic analysis of attention and feed-forward (FFN) blocks reveals that these blocks systematically ignore MA coordinates while reading, but not while writing; creating a read-write asymmetry that blocks corrective feedback while allowing continued accumulation. We find that both attention and feed-forward layers have this read-blindness, and contribute to the emergence and persistence of MAs.
  To validate prior work that hypothesized that FFN's amplification abilities is the primary reason for MAs (Sun et al., 2026), we analyze the model checkpoints during learning. Contrary to our expectation, read-blindness emerges before FFN amplification, suggesting that it acts upstream in the MA mechanism. We further contribute gradient analysis to link this behavior to surprising asymmetries in the loss landscape, concluding that the model actively maintains this read-blindness. Finally, we find that removing read-blocking at different locations induces compensatory shifts elsewhere, but MAs still persist.

AI.tldr: 论文研究 Transformer 中大量激活（MAs）为何能跨层持续存在，发现注意力与 FFN 在读取时系统性忽略 MA 坐标、写入时却不忽略，形成读写不对称，导致纠正反馈受阻并允许 MA 持续累积。
AI.motivation: MAs 是极端值的残差流特征，尽管模型有能力抑制它们，却仍跨层持续存在，因此需要解释其存活机制。
AI.method: 采用算子级机制分析注意力与 FFN 块，分析学习过程中的模型检查点，并进行梯度分析与损失景观分析；还通过移除不同位置的读取阻断进行干预实验。
AI.result: 注意力和 FFN 均存在读取盲区，且共同促成 MAs 的出现与持续。读取盲区早于 FFN 放大出现，说明其位于 MA 机制上游；损失景观存在不对称性，表明模型主动维持这种读取盲区。移除读取阻断会引起其他位置补偿性偏移，但 MAs 仍持续存在。
AI.conclusion: MAs 的持续并非主要由 FFN 放大导致，而是源于注意力与 FFN 的读写不对称和读取盲区；模型主动维持该机制，局部干预只会引发补偿性变化，难以消除 MAs。

title: PPG-LM: A Photoplethysmography-Language Model with Multi-Level Clinical Alignment
summary: Photoplethysmography (PPG) is widely recorded by clinical monitors and consumer wearables, providing a scalable source of continuous physiological information. These recordings offer an opportunity for physiological assessment at scale, but realizing this potential requires models to learn from both signal-derived physiological supervision and broader clinical context captured in electronic health records (EHRs). This involves aligning information spanning local observations, care events, and entire visits with PPG representations at corresponding temporal scales. However, existing PPG foundation models primarily rely on task-specific prediction heads, while the medical knowledge of large language models does not necessarily translate into waveform understanding. To bridge this gap, we introduce PPG-LM, the first PPG-language model family to learn physiological representations from both signal-derived supervision and broader clinical context captured in EHRs. To construct clinically grounded captions, we develop an automatic captioning pipeline that generates segment-, event-, and visit-level descriptions from signal measurements and structured EHR records. We then learn from these pairs through a two-stage framework that first establishes segment-language correspondence through contrastive learning and waveform-conditioned captioning, then extends alignment to events and visits through time-aware aggregation and temporal statement matching. Pretrained on approximately 73k hours of PPG, PPG-LM supports language-based recognition, cross-modal retrieval, and segment captioning. Experiments on MC-MED, MIMIC-III, and VitalDB show improved retrieval and caption factuality over language-model baselines and gains over PPG and time-series foundation models on multiple clinical prediction tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 PPG-LM，首个 PPG-语言模型族，通过自动生成片段、事件和就诊级临床描述，并采用两阶段对比学习与波形条件生成/时序匹配，从信号和 EHR 上下文中学习 PPG 表征。
AI.motivation: PPG 可由临床监护和可穿戴设备大规模采集，但现有 PPG 基础模型多依赖任务专用预测头，且大语言模型的医学知识未必能理解波形；需要将信号级生理监督与 EHR 中的临床上下文在对应时间尺度上对齐。
AI.method: 构建自动描述生成流程，从信号测量和结构化 EHR 生成片段、事件、就诊级文本；两阶段框架：先通过对比学习和波形条件描述建立片段-语言对应，再通过时间感知聚合和时序陈述匹配扩展到事件与就诊；在约 73k 小时 PPG 上预训练。
AI.result: PPG-LM 支持基于语言的识别、跨模态检索和片段描述；在 MC-MED、MIMIC-III、VitalDB 上，相比语言模型基线提升检索和描述事实性，并在多个临床预测任务上优于 PPG 和时间序列基础模型。
AI.conclusion: 将 PPG 表征与多层级临床文本对齐，可同时利用信号监督和 EHR 上下文，提升 PPG 基础模型的临床理解、检索与预测能力。

title: Resource-Aware Parameter-Efficient Model Adaptation for Onboard High-Dimensional Data
summary: Onboard satellite models often require frequent updates, but the weights adapted to earlier data distributions can quickly become outdated. However, updating large-scale model parameters in orbit presents significant challenges due to the limited uplink bandwidth of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite systems, particularly for hyperspectral satellite imagery, where high-dimensional spectral-spatial inputs lead to increased model size and update costs. Existing full fine-tuning methods are thus expensive to retrain and difficult to deploy under strict communication constraints. To address this challenge, we propose NE-LoRA, a parameter-efficient adaptation framework for bandwidth-constrained onboard hyperspectral model updates. NE-LoRA combines a primary low-rank branch with a nonlinear auxiliary branch to capture both global update trends and complex spectral-spatial variations. Additionally, we introduce a differentiated training strategy for multi-matrix adapters, motivated by the asymmetric initialization and gradient dynamics of different adapter matrices. Experiments on four hyperspectral datasets and three representative backbone models demonstrate that NE-LoRA consistently outperforms LoRA-based baselines and remains competitive with, and in several cases superior to, full fine-tuning. Across the evaluated settings, NE-LoRA updates only a small fraction of the total parameters on average while preserving low deployment overhead, offering a favorable accuracy-communication trade-off for onboard hyperspectral adaptation.

AI.tldr: 提出NE-LoRA，一种面向带宽受限星载高光谱模型更新的参数高效适应框架，在多个数据集和骨干模型上优于LoRA类基线，并接近甚至部分超过全微调。
AI.motivation: 星载模型需频繁更新，但LEO卫星上行带宽有限；高光谱影像的高维谱空输入使模型大、更新成本高，现有全微调重训昂贵且难以在严格通信约束下部署。
AI.method: NE-LoRA结合主低秩分支与非线性辅助分支，以捕捉全局更新趋势和复杂谱空变化；并针对多矩阵适配器提出差异化训练策略，基于不同适配器矩阵的非对称初始化与梯度动态。
AI.result: 在四个高光谱数据集和三个代表性骨干模型上，NE-LoRA持续优于LoRA类基线，并与全微调竞争，部分场景超过全微调；平均仅更新少量参数，部署开销低。
AI.conclusion: NE-LoRA在精度与通信成本之间取得良好权衡，适合星载高光谱模型在带宽受限条件下的适应更新。

title: MAD-Guard: Controlled Study of Autoregressive Generation versus Direct Decision Interfaces for Closed Multimodal Forensic Tasks
summary: When should multimodal foundation models generate tokens, and when should they directly output a decision? We present MAD-Guard, a controlled study of output-decision interfaces for closed multimodal forensic tasks. Once a multimodal representation is computed, is autoregressive generation necessary for closed forensic decisions with high input complexity but low output entropy? Under a matched Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, 2,400 FakeClue training samples, and LoRA budget ($r=16, α=32$) on Huawei Ascend 910C NPUs, we evaluate a progression of decision interfaces (AR-SFT [generate] $\to$ Logit Slice $\to$ Binary Direct Head $\to$ +choice $\to$ +act $\to$ CLM-Head) and decompose latency into backbone representation (53.12 ms), 151,643-way vocabulary projection (+85.04 ms $\to$ 138.16 ms), and decoding (+248.26 ms $\to$ 386.42 ms). Under 1-to-1 binary supervision ($\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{BCE}}$), a Binary Direct Head cuts latency by $2.60\times$-$7.27\times$ (53.12 ms) and lowers calibration error by $1.88\times$ (ECE = 0.0450 vs. 0.0845), with a -1.80% accuracy trade-off (93.10% vs. 94.90%; 0.9795 vs. 0.9871 ROC-AUC) from forfeiting token priors. Gains above AR-SFT arise either from multi-task attribution and uncertainty gating (+choice+act: 96.44% accuracy, 0.9940 ROC-AUC, 0.0187 ECE at 53.71 ms) or from a disaggregated contrastive head (CLM-Head: 96.55% binary and 96.44% multi-task accuracy, 0.0166 ECE, 98.79% 7-class attribution at 54.42 ms) retaining semantic priors without token decoding. Across 5,000 out-of-sample images from five benchmarks, our framework excels on synthetic, camouflage, and document forgeries (96.44% GenImage, 97.73% Chameleon, 91.84% Doc) while showing a clear boundary on compressed face manipulation (FF++ ROC-AUC = 0.5913).

AI.tldr: MAD-Guard 研究了闭集多模态取证任务中多模态基础模型应自回归生成 token 还是直接输出决策，提出并比较多种输出决策接口，发现直接头/对比头可在几乎不损失甚至提升性能的同时大幅降低延迟与校准误差。
AI.motivation: 探究在输入复杂但输出熵很低的闭集取证决策中，多模态表示计算完成后是否仍有必要进行自回归生成；希望厘清生成式接口与直接决策接口在效率、校准和准确率上的权衡。
AI.method: 在匹配的 Qwen3-VL-8B 主干、2400 个 FakeClue 训练样本、LoRA（r=16, α=32）和华为昇腾 910C NPU 上进行控制实验；评估 AR-SFT（生成）→ Logit Slice → Binary Direct Head → +choice → +act → CLM-Head 的接口演进；分解延迟为主干表示（53.12 ms）、151643 类词表投影（+85.04 ms）和解码（+248.26 ms）；使用 BCE 进行一对一二元监督，并比较校准误差、准确率、ROC-AUC 等指标。
AI.result: Binary Direct Head 将延迟降低 2.60×-7.27×（53.12 ms），校准误差降低 1.88×（ECE=0.0450 vs. 0.0845），但准确率有 -1.80% 的权衡（93.10% vs. 94.90%；ROC-AUC 0.9795 vs. 0.9871）。+choice+act 达到 96.44% 准确率、0.9940 ROC-AUC、0.0187 ECE，延迟 53.71 ms；CLM-Head 达到 96.55% 二分类准确率、96.44% 多任务准确率、0.0166 ECE、98.79% 七类归因准确率，延迟 54.42 ms。在来自五个基准的 5000 张样本外图像上，该框架在合成、伪装和文档伪造上表现突出（GenImage 96.44%、Chameleon 97.73%、Doc 91.84%），但在压缩人脸篡改上存在明显边界（FF++ ROC-AUC=0.5913）。
AI.conclusion: 对于高输入复杂度、低输出熵的闭集取证决策，自回归生成并非必要；直接二元头可显著提升效率但损失部分 token 先验，多任务归因与不确定性门控或解耦对比头可在不进行 token 解码的情况下保留语义先验，并带来更好的准确率与校准。该方法在多种伪造检测上有效，但对压缩人脸篡改仍有限。

title: EverMine: Dissecting the Self-Evolution of Research Capabilities in Long-Horizon Alpha Research
summary: Self-evolving agents aim to turn research feedback into reusable skills, tools, and research rules. Whether these accumulated capabilities continue to improve later research requires controlled evaluation. Long-horizon alpha discovery provides a state-dependent setting: once a new factor enters the portfolio, the predictive information already covered changes, so the value of the same candidate or experience may change over time. We introduce EverMine, an empirical framework for studying self-evolving research capabilities in long-horizon alpha discovery. EverMine decomposes the research state into history (Hist), the current factor portfolio (Frontier), and reusable capabilities (Cap). Under matched resource limits, we compare complete runs with fixed or evolving Cap, and replace Cap while holding Hist and Frontier fixed to estimate the conditional value of accumulated capabilities. We also combine full trajectories with historical-state replay to examine how experience-based decisions affect candidate selection and portfolio outcomes. Across 18 long-horizon trajectories, end-to-end comparisons show no consistent gain from Cap evolution. Across 48 continuation branches from shared Hist and Frontier states, accumulated Cap also does not consistently outperform the initial Cap. Parameter tuning of existing factor structures can still improve the portfolio. In an exploratory replay of two screening batches from one Evolving trajectory, some screened-out candidates have positive marginal value at the original state, yet submitting all screened-out candidates sequentially slightly lowers final portfolio IC in both batches. These results show that candidate value depends on the evolving portfolio and submission order, and motivate evaluating self-evolving research capabilities through end-to-end outcomes, conditional capability value, and the consequences of experience-based decisions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 EverMine，一个用于研究长周期 alpha 挖掘中自演化科研能力的经验框架，并通过受控实验检验累积能力是否持续提升后续研究表现。
AI.motivation: 自演化智能体希望将研究反馈转化为可复用的技能、工具和规则，但这些累积能力是否真正提升后续研究，需要受控评估；长周期 alpha 挖掘具有状态依赖性，新因子进入组合后会改变已有预测信息，因此同一候选或经验的价值可能随时间变化。
AI.method: 将研究状态分解为历史 Hist、当前因子组合 Frontier 和可复用能力 Cap；在匹配资源限制下，比较固定 Cap 与演化 Cap 的完整运行；固定 Hist 和 Frontier 替换 Cap，估计累积能力的条件价值；结合完整轨迹与历史状态回放，分析基于经验的决定如何影响候选选择和组合结果。
AI.result: 在 18 条长周期轨迹中，端到端比较未显示 Cap 演化带来一致收益；在来自相同 Hist 和 Frontier 的 48 个延续分支中，累积 Cap 也未持续优于初始 Cap。调优已有因子结构仍能改善组合。对一条演化轨迹中两个筛选批次的探索性回放显示，部分被筛除候选在原状态下有正边际价值，但按顺序提交所有被筛除候选会略微降低两个批次的最终组合 IC。
AI.conclusion: 候选价值取决于不断演化的组合和提交顺序；评估自演化科研能力应关注端到端结果、条件能力价值以及基于经验决策带来的后果。

title: Late Attention Layers Alone Can Copy Entity Tokens, but Not Without Attending to Their Context
summary: Large language models (LLMs) reliably perform entity copying, in which a model copies tokens referring to an entity, termed entity tokens, from the prompt into its output to answer a question. Although entity copying is straightforward for most LLMs, existing research does not provide a systematic account of which layers specialize in this fundamental task or how other tokens in the same sequence, termed context tokens, influence the model's ability to copy the entity tokens. To address these questions, we conduct experiments on Qwen3-8B using two novel methods: genie-in-a-bottle, which controls exactly which layers can participate in an entity-copying task, and attention lobotomy, which cuts off specific tokens' attention to entity tokens without affecting the remaining attention distribution. We find that two distinct groups of layers in the second half of the model are both necessary and sufficient for entity copying. Moreover, in addition to the decoding position's attention to entity tokens, context tokens' attention to entity tokens also proves necessary for copying the exact tokens, even though context tokens do not store entity information themselves unless they satisfy particular semantic properties. Our findings establish the critical role of late layers in entity copying under the guidance of context tokens, calling for future work on how models propagate and consume entity information.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析大语言模型在问答中复制实体 token 的机制，发现模型后半部分的两个层组对实体复制既必要又充分，并且上下文 token 对实体 token 的注意力也对精确复制至关重要。
AI.motivation: 现有研究尚未系统说明哪些层专门负责实体复制这一基本任务，以及同一序列中的上下文 token 如何影响模型复制实体 token 的能力。
AI.method: 在 Qwen3-8B 上开展实验，提出两种新方法：genie-in-a-bottle，用于精确控制哪些层参与实体复制任务；attention lobotomy，用于切断特定 token 对实体 token 的注意力而不影响其余注意力分布。
AI.result: 模型后半部分的两个不同层组对实体复制既必要又充分；除解码位置对实体 token 的注意力外，上下文 token 对实体 token 的注意力也是精确复制所必需的，尽管上下文 token 本身通常不存储实体信息，除非满足特定语义属性。
AI.conclusion: 实体复制关键依赖模型后期层，并在上下文 token 的引导下完成；未来需进一步研究模型如何传播和消费实体信息。

title: Rubric Rewards from Item Response Theory
summary: Many language tasks have no single answer that can be checked automatically. Rubrics provide criteria for judging responses to these tasks. For reinforcement learning, the resulting verdicts must be combined into a scalar reward. A common approach sums the points assigned to satisfied criteria. Distinct verdict patterns can thus receive the same reward, and the fixed points encode how much each criterion should count, not how strongly its verdict distinguishes the current rollouts. Beyond this aggregation problem, judging the full rubric needs more judge requests as the criterion count grows. To address these limitations, Rubric Response Theory (RRT) measures quality and selects criteria when rubric criteria are monotone indicators of a shared target. Rather than adding assigned points, RRT uses a two parameter item response model that treats the verdict pattern as evidence about scalar quality specific to the rubric. Under this model, its likelihood score maximizes the local signal-to-noise ratio for quality. Its Response Parameter Network (RPN) reads the prompt and criterion text to predict criterion difficulty and discrimination. As the policy distribution changes during training, RRT uses online expectation maximization to update the RPN from current rollout verdicts. With Qwen3.5-4B as the policy, RRT's macro criterion score across Medical, Science, Rubrics as Rewards Science, and RubricBench is 1.7 points above that of group relative policy optimization (GRPO). On hard and very hard criteria in Medical and Science, RRT gains 2.8 to 5.6 points over GRPO. At half the criterion budget, adaptive Fisher selection with a frozen RPN keeps the macro criterion score across four datasets within 0.1 points of GRPO with full judging. These results show RRT can reduce judge requests while remaining competitive with GRPO.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Rubric Response Theory (RRT)，用项目反应理论建模评分标准，将评审结果转化为质量信号与奖励，并动态选择与更新评分标准，从而减少评审请求并提升强化学习效果。
AI.motivation: 许多语言任务没有可自动检查的单一答案，通常依赖评分标准（rubric）判断回答；但强化学习需要将多个判断汇总为标量奖励。常见做法是累加满足标准的分数，这会导致不同判断模式得到相同奖励，且固定分值只表示标准重要性而非其对当前 rollout 的区分度。同时，标准数量增加会带来更多评审请求。
AI.method: RRT 在评分标准是共享目标单调指标的前提下衡量质量并选择标准。它不直接累加分数，而是采用双参数项目反应模型，将判断模式视为关于该 rubric 特定标量质量的证据。其似然得分最大化质量的局部信噪比。Response Parameter Network (RPN) 读取提示和标准文本，预测标准难度与区分度。训练中策略分布变化时，RRT 使用在线期望最大化，根据当前 rollout 的判断结果更新 RPN。
AI.result: 以 Qwen3.5-4B 为策略时，RRT 在 Medical、Science、Rubrics as Rewards Science 和 RubricBench 上的宏观标准得分比 GRPO 高 1.7 分。在 Medical 和 Science 的困难与非常困难标准上，RRT 比 GRPO 提升 2.8 至 5.6 分。在标准预算减半时，使用冻结 RPN 的自适应 Fisher 选择在四个数据集上的宏观标准得分与 GRPO 全量评审相差不超过 0.1 分。
AI.conclusion: RRT 能在保持与 GRPO 竞争力相当的同时减少评审请求，表明其可有效缓解评分标准奖励聚合与评审成本问题。

title: Seeing and Solving Are Not Enough for Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-language models (VLMs) answer visual questions by combining visual information extraction with downstream problem solving. We investigate a fundamental question: Does an incorrect answer necessarily reflect a failure in visual extraction or problem solving? A model may succeed at both abilities when tested separately yet still fail on the original multimodal question, a distinction that overall answer accuracy cannot reveal. To study this, we perform a question-level empirical analysis across multiple VLMs and visual domains. We define an exactly scorable task state (i.e., the visual information sufficient to solve a question) and use it to test whether the same model can extract the required state, solve the question from the ground-truth state, and answer the original multimodal question. We find that composition failures, where extraction and solving both succeed but direct answering fails, account for 17.7% to 75.6% of direct-answering errors across multiple VLMs and datasets. To address this failure mode, we introduce a simple yet effective method, termed State Realization Tuning (SRT). SRT fine-tunes LoRA adapters attached to the language-model layers while keeping the pretrained VLM weights frozen. It trains the model to output the ground-truth task state before the final answer in a single autoregressive response. SRT improves over standard supervised fine-tuning by 1.7 to 14.1 percentage points and repairs 92.5% to 98.1% of diagnosed composition failures. A single LoRA adapter trained with SRT also improves performance across substantially different task-state structures. Our work shows that having both visual extraction and problem-solving capabilities does not guarantee correct multimodal answering. Requiring the model to first output the visual information needed to solve the question can help bridge this gap.

AI.tldr: 论文研究VLM错误答案是否必然反映视觉提取或问题解决失败，发现存在“组合失败”现象，并提出状态实现微调（SRT）方法。
AI.motivation: 探究VLM在视觉提取和问题解决分别成功时，为何仍会在原始多模态问题上失败；整体答案准确率无法揭示这种区别。
AI.method: 对多个VLM和视觉领域进行问题级实证分析，定义可精确评分的任务状态，检验模型能否提取状态、从真实状态解题、直接回答原问题；提出SRT，冻结预训练VLM，微调语言模型层LoRA适配器，让模型在自回归响应中先输出真实任务状态再给出答案。
AI.result: 组合失败占直接回答错误的17.7%–75.6%；SRT比标准SFT提升1.7–14.1个百分点，修复92.5%–98.1%的组合失败；单个LoRA适配器可跨不同任务状态结构提升性能。
AI.conclusion: 具备视觉提取和问题解决能力不保证多模态回答正确；要求模型先输出解题所需视觉信息可弥合差距。

title: Prompt-Anchored Residual Adaptation for Biomedical Vision-Language Models
summary: Pretrained biomedical vision-language models achieve strong zero-shot performance in biomedical image classification. However, downstream biomedical classification often depends on subtle visual differences between classes that may not be fully captured by pretrained representations. Few-shot adaptation addresses this mismatch by optimizing a task-specific predictor on a small labeled support set. Because the selected examples capture only part of the visual variation within the target classes, the adapted predictions can depend strongly on their composition. We propose Prompt-Anchored Residual Adaptation (PARA), which retains the frozen prompt prediction as a support-invariant semantic anchor and incorporates a visual prediction learned from the support set through an anchor-relative residual. The residual step is computed in a closed form from frozen support embeddings using anchor discrepancy and support agreement. Support-set dependence also limits evaluation: comparisons are fair within a shared draw but remain conditional on its composition. To obtain more reliable comparisons, we introduce a repeated-support protocol that separates support-selection variation from optimization randomness and reports both average and worst-20% performance. PARA achieves state-of-the-art performance in both few-shot classification and base-to-novel generalization.

AI.tldr: 提出Prompt-Anchored Residual Adaptation (PARA)，通过保留冻结提示预测作为语义锚点，结合从支持集学习的残差视觉预测，实现少样本生物医学图像分类，并引入重复支持协议进行更可靠评估。
AI.motivation: 预训练生物医学视觉语言模型在零样本分类中表现良好，但下游分类常依赖预训练表示可能无法充分捕捉的细微视觉差异。少样本适配虽可缓解此问题，但支持集样本仅覆盖目标类部分视觉变化，导致适配预测强烈依赖支持集组成。
AI.method: PARA将冻结的提示预测作为支持集不变的语义锚点，并通过锚点相对残差融入从支持集学习的视觉预测。该残差基于冻结支持嵌入，利用锚点差异和支持一致性以闭式解计算。同时提出重复支持协议，分离支持集选择变异与优化随机性，并报告平均性能与最差20%性能。
AI.result: PARA在少样本分类和基类到新类泛化任务上均达到最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: PARA通过锚定提示预测并引入支持集残差，有效提升少样本生物医学分类的鲁棒性和泛化能力，重复支持协议为公平比较提供了更可靠的评估方式。

title: Revisiting Diffusion Fine-Tuning for Unsupervised Domain Adaptation
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Diffusion-based unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) improves cross-domain transfer by generating target-specific synthetic data for downstream adaptation. Existing methods are largely designed for single-target adaptation: when a model trained on one labeled source domain must be adapted to multiple unlabeled target domains, they typically require separate diffusion fine-tuning for each source--target pair, causing training, storage, and deployment costs to grow with the number of targets. In this paper, we study multi-target data generation for diffusion-based UDA, where a single source-guided diffusion fine-tuning process is reused to generate target-specific synthetic data for multiple target domains. We propose MUSE (Multi-target UDA-oriented Synthesis with Efficient diffusion fine-tuning), a decoupled adaptation framework that separates source-supervised semantic adaptation from target-specific style adaptation. MUSE uses a shared semantic branch updated by labeled source data and target-private style branches specialized to individual target domains, enabling target-specific generation while avoiding repeated source-guided fine-tuning for each target. Experiments on standard UDA benchmarks show that MUSE achieves a stronger accuracy--efficiency trade-off than repeated per-target diffusion adaptation, reducing diffusion fine-tuning cost while improving average target-domain accuracy. The project page is available at https://xuanqi99.github.io/MUSE/.

AI.tldr: 本文研究扩散式无监督域适应（UDA）中的多目标数据生成问题，提出 MUSE 框架，通过一次源域引导的扩散微调复用，为多个无标签目标域生成目标特定合成数据。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散式 UDA 方法多面向单目标域适应；当需要适应多个目标域时，通常要为每个源-目标对分别微调扩散模型，导致训练、存储和部署成本随目标数量增长。
AI.method: MUSE 采用解耦式适应框架，将源监督的语义适应与目标特定的风格适应分离：共享语义分支由有标签源数据更新，目标私有风格分支分别专用于各个目标域，从而避免为每个目标重复进行源引导微调。
AI.result: 在标准 UDA 基准上，MUSE 相比逐目标重复扩散适应取得了更好的精度-效率权衡，在降低扩散微调成本的同时提升了平均目标域准确率。
AI.conclusion: MUSE 表明，通过共享语义分支与目标私有风格分支的解耦设计，可以高效实现多目标扩散式 UDA，并兼顾生成目标特定数据与降低重复微调开销。

title: Reasoning on the Simplex: Geometric Fixed-Point Models
summary: Looped reasoners spend test-time compute by iterating a weight-tied map, but a small residual does not mean the state is a fixed point when that map lives in unconstrained latent space. We propose Geometric Fixed-Point Reasoning (GFPR), in which the iterated state is the prediction itself: a field of categorical beliefs on a product of simplices, whose argmax is the answer at every step. Because the state is a belief, task structure can be imposed through compact convex relaxations, either as structured readouts or directly in the recurrent state; in the latter case the update remains a continuous self-map, so a fixed point exists for any parameters. At about 7M parameters, GFPR reaches 95.1% exact match on Sudoku-Extreme, 92.0% on Maze-Hard, and 100% sequence accuracy on S_5 length 128, above the published FPRM numbers at the same scale. The same update also trains a 201M language model on FineWeb-Edu in which each site is a distribution over the vocabulary; with 24 Picard steps it is above GPT-2 small on four zero-shot multiple-choice tasks and above GPT-2 medium on ARC-Easy.

AI.tldr: 论文提出几何不动点推理（GFPR），将循环推理的状态设为预测本身，即单纯形积上的类别信念场，使每步argmax即为答案；在7M参数下于Sudoku-Extreme、Maze-Hard和S5任务上超过同规模FPRM，并可用于训练201M语言模型，在多个零样本选择题上超过GPT-2 small，在ARC-Easy上超过GPT-2 medium。
AI.motivation: 循环推理器通过迭代权重共享映射消耗测试时计算，但在无约束潜空间中，小残差并不意味着状态是不动点；同时需要一种能自然施加任务结构并保证不动点存在的推理状态表示。
AI.method: 提出GFPR，将迭代状态定义为预测本身：类别信念在单纯形积上的场，每步argmax即答案。通过紧凑凸松弛施加任务结构，可作为结构化读出或直接用于循环状态；直接用于循环状态时更新为连续自映射，因此任意参数下均存在不动点。使用Picard迭代。
AI.result: 约7M参数下，GFPR在Sudoku-Extreme达95.1% exact match，Maze-Hard达92.0%，S5长度128达100%序列准确率，超过同规模已发表FPRM结果。同一更新用于训练201M语言模型（FineWeb-Edu，每个位置为词表分布），24步Picard迭代后在四个零样本多选任务上超过GPT-2 small，在ARC-Easy上超过GPT-2 medium。
AI.conclusion: 以预测本身作为信念状态并施加几何/凸结构的GFPR，能保证不动点存在并有效提升循环推理；该方法从小规模推理任务扩展到大规模语言模型训练均表现优异。

title: OSCC: Certified Observation-Safe Coupling Optimization for Gradient-Noise Control in Imperfect-Information Learning
summary: Coupled rollouts can reduce the noise of counterfactual action comparisons, but two issues prevent standard common-random-number constructions from serving as a general learning primitive in imperfect-information environments. First, an invalid coupling may expose hidden state, synchronize endogenous policy randomness, or misalign chance events after counterfactual histories diverge. Second, in multi-action policy optimization, lower return-contrast variance is not by itself the relevant objective: the optimizer depends on the return covariance matrix after projection through the local policy-gradient geometry. We introduce observation-safe counterfactual coupling (OSCC), a framework that defines an admissible class through marginal preservation, information-state safety, branch-local policy randomness, semantic event alignment, and trace-before-oracle replay. We derive a gradient-aware coupling criterion showing that, for marginal-preserving couplings, policy-gradient noise changes are determined by policy-Jacobian-weighted off-diagonal return covariance. This motivates OSCC-Select, a calibration-only selector that chooses among independent, root-only, continuation-only, and fully coupled rollouts using separate safety and gain certificates. Its gain target combines projected gradient noise with measured physical sampling cost and falls back to independent sampling whenever a simultaneous lower confidence bound does not certify improvement. On 100,000 fixed-root Leduc comparisons, the fully coupled CP-GRPO instantiation reduces return-contrast variance from 41.1158 to 18.1441, a 55.87% reduction, while preserving the declared branch marginals. With three actions, OSCC-Select chooses continuation coupling and attains gradient-noise trace 0.0783 versus 0.0917 for return-variance selection. Increasing calibration from 64 to 2,048 groups raises certification from 0.327 to 0.995.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 observation-safe counterfactual coupling (OSCC) 框架，为不完全信息环境中的反事实动作比较定义安全且有效的耦合 rollout 规则，并给出 OSCC-Select 选择器，在保证信息状态安全与边际保持的前提下降低策略梯度噪声。
AI.motivation: 标准公共随机数耦合虽能降低反事实比较噪声，但在不完全信息环境中可能暴露隐藏状态、同步内生策略随机性、错配机会事件；同时多动作策略优化真正关心的是经策略梯度几何投影后的回报协方差，而非单纯回报对比方差。
AI.method: 提出 OSCC 可允许耦合类，要求边际保持、信息状态安全、分支局部策略随机性、语义事件对齐、trace-before-oracle 重放；推导梯度感知耦合准则，说明边际保持耦合下策略梯度噪声变化由策略雅可比加权的非对角回报协方差决定；据此设计仅需校准的 OSCC-Select，在独立、仅根节点、仅后续、完全耦合 rollout 间选择，并用安全与增益证书决定，增益目标结合投影梯度噪声与实测采样成本，若同时下置信界未认证改进则回退独立采样。
AI.result: 在 100,000 次固定根 Leduc 比较中，完全耦合的 CP-GRPO 实例将回报对比方差从 41.1158 降至 18.1441，减少 55.87%，同时保持声明的分支边际；三动作时 OSCC-Select 选择 continuation coupling，梯度噪声迹为 0.0783，优于基于回报方差选择的 0.0917；校准组数从 64 增至 2,048 时认证率从 0.327 提升至 0.995。
AI.conclusion: OSCC 为不完全信息博弈中的耦合 rollout 提供了安全性与梯度收益兼顾的一般学习原语，OSCC-Select 能根据安全与增益证书自适应选择耦合方式，并在未认证改进时保守回退独立采样。

title: MS-GLA: Multi-Scale Gated Linear Attention for Addressing Representational Bottlenecks via Multi-Temporal Resolution
summary: Gated Linear Attention (GLA) Transformers advance linear recurrent models through data-dependent gating, but face a core limitation: the fixed-capacity memory matrices across all heads operate at a single temporal resolution, where each token is processed individually, forcing them to simultaneously encode local syntactic patterns and long-range semantic structure, creating a representational bottleneck that gating alone is insufficient to resolve. We introduce Multi-Scale Gated Linear Attention (MS-GLA), which addresses this by distributing attention heads across multiple temporal resolutions. Coarser resolutions pool longer token spans naturally specializing toward long-range dependencies, while finer head groups retain sensitivity to local syntactic structure. A learnable, input-dependent fusion layer dynamically recombines head group outputs at each timestep, expanding effective memory capacity without increasing per-head state size. This multi-resolution decomposition draws on principles from Multi-Scale State-Space Models (MS-SSM), adapting them to the gated linear attention setting. We evaluate MS-GLA on language modeling, recall-intensive tasks, and long-context generalization. Across all settings, MS-GLA consistently achieves higher accuracy and lower perplexity than GLA at matched parameter counts, with up to 18.9% improvement on recall-intensive tasks and 9.5% lower average perplexity on language modeling benchmarks, validating multi-temporal resolution decomposition as a principled and effective extension of Gated Linear Attention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出多尺度门控线性注意力（MS-GLA），通过将注意力头分布在多个时间分辨率上，并采用可学习的融合层动态重组输出，以解决GLA中固定容量记忆矩阵的表示瓶颈。
AI.motivation: GLA的固定容量记忆矩阵在所有头上以单一时间分辨率运行，每个token独立处理，迫使同时编码局部句法和长程语义，形成表示瓶颈，仅靠门控无法解决。
AI.method: MS-GLA将注意力头分配到多个时间分辨率：粗粒度分辨率池化更长的token跨度以专注于长程依赖，细粒度头组保留对局部句法结构的敏感性。一个可学习的、输入依赖的融合层在每个时间步动态重组头组输出，在不增加每头状态大小的情况下扩展有效记忆容量。该方法借鉴了多尺度状态空间模型（MS-SSM）的原理。
AI.result: 在语言建模、召回密集型任务和长上下文泛化上评估，MS-GLA在匹配参数数量下比GLA取得更高准确率和更低困惑度，召回密集型任务上提升高达18.9%，语言建模基准上平均困惑度降低9.5%。
AI.conclusion: 验证了多时间分辨率分解作为门控线性注意力的一种原则性且有效的扩展。

title: Dr. Free: You Don't Need Difficulty Rewards for Self-Evolving Search Agents
summary: A central limitation of current data-free self-evolution methods for training search agents is their reliance on difficulty-based proposer rewards. These methods reward a proposer for generating questions that challenge a co-evolving solver, using solver difficulty as a proxy for question quality. Yet difficulty alone is insufficient to distinguish questions that require cross-passage evidence from those that are answerable via simpler shortcuts. In addition, measuring difficulty demands repeated solver rollouts for every candidate question, leading to substantial computational costs. In this paper, we introduce \methodname, the first self-evolving search framework that eliminates difficulty-based proposer rewards and directly optimizes for evidence necessity relative to shortcut contexts. Dr. Free samples relational chains from a knowledge graph and pairs them with aligned passages, giving question generation an explicit multi-hop structure. A generated question receives a positive information-gain reward only when the likelihood of the target answer under the complete evidence passages exceeds the maximum likelihood under all evaluated shortcut contexts. Because this signal is computed from teacher-forced likelihoods, it removes the need for pass-rate estimation and reduces proposer training time by over $7\times$. Experiments on seven open-domain QA benchmarks show that Dr. Free outperforms prior data-free search agents and the supervised baseline, with large improvements on multi-hop QA benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Dr. Free，首个不依赖难度奖励的自进化搜索框架，直接优化问题对证据的必要性，从而提升多跳开放域问答并大幅降低训练成本。
AI.motivation: 现有 data-free self-evolution 搜索智能体依赖基于难度的 proposer 奖励，但难度无法区分需要跨段落证据的问题与可走捷径回答的问题，且需对每个候选问题重复 solver rollout，计算成本高。
AI.method: 从知识图谱采样关系链并配对对齐段落，为问题生成提供显式多跳结构；仅当目标答案在完整证据段落下的似然超过所有已评估捷径上下文中的最大似然时，才给予正的信息增益奖励；该信号由 teacher-forced likelihood 计算，无需 pass-rate 估计。
AI.result: proposer 训练时间减少超过 7 倍；在七个开放域 QA 基准上优于先前 data-free 搜索智能体和监督基线，并在多跳 QA 基准上取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: 消除难度奖励、直接优化证据必要性，是训练自进化搜索智能体的有效且高效方向，尤其有利于需要跨段落推理的多跳问答。

title: OpenFC: Learning Verification Policies towards Open-Search Fact Checking
summary: Open-search fact checking is not merely retrieval followed by classification, but a sequential decision problem in which every query, source visit, and stopping decision reshapes the evidence available for verification. Yet existing systems often distribute these decisions across predefined pipelines or separately prompted modules rather than learning them as a unified task-specific policy. We introduce \textbf{OpenFC}, a unified verification-policy training framework that post-trains Qwen3-8B as a compact next-action controller over reasoning, evidence acquisition, and stopping. OpenFC learns this policy in two stages. \textbf{Stepwise-Calibrated Cold Start (SCCS)} uses a strong training-time supervisor to review post-initial reasoning, tool-use, and stopping proposals before execution, producing reliable trajectories for supervised fine-tuning without access to gold verdicts. \textbf{Verification-Aware Reinforcement Learning (VA-RL)} then improves the cold-start policy on unresolved claims through budget-aware tool rewards, label-aware advantage reweighting, and localized response masking. Across six fact-checking benchmarks, OpenFC achieves 70.39\% average accuracy and 63.30\% macro-F1, the highest overall averages among the evaluated methods. Stage-wise ablations further show that SCCS and VA-RL provide complementary gains, supporting the design of the two-stage training framework. These results position OpenFC as a strong and effective framework for open-search fact-checking. We will open-source our code and release the model checkpoints to support reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 论文提出OpenFC，一个统一的验证策略训练框架，将Qwen3-8B后训练为开放搜索事实核查中的紧凑下一步动作控制器，统一学习推理、证据获取与停止决策，并在六个基准上取得最高平均准确率和宏F1。
AI.motivation: 开放搜索事实核查不仅是检索后分类，而是顺序决策问题：每次查询、来源访问和停止决策都会改变可用证据。现有系统通常把决策分散在预定义流程或单独提示的模块中，而不是作为统一的任务特定策略来学习。
AI.method: OpenFC采用两阶段训练：第一，Stepwise-Calibrated Cold Start（SCCS）使用强训练时监督器在初始推理后审查工具使用和停止提议，从而在无需金标准结论的情况下生成可靠轨迹用于监督微调；第二，Verification-Aware Reinforcement Learning（VA-RL）通过预算感知工具奖励、标签感知优势重加权和局部响应掩码，在未解决claims上改进冷启动策略。
AI.result: 在六个事实核查基准上，OpenFC达到70.39%平均准确率和63.30%宏F1，是所评估方法中总体平均表现最高的。阶段消融进一步表明SCCS和VA-RL提供互补增益，支持两阶段训练框架设计。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明OpenFC是开放搜索事实核查中强大且有效的框架。作者将开源代码并发布模型检查点以支持可复现性。

title: GeoShrink: Accelerating Diffusion Transformers with Two Lines of Code
summary: Diffusion transformers incur substantial inference cost through repeated model evaluations along a sampling trajectory. We introduce GeoShrink, a training-free acceleration method that retains the original solver grid while evaluating the model only at a prescribed set of anchors. At skipped stages, GeoShrink predicts the solver-facing output by adding a geometrically retained fraction of the latest observed innovation to the most recent exact output. We derive this rule from chordal tangent transport and round-trip line projection, and establish a geometric anchor-spacing principle that minimizes the largest adjacent gap expansion under fixed coverage and first span. The analysis characterizes the geometric closure and propagation of prediction errors without assuming access to future model outputs. Experiments cover image, video, motion, and audio generation, together with adapted 3D backends. At approximately $5\times$ acceleration, GeoShrink improves FLUX PSNR by 3.10 dB over the strongest listed baseline. On HunyuanVideo, it achieves a reported $4.99\times$ speedup and improves ChronoMagic-Bench-150 PSNR by 5.44 dB over the strongest listed fidelity baseline. Comparisons at fixed evaluation budgets further show substantial gains on motion, audio, music, and 3D generation.

AI.tldr: GeoShrink 是一种无需训练的扩散 Transformer 推理加速方法，在保留原求解器网格的同时仅在预设锚点评估模型，并通过几何规则预测被跳过阶段的输出，从而在图像、视频、运动、音频和 3D 生成中实现显著加速与保真度提升。
AI.motivation: 扩散 Transformer 在采样轨迹上需要重复进行模型评估，导致推理成本很高；研究动机是在不训练额外模型的前提下加速推理，并尽量保持生成质量。
AI.method: GeoShrink 保留原始求解器网格，仅在指定锚点调用模型；在跳过阶段，将最近一次精确输出与按几何比例保留的最新观测创新相加，以预测求解器所需输出。该方法由弦切线传输与往返线投影推导而来，并提出几何锚点间距原则，在固定覆盖和首段跨度下最小化最大相邻间隙扩张。分析还刻画了在不访问未来模型输出时的预测误差闭合与传播。实验覆盖图像、视频、运动、音频生成及适配的 3D 后端。
AI.result: 在约 5 倍加速下，GeoShrink 使 FLUX 的 PSNR 比最强列出的基线提高 3.10 dB；在 HunyuanVideo 上实现 4.99 倍加速，并使 ChronoMagic-Bench-150 PSNR 比最强保真度基线提高 5.44 dB。固定评估预算下的比较还显示在运动、音频、音乐和 3D 生成上有显著增益。
AI.conclusion: GeoShrink 是一种有效的无需训练加速方法，可在多种生成模态中改善扩散 Transformer 的速度与保真度权衡，并具有理论上的几何锚点与误差传播分析支持。

title: Tracing the Evolution of Oracle Bone Characters Across Three Millennia
summary: Of the approximately 4,500 Oracle Bone Inscription (OBI) characters discovered from the Shang dynasty, only about 1,600 have been deciphered. Many computational approaches compare OBI with glyphs from one historical period at a time. However, during the evolution of Chinese characters, significant structural or semantic changes often occur in uncertain dynasties. A single-period reference may be insufficient when relevant forms change substantially between observed eras. Therefore, we propose the \textbf{Manifold-based Script Evolution Framework (MSEF)}, a framework that models the evolution series (OBI, Bronze, Seal, Clerical, Regular) of Chinese characters as the continual evolution of a manifold space. MSEF represents each character as an era-specific manifold point and learns continuous inter-era transition rules via Neural Ordinary Differential Equations. Both manifold space and transition dynamics can be trained end-to-end through character evolution pairs across any two eras.

AI.tldr: 论文提出基于流形的文字演化框架MSEF，将汉字从甲骨文、金文、小篆、隶书到楷书的演化建模为流形空间的连续演化，并用神经常微分方程学习跨时代转换规则。
AI.motivation: 约4500个甲骨文字中仅约1600个被破译；现有计算方法多只将甲骨文与某一历史时期的字形比较，但汉字演化中结构和语义变化可能发生在不确定朝代，单一时期参考往往不足。
AI.method: 提出MSEF，将汉字的演化序列建模为流形空间的持续演化；每个字符表示为特定时代的流形点，通过Neural ODE学习连续的跨时代转换规则；流形空间和转移动力学可利用任意两个时代的字符演化对进行端到端训练。
AI.result: 摘要未给出具体实验数据或定量结果，主要贡献是提出MSEF框架及其可端到端训练的演化建模方法。
AI.conclusion: MSEF为跨时代汉字演化建模提供了连续、端到端的框架，有望弥补单时期字形比较的不足，并支持甲骨文破译等任务。

title: QuanReview: Offline, Auditable Reconciliation of Human and LLM Span Annotations
comment: 6 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. System demonstration. Code and runnable demo: https://github.com/mattemusacchio/quanreview
summary: Structured span annotations, such as quantities with their units, uncertainty modifiers, and event classes, are expensive to create and hard to keep trustworthy once language models enter the loop. We present QuanReview, an open-source system for auditing and correcting such annotation layers. QuanReview aligns two annotation streams over the same documents at character level, resolves unambiguous cases by an explicit and logged policy, and routes candidate conflicts to a browser-based adjudication interface where reviewers accept either side, build field-level hybrids, or flag items for re-annotation. A campaign manager assigns documents to multiple annotators with configurable redundancy, computes agreement at document and span level, auto-merges unanimous documents, and exports the corrected layer in the original file format, so that it can replace the original annotation files directly. Applied to a 4,457-record humanitarian benchmark and an LLM extraction stream, the system fully auto-merged 8% of documents, applied automatic policy decisions to a further 1,513 records, and concentrated human attention on 3,131 candidate conflicts, a mean of 5.4 per reviewed document.

AI.tldr: QuanReview 是一个开源系统，用于审计和修正结构化跨度标注层。它通过字符级对齐、策略自动决策和人工裁决界面来处理两个标注流之间的冲突。
AI.motivation: 结构化跨度标注（如数量、单位、不确定性修饰和事件类别）创建成本高昂，且在语言模型介入后难以保持可信。
AI.method: 系统在字符级对齐同一文档的两个标注流；用显式且可记录的策略解决无歧义情况；将候选冲突发送到浏览器裁决界面，供审查者选择任一方、构建字段级混合结果或标记重新标注。活动管理器可分配文档给多名标注者，支持可配置冗余，计算文档级和跨度级一致性，自动合并全体一致的文档，并按原始文件格式导出修正后的标注层。
AI.result: 在包含4,457条记录的人道主义基准和LLM抽取流上应用：完全自动合并了8%的文档，对另外1,513条记录应用了自动策略决策，并将人工注意力集中在3,131个候选冲突上，平均每篇审查文档5.4个。
AI.conclusion: QuanReview 能有效审计和修正标注层，减少人工审查负担，并可直接替换原始标注文件。

title: Harness Learning Enables Generalizable Test-Time Adaptation
summary: A language-model agent is jointly defined by its model and its harness, the executable program that organizes model calls, tool use, and information flow. Because different tasks call for different ways of organizing these operations, the harness needs to be adapted using feedback from the task at hand. We introduce harness learning, which trains a proposer model to revise a solver's harness using execution feedback. We formulate this process as meta-learning over executable programs, with harness revisions playing the role of weight updates in gradient-based adaptation. We train the proposer with reinforcement learning, using the task performance of revised harnesses as the reward. At test time, the proposer uses feedback from successive executions on a new task to refine the harness, without performing any parameter-space update. Experiments on reasoning and multi-hop question answering show that harness learning improves revision quality and that the ability to adapt at test time transfers to unseen tasks. Policies trained on individual revisions can continue improving harnesses over multiple rounds, while the benefits of training on revision sequences vary across settings. These findings suggest a path towards continually learning agents that turn accumulated experience into generalizable improvements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出“harness learning”，即训练一个提议模型，根据执行反馈修改求解器智能体的可执行程序框架（harness），从而在不更新模型参数的情况下实现测试时自适应。
AI.motivation: 语言模型智能体的能力不仅取决于模型本身，也取决于组织模型调用、工具使用和信息流的harness；不同任务需要不同的harness，因此需要利用任务反馈自适应调整harness。
AI.method: 将harness修改视为对可执行程序的元学习，把harness修订类比为梯度适应中的权重更新；使用强化学习训练提议模型，以修订后harness的任务表现作为奖励；测试时利用新任务上的连续执行反馈迭代优化harness，但不进行参数空间更新。
AI.result: 在推理和多跳问答任务上，harness learning提升了修订质量，测试时适应能力可迁移到未见任务；基于单次修订训练的策略能在多轮中持续改进harness，而基于修订序列训练的效果因设置而异。
AI.conclusion: 该研究表明，通过将累积经验转化为可泛化的harness改进，有望实现持续学习的智能体。

title: JustQuant: You Don't Need Smoothing, SVD, or Rotation for 4-Bit Activation Quantization
summary: Recent generative models have become increasingly powerful, but their inference cost continues to grow. Model quantization offers a promising way to compress these models and accelerate inference. However, at 4 bits, activation quantization is substantially more challenging than weight quantization. Recent post-training quantization (PTQ) and quantization-aware training (QAT) methods have made progress in 4-bit activation quantization by introducing smoothing, SVD branches, rotations, mixed precision, or advanced formats such as NVFP4. These additional operators and data types impose demanding requirements on inference engines and hardware, limiting the broad adoption of low-precision models. Can quantization be achieved using only plain low-bit operators? To answer this question, we propose JustQuant, a simple yet effective framework that moves the complexity of low-bit quantization from deployment-time operators into the training process. We first revisit model quantization from the perspective of knowledge distillation and show that a key reason existing PTQ and QAT methods fail is that they typically exploit supervision at only a single level.
