Relative to the human drawings, the agent drawings score higher in creativity but lower in recognizability. We release the final drawings, per-round canvas snapshots, tool call traces, stimulus bank, benchmark harness, crowdsourced ratings (N = 72,000), and ViDrA checkpoint.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PainterBench基准，将人类的不完整绘画任务移植到智能体场景，要求多模态语言模型通过工具调用在含不可擦除起始形状的画布上作画，评估其图形发散思维能力，并收集大量人类评分与自动评分器。
AI.motivation: 图形发散思维在人类中通过不完整绘画任务评估，但缺乏针对AI智能体的基准，尤其是多轮工具使用中的增量视觉规划和从预训练到智能体行为的创造力迁移。
AI.method: 构建PainterBench：智能体通过工具调用在画布上绘画，每轮观察结果，画布含不可擦除的起始形状，目标是将其融入最原创的绘画，任务开放且智能体自行决定结束。评估14个多模态语言模型，进行主要研究和六项敏感性分析，收集2700幅画作及300幅人类参考画，众包创造力和可识别性评分，并提出ViDrA-adapted自动评分器。
AI.result: 14个模型的图形发散思维差异显著，GPT-6 Astra的绘画最具创意；相比人类画作，智能体画作创造力更高但可识别性更低；ViDrA-adapted在随机留出测试集上预测人类创造力评分的相关系数为0.85。
AI.conclusion: 该基准揭示了多模态模型在短时程增量视觉规划与创造力迁移上的表现差异，智能体虽在创造力上超越人类但牺牲了可识别性；论文发布了画作、每轮快照、工具调用轨迹、刺激库、基准框架、众包评分（72,000条）和ViDrA检查点。

title: BIABench: Evaluating AI agents on real-world bioimage analysis tasks
summary: Artificial-intelligence (AI) agents hold promise for automating bioimage analysis, yet no benchmark evaluates whether they can carry out real-world analyses end to end. Such analyses are hard for agents because 2D images, 3D volumes and time-lapse sequences are often too large to read as context, so an agent must choose and run an analysis through code, specialized software and rendered views. Published studies make this capability testable, because each pairs raw images with a peer-reviewed result. We introduce BIABench, a benchmark of 16 tasks reconstructed from published biological studies that retain their scientific questions, imaging data and ground truth. The tasks span eleven analysis subtasks and modalities from H&E histology to single-molecule localization microscopy. Each submission receives an outcome score, which compares the output files with the ground truth using field-standard metrics, and a process score, in which a vision-language model judges method choice and quality control against an expert-written rubric. We evaluated general-purpose and biology-specific agents across several language models, with repeated runs of every task. Routine two-dimensional tasks were solved well, but on some tasks that added a third dimension or a time axis no agent scored above 0.19. Neither biological specialization, stronger models nor detailed expert instructions closed this gap. The agents were also unreliable, with scores varying more between repeated runs of one agent than between different agents, and without ground truth a correct run could not be told from a wrong one by its process score or by the time spent. Released openly with its data and code, BIABench provides a verifiable framework for evaluating, and eventually training, agents for reliable long-horizon bioimage analysis.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出BIABench，一个从已发表生物学研究重建的16项任务基准，用于端到端评估AI智能体执行真实生物图像分析的能力；结果显示常规2D任务表现较好，但3D和时间序列任务表现很差且不稳定。
AI.motivation: AI智能体有望自动化生物图像分析，但此前没有基准能评估其能否端到端完成真实分析。真实分析中2D图像、3D体数据和延时序列通常过大，无法直接作为上下文读取，智能体必须通过代码、专业软件和渲染视图选择并执行分析流程。
AI.method: 构建BIABench，包含16项从已发表生物学研究重建的任务，保留原始科学问题、成像数据和真实结果，覆盖11类分析子任务及从H&E组织学到单分子定位显微镜等多种模态。每项提交同时评估结果分数（用领域标准指标比较输出文件与真实结果）和过程分数（由视觉语言模型依据专家编写的评分标准判断方法选择和质量控制）。评估了通用及生物学专用智能体，使用多种语言模型并重复运行每项任务。
AI.result: 常规二维任务解决得较好，但在部分增加第三维或时间轴的任务上，没有智能体得分超过0.19。生物学专业化、更强模型或详细专家指令都未能弥合这一差距。智能体也不可靠，同一智能体重复运行之间的分数差异大于不同智能体之间的差异；在没有真实结果时，仅靠过程分数或耗时无法区分正确与错误的运行。
AI.conclusion: BIABench作为开放基准，连同数据和代码发布，为评估并最终训练智能体进行可靠的长时程生物图像分析提供了可验证框架。

title: A Multi-Dataset Benchmark of YOLO-Based Weed Detection in Precision Agriculture
summary: Weed detection is an important component of precision agriculture, enabling site-specific weed management and reducing unnecessary herbicide use. Although deep learning methods have achieved strong results for crop and weed detection, many studies rely on single-dataset evaluation, making it difficult to assess robustness across different agricultural domains. This paper presents a multi-dataset benchmark of deep object detectors for weed detection in precision agriculture, with a focused evaluation of YOLO26 models. We evaluate nano, small, and medium variants on seven public weed-detection datasets covering different crops, weed species, field conditions, acquisition setups, and annotation protocols. The models are compared in terms of detection accuracy, model complexity, inference latency, FPS, and model size. In addition to in-dataset evaluation, we investigate cross-domain generalization using a unified one-class weed setup and evaluate multi-source training using the combined training subsets from all datasets. The results show that YOLO26 achieves strong in-dataset performance, with YOLO26m obtaining the highest average accuracy and YOLO26s providing the best practical accuracy-efficiency trade-off. However, cross-domain performance decreases substantially, with YOLO26s dropping from an average in-domain mAP$_{50:95}$ of 0.603 to 0.148 in the off-domain setting. Multi-source training improves performance on several datasets, but does not fully eliminate domain shift. Overall, the benchmark highlights the importance of dataset diversity, domain similarity, and target-domain adaptation for robust weed detection in real-world precision agriculture applications.

AI.tldr: 本文对YOLO26等深度目标检测器在7个公开杂草检测数据集上进行多数据集基准评测，评估其精度、效率及跨域泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习杂草检测研究多依赖单一数据集评估，难以衡量模型在不同农业场景下的鲁棒性，因此需要多数据集基准来系统评估。
AI.method: 在7个涵盖不同作物、杂草、田间条件、采集设备和标注协议的公开数据集上，评测YOLO26的nano、small、medium变体，比较检测精度、模型复杂度、推理延迟、FPS和模型大小，并开展数据集内评估、统一单类杂草的跨域泛化及多源联合训练实验。
AI.result: YOLO26数据集内性能强，YOLO26m平均精度最高，YOLO26s精度-效率权衡最佳；但跨域性能显著下降，YOLO26s平均域内mAP50:95从0.603降至0.148；多源训练可提升部分数据集表现，但未完全消除域偏移。
AI.conclusion: 数据集多样性、域相似性和目标域自适应对真实精准农业中的鲁棒杂草检测至关重要。

title: SpecRead: A Benchmark for Measuring Whether Language Models Understand Hardware Specifications
comment: 13 pages. Benchmark data and code at https://github.com/EDGAhab/specread
summary: Existing benchmarks for large language models (LLMs) in hardware design evaluate downstream artifacts such as generated RTL, assertions, or testbenches. When a model fails such a benchmark, the failure is ambiguous: it may have misread the specification, or it may have understood the specification and failed to write the code. We present SpecRead, a benchmark that isolates specification comprehension from generation ability. SpecRead v2.1 contains 385 questions over 10 open-source OpenTitan IP blocks: exact retrieval, cross-section reasoning, contradiction detection in mutated specifications, and spec-RTL consistency checking, plus 82 controls (41 distractor, 41 consistent-RTL). Type-4 items are built from real RTL mutations; we retain only mutations that Icarus Verilog simulation shows to change observable behavior. A with-spec vs. without-spec ablation suggests the questions require the excerpt, not training recall alone (without-spec accuracy 3/20 on the t1/t2 subset), though memorization of the source text may still help spot mutations. As an initial characterization with a small model, Ministral-3B scores 33.2% overall (128/385; macro average 39.0%): 55.2% on retrieval, 51.7% on cross-section reasoning. On the two contradiction-focused types, the verdict-plus-location measure gives 48.0% (t3) and 63.3% (t4), with a 51.2% false-positive rate on distractors and 100% on consistent-RTL controls. Layered scoring shows the model locates contradictions well (78.9-81.6% location accuracy) but scores lower on their category (43.9-49.7%). A structured "rule-table" prompting intervention lowers accuracy on every question type except t2 (tied). SpecRead is automatically scorable by deterministic checks, with gray-zone cases counted wrong under the conservative main scoring. The benchmark is regenerable for type-3 items via mutation injection, and built exclusively from public sources.

AI.tldr: SpecRead v2.1 是一个隔离大语言模型硬件设计规范理解能力与生成能力的基准，包含 385 道题和 82 个控制项，覆盖 OpenTitan 的 10 个 IP 块。初步评估显示 Ministral-3B 整体得分 33.2%，在检索和跨节推理上表现较好，但在矛盾检测类别上较低，且结构化提示干预反而降低多数类型准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有硬件设计 LLM 基准评估下游产物（如 RTL、断言、测试平台），失败原因模糊：可能是误读规范，也可能是理解规范但生成代码失败。因此需要隔离规范理解与生成能力的基准。
AI.method: 构建 SpecRead v2.1，包含 385 道题（精确检索、跨节推理、变异规范中的矛盾检测、规范-RTL 一致性检查）和 82 个控制项（41 干扰项、41 一致 RTL）。类型 4 项基于真实 RTL 变异，仅保留 Icarus Verilog 仿真显示可观察行为变化的变异。采用有规范与无规范消融、分层评分、结构化“规则表”提示干预，并由确定性检查自动评分。
AI.result: 无规范消融在 t1/t2 子集准确率 3/20。Ministral-3B 整体 33.2%（128/385，宏平均 39.0%）：检索 55.2%，跨节推理 51.7%。矛盾聚焦类型中，裁决加位置度量 t3 为 48.0%、t4 为 63.3%，干扰项假阳性率 51.2%，一致 RTL 控制项 100%。分层评分显示定位矛盾准确率 78.9-81.6%，但类别得分仅 43.9-49.7%。规则表提示除 t2 持平外，所有类型准确率下降。
AI.conclusion: SpecRead 能自动评分且可重新生成（类型 3 通过变异注入），仅使用公开来源。它有效隔离规范理解能力，揭示模型在矛盾检测类别判断上的不足，并表明结构化提示干预未必提升性能。灰色区域案例在主评分中保守计为错误。

title: MetaSampling: Making Frame Samplers Efficient for Long-Video Question Answering
summary: Frame selection is an important component of long-video question answering (VQA) with Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). Existing frame-selection methods improve over simple top-$k$ embedding retrieval and uniform sampling, but are typically applied under a fixed global selection budget. We introduce \textbf{MetaSampling}, a training-free, plug-and-play sampling strategy that can be applied on top of existing frame selectors. MetaSampling improves downstream VQA efficiency by dynamically reducing the number of frames passed to the MLLM while preserving, and in some cases improving, answer accuracy. We evaluate MetaSampling across 36 paired frame-selector--MLLM-backbone--VQA-benchmark configurations. MetaSampling reduces the number of selected frames in all 36 configurations and improves accuracy in 25 of them, yielding an average frame reduction of $8.9\%$ while slightly improving accuracy overall.

AI.tldr: 提出 MetaSampling，一种无需训练、即插即用的视频问答帧采样策略，可在现有帧选择器上动态减少送入多模态大模型的帧数，同时保持或提升准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有长视频问答的帧选择方法通常采用固定的全局选择预算，难以在效率和准确率之间取得更优平衡。
AI.method: MetaSampling 是一种无需训练、可即插即用的采样策略，叠加在已有帧选择器之上，动态减少传递给 MLLM 的帧数量，并在 36 组“帧选择器—MLLM 主干—VQA 基准”配置上进行评估。
AI.result: 在全部 36 组配置中均减少了所选帧数，其中 25 组准确率提升；平均减少 8.9% 的帧数，同时整体准确率略有提升。
AI.conclusion: MetaSampling 能有效提升下游 VQA 效率，并在多数情况下保持或改善答案准确率，说明动态帧数缩减是可行且有效的。

title: BIRD: Distilling Decision Boundaries into Rationales for MLLM Adaptation
summary: Adapting general-purpose multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to specialized domains requires learning domain-specific decision criteria, which often hinge on subtle visual distinctions between otherwise plausible answers. Rationale augmentation aims to expose such evidence through additional observations or inter-sample comparisons, yet a visually valid cue is not necessarily decision-relevant: it may describe how samples differ without changing the model's relative preference between competing answers. We therefore introduce BIRD, a self-improving Boundary-Informed Rationale Distillation framework that uses model-specific confusions to locate unresolved local decision boundaries and distills the evidence that resolves these confusions into rationales. For each sample, BIRD retrieves candidate neighbors from the target MLLM's own representation space and selects the most confusable one according to its answer preferences. It then generates answer-blind candidate evidence from their visual differences and functionally verifies which evidence most effectively strengthens the model's preference for the correct answer while avoiding inappropriate transfer across the pair. The verified evidence is then distilled into a single-sample rationale for standard supervised fine-tuning. Experiments on medical and chart VQA show that BIRD outperforms competing rationale-augmentation methods across two target MLLMs, while further analyses demonstrate clearer separation of confusable answers and stronger gains from model-matched supervision.

AI.tldr: BIRD框架通过利用模型自身的混淆边界，生成并验证与决策相关的理由，蒸馏为单样本理由用于监督微调，提升多模态大模型在专业领域的性能。
AI.motivation: 将通用多模态大语言模型适配到专业领域需要学习领域特定的决策标准，这些标准常依赖于细微的视觉差异。理由增强旨在通过额外观察或样本间比较暴露证据，但视觉上有效的线索未必与决策相关，可能只描述样本差异而不改变模型对竞争答案的相对偏好。
AI.method: 提出BIRD（边界感知理由蒸馏）自改进框架。对每个样本，从目标MLLM自身表示空间检索候选邻居，根据答案偏好选择最易混淆的邻居；从视觉差异生成答案无关的候选证据，并通过功能验证选择最能增强模型对正确答案偏好且避免不当迁移的证据；将验证后的证据蒸馏为单样本理由，用于标准监督微调。
AI.result: 在医学和图表VQA任务上，BIRD在两个目标MLLM上均优于竞争的理由增强方法；分析表明，BIRD能更清晰地区分易混淆答案，并且模型匹配的监督带来更大增益。
AI.conclusion: BIRD通过模型特定的混淆定位和功能验证，有效蒸馏出决策相关的理由，提升专业领域多模态大模型的性能，证明了模型匹配监督的重要性。

title: Robust Biomolecular Complex Design Across Protein Conformational Landscapes
summary: Proteins populate conformational ensembles, yet structure-based biomolecular design typically optimizes candidates against a single target conformation. Consequently, a candidate that fits one state can lose favorable interactions or develop steric clashes when the target adopts another. We introduce FlexEvo, a model-agnostic evolutionary framework that adapts candidates once at inference time from a single target conformation to improve compatibility with alternative natural conformations unseen during adaptation, without retraining the source model or requiring a conformational ensemble. FlexEvo casts cross-state adaptation as geometry-constrained bi-objective optimization, balancing preservation of input-state interactions against robustness to plausible conformational perturbations. To limit the search space and reduce invalid structural edits, geometry-derived FlexBoxes define protected anchor regions, adaptable regions for local exploration, and forbidden regions for clash avoidance. A unified all-atom representation supports topology-preserving adaptation across diverse binder categories, while Pareto selection preserves nondominated candidates across the two objectives. We evaluate FlexEvo across multiple generation baselines and nine representative binder categories spanning diverse molecular sizes and structural topologies. FlexEvo reduces the category-balanced mean relative performance degradation from 47.8% to 4.4%, while adding only 1.4--3.1 minutes of adaptation per sample. These results establish single-state inference-time adaptation as a practical route toward robust biomolecular complex design across protein conformational landscapes.

AI.tldr: 提出一种模型无关的进化框架FlexEvo，可在推理阶段将基于单一目标构象设计的候选分子适配到未见过的其他天然构象，从而提升蛋白质复合物设计的构象鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于结构的生物分子设计通常只针对单一目标构象优化候选分子，当靶标发生构象变化时，原本匹配的候选可能失去有利相互作用或产生空间碰撞，因此需要一种无需重训练、无需构象集合的跨构象适配方法。
AI.method: FlexEvo将跨状态适配建模为几何约束的双目标优化：在保留输入状态相互作用与增强对合理构象扰动的鲁棒性之间权衡。利用几何推导的FlexBoxes划分保护锚定区、可适应局部探索区和禁止碰撞区，以限制搜索空间并减少无效结构编辑。采用统一全原子表示支持多种结合剂类别的拓扑保持适配，并通过Pareto选择保留非支配候选。
AI.result: 在多种生成基线和九类代表性结合剂上评估，FlexEvo将类别平衡的平均相对性能退化从47.8%降至4.4%，每个样本仅增加1.4–3.1分钟适配时间。
AI.conclusion: 单状态推理时适配是一种实用途径，可提升生物分子复合物设计在蛋白质构象景观变化下的鲁棒性。

title: PlaylistEval: Can Video-Language Judges Be Trusted at Day Scale and Beyond?
comment: 53 pages, 15 figures, 23 tables. Project page: https://playlisteval.github.io
summary: Video-language models are increasingly used as judges of video understanding, both for evaluating model outputs and for training reward models. Whether their judgments remain reliable when the evidence is buried in day-long videos has yet to be established. Existing benchmarks cannot answer this. Their videos are typically only a few minutes long, many answer pairs can be separated from the transcript alone, and collecting human judgments does not scale to ultra-long videos. We introduce PlaylistEval, an agentic framework that builds video-language judge benchmarks over 100-hour playlist collection without human annotation. It automatically generates questions with paired answers whose differences are controlled by causal degradation, so that every pair demands retrieval across the collection. The resulting benchmark contains 630 pairs across seven domains spanning both static and dynamic knowledge, and on a stratified subset of 152 pairs it agrees with human judgments 93.0% of the time (IAA 0.781). Evaluating 17 omnimodal and multimodal models from eight families reveals that frontier judges reach only 75.4% pairwise accuracy, while open-source judge models perform far behind. We further show that both retrieval and final judgment depend on using multiple modalities, and that judge accuracy degrades as the playlist set grows. We release our pipeline, benchmark, and evaluation code at https://playlisteval.github.io.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PlaylistEval，一个无需人工标注的智能体框架，用于构建超长视频（100小时播放列表）的视频语言评判基准。基准包含630对问题-答案，覆盖七个领域，在152对分层子集上与人类判断一致率达93.0%。评估17个模型发现前沿评判模型仅达75.4%成对准确率，开源模型更差，且多模态检索和判断至关重要，准确率随播放列表增大而下降。
AI.motivation: 视频语言模型日益被用作视频理解的评判者，但其在证据埋藏于长达一天视频中的可靠性尚未验证。现有基准视频仅几分钟，许多答案仅凭转录即可区分，且人工标注无法扩展到超长视频。
AI.method: 提出PlaylistEval智能体框架，在100小时播放列表上自动生成视频语言评判基准，无需人工标注。通过因果退化控制生成成对答案，确保每对都需要跨集合检索。基准包含630对，覆盖七个领域（静态与动态知识）。在152对分层子集上验证与人类判断的一致性。评估来自八个家族的17个全模态和多模态模型。
AI.result: 在152对分层子集上，基准与人类判断一致率达93.0%（IAA 0.781）。评估显示，前沿评判模型仅达到75.4%的成对准确率，开源评判模型表现远落后。检索和最终判断均依赖多模态信息，且随着播放列表集合增大，评判准确率下降。
AI.conclusion: 现有视频语言评判模型在超长视频场景下可靠性不足，多模态检索与判断是关键，且规模扩大会导致性能退化。本文发布流水线、基准和评估代码以促进相关研究。

title: UnfoldCRF: Structured Mask Refinement with Image-Conditioned Latent Regions
summary: Learned mask refiners improve segmentation accuracy, but it is hard to tell how much of the improvement comes from explicit structure rather than from extra capacity, and whether it holds up when the mask generator or its error distribution changes. UnfoldCRF treats refinement as inference in a conditional random field over pixel labels and latent region variables. Its energy has a corrected unary term, learned local pairwise interactions, and image-conditioned latent-region consistency, with a null state that lets a region with weak label agreement withdraw from the consistency term; inference unrolls damped mean-field updates on this one energy. To isolate the effect of structure, we compare against recurrent black-box refiners that read the same inputs and receive the same parameter budget, stage count, and supervision. On COD10K, UnfoldCRF beats the strongest matched control by 1.0 $F^ω_β$ point, improves all four COD metrics, and lowers the fraction of images made worse from 11.7\% to 8.5\%. Under a train-once protocol over five datasets and several mask sources, the 2.6M-parameter variant gains 4.2 mean $Δ$IoU against 2.0 for its control, and a variant built on frozen DINOv2 features matches the strongest foundation-model refiner with about a seventh of its resident parameters while staying ahead of its own control. On mask generators never seen in training, the gain is 2.0 $F^ω_β$ points against 0.6 for the control. Zeroing individual messages shows where the corrections come from: the pairwise messages mostly fix boundaries, the region messages mostly fix non-boundary errors. Code and supporting materials will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 UnfoldCRF，将掩码细化建模为像素标签和潜在区域变量上的条件随机场推断，通过展开阻尼平均场更新实现，并与相同输入、参数预算、阶段数和监督的循环黑箱细化器对比，以验证显式结构带来的增益。
AI.motivation: 现有学习式掩码细化器能提升分割精度，但很难判断提升有多少来自显式结构而非额外容量，也不清楚当掩码生成器或其误差分布变化时是否仍然稳健。
AI.method: UnfoldCRF 将细化视为 CRF 推断；其能量函数包含校正一元项、可学习局部成对交互、图像条件潜在区域一致性，并设置空状态使弱标签一致区域退出一致性项；推断过程展开阻尼平均场更新。作者与读取相同输入、具有相同参数预算、阶段数和监督的循环黑箱细化器进行匹配对比。
AI.result: 在 COD10K 上，UnfoldCRF 比最强匹配控制高 1.0 Fωβ，四项 COD 指标均提升，变差图像比例从 11.7% 降至 8.5%。在五数据集、多掩码源的 train-once 协议下，2.6M 参数变体平均 ΔIoU 增益为 4.2，控制为 2.0；基于冻结 DINOv2 特征的变体以约七分之一常驻参数匹配最强基础模型细化器，并优于自身控制。在训练中未见的掩码生成器上，增益为 2.0 Fωβ，控制为 0.6。消融显示，成对消息主要修正边界，区域消息主要修正非边界错误。
AI.conclusion: 显式结构化 CRF 细化在匹配容量和监督下能带来稳定且可解释的提升，并在跨数据集、跨掩码源及未见生成器上保持优势，说明增益并非仅来自额外容量。代码和支持材料将公开。

title: Self-Designed Evaluators and Warm Memory for Long-Horizon Agents
summary: A tool-using language-model agent deployed over a long stream of tasks receives no reward, so it cannot tell whether it succeeded, cannot safely retry, and cannot label the experience it needs to improve. We present SelfSuite, in which the agent's own base model, given only the world's public materials, designs a small evaluation suite of weighted judges and grounded per-task briefs, freezes it, and uses it to gate a keep-best retry and to label a typed, outcome-tracked memory. On matched five-repeat benchmarks over tau2-bench and AppWorld, SelfSuite scores above the plain agent without any labels, matches methods given ten expert labels on tau2-bench, and trails Agentic Context Engineering (ACE) on AppWorld, where code execution gives a direct success signal. In an ablation campaign run on the same tasks, it is above label-free ACE in every repeat, and the gated second attempt is the only component whose removal hurts in every repeat. We also simulate a subject-matter expert who grades ten onboarding tasks per world. Using those labels to calibrate SelfSuite's evaluator gives a small, consistent gain, and using them to warm up ACE's memory lifts ACE to tie calibrated SelfSuite. A single-run study on a second model family shows the same ordering.

AI.tldr: 提出 SelfSuite：让工具使用型语言模型智能体仅基于公开材料，用自身基座模型设计小型加权评审评估套件和任务简报，冻结后用于门控 keep-best 重试，并标注带类型、追踪结果的内存。
AI.motivation: 长期任务流中部署的工具智能体没有奖励，因此无法判断是否成功、无法安全重试，也无法标注用于自我改进的经验。
AI.method: 智能体用自身基座模型设计由加权 judges 和 grounded per-task briefs 组成的评估套件并冻结；用其门控 keep-best 重试，并构建 typed、outcome-tracked memory。在 tau2-bench 和 AppWorld 上进行五次重复匹配基准、消融实验、模拟专家标注校准，并在第二模型族上做单次验证。
AI.result: 无任何标签时，SelfSuite 超过普通智能体；在 tau2-bench 上匹配使用十个专家标签的方法；在 AppWorld 上落后于 ACE，因为代码执行提供直接成功信号。消融中，它在每次重复都高于无标签 ACE；门控第二次尝试是唯一移除后每次重复都受损的组件。用模拟专家每世界十个 onboarding 任务标签校准评估器，带来小幅一致增益；用这些标签热启动 ACE 内存后，ACE 追平校准后的 SelfSuite。第二模型族单次研究显示相同排序。
AI.conclusion: SelfSuite 能在无奖励、少标签条件下为智能体提供有效成功判断、安全重试门控和经验标注；但在有直接执行成功信号时仍不如 ACE。专家标签可用于校准评估器并获得稳定小增益。

title: Knowing When Thinking Is Not Enough: Teaching Small Reasoning Models to Reason Beyond Their Parametric Knowledge
summary: Scaling test-time computation is a powerful way to improve language-model reasoning, and is particularly appealing for small reasoning models (sRMs) that are cheap to serve. However, is additional thinking always the right operation? By intervening at intermediate reasoning states across two model families and multiple scales, we find that self-refinement largely consolidates probability mass onto solutions already reachable from the current state, rather than making new ones reachable. These interventions reveal two failure regimes: execution bottlenecks, where the correct path is reachable and reflection can recover it, and knowledge bottlenecks, where relevant external information makes it reachable. Motivated by this distinction, we introduce FlyBy, a selective querying framework, and train 4B and 8B variants to reason first, diagnose what remains unresolved, and, at a knowledge bottleneck, query stronger models whose parametric knowledge extends beyond its own. Supervised fine-tuning bootstraps a multi-depth query action, and cost-aware reinforcement learning calibrates whether to query, what to ask, and how much to spend. On 1,158 hard problems across six benchmarks, FlyBy-4B achieves 45.96% pass@8, surpassing Qwen3-14B (41.64%) at 2.7 times lower serving cost, while also exceeding Qwen3-8B in pass@1 (16.85% vs. 15.31%). Scaling to FlyBy-8B further improves pass@8 to 51.81%.

AI.tldr: 论文研究测试时增加思考是否总有效，发现自我精炼主要巩固当前状态已可达的解，并区分执行瓶颈与知识瓶颈，进而提出选择性查询框架 FlyBy，让 4B/8B 小模型在知识瓶颈时查询更强模型，在多个基准上超越更大模型且降低服务成本。
AI.motivation: 扩展测试时计算可提升语言模型推理，尤其适合服务成本低的小推理模型，但额外思考未必总是正确操作。干预中间推理状态后发现，自我精炼难以让新解变得可达，且存在执行瓶颈和知识瓶颈两类失败模式，因此需要更选择性地引入外部知识。
AI.method: 通过干预两个模型家族、多个规模下的中间推理状态，分析自我精炼作用；提出 FlyBy 选择性查询框架，训练 4B 和 8B 变体先推理、诊断未解决问题，并在知识瓶颈处查询参数知识更强的模型；用监督微调引导多深度查询动作，再用成本感知强化学习校准是否查询、查询什么以及花费多少。
AI.result: 在六个基准的 1,158 个难题上，FlyBy-4B 达到 45.96% pass@8，超过 Qwen3-14B 的 41.64%，服务成本低 2.7 倍；pass@1 为 16.85%，超过 Qwen3-8B 的 15.31%。扩展到 FlyBy-8B 后，pass@8 提升至 51.81%。
AI.conclusion: 自我反思更适合执行瓶颈，而知识瓶颈需要外部查询。选择性查询能让小模型以更低成本超越更大模型，并且扩大模型规模可进一步提升性能。

title: ActionLens: Diagnosing Spatial-Temporal Binding Failures in Vision-Language Models
summary: Video-capable vision-language models score above 80\% on popular benchmarks yet struggle with spatial-temporal binding: associating the right action with the right person at the right moment. We introduce ActionLens, a diagnostic benchmark of 6,701 multiple-choice video questions spanning five targeted diagnostics: transition detection, actor-specific identification, concurrent action binding, directed interaction reasoning, and gaze detection. Ground-truth answers are derived deterministically from 1.58 million per-second, per-person annotations. Fourteen rounds of human quality engineering raised answer clarity from 53% to above 90% human accuracy. Across 20 VLMs, the full-set leader scores 68.8%; on the human-reviewed subset, it scores 65.9% versus 91.0% for the pooled human reference. Gaze detection remains near chance against 89.6% human accuracy. On actor disambiguation, reference-interface controls show that relational descriptions recover 5.55--13.25 points over static coordinates, confirming a substantial numeric-parsing penalty; yet visual boxes still lead every model by 1.15--6.50 points, exposing a residual unboxed actor-resolution gap. A binding-trap analysis shows models systematically select the wrong actor's action. ActionLens provides diagnostic measurements of these distinct failure modes across model families and scales for direct comparison. We release all data, code, and evaluation scripts at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/lmms-eval-2276

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ActionLens，一个用于诊断视频视觉语言模型时空绑定能力的基准，包含 6,701 个视频多选问答，发现模型在将正确动作绑定到正确人物与正确时刻方面显著落后于人类。
AI.motivation: 现有视频视觉语言模型在流行基准上得分超过 80%，但仍难以完成时空绑定：把正确动作与正确人物、正确时刻关联起来，因此需要新的诊断性评测来定位这些失败模式。
AI.method: 构建 6,701 个多选视频问题，覆盖五类诊断：转换检测、特定人物识别、并发动作绑定、有向交互推理和注视检测；真值由 158 万条每秒、每人的标注确定性生成；经过 14 轮人工质量工程提升答案清晰度；评测 20 个视觉语言模型，并进行人审子集、参考界面控制和绑定陷阱分析。
AI.result: 全量基准最高模型得 68.8%；人审子集上最高模型 65.9%，人类参考为 91.0%；注视检测接近随机，而人类为 89.6%；人物消歧中，关系描述比静态坐标提升 5.55—13.25 分，但视觉框仍领先所有模型 1.15—6.50 分，显示未框选人物解析缺口；模型在绑定陷阱中系统性地选择错误人物的动作。
AI.conclusion: ActionLens 能跨模型家族和规模诊断不同的时空绑定失败模式，便于直接比较，并已发布全部数据、代码和评估脚本。

title: Position Aware Layer Queries for Test Time Training in Vision Language Models
summary: Test-Time Training (TTT) adapts models to incoming test samples (e.g. out-of-distribution, (OOD)) when conventional fine-tuning is infeasible. Existing TTT methods for Vision-Language Models (VLMs) create supervision from several augmented views, each requiring forward (and often backward) passes through the entire VLM, incurring substantial computational cost. We observe that one forward pass with all the intermediate layer outputs already yields far more signal than the final embedding from all augmentations. We introduce Layer Query Network (LQN), a lightweight approach that can adapt a frozen VLM (teacher) in a single forward pass of the VLM via a small model (student). LQN uses Position-Aware Distillation (PAD) to mimic the teacher VLM's intermediate-layer spatial tokens by querying spatial coordinates of intermediate tokens. LQN additionally relies on Location Consistency Regularization (LCR), a self-supervision technique, replacing expensive O(H x W) image augmentation with O(1) coordinate sampling. Integrating these, LQN i) adapts and improves zero-shot CLIP ViT-B/16 by 9.8% Top-1 on OOD ImageNet, ii) outperforms the previous best GS-Bias on fine-grained classification by 3.9% Top-1, iii) achieves faster convergence than TPS for CLIP ResNet-50 (47 mins vs 55 mins), iv) generalizes adaptation to VLMs like SigLIP, EVA-CLIP, and CoCa, and lightweight students like MLP, ResNet, VGG, and v) extends to panoptic, instance, and semantic segmentation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Layer Query Network（LQN），一种轻量测试时适应方法，仅需对冻结的视觉-语言模型（VLM）进行单次前向传播，即可通过小模型（学生）适应 VLM，并在 OOD、细粒度分类和分割任务上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 测试时适应方法通常依赖多个增强视图，每个视图都要经过整个 VLM 的前向甚至反向传播，计算成本很高。作者观察到，单次前向传播中所有中间层输出所包含的信号，远多于所有增强视图的最终嵌入。
AI.method: LQN 使用小模型作为学生，在冻结 VLM 作为教师的一次前向传播中进行适应。其核心包括：Position-Aware Distillation（PAD），通过查询中间 token 的空间坐标来模仿教师 VLM 的中间层空间 token；Location Consistency Regularization（LCR），一种自监督技术，用 O(1) 坐标采样替代 O(H×W) 图像增强。
AI.result: LQN 将零样本 CLIP ViT-B/16 在 OOD ImageNet 上提升 9.8% Top-1；在细粒度分类上比此前最佳的 GS-Bias 高出 3.9% Top-1；对 CLIP ResNet-50 收敛快于 TPS（47 分钟 vs 55 分钟）；可泛化到 SigLIP、EVA-CLIP、CoCa 等 VLM，以及 MLP、ResNet、VGG 等轻量学生模型，并扩展到全景、实例和语义分割。
AI.conclusion: LQN 表明利用单次前向中的中间层空间 token 和坐标采样，可以高效、有效地适应冻结 VLM，降低计算成本，并具备跨模型、跨任务和跨学生架构的广泛适用性。

title: HTN Planning as a Coordination Layer for Multi-Server MCP Tool Orchestration
comment: 5 pages. Camera-ready version of a paper accepted at the ICAPS 2026 Workshop on Hierarchical Planning (HPlan 2026), Dublin. Non-archival. Code: https://github.com/PCfVW/hplan26-artifact
summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) isolates servers by design: only the host can orchestrate cross-server workflows. When the host is a large language model, the resulting orchestrations are non-deterministic, non-reproducible, and pay one inference round-trip per tool call. We present a coordination architecture in which a Hierarchical Task Network (HTN) planner generates a verifiable cross-server plan once, and a runtime middleware executes it deterministically across multiple MCP servers, binding cross-action data dependencies via a template mechanism (\verb|${context.X}|) substituted at execution time. The architecture mirrors MCP's isolation constraint: each compound task decomposes into server-local primitive actions, and inter-server data flow is bound at execution time via JSON-path output extractors. We instantiate the architecture on five HTN domains spanning laboratory robotics, bioinformatics and multiscale modelling, and demonstrate end-to-end execution from a browser-based plan controller against eight live third-party MCP servers querying real biological databases.

AI.tldr: 提出一种协调架构，用HTN规划器一次性生成可验证的跨服务器计划，并由运行时中间件在多个MCP服务器上确定性执行，通过模板机制和JSON路径绑定跨动作数据依赖，在五个领域和八个真实MCP服务器上验证。
AI.motivation: MCP设计上隔离服务器，仅主机可编排跨服务器工作流；当主机为大语言模型时，编排非确定、不可复现，且每次工具调用需一轮推理。
AI.method: HTN规划器生成可验证的跨服务器计划；运行时中间件确定性执行；用模板机制(${context.X})在执行时替换绑定数据依赖；复合任务分解为服务器本地原语动作，服务器间数据流通过JSON路径输出提取器在执行时绑定。
AI.result: 在实验室机器人、生物信息学和多尺度建模等五个HTN领域实例化；通过基于浏览器的计划控制器对八个实时第三方MCP服务器端到端执行，查询真实生物数据库。
AI.conclusion: 该架构在遵循MCP隔离约束的同时，实现了确定、可复现的跨服务器编排，避免了LLM主机编排的非确定性和额外推理开销。

title: ControlScope: Workflow Revision and Reliability in LLM Agents
summary: How much of a running workflow should a language model agent revise? ControlScope compares continuing generated code, editing the next tool call's data arguments, and replacing the unfinished workflow from the same public execution state. The nested permissions separate available repairs from the actions an agent selects. We evaluate one-time and repeated reviews across filesystem tasks, ALFWorld, and AppWorld. Across two source programs per task and three reasoning-reviewer draws on 20 filesystem tasks, FULL completes 15-16 tasks versus 13 for KEEP; across four fast draws it completes 10-13 versus 13. Fresh student-record confirmation reproduces a batch-read repair. ALFWorld fast panels yield KEEP/ARG/FULL scores of 85/86/87 on 87 tasks across 52 scenes and 134/134/127 on 134 tasks across four scenes; reasoning on the 87-task cohort also yields 85/86/87 with substantial review cost. An AppWorld V1 official-test panel of 585 task instances from 195 scenario templates shows small net differences. Frozen replays expose viable agent-written replacements interrupted by later revision in two failed file-organization runs. An offline source-trajectory midpoint comparison shows later reviews completing an insufficient repair. Five-call protection saves 19.4% of logged model output and loses one success across 20 fresh source runs. An argument-only shortcut shows that the broader sampled policy can overlook a cheaper successful edit available in both operation sets. These outcomes tie repair access to actual choices and subsequent execution.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ControlScope，研究语言模型智能体在运行工作流中应修改多少：继续生成代码、编辑下一次工具调用的参数，还是从同一公开执行状态替换未完成工作流。通过嵌套权限区分可修复选项与智能体实际选择，并在文件系统、ALFWorld、AppWorld 上评估，发现修复范围与执行效果相关，但更大修改范围并不总是更好。
AI.motivation: 探究智能体应修复多少运行中的工作流，以及可用修复权限如何影响实际选择与后续执行；核心是区分“能够修复”和“选择修复”。
AI.method: ControlScope 比较 KEEP、ARG、FULL 三种修复范围；定义嵌套权限；在文件系统任务、ALFWorld、AppWorld 上进行一次性与重复审查、快速与推理评审、多次抽样；并使用冻结回放、离线源轨迹中点比较、五调用保护、仅参数捷径等分析。
AI.result: 文件系统20任务中，推理评审下 FULL 完成15-16个，KEEP为13个；快速抽取下 FULL为10-13个，KEEP为13个。ALFWorld快速面板：87任务/52场景 KEEP/ARG/FULL 为85/86/87；134任务/4场景为134/134/127；87任务推理也为85/86/87但审查成本高。AppWorld 585任务/195模板显示净差异小。冻结回放显示两个失败文件组织运行中智能体编写的替换被后续修订中断；离线中点比较显示后续审查完成不足修复；五调用保护节省19.4%模型输出但20次新源运行中少1次成功；仅参数捷径显示更广采样策略可能忽视两种操作集都存在的更便宜成功编辑。
AI.conclusion: 修复范围与权限同实际选择和后续执行紧密绑定；更大修复权限不保证更好性能，需要权衡审查成本、输出节省与成功率。

title: Skill2Env: Capability-Oriented Environment Synthesis from Skills for General Agents
summary: Executable environments are critical for post-training agents on tasks that require tool use and multi-step interaction, but constructing executable tasks together with their environments remains difficult to scale. Skills provide reusable domain knowledge, operational procedures, and tool-use instructions, but a substantial gap remains between the information contained in a skill and a concrete, challenging task with a complete executable environment. To address this gap, we introduce Skill2Env, a capability-oriented framework that starts from a skill and uses agent capability demands to guide task and environment synthesis. Skill2Env represents these demands through reusable difficulty patterns and instantiates them into task blueprints that specify objectives, challenges, environment facts, information boundaries, and acceptance criteria. These blueprints guide the joint construction of task instructions, execution substrates, workspaces, and rubric-based evaluators around source skills. We further propose Iterative Task Hardening, which uses solver execution evidence to identify insufficiently challenging task designs, strengthen or extend their difficulty-pattern instantiations, and revise the corresponding blueprints and environments. Using 1.5K high-scoring trajectories generated from Skill2Env environments for supervised fine-tuning, we observe consistent improvements across a broad range of agent benchmarks, demonstrating the effectiveness of capability-oriented environment synthesis for agent post-training.

AI.tldr: 提出 Skill2Env：一种从技能出发、以智能体能力需求为导向，自动合成可执行任务与环境的框架，并用迭代任务强化提升任务难度，最终通过生成轨迹微调提升智能体表现。
AI.motivation: 可执行环境对需要工具使用和多步交互的智能体后训练至关重要，但从技能到具体、有挑战性且环境完整的可执行任务之间存在较大鸿沟，难以规模化构建。
AI.method: Skill2Env 以技能为起点，用可复用的难度模式表示能力需求，并实例化为任务蓝图，规定目标、挑战、环境事实、信息边界和验收标准；再联合构建任务指令、执行底座、工作区和基于评分量表的评估器。同时提出 Iterative Task Hardening，利用求解器执行证据识别挑战不足的任务，强化或扩展难度模式，并修订蓝图与环境。
AI.result: 使用 Skill2Env 环境生成的 1.5K 条高分轨迹进行监督微调后，在多个智能体基准上取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 面向能力的可执行环境合成方法能有效支持智能体后训练，并缩小技能与可执行任务环境之间的差距。

title: SCOPD: Sparse-Context On-Policy Self-Distillation for Efficient Vision-Language Models
summary: Reasoning vision-language models (VLMs) process images and videos as long sequences of visual tokens, making inference expensive. Training-free token pruning reduces this cost, but aggressive compression can sharply degrade performance, often attributed to irreversible loss of task-relevant visual information. We show that this explanation is incomplete. In a fixed-context Pass@K analysis, repeated sampling from the same pruned visual representation recovers many examples missed by greedy decoding, indicating that useful visual evidence can remain accessible but be used unreliably. We call this the representation-utilization gap. Motivated by this observation, we introduce SCOPD, a sparse-context on-policy self-distillation framework in which a student generates reasoning trajectories from pruned visual tokens while a privileged full-context teacher supervises the same on-policy prefixes. SCOPD requires no ground-truth responses, architectural changes, or additional inference-time computation. We further introduce SCOPD+, which uses a small visual-budget intervention to identify visually sensitive response positions and selectively distill them. At 10% visual-token retention, the Vanilla model retains 86.37% of its unpruned performance across 13 benchmarks. SCOPD raises this to 90.49%, while SCOPD+ further improves it to 92.43%. Across token budgets, benchmarks, and pruning operators, our results show that efficient reasoning depends not only on which visual information survives pruning, but also on how reliably the model learns to use it.

AI.tldr: 论文研究推理型视觉语言模型在视觉token剪枝后性能下降的原因，发现存在“表示-利用缺口”：有用视觉证据仍在但被不可靠使用。为此提出无需训练的SCOPD稀疏上下文在线自蒸馏框架及其增强版SCOPD+，在10%视觉token保留率下显著缩小性能损失。
AI.motivation: 推理型VLM将图像/视频视为长视觉token序列，推理成本高。免训练token剪枝可降本，但激进压缩会严重掉点，通常被归因于任务相关视觉信息不可逆丢失。作者通过固定上下文Pass@K分析发现，同一剪枝表示重复采样可恢复贪心解码漏掉的样本，说明信息仍可访问但利用不可靠，因此需要解决“表示-利用缺口”。
AI.method: 使用固定上下文Pass@K分析揭示表示-利用缺口；提出SCOPD：学生模型从剪枝视觉token生成推理轨迹，特权全上下文教师对相同在线策略前缀进行监督，无需真实答案、架构改动或额外推理计算；进一步提出SCOPD+，通过小视觉预算干预识别视觉敏感响应位置并选择性蒸馏。
AI.result: 在10%视觉token保留率下，13个基准上Vanilla模型保留无剪枝性能的86.37%，SCOPD提升至90.49%，SCOPD+进一步提升至92.43%；在不同token预算、基准和剪枝算子下结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 高效推理不仅取决于哪些视觉信息在剪枝后存活，还取决于模型能否学会可靠地利用这些信息；通过在线自蒸馏可有效缩小表示-利用缺口，提升剪枝后推理性能。

title: Nudgeability: Reasoning Models Follow Confidence Signals Without Tracking Their Own Competence
summary:
Reasoning language models that can call tools must decide during inference whether to answer unaided or delegate. Any self-reflection mechanism for this must answer three questions: where the reflective signal comes from (verbal reports, output distributions, hidden states, a separate predictor), how it is presented to the model (numerical prediction, confidence token, prompt injection), and whether it changes the model's subsequent action. We isolate the third question. At a fixed point in otherwise identical reasoning trajectories, we insert a single first-person sentence expressing either confidence or doubt; the model then continues reasoning and chooses whether to answer directly or call a tool. Comparing these counterfactual continuations measures the causal effect of the reflective signal on delegation. We call this behavioral response Nudgeability and measure it along two dimensions: sensitivity, how strongly confidence and doubt change delegation rates, and targeting, whether delegation increases for problems the model cannot solve unaided and decreases for those it can.
  Across nine small-to-medium open-weight reasoning models from three families (Qwen, Gemma, and GLM) and two tasks, models are consistently sensitive: doubt increases delegation and confidence decreases it, with a median confidence-to-doubt swing of 20.6 percentage points, and 53 to 70 points for the larger provider-served models. This responsiveness is poorly targeted: a median 42% of induced flips are well-targeted, only a +2 percentage-point lift over a random-selection baseline. Confidence language is thus a strong control surface for delegation, but current models use it only weakly in accordance with their actual competence. Nudgeability offers a simple, post-training-free way to evaluate both sensitivity and targeting as endogenous self-reflection mechanisms mature.

AI.tldr: 论文研究推理语言模型在决定是否调用工具时，对插入的自信或怀疑语言信号的行为响应，称为Nudgeability，并从敏感性与针对性两个维度衡量。
AI.motivation: 能调用工具的推理模型必须在推理中决定独立回答还是委托工具。自我反思机制需回答信号来源、呈现方式和是否改变后续行动，本文聚焦第三个问题：反思信号是否因果影响委托决策。
AI.method: 在相同推理轨迹的固定点插入一句表达自信或怀疑的第一人称语句，比较反事实续写，测量其对委托率的因果效应。在Qwen、Gemma、GLM三家族9个中小型开源推理模型和两个任务上，评估敏感性与针对性。
AI.result: 模型普遍敏感：怀疑增加委托、自信减少委托，中位自信到怀疑摆幅为20.6个百分点，较大服务模型达53至70个百分点。但针对性差：中位仅42%的诱导翻转是良好针对，仅比随机选择基线高2个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 自信语言是委托决策的强控制面，但当前模型仅弱按其真实能力使用该信号。Nudgeability为评估内生自反思机制的敏感性与针对性提供了一种无需后训练的方法。

title: Re:Cognize -- Open-Set Comic Character Re-Identification
summary: A manga reader meets a character on one page and knows them on sight a hundred pages later, without ever being handed a cast list. Re-identifying comic characters demands the same, open-set and sequential: pages arrive as a stream in reading order, new faces appear before anyone names them, and the cast is assembled as the story is read. $\textbf{Re:Cognize}$ evaluates recognition as the story is read, not against a cast handed over in advance: four protocols on one query stream, from closed-set retrieval to a cast the model must build and grow itself. The surprise is where models fail. Recognising is close to solved: one reference image per character already ranks as well as a gallery built in advance. Knowing what to believe is not: a model that adds its own matches makes its cast worse, while the same growth with correct labels would gain over twenty points of top-1 accuracy. The bottleneck is acceptance, not vision, and one comparison decides it: an addition pays exactly when it is right more often than the cast already was on the queries it takes over. The comparison has nothing to fit, and measured on half of a new corpus it calls the other half correctly. $\textbf{ReCast}$ puts it to work with nothing fitted on data: a cast sheet of one running average per character, grown only where the page itself vouches for a crop. It recovers a third to two thirds of what perfect labels would, depending on whether the cast starts from random examples or from first appearances. Re:Cognize measures whether a model can read along; ReCast is a cast that does. Our claims are on identity maintenance, recognising characters already met; the emergence of new ones is measured as a diagnostic under a fixed reference rule, and we propose no method for it.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Re:Cognize 与 ReCast，研究漫画角色在阅读流中的开放集、序列化重识别：模型需边读边维护角色身份并自行增长角色名单，而非依赖预先给定的完整演员表。
AI.motivation: 漫画读者能在没有角色名单的情况下，按阅读顺序识别并跟踪角色。现有重识别多假设封闭集或预先构建的图库，无法评估这种随故事推进、新角色不断出现的开放式身份维护能力。
AI.method: 提出 Re:Cognize，用同一查询流上的四种协议评估从封闭集检索到自增长角色名单的识别能力；分析模型自行接受匹配的决策问题；提出 ReCast，无需在数据上拟合，为每个角色维护一个运行平均表示，仅当页面自身证实时才增长角色名单。
AI.result: 识别本身接近解决：每个角色一张参考图即可达到与预建图库相当的效果。失败在于“是否相信新匹配”：模型自行添加匹配会损害角色名单，而同样增长若使用正确标签可提升超过 20 个 top-1 点。瓶颈是接受决策，而非视觉识别；一个简单比较准则可在新语料一半上测得并正确预测另一半。ReCast 可恢复完美标签收益的三分之一到三分之二，取决于角色名单从随机样例还是首次出现开始。
AI.conclusion: Re:Cognize 衡量模型能否“边读边识别”，ReCast 实现了可行的角色名单维护。论文主要贡献在已遇角色的身份维护；新角色出现仅作为固定参考规则下的诊断指标，并未提出新角色涌现的解决方法。

title: Rethinking Latent Visual Reasoning: Grounding Latent Reasoning in Visual Evidence
summary: Latent visual reasoning (LVR) enables multimodal large language models (MLLMs) to perform intermediate computation in continuous latent tokens rather than expressing every reasoning step in words. However, unlike textual CoT, latent reasoning is not directly observable, making it difficult to supervise what latent tokens learn. In this work, we first conduct a thorough analysis of latent-token behavior and identify a latent evidence-credit gap: latent tokens respond only weakly to image perturbations that alter the correct answer. We hypothesize that this issue stems from the lack of explicit supervision during GRPO training. These findings suggest that a final-answer reward provides too little guidance on what visual evidence to preserve or how credit should be assigned across latent tokens. To bridge this gap, we propose ReaLVR, which brings visual-evidence supervision to the model's own free-running latent trajectories. ReaLVR contrasts correct and model-generated wrong answers to determine where stronger supervision is needed, and relevant and mismatched visual evidence to specify what to preserve. Across three model families, ReaLVR consistently outperforms evaluated LVR baselines, achieving the highest five-task average of 63.7% on Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Crucially, we are the first to scale visual reasoning in latent space, showing that our framework continues to deliver robust improvements at frontier model scales up to 235B. Further analyses show more question-sensitive latent-token positions, stronger alignment with relevant visual regions, and greater fixed-context dependence on the most attended latent tokens.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多模态大模型中的潜在视觉推理（LVR），发现潜在token存在“证据-信用差距”，即对改变正确答案的图像扰动响应微弱，为此提出ReaLVR，通过对比正确与错误答案以及相关与不匹配视觉证据，为潜在轨迹提供视觉证据监督，在多个模型规模上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 潜在视觉推理中，中间计算在连续潜在token中进行，不像文本CoT那样可直接观察，难以监督潜在token学到了什么。分析发现潜在token对影响答案的图像扰动响应弱，作者假设这是因为GRPO训练中缺乏显式监督，仅靠最终答案奖励无法指导保留哪些视觉证据以及如何在潜在token间分配信用。
AI.method: 提出ReaLVR，将视觉证据监督引入模型自身自由运行的潜在轨迹。通过对比正确与模型生成的错误答案，确定何处需要更强监督；通过对比相关与不匹配的视觉证据，指定需要保留的内容。
AI.result: 在三个模型家族上，ReaLVR持续优于评估的LVR基线，在Qwen2.5-VL-7B上取得五任务平均最高63.7%。首次在潜在空间扩展视觉推理，在高达235B的前沿模型规模上仍带来稳健提升。进一步分析显示潜在token位置更敏感于问题、与相关视觉区域对齐更强，且最受关注的潜在token对固定上下文依赖更大。
AI.conclusion: ReaLVR通过为潜在视觉推理提供视觉证据监督，有效弥合了证据-信用差距，并在不同模型规模上验证了其有效性和可扩展性，为潜在空间中的视觉推理监督提供了新思路。

authors: Jose Luis Garcia del Castillo y Lopez
title: ARCH-B: Architectural Representation, Comprehension and Hierarchy Benchmark
summary: Multimodal models increasingly interpret visual environments, but their ability to recognize the same building across photographs, floor plans, elevations, sections, and renderings remains poorly characterized. We introduce ARCH-B, a benchmark of 354 four-choice questions across 11 cross-representational archetypes, constructed from a building-linked corpus of 3.9 million architectural images using visually similar distractors, model-guided difficulty screening, and manual validation. We evaluate 25 multimodal models and collect 5,830 responses from non-expert human participants. Model accuracy ranges from 10.45% to 83.90%, compared with a human baseline of 35.35%. Models perform comparatively well on mixed-representation outlier detection and photograph matching, but remain weaker on floorplan-to-photograph correspondence. Human and model difficulty across archetypes is only weakly correlated (Spearman's (ρ=0.33)). Held-out evaluation confirms that the difficulty identified during screening generalizes beyond the curation models. ARCH-B provides a diagnostic evaluation of visual correspondence and representation transfer across architectural media.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了ARCH-B基准，用于评估多模态模型在建筑不同表示形式（照片、平面图、立面图、剖面图、渲染图）中识别同一建筑的能力。
AI.motivation: 多模态模型在视觉环境理解上日益重要，但其跨建筑表示形式的识别能力尚未被充分表征。
AI.method: 构建包含354道四选一问题的ARCH-B基准，涵盖11种跨表示原型，基于390万张建筑图像语料，使用视觉相似干扰项、模型引导难度筛选和人工验证。评估25个多模态模型并收集5,830份非专家人类回答。
AI.result: 模型准确率在10.45%到83.90%之间，人类基线为35.35%。模型在混合表示异常检测和照片匹配上表现较好，但在平面图到照片的对应上较弱。人类与模型难度相关性弱（Spearman ρ=0.33）。留出评估证实筛选难度可泛化。
AI.conclusion: ARCH-B为跨建筑媒体的视觉对应和表示迁移提供了诊断性评估。

title: SNaP: One-Step Posterior Sampling for Noisy Inverse Problems
summary: Diffusion and flow-matching models can produce high-quality posterior samples for inverse problems, but typically require tens to thousands of network evaluations per draw. MeanFlow enables one-step generation, yet applying it to inverse problems leaves no intermediate steps at which to enforce measurement consistency. We introduce SNaP, a one-step MeanFlow posterior sampler for linear inverse problems with Gaussian noise. Its central innovation is a measurement-adapted source: a Gaussian distribution whose mean and anisotropic covariance are determined by the measurement operator, observation, and noise level. The source anchors well-measured directions while preserving variation where the measurements are weak or uninformative. We show that the exact conditional flow transports this source to the true posterior. Across natural-image restoration and multi-coil MRI, SNaP produces diverse, high-quality samples with one network evaluation per draw, 30 to 2250 $\times$ faster than iterative samplers.

AI.tldr: 提出 SNaP，一种面向高斯噪声线性逆问题的一步 MeanFlow 后验采样器。它通过测量自适应的源分布实现一步生成，并在自然图像恢复和多线圈 MRI 上取得高质量、多样化且显著加速的采样结果。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型和流匹配模型能为逆问题生成高质量后验样本，但通常每次采样需要数十到数千次网络评估。MeanFlow 虽可实现一步生成，但直接用于逆问题会缺少中间步骤来施加测量一致性约束。
AI.method: SNaP 的核心是测量自适应源分布：一个由测量算子、观测值和噪声水平决定均值与各向异性协方差的高斯分布。该源分布在测量充分的 directions 上锚定信息，在测量较弱或无信息处保留变化。作者证明精确条件流可将该源分布输运到真实后验分布。
AI.result: 在自然图像恢复和多线圈 MRI 任务中，SNaP 每次采样仅需一次网络评估，即可生成多样化且高质量的样本，相比迭代采样器加速 30 到 2250 倍。
AI.conclusion: SNaP 通过测量自适应源分布与条件流，实现了线性高斯逆问题的一步后验采样，在保持样本质量与多样性的同时大幅降低计算成本。

title: Learning Strategies to Break Judges
summary: As AI agents surpass human performance, it becomes exceedingly hard for system designers to evaluate them directly and understand their failure modes. Consequently, agents themselves are being deployed extensively to evaluate, judge, and provide feedback on model traces. But this raises an important question: how can we trust the judge? In this work, we propose an agent-guided method to find weaknesses of agentic judges that expose interpretable failure mechanisms. Our method focuses on mathematical reasoning and proceeds in two stages: first, we deploy adversarial agents to mutate a set of sound proofs by introducing errors, attempting to misguide judges---in other words, injecting errors that judges are unable to catch. Then, we distill these attempts into a small set of mutation strategies which allow us to analyze the failure modes of the judges. To ensure that these strategies are not overfit to the initial set of proofs, we evaluate them by applying the mutation strategies to a held-out set of proofs and querying the same judge. We deploy our method on GPT-5.6-sol and Claude Opus 5, paired with their agent orchestrators, Codex and Claude Code, respectively. These are used both as mutators to introduce errors and as judges to evaluate correctness of mathematical reasoning. We find that across all the agentic judges, we are able to distill mutation strategies that consistently bypass their evaluations, thereby enabling us to ascertain actionable failure modes. Our analysis also reveals that judge reliability degrades at the frontier: errors in Olympiad-level proofs or graduate-level mathematical texts are detected more consistently, whereas flaws in research-level manuscripts are more likely to escape detection.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种由智能体引导的方法，用于发现智能体评判者的弱点并揭示可解释的失败机制。方法在数学推理任务中通过对抗性变异证明来误导评判者，并蒸馏出可复用的变异策略；实验显示这些策略能稳定绕过 GPT-5.6-sol/Claude Opus 5 及其编排器 Codex/Claude Code 的评判，且研究级数学文本中的错误更易漏检。
AI.motivation: 随着 AI 智能体超越人类表现，系统设计者很难直接评估它们并理解其失败模式，因此越来越多地部署智能体来评估、判断和反馈模型轨迹。但这引出关键问题：我们如何信任这些评判者？
AI.method: 提出智能体引导的两阶段方法，聚焦数学推理：首先部署对抗性智能体，对一组正确证明进行变异并注入错误，试图误导评判者；然后将这些尝试蒸馏为少量变异策略，以分析评判者的失败模式。为避免过拟合，将策略应用于留出证明集并查询同一评判者。实验使用 GPT-5.6-sol 与 Claude Opus 5，分别搭配 Codex 和 Claude Code，它们既作为变异者引入错误，也作为评判者评估数学推理正确性。
AI.result: 在所有智能体评判者上，都能蒸馏出持续绕过其评估的变异策略，从而识别可操作的失败模式。分析还表明，评判可靠性在前沿任务上下降：奥林匹克级证明或研究生级数学文本中的错误更常被检测到，而研究级手稿中的缺陷更容易逃过检测。
AI.conclusion: 智能体评判者存在可通过对抗性变异策略暴露的可解释失败模式；其可靠性在更高阶、研究级数学文本上明显不足，因此不应盲目信任智能体评判者，需针对其失败模式进行审计与改进。

title: Evidence-Inference Reconstruction: When The Evidence Is Recalled But The Reasoning Goes Wrong
summary: Modern multi-hop LLM agents are equipped with built-in mechanisms to detect errors in intermediate reasoning steps. Such errors trigger corrective actions from these agents, which mostly follow the paradigm of retrying the steps or the reasoning trajectories. Not only are these retries expensive, we present in this paper that they are also potentially unnecessary. To this end, we introduce Evidence-Inference Reconstruction (EIR), which uses structured state to guide one retrieval trajectory, accumulating source evidence in the process. We show that as long as the relevant evidence has been collected, EIR is capable of generating the correct answer in a single final model call even if erroneous evidence has been mixed in due to incorrect intermediate reasoning steps. In one evaluation, using Haiku 4.5 and GPT-4.1 Mini, we evaluate EIR on matched 1,000-question subsets of HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHopQA, and MuSiQue, showing that EIR improves Answer F1, the overlap between the model's and the correct answer, over the baseline by 8.3--32.8 points, Agentic SSR by 10.6--29.1 points, and Reflexion by 1.1--15.9 points. Additionally, we show that EIR averages 4.85 total model calls per question, compared with 35.29 for Agentic SSR and 12.41 for Reflexion. Together, these results corroborate EIR's central premise: separating evidence retrieval from the final answer model call can improve answer accuracy while utilizing substantially less computation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Evidence-Inference Reconstruction（EIR），用结构化状态引导单条检索轨迹并累积证据；只要收集到相关证据，即使中间推理混入错误证据，也能在最后一次模型调用中生成正确答案，从而减少昂贵且可能不必要的重试。
AI.motivation: 现代多跳 LLM 智能体虽能检测中间推理错误并触发纠正，但主流纠正方式是重试步骤或整个推理轨迹。这些重试不仅昂贵，而且论文指出它们可能是没有必要的。
AI.method: EIR 使用结构化状态引导一条检索轨迹，并在过程中累积源证据。收集到相关证据后，EIR 通过单次最终模型调用来生成答案。实验在 HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHopQA 和 MuSiQue 的匹配 1000 题子集上进行，使用 Haiku 4.5 和 GPT-4.1 Mini，并与 baseline、Agentic SSR、Reflexion 比较。
AI.result: EIR 将 Answer F1 相比 baseline 提升 8.3–32.8 点，相比 Agentic SSR 提升 10.6–29.1 点，相比 Reflexion 提升 1.1–15.9 点。平均每问题总模型调用为 4.85 次，而 Agentic SSR 为 35.29 次，Reflexion 为 12.41 次。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持 EIR 的核心前提：将证据检索与最终答案模型调用分离，可以在显著减少计算量的同时提高答案准确率。

title: SeLMRoute: Probabilistic Semantic Evidence for Large Language Model Routing
summary: Large language model (LLM) routing aims to select the most suitable model for each incoming query. Most existing routers learn this decision directly from query embeddings, model representations, preference data, or clusters of similar examples. Such approaches can be effective, yet the representation used for routing rarely states what a query actually requires. We introduce SeLMRoute, a routing framework that separates the extraction of candidate-independent semantic evidence from the learning of candidate performance and the application of deployment objectives. A decision model first evaluates a set of interpretable questions about the query, such as its reasoning requirements and use of external knowledge, with each judgment retained as a probability distribution. The resulting probabilistic semantic state is used by a lightweight supervised router to estimate candidate model performance. Routing objectives are applied after performance estimation, which allows the same semantic state to support performance-oriented and cost-aware decisions. On the LLMRouterBench (15 datasets, 20 candidate models, 11,481 queries), SeLMRoute achieves an average accuracy of $72.08\% \pm 0.45$, while grouped five-fold out-of-fold evaluation reaches $72.64\%$, compared with $69.23\%$ for the strongest fixed candidate. The representation achieves the highest mean performance among the evaluated semantic, dense, lexical, and domain-level representations. In a separate 13-model performance-cost setting, SeLMRoute improves performance in all five grouped splits, with a mean PerfGain of $2.66\%$. Our code is available at https://github.com/Indigma-Innovations/SeLMRoute.

AI.tldr: 提出SeLMRoute路由框架，将查询语义证据提取与候选模型性能估计、部署目标应用解耦，通过可解释问题生成概率语义状态，轻量路由器据此选择模型，在LLMRouterBench上平均准确率达72.08%±0.45，优于最强固定候选的69.23%。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM路由器直接从查询嵌入、模型表示、偏好数据或相似示例聚类中学习决策，但所用表示很少明确说明查询实际需要什么，导致路由依据不透明且泛化能力有限。
AI.method: SeLMRoute将候选无关的语义证据提取、候选性能学习与部署目标应用分离。决策模型先对查询回答一组可解释问题（如推理需求、外部知识使用），每个判断保留为概率分布，形成概率语义状态；轻量监督路由器利用该状态估计候选模型性能；路由目标在性能估计后应用，使同一语义状态支持性能导向和成本感知决策。
AI.result: 在LLMRouterBench（15个数据集、20个候选模型、11,481条查询）上，SeLMRoute平均准确率为72.08%±0.45，分组五折折外评估达72.64%，对比最强固定候选的69.23%。该表示在语义、稠密、词汇和领域级表示中平均性能最高。在独立的13模型性能-成本设置中，SeLMRoute在五个分组划分上均提升性能，平均PerfGain为2.66%。
AI.conclusion: SeLMRoute通过显式概率语义状态有效提升LLM路由准确率，并能灵活适应性能与成本目标，代码已开源。

title: WhiteCon: Semi-Supervised Domain Adaptation Regression Through Whitening Transform and Dual Consistency
summary: Domain adaptation is crucial for addressing distributional shifts that degrade model performance across domains. While most existing research has centered on classification, semi-supervised domain adaptation regression (SSDAR) for continuous-output tasks remains largely unexplored, particularly in practical scenarios with limited labeled target data. To address this gap, we propose semi-supervised domain adaptation regression through whitening transform and dual consistency (WhiteCon), which combines domain-specific whitening transform (DWT) and dual consistency regularization to enhance training stability and domain adaptation. DWT reduces the variance of the model parameters by transforming the feature covariance matrix into an identity matrix, thus stabilizing training under ordinary least squares assumptions. In addition, variance consistency regularization, as part of dual consistency regularization, aligns the variances of weak, strong, and mixup-augmented features to improve resilience against augmentation-induced perturbations. Empirical evaluations on various benchmark datasets under SSDAR settings demonstrate that the proposed WhiteCon achieves state-of-the-art performance compared to existing methods, effectively addressing domain shifts in regression tasks. The code for WhiteCon is available at https://github.com/sejin-sim/WhiteCon.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 WhiteCon，一种用于半监督域适应回归（SSDAR）的方法，通过域特定白化变换和双重一致性正则化提升训练稳定性与域适应能力，并在多个基准上取得最优性能。
AI.motivation: 域适应对缓解跨域分布偏移至关重要，但现有研究多集中于分类任务；半监督域适应回归在目标域标注数据有限的实际场景中仍缺乏探索。
AI.method: 提出 WhiteCon，结合域特定白化变换（DWT）和双重一致性正则化。DWT 将特征协方差矩阵变换为单位矩阵以降低模型参数方差，在普通最小二乘假设下稳定训练；双重一致性中的方差一致性正则化对齐弱增强、强增强和 mixup 增强特征的方差，提高对增强扰动的鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的 SSDAR 设置实验表明，WhiteCon 相比现有方法达到 state-of-the-art 性能，有效应对回归任务中的域偏移。
AI.conclusion: WhiteCon 能有效解决半监督域适应回归中的域偏移问题，代码已开源。

title: After the Fix: How Corrected Agent Histories Transfer to Related Tasks
summary: Does repairing an episode make its experience a better memory for the next task? We transfer the same failed source before and after accepted repair to a fixed target, alongside independent execution. Our 3,300 runs cover 100 ThinkingBox pairs and the same 100 APEX pairs with and without source-state inheritance, under eleven conditions. ThinkingBox's Full/Skill/Hybrid correction gains are 44/29/32 percentage points, with corrected performance 25/22/18 points above independence; inference weakens at the task-family level. Yet 12 of Full's 15-point larger correction gap over Skill come from worse uncorrected performance, not better corrected memory. Moreover, 22 of Full's 46 upward transitions restore observed baseline success. Neither APEX regime establishes comparable aggregate correction benefits. Action evidence connects workflow gains with reusable obligations and convention conflicts with source-local choices. Text APEX's accepted execution reaches 52% versus its summary's 40%, without robust global/group-level superiority or an estab- lished advantage over independence. Smaller handoffs reduce input but increase calls. The value of repairing experience is therefore distinct from the value of reusing it: memory updates require both a previous-version reference and a fresh-start reference.

AI.tldr: 论文研究“修复一个失败片段是否会让其经验成为下一任务更好的记忆”。通过比较修复前后同一失败源迁移到固定目标并独立执行，发现修复经验的价值与复用经验的价值不同；记忆更新既需要旧版本参考，也需要全新开始参考。
AI.motivation: 探究修复失败经验是否能提升其作为后续任务记忆的复用价值，并区分“修复经验的价值”与“复用经验的价值”。
AI.method: 在100个ThinkingBox任务对和100个APEX任务对上进行3300次运行，覆盖有/无源状态继承及11种条件。将同一失败源在修复前后迁移到固定目标，并与独立执行比较，分析纠正增益、性能变化和迁移效果。
AI.result: ThinkingBox的Full/Skill/Hybrid纠正增益分别为44/29/32个百分点，纠正后性能分别高于独立执行25/22/18点；但推理在任务族层面减弱。Full比Skill多出的15点纠正差距中，有12点来自未纠正性能更差，而非纠正后记忆更好；Full的46次向上转移中有22次只是恢复观测基线成功。APEX未建立可比的总体纠正收益。行动证据将工作流收益与可复用义务关联，将约定冲突与源局部选择关联。文本APEX接受执行达52%，其摘要为40%，但没有稳健的全局/组级优势，也未确立相对独立执行的优越性。更小交接减少输入但增加调用。
AI.conclusion: 修复经验的价值不同于复用经验的价值；记忆更新需要同时具备前一版本参考和全新开始参考。

title: When Do Model Internals Help? Exploring the Role of Representation Engineering in LLM Safety
summary: Reliable AI safeguards require both control mechanisms that reduce unsafe behavior and monitoring mechanisms that detect safety risks during model interactions. Established behavioral safeguards include alignment methods that optimize model outputs and text monitors that assess interaction text. Representation engineering instead reads or modifies internal model states, but the relative strengths of these approaches remain unclear because they are often evaluated under different settings. We present a matched evaluation across two tracks. For safety control, we compare DPO, a behavioral alignment method, with three representation steering methods across robustness, practicality, and granularity. DPO provides the strongest overall control and generally improves with increasing training data, although its safety can degrade after subsequent benign fine-tuning. Representation steering remains competitive primarily in low-data settings, particularly with high-quality contrastive data. For safety monitoring, we compare representation probes with fine-tuned and open-weight text monitors across full-response detection, early detection, and computational cost. Specialized text monitors achieve the strongest overall detection accuracy, while representation probes remain competitive at substantially lower marginal cost. Finally, monitor-guided interventions recover much of the safety lost by DPO after benign fine-tuning, with little additional over-refusal. Overall, representation engineering does not generally replace behavioral safeguards, but offers practical advantages under specific conditions and can provide complementary safety benefits.

AI.tldr: 本文对行为安全防护（DPO、文本监控器）与表征工程方法（表征引导、表征探针）进行了匹配评估，比较其在安全控制与安全监控中的效果、鲁棒性、成本和互补性。
AI.motivation: 可靠的人工智能防护既需要减少不安全行为的控制机制，也需要检测交互中安全风险的监控机制。现有行为防护与表征工程方法常在不同设置下评估，导致其相对优劣不明确，因此需要匹配条件下的系统比较。
AI.method: 在安全控制轨道，比较DPO这一行为对齐方法与三种表征引导方法，评估指标包括鲁棒性、实用性和粒度；在安全监控轨道，比较表征探针与微调及开放权重文本监控器，评估全响应检测、早期检测和计算成本。此外，还测试了监控引导的干预措施能否恢复良性微调后DPO损失的安全性。
AI.result: DPO总体控制最强，且通常随训练数据增加而提升，但在后续良性微调后安全性可能退化。表征引导主要在低数据场景下具有竞争力，尤其搭配高质量对比数据时。安全监控方面，专用文本监控器整体检测准确率最高，而表征探针以显著更低的边际成本保持竞争力。监控引导的干预可恢复良性微调后DPO损失的大部分安全性，且几乎不增加过度拒绝。
AI.conclusion: 表征工程通常不能替代行为安全防护，但在特定条件下具有实用优势，并能提供互补的安全收益。可靠防护应结合行为控制与监控机制，并根据数据、成本与部署场景选择合适方法。

title: BV Loss: Block Verification-Aware Loss for Block Diffusion Speculative Decoding
summary: Diffusion drafters accelerate speculative decoding by proposing multiple tokens in parallel. Despite recent advances in speculative decoding through sequence-level drafting and verification, existing training objectives remain largely designed around token-level verification. To address this mismatch, we introduce Block Verification-aware loss (BV loss), a training objective designed to maximize the expected acceptance length of a drafted sequence. BV loss is directly derived from the block verification acceptance rule, providing a principled connection between the drafter training objective and the inference-time verification mechanism at the sequence level. Across math, code, and chat benchmarks, BV loss increases the mean number of tokens accepted per verification call under block verification by 13.0--21.0\% over cross-entropy loss training for DFlash and DSpark with Qwen3-4B and Qwen3-8B without changing the inference procedure. BV loss also outperforms tokenwise acceptance objectives such as TV loss and LK loss, and its gains extend to token verification and greedy decoding. These results demonstrate the benefit of training block diffusion drafters with an objective aligned with sequence-level verification, rather than optimizing each token independently.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Block Verification-aware loss（BV loss），用于训练扩散式草稿模型，使训练目标与推理时的块级验证机制对齐，从而提升投机解码中每次验证可接受的 token 数。
AI.motivation: 扩散草稿模型可并行生成多个 token，但现有训练目标多基于 token 级验证，与序列级/块级草稿和验证机制不匹配，导致训练目标与推理验证规则脱节。
AI.method: 从块验证接受规则直接推导出 BV loss，以最大化草稿序列的期望接受长度；在不改变推理流程的情况下，用该损失训练 DFlash 和 DSpark 等扩散草稿模型。
AI.result: 在数学、代码和聊天基准上，使用 Qwen3-4B 和 Qwen3-8B 时，BV loss 相比交叉熵训练使块验证下每次验证调用的平均接受 token 数提升 13.0–21.0%；也优于 TV loss 和 LK loss，且收益可扩展到 token 验证和贪婪解码。
AI.conclusion: 训练块扩散草稿模型时，应采用与序列级验证对齐的目标，而非独立优化每个 token；BV loss 能有效提升块验证下的投机解码效率。

title: Dual-Vocabulary Language Model for Cross-Tokenizer Distillation
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) bridges teacher supervision and student behavior, but different teacher-student tokenizers introduce misalignment in both input tokenization (#1) and output logits (#2). Existing approaches address the former by matching same-text spans or converting tokens to bytes, often losing fine-grained token information or disrupting the native-token paradigm, while for the latter, strategies such as ranking, padding, or key-token selection retain only shared logit dimensions, resulting in much distribution loss. In this paper, we propose Dual-Vocabulary Language Model (DVLM), which replaces the teacher's LM head with a new student-vocabulary projection head and obtains full-dimensional student logits (for #2). To support student tokens (for #1), it takes a Parallel-Tokenized Sequence (PTS) as input, which concatenates the original teacher-tokenized sequence and a re-tokenized sequence formed by independently converting each student token into a teacher-token group. To avoid inference inconsistency with the original teacher tokens, the Hybrid-Prefix Attention (HPA) further restricts re-tokenized groups to their corresponding teacher prefix and uses its last state as the aggregation of the original student-token representation for projection into the student vocabulary space. Similarly, via the combined use of PTS and HPA, the DVLM teacher can provide distribution-aligned supervision with the student's input-tokenization and output-logit during OPD. Experimental results demonstrate that our DVLM teacher has a similar converged loss as the original teacher model and enables student models to improve performance across six reasoning tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Dual-Vocabulary Language Model (DVLM)，通过 Parallel-Tokenized Sequence (PTS) 和 Hybrid-Prefix Attention (HPA) 解决师生模型因词表不同导致的输入 tokenization 与输出 logits 不对齐问题，实现跨词表的在线策略蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 现有在线策略蒸馏中，教师与学生使用不同 tokenizer 时，输入分词和输出 logits 维度均不匹配；已有方法或丢失细粒度 token 信息，或破坏原生 token 范式，或只保留共享 logit 维度，造成分布信息损失。
AI.method: DVLM 将教师 LM head 替换为面向学生词表的新投影头，以获得完整维度的学生 logits；输入采用 PTS，将原始教师 token 序列与由学生 token 独立转换得到的教师 token 组序列拼接；HPA 将重分词组限制在对应教师前缀内，并用其最后状态聚合原学生 token 表示，再投影到学生词表空间。
AI.result: DVLM 教师收敛损失与原始教师模型相近，并使学生模型在六个推理任务上性能提升。
AI.conclusion: DVLM 能在师生 tokenizer 不同的在线策略蒸馏中，同时对齐学生输入分词与输出 logit 分布，提供分布一致的监督，从而有效提升学生模型表现。

title: Advancing Wildlife Conservation through Multimodal Animal Re-Identification with Environmental Metadata
summary: Identifying individual animals is crucial for effective wildlife monitoring and conservation efforts. Recent advancements in computer vision have shown promise in animal re-identification (Animal ReID) by leveraging data from camera traps. However, existing Animal ReID datasets rely exclusively on visual data, overlooking environmental metadata that ecologists have identified as highly correlated with animal behavior and identity, such as temperature and circadian rhythms. Meanwhile, modern vision-language models (VLMs) offer rich multimodal reasoning capabilities, but existing resources underutilize their text-processing potential. To address these limitations, we propose MetaWild, a multimodal Animal ReID dataset comprising 20,890 images across six species, paired with environmental metadata extracted from embedded camera trap overlays and scene contexts. Additionally, to facilitate the use of metadata in existing ReID methods, we propose the Meta-Feature Adapter (MFA), a lightweight module that can be incorporated into existing VLM-based ReID methods, allowing ReID models to leverage both environmental metadata and visual information to improve ReID performance. Experiments on MetaWild show that combining baseline ReID models with MFA to incorporate metadata consistently improves performance compared to using visual information alone, validating the effectiveness of incorporating metadata in re-identification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MetaWild——一个包含环境元数据的多模态动物重识别数据集，以及Meta-Feature Adapter（MFA）轻量模块，可将元数据融入现有基于视觉语言模型的重识别方法，实验证明能持续提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有动物重识别数据集仅依赖视觉数据，忽略了生态学家认为与动物行为和身份高度相关的环境元数据（如温度、昼夜节律）。同时，现有视觉语言模型未能充分利用其文本处理能力。
AI.method: 构建MetaWild数据集，包含6个物种的20,890张图像，并从相机陷阱叠加层和场景上下文中提取环境元数据。提出Meta-Feature Adapter（MFA），一种可集成到现有基于VLM的重识别方法中的轻量模块，使模型能同时利用环境元数据和视觉信息。
AI.result: 在MetaWild上的实验表明，将基线重识别模型与MFA结合以引入元数据，相比仅使用视觉信息，性能持续提升，验证了在重识别中融入元数据的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 在动物重识别中结合环境元数据是有效的，MetaWild和MFA为多模态动物重识别提供了新资源和方法。

title: The Devil is in the Spectrum Bias: Spectrum-Balanced Feature Matching for Robust Representation Distillation
summary: Large visual foundation models have demonstrated remarkable transferability across a wide range of downstream tasks. To deploy such models efficiently, feature matching has become a popular knowledge distillation approach that transfers teacher representations to smaller student models without requiring labeled data. However, we show that the conventional feature matching objective with L2-distance is inherently biased toward reconstructing dominant spectral directions of the teacher representation, while under-optimizing low-variance directions that often contain task-relevant information. To address this, we propose Spectrum-Balanced Feature Matching, SpecMatch, a simple objective that adaptively emphasizes under-optimized spectral directions while preserving the relative importance of dominant directions. SpecMatch is easy to implement and introduces negligible computational overhead. Extensive experiments on image recognition demonstrate that SpecMatch consistently improves downstream adaptation across diverse tasks, including image classification, anomaly detection, medical image analysis, and domain generalization. In particular, SpecMatch outperforms conventional feature matching in 40 of 42 teacher--student and training-setting combinations, while consistently improving over the original student model in all settings. We further demonstrate that the proposed objective generalizes beyond vision, improving downstream performance across six protein understanding tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出SpecMatch，一种频谱平衡的特征匹配知识蒸馏目标，用于将大型视觉基础模型迁移到小模型，并在多种下游任务及蛋白质理解任务中验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 传统基于L2距离的特征匹配目标会偏向重建教师表示中的主导频谱方向，而低估常包含任务相关信息的低方差方向，导致知识蒸馏不充分。
AI.method: 提出Spectrum-Balanced Feature Matching（SpecMatch）：自适应强调被欠优化的频谱方向，同时保留主导方向的相对重要性；实现简单，计算开销可忽略。
AI.result: 在图像识别等任务中，SpecMatch在42种教师-学生与训练设置组合中的40种优于传统特征匹配，并在所有设置中优于原始学生模型；还提升了六项蛋白质理解任务。
AI.conclusion: SpecMatch能有效缓解特征匹配的频谱偏差，提升下游适配性能，并可推广到视觉之外的领域。

title: SpatialSkill: Self-Evolving Skills for Cross-View Spatial Reasoning
summary: Cross-view spatial reasoning requires a model to align different viewpoints into a coherent spatial representation, yet this ability remains challenging for vision-language models despite being natural to humans. Existing methods typically improve spatial reasoning by updating model weights, which keeps the acquired knowledge implicit and tied to a specific backbone. We propose \textit{SpatialSkill}, a weight-update-free framework that enables a frozen vision-language model to accumulate explicit natural-language reasoning skills from offline trajectories. Unlike symbolic tasks, perceptual skills cannot be reliably verified simply by executing them: a plausible spatial rule may lack visual support or require transformations that the frozen model cannot perform. SpatialSkill therefore admits candidate skills only after visual-grounding and executability checks, constrains manual evolution to prevent harmful regressions, and routes skills by spatial-reasoning category to reduce negative transfer. On CityCube, across four frozen executors, SpatialSkill yields consistent gains, and a 9B executor equipped with SpatialSkill surpasses the strongest closed-source reference in our evaluation. The skills are stored in a versioned natural-language manual, making the reasoning strategies explicit and auditable without modifying model parameters. Code at https://github.com/vindahi/SpatialSkill.

AI.tldr: 提出 SpatialSkill，一种无需更新模型权重的框架，让冻结的视觉语言模型从离线轨迹中积累显式的自然语言空间推理技能，从而提升跨视角空间推理能力。
AI.motivation: 跨视角空间推理要求模型将不同视角对齐为一致的空间表示，但现有视觉语言模型仍难以实现。已有方法通常通过更新模型权重来改进，导致所学知识隐式且绑定于特定骨干网络。
AI.method: SpatialSkill 从离线轨迹中提取候选技能，并仅接受通过视觉接地与可执行性检查的技能；同时约束人工进化以避免有害回归，并按空间推理类别路由技能以减少负迁移。技能存储为版本化的自然语言手册。
AI.result: 在 CityCube 上，SpatialSkill 在四个冻结执行器上均带来一致提升；配备 SpatialSkill 的 9B 执行器超越了评估中最强的闭源参考模型。
AI.conclusion: SpatialSkill 无需修改模型参数即可使推理策略显式且可审计，并有效提升冻结视觉语言模型的跨视角空间推理表现。

title: Vestrum: Improving Agent Harnesses by Adapting Their Verification, Structure and Memory
summary: An agent harness controls how a language model accesses information, uses tools, preserves memory, and checks its work. Improving this software is costly when each evaluation requires a long interaction with an environment. We introduce Vestrum, a framework that turns failures in execution traces into scoped harness changes without training the task model. Its organizing overhypothesis is that tasks of a shared kind may exhibit recurring failures whose remedies transfer within that kind. Vestrum expresses failures as recognizable classes, proposes changes across verification, retrieval, decomposition, and knowledge synthesis, and screens their scope before evaluating them as a bundle. A persistent lessons file informs subsequent proposals. Across five settings and two baseline harnesses, the frozen harnesses improve held-out performance: UltraHorizon rises from 47.6 to 59.8 over GAM, Terminal-Bench 4 Hard from 63.7% to 70.3% of checks passed over Claude Code on eight held-out tasks at 1.03x test cost, and cell-type annotation agreement from 67.5% to 77.8% on held-out sections of one slide, alongside gains on LoCoMo and AMA-Bench. Across our searches, verification grounded in evidence helped both intermediate steps and final answers, at lower cost at intermediate steps, while critics asked to rebuild finished answers broke more than they repaired. On the three memory benchmarks, Vestrum also scores above the evaluated GEPA configurations in every paired evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Vestrum，一个无需训练任务模型即可将执行轨迹中的失败转化为范围受限的智能体框架（harness）修改的框架，并在多个基准上提升了冻结 harness 的留出性能。
AI.motivation: 改进控制语言模型信息访问、工具使用、记忆保存与自检的 agent harness 通常成本高昂，因为每次评估都需与环境进行长交互；因此需要一种能从执行失败中自动、低成本地改进 harness 的方法。
AI.method: Vestrum 以“同类任务可能存在可迁移的重复失败”为组织性超假设，将失败表达为可识别类别，在验证、检索、分解和知识合成等方面提出修改，先筛查作用范围再作为捆绑方案评估；同时使用持久化 lessons 文件指导后续提案。
AI.result: 在五个设置和两个基线 harness 上，冻结 harness 的留出性能得到提升：UltraHorizon 从 47.6 升至 59.8（对比 GAM）；Terminal-Bench 4 Hard 从 63.7% 升至 70.3%（对比 Claude Code，八个留出任务，测试成本 1.03 倍）；细胞类型注释一致率从 67.5% 升至 77.8%（单张切片留出区域）；LoCoMo 和 AMA-Bench 也有增益。基于证据的验证有助于中间步骤和最终答案，且中间步骤成本更低；要求批评者重建已完成答案则会破坏多于修复。在三个记忆基准上的成对评估中，Vestrum 均高于所评估的 GEPA 配置。
AI.conclusion: Vestrum 表明，无需训练任务模型，仅通过将执行轨迹中的失败转化为范围受限的 harness 修改，即可有效提升多种任务和基线下的性能；其中基于证据的验证尤其有效，而某些批评式重建可能有害。

title: How code helps different tasks? A decompositional lens on LLM post-training
summary: Evaluating code data as a single corpus can obscure which types of code data benefit which models and downstream tasks. Effective data selection requires understanding both the benefits of individual categories and whether these benefits persist when categories are combined. We introduce a decompositional lens for studying these effects in LLM post-training. We first decompose an execution-verified code corpus into interpretable categories based on the computational patterns of its solutions. Through controlled fine-tuning experiments, we compare individual categories with a balanced mixture across instruction-tuned models on question answering, mathematics, and code generation. The resulting response maps reveal recurring gains in average question-answering performance, while the same category can improve one model or task and degrade another. The best-performing category also varies with the starting model and target task. We then compose compact mixtures guided by these results and examine whether benefits observed in individual categories persist under joint training. On selected model--task pairs, mixtures whose constituents each improve the target task outperform both their best constituent and full-corpus training while using roughly 10--15\% of the full corpus. These exploratory findings illustrate a \emph{less is more} pattern and highlight how the value of code data in post training depends on which categories are combined for which model and task.

AI.tldr: 该论文从分解视角研究代码数据在LLM后训练中的价值：将执行验证的代码语料按计算模式划分为可解释类别，发现不同类别对不同模型和任务效果不同，并可通过组合少量类别以约10-15%数据量获得优于全语料训练的效果。
AI.motivation: 将代码数据视为单一语料会掩盖哪些类型的代码数据对哪些模型和下游任务有益。有效的数据选择需要理解单个类别的收益，以及这些收益在类别组合后是否仍然存在。
AI.method: 作者将执行验证的代码语料分解为基于解题计算模式的可解释类别；通过受控微调实验，在指令微调模型上比较单个类别与平衡混合数据在问答、数学和代码生成任务上的表现，并构建响应图；随后依据结果组合紧凑混合数据，检验联合训练时单个类别的收益是否持续。
AI.result: 响应图显示问答平均性能有反复出现的提升，但同一类别可能提升某一模型或任务而损害另一模型或任务；最佳类别随起始模型和目标任务变化。在部分模型-任务对上，由各自提升目标任务的类别组成的混合数据优于最佳单类别和全语料训练，且仅使用约10-15%的全语料。
AI.conclusion: 研究呈现了“少即是多”的模式，并表明代码数据在后训练中的价值取决于针对哪个模型和任务组合哪些类别。

title: One Readout, Many Repairs: Diffusion-Guided Hierarchical Search for Tool-Agent Repair
summary: Tool agents use large language models to act through external tools, yet successfully executed calls can still leave user requests unfulfilled. Tool-agent repair seeks alternative call sequences that execute successfully and fulfill the original requests. However, repair requires exploring both operation choices and their concrete realizations, making complete-sequence regeneration costly. Moreover, regeneration repeats operation selection even when failure arises from how those operations are realized. The resulting challenge is to reduce this repetition while preserving exploration of alternative operations and realizations. Therefore, we formulate repair as hierarchical search over operation supports, which we introduce as sets of permitted operation types that define reusable search regions for concrete tool-call sequences. We propose ReCommit, a training-free, diffusion-guided framework for improving tool-agent failure recovery while reducing repair computation. ReCommit amortizes operation-level proposal computation across repair trials by reusing operation-type scores from a single parallel readout of a masked diffusion language model. These scores guide search across supports, while realization search explores alternative entity bindings, arguments, and action composition within each support. Experiments on real failures across four enterprise services in the Agent-Diff benchmark show 75.9\% and 63.2\% relative recovery gains with 61.3\% and 51.3\% reductions in mean full-budget repair time at repair budgets $B=3$ and $B=13$, respectively, over the strongest evaluated 8B comparison method. ReCommit achieves a favorable recovery--cost trade-off, including in comparisons with the evaluated 32B models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ReCommit，一种免训练、扩散引导的工具智能体故障修复框架，将修复建模为对操作支持集的分层搜索，在提升恢复率的同时显著降低修复计算。
AI.motivation: 工具调用即使成功执行，也可能未满足用户请求；修复需要同时探索操作选择及其具体实现，而完整序列重生成成本高，且失败仅源于实现方式时仍会重复操作选择。目标是减少这种重复，同时保留对替代操作和实现的探索。
AI.method: 将修复形式化为对操作支持集（允许的操作类型集合）的分层搜索；ReCommit 免训练、扩散引导，通过掩码扩散语言模型的一次并行读出复用操作类型分数，摊销操作级提议计算；这些分数引导支持集搜索，实现搜索则在每个支持集内探索实体绑定、参数和动作组合。
AI.result: 在 Agent-Diff 基准四个企业服务的真实失败上，当修复预算 B=3 和 B=13 时，相对最强 8B 对比方法分别取得 75.9% 和 63.2% 的相对恢复增益，并将平均全预算修复时间降低 61.3% 和 51.3%；与评估的 32B 模型相比也表现出有利的恢复-成本权衡。
AI.conclusion: ReCommit 能改善工具智能体的失败恢复并显著降低修复计算，实现较好的恢复率与成本权衡。

title: Is your uncertainty map wrong, or is its target? Exact diagnostics for the Tweedie diagonal, and a gradient-free alternative
summary:
A diffusion model can predict a follow-up medical scan from a baseline, but a clinician needs a per-voxel map of where that prediction can be trusted. Many such maps approximate the diagonal of the Tweedie posterior covariance, and are evaluated against another approximation of it, so whether the estimator or the target limits them is unclear. We compute the exact diagonal on six checkpoints across fourteen model-corpus conditions. Hutchinson at M=200 tracks it at rank agreement of at least 0.92 everywhere, yet in four of the fourteen the exact diagonal is anti-correlated with the denoising error, reaching -0.13, so a faithful estimator reproduces that reversal. All four are real-image conditions; on the models' own samples the reversal does not appear, so evaluating on generated samples flatters this family. What limits these maps is the target, not the estimator.
  We then introduce Tweedie Probe-Tangent (T-PT), a gradient-free residual probe that corrupts one model-supported prediction repeatedly and measures the voxel-wise variance of the denoiser's response. T-PT reads a different functional of the same Jacobian, and its exact second-order form ranks with the diagonal wherever the diagonal reverses; at thirty probes it returns a map too unstable to reproduce that ranking, while Hutchinson at M=5 already reproduces it, so T-PT there is not evidence against the reversal. We offer it as an instrument, not a better approximation. On brain MRI at full resolution, where every Jacobian-based estimator we test runs out of memory, T-PT leads a twenty-chain Monte-Carlo ensemble on five of eight endpoints inside tissue and trails it on none, at 16x fewer network evaluations; over the whole volume the ensemble leads, and fifty chains close the tissue gap.
