The tasks assess three forms of inference: identifying physical mechanisms, comparing latent control variables, and predicting outcome properties. Across representative open-source and proprietary MLLMs, zero-shot performance is low: the best model achieves a chance-normalized score of 29.3, while several open-source models remain near chance. In contrast, a task-specific supervised vision transformer performs substantially better, demonstrating that the inputs contain learnable physical information. To diagnose these failures, a structured self-explanation analysis attributes most errors to missed visual patterns and incorrect visual-to-physical mappings. Further, to explore whether post-training can improve physical inference and generalize to unseen tasks, we compare supervised fine-tuning with final answers or chain-of-thought supervision and reinforcement learning. Final-answer supervision performs best overall but transfers less effectively, whereas reinforcement learning after chain-of-thought supervision achieves the best generalization. Together, these findings highlight the need to improve visual-to-physical grounding and cross-task generalization for MLLMs to reliably interpret physical fields in scientific and engineering workflows.

AI.tldr: 论文提出PhysFieldBench基准，系统评估多模态大语言模型从连续物理场观测中推断物理信息的能力，并分析其失败原因与后训练改进效果。
AI.motivation: MLLM正被设想为科研与工程智能体的核心组件，但其解读物理场的能力尚不清楚；现有物理基准多侧重教科书解题或直觉物理推理，未考察模型能否从连续场观测中推断有物理意义的信息。
AI.method: 构建包含24个任务、1160个评估样例的基准，覆盖控制方程场、模拟物理场和观测物理场；评估三类推理：识别物理机制、比较潜在控制变量、预测结果属性；测试代表性开源与闭源MLLM的零样本表现，并与任务专用监督视觉Transformer对比；通过结构化自解释分析错误原因；比较最终答案监督微调、思维链监督微调及强化学习等后训练策略。
AI.result: 最佳MLLM的机会归一化得分仅29.3，多个开源模型接近随机水平；任务专用监督ViT显著更好，说明输入包含可学习物理信息。错误主要归因于漏检视觉模式和视觉到物理的错误映射。最终答案监督整体表现最佳但迁移效果较差，思维链监督后的强化学习泛化最好。
AI.conclusion: MLLM要可靠解读科研与工程中的物理场，需重点改进视觉到物理的grounding能力与跨任务泛化能力。

title: K-OPSD: Verifiable On-Policy Self-Distillation for Post-Training Vision-Language Models on AEC Drawings
summary: Interpreting architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) drawings is hard for general Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs). We introduce K-OPSD, a VLM post-training methodology for improving AEC drawing understanding. Building on On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) with verifiable supervision, we construct a teacher from the model's own best-of-N generations, certified by a process-level verifier, and rescue failed prompts by resampling under a hint that exposes the verified answer. We then perform an on-policy model update by training on verified completions with a cross-entropy inner-loss, outperforming the bounded token-wise generalized Jensen-Shannon divergence (JSD) used by on-policy distillation. Using K-OPSD, we fine-tune Qwen3-VL models on the AECV-Bench dataset. The resulting models attain the top average judge score (0.819) and combined accuracy (0.738), achieving competitive results against open-source baseline models. The recipe transfers to the out-of-domain ArchCAD dataset, where the 8B model gains most. We present the verifier suite and the continual learning and self-improving pipeline, our results provide preliminary evidence that verifier-guided self-distillation is a promising route toward more reliable machine reading of architecture drawings.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 K-OPSD，一种面向建筑、工程与施工（AEC）图纸理解的视觉语言模型后训练方法，通过可验证监督引导的在线自蒸馏提升模型识图能力，并在 AECV-Bench 与 ArchCAD 数据集上取得有竞争力的效果。
AI.motivation: 通用多模态大语言模型与视觉语言模型在解读 AEC 图纸时表现较差，而该领域对可靠机器读图有实际需求，因此需要一种能提升 AEC 图纸理解能力的后训练方法。
AI.method: 在带可验证监督的在线自蒸馏（OPSD）基础上构建 K-OPSD：从模型自身 best-of-N 生成中选取由过程级验证器认证的结果作为教师；对失败提示通过给出已验证答案的提示进行重采样以挽救；随后用交叉熵内部损失在验证通过的完成上进行在线策略更新，替代在线蒸馏中有界的逐 token 广义 Jensen-Shannon 散度（JSD）。用该方法在 AECV-Bench 上微调 Qwen3-VL 系列模型，并迁移到域外的 ArchCAD 数据集。
AI.result: 微调后的模型取得最高平均评审分 0.819 与综合准确率 0.738，与开源基线模型相比具有竞争力；该方法可迁移到域外 ArchCAD 数据集，其中 8B 模型提升最大。
AI.conclusion: 论文给出了验证器套件以及持续学习与自我改进流程，初步证据表明验证器引导的自蒸馏是通向更可靠建筑图纸机器阅读的一条有前景的路径。

title: SpecRegMatch: Robust Semi-Supervised Regression for Vehicle Interior Noise Prediction
comment: Published in IEEE Access, vol. 12, pp. 60-72, 2024
summary: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence has observed increased application in predicting vehicle interior noise levels within the automotive industry. However, the collection of labeled data for training models in this context involves significant costs. Previous studies in semi-supervised regression (SSR) have effectively mitigated the reliance on labeled data by incorporating unlabeled data. Nonetheless, these approaches often introduce a high computational cost due to the training of multiple models and data sampling. This study introduces SpecRegMatch, a novel SSR method aimed at addressing the computational cost associated with training by leveraging a single model, thus eliminating the need for multiple data samplings. SpecRegMatch integrates consistency regularization and information maximization to robustly train the model, achieved through various augmentations applied to both the embedding vectors and predicted values. Experimental results demonstrate that SpecRegMatch achieves state-of-the-art performance across various scenarios, even when using a single model. It attains a remarkable performance, as indicated by an R^2 score of 0.434. This is especially noteworthy in scenarios where labeled data is scarce. You can access the code for our proposed method at https://github.com/sejin-sim/SpecRegMatch.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种名为SpecRegMatch的半监督回归方法，用于车辆内部噪声预测，通过单模型训练降低计算成本，并在标注数据稀缺时取得优异性能。
AI.motivation: 车辆内部噪声预测中，获取标注数据成本高昂；现有半监督回归方法虽能利用无标注数据，但通常需要训练多个模型并进行数据采样，导致计算成本较高。
AI.method: 提出SpecRegMatch，一种基于单模型的半监督回归方法，无需多次数据采样。该方法结合一致性正则化与信息最大化，并通过对嵌入向量和预测值施加多种数据增强来稳健地训练模型。
AI.result: 实验表明，SpecRegMatch在多种场景下达到当前最优性能，即使仅使用单个模型。其R^2得分达到0.434，在标注数据稀缺的场景中表现尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: SpecRegMatch能够有效缓解半监督回归中的高计算成本问题，并在标注数据有限时实现领先的预测性能，代码已开源。

title: ReGDiff: Guided Diffusion in Regulated Latent Space for Exploring Metamaterial Voxel Geometry
summary: Metamaterials are artificially engineered structures whose mechanical and physical behaviors are strongly shaped by geometry rather than composition. Voxel representation provides a unified format for metamaterial geometry generation, as it can express diverse classes such as truss, shell, and porous structures within a single cubic discretization. However, voxel-based generation faces a plausibility-novelty trade-off: staying close to known geometries helps preserve geometric regularities, while moving away from them is necessary for novelty but may produce degenerate geometries. To address this challenge, we propose REGDIFF, a generative framework that couples voxel representation with latent space regulation and guided diffusion. REGDIFF introduces a repel-and-sink (RAS) mechanism to smooth the latent distribution of plausible geometries, and short-range repulsion (SRR) guidance to discourage generation overly close to known samples while maintaining geometric plausibility. We further contribute a voxel-based benchmark covering truss- and shell-type metamaterial geometries, together with an evaluation module for geometric plausibility, novelty, and diversity. Experiments show that REGDIFF outperforms voxel-based generative baselines, achieving +8.9% in geometric plausibility, +46.4% in novelty, and +128.6% in diversity on average across two datasets. These results suggest that REGDIFF is a strong geometry candidate generator for downstream evaluation. Our code is provided at https://github.com/wzhan24/ReGDiff.

AI.tldr: 提出REGDIFF，一个结合体素表示、潜空间正则与引导扩散的超材料几何生成框架，用于缓解合理性-新颖性权衡，并建立体素基准与评估模块。
AI.motivation: 体素表示能统一表达桁架、壳和多孔等超材料几何，但基于体素的生成存在合理性-新颖性权衡：靠近已知几何有助于保持几何规则性，远离则可能产生退化几何，因此需要兼顾合理性与新颖性。
AI.method: REGDIFF将体素表示与潜空间正则、引导扩散耦合，引入repel-and-sink机制平滑合理几何的潜分布，并采用短程排斥引导避免生成结果过度接近已知样本；同时构建覆盖桁架型和壳型超材料的体素基准及几何合理性、新颖性、多样性评估模块。
AI.result: 在两个数据集上平均优于基于体素的生成基线，几何合理性提升8.9%，新颖性提升46.4%，多样性提升128.6%。
AI.conclusion: REGDIFF可作为下游评估的强候选几何生成器，代码已在GitHub开源。

title: GenoMorph: Pathway-Grounded Genomic Disease Reasoning via Adaptive Latent Computation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have demonstrated strong capabilities in biological reasoning; however, genomic disease inference remains largely dependent on memorized gene-disease associations rather than understanding biological pathways. This shortcut learning undermines robustness and generalization, and breaks down when molecular identifiers are unavailable. We present GenoMorph, a multimodal genomic reasoning framework that shifts disease prediction from associative gene-disease mapping toward pathway-grounded reasoning. GenoMorph couples a frozen DNA foundation model with question-conditioned cross-attention fusion, self-adaptive latent reasoning (LatentSp), a residual reasoning gate for iterative genomic evidence reinjection, and rejection sampling fine-tuning regularized by hierarchical optimal transport (OT). Rather than learning direct gene-disease mappings, GenoMorph aligns genomic sequence representations with latent pathway dynamics, enabling reasoning trajectories that follow molecular interactions before producing disease predictions. LatentSp dynamically allocates computation according to reasoning confidence, reducing unnecessary reasoning steps and improving inference efficiency. We further construct an anonymized benchmark from the Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes (KEGG), replacing every gene and molecular identifier with anonymous symbols while preserving sequences and pathway topology, thereby removing memorization shortcuts. GenoMorph raises the weighted F1 from 0.7863 (BioReason) to 0.9412, and rejection sampling fine-tuning with self-adaptive latent reasoning pushes it to 0.9725 while cutting latency nearly 60%. On the anonymized benchmark it reaches 0.9465 F1, substantially outperforming prior systems and confirming that accurate disease prediction can arise from pathway reasoning rather than memorized gene-disease associations.

AI.tldr: 提出GenoMorph多模态基因组推理框架，通过通路推理而非记忆基因-疾病关联进行疾病预测。加权F1最高达0.9725，延迟降低近60%；在匿名基准上F1达0.9465，显著优于先前系统。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在基因组疾病推断中依赖记忆的基因-疾病关联，而非理解生物通路，导致捷径学习，鲁棒性和泛化性差，且当分子标识符不可用时失效。
AI.method: GenoMorph结合冻结的DNA基础模型与问题条件交叉注意力融合、自适应潜在推理(LatentSp)、残差推理门进行迭代基因组证据重注入，以及由分层最优传输(OT)正则化的拒绝采样微调。将基因组序列表示与潜在通路动态对齐，实现遵循分子相互作用的推理轨迹。构建KEGG匿名基准，替换基因和分子标识符为匿名符号，保留序列和通路拓扑。
AI.result: 加权F1从0.7863 (BioReason) 提升至0.9412，加入拒绝采样微调和自适应潜在推理后达到0.9725，延迟降低近60%。在匿名基准上达到0.9465 F1，显著优于先前系统。
AI.conclusion: 准确的疾病预测可以来自通路推理而非记忆的基因-疾病关联，GenoMorph验证了这一点。

title: Trustworthy synthetic visual media: Evidence across the media lifecycle
summary: Images and videos have long helped people understand what happened and how a work came into being. Generative systems complicate that role. Realistic media can now be produced and revised without leaving a stable history, so appearance no longer reveals whether a scene was captured, synthesized, or altered along the way. Trust must instead come from evidence that explains the path an asset has taken and the circumstances in which it was used. Some of this evidence can be recovered from the media, while some must be recorded during production and preserved as the asset circulates. This review brings those approaches together and asks when their claims remain meaningful after ordinary processing or deliberate manipulation. We argue that trustworthy media do not depend on one universal marker of authenticity. The evidence must suit the question at hand, reach the person making the judgment, and remain open to correction when better information emerges. The larger goal is to keep the history of media intelligible even as the media itself continues to change.

AI.tldr: 这是一篇综述，讨论生成式系统时代媒体可信性：外观已不足以判断真假，应依赖说明媒体来源、处理路径和使用情境的证据来维持可追溯性。
AI.motivation: 生成系统使逼真媒体可被轻易生产与修改，且不留稳定历史，导致人们无法仅凭外观判断内容是拍摄、合成还是篡改。
AI.method: 综述并整合两类证据路径：从媒体本身恢复的证据，以及生产过程中记录并随资产传播而保存的证据；同时评估这些证据在常规处理或恶意操纵后是否仍有意义。
AI.result: 不存在单一通用的真实性标记；可信证据必须适合当前问题、能到达判断者，并在出现更好信息时可被修正。
AI.conclusion: 可信媒体的目标不是寻找万能真伪标识，而是在媒体持续变化时仍保持其历史可理解、可追溯和可纠正。

title: A Differentiable Optimization Framework for Registering Sequential Bounding Boxes with Point Cloud Stream
summary: Refining a sequence of coarse 3D bounding boxes against a LiDAR point-cloud stream demands tracks that are geometrically accurate (high IoU) and temporally coherent (low roughness), preferably without training data. The usual recipe keeps the two concerns apart: register each frame independently, then smooth the trajectory afterwards with a Kalman~RTS or Savitzky--Golay filter. Smoothing displaces boxes from a geometric optimum and never re-optimises, so it trades accuracy for smoothness. We instead fold the temporal smoothness constraint into a training-free registration objective and solve for all poses jointly with L-BFGS. The payoff depends on how well the object is seen. On well-observed tracks it is large: within the low-roughness budget, the joint objective beats both post-hoc smoothers on paired multi-seed statistics and cuts roughness several-fold relative to frame-wise registration at matched accuracy. Treating visibility as an experimental variable exposes the limit. The advantage decays monotonically as views become one-sided, until it is indistinguishable from zero for near-edge-on objects and slightly negative under a ray-cast simulator with range-dependent density and ego motion, where the decoupled pipeline is in fact ahead at tight roughness budgets. We locate that boundary and trace it to one term: orientation alignment ties yaw to the estimated velocity and fails once that estimate is noisy. A ground-truth-free rule can choose the temporal scale and keep every track inside the roughness budget.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究如何在无训练数据条件下，从LiDAR点云序列中精化粗3D边界框轨迹，使结果同时具备高几何精度（高IoU）和低时间粗糙度。作者将时间平滑约束融入无训练配准目标，并用L-BFGS联合求解所有位姿。
AI.motivation: 传统方法将几何配准与轨迹平滑分开：先逐帧独立配准，再用Kalman-RTS或Savitzky-Golay滤波平滑。但这会使边界框偏离几何最优且不再重新优化，从而以精度换取平滑度。因此作者希望在不牺牲精度的前提下直接联合优化几何与时间一致性。
AI.method: 提出一种无训练配准目标，将时间平滑约束折叠进配准过程，并用L-BFGS联合求解整个序列的位姿。通过多随机种子配对统计比较联合目标与事后平滑器，并将可见性作为实验变量系统评估性能边界。
AI.result: 在观测充分的轨迹上，联合目标在低粗糙度预算内优于两种事后平滑器，并在相同精度下将粗糙度较逐帧配准降低数倍。随着视角变得单侧，优势单调衰减；在近边缘视角下优势不显著，而在具有距离相关密度和自我运动的射线投射模拟器中，紧凑粗糙度预算下略负，解耦流水线反而更优。作者将边界归因于方向对齐项：它将偏航角与估计速度绑定，速度估计有噪声时失效。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化几何与时间平滑在观测充分时显著有效，但其优势受可见性限制，尤其在单侧视角和噪声速度估计下会消失甚至反转。一个无需真值的规则可选择时间尺度，并让每条轨迹保持在粗糙度预算内。

title: SegBanana: Steering Unified Multimodal Models into Medical Segmenters
summary: Medical image segmentation remains challenging in practical deployment, as models often struggle to generalize beyond the distributions covered by their training data and high-quality pixel-level annotations are typically unavailable for adaptation. Inspired by the cross-task transferability of large language models, we investigate whether unified multimodal models (UMMs) can transfer their pretrained visual understanding, reasoning, and generation capabilities to medical image segmentation without task-specific post-training. By recasting segmentation as structured visual generation, we find that frontier UMMs (e.g., Nano Banana) already exhibit basic segmentation capabilities across diverse clinical scenarios, but still struggle with challenging tasks requiring specialized anatomical or domain-specific knowledge. We further show that these limitations can be effectively mitigated by incorporating visual anatomical knowledge from in-context exemplars, expanding candidate solutions through repeated sampling, and refining suboptimal predictions via targeted editing.Motivated by these observations, we propose SegBanana, to our knowledge, the first agentic visual generation framework for training-free medical image segmentation. SegBanana builds on a frozen UMM as the core generative model, augmented with Anatomy-Aware Knowledge Retrieval and Comparative Quality Critique to unlock its potential segmentation capability. A State-Aware Multimodal Controller maintains structured state and iteratively orchestrates these tools, repeatedly refining intermediate predictions toward higher-quality masks. Across eight medical segmentation datasets, SegBanana achieves an average mDice of 77.45%, outperforming representative generalist (SAM3 and SegGPT) and medical-specific (BiomedParse and MedSAM3) baselines by at least 14.93 points, while remaining robust to out-of-domain visual supports.

AI.tldr: 该论文探索统一多模态模型（UMM）能否无需任务后训练直接迁移到医学图像分割，并提出免训练智能体视觉生成框架 SegBanana，在八个医学分割数据集上取得平均 77.45% mDice。
AI.motivation: 医学图像分割在实际部署中面临模型难以泛化到训练分布之外、且高质量像素级标注通常不可用于适配的问题。受大语言模型跨任务迁移能力启发，作者研究前沿 UMM 是否可将其预训练视觉理解、推理和生成能力迁移到医学图像分割。
AI.method: 将分割重铸为结构化视觉生成，并发现前沿 UMM 已具基本分割能力，但在需要专业解剖或领域知识的困难任务上仍受限。为此提出免训练智能体视觉生成框架 SegBanana：以冻结 UMM 为核心生成模型，引入解剖感知知识检索与比较式质量批判，并通过状态感知多模态控制器维护结构化状态、迭代编排工具，反复优化中间预测以生成更高质量掩码。
AI.result: 在八个医学分割数据集上，SegBanana 平均 mDice 达 77.45%，至少超过代表性通用模型（SAM3、SegGPT）和医学专用模型（BiomedParse、MedSAM3）14.93 个百分点，并对域外视觉支持保持稳健。
AI.conclusion: 统一多模态模型具备基础医学分割潜力，但需借助解剖知识、重复采样与目标编辑等策略增强；SegBanana 表明通过智能体式编排冻结 UMM，可实现有效且鲁棒的免训练医学图像分割。

title: DecFlowEdit: Self-Localized Flow-based Image Editing via Guidance Decoupling
summary: Flow-based image editing (FlowEdit) enables inversion-free semantic changes through the difference between source and target velocities. In this paper, we observe that FlowEdit's default classifier-free guidance (CFG) configuration, with asymmetric source and target scales, causes substantial background leakage. Matching these guidance scales, for example by removing CFG, improves edit-relevant localization but severely degrades editability. To get the best of both worlds, we propose DecFlowEdit, which decouples the optimal guidance scales for localization and for editing in flow-based generative models. In particular, DecFlowEdit first extracts an edit-relevant prior by temporally aggregating velocity differences evaluated without CFG, and then uses this prior to reweight the original updates under default CFG. Our method remains training-free and inversion-free, requiring neither external spatial masks nor attention manipulation. Experiments on PIE-Bench across FLUX, SD3, and SD3.5 show that DecFlowEdit improves background preservation, reducing structure distance by approximately 61 to 73 percent and background LPIPS by 68 to 80 percent relative to FlowEdit at comparable editing fidelity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 DecFlowEdit，一种无需训练和反演的流模型图像编辑方法，通过解耦定位与编辑所需的最优引导尺度，在保持编辑保真度的同时显著减少背景泄漏。
AI.motivation: FlowEdit 默认的无分类器引导（CFG）配置使用不对称的源/目标引导尺度，会导致明显的背景泄漏；若匹配这些尺度（如移除 CFG）虽能改善编辑相关定位，却会严重降低可编辑性。
AI.method: DecFlowEdit 将流模型中用于定位和用于编辑的最优引导尺度解耦：先在无 CFG 条件下评估速度差，并对其进行时间聚合，提取与编辑相关的先验；再用该先验对默认 CFG 下的原始更新进行重加权。方法保持免训练、免反演，且无需外部空间掩码或注意力操作。
AI.result: 在 PIE-Bench 上，针对 FLUX、SD3 和 SD3.5 的实验表明，与 FlowEdit 相比，DecFlowEdit 在编辑保真度相当的情况下改善了背景保持：结构距离降低约 61% 至 73%，背景 LPIPS 降低约 68% 至 80%。
AI.conclusion: 通过解耦定位与编辑的引导尺度，DecFlowEdit 能够同时兼顾编辑相关定位和可编辑性，并显著提升背景保持效果。

title: GUITAR: Structured Failure Diagnosis of GUI Agents via State Transitions
summary: Understanding where and why Graphical User Interface (GUI) agents fail is essential for building more reliable systems, yet current evaluation relies on step accuracy, a metric that treats each screen independently and overlooks the underlying structure of GUI environments. This leads to two critical blind spots: (1) functionally equivalent screens are evaluated in isolation, obscuring systematic failure patterns across shared screens; and (2) the long-tailed GUI distribution renders failures on rare but critical screens invisible under standard metrics. To address these issues, we propose \textbf{GUITAR}, a state-centric diagnostic framework that performs structured failure analysis over both states and transitions, using a State Transition Graph (STG) by mapping visually diverse screens to shared functional states. Across 8 agents and 6 tasks from AndroidControl and Mind2Web, GUITAR reveals that 60.4\% of failures occur in 20\% of states, localizing errors to a small set of bottlenecks. Bottleneck-targeted guidance improves SR by 2.8\% and retains a 1.88\% average gain across 7 agents under three-fold trajectory-held-out evaluation with fully automatic STGs. These findings demonstrate the diagnostic and actionable value of structure-aware evaluation within the evaluated mobile and web tasks. Code is available at https://github.com/sqzhang-lazy/GUITAR

AI.tldr: 该论文提出GUITAR，一个以状态为中心的诊断框架，通过状态转移图（STG）对GUI智能体进行结构化的失败分析，揭示失败集中在少数关键状态，并验证了针对性引导的有效性。
AI.motivation: 当前评估依赖步骤准确率，独立看待每个屏幕，忽略了GUI环境的结构，导致两个盲点：功能等价的屏幕被孤立评估，掩盖了跨共享屏幕的系统性失败模式；长尾GUI分布使罕见但关键屏幕上的失败在标准指标下不可见。
AI.method: 提出GUITAR框架，将视觉多样的屏幕映射为共享功能状态，构建状态转移图（STG），对状态和转移进行结构化失败分析。在AndroidControl和Mind2Web的8个智能体、6个任务上评估，并采用全自动STG进行三折轨迹留出评估。
AI.result: 60.4%的失败发生在20%的状态中，错误定位于少量瓶颈状态；针对瓶颈的引导使成功率提升2.8%，在7个智能体上平均增益1.88%。
AI.conclusion: 研究证明了在移动和网页任务中，结构感知评估具有诊断和可操作价值。代码已开源。

title: Scaling Versatile 3D Assets Editing with a Million-Scale Dataset
summary: Although recent 3D generative models produce increasingly realistic assets, controllable 3D asset editing remains challenging. Existing methods are limited by scarce training data, insufficient source-aware modeling, and a lack of practical evaluation protocols. To address these limitations, we present Alchemy3D, a unified framework for training and evaluating versatile 3D asset editors that covers data construction, model architecture, and benchmark evaluation. Specifically, we curate Alchemy3D-1M, a large-scale 3D editing dataset containing 1.25M assets and 1.38M editing pairs across seven editing types. On this data, we train a family of generative flow models for general-purpose 3D asset editing. The model family supports image- and text-conditioned editing, few-step inference, and transfer to multi-view 3D part segmentation. We further introduce GEdit3D-Bench, a large-scale, open-world benchmark with a multi-dimensional evaluation protocol. Across existing and newly introduced benchmarks, our method outperforms prior methods on most metrics of editing fidelity, source preservation, and visual quality.

AI.tldr: 提出Alchemy3D统一框架，涵盖数据构建、模型架构与基准评估，用于可控3D资产编辑。
AI.motivation: 现有3D生成模型虽能生成逼真资产，但可控3D资产编辑仍面临训练数据稀缺、源感知建模不足及缺乏实用评估协议等挑战。
AI.method: 构建大规模3D编辑数据集Alchemy3D-1M（125万资产、138万编辑对、七种编辑类型）；训练生成流模型族，支持图像/文本条件编辑、少步推理及多视图3D部件分割迁移；提出开放世界基准GEdit3D-Bench及多维评估协议。
AI.result: 在现有及新基准上，方法在编辑保真度、源保留和视觉质量等多数指标上优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: Alchemy3D通过数据、模型与评估一体化推进了可控3D资产编辑，并展现出优越性能。

title: From Attack Success to Attack Severity: Counterfactual Memory Attacks on LLM Agents
summary: As LLM agents increasingly rely on persistent memory for long-horizon and personalized behavior, they can retain and reuse information across interactions, but this also creates a lasting channel through which malicious memory writes can influence future behavior. Persistent-memory attacks are typically evaluated by whether they succeed, yet successful attacks can leave persistent states with substantially different downstream consequences. We study this severity as a distinct attack-design objective and formalize it with counterfactual memory regret (CMR), the paired increase in expected downstream loss relative to clean memory. We introduce MemHarm, which predeclares a finite class of sparse, grounded semantic edits, evaluates candidates through the normal agent memory interface using offline paired-loss feedback, and certifies resolved selections within that class. Compared with attack-success optimization, CMR-guided selection produces substantially larger downstream loss while retaining most of the success-rate gain. Across two agent benchmarks and diverse memory designs, MemHarm attains the highest CMR point estimates among the evaluated general attacks on identical support. Factor-removal interventions link this harm to the selected semantic factor, and native-agent deployments verify the write-to-fresh-process attack path.

AI.tldr: 论文研究LLM智能体持久记忆攻击的下游危害严重性，提出反事实记忆后悔（CMR）作为攻击设计目标，并推出MemHarm方法，在多个基准上取得更高危害且保留多数攻击成功率。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体依赖持久记忆进行长时程与个性化行为，恶意记忆写入会形成长期影响通道。现有攻击多以是否成功为评价标准，但成功攻击造成的下游后果可能差异巨大，因此需要将危害严重性作为独立目标来研究。
AI.method: 形式化反事实记忆后悔（CMR），即相对于干净记忆的配对期望下游损失增量。提出MemHarm：预先声明一类稀疏、有根据的语义编辑，通过正常智能体记忆接口评估候选，利用离线配对损失反馈进行选择，并在该类内认证所选编辑。
AI.result: 与攻击成功率优化相比，CMR引导的选择产生显著更大的下游损失，同时保留大部分成功率收益。在两个智能体基准和多样记忆设计上，MemHarm在相同支持集上取得所评估通用攻击中最高的CMR点估计。因子移除干预将危害与所选语义因子联系起来，原生智能体部署验证了从写入到新进程的攻击路径。
AI.conclusion: 持久记忆攻击应被视为具有不同严重性的设计问题，CMR可作为有效目标；MemHarm能更严重地影响下游行为，且其危害可归因于特定语义编辑，并在真实部署路径中成立。

title: StateGuard: Analytical-State Management with Validity-Aware Intervention for Long-Horizon Data Agents
summary: LLM-based agents have shown strong capabilities in automated data analysis and are increasingly moving toward long-horizon, multi-stage analytical workflows. However, as the analytical process evolves, constraints, variables, and conclusions remain implicitly embedded in interaction histories, making it difficult for agents to track which analytical artifacts remain valid over increasingly long horizons and changing dependencies. Consequently, stale artifacts may be silently inherited, propagating errors to downstream stages. To address this challenge, we propose StateGuard, an analytical-state validity management framework for long-horizon data agents. StateGuard externalizes evolving analytical progress into a state graph containing constraints, versioned variables, intermediate conclusions, and cross-state relations, treating each state as an executable, verifiable, and traceable object rather than textual memory alone. StateGuard maintains state validity through evidence-grounded verification and hierarchical intervention. To equip StateGuard with these capabilities, we first introduce Manager-Oriented Counterfactual Supervision, which constructs 3K state-centric trajectories through counterfactual runtime synthesis to fine-tune StateGuard for state maintenance, verification, and repair. We then apply Validity-Guided Policy Optimization, using runtime validity evidence to provide fine-grained learning signals for protocol correctness, state grounding, and intervention quality. Experiments on three diverse long-horizon data-analysis benchmarks show that StateGuard consistently improves data-agent performance while reducing dependency-induced downstream error propagation, demonstrating the advantages of explicit analytical-state management for reliable long-horizon data analysis.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 StateGuard，一个面向长程数据分析智能体的分析状态有效性管理框架，通过显式状态图与验证干预机制，减少错误沿依赖链传播并提升数据分析性能。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 智能体执行长程、多阶段数据分析，约束、变量和结论常隐式存在于交互历史中，导致智能体难以追踪哪些分析产物在长时程和依赖变化下仍然有效，陈旧产物可能被静默继承并把错误传播到下游阶段。
AI.method: StateGuard 将分析进展外化为状态图，包含约束、版本化变量、中间结论和跨状态关系，把每个状态视为可执行、可验证和可追踪的对象。它通过基于证据的验证和分层干预维护状态有效性。训练上，先提出 Manager-Oriented Counterfactual Supervision，利用反事实运行时合成构建 3K 状态中心轨迹，微调状态维护、验证与修复能力；再采用 Validity-Guided Policy Optimization，以运行时有效性证据为协议正确性、状态 grounding 和干预质量提供细粒度学习信号。
AI.result: 在三个不同的长程数据分析基准上，StateGuard 持续提升数据智能体性能，同时减少由依赖关系引发的下游错误传播，表明显式分析状态管理对可靠长程数据分析具有优势。
AI.conclusion: 显式管理长程数据分析中的分析状态，有助于提升智能体的可靠性、可追踪性和下游任务表现，并缓解错误传播问题。

title: PSM: Dataset Distillation Based on Precise Statistical Matching by Difficulty
summary: Dataset distillation (DD) condenses a large original dataset into a small distilled dataset with high training utility. Decoupled statistical matching methods substantially reduce distillation time and memory overhead while achieving strong performance. However, they typically supervise all distilled samples using running statistics estimated from the entire original dataset. These statistics mainly capture the average feature distribution while overlooking differences in sample difficulty, limiting their ability to characterize the difficulty structure of the original data. To address this issue, we propose Precise Statistical Matching (PSM) by difficulty. After pretraining, PSM uses the Global Precision Score (GPS) to estimate image difficulty, ranks the samples within each class, and partitions each class into IPC (images per class) difficulty groups. During distillation, Statistics Updated Again (SUA) updates the teacher's batch normalization (BN) running statistics through forward passes on original samples from each group, providing difficulty-specific supervision for the corresponding distilled batch. Meanwhile, Initial Sample Screening (ISS) initializes distilled samples using original images from the corresponding difficulty group, providing an effective starting point for precise matching. Experiments across multiple datasets and model architectures demonstrate that PSM broadens the difficulty range of distilled samples and improves downstream performance in most evaluated settings. Code will be released.

AI.tldr: 本文提出按难度进行精确统计匹配的蒸馏方法 PSM，通过将原始数据按难度分组，并为对应的蒸馏样本提供难度特定的批归一化统计监督，从而提升蒸馏数据集的训练效用。
AI.motivation: 现有的解耦统计匹配方法通常使用从整个原始数据集估计的运行统计量来监督所有蒸馏样本，这些统计量只反映平均特征分布，忽略样本难度差异，难以刻画原始数据的难度结构。
AI.method: PSM 在预训练后使用全局精度分数（GPS）估计图像难度，对每个类别内样本排序，并按 IPC 划分为多个难度组。蒸馏过程中，SUA 通过对每组原始样本前向传播来更新教师网络的批归一化运行统计量，为对应蒸馏批次提供难度特定监督；ISS 则用对应难度组的原始图像初始化蒸馏样本。
AI.result: 在多个数据集和模型架构上的实验表明，PSM 拓宽了蒸馏样本的难度范围，并在大多数评估设置中提升了下游性能。
AI.conclusion: 按难度进行精确统计匹配能够弥补传统解耦统计匹配忽略样本难度结构的不足，是一种有效的提升数据集蒸馏性能的方法。

title: See, Measure, and Reason: Learning Visually Grounded Reasoning in Pathology
summary: Pathological assessment relies on recognizing fine-grained visual details in histological images. Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly support pathology interpretation, yet their ability to perceive these details remains inadequate. This weakness leads to inaccurate cellular observations that can persist even when final answers are correct. In this paper, we propose ASPECT to improve visually grounded reasoning through explicit supervision of cellular appearance and abundance. ASPECT trains intermediate visual tokens through pathology feature reconstruction, cell feature alignment, and count supervision. Three-stage supervised fine-tuning teaches the model to perceive, generate visual tokens, and reason, followed by reinforcement learning that rewards answer correctness and consistency with reported measurements. We also introduce PathoVernier, a benchmark of 759 expert-reviewed questions from five pathology datasets covering four cellular composition tasks. It evaluates both final answers and intermediate measurements to expose errors hidden by answer accuracy. On PathoVernier, ASPECT achieves relative accuracy gains of approximately 19.2% over the strongest baseline, Gemini-3.1-Pro, and 99.3% over its Qwen3-VL-8B backbone, while reducing RAWR, which measures counting errors within correct responses, by 28.1% and 42.7%, respectively. ASPECT also improves over its backbone on three external pathology benchmarks covering classification and question answering beyond cellular composition tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出ASPECT方法，通过显式监督细胞外观和数量来提升病理视觉语言模型的细粒度视觉推理能力，并构建PathoVernier基准评估中间测量结果。
AI.motivation: 病理评估依赖组织学图像中的细粒度视觉细节，但现有视觉语言模型对细节感知不足，导致细胞观察不准确，即使最终答案正确也可能隐藏错误。
AI.method: ASPECT通过病理特征重建、细胞特征对齐和计数监督训练中间视觉token；采用三阶段监督微调（感知、生成视觉token、推理）和强化学习（奖励答案正确性与测量一致性）。同时提出PathoVernier基准，包含来自五个病理数据集的759个专家审核问题，覆盖四类细胞组成任务，同时评估最终答案和中间测量。
AI.result: 在PathoVernier上，ASPECT相对最强基线Gemini-3.1-Pro准确率提升约19.2%，相对Qwen3-VL-8B骨干提升99.3%；RAWR（正确回答中的计数错误）分别降低28.1%和42.7%。在三个外部病理基准（分类和问答）上也优于骨干模型。
AI.conclusion: ASPECT能有效提升病理视觉语言模型的视觉grounding和细胞感知能力，PathoVernier可揭示被答案准确率掩盖的中间错误。

title: You Can't Have It Both Ways: Concept Entanglement Limits Diffusion Model Unlearning
comment: 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
summary: Concept unlearning in text-to-image diffusion models aims to suppress a target concept (e.g., \texttt{horse}) while preserving related but distinct content (e.g., \texttt{donkey}), yet existing methods either leak under indirect prompts or visibly degrade other concepts. We show that these failure modes stem from the geometry of concept representations rather than from any particular algorithm. Formalizing concepts as activation-space regions, we prove that the overlap between a target and other concepts lower-bounds the damage any robust erasure must inflict on them, with the trade-off scaling linearly in the degree of overlap. Across thirteen unlearning methods, including methods designed to preserve non-target concepts, no method achieves both strong erasure and strong neighbor preservation: STEREO nearly eliminates indirect leakage but cuts neighbor generation by more than 75\%, while sparse inference-time methods preserve neighbors but leak. Damage increases with our overlap measure, monotonically so for STEREO; the $κ$-scaling reproduces on SDXL, and neighbor-selective damage recurs on FLUX. Perfect unlearning is the wrong target for entangled concepts; methods should be evaluated on the Pareto frontier our theorem establishes.

AI.tldr: 本文从概念表示的几何结构出发，解释并证明了文本到图像扩散模型概念遗忘中擦除目标概念与保留邻近概念之间的根本权衡。
AI.motivation: 现有概念遗忘方法要么在间接提示下泄漏目标概念，要么明显破坏其他相关概念，作者希望揭示这些失败模式是否源于概念表示本身而非具体算法。
AI.method: 将概念形式化为激活空间中的区域，证明目标概念与其他概念的重叠程度会下界约束任何稳健擦除对非目标概念造成的损害，且该权衡随重叠程度线性缩放；在十三种遗忘方法上验证，并扩展到 SDXL 与 FLUX。
AI.result: 没有方法能同时实现强擦除与强邻近概念保留：STEREO 几乎消除间接泄漏但使邻近生成下降超过75%，稀疏推理时方法保留邻近概念却仍泄漏；损害随重叠度量增加而增加，对 STEREO 呈单调关系，κ缩放现象在 SDXL 复现，邻近选择性损害在 FLUX 重现。
AI.conclusion: 对于相互纠缠的概念，完美遗忘不是正确目标；应根据本文定理所建立的帕累托前沿来评估概念遗忘方法。

title: Semantic Modality Compensation for Unsupervised Visible-Infrared Person Re-identification under Unpaired Settings
summary: Unsupervised visible-infrared person re-identification (USL-VI-ReID) learns person representations that can be compared across modalities without identity annotations. In the unpaired setting, however, identity correspondences between modalities are often incomplete, leaving many identities without an observed counterpart in the other modality. Existing unpaired methods bridge this gap by generating or mapping features for the other modality, mainly by exploiting the statistics of visual features without explicitly separating content that is discriminative for identity from style that is specific to modality. Consequently, the generated features may distort identity cues or inherit bias from the source modality, undermining the reliability of supervision across modalities. We formulate unpaired learning across modalities as a semantic compensation problem and propose Semantic Modality Compensation (SMC), a framework based on prompt composition that decouples identity semantics from modality style within a shared visual semantic space. SMC first constructs a discriminative ReID space through augmented dual contrastive learning, yielding pseudo labels, cluster prototypes, and memory banks for each modality. It then learns visible and infrared modality prompts in the CLIP semantic space and maps clusters obtained from pseudo labels to identity semantic tokens. For each cluster lacking a reliable match in the other modality, SMC combines its identity token with the prompt for the target modality to synthesize a semantic counterpart in the missing modality. The synthesized counterpart is then projected back into the ReID space and injected into a compensation memory through confidence gating. Extensive experiments under both paired and unpaired settings demonstrate that SMC consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods, with particularly large gains when identity mismatch is severe.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究无监督可见光-红外行人重识别中的非配对场景，提出语义模态补偿框架SMC，通过提示组合解耦身份语义与模态风格，并合成缺失模态的语义对应特征，从而提升跨模态重识别性能。
AI.motivation: 现有非配对方法通常直接生成或映射另一模态特征，主要利用视觉特征统计信息，未显式区分身份判别性内容与模态特有风格，导致生成特征可能扭曲身份线索或继承源模态偏差，削弱跨模态监督可靠性。
AI.method: 将非配对跨模态学习建模为语义补偿问题，提出基于提示组合的SMC框架。首先通过增强双对比学习构建判别性ReID空间，得到伪标签、聚类原型和各模态记忆库；然后在CLIP语义空间中学习可见光和红外模态提示，将伪标签聚类映射为身份语义token；对另一模态缺乏可靠匹配的聚类，将其身份token与目标模态提示组合，合成缺失模态的语义对应特征；最后投影回ReID空间，并通过置信度门控注入补偿记忆库。
AI.result: 在配对和非配对设置下的大量实验表明，SMC持续优于现有最先进方法，尤其在身份不匹配严重时增益显著。
AI.conclusion: SMC通过显式解耦身份语义与模态风格，并合成缺失模态的语义对应特征，可有效缓解非配对跨模态身份对应不完整问题，提升无监督可见光-红外行人重识别性能。

title: MaLiang-Harness: A Programmable Path to Image and Video Generation
summary: Executable programs offer explicit control over how images and videos are constructed, but generating runnable code is only the beginning of visual creation. A program can execute correctly while violating the requested composition, appearance, or motion. We define this discrepancy as the Program-to-Visual (P2V) gap and introduce MaLiang-Harness, a unified framework for organizing MLLM-driven visual generation into a persistent process of construction, inspection, and revision. Its central design is to make the evolving visual program, its construction history, and its verification share a common revision reference. We define the Persistent Executable Generation (PEG) state as preserving programs and task context. Traceable Generation Process (TGP) connects edits to rendered evidence, and Revision-aware Editing and Verification (REV) supports restoration and checks the current revision before completion. Together, these mechanisms coordinate planning, execution, and visual feedback across rendering backends. We evaluate 11 powerful closed-source MLLMs on MaLiang-IBench and four on MaLiang-VBench, measuring generation success, visual quality, and computational cost. GPT-6-Astra achieves 100% generation success on both benchmarks, with 96.0% of image tasks and 76.9% of video tasks meeting all quality thresholds. The comparison also reveals a mismatch between general capability scores and visual generation performance, with similarly scored models differing substantially in their ability to satisfy visual requirements. MaLiang-Harness provides a systematic basis for studying how MLLMs translate executable code into visual outcomes, exposing both the potential of programmable generation and the limitations of general benchmarks as predictors of this ability. The project is available at https://github.com/gulucaptain/MaLiang-Harness.

AI.tldr: 论文提出“程序到视觉（P2V）鸿沟”概念，并构建 MaLiang-Harness 框架，将 MLLM 驱动的视觉生成组织为持续性的构建、检查与修订过程，以缩小可执行程序与其实际渲染结果之间的差距。
AI.motivation: 可执行程序能显式控制图像和视频的构建方式，但程序正确执行并不代表满足预期的构图、外观或运动要求；这种程序与视觉结果之间的不一致被定义为 P2V 鸿沟，现有方法缺乏系统化框架来持续检查与修订生成过程。
AI.method: 提出 MaLiang-Harness 统一框架，核心是让不断演化的视觉程序、构建历史和验证过程共享同一修订参考；引入持久可执行生成（PEG）状态保存程序与任务上下文，可追踪生成过程（TGP）连接编辑与渲染证据，修订感知编辑与验证（REV）支持恢复并在完成前检查当前修订，从而协调规划、执行与视觉反馈。
AI.result: 在 MaLiang-IBench 上评估 11 个闭源 MLLM，在 MaLiang-VBench 上评估 4 个模型，衡量生成成功率、视觉质量和计算成本；GPT-6-Astra 在两个基准上均达到 100% 生成成功率，图像任务 96.0%、视频任务 76.9% 满足全部质量阈值；同时发现通用能力评分与视觉生成表现不匹配，分数相近的模型在满足视觉要求上差异显著。
AI.conclusion: MaLiang-Harness 为研究 MLLM 如何将可执行代码转化为视觉结果提供了系统基础，既展示了可编程生成的潜力，也暴露了通用基准作为该能力预测指标的局限性。

title: Waggle: Learning One Anonymous Local Law for Self-Organizing LLM Swarms
summary: As LLM agents increasingly collaborate on complex tasks, how to organize their interactions becomes a central design question. Existing multi-agent systems typically learn or adapt explicit roles, hierarchies, routing policies, or communication topologies. We shift the learning target to a reusable local law that can be shared across interchangeable agents and adapt coordination as populations or interaction conditions change, without redefining a global organization. We introduce Waggle, a shared anonymous policy over bounded local views that jointly selects task actions, semantic communication, and local commitment updates. Repeated execution of the same law allows coordination to form, persist, and reorganize online without explicit roles or global topology. To learn this law across interchangeable agents and evolving coordination, we develop Swarm-Consistent Distillation (SCD), combining anonymous-orbit consistency with rollout-grounded prediction of the next local coordination field, with no added inference-time components. Across diverse coordination settings, the same learned law remains effective as populations and interaction budgets change, retains over 96% of substrate-specific oracle quality, and transfers without retraining; SCD further improves reorganization after counterevidence. Together, these results show that LLM-agent organization can emerge and adapt through repeated execution of a learned local law.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Waggle——一种可共享的匿名局部策略，让 LLM 多智能体通过重复执行同一局部法则自发形成、维持并在线重组协作，而不依赖显式角色或全局拓扑；并用 Swarm-Consistent Distillation (SCD) 学习该法则。
AI.motivation: 现有多智能体系统通常学习或适应显式角色、层级、路由策略或通信拓扑；当智能体群体或交互条件变化时，往往需要重新定义全局组织，缺乏可复用、可迁移且能自适应变化的局部协调机制。
AI.method: Waggle 是基于有界局部视图的共享匿名策略，联合选择任务动作、语义通信和局部承诺更新；重复执行同一法则可使协调涌现、持续并在线重组。SCD 结合匿名轨道一致性与基于 rollout 的下一局部协调场预测，跨可互换智能体和演化协调学习该法则，且不增加推理时组件。
AI.result: 在多种协调场景中，同一学习法则在群体规模和交互预算变化时仍有效，保留超过 96% 的 substrate-specific oracle 质量，并可无需重训练迁移；SCD 在出现反证后进一步改善重组。
AI.conclusion: LLM 智能体组织可以通过重复执行学习到的局部法则而涌现并自适应，无需显式设计全局组织。

title: CAT-Free: Multi-View Pedestrian Localization without Calibration, Annotations, or Target-Scene Training via Adaptive Geometric Filtering
summary: Multi-camera pedestrian localization is useful for wide-area monitoring in public and commercial spaces. However, deploying these systems often requires considerable setup for each new environment. Existing methods typically require camera calibration, position annotations, or target-scene training. CAT-Free removes all three requirements. It uses synchronized RGB video as its only scene-specific input. Camera configuration is estimated directly from the video. Pedestrian locations are then estimated by combining observations from multiple cameras. Automatic camera estimation is not always accurate. This can produce unreliable pedestrian locations. CAT-Free therefore introduces two adaptive geometric filters. They remove unreliable position estimates. Their thresholds are estimated from each input sequence. CAT-Free achieves 82.5, 84.5, and 65.7 MODA on WildTrack, MultiviewX, and GMVD. It uses no supplied calibration, position annotations, or target-scene training. Published methods using such scene-specific information report 88.2--95.0 MODA on WildTrack and 83.9--96.5 on MultiviewX under their respective protocols. CAT-Free also transfers without retuning. It reaches 74.9 MODA on four additional sequences and 78.6 on an unseen 8-camera installation. Finally, localization uncertainty predicts MODA with $r=-0.98$. This provides a label-free estimate of localization reliability.

AI.tldr: CAT-Free 提出一种免相机标定、免位置标注、免目标场景训练的多摄像头行人定位方法，仅使用同步 RGB 视频估计相机配置并融合多视角观测，同时用自适应几何滤波剔除不可靠定位；在 WildTrack、MultiviewX、GMVD 上分别达到 82.5、84.5、65.7 MODA，并可跨场景迁移。
AI.motivation: 多摄像头行人定位适用于公共和商业空间的广域监控，但现有系统部署通常需要大量环境相关设置，如相机标定、位置标注或目标场景训练，限制了快速部署和迁移。
AI.method: CAT-Free 仅以同步 RGB 视频作为场景特定输入，直接从视频估计相机配置，再融合多摄像头观测估计行人位置；引入两个自适应几何滤波器去除不可靠位置估计，其阈值由每条输入序列自动估计。
AI.result: CAT-Free 在 WildTrack、MultiviewX、GMVD 上分别达到 82.5、84.5、65.7 MODA，且未使用标定、位置标注或目标场景训练；相较之下，使用场景特定信息的已发表方法在 WildTrack 和 MultiviewX 上分别报告 88.2–95.0 和 83.9–96.5 MODA。迁移时无需调参，在四个额外序列上达到 74.9 MODA，在未见过的 8 摄像头装置上达到 78.6 MODA；定位不确定性以 r=-0.98 预测 MODA，可无标签估计定位可靠性。
AI.conclusion: CAT-Free 能在无需相机标定、位置标注和目标场景训练的条件下实现可迁移的多摄像头行人定位，并通过自适应滤波和不确定性估计提升可靠性，为低部署成本、跨环境应用提供了可行方案。

title: Same Tasks, Different Apps: Why Mobile GUI Agents Fail to Generalize?
comment: Accepted to Findings of EMNLP 2026. 30 pages
summary: Mobile GUI agents deployed in real settings must work across different applications that support the same functionality. Most existing benchmarks test each task in only one app, so a high score can mean the agent understands the task, or only that it knows that particular app. We introduce AnyAppBench, a category-controlled live Android benchmark that evaluates cross-application generalization while keeping the user goal fixed. It spans 10 functional categories, 100 task templates, and 520 task--application pairs over 52 applications. Agents run from raw instructions and with app-independent sub-goals, and a VLM judge labels every failed run under a fixed failure taxonomy whose reliability is measured by human annotation. We find that, across 13 agents, success on the original application does not transfer reliably to new applications with the same goal. Furthermore, providing high-level sub-goal decomposition produces only small, category-dependent changes that do not close the gap, and the mix of failure types changes with the target interface. Based on those insights, we believe the AnyAppBench benchmark provides an important stepping stone toward robust real-world deployment of mobile GUI agents. Our code, data and the leaderboard can be found at the project website https://anyappbench.github.io/.

AI.tldr: 提出AnyAppBench，一个类别控制的实时Android基准，用于在固定用户目标下评估移动GUI智能体的跨应用泛化能力。它覆盖10个功能类别、100个任务模板、520个任务-应用对和52个应用。
AI.motivation: 现有基准通常每个任务只在一个应用中测试，高分可能只说明智能体熟悉该应用，而非真正理解任务。真实部署要求智能体能在支持同一功能的不同应用间工作。
AI.method: 构建类别控制的实时Android基准，保持用户目标固定；让13个智能体从原始指令和应用无关子目标运行；使用VLM评审按固定失败分类法标注失败，并通过人工标注测量其可靠性。
AI.result: 在原应用上的成功不能可靠迁移到具有相同目标的新应用；高层子目标分解只带来较小且依赖类别的变化，无法弥合跨应用差距；失败类型组合会随目标界面而变化。
AI.conclusion: AnyAppBench为移动GUI智能体走向稳健的真实世界部署提供了重要基础。代码、数据和排行榜见项目网站https://anyappbench.github.io/。

title: Evo2Team: When Do Evolved Skills Transfer? From Selection to Deployment
summary: A skill bank that helps one multi-agent system may leave another's behavior unchanged. A transferred rule helps only when target agents act on it successfully. We study this path for routing and communication skills in Count-Frequency and AgentsNet, using teams of 4--32 agents and GPT and Qwen model ladders. Source evolution meets a joint quality, cost, model-tier, and confirmation goal in 14 of 16 settings. We then evaluate Evo2Team, which selects, adapts, and confirms source skills for the target team, alongside six frozen selectors across 28 transfer directions. Evo2Team's target-side exploration cost is below that of evolving a new target bank in every direction, even when reused reference evaluations are charged once. Twenty of 28 held-out outcomes meet the positive-transfer criterion, including three saved diagnostic tests. Selection alone does not explain these outcomes: KNN and CORAL choose different banks in two AgentsNet directions but produce identical recorded executions. When Evo2Team changes execution, gains can reach many tasks, as in a Count-Frequency direction that improves 28 of 32 tasks over KNN. Seven positive AgentsNet outcomes save 6.1--14.6\% in deployment cost while using transferred skills on only three to six of fifteen tasks. In five earlier accepted directions, all 22 task records using transferred skills pass three fixed-graph confirmations, but four fail in recorded executions on new graphs. Graphs and model responses change together in this comparison. These results show that skill transfer must be assessed through the actions agents take, the tasks those actions reach, and the quality and cost of the final deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究多智能体系统间的路由与通信技能迁移，在 Count-Frequency 和 AgentsNet 中用 4–32 个智能体及 GPT、Qwen 模型阶梯测试源技能演化与目标迁移，并提出 Evo2Team 进行选择、适配和确认。
AI.motivation: 帮助一个多智能体系统的技能库不一定能改变另一个系统的行为，转移规则只有在目标智能体成功执行时才有用，因此需要从动作、任务和部署效果评估技能迁移。
AI.method: 在 Count-Frequency 与 AgentsNet 中进行源技能演化，设定质量、成本、模型层级和确认的联合目标；提出 Evo2Team，选择、适配并确认源技能用于目标团队，并与六个冻结选择器在 28 个迁移方向上比较。
AI.result: 16 个设置中 14 个满足联合目标；Evo2Team 的目标侧探索成本在每个方向都低于从零演化目标技能库；28 个留出结果中 20 个满足正迁移，含 3 个节省诊断测试；选择本身不足以解释结果，KNN 与 CORAL 在两个 AgentsNet 方向选不同技能库但执行记录相同；Evo2Team 改变执行时收益可达多任务，如一个 Count-Frequency 方向比 KNN 提升 32 个任务中的 28 个；7 个 AgentsNet 正结果节省 6.1–14.6% 部署成本，但仅 15 个任务中的 3–6 个使用迁移技能；5 个先前接受方向中，22 条使用迁移技能的任务记录通过固定图确认，但 4 条在新图执行中失败。
AI.conclusion: 技能迁移必须通过智能体实际采取的动作、这些动作到达的任务，以及最终部署的质量和成本来评估。

title: Self-Evolving Agents via Likelihood-Guided Tool-Space Optimization
summary: Self-evolving agents can continually improve their behavior, while tools define the executable action space through which they interact with the environment. However, exposing the full tool library to model introduces substantial irrelevant context and can impair tool-use decisions. We study tool-space self-evolution, where each recurring task type maintains a persistent tool space which is constructed from accumulated output experience. We identify three limitations of existing methods: (1) output-unaware selection: they rely primarily on tool descriptions or model priors rather than observed tool outputs; (2) statelessness across request: they select tools independently for each request without consolidating prior output experience into persistent task-specific state; (3) inference cost: they repeatedly search, rank, or reason over candidate tools for subsequent requests of the same task. We address these limitations through output-aware tool scoring, persistent task-specific tool spaces, amortized tool selection, and reusable configurations across models. We introduce LOTS (Likelihood-Only Tool Scoring), which evolves an agent's tool space from accumulated output experience while keeping model parameters fixed. After each request, LOTS holds the model's generated answer and estimates each tool's contribution by measuring how much the answer likelihood changes when its observed output is removed. These contributions are aggregated within each recurring task to rank tools and update its persistent space. Across three benchmarks, LOTS improves task performance while substantially reducing tool context. More importantly, sequential experiments demonstrate that task-specific spaces persist and continue to improve over time, while cross-model experiments show that learned configurations transfer across different models.

AI.tldr: 论文研究智能体工具空间的自进化，提出 LOTS 方法，通过累积输出经验构建并持续优化任务特定的工具空间，在固定模型参数下提升任务表现并减少工具上下文。
AI.motivation: 自进化智能体需要工具来定义可执行动作空间，但将完整工具库暴露给模型会引入大量无关上下文并损害工具使用决策。现有方法存在输出无感知选择、跨请求无状态、重复推理成本高等问题。
AI.method: 提出 LOTS（Likelihood-Only Tool Scoring）：每次请求后保留模型生成的答案，通过移除某工具观测输出后答案似然的变化来估计该工具贡献；将贡献按重复任务聚合，用于排序工具并更新持久化任务工具空间；同时采用输出感知评分、任务特定持久空间、摊销式工具选择和可复用配置。
AI.result: 在三个基准上，LOTS 提升了任务表现并显著减少工具上下文。序贯实验表明任务特定工具空间能够持续存在并随时间改进；跨模型实验表明学习到的配置可以迁移到不同模型。
AI.conclusion: 通过输出感知、持久化和摊销式工具空间自进化，可以在不更新模型参数的情况下有效优化工具选择，并实现工具空间持续改进与跨模型复用。

title: TableSeek: Structure-Preserving Agentic Evidence Seeking over Heterogeneous Table Corpora
summary:
Open-domain table retrieval seeks tables that contain sufficient evidence for answering a question or verifying a claim. Yet semantic relevance is often misleading: topically similar tables may lack the required facts, while answer-bearing evidence is often confined to a few cells whose meaning depends on surrounding schema and table context. Heterogeneous schemas, value formats, and serializations further weaken one-shot matching.
  We present TableSeek, a structure-preserving agentic search framework for heterogeneous table corpora. Instead of ranking tables once, an LLM agent iteratively follows sparse clues, inspects schema-preserving previews, identifies schema- and value-level mismatches, and refines its investigation. TableSeek uses cells and schemas as evidence anchors while retaining complete tables as evidence units, enabling fine-grained localization without losing the context required for interpretation and answerability checking.
  Without relying on retriever training or a precomputed semantic index, TableSeek produces transparent evidence-seeking trajectories and achieves competitive end-to-end performance against strong retrieval-and-reranking pipelines on heterogeneous table benchmarks. These results suggest that active, structure-preserving evidence seeking is a promising paradigm for open-domain table retrieval.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 TableSeek，一种结构保持的智能体搜索框架，用于异构表格语料库的开放域表格检索。它让 LLM 智能体迭代追踪稀疏线索、检查保结构预览、识别模式与值级不匹配，并细化搜索，而非一次性排序表格。
AI.motivation: 开放域表格检索中，语义相关性常具误导性：主题相似的表格可能缺少所需事实，而答案证据常局限于少数单元格，其含义依赖周围模式与表格上下文；异构模式、值格式和序列化方式进一步削弱一次性匹配的效果。
AI.method: TableSeek 以单元格和模式作为证据锚点，同时保留完整表格作为证据单元，支持细粒度定位而不丢失解释与可回答性检查所需上下文。具体上，LLM 智能体迭代地跟踪稀疏线索、检查保留模式的预览、识别模式级和值级不匹配，并逐步细化调查。该方法不依赖检索器训练或预计算语义索引。
AI.result: TableSeek 产生透明的证据寻求轨迹，并在异构表格基准上取得与强检索-重排序流水线相比有竞争力的端到端性能，且无需检索器训练或预计算语义索引。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，主动的、结构保持的证据寻求是开放域表格检索中一个有前景的新范式。

title: MiCo: Mutual Information Coverage Optimization through Semantic Erasure Modeling for Efficient MLLM Inference
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive performance in multimodal understanding, but processing large numbers of visual tokens results in high computational costs. While many methods have been proposed to reduce the number of visual tokens, most of them rely on heuristics and are prone to discarding substantial visual information during pruning, leading to degradation in model performance. In this work, by using a semantic erasure model, we derive a general mutual information coverage objective from task log-loss and propose MiCo, a training-free two-stage pruning method. MiCo first uses visual signals to select a representative candidate pool before visual tokens enter the language model, then performs task-aware subset selection within it. At each stage, suitable observable proxies instantiate the derived objective as a monotone submodular coverage function, which MiCo greedily optimizes under the token budget. MiCo is evaluated on diverse MLLMs ranging from 7B to 13B parameters across a broad range of image and video benchmarks spanning general visual reasoning, fine-grained OCR and grounding, hallucination detection, and long-video understanding. MiCo consistently achieves the best performance across nearly all evaluated models under all pruning ratios. On LLaVA-NEXT-13B, MiCo uses only 5.6% visual tokens, retains 97.5% of baseline performance, and achieves a 3.8-fold inference speedup. Our experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of MiCo and our mutual information coverage objective for visual token pruning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出无需训练的视觉令牌剪枝方法 MiCo，通过互信息覆盖目标在两阶段中贪心选择代表性视觉令牌，以大幅降低多模态大模型计算成本并保持性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型处理大量视觉令牌时计算成本很高，而现有剪枝方法多依赖启发式规则，容易丢弃重要视觉信息，导致模型性能下降。
AI.method: 利用语义擦除模型从任务 log-loss 推导出通用的互信息覆盖目标，并提出 MiCo 两阶段剪枝方法：在视觉令牌进入语言模型前先选择代表性候选池，再进行任务感知的子集选择；每个阶段将目标实例化为单调子模覆盖函数，并在令牌预算下贪心优化。
AI.result: MiCo 在 7B 到 13B 的多种 MLLM 以及图像和视频基准上评估，覆盖通用视觉推理、细粒度 OCR 与定位、幻觉检测和长视频理解等任务；在所有剪枝比例下几乎均取得最佳性能。在 LLaVA-NEXT-13B 上仅使用 5.6% 视觉令牌，保留 97.5% 基线性能，并实现 3.8 倍推理加速。
AI.conclusion: 实验证明了 MiCo 以及所提出的互信息覆盖目标在视觉令牌剪枝中的有效性。

title: SkillPE: Creativity-Oriented Cinematic Skill Evolution for Text-to-Video Prompt Engineering
summary: Achieving high-quality, cinematic results in text-to-video generation remains challenging for non-experts, whose prompts often lack professional narrative and creative design. We propose SkillPE, a prompt engineering (PE) framework that evolves reusable cinematic skills from expert-authored seeds. SkillPE represents shot logic, composition, lighting, sound design, and other filmmaking cues in a fine-grained format, and retrieves movie references categorized as resonators (good matches), dissonants (weak matches), and divergents (creatively useful near-misses). The first two refine when and how a skill should be applied, while divergents inspire alternative cinematic realizations at different degrees of modification while preserving the user intent. Candidate skills are assessed through generated videos along prompt fidelity, cinematic quality, narrative appeal, and creativity to construct the final skill libraries. Experiments on StoryEval and VBench show improvements of up to 1.40 points over the strongest external baseline and 0.51 points over seed skills on 7-point four-dimensional evaluation, while remaining competitive on benchmark-native metrics. Overall, SkillPE offers a practical approach to balancing fidelity and creativity in cinematic text-to-video generation. Code is available at https://github.com/Ais0n/SkillPE .

AI.tldr: 提出SkillPE提示工程框架，从专家撰写的种子中演化出可复用的电影化技能，用于提升文本到视频生成的电影感与创意。
AI.motivation: 非专家用户编写的提示往往缺乏专业叙事与创意设计，导致文本到视频生成难以获得高质量、电影级的结果。
AI.method: 将镜头逻辑、构图、灯光、声音设计等电影制作线索表示为细粒度格式；检索电影参考并分为resonators（好匹配）、dissonants（弱匹配）和divergents（创意有用的近似不匹配）。前两者精炼技能的应用时机与方式，divergents则在不同修改程度下启发替代性电影实现，同时保留用户意图。候选技能通过生成视频在提示保真度、电影质量、叙事吸引力和创造力四个维度上评估，最终构建技能库。
AI.result: 在StoryEval和VBench上，7分制四维评估中，较最强外部基线提升最多1.40分，较种子技能提升0.51分，同时在基准原生指标上保持竞争力。
AI.conclusion: SkillPE为电影化文本到视频生成中平衡保真度与创造力提供了一种实用方法，代码已开源。

title: ReplayLens: Auditing Agents' Use of Outcomes
summary: When an agent reuses logged experience, a changed decision may reflect the recorded score, the action's name, or the record's position in storage. Standard memory evaluations do not reveal which relationship drives that change. We introduce ReplayLens, a black-box audit that changes one relationship in the stored history at a time, holds the remaining interface fixed, and measures the resulting decision. Four interventions target four relationships. Outcome reassignment swaps which scores belong to which actions. Pair transport moves intact action-score pairs to new record slots. Consistent renaming relabels actions in both history and menu. Key-slot reassignment changes both score attachment and position. A constructive separation shows why the audit is needed: two memory writers with identical endpoint accuracy respond differently to the same replay, so conventional evaluation cannot resolve the underlying dependence. On black-box LLM interfaces, swapping scores changes decisions while moving intact pairs does not, separating score attachment from record order. A bounded-memory study exposes ingestion-order sensitivity that endpoint comparison misses. In sequential experiment planning, altered historical scores redirect exploration and reduce final utility despite fresh measurements. A code-debugging agent with sealed hidden tests shows the same pattern outside model selection. ReplayLens provides a relationship-level audit for deciding whether logged experience can be merged, reordered, or reindexed safely.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ReplayLens，一种黑盒审计方法，用于判断智能体复用历史经验时，决策变化究竟由记录分数、动作名称还是存储位置等关系驱动。
AI.motivation: 标准记忆评估只关注端点准确率，无法揭示历史记录中哪种关系导致决策改变，因此难以判断日志经验能否安全合并、重排或重新索引。
AI.method: ReplayLens 每次只改变存储历史中的一种关系并保持其他接口固定，通过四种干预进行审计：结果重分配、配对搬运、一致重命名和键槽重分配；并使用构造性分离说明传统端点评估的不足，在黑盒 LLM 接口、有限记忆、序列实验规划和代码调试智能体上验证。
AI.result: 在黑盒 LLM 接口上，交换分数会改变决策，而移动完整动作-分数对不会，从而区分分数附着与记录顺序；有限记忆研究暴露了端点比较遗漏的摄入顺序敏感性；序列实验规划中，篡改历史分数会改变探索并降低最终效用；带隐藏测试的代码调试智能体也出现相同模式。
AI.conclusion: ReplayLens 提供了关系级别的审计，可用于判断日志经验能否安全地合并、重排或重新索引。

title: SyncRA: Learning Temporal Correspondence in Omni-Modal Models
summary: Recent omni-modal models demonstrate strong perception of audio and visual inputs, yet often struggle to connect what they hear with what they see at the same moment. This weakness in temporal correspondence can cause models to associate spoken cues with the wrong visual scenes, producing plausible answers grounded in incorrect audio-visual pairings. We diagnose this problem through controlled temporal swaps, revealing that model answers do not reliably follow changes in these pairings. To address it, we propose Synchrony-Guided Representation Alignment (SyncRA), a lightweight method for strengthening temporal correspondence between audio and vision. Specifically, SyncRA contrasts intermediate audio-visual representations within each video, aligning matching moments while separating mismatched ones to capture local temporal correspondence within a shared global context. The objective derives supervision directly from existing input timing, requiring no additional annotations and leaving inference unchanged. We evaluate SyncRA across four open omni-modal models spanning different sizes and architectures on five public video benchmarks. SyncRA consistently outperforms answer-only fine-tuning across all model-benchmark combinations, while substantially improving the ability to track changing audio-visual pairings in controlled evaluations. These results demonstrate that lightweight, targeted supervision can effectively strengthen temporal correspondence and translate into broad improvements in audio-visual question answering.

AI.tldr: 论文诊断了全模态模型在音频与视觉时间对应上的缺陷，并提出轻量级同步引导表示对齐方法SyncRA，以增强视听时序对应并提升视听问答性能。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态模型虽能感知音频和视觉输入，但难以将同一时刻听到与看到的内容正确关联，容易将语音线索匹配到错误视觉场景，从而给出基于错误视听配对的看似合理答案。
AI.method: 通过受控时间交换实验诊断该问题；提出SyncRA，在视频内部对比中间视听表示，拉近匹配时刻、推开不匹配时刻，以共享全局上下文捕捉局部时序对应；监督直接来自输入时间信息，无需额外标注，且不改变推理过程。
AI.result: 在四种不同规模和架构的开源全模态模型、五个公开视频基准上，SyncRA在所有模型-基准组合中均优于仅答案微调，并显著提升追踪动态视听配对的能力。
AI.conclusion: 轻量且有针对性的监督能有效强化视听时间对应，并转化为视听问答任务的广泛性能提升。

title: E-WAVE: Event-based Continuous Optical Flow via Warping-Aligned Visual Encoding
summary: Temporally dense optical flow is essential for dynamic perception in immersive VR/AR systems, where rapid head, hand, and object motion must be continuously captured and tracked. Existing frame-based optical flow estimation methods are constrained by the tradeoff between temporal resolution and computational cost; while event cameras, with their high temporal resolution and energy efficiency, serve as a natural solution to the dilemma. However, event-based approaches commonly rely on correlation volumes to capture pairwise voxel correspondences, which incur substantial memory and computation overhead. We present E-WAVE, a correlation-free framework for high-temporal-resolution (HTR) optical flow estimation from event streams. Instead of constructing all-pairs correlation volumes, E-WAVE employs global attention mechanism to model long-range feature dependencies and performs trajectory guided feature warping using Bézier curve. Through iterative updates, it predicts trajectories that allow for querying at arbitrary timestamps without repeated inference. Experiments on MultiFlow and DSEC-Flow demonstrate a 25% lower trajectory error and comparable endpoint flow estimation accuracy relative to state-of-the art baselines. Additional evaluations on self-captured data using a head-mounted prototype validate that E-WAVE remains robust under challenging real-world conditions.

AI.tldr: 提出E-WAVE，一种无需相关体积的事件流高时间分辨率光流估计框架，通过全局注意力与贝塞尔曲线轨迹引导特征变形实现任意时间戳查询。
AI.motivation: VR/AR动态感知需要时间密集光流，但现有帧基方法在时间分辨率与计算成本间权衡；事件相机虽具高时间分辨率与能效，但现有事件方法依赖相关体积，内存与计算开销大。
AI.method: E-WAVE摒弃全对相关体积，采用全局注意力建模长程特征依赖，并使用贝塞尔曲线进行轨迹引导特征变形；通过迭代更新预测轨迹，支持任意时间戳查询而无需重复推理。
AI.result: 在MultiFlow和DSEC-Flow上，轨迹误差较SOTA降低25%，端点光流精度相当；基于头戴原型的自采数据验证其在真实挑战条件下仍具鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: E-WAVE为事件流高时间分辨率光流提供无相关体积的高效方案，兼顾轨迹精度与端点流精度，并具备真实场景部署潜力。

title: DORA: Dynamic Online Reinforcement Agent for Token Pruning in Vision Transformers
summary: Vision Transformers (ViTs) incur quadratic self-attention cost in the number of tokens. Most token-reduction methods adapt token identities within a prescribed layer-wise compression schedule, or search a static mask offline, and thus limit online adaptation of when and how much to prune. We propose DORA (Dynamic Online Reinforcement Agent), which learns an input-adaptive pruning policy itself for frozen ViTs. At each eligible block, a hierarchical actor decides whether to prune, how many tokens to remove, and which tokens to remove from each image's evolving representation. Because early deletions change the states observed by later decisions, DORA formulates pruning as a finite-horizon Markov decision process. Complete-prefix shadow evaluations convert final-prediction fidelity into localized per-step credit, while closed-loop accuracy feedback adjusts the fidelity penalty toward a shared accuracy-drop target. A privileged critic and all shadow computations are training-only. Deployment retains the frozen backbone and a lightweight actor that applies hard deletion and packed variable-length FlashAttention, converting token reduction into measured speedups. On ImageNet-1K with DeiT-Base, DORA reduces FLOPs by 38.4% relative to the uncompressed backbone within one percentage point of accuracy loss. Averaged across four ViT-type backbones at matched accuracy, DORA uses 13.2% fewer FLOPs and achieves 32.4% higher throughput than the corresponding per-backbone baseline means. Under zero-shot transfer to ImageNet-A, these gains widen to 20.3% and 45.6%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 提出DORA（动态在线强化代理），为冻结的ViT学习输入自适应的token剪枝策略，在每块决定是否剪枝、剪多少及剪哪些token，以减少计算量并保持精度。
AI.motivation: ViT的自注意力计算随token数呈二次增长，现有token缩减方法大多在预设的层级压缩计划内调整token身份或离线搜索静态掩码，限制了在线自适应地决定何时剪枝及剪枝比例。
AI.method: 将剪枝建模为有限时域马尔可夫决策过程，使用分层actor在每个合适块进行决策；通过完整前缀影子评估将最终预测保真度转化为每步局部信用，并用闭环精度反馈调整保真度惩罚至目标精度下降；训练时使用特权critic和影子计算，部署时仅保留冻结主干和轻量actor，采用硬删除和打包变长FlashAttention实现实际加速。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-1K上，DeiT-Base相对未压缩主干减少38.4% FLOPs，精度损失在1个百分点内；在四个ViT类主干上平均，匹配精度下比各主干基线平均减少13.2% FLOPs并提升32.4%吞吐量；零样本迁移到ImageNet-A时，优势扩大至20.3%和45.6%。
AI.conclusion: DORA能有效实现输入自适应的在线token剪枝，在极小精度损失下显著降低计算量并提升吞吐量，且在不同主干和零样本迁移任务上具有泛化优势。

title: Decision Readouts for Text-Mediated Video Anomaly Detection: An Exploratory Evaluation of Jev and Qwen
summary: How much does the decision readout matter when video-derived textual evidence is held fixed? We evaluate Jev typed decisions and three Qwen readouts on a sparse development sample of 40 videos and 400 target anchors from UCF-Crime and XD-Violence, each presented as a summary and ordered captions. Each dataset contributes 20 source groups and 200 anchors, including only 10 and 37 positives, respectively. The original five-backend pilot requested 4,000 predictions; Jev Choice returned 776 valid responses out of 800 under the study's strict numerical policy, blocking its full-coverage quality comparison. On XD captions, Jev Noul achieved 75.99% average precision versus 48.47% for Qwen generated probability and 57.81% for the stronger local ordinal-likelihood expectation. The latter paired difference was 18.18 percentage points (95% source-group bootstrap interval 5.53-31.50). UCF did not show a corresponding advantage: caption ROC-AUC was 52.26% for Noul and 65.95% for ordinal likelihood. Both probability readouts had higher, hence worse, UCF Brier scores than the evaluation-prevalence reference of 0.0475. We additionally audit historical LAVAD scores at exactly matched anchors and distinguish response structure from numerical consistency. A binary-likelihood control is missing. These exploratory offline results characterize ranking, probability quality and interface failures; they establish neither a causal typed-interface benefit nor general superiority, calibration or end-to-end acceleration.

AI.tldr: 该论文在视频文本证据固定的条件下，评估Jev类型化决策读出与三种Qwen读出在UCF-Crime和XD-Violence稀疏开发样本上的表现，发现读出方式对排名和概率质量有影响，但结果仅为探索性，不能证明类型化接口的因果优势或普遍优越性。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探究当视频衍生的文本证据保持不变时，决策读出方式对最终判断的影响有多大。
AI.method: 在40个视频和400个目标锚点上评估Jev类型化决策及三种Qwen读出，数据来自UCF-Crime和XD-Violence，每个数据集20个源组和200个锚点，输入为摘要与有序字幕。原五后端试点请求4000个预测，但因严格数值策略，Jev Choice仅返回800个中776个有效响应，导致无法进行全覆盖质量比较。还使用源组bootstrap区间，并对历史LAVAD分数在完全匹配锚点上进行审计，区分响应结构与数值一致性。
AI.result: 在XD字幕上，Jev Noul平均精度为75.99%，高于Qwen生成概率的48.47%和更强的局部序数似然期望的57.81%；与后者的配对差异为18.18个百分点（95%源组bootstrap区间5.53-31.50）。UCF未显示对应优势：字幕ROC-AUC为Noul 52.26%，序数似然65.95%。两种概率读出的UCF Brier分数均高于评估患病率参考值0.0475，即更差。Jev Choice仅776/800有效，阻碍完整比较。
AI.conclusion: 这些离线探索性结果刻画了排名、概率质量和接口失败，但既未建立类型化接口的因果收益，也未证明普遍优越性、校准或端到端加速。此外，缺少二元似然对照。

title: Efficient Reasoning via Constrained Optimization in Latent Space
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have shown remarkable reasoning capabilities, yet they still suffer from overthinking, generating redundant reasoning steps which incur substantial token consumption. Existing methods, such as suppressing reflective keywords or forcing shorter reasoning lengths, attempt to mitigate this issue but inevitably truncate necessary steps and induce underthinking, thereby compromising performance. To address this dilemma, we investigate the latent representations and observe that efficient reasoning steps naturally cluster into a concentrated region in latent space, while those deviating from this region tend to produce verbose sequences. To leverage this, we keep reasoning focused within this region via a quadratic program which projects deviating hidden states back into the region. Then we propose a novel training-free framework to achieve efficient reasoning that reduces token generation costs without sacrificing performance. Extensive experiments conducted on four models ranging from 1.5B to 14B, and across six benchmarks in math reasoning, coding, and scientific QA, validate the effectiveness of our method, up to a 12.1\% improvement in accuracy while reducing generated tokens by 11.8\% to 52.8\%. Codes are available at \href{https://github.com/hzn18/Opt4Reasoning}{https://github.com/hzn18/Opt4Reasoning}.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对大型推理模型的过度思考问题，提出一种无需训练的框架，通过将偏离有效推理区域的隐状态投影回集中区域，在不牺牲性能的情况下减少冗余推理 token。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型虽然推理能力强，但存在过度思考，生成大量冗余推理步骤，导致 token 消耗过高。现有通过抑制反思关键词或强制缩短推理长度的方法，容易截断必要步骤并引发思考不足，从而损害性能。
AI.method: 作者分析隐表示后发现，高效推理步骤在隐空间中自然聚集于一个集中区域，而偏离该区域的步骤往往产生冗长序列。基于此，他们使用二次规划将偏离的隐状态投影回该区域，使推理保持聚焦，并提出了一个无需训练的高效推理框架。
AI.result: 在四个模型（1.5B 到 14B）和六个基准（数学推理、编码、科学问答）上的实验表明，该方法最高提升准确率 12.1%，同时减少生成 token 11.8% 到 52.8%。
AI.conclusion: 通过约束隐状态保持在高效推理区域，可以在无需训练的情况下缓解过度思考，减少 token 生成成本且不牺牲性能，为高效推理提供了有效方案。

title: Rate-Distortion Adaptive Primitive Selection for Omnidirectional Gaussian Splatting
summary: Learned image codecs (LICs) achieve high reconstruction quality, but their decoding speed is often insufficient for immersive virtual reality (VR). Gaussian splatting (GS) codecs render much faster, yet still lag in reconstruction quality and typically decide primitive allocation without considering the coding cost of each primitive. We introduce OIC-GS, an omnidirectional GS codec with a new hierarchical HEALPix primitive grid representation. Gaussian primitives are anchored at predefined spherical locations, eliminating explicit coordinate coding. Finer levels refine their coarser ancestors, naturally supporting coarse-to-fine reconstruction and layered transmission. The predefined grid also enables efficient viewport decoding by selecting only view-relevant primitives. We further introduce a lightweight entropy model for quantized primitives and optimize the codec under a spherical rate-distortion objective. Primitives with insufficient rate-distortion benefit are automatically removed when their quantized opacity becomes zero, allowing OIC-GS to adapt both primitive density and level of detail without a fixed primitive budget. A single bitstream supports full-sphere, viewport-dependent, and progressive decoding. The first viewport reaches final quality after decoding only 52% of the bitstream, and is then rendered at 1,270 FPS. On a 100-image omnidirectional benchmark, OIC-GS outperforms all evaluated GS codecs, reducing WS-PSNR BD-rate by 49.6% over GaussianImage++ and 68.6% over SGI, which uses a learned entropy model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了OIC-GS，一种用于沉浸式VR的全向高斯泼溅编解码器，采用分层HEALPix图元网格表示，支持全向、视口相关和渐进式解码，在保持高质量重建的同时实现高速渲染。
AI.motivation: 现有学习图像编解码器重建质量高但解码速度不足以支持沉浸式VR；高斯泼溅编解码器渲染更快，但重建质量落后，且通常不考虑每个图元的编码成本来分配图元。
AI.method: 提出OIC-GS，使用分层HEALPix图元网格表示，将高斯图元锚定在预定义球面位置以消除显式坐标编码；细层级细化粗层级祖先，支持粗到细重建和分层传输；预定义网格支持高效视口解码；引入轻量级熵模型量化图元，并在球面率失真目标下优化；量化不透明度为零时自动移除率失真收益不足的图元，自适应图元密度和细节层次，无需固定图元预算。
AI.result: 单一码流支持全向、视口相关和渐进式解码；首个视口解码52%码流后即达最终质量，渲染速度达1270 FPS；在100图像全向基准上，OIC-GS优于所有评估的高斯泼溅编解码器，相比GaussianImage++降低WS-PSNR BD-rate 49.6%，相比使用学习熵模型的SGI降低68.6%。
AI.conclusion: OIC-GS通过分层HEALPix网格和率失真优化，有效解决了VR场景中高斯泼溅编解码的质量与速度平衡问题，并支持灵活的视口和渐进式解码。

title: CASS: Contribution-Aware Structured Sparsity for Model Merging
summary: Model merging integrates task-specific fine-tuned models into a single multi-task model, but often suffers from parameter interference caused by conflicting task-vector updates. Existing methods typically mitigate conflicts by pruning task vectors based on weight magnitude or random heuristics, treating Transformers as unstructured ``bags of parameters'' and overlooking their inherent modularity. In this paper, we propose \textbf{C}ontribution-\textbf{A}ware \textbf{S}tructured \textbf{S}parsity (CASS), a unified framework that reduces parameter interference by identifying and preserving task-specific components. At the core of CASS is a contribution-aware structured mask that identifies task-relevant attention heads and FFN neurons. We instantiate this mask in two settings: CASS-Merging, the primary post-hoc setting where masks serve as a plug-and-play denoising filter for existing merging operators, and CASS-Tuning, an extension for scenarios with fine-tuning access where masks constrain gradients to reduce structural overlap between task vectors. Our analysis shows that task-relevant components are sparse and partially disjoint, supporting structured component-level filtering as an effective way to reduce merging interference. Extensive experiments across vision (ViT, 20 tasks) and language (RoBERTa, 8 tasks; Qwen2.5, 4 tasks) benchmarks demonstrate that CASS improves a range of representative merging baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出CASS框架，通过贡献感知的结构化稀疏掩码识别并保留任务相关组件，以减少模型合并中的参数干扰。
AI.motivation: 现有模型合并方法多基于权重幅度或随机启发式修剪任务向量，将Transformer视为无结构的参数集合，忽视了其固有的模块化结构，导致参数干扰问题。
AI.method: CASS使用贡献感知的结构化掩码定位任务相关的注意力头和FFN神经元，并实例化为两种设置：CASS-Merging作为即插即用的去噪滤波器用于现有合并算子，CASS-Tuning在微调时约束梯度以减少任务向量间的结构重叠。
AI.result: 分析表明任务相关组件稀疏且部分不相交；在视觉（ViT，20任务）和语言（RoBERTa，8任务；Qwen2.5，4任务）基准上，CASS提升了多种代表性合并基线的性能。
AI.conclusion: 结构化组件级过滤是减少合并干扰的有效途径，CASS框架能普遍改善现有合并方法。

title: From Static to Dynamic: On-Policy Distillation from Image to Video Diffusion Models
summary: On-policy distillation (OPD) specializes pretrained video diffusion models through teacher supervision along the student's own generation trajectory. Although large video models are natural teachers, developing specialized video experts can require costly video data and training, while querying them incurs substantially higher latency than querying image experts. More readily available and cheaper to query, image experts offer a cost-effective alternative, particularly for largely temporal-agnostic capabilities such as aesthetics and OCR that admit frame-level supervision. However, heterogeneous image and video latent spaces prevent direct supervision of intermediate student states, while image experts lack cross-frame motion supervision, making temporal consistency vulnerable to frame-level improvements. In this paper, we propose MILD, a Motion-Preserving Image-to-Video Latent Distillation framework that transfers specialized image expertise while preserving pretrained video dynamics. MILD uses a learnable linear connector that aligns student latent states and predicted updates with those of image experts, enabling supervision transfer across heterogeneous latent spaces. We further constrain image-guided corrections around the pretrained student's predictions to preserve video dynamics and incorporate an optical-flow-based motion reward to improve motion quality and temporal consistency. Across specialized image experts and multiple video-student backbones, our method consistently outperforms video-teacher OPD baselines, with further studies demonstrating effective transfer across connector designs and heterogeneous architectures. These results establish image-to-video distillation as an effective route to improving video generation by drawing on the diverse and evolving capabilities of the image-generation ecosystem.

AI.tldr: 提出MILD：一种运动保持的图像到视频潜在蒸馏框架，将图像专家的专业能力迁移到预训练视频扩散模型，同时保持视频动态并提升时序一致性。
AI.motivation: 现有视频教师在线策略蒸馏成本高、查询延迟大；图像专家更易获取且查询便宜，但其与视频学生潜在空间异构，且缺乏跨帧运动监督，直接帧级改进易破坏时序一致性。
AI.method: MILD使用可学习线性连接器对齐学生潜在状态及预测更新与图像专家，实现跨异构潜在空间的监督迁移；将图像引导修正约束在预训练学生预测附近以保持视频动态；并引入基于光流的运动奖励改善运动质量与时序一致性。
AI.result: 在多种专用图像专家和多个视频学生骨干上，MILD一致优于视频教师在线策略蒸馏基线；研究还表明其能跨不同连接器设计和异构架构有效迁移。
AI.conclusion: 图像到视频蒸馏是利用图像生成生态中多样且不断演进的能力来改进视频生成的有效途径。

title: RoutePrism: Tracing Construction Order Effects in Agent Memory
summary: Processing the same records in a different order can discard different evidence, yet endpoint accuracy alone cannot reveal what changed or whether it mattered. We introduce RoutePrism, a diagnostic protocol that builds memory twice from the same source pool in two processing orders, then traces which sources, compiled contexts, and answers differ. Because record content, timestamps, policy, and the answer model all stay fixed, any observed difference is localized to the memory construction step. A matched four-condition intervention tests whether a record displaced by reordering actually carried task-relevant evidence: restoring that single record recovers over 60 percentage points of lost accuracy, while substituting a non-supporting record of equal length does not. We evaluate the protocol on PersonaMem-32K (63 primary queries, 29 users) and 470 LongMemEval-S questions with histories spanning 38 to 62 sessions, replicating the core intervention across five answer models. Survivor selection, defined as the choice of which record a cluster retains, drives most source-level changes, while different memory policies (compaction, bounded recency, MemoChat-style summarization, A-MEM) produce distinct failure signatures at the source, context, and metadata layers.

AI.tldr: 提出RoutePrism诊断协议，通过两次不同顺序处理相同记录来追踪记忆构建中的差异，发现恢复被替换的记录可挽回超过60个百分点的准确率损失，且幸存者选择是主要驱动因素。
AI.motivation: 处理相同记录的不同顺序会丢弃不同证据，但仅靠最终准确率无法揭示哪些证据被改变或是否重要，因此需要一种诊断方法来定位和量化记忆构建步骤中的差异。
AI.method: RoutePrism协议：从相同源池以两种处理顺序构建记忆两次，追踪哪些源、编译上下文和答案不同；采用匹配的四条件干预，测试被重排替换的记录是否携带任务相关证据；在PersonaMem-32K（63个主要查询，29个用户）和470个LongMemEval-S问题（历史跨度38-62个会话）上评估，并在五个答案模型上复现核心干预。
AI.result: 恢复被替换的单个记录可挽回超过60个百分点的准确率损失，而替换为等长但不支持任务的记录则不能；幸存者选择（聚类保留哪条记录的选择）驱动了大多数源级变化；不同记忆策略（压缩、有界近期、MemoChat式摘要、A-MEM）在源、上下文和元数据层面产生不同的失败特征。
AI.conclusion: RoutePrism能够将观察到的差异定位到记忆构建步骤，证明幸存者选择是关键驱动因素，并揭示不同记忆策略的独特失败模式，为诊断记忆系统提供了有效工具。

title: Behavior-Grounded Semantic Enrichment for Financial Fraud Modeling and Reasoning
summary: In financial fraud detection, rich semantic context can provide important evidence for transaction behavior modeling and fraud reasoning. However, public real-world financial datasets often lack rich semantics due to privacy constraints. Consequently, synthetic datasets incorporate generated semantics, but at the cost of behavioral realism; textual descriptions for contextual reasoning remain scarce. We address this gap through a semantic enrichment framework grounded in original transaction behavior to simulate multimodal financial data. We (1) propose a multi-agent semantic enrichment framework that generates interpretable financial semantics grounded in transaction behavior through role-specialized agents and consistency refinement, and (2) newly contribute a valuable multimodal financial fraud dataset, MS-FFSD, enriched with structured semantics and textual semantics while preserving real-data-grounded transaction behavior. Furthermore, we systematically analyze the quality and utility of semantic enrichment. Results demonstrate statistical fidelity and framework generalizability, while showing that richer semantics benefit fraud modeling and context-aware LLM reasoning. Overall, this work advances multimodal financial fraud research and bridges emerging LLM and multi-agent capabilities with operational anti-fraud practice. The framework and dataset are released at https://github.com/AI4Risk/MS-FFSD.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种基于原始交易行为的多智能体语义增强框架，用于模拟多模态金融数据，并构建了包含结构化语义和文本语义的多模态金融欺诈数据集MS-FFSD。
AI.motivation: 金融欺诈检测需要丰富语义上下文，但真实金融数据因隐私限制缺乏语义；合成数据虽加入语义却牺牲行为真实性，且用于上下文推理的文本描述仍然稀缺。
AI.method: 提出多智能体语义增强框架，通过角色专业化智能体和一致性优化生成可解释的金融语义，并基于原始交易行为构建多模态金融欺诈数据集MS-FFSD；同时系统分析语义增强的质量和效用。
AI.result: 结果表明该框架具有统计保真性和泛化性；更丰富的语义有助于欺诈建模和上下文感知的LLM推理。
AI.conclusion: 该工作推动了多模态金融欺诈研究，并将新兴LLM与多智能体能力同实际反欺诈实践相衔接，同时开源了框架和数据集。

title: Marathoner: Ultra-Long-Horizon Autonomous Intelligence
summary: Humans naturally possess the ability to work persistently toward long-term goals. Given a challenging task, humans can continuously work for months or even years to accomplish a specific objective. In this paper, we propose Marathoner, an autonomous agentic model possessing the ability of ultra-long-horizon execution. Specifically, we propose a comprehensive post-training pipeline to instill this critical capability into base model. For Ultra-Long-Horizon Task Synthesis, we leverage major release PRs containing 1000+ lines of new code from diverse GitHub repositories as the primary source for synthesizing challenging task-level data. Additionally, we introduce Multi-Task Chaining, which chains multiple generated tasks into a single more challenging task, enabling the synthesis of tasks with frontier-level difficulty. For rejection sampling finetuning, we combine strong teacher model with diverse harnesses to generate trajectories on our synthesized tasks and conduct supervised finetuning on base model with rejection sampled trajectories.
