AI.result: 四项发现通过所有检验：1）提示词-内容对齐（页面词元与完整工作区提示语料库的Jaccard重叠）是最强页面级预测因子，beta=+0.37，95%CI[+0.33,+0.41]，q约10^-73；2）标准AEO清单（FAQ块、结构化数据、Core Web Vitals）在合并数据中呈正效应，但加入域名固定效应后反转或归零，构成Simpson悖论；3）域名级AI权威在平均绝对SHAP值上比最强非对齐页面级特征高6倍；4）发布分析流程作为方法学贡献。
AI.conclusion: LLM引用频率主要由提示词-内容对齐和域名级AI权威驱动；常见AEO页面特征可能因域名混杂而产生误导性结论。研究强调应在域名层面建模，并重视页面内容与完整提示语料库的对齐程度。

title: G$^3$-LoRA: Organizing Reward-Weighted Video Data with Gradient-Guided Grouped LoRA
summary: Post-training foundation video models on heterogeneous reward-weighted data usually assume that all data categories induce compatible updates. This assumption is fragile when categories correspond to different skills, domains, or evaluation dimensions. We study this problem in text-to-video post-training, where VBench2.0 dimensions define data buckets and an external multimodal reward pipeline assigns sample weights. We propose G$^3$-LoRA (Gradient-Guided Grouped LoRA), a data organization procedure that probes category-level gradients induced by reward-weighted video samples, removes the shared global update direction, clusters categories by residual gradient compatibility, trains group-specific LoRA experts, and consolidates them into one adapter by weight merging followed by on-policy distillation from the experts. We motivate this procedure by viewing reward-weighted flow matching as velocity-field regression: incompatible reward dimensions may prefer different denoising directions in overlapping noisy latent regions, causing shared LoRA training to average capabilities. On Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers, the merged grouped adapter improves the matched VBench2.0 evaluation over the base model, a joint reward-weighted LoRA baseline, and random, semantic, and raw-gradient partitions trained with the same pipeline; an independent evaluator agrees, and on CogVideoX-2B grouping avoids the negative transfer of joint training. The gain is not uniform: merging compresses the largest specialist gains, distillation recovers part of this loss, and camera motion and several local-quality dimensions remain challenging. Together, these results suggest that gradient compatibility can serve as a practical diagnostic for organizing reward-weighted video post-training data.

AI.tldr: 论文研究文本到视频后训练中异构奖励加权数据的兼容性问题，提出G3-LoRA：通过类别级梯度兼容性分组训练LoRA专家，再合并并蒸馏为一个适配器。
AI.motivation: 常规做法假设所有数据类别产生兼容更新，但不同技能、领域或评价维度可能导致冲突更新，使共享LoRA训练平均化甚至负迁移能力。
AI.method: 将奖励加权流匹配视为速度场回归，探测类别级梯度，去除共享全局更新方向，按残差梯度兼容性聚类，训练组特定LoRA专家，并通过权重合并与专家在线蒸馏整合为单一适配器。
AI.result: 在Wan2.1-T2V-1.3B-Diffusers上，合并分组适配器在匹配的VBench2.0评估中优于基座、联合奖励加权LoRA基线及随机、语义、原始梯度划分；独立评估一致，并在CogVideoX-2B上避免联合训练负迁移。增益不均匀：合并压缩最大专家增益，蒸馏可恢复部分损失，相机运动和若干局部质量维度仍具挑战。
AI.conclusion: 梯度兼容性可作为组织奖励加权视频后训练数据的实用诊断指标。

title: From UNI2-h to ConvNeXt-T: Lightweight Nuclei Instance Segmentation via Knowledge Distillation
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI 2027)
summary: Nuclei instance segmentation is a core task in digital pathology, yet high-accuracy models rely on large vision transformer (ViT) encoders whose inference speed cannot meet real-time clinical demands. We propose a lightweight scheme that distills the UNI2-h pathology foundation model into a ConvNeXt-Tiny student (Ours-T, 34.7M parameters, 1/20 of the teacher) via output-level knowledge distillation. Ours-T achieves an mPQ of 0.519 on PanNuke (98.8% of the teacher), a zero-shot bPQ of 0.668 on MoNuSeg, and an inference speed of 634.3 img/s, requiring only 0.045 s for full-resolution 1024^2 analysis (21.8x speedup). Experiments further show that multi-scale gated convolution (MALA) yields no gain under ViT encoders, and output-level distillation alone suffices for efficient knowledge transfer.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种轻量级细胞核实例分割方案，通过输出级知识蒸馏将病理基础模型UNI2-h压缩为ConvNeXt-Tiny学生模型，在保持接近教师精度的同时大幅提升推理速度。
AI.motivation: 数字病理中的细胞核实例分割对临床实时性要求高，但高精度模型依赖大型ViT编码器，推理速度难以满足实时临床需求。
AI.method: 采用输出级知识蒸馏，将UNI2-h病理基础模型蒸馏到轻量级ConvNeXt-Tiny学生模型（Ours-T，34.7M参数，仅为教师的1/20）；并实验分析了多尺度门控卷积（MALA）在ViT编码器下的效果。
AI.result: Ours-T在PanNuke上达到mPQ 0.519，为教师的98.8%；在MoNuSeg上零样本bPQ为0.668；推理速度634.3 img/s，全分辨率1024×1024分析仅需0.045s，实现21.8倍加速。实验还表明，MALA在ViT编码器下无增益，仅输出级蒸馏即可实现高效知识迁移。
AI.conclusion: 输出级知识蒸馏足以将大型病理基础模型高效迁移到轻量学生模型，在几乎不损失精度的前提下显著提升细胞核实例分割的推理速度，满足实时临床需求。

title: When Valid Tool Calls Change Meaning: Formation-Consistent Dispatch for LLM Agents
summary: Tool-enabled agents form calls from model-visible interfaces, while hosts later select their implementation. Standard dispatch omits the descriptor-handler relation. An unchanged and schema-valid call can therefore acquire a different security effect during rollout, reconnect, or delayed approval. We call this failure schema-epoch drift. We present formation-consistent dispatch (FCD), which connects implementation analysis to execution authority. Reviewed profiles produce provenance-bound over-approximations of declared in-scope effects from official source. Under a closed-target approval policy, a verifier applies each formed call to a summary and captures a successor only when its effects fit the call's security contract. Atomic admission and a final-hop fence preserve this decision to the effect. The exact source retains priority, and the captured successor becomes eligible only after source retirement. Stock releases and deployment changes reproduced the failure. Four profiles covered 32 official releases: 29 required no release-specific change and three escalated. A frozen 16-release expansion matched a separate source oracle. In a preregistered stock comparison, FCD completed all three pending calls whose effect remained private and blocked all three whose omission became public. Exact pinning and release-wide denial stopped all six calls, while release-wide approval completed all six but produced three public effects. A separate lifecycle experiment carried a formation-captured certificate across source retirement. The same safe certificate installed later governed new formations without expanding the pending call's authority.

AI.tldr: 论文提出并解决“模式纪元漂移”问题：工具调用由模型可见接口生成、宿主后选实现，标准分派忽略描述符与处理器的绑定，导致同一合法调用在不同实现或发布阶段产生不同安全效果。作者提出形成一致性分派（FCD），将实现分析与执行权限绑定。
AI.motivation: 工具代理的调用形成与宿主实现选择相分离，调用在发布、重连或延迟审批后可能因实现版本变化而获得不同安全效应。现有调度未关联描述符与处理器，存在安全漏洞。
AI.method: 提出FCD；基于审查配置从官方源生成带来源绑定的声明范围内效果过近似；在封闭目标审批策略下，验证器将形成的调用应用于摘要，仅当效果符合调用安全契约时捕获后继；原子准入与最后一跳围栏将决策保持到效果层；精确源优先，后继仅在源退役后可用。通过官方发布、部署变更、32个发布/4配置、冻结16发布源预言机、预注册库存比较和生命周期实验验证。
AI.result: 库存发布和部署变更复现了该失效。四配置覆盖32个官方发布：29个无需发布特定修改，3个需升级。冻结16发布扩展与独立源预言机一致。预注册比较中，FCD完成3个效果保持私有的待处理调用，阻止3个遗漏公开的调用；精确固定和全发布拒绝阻止全部6个，全发布批准完成全部6个但产生3个公开效果。生命周期实验表明形成时捕获的证书可跨源退役传递，且不扩大待处理调用权限。
AI.conclusion: FCD可将实现分析与执行权限一致绑定，防止模式纪元漂移；在保持精确源优先的同时安全处理源退役和更新，避免调用在后续实现中获得未经授权的安全效果。

title: Sol-H3: Recursive Self-Improvement for MiniMax-H3 Inference Acceleration on Sol-Engine across Cloud and Edge
summary: Video diffusion models are rapidly scaling and exhibiting enhanced generation capabilities. Among these recent advancements, MiniMax-H3 stands out as a highly capable, production-level open-source model. However, its 33-billion parameters and multi-step iterative denoising process introduce substantial computational overhead. Consequently, their practical production is hindered by generation latency in the cloud deployment like NVIDIA-GB200, alongside strict memory limits that pose further challenges at the edge device like DGX-Spark. To address these diverse hardware bottlenecks from cloud to edge device, we present a full-stack inference pipeline that integrates efficient algorithmic design with optimized operator implementations. Algorithmically, we introduce a cross-resolution two-stage generation scheduler that exploits the step-wise nature of diffusion: early low-resolution steps rapidly establish the global layout, while later high-resolution steps focus refinements of local and perceptual details. These stages are connected by a learned latent-to-latent mapping module, completely eliminating the computationally expensive VAE decode-reencode cycle for resolution transferring cross different resolutions. For operator implementation, we deploy a Recursive Self-Improvement (RSI) loop that searches kernel fusions and memory layouts, evaluating latency together with numerical agreement. Together, these optimizations deliver up to 30x end-to-end speedup and 20% lower memory: a 5-second 1344x768 video with audio is generated 3.5x faster than real time on an 8xGB200 node, and in under a minute fully memory-resident on a single DGX Spark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套面向视频扩散模型MiniMax-H3的全栈推理流水线，通过跨分辨率两阶段生成调度与算子级优化，显著降低云端和边缘设备上的生成延迟与内存占用。
AI.motivation: MiniMax-H3拥有330亿参数且需多步迭代去噪，计算开销巨大，导致云端部署延迟高、边缘设备内存受限，难以满足实际生产需求。
AI.method: 算法上引入跨分辨率两阶段生成调度器：早期低分辨率步骤快速建立全局布局，后期高分辨率步骤细化局部与感知细节；两阶段间使用学习到的潜空间到潜空间映射模块，避免昂贵的VAE解码-重编码。算子实现上采用递归自改进循环，搜索核融合与内存布局，同时优化延迟与数值一致性。
AI.result: 端到端最高加速30倍，内存降低20%；在8xGB200节点上生成5秒1344x768带音频视频比实时快3.5倍，在单台DGX Spark上可在1分钟内完全驻留内存生成。
AI.conclusion: 该全栈优化方案有效解决了从云端到边缘设备的多样化硬件瓶颈，使大规模视频扩散模型在生产环境中更高效、可部署。

title: DuplexCadence: Exact State and Execution from a Speech Model's Declared Timelines
summary: Full-duplex speech models support streaming interaction that listens and speaks at the same time. Serving them is governed by a strict, repeating deadline: conversation advances on a one-second cadence, and every second of input must be turned into a second of speech before the next second arrives. Because stages within a session run in strict sequence, per-invocation overhead cannot be batched away. Profiling reveals that the autoregressive stages of a duplex second already fit within the period, whereas the token-to-audio synthesis tail is what causes overruns. This tail stage suffers from orchestration slack where the GPU is left waiting as thousands of tiny, regular operations are issued one by one, while also wasting substantial memory by over-provisioning state at static implementation constants. Existing remedies, such as graph recording and demand-sized allocation, fail because streaming state dynamics violate their prerequisites. The root cause is that the runtime lacks the model's native clocks: the per-region counters that govern advancement rates and retention policies. We propose DuplexCadence, which explicitly declares native clocks to the runtime and derives two mutually enabling rules: demand-sized state allocation at a stable address, and exact-shape graph replay without padding. The former eliminates idle memory and stabilizes tensor pointers, while the latter removes orchestration slack without padding overhead. Evaluated on four released models across three decoder architectures with bit-for-bit identical output, DuplexCadence reaches $2.85\times$ the stock runtime's speed at $38.8\%$ lower peak memory. On the live duplex path, mean SPEAK time falls from $14\%$ over the one-second cadence to $2\%$ under it, enabling models to reliably keep up with interactive speech while markedly expanding multi-

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DuplexCadence，通过向运行时显式声明全双工语音模型的“原生时钟”，解决流式对话中 token 到音频合成尾阶段的开销与内存浪费问题，从而让模型稳定跟上每秒一轮的交互节奏。
AI.motivation: 全双工语音模型需以一秒为周期同时听与说，每个阶段严格串行，单次调用开销无法批处理掩盖。分析发现自回归阶段尚能在一秒内完成，但 token 到音频合成的尾阶段因逐个小算子下发造成 GPU 编排空转，并因静态常量过度分配状态而浪费显存。图录制和按需分配等现有方案因流式状态动态变化而失效，根因是运行时缺少模型原生的推进速率与保留策略计数器。
AI.method: 提出 DuplexCadence，将模型原生时钟显式暴露给运行时，并据此导出两条相互支撑的规则：在稳定地址上进行按需状态分配，以及无填充的精确形状图重放。前者消除空闲显存并稳定张量指针，后者消除编排空转且避免填充开销。
AI.result: 在四种已发布模型、三种解码器架构上评估，输出逐位一致。DuplexCadence 达到原运行时 2.85 倍速度，峰值显存降低 38.8%。在实时全双工路径上，平均 SPEAK 时间从超过一秒节奏 14% 降至低于该节奏 2%，使模型能可靠跟上交互式语音，并显著扩展多路并发能力。
AI.conclusion: 显式声明流式模型的原生时钟，并配合稳定地址按需分配与精确形状图重放，可有效消除合成尾阶段的编排空转和显存浪费，使全双工语音服务在严格一秒期限下稳定运行，同时大幅提升速度、降低内存并扩展并发。

title: Using Context Is Not Enough: Test-Time Training for Personalized Reward Modeling
summary: Reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) aligns large language models (LLMs) with human preferences, yet most pipelines learn a single reward model that overlooks individual differences in preferences. Personalized reward models (PRMs) address this by conditioning rewards on user-specific feedback, most commonly through in-context learning (ICL), where a user's historical comparisons are supplied as contextual preference pairs. However, we identify a key limitation of ICL-based PRMs: they fail to capture the preference relations conveyed by contextual pairs. To address this, we propose Preference-Aligned Test-Time Training (P-TTT), which explicitly encodes these relations into user-specific fast weights for personalized reward prediction. P-TTT introduces sequence-level update and apply operations to match the response-level granularity of preference feedback, together with a preference-aligned objective that directly uses pairwise preference relations to guide fast-weight adaptation. Notably, P-TTT is simple to implement and computationally efficient, updating fast weights within a single forward pass without inference-time backpropagation. Extensive experiments show that P-TTT more effectively captures historical preference relations and outperforms state-of-the-art methods by a large margin.

AI.tldr: 论文提出偏好对齐的测试时训练（P-TTT），通过将用户历史偏好关系编码到快速权重中，实现个性化奖励模型，计算高效且无需推理时反向传播，实验大幅超越现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于人类反馈的强化学习通常学习单一奖励模型，忽略个体偏好差异；个性化奖励模型多采用上下文学习（ICL），但ICL无法捕捉上下文偏好对中蕴含的偏好关系。
AI.method: 提出P-TTT，将偏好关系显式编码为用户特定的快速权重；引入序列级更新与应用操作以匹配响应级偏好反馈；设计偏好对齐目标直接利用成对偏好关系指导快速权重适应；单次前向传播更新快速权重，无需推理时反向传播。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，P-TTT能更有效地捕捉历史偏好关系，并大幅优于最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: P-TTT是一种简单高效、能显式建模用户偏好关系的个性化奖励建模方法，显著提升个性化奖励预测性能。

title: Token-Disentangled Latent Test-Time Scaling for Vision-Language Reasoning
summary: Latent test-time scaling improves reasoning by refining hidden states during inference, but existing methods typically apply a single scalar reward to all editable latent tokens. For multimodal large language models, this global update ignores that generated tokens play different roles: some are sensitive to visual evidence, while others correspond to uncertain reasoning decisions. We present Token-Disentangled Latent Test-Time Scaling, an inference-time framework that makes latent refinement token-role-aware. Starting from an initial generated trajectory, we optimize a short hidden-state prefix while routing perception-side visual feedback to image-sensitive tokens and reasoning feedback to high-entropy tokens. Tokens selected by neither route are constrained by an anchor regularizer. Across both perception and reasoning benchmarks on Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B, our method lifts macro accuracy over CoT by +2.57 and +1.51 respectively, and outperforms strong output-space test-time scaling baselines under matched decoded-candidate budgets. Code is available at https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/TD-LTTS.

AI.tldr: 提出 Token-Disentangled Latent Test-Time Scaling，一种推理时 latent 细化框架，使多模态大模型的可编辑隐状态更新具备 token 角色感知：视觉反馈作用于图像敏感 token，推理反馈作用于高熵 token，其余 token 由锚点正则约束。
AI.motivation: 现有 latent test-time scaling 通常对所有可编辑 latent token 施加单一标量奖励或全局更新，但在多模态大模型中，不同生成 token 角色不同：部分依赖视觉证据，部分对应不确定的推理决策，全局更新会忽略这种差异。
AI.method: 从初始生成轨迹出发，优化一个短隐状态前缀；将感知侧视觉反馈路由到图像敏感 token，将推理反馈路由到高熵 token；未被两条路由选中的 token 用 anchor regularizer 约束。在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 InternVL3.5-8B 的感知与推理基准上评估，并与 CoT 及输出空间 test-time scaling 基线比较。
AI.result: 相比 CoT，在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 和 InternVL3.5-8B 上宏观准确率分别提升 +2.57 和 +1.51；在匹配解码候选预算下，优于强输出空间 test-time scaling 基线。
AI.conclusion: 按 token 角色解耦的 latent 细化能更有效地提升多模态大模型推理性能，代码已开源。

title: DrawingsDreamer: A Unified Multi-View Engineering Drawings Generation Model
summary: Scalable Vector Graphics (SVG) are essential for modern industrial Computer-Aided Design (CAD). However, existing autoregressive SVG generation models are predominantly tailored for artistic creation and struggle to maintain the rigorous geometric fidelity and cross-view spatial alignment required for engineering drawings. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{DrawingsDreamer}, a unified Large Language Model (LLM)-driven framework for multi-view vector-based engineering drawings generation. By formulating the generation of multi-view engineering drawings purely as a sequence modeling task, we eliminate the need of raster image encoders. We propose a Streamlined Representation utilizing hierarchical postfix tokenization, which guides the model to establish local geometric coordinates before assigning semantic boundaries. Optimized via a progressive task-aware curriculum schedule, \textbf{DrawingsDreamer} effectively transitions from localized structural repair to macroscopic generation in a unified model. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our unified model achieves strong performance in both geometric fidelity and syntactic accuracy across diverse conditional and unconditional generation tasks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 DrawingsDreamer，一个由 LLM 驱动的统一框架，用于多视角矢量工程图生成，将生成任务纯化为序列建模，无需栅格图像编码器，并在几何保真度与语法准确度上取得良好表现。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归 SVG 生成模型主要面向艺术创作，难以满足工程图所需的严格几何保真度和跨视角空间对齐要求，因此需要一种面向工业 CAD 工程图的专用生成方法。
AI.method: 将多视角工程图生成完全建模为序列建模任务，去除栅格图像编码器；提出基于层次化后缀分词（hierarchical postfix tokenization）的流线型表示，先建立局部几何坐标再分配语义边界；并采用渐进式任务感知课程调度（progressive task-aware curriculum）进行优化，使统一模型从局部结构修复过渡到宏观生成。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，该统一模型在多种条件与无条件生成任务中，在几何保真度和语法准确度方面均取得了强性能。
AI.conclusion: DrawingsDreamer 为多视角矢量工程图生成提供了一种有效的统一 LLM 框架，验证了纯序列建模在该任务上的可行性，并能同时兼顾几何精度与语法正确性。

title: Generative AI-Based Data Augmentation for Oral Lesion Classification: The PhotoMOCI Dataset and Benchmark
summary: Early detection of oral cancer via photographic imaging presents a promising avenue for large-scale oral cavity screening. However, the development of robust deep learning models is frequently hampered by the scarcity of high-quality, annotated datasets. To address this limitation, a novel and well-curated resource, the Photographic Multi-purpose Oral Cancer Imaging (PhotoMOCI) dataset, is introduced for developing models across multiple diagnostic tasks in oral oncology. Then, a comprehensive benchmark study was conducted to investigate how various data augmentation strategies influence the performance of image classifiers. Our analysis spans different generative AI frameworks, evaluating the efficacy of traditional methods against advanced generative approaches, including Generative Adversarial Networks (GANs) and Diffusion Models (DMs). Additionally, we propose the Synthetic Image Filter (SIF), a mechanism to select specific samples based on two auxiliary models: Synthetic Proxy Classifier to ensure samples are representative of the target class and Synthetic Image Detector to verify they appear realistic, thereby selecting only the high-utility images that contribute to improving downstream performance. Across the evaluated datasets and classifiers, the best SIF-filtered setup improves accuracy over traditional augmentation in all cases, with gains of +1.73% and +2.35% on PhotoMOCI and +2.38% and +2.08% on KOCD for ResNet50 and ViT, respectively. Our findings reveal that while the direct application of generative data augmentation may yield performance drops, the integration of SIF, considering (i) how synthetic data looks real and (ii) how it reflects the discriminative features of the belonging class, provides a simple yet effective mechanism to filter out synthetic samples that confuse the classifier during training.

AI.tldr: 论文提出口腔癌摄影成像数据集PhotoMOCI，并系统基准测试生成式数据增强方法，提出SIF过滤合成图像，以提升口腔癌图像分类性能。
AI.motivation: 口腔癌早期通过摄影成像筛查前景广阔，但高质量、带标注数据稀缺，限制了鲁棒深度学习模型的开发；同时直接使用生成式数据增强可能导致性能下降。
AI.method: 构建并发布PhotoMOCI多用途口腔癌成像数据集；比较传统增强与GAN、扩散模型等生成式增强策略；提出Synthetic Image Filter（SIF），利用Synthetic Proxy Classifier保证合成样本对目标类具有代表性，利用Synthetic Image Detector验证其真实性，从而筛选高价值合成图像。
AI.result: 在PhotoMOCI和KOCD数据集上，最佳SIF过滤配置均优于传统增强：ResNet50和ViT在PhotoMOCI上分别提升+1.73%和+2.35%，在KOCD上分别提升+2.38%和+2.08%。
AI.conclusion: 直接应用生成式数据增强可能带来性能下降，而结合合成图像真实性与类别判别特征进行过滤的SIF机制，能有效剔除混淆分类器的合成样本，简单且有效地提升下游分类性能。

title: Tool Mediation Alters Refusal Mechanisms in Large Language Models
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed with access to external tools, yet harmful tool-mediated interactions are less likely to be refused when compared to regular conversational ones. As this change in refusal behavior remains underexplored, we investigate its underlying mechanisms across a diverse set of open-weight language models. We find that information about the harmfulness of a request remains strongly encoded in the model's representations and transfers across conversational and tool-mediated inputs. Evidence from representation geometry and neuron-level analysis further indicates that the two interaction modes systematically distribute harm-related computation differently. Crucially, while conversational inputs can be refused at relatively low levels of perceived harmfulness, tool-mediated inputs remain permissive until harmfulness crosses a substantially higher effective refusal threshold. Moreover, tool-mediated refusal is also more brittle: progressively weakening the refusal computation disrupts tool-mediated refusal at lower intervention strengths than conversational refusal, even when benign capabilities remain intact. Together, our findings indicate that tool mediation does not simply reduce the internal perception of harm, but instead impacts its conversion into refusal. Overall, this suggests tool-mediated environments may intrinsically reduce robustness of models to harmful requests, and that conventional safety evaluations may not fully transfer to LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨LLM在工具调用场景中比普通对话更少拒绝有害请求的机制，发现工具中介并未降低模型对危害的感知，而是改变了危害感知向拒绝行为的转化。
AI.motivation: LLM日益连接外部工具，但工具中介的有害交互相比普通对话更不易被拒绝，这一拒绝行为差异的机制尚不清楚，因此需要研究其内部原因并检验传统安全评估是否适用于LLM智能体。
AI.method: 作者在多种开放权重语言模型上，结合表示分析、表示几何和神经元级分析，比较对话输入与工具中介输入中危害信息的编码、迁移及拒绝计算分布，并通过逐步削弱拒绝计算来测试拒绝鲁棒性。
AI.result: 危害性信息在模型表示中仍被强编码，并可在对话和工具中介输入间迁移；两种交互模式对危害相关计算的分布不同。工具中介输入需要更高的有效拒绝阈值才触发拒绝，且其拒绝更脆弱：削弱拒绝计算时，工具中介拒绝比对话拒绝在更低干预强度下就被破坏，同时良性能力仍保持完整。
AI.conclusion: 工具中介并非简单降低模型对危害的内部感知，而是影响其转化为拒绝的过程。工具中介环境可能内在地降低模型对有害请求的鲁棒性，常规安全评估未必能完全迁移到LLM智能体。

title: Beyond Selection: Token Parameterization for Extreme Visual Token Compression
summary: Visual-token compression is effective for improving the efficiency of vision-language models, but under extreme compression budgets, token pruning can break visual grounding while learned resamplers increase parameter count, attention cost, and training complexity. We revisit compression through a token parameterization lens, separating (i) basis transformation and structured truncation (retained subspace/compressibility) from (ii) coordinate organization (optimization and cross-modal alignment). This view yields two coupled objectives, compressibility and learnability, which we formalize as unified functionals. Guided by these objectives, we design Braco, a lightweight four-step coder that combines transform-basis truncation, input-independent basis-coordinate embeddings, budget-dependent orthogonal re-parameterization, and learned spatial residual tokens from lightweight pooling. Experiments show that Braco forms the favorable empirical accuracy-efficiency frontier under $23\times$--$64\times$ compression and remains competitive at $144\times$, reaching 95.2% accuracy while reducing prefill FLOPs by 84.2%--86.7% relative to the uncompressed upper bound. Against prior methods, Braco matches or improves accuracy while achieving up to approximately 36% end-to-end speedup and using $16.6\times$/$78.8\times$ lower compressor latency/FLOPs.

AI.tldr: 该论文从 token 参数化视角重新审视视觉 token 压缩，提出轻量四步编码器 Braco，在极端压缩率下兼顾视觉 grounding 与效率，形成更优的精度-效率前沿。
AI.motivation: 视觉 token 压缩能提升视觉语言模型效率，但极端压缩预算下 token 剪枝会破坏视觉 grounding，而可学习 resampler 又会增加参数量、注意力开销和训练复杂度。
AI.method: 将压缩拆分为基变换与结构化截断，以及坐标组织两部分，并形式化可压缩性与可学习性两个耦合目标。基于此设计 Braco 四步编码器：变换基截断、输入无关的基坐标嵌入、预算相关的正交重参数化、以及来自轻量池化的可学习空间残差 token。
AI.result: 在 23 倍至 64 倍压缩下形成有利的精度-效率前沿，在 144 倍压缩下仍具竞争力；达到 95.2% 准确率，同时相对未压缩上界将 prefill FLOPs 降低 84.2% 至 86.7%。相比先前方法，精度匹配或更优，端到端最高约加速 36%，压缩器延迟/FLOPs 分别降低约 16.6 倍/78.8 倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过 token 参数化视角并显式平衡可压缩性与可学习性，可以在低额外开销下实现有效的极端视觉 token 压缩，获得更优的精度-效率权衡。

title: PEARL: Adaptive Prefill-Decode Execution with Elasticity for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary:
Multi-turn rollout dominates the cost of agentic reinforcement learning (RL). Asynchronous execution and elastic GPU resources can accelerate this stage, but adding rollout replicas yields diminishing returns while training GPUs remain idle between updates. We observe that effective resource use also depends on the prefill--decode (PD) configuration. Both the choice between colocation and disaggregation and the optimal PD ratio vary with the workload, making resource scaling and PD configuration interdependent. Exploiting this opportunity requires selecting effective configurations and realizing their benefits within transient resource-availability windows despite reconfiguration costs.
  We present PEARL, an asynchronous agentic RL system that coordinates external resource elasticity, temporary reuse of idle training GPUs, and adaptive PD execution. PEARL maintains a unified GPU--worker--role state and uses runtime profiles to predict rollout batch completion time, accounting for environment-induced reductions in decode concurrency. It selects the PD mode and ratio under the current GPU budget and translates each decision into an incremental transition plan that minimizes worker and role changes. Cost-aware switching and borrowing policies suppress transitions with insufficient expected benefit while ensuring timely return of training GPUs. Our evaluation show that PEARL achieves $2.17$--$2.79\times$ the throughput of fixed-resource ROLL across different LLMs. Compared with RLBoost+, throughput improves by up to approximately 26.9\% for Qwen3-8B and 36.3\% for Qwen3-30B-A3B.

AI.tldr: PEARL 是一个异步智能体强化学习系统，通过协调外部资源弹性、临时复用空闲训练 GPU 以及自适应预填充-解码（PD）执行，显著提升多轮 rollout 吞吐量。
AI.motivation: 多轮 rollout 主导了智能体 RL 的成本；异步执行与弹性 GPU 虽可加速，但增加 rollout 副本收益递减，且训练 GPU 在更新间空闲。有效资源利用还取决于 PD 配置（同置与分离、最优 PD 比例），且随工作负载变化，使资源扩展与 PD 配置相互依赖。需在瞬态资源窗口内选择有效配置并克服重配置开销。
AI.method: PEARL 维护统一的 GPU-工作器-角色状态，利用运行时画像预测 rollout 批次完成时间（考虑环境导致的解码并发下降）；在当前 GPU 预算下选择 PD 模式与比例，并将决策转化为最小化工作器与角色变更的增量过渡计划；采用成本感知的切换与借用策略，抑制预期收益不足的转换并确保训练 GPU 及时归还。
AI.result: 在不同 LLM 上，PEARL 吞吐量达到固定资源 ROLL 的 2.17–2.79 倍；相比 RLBoost+，Qwen3-8B 吞吐量提升约 26.9%，Qwen3-30B-A3B 提升约 36.3%。
AI.conclusion: PEARL 通过自适应协调资源弹性与 PD 配置，有效提升异步智能体 RL 的 rollout 吞吐量，并优于现有固定资源与基线方法。

title: Evaluating Hierarchy-Aware Deep Learning for the Recognition of Tironian Notes
comment: Accepted at the 2026 ICDAR Workshop on Computational Paleography (IWCP). 25 pages, including supplementary material
summary: Tironian notes are generally regarded as the first Latin shorthand system and are notable for their large, fine-grained symbol inventory. Their high visual similarity and large class set make manual reading time-consuming, leaving manuscripts that contain Tironian notes inaccessible to many researchers. Automatic recognition is also challenging because models must distinguish subtle differences in stroke shape and sign structure while realistic training data remain scarce. However, standard flat classifiers do not explicitly use visual or structural relations between related signs. This paper investigates whether structural relationships between Tironian notes can support automatic recognition. We use the Supertextus Notarum Tironianarum (SNT) by Martin Hellmann, which provides idealized sign forms and a hierarchical organization of Tironian notes. We compare flat ResNet18, ConvNeXt, Shifted Window Transformer (Swin), and Vision Transformer (ViT) classifiers with Hierarchical Deep Convolutional Neural Network (HD-CNN)-style coarse-to-fine models and hierarchy-aware routing models based on visual class cleaning and similarity-based re-clustering. The models are evaluated on handwritten samples and manuscript-domain samples from Vergilius Turonensis, both with and without limited few-shot adaptation to the manuscript domain. The results show that the relative performance of flat and hierarchical models depends on adaptation. On Vergilius Turonensis, HD-CNN achieves the best non-adapted Top-1 result with 45.43%, while flat classification reaches the best Top-1 result after few-shot adaptation with 82.09%. Overall, the results indicate that hierarchical structure can support Tironian note recognition, especially under non-adapted conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文研究能否利用提罗记号（Tironian notes）之间的层级结构关系来提升自动识别效果，并比较了扁平分类器与多种层级/路由模型在手写及手稿域样本上的表现。
AI.motivation: 提罗记号是首个拉丁速记系统，符号数量大、视觉相似度高，人工释读耗时，手稿对研究者难以访问；自动识别也因笔画和结构差异细微、训练数据稀缺而困难，且标准扁平分类器未显式利用相关符号间的视觉或结构关系。
AI.method: 基于 Hellmann 的 Supertextus Notarum Tironianarum（SNT）提供的理想符号形式和层级组织，比较扁平 ResNet18、ConvNeXt、Swin、ViT 分类器与 HD-CNN 式粗到细模型，以及基于视觉类别清洗和相似度重聚类的层级感知路由模型；在手写样本和 Vergilius Turonensis 手稿域样本上评估，并测试是否进行少量小样本域适应。
AI.result: 在 Vergilius Turonensis 上，HD-CNN 取得最佳未适应 Top-1 结果 45.43%；经过小样本适应后，扁平分类取得最佳 Top-1 结果 82.09%。扁平与层级模型的相对表现取决于是否进行域适应。
AI.conclusion: 层级结构能够支持提罗记号识别，尤其在未进行域适应的情况下效果更明显。

title: Beneath the Tokens: A Performance Engineering Study of Multi-Token Prediction in GPU-Accelerated LLM Inference
summary: Autoregressive large language model inference repeatedly invokes the target model to generate one token at a time, making generation sensitive to GPU memory movement and sequential execution. This study evaluates two-token multi-token prediction (MTP) against autoregressive decoding in a controlled single-request deployment on an NVIDIA A10G GPU. A 360-request benchmark covered plain-text, reasoning-intensive, and tool-calling workloads, while runtime telemetry, Nsight Systems, PyTorch Profiler, and selected Nsight Compute measurements were used to explain the observed performance. MTP increased output throughput by \(1.91\times\) to \(2.19\times\) across all prompts and reduced time to first output by 10.0--14.2\%. Median mean acceptance length ranged from 2.370 to 2.595 tokens per verification iteration. Profiling showed that MTP introduced a longer and more complex execution path, including proposal, sampling, attention, gathering, and reduction operations. However, it required 56.4--78.1\% fewer executions of the selected repeating CUDA Graph per generated token. The dominant MTP GEMM kernel was not faster than the dominant autoregressive GEMV kernel, and selected instances of both approached the A10G memory-bandwidth limit. These results show that MTP improved inference through amortization: greater token progress reduced repeated GPU execution sufficiently to outweigh the additional speculative-execution cost.

AI.tldr: 在NVIDIA A10G单请求部署下，评估两token多token预测（MTP）相对自回归解码的性能，并通过多种性能分析工具解释其加速来源。
AI.motivation: 自回归大语言模型推理逐token生成，对GPU内存移动和顺序执行敏感，因此需要研究多token预测能否在受控场景下提升推理效率。
AI.method: 在NVIDIA A10G GPU上进行单请求部署对比两token MTP与自回归解码；使用360个请求的基准测试，覆盖纯文本、推理密集和工具调用负载；结合运行时遥测、Nsight Systems、PyTorch Profiler及部分Nsight Compute测量进行性能归因。
AI.result: MTP将输出吞吐量提升1.91倍至2.19倍，并将首次输出时间降低10.0%至14.2%；每次验证迭代的中位平均接受长度为2.370至2.595个token；每生成token所选重复CUDA Graph执行次数减少56.4%至78.1%。但MTP执行路径更长更复杂，包含提议、采样、注意力、收集和归约操作；其主导GEMM内核并不比自回归主导GEMV内核更快，且两者部分实例均接近A10G内存带宽上限。
AI.conclusion: MTP通过摊销效应提升推理性能：更大的token推进量减少了重复GPU执行次数，其收益足以抵消额外的推测执行成本。

title: AnswerMap: Faithful Spatial Interpretability of VLMs from Answer Posteriors
summary: When a VLM answers a visual query, current interpretability tools rely on text rationales, which use a mismatched modality, or on internal read-outs, which originate too early to reflect the final output and require white-box access to the model. We introduce AnswerMap, a training-free, task-agnostic, black-box visual rationale constructed from the output head. The image is cut into K row and K column bands, each shown alone to the frozen model along with the query in the format of a yes/no relevance question. The outer product of the row and column ``yes'' posteriors gives the query-conditioned spatial map. Crucially, by defining a fixed read-out R (e.g., expectation, maximum) on top of AnswerMap, we can derive continuous outputs like location natively. This bypasses the reliance on discrete text tokens for continuous-output tasks and guarantees an image-dependent answer by construction. However, a rationale can be confabulated, so we validate AnswerMap across four models and three query distributions with two tests: (a) agreement with the model's own generated point and (b) deletion of the map's region. The map lands where the model points (AUC 0.85 against 0.38 for attention), and deleting its region flips 53% of correct answers (against 19% for attention's). Beyond establishing faithfulness, we demonstrate the map's task-agnostic utility through three distinct read-outs: its maximum flags hallucinated objects without generation, its expectation localizes correctly when the model's own pointing fails, and its top-mass region, fed back as a crop, fixes half of the model's wrong answers. AnswerMap thus offers a new lens on VLM interpretability and, through its read-outs, a new output interface for visual tasks beyond text tokens.

AI.tldr: 提出 AnswerMap：一种无需训练、任务无关、黑盒的视觉理由图，从 VLM 输出头构建，既能解释模型，也可作为视觉任务的新输出接口。
AI.motivation: 当前 VLM 可解释性工具依赖文本理由，存在模态不匹配；或依赖内部读数，出现过早且需要白盒访问，不能反映最终输出。
AI.method: 将图像切成 K 个行带和 K 个列带，分别与查询以 yes/no 相关问题输入冻结模型，取行、列 yes 后验的外积得到查询条件空间图；在 AnswerMap 上定义固定 read-out R（如期望、最大值）以直接得到位置等连续输出，避免依赖离散文本 token。用四个模型、三种查询分布，通过两项测试验证：与模型自身生成点的一致性、删除图中区域的影响。
AI.result: AnswerMap 与模型指向一致，AUC 0.85，高于注意力的 0.38；删除其区域使 53% 正确回答翻转，注意力为 19%。三种 read-out 显示：最大值可无生成地标记幻觉物体；期望在模型自身定位失败时仍能正确定位；top-mass 区域作为裁剪反馈可修正一半错误答案。
AI.conclusion: AnswerMap 为 VLM 可解释性提供了新视角，并通过其 read-out 为视觉任务提供了超越文本 token 的新输出接口。

title: Domain-adaptive Zero-Shot Image Enhancement via Locality-Constrained Diffusion Guidance
comment: Accepted manuscript. The final version is published in Computers & Graphics
summary:
Denoising Diffusion Probabilistic Models have shown remarkable performance in unconditional image generation. In order to generate images with desired semantics, recent works have restricted the solution space by using guidance constraints in the diffusion sampling process.
  However, for image enhancement across different domains, these methods struggle to balance two main requirements: looking realistic in the target domain (photorealistic images) and preserving relevant features of the source domain, e.g., low-quality renderings or art paintings. Here, small local changes can alter the fidelity of the image completely, while large changes in other regions might be insignificant.
  We introduce LocDiff, a locality-constrained guidance method for image enhancement, which serves as a zero-shot extension to pre-trained diffusion models, ensuring the preservation of critical features during domain adaptation. In this way, we retain important local features, while allowing less critical regions to remain unconstrained and not interfere with the guidance process for relevant regions. We evaluate our method on two different domain-shift tasks: For art-to-photo translation, we apply the method in a fully zero-shot setting, preserving facial identity from paintings while generating photorealistic details. For enhancing low-quality fetal ultrasound renderings, we demonstrate zero-shot inference with auxiliary prior alignment. Here, the objective is to artificially add high-resolution characteristics and produce photorealistic ultrasound renderings, a target domain for which no ground truth distribution exists. Our experimental results demonstrate that LocDiff achieves favorable realism-faithfulness trade-offs compared to state-of-the-art methods, enabling controllable cross-domain enhancement.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 LocDiff，一种用于图像增强的局部约束引导方法，可零样本扩展预训练扩散模型，在跨域增强中平衡目标域真实感与源域关键特征保留。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型引导方法在图像增强中难以同时满足两个需求：生成目标域中逼真的图像，并保留源域（如低质量渲染图或艺术画）的重要特征。局部小变化可能严重影响保真度，而其他区域大变化可能无关紧要。
AI.method: LocDiff 在扩散采样过程中引入局部性约束引导，作为预训练扩散模型的零样本扩展。它保留关键局部特征，同时不对较不重要区域施加约束，以免干扰相关区域的引导过程。方法在艺术到照片翻译和低质量胎儿超声渲染增强两个域偏移任务上评估，后者还结合辅助先验对齐。
AI.result: 在艺术到照片翻译中，方法在完全零样本设置下保留画作中的人脸身份并生成照片级细节；在胎儿超声增强中，实现零样本推断并加入高分辨率特征，生成逼真超声渲染。实验表明 LocDiff 相比当前最优方法取得更好的真实感-保真度权衡。
AI.conclusion: LocDiff 能实现可控的跨域图像增强，在缺乏目标域真值分布时也能有效保持源域关键特征并提升目标域真实感。

title: From Migration to Calibration: Preserving Agent Capabilities across Models, Jurisdictions, and Scale
comment: 24 pages, 7 figures. Methodological proposal: three-layer agent calibration framework; no empirical results reported
summary: Agents need calibration when deployment conditions change: replacing a driving model, including a foundation-to-post-trained transition; crossing jurisdictions; or scaling across heterogeneous markets and sources. Interface compatibility alone does not establish capability retention or target-contract satisfaction. We formulate agent calibration as constrained behavioral adaptation across three interacting layers: information preservation, harness adaptation, and user acceptance; the layers apply to every scenario, not one-to-one to the three. The basic objective is non-degradation on prespecified capability measures while satisfying target requirements; aggregate improvement is stronger. Information calibration preserves independently validated source content still applicable to the target task. Harness calibration aligns observable artifacts at semantic checkpoints and repairs them through iteration, tool substitution, or local replanning within explicit budgets. User calibration enforces recipient-specific output contracts: templates, schemas, and section-level preferences. A global e-commerce example shows how shared standards coexist with site- and market-specific adapters and validation. We distinguish trainable policies from frozen-backbone configuration or controller optimization, and evidence verification from relative judgment and DPO/GRPO optimization. Recent harness-transfer and judge-validity studies motivate target-native execution records, separate audits of task validity and near-tie ranking, and matched target-native optimization controls. We propose held-out evaluations for model changes, cross-border adaptation, and scale, including a factorial test of source evidence and checkpoint repair and group-level reporting to prevent aggregate gains from masking local failures. This is a methodological proposal; implementation and empirical validation remain future work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种智能体校准的方法论框架，用于部署条件变化时（如模型替换、跨司法管辖区、跨市场扩展）的约束行为适应。校准分为信息保留、执行适配和用户接受三个交互层，目标是在满足目标要求的同时不降低预设能力指标。
AI.motivation: 部署条件变化时，仅靠接口兼容无法保证能力保留或满足目标契约，需要系统化的校准方法来适应新场景。
AI.method: 将智能体校准形式化为跨三个交互层的约束行为适应：信息校准（保留源内容中适用于目标任务的部分）、执行校准（在语义检查点对齐可观察产物并通过迭代、工具替换或局部重规划修复）、用户校准（强制执行接收方特定的输出契约）。通过全球电商示例说明共享标准与本地适配器共存。区分可训练策略与冻结主干配置、证据验证与相对判断，并提出留出评估、因子测试和分组报告。
AI.result: 本文为方法论提案，未进行实现和实证验证。提出了评估方案，包括模型变更、跨境适应和规模化的留出评估，以及源证据和检查点修复的因子测试和分组报告，以防止聚合增益掩盖局部失败。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架旨在为智能体在部署条件变化时提供系统化校准方法，确保能力非退化并满足目标要求。未来工作包括实现和实证验证。

title: FONDANT: Strong and Best-Effort Planning via Antichains
summary: A classical solution concept in fully observable nondeterministic (FOND) planning, is the strong policy (aka winning strategy in the closely related area of reactive synthesis), i.e., such a policy ensures that the goal is reached in an adversarial environment. When strong policies are not available or there is no evidence that the environment is adversarial, one can resort to best-effort policies, which always exist, and which follow the classic decision-theoretic principle that an agent should not use a dominated strategy. A typical positional best-effort policy works as follows: from every state, it follows a strong policy if one exists from that state (such states are called ``strong-winning''), else a weak policy if one exists from that state (``weak-winning''), and else is unconstrained (``losing''). In this work, we introduce a sound and complete planner for both best-effort planning and strong planning. The algorithm that underpins the planner is quite simple: it represents certain sets of states, such as the winning regions, by their $\subseteq$-minimal elements. The algorithm returns uniform policies, i.e., it returns a policy $π_t$ that is a strong solution starting in every strong-winning state, and it returns a policy $π_w$ that is a weak solution starting in every weak-winning state, and it provides a certificate for the set of losing states. We implemented the algorithm with some simple optimizations (calling it FONDANT), and evaluated it on a benchmark set consisting of the instances that were used in the evaluation of leading strong planners PR2 and FOND-SAT, and the best-effort planner BeSyftP. On coverage, our implementation is at least as good on all domains, and outperforms on some domains; and on wall time, it is slower on small and medium-sized instances, and outperforms on larger instances.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个用于FOND规划中best-effort规划和strong规划的可靠且完备的规划器。该规划器用子集极小元素表示获胜区域等状态集合，返回统一策略：在每个strong-winning状态上强解，在每个weak-winning状态上弱解，并为失败状态集提供证书。实现为FONDANT，在多个基准上覆盖表现至少不差甚至更好，大实例上时间表现更优。
AI.motivation: 在完全可观察非确定性规划中，强策略能保证在对抗环境下达成目标，但强策略可能不存在，或环境未必对抗。此时可采用总是存在的best-effort策略，其遵循决策论原则，即智能体不应采用被支配策略。因此需要同时支持best-effort规划和strong规划的可靠且完备规划器。
AI.method: 算法通过状态集合的⊆-极小元素来表示获胜区域等集合；返回统一策略π_t和π_w，分别从所有strong-winning状态给出强解、从所有weak-winning状态给出弱解，并为losing状态集提供证书。作者实现了带简单优化的FONDANT，并在PR2、FOND-SAT和BeSyftP所用基准实例上进行评估。
AI.result: 在覆盖度上，FONDANT在所有领域至少与领先规划器相当，并在部分领域更优；在运行时间上，小型和中型实例上较慢，但在大型实例上表现更优。
AI.conclusion: 该工作给出了一个用于best-effort规划和strong规划的可靠且完备规划器，能够返回统一策略并为失败状态提供证书。尽管实现较简单，但在覆盖度和大型实例效率上具有竞争力。

title: Scaffold Then Internalize: Representation Injection for Diffusion Transformers
summary: Recent representation alignment (REPA) methods accelerate diffusion transformer training by aligning projections of the transformer's hidden states with representations from pretrained visual encoders. In this work, we explore a reverse and complementary direction to REPA: rather than projecting diffusion representations into the encoder's space, we inject encoder representations into the diffusion transformer, allowing them to actively participate in the denoising process. To this end, we introduce \textit{REPresentation Injection} (REPI), a training framework based on a scaffold-to-internalization strategy, in which projected encoder representations initially serve as a temporary scaffold and are then progressively internalized by the diffusion transformer. REPI outperforms REPA across a wide range of backbones and is highly complementary to it: combining the two yields substantial gains over either alone. Notably, with only 160K training steps, REPI + REPA matches vanilla SiT trained for 7M steps, a speedup of over $43.5\times$. Code will be available at https://jeneveuxpas.github.io/REPI

AI.tldr: 本文提出 REPI，一种将预训练视觉编码器表示注入扩散 Transformer 并逐步内化的训练框架，可显著加速扩散 Transformer 训练，且与 REPA 互补。
AI.motivation: 现有 REPA 方法通过将扩散 Transformer 的隐状态投影到预训练视觉编码器表示空间来加速训练；本文探索相反且互补的方向：把编码器表示注入扩散 Transformer，使其主动参与去噪过程。
AI.method: 提出 REPI 训练框架，采用 scaffold-to-internalization 策略：投影后的编码器表示先作为临时脚手架，随后逐步被扩散 Transformer 内化；该方法可与 REPA 结合使用。
AI.result: REPI 在多种 backbone 上优于 REPA，并且与 REPA 高度互补，二者结合比单独使用带来更大提升；仅用 160K 训练步，REPI + REPA 即可达到 vanilla SiT 训练 7M 步的效果，加速超过 43.5 倍。
AI.conclusion: 将编码器表示注入扩散 Transformer 并逐步内化，是加速扩散 Transformer 训练的有效方向，且与 REPA 结合具有显著互补优势。

title: ASCT: Attentive Search over Counterfactual Trees for Credit Assignment in Agentic Reinforcement Learning
summary: Terminal utility evaluates a complete agentic workflow, but learning requires credit for the decisions within it. We introduce Attentive Search over Counterfactual Trees (ASCT), a framework that turns training-time multi-step search into local action credit. At actor-visited states, an auxiliary tree evaluates alternative legal actions from the same recoverable prefix. Its action-value table is centered by the frozen actor's probabilities and supplies credit for PPO on actor-sampled trajectories. This protocol connects counterfactual evaluation to policy learning while deploying the actor alone. Uniform, UCT, and cost-aware AgentUCT instantiate the framework. On HotpotQA agentic retrieval-augmented generation, all three improve mean held-out utility over trajectory-return PPO and workflow-adapted VinePPO. Across three seeds, ASCT-AgentUCT reaches 0.6187 utility versus 0.5939 for VinePPO, with gains in answer F1 and execution cost, and uses 50.3% fewer recorded auxiliary Qwen tokens. Transfer and component-description studies examine the learned policies beyond the training setting.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 ASCT 框架，将训练时的多步搜索转化为动作级信用分配，用于 PPO 学习智能体工作流策略，并在 HotpotQA 的智能体检索增强生成任务上验证其效果。
AI.motivation: 终端效用只能评价完整智能体工作流，但学习过程中需要对工作流内部各个决策进行信用分配，因此需要一种能把反事实评估与策略学习连接起来的方法。
AI.method: ASCT 在 actor 访问过的状态上，用辅助树从同一可恢复前缀评估替代合法动作；通过冻结 actor 概率对动作价值表进行中心化，并为 actor 采样轨迹上的 PPO 提供信用。部署时仅使用 actor，不使用辅助树。Uniform、UCT 和成本感知的 AgentUCT 是该框架的具体实例。
AI.result: 在 HotpotQA 的智能体检索增强生成任务上，三种 ASCT 实例均优于轨迹回报 PPO 和适配工作流的 VinePPO。三次随机种子下，ASCT-AgentUCT 达到 0.6187 效用，VinePPO 为 0.5939；同时在答案 F1 和执行成本上取得提升，并减少 50.3% 记录的辅助 Qwen token 使用量。迁移和组件描述研究进一步考察了训练设置之外学到的策略。
AI.conclusion: ASCT 将反事实评估与策略学习有效连接，在仅部署 actor 的前提下提升了智能体工作流的训练效果，并在多步检索增强生成任务中优于相关基线。

title: Beyond Saying Less: Fine-Grained Alignment for Informative and Faithful Vision-Language Models
summary: Object hallucination remains a major challenge for large vision-language models. While off-policy preference optimization proves to be an effective solution, on-policy reinforcement learning provides a more promising direction as it directly targets a model's current failure modes. However, we find that without fine-grained reward formulation and allocation, on-policy optimization often falls into an easy shortcut: reducing hallucinations merely by saying less---making fewer valid claims. To comprehensively resolve this, we propose a fine-grained alignment framework that couples dense reward signals at the data level with precise credit assignment at the algorithmic level. Specifically, we first construct the Dense Object Presence and Absence (DOPA) dataset to address sparse annotations that prevent valid object claims from being verified and rewarded. DOPA exhaustively annotates the deterministic presence and absence of every concept across an expanded vocabulary, significantly increasing the density of reliable reward signals during on-policy rollouts. Second, we propose Subsentence-level Credit Assignment for on-Policy Optimization (SCAPO) to prevent response-level shared advantages from allowing local hallucinations to compromise all other valid outputs within the same response. By assigning credit to each subsentence independently based on its object claims, SCAPO can precisely reinforce faithful generations and penalize hallucinations. Furthermore, we leverage the resulting faithful image descriptions as auxiliary context to transfer generative gains to discriminative tasks. Experiments demonstrate that our method produces highly informative, faithful descriptions in generative tasks while yielding clear performance gains on discriminative evaluation.

AI.tldr: 该论文针对大型视觉语言模型中的物体幻觉问题，提出一种细粒度对齐框架，结合DOPA数据集与SCAPO算法，在生成任务中产生忠实描述并提升判别任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有on-policy强化学习虽能直接针对模型当前失败模式，但缺乏细粒度奖励与分配，易陷入“少说少错”的捷径，仅通过减少有效声明来降低幻觉。
AI.method: 构建DOPA数据集，对扩展词汇表中每个概念的存在与缺失进行密集标注；提出SCAPO，在子句级别独立分配信用，基于物体声明进行奖励，精确强化忠实生成、惩罚幻觉；并将忠实图像描述作为辅助上下文迁移到判别任务。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法在生成任务中产生信息丰富且忠实的描述，并在判别评估中取得明显性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度对齐框架能有效解决物体幻觉，通过密集奖励和子句级信用分配避免捷径，并实现生成到判别任务的迁移。

title: EP-Mem: Elastic Privacy Memory for Social Relationship-Aware LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents face critical privacy risks when acting as delegates in human-agent-human communication. To prevent such breaches, agents must understand users' social relationships and adhere to context-dependent social information disclosure boundaries. Current studies on agent memory privacy focus on instantaneous interactions, leaving the long-term relational disclosure problem unexplored. In this paper, we propose EP-Mem, an Elastic Privacy Memory architecture that reframes privacy as user-owned boundary control across social roles. EP-Mem introduces (1) token-level memory driven by user-configurable a privacy policy that stratifies persons and events, combining domain-level default circulation rules with fact-level whitelist/blacklist exceptions; and (2) a pluggable sidecar with a privacy engine that aligns disclosure controls with memory across summary, detail, and boundary granularities, enforced throughout generation, storage, and retrieval. We construct EP-Bench, to our knowledge the first long-term multi-party benchmark with cross-session correlated events for policy-conditioned relational disclosure. Experiments show that EP-Mem achieves 94.0% privacy classification accuracy, improves disclosure-permission judgment from 22% to 68%, and reduces privacy leakage by 75.6%, while maintaining retrieval performance and cross-benchmark generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EP-Mem，一种弹性隐私记忆架构，用于LLM智能体在长期人际沟通中控制社会关系相关的信息披露边界。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体作为代理面临隐私风险，需理解用户社会关系并遵循上下文相关的信息披露边界；现有研究局限于即时交互，未探索长期关系披露问题。
AI.method: EP-Mem包含：(1) 基于用户可配置隐私策略的token级记忆，对人物和事件分层，结合领域级默认流通规则与事实级白名单/黑名单例外；(2) 可插拔边车隐私引擎，在摘要、细节、边界粒度对齐披露控制，并在生成、存储、检索中强制执行。同时构建EP-Bench长期多方基准，含跨会话相关事件。
AI.result: EP-Mem达到94.0%隐私分类准确率，将披露许可判断从22%提升至68%，减少75.6%隐私泄露，同时保持检索性能和跨基准泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: EP-Mem能有效管理长期关系信息披露，在保持检索性能与泛化性的同时显著降低隐私泄露。

title: Towards Reliable AI Data Scientists: Data Agents with Workflow Harnesses
summary: Large language model agents are increasingly deployed for data-intensive work, yet reliable data analysis requires more than general-purpose reasoning and ad hoc tool augmentation. Data Agents, equipped with workflow harnesses, offer a promising paradigm for automating the end-to-end data science lifecycle. This paper examines Data Agents from a harness-centric perspective. First, we introduce a taxonomy of Data Agents and associated data environments, organizing the literature around five functional stages: perception, planning, execution, verification, and repair. Second, we analyze the key technical routes within each stage, identifying 15 distinct approaches ranging from data structure probing to data state reconstruction. Third, we identify four open reliability problems: inactive semantic calibration, missing clarification, missing experience transfer, and the missing verification-repair repository. These problems explain why silent failures can persist even when individual components function correctly, highlighting the need for rigorous workflow harnesses and shared reliability resources. Finally, we summarize the horizontal task families of Data Agents, examine their vertical application settings, and benchmarks for evaluation, while maintaining a companion repository at https://github.com/DEEP-PolyU/Awesome-Data-Agents.

AI.tldr: 本文从工作流执行框架（harness）视角系统综述数据智能体（Data Agents），提出分类体系、技术路线、可靠性问题与应用/评测总结，并维护配套资源库。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型智能体越来越多用于数据密集型工作，但可靠的数据分析不仅需要通用推理和临时工具增强，还需要面向端到端数据科学生命周期的系统化工作流支持。
AI.method: 从harness中心视角出发，构建数据智能体及数据环境的分类法，按感知、规划、执行、验证、修复五个功能阶段组织文献；分析各阶段关键技术路线，归纳15种方法；识别四个开放可靠性问题；总结横向任务族、纵向应用场景与评测基准，并提供配套GitHub仓库。
AI.result: 提出五阶段分类体系和15种技术路线；指出四个可靠性问题：非活跃语义校准、缺失澄清、缺失经验迁移、缺失验证-修复资源库；说明即使组件正常，静默失败仍可能持续存在。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的数据智能体需要严格的工作流执行框架和共享的可靠性资源，以支撑端到端数据科学自动化并减少静默失败。

title: Generative Uncertainty as a Self-supervised Signal for Semantic Similarity Learning
summary: Evaluating semantic similarity between videos is a fundamental challenge in computer vision, essential for tasks ranging from out-of-distribution (OOD) detection to video retrieval. However, defining and labeling video similarity is notoriously difficult and expensive due to the complex spatio-temporal nature. In this paper, we propose a novel self-supervised approach that leverages generative uncertainty from text-to-video (T2V) diffusion models to learn semantic similarity without human annotations. Our method is based on the observation that T2V models produce consistent outputs for familiar concepts but exhibit high variance and uncertainty when prompted with specialized concepts. We utilize this behavior to identify stable semantic features within existing pretrained representations, such as VideoMAE and V-JEPA. Specifically, we learn a mask over these embeddings using purely generated data, encouraging the model to retain features that remain consistent across generations of general concepts while discarding those associated with generative noise or uncertainty. Experimental results across three key tasks demonstrate that our learned feature subspaces consistently outperform original pretrained features and baseline feature selection methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种自监督方法，利用文本到视频扩散模型的生成不确定性，从预训练视频表示中学习语义相似性特征子空间，无需人工标注。
AI.motivation: 视频语义相似性评估在OOD检测、视频检索等任务中很重要，但视频的复杂时空特性使相似性定义和标注非常困难且昂贵。
AI.method: 基于T2V扩散模型对熟悉概念输出一致、对专门概念输出高方差和不确定的观察，在VideoMAE、V-JEPA等预训练表示上学习掩码，仅用生成数据训练，保留跨生成稳定的一般概念特征，丢弃与生成噪声或不确定性相关的特征。
AI.result: 在三个关键任务上，学习到的特征子空间持续优于原始预训练特征和基线特征选择方法。
AI.conclusion: 利用T2V扩散模型的生成不确定性可以无标注地学习视频语义相似性，并有效提升下游任务中的特征表示。

title: PIVOT: Pivot-Aware On Policy Self Distillation for Multi-Turn VLM Agents
comment: 11 pages for the main paper, 20 pages for the supplementary
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) via Group-Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) is widely used for multi-turn VLM agent training, yet it suffers from zero-gradient silence on uniform failures and coarse episode-level credit assignment. While On-Policy Distillation (OPD) and On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) mitigate sparse rewards using hindsight information, their underlying mechanisms remain poorly understood. Through controlled counterfactual rollback probes across five multi-turn VLM agent benchmarks, we reveal that performance gains in OPSD/OPD are largely driven by physical state rollback at the pivot step, defined as the first unrecoverable action without remaining step budget. However, physical state rollbacks are computationally prohibitive and infeasible in real-world environments. To bridge this gap, we present Pivot-Aware Internalized Visual On-Policy Training (PIVOT), an RL framework that internalizes pivot localization and state restoration directly into token-level parameter updates, eliminating environment rollbacks during RL training and additional skill hints at test time. PIVOT unifies three functional roles within a single architecture: a failure Analyzer non-invasively localizes the pivot step and diagnoses failure modes from visual trajectory collages and action logs; a detached Teacher re-scores failed tokens under this privileged diagnostic context; and a Student optimizes joint GRPO and confidence-gated OPD objectives. At test time, both Teacher and Analyzer branches are stripped. Evaluated on five multi-turn VLM agent tasks across cognitive grid puzzles, 3D embodied control and navigation, and generative reasoning, PIVOT achieves 0.90 overall accuracy on Qwen2.5-VL-3B (+8% over SFT+GRPO baseline and +5% over previous SOTA) and scales to 0.92 on Qwen3-VL-2B (+12% over SFT+GRPO baseline).

AI.tldr: 论文研究多轮VLM智能体强化学习中的稀疏奖励与信用分配问题，发现OPSD/OPD等方法的收益主要来自“枢轴步”的物理状态回滚，并提出PIVOT框架，将枢轴定位与状态恢复内化为token级参数更新，无需环境回滚和测试时额外提示。
AI.motivation: 基于GRPO的可验证奖励强化学习广泛用于多轮VLM智能体训练，但存在失败样本上零梯度静默和粗粒度回合级信用分配问题；现有OPSD/OPD虽利用后见信息缓解稀疏奖励，其机制尚不清晰，且依赖物理状态回滚，计算代价高且现实环境不可行。
AI.method: 通过五个多轮VLM智能体基准上的受控反事实回滚探针，识别性能提升主要源于枢轴步的物理状态回滚；提出PIVOT框架，在单一架构中统一三个角色：Analyzer从视觉轨迹拼贴和动作日志中非侵入式定位枢轴步并诊断失败模式，detached Teacher在特权诊断上下文下重新评分失败token，Student联合优化GRPO和置信度门控OPD目标；测试时移除Teacher和Analyzer分支。
AI.result: 在认知网格谜题、3D具身控制与导航、生成式推理等五类多轮VLM智能体任务上，PIVOT在Qwen2.5-VL-3B上达到0.90总体准确率，较SFT+GRPO基线提升8%，较此前SOTA提升5%；在Qwen3-VL-2B上达到0.92，较SFT+GRPO基线提升12%。
AI.conclusion: OPSD/OPD的增益主要来自枢轴步状态回滚，但PIVOT证明无需实际环境回滚也能将枢轴感知和状态恢复内化到策略更新中，从而有效提升多轮VLM智能体训练效果与可扩展性。

title: Textual User Taste: Natural-Language User Context for Foundation-Model Recommender System at Scale
summary: Foundation model recommender systems require user context that can be consumed by large language models, reasoned over, and refined through natural-language interaction. Traditional behavioral embedding vectors remain highly effective for retrieval and ranking, but they are opaque to users and not natively expressed for language model workflows. We present Textual User Taste, a system that generates structured natural-language taste profiles from listening behavior, interaction signals, content metadata, and optional user feedback, and deploys them to millions of Spotify users. We describe the end-to-end production lifecycle required to generate, evaluate, optimize, and maintain these representations at industrial scale, including prompt development and compression, user steering, and integration with downstream personalization systems. Because no unique ground-truth taste profile exists, we introduce a multi-faceted evaluation framework to evaluate taste profiles as a production representation: they carry user-specific predictive signal independently, and when integrated with behavioral embeddings, improve MRR by 0.6% for future-track prediction and NDCG@7 by 2.2% for search ranking. Our evaluation also reveals that taste profiles support positive natural-language steering, while exposing important limitations, including challenges with negation and short-term temporal adaptation. These findings position taste profiles not as replacements for behavioral embeddings, but as an interpretable and steerable interface between evolving user context and foundation-model recommender systems.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Textual User Taste 系统，将用户听歌行为、交互信号、内容元数据和可选反馈生成结构化自然语言品味画像，并部署到数百万 Spotify 用户，用于基础模型推荐系统。
AI.motivation: 基础模型推荐系统需要可被大语言模型消费、推理并通过自然语言交互优化的用户上下文。传统行为嵌入向量虽在检索和排序中有效，但对用户不透明，且不天然适配语言模型工作流。
AI.method: 从倾听行为、交互信号、内容元数据和用户反馈生成结构化自然语言品味画像；构建覆盖生成、评估、优化和维护的端到端生产生命周期，包括提示开发与压缩、用户引导，以及与下游个性化系统集成；由于没有唯一真实品味画像，提出多维度评估框架，验证其独立预测信号及与行为嵌入结合的效果。
AI.result: 品味画像可独立携带用户特定预测信号；与行为嵌入结合后，未来曲目预测 MRR 提升 0.6%，搜索排序 NDCG@7 提升 2.2%。评估还发现其支持正向自然语言引导，但在否定表达和短期时间适应方面存在局限。
AI.conclusion: 品味画像并非替代行为嵌入，而是演化用户上下文与基础模型推荐系统之间可解释、可引导的接口。

title: Ego-Forge: Text and Geometric-Attention Free Exo-to-Egocentric Video Generation
summary: Exo-to-egocentric video generation aims to synthesize what a person sees from their own viewpoint given third-person footage and a target head trajectory. The task requires transferring appearance and semantics across large viewpoint changes while hallucinating content never observed by the exocentric camera. Existing approaches either impose additional input requirements, such as a ground-truth initial egocentric frame or multiple synchronized exocentric views, or remain limited to category-specific settings. EgoX is the first to address cross-activity and in-the-wild generalization, but requires a human-provided caption of the non-existent egocentric view at inference and introduces a computationally expensive geometry-guided attention bias that can propagate reconstruction errors and suppress textual and visual context. We therefore propose \textbf{Ego-Forge}, a caption-free and bias-free framework for exo-to-egocentric generation. It introduces \textit{Dynamic Captioning}, which derives conditioning tokens directly from the model's hidden states and adapts them to the diffusion timestep and network depth, replacing external text conditioning. By scaling training by an order of magnitude and using all available exocentric viewpoints, Ego-Forge learns cross-view correspondence implicitly and eliminates the need for geometry-guided attention, requiring only a lightweight depth prior. Ego-Forge achieves state-of-the-art performance on Ego-Exo4D, runs faster end-to-end, requires no external annotation at inference, and generalizes to in-the-wild scenes, including cases where over-reliance on geometry blocks appearance inference. Our model and source code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出 Ego-Forge，一个无需人工描述、无需几何引导注意力偏置的 exo-to-egocentric 视频生成框架，可从第三人称视频和目标头部轨迹生成第一人称视角视频。
AI.motivation: 现有方法通常需要额外输入（如真实初始第一人称帧或多视角同步视频），或局限于特定类别；EgoX 虽支持跨活动与野外场景，但推理时依赖人工提供的目标第一人称描述，且几何引导注意力计算昂贵、易传播重建误差并抑制文本与视觉上下文。
AI.method: Ego-Forge 引入 Dynamic Captioning，从模型隐藏状态直接生成条件 token，并适配扩散时间步和网络深度，取代外部文本条件；通过扩大训练规模一个数量级并利用所有可用第三人称视角，隐式学习跨视角对应关系，去除几何引导注意力，仅需轻量深度先验。
AI.result: 在 Ego-Exo4D 上达到最先进性能，端到端运行更快，推理无需外部标注，并可泛化到野外场景，包括过度依赖几何导致外观推断受阻的情况。
AI.conclusion: Ego-Forge 实现了无描述、无几何偏置的 exo-to-egocentric 生成，提升了泛化性与效率；模型和源代码将公开发布。

title: Rethinking Visual Token Compression for Video Large Language Models: A Simple Yet Strong Baseline
summary: Video Large Language Models (Video LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding, but their inference efficiency is constrained by the large number of visual tokens produced by long videos. Recent video token compression methods increasingly introduce sophisticated strategies for token selection, pruning, and merging. This raises a fundamental question: how much of compression performance can be obtained by simply preserving the structure encoded in the visual representations? We investigate this question with SimpleCluster, a simple and training-free baseline that performs position-aware cross-frame clustering in the visual feature space and represents each cluster using the mean of its original visual features. Extensive experiments across four video understanding benchmarks and three representative Video LLMs show that SimpleCluster achieves competitive or superior performance over recent compression methods across a wide range of token retention ratios, with particularly strong robustness under extremely low retention rates (e.g., 1%). To understand this behavior, we analyze the feature space preserved by different compression methods in terms of local approximation fidelity and global coverage. The results show that stronger downstream performance is consistently associated with better preservation of the original visual feature distribution, especially its global coverage. These findings highlight feature-space preservation as an important consideration for video token compression under highly constrained token budgets. Our code is available at https://github.com/xiaozhang79/SimpleCluster.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SimpleCluster，一种免训练、位置感知的跨帧聚类视频 token 压缩基线。它在多个视频理解基准和 Video LLM 上取得有竞争力或更优的性能，并在极低 token 保留率下表现鲁棒。
AI.motivation: 视频大语言模型在视频理解上进展显著，但长视频产生大量视觉 token，导致推理效率受限。现有视频 token 压缩方法日益复杂，因此作者想探究：仅保留视觉表示中编码的结构，能获得多少压缩性能。
AI.method: SimpleCluster 在视觉特征空间中进行位置感知的跨帧聚类，并用每个簇原始视觉特征的均值表示该簇，整个过程免训练。作者还从局部近似保真度和全局覆盖两个角度分析不同压缩方法所保留的特征空间。
AI.result: 在四个视频理解基准和三个代表性 Video LLM 上的实验表明，SimpleCluster 在多种 token 保留率下达到与近期压缩方法相当或更优的性能，尤其在极低保留率（如 1%）下鲁棒性突出。分析显示，更强的下游性能与更好保留原始视觉特征分布，特别是全局覆盖， consistently 相关。
AI.conclusion: 在高度受限的 token 预算下，特征空间保留是视频 token 压缩的重要考虑因素；简单保留视觉结构即可作为强基线，并提示未来方法应重视原始视觉特征分布的保持。

title: Imprint Reader: From Weight-Update Readout to Behavioral Intervention
summary: As language models take a growing role in AI development, a natural aspiration is for them to reflect on their own learning process, as humans do, and use that reflection to improve themselves. At the same time, these models have an advantage that human learners lack, since training leaves parameter-level traces that can, in principle, be inspected directly. However, current models cannot decode these traces into an explicit account of what they have learned. To this end, we introduce the \textit{Imprint Reader}, a model trained with \textit{Semantic Mount-and-Read Tuning} (SaRT) to describe frozen weight updates. SMaRT mounts each update onto the Reader and uses an anchor-free meta-query to elicit a natural-language description, while no-change and random-perturbation controls discourage unsupported claims. On held-out updates, the joint Reader reaches judge-based Pass@100 of $2\%$ for knowledge and $16\%$ for behavior. These results demonstrate the feasibility of natural-language readout while pointing to reliability across updates as the next step. Beyond free-form generation, the Reader provides a differentiable proxy for the gap between a specified target behavior and a candidate weight update. Its coordinate-aligned gradients support intervention through MetaEdit. At a $0.5\%$ pruning rate, Reader-guided selection raises measured harmful-prompt refusal from $57.9\%$ to $64.1\%$ under a safety-maintenance target. Using behavior descriptions without target-task training data, MetaEdit increases the frequency of backtracking and sub-goal expressions in mathematical reasoning traces and raises BFCL Overall from $41.69\%$ to $44.60\%$.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 Imprint Reader，用 Semantic Mount-and-Read Tuning 训练模型以自然语言描述冻结的权重更新，并进一步将 Reader 作为可微代理，通过 MetaEdit 指导权重干预与选择。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型在 AI 发展中作用增强，人们希望模型能像人类一样反思自身学习过程并自我改进；训练虽留下参数级痕迹，但当前模型无法将这些痕迹解码为明确的学习内容说明。
AI.method: 提出 Imprint Reader，并采用 Semantic Mount-and-Read Tuning（SaRT/SMaRT）：将每个更新挂载到 Reader 上，用无锚点元查询引出自然语言描述，同时用无变化和随机扰动控制抑制无依据声明；还将 Reader 用作目标行为与候选权重更新之间差距的可微代理，其坐标对齐梯度支持 MetaEdit 干预。
AI.result: 在留出更新上，联合 Reader 在知识类达到基于评审的 Pass@100 为 2%，行为类为 16%；在 0.5% 剪枝率下，Reader 引导选择在安全维持目标下将有害提示拒绝率从 57.9% 提升到 64.1%；仅使用行为描述、无需目标任务训练数据时，MetaEdit 增加数学推理轨迹中的回溯和子目标表达，并将 BFCL Overall 从 41.69% 提升到 44.60%。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明自然语言读出权重更新具有可行性，但跨更新的可靠性仍是下一步关键；Reader 还可作为可微代理支持权重干预与行为调控。

title: Reduce, Then Encode: Multiscale Volumetric Reduction for 2D Foundation Models in Brain MRI
summary: Pretrained 2D foundation models offer a practical alternative to dedicated 3D pretraining for brain structural magnetic resonance imaging (sMRI), but their use on volumetric data requires bridging the mismatch between a 2D encoder and a 3D volume input. Existing methods typically encode slices independently and integrate their features afterwards. We introduce Multiscale Volumetric Reduction (MVR), a reduce-then-encode approach that compresses each anatomical view from (D) slices into (M << D) complementary 2D components before foundation-model encoding. MVR combines an uncentered-PCA base component derived from the original through-plane intensities with residual detail components constructed from multiscale spatial descriptors. The reduction is estimated from the training volumes without diagnostic labels or gradient-based optimization and remains fixed thereafter. The resulting components are independently processed by a shared frozen 2D foundation model and concatenated for linear probing. Under this frozen-encoder setting, MVR achieves strong overall performance across ADNI, OASIS, and ABIDE relative to the evaluated 2D-to-3D adaptation methods and simple input-reduction baselines, while also generalizing strongly from ADNI to AIBL.

AI.tldr: 提出多尺度体积降维（MVR）方法，将3D脑部sMRI的每个解剖视图从D层切片压缩为M个互补2D成分，再送入冻结的2D基础模型进行线性探测。
AI.motivation: 预训练2D基础模型可用于脑部sMRI，但2D编码器与3D体积输入之间存在维度不匹配，现有方法通常独立编码切片后再融合特征。
AI.method: MVR采用先降维再编码策略：用无中心PCA从原始穿平面强度得到基础成分，并用多尺度空间描述子构建残差细节成分；降维基于训练体积估计，无需诊断标签或梯度优化，之后固定；各成分由共享冻结2D基础模型独立处理并拼接用于线性探测。
AI.result: 在冻结编码器设置下，MVR在ADNI、OASIS和ABIDE上相对所评估的2D到3D自适应方法及简单输入降维基线取得较强总体性能，并从ADNI到AIBL具有较强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: MVR能有效弥合2D基础模型与3D sMRI体积输入之间的差距，在不微调编码器的情况下实现有竞争力的脑结构MRI分析性能与跨数据集泛化。

title: Spectral Super-Resolution using Spatial-Spectral Residual Operator Networks
comment: IEEE International Geoscience and Remote Sensing Symposium (IGARSS) 2026
summary: Spectral super-resolution of multispectral satellite images can enable high temporal- and spatial-resolution hyperspectral satellite imagery at a modest cost, significantly increasing the applicability of hyperspectral remote sensing. This task is inherently ill-posed, making it well-suited for deep learning-based methods. In this study, the spectral super-resolution task is framed as an operator learning problem, and SSRON is proposed as a Deep Operator Network that effectively learns function-to-function mappings from downsampled spectra to continuous spectra. The model is trained to super-resolve Sentinel-2A-like multispectral imagery to EMIT images. Compared to baseline models, SSRON achieves superior performance across all metrics. The model also demonstrates zero-shot spectral super-resolution capability by predicting bands unseen during training. Furthermore, its continuous-output formulation suggests the potential to estimate spectra at finer wavelength intervals than the native sensor. These results suggest the potential of SSRON and establishes operator learning as a promising direction for spectral super-resolution.

AI.tldr: 该研究将多光谱卫星图像的光谱超分辨率视为算子学习问题，提出SSRON（深度算子网络），可学习从降采样光谱到连续光谱的函数到函数映射，并能将Sentinel-2A类多光谱影像超分辨为EMIT高光谱影像。
AI.motivation: 光谱超分辨率能以较低成本实现高时空分辨率的高光谱卫星影像，显著拓展高光谱遥感应用；但该任务本身不适定，适合深度学习方法，因此作者探索将算子学习用于该任务。
AI.method: 提出SSRON，一种深度算子网络，将光谱超分辨率建模为算子学习问题，学习从降采样光谱到连续光谱的函数到函数映射；模型在Sentinel-2A类多光谱影像到EMIT影像的任务上进行训练。
AI.result: SSRON在所有指标上均优于基线模型；具备零样本光谱超分辨率能力，可预测训练中未见过的波段；其连续输出形式还表明有潜力估计比原生传感器更细波长间隔的光谱。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明SSRON具有应用潜力，并确立了算子学习作为光谱超分辨率一个有前景的研究方向。

title: AbGaze: Attentive Geometric Representation Learning for End-to-End Antibody Design
summary: Computational antibody design requires representations that capture the geometric patterns underlying antigen--antibody interactions, yet existing approaches often rely on scalar distances or surface-intrinsic features, leaving cross-molecular geometry largely implicit. We present AbGaze, an end-to-end antibody design framework based on attentive geometric representation learning, which encodes distance, spatial direction, and surface-normal orientation of antigen surfaces relative to antibody-residue local frames, and adaptively aggregates these geometric interactions according to their interfacial context. The learned interaction representation is shared across multi-CDR co-design, complex structure prediction, and affinity optimization, with local-frame geometric supervision further constraining the representation. AbGaze outperforms prior methods across all three tasks: relative to the second-best method, it improves amino-acid recovery by 7.1% and reduces structural error by 14.9% on average over the six CDRs, improves interface docking quality (DockQ) by 6.6%, and raises the affinity improvement rate (IMP) by 32.5%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AbGaze，一种基于注意力几何表示学习的端到端抗体设计框架，通过显式编码抗原表面与抗体残基局部坐标系之间的距离、方向和表面法向朝向，并在多个抗体设计任务中共享学习到的相互作用表示。
AI.motivation: 现有计算抗体设计方法多依赖标量距离或表面内在特征，未能充分捕捉抗原-抗体相互作用背后的几何模式，导致跨分子几何信息大多隐式表达。
AI.method: AbGaze采用端到端抗体设计框架和注意力几何表示学习：编码距离、空间方向以及抗原表面相对抗体残基局部坐标系的表面法向朝向；根据界面上下文自适应聚合几何相互作用；学习到的交互表示共享用于多CDR联合设计、复合物结构预测和亲和力优化，并通过局部坐标系几何监督约束表示。
AI.result: AbGaze在三个任务上均优于先前方法：相比第二优方法，六个CDR上的氨基酸恢复率平均提高7.1%，结构误差平均降低14.9%；界面对接质量DockQ提高6.6%；亲和力提升率IMP提高32.5%。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模跨分子几何关系并结合注意力聚合，可有效提升抗体多CDR设计、复合物结构预测和亲和力优化性能，表明几何表示学习对抗体设计具有重要价值。

title: BiMoGen: Bidirectional Motion-Text Generation via Unified Masked Discrete Diffusion
summary: Text-to-motion generation and motion-to-text captioning are two fundamental tasks in human motion modeling, both grounded in the same underlying motion-text correspondence. Existing unified approaches mostly rely on autoregressive modeling, which imposes a fixed generation order and is therefore poorly suited to the bidirectional dependencies between language and motion, allowing early prediction errors to persist as fixed context and degrade both temporal coherence and cross-modal consistency. Masked discrete diffusion, which models sequences through iterative bidirectional prediction, offers a natural remedy. We therefore propose BiMoGen (Bidirectional Motion-text Generation), a unified masked discrete diffusion framework for bidirectional motion-text modeling. To stabilize training, we design Decoupled Uni- and Cross-Modal Training, in which masked pretraining first establishes cross-modal correspondence on paired motion-text sequences, after which supervised fine-tuning specializes the model for bidirectional generation. Masked diffusion nonetheless introduces its own source of error, as the model is trained on clean ground-truth context yet encounters self-generated and potentially erroneous context at inference, with errors committed under heavily masked states propagating through subsequent steps. We further introduce Generation-Aware Self-Correction that exposes the model to its own predictions during training and applies correction passes at early sampling steps to revise unreliably committed tokens. Extensive experiments on HumanML3D and KIT-ML demonstrate competitive performance on both tasks, validating the effectiveness of the proposed two-stage training and self-correction designs. The project page is available at https://wengwanjiang.github.io/BiMoGen-Page.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BiMoGen，一个基于掩码离散扩散的统一双向运动-文本生成框架，可同时用于文本到动作生成和动作到文本描述。
AI.motivation: 现有统一方法多依赖自回归建模，固定生成顺序难以适应语言与动作之间的双向依赖，早期错误会作为固定上下文持续存在，损害时序连贯性和跨模态一致性。掩码离散扩散通过迭代双向预测建模序列，可自然解决该问题。
AI.method: 提出BiMoGen统一掩码离散扩散框架；设计解耦的单模态与跨模态训练：先掩码预训练建立跨模态对应，再监督微调专用于双向生成；引入生成感知自校正，训练时暴露模型自身预测，并在早期采样步骤进行校正以修正不可靠的token。
AI.result: 在HumanML3D和KIT-ML上实验，两个任务均取得有竞争力的性能，验证了两阶段训练和自校正设计的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 掩码离散扩散结合两阶段训练和自校正设计，可有效实现双向运动-文本建模，为统一的生成与描述任务提供可行方案。

title: Narrowing the Horizon: Quantifying Topic Saliency Shifts in Generative Monoculture
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become central to how we access and share information, they play an increasingly powerful role in shaping global knowledge. However, as these models evolve, their outputs risk converging into a \textit{generative monoculture}, where the diversity of perspectives they represent narrows over time. Studies at the model level often fail to pinpoint which specific topics or viewpoints are being marginalised or amplified in this process. In this paper, we introduce a method to measure shifts in topic saliency across model families, tracking what gains or loses prominence during post-training. Applying this approach to a case study of climate change discourse, we demonstrate how homogenisation affects the representation of diverse solutions across different models. We also test interventions to counter this trend, showing that specialised models can help preserve a broader range of perspectives. This underscores the importance of monitoring topic saliency to diagnose the risks of monoculture and to ensure AI systems reflect a pluralism of ideas. Data and Code are accessible \href{https://github.com/oriane/topic_saliency_shift}{here}.

AI.tldr: 论文关注大语言模型输出可能趋同的“生成单一文化”问题，提出一种测量模型家族后训练中主题显著性变化的方法，并以气候变化话语为案例，展示同质化对多元观点呈现的影响及干预效果。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型在信息获取与分享中日益核心，其输出可能逐渐收敛为单一文化，导致观点多样性收窄；而现有模型层面研究常难以定位哪些主题或视角被边缘化或放大。
AI.method: 提出测量跨模型家族主题显著性偏移的方法，追踪后训练阶段哪些主题获得或失去突出地位；以气候变化话语为案例研究，并测试干预措施，如使用专用模型来对抗同质化趋势。
AI.result: 案例展示同质化会影响不同模型对多元解决方案的表征；专用模型有助于保留更广泛的观点和视角。
AI.conclusion: 监测主题显著性对于诊断单一文化风险、确保AI系统反映思想多元性至关重要；数据与代码已公开。

title: The Argument and the Letterhead: Source-Position Coherence in AI Evaluation
comment: 28 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Preregistrations, materials and code available on GitHub. Preprint; not yet peer reviewed
summary: An argument can be surprising coming from a particular speaker without being a bad argument. Do AI evaluators keep these judgments apart? Two preregistered descriptive studies and a later Jev supplement collected 2,976 usable evaluations of six fixed texts about US AI policy, Germany's debt brake and Swiss nuclear energy. Each text was presented under several source attributions. The key comparison asks whether the gap between two sources changes when the argument changes. On Sol, for example, a national-security argument received mean ratings of 0.359 under CODEPINK and 0.639 under College Republicans; a civil-rights argument received 0.742 and 0.721. A constant preference for one source cannot explain that pattern. Related interactions appeared across topics and recent model configurations, including those with reasoning enabled, while several comparisons yielded small effects. The later European Jev supplement yielded five interactions below the adopted absolute reference of 0.05; its distinct rubric and interrupted collection limit comparison with the chat systems. Some written evaluations explicitly invoked a mismatch between a source and its attributed position. Taken together, the numerical and verbal evidence supports source-position coherence as a plausible explanation, alongside competing accounts involving credibility, authenticity and interpretation of the task. The paper develops this inference through controlled comparisons, reports conditional post hoc p-values in an appendix, and documents the human decisions and delegated checks behind an AI-conducted study.

AI.tldr: 该研究考察AI评估者能否区分“论证令人意外”与“论证质量差”，发现对同一论证的评价会随署名来源变化，且来源与立场的一致性可解释这种模式。
AI.motivation: 作者关心AI评估者是否会因演讲者或来源不同而改变对论证的判断，以及是否会把来源与立场不匹配误判为论证质量差；已有评估可能混淆来源偏好与论证内容。
AI.method: 两项预注册描述性研究和后续Jev补充研究，共收集2,976份可用评估；六篇固定文本涉及美国AI政策、德国债务刹车、瑞士核能，每篇在多个来源署名下呈现；关键是比较来源间评分差距是否随论证内容变化；涵盖近期模型配置（含开启推理），并附录报告条件事后p值，记录AI主导研究中的人类决策与委托检查。
AI.result: 出现显著交互：例如Sol上国家安全论证在CODEPINK下均分0.359、在College Republicans下0.639，而民权论证为0.742和0.721，说明恒定来源偏好无法解释；多主题和模型配置中也见相关交互，部分效应较小。Jev补充研究采用不同评分标准且收集中断，得到五个低于0.05绝对参考的交互，限制与聊天系统比较；部分文字评估明确提到来源与归属立场不匹配。
AI.conclusion: 数值与文字证据共同支持“来源—立场一致性”作为合理解释，但也存在可信度、真实性和任务解释等竞争性解释；论文通过受控比较推进该推断，并公开事后p值及人类决策流程。

title: When Should the Count Change? Learning State Maintenance for Causal Video Counting
summary: Continuous video counting requires distinguishing new observations from new objects or completed events. We introduce StaMina (State Maintenance), which learns to maintain counting state through state-conditioned updates. Recurrent visual context supports recognition; learned transitions maintain visibility, persistent identities, and completed-event records. A differentiable recurrence trains event transitions over legal paths constrained by count endpoints; visibility and association objectives train the object branch. A multi-source pipeline organizes 39.8K spatial queries and complementary event annotations into counting trajectories. On SVCBench, we evaluate counting adaptation with partial video overlap and held-out groups of linked annotations. Under prefix replay (Full) and persistent streaming (Stream), 4B and 8B models reach 41.9/36.4 and 44.9/38.2 Gaussian Precision Accuracy, respectively. The 8B model gains 10.9/3.2 points over Counting-SFT on the same queries. Matched-graph comparisons isolate phase conditioning and trajectory supervision, assessing training objectives alongside hard decisions. Online video benchmarks and count-conditioned decisions assess online understanding and task eligibility. Project Page: https://PLACEHOLDER.github.io/StaMina/

AI.tldr: 论文提出 StaMina（状态维护）框架，用于连续视频计数：通过状态条件化更新来维护计数状态，用循环视觉上下文辅助识别，用可学习的状态转移维护可见性、持久身份与已完成事件记录，并构建了含 39.8K 空间查询的多源计数轨迹数据 pipeline。
AI.motivation: 连续视频计数需要在流式观测中区分「新观测」与「新物体/已完成事件」，即模型必须持续维护并更新计数状态，而现有方法缺乏对状态维持、身份持久性和事件完成记录的显式建模与监督。
AI.method: 1) 状态条件化更新 + 循环视觉上下文：转移负责可见性、持久身份与完成事件记录；2) 可微循环结构，在由计数端点约束的合法路径上训练事件转移；3) 可见性与关联目标训练物体分支；4) 多源数据 pipeline 将 39.8K 空间查询与互补事件标注组织成计数轨迹；5) 在 SVCBench 上设计前缀回放（Full）与持续流式（Stream）两种评测，并用匹配图对比隔离阶段条件与轨迹监督的作用。
AI.result: 在 SVCBench 上，4B 与 8B 模型在 Full/Stream 设置下分别达到 41.9/36.4 与 44.9/38.2 的 Gaussian Precision Accuracy；8B 模型在相同查询上比 Counting-SFT 提升 10.9/3.2 个点。匹配图对比进一步分离了阶段条件与轨迹监督的贡献，在线视频基准与计数条件决策实验验证了在线理解能力与任务适用性。
AI.conclusion: 显式的状态维护与轨迹级监督能显著提升连续视频计数的准确性与流式适应能力，为在线计数任务提供了可迁移的训练与评测范式。

title: Reliability Engineering for AI Systems: Challenges, Methods, and Directions
summary: AI reliability concerns whether an AI system performs its intended function dependably over a stated period and under stated operating conditions, with stated evidence. As these systems become more autonomous, that function includes more than a correct output. Retrieval, memory, tool use, permissions, human oversight, and interactions among systems must operate consistently and safely, and, for generative systems, so must the reasoning process that produces the output. Average benchmark accuracy measures capability; it does not quantify this broader reliability claim. This paper adapts established reliability engineering methods, from failure definitions and operational envelopes to FMEA, accelerated testing, field monitoring, and reliability growth, to AI systems. A four-level diagnostic framework classifies failures as component, operational-loop, agentic-conduct, or network and governance failures. Test, evaluation, verification, and validation (TEVV), sequential monitoring, and FRACAS create and refresh evidence.
